Not to mention the fact that the three of them often sparred against each other on the road. Without using the crossbow, dealing with Little Cabbage wasn’t actually much easier than dealing with Gu Nian.
This little loli seemed to have a natural fighting instinct, and her learning ability was also very strong. She never made the same mistake twice, and the same trick would never work twice on her.
‘She’s practically a beautiful girl version of Saint Seiya…’ Gu Nan silently commented.
Of course, no matter how powerful the pretty female Saint Seiya was, she still wasn’t his match right now. After all, he was an old hand who had been immersed in virtual reality fighting for many years, and he still carried many tricks.
“The destination is ahead.” They finally arrived after half a month’s journey, and Gu Nian’s mood also seemed to improve. “This is the place people from Langya World use to ascend. All of those ascendants left from here.”
“In that case, the only types of people here are either reincarnators like you or people preparing to ascend?” Gu Nan asked with some excitement and quickly checked his Evil God Temple, but nothing happened.
This made Gu Nan a little disappointed. It was such a messy place, yet the Evil God Temple didn’t issue any events. And throughout the journey this half month, none of the dungeons reset, which puzzled Gu Nan.
Gu Nian nodded. “That’s basically right. There are also some staff recruited from this world… Alright, get in the car.”
“Eh?” Gu Nan and the loli were dumbfounded.
This small town was very remote. They hadn’t seen modern transportation for several days now.
As Gu Nian’s voice fell, a tattered small van drove over. There was no license plate, and its white exterior had the words— “Mingguang Ascension Center, Langya Branch.”
Gu Nan immediately became amused. It turned out that in Star Realm, there were even businesses that took care of all services related to people ascending from lower planes?
“Which one of you is a reincarnator? Confirm your identity.” The van driver asked as he opened the window, revealing the face of a middle-aged man.
“Gu Nian. Federation number 10XXXXXXXXXX28.” Gu Nian expertly reported a bunch of numbers, while the middle-aged man also took out a strange-looking machine and started typing.
Taking advantage of this pause, Gu Nian turned around and explained, “Reincarnators will all retain their original names. This is a way to protect the soul.”
Gu Nan nodded. “What about foreigners?”
“…If you don’t understand the language, you will be reincarnated as someone whose real name sounds similar, or you can change it yourself.” Gu Nian’s face darkened again.
“It seems that you can find reincarnators this way.”
Gu Nian was speechless.
Just then, the middle-aged driver over there also finished checking the information and said, “Gu Nian, a member of the Federation’s Ninth Region, Ruby Fish Star, with two ascendants… The fees have already been paid, please get in the van.”
The three of them climbed into this suspicious van, and Gu Nan found that there were already two people sitting in the van in addition to them.
It was a man and a woman. The man looked like he was in his thirties, but his expression was a little cautious. The woman looked about the same age as Little Cabbage. Contrary to expectations, she was the one who nodded at Gu Nian.
Obviously, she was the reincarnator. She saw the confirmation of Gu Nian’s identity just now, so she took the initiative to greet Gu Nian.
As for Gu Nan and Little Cabbage, she directly ignored them.
Gu Nan felt a little interested and gently rubbed his nose. It was quite normal for people from larger maps to look down on countryside cultivators, but one could see the status of ordinary ascendants from this interaction.
As for the man in his thirties, Gu Nan couldn’t see the slightest fluctuation of internal energy on him. He likely wasn’t a martial artist, nor should he be the same type of ascendant as Gu Nan and the loli.
Gu Nian also gave a light nod in response and didn’t reply. After getting off the van and arriving in town, she casually explained to Gu Nan.
“That woman just now reincarnated to a lower realm to find a boy toy… Compared with Star Realm’s slaves, the lower realm is much more cost-effective.”
Gu Nan suddenly gasped. “Sister, do you still need a boy toy?”

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Challenge Dungeon
chapters.content:
“Eldest Martial Sister, what’s a boy toy?”
“What are you asking, kid?!”
“Oh… Big Brother, what’s a…”
“I’ll tell you if you call me Daddy.”
“…”
Their conversation echoed on the empty street. Gu Nian felt her expression getting darker and darker. Fortunately, they finally arrived at their destination.
The entire town was the so-called “Mingguang Ascension Center,” but ascending to different destinations was carried out inside different areas within the town. Gu Nian brought them to the ascension area of Star Realm’s Ninth Region.
“Enter the ascension ship. Someone will remind you of what to do later. I’ll see you in Star Realm.” After leaving such irresponsible instructions, Gu Nian’s figure quickly disappeared.
Gu Nan and Little Cabbage looked around blankly, only to see two beams of light suddenly falling from the sky, enveloping them completely.
Gu Nan felt a strange force surrounding him, and his whole body started floating upwards, slowly flying towards the ship.
Only in mid-air did he see what the so-called “ascension ship” was.
It was an airship similar to an airship. It was quietly suspended in the air, and the light beam shot from the gap on it.
“What are you thinking about?” The entire process was very slow, so Little Cabbage couldn’t help but wonder curiously when she saw Gu Nan pondering something attentively beside her.
Gu Nan casually invented some crazy nonsense, “I was thinking about the principle behind these light beams.”
“Oh, then you understand them now?”
“I roughly understand. It should be using a suspension force field to offset the gravity, and then the adsorbed particles are mixed into the light beam, resulting in localized low pressure, so the air pressure below will automatically push us up.”
The explanation made Little Cabbage dumbfounded. She exclaimed in surprise, “Y-you’re so amazing… But how come I feel like the suction is coming from above me?”
“Oh, because I made that up.”
“…”
A few moments later, Gu Nan stood on the side of the ascension ship, smiling as he sent away the staff who had transported them onboard, while Bai Luoluo, the little loli, was still standing on the side sulking.
”Hey, what are you doing?”
“I hate people who lie to me the most!”
“That was someone else who reincarnated into my body just now. The one speaking wasn’t me.”
“Do you think I’m a little kid? You…”
“Yes.”
Bam!
The little loli angrily slammed the door closed. The sound echoed, and Gu Nan shrugged helplessly before he walked towards the deck.
There was still some time left before the ascension mechanism activated, so he just casually strolled around.
Of course, more importantly, a burst of noise came from the deck, which immediately aroused Gu Nan’s curious spirit.
Although he couldn’t be a protagonist, Gu Nan still played the role of a spectator very professionally.
Over ten people stood on the deck. Like Gu Nan, most of them belonged to the peanut gallery.
The main characters were two men—one tall and one short—who were currently mocking a young woman.
And between the two sides, there was a young man who looked like a staff member trying to mediate the fight.
“Brother, what happened?” Gu Nan touched the arm of the person next to him and asked curiously.
Gu Nan asked a bald man with a somewhat funny appearance. He had a delighted expression on his face. “Brother is also an ascendant and not a native of the imperial capital, right?”
“No, I’m from Feng City.”
“I knew it. If you were from the imperial capital, you’d definitely know these people!” He said with a smile and continued to explain to Gu Nan.
It wasn’t a very complicated story. A particularly powerful reincarnator organization descended upon the imperial capital to look for some good seedlings to accept as disciples.
Those two, one tall and one short, were the chosen ones.
The tall one was called Luo Miao, and the short one was called Cai Yuanyi. The former was a descendant of an influential family in the imperial capital, while the latter was an ordinary common folk.
It stood to reason that the two should then start fighting and scheming against each other, but that didn’t happen. On one hand, Luo Miao knew how to behave with integrity, and on the other hand… It was because of this woman.
“This woman’s name is Qin Xuanji. She’s the daughter of a small bureaucrat in the imperial capital. Her entire family had just been killed… But do you know what happened after that?”
“What happened?” Gu Nan asked very cooperatively.
The bald guy turned his head to the side and answered in a low voice, “I heard that this Qin Xuanji crawled to that one’s door naked and knelt there all night, so that one finally accepted her!”
Of course, “that one” referred to Luo Miao and Cai Yuanyi’s master.
“Oh!” Gu Nan had a sudden realization, and he exchanged a grin with the bald guy. Both their faces showed a grin that only men would understand.
But Gu Nan’s heart was extremely calm, because the moment he saw this Qin Xuanji, he faintly felt a thorn on his back, as if he was facing an ancient monster.
‘There’s something wrong with this woman…’ Gu Nan made such a judgment in his heart.
As if to verify his conjecture, the Evil God Temple in his mind suddenly shook gently, and a line of small words appeared.
｢A new dungeon has been detected——Challenge Dungeon: Qin Xuanji. Accept?｣
>｢Accept｣ Gu Nan subconsciously chose accept and immediately came back to his senses.
‘It’s actually a challenge dungeon!’
The dungeon system in 《Evil God Cultivation》was actually quite complicated. The ones that Gu Nan cleared before were all mission dungeons, which were normally divided into three categories based on size: small, intermediate, and large. These could be entered repeatedly, but they would disappear once they were cleared.
In other words, the core of the mission dungeon was the mission itself. After completing the mission and receiving the rewards, the dungeon can no longer be entered again.
Yet challenge dungeons were different. They were especially designed for combat-oriented players. The goal of the dungeon was to defeat the challenge target, and even after winning, the player could still continue to challenge the target.
However, challenge dungeons had a time limit. For example, the current one Gu Nan had was only open for one day.
‘Not even Gu Nian could trigger a challenge dungeon, but this woman actually could?’ Gu Nan frowned slightly and pondered in his heart.
The challenge dungeon was generated by selecting a “challenging” target based on the player’s experience.
‘If the Evil God Temple also follows this logic… Does that mean Qin Xuanji is stronger than Gu Nian?’
Without another word, Gu Nan promptly chose to enter the dungeon. In any case, time in the outside world would be completely still relative to the dungeon. It would only take an instant for him to enter and leave.
The challenge dungeon was no different from the game in Gu Nan’s previous life. It was still located in a spacious and empty arena.
When Gu Nan entered, Qin Xuanji was already standing on the other side of the arena.
The instant Gu Nan’s figure appeared, she rushed forward like lightning and directly threw a punch at Gu Nan’s face!
‘So fast!’
Gu Nan also reacted exceptionally quickly. He immediately turned his face to the side; her petite and hard fist practically brushed past his face, and the wind from the punchmade his hair stand on end.
‘It would’ve been bad if her hands were slightly larger…’
Although he was silently rejoicing in his heart, his movements weren’t slow. Gu Nan quickly kicked his leg out and precisely swept it towards the opponent.
Gu Nan was highly confident with this kick. He knew that the so-called martial artists in this world valued martial arts but not combat or wrestling skills. They weren’t used to adapting to minute changes like these.
However, he didn’t expect Qin Xuanji’s reaction to be so fast. She supported her abdomen with one hand, her legs slightly bent, as Gu Nan’s kick connected with her abdomen. Her whole body flew out, yet she landed steadily on the ground.
‘I’ve encountered a tricky opponent.’
Gu Nan looked at Qin Xuanji in the distance and felt his heart sink slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Information on Star Realm
chapters.content:
Two silhouettes rapidly crisscrossed on the challenge dungeon’s arena, colliding fiercely one moment and pulling away from each other the next moment.
Gu Nan already felt a bit of sweat drip down his face, which was a rare occurrence ever since he advanced to Tier 2—not even those dozen or so Innate Realm experts affected him this much.
He and this woman named Qin Xuanji fought wildly for over two hundred rounds in a short period of time, yet they failed to land fatal injuries on each other.
Of course, Gu Nan’s advantages had begun to appear.
The strong Evil God physique made him equivalent to a humanoid beast—full of physical strength and extreme defensive power.
If Gu Nan was only a little short of breath, then Qin Xuanji was full-on gasping for air. Her stamina was much inferior to Gu Nan’s, and it didn’t help now that she had multiple injuries.
A punch landed on her face, bruising her left eye. Redness and swelling could be seen all over her body.
‘Her physical strength and defensive power have already exceeded that of ordinary martial artists, plus she can actually keep up with my speed…’ Gu Nan thought to himself. Her speed was the most confusing part.
He was an agility type Evil God!
Qin Xuanji didn’t have any internal energy in her body, and it didn’t seem like she advanced to the Innate Realm using external kung fu… Could she be a monster that transformed into a human?
Gu Nan immediately thought of the possibility of her being a mixed race.
“Courting death.” On the other side, the dungeon’s simulated Qin Xuanji coldly spat out these words, then stopped her movements.
Clearly, she was about to unleash a major attack, but Gu Nan didn’t move. Instead, he watched with great interest—in any case, he was inside the dungeon, so he could still revive after dying. It was more important to analyze the enemy’s secret skills.
The next instant, Gu Nan suddenly felt the sky darken, and everything turned black.
｢You’ve died｣
The prompt came from the Evil God Temple, and Gu Nan was kicked out of the dungeon and returned to the main hall.
“F**k, what the hell is this!” Gu Nan, who didn’t believe it, entered the dungeon once again. He beat Qin Xuanji half to death again, but the result was no different.
‘Why the hell did the sky turn black? Did her skill take up the entire screen? What, did she steal the sky and switch out the sun?’
Despite his complaints, Gu Nan entered the dungeon again… By the twelfth time, only after Gu Nan withdrew a few hundred meters in advance did he finally see the truth.
Qin Xuanji’s ultimate move was actually… transformation! No, head changing!
Her body did not move. It was her head that suddenly turned into a huge snake’s head. Opening her oversized mouth, she swallowed Gu Nan in one bite!
The darkness Gu Nan experienced earlier was precisely because the huge snake head blocked even the sky.
After dozens of consecutive failures, Gu Nan finally gave up on meaningless attempts to fight the transformation. The snake head approached too fast and the attack range was too wide. He couldn’t avoid it at all.
But when he stopped sitting on the sidelines, he started winning—the “head changing technique” was indeed powerful, but all he had to do was to prevent her from using it.
When Gu Nan relied on his superior physical strength to beat his exhausted opponent to death, his smile was particularly satisfied.
+
｢The challenge dungeon has been cleared. Obtained 10 points as reward｣
｢The challenge dungeon has been cleared. Obtained 9 points as reward｣
｢The challenge dungeon has been cleared. Obtained 9 points as reward｣
｢The challenge dungeon has been cleared. Obtained 8 points as reward｣
. . .
｢The challenge dungeon has been cleared. Obtained 1 point as reward｣
+
Challenge dungeons were a good place to harvest points, but after continuous wins, the amount of points obtained would gradually decrease. After about 30 victories, Gu Nan basically stopped earning points.
However, he also gained over 200 points from this, which made his total points reach 236 points, so he earned back the money used to buy the Four Element Crossbow.
There were only a few hours left for the dungeon, and Gu Nan was not idle at all. He switched up his methods to test Qin Xuanji’s trump cards.
By exploring the attack range, buildup time, usage limit, and even cooldown time of the “head changing technique,” he finally discovered some of Qin Xuanji’s weaknesses.
For example, the “head changing technique” couldn’t be used at will. It only appeared when Qin Xuanji became emotional. Another example was that the snake head couldn’t extend indefinitely; it could only move with Qin Xuanji herself…
In the last battle between Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji, he even pulled out the Four Element Crossbow. By using the kite tactic all the way, he forced her to use the “head changing technique” twice in a row, but in the end, the snake head still bit him to death because space inside the challenge dungeon was limited.
“Forget it… At least I know that although this skill has no cooldown, it consumes a lot of energy.” Gu Nan was still muttering this even as he left the dungeon and returned to reality.
The bald man next to him was still watching the show with excitement. He didn’t know that the person beside him had already fought Qin Xuanji all night.
Gu Nan took a closer look at the so-called dispute. It was mainly Luo Miao and Cai Yuanyi ridiculing her, while Qin Xuanji was standing to the side and staring quietly towards a certain direction.
‘Is she thinking about her hometown?’ Gu Nan went around to the left and looked at the girl’s profile as he wondered what she was thinking.
‘It doesn’t look like she sold her body to win over an expert, so… Did the expert become interested in her strange ability?’
While Gu Nan was madly imagining her backstory, Qin Xuanji seemed to have seen enough and suddenly turned to walk towards the crowd.
“Hey, you. Stop…”
“Get lost.”
Qin Xuanji’s voice was slightly low, and her hand movements were vigorous and powerful.
She suddenly waved her hand and directly slapped Luo Miao’s face. Student Luo, who was caught off guard, was sent flying.
Hiss!
The crowd that was still noisy a second ago gasped in unison, shocked speechless by Qin Xuanji’s slap.
Even Gu Nan was taken aback. He didn’t expect this little girl to have such a violent temper…
Gu Nan, who was fully aware of her strength, knew that Luo Miao’s face would be swollen for at least three days.
Cai Yuanyi’s eyes widened as he pointed to Qin Xuanji speechlessly. He never could’ve imagined that a b***h who relied on her body to please his master would have such power…
Gu Nan hid in the depths of the crowd, not looking at Qin Xuanji’s figure. Like many others, he quietly retreated.
After watching the show and earning his points, he scurried off.
He was just a little curious about this mysterious woman, but he didn’t want to provoke her.
– – – – – –
Not long after returning to his room, a reminder blasted out of the speakers.
“The ship will leave in half an hour. All ascendants, please stay in your rooms and do not go out.”
The ship’s purpose was to shuttle between two worlds. Once it started its journey, even the strong winds from passing through the atmosphere could kill people. Of course, no one dared to go out and seek death right now.
The “ascension” would last about two days. Mingguang Ascension Center’s arrangements were very user-friendly. It provided each ascendant with a large amount of information about Star Realm.
For everyone who wants to ascend to Star Realm, this information is exactly what they urgently need.
The reincarnators who brought them may not be willing to explain some general knowledge stuff, and even if they did explain, it might not be as clear and detailed as the provided information.
Gu Nan started to read with keen interest.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: The Half-Hidden Truth
chapters.content:
Star Realm was one of the 72 Realms in the overworld. Its vast territory greatly exceeded the imagination of rural bumpkins like Gu Nan.
As a realm governed by a federation, Star Realm’s Thirteen Regions formed an enormous federation, which ruled over a diverse population numbering tens of billions of people.
Gu Nan planned to head off to Ruby Fish Star, the main star of the Ninth Region. The soaring ship would drop him off in passing, and the local reception center would receive him.
In addition, there was a lot of other data about Star Realm. Gu Nan could only select the more important ones to examine.
The most important information was, of course, two aspects: one was information related to Ruby Fish Star, and the other was about Star Realm’s power ranking system.
Different from the Langya World where he transmigrated into before, Star Realm had an unimaginable level of scientific and technological achievements, yet it wasn’t a society ruled by science and technology. Instead, it focused on‒
“In XX Continent, the strong reigned supreme…” Oh, got off track there.
Star Realm’s entire population practiced martial arts. Martial arts cultivators were divided into five realms according to their levels: Acquired, Innate, Prodigious, Void Cutter, and Star Ruler. Each realm could be divided into several small stages.
“My current level of strength is probably… Innate Realm Third Stage?”
Cultivators’ realms would usually be determined by the quality of their internal energy, but Gu Nan didn’t have any internal energy, so he had to roughly evaluate his level according to his explosive force.
The Innate Realm had only six stages in total. He was already considered mid-tier, which wasn’t bad.
Time slipped away bit by bit while Gu Nan was reading. He eventually fell asleep but was suddenly startled awake when the entire resting room shook violently.
He turned to look out the window and saw colorful, dazzling, and brilliant lights rapidly flowing by‒ the ascending ship seemed to be traveling through the legendary wormhole.
It’s just that… the corners of Gu Nan’s mouth twitched slightly, strange ideas popping up in his brain.
“Why does it resemble some third-rate domestic cartoon?”
While Gu Nan was admiring this strange scenery, the Evil God Temple in his head suddenly shook, and a line of unprecedented words appeared.
｢Detecting that the player’s main body has arrived at another large-scale dungeon space. Set as second base?｣
Gu Nan stared blankly in shock.
Another large-scale dungeon space… is it talking about Star Realm?
According to the time and the scenery outside the window, they should be crossing the gap between the two worlds and arriving at the outermost periphery of Star Realm right now..
If Star Realm is “another large-scale dungeon space,” then doesn’t it mean that… the things I experienced before were also dungeons? Is the so-called overworld made up entirely of dungeons?
Gu Nan suddenly felt his hair stand on end, as if there was a layer of invisible fog hanging over everyone’s eyes, but he accidentally caught a glimpse of the truth because of the Evil God Temple.
After subconsciously choosing ｢Yes｣, Gu Nan slowly calmed down.
It was still too early to make a conspiracy theory judgment based on one sentence from the Evil God Temple.
It’s a fact that dungeons will reset every time I enter one, which is true for all the dungeons I experienced so far. And the Evil God Temple’s judgment may not necessarily be correct, and it may also not be the same as my own understanding. Perhaps it just recognizes all planes as dungeons by default…
[Esteemed guests, the ship will soon reach your destination: Ninth Region, Ruby Fish Star. Please stand by at the reception area.]
Without giving Gu Nan too much time to think, the broadcast reminder came again, and a circle lit up in the room, highlighting the so-called reception area.
Gu Nan didn’t think much. He went straight to the circle and was led away from the ship by the beam of light.
But at the next second, he sensed that something was wrong.
He, who should have left together with the little loli, Bai Luoluo, actually had a different woman beside him‒ Qin Xuanji!
Gu Nan suddenly felt his consciousness blur…
– – – – – –
“Fourth Bro, who are these two little fellows? They’re merely two Innate Realm weaklings, yet we actually have to use five Prodigious Realm cultivators to snatch them away…”
“One is because of a mission from the West‒ she’s most likely a bloodline user. The other is the rebirth karma of the Gu family’s girl… so we can’t kill these two. We can’t afford to offend the West or the Gu family. Once we become directly involved in this karma, the consequences will be unpredictable.”
“Then what should we do?”
“Just leave them in Radiant Tower. It’s best if they die, and even if they don’t, it’ll still take several years for them to leave, so they won’t be able to find us.”
In a daze, Gu Nan’s consciousness gradually woke up. He vaguely heard their words, but his mind was still exhausted and was soon enveloped by deep darkness again.
When he truly woke up later on, he found himself in a small room with two beds. Qin Xuanji was lying on the adjacent bed.
The words he heard when in his daze clearly emerged in Gu Nan’s mind at this time. He knew very well that because his physique was far superior to that of ordinary people, he didn’t enter a deep coma.
“Those people probably didn’t expect that I would wake up early because of my overly strong physique… Did they attack me because of Gu Nian?”
Gu Nan sat up and pondered quietly.
“I wonder if anything happened to the little loli, but I shouldn’t think too much about that, not when I’m powerless to even defend myself right now.”
Gu Nan began to look around. It was quite simple, crude, and old-fashioned, but traces of modern civilization could still be seen, indicating that it wasn’t too far away from Ruby Fish Star and might even be on Ruby Fish Star itself.
“What would the Radiant Tower be?”
Gu Nan took these questions with him as he got up and opened the door. The outside was simply empty grassland, not a single figure could be seen.
A slight sound came from behind him. Gu Nan didn’t even need to think as he turned and swept a punch out. Suddenly, a muffled grunt came‒ the sound of Qin Xuanji being thrown into the air.
Gu Nan smiled silently. He had fought her hundreds of times in the challenge dungeon and was exceedingly familiar with the details of his opponent’s fighting style. How could a sneak attack succeed?
But now was not the time for infighting.
“Don’t be so quick to attack. I was also brought in from the ship, remember?”
Qin Xuanji stood up with an indifferent expression. Her cold personality didn’t mean that she was stupid. After being reminded by Gu Nan, she immediately recalled their situation.
Gu Nan didn’t know how much she knew of the situation, but it was probably impossible for her to tell him any information.
Just when the two were standing in silence, a line of small text suddenly emerged from the ceiling and quickly flashed with light.
[Entering Radiant Tower’s assessment plane after two breaths: two challengers, please prepare yourselves.]
Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji exchanged a glance, frowning in unison. It was a very bland sentence, but they understood the core information‒ the two of them had to go to a special plane to complete the challenge.
What challenge? Is it assessing combat power or other abilities? Are the two of them working together or against each other?
Gu Nan had even more thoughts. A ‘breath’ was the standard unit of time in Star Realm, or the amount of time it took for an ordinary person to take a breath. One breath was equivalent to about 15 seconds.
Sure enough, I’m already in Star Realm. His expression remained unchanged, but his heart made a judgment.
Two breaths passed quickly, and Gu Nan felt his vision go dark. When he regained his sight, he was already in a completely different environment, and only Qin Xuanji still stood beside him.
At that moment, another incomprehensible notice from the Evil God Temple appeared.
｢External mission detected. Incorporate into current mission sequence?｣

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Courting Death
chapters.content:
｢Yes｣
｢Incorporating external mission… Processing data… New mission has been generated. Please check the mission list.｣
Gu Nan could guarantee that there was absolutely no such prompt in the game from his past life since external missions also didn’t exist. The only possibility was this ongoing “assessment” in reality.
When he opened the mission list, the shocking content appeared:
+
｢Mission Objective: Kill Han Yueren
Mission Time Limit: One hour
Mission Reward: Medium｣
+
Dungeon missions issued by the Evil God Temple would never inform the player of the reward in advance. Instead, the rewards would be issued based on the actual completion rate. Thus, the player wouldn’t be informed of the scale of the reward.
A medium mission reward meant that this was an intermediate task dungeon… but how could an intermediate mission be so simple?
Gu Nan quickly examined his surroundings. This was a dungeon that had an ancient style. The people’s clothes around him were clearly in an old style.
An ancient setting often meant that the level of science and technology was insufficient, which meant that the security would not be strict enough. An assassination mission like this was far easier here than in a high-tech world.
Gu Nan hadn’t received a single intermediate mission ever since he transmigrated into this world.
According to the pattern in his past life, intermediate dungeons were not easy to complete. Normally, it would take at least a month or two.
But now, the time limit was actually an hour?
The slow prompt from Radiant Tower only arrived right then. A slightly cold female voice was directly transmitted into Gu Nan’s ears.
[Please kill the Commander of the Imperial Guards, Han Yueren, within an hour.]
“Han Yueren?” Qin Xuanji clearly also heard the voice and turned to whisper.
Gu Nan gently nodded to confirm. Then he paused and looked around with some deep thinking. A slightly mocking smile hung on his lips.
……
In a clean white room, a man and a woman were looking at the big screen. The picture inside was precisely Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji.
“Old Zhang, what do you think that boy is laughing at?” The woman looked at Gu Nan’s action and casually asked. Judging from her voice, she was the person who sent the message to Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji.
In fact, Old Zhang wasn’t old at all. He was a tall and elegant man. He laughed while answering, “He can’t be laughing at us… He’s most likely laughing at the mission’s low difficulty. He looks experienced.”
These two had completed countless assassination missions. They naturally understood that this environment was full of flaws. If the challenger was experienced, it would be easy to find an opening.
“Our branch finally gained two newcomers after much difficulty. Of course we had to choose an easy assessment…” The woman picked up an apple and chewed it while muttering.
“I hope they can pass… If they underestimate Radiant Tower’s missions just because we went easy on them, their deaths won’t be pretty.”
……
To be honest, the mission to assassinate Han Yueren wasn’t hard. At least for a pro player like Gu Nan, it couldn’t even be counted as a small-scale mission in the game.
“There’s no skill involved at all…”
Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji quickly hid themselves near the Imperial Guard Commander, Han Yueren — don’t ask why it was so easy. After all, four large characters with “Imperial Guard Han Residence” hung right above the gate.
“They even wrote ‘Imperial Guard’ on it. They’re clearly giving away free points!” Gu Nan complained that the mission was too easy while grinning from ear to ear because of the free reward.
“Keep your voice down!” Qin Xuanji saw Gu Nan giggling beside her and couldn’t help berating him in a low voice.
Unlike the sloppy Student Gu, Qin Xuanji was the kind of person who took everything very seriously. Only she herself knew just how much she’d suffered for the sake of obtaining this identity as a bloodline user. If she was even slightly careless, she might have died during the process.
Gu Nan pouted dully, feeling like he’s on a mission with an NPC.
However, according to the game’s usual routine, whenever an NPC assisted the player, the NPC often withdrew from the battle for some inexplicable reason, so the player still needed to complete the battle alone.
“But this is reality. There shouldn’t be silly nonsense like that…”
However, in the next moment, Qin Xuanji suddenly uttered, “Go.” Her figure immediately disappeared, rushing straight towards Han Yueren ahead.
Only then did Gu Nan see that somehow, Han Yueren was alone right now. Only a few crooked guards remained around him, but there were no personal bodyguards.
“Hey!” Gu Nan cursed secretly, just now finding out that from the beginning, this woman had no intention of cooperating. Perhaps, in her opinion, if she can complete the task by herself, then why carry an extra burden?
Even if Gu Nan didn’t originally plan to attack right now, at this time, he also had to… Yeah forget it, I’m not attacking.
After thinking about it, Student Gu Nan returned to squatting in his hiding spot.
The two people in the white room simultaneously covered their faces the instant Qin Xuanji launched her rash attack. It seemed that they couldn’t bear to watch the following scene.
Han Yueren was a beardless young man. He looked very refined and gentle, the complete opposite of such an awe-inspiring title like “Commander of the Imperial Guards.”
Perhaps because she was also fooled by his appearance, when Qin Xuanji suddenly appeared, he was first slightly stunned, then made an unexpected response.
Han Yueren showed an expression that looked like he didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. He leisurely took a step back and easily blocked Qin Xuanji’s fist.
Only then did the girl realize that the situation wasn’t good. She also realized that she had been fooled by the mission’s difficulty level and had ignored the most important thing: the strength of the assassination target himself!
“A mere Martial King dares to assassinate me? Could it be that the name ‘Han Yueren’ no longer means anything in the martial arts community?”
While speaking words of disdain, Han Yueren lifted his foot very quickly, kicking Qin Xuanji’s lower abdomen. The latter gave a muffled grunt, and her body flew out involuntarily.
“At least the Innate Realm Sixth Stage, or he may even be in the Prodigious Realm… Sure enough, NPCs will all court death and gift the tower[1] as soon as they act.” Gu Nan hid in the dark as he watched Qin Xuanji be taken away.
He had no intention of attacking at all. He wasn’t much better than Qin Xuanji in terms of a frontal assault, even though his endurance and speed were slightly better. He was still no match for Han Yueren.
“Oh? This little fellow actually didn’t attack?”
“It’s useless. Han Yueren is at the peak of their so-called Martial King Realm — that is, Innate Realm Sixth Stage. This boy can’t hide his aura from Han Yueren… It seems that when we removed all external obstructions, we actually caused them to underestimate the enemy instead.”
Old Zhang was a little annoyed. If they missed these two, he didn’t know when they could get fresh blood into the branch organization anymore.
As if to confirm Old Zhang’s words, after Han Yueren had Qin Xuanji taken away, he stood with rapt attention for a while and suddenly shouted, “Come out! Just how long are you planning to hide?”
The breeze was still, and the waves were quiet. No one responded to him.
Gu Nan’s mouth curled. Does he take me to be Qin Xuanji? That mental woman who’s so easily fooled?
Han Yueren had a sneer on his face. It’s true that he can’t grasp the other party’s specific location, but this is inside his Han Residence…
“Guards, search this place inch by inch!”
Gu Nan couldn’t sit still anymore. His figure suddenly darted out. At the same time, he loudly shouted, “Han Yueren, do you think we’re really here to assassinate you?
“To tell you the truth, this is merely a stalling tactic! Now our plan in the palace has already succeeded, hahahaha…”
Han Yueren’s expression changed wildly, and he flew into a rage. “You thieving b*****d, how dare you attack the Third Prince!”
“Third Prince… Huh?” Gu Nan murmured in a low voice as he took advantage of the other party’s pause, his figure rapidly fleeing.
Notes
[1]: Gifting the tower refers to when a player dies by the hand of the enemy’s defensive tower in a MOBA game, thus gifting their life to the tower. Basically courting death in this context.

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Strongest Kite Weapon in the Novice Period
chapters.content:
Han Yueren hurried to the palace and found the Third Prince safe and sound. Only then did he realize that he had fallen into a trap.
This couldn’t be blamed on his lack of caution. With the current situation in the palace, it was no secret at all that he and the Third Prince were allies. He never imagined that the other party was actually trying to extract this piece of information.
“Master Han, Master Han! This isn’t good…”
“What’s the matter now?”
Han Yueren was in a very bad mood. He had encountered an assassin for no cause and no reason. The other party even tricked him into entering the palace before he had a chance to interrogate the other assassin… He still didn’t know what exactly his enemy’s objective was.
One of his family’s servants ran to report to him in a frightful panic, “Master Han, Youngest Master, he… he was hit by an arrow through his solar plexus(1) and is currently unconscious. Master, please hurry home!”
“What?!”
“Damned assassin!” Han Yueren was instantly shocked and infuriated. He could guarantee that it was the same assassin from before as it would be too much of a coincidence otherwise!
As the saying goes: “Family is off limits and free from retaliation,” but these assassins with no heart actually laid hands on his youngest son!
Han Yueren rushed home as fast as he could, but what he saw was a scene that almost tore him apart — his seventy-year-old mother was holding his six-year-old son Han Hao in her arms as she cried bitterly.
“Hao’er!”
Han Yueren cried out in grief and hurriedly rushed to the front. Indeed, he saw a crossbow arrow that pierced straight through Han Hao’s solar plexus[1], nearly completely sinking into his chest.
The two doctors beside him who rushed here could only give a light sigh and said, “Master Han… our condolences!”
In fact, there was no need for the doctors to say anything. It was also clear from Han Yueren’s years of combat experience that nine times out of ten, not even adults would be able to survive this type of arrow wound, let alone a six-year-old child.
But…
“Just who could do such a vicious thing? I, Han Yueren, will definitely tear you into ten thousand pieces!”
As Han Yueren knelt down in the hall and roared in rage, a bland voice rang out—
“Don’t you know who did it, Master Han?”
Han Yueren suddenly turned and saw the assassin who had previously escaped standing cheerfully in the courtyard outside the hall, with a crossbow in his left hand and a boy’s neck in his right hand.
That boy happened to be Han Yueren’s other son, Han Bang, Han Hao’s older brother, who was only eight years old!
“You! Despicable! Scumbag!” Han Yueren gnashed his teeth so hard he almost shattered them. If looks could kill… Well, the scene would probably be quite terrifying.
It’s a pity that Gu Nan was completely unmoved. With his arm around Han Bang’s neck, he looked at the people in the hall with a sneer.
With Han Yueren’s eyes fixed on Gu Nan with a death glare, he walked out of the hall and coldly said, “Let my son go. Whatever objective you have, you can come at me. Why do you want to hurt innocent people?!”
“Hurt innocent people?” Gu Nan couldn’t help laughing heartily, but then his expression quickly turned cold. “I want to kill your entire family, so how can this be considered hurting innocent people?”
“Don’t!” Upon hearing these words, Han Yueren seemed to understand something and hurriedly screamed aloud.
However, Gu Nan moved even faster. He lifted little Han Bang’s collar with one hand and threw him into the air while raising his left hand, aiming the Four Element Crossbow[2] at the young body.
“Fire!”
The four colors around the Four Element Crossbow flashed red. A fiery red arrow shot out, hitting little Han Bang in midair!
Boom!
A violent explosion rang out. It was accompanied by flying pieces of flesh and mutilated body parts, which fell all over the yard and immediately flooded the nice mansion with the smell of blood.
There was silence in the courtyard. No one made a sound until the bloody mist slowly fell to the ground.
Two faces could be seen.
Gu Nan’s smiling face, which was still calm and indifferent, and Han Yueren’s completely twisted face.
“I’ll kill you!!!”
Han Yueren roared with rage, crossing the courtyard at the fastest speed in his entire life, and rushed towards Gu Nan. If the latter paused for even an instant, he would be torn to pieces immediately.
But Gu Nan was already prepared. He had aimed the Four Element Crossbow at the ground early on and shot another arrow.
“Wind!”
A teal light shone, and the wind arrow hit the ground. The huge recoil directly pushed Gu Nan off the ground, which allowed him to just barely avoid Han Yueren’s fatal blow.
Han Yueren had just looked back when six consecutive teal arrows flew over, but Han Yueren, whose head had been overwhelmed with fury, no longer had any rationality left, so he rushed forward without hesitation.
The arrows tore through Han Yueren’s skin, but they couldn’t penetrate deeply and were stuck inside his muscles.
“Ahhhhhhhh!!!” The pain made him roar in anger, becoming more and more like a madman.
Gu Nan was currently in a strange state — he was on the roof!
After firing six consecutive arrows, he had used the recoil to push himself to the top of the three-story Han residence nearly 20 meters high and looked down with a cold smile.
The reason he chose the Four Element Crossbow instead of other weapons finally became clear.
As a powerful weapon that could provide arrows made of the four elements: earth, water, wind, and fire, the Four Element Crossbow had some shortcomings, but a true veteran player could bring out previously unimagined results!
The recoil, which was originally a shortcoming of the wind arrow, had formed a unique skill after being developed by the players: scaling walls with wind arrows!
Using the wind arrow’s reverse thrust, players could send themselves into the air and even climb up the roof, breaking through some otherwise-unscalable terrains.
As a top player, this skill was naturally a walk in the park for Gu Nan.
But this didn’t mean that Gu Nan was safe now. Although Innate Realm martial artists couldn’t fly, it wasn’t difficult to jump 20 meters. Han Yueren could still attack him.
“You have nowhere to run!” Han Yueren leaped up, propelling his body straight up dozens of meters and slamming down heavily onto the roof.
If the site of the battle wasn’t in his home, in his present mood, he probably would’ve directly smashed everything in the way.
“Earth!”
Gu Nan’s calm voice rang through the courtyard. The dirt-yellow bolt shot into the earth. A massive stone pillar drilled out of the ground and just happened to hit Han Yueren.
Even with Han Yueren’s physique, this kind of “stone column smashing his face” almost made him cry out in pain, but hatred still dominated him and made him ignore the pain.
A calm smile still hung on Gu Nan’s face. He slowly retreated and once again used the wind arrow to reach another roof, widening the distance between himself and Han Yueren yet again.
It was hard for ordinary people to imagine the extent to which a top player could bring out the power of the Four Element Crossbow.
The three characteristics of long-range attack, flight, and changing terrain constituted the strongest kite[3] weapon in the novice period. This was also the reason Gu Nan dared to challenge Han Yueren like this.
“Fire!”
Another explosive arrow shot out with precision, which perfectly hit the other side of Student Han Yueren’s face, blowing up his hair into a charcoal mess.
This wasn’t a fatal injury, but it was particularly irritating. Han Yueren, who was already in a state of extreme rage, went mad and crazily rushed towards Gu Nan.
These events were perfectly captured by the small room’s screen.
“Has this boy gone crazy? Even if he can last for a while with the crossbow, it’s still impossible for him to be a match for the target!”
Notes
[1]: a complex system of radiating nerves and ganglia
[2]: “Four-Yuan Hand Crossbow” has been changed to “Four Element Crossbow”
[3]: Kite: game strategy where the player continuously backs away from enemies, keeping at a safe distance, while simultaneously using ranged attacks

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Radiant Tower
chapters.content:
Among all the missions, the assessment mission to [Assassinate Han Yueren] could only be regarded as one with moderate difficulty. Although Han Yueren was powerful, they had also arranged many of his weaknesses into the mission.
Some of these weaknesses were in the Han residence, some were in the Imperial Guard barracks, and there was even one in the imperial palace.
The real difficulty of this mission lay in whether they could find enough weaknesses within the time limit to greatly weaken Han Yueren’s strength so that they could then face him head-on.
Originally, the two people calculated that with Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji’s strength, they could successfully complete the mission as long as they found even a single weakness.
But who would’ve known that Qin Xuanji would get herself trapped right from the start because she was too honest and frank?
And who would’ve thought that Gu Nan’s behavior would be so unexpected…
“Does he want to kill Han Yueren by himself with these methods?” The woman named Tang Xuan couldn’t help but sneer. The gap between Innate Realm Third Stage and Innate Realm Sixth Stage was not so easy to bridge.
She was very clear that even if Gu Nan shot ten arrows, perhaps not even a single arrow would be able to touch his opponent, so what’s the point of that?
Old Zhang beside her touched his chin and said, “Actually, it’s not like his chances are zero… I’m afraid this was exactly his intention when he deliberately angered Han Yueren earlier.”
“What intention?”
“Flying a kite.”
……
Kite tactics had never been a new term, but few could actually use it in reality because the conditions for achieving it were quite harsh.
But Gu Nan did it.
He angered the other party with the blood of Han Yueren’s two sons, achieved far superior mobility with the Four Element Crossbow, then took away Han Yueren’s vitality one arrow at a time.
The seconds ticked by, gradually approaching the mission’s time limit, but no trace of anxiety could be seen on Gu Nan’s face.
Han Yueren felt his body become more and more tired.
One of his eyes had been shot blind, and there was a mess of black marks on his right knee — besides vital points, Gu Nan’s arrows almost always went towards the knees.
An arrow to the knee was not only a meme, but it also greatly affected mobility. Han Yueren began to realize that the situation was changing.
Before, he chased his opponent all over the world, but now, the other party would even come forward to attack from time to time, not giving him any time to rest…
Am I really going to die here?
Han Yueren also thought about running away, but the target of his blood feud was right in front of him, and his aging mother, relatives, and friends at home were all behind him. How could he run away?
His escape would mean the death of his entire family. What’s the use of escaping with just his own life?
Standing among the broken walls of the ruined house, Han Yueren suddenly felt that although the world was so massive, there was no place for him inside it.
Swish!
Another fire arrow shot forth fiercely and slammed hard into his chest. A terrifying explosion followed, blasting him into the air.
This was the first time that Han Yueren failed to avoid the arrow and suffered a direct hit.
Gu Nan instantly became focused. Quantitative change gave rise to qualitative change, and he knew that this critical point had finally arrived.
Even if ten arrows couldn’t hit the opponent, what would happen after one hundred arrows, two hundred arrows?
Humans would always become exhausted sooner or later, especially in the case of extreme emotional fluctuations, where stamina would be consumed particularly quickly. On the other hand, Gu Nan’s actions were completely dependent on his crossbow, so he still maintained abundant physical strength and stamina.
The scales of victory were slowly tilting towards him.
In the small room, this arrow also became a turning point. Under Tang Xuan’s astonished gaze, the situation reversed itself to overwhelmingly favor Gu Nan.
Gu Nan didn’t give his opponent a chance at all, appearing particularly aggressive. He shot 22 arrows in a row, all of which hit their target and directly blasted Han Yueren into a sieve.
Only then did Old Zhang sigh, but his face showed a happy smile. “This little fellow is not bad. He’s a good seedling… Bring them back.”
Tang Xuan nodded numbly, turning on the device used to guide the members back. However, after a flash of white light, only Qin Xuanji appeared.
The three of them just stared at each other with wide eyes.
Both sides had confused expressions.
Why haven’t Gu Nan been brought back?
｢The dungeon’s main mission has been completed. Return immediately?｣
The familiar prompt rang in his ears. Gu Nan casually clicked ｢No｣, then continued his great cause of slaughtering everyone alive.
In the small room, events inside the dungeon played out on-screen. Gu Nan dove into the Han residence like a sharp arrow, crazily shooting the rest of the Han family members.
From Han Yueren’s 70-year-old mother to the little white dog raised by the outer courtyard’s maid, no living being escaped the massacre.
It wasn’t until a river of blood flowed through the entire Han residence and nothing alive remained that Gu Nan finally submitted the mission leisurely.
+
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed:
Main Mission Evaluation: C
Side Story Development: D
Map Exploration: C
Evil Value: B
Comprehensive Evaluation: C+｣
+
｢Accumulated evil points: 100 points
Accumulated Guilt Points: 10 points｣
+
｢Return immediately｣
The next moment, Gu Nan’s figure appeared inside the small room. He looked calm, but his mood wasn’t calm at all.
The evaluation was clearly only C+, and the mission also didn’t have a high difficulty, yet the evil points and Guilt Points were far beyond the normal situation, so there was only one possibility…
It’s because this was an intermediate dungeon mission!
100 evil points and 10 Guilt Points were the minimum rewards for intermediate missions. No matter how low the difficulty was, the reward wouldn’t be any lower than this.
The logic in Gu Nan’s mind gradually became clear — the Evil God game regarded the various planes in this world as dungeon spaces, but there was one problem. The game judged the mission rank based on mission difficulty, yet mission difficulty in this world depended on the level and size of the plane.
In other words, as long as it was in a medium-sized plane, no matter the mission difficulty, it would always be an intermediate reward!
Gu Nan seemed to see a new way to get rich…
Just as Gu Nan was smiling like a fool as he stared at his 26 Guilt Points, Old Zhang, Tang Xuan, and Qin Xuanji were also staring at him with slightly strange expressions.
Old Zhang didn’t suspect anything from Gu Nan’s delayed return. After all, this wasn’t the first time that something went wrong with the equipment, but Gu Nan’s behavior after completing the mission…
“Cough!” Old Zhang coughed dryly and said, “Since the two of you have passed the assessment, we’re a family now. Let’s get to know each other. Welcome to Radiant Tower.”
“Zhang Dongsheng, you can call me Old Zhang.”
“Tang Xuan… To be exact, this is Radiant Tower’s branch office on Ruby Fish Star’s sixth asteroid belt.”
Old Zhang gave her a helpless look. He wanted to say something but in the end, didn’t say it. He then introduced the two newcomers to Radiant Tower’s situation — they already knew about Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji’s information.
With Old Zhang’s explanation, Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji gradually realized what kind of environment they were in.
Radiant Tower was a giant organization that spanned the entire Star Realm and could even influence several adjacent realms. It was a super organization capable of carrying out missions in other worlds.
According to Gu Nan’s understanding, this was a super-large mercenary organization specialized in accepting plane-level missions and used rebirth as their primary means of completing such missions.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Do you wipe your ass when you use the restroom?
chapters.content:
In a sense, both Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji were smart people, so neither of them yelled silly things like “I will not join your organization of unknown origin!” or “Let me go home!”
The other party had already revealed the origin of their organization. If they still refused to join now, then only death awaited them.
This “Radiant Tower branch office on Ruby Fish Star’s sixth asteroid belt” was naturally located on an asteroid, which looked desolate to the naked eye, but the facilities in the branch were quite comprehensive.
Equipment such as a gravity chamber, force measuring counter, etc., opened the eyes of Gu Nan, who had just ascended from “Earth.”
Now this is a genuine cultivation civilization!
“Come with me. We’ll first evaluate your cultivation path. The organization will find suitable cultivation techniques for you so that you can grow quickly.”
Tang Xuan led Gu Nan forward as she spoke with a cold tone.
Qin Xuanji was taken away by Old Zhang. Originally, Tang Xuan was more optimistic about the girl, but Old Zhang snatched her away first.
There were basically no weaklings among bloodline users. This was especially true during the Innate Realm, where they could casually crush cultivators of the same level. Qin Xuanji had just been too careless in the assessment mission. She didn’t even get to use her abilities before she was defeated.
But in contrast, this boy in front of her… Tang Xuan looked at Gu Nan’s calm and curious expression as she internally shook her head.
He had to use up all his tricks just to win against a single Han Yueren. His potential basically ended here.
There has never been a shortcut in the path of cultivation. Only absolute power can get you so far.
[Agility, regeneration type talent, unknown cultivation route, suspected of being a body cultivator, comprehensive rating: Innate Realm Third Stage.]
After a series of tests, Gu Nan’s data were all listed out and fell into Tang Xuan’s hands. The latter frowned.
“Search similar cultivation routes,” Tang Xuan spoke in a low voice.
[Data loading, searching…… There is currently no relevant data in the Level 1 database. Analysis of possible cause: agility and regeneration talents conflict.]
The disappointment on Tang Xuan’s face deepened. Under normal circumstances, the regeneration talent was always related to “strength” or “physique”. She had never seen someone who awakened an agility talent at the same time.
Even the organization’s database couldn’t find a cultivation path for him. This further showed that Gu Nan’s potential was insufficient.
Cultivation never placed much emphasis on “winning by a surprise move.” The narrower and more obscure the path, the easier it was to go astray…
Considering the fact that Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji came from a small plane in a lower world, Tang Xuan had already made up a backstory in her head — a sect had no choice but to choose an obscure, crooked path because of the extreme lack of resources, which caused him to awaken such conflicting talents.
Gu Nan had more or less guessed Tang Xuan’s thoughts and was a little amused. “It doesn’t matter if there’s no technique that suits me. The martial arts path I cultivate doesn’t have bad growth prospects.”
The power of the Evil God wasn’t naturally weak. Both the “agility” specialization he chose and the basic Evil God physique’s super regeneration were very strong.
Upon hearing these words, Tang Xuan couldn’t help but roll her eyes while being more certain of the backstory she thought up.
How can techniques created by your lower world compare to Star Realm’s techniques?
Tang Xuan sighed in secret and could only comfort herself that although Gu Nan didn’t have any training value, it was still feasible for him to be an Innate Realm combat power.
Seeing her disbelief, Gu Nan could only shrug and didn’t say anything more.
……
“Here comes some fresh talents again! This time two came at once. Who knows if they can survive three missions?”
“Ye Chong, all you can say is demoralizing stuff!”
“What can I do? Who let the previous batches of people all be like that? I’m also telling the truth here!”
After Gu Nan finished the evaluation, Tang Xuan took him to a place similar to a small tavern, where there were already five or six people, including Zhang Dongsheng and Qin Xuanji.
As soon as he entered the door, he heard waves of loud noises from inside.
Tang Xuan’s face suddenly darkened. “Ye Chong, what are you talking about? Do you remember what the organization’s rules say?”
“Of course I remember, Elder Sister Xuan, don’t be angry!” Ye Chong, a young man with blue hair, came up with a cheeky smile and said, “I’m doing this for their own good.”
“Sister Xuan, Old Ye is right. In the past, we looked after the newcomers too much and made them think that missions were just sightseeing trips, so they weren’t vigilant at all… It’ll be bad for us if the newcomers aren’t cautious.”
A black-haired and black-robed woman next to Ye Chong spoke while peeling a green fruit in her hand, but she peeled it directly with her nails instead of a knife.
Gu Nan couldn’t help but cast a few more glances at her. The woman seemed to have sensed that. She glared back and asked, “The hell are you staring at? Never seen steel claws before?”
“That’s right, I’ve never seen it.” Gu Nan nodded honestly. “Do you wipe your ass when you use the restroom?”
The scene immediately fell into an awkward silence. The noisy people went quiet, and Ye Chong was also stunned. He looked at the woman, then looked back at Gu Nan. Ye Chong grinned. “Newcomers nowadays sure are fierce. You’ve just joined, yet you dare to…”
Bang!
Before he finished speaking, the woman had already slammed her hand down, smashing the tabletop. She suddenly stood up and glared at Gu Nan. “Care to spar?”
So they’re still calling it “sparring,” even after that. Radiant Tower’s “training” is indeed strict…
Gu Nan had fished out some more information while his hands nonchalantly fiddled with his sleeves. He answered casually, “Go ahead.”
The woman raised her eyebrows. Just as she was about to attack, Tang Xuan resolutely stopped the two. “All of you shut up. Spar, what spar? Lin Ruo, you’re Innate Realm Fifth Stage, yet you’re looking to spar with an Innate Realm Third Stage cultivator?”
Old Zhang, who had been sitting next to Qin Xuanji all this time, also stood up with a light smile on his face.
“Why don’t we do this? The mission in Azure City will be carried out by Ye Chong and Lin Ruo. You can take the two newcomers with you.”
Lin Ruo immediately became anxious. “Boss Zhang, this won’t work. I can’t take such a newcomer!”
“What do you mean you can’t? It’s settled then.” Zhang Dongsheng waved his hand.
Since Zhang Dongsheng had already made up his mind, Lin Ruo could no longer get out of this, so she gave Gu Nan a bitter glare, then turned and headed back upstairs.
Right now, Ye Chong wanted to cry but had no tears. He completely got shot while lying down[1]. He came up and patted Gu Nan on the shoulder. “Brother, prepare well. The mission will start in seven days.”
He gave Gu Nan a look that said, “You’re on your own.” Clearly, he didn’t think Lin Ruo would let Gu Nan off the hook so easily.
She probably wouldn’t take his life. After all, he was still a member of the organization. But she would definitely make his life miserable.
Ye Chong knew all about Lin Ruo’s methods.
“You can disperse now. I’ll inform everyone of the next mission. Let’s all return home now.” Zhang Dongsheng clapped and motioned for the crowd to break up, and everyone was also very cooperative in leaving, but most of them couldn’t help sizing Gu Nan up.
In all these years, this was the first time they had seen such a gutsy newcomer…
I wonder if he’ll return alive seven days later?
The members quickly dispersed. Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji were also led to two small rooms on the second floor, leaving only Tang Xuan and Zhang Dongsheng to walk out slowly.
“Old Zhang, did we make a mistake by introducing Gu Nan into the organization?”

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Azure City’s Mission
chapters.content:
Strictly speaking, only Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan were in charge of the Radiant Tower branch office where Gu Nan was located. The others were all ordinary members, with no superior or subordinate rank distinction; there was only a distinction between old and new members.
This could also be seen from their strength levels—both Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan were Prodigious Realm martial artists, while all the others were only at the Innate Realm.
"What?" Zhang Dongsheng slightly raised an eyebrow, giving Tang Xuan a confused look.
His philosophy was slightly different from Tang Xuan's. He didn’t shy away from using any method to complete the mission, so he was more optimistic about Gu Nan's previous performance. If it wasn’t for his curiosity towards bloodline users, he wouldn't have left Gu Nan to the other party.
Tang Xuan informed him of Gu Nan’s evaluation results with a dark expression.
"Body cultivator, agility and regeneration double talent? It is a bit strange..." Zhang Dongsheng's expression somewhat dimmed, and he seemed to have some regret. "I'll check the higher level database to see if there’s any suitable technique for him."
Tang Xuan's face grew even gloomier upon seeing that he still held expectations for Gu Nan. "Forget his cultivation path, didn't you see his performance? He’s a complete thorn!"
Zhang Dongsheng became amused. He pointed to her and said, "To think you’re calling other people thorns. You weren’t much better when you first joined the organization back then."
Tang Xuan showed a rare blush and coughed softly. "It’s not the same. People were deliberately making my life difficult, whereas he obviously picked a fight by himself..."
"Alright, alright. In any case, it’s fine as long as he can complete missions as a member of the organization. Why worry about personality problems?"
"That’s true... the organization doesn’t allow infighting among members, but of course they don’t merely use ‘love and friendship’ to enforce this. If they really dared to break the rules, the karma secret technique will make them feel the consequences."
……
Gu Nan sat alone in the room without a glimmer of light. Just like this, he stayed quietly in the dark.
"Indeed, it’s easier to receive missions if I deliberately stir up trouble."
"The next time I reincarnate to another plane, if I can still receive missions from the game system, then it proves that the Evil God Temple can really accept such external missions."
"Then, as long as I keep looking for simple missions in mid-sized planes, won’t I be able to easily grind Evil Value?"
Every high-level player was keen on finding game bugs and using them to benefit themselves as long as their accounts didn’t get banned… which was probably the least of Gu Nan’s worries right now.
Knock, knock.
There was a slight knock on the door. Gu Nan didn’t lock the door, so it slightly opened.
"Gu Nan?" Qin Xuanji's voice came from the door.
"What’s the matter?"
Gu Nan casually threw a book over, which hit the light switch right in the center. The hanging lamp on the ceiling lit up, and the room suddenly brightened.
Qin Xuanji’s expression was still cold and calm, but there was a rare trace of reserved stiffness. She hesitated, then spoke, "It’s by your contribution alone that I was able to pass the assessment mission. I want to thank you."
"Oh, you're welcome. Just repay me when you get the chance... Anything else?"
The situation immediately became awkward. Qin Xuanji felt that the other party had already finished everything she wanted to say.
Qin Xuanji was a very serious person. After failing in the assessment, she constantly reflected on herself and felt that her success in becoming a bloodline user might have made her lose her vigilance.
Otherwise, with her strength, she wouldn’t necessarily lose, even if she confronted Han Yueren head-on.
Because of this, she was particularly curious about Gu Nan, who could beat Han Yueren despite only being at Innate Realm Third Stage. She was so curious that she tried to understand his every move.
She thought about it and asked, "I've always wanted to ask you something. Why did you kill Han Yueren's entire family in the assessment mission? Is this also related to the mission?"
"It has nothing to do with the mission." Gu Nan smiled. "It's just that I promised Han Yueren I’d kill his entire family. Humans naturally have to keep their promises."
‘And also get some more Evil Value in passing, but unfortunately, the mission difficulty was so low that not even killing the entire family had any effect.’
Qin Xuanji thought about it for a long time and actually nodded seriously. "You’re right. Since you promised him, it’s only natural to do your best to keep your word."
"I look forward to working with you on the next mission." The corners of Qin Xuanji’s mouth raised slightly. It seemed that she wanted to show a smile, but failed.
"Me too." Gu Nan, on the other hand, gave a clear and bright smile.
……
Seven days passed quickly. Gu Nan adjusted his condition in a simple manner, but he still didn't know much about Star Realm.
Radiant Tower was a very strange organization. On one hand, it expressly forbade members from killing each other, but on the other hand, it seemed very inhumane, as though it only wanted to train its members into machines that could complete missions.
Besides mission and combat related information, they weren’t allowed to touch any other information.
"Just what kind of organization would disregard members’ origin and background, and only require its members to complete missions?"
Gu Nan couldn’t understand Radiant Tower’s purpose as an organization, but this did not stop him from completing missions— ‘As long as you can provide me with points and Evil Value, who cares if you’re Radiant Tower or Dark Tower?’
"The 'Azure City' we’re going to this time is a fairly difficult and old mission. Three waves of people from the organization have already suffered defeat, so we must not take it lightly." In the tavern hall, Ye Chong distributed the mission information, and his tone sounded grave.
"This time, it's our branch’s turn to send people, and there are even two newcomers here, so just do your best. If worst comes to worst, we’ll just withdraw in advance. I think that’s also Old Zhang’s intent." Lin Ruo didn't take the information. She already knew the mission like the back of her hand and spoke casually.
The organization allowed them to withdraw if they couldn’t complete the mission. In principle, fights to the death were not encouraged in order to preserve the effective fighting force.
Everyone knew how difficult this "Azure City" mission was.
“Even those larger branch offices on administrative stars were powerless against this mission. Do they actually expect anything from us, a small branch office on an asteroid belt?”
Ye Chong remained silent at Lin Ruo's words but did not refute them. Clearly, he also had similar thoughts in his heart.
This was Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji’s first time seeing the mission. They both read over the information carefully. Qin Xuanji’s frown deepened the more she read, while Gu Nan remained expressionless.
The Azure City mission was both a simple and a difficult mission.
The mission objective was very clear: they just had to protect an item and prevent the enemy from snatching it for three days.
The difficult part was that they would have practically no time to prepare after reincarnating and had to be ready to fight as soon as they woke up, while the enemy was well prepared in all aspects.
This was a contest of hard power, and there was almost no place to take a shortcut.
Lin Ruo's gaze was fixed on Gu Nan's face. This was not only because of the previous conflict, but also because of what Tang Xuan said to her privately afterwards:
“This newcomer, Gu Nan, likes to take shortcuts inside missions. You can go teach him a lesson in this mission.”
Thinking of Tang Xuan's words, Lin Ruo’s face couldn't help but show a cold smile.
Gu Nan naturally couldn't read Lin Ruo's smile. He threw the information aside and asked, "When will we leave?"
"After 17 minutes and 35 seconds. The time flow of the small plane is different from the time flow here, so we must reincarnate at the right time." Ye Chong answered, then looked at him in disbelief. "Did you finish reading already?"
There was a lot of information for the Azure City mission. Gu Nan had merely flipped through it twice and put it aside. ‘Could he actually understand everything with just that?’
"En, it's just a small mission. It's not hard." Gu Nan waved his hand.
‘This arrogant newcomer!’
The sneer on Lin Ruo’s face became heavier, and even Ye Chong couldn't help but want to shake his head.
In fact, they didn’t know that Gu Nan was just telling the truth. With his many years of experience of roaming about major dungeons, this really could only be regarded as child’s play.
After all, this was experience gained between life and death, which was a right exclusive to players. NPCs didn’t have the unlimited resurrection treatment.
T/N: Reincarnation and rebirth will be used interchangeably from now on

chapters.title: Chapter 19: This is all to protect your… blood
chapters.content:
“I don’t care what you think about the mission. Have you clearly memorized the rebirth rules?”
Two minutes before departure, Ye Chong was still warning the two newcomers seriously — Zhang Dongsheng seemed to have appointed him as the person who’d be in charge and responsible for the results of this mission.
Qin Xuanji nodded seriously and didn’t speak; Gu Nan also nodded “seriously” and yawned while he was at it.
Ye Chong’s expression was a little dark, and he shouted at Gu Nan, “Gu Nan! Memorize this for me—it doesn’t matter if we completely fail the mission, but no one is allowed to violate even a single line of the rebirth rules, do you understand?!”
“I understand…” Gu Nan still seemed dispirited.
Ye Chong shook his head.
Actually, Gu Nan wasn’t intentionally looking for trouble, but he really couldn’t get serious.
The so-called rebirth rules were exactly what they had been asked to understand and memorize in the past seven days, which talked about all kinds of taboos during reincarnation.
For example, like how reincarnators must use their real name, and how reincarnators should never leave behind karma on the rebirth plane.
This wasn’t the first time that Gu Nan had heard of the word “karma.”
The reason he came to Star Realm was because Gu Nian wanted to settle her “karma;” the reason he was snatched away and sent to Radiant Tower was because someone didn’t want Gu Nian to settle her “karma;” and the reason those people didn’t dare to kill him was also because they feared coming into contact with this “karma.”
[If “karma” isn’t settled, your inner demon will haunt you when advancing to the next realm, and the cultivator will die on the spot…]
“Like hell I’d believe that…” Gu Nan was disdainful in his heart.
If karma acted on the cultivator through their inner heart demons, then how come the theory of karma had never been mentioned in their own plane, but only showed up during rebirth?
Clearly, “karma” was related to “rebirth.”
The time of rebirth soon arrived. As a blue light flashed on the round table in the center of the pub, the souls of the four people were drawn out and thrown into a small, broken plane at the other side of the endless void.
……
Early in the morning, crisp and melodious bird songs echoed in the mountains. There was a dilapidated orphanage at the foot of the mountain. Four young men and women gradually woke up.
These four were precisely Gu Nan and the others.
Their identities were orphans adopted by the director of the orphanage 16 years ago, and they had grown up together.
Ms. Luo Bing, the director of the orphanage, was the objective in this mission. The Ice Soul Crystal in her blood was the target their enemies had been pursuing.
Ye Chong stood up as soon as he opened his eyes. He looked around for a while and saw his companions wake up at the same time, so he naturally started giving instructions.
“The first wave of attacks will arrive in a quarter of an hour. Build some countermeasures and traps here, or find a handy weapon to kill the vanguard and buy some time.”
Lin Ruo added, “We all reincarnated with our entire souls, so we’ll recover our original strengths very quickly, but it’ll still take around half a day. During this period, we must pay attention to our own safety.”
Reincarnating with the entire soul meant their strengths would be restored extremely quickly. However, once they died during reincarnation, their souls would also suffer heavy damage, and they may even die
Therefore, when dealing with this kind of mission, once failure seemed inevitable, members of Radiant Tower would choose to give up the mission directly.
Lin Ruo’s words were obviously meant for the two newcomers. Although she had a conflict with Gu Nan, now was not the time to deal with personal conflicts.
Qin Xuanji’s expression looked grave, and she meticulously began to search for weapons. Before her strength fully restored itself, weapons could still greatly influence the outcome of a fight.
On the other hand, Gu Nan looked relaxed, but he also began looking around, which made Ye Chong and Lin Ruo relieved.
They were afraid that Gu Nan, this boy, would still refuse to take this seriously and drag everyone down.
But when he came back, they couldn’t smile anymore. At least Qin Xuanji had somehow found a wood chopper, but Gu Nan actually found a… bottle?
“What are you going to do with a bottle?! The enemy is coming soon. We must rely on our current bodies to fight against more than a dozen Acquired Realm opponents!” Lin Ruo roared at Gu Nan.
She felt like she was about to go crazy. I hate this kind of fellow who’s still so sloppy even when facing serious business! Dying serves you right! But you just have to drag down your companions…
“Who says we absolutely have to fight? You NPCs don’t know a d**n thing about dungeons!” Gu Nan curled his lips disdainfully and said to Qin Xuanji in passing, “Lend me the knife.”
“Oh…”
Gu Nan walked to the inner room with the wood chopping knife in one hand and an empty bottle in the other.
It just so happened that Ms. Luo Bing, the mission’s target, was walking out of the inner room. Ye Chong quickly rushed up to her and spoke with a face full of anxiety, “Foster Mother, get ready quickly. The subordinates of Azure City’s Young Master are coming to kill us!”
As an orphan adopted by Luo Bing, the four had always called her “Foster Mother.”
When Luo Bing heard the words “Azure City’s Young Master,” her entirety seemed shocked and her face paled. “San’er[1], how can you know that… Forget it. They’re coming for me, so you guys should hurry and run as far away as possible!”
Of course Ye Chong couldn’t say they figured this out during the previous mission attempts. He turned to look at Lin Ruo.
According to the previous teams’ experience, at least two people needed to cooperate in order to persuade Ms. Luo Bing.
As long as they could persuade her to escape first with two people and leave the other two to take up the rear, things would get much easier after that.
Lin Ruo already knew the process, so she also walked up and gently hugged Luo Bing’s arm. She said softly, “Foster Mother, you also know that we’ve grown up with you since childhood. If anything happens to you, we… sniff sniff”
Lin Ruo’s appearance was lovely and touching. Luo Bing was instantly moved by this, and her expression also relaxed.
Ye Chong couldn’t help but secretly praise her.
No matter how cold and proud Lin Ruo usually was, she was really competent when carrying out missions. Right now, she acted like a caring daughter without any hint of embarrassment.
However, just when the two were feeling slightly relieved, a black light slashed across them, and the two simultaneously felt something warm splash across their faces.
Blood!
Luo Bing’s blood!
That Gu Nan had actually slashed Luo Bing’s neck with the knife!
Ye Chong only felt a stream of blood rush to his head. Their good plan was instantly destroyed!
“Do you know what you’ve done?! You…..” He rushed over with bulging eyes and grabbed Gu Nan by the collar, shouting angrily.
Gu Nann pushed him away. “Go away, don’t hinder me.”
“I… You…” Ye Chong was too angry to speak.
Only Qin Xuanji was still staring at Gu Nan. After learning from Old Zhang about how Gu Nan passed the assessment mission, she became very interested in this person.
She wanted to know how he’d complete this Azure City mission.
Gu Nan squatted down and placed the bottle by Luo Bing’s neck wound to catch the blood flowing out.
At this time, Ms. Luo Bing wasn’t completely dead yet. She stared at Gu Nan with wide eyes. She couldn’t understand why her family, who had relied upon each other for survival for 16 years, would attack her.
“W-why…”
Gu Nan glanced at her. Because he still needed to collect blood, it wasn’t convenient to twist off her neck for the time being. Thus, he answered earnestly, “This is all to protect your Ice Soul bloodline. Since you’re going to die anyway, isn’t it better for us to take your blood so that at the very least, we can prevent Azure City’s Young Master from succeeding, right?”
Due to excessive blood loss, Ms. Luo Bing, whose brain had begun to suffer from oxygen deprivation, thought “His words are really reasonable,” and her consciousness gradually blurred…
Notes
[1]: San’er: affectionate nickname; means “Third Son” or “Third Child”

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Pursuers Around the Corner
chapters.content:
On the Azure City plane, in a hidden forest, Gu Nan and three other people were advancing at full speed. Gu Nan was carrying a small bottle in his hand.
Right now, nearly an hour had passed since they woke up. Their strengths gradually recovered to the peak of Acquired Realm, and Ye Chong, their strongest, had even begun to enter the Innate Realm.
“Why didn’t those people pursue us here? That’s why I’m saying that you all didn’t seriously examine the information!” Gu Nan spoke frankly with assurance.
