The three people listening to him felt their lips twitch. They almost couldn’t stop themselves from beating him up.
You’re clearly the one who didn’t examine the information seriously!
Gu Nan’s footsteps didn’t stop as he said indifferently, “The first three failed attempts all had a common feature: that is, they could never throw off their pursuers. Clearly, the enemy has the means to track them down.”
“Since their goal is the Ice Soul’s Blood, it’s not unusual to be able to track it. Perhaps the tracking target is the blood itself.” Ye Chong guessed, frowning as he looked at Luo Bing’s blood in Gu Nan’s hands. In any case, Luo Bing was dead, so they had no choice but to let Gu Nan carry out his plan.
When he heard this, Gu Nan sneered, “In the second mission attempt, the team of four fled in four different directions towards the end, but they were all overtaken. How do you explain this?”
“This…..”
“Clearly, the other party’s tracking methods were left after they first made contact with the enemy. You guys only thought about buying time and restoring strength, but it never occurred to you that strength is sometimes not the most important thing.”
These words silenced both Ye Chong and Lin Ruo. They never thought that their plan actually had such a huge flaw.
Was it wrong from the beginning…?
And Gu Nan continued to explain.
“How can Azure City’s Young Master locate us? If you read the background story, you should find that Luo Bing has been to Azure City before. Someone probably noticed her then.
“In other words, the tracking device on her body probably wasn’t acting on her bloodline, or else they would’ve found her a long time ago. Why would they wait so long for us to reincarnate here?”
No one could answer Gu Nan. Lin Ruo fell into a long silence, even unconsciously slowing her pace.
It wasn’t until a long time later that Qin Xuanji suddenly asked, “How do you know so many things when it’s obvious that you only glanced at the information? And I’ve thought about it for a long time, but I still don’t remember Luo Bing visiting Azure City…”
“Oh, I made that last part up.”
“…”
“…”
Another half an hour later, the four came to a streaming body of water, which was an estuary where the river fed into the sea.
“Guys, you don’t have to have such tense expressions…”
“Didn’t you see that I left so much blood in the original location? It’s precisely to confuse the other party. Even if they’re tracking the blood, we can still buy some time!”
Lin Ruo’s face looked cold as she asked disdainfully, “Are you sure it wasn’t because your hand shook and some blood splashed out?”
Gu Nan turned his head away, indicating his intent to ignore the other party so as to avoid answering.
“Alright, let’s pour half of the blood here…” Gu Nan smiled and spoke with some kind of evil delight, and his hands were doing exactly that.
Just like that, the precious blood containing the power of the Ice Soul’s Blood was poured into the estuary and washed away in the blink of an eye. No trace of it could be seen anymore.
……
Just when Gu Nan was angering the heavens and the people with his actions, a group of people also arrived at the orphanage at the foot of the mountain.
“Young Master, the descendent of the Ice Soul’s Blood who we found before is just ahead.”
“Are you sure it’s the Ice Soul’s Blood?” A young man with sky blue hair stepped out of the limousine and looked at the orphanage in the distance.
The man next to him replied flatteringly, “It’s precisely because we aren’t certain that we troubled Young Master to make a personal trip…”
“En.” The young man nodded slightly. The matter of the Ice Soul’s Blood was too important and he couldn’t rely on others, so he could only come in person.
“Young Master, Young Master…” The person who went ahead to scout the situation ran back in a panic, out of breath.
“Not good, Young Master… that Luo Bing, she’s dead!”
“Dead?!”
Azure City’s Young Master immediately stared with wide eyes. He’d thought of the possibility that the other party might run away, or sense something and find a helper, but it never occurred to him that the target would be dead.
If the holder of the bloodline died… then what about the bloodline?
Thinking of this, Azure City’s Young Master thundered angrily, “Hurry! Get there as fast as you can! Before the spiritual power in her blood dissipates!”
However, the Young Master never imagined he’d see such a scene when he finally arrived.
Luo Bing’s corpse was lying in front of the orphanage with wide open eyes. Sparkling and translucent blood remained at her neck, shining with a faint blue light.
The Ice Soul’s Blood was indeed remarkable. When exposed to the air for a long time, instead of solidifying and deteriorating, it actually became more and more brilliant, with an inexplicable chilliness.
“That’s right, this is the Ice Soul’s Blood!” Azure City’s Young Master was pleasantly surprised. He finally found the bloodline he’d been searching many years for!
An old man went forward to investigate. After a moment, he returned to the Young Master and whispered, “Someone took most of the blood…… With the density of her bloodline, the Ice Soul blood can only be preserved for three days at most after leaving her body.”
“Three days? That’s enough!” Azure City’s Young Master had a cold smile. He immediately bowed at the old man. “I’ll have to trouble Elder Xu to act.”
Elder Xu nodded gently, carefully taking a trace of Luo Bing’s blood as he started chanting.
That drop of blood began to shine with a faint light, then unexpectedly started floating in mid-air, slowly sinking between the old man’s eyebrows.
Azure City’s Young Master stood aside, looking calm. With Elder Xu’s aid, he could draw out the bloodline’s power with a unique secret technique and locate the direction of the Ice Soul blood. This was his trump card.
Moments later, Elder Xu suddenly opened his eyes and pointed his finger to one side, “That way.”
“Chase after them!”
……
“The blood suddenly started to emit a blue light just now. What does this mean?”
“It’s probably some kind of tracking method.” Gu Nan shook the small bottle in his hand and sighed. “It must’ve been Luo Bing’s corpse… Unfortunately, we didn’t have much time, otherwise it would’ve been best to burn down the entire orphanage.”
The three people got chills from hearing this.
Lin Ruo’s brows wrinkled, and she spoke frankly, “Your actions are too cruel. You’re willing to use any means in order to complete the mission. Sooner or later, you will be entangled in karma… You even killed Luo Bing, which is already very dangerous in itself.”
“What danger can there be?” Gu Nan raised an eyebrow, his expression full of disapproval.
“Karma.” Ye Chong finished for Luo Bing with a heavy expression, “Although we don’t know whether Luo Bing’s karma will fall on us, there is still a risk of that happening… Once we’re entangled by karma, it will be extremely difficult to advance to the Prodigious Realm in the future.”
According to Star Realm’s theory, “rebirth karma” will lead to inner heart demons and hinder the cultivator’s progress, especially when attempting to advance to a higher realm.
But Gu Nan scoffed at that.
If entering into a dungeon plane counted as rebirth, then when he was grinding countless dungeons in Langya World, he had already been reincarnated countless times, which meant he would’ve been entangled in an astronomical amount of karma.
But even so, didn’t his advancement to Tier 2 Evil God, the equivalent of this world’s “Innate Realm,” still go smoothly without a hint of resistance?
As long as he had the Evil God Temple, Gu Nan didn’t care about this whole karma thing.
“Next, we need to find a living being, even a living human can work… Oh, there’s a wild boar over there. It’ll do.”
As Gu Nan’s voice fell, a wild boar’s miserable cry rang out in the forest.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: A True Top Player
chapters.content:
On the other side, Azure City’s Young Master, Elder Xu, and their party traced the footsteps of Gu Nan and the others, coming all the way to the estuary.
“D**n it! These bastards should be killed with thousands of knives!”
The Young Master’s entire face twisted with anger. Without Elder Xu needing to say anything, he also understood what happened.
Some light blue liquid was floating on the continuously flowing sea.
“How dare they pour the Ice Soul blood into the sea!” If Gu Nan was present right now, Azure City’s Young Master definitely wouldn’t hesitate to personally tear him into eight pieces to vent his hatred.
Do these bastards know how precious the Ice Soul’s Blood is? How could they actually pour it into the sea?
Elder Xu didn’t even have the time to feel distressed. He quickly ran to the estuary with a sullen expression, suddenly waving his sleeves. A flash of light instantly enveloped those blue lights.
There were countless cultivation paths in this world, and this Elder Xu was clearly someone who specialized in powers of the mind, such as telekinesis.
He forcibly wrapped the remaining blood with his mental powers to ensure that they wouldn’t be lost, and only then did he dare to start slowly extracting it.
“The actual blood has been completely washed away, leaving only pure Ice Soul power.” Elder Xu sighed lightly.
“Fortunately, Luo Bing’s bloodline was dense enough, otherwise it would’ve long been washed away by the sea.”
Azure City’s Young Master couldn’t help but ask urgently, “Is there any way to extract the bloodline?”
“Of course there is.” Elder Xu replied proudly, “Those people tried to steal a chicken but ended up losing even the rice they used to lure it[1]. They probably didn’t expect us to arrive so soon and didn’t expect the Ice Soul’s Blood to not be washed away by the water.”
“Right now, I’ve already preserved it with a secret technique. As long as I hurry to extract it and prevent it from being overly contaminated by the seawater, the Ice Soul’s Blood will still be intact.”
When he heard this, Azure City’s Young Master felt relieved and nodded. “We only need about 80% of the bloodline, that will be enough… Elder Xu, please start as soon as possible!”
Every second they delayed would contaminate the bloodline a little more. Elder Xu also dared not delay, so he hurriedly sat down and started using his mental power to refine the seawater.
As time went by, Azure City’s Young Master was no longer in a hurry. In any case, they had already obtained the bloodline, so he just ordered his men to secure the area.
A few hours later, Elder Xu slowly opened his eyes, exhaustion clear on his face.
However, his mind was very excited. “Young Master, this Ice Soul’s Blood has been completely purified… Eh? Why is there so little?”
“Shameless thieves! They didn’t pour all of it in!”
……
Gu Nan and the others walked in the mountains. Everyone held a large pile of frozen meat chunks in their hands.
The Ice Soul’s Blood was truly remarkable. After leaving the host body and feeding just a tiny sip to the boar, the poor little boar instantly froze into an ice statue.
Gu Nan chopped the frozen boar into pieces and handed everyone a little bit so that they could throw some pieces while they walked.
“What’s the purpose of this?” Qin Xuanji asked curiously. She was also someone who often traveled in the wild, but she still couldn’t understand Gu Nan’s actions.
Gu Nan casually threw a chunk of meat and explained, “To interfere with their tracking.”
“Normally, locating something by sensing the bloodline power can’t possibly be as accurate as technological methods. At most it’ll just be a vague feeling…”
Before he even finished speaking, Lin Ruo interrupted, “So something that’s far away and something with weak bloodline energy will both feel similar to the other party’s senses, and they won’t be able to tell them apart?”
“Most likely so.” Gu Nan nodded.
Lin Ruo and Ye Chong exchanged glances. After carefully thinking about it, this seemed very reasonable. The tracking methods they usually used also seemed to have such shortcomings.
It’s just that they had never thought about it like this, let alone making use of these blind spots in their thought processes.
The reality also seemed to be as Gu Nan expected.
When they were almost at the edge of the dense forest, they heard a bunch of loud noises behind them. It was obvious that the other party had launched a large-scale search.
Azure City’s Young Master stood in the same place as he breathed heavily.
He commanded his subordinates to search around while holding a chunk of frozen boar in his hand.
“These petty tricks again…” Azure City’s Young Master snorted coldly while feeling vicious.
He thought that they already worked swiftly and also had Elder Xu to help with the tracking, so they should’ve caught up quickly, but the other party used these tricks to delay them again and again.
Elder Xu also had a gloomy expression. A few strands of his hair even turned white with anger.
Originally, the bloodline clearly pointed them in this direction, but when he actually came here, he found that the bloodline was suddenly pointing in dozens of directions!
From the moment he saw the piece of frozen boar, he knew what the other party had done, but there was no good way to deal with it.
He could sense dozens of signals of varying strengths, yet the correct answer was hidden in a pile of illusions. How could he distinguish them?
“Cunning villain!”
……
Even more surprising events were yet to come.
Ye Chong and the others followed Gu Nan, walking around the mountain forest for three days. They actually didn’t encounter a single enemy attack.
Gu Nan had too many petty tricks, such as obscuring their line of sight, creating roadblocks, leading disaster to them… Everything that could be used in the dense forest was all used by him.
When they ran out of options, he caught over a dozen wild animals and gave each a sip of the Ice Soul blood.
Gu Nan and the others could just walk away, but poor Elder Xu had to work hard to extract the bloodline from animal blood.
After three days, Gu Nan and the others were able to save their energy. Instead, the group of pursuers were exhausted and didn’t sleep well for the entire three days and three nights.
After the Ice Soul’s Blood left the host’s body, the spiritual energy within it would continuously dissipate and become completely ineffective in three days, so no one dared to rest.
“Young Master, they have been blocked by us. We’ve surrounded them in the valley up ahead. They can’t run anymore!”
A man in black clothes stood in front of Azure City’s Young Master and reported in a heavy voice.
His eyes were bloodshot, and his image looked horrendous. Azure City’s Young Master, who normally paid the most attention to bearing and banners, would have kicked him a long time ago, but now he wasn’t in the mood.
On one hand, it was because he himself wasn’t much better, and on the other hand, it was naturally because…
“Finally! Caught them!”
The distinguished Young Master of Azure City actually had an urge to cry with joy right now. He grabbed Elder Xu’s arm beside him and said, “Elder Xu, please hold on a little longer. We’ll have our victory soon!”
Elder Xu nodded hard, but he didn’t even have the strength to speak anymore.
By now, he didn’t even look like a human. His eyes tainted red, his face covered with bloody gashes, his hair grew white, and he was being pushed in a simple wheelchair.
Azure City’s Young Master saw his appearance and couldn’t help feeling a heartache.
This elder who watched him grow up had done the most exhausting work in the past three days!
He needed to always sense the other party’s position and also had to extract the Ice Soul’s Blood from random places, so he didn’t have any time to rest!
After three days and nights like this, not even an iron man can stand that!
“Charge! Charge with me!” A line of people rushed to the entrance of the valley, and Azure City’s Young Master eagerly roared.
He had completely stopped caring about anything like scouting the terrain or investigating the enemy’s strength. Right now, he just wanted to have a good fight.
Even if he died in battle, it was still much better than what he had to endure these past three days!
Of course, in the bottom of his heart, the Young Master was still very sure of his own decisions.
According to the information, the other party merely consisted of four orphans raised by Luo Bing, without any special abilities. All they could do was play some clever tricks. How could they be his opponent?
It’s a pity that he didn’t expect to face four Innate Realm experts in great spirits.
Notes
[1]: “Tried to steal a chicken but ended up losing even the rice they used to lure it.” Not only did their plan fail, but they even lost the bait they threw into the plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Second Equipment Page: Soaring Strength
chapters.content:
The battle between the four from Radiant Tower and the group led by Azure City’s Young Master could only be described as a devastating slaughter.
The strength level of Azure City’s pursuers were merely Innate Realm First or Second Stage to begin with, and they were all extremely exhausted, so they couldn’t display even half of their combat’s effectiveness.
Originally, according to the process, the first wave of enemies would not be very powerful.
The number of strong experts on the enemy’s side was small, and it was also impossible for them to take part in this pursuit. The strong experts would only arrive when the current party had already been tailed and surrounded.
Under Gu Nan’s influence, this was akin to cheating in a tower defense game where you only had to kill the first wave of monsters, which was extremely easy.
Gu Nan didn’t even have to do anything. After killing several enemies, Qin Xuanji found that she couldn’t beat Ye Chong and Lin Ruo, the two crazy “headhunting dogs’” so she could only quietly return to Gu Nan’s side.
“Is this your martial arts path?” Qin Xuanji asked as she stood beside Gu Nan, watching him look down at the tumultuous battlefield with a calm expression.
Gu Nan turned his head in surprise. “What martial arts path?”
“A senior told me that there are thousands of martial arts paths in the world, and only by staying true to your own path can you reach the peak. His path is a bit like yours— making decisions thousands of miles ahead of everyone and devising battle plans on the spot.”
“No need to sound so erudite, I’m just using my brain to play games.”
……
+
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed:
Main Mission Evaluation: B
Side Story Development: B
Map Exploration: A
Evil Value: B
Comprehensive Evaluation: B+｣
+
｢Accumulated evil points: 40 points
Accumulated Guilt Points: 4 points｣
+
The main mission was finished easily, but Gu Nan was somewhat dissatisfied. “The reward is a little small. It seems that this is a small-scale dungeon…”
Small dungeons couldn’t possibly give good rewards, but in Gu Nan’s view, the difficulty this time was also low, so it was worth the entrance price.
And he just happened to receive 4 Guilt Points this time, so he had already accumulated 30 Guilt Points, which meant he could open the second equipment page!
With 376 evil points in hand, that was enough for him to buy some good equipment and enhance his fighting strength again.
“The mission is completed, let’s return. Do you two still remember the chant for drawing your souls back out?” Ye Chong walked over and looked at Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji.
As he spoke, he also took a deep look at Gu Nan.
This newcomer had brought him too much shock. For three days and three nights, he “walked the dog[1]” and played their pursuers in the palm of his hand. This decision-making skill was definitely not something that ordinary people possessed.
In contrast, his strength wasn’t as important anymore.
In response to Ye Chong’s words, Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji nodded.
Reincarnating their entire souls was a relatively dangerous reincarnation method, but it also had many conveniences.
For example, they could restore their strengths very quickly, and it was also very convenient to return to their original plane.
Previously, Gu Nian had only thrown part of her soul into the reincarnation process, so she had to rely on external forces to return. However, those who reincarnated with their entire souls would only need to rely on their soul’s power.
After about a minute of chanting, Gu Nan felt a force from inside his soul slowly dragging him away from the body and floating toward the sky.
“This is like chanting and rubbing the hearthstone to return to the city…”
The next moment, Gu Nan’s consciousness woke up in the tavern in Radiant Tower’s branch office. His body was wrapped in a blue light, emerging in reality bit by bit.
Gu Nan was not surprised by this. This was a common occurrence in rebirth.
When reincarnating, there were corresponding seals for members to entrust their bodies to the endless void and preserve them with a secret technique, which was the safest and most convenient method.
After all, sometimes they didn’t have the luxury of reincarnating in absolute safety, so they could only do this.
Of course, souls normally couldn’t enter the endless void, and the preparations were also complicated, so it couldn’t be used as a way to save one’s life.
“How was it? Did it go well?” Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan were already waiting in the tavern hall.
Seeing four people return, Zhang Dongsheng smiled.
He was in a pretty good mood. As long as there were no casualties, they could at least give them a break even on this mission. He never planned on the mission being successful anyways.
It’s such a difficult task and only four people could go. Plus, there are even two newcomers, so how can they possibly complete…
“The mission has been completed.” Ye Chong said calmly, but his words stunned Zhang Dongsheng.
“Completed? How did you complete it?”
Ye Chong glanced at Gu Nan, hesitating on what to say. Lin Ruo pressed her lips together and simply turned and left; Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji also left, one after another.
Suddenly only Ye Chong, Zhang Dongsheng, and Tang Xuan were left in the hall.
Ye Chong saw the two simultaneously turning to him and smiled wryly as he recounted the entire mission process from beginning to end. After listening to his account, the two people stared with wide eyes.
“You mean, Gu Nan took you around in circles and led the pursuers around for three days, just like walking a dog?”
“Simply absurd!” Tang Xuan couldn’t believe Ye Chong’s words at all. It wasn’t that she didn’t trust Ye Chong, but because this completely violated basic logic.
Ye Chong smiled bitterly. If he didn’t personally experience all this, he would also feel incredulous.
What kind of person completes missions this way?
What they didn’t know was that Gu Nan had already done this kind of thing too many times in the Evil God game.《Evil God Cultivation》, which claimed to be a complete virtual reality, had such a mission system with diverse routes to begin with.
It was precisely because of this that most of the missions in 《Evil God Cultivation》 were very complicated and difficult. In Gu Nan’s eyes, Radiant Tower’s missions were just child’s play.
Just when Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan were still feeling shocked as they interrogated Ye Chong, Gu Nan had already hid in his room. His consciousness sank into the Evil God Temple.
+
｢Activate the second equipment page!｣
+++
｢The second equipment page has been activated. Please select the equipment type.｣
>
｢Accessories｣
As soon as Gu Nan issued the command, a glimmer of light flashed in the Evil God Temple. The second equipment page appeared in the store, and a series of accessories were displayed.
At the same time, an inexplicable force acted upon Gu Nan, and he suddenly felt that his physique had been greatly strengthened.
“Eh? Does opening the equipment page also enhance the player’s physique?” Gu Nan had some doubts.
He had never heard of such a thing in the game in his past life. The player’s advancement could only depend on raising their tiers. But the Evil God Temple in reality seemed to upgrade the player more smoothly.
Perhaps there was also an improvement when the first equipment page was opened, but I didn’t notice because the magnitude was too small.
Gu Nan thought to himself. However, this didn’t affect his purchase of the equipment he had decided on long ago.
>
｢Buy——Observer Eyepiece, Shadow Earrings｣
+++
｢Purchase successful. Deducting a total of 345 evil points｣
｢Observer Eyepiece: Fixed Tier 2 magic “Insight.” 120 evil points｣
｢Shadow Earrings: Exclusive to agility type Evil Gods. Skill “Power of Shadows” +1. 225 evil points｣
+
The purchase of the two accessories directly left Gu Nan with only 31 points; he practically used up his entire wealth. But these two accessories were definitely worth it!
With these two new pieces of equipment, he could finally dare to confront Ye Chong and Lin Ruo—the two Innate Realm Fifth Stage cultivators—with just his Innate Realm Third Stage cultivation!
Notes
[1]: “Walked the dog” – he led them around wherever he wanted like he was walking a dog

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Radiant Tower Arena
chapters.content:
Players could use three kinds of equipment in the Evil God game: weapons, armor, and accessories.
Among the three, players could only equip one piece each for weapons and armor, but accessories had three slots: earrings, necklace, and facial accessories, which was why Gu Nan chose to activate the accessories page for his second equipment page.
Of course, although there were many accessories that could be equipped, they still required evil points to purchase. For example, Gu Nan only had enough points to buy two pieces right now—if it wasn’t for his lack of money, the accessories page would’ve been the first equipment page he unlocked.
The two accessories he bought were good items he carefully selected.
The Observer Eyepiece was a monocle. Wearing it on the right eye was equivalent to having the passive skill “Insight.” On using this skill, one could obtain high-precision data analysis when looking at people or objects.
And the Shadow Earring was even more remarkable. It was a legendary skill-type of equipment, which directly raised the level of a skill.
Before reaching Tier 3 and learning any skills, this kind of equipment was simply divine, allowing players to access skills in advance.
After equipping the Shadow Earring, Gu Nan earned a Level 1 skill, “Power of Shadows,” which gave him the power to manipulate shadows to a fine degree, and he could also use the “Hidden Shadows” skill.
After his consciousness returned to reality, Gu Nan equipped the eyepiece and earring, and his entire temperament suddenly changed.
In the full-length mirror, Gu Nan wore a monocle over his right eye while a dark gold earring hung from his right ear. Coupled with his calm and indifferent eyes, his temperament became cold and eerie.
Gu Nan knew that this was due to the Shadow Earring revealing a trace of its power over shadows, which made him look a little sinister.
His thoughts moved slightly, and the Shadow Earring shook gently as an inexplicable fluctuation rose from his body.
A shadow appeared from under Gu Nan’s feet and slowly stretched forward. After extending nearly 20 meters in front of him, it suddenly turned into a sharp blade and mercilessly stabbed upward from the ground.
“It’s been a long time since I’ve manipulated shadows. I’m really not used to it yet…” Gu Nan muttered, but he was actually quite satisfied.
After all, he had nothing more than a “subtle level” of shadow control right now, so it was already pretty good that he could use this skill that players called “Shadow Blade.” The next moment, the shadow rapidly retreated under Gu Nan’s feet, and his entire body suddenly disappeared, turning into a dark shadow and lurking right on the ground.
The core skill of the agility type of Evil Gods—Hidden Shadow!
Compared with other types of Evil Gods, the agility type of Evil Gods didn’t have great strength, vigorous vitality, or all kinds of mental powers, but they possessed the strangest and most unpredictable skill system in the game.
If this type followed the path of “Shadows,” then they would become natural assassins.
With “Hidden Shadow” and “Shadow Manipulation,’ Gu Nan could face Innate Realm Fifth Stage experts without any fear.
“And my strength seems to have increased again after activating a new equipment page. It’s time to test it.” Gu Nan felt the abundant power in his body and lightly spoke to himself.
From the corner of the room, he found an old helmet and gently placed it on his head—this was the login device for Radiant Tower’s internal virtual reality arena.
Star Realm was a plane that partially relied on science and technology, so it already had virtual reality technology, but it was quite underdeveloped compared to Gu Nan’s past life.
The reason was very simple. On one hand, the technology here focused on military use, and the precision of virtual reality technology was insufficient; on the other hand, it was also because of the lack of cooperation from the top class.
In the first place, virtual reality fighting arenas needed to scan all the data of the fighter’s body, which would even include the amount of hair you have.
Which famous expert would be willing to be scanned like this?
This was equivalent to exposing all their trump cards and then waiting for troublemakers to come knocking on their doors.
Therefore, those who were willing to enter the public virtual reality arena were basically all Acquired Realm fighters and even martial arts enthusiasts. Innate Realm martial artists like Gu Nan would only use a “private server.”
For example, the fighting arena of Radiant Tower built for its members was called “Radiant Tower Arena.”
There were a large number of Innate Realm cultivators here, and even Prodigious Realm cultivators would occasionally appear.
In any case, all their body’s data had long been known by the organization. Besides certain people with their own secrets, the others didn’t care much.
The “Radiant Tower Arena” interface was very simple, almost the same as the pixel games hundreds of years ago in Gu Nan’s past life, containing rough text and rough lines.
Gu Nan’s information was also stated briefly. Only his name and his branch name of “Ruby Fish Star Sixth Asteroid Belt Division” was visible. It didn’t even show his strength level.
[Start matching…]
There were still many people who used Radiant Tower’s internal arena. After just a few seconds, Gu Nan found an opponent.
This was a young man in black tights, which was the typical attire of people in Radiant Tower.
His data said: [Sky Enterprise Star Headquarters, Qin Chonghua]
When the young man saw Gu Nan’s data, he almost laughed aloud. “Asteroid Belt Branch? What kind of backcountry is that? The organization actually has branches on asteroid belts?”
Sky Enterprise Star was also located in the Ninth Region. Although it wasn’t the main star, it was still one of the three administrative stars, second only to Ruby Fish Star.
Besides, this young man came from the administrative star’s headquarters, so it wasn’t a surprise when he looked down on some branch office on an asteroid belt.
Usually, very few people would live in a branch office like this. It was useless to expect any resources from the organization, so how strong can its members be?
Although Qin Chonghua was only in Innate Realm Fourth Stage, he had mastered many high-end martial arts, skills and techniques, so he was very confident.
“Boy, attack me. Don’t say I didn’t give you a chance!” Qin Chonghua just stood in the arena as he looked at Gu Nan with a light smile.
“Okay.” Gu Nan nodded, then his figure suddenly darted out like a sharp arrow, reaching the front of his opponent in the blink of an eye.
“So fast! Why is he so fast…” Qin Chonghua’s eyes suddenly widened, but his body couldn’t keep up with his movements.
Bang!
Gu Nan punched him in the face and directly blasted Qin Chonghua into the air. The terrifying force even created a sonic boom.
The attack speed bonus of an agility type Evil God was no joke…
“You……” Qin Chonghua’s face touched the ground. He finally got up after much difficulty, and his face was swollen with a big lump. But before he could speak, Gu Nan rushed up again.
Qin Chonghua soon discovered that he had made a huge mistake.
He simply wasn’t qualified to act as the stronger one. His opponent wasn’t inferior to him at all, even in a frontal confrontation, let alone now, when he had an absolute advantage!
This person didn’t seem to know any martial arts, but his attack speed was too fast and too clean. He didn’t give people the opportunity to use their martial arts at all.
Qin Chonghua wanted to cry but had no tears. He had never seen such a martial artist before!
Merely two minutes later, Qin Chonghua’s hands lost their strength, and he was punched in the throat by Gu Nan. He was judged dead by the system due to a fractured bone in his throat and was sent out of the arena.
Thus, a genuine Innate Realm Fourth Stage expert was killed by Gu Nan’s flurry of punches which felt like strong wind and heavy rain.
He couldn’t even bring in any equipment because of the arena’s system, so he was fighting solely with his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Multiplayer Dungeon, Collaborative Mission
chapters.content:
After several more rounds of fighting, Gu Nan roughly confirmed his own strength level.
Purely in terms of strength and explosive force, he probably ranged between Innate Realm Fourth Stage and Fifth Stage. However, his body’s physique was extremely strong, allowing him to directly withstand attacks from opponents of the same level, so his actual combat power far surpassed that.
Furthermore, Gu Nan still had three pieces of equipment in hand. Once he used the Four Element Crossbow and Shadow Earring, he could even fight Innate Realm Sixth Stage experts.
“My strength has roughly been confirmed, but it’s a pity that with Radiant Tower’s rules, who knows how long it’ll take before I get a chance to leave…”
Gu Nan didn’t forget that people had kidnapped him to Radiant Tower because of a problem on Gu Nian’s side. If he had the chance, he definitely wanted to leave here to meet Gu Nian and check who secretly laid hands on him while he was at it.
It was important to improve his strength, and revenge was also necessary—maybe he could even earn some guilt points in the process.
But they threw him into a small asteroid belt branch office to stall and prevent him from making any kind of appearance right now.
Because according to Radiant Tower’s rules, five missions were considered one round, and members were only allowed to leave after completing one round of missions.
After leaving Radiant Tower, they would no longer be Radiant Tower members for the time being. If they wanted to return once more and complete missions, they would have to complete a whole new round of missions before they could leave again.
This peculiar rule was the origin of the air of mystery surrounding Radiant Tower—all the official members would be performing missions, and those who were outside must not be official members. At most, they were just former members.
Those who kidnapped Gu Nan earlier said that he would stay for at least several years, and they weren’t wrong.
For these fighters, Radiant Tower’s missions were still very difficult. Newcomers already needed a lot of time to train and gain experience, so they would really need two to three years to complete five missions.
In particular, they deliberately sent Gu Nan to the small asteroid belt branch office to curb his growth to the utmost extent.
Radiant Tower would allocate resources to some larger branches, but backwater branches like the asteroid belt offices couldn’t even complete their normal mission quota, so why would Radiant Tower ever allocate them any resources?
But nobody ever imagined that there would be a freak like Gu Nan, whose strength soared at a rapid pace. Gu Nan even wanted to thank them.
If he hadn’t been taken to Radiant Tower, Gu Nan wouldn’t have had the chance to experience an explosive growth in strength. To begin with, there was no way to “farm missions” so quickly in the Evil God game!
Based on the mission frequency when he first transmigrated into this world, he received an average of one small low-difficulty mission per week with low rewards.
It wasn’t like Radiant Tower at all, where he could “manually import” external missions.
……
“What did you say? You want to accept a new mission?”
Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan both frowned as they looked at Gu Nan, who had a calm expression.
Zhang Dongsheng politely advised, “Gu Nan, I know that you’re very confident about completing missions, but a small branch office like ours won’t be able to finish our quota even if we try hard, and there also won’t be any rewards. Why bother?”
Every Radiant Tower branch had a certain quota of missions and resources. Those who finished more missions would be rewarded accordingly, while those who finished less would have their resources appropriately deducted.
Branch offices on asteroid belts were poor to begin with, so headquarters wouldn’t deduct too much for fear of a strike.
Of course Gu Nan would never say, “It’s true that you won’t get rewards from completing missions, but for me, they’re the path to leveling up.”
Instead, he spoke righteously, “Since the organization has decided to let me become one of its members, please allow me to read two poems first…”
Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan looked at each other in dismay. In the end, they couldn’t persuade Gu Nan, so they could only let it go.
Tang Xuan said with a serious expression, “I heard that you killed Luo Bing as soon as you entered the ‘Azure City’ mission? Never do this again in the future!”
“Eh, why?”
“Did you seriously read the ‘rebirth rules’?!” Tang Xuan said angrily, “When you reincarnate into someone’s body, you will bear their karma. Luo Bing is the next of kin of the body you reincarnated into. How can you attack her?”
“You were lucky this time that this karma did not fall upon you. Do you still expect to be so lucky next time?”
The theory of karma was very mysterious. Not even members of Radiant Tower, who reincarnated for a living, dared to claim the understanding of karma completely.
According to logic, when Gu Nan killed Luo Bing, he completely violated the karma of the body he reincarnated into, yet he was still untangled by karma. This was most likely the work of certain unknown rules.
But this didn’t mean that Gu Nan could act recklessly. At the very least, Tang Xuan wouldn’t allow it.
However, Gu Nan just waved his hand indifferently, which infuriated Tang Xuan.
“Since you want to participate in missions so much, I happen to have an organization-wide collaborative mission here with me. Are you willing to accept it?” Tang Xuan stared at Gu Nan as she asked.
“Of course I’ll accept!” Gu Nan didn’t even have to think about it. “But what’s a collaborative mission?”
Zhang Dongsheng explained, “In addition to ordinary missions, there are also some large-scale missions whose content is very complicated. They require the cooperation of people from multiple branches to complete…”
“I’ll take it! I’m definitely taking this mission!” Before Zhang Dongsheng could even finish, Gu Nan interrupted excitedly.
‘What collaborative mission? This is called a multiplayer dungeon in-game!’
Multiplayer dungeons were at least mid-sized dungeons, and they had one common characteristic—that is, they had a large number of side quests and a system that calculated side quest rewards in advance!
Multiplayer dungeons required multiple players to join and to accomplish some goals through either cooperation or opposition.
In his previous life’s game, multiplayer dungeons were rare and could even be considered precious, because they could bring huge benefits to players but were difficult to open.
Multiplayer dungeons wouldn’t appear normally and could only be opened by using a dungeon scroll.
The main mission of multiplayer dungeons was usually very complicated and required a long time to complete, so in the meantime, players could improve themselves by completing side quests.
Now that a multiplayer dungeon had been presented to Gu Nan, how could he refuse?
When Tang Xuan saw that he really did agree, she couldn’t help giving a soft
Hmph
. “If you want to participate in the mission, you must obey our commands. A collaborative mission is no joke, and so we can’t afford for you to act without our approval!”
Gu Nan nodded repeatedly. “I promise to obey commands. If I don’t obey… why don’t you hit me?”
“…What did you say?!”
“I said, if I don’t listen to your commands, just beat me to death!”
……
A few days later, when Gu Nan had finished reading a large amount of information regarding both the dungeon and the mission, he finally embarked on another dungeon journey.
｢External mission detected. Incorporate into current mission sequence?｣
｢Yes. Name the dungeon ‘Immortal Demon World’｣
At Gu Nan’s command, the Evil God Temple instantly incorporated the mission into his mission list, and as Gu Nan’s soul was gradually pulled out, he also slowly approached the large target world through the endless void.
Unlike the last Azure City mission, the soul travel this time was very slow and seemed to be very laborious, so Gu Nan had time to take a good look at the endless void and the many different worlds.
He saw Star Realm and the Azure City plane he’d visited earlier, as well as the “Immortal Demon World” he was heading to.
The Immortal Demon World was very large.
If Star Realm was earth, then the Immortal Demon World would be the size of the moon, while the Azure City plane couldn’t even be the size of a basketball.
“As expected of a multiplayer dungeon. Although it can’t compare to Star Realm, it has the fledgling shape of a large-scale dungeon plane…”

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Immortal Demon World
chapters.content:
Inside an ancient-style room, a delicate and fine young man slowly opened his eyes.
What greeted his eyes was very different from the usual scenery, but his gaze remained calm and indifferent without the slightest surprise.
“Young Master Gu, are you awake?” Beside the young man, there was a girl dressed in a palace outfit standing by respectfully. When she saw the other party open his eyes, she hurriedly came forward and spoke.
“Do you know me?”
“Miss Tang told me to be your guide after you wake up.”
This young man was, of course, the Gu Nan who had just reincarnated into the “Immortal Demon World.” He stared at the girl for a moment and suddenly showed a strange smile before nodding gently.
“Then please first let me…”
“Get out.”
“Ah?”
“I said get out.”
“Yes…”
Right when the girl turned around, Gu Nan suddenly moved, slamming his palm towards the back of the girl’s head. Even though he’d just reincarnated, his palm strike still contained the strength of a peak Acquired Realm cultivator. If it hit, the girl’s brains would burst out.
But just when his palm strike was about to land, the young girl suddenly turned sideways and just happened to dodge the attack.
There was no more respect on her face; only a little curiosity remained. “How could you tell that I’m not one of your righteous path cultivators?”
Gu Nan shook his head. “I couldn’t tell.”
“Yet you still struck to kill?” The girl’s eyes widened. She didn’t really understand her opponent’s thoughts.
“At worst, I’ll just have killed the wrong person. What’s the big deal?” Gu Nan looked at her strangely.
The young girl was stunned when she heard his answer, then she immediately bursted out into a loud laughter, throwing her head back. “Gu Nan, right? Okay, I’ll remember you. You should have been reincarnated into our six demonic factions instead.”
As her voice fell, the girl’s figure quickly disappeared. After all, this was still the righteous path cultivators’ territory, and she didn’t dare to stay.
Gu Nan was left alone in the small room. He shook his arm and felt the power rapidly recovering in his body. His mouth curled slightly.
“Tang Xuan… The way she handles matters really leaves much to be desired!” He pouted in displeasure and walked out the door. “Let’s settle this body’s karma first.”
……
In the Immortal Demon World, the righteous and demonic paths couldn’t coexist peacefully.
In Gu Nan’s words, the main societal conflict here was the class conflict between the righteous path and the demonic path.
There were five righteous sects and six demonic factions that dominated the power of the whole world. The mission of Radiant Tower reincarnators like Gu Nan was to help the righteous path defeat the demonic path.
The demonic path cultivators also had external help, but they were from a different force and didn’t seem to be an organization of reincarnators.
This mission had been ongoing for several years, and both sides fought each other many times, but neither side managed to complete the mission. However, both sides gained a lot of benefits from it.
Because of this, demonic path cultivators were very aware of reincarnators’ weaknesses and knew that they were the weakest when they just woke up and would quickly grow stronger.
Tang Xuan was already busy with many other matters inside the mission, so she sent a subordinate to help Gu Nan, but demonic cultivators kidnapped her and replaced her with one of their own.
If it wasn’t for Gu Nan’s calm temperament—okay, fine, his excessive paranoia and the way he regarded human life as dirt—he probably wouldn’t have been able to avoid the sneak attack.
+
｢Main Mission: Eliminate the six demonic factions｣
｢Side Quest: Kill the six demonic factions’ ‘Innate Realm and above’ cultivators｣
｢Mission Reward: Medium｣
+
Gu Nan walked on the streets of ancient times. His face looked calm and natural as he read the notices given by the Evil God Temple in his mind.
An intermediate reward showed that this was still a mid-sized mission, not a large one. However, the upper reward limit for intermediate missions was also very high, so at least Gu Nan wouldn’t lose out.
Gu Nan’s steps quickened. In a few minutes, he had already reached an official residence.
Above the main entrance of the residence, the words “Gu Residence” were written in impressive calligraphy.
Gu Nan’s body in this world was also surnamed Gu, although the name was slightly different. The original body’s owner was the abandoned son of Jiujiang Prefecture’s Gu family.
He was the illegitimate child of the Gu family patriarch, and grew up in the residence as the status of a young master. However, his actual situation wasn’t much better than that of a servant, since he was often beaten and cursed at.
His mother was also a servant. She accidentally became pregnant after the patriarch got drunk and ***, and her status was never elevated to a legitimate wife.
Three days ago, she was beaten to death by the servants of the Gu family mistress, and the original body’s owner was also driven out of the residence.
“This is the ‘trash young master strikes back’ protagonist template… Tang Xuan really took a lot of trouble to find this identity.” Gu Nan recalled the history of this body and laughed unintentionally.
Of course it was no coincidence that Gu Nan reincarnated into this body. Tang Xuan specially chose this body for his identity.
In order to avoid being touched by karma, reincarnators often chose this kind of identity to facilitate settling the original body’s karma—the more miserable the initial situation, the better. They only needed to kill and kill some more.
“Gu Sheng, you actually dared to return?”
When the two guards at the gate of the Gu residence saw Gu Nan, they immediately sneered and walked over.
Gu Sheng was the name of the original body.
Gu Nan lightly shook his head. He didn’t intend to say anything and was about to smash the guards’ heads with his fist, but the Evil God Temple issued a notice again.
｢Evil Event: Take revenge on Jiujiang Prefecture’s Gu family. Can earn up to 8 Guilt Points｣
When he saw this line, Gu Nan’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Guilt Points were always welcomed. He just accumulated 30 Guilt Points. If he could reach 45 Guilt Points and open another equipment page, his overall strength would level up.
The Evil Event that he hadn’t seen for a long time finally appeared, so Gu Nan stopped his attack.
He could earn up to 8 Guilt Points from this mission, but if he wanted to earn the maximum number of Guilt Points, it wasn’t enough to simply make a fuss.
“Where is Gu Weiran? Tell him to crawl out to meet me!” Gu Nan gave a cold
Hmph
as he stood at the gate to the Gu residence, prattling on self-importantly. Gu Weiran was this body’s father, the patriarch of the Gu family.
Hearing this, the guards’ expressions suddenly changed. “Gu Sheng, how dare you! Who gave you the courage to call the Patriarch by name?”
Gu Nan coldly swept a glance over the guard and slapped him in the face. The guard instantly flew out and smashed into a wall.
The guard beside him was stupefied. He pointed to Gu Nan, and his voice trembled slightly, “Gu Sheng, you dare to attack us? The Patriarch is a great Innate Realm master!”
“Innate? What I want to kill today are precisely Innate Realm cultivators!” Gu Nan curled his lips into a sneer.
The guard panicked once he realized that the Patriarch’s name had no effect. He stumbled and crawled as he ran into the residence to hurriedly inform the patriarch.
And Gu Nan just followed him, leisurely walking into the Gu residence with a faint smile tugging on the corners of his mouth.
At noon in broad daylight, people in the Gu residence were bustling about, creating a lively scene. Gu Nan was the only one just standing there silently, out of place with the surrounding atmosphere.
At the same time, not far from the entrance of the Gu residence, the figures of two young girls appeared, one tall and one short.
“Elder Sister Xin, is he the person you were in such a hurry to find?”
“En, that’s him. I thought he‘d be in danger, but it seems that he’s already averted the disaster.”
“I know that person!”
“…”

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Killing the Whole Family
chapters.content:
Gu Nan slowly turned around. Two girls stood in front of him.
One was a girl in white whose height just reached his chest—oh, it should be a loli in white; the other one was a head taller than him, with short hair and purple clothes.
It’s said that there is a pure and beautiful loli standing behind every protagonist. Even when everyone dislikes and despises the protagonist, she will always……
Bam!
The little loli threw a punch towards Gu Nan, but he caught it without extra trouble.
“Eh? How did you become so powerful?” The little loli looked at him in surprise.
The little loli was called Yan Xiaoxiao, who was also a child of an influential family in Jiujiang City, so naturally she knew of Gu Nan’s reputation.
When she saw how Gu Nan sent the guards flying, she couldn’t help wanting to try her hand, but she didn’t expect Gu Nan to block her attack so easily.
Gu Nan’s eyes narrowed slightly, flashing with danger. She knew Gu Nan, but Gu Nan didn’t know her. Against those who dared to attack him……
“Gu Nan.”
Gu Nan’s action suddenly stopped when someone called out his real name. Only then did his gaze turn to the older sister with short hair.
Of course reincarnators’ faces would be different from their original faces, but just as their strength could recover quickly, the appearance and figure of the bodies they possessed would gradually draw closer to their original bodies due to the influence of the soul.
Under careful observation, Gu Nan easily recognized her.
Mo Jiaqi, one of the companions belonging to the Sixth Asteroid Belt Division, was a rare psychic power cultivator, with a name and ability incompatible with this Immortal Demon World.
When she saw Gu Nan, Mo Jiaqi felt actually relieved as well.
She had devoted a lot of time to this mission and didn’t know anything about Gu Nan, so she only regarded him as an ordinary newcomer.
So when she heard that the guide had been killed on the road, she thought something was going to go wrong.
Fortunately, the newcomer seemed to be more vigilant than she imagined.
“Just settle the karma first.”
Gu Nan nodded. Since this little loli was with Mo Jiaqi, naturally it’d be hard to kill her, however, Gu Nan still gave Yan Xiaoxiao a strange smile.
Yan Xiaoxiao was scared by his smile. She looked at her cousin and couldn’t understand what they were doing.
Someone from the Gu family soon appeared, and a group of people came over in a grandiose manner. The leader shouted, “Gu Sheng! How dare you return to the Gu family? Are you deaf to the Patriarch’s orders?”
The leader was this body’s uncle. Gu Nan couldn’t remember his name; he just recalled that this person didn’t treat the body’s original owner very well before.
“En, he can be killed.” Gu Nan nodded in his heart.
However, since Mo Jiaqi came, he still had to walk through the proper procedures. Originally, he was going to directly kill everyone.
“From today on, call me Gu Nan,” Gu Nan stepped forward and spoke loudly.
He then took out a sheet of paper from somewhere, which was crammed full of words. It was an official proclamation.
“Jiujiang City’s Gu family disregarded ethics and ruled as oppressors. They bullied me because I was young and weak, killed my mother, and drove me out of the house… Fortunately, I was blessed by immortals and cultivated……
“Today, I shall kill the one hundred and four people in the Gu family, in order to settle my karma.”
This long address certainly wasn’t written by Gu Nan, but prepared for him by Tang Xuan in advance.
Reincarnators had long found that by means corresponding to the world’s background, if they declared that they would settle their karma, the effect would be better than just taking action without any explanation.
‘Which is to say, even the god of karma likes to listen to such reports,’ Gu Nan silently ridiculed.
Upon hearing those words, the face of Gu Nan’s uncle instantly paled, and even Yan Xiaoxiao couldn’t help but look at Gu Nan in surprise.
“You’ve… actually become one of the Blessed?”
All the righteous path reincarnators come from Radiant Tower, and many people have said similar things, so legends about them already exist in the righteous path. They were even called the “Blessed.”
The so-called Blessed was a person who had been blessed by the teachings of immortals.
Reincarnators usually grew at an incredible speed, which, in the eyes of ordinary people, had no other explanation except being blessed by immortals.
His uncle tried to calm himself down and said, “Gu… Nan, don’t think that you can do whatever you want just because you’ve become one of the Blessed! My Jiujiang City’s Gu family is protected by the righteous path’s Five Sect Alliance!”
Over half of the so-called Five Sect Alliance had been infiltrated by Radiant Tower’s people. They might be fair and just when dealing with native inhabitants’ affairs, but once the matters involved reincarnators, fairness and justice were nothing more than jokes.
“Don’t come over… you……”
Gu Nan threw the proclamation aside and looked at him in confusion. “But I’ve never walked over?”
“Ah…”
The next moment, a red light lit up.
“Fire!”
The fiery red arrow flew out, causing an explosion directly in the crowd and sending blood and pieces of flesh flying everywhere. A broken hand flew out and fell beside Yan Xiaoxiao’s feet.
“Ah!”
The little loli in white had never seen such a gruesome scene before and screamed on the spot. Even Mo Jiaqi became somewhat speechless as she hurriedly covered Yan Xiaoxiao’s eyes—this Gu Nan’s methods were truly cruel……
Although the proclamation spoke about killing the whole family, most reincarnators wouldn’t do so.
After all, they were merely granting their predecessor’s wish, so not everyone had such a murderous heart.
“Who dares to attack the Gu family!” A furious shout thundered out, and a figure quickly came out from the front.
This was the father of Gu Nan’s current body, the head of the Gu family, Gu Weiran.
Mo Jiaqi let out a small sigh of relief when she saw Gu Weiran appear, and her hands, which were covering the little loli’s eyes, also loosened a little—
Now that the family head is here, Gu Nan probably won’t need to use such cruel methods to force them
……
As if to face-slap her, Gu Nan had already shot out another arrow before Gu Weiran even had time to stand firmly.
“Wind!”
After his strength was increased again, the strength of the Four Element Crossbow also became stronger, and the bolt of wind shot out at an incredible speed, hitting Gu Weiran’s heart dead-center.
“You…” Gu Weiran couldn’t even say a complete sentence before his body collapsed loudly.
Mo Jiaqi was flabbergasted. No matter how weak Gu Weiran was, he was still an Innate Realm expert. How could he be killed in one shot?
She couldn’t help but turn to look at Gu Nan’s profile, but she saw no expression on his face, as if he had done a trivial thing.
For Gu Nan though, this was indeed a trivial matter.
Ever since he killed over a dozen Innate Realm cultivators in Langya World and understood the combat mechanisms behind these martial artists, he never put those who used innate energy in his eyes again.
They had to mobilize their internal energy before fighting, or else they would be just like any other ordinary fighter. This was their fatal weakness. Once faced with an attack they didn’t have time to respond to, they could be instantly killed.
In essence, they were like mages in the game, who were usually fragile since they couldn’t maintain their magic shields at all times and needed time to temporarily activate those shields.
As Gu Weiran fell, Gu Nan seemed to become a ball of shadow and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
“So fast…” Mo Jiaqi became stunned again. This newcomer gave her too much surprise, both in terms of strength and in terms of how he dealt with such matters.
As for Yan Xiaoxiao, she was completely stunned. Although she had an extraordinary background, she had never seen such a grisly scene before.

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Crazy Hunter
chapters.content:
Unlike the great karma god who liked to listen to reports, the Evil God Temple never determined players’ Guilt Point rewards based on their words. Guilt Points were only awarded based on their actions.
So Gu Nan also developed the habit of never speaking any superfluous words. He only liked to speak using the crossbow in his hand.
The killing continued, blood splashed everywhere, and the endless blood filled the small courtyard. Yan Xiaoxiao felt as if she was surrounded by blood.
Her inability to escape the scent of blood and the indescribable sensory stimulation she experienced caused her to sink into a wonderful experience.
On one hand, there was the constant urge to vomit, but on the other hand, there was a shudder from the depths of her soul—seeing them deprived of their lives one after another shocked her eyes and astonished her heart.
She didn’t know how much time had passed. The Gu residence became silent, and the sounds of fighting, shouting, or footsteps could no longer be heard. All was quiet.
A strong sense of suffocation struck her, and Yan Xiaoxiao felt dizzy. Her vision gradually grew dark.
“What happened to her?”
“You probably scared her so much that she fainted.”
“Oh, she really is fragile…”
With the last of her consciousness, she seemed to hear this kind of dialogue. That calm tone……
……
“Ah!”
Yan Xiaoxiao suddenly sat up from the big warm bed. Her body was still shaking slightly. Everything she had experienced before seemed to be a dream.
“Are you awake?” Mo Jiaqi was sitting beside her with a faint smile on her face.
Upon seeing her, the little loli finally recalled that all of it wasn’t a dream. That indifferent voice and that person’s figure walking slowly out of the Gu residence courtyard were deeply imprinted in her mind.
The blood, the killing, the loss of life……
“Cousin, I want to join your organization comprised of the Blessed.” Yan Xiaoxiao suddenly turned her head and spoke in an incomparably firm tone.
She had long known that her cousin was one of the Blessed, just like that person. She also knew that the Blessed had an organization mostly composed of other Blessed, but there were also ordinary people.
Of course, what she didn’t know was that natives like her could only ever be outer circle members, but this didn’t matter.
“Oh?” Mo Jiaqi gave her a strange look. “You want to find Gu Nan?”
“I want to… study under him.”
“Why?”
“I feel that I have found the meaning of my existence.”
……
Ten days later, Yan Xiaoxiao followed Mo Jiaqi, looking a little haggard.
They stood in front of a manor. According to Mo Jiaqi, the headquarters of their “organization” was here.
Because she wasn’t a reincarnator, it wasn’t easy for her to even become a member of the organization’s outer circle.
In the last ten days, Yan Xiaoxiao only slept for ten hours in total. She had constantly been undergoing unimaginable special training. And whenever she felt like giving up, she would recall the bloody scene that almost suffocated her.
“Elder Sister Jiaqi.” At the front desk of the manor, a girl in green saw Mo Jiaqi and greeted her with a smile.
“I’m looking for Gu Nan.” After greeting her back, Mo Jiaqi cut to the chase and directly spoke her request.
“Gu Nan?” When she heard his name, the girl in green paused slightly.
“What? He still hasn’t reported for duty yet?” Mo Jiaqi was somewhat doubtful. Ten days had already passed. No matter how slow he was, Gu Nan should’ve already reported to the organization already for duty.
“No, it’s just that he…”
A voice came from behind them, “Mo Jiaqi, do you know that Gu Nan?”
Mo Jiaqi turned to look and saw a familiar face. She was a colleague from a branch office on Ruby Fish Star. Her name was Zhang Yan. They fought side-by-side together several times in the past, and their relationship wasn’t bad.
“Yeah, he’s a newcomer to our branch,” Mo Jiaqi inevitably replied.
“Ah? He’s a newcomer?” Zhang Yan was normally a woman who paid great attention to manners, but now she couldn’t help but open her mouth.
“And he’s even from your branch office…” The gaze Zhang Yan directed at Mo Jiaqi suddenly became strange.
Mo Jiaqi suddenly had a bad feeling. “Did he do something… Did he offend those people from the headquarters?”
The headquarters naturally referred to the Ruby Fish Star headquarters. With her understanding of Gu Nan, it actually wasn’t so strange if he really did offend them.
It would still be fine if it was people from another administrative star’s headquarters, but if he offended people from Ruby Fish Star’s headquarters, then they might make his life difficult even after the mission was over.
“No, on the contrary, Lord Yue Chenxing from headquarters has quite a favorable impression of Gu Nan……”
“Ah?”
After listening to Zhang Yan’s explanation and understanding what Gu Nan had done in the past ten days, Mo Jiaqi felt that she couldn’t quite process the news.
“You mean, ever since he came here, he has hunted at least 20 Innate Realm fighters every day?”
Zhang Yan nodded. “The number has never fallen below 20, and it’s still growing… Many people are betting on how many heads Gu Nan will bring back today.”
Mo Jiaqi was by no means inexperienced, so she knew very well how difficult it was to assassinate one of the six demonic factions’ Innate Realm cultivators.
Every single Innate Realm expert possessed an extraordinary identity, so it wasn’t easy to approach them without being discovered. More importantly, it was very troublesome to escape after the assassination. After all, he would be inside enemy territory.
Although she had seen Gu Nan’s crossbow in action before and knew that he could kill Innate Realm fighters like killing chickens, this was still……
Instead, Yan Xiaoxiao’s gaze lit up from beside her.
“He’s back, Gu Nan is back!”
“Oh? How many heads did he bring back? “
“I don’t know, enough to fill an entire sack. I’m still counting…”
“Oh!”
A noise came from the door, and several people looked over simultaneously. They saw a familiar figure standing there.
Today Gu Nan was dressed in all white, without any liveliness typical of the mortal world, as if he was a young master out on an excursion rather than an assassin who killed people like flies.
“Eh? How come there are only 17 today…”
“Only 17? Haha, I win… No wait, this is Lin Tianyun! It’s Lin Tianyun’s head!”
“Lin Tianyun? Isn’t he a great master at the peak of Innate Realm Sixth Stage?”
“That’s the one…”
Gu Nan stood aside and watched them exclaim while counting the number of heads. He nodded in realization. “So he was at the peak of Innate Realm. No wonder he was somewhat hard to kill.”
He really wasn’t easy to kill. This peak Innate Realm cultivator costed him a lot of effort. Finally, he had to trick his opponent into the mountains and use guerrilla warfare for half the day to kill him, which was why he killed fewer people today.
But Gu Nan didn’t suffer any losses because the stronger the target, the higher the reward.
｢Side Quest: Kill the six demonic factions’ ‘Innate Realm and above’ cultivators｣
This was the only side quest Gu Nan received so far, and it was also the reason for his crazy hunting spree in the past ten days. Unfortunately, almost all of these hunts only provided evil points, and targets that rewarded Guilt Points were pitifully few.
His original 31 evil points had now risen to 450 evil points, but he only had 35 Guilt Points in total, which meant he’d only gained 5 Guilt Points from ten days of fighting.
“Mo Jiaqi? Long time no see.” Seeing Mo Jiaqi, Gu Nan immediately stepped forward and greeted with a smile.
The current him seemed to be nothing more than a friendly neighborhood teenager, where no trace of bloodthirst or coldness could be seen.
Mo Jiaqi looked at him deeply and took a deep breath. “It hasn’t been a very long time… Right, there’s one request I want to ask of you.”
“What is it?”
Mo Jiaqi pushed Yan Xiaoxiao forward. “This is Yan Xiaoxiao, she wants to…”
Before she even finished, Gu Nan suddenly felt a gentle vibration from the Evil God Temple, and a line of text appeared.
｢Side Quest: Accept Yan Xiaoxiao as a disciple and train her into a strong killer. Reward to be determined｣

chapters.title: Chapter 28: A Murderous Heart
chapters.content:
Mo Jiaqi never thought that Gu Nan would be this easy to deal with. He immediately agreed almost as soon as she started speaking.
This satisfied her. Of course, she thought that he agreed out of respect for her as his senior from the same branch office.
In fact, after learning about Gu Nan’s terrifying accomplishments, she had no pride as his senior anymore. After all, strength decides the hierarchy in this world.
If it wasn’t for the fact that Yan Xiaoxiao was an important karma of hers in this world, she wouldn’t have stubbornly tried to handle this by herself.
“Yan Xiaoxiao?”
“Here… Teacher.” In the inner hall, Yan Xiaoxiao stood in front of Gu Nan with some nervousness and replied with her head down.
Actually, she didn’t quite understand why the other party didn’t allow her to call him “Master” and insisted on using such a strange word like “Teacher.”
Gu Nan nodded gently and looked calmly into her eyes. “First of all, you must understand one thing… The current me is not the same person as the former me.”
It was common knowledge among the natives, that a Blessed person before and after being blessed by immortals, was considered two totally different people.
Yan Xiaoxiao nodded vigorously when she heard this.
Gu Nan showed a trace of a smile. He was actually quite curious about the sudden appearance of this side quest. After all, he had transmigrated for a long time, yet this was the first time that a new side quest had appeared.
The so-called side quests were things that would have a significant impact on the main mission.
This young girl in front of him… will have a great impact on the main mission of exterminating the six demonic factions? This meant that even without his appearance, she would have still been an important character.
Whenever this happened, Gu Nan experienced the wonderful feeling of participating in history.
“You said you want to study under me, so what do you want to learn?” Gu Nan asked Yan Xiaoxiao kindly, but there was no emotion in his eyes, only calmness.
“I don’t know either.” Yan Xiaoxiao hesitated. “That day… After the events at the Gu residence, I had this thought.”
Gu Nan raised his eyebrows. “You want to learn how to kill people?”
As if her true thoughts had been stabbed by a sharp arrow, Yan Xiaoxiao’s breathing quickened a little, and she took a deep breath. “……Yes.”
“Okay, then come with me.”
……
In the territory of the five righteous sects, everyone in Radiant Tower’s southern branch suddenly found a strange thing.
Gu Nan, formerly known as the “Craziest Hunter,” suddenly vanished without a trace. Not only did he stop attacking demonic path Innate Realm cultivators, but he also rarely returned to the branch office anymore.
A few days ago, someone curiously asked him why.
“Oh, I’ve killed almost all the Innate Realm experts around here.”
“……”
Gu Nan wasn’t exaggerating. Innate Realm cultivators weren’t cabbages that popped up all over the place. Almost all the Innate Realm warriors in the major southern cities had been killed by him.
Even if Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t appear, he still would’ve stopped recently or ran to other places to continue his hunting.
The six demonic factions had also realized this, but they merely felt lucky that this god of slaughter was finally willing to take a break.
In a hidden abode, three men and two women were standing in the shadows.
“That fellow… is he finally willing to stop?”
“En.” A man wearing a blue crown smiled bitterly. “As expected of someone from a major organization like Radiant Tower. Just when we thought we could fight them on equal ground, this kind of person appeared.”
“It can’t be helped. After all, we’re not a full-time reincarnator organization. We can only rely on the natives… These natives cannot cope with powers they find difficult to understand after all.”
The biggest difference between natives and reincarnators lies in their scope of knowledge; they had never seen many of the reincarnators’ techniques before.
“Gu Nan… It’s actually him? If I’d known that, I would’ve sent him back no matter the risk earlier.”
A female voice interrupted. If Gu Nan was here, he’d definitely recognize this young girl as the one who tried to launch a sneak attack on him after he just reincarnated.
“Tang You, it’s too late to say that now… and looking at the present situation, you might not be able to beat him. “
“……”
“Alright, in any case, the people at the top will soon send a Prodigious Realm cultivator here to try to send this Gu Nan out.” A man who seemed to be the leader interrupted the conversation.
After a pause, he said, “Recently, there is a report from below that someone is killing civilians in our area. Tang You, go investigate.”
Tang You, the girl who fought Gu Nan before, wondered, “I understand…… Just who would kill even civilians?”
“That’s exactly what you need to investigate.”
……
Within the six demonic factions’ sphere of influence, a figure was flying around in a small village in the countryside, wantonly killing ordinary civilians in the village.
A girl dressed in black, with a simple crossbow in her left hand and a dagger in her right hand.
Her movements were very concise. She took away each life with almost every attack, and there were few redundant movements. Her killing efficiency was also very high.
“To become a killer, the first thing you must learn is not the skillset or the related knowledge, but a heart that is apathetic to life.
“After you get used to killing, that’s when you can start to learn the skills.”
With Teacher’s cold and indifferent words constantly echoing in her heart, Yan Xiaoxiao restrained her instinctive reaction while carrying out the massacre—nausea, fear, and… excitement.
This was the sixth village she slaughtered.
Originally, she thought that because she had the power of a peak Acquired Realm fighter and was a famous genius who had received Mo Jiaqi’s special training, how could a group of ordinary people pose any trouble to her?
However, reality taught her a deep lesson.
Killing people was nowhere near as simple as she had imagined. Everyone could easily burst out with amazing potential when faced with life or death situations. This was especially dangerous for her when there were a large number of opponents.
In the first village, when she almost vomited because she saw the first person’s intestines exposed, more than ten big men rushed up from behind, each with a weapon in his hand.
Even the crude agricultural “weapons” brought her considerable harm. The nearest rake was only half an inch away from her neck.
Fortunately, Teacher was there…
Yan Xiaoxiao’s movements paused slightly and she looked back at the white figure standing on the side of the road—
’Because he likes to wear white clothes, he won’t allow me to wear them. He really is……’
“Don’t get distracted, there are two more over there.” Gu Nan’s lazy voice rang out, “If one escapes, you won’t get dinner tonight.”
‘You’re speaking as if I actually have any appetite……’ Yan Xiaoxiao secretly rolled her eyes. She couldn’t compare with her teacher after all, who could still gorge himself even after a bloody slaughter.
But she very earnestly went towards that side.
Not only to complete the tasks that Teacher assigned, but also… to be loyal to her own deepest thoughts.
‘Kill them… Don’t let even a single person escape… Kill everyone here……’
A kind of unspeakable excitement began to occupy Yan Xiaoxiao’s tiny body, and the endless desire to kill reverberated in her mind. Just when she was about to lose herself in that desire, a pair of calm eyes appeared in front of her.
‘Those are Teacher’s eyes… Even in the midst of the craziest slaughter, he still has that sort of gaze.’
Yan Xiaoxiao’s remaining reason told her this.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: The Last Stop
chapters.content:
“What happened to me earlier?”
“In your words, you were suffering a Qi deviation.”
“And in Teacher’s words?”
“It got to your head.”
In a small inn, Yan Xiaoxiao woke up on a bed again, but this time Gu Nan was sitting next to her instead of Mo Jiaqi.
Gu Nan held a bowl of rice congee and smiled lightly. “What’s ‘got to your head’? You won’t understand even if I explain… Do you want porridge?”
Yan Xiaoxiao blinked. “Can Teacher feed me?”
“No.”
“Oh…”
After half a day of struggling, Yan Xiaoxiao finally felt that she had recovered some strength. She was rapidly recovering from the exhaustion brought about by the close combat fighting.
The gaze that Gu Nan leveled at her carried an indescribable sort of appreciation, as if looking at a piece of beautiful jade covered in dust.
He never believed that there were any coincidences in the world. Everything had its own rules.
Yan Xiaoxiao was born a madman—a natural-born homicidal maniac and a fanatic. Even without Gu Nan’s appearance, sooner or later, she would’ve awakened that desire deep within her soul.
And she also existed independently as a side quest. It was obviously not too difficult for a top player like Gu Nan to guess the origin of her identity.
“Then, you only have one last chance.”
Yan Xiaoxiao was shocked to hear this and immediately realized, “Are we going to reach our destination?”
“En, there’s one last stop.” Gu Nan nodded lightly. He didn’t actually take Yan Xiaoxiao out for a random stroll. They were traveling all the way to the center of the Immortal Demon Continent.
Tang Xuan was there. According to their earlier agreement, after adapting to this world, Gu Nan already planned to go to the continent’s central region to assist Tang Xuan.
“Come with me.”
……
Moments later, Gu Nan walked down the street side by side with Yan Xiaoxiao, accompanied by a beautiful woman.
“So Gentleman Gu and his sister are from Jiujiang City?”
“Yeah. It’s our first time in the central region, so we still have to trouble Lady Shangguan to be our guide… Pardon us for bothering Lady Shangguan,” Gu Nan said leisurely with a small smile.
The woman addressed as “Lady Shangguan” covered her mouth and chuckled. “It’s no bother.”
Whether it was the past life or this one, Gu Nan’s appearance had always been good, and it wasn’t difficult for him to attract bees and butterflies. Yan Xiaoxiao, on the other hand, had an unnatural expression as she occasionally studied Lady Shangguan with a strange gaze.
Shangguan Xian merely thought of her as an aristocratic young lady who rarely went out, but she never would’ve imagined that when this little girl was occasionally sizing her up, her thoughts were……
‘If I want to kill her, how long will it take? How many moves will I need? How can I pull the wool over people’s eyes… Oh my, what am I thinking?!’
Yan Xiaoxiao’s brain was full of flights of fancy
[1]
as she followed behind the two, but their conversation constantly flowed into her ears.
“So this is the famous Red Tide Levee… This one has long heard of its fame. It truly deserves its reputation.”
“Is Gentleman also interested in the legend of the famous courtesan Qin Hongshi?”
“Of course… not.”
“Ah……”
Time passed gradually as the three strolled around. In the evening, the three of them had a few drinks in a restaurant, and Gu Nan bid farewell to Shangguan Xian.
“Lady Shangguan, thank you for your trouble today.”
“If Gentleman doesn’t disdain it, there’s no harm in calling me Xian’er……” Shangguan Xian’s face slightly flushed. Nobody knew whether it was because she drank a few glasses of wine or because of her words.
“Then… this humble one will overstep his bounds. Xian’er, be careful on the way home.” Gu Nan showed a slightly dazed expression on his face, but if one looked carefully, they would find nothing but cold detachment in the depths of his eyes.
Shangguan Xian gently nodded. “Will Gentleman leave for the central region tomorrow?”
Gu Nan paused, as if hesitating. After a while, he finally said, “We siblings… will stay for another day.”
“Ah! That’s truly great… Tomorrow Xian’er will visit the Red Lake with Gentleman again.”
“Okay……”
……
Shangguan Xian left joyfully. Gu Nan and Yan Xiaoxiao watched her leave. It wasn’t until her figure disappeared completely that Gu Nan spoke with a light smile.
“What do you think of this woman?”
“Is Teacher asking about how to kill her?”
“No, from an ordinary friend’s point of view… or from your old point of view.”
Yan Xiaoxiao hesitated a little. Although only a short ten or so days had passed, when recalling her carefree self from before, she felt as if that was a lifetime ago.
Sometimes she’d think about it—she gave up her illustrious family background, gave up her close friends, and gave up her loving mother and strict father… And instead embarked on the road of a killer without hesitation.
‘In my home right now, they would’ve already discovered that I’m missing and started to anxiously look for me, right?
‘Father, Mother……’
A pair of hands gently patted her on the shoulder, taking her back to the room. It was Gu Nan.
“Sleep well. You’ll be fine tomorrow.”
……
The next day, Shangguan Xian was indeed on time for their appointment. In the process of sightseeing, she keenly sensed the difference in Yan Xiaoxiao.
This little girl seemed to have become more cheerful… She was indeed just a little girl who was afraid of strangers. Once she got to know Shangguan Xian, she became very cute.
A small smile appeared on Shangguan Xian’s delicate face.
