Ever since she recalled her past, the softness inside Yan Xiaoxiao’s heart seemed to be stirred up. She began to revert to the lively girl she had been before, while the personality that was obsessed with killing seemed to be temporarily sealed.
Once again, the three came to the Red Tide Levee, but this time it was dusk, and the Red Lake under the setting sun was particularly charming.
The golden sunlight fell on the surface of the lake, which set off the fiery red color of the lake as it rose and fell along with the tide, which was the origin of the name of “Red Tide.”
“The Red Lake is truly worthy of its name.” Gu Nan stood on the levee and sighed with emotion.
Shangguan Xian stood side by side with him, one hand unobtrusively holding his arm, as if she was also intoxicated by this amazing scenery. “Yeah……”
“Xian’er… Say, does this red tide look like something else?”
“Oh? What is it?” Shangguan Xian showed a curious expression. Along the way, she had already become accustomed to Gu Nan’s random quips.
“Blood.”
“Huh?”
A bloody flower exploded on Shangguan Xian’s back. She didn’t understand what happened at all. Only Yan Xiaoxiao’s face was full of horror—she was standing beside the two.
The shadow at Gu Nan’s feet slowly stretched forward until it was behind Shangguan Xian, gradually turning into a human figure and ruthlessly stabbing the girl’s back with a blade.
“This is……”
Yan Xiaoxiao couldn’t help but look towards Gu Nan, only to see his emotionless face. He was already wearing a dark gold earring on his right ear, and his entire person looked very eerie.
In the next moment, a monocle hung on Gu Nan’s face, and he calmly looked into the distance. “We only stayed for one more day, but a guest has already arrived……”
“Huh? What are you looking at?” Gu Nan turned to look at Yan Xiaoxiao, who seemed about to collapse.
Shortly after, he showed a faint smile. “Oh, I forgot to tell you: this is the last stop!”
Notes:
[1]
An unrealistic idea or fantastic notion, a pipe dream; the idiom uses flight as in “the soaring of the imagination”

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Prodigious Realm!
chapters.content:
Slaughtering a village and slaughtering a small city were completely different concepts.
In the former case, one only had to block several main routes to ensure that no one could escape and that news wouldn’t leak for at least a few days, but in the latter case……
Tang You never thought that the murderer would be so crazy that they’d start killing directly in the city.
She’s afraid that after today, the other party’s vicious reputation will spread all over the world…… ‘Who exactly can this be?’
In the city overflowing with a river of blood, when Tang You found the source of the killing, she only saw a girl dressed in black with a face that clearly still had childish features…… She might not even be an adult yet?
“Long time no see.” A voice sounded beside her ear.
Tang You suddenly turned around but saw a familiar figure standing to the side.
“Gu Nan! So it was you……”
“Oh? What do you mean by ‘so it was you’?” Gu Nan asked innocently.
Tang You felt her lips tremble. It was a manifestation of the universal anger a human felt at seeing other humans being deprived of their lives.
“These people have no enmity with you. We’re only here for missions, yet you’ve done such things that hurt both Heaven and Earth. Do you not fear incurring Heaven’s wrath?”
Gu Nan thought about it seriously. “In a sense, I don’t fear that.”
Evil Gods were an existence that belonged to the Western fantasy system, so of course they didn’t fear Heaven’s wrath, which was a characteristic of Eastern fantasy systems.
“You…… Hurry up and tell her to stop!” Tang You huffed.
Although Tang You’s organization was assigned to the six demonic factions, this didn’t mean that they were evil demons—they had simply come to complete a mission.
Gu Nan smiled but didn’t speak. He gave her a reply through his actions.
“Wind!”
The arrow of wind created a gale that was hard to see with the naked eye, which shot straight towards Tang You, but ultimately, Tang You wasn’t a loser like Gu Weiran, so she jumped up immediately.
“Innate Realm Sixth Stage, hm?”
The corners of Gu Nan’s lips curled into a cold smile. A red light flashed on the Observer Eyepiece, and Tang You was instantly parsed into data in his eyes. None of her movements could escape Gu Nan’s calculation.
Tang You, who was forced to jump by the wind arrow, had actually fallen into a disadvantage, because it was the hardest for people to control themselves in midair.
“Here it is!”
Gu Nan’s eyes seemed to see through all the fog, and a fiery red arrow shot forth. Even though Tang You changed her falling direction several times, she was still shot in the abdomen.
Boom!
Tang You was sent flying by the blast, but a fierce look flashed through her eyes. She had no intention of admitting defeat. ‘It’s nothing more than a superficial injury, just wait until I……’
Her eyes gradually widened, because she saw a figure quickly breaking out of the smoke from the explosion—it was Gu Nan.
‘He can even calculate where I’ll land after the explosion?’
Tang You’s mind just had such a thought when Gu Nan’s fist smashed into her face.
What happened next was only to be expected. To begin with, Gu Nan’s strength wasn’t weak. Although Tang You was a distinguished Innate Realm Sixth Stage expert, her ability to take a beating wasn’t very high.
After several heavy punches from Gu Nan, most of her fighting strength had disappeared, leaving her with only the strength to bitterly defend herself.
‘So this is Innate Realm Sixth Stage…… It’s really weak.’ Gu Nan shook his head and sighed while continuing with his punches.
It’s not that he was arrogant, but that he had already surpassed the Innate Realm. An Evil God’s physique was too strong, and although its explosive force was only at Innate Realm Fourth Stage, it didn’t mean that it couldn’t win against those at Innate Realm Sixth Stage.
Even for Innate Realm Sixth Stage fighters, how many opportunities did they have to fully unleash their power? If they had to hastily defend, then of course they were no match for Gu Nan. After all, every punch of his contained this much strength.
Therefore, once the battle entered Gu Nan’s rhythm, his fights against people at Innate Realm Sixth Stage were like bullying children.
However, just when Tang You was completely suppressed by him, an indescribable feeling suddenly appeared in his mind. Gu Nan’s expression changed slightly, and he didn’t even have time to care about the opponent in front of him as he hurriedly flickered to the side.
Almost at the same time as he left, a dark shadow fell down. It was a long blade and a man with sideburns.
Tang You saw him appear and breathed a great sigh of relief. “Elder Wen.”
Elder Wen nodded gently and protected her behind him. He looked at Gu Nan with a smile. “Your name is Gu Nan? I don’t remember a person like you in Ruby Fish Star’s vicinity.”
Immortal Demon World had already been open for two or three years, so it wasn’t surprising that the other party knew Radiant Tower was the enemy organization and that Gu Nan was from Radiant Tower’s branch office near Ruby Fish Star.
Even in Star Realm, peak Innate Realm experts would still be pretty famous.
But a person who can talk like this……
“Prodigious Realm?” A slightly serious expression finally appeared on Gu Nan’s face. This was the first time he faced a Prodigious Realm martial artist.
“That’s right. You might as well kill yourself and leave this world.” Elder Wen said indifferently, “Of course, if you want to experience the power of a Prodigious Realm cultivator, that’s fine too. After all, such opportunities are hard to come by.”
A world as big as Immortal Demon World allowed reincarnators to divide their spirit into two. Half of their soul would enter the world, and the other half would be preserved in the gap in between worlds.
The advantage of this was that even if they died inside the plane, they could still preserve their life. They would only need some time to recover.
However, once a reincarnator died inside the Immortal Demon World, the world would stamp a mark onto their soul, and the person would never be able to enter this world again.
For example, Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan from Gu Nan’s branch office were originally both inside this mission, but Zhang Dongsheng died in an accident, so Tang Xuan was the only one left here.
The Observer Eyepiece constantly scanned Elder Wen but couldn’t obtain much information.
The other party seemed to be completely closed-off from the rest of the world, and very little power leaked out, so naturally he couldn’t get any useful data.
[Prodigious Realm individuals are self-contained worlds……] Gu Nan remembered the description of Prodigious Realm cultivators in the database.
If we say that Acquired Realm fighters are ordinary people and Innate Realm individuals are extremely powerful humans, then Prodigious Realm cultivators would begin to transcend the category of human beings.
At best, the peak of Innate Realm was called “inhuman”, but Prodigious Realm cultivators were truly no longer human.
Moving mountains, filling up the sea, controlling fire, and manipulating thunder……
Although Gu Nan’s fights against Innate Realm Sixth Stage experts were the same as beating dogs, in the eyes of Prodigious Realm cultivators, they could casually crush any number of Innate Realm fighters.
Gu Nan’s gaze swept around, but he couldn’t find traces of Yan Xiaoxiao anymore. He couldn’t help smiling a little at that.
This little girl was very clever, so it was inevitable that she would escape as soon as possible. Staying behind would only drag him down for no reason.
‘Even if you’re at the Prodigious Realm, you still may not catch me, someone with the power of shadows……’Gu Nan looked at Elders Wen with gloomy eyes as he thought to himself.
And Elder Wen seemed to be in no hurry, as if he was certain that Gu Nan wouldn’t be able to jump out of his hands.
On the other hand, Tang You was very relaxed right now. It was common sense that it was impossible for Innate Realm experts to defeat Prodigious Realm cultivators, unless in some special circumstances when the Prodigious Realm cultivator suppressed some of their own power.
Just as she relaxed and looked at Gu Nan, Gu Nan suddenly moved.
“So fast!”
Gu Nan displayed a speed that made Tang You’s jaw drop. She had never seen an Innate Realm expert with such fast speed before. Gu Nan appeared before her almost in the blink of an eye.
“You……” Tang You couldn’t believe that in front of a distinguished Prodigious Realm cultivator, the other party’s goal was actually herself!
She seemed to see Gu Nan’s sneer at the corner of his mouth. However……
“Hmph!”
A cold snort came from the side, and Gu Nan was sent flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 31: The Legendary Bug
chapters.content:
In fact, Tang You hadn’t actually seen Prodigious Realm cultivators attack before. Not every organization was as large as Radiant Tower. Among the ordinary organizations, Prodigious Realm individuals were already aloof and remote existences, so they rarely made public appearances.
However, this didn’t affect her confidence in Elder Wen, because this young elder named Wen Changfeng ranked quite high among all the elders.
Gu Nan gradually stood up amidst the ruins in the distance and stared at the other party with a dangerous glint in his eyes.
‘Air pressure? As expected, the so-called Prodigious Realm cultivators are nothing more than Tier 3 Evil Gods……’ Gu Nan’s expression remained unchanged, but he was smiling coldly in his heart.
With the Observer Eyepiece, he had already noticed the change before he was blasted away and clearly saw what just happened.
When he was only half a step away from Tang You, the air in front of him suddenly became highly compressed, and the strong pressure was like a heavy punch, which sent him flying.
‘This Elder Wen should be someone with an ability related to air, but he clearly just entered Tier 3, and his control over his core skills is still very weak.’
‘Otherwise, he could’ve simply detonated the high air pressure inside my body and blown me to pieces.’
It wasn’t like he couldn’t collect any data at all from Prodigious Realm cultivators. Gu Nan noticed a long time ago that Prodigious Realm cultivators were very similar to Tier 3 players in his previous life’s game.
Starting from the Prodigious Realm, martial artists began to be called “cultivators” and would awaken their own attributes, as well as the corresponding “innate ability”. For example, Elder Wen’s skill “Air Explosion” was a kind of “innate ability”.
This was extremely similar to how Evil God players could gradually learn skills starting from Tier 3.
“Oh? Still not dead?”
Elder Wen was wearing a blue shirt, but he had a big face and sideburns. Coupled with his western-style tone of voice from Star Realm, he didn’t seem to fit in Immortal Demon World.
But Gu Nan was not in the mood to consider this, because he had already felt an astonishing amount of killing intent.
Elder Wen was so fast that he appeared in front of Gu Nan almost in the blink of an eye. He casually stretched out a hand and instantly locked the air around Gu Nan.
Gu Nan had the urge to roll his eyes. ‘It’s way too easy for ability users who control the air to bully lower level people…… Fortunately, I had good foresight a long time ago.’
The dark golden earring on his right ear flashed faintly, and Gu Nan turned into a ball of shadows and quickly fled.
Wen Changfeng was truly surprised now. He said strangely, “Rudimentary innate ability? To think that you were able to comprehend your innate ability to such a degree with your mere Innate Realm Fourth Stage cultivation.”
When she heard this, Tang You’s eyes behind him couldn’t help flickering. “So he’s only at Innate Realm Fourth Stage……”
But after seeing that ball of shadows, she really didn’t think she could win anymore. There would always be some geniuses who could make people speechless in this world. This Gu Nan was obviously such a person.
That he was able to comprehend a rudimentary form of his innate ability meant that he was only half a step away from Prodigious Realm. What he lacked was nothing more than to further accumulate his cultivation.
If Gu Nan knew their thoughts, he would definitely laugh.
His skill wasn’t any sort of rudimentary innate ability. Instead, it was a genuine core skill, which was the equivalent of a Prodigious Realm cultivator’s innate ability, except that he relied on a piece of equipment to acquire this skill.
“Can you escape even if you have a rudimentary innate ability?” Wen Changfeng’s expression calmed down, and he spoke with a light smile.
In the next moment, his figure suddenly soared and started floating in midair, then quickly shot forth in a certain direction.
Gu Nan, who was lurking on the ground, became dumbfounded. He actually forgot the most annoying thing about air ability users—by controlling the air pressure, they could fly quickly even when they were only Tier 3.
Gu Nan’s brow wrinkled. He knew that the other party was conducting a carpet search, constantly swooping down at low altitudes as he quickly investigated the surroundings.
His movement speed wasn’t fast when using Hidden Shadow, which was an obvious disadvantage. If it went on like this, the other party would find him sooner or later……
‘I can only try that…… I hope it still works the same here as it did in the game.’ Gu Nan kept thinking about countermeasures in his mind but ultimately found that he could only take a gamble.
The gap between Tier 2 and Tier 3 was really big, especially when the enemy also possessed such a special ability.
Even if he used all 450 evil points in his hand right now, there was no equipment that could help him turn the tide, be it a necklace or defensive equipment.
Since the power within the scope of the system didn’t work, Gu Nan had no choice but to use some methods unique to players, such as—triggering a bug.
The Four Element Crossbow was very famous in the game not only because it was powerful, but also because it produced several famous bugs, one of which was……
“Wind!”
A teal arrow came from below, but Wen Changfeng shook his head slightly. ‘This youth is still too impatient…… Although the result won’t be any different.’
He casually set off another air explosion with a wave of his hand, shattering the wind arrow. Wen Changfeng’s figure quickly rushed down and appeared in front of Gu Nan in the blink of an eye.
“You still won’t admit defeat?” Wen Changfeng looked at Gu Nan with a calm smile.
In any case, he couldn’t truly kill the other party. If Gu Nan was receptive to it, he didn’t mind making friends with him.
As long as the other party obediently left this plane, their mission wouldn’t be affected anymore. Plus, he could also make friends with a genius who could already comprehend rudimentary innate ability even at Innate Realm Fourth Stage. What could he have against that?
Gu Nan sensed the air around him rapidly solidify, and his movements became more and more difficult; he couldn’t even turn his head.
He simply looked straight ahead and said, “See my crossbow? It can create explosive arrows.”
Wen Changfeng couldn’t help laughing involuntarily. “The air pressure around you right now has already exceeded 20 standard units. No explosive can exist stably under these conditions unless you can create one out of thin air……”
Boom!
Before his words even finished, a terrifying explosion sounded, and Wen Changfeng was blasted away.
Poor Elder Wen’s face was full of bewilderment, and he couldn’t understand what happened at all. However, he saw a figure breaking out of the smoke. It was Gu Nan, who had ripped through the high air pressure.
Gu Nan was also affected by the explosion, but his Evil God physique was extremely strong, so why would he care about this minor injury?
A sneer appeared at the corner of Gu Nan’s mouth. Wen Changfeng instantly sensed the simultaneous appearance of over ten energy spots.
‘Not good.’
He tried to remove the high air pressure, but it was already too late.
A far more terrifying explosion occurred, which affected even Tang You, who was standing in the distance. The huge shockwave lifted her up, and she fell heavily to the ground.
But Tang You didn’t have time to worry about that. She hurriedly climbed up from the ground and rushed to the center of the explosion.
“Elder Wen, Elder Wen!”
“Cough! Cough cough…… I’m fine.” Wen Changfeng’s voice came from the front.
Tang You sighed in relief, then hurriedly came forward to help Wen Changfeng up.
“But that Gu Nan’s figure disappeared…… Has he been blown to smithereens?”
“He escaped.” Elder Wen showed a bitter smile. “It was a miscalculation on my part…… but this boy really has a lot of methods. He can create inexplicable explosions and has a physique that won’t die even after enduring this kind of explosion……”
Wen Changfeng stood up and dusted his body. He said quietly, “Have headquarters strengthen their guard. I think this Gu Nan…… will reappear in front of us very soon.”

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Side Quest Completed
chapters.content:
On a small rural path, a dark shadow quickly drifted by and turned into a human shape. This was Gu Nan, who had just escaped from the hands of a Prodigious Realm cultivator.
As soon as Gu Nan’s human form appeared, he couldn’t help falling to the ground and coughing violently.
It was no laughing matter to simultaneously detonate over a dozen explosive arrows around himself. Even with his Evil God physique, it was still a bit much.
However, he knew that the other party wouldn’t be much better off than him. Both of them would need to recuperate for a few days before their injured internal organs could recover from the explosion’s shockwaves.
Purely in terms of physique alone, he believed that he wasn’t much worse than those in the Prodigious Realm.
‘To think that the Four Element Crossbow’s bug can actually be used in reality……’ Gu Nan raised the crossbow in his hand and showed a strange smile.
《Evil God Cultivation》was a highly realistic game, but no matter how realistic it was, as long as it was a game, there must be some unscientific places, such as the creation of elemental arrows.
Taking the fire arrow as an example, its principle is to inject explosive power into the arrow, so where does this power come from?
Can’t be explained.
According to common sense, unstable explosives couldn’t exist under high air pressure and couldn’t be produced under such conditions, because they would lose control during the manufacturing process.
However, the Four Element Crossbow skipped the “manufacturing” process and basically created something out of thin air, which gave the arrows an explosive attribute.
And once the fire arrow appeared, it would directly explode because of the high air pressure in the surroundings, so there was no need to shoot it at all.
In other words, it was the high air pressure made by Wen Changfeng that gave Gu Nan the “portable hand grenades” skill, which gave him a chance to escape.
‘In the end, I’m still too weak……’ For the first time since his transmigration, Gu Nan was dissatisfied with his own strength.
‘If I’ve already reached Tier 3 and learned a few random skills, I can pwn these so-called Prodigious Realm contestants with one hand.’
As a great Tier 16 Evil God in his previous life, he was qualified to say such a thing.
Putting away his strange equipment, Gu Nan found his direction and continued his journey.
‘First, find Tang Xuan in the central region and recuperate. With Radiant Tower’s power, it shouldn’t be difficult to find Yan Xiaoxiao…… Whether I can advance quickly will depend on this little fellow.’
……
Yan Xiaoxiao walked alone on the busy street. Her hair was messy and her eyes were somewhat dull, much like a girl who got lost from her family.
She was very beautiful, so she easily attracted the attention of some vagabonds.
So at a hidden corner, three young men stopped her. “Little sister……”
Snap.
Yan Xiaoxiao stretched out a hand and gently broke the person’s neck, so the rest of his words were stuck in his throat.
The other two stared blankly, then quickly turned pale. They were just street punks. When had they ever seen such a clean killing technique before?
Yan Xiaoxiao’s movements were precise, efficient, and not sloppy at all. She was like a killer who had mastered the art of assassination for many years.
But who could have imagined that less than a month ago, she was still an innocent and ordinary little girl?
Yan Xiaoxiao coldly watched the two escape without any other expression. She casually threw the corpse aside and walked out of the shadows, continuing forward.
It’s been almost three days since the battle in the small city. Every time she recalled the situation that day, her heart became very complicated.
“This is betrayal.”
Yan Xiaoxiao said such to herself.
She betrayed her teacher, and when faced with a strong enemy, she cowardly abandoned Teacher and fled on her own…… but another voice in her heart told her: ‘It should be like this.’
Killers should accurately judge the situation. Escaping was the best way to help Teacher. Not only was staying behind useless, but it may even drag Teacher down.
‘Perhaps Teacher originally could’ve escaped, but had to stay behind because of me…… Is that really possible? That’s a Prodigious Realm cultivator……’
No matter how innocent or naive she was, Yan Xiaoxiao still understood the meaning of the words “Prodigious Realm”.
On one hand, she felt guilty toward Teacher, but on the other hand, her heart was wavering.
The heart of a killer, which had been formed by slaughtering six villages, was shattered by Teacher in just two days. When the blood flower bloomed and Shangguan Xian’s body slowly fell down, she really wanted to ask Teacher……
“So killers can even kill innocent friends at will?”
‘If this is the case, then will Teacher one day, towards me as well……’
While letting her imagination run wild, Yan Xiaoxiao inadvertently came to the city gate. A new notice was posted on the bulletin board.
Yan Xiaoxiao originally had no interest in these, but when she took a casual glance, she seemed to see her own portrait on it, so she hurriedly went up to take a closer look.
At the sight, her face grew paler and paler.
[Homicidal demon…… The six demonic factions’ revenge…… Jiujiang City’s Yan family……]
……
In a secret manor in the central region, Gu Nan stood up slowly after meditation and spat out a polluted breath, but his face showed a happy smile.
After three days of recuperation, the majority of his previous injuries finally disappeared. At the very least, it wouldn’t affect his combat ability anymore.
He pushed open the door and walked out. A familiar figure was already standing at the door. It was Tang Xuan, someone he hadn’t seen for a while.
“How is it? Still can’t find Yan Xiaoxiao?”
Tang Xuan shook her head, which gave Gu Nan a slight headache. This era was even more behind than he had imagined. The enormous five righteous sects couldn’t even find a single girl’s whereabouts……
When Tang Xuan saw him like this, she couldn’t help laughing. “Although we couldn’t find the person, the matter you requested has been done.”
“Oh?”
“News of the homicidal demon from before, which is Jiujiang City’s Yan Xiaoxiao, is now known all over the world. As expected, the six demonic factions really did send people to avenge their fallen…… but I didn’t expect them to use such a cruel method.”
After a pause, Tang Xuan frowned. “I thought they would kidnap Yan Xiaoxiao’s parents and force her to show up……”
Gu Nan said with a smile, “I was the one who gave Mo Jiaqi the order to secretly slaughter the entire Yan family and frame the six demonic factions.”
“Mo Jiaqi would listen to your orders?” Tang Xuan immediately stared in disbelief.
“Disguised as your orders, of course.” Gu Nan just shrugged carelessly, as though his actions were proper and to be expected.
“You……” Tang Xuan couldn’t help getting angry. If it was before, she would’ve already slapped the offender, but now, she merely fought back her anger and tried to calm herself down.
The reason was very simple. Ever since news of Gu Nan’s battle record in the south and news that he easily escaped from Wen Changfeng’s hands spread, no one in the entire organization dared to look down on him anymore.
There were even widespread rumors within the organization that he was now number one under the Prodigious Realm, and it was only a matter of time before he entered Prodigious Realm himself—after all, he was someone who comprehended rudimentary innate ability when he was only Innate Realm Fourth Stage.
Wen Changfeng and Tang You were not kind enough to help him keep that secret. The news had already spread all over the world.
‘That’s Wen Changfeng, you know?’ Even Tang Xuan herself believed that she would get a headache when facing Wen Changfeng. After all, she had just advanced to Prodigious Realm not long ago.
“You took great pains to handle so many matters. Don’t tell me you merely wanted to create a killing machine?” Tang Xuan frowned as she looked at Gu Nan and asked.
His actions up until now might have been able to deceive outsiders, but it was very hard to deceive Tang Xuan, who personally helped him cover up matters.
She knew very well how much Yan Xiaoxiao would hate the six demonic factions after experiencing all these events.
A genius killer hell-bent on revenge was very headache-inducing.
“You can understand it that way.” Gu Nan’s smile remained unchanged. “But it’s not because I have any perverted hobbies, it’s just……”
“Here it is!”
At the same time that Yan Xiaoxiao saw the contents of the notice, the Evil God Temple in Gu Nan’s mind shook gently.
｢Side Quest has been completed. There is no evaluation for the time being. Please enter the Evil God Temple to check the reward.｣

chapters.title: Chapter 33: The Deal with Qin Xuanji
chapters.content:
The content of the side quest was to train Yan Xiaoxiao into a competent assassin, and the reward was yet to be determined.
According to the rules in his previous life’s game, “reward yet to be determined” actually meant that this quest could be further developed in depth, and the level of the obtainable reward depended on how deeply the player could develop the quest.
Gu Nan’s consciousness appeared in the Evil God Temple, and the reward was also announced:
｢500 Points｣
It rewarded points!
Gu Nan’s eyebrows rose, and a hint of joy passed through his heart. It was normal for side quests to only award either points or Evil Value
[1]
, so he wasn’t surprised by this.
But he didn’t expect that such a “simple” side quest would actually give a full 500 points!
One must not think that just because Evil Value was very important, points didn’t matter. Without points, it would be impossible to advance to a new tier even if players had enough Evil Value, and after advancing, they wouldn’t be able to buy equipment or skills either. Even if they bought them, they still wouldn’t be able to afford to use them if they lacked points……
To sum it up in a very simple sentence: How can you become stronger if you don’t have any money?
For example, Gu Nan had been reluctant to buy an accessory for the “necklace” slot because he was making preparations for Tier 3—the advancement from Tier 2 to Tier 3 required 1000 points.
But now Gu Nan already had 950 points, so he didn’t have to be too frugal anymore. Without another word, he bought a piece of equipment.
｢Item: Dragon Heart Pendant. Purchase successful. Deducting 250 points｣
With a flash of light, a crimson pendant appeared in Gu Nan’s hands. A Western-style dragon was carved at the top of the pendant, but it was a little small, so not only was it not majestic, but it even seemed kind of cute.
But the function of this 250 point pendant wasn’t cute at all.
｢Dragon Heart Pendant: Allows players to activate the skill “Dragon Power”. This skill cannot be upgraded｣
｢Dragon Power: Active skill. Greatly enhances the player’s strength and physique. Duration: 5 seconds. Cooldown: 5 minutes｣
The Dragon Heart Pendant was a very famous item in the game that gave players a “mini-Superman” mode every 5 minutes. It was very popular with players who didn’t choose the spirit type advancement direction. The price was also very expensive.
The price of this pendant, whose skill couldn’t even be upgraded, was actually more expensive than the “Shadow Earring”, so one could imagine how powerful the “Dragon Power” skill would be.
‘Now I have 700 points and an Evil Value of 35. According to this pace, I should still have a surplus of points when I advance to Tier 3, so I can buy some good skills.’
That’s right, after advancing to Tier 3, players also had to pay points if they wanted to learn skills, and the price wasn’t cheap at all.
‘The main mission won’t be completed in one night, and there’s also only one side quest left, which is to kill the enemy factions’ cultivators……’ Gu Nan calculated what he could do next.
‘If only I can trigger one more side quest.’
Well, alright, this child keeps on dreaming about good things.
In the following days, there was still no news of Yan Xiaoxiao. Gu Nan could only try to go out and “steal some kills”, but unfortunately, thanks to Wen Changfeng and Tang You, he now had people watching his every move, which made it impossible to sneak out.
This was the pain of becoming a celebrity. The enemy had already run away before he even arrived at the battlefield……
In this sense, the enemy vigorously promoted Gu Nan’s reputation in order to protect their subordinates.
More than a month passed like this, but Gu Nan barely managed to earn 100 points and no Evil Value at all. It was simply a waste of time.
……
Inside the sixth asteroid belt division’s tavern hall.
The central pillar of light slowly lit up, and Gu Nan’s figure walked out of the endless void with a resentful look on his face.
Since he couldn’t earn more points and Evil Value in the “Immortal Demon World”, he temporarily left the plane. In any case, he could always enter it again if he needed to, and there were still a lot of things in Star Realm that he had to acquaint himself with.
There was no day or night on the asteroid belt. The tavern was always lit up, and only one person witnessed Gu Nan’s return at this moment.
That was Lin Ruo, the person who had a problem with him when he first arrived. However, she never brought up their disagreement again after watching him complete the “Azure City” mission.
Lin Ruo wasn’t a fool. It was one thing to use her strength to bully a newcomer, but Gu Nan clearly wasn’t any kind of newcomer. News that the Azure City mission was completed by a small obscure branch office had already spread throughout Radiant Tower.
She didn’t know the situation in the Immortal Demon World yet and wasn’t aware of Gu Nan’s latest battle record, or else she wouldn’t dare to have any ideas at all.
But on the flip side, there was also no need for her to change directions and curry favor with him, so when she saw Gu Nan appear, she immediately got up and left.
Faced with Lin Ruo’s coldness, Gu Nan didn’t care. The thoughts of people who lacked the power to affect him didn’t matter at all.
He returned to his room and found a note from Qin Xuanji.
[Private mission, are you interested?]
Private mission?
The message on the note caused some doubts to arise in Gu Nan’s heart. He had no choice but to enter the Immortal Demon World because he could no longer receive any new missions in Radiant Tower’s branch office. Otherwise, there was really no need to go to such trouble.
As for the origins of such peculiar things like “missions”, Gu Nan had checked the database long ago but didn’t get much useful information.
He only knew that these missions seemed to originate from some natural law, rather than from human control.
This made Gu Nan lament for a long time. If missions were issued by people, then he could find someone to specifically issue missions and complete them himself to casually farm Evil Value.
Even if missions came from another channel, he could still break away from Radiant Tower later and become a solo reincarnator.
‘It seems that Qin Xuanji knows more than I do.’ Such a thought crossed Gu Nan’s mind.
Gu Nan already expected this. After all, even now, he still didn’t really understand the peculiar existence called bloodline users. Qin Xuanji clearly had quite a few secrets.
There was no night or day on the asteroid belt, so Gu Nan immediately came to Qin Xuanji’s room.
Qin Xuanji was in the room at this time. After a while, she walked out of the inner room, her black hair dripping wet.
Gu Nan took a look. The liquid on her hair didn’t seem to be sweat or ordinary water, but resembled some kind of special medicinal liquid, and Gu Nan could still smell a faint fishy smell.
‘A special cultivation method?’ Gu Nan secretly pondered in his heart.
Except for oddball personnel like him who relied on missions to advance, most people usually seized any free time they had to cultivate. After all, no one knew if the next mission would be dangerous.
Although Radiant Tower prioritized the lives of its members, casualties were still inevitable.
“What do you mean by a private mission?” Gu Nan saw her appear and asked bluntly.
“A rather special kind of mission…… Before that, I want to ask you a question.” Qin Xuanji’s face actually had a rare smile, as though she had stumbled upon something good.
“What?”
“I know a type of person who is naturally recognized by the universe and can gain benefits from the missions themselves. Are you this type of person?”
Gu Nan’s expression turned serious. He knew that his peculiar behavior of eagerly searching for missions had finally aroused the suspicion of others.
Zhang Dongsheng and Tang Xuan might also suspect something, but they just didn’t say anything.
Gu Nan’s silence made Qin Xuanji understand the answer, so she spoke with bright eyes, “Let’s make a deal.”
Notes:[1]
: “Guilt Points” will be referred to as “Evil Value”, and “evil points” will be referred to as simply “points” to better differentiate the two. All s will eventually be updated with the new terms

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Returning to Langya World Again
chapters.content:
The content of Qin Xuanji’s deal was still beyond Gu Nan’s expectations.
“Radiant Tower is only a semi-open organization. It’s by no means a good place for a fated one like you.” Qin Xuanji curbed her smile and said in a low voice, “If you help me leave this place, I’ll teach you how to become a solo reincarnator.”
“What are the benefits and restrictions of solo reincarnation? And what’s a fated one?” Gu Nan frowned. “You know that Radiant Tower’s database doesn’t cover these topics.”
Qin Xuanji nodded. “Of course. Radiant Tower only needs its members to complete missions. They will never give extra information.”
“To explain, we must first start with the concept of reincarnation.”
“In the beginning, reincarnation wasn’t spontaneously carried out by cultivators. Instead, cultivators would be called away by the will of other worlds, traveling to different planes to complete missions……”
“The world provides the reincarnator with a body, and the reincarnator takes on the identity of a native of that world. The reincarnator’s mission is to erase some kind of anomaly for the world’s will.”
“In this process, the reincarnator uses their real name as a core characteristic, which serves as proof that the reincarnator retained their ‘self’. At the same time, they must fulfill a wish for the previous owner of the body as the price for possessing that body.”
As Qin Xuanji’s narrative unfolded, a set of strange and self-contained laws of reincarnation was presented to Gu Nan.
“So this is what it means to settle your karma?” Gu Nan felt that the mystery surrounding reincarnation seemed to lessen.
“That’s right.” The corners of Qin Xuanji’s mouth curled slightly, and she continued with a hint of mockery, “Not many people understand this nowadays. They interpret karma literally and still believe that one’s heart demon is responsible.”
“How can heart demons exist in this world? If you don’t settle your karma, you’ll naturally be punished by the will of the world. It’s just that the punishment will manifest in that particular way.”
“As for the fated ones, they are people favored by many worlds’ wills. They will receive additional rewards from the world itself upon completing missions.”
Only such people would be keen to complete the missions themselves. Others would simply try to obtain some benefits during the missions.
‘One’s real name is proof, while karma is the price……’ Gu Nan felt that this world’s style became slightly magical.
People like Ye Chong and Lin Ruo were merely the outermost members of Radiant Tower. Naturally, they wouldn’t understand the true nature of karma, and someone at the top may have even deliberately misguided them.
‘It’s just that…… Qin Xuanji actually knows so much about this?’
Gu Nan couldn’t help staring at her.
As if understanding Gu Nan’s thoughts, Qin Xuanji explained expressionlessly, “We bloodline users have our own inheritance, and our knowledge comes from our bloodline.”
Gu Nan coughed lightly and said without any embarrassment at all, “I didn’t ask you about that…… Speaking of which, do you want to leave Radiant Tower that much?”
“Of course.” Qin Xuanji’s tone seemed to ask ‘Are you stupid?’ The gaze that she directed at Gu Nan couldn’t help containing some hidden bitterness.
It wasn’t hard to leave Radiant Tower. Members were allowed to leave the organization as long as they completed a single round (five times) of missions, and Radiant Tower didn’t even restrict members from publicizing what they had seen and heard inside Radiant Tower. Everything was up to the former member.
Qin Xuanji originally thought that because both she and Gu Nan were kidnapped to Radiant Tower, Gu Nan would definitely want to find a way to leave as well. Unexpectedly, he wasn’t in a hurry at all……
With no other alternatives, she could only make the first move. After all, if she wanted to complete missions quickly, she still had to rely on this “fated one”.
Each fated person would have their own special ability with respect to completing missions. Qin Xuanji naturally attributed Gu Nan’s strangeness to his identity as a fated one.
Gu Nan was very satisfied with the information Qin Xuanji provided, so he “reluctantly” agreed to her deal.
His strength really was progressing too fast. Based on his current progress, he would enter the Prodigious Realm in a few months, which was equivalent to Tier 3 in the Evil God system.
If he remained inside Radiant Tower, he would be too conspicuous and would easily attract the attention of certain people.
It would be too naive to believe that Radiant Tower was a benevolent organization just because it didn’t restrict its members too much.
“Alright, let’s talk about your private mission first.” Gu Nan still remembered this. He didn’t know whether there would be a reward for private missions, but he still had to try.
“That’s fine with me. I’ll tell you a relatively simple reincarnation method first. Treat it as an advance payment.”
……
A few moments later, the two people’s figures appeared in a small plane that was both familiar and unfamiliar to Gu Nan.
“This is…… Langya World?” Gu Nan looked at the somewhat familiar environment around him and asked in confusion.
“Yes.” Qin Xuanji simply nodded. “I still have karma over here that hasn’t been settled yet, and it has already evolved into a mission.”
‘Karma will evolve into missions?’ Gu Nan obtained some more information. ‘Maybe this is the origin of private missions.’
In fact, Gu Nan was still very unfamiliar with Langya World.
This was a plane that was somewhat similar to Earth, but also very different. Similar to Earth, it had an outstanding level of technology, but it also contained the existence of martial artists, as well as special powers.
Qin Xuanji continued, “Our mission this time is……”
“To kill a person called ‘Yan Fei’?” Gu Nan casually finished for her.
As soon as he accepted the external mission, the content of the mission had already appeared in his Evil God Temple:
｢Main Mission: Kill Yan Fei
Mission Reward: Small｣
“Sure is nice to be a fated one.” Qin Xuanji resisted the urge to roll her eyes and sighed somewhat sourly. Even her identity as a bloodline user seemed to pale in comparison to the advantages that fated ones possessed.
“We reincarnated with our entire souls this time, so we should resolve this battle in the shortest time possible to reduce the risks…… By the way, that body of yours may still have unsettled karma,” Qin Xuanji said after a pause.
At the beginning, she and Gu Nan ascended to Star Realm using their own bodies, so this time, they naturally returned to this world by possessing other people’s bodies.
Qin Xuanji’s body was that of an ordinary young girl she had prepared a long time ago, while the one Gu Nan possessed was merely a companion she found in a hurry.
Gu Nan carefully checked his body’s memory and found that there really was a wish that needed to be fulfilled.
This body was originally named Wang Sheng. He came from a poor family in the nearby mountains and had just turned 16 this year. He was sold by human traffickers 11 years ago.
His adoptive parents were unable to have children, so they spent money to buy a child and treated him as if he were their own. His living conditions couldn’t have been better. Therefore, Wang Sheng’s wish was not revenge, but to find his biological parents.
“This kind of wish is the most troublesome, and his obsession just happens to be very deep, so the wish must be fulfilled.” Qin Xuanji frowned slightly, lamenting at Gu Nan’s bad luck.
This type of karma, which required the reincarnator to search for a target, would waste a lot of time. Unfortunately, they just happened to reincarnate with their entire souls, so time was the one thing they lacked the most.
Reincarnating with the entire soul was all about recovering strength quickly and resolving the battle in the shortest time possible, because the soul being away for too long would inevitably have an effect on their real bodies.
“Is that so?” Gu Nan rubbed his nose and smiled. “Let’s go straight to Yan Fei.”
“Eh…… Don’t you want to settle your karma first?” Qin Xuanji looked at Gu Nan in astonishment.
Gu Nan’s eyes flickered with curiosity. “It’s alright. It just so happens that I want to see what karma is like.”

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Mindset and Luring Monsters
chapters.content:
Two days later, on the mountain trail, a medium-sized bus stopped outside the rest area. There was no one in the surroundings, only the silent mountain breeze.
“Passengers, we have arrived at the scenic area in Mt. Yanxing. Please pack your bags and prepare to disembark.” The door of the bus opened, and a beautiful young girl walked off as she spoke through a megaphone in her hand. She was the full-time tour guide of this tour group, responsible for taking the tourists to sightsee the famous scenic spots of Mt. Yanxing.
A middle-aged woman was sitting right by the front door of the bus. Just as she was about to stand up and get off, she looked around and complained, “Why are we parked in such a damned place? Can’t you drive in a little further?”
The girl tour guide showed an apologetic smile. “I’m really sorry, because Yanxing Mountain is a Level 5A scenic location, foreign vehicles are not allowed to enter, so we can only walk through this section of the road……”
“Ah? Then how long will walking take?”
“Please rest assured, honored guest. It’s not that far, it’s just a ten minute walk.”
“Really now, the worst thing that can happen is a few fines, what’s the big deal…… Ouch! Do you not have eyes?” The middle-aged woman still had a face full of reluctance, but halfway through the sentence, she was knocked aside.
When she looked up, she saw a dark-skinned young man helping his girlfriend off the bus. He was the one who had rudely knocked her aside just now.
When had the middle-aged woman ever suffered such injustice before? She started swearing at him on the spot.
When the young man heard her curses, he looked back at her in surprise. His gaze was a little strange, as if a pig had run into him while he was walking on the road.
Immediately after, the middle-aged woman saw a scene she would never forget in her life.
The young man stepped off the bus and pulled out a crossbow from somewhere, after which a red arrow shot under the bus.
Boom!
A huge explosion came, and the entire bus was blasted straight off the ground and fell towards the bottomless foot of the mountain!
‘Why…… Why am I flying……’ The last thing the middle-aged woman saw was the bus, together with herself, being thrown off the mountainside.
Next to him, the girl tour guide who got off early was already dumbfounded. Her whole face was pale, and she couldn’t say a single word.
It wasn’t until Gu Nan turned to look at her that she hurriedly waved her hands and pleaded, “Great Master! I didn’t see anything, don’t kill me, Great Master……”
Gu Nan was almost amused by her address. He shook his head with a smile, then casually picked her up by the collar and threw her down as well.
“Ahh……”
The girl’s miserable scream echoed in the mountains, making people’s blood run cold, but Qin Xuanji, who was beside him, still looked calm. However, the gaze she directed at Gu Nan was somewhat strange.
This wasn’t the first time Gu Nan had done this on the road.
In fact, he would’ve chosen to kill everyone traveling with them regardless of that middle-aged woman’s actions. No matter what kind of people were traveling with them, the ending would still be the same, because he always acted this way.
“Since that Yan Fei has many subordinates, isn’t it necessary to clean up traces of our tracks along the way?”
Qin Xuanji had nothing to say in response to Gu Nan’s words. It did make sense, but exactly how many people would use such a brutal method just because of that?
Qin Xuanji actually had a rather high EQ. She grew up in a major family in the imperial capital, so being able to guess other people’s thoughts and intentions had almost become an instinct.
Her usual indifference was just a self-defense mechanism for her, as well as a way to numb the people beside her.
But she couldn’t see through Gu Nan at all.
If you say that he’s cruel in nature, fickle, and ungrateful, you wouldn’t be able to tell that at all just from everyday conversations with him—he was usually no different from an ordinary youth.
But he seemed to transform into another person when inside missions, treating human life like dirt and preferring killing over negotiations.
“Let’s go. According to the information, Yan Fei is living in seclusion on Yanxing Mountain.” Gu Nan called Qin Xuanji to action, his demeanor calm. A stranger wouldn’t be able to tell that he had just harvested dozens of lives.
It’s normal that Qin Xuanji can’t understand Gu Nan’s mentality.
In fact, Gu Nan had never been addicted to killing, and he also wasn’t indifferent to human life. It’s just that… He simply didn’t treat these people as human beings at all.
As a veteran player who had experienced countless realistic virtual reality games in his former life, he often took a submachine gun and randomly swept through the city streets in games, so taking out a bus full of people was nothing.
At the end of the day, he merely treated this world as farming a dungeon. Who can feel any guilt from killing NPCs?
In Gu Nan’s eyes, even Qin Xuanji was simply an NPC who formed a party with him to complete a mission. If necessary, she could still be killed. After all, the meaning of an NPC’s entire existence is to serve players.
No matter whether they have to pay with their lives, or with everything they have.
Yanxing Mountain was a very famous scenic spot. The two had just walked for a few minutes, but they could already see a lot of tourists.
However, after the two of them got off the bus and started walking, it was very easy for them to hide their tracks.
Merely a few moments later, they bypassed the border around the scenic area and went deeper into Yanxing Mountain, which was the location of this region’s big shot mafia boss, Yan Fei, who also happened to be their target.
“Yan Fei used to be my friend and was also one of the people who competed for the bloodline user’s inheritance back then.” When they reached this location, Qin Xuanji finally revealed some information.
Gu Nan nodded and said nothing more.
The fact that he “used to be her friend” and not “is an old friend” was enough to explain everything.
And for Gu Nan, assassination missions were the simplest kind of missions. He could simply go up and kill the other party without having to say a word. He didn’t need to understand the “storyline” at all.
As the two of them walked deeper into the mountain, an ancient castle with a strange style gradually appeared in front of them.
Although the castle was newly built, its style wasn’t modern, but rather a deliberate imitation of some ancient civilization; there were even some arcane patterns carved onto the walls.
“Is this the inheritance of you bloodline users?” Of course Gu Nan could guess the origin of Yan Fei’s ancient castle.
Qin Xuanji’s expression was graver than ever. “En…… He may have found a different bloodline user’s inheritance…… D**n it, there’s actually a second bloodline user in Langya World?”
Gu Nan couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows. He didn’t forget how he’d been instantly killed by Qin Xuanji’s “head transformation technique” inside the challenge dungeon.
If all bloodline users’ special abilities are at this level, then even the current him is in danger.
This is especially true when he doesn’t understand the other party’s abilities yet. It would be too late for regrets if he got himself killed in a moment of carelessness. Since he reincarnated with his entire soul, there wouldn’t be a second chance of entering Langya World again if he died here.
Seeing Gu Nan’s hesitation, Qin Xuanji couldn’t help revealing a trace of a smile. “What, are you scared?”
She had very good control over her expressions. This small smile was just right. Not only would it not arouse Gu Nan’s displeasure, but it would even have the effect of provoking the other party.
She believed that as long as the other party was one of the strong, especially a strong man, then he would not back down from this challenge.
However Gu Nan nodded decisively. “En, it’s dangerous. You can enter first and lure him out. I’ll follow behind you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 36: The Divine Art of Blood
chapters.content:
For Gu Nan, it was perfectly normal to have NPCs lure monsters out. NPCs are meant to be used.
His decision this time was also reasonable. This was mainly Qin Xuanji’s mission. If she refused to be bait, then Gu Nan could simply walk away without any loss.
So Gu Nan didn’t feel guilty at all about his decision to have Qin Xuanji take the lead while he followed her.
A moment later, after confirming that Gu Nan was not, in fact, joking, Qin Xuanji could only sneak into the ancient castle alone with a dark expression.
In her view, she really was “alone”, because her eyes couldn’t catch a trace of Gu Nan at all. She couldn’t even see a shadow of Gu Nan anywhere.
If her special intuition as a bloodline user didn’t sense a gaze that vaguely seemed to be staring at her, she almost would’ve believed that the other party had already run away.
‘He’s not a man!’ Qin Xuanji could only curse him in her thoughts, and then… obediently embarked on the journey of a guinea pig.
Like Qin Xuanji, Yan Fei was one of the people who participated in the competition over a bloodline user’s inheritance back then, so he had a considerable understanding of bloodline users, to begin with, and possessed innumerable methods to deal with them.
The whole Mt. Yanxing region was Yan Fei’s territory. If the two of them wanted to kill him, they had to either lure him out of his stronghold or sneak into the castle.
And one could imagine the danger of sneaking into his castle—it was the other party’s headquarters that he had managed for many years.
Along the way, Qin Xuanji used practically every trick she knew, but she was still tormented by all kinds of traps, pitfalls, and snares, cutting an extremely sorry figure.
After all, it wasn’t enough to merely see through these traps. She also had to think of ways to avoid them and couldn’t even trigger them intentionally, or else she’d be telling Yan Fei that someone had broken in.
Even Gu Nan felt a little apprehensive when he watched from behind her. After all, bloodline users’ methods were still a little strange and unpredictable to him, and they differed from what he’d seen in the game.
Although he could see the theory behind most traps and find a temporary solution, it was impossible to do so in advance, before triggering these traps.
If he challenged this ancient castle by himself, he wouldn’t be able to avoid alerting the enemy, even if he could still avoid injuries.
As expected of someone who ultimately won the bloodline user’s inheritance, Qin Xuanji was extremely familiar with these methods. She painstakingly dealt with the traps, one after another, and finally came all the way to the castle’s top floor.
There was no sign of any living creature in the ancient castle, but the top floor alone was different. The owner of the castle lived here.
Qin Xuanji’s infiltration reached its limit here. Yan Fei had placed a large number of traps and mechanisms on the top floor, which was an absolutely private space to him. He sensed that someone was coming almost immediately.
Yan Fei was a middle-aged man with a refined temperament. He was dressed in a gray Chinese tunic suit and sat cross-legged on the ground. The marble floor under his feet was covered with runes.
The blood colored runes on the ground gradually lit up and dimmed with every breath he took, as if they were alive.
The instant Qin Xuanji arrived, Yan Fei suddenly opened his eyes, and the blood colored runes under his feet all lit up simultaneously, casting a scarlet light over the entire top floor.
“You are… Qin Xuanji?” Yan Fei looked at the unfamiliar face in front of him, hesitated for a moment, then reacted quickly.
No matter whose body she reincarnated into, the essence of her soul wouldn’t change. Yan Fei was naturally very familiar with his old rival.
Qin Xuanji didn’t have any intention of wasting words with him. A cruel smile tugged on the corners of her lips.
In the next instant, the shadow that Gu Nan was familiar with suddenly appeared!
Qin Xuanji’s head transformed into a snake’s head in an instant. She opened her gigantic mouth, which was a hundred times larger than normal, and bit down towards Yan Fei!
This was like the game “Fight the Landlord”
[1]
—she dropped the bomb as soon as the game began!
However, it had to be said that Qin Xuanji’s decision was actually very correct. Even though their strength was more or less equal, this castle was Yan Fei’s territory, so how can stalling be advantageous for her?
Since she’d be at an increasing disadvantage the more she delayed, it was better to use her ultimate technique from the start and catch her opponent off guard.
The result was also quite good. When Yan Fei realized that someone had infiltrated his stronghold and that the person was Qin Xuanji, his heart was shocked. He wasn’t able to react in time and was swallowed in one bite.
Gu Nan used “Hidden Shadow” to hide on one side. When he saw this scene, he still waited with patience.
This wasn’t because he knew anything about Yan Fei. Instead, based on his years of gaming experience, how can an NPC actually complete the mission? Ultimately, the player must still clean up after their mess.
So, 30 seconds passed… 1 minute passed… 5 minutes passed…
The scarlet runes had gradually dimmed, and Yan Fei’s aura also dissipated completely, as if there was no longer any trace of him between Heaven and Earth.
The top floor of the ancient castle fell into a strange silence. Qin Xuanji stood completely still. Even she herself didn’t believe that Yan Fei had died so easily, just like that.
She had always boasted about her great patience, but in the face of this weird situation, even she couldn’t help feeling irritable.
For an instant, she even wanted to open her mouth and ask Gu Nan, but fortunately, her remaining reason stopped her—exposing your own trump card was the stupidest and most meaningless behavior.
Gu Nan was still waiting motionlessly, not releasing even a slight trace of his aura.
The reason was very simple: his Evil God Temple still didn’t give him a mission complete prompt yet.
As a veteran player, Gu Nan always kept one principle in mind—your eyes will deceive you, your ears will deceive you, and NPCs will also deceive you, but the system prompt will not deceive you.
Sure enough, an aura that made the heart palpitate rapidly attacked, knocking into Qin Xuanji and sending her flying.
“Hahahaha! Qin Xuanji, to think that you really dared to return!”
The thing that sent Qin Xuanji flying was a mass of thick, sticky blood, which quickly changed into Yan Fei’s appearance.
The current Yan Fei was quite different from before. Not only was he dressed in a blood red robe, but he also had a much younger appearance, and his skin was suffused with a strange red color.
Qin Xuanji stood up from the rubble and looked at Yan Fei with cold eyes. “This is not the power of bloodline users… You pledged yourself to the gods!”
The conflict between gods and bloodline users was even larger than the conflict between inheritors of different bloodline users. No wonder it evolved into a private mission.
Yan Fei sneered, “If I can’t walk the path of a bloodline user, then of course I have to switch paths. Do you think I’m one of those idiots who became your stepping stone for nothing?!”
Qin Xuanji’s eyes narrowed slightly. The bloodline in her body vibrated again. The huge snake head that swallowed the sky reappeared and swallowed Yan Fei again.
However, just a moment later, a ball of blood surged once again, and Yan Fei’s figure reappeared.
Incidentally, even the blood runes all over the ground lit up, as if revealing a sinister face to give Qin Xuanji an evil grin.
“It’s useless.” Yan Fei had a disdainful smile. “I worship the God of Blood and sought and obtained a divine art that grants infinite resurrection—all to deal with you, Qin Xuanji!”
Back then, he lost the fight for the bloodline user’s inheritance and personally witnessed Qin Xuanji swallowing several of his companions with one bite. From then on, he had a lingering fear of this move.
So when picking a divine art, he subconsciously chose this one, which just happened to neutralize Qin Xuanji’s skill. He didn’t expect it to be useful today.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Crushed
chapters.content:
Using the “head changing technique” twice made Qin Xuanji’s face turn pale. It clearly consumed a lot of her energy.
She believed that Yan Fei’s resurrection divine art certainly couldn’t be used indefinitely, but it was hard for her to injure the other party unless she relied on her bloodline.
If the battle ultimately dragged on into a war of attrition, then the other party would certainly have the advantage—after all, this was Yan Fei’s castle!
Right now, Qin Xuanji was glad that she had called a helper. Moreover, it was a helper that could receive rewards from the world itself, so it didn’t require her to pay a high price.
“You still won’t attack?” Qin Xuanji turned around and shouted lightly.
Yan Fei’s movements suddenly stopped. Even his scarlet runes paused in their flickering. His gaze swept the area behind Qin Xuanji a few times.
After a long time, there was still no movement. Only then did Yan Fei regain his calm. His smile, which stated that everything was within his control, also returned to his face.
“Trying to trick me? Heh, it’s useless to stall for time!” Yan Fei said in a cold voice.
Yan Fei was already a god’s apostle, so killing one bloodline user actually wouldn’t bring him any substantial benefits, but… it was cathartic!
The winner of those years was now going to die inside his stronghold, all her techniques neutralized by him.
“Is that so…”
The voice that contained a light smile traveled over. Yan Fei’s expression instantly froze, because he suddenly found that this voice was actually coming from behind him!
‘How is that possible?!’
It was already inconceivable that someone could sneak into the top floor of his castle undetected, but how could a person possibly sneak behind him!?
And Qin Xuanji also looked shocked. She hadn’t actually seen Gu Nan attack before, but when she finally saw it, what greeted her was an incomparably strange scene.
Behind him, a pitch-black hand slowly appeared from Yan Fei’s shadow. The hand held a shadow dagger, which gently stabbed Yan Fei’s heart.
The sound of a sharp blade entering flesh came, and Yan Fei was instantly deprived of his life. He never saw the enemy’s face, even until his death.
Almost at the same time when he fell down, his body turned into blood and sank into the ground. Another Yan Fei revived.
This time, Yan Fei’s expression was livid. He watched his surroundings with rapt attention. His nerves remained in a highly tense state, but his words didn’t stop, “What’s so good about sneak attacks? If you have the ability, then…”
Another dagger stabbed him in the chest, and Student Yan Fei collapsed again.
This time, Yan Fei’s body condensed faster, and his expression was also uglier. He no longer had any time to trash talk. All his energy was used to guard against Gu Nan’s attack, which could appear at any time.
The dagger made of shadows once again rose from behind Yan Fei. This time, the latter reacted with lightning speed. A short knife appeared in his hand, slashing the area behind him.
Yan Fei was actually very strong. He was already half a bloodline user to begin with, so his physique was powerful. In addition, he was also a martial arts expert and a god’s apostle…
This was equivalent to being strengthened by three different power systems. If Qin Xuanji didn’t use her bloodline powers, she might not be able to beat him.
Unfortunately, his opponent was Gu Nan.
Gu Nan’s base strength was already between Innate Realm’s Fourth and Fifth Stage. With the addition of the Evil God physique, his agility, and the existence of bug skills like the “Power of Shadows,” he could even crush peak Innate Realm fighters.
Of course, the peak Innate Realm natives from the Immortal Demon World couldn’t be compared with experts such as Yan Fei at all.
Yan Fei’s slash directly severed the shadow blade that Gu Nan made. He started to smile, but immediately stopped.
‘No one! There’s no one behind me!’
Yan Fei felt cold sweat gather on his forehead. ‘There’s no such thing as ghosts in this world… right? That should be the case?’
The instant he became distracted, another pitch-black dagger appeared behind him!
Yan Fei, who was extremely tense, reacted even faster than the first time. He immediately cut the dagger in half, but it didn’t help his situation much.
He can cut the dagger apart once or twice, but can he cut it ten or twenty times?
For Gu Nan, manipulating Hidden Shadows to stick to the enemy’s back like this was the most basic of all basic skills—it wasn’t difficult at all.
It’s just like how in other virtual reality games, players with high agility classes can always stay behind the enemy, and this skill was often used to bully newbie players and look cool.
But Yan Fei was completely dumbfounded. This world’s battles paid more attention to the attacks themselves and seldom touched upon this kind of dazzling fighting style that relied on pure skill.
So when Gu Nan’s attacks increased in frequency, Yan Fei finally found it difficult to parry. He was stabbed firmly through the heart once again and died.
Qin Xuanji, who was watching from the sidelines, was stupefied. She had never seen such a weird fighting style before.
Gu Nan never showed himself from beginning to end. Yan Fei looked like he was fighting with shadows the whole time. He didn’t even know how to attack the other party, so how could he fight back?
Qin Xuanji concluded that without launching a sneak attack using her bloodline, even she herself would be unable to fight back in this situation.
No matter how powerful the Heaven Devouring Python is, it still can’t swallow shadows—the shadows have already touched upon a power involving the laws of this world.
When Yan Fei appeared again, he’d already learned his lesson. The puddle of blood appeared on the wall in the distance. As soon as he condensed, he immediately adhered to the wall.
He failed to see through the essence of Gu Nan’s methods and still believed that it was some kind of spell involving the law of cause and effect. For example, bloodline users had a kind of magic with similar effects.
In order to neutralize this kind of spell, one must find a way to destroy the prerequisite conditions needed to cast the spell.
Gu Nan, who was hidden in the dark, couldn’t help laughing. Yan Fei’s actions were naturally useless. It wasn’t like sticking to the wall would get rid of his shadow. Moreover, the “Power of Shadows” didn’t actually require shadows to begin with.
However, since the other party limited himself like this, Gu Nan had better ways to deal with him.
In the dark, a ball of dark shadow difficult to discern with the naked eye came to Qin Xuanji’s side, and Gu Nan’s figure slowly walked out of it.
He wore pitch-black skintight clothing with a monocle on his face. There was also an earring on his right ear, which flickered with a lavender light. His entire person looked very eerie.
Yan Fei finally saw the enemy’s true face and hurriedly spoke, “What form of address does Your Excellency prefer? This humble one is willing to pay double the price that Qin Xuanji gave!”
Gu Nan smiled but didn’t speak. He simply raised his hand and shot an arrow.
“Wind!”
‘You don’t even have a mission……’
He was willing to help Qin Xuanji only because he had both the rewards from the mission itself and also the tempting information regarding solo reincarnators. It was precisely because Qin Xuanji knew this that she could rest assured about bringing him here.
The teal arrow directly entered Yan Fei’s throat at a speed invisible to the naked eye. Yan Fei didn’t even have time to dodge.
Once again, he resurrected himself through blood, and the revival speed also became faster, but the ball of blood was smaller than before. Clearly, Yan Fei was at the end of his rope.
As soon as Yan Fei’s figure reappeared, Gu Nan instantly killed him off again with another arrow.
As the number of resurrections increased, it was obvious that all of Yan Fei’s stats were also declining. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be so weak.
Yan Fei gnashed his teeth, almost breaking them. The other party didn’t communicate with him at all and was completely bent on taking his life. ‘However, the enemy’s methods just happen to be incomparably strange, completely suppressing me…’
“In that case, let’s die together!”

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Traces of the Gods, Past and Present Life
chapters.content:
“In that case, let’s die together!”
Yan Fei’s crazy roar echoed through the top floor, and those blood runes on the ground suddenly lit up, emitting bursts of amazing power.
Qin Xuanji’s expression changed slightly, and she suddenly pulled Gu Nan away. “We have to leave now! He’s going to self-detonate the blood runes!”
“Purely Tier 2 explosive power.” Gu Nan, however, smiled lightly and shook his head. He grabbed Qin Xuanji’s collar and threw her out the window.
Bang!
Qin Xuanji flew up and smashed the only window on the top floor. Her figure appeared in mid-air, and she could only watch the violent explosion destroy the ancient castle.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!
Yan Fei was truly ruthless enough. The blood runes, the result of his years of operation, connected to each other and self-detonated. A terrifying shockwave almost lifted off the roof of the ancient castle.
Qin Xuanji, who was in mid-air, was also hit by the shockwave and flew out dozens of meters away, landing heavily on the ground.
Of course this sort of impact was nothing for a warrior at her level, so she got up immediately and fixed her gaze upon the smoke-filled top floor of the castle.
When the spoke dispersed, Qin Xuanji saw an unbelievable scene.
“He’s actually fine…… And……”
Gu Nan stood on the top floor without any protective measures. His clothes had already been blown to pieces, and even his fair abdomen, which wasn’t particularly muscular, was revealed.
But he didn’t have any injuries at all. Not even his hair style was messed up. Step by step, he began to walk towards Yan Fei not far away.
“Why……” Yan Fei had already taken cover before the explosion, but he was still badly injured. He couldn’t help asking when he saw that Gu Nan was uninjured.
“Without the blood runes, you can no longer use Blood Sacrifice, right?” Gu Nan walked up to him and answered his question with another question.
“Yes… Wait a minute, how can you know about Blood Sacrifice?” Yan Fei’s eyes widened. This surprised him even more than seeing Gu Nan uninjured.
The blood divine art he learned was precisely called “Blood Sacrifice.” This kind of secret art was secret knowledge handed down from the God of Blood. ‘Even Qin Xuanji only has some general knowledge, so how can this person know so much about Blood Sacrifice?’
“How can I know…” A trace of helplessness flashed across Gu Nan’s face. He muttered to himself, “How can I possibly not know the skills of a Tier 2 monster like the Apostle of Blood?”
Without giving Yan Fei another chance to talk, Gu Nan ended him directly with an arrow, and the notice from the Evil God Temple finally came.
+
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed:
Main Mission Evaluation: B
Side Story Development: C
Map Exploration: B
Sin Value: B
Comprehensive Evaluation: B-｣
+
｢Accumulated points: 30
Accumulated Evil Value: 3｣
+
The point rewards were pitiful, but the Evil Value wasn’t bad. After all, this was merely a small dungeon, so Gu Nan expected that.
Although the mission was complete, Gu Nan didn’t feel any happiness in his heart because the information verified by Yan Fei was too unexpected.
In his previous life’s game, the Evil God that players roleplayed had to fight the gods. This was considered the only “main storyline” in the game.
Evil Gods weren’t actually gods. Be it the gods affiliated with light or with darkness, both factions were the enemies of Evil Gods. Thus, Gu Nan had killed many of the God of Blood’s apostles in his past life.
But he never would’ve thought that the God of Blood would also exist in this world.
According to his probing just now, even the apostle’s skills were exactly what he remembered… ‘Is there any connection between this world and my past life’s game?’
But there were absolutely no martial artists in the game, not to mention those messy cultivators.
“Is Yan Fei dead?” Qin Xuanji had already reached his side some time ago. She looked at Yan Fei’s body on the ground and asked.
“Yeah.” Gu Nan nodded, his thoughts still on the Apostle of Blood. He casually explained, “Apostles of Blood prepare blood runes in advance and sacrifice the runes to escape death. Without any runes, of course he’s truly dead.”
Qin Xuanji couldn’t help looking at him strangely. “Do you… know a lot about the God of Blood?”
Gu Nan came back to his senses and stared at Qin Xuanji as if she was a huge treasure. “Tell me everything you know about the gods!”
……
……
When the two souls returned to Radiant Tower, only a little under an hour had passed in Star Realm. The smaller the plane, the greater the speed at which time flowed relative to larger planes.
Everything that needed to be communicated had already been done inside Langya World, so Gu Nan turned and left without another word.
‘Gods… They’re indeed very similar to the ones in the game. However, are they concentrated in some large worlds?’
According to Qin Xuanji, gods did exist, but they rarely appeared in Star Realm. Instead, they were on the other side of the universe and were concentrated in certain worlds.
Although there were gods’ worshippers in Star Realm and several large worlds nearby, they were all very weak, and their faith might not be too resolute either.
Yan Fei, for example, made it clear that he wanted to strengthen himself by using the God of Blood and just might betray his faith one day.
The appearance of traces of the gods suddenly strengthened the sense of urgency in Gu Nan’s heart. His natural enemies still existed. Furthermore, this wasn’t a game. The gods wouldn’t sit in their homes waiting for him to come knocking.
According to the game, gods couldn’t see through Evil Gods’ identities, but in this reality, who could say for sure?
Gu Nan didn’t want to joke around with his little life.
‘I have to hurry up……’ Gu Nan sat in his room, his eyes flickering, and began to think about his next plan of action.
If it was before, when he wasn’t in a hurry, he could still happily complete missions in Radiant Tower to earn points and Evil Value.
As for what would happen to Gu Nian if she failed to settle her karma regarding him… What did Gu Nian’s life or death have to do with him?
But now, since he needed to level up as soon as possible, it was necessary to leave Radiant Tower soon and become a solo reincarnator. It just so happens that he can look for Gu Nian and get a legitimate identity to use as a cover.
Solo reincarnators required many materials and the assistance of equipment, so a legitimate surface identity was a must.
Qin Xuanji was right about one thing. Since he was a fated one, the longer he stayed in Radiant Tower, the greater the danger.
It wasn’t hard to leave Radiant Tower. As long as he didn’t catch the attention of anyone on top, he could leave normally by completing missions.
With Gu Nan’s skills, the next time Radiant Tower issued missions, he could reach the required number in the shortest possible time and leave the organization.
‘If I don’t have any matters in Immortal Demon World, then I should stop visiting for the time being.’
There were a large number of reincarnators in Immortal Demon World, as well as Prodigious Realm experts. It would be too easy to expose himself there.
Although there might be other side quests and a main mission with rich rewards there, this wasn’t what Gu Nan needed right now.
On the contrary, the current progression of Gu Nan’s strength was already very excessive. If he entered the Prodigious Realm without any warning, then it would be too eye-catching.
Even if he did have enough Evil Value to advance to Tier 3, he would still choose to not advance for the time being, so he might as well make plans after leaving Radiant Tower.
In any case, he held Immortal Demon World’s coordinates, so he could still enter the world again even after leaving Radiant Tower. It’s just that he would no longer receive any assistance from Radiant Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Chance Encounter
chapters.content:
“Gu Nan, are you serious?” Zhang Dongsheng’s expression was a little helpless as he looked at Gu Nan standing in front of him.
“Yeah. I’ve already completed five missions. According to the rules, I can leave Radiant Tower now,” Gu Nan had a calm expression as he plainly replied.
Over a month had already passed since the private mission last time, and new missions from Radiant Tower’s headquarters had long been issued.
Gu Nan casually picked several small missions. Due to the faster passage of time in smaller worlds, when he completed all of time, only two to three days had passed in Star Realm.
Although they were small missions, the combined reward still wasn’t small.
Gu Nan had 950 points now, about to approach the 1000-point mark. And his Evil Value had also reached 44, so he was one Evil Value away from unlocking the third equipment page.
Zhang Dongsheng really did feel helpless.
It was understandable that Gu Nan wanted to leave. In fact, there wasn’t a single person in this branch who didn’t want to leave. Even if they wanted to remain in Radiant Tower, they could still go to a larger branch. Why suffer here?
Not to mention that Gu Nan and Qin Xuanji were originally kidnapped here, so it was normal for them to be in a hurry to leave.
But what Zhang Dongsheng didn’t understand was how those two could actually complete five missions!
Of the ten or so people in this branch office, the longest had been trapped for two years. This was all because they still couldn’t complete a single round of five missions. One can see from the Azure City mission that missions aren’t so easy to handle!
But when it came to this young man in front of him, everything was different.
For him, completing missions was as simple was eating meals or drinking water. He even took Qin Xuanji with him in passing, allowing her to finish five missions as well.
“I understand… But can you wait for a while? The Immortal Demon World is in need of your assistance.” Zhang Dongsheng thought for a moment and asked.
Nearly half a year had already passed in the Immortal Demon World. The righteous and demonic paths were in an all-out war, which had already reached its climax. A combat force like Gu Nan, the strongest person under the Prodigious Realm, was still very important.
It was precisely because of this that Tang Xuan had no time to return to Star Realm anymore.
Gu Nan shook his head firmly. “I have to return to Ruby Fish Star first… As for the Immortal Demon World, I’ll enter it again if I have the chance.”
