At first, Zhang Dongsheng was disappointed, but when he heard the second half of Gu Nan’s words, he could only nod. This was probably the best outcome.
“Alright. I’ll handle the procedures for you… Do you want to wait for Qin Xuanji? She also applied to leave the organization.”
“No need. I’m not on familiar terms with her.”
Zhang Dongsheng: “……”
……
……
[We have arrived at the Sixth Asteroid Belt Station. The transport ship will only stop here for three minutes. Passengers, please don’t leave the ship and walk around…]
As the electronic female voice sounded, Gu Nan entered the transport ship’s third section.
“Sir, please show me your ID.” The third section’s attendant stood by the door and was clearly stunned when she saw Gu Nan entering. After a pause, she hurriedly asked for his ID.
She had worked on the transport ship for several months now and had never seen someone entering or leaving from the Sixth Asteroid Belt Station. This was her first time seeing a passenger at this station.
A moment later, she returned the documents to Gu Nan and couldn’t help giving the latter a few more glances.
All of Gu Nan’s documents were naturally prepared for him by Radiant Tower. It’s just that the information would inevitably be a little casual…… For example, in the box detailing his birthplace, the “Sixth Asteroid Belt” was shockingly written.
“To think someone was actually born in this trashy place…” The attendant lady’s three views were about to collapse.
The next stop, Ruby Fish Star, would be the final stop. The ship was a little empty; there were only a few sparse passengers in it. Gu Nan was also happy with the silence and found a seat to sit.
“Elder Sister, what kind of place is the Sixth Asteroid Belt?”
“I don’t know. It seems to be an interstellar observation point… To think someone actually came from that station.”
“Could it be a bad person……”
“How can the bad guys dare to get on one of the Federation’s transport ships? Don’t daydream!”
The faint sounds of conversation traveled over.
Gu Nan didn’t even have to lift his eyes to know that it was a pair of sisters at the back conversing with each other. They were naturally talking about him.
Although they tried to keep their voices down, it was still a little difficult to hide from Gu Nan’s ears.
The two irrelevant passers-by were merely curious, so Gu Nan wasn’t interested in eavesdropping any further. Just when he planned to ignore them, they attracted his attention with the next sentence.
“Elder Sister, why did Sister Gu Nian invite us to Ruby Fish Star?”
“I suppose I can tell you now… She has a friend who’s cultivating the Pure Heart Dao, but something went wrong, and she’s about to suffer a Qi deviation.”
“Eh? Who is it, who is it? Do we know her?” For some reason, the younger sister’s voice suddenly became excited. “Older Sister, can you let me do it this time?”
“Absolutely not. The patient this time is an ascendant. Her Heart of Dao is quite complicated. You won’t be able to handle it.”
“Oh……”
Their conversation ended here. Gu Nan, who was sitting silently in front, raised his eyebrows slightly. ‘Gu Nian’s friend and also an ascendant…… Could it be Bai Luoluo?’
Gu Nan wasn’t surprised that he unexpectedly ran into this pair of sisters. Because this was the only ship going to Ruby Fish Star around this time.
But since this happened, it would be easy to find Gu Nian. He just had to follow the two sisters.
The Sixth Asteroid Belt wasn’t far from Ruby Fish Star. The transport ship soon arrived at the station, and Gu Nan left with the rest of the passengers.
Only then did he see the two sisters’ appearances. The older sister was a typical Eastern beauty with black hair, black eyes, and fair skin. The younger sister looked more youthful and lively. She was a person of mixed blood, and her hair had a light golden color to it.
Someone was already waiting at the station to pick up the two sisters. Gu Nan stood nearby and overheard the entire conversation.
“Miss Lu, our Young Miss is already waiting for the two of you. Please follow me.” A man in a black suit stood in front of the two women with a respectful expression.
“Gu Nian also came?” The older sister, who was addressed as “Miss Lu,” was a little surprised.
She originally thought that Gu Nian would be waiting for them at the Gu residence. After all, it would be a sensitive affair if someone of Gu Nian’s status personally came to pick people up. If she was seen, then all kinds of rumors might be flying around the next day.
The two followed the man and left the transport ship station. They took a lot of turns and winding roads, finally arriving at a very remote cabin. A delicate and pretty girl was already waiting at the door.
However… She was not Gu Nian.
“Gu Xingzhu? Where’s Gu Nian?” Miss Lu frowned slightly. She felt as if she had just been drawn into trouble. Gu Xingzhu was also a member of the Gu family, but she and Gu Nian didn’t usually get along.
Gu Xingzhu didn’t look any older than twenty, but her bearing was very mature. She had a confident smile on her face, as though she had everything planned out.
“Don’t be nervous, Miss Lu Xinyu. Something happened at home. This time, Eldest Miss and I are on the same side.”
“How can I trust you?” Indeed, Lu Xinyu wasn’t nervous. Anyhow, she just came to help. Even if she can’t help out…… Then she just won’t help—no big deal.
“We can talk about this later. You should visit the patient first.” Gu Xingzhu looked a little helpless. “If you’d come any later, it would’ve been too late for her.”
As she spoke, Gu Xingzhu opened the door of the cabin and revealed a girl curled up into a ball inside the room. Her expression looked a little dull.
She was precisely Bai Luoluo!

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Because I’m Happy
chapters.content:
Gu Nan and Bai Luoluo could be considered old acquaintances. Back then, they ascended from Langya World together and talked about a lot of things along the way.
Later, Gu Nan was kidnapped to Radiant Tower, but Bai Luoluo seemed to be fine and smoothly arrived at Ruby Fish Star. However, it was obvious that her current situation wasn’t very good.
Lu Xinyu’s expression turned ugly when she saw Bai Luoluo’s state.
“This is… Did someone forcibly destroy her Heart of Dao?” Before Lu Xinyu could speak, her young sister, who had been standing beside her, couldn’t help exclaiming.
Gu Xingzhu clearly didn’t recognize this person and looked at Lu Xinyu suspiciously.
“My younger sister, Lu Zhanyu.”
Only then did Gu Xingzhu’s expression clear up. She knew that Lu Xinyu’s entire family were all expert researchers of the Pure Heart Dao, so if she had a younger sister, then the sister would likely also specialize in this.
She hurriedly explained the situation to the two.
“This girl is called Bai Luoluo. Eldest Miss brought her from a smaller plane. Her talent is very good, and she has a pure mind. Eldest Miss originally wanted her to cultivate the Pure Heart Dao, but…”
Here, she smiled a little at Gu Nian’s misfortune. “You also know that Eldest Miss is in charge of half the Gu family right now. She recently dealt with an organization, but she used some… despicable methods.”
Lu Xinyu frowned. She understood her friend Gu Nian pretty well. Despite being a woman, Gu Nian was able to become the heir of a major family like the Gu family. Of course her methods wouldn’t be too clean.
She wanted Bai Luoluo to cultivate the Pure Heart Dao, but Bai Luoluo discovered this other side of Gu Nian… This destroyed Bai Luoluo’s three views
[1]
.
The so-called Pure Heart Dao was one of the “children’s techniques.” It was especially used to train innocent and naive children who weren’t familiar with how the world worked. These children would maintain a pure heart in order to rapidly increase their strength.
When their strength reached a certain level, they would be released into the world to continue their cultivation, gathering their worldly and materialistic heart step by step.
This wasn’t usually considered a dangerous path. Many forces used this, but accidents would always happen.
Bai Luoluo’s situation was one of those accidents. Originally, she thought of Gu Nian as her life mentor—an immortal fairy who was untouched by the dust of the mortal world—but the result was…
“What did Gu Nian do this time?”
“She killed an entire family and kidnapped the wife and daughter, after which she personally chopped them into pieces and fed them to the dogs.” Gu Xingzhu shrugged. “This little girl just happened to see it.”
Lu Xinyu’s frown deepened. She thought for a moment. “Go outside first. Let me talk to her.”
Her younger sister, Lu Zhanyu, also knew that this “medical case” was truly difficult, so she followed Gu Xingzhu outside without another word.
The two waited by the door for a long time. They listened as the words inside the cabin changed from a monologue to a conversation. The voices went from soft to loud, but finally, everything fell silent again.
Lu Xinyu finally opened the door and walked out with exhaustion written all over her face. She shook her head gently. “There’s nothing I can do either. She… Where is she?!”
Lu Xinyu turned around in the middle of her sentence and found that Bai Luoluo had actually disappeared.
……
……
“Let go of me! Let go! Who the hell are you?!”
“You can’t even recognize me? That really saddens me…” Gu Nan threw Bai Luoluo to the ground and lightly shook his head.
Bai Luoluo had always been carried by him while they were running, so she only saw his face just now. “Y-You’re Gu Nan?”
“Who else would I be? How about it—do you know Gu Nian’s true face now?” Gu Nan grinned. “I told you that she isn’t a good person…”
“Wait, when did you tell me that?” Bai Luoluo’s thoughts were interrupted by his words. She couldn’t restrain her melancholy anymore and hurriedly interrupted him.
“Hmm? I didn’t?” Gu Nan looked surprised. “No matter. I’m saying it now. I’m telling you…”
“Alright, Gu Nan.” Bai Luoluo interrupted again. She no longer looked interested now, and her expression returned to a depressed one.
“I know you want to console me… But this is my problem, my inner demon…”
Gu Nan couldn’t stop himself from rolling his eyes. He didn’t have the energy to even ridicule little brats like her with Eighth Grade Syndrome.
In fact, he didn’t actually want to meddle in this business. After all, he and Bai Luoluo were merely acquaintances, so he was too lazy to deal with such a troublesome matter.
But just when he was in front of the cabin and was about to take a look, a message suddenly came from the Evil God Temple.
｢Evil Event triggered: Bai Luoluo’s Blackening｣
Gu Nan’s jaw dropped on the spot. The long-awaited Evil Event actually appeared in this form, and with such a “no bottom line” content!
‘From Yan Xiaoxiao to Bai Luoluo, the same loli blackening subject matter… Evil God Temple, do you have a special fondness for lolis with repeated characters in their names?!’
But roasts were just roasts. Nevertheless, the reward still had to be obtained…
“Follow me,” Gu Nan spoke with a cold expression when he thought of that.
……
……
A while later, Gu Nan took Bai Luoluo to the slums.
Children with yellow faces and emaciated bodies were everywhere, as well as women with heavy makeup. Everything was in line with ordinary people’s imagination of such a place.
A woman with slightly beautiful makeup came over and approached Gu Nan. “Sir, do you want to…”
“No, f**k off.”
“F**k! Why so…” The woman had never seen such a coarse response like Gu Nan’s, so she cursed as she turned around.
Without another word, Gu Nan directly grabbed her hair and smashed her head onto the ground.
After five or six times, accompanied by shrill screams, the woman’s forehead was full of blood, and she kept apologizing and begging for mercy.
Gu Nan threw her aside and turned to ask Bai Luoluo, “Do you know why I hit her?”
Bai Luoluo seemed as though she couldn’t bear to look at the scene. She hesitantly answered, “Because she cursed at you?”
“No.” Gu Nan shook his head and spoke to another woman nearby. “You, come here.”
This woman was much older, and her makeup was heavier. When she heard Gu Nan’s order, she trembled a little and forced herself to come over with a smile. “Sir…”
This time, Gu Nan didn’t even say anything as he grabbed her hair and smashed her face into the ground.
Afterwards, he asked Bai Luoluo again, “Do you know why I hit them?”
“I don’t know… Why?”
“Because I’m happy!”
Gu Nan looked as though this was proper and to be expected. He then patted the little loli on the shoulder. “As one of the strong, what you want to do to others only depends on your own needs—it has nothing to do with the other party. Do you understand?”
A cold wind blew. The two innocent prostitutes who suffered from a random beating had fled a long time ago, leaving Bai Luoluo alone in a daze, while Gu Nan stood beside her.
“If you don’t understand, then go back and think about it… Now take me to see Gu Nian.”
……
……
“What did you say? Bai Luoluo has already returned?”
Gu Xingzhu sent people to search around the area for a long time, but there was still no sign of Bai Luoluo. With no other alternative, she could only take the Lu sisters to the Gu residence first.
But as soon as she got home, she heard the unexpected news that Bai Luoluo had already returned.
“Eldest Miss should still be in the conference… Then did Bai Luoluo return by herself? This little girl has even learned how to run away now!” Gu Xingzhu said angrily. She had basically wasted her time running around for half a day.
The Gu family’s butler, a middle-aged man with an elegant temperament, gave a bitter and helpless smile. “Sixth Miss, you misunderstood… Miss Bai Luoluo was brought back by someone.”
“Oh, who did that?” This time, Gu Xingzhu wasn’t the only person who looked curious. Even Lu Xinyu couldn’t help looking over.
After all, Bai Luoluo had disappeared under her watch. She really wanted to know what happened.
“It’s this sir, Gu Nan.” The butler pointed towards the lobby.
There was a young man sitting quietly with a cup of green tea in his hand. His expression was unhurried, and he leisurely took a sip. He had the aura of a mysterious expert.
“Bah! What kind of lousy tea is this? So bitter… What’s-your-face, get me two cubes of sugar.”
Notes:[1] Three views: One’s worldview, values of worth, and philosophy on life

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Visiting Immortal Demon World Again
chapters.content:
“Mr. Gu Nan, you’re saying that you and Bai Luoluo didn’t know each other before?”
Gu Xingzhu sat in the hall with a dark expression as she looked at the young man in front of her drinking tea while adding sugar cubes. The kinds of tea that the Gu family took out to entertain guests were all priceless tea that used fragrant young tea leaves, but this person actually… put sugar in it?!
Gu Nan didn’t care what she thought. Based on his personal tastes, of course drinks should be sweet, just like jellied tofu.
“Yeah, I don’t know that little loli.” Gu Nan nodded without any trace of politeness. “I met her on the side of the road. She looked like she was lost, so I brought her back.”
‘Would Bai Luoluo, who’s in such a state, talk to a stranger? Like hell she would!’
Gu Xingzhu didn’t believe a word from Gu Nan’s mouth. However, she also couldn’t find fault with the person and interrogate him when he was denying it so blatantly. After all, he did bring Bai Luoluo back.
“Then, Mr. Gu Nan…”
“Oh, you’re welcome. Just call me Red Scarf
[1]
.”
“I wasn’t going to thank you!”
……
……
Half an hour later, Gu Xingzhu angrily shattered a cup and walked straight to the inner hall. She threw down the words, “Eldest Miss can talk to this person herself when she returns!”
Gu Nan looked at her retreating figure and shrugged.
“Mr. Gu Nan, have we met before?” After Gu Xingzhu left, Lu Xinyu, who had been sitting beside him, suddenly asked.
“Yes, on the transport ship,” Gu Nan readily admitted.
Lu Zhanyu slapped her thigh. “So it’s you! Did… Did you follow us?”
Lu Zhanyu wasn’t stupid at all. She almost immediately thought of this possibility and blurted it out.
On the other hand, Lu Xinyu’s expression changed slightly. She didn’t stop her younger sister but merely smiled bitterly in helplessness.
‘My little sister is still too honest. Even if she guessed that, she still can’t just say it outright…’
“Eh? You even found out about this?”
Lu Xinyu: “……”
“How can you be like this?!”
“What, why don’t you come beat me if you won’t accept it?”
Lu sisters: “…….”
Another half an hour later, Lu Xinyu, who prided herself on being a “negotiation expert,” helplessly realized that she indeed couldn’t deal with this young man.
The other party wouldn’t reason with her at all, and it was impossible to attack him inside the Gu residence, so there was nothing to talk about.
After two different groups tried and failed to communicate with Gu Nan, the butler finally took him to a room to rest.
Without anyone to bother him, Gu Nan was also happy with the peace and quiet.
Gu Nan was still eagerly reading some books in the room when evening arrived. A gust of wind blew from behind him.
Gu Nan almost subconsciously activated the Shadow Earring. The eerie lilac light flashed. The next instant, Gu Nan had already reappeared half a meter away.
“Prodigious Realm?” Gu Nan looked at Gu Nian in front of him and exclaimed with a little surprise.
This was the first time he saw Gu Nian’s real body. Be it her appearance or temperament, she wasn’t much different from the Gu Nian in Langya World. However, her expression was just slightly more indifferent.
Gu Nan wasn’t surprised at her appearance. However, the fact that Gu Nian had actually reached the Prodigious Realm in a few short months was beyond his expectations.
Did she already achieve this long ago, or did she step into the Prodigious Realm because of the harvest from reincarnating into Langya World?
Gu Nan felt that the latter was more likely.
“You’ve actually obtained a treasure that grants innate ability. Looks like you’ve had a lot of fortuitous encounters in these months,” Gu Nian looked at the strange earring on Gu Nan’s ear and commented in surprise.
Speaking of surprise, Gu Nian was actually more surprised.
Gu Nan was an ascendant who came from a small plane. It’s only been a few months, yet he had already obtained treasures of this level. Moreover, judging from his proficiency with it, he obviously had a deep understanding of this innate ability of his.
Gu Nian was more willing to believe that this was a treasure related to Gu Nan’s inheritance.
The two were like good friends who hadn’t seen each other for many years. They sat freely on either side of the tea table and talked about their experiences during this period of time.
“So it was Radiant Tower… No wonder my people couldn’t find you no matter what.” Gu Nian came to a sudden realization after she heard that he had been kidnapped to Radiant Tower. “Who would’ve thought that you also embarked on the path of reincarnation.”
“Is reincarnation bad?” Gu Nan was slightly surprised. In his opinion, reincarnation was basically a business that made steady income with practically zero loss.
Gu Nian shook her head lightly and didn’t explain further. She changed the topic, “So the reason you found me is to get a cover identity so that you can become a solo reincarnator?”
“That’s right.”
Gu Nan readily admitted this. It wasn’t a secret or anything. He chose to reveal the news about “Radiant Tower” because he needed Gu Nian’s help.
Of course, he naturally kept silent about Qin Xuanji, the gods, and himself.
Gu Nian thought for a while and suddenly revealed a smile. “I can provide you with the reincarnation materials, but in exchange…”
“Hey hey, don’t you still owe me karma?” Gu Nan quickly interrupted when he heard that Gu Nian still had conditions.
He now knew what karma was. Clearly, Gu Nian’s karma back then was to take good care of the Gu family in Langya World, and Gu Nan was also included in this.
Apart from those who courted death, she probably also found a place for everyone else in the Gu family as well. However, only an anomaly like Gu Nan couldn’t be handled with common methods, so she had no choice but to take him to Star Realm.
“Me bringing you to Star Realm is already the greatest help for you, right?” Gu Nian smiled. “With your fate so far, Langya World’s will can’t fault me because of your karma.”
Gu Nan couldn’t help falling silent. He knew that he couldn’t trick an old fox like Gu Nian, so he could only ask, “What’s your condition?”
“I have to deal with some matters right away. You don’t have to manage the Gu family, but Luoluo will be in your care.” Gu Nian’s expression became serious. “She came from the same place as you. Helping her is the same as helping yourself.”
Gu Nian thought about the Evil Event he hadn’t completed yet and immediately nodded. “Deal!”
……
……
That night, Gu Nan moved out of the Gu family and came to a single residence provided by Gu Nian—he needed to carry out the reincarnation ceremony here, so he naturally couldn’t live in the Gu family.
‘Bai Luoluo’s matter isn’t urgent. This should be a long-term event… Who knows when the blackening would be considered complete.’ Gu Nan prepared to reincarnate while thinking in his heart.
“Blackening” was quite a complicated process, and reconstructing a person’s three views also couldn’t be done in one day… Oh, maybe one day just might work.
Putting this aside for now, Gu Nan currently wanted to return to “Immortal Demon World” to have a look. Of course it wasn’t because there was another little loli over there, but because there was a main mission over there.
Radiant Tower had already mobilized all its forces. If everything went well, then he might be able to enter and assist them so as to complete the main mission.
Although there would be a great amount of penalties for completing it as a team and although the final rewards may be pitifully meager, still, it wouldn’t be lower than the minimum… This was at least a medium-sized plane!
In the dim little room, Gu Nan meticulously carved runes onto the ground according to the method Qin Xuanji provided.
About half an hour later, he finally succeeded and sprinkled the void powder evenly. An exquisite void portal immediately formed.
Notes:[1] Red Scarf: A member of the Young Pioneers in China. Here he’s just saying that he’s a really helpful good samaritan

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Quite Strong
chapters.content:
In a remote cemetery in the Immortal Demon World, two young men—one tall and one short—were looking around in search of something.
“Brother Xu, how come it feels so chilly? Why don’t we leave……” The tall man walked behind the other one, lowering his head for warmth.
“Leave? Leave what?! In this world, the bold will eat full meals, while the timid will starve to death……” Although Brother Xu was short, he was brave. He scolded, “Besides, isn’t it the middle of the day right now? What are you scared of?!”
It turned out that these two cowardly grave robbers dared not come in the middle of the night and instead came at noon.
“This one will do. Looks like a rich person.” Both of them were amateurs. Even after searching for a long time, they still didn’t know which grave to steal. Finally, Brother Xu randomly pointed to one.
The tall and thin one gulped. Under Brother Xu’s scolding, he finally started to dig with trembling hands.
While digging, he was even chanting, “Ancestors, please protect us. Ancestors, please bless us… It’s not that we want to do this job, but the world really won’t allow us to survive otherwise……”
A short while later, the two actually did dig out a coffin. Brother Xu’s eyes began to shine. “This coffin is so beautiful! Come on, open it! There must be treasure inside!”
“B-Brother Xu……”
“What?” Brother Xu still had his back turned to the coffin, too busy looking for tools. When he heard the taller man’s voice, he turned his head and his soul almost flew away in fright.
They saw a gap opening up in the coffin by itself, followed by a figure standing up from inside!
“Ahh!”
Both screamed in unison and turned around, trying to run away. However, a strand of shadow reached them and gently circled around their solar plexus, instantly severing their life force.
The person who came out of the coffin was naturally Gu Nan. After getting the Shadow Earring for so long, he became more and more skilled in manipulating shadows.
“To think I was dug up by two little thieves. Looks like I need to find a safer place next time.” Gu Nan looked at the cemetery behind him and shook his head gently.
When a reincarnator leaves the reincarnation plane, the body they possessed also needs to be preserved properly—in reality, that just means finding a place to hide it.
It’s only been half a year, but the surrounding environment has changed greatly, becoming a desolate scene.
Gu Nan frowned slightly and walked towards a nearby city according to the route in his memory.
Two hours later, Gu Nan stood in front of a small pawn shop and rubbed his forehead somewhat helplessly.
This city had also been affected by war. Right now, it was a dead city with no traces of the living. And the small base that Radiant Tower used to have here was also empty.
‘They didn’t even leave behind any information or materials. Looks like they weren’t in a hurry and retreated calmly……’
Gu Nan walked out of the pawn shop but didn’t find any other valuable clues. He couldn’t even find anyone from Radiant Tower, which made him a little irritated.
Just then, voices from afar attracted his attention.
“Fairy Lin, this is Qingyun City.” A young man was talking, “Wherever that Polis Witch goes, not even a blade of grass will grow. She’s truly a witch!”
However, another man sneered and interjected, “Zhang Tianshu, that witch is hunting down people from the six demonic factions. If you think about it, she’s actually on the same side as you righteous path folks.”
“Mo Wusheng, don’t say such venomous slander!”
“Alright, both of you are here to catch the witch. There’s no need to quarrel like this……” A soft female voice spoke up, sounding rather helpless.
Gu Nan turned his head and saw that the three figures had gradually walked closer. It was very easy to tell them apart.
The woman with extraordinary temperament wearing a pink gauze dress should undoubtedly be “Fairy Lin.” Next to her, the young man wearing a Big Dipper Daoist robe with an imposing appearance should be “Zhang Tianshu.”
That left the last man. He was dressed like a wandering martial artist and had an expression of disdain. He would probably be “Mo Wusheng.”
The three of them were also surprised to see Gu Nan here, because no matter how they looked, Gu Nan’s clothing and bearing didn’t seem like that of a refugee in the war.
“Honorable Gentleman, greetings.” Fairy Lin stepped forward and gave a slight curtsy. “Has Gentleman seen a woman in black?”
“A woman in black? Is she the one you call the ‘Polis Witch’?” Some curiosity appeared on Gu Nan’s face.
“That’s right. That Polis Witch is the reincarnation of the Polis Star and is extremely bloodthirsty. If Gentleman can find her trail, it will be a blessing for all the common people in the world,” Fairy Lin spoke with a solemn expression.
Gu Nan shook his head. “I also just arrived.”
A trace of disappointment appeared on Fairy Lin’s face, but she still smiled and thanked Gu Nan. Her words were like a spring breeze; it was obvious that she came from a large sect.
Right then, Mo Wusheng’s expression changed. A bird slowly flew down from the sky and spat a rolled-up letter into his hand.
Mo Wusheng read it in a single glance and suddenly became happy. “Fairy, we found her! We found that witch’s whereabouts!”
“Really? That’s great!” Fairy Lin was pleasantly surprised, but beside her, Zhang Tianshu’s expression turned gloomier.
Mo Wusheng glanced at Zhang Tianshu gloatingly and handed the letter to Fairy Lin. “The news came from my family. The Polis Witch is in the Luo River Valley, and she’s been surrounded by demonic path experts.”
Zhang Tianshu hurriedly said, “Then we must hurry over. Those in the demonic path hate that witch to the bone. Once a Prodigious Realm expert arrives, they will certainly kill her.”
Fairy Lin also nodded. A compassionate look of pity appeared on her face. “In the end, the Polis Witch is still the demonic path’s enemy. If her murderous nature can be dispelled, then it will be a blessing for the righteous path.”
“Fairy is compassionate and merciful,” Zhang Tianshu and Mo Wusheng sighed together.
Next to them, Gu Nan secretly rolled his eyes. He had already labelled this Fairy Lin as a “Saintess B***h
[1]
” in his heart, but he merely said, “The Polis Witch sounds really powerful. Why don’t you let me help?”
The three stared at him blankly. The two young men looked at Gu Nan with some disdain, and Fairy Lin also showed a bitter smile.
“Lin Jun appreciates Gentleman’s kindness, but that witch is overwhelmingly powerful. If you……”
Bam!
Gu Nan suddenly stretched out his left hand and punched the wall next to him, causing a muffled noise that interrupted Lin Jun’s words.
There was no reaction from the wall after his punch, which really confused the three of them.
The next second, a crack began forming on the wall. Zhang Tianshu rolled his eyes.
After a little while, the crack widened a little. Mo Wusheng frowned slightly, beginning to lose his patience.
After fifteen seconds, Gu Nan pulled his hand back and patted the dust on his hand. Lin Jun was about to speak, but Gu Nan placed a finger in front of his mouth in a shushing motion and pointed to the pawn shop.
“Say……” Zhang Tianshu raised his head, but before he could continue, Mo Wusheng suddenly pulled him.
Crack, crack, crack.
Zhang Tianshu couldn’t stop himself from turning around to look. He saw those cracks expanding at a speed visible to the naked eye, rapidly speeding up as they raced across the building. In the blink of an eye, the entire pawn shop had completely collapsed.
“This……”
Gu Nan grinned at the three of them. “I’ve always been quite strong.”
Notes: [1] Saintess b***h: Internet slang describing a person who incites people to sacrifice themselves to help others while standing on the moral high ground and denouncing anyone who refuses to do that

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Polis Witch
chapters.content:
Clouds of dust flew up as four horses galloped past.
Fairy Lin, whose name was Lin Jun, took the lead. The Polis Witch was right up ahead, and her several months of exhausting pursuit was finally about to yield results. She couldn’t afford to be indifferent.
Zhang Tianshu and Mo Wusheng guarded her on either side. Their expressions were both a little strange, because another figure was following them at a reasonable pace.
‘This self-proclaimed Gu Nan fellow has a strange aura. He’s definitely not a good person…… Fairy Lin is too kind.’ These two came to a rare agreement.
“Brother Zhang, Brother Zhang.” That Gu Nan had gotten closer when he wasn’t aware and was now right next to Zhang Tianshu.
Zhang Tianshu felt an incoming headache, but in front of Lin Jun, he still had to show his magnanimity as the chief sect of the five righteous sects, so he forced himself to ask, “Brother Gu, what’s the matter?”
“I want to ask Brother Zhang about that Polis Witch’s specific situation.”
“Oh, I know a little about this……” Zhang Tianshu sighed in relief. They were going to catch the witch, so it was normal for the other party to want to learn about the situation.
“Hm, is her strength greater than mine?” Gu Nan widened his eyes innocently.
Zhang Tianshu’s mouth twitched slightly, and he choked back everything he was about to say. “……No!”
“Brother Mo, Brother Mo. Brother Zhang is ignoring me……”
“I don’t want to talk to you either.”
“Okay. Then, Fairy Lin……”
“Wait!”
……
……
“We’re here. Luo River Valley is right in front of us,” Lin Jun jumped off her horse and spoke to the three.
The four had reached a valley. A harsh, murderous aura faintly emanated from the front.
Lin Jun then looked at Gu Nan. “Gentleman Gu, you must know by now how dangerous the Polis Witch is. If……”
“I know.” Gu Nan waved a hand impatiently. “Isn’t it just slaughtering 24 cities and taking over 10,000 lives in the six months since her debut?”
“Brother Gu sure is magnanimous. He can even downplay the description for such a demon,” Mo Wusheng sneered from the side.
Gu Nan shrugged disdainfully. After several rounds of fishing for information, he could more or less guess her identity, even if nobody knew the Polis Witch’s real name.
‘Who would’ve thought that the next time I receive news about Yan Xiaoxiao, it would be in this way……’
Lin Jun came out again to stop their “quarrel,” and the four began to enter the valley.
……
……
Deep in the valley, the blood on the ground had already formed a river. Clearly, a big battle occurred here.
A group of people gathered around a bottomless cave, and drops of blood extended all the way to the cave entrance.
“Xiaoxiao, come out. I know you’re in there,” A young man in a brocade robe stood in front of the cave entrance and shouted inside.
“Xiaoxiao, I’m Mo Wuya! Did you forget? I visited Jiujiang City as a child, and we even ran to Martial Temple together, but those smelly Daoists caught us in the end and returned us……”
The youth who claimed to be Mo Wuya tried to persuade Yan Xiaoxiao from outside the cave, but no reply came from the cave.
Just then, Lin Jun, Gu Nan, and the others arrived as well.
“Elder Brother, is that Polis Witch in there?” Mo Wusheng saw the young man’s figure and immediately stepped forward to ask.
Mo Wuya was just feeling dejected from the lack of response. When he heard Mo Wusheng, he reverted to his energetic self. He pulled Mo Wusheng’s hand with an excited look. “Second Brother, you’re just in time!”
“Do you know who that witch is?” Mo Wuya’s face was filled with joy. “It’s Xiaoxiao! Yan Xiaoxiao! We went to Jiujiang when we were young…”
After listening to his older brother, Mo Wusheng finally remembered his experience back in those days.
“So it was her…… No wonder the Polis Witch regards the demonic path as her mortal enemy. It’s said that Jiujiang City’s Yan family was slaughtered by the six demonic factions back then.” Mo Wusheng came to a sudden realization.
He immediately recounted the Yan family’s fate to the people around him. Lin Jun and Zhang Tianshu listened carefully. Gu Nan also listened carefully at first but stopped paying attention later on.
This was because he realized that Mo Jiaqi actually handled matters very impressively. She didn’t leave behind any clues or trails when killing the Yan family.
‘However, I need to find a chance to send Mo Jiaqi out……’ Gu Nan remembered that the only other person who knew the truth was still active inside Immortal Demon World.
Now that he left Radiant Tower, he had no more scruples about attacking its members.
After hearing Yan Xiaoxiao’s story, Lin Jun sighed endlessly. “So there was actually such a story behind it. She experienced great changes in her family—no wonder Miss Yan embarked on this path.”
“This one is……” Mo Wuya clearly didn’t know Lin Jun.
Mo Wusheng looked slightly pleased with himself. “This is Goddess Sect’s Fairy Lin, Lin Jun. Big Brother should’ve heard of her before.”
Mo Wuya was indeed surprised. “So I’ve been in the presence of the Teal Mist Goddess all this time. Please pardon my disrespect.”
“Elder Brother Mo, there’s no need to be so polite……” Lin Jun replied.
‘The way Lin Jun addresses my older brother naturally follows the way I address him.’ This pleased Mo Wusheng even more. He glanced at Zhang Tianshu’s face and saw that, sure enough, Zhang Tianshu’s expression looked dark and gloomy. Mo Wusheng became increasingly proud.
He even glanced at Gu Nan in passing, wanting to see this barbarian’s reaction.
No expression at all.
‘Hmph, he really is a countryside barbarian. He hasn’t even heard of Fairy Lin……’ Mo Wusheng sneered in his heart.
Actually, he misunderstood Gu Nan here. At the very least, Gu Nan still spent a long time in Immortal Demon World, so he was somewhat knowledgeable about the important figures on both the righteous and demonic sides.
Goddess Sect was one of the five righteous sects. It was led by the three Goddesses, and Teal Mist Goddess was one of them.
Gu Nan knew about the situation inside Goddess Sect, but he just didn’t expect that Lin Jun would be one of its Goddesses.
Speaking of which, Goddess Sect actually sent one of its three Goddesses directly to pursue Yan Xiaoxiao…… At a time when tensions between the righteous and demonic paths were incomparably high, this was a big move.
‘What exactly do they want?’
‘Forget it. No matter what Goddess Sect’s goal is, it still won’t affect my actions.’ Even if they sent a Prodigious Realm cultivator, he still didn’t fear them.
After all, the “Power of Shadows” was a genuine innate ability. It’s just that he was still Tier 2, so the amount of power he could use was limited.
Admittedly, it was beyond him to win against a reincarnator like Wen Changfeng, but he still had a chance when fighting against a native Prodigious Realm cultivator.
Mo Wuya was still sighing about Lin Jun’s amazing appearance, but on the other side, Zhang Tianshu couldn’t help giving a light cough. “Everyone, we’d better find a way to draw that witch…… draw Miss Yan out as soon as possible.”
“That’s right. We’re still surrounded by the demonic path. It’ll be bad if we attract any Prodigious Realm masters,” Mo Wuya also agreed.
“Is Miss Yan inside this cave?” Lin Jun glanced at the cave entrance.
Mo Wuya nodded with a bitter smile. “Xiaoxiao was hunted down by demonic path experts and had no choice but to escape into the cave for the time being…… The path inside this cave is narrow and only allows space for one person to walk at a time. With her abilities, she’s indeed like a fish in the water here.”
After a pause, he continued, “But Xiaoxiao right now…… She seems to have already suffered a Qi deviation. She doesn’t recognize any friends or relatives. Even I was thrown out by a slash of her sword when I tried to enter.”
As he spoke, Mo Wuya even leaned to the side. Sure enough, there was a long cut on his right arm.
Mo Wusheng’s expression suddenly sank a little. He knew his big brother’s strength very well.
As the eldest son of the Mo family, Mo Wuya had been trained as the family’s heir since young. His cultivation was not inferior to that of the top geniuses from the righteous and demonic paths. But Yan Xiaoxiao was actually able to hurt him.
‘That’s right. It’s said that the Polis Witch is already at the peak of Innate Realm……’
A voice nobody expected suddenly cut in, “I’ll go in and take a look.”
Several people simultaneously turned their heads in amazement towards Gu Nan, who just spoke up for the first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Young Demon Lord Du Mian
chapters.content:
In the end, Gu Nan didn’t enter the cave. Not because anyone could’ve stooped him, but mainly because Lin Jun convinced everyone else to stay behind.
“My Goddess Sect has a secret technique that can eliminate the killing intent inside Miss Yan’s heart. Gentlemen, please wait here.” Lin Jun commanded as her figure drifted away.
Gu Nan rubbed his nose but didn’t stop her.
According to Radiant Tower’s data, Goddess Sect was the most mysterious one out of the five righteous sects. Their inheritance might have come from ancient times, so many people in Radiant Tower became interested.
Goddess Sect’s many techniques directly affect the mind and spirit, so they’re kind of an extremely high grade.
Therefore, Gu Nan was also quite interested in Lin Jun’s secret technique. He didn’t mind learning more about it.
However, Mo Wusheng and Zhang Tianshu glared at Gu Nan with unkind eyes. From their perspective, their hesitation just now made miss an excellent opportunity!
‘If I’d known earlier that Lin Jun had a secret technique, I would’ve volunteered to enter the cave and show off my chivalry. But now, the spotlight went straight to this barbarian…….’
The cave that Yan Xiaoxiao was filled with silence. Lin Jun had gone in for about fifteen minutes, but no sound was heard at all, which worried the people outside.
Not only were they worried if an accident might have happened to Lin Jun, but they were also worried if the demonic path cultivators outside might attack at any time.
Right now, the Mo family alone was blocking countless demonic path cultivators, so the situation wasn’t getting any better.
A number of people had already come to report, hoping that Mo Wuya would retreat as soon as possible.
“Young Master, it’ll be too dangerous if we don’t retreat soon!” Next to him, an old man in plain clothes was desperately trying to persuade Mo Wuya.
“Uncle Fu, I also know that it’s very dangerous now, but…” Mo Wuya’s face turned bitter as he hesitated, “Luo River Valley is in a remote location, so Prodigious Realm experts shouldn’t be able to arrive so soon…….”
While he was hesitating, a sound of laughter bursted from afar.
“HAHAHAHA! This was effortless~ To think that while catching a Polis Witch, I even ran into the ‘Big Dipper Sword’ Zhang Tianshu!”
As the laughter approached, the crowd saw the person’s appearance.
The figure of a young man with black hair and purple eyes greeted them. He was dressed in pitch-black armor with a pair of metal gauntlets on his hands and a ferocious black helmet.
“Du Mian!” Zhang Tianshu couldn’t stop himself from blurting out a name as soon as he saw the newcomer.
Mo Wusheng’s expression changed slightly. “Is this ‘Young Demon Lord’ Du Mian?”
Du Mian, known as the “Young Demon Lord” in the demonic path, was the undisputed number one genius among the demonic path’s younger generation and was only one step away from the Prodigious Realm.
Thinking of this, Mo Wusheng couldn’t help feeling a little helpless as he glanced at his older brother. ‘True, a Prodigious Realm master didn’t come, but the demonic path’s number one young talent did…’
Du Mian’s gaze swept over the people present, but he didn’t see the figure of the Polis Witch. He also recognized the Mo brothers, while Gu Nan was directly ignored.
‘The Polis Witch has to die! But as the second disciple of Heavenly Inquiry Sect… Of course Zhang Tianshu also has to die!’
Du Mian’s gaze focused in before his figure appeared right in front of Zhang Tianshu with incredible speed, punching him in the face!
‘The Ninth Level of Demon Arts!’ That was all Zhang Tianshu managed to think before his entire body flew backwards.
The Mo brothers were flabbergasted as they watched this scene. They knew of Du Mian’s superior powers, yet they didn’t expect him to be this strong.
“He actually reached the Ninth Level in the Demon Arts…….” The brothers exchanged gazes and saw the bitterness in each other’s eyes.
The technique inherited by every Demon Lord throughout the ages didn’t have any other name—it was simply called “Demon Arts.” Besides the first generation Demon Lord, the genius who pushed his Demon Arts to the Tenth Level, the strongest among the past generations of Demon Lords was the peak of the Ninth Level.
Du Mian’s Demon Arts had already entered the Ninth Level, which wasn’t any worse than the current Demon Lord. All he lacked was the corresponding cultivation realm.
Gu Nan, however, looked at Du Mian in surprise. After transmigrating for so long, this was the first time he saw a cultivator who went the body-strengthening route, so he spared Du Mian a few more glances.
Different from a semi-finished product like Qin Xuanji, this Du Mian’s aura had already reached the peak of Innate Realm. ‘Although there’s still a gap between our speeds, his strength is already comparable to mine.’
If he didn’t activate the “Dragon Heart Pendant” and only used his physical strength, Gu Nan estimated that he would need over a hundred moves to be able to deal with Du Mian.
Du Mian watched Zhang Tianshu fly away and sneered, no longer sparing him another glance. His subordinates would naturally handle Zhang Tianshu.
He turned towards the two Mo brothers and said, “The world is currently in great chaos. I’ll give Elder Mo some face, I won’t have to take your lives…. Where is the Polis Witch?”
Mo Wuya’s face tensed. Of course he would never reveal Yan Xiaoxiao’s whereabouts, but Mo Wusheng’s gaze flickered a little.
Mo Wusheng actually didn’t know Yan Xiaoxiao very well. He just wanted to curry favor with Lin Jun. ‘Now that Du Mian is here, even Lin Jun herself will be in danger……’
“In that cave.”
A voice came from the side.
Originally, Mo Wusheng was still hesitating, but he was immediately stunned when he heard this voice. On the other hand, Mo Wuya had already turned his head to look at the owner of the voice, his eyes full of anger.
Du Mian also looked at Gu Nan in astonishment, then burst out into loud laughter. “Good! Little Brother, remember to visit my Limitless Demon Sect in the future. I’ll give you the rank of a Branch Master to play with!”
Gu Nan nodded seriously. “I’ll pay a visit if I have the chance.”
Du Mian didn’t take his words to heart. He turned and rushed into the cave.
Gu Nan revealed a small smile as he watched Du Mian’s figure disappear. He also started walking towards the cave. People with intentions against Yan Xiaoxiao had all gone in; of course, he also needed to enter and join the fun.
However, as soon as he took a step, he was stopped by Mo Wuya.
“What are you doing?” Gu Nan looked at him in confusion.
“How dare you ask what I’m doing?!” Mo Wuya practically forced out every single word through gritted teeth, “You despicable villain, how dare you sell out Xiaoxiao’s whereabouts?! I… Ow!”
Gu Nan punched Mo Wuya in the abdomen. The monstrous strength forced him to bend down, and it hurted so much that he couldn’t say a single word.
“Stupid… You didn’t even dare to speak up when someone wanted to kill your Xiaoxiao, but now you’re running here to demand an explanation from me?” Gu Nan squatted down with a smile and patted Mo Wuya’s face. “Is it because you think I’m easy to bully?”
After saying this, Gu Nan didn’t give him a chance to answer and quickly stepped into the cave.
Mo Wusheng and Uncle Fu, who were behind Mo Wuya, finally reacted and rushed to hold up Mo Wuya, who had fallen to the ground.
“Big Brother!”
“Young Master!”
“I-I’m fine.” Mo Wuya held his stomach and retched for a long time. Finally, he asked with a pale expression, “Second Brother, who exactly is this person?”
Mo Wusheng’s gaze looked a little strange. “I don’t know much either. We met him nearby. All we know is that his name is Gu Nan… Mm, and that he has a tremendous amount of strength.”
The corner of Mo Wuya’s lips twitched slightly and finally spat out a sentence, “A tremendous amount of strength indeed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Teacher
chapters.content:
Faint light seeped into the dark cave, but this setting didn’t interfere with Gu Nan’s progress. With the Evil God physique, dark vision was a basic ability.
Its complicated routes, however, gave him a slight headache. There were so many forks in the paths that it was almost impossible to search every inch.
This was probably the main reason why Yan Xiaoxiao could hide here and avoid the demonic path’s pursuit.
Fortunately, Gu Nan had let in several enemies. Soon, a wave of power flashed from the front like a lamp in the dark, guiding Gu Nan forward.
Deep inside the cave, Lin Jun sat cross-legged on the ground, surrounded by a white light that was expanding bit by bit.
Du Mian stood on the edge of the white light with a sneer on his face. “Fairy Lin, don’t even bother struggling on your deathbed. How long can you maintain your secret technique? Time is on my side right now!”
“Since ancient times, evil has never prevailed over justice. Lin Jun can only try her best.” Lin Jun’s expression didn’t change, but when she looked to the side, she couldn’t hide the worry in her eyes.
Yan Xiaoxiao was lying next to Lin Jun with her eyes tightly shut. Her fingers were moving slightly.
Du Mian noticed Lin Jun’s gaze, and his smile widened. “Is this the Polis Witch? On one hand, you have to block me, while on the other, you have to block out her murderous thoughts with ‘Great Mercy Universal Wish.’ I’m afraid that it won’t be long before you run out of energy.”
Lin Jun didn’t reply this time. She merely looked at him with an icy expression.
In fact, Du Mian was entirely correct. If she didn’t insist on taking Yan Xiaoxiao no matter what, she would be able to get away from Du Mian and wouldn’t fall into such a dilemma.
Just when the two were deadlocked, the sound of footsteps came from the side.
‘The only ones who would enter the cave right now are the few people outside……’
Hope flashed through Lin Jun’s eyes, while Du Mian frowned slightly as he thought, ‘Since you guys are looking for death, then don’t blame me for not holding back, even if you are from the Mo family!’
However, when the visitor’s figure appeared, the two were both stunned.
“It’s you!” Du Mian raised his eyebrows slightly and was about to threaten Gu Nan, but Lin Jun beat him to the punch.
“Gentleman Gu, you’re just in time. Quickly step inside.” Lin Jun took a deep breath. “This person is the current Demon Lord’s disciple. He is exceptionally dangerous. Please take care of this girl on my behalf,” Lin Jun’s voice was full of resolve, as though she was about to fight Du Mian with everything she had.
Actually, this wasn’t impossible. As long as Gu Nan entered the range of the white light and helped her watch over Yan Xiaoxiao, she would then be free to deal with Du Mian.
With her grand position as one of the three Goddesses, she did have some hidden methods to attack.
Before Gu Nan could speak, Du Mian sneered, “Too late!”
Almost simultaneously, his fist had already reached Gu Nan’s face—it was better to strike first and gain the upper hand. As long as he eliminated this variable called Gu Nan, he would surely win.
Gu Nan didn’t dodge this punch at all. He only gave it a light glance, as if he didn’t even see it.
‘You can’t even react?’ Du Mian sneered even more inside his heart, and a trace of contempt flashed through his eyes.
However, he didn’t notice the pendant on Gu Nan’s chest shining faintly. The instant his fist was about to connect, Gu Nan suddenly raised his fist and punched him hard in the face.
Dragon Power!
Gu Nan’s strength, which wasn’t inferior to Du Mian’s to begin with, increased several times in an instant—his strength and speed reaching an incredible level. Du Mian came at him fast and left even faster, flying back at his original speed several times.
“Be careful—” Lin Jun’s belated warning finally arrived, but the rest of the words were stuck in her throat.
Gu Nan ignored her. Before the duration of Dragon Power ended, he rushed into the white light and grabbed the stunned Du Mian, punching him several times in a row.
Bam! Bam! Bam……
His fists fell down on Du Mian like rain and made dull noises. The physique of the “Young Demon Lord” was truly strong.
Five seconds passed quickly, and Gu Nan’s “five seconds as a real man” state disappeared, so he also stopped his attacks. Du Mian, on the other hand, had been beaten so much that he no longer looked human; no trace of his original appearance could be seen from his face.
Lin Jun was completely stunned. She knew that Gu Nan was “quite strong,” but… this was Du Mian!
Strictly speaking, she and Du Mian were from the same generation. If she didn’t inherit the identity of one of the three Goddesses, she would actually be weaker than the “Young Demon Lord.”
‘But now, this barbarian… no, Gentleman Gu… actually pressed Du Mian to the ground and gave him a vicious beating?!
‘More importantly… How can he still attack anyone while standing inside the Great Mercy Universal Wish?’
Student Lin Jun felt like her brain had turned into mush. She couldn’t understand anything that Gu Nan did.
After Gu Nan gave Du Mian a vicious beating, he casually tossed Du Mian aside and began to walk towards Lin Jun. To be specific, he was walking towards Yan Xiaoxiao.
Of course he immediately noticed that a power began to invade his mind as soon as he entered the white light, but this power was quickly consumed inside his sea of knowledge before it even reached the depths of his mind. Soon, it disappeared completely.
The Evil God physique came with many abilities, such as super regeneration, dark vision, common poison immunity, and spiritual and mental resistance. Ordinary mental spells wouldn’t have any effect on Gu Nan.
Gu Nan went to Yan Xiaoxiao and gave her pretty face a few light slaps.
“G-Gentleman Gu! What are you doing!?” Lin Jun felt like she was about to go crazy. It took her so much time and effort to finally force Yan Xiaoxiao into a light sleep, but this Gu Nan was slapping her to wake up!
‘Doesn’t he know that once the Polis Witch awakens… No wait, he casually handled Du Mian, so it seems like the Polis Witch won’t be a problem for him either……’
In the face of absolute power, it didn’t matter whether or not Yan Xiaoxiao was a witch.
Lin Jun barely managed to hypnotize Yan Xiaoxiao. Thus, with the addition of an external force, she soon opened her eyes.
Her hands moved . The instant she opened her eyes, her right hand had pulled out a dagger from her waist and slashed it towards Gu Nan’s throat.
At the same time, her left hand clenched into a fist and delivered an uppercut to Gu Nan’s chin.
If no accidents happened, the uppercut to Gu Nan’s chin would snap his head back, after which the dagger would slit his throat.
However, Gu Nan moved even faster. He simply lowered his head slightly, causing Yan Xiaoxiao’s uppercut to miss. His left hand turned lightly and actually grabbed the girl’s wrist from a strange angle.
All of this happened so fast that everything was completed almost instantly.
In the eyes of a bystander like Lin Jun, Yan Xiaoxiao’s punch missed, and then she sent her hand over for the other party to grab.
‘Had this person seemed to have completely predicted Miss Yan’s moves? How can that be……’ Lin Jun was ignorant of martial arts, so she suddenly had an outrageous guess in her heart.
‘Since her debut, the Polis Witch has been famous for her treacherous, cunning, and varied martial arts. To think that someone can actually see through her moves……’
However, the two’s following conversation made her gasp in shock.
“Not bad.” Gu Nan let go of Yan Xiaoxiao’s wrist. He commented with a light smile, “Anyhow, you didn’t waste these six months.”
At this point, Yan Xiaoxiao’s vision cleared up enough to see the face of the person in front of her. Her original cold expression gradually melted, and her nose even stung slightly, as though about to cry.
“Teacher……”

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Night of the Full Moon, Price
chapters.content:
Mo Wusheng waited outside the cave, his entire person falling into anxiety.
On one side lay his heavily injured older brother. On the other side was his sweetheart who was in danger…….
Fortunately, he didn’t need to hesitate for long. Because not long after Gu Nan entered the cave, he walked back out again with three people.
To be exact, he carried one in his hand while two followed behind him.
“Is that… Du Mian?” Mo Wusheng’s eyes almost popped out of his sockets. Du Mian, who was known as the younger generation’s top genius and who had defeated Tianshu with one strike, had actually been beaten till his appearance resembled that of a dead dog?
“Then Fairy Lin, this humble one will take his leave.” Gu Nan walked out of the cave as he smiled lightly at Lin Jun and said, “I hope that Fairy can find what I need as soon as possible.”
“Gentleman, rest assured… How should Lin Jun contact Gentleman?”
“I will appear at the next full moon.” With his hands behind his back, Gu Nan coolly pretended to be a mysterious expert, then nimbly left with Yan Xiaoxiao.
Only then did Mo Wusheng come to his senses and hurriedly walk forward. “Fairy, that Gu Nan… Is he a righteous path expert who was previously living in seclusion?”
“No.” Lin Jun shook her head gently.
“Ah? Then which side is he on?” Mo Wusheng was a little confused. ‘Since the other party beat Du Mian like this, he can’t be from the demonic path, right?’
“He is… on Miss Yan’s side.” Lin Jun also seemed somewhat at a loss. She thought for a long time before answering.
After a pause, she sighed softly. “He is Miss Yan’s teacher.”
……
……
While the Mo brothers were falling into a stupefied state, Gu Nan was already wandering along an unknown river bank with his apprentice—Yan Xiaoxiao, who was now the Polis Witch.
“Teacher, this half a year……”
“Oh, I went into secluded cultivation.” Gu Nan didn’t have any self-awareness about lying and deadpanned, “In the battle with Wen Changfeng back then, I luckily escaped with my life. I went into closed-door cultivation to recuperate and only recently left secluded cultivation.”
His words sounded very fake, but in Yan Xiaoxiao’s ears, they couldn’t have sounded more true.
She was no longer the ignorant girl of the past. Right now, she was also a figure standing at the peak of Innate Realm, so she could understand the significance of a Prodigious Realm cultivator like Wen Changfeng.
Only now did she realize exactly what kind of impressive feat it was for her teacher to escape from a Prodigious Realm expert back then.
“Then Teacher, have you taken that step now?” She looked at Gu Nan with an expectant gaze.
“Not yet. I still need one last step.” Gu Nan lightly shook his head, then laughed in spite of himself. “What’s the matter? Hoping I can avenge you?”
Yan Xiaoxiao lowered her head in slight embarrassment. She couldn’t remember the last time she had felt embarrassed, but in front of Teacher, she seemed to have reverted into the little girl who didn’t understand anything.
Gu Nan patted her shoulder. “Of course, you have to personally avenge your parents and family.”
“But……”
“You feel that the demonic path is too powerful, and it’s impossible for you to take revenge?”
Yan Xiaoxiao fell silent. Gu Nan’s words shot like a sharp arrow, directly piercing her innermost thoughts.
Gu Nan, however, started smiling. “Back then, I taught you what a killer is, but I didn’t teach you how to kill yet. Just in time—we can have a make-up lesson now.”
……
……
The night of the full moon soon arrived. Lin Jun didn’t have much time to gather more information, but she still hurried and finally fulfilled Gu Nan’s request.
The moonlight swayed in the dark like water. A thin booklet lay quietly in front of Lin Jun. Its silver cover reflected the moonlight onto Lin Jun’s delicate face.
Mo Wusheng sat beside her and also saw that booklet. He couldn’t help feeling a little indignant. “Fairy, you’ve been so busy gathering this information that you haven’t slept for several nights now. If that person doesn’t come tonight……”
“How can such a figure miss an appointment?” Lin Jun wasn’t worried at all and had a small smile on her face.
Of course Mo Wusheng also knew that a fellow who could beat Du Mian like a dead dog wouldn’t fall so low as to ghost them, but……
‘He was clearly just a countryside barbarian. How did he suddenly become an outstanding and talented person?’
‘The Polis Witch’s teacher… If someone could train his own apprentice into a freak like the Polis Witch, then he would indeed be a frightening character.’
But Mo Wusheng’s heart still couldn’t quite accept this. He finally drove Zhang Tianshu away after much difficulty, but Fairy Lin worked herself to the bone for another man……
The two of them sat in the courtyard and waited quietly. Suddenly, a cold wind blew past. Neither of them noticed that a dark shadow had already reached their side.
Gu Nan slowly walked out from the shadow and gently picked up the booklet with a smile. “Fairy, many thanks.”
Only then did Lin Jun notice Gu Nan. She hurriedly shouted, “Gentleman, please wait.” But inwardly, she was amazed at the other party’s elusive entrance, almost like a ghost.
“Does Fairy have another matter?” Gu Nan turned his head back in surprise.
Mo Wusheng’s face couldn’t help but darken. ‘Did you come here just to get the information and leave? At the very least, we worked hard for half a month, but you didn’t even express gratitude……’
In all honesty, Gu Nan had never been in the habit of thanking NPCs, not unless he was still waiting to trigger the next mission.
Lin Jun, on the other hand, didn’t mind. She looked calm as she spoke, “It’s still about Miss Yan……”
“I have my own arrangements for Xiaoxiao, so there’s no need to trouble Fairy,” Gu Nan interrupted with a small wave of his hand.
Gu Nan’s rude behavior again and again finally enraged Mo Wusheng. He suddenly stood up and shouted, “Gu Nan! Don’t be so shameless. We chased the Polis Witch for several months, but you’re just going to take her away with a single sentence?”
Looking at Mo Wusheng standing in front of him, Gu Nan smiled and didn’t even have any desire to attack. He merely pointed behind Mo Wusheng. “Look behind you.”
“Hmph! Enough with your tricks……” Mo Wusheng sneered. However, his expression suddenly froze before he could finish the sentence, because he felt something cold touch his neck.
He didn’t know when, but a pitch-black dagger was already on his neck.
Even weirder, Gu Nan didn’t move at all. A human figure had appeared out of Mo Wusheng’s shadow and placed a dagger on his neck.
Lin Jun was behind Mo Wusheng and saw the scene clearly. She couldn’t help exclaiming, “Rudimentary innate ability!”
This Gu Nan really was only a step away from Prodigious Realm!
Mo Wusheng finally showed a reaction. His face suddenly turned terribly pale. Gu Nan gave him a casual push and made him stumble back and fall. He ended up sitting on the ground.
At this time, Lin Jun also stood up. She walked up to Gu Nan and bowed slightly. “Gentleman’s power is more than capable of suppressing Miss Yan’s murderous nature. Lin Jun dare not say more.” She continued, “It’s just that the troubled times have come now, and no one in the world can stay out of it. I hope that Gentleman will attach the utmost importance to the common people……”
“You want my help to deal with the demonic path?” Gu Nan looked at her with great interest.
Lin Jun nodded firmly. “That’s right. If Gentleman can lend a helping hand to the righteous path, it will be a blessing for the world.”
“Oh, it won’t be cheap to recruit me as a hired thug.” Gu Nan’s gaze traveled up and down her body as he chuckled. “What price do you plan to pay?”

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Azure Dragon Hall, Bait
chapters.content:
What price was Lin Jun willing to pay?
‘Normally speaking, for the sake of the common people in the world, not even serving the demon with my body is out of the question. Goddess Sect also has such a tradition, but… How can you ask so directly?’
Lin Jun couldn’t stop herself from giving Gu Nan a bitter glare.
‘If he followed the rules of the righteous path and made his allegiance clear, then he and I can live and spend the night together, both returning to the righteous path. That can still be regarded as a good story, and even Mo Wusheng and the others would only be able to sigh in response……’
But she didn’t know that Gu Nan was just casually flirting while trying to see if he could trigger any “missions” here. He wasn’t actually interested in her.
So when Lin Jun hesitated, Gu Nan immediately smiled and said, “Looks like Fairy can’t give me the price I want. Then I’ll take my leave now.”
As his voice fell, his figure immediately turned into a dark shadow and quietly left.
……
……
A moment later, Gu Nan’s figure reappeared outside the courtyard.
“So Teacher likes Goddess Sect’s big-chested fairies?” Yan Xiaoxiao stood beside him and muttered in a very soft voice.
Gu Nan’s expression darkened, and he said unhappily, “What are you muttering about? Go and memorize the list of names here and burn it tomorrow morning. Don’t miss a single name!”
“Teacher, what’s this?” Yan Xiaoxiao giggled playfully, looking a little frivolous. She didn’t seem like her hands were stained with blood at all, but in reality, she was a murderer who had slaughtered tens of thousands of people.
“A list of people who view the demonic path as their most hated enemy.” Gu Nan had a strange smile on his face. “War is hell for the weak, but heaven for the strong.”
“Gather these people together, and you can build an assassin organization spanning the three provinces in a short time. It will become the sharpest sword in your hand.”
“A real assassin is completely unscrupulous when killing, willing to commit all manners of crimes. Framing someone with planted evidence, shifting blame onto others, political strife, moral coercion, blackmail… Killing people with your own hands is merely the lowest of methods.”
……
……
The turmoil in Immortal Demon World continued on. The confrontation between the righteous and demonic paths became more and more intense, and even the mortal countries became fully involved in the war.
In such a situation enveloped in the flames of war, an assassin organization called “Azure Dragon Hall” was quietly but abruptly emerging.
Experts who harbored resentment towards the demonic path or had close relatives die in the chaos of war were deliberately recruited and taught assassination methods. These kinds of experts were extremely hostile to the demonic path.
Thus, starting from the South Central Region and going along the three provinces in the Taixu Mountain Range, demonic path experts were constantly assassinated.
Because these assassinations were mixed into the chaos of war, they didn’t attract much attention. After all, countless experts from both sides died every day. Who had time to verify them one by one?
West of the South Central Region, the existence of a small villa was incompatible with these troubled times.
The villa possessed a tranquility that was rarely seen in the outside world. The wind and snow blew, accumulating a layer of white frost at the gate of the manor.
The soft sound of hoofbeats approached under the night sky. A carriage entered the villa, and a young man in white descended from the carriage.
He returned on a snowy night.
The young man slowly walked into the small villa, taking off the silver cloak behind him and handing it to the maid beside him. “Where’s your family’s Miss?”
“Answering Gentleman, Miss is discussing business in the inner hall.”
The young man nodded gently and without a word, he walked towards the inner courtyard. He soon arrived in the inner hall, where a young woman with a serene expression was talking to a middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man had a tough and stocky build. One could tell at first glance that he was someone with high martial arts attainments. However, a man in front of the lady who seemed to be from a noble and wealthy family, lowered his eyes and repeatedly agreed with her.
The title of “Hall Master” could be vaguely heard from his words.
When the girl saw the young man’s arrival, she waved her hand. “That’s all for today. In the evening, have someone send over the list of names for these ten days.”
“Yes, Hall Master.” The middle-aged man quickly bowed, then gave the young man a slight nod as he retired from the inner hall.
“Teacher.” After the middle-aged man left, the young lady finally showed a relieved smile, as though a weight had been lifted off her mind. She grabbed the young man’s hand and said, “While Teacher was traveling alone outside, free and unfettered, Xiaoxiao was here working hard.”
The young man rolled his eyes. “I just told you to restrain your murderous spirit. I didn’t tell you to actually think of yourself as the daughter of a noble family. There’s no need to talk like this.”
These two were naturally Yan Xiaoxiao and Gu Nan.
Ever since Gu Nan told her, “Your killing intent is so strong that you just lack the words ‘I’m a killer’ on your forehead,” Yan Xiaoxiao began to “put down the butcher’s knife” and properly carry out her role as the daughter of an affluent family. At the same time, she carried out her role as the head of an assassin organization.
Yan Xiaoxiao was indeed a natural-born killer. She hadn’t unsheathed her sword for nearly a month now, but Gu Nan knew that the next time she pulled out her sword, her strength would only be greater than before.
Faced with Gu Nan’s chiding, Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t take it to heart. She ran behind him and massaged his shoulder, smiling lightly. “Teacher came back so soon this time. Did you have any gains?”
Gu Nan narrowed his eyes and enjoyed the massage for a while. He nodded slowly. “That’s right. After this, I just have to wait patiently……”
“There are no accidents on Du Mian’s side, right?” He asked after a pause.
“Everything is normal.” Yan Xiaoxiao covered her mouth as she gave a small smile, but her eyes were a little cold. “In accordance with Teacher’s instructions, I cut the tendons in his wrists and ankles everyday.”
“Good, take me to see him.”
……
……
In the dark dungeon, the two walked all the way to the deepest place. Du Mian, the “Young Demon Lord” who was full of mettle back then, was now covered with scars. His hands and feet were nailed to the wall.
“Gu Nan…… Kill me if you can, or else you’ll definitely regret it!” Du Mian hadn’t seen Gu Nan for a long time. As soon as he saw Gu Nan appear before him, his eyes immediately turned red and he roared with anger.
Gu Nan spread his hands with much helplessness. “I didn’t leave all these wounds on your body. Even if you want to die, why ask me?”
Du Mian’s expression was a little stiff. Of course he knew from whom his injuries came from, but whenever his eyes fell on that girl, he couldn’t help feeling cold with fright.
The grand “Young Demon Lord” had an unbelievably firm will, but his experience over the past month nearly collapsed his state of mind, almost causing a backlash from his Demon Arts.
Just because his self-healing ability was excellent, this woman came here everyday and cut the tendons in his wrists and ankles inch by inch with a knife.
While cutting, she could actually still keep herself calm and chat about daily life with him like it was nothing.
When occasionally mentioning her teacher, she would even blush a little, but even so, her hands continued their cutting movement without making the slightest mistake.
Seeing that Du Mian didn’t speak, Gu Nan came forward and patted him on the shoulder. “Thanks to you, Brother, I finally found a suitable target… And you no longer have to die.”
Du Mian was silent for a moment before giving a cold snort. “Then you’d better let me go at once. Otherwise, the seniors from my sect will come here to search for me.”
“Of course I’m going to let you go.” Gu Nan looked at Du Mian like he was a moving Evil Value. “However, you’ll have to wait until your role as bait is exhausted.”
“What did you say?!” Du Mian was startled, and an outrageous idea appeared in his heart.
Yan XIaoxiao, who hadn’t spoken a word so far, sighed then and showed a pitiful expression. “You still don’t understand? From the beginning, Teacher wanted to use you to lure a Prodigious Realm master here.”

chapters.title: Chapter 48: His Target is You
chapters.content:
Yan Xiaoxiao’s guess about Gu Nan’s intentions was undoubtedly correct. The reason why Gu Nan kept Du Mian until now was to lure out a Prodigious Realm expert from the demonic path.
Gu Nan didn’t come to Immortal Demon World to teach a little loli—he wanted to accumulate Evil Value faster.
Besides the main mission, Immortal Demon World also had a “kill demonic path experts” side quest. Characters such as “Young Demon Lord” Du Mian were likely to contribute Evil Value when killed.
However, Gu Nan was a very greedy person. Not only did he want Du Mian’s Evil Value, but he also wanted to lure out a native Prodigious Realm expert and try to kill that person too.
The strength of Prodigious Realm natives in Immortal Demon World was already slightly inferior to that of Prodigious Realm experts outside. In addition, Gu Nan had many methods, so it wasn’t entirely impossible.
During the past month, Gu Nan obtained the whereabouts of demonic path masters from Du Mian’s mouth. He eliminated six demonic path strongholds in a row and finally earned one Evil Value.
This vital one Evil Value made it possible for him to hunt Prodigious Realm experts, because his current Evil Value had already reached 45!
> ｢Activate the third equipment page!｣
> ｢Buy armor——Dawn Sage’s Robe｣
His consciousness sank into the Evil God Temple, and Gu Nan appeared on the high throne, overlooking the cold palace below.
With his command, the third equipment page was activated, and an indescribable force rose from within his body. Gu Nan only felt that his entire body was full of power.
There seemed to be some kind of energy surging in his bones, sorting out his meridians, veins, and muscles bit by bit.
Ever since the last time, Gu Nan now knew that every time he unlocked a new equipment page, it would bring him an enhancement of all his stats.
In fact, there should have been an enhancement as well when he activated the first equipment page—weapons—but that enhancement was too weak to be noticed by him.
Because of this, his strength reached Innate Realm Third Stage, and after unlocking the equipment page for accessories, his explosive power had already reached someplace between Innate Realm Fourth Stage and Fifth Stage.
Therefore, he estimated that activating the armor equipment page this time would increase all his stats to the peak of Innate Realm, which was also the peak of a Tier 2 Evil God.
Once his Evil Value reached 50, he would be able to advance to Tier 3 and thoroughly enter Prodigious Realm.
He didn’t know how much time passed. When Gu Nan opened his eyes again, the explosive power in his body disappeared, but his physique seemed stronger than before.
And a moon-white robe embroidered with golden patterns was also lying quietly in front of him.
｢Armor “Dawn Sage’s Robe” purchased successfully. Deducting 200 points｣
After buying the armor, he still had 810 points left—although he only earned one Evil Value in the past month’s hunting, he earned a lot of points.
｢Dawn Sage’s Robe: Basic level defense.
If you are not attacked within 3 seconds,
you will receive the “Praise of Dawn” effect｣
｢Praise of Dawn: Increases self-healing ability by 300%｣
This piece of armor only provided basic defense, but it was still very popular with players because it had a special effect that could be called top-class.
Every Evil God has extremely strong self-healing abilities. It won’t take a second to heal a cut made on the skin with a knife.
And once Praise of Dawn activated, it meant that the effectiveness of the self-regeneration ability would be tripled… It was basically no different from Superman.
Players always had some methods to save their lives, so it wasn’t too hard to keep themselves from getting hurt for 3 seconds. Moreover, with the Dawn Sage’s Robe, a player would be like an immortal cockroach.
Gu Nan swiftly wore this robe that had slightly wider cuffs. Its style was very different from the clothes in Immortal Demon World. It was classic Western-style clothing.
After all, 《Evil God Cultivation》 was essentially a game with magic as the main background.
……
……
“Is His Highness the Young Demon Lord imprisoned in this manor?”
The wind and snow remained the same. A person in black robes stood proudly in the snow, but his voice was even colder than the surrounding temperature.
“Elder, all the reports from our 46 spies in the South Central Region point to this location,” A young man in blue answered politely as he stood beside the black-robed man.
The black-robed man glared at him with an icy gaze. “Three days ago, these spies were still running around like headless flies, but they suddenly all have the same information now… Second Highness, if I say this isn’t the enemy’s trap, will you believe that?”
The young man known as “Second Highness” smiled lightly and shook his head. “This humble one is just telling the facts. My Elder Martial Brother is fortunate and favored by Heaven. Elder, you don’t necessarily have to look for him in a hurry; you can take your time to slowly figure it out.”
The black-robed man pressed his lips together slightly, and the anger in his heart worsened.
He knew that this Second Highness actually meant the opposite of everything he said. This young man dearly wished that his elder martial brother—His Highness the “Young Demon Lord”—would die here so that he could control the demonic path all by himself in the future.
‘But I really am in a hurry to find Du Mian… Even if I know this might be the enemy’s trap—so what?’
The black-robed man gave him a final glance and was about to threaten him again when his expression suddenly changed. “Who’s here!?”
The young man in blue called “Second Highness” was also stunned. ‘Although only the two of us are here right now, the one in front of me is not an ordinary person. Who can hide under his eyes?’
Just as he was thinking that, a burst of laughter came from beside him. “As expected of a Prodigious Realm master. You can actually sense me from ten meters away.”
Second Highness felt his eyelids twitch nonstop. This person could actually sneak up to a Prodigious Realm master and remain undetected until he was merely ten meters away… Only then did he make something out of the newcomer’s appearance.
This person wore a moon-white robe embroidered with golden patterns, with both his hands behind his back. He wore a strange ornament on his right ear.
The black-robed man had an ice-cold gaze. He waved his hand and sent out a burst of black Qi, which flew straight towards the newcomer.
The newcomer was naturally Gu Nan. He wasn’t surprised at such an attack and instead sighed in relief. There was indeed a gap between native Prodigious Realm experts and those from Star Realm.
That Wen Changfeng’s innate ability was “air,” and the techniques he cultivated allowed him to manipulate the atmosphere with his thoughts, giving him unlimited power.
But the black-robed man in front of Gu Nan still had to use martial arts to activate his innate ability. Even if it was just a simple wave of his hand, there was still a fundamental difference between him and Wen Changfeng.
Without using the Power of Shadows to dodge, he took the blow head-on.
The strike fell on his shoulder. The Dawn Sage’s Robe on his body was perfectly intact, but underneath, his flesh and blood were already badly mangled, and the wound was deep enough to see bone.
This scene fell into the eyes of the two present. The black-robed man frowned slightly, while Second Highness smiled coldly. ‘This person really is stupid. He actually took an attack from a Prodigious Realm master head-on…… Eh?’
What happened in the next moment made Second Highness change his expression.
In just a few seconds, the person stood up again as if nothing had happened.
“An attack from a Prodigious Realm master? It doesn’t look like much.” Gu Nan chuckled and raised the person that had been behind him. “Are you looking for this guy?”
It was precisely Du Mian.
“Your Highness!” The black-robed man immediately rushed up and held him as soon as he saw Du Mian.
Gu Nan had also let go at the right time and handed Du Mian over.
However, as soon as Du Mian saw the man in black robes, he hurriedly shouted, “Martial Uncle Han, leave now! His target is you……”

chapters.title: Chapter 49: IQ Suppression
chapters.content:
Han Qiong was one of the demonic path’s older generation powerhouses and the martial uncle of “Young Demon Lord” Du Mian. He was also a cultivator who had entered the Prodigious Realm for many years. When had he ever taken the younger generation seriously?
So when Du Mian shouted that warning, his brain didn’t fully process it.
