It wasn’t until that young man, who was ten meters away from him, appeared directly in front of his eyes at an unimaginable speed that the old demon’s face suddenly paled.
“Power of Shadows!”
“Weak Point Insight!”
“Dragon Power!”
For the first time since the battle with Wen Changfeng, Gu Nan attacked with his full strength. The Shadow Earring, Observer Eyepiece, and Dragon Heart Pendant lit up simultaneously.
The shadows under his feet spread out, turning into two pitch-black ghostly claws that grabbed onto Han Qiong’s ankles.
The fist strengthened by Dragon Power struck towards his head!
As long as there was extreme speed, any weapon—no matter fist or sword—would become incomparably deadly and unable to be dodged. The enemy could only receive the attack.
That was how Han Qiong felt right now.
The opponent’s punch came too fast. Because of his arrogance, he didn’t immediately mobilize his innate ability. He could only make a gesture with difficulty, crossing his arms in front of him to block the blow.
Crack!
Beside him, Du Mian clearly heard the sound of bones breaking and also felt the attack’s astonishing power. His face had already paled.
“He seems to have… gotten stronger again.”
Gu Nan had indeed gotten stronger. After unlocking the third equipment page, his explosive power no longer belonged to the peak of Innate Realm. His physique, speed, and other attributes had comprehensively surpassed Innate Realm.
In the face of a Prodigious Realm master, the existence of the Dragon Heart Pendant gave him the means to threaten the enemy.
The strengthening from Dragon Power wasn’t unlimited. The stronger the player’s own strength, the weaker the strengthening effects of the pendant. With Gu Nan’s current strength, the pendant could roughly increase his strength to that of someone who just entered Tier 3. Such a punch was already deserving of serious attention from a Prodigious Realm native.
Gu Nan just happened to take advantage of his mentality, which underestimated his enemy, and also used Du Mian as bait to distract him. Only then was this punch able to succeed.
Senior Han Qiong really suffered a lot.
He was knocked to the ground by this punch but soon crawled up again. His glare was fixed on Gu Nan and his face was entirely red.
His injuries weren’t very serious; only the wrist bone in his left hand broke. It wasn’t a big deal—he just wouldn’t use his left hand for a while…… But what really enraged him was that a junior had actually injured him!
The gap between Prodigious and Innate was akin to the gap between immortals and mortals, but he had actually been hurt by a mortal!
The sense of honor from his superior cultivation realm constantly provoked Han Qiong and made his anger accumulate further. “Boy, I want you to die without a burial site!”
“Hahahaha~ Then come!” What answered him was Gu Nan’s arrogant laughter, as well as… His rapidly retreating figure.
Once his power reached the peak of Innate Realm, his speed became even more terrifying. With the additional help of Power of Shadows, Gu Nan could truly run faster than a rabbit now.
Despite Du Mian’s dissuasion, Han Qiong suddenly stamped his foot and shot off like a cannonball.
He was still a Prodigious Realm master after all—an existence that could completely crush Innate Realm experts. Han Qiong’s speed wasn’t slow at all. He quickly narrowed the distance between them, although Gu Nan only used 50% of his speed.
Even back then, Wen Changfeng could only catch up to Gu Nan by relying on the special characteristic of his “air” innate ability. Gu Nan’s speed had already greatly surpassed that of ordinary Prodigious Realm cultivators.
However, Gu Nan intended to bait this fish, so of course he wouldn’t increase his speed and throw Han Qiong off. He kept the other party hooked like this while taking out the Four Element Crossbow.
Originally, Han Qiong was sneering in his heart. ‘Looking at this situation, I can catch up within two breaths.’
However, a teal arrow flew at him.
“Wind!”
The wind energy echoed through the snowy night. Such an arrow naturally couldn’t hurt Han Qiong, but it could stop his attack.
Gu Nan, on the contrary, borrowed the recoil from the wind arrow to rush forward once again, widening the distance between the two.
Han Qiong’s gaze was slightly cold. He didn’t bother wasting words anymore and just held back his anger as he immersed himself in the chase. ‘The other party is merely an Innate Realm fighter. How long can he maintain this “full speed” of his?’
Han Qiong was confident that he could win this war of attrition.
Sure enough, it didn’t take long for him to catch up to Gu Nan once more, and Gu Nan also used the wind arrow again to pull away from Han Qiong.
After a few rounds like this, as Han Qiong expected, the opponent’s speed gradually slowed, and that extremely fast arrow no longer appeared.
‘Hmph! Is your internal energy almost exhausted?’ Han Qiong sneered in his heart, accelerating once again and quickly narrowing the distance.
But he didn’t notice that with this swift chase, the two had already reached an unknown region.
As if he was panicking, Gu Nan suddenly turned around and rushed towards him. Han Qing immediately became focused. He knew that the other party was running out of strength and was about to make a final desperate struggle.
Han Qiong was also an experienced veteran. In a situation like this, he became more cautious and vigilant.
However, he never could’ve imagined that his every thought and move had all been predicted by his opponent.
Seeing Han Qiong become more cautious, Gu Nan smiled and put away the Four Element Crossbow. He started to attack with all his strength using his hands and feet, entirely disregarding any injuries he would receive!
A punch and a kick attacked from mid-air, directly ignoring the black energy surrounding Han Qiong. Gu Nan intended to exchange injury for injury!
“Seeking death!”
Han Qiong’s sneer deepened when he saw the opponent act like this. He didn’t hesitate to throw a punch back.
He was a grand Prodigious Realm master. How can he be afraid to exchange injuries with a mere Innate?
Bam!
The dull sound of fists colliding traveled out. Gu Nan was directly blown away by this punch, while Han Qiong didn’t seem affected at all.
But he didn’t expect that while his opponent was flying upside down, he could still shoot a red arrow that fell right on Han Qiong’s chest. The violent explosion sent him flying as well.
This explosion didn’t hurt Han Qiong, but it made him a little puzzled.
‘His power is much weaker now…… Was his earlier attack the result of some sort of secret technique?’ Han Qiong felt Gu Nan’s strength drop and came to a sudden realization.
‘Hmph! Sure enough, he’s still just at the Innate Realm.’ Han Qiong felt that he had seen through the other party’s methods and became confident.
Gu Nan, however, broke through the smoke. His right arm had already been broken in the confrontation just now, so he used his left arm to swing a fist at Han Qiong.
Han Qiong was very baffled. He casually threw a punch in response but felt flabbergasted. ‘Does this person not care about his own life?’
But the result was beyond his expectations.
A terrifyingly powerful force came from Gu Nan’s fist, and Han Qiong’s hand also followed suit, shattering into pieces under this monstrous strength.
“Shameful thief!” Han Qiong roared in anger and finally realized that he had fallen into a trap, but Gu Nan had long since disappeared.
The chase between the two exceeded five minutes now, and the cooldown of “Dragon Power” had completely refreshed already. So Gu Nan played a trick and gave Han Qiong some more injuries.
After retreating at full speed, Gu Nan was already hundreds of meters away in the blink of an eye.
“This is IQ suppression.” A small smile hung on Gu Nan’s mouth. He seemed to have returned to the game, where he kited to death each and every boss whose strength far surpassed his own.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Hunting a Prodigious Realm Cultivator
chapters.content:
Han Qiong actually had many tricks up his sleeve, but Gu Nan accurately predicted his decisions at every step, making it hard for him to play his cards.
He had an absolute advantage at the beginning; even when Gu Nan attacked and crippled one of his hands, he could still chase Gu Nan all over the land.
However, now that both of his hands were injured, Han Qiong no longer had an advantage. Neither time nor geographical conditions were on his side.
“Little thief, you……” Han Qiong watched the other party dashing away at a much faster speed than before and finally realized that something was wrong.
“Let me introduce myself.” Gu Nan stood at a safe distance. He smiled lightly while sending a nod in greeting. “This humble one is Gu Nan. In your words, I am someone who you call as one of the Blessed.”
Han Qiong’s heart sank a bit more. Having reached a position as high as his, he already knew some of the reincarnators’ secrets. For example, although reincarnators each help a respective side, they might actually originate from the same place.
If he’d known that the other party was one of the Blessed, he would have never been so careless.
It was a pity that the term “Innate Realm” gave him a preconceived motion, so at first, he didn’t take Gu Nan seriously at all.
Just as Gu Nan was stalling for time with senseless chatter, “Praise of Dawn” was already activated, and his injuries started rapidly recovering. Even the broken arm repaired itself at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
Only then did Han Qiong remember the scene when they had first met. ‘I’m afraid I can recall how my opponent didn’t block my attack, but took it straight-on using his powerful regeneration abilities!’
‘No wonder he dares to trade injury for injury with me……’
To put it bluntly, Gu Nan’s series of actions didn’t have any technical skill involved at all. All he did was make good use of his own advantages.
However, the most critical piece was how to induce the enemy into playing by Gu Nan’s rules—in other words, life is like a play, and everything depends on one’s acting skills.
Han Qiong looked around but found that he hadn’t been able to recognize his surroundings for a while now.
Earlier, he didn’t take Gu Nan seriously at all, so how could he even consider the possibility of a trap? Even if someone ambushed him, he was still confident that he could get away using his Prodigious Realm strength, but……
“Then, Your Excellency, are you ready to die?” The wounds on Gu Nan’s body finally closed up. He grinned and raised his hand, shooting forth a flame arrow.
……
……
Du Mian and Second Highness remained in the same place.
The former didn’t move because the tendons in his wrists and ankles had been severed. He didn’t have the ability to move quickly for the time being, while the latter stayed in the same location because he wasn’t worried at all. He was simply waiting for Han Qiong to return with that boy in his hand.
Of course, there was also the small chance that Han Qiong’s old age would deplete his strength faster, and that boy might make a successful escape.
‘Then, I can just mock him when he returns.’ That was what Second Highness thought.
Soon, the sound of someone breaking through the air traveled over, and Han Qiong hurriedly ran towards the two from a distance. He was indeed alone.
Second Highness was just about to speak, but Han Qiong had already yelled out, “Leave! Leave now!”
Second Highness was slightly stunned when he heard this. Before he could react, he felt something cold approach him from behind. Then he felt a pain in his neck, and his entire vision seemed to be flying.
“That’s…… My body……” Second Highness saw his headless body, and then also saw Han Qiong.
Han Qiong was bleeding all over. One arm was completely broken, the left side of his face was blown up, and there was a dreadfully large wound in his abdomen—even his wriggling intestines could be seen.
“How could……”
Beside him, Du Mian’s vision had already gone dark, and he couldn’t stop himself from falling onto the ground. His worst fear still came true.
‘Although I don’t know how that person did it, even Martial Uncle suffered a defeat at his hands……’
When Han Qiong saw the shadow pass by from a distance, followed by Second Highness’ head flying up, he paused in his steps. He could clearly see that Gu Nan merely stood behind Second Highness and slapped his head.
“Is that the secret technique to increase his explosive strength again…….”
Han Qiong almost gnashed his teeth. He had never seen such a secret technique. The opponent had used it over ten times along the way, but it didn’t seem to have consumed any energy at all.
Normally, such a secret technique which allowed an Innate Realm to challenge a Prodigious Realm could only be used once or twice.
How could he know that Gu Nan didn’t actually need to consume any energy to use equipment skills? At most, he just had to wait for the cooldown to end.
Now, Han Qiong simply stopped running. He knew that he probably wouldn’t be able to escape. Instead, he calmed down and looked at Gu Nan. “Your Excellency, who are you? What grudges do you have against my Limitless Demon Sect?”
Gu Nan naturally didn’t have any grudge against them. He just wanted to kill Han Qiong and get the reward.
So Gu Nan raised his head and declared righteously, “For righteous people like us, we must eliminate the wicked demonic path evildoers!”
Han Qiong didn’t have much reaction to that. He just felt that he was unlucky to have run into such a thickhead, so he was out of luck. Du Mian, on the other hand, almost started swearing on the spot.
‘Like hell you’re part of the righteous path! Does the righteous path have people like you, who cut prisoners’ wrist and ankle tendons all day?!’
Han Qiong suffered guerilla warfare from Gu Nan along the way. He was originally relying on that one last thought in his heart to keep himself alive, but upon seeing Second Highness die and Du Mian with probably no way to survive either, he died soon after his will broke.
Like this, a Prodigious Realm master, who could traverse both heaven and earth, died in Gu Nan’s hands.
“3 Evil Value and 100 points.” Gu Nan looked at the display in the Evil God Temple and nodded with satisfaction.
The Evil God Temple’s mechanism for determining the amount of rewards was quite flexible. He killed his Tier 3 target using only with Tier 2 strength, so the reward was much higher than normal.
Right now, Gu Nan’s Evil Value had reached 48, so he only needed to earn 2 more to advance to Tier 3.
Contrary to his expectations, Du Mian calmed down after seeing Han Qiong’s corpse fall to the ground. He watched Gu Nan walk over step by step and closed his eyes, waiting for death to come.
However, Gu Nan just patted him on the shoulder. “Boy, go back now. Remember to come back and take revenge on me… Oh right, do you know the way?”
……
……
When Gu Nan returned to the manor, Yan Xiaoxiao was still dressed as a girl from a wealthy family. She wore a bright yellow garment as she waited for Gu Nan’s return.
But the first sentence that came out of her mouth was, “Teacher, why did you let Du Mian go?”
Gu Nan immediately gave her head a hard knock. “You sure have guts. You dared to even watch a fight involving a Prodigious Realm expert?”
Yan Xiaoxiao held her head and gave him an innocent expression, but Gu Nan knew that she was merely curious about his actions.
Perhaps in Yan Xiaoxiao’s eyes, this Teacher of hers should be vicious and merciless, cutting down enemies and also eliminating their very roots.
As for the real reason why Gu Nan let Du Mian go, it was actually very simple—killing an Innate Realm Du Mian would give him one Evil Value at most, or perhaps even none at all. It was better to kill him after fattening him up.
“Du Mian is just a trivial matter…… How many members does Azure Dragon Hall have now?”
Speaking about the newly-established organization, Yan Xiaoxiao turned serious and replied, “There are 233 members at Innate Realm, but no detailed statistics about those at Acquired Realm—probably around 1200 people.”
Most of her recent efforts had been focused on this, so she had long since memorized this kind of data.
Gu Nan just gave a slight nod. “I’m going into closed-door cultivation for a while…… Additionally, I’ll bring a child over in a couple of days, so you can get acquainted with her.”

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Bai Luoluo’s Transmigration Journey
chapters.content:
Players were extremely goal-oriented people. They wouldn’t get up early if there weren’t any benefits. As a top player, not only was Gu Nan good at completing missions, but he also excelled in killing many birds with one stone; he could achieve several goals with one action.
For example, ever since he received the “Bai Luoluo’s Blackening” Evil Event, he had been thinking about how to handle it.
Gu Nan already had a set of procedures in his heart for how to reconstruct Bai Luoluo’s three views, and now the preparations were also finished.
When he returned to Star Realm again, 10 days had already passed since he last saw Bai Luoluo.
Gu Nan went to his desk and quickly skimmed over the message Gu Nian sent. A trace of a smile appeared on his lips as he casually replied to Gu Nian.
“Let’s begin.”
……
……
Darkness met with the night. Bai Luoluo was lying alone on a bed inside the Gu family’s mansion. Her entire body was curled up into a ball, and she wrapped the blankets tightly around herself.
The Pure Heart Dao was an extremely powerful and strange cultivation technique.
This technique allowed cultivators to have a firm Heart of Dao and a steady will. It was the most suitable technique for inexperienced youngsters who had yet to see the world.
But once the strongest link breaks, it also becomes the weakest link. Once the Heart of Dao collapsed, it would be extremely difficult for someone cultivating the Pure Heart Dao to return to the right track.
Bai Luoluo was in such a state.
“So Eldest Martial Sister…was actually such a person? She’s been lying to me this entire time……”
“But why did she have to lie to me? I’m not a child. For the sake of her family, even if her methods are a little cruel, it’s still……”
Bai Luoluo wasn’t entirely sweet and naive. The real contraction in her Pure Heart Dao lied in some deeper problems that even her heart was avoiding.
While she was still struggling with these questions, a sudden murderous shout came from outside the house.
“Kill! If Gu Nian doesn’t come out, then kill the entire Gu family!”
“That’s right! That Gu Nian is cruel and ruthless. She killed my entire Wang family back then. Today, I want her to also experience the feeling of having her whole family killed!”
“Brothers, follow me!”
……
……
Bai Luoluo jumped up from the bed. Just because something went wrong with her Heart of Dao didn’t mean that her strength disappeared. When faced with life and death, her survival instinct quickly energized her.
But she still felt indescribably surprised. Ever since she came to Star Realm, the “omnipotence” of Gu Nian and the Gu family had long been deeply ingrained into her mind.
Now that people suddenly slaughtered their way to her door, she couldn’t respond to such an unforeseen event in time.
However, the enemy didn’t give her a chance to respond. Before Bai Luoluo even returned to her senses, the door to her house had already been kicked open, revealing the figure of two burly men with swords.
When the two saw Bai Luoluo, they slashed at her without another word.
“D**n it!” Bai Luoluo’s heart tightened, and she hurriedly dodged.
But the two men relentlessly capitalized on their advantage and slashed at her again. Every strike was aimed at Bai Luoluo’s throat. They didn’t have any intention of leaving any survivors.
Although she studied martial arts since childhood, this was the first time she faced a life and death battle. Bai Luoluo couldn’t help getting nervous, and her movements also began to delay slightly.
But faced with two experienced opponents, this amount of nervousness was fatal.
In less than two moves, a blade managed to strike Bai Luoluo’s shoulder, and her blood instantly flowed out like a river.
‘Run!’ The severe pain made her more flustered. She promptly turned and ran away. In doing so, she made an even more serious mistake—leaving her back faced towards the enemy.
The two burly men exchanged glances and bursted into laughter at the same time. They caught up with Bai Luoluo in a few steps. Without the slightest bit of tender feelings for the fairer sex, they sent several slashes in a row.
“Ahh!” The pain from her back almost made Bai Luoluo cry, but when faced with a life and death situation, there was no time to cry.
Run, run desperately.
She didn’t know how long she ran for, or where she ran to. Bai Luoluo didn’t even have the courage to look back.
Finally, she exhausted all her strength and fell in front of a pile of ruined walls, gasping for breath.
However, a sneering voice rang around her.
“Go on, run. Why did you stop running?”
“Big Brother, wait a minute. This little girl looks pretty nice.”
“What? Are you interested?”
“How can I possibly be interested? She’s just a lowly Gu family whore, I want to scratch up her face and sell her to the west of the city……”
Bai Luoluo’s thoughts shattered into a panicked mess. She desperately tried to struggle but had no more strength left. Her consciousness also gradually dimmed……
……
……
“It’s quite expensive to put on such a play in the center of the city. I hope you don’t let me down.” Gu Nian looked at Bai Luoluo, who had bruises all over her body, and motioned to the doctor beside her to apply medicine. She then turned to look at Gu Nan.
“Anyhow, it can’t be worse than her current situation.” Gu Nan looked indifferent. “Besides, how could you have gotten to this point if you didn’t want to control the girl yourself?”
There were many ways to cultivate the Pure Heart Dao, but Gu Nian chose the “modeling” cultivation method.
In Gu Nan’s view, this naturally looked like she wanted to strengthen her control over Bai Luoluo. Even if Bai Luoluo grew up in the future, she still wouldn’t betray the Gu family—at least not Gu Nian herself.
Gu Nan always assigned the most malicious motives to anyone’s actions.
A green vein bulged out on Gu Nian’s forehead. “The heart of a villain! Why do you think I let you two travel together during ascension?”
“Ah?” Gu Nan stared blankly for a moment, then smiled a little awkwardly.
‘It turns out that the very first person Gu Nian chose to act as a model for Bai Luoluo was me…… But then I was kidnapped to Radiant Tower, so Gu Nian had no choice but to act as the model.’
Thus, Gu Nan gave a light cough. “In that case…… Leave it to me.”
……
……
The next time Bai Luoluo woke up, the first thing she sensed was the nauseating smell of blood, mixed with the stench of sweat, rotten corpses, excrement, and other smells.
She opened her eyes with difficulty and finally understood her current situation.
A messy burial ground……
Bloodstained corpses were scattered everywhere, and her left palm was even pressing on an eyeball that had popped out. Two sections of severed intestines were lying on her stomach—thankfully it wasn’t hers.
If it was before, Bai Luoluo probably would’ve screamed a long time ago. Now, however, she merely held back her nausea with great difficulty and slowly stood up. She moved towards the side with great difficulty.
There was a small river there. Bai Luoluo, who didn’t sense anything wrong with her body, decided to wash herself clean first.
However, when her face was reflected in the river, she finally couldn’t stop herself from screaming.
“Ahhh! Who is this!?”
Bai Luoluo collapsed onto the ground. The person in the river looked very different from her old appearance, but they had only one thing in common—her face had been scratched up by a sharp tool.
Only then did Bai Luoluo feel the scorching pain coming from her face. Dozens of uneven gashes were constantly burning her nerves.
“Why…… Why did this happen……” Bai Luoluo finally couldn’t stop herself from crying bitterly. She punched the ground with both hands, as if denouncing fate.
“A lucky one who survived the chaos of war?” A soft voice came from near her ear. “Did someone ruin your face? Quite pitiful.”
“Why don’t you follow me from now on?”
Bai Luoluo raised her head in amazement and saw a girl in bright yellow brocade clothing standing in front of her.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Combat Coach
chapters.content:
After sending Bai Luoluo back to Immortal Demon World, Gu Nan stayed in Star Realm and didn’t start a new round of reincarnations for the time being.
When he was arranging things in Immortal Demon World, Gu Nian sent him several messages urging him to find an identity in Star Realm as soon as possible.
Star Realm was a federation of autonomous regions. The situation in the Ninth Region consisted of three administrative stars each taking care of their own business. The residents of Ruby Fish Star only needed to follow the rules set by Ruby Fish Star’s government.
Since Gu Nan entered Ruby Fish Star lawfully, he naturally entered the government’s regulatory oversight.
If he stayed in seclusion for a long time, he would soon attract the attention of the relevant departments, which would be a troublesome thing.
Because——reincarnation is illegal.
That’s right. Although many people in Star Realm used reincarnation to cultivate, reincarnation was an illegal activity under the current law.
There wouldn’t really be any punishment once discovered other than the cultivator being deported from the realm.
When Gu Nan first heard about this, he was also in a dumbfounded state. Later, he finally learned that, as it turned out, reincarnation was inconsistent with “humanitarian” behavior.
On the other hand, Gu Nan really did need a job in Star Realm.
Qin Xuanji also told him how to obtain missions from different worlds while in Star Realm. Most of the required materials were relatively common, except for one where he had to buy raw materials for and personally prepare.
Gu Nan didn’t want to use the Gu family to purchase key materials like this, so he needed to find a way to earn some money to buy them.
“So the job Gu Nian found for me is being a combat coach?” Gu Nan asked casually as he stepped down from a floating car and followed a girl.
“Eldest Miss said this job suited you the most……” Gu Xingzhu turned her head back and sized up Gu Nan’s small body. The words “I don’t believe her” were practically written on her face.
Gu Nian was already considered a half-elder in the Gu family. As the only Prodigious Realm cultivator in the younger generation, she had too many things to do. Of course she couldn’t stay with Gu Nan all day.
So Gu Xingzhu became their “liaison.”
Originally, she wasn’t too happy about contacting a poisonous snake like Gu Nan, but she couldn’t disobey Gu Nian’s order.
Lu Xinyu’s understanding of Gu Xingzhu was already outdated information. There was indeed considerable strife within the Gu family, but that was because its members were competing against one another.
Ever since Gu Nian advanced to Prodigious Realm, competition amongst the younger generation had lost its meaning. Unless a second Prodigious Realm expert appears before Gu Nian completely takes control of the Gu family, Gu Nian would be the undisputed winner. And Gu Xingzhu was one of the first people to surrender and join Gu Nian’s side.
This was the difference between the Prodigious and Innate Realms.
Gu Nan didn’t show any response to Gu Xingzhu’s doubts. He just nodded. “This really does suit me.”
To think that Gu Nian could actually find such a suitable job for Gu Nan—he just needed to go there a few times a week and ask for leave in advance. Even the field of specialization was quite suitable for him.
What Gu Nan excelled at had never been in martial arts, but with fighting skills. Gu Nian had already realized this back when she was in Langya World.
Gu Xingzhu shrugged. “Then go in with me…… I have to warn you first that the boss of this fight club isn’t easy to talk to.”
Gu Nan didn’t even respond this time. One after another, the two entered the fight club called “Reincarnation.”
A fight club with such a literary name was actually thriving. Thinking about it, this fight club definitely wasn’t anything ordinary.
“Xingzhu? You have time to come here today?” When a young girl saw them, she immediately asked in pleasant surprise, “How about it? Want to fight a match?”
“Okay! I’ve made considerable progress in the past two months.” Gu Xingzhu also smiled brightly when she saw the girl.
When the girl walked over, Gu Xingzhu continued, “But I have to take him to see your elder brother first…… This is Gu Nan, here to apply for the combat coach position. He’s my distant younger cousin.”
“Older cousin,” Gu Nan flatly emphasized.
Gu Xingzhu’s expression darkened.
She rolled her eyes at him and introduced the girl, “Wang Lizhi
[1]
, the second boss of this club. Her older brother is the boss.”
Wang Lizhi looked at Gu Nan with curiosity, while Gu Nan also had the same expression. “Wang Lizhi, is your older brother Wang Caomei?”
“Of course not! What man would have a name like Caomei?” Wang Lizhi showed a disdainful expression. “His name is Wang Guodong.”
“Oh, that’s very manly.” Gu Nan nodded.
……
……
The three walked forward together. They soon arrived at the inner part of the club and saw the legendary boss, Wang Guodong.
He was currently teaching a class of several students. Upon seeing the three, he had the students train freely for a while and started to walk towards them.
Wang Guodong was also a slightly thin man. He looked around thirty years old, but people couldn’t be judged by their appearances. Not only was he the boss of the fight club, but he was also their top coach.
In other words, he was the best fighter here.
Wang Guodong’s words were direct. “Gu Nan, right? You’re just in time. We’ve always been short on coaches, but we just couldn’t find professionals…… Let’s spar first?”
“Okay. Right here?” Gu Nan didn’t say much either. He just looked around.
Their surroundings should be a public training room. Many coaches were guiding students in their training, so there were many people watching them.
“Yes.” Wang Guodong nodded without hesitation. He felt as if that was a little impolite, so he smiled and explained, “Pardon me, because it’s training time right now……”
Gu Nan also nodded. Just when he was about to speak, a person hurriedly ran over.
“Brother Guodong, Miss Xu’s side…… Er……” A man in a coach’s uniform hurriedly spoke as soon as he ran to Wang Guodong, but halfway through, he realized that an outsider was present and quickly shut up.
Wang Guodong, however, didn’t care about these things. He frowned. “Not even Old Lin could do it?”
“Yeah.” That man smiled bitterly. “Miss Xu came to the club again in the evening. Coach Lin fought five matches against her and lost all five…… According to the previous agreement……”
“According to the previous agreement, it’s your turn to be my private coach now, Coach Wang.” A slightly cold female voice came from behind the man and finished his sentence.
The crowd couldn’t help looking behind them. They saw a young girl in loose sportswear standing behind them with a cold expression. Her arms were crossed in front of her chest, and her right sleeve was slightly damaged.
Gu Nan knew at a glance that this was caused by her fights previously.
“This is Xu Feiyan, the Xu family’s beloved daughter. Don’t provoke her.” Gu Xingzhu whispered in Gu Nan’s ear, as if she’s afraid of him causing any trouble.
In Gu Xingzhu’s eyes, Gu Nan was simply a thorn who’d dare to violate all sorts of taboos.
Not that her description is inaccurate, of course.
“The Xu family’s beloved daughter…… So basically she’s very rich?” Gu Nan thought for a moment and asked.
“Of course she’s rich,” Gu Xingzhu answered subconsciously, but then she immediately shot him a fierce glare. “It’s true that she’s very rich, but you still need to be alive after getting that money!”
Gu Nan turned his head and smiled at her, making the latter’s blood run cold.
Notes:
[1]
Lizhi = Lychee. Caomei = Strawberry. Guodong = Jelly
What the conversation sounds like:
She rolled her eyes at him and introduced the girl, “Lychee, the second boss of this club. Her older brother is the boss.”
Wang Lizhi looked at Gu Nan with curiosity, while Gu Nan also had the same expression. “Lychee, is your older brother Strawberry?”
“Of course not! What man would have a name like Strawberry?” Wang Lizhi showed a disdainful expression. “His name is Jelly.”
“Oh, that’s very manly.” Gu Nan nodded.
(So someone actually calls him “Brother Jelly” later…)
[ed/n: Chinese wordplay let’s go (^^) ]

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Xu Feiyan
chapters.content:
Looking at Xu Feiyan standing in front of him, Wang Guodong couldn’t help revealing a bitter smile. “Miss Xu, I really can’t leave this club……”
Ever since this Miss Xu first came to the “Reincarnation” club, she specifically asked Wang Guodong to be her private coach and said that money wasn’t a problem.
It’s just that Wang Guodong ran this club as a business undertaking. Naturally, it was impossible for him to abandon his family business to become something like a private coach.
So the two sides made an agreement. Wang Guodong was responsible for providing her with private coach candidates. The day she defeats all these coaches would be the day Wang Guodong becomes her personal coach.
The “Old Lin” that Wang Guodong mentioned earlier was a veteran coach in the fight club.
Who would’ve thought that he would lose five matches in a row after teaching her for less than fifteen days? Old Lin basically lost his face as an elder.
Xu Feiyan’s expression didn’t change. She flatly demanded, “Coach Wang, we had an agreement.”
With her status, she could even force Wang Guodong to be her coach for half a year, but she simply wasn’t willing to force someone to do something.
However, if Wang Guodong wanted to renege on the gentleman’s agreement they made, then she didn’t mind using other methods to make him agree.
Wang Guodong was also well aware of this. He knew that he had no way to refuse, so he could only give a small sigh. “I hope Miss Xu will give me some time. I still need to make some arrangements for the club.”
“Okay.” Xu Feiyan nodded and immediately turned and left. From beginning to end, she didn’t even glance at the crowd around her.
However, no one ever expected that just as Xu Feiyan turned around to leave, a soda can flew over from nowhere and hit her right calf.
Xu Feiyan’s entire body froze, and a sudden silence descended upon the crowd. Only Gu Nan, the one who kicked that can, still maintained a calm smile.
“Gu Nan, you……” Gu Xingzhu looked at him like he was a fool.
Even Wang Lizhi beside him subconsciously inched away a couple of steps, as if trying to distance herself from Gu Nan.
“This person must be crazy. He actually dared to prank Miss Xu……” The person in a coach uniform next to them was already gaping at him, looking at Gu Nan with a dumbfounded look .
But to everyone’s surprise, Xu Feiyan didn’t suddenly explode in anger because of this prank. Instead, she paused for a moment before slowly turning around.
Her brows were furrowed tightly. She looked around, and her gaze finally fell on Gu Nan.
“Did you kick this can?”
“I did.” Gu Nan smiled and asked, “How did you feel? Did you feel like you couldn’t dodge it, no matter what?”
Xu Feiyan fell silent. She looked down at her right leg and ground her toes into the ground as she twirled her right leg twice. The awkward, uncomfortable feeling in her heart intensified.
She was an Innate Realm Sixth Stage martial artist and had already cultivated an elite level of internal energy technique. Of course she was no stranger to identifying the positions of objects by listening to the wind.
As soon as that can flew up, she recognized that it would fall on her body, and she could even discern the exact landing point with her ears.
But when she wanted to move, all her movements felt wrong no matter how she moved. It was as if the other party aimed at a blind spot, so that she couldn’t dodge no matter which side she moved to.
But when she calmed down, she felt that this was abnormal.
‘Obviously, I could’ve dodged if I’d just lifted my foot, so why would I feel this way?’
“Because there’s something wrong with your walking posture,” Gu Nan still didn’t get a reply from Xu Feiyan, so he simply spoke.
Everyone, including Wang Guodong, was baffled by his words. ‘Don’t tell me there’s actually a fixed posture for walking?’
Xu Feiyan was the only one who raised her head in a flash of understanding. She rushed up and grabbed Gu Nan’s arm. Her good-looking face, which was originally cold, instantly changed into a pleasant surprise. “You. Be my personal coach.”
“Will you pay me?” Gu Nan asked.
“I’ll double whatever amount the club is giving you.” Miss Xu was a generous one.
So Gu Nan turned his head to look at Wang Guodong. “You heard her, Boss Wang. Give me a wage of a few million per hour. I’ll split half with you when the time comes.”
Xu Feiyan’s face instantly darkened.
Wang Guodong: “……”
……
……
In the end, Wang Guodong didn’t write out any sky-high type of price. He gave Gu Nan a special contract based on the highest treatment given to any coach in the club. Gu Nan would be Xu Feiyan’s personal coach, but he would still be part of the club.
Remaining as a member of the club was a necessary process, or else Classmate Gu Nan wouldn’t even have a coach qualification certificate.
Only then did Xu Feiyan know the details about Gu Nan’s employment—he was a temporary worker who had no coaching qualifications and hadn’t even been “accepted” by the club.
Of course, as long as he could give her good guidance, she didn’t care about his lack of qualifications.
In a private training room, only Gu Nan and Xu Feiyan were present. The latter slowly told him about her experience.
“When I was very young, I often trained with an épée
[1]
in my right hand, and my family didn’t think much of it. One day, an elder saw me and stopped me from practicing.
“He said that my form had yet to develop, so practicing martial arts like this will affect the balance in my entire body and leave fatal flaws in my movement.
“When I was 14 years old, there was another elder who gave pointers for my martial arts. At that time, he also said that…… I have a problem with my walking posture.”
Xu Feiyan used very concise language to create an image in Gu Nan’s mind of a female martial arts maniac who trained diligently but overreached herself.
Of course, what she didn’t say was that these two elders were both veteran Prodigious Realm experts, and it was usually rare to even see them in her family. Gu Nan was the third person to identify problems with her form.
Gu Nan nodded lightly. He had been immersed in constantly fighting for over ten years in his previous life. His fierce insight naturally wasn’t something ordinary people could compare to.
“It’s indeed a problem with your balance. When you walk, your right calf will subconsciously contract and walk slightly faster than your left. So when I aimed at one of the balance points, you couldn’t dodge it.”
“Coach, then what should I do?” Xu Feiyan’s face showed some eagerness and impatience.
Although she knew about this problem before, she didn’t expect that the problem could be so serious. ‘An enemy can actually take advantage of the difference in my walking speed and launch an attack that I cannot avoid?’
If Gu Nan knew her thoughts right now, he would definitely laugh involuntarily.
Because even if he ignored this, Gu Nan could still easily find dozens of flaws in her form and take advantage of them. It’s just that the problem with her right leg was the most obvious.
“It’s not hard to resolve,” Gu Nan said nonchalantly.
Xu Feiyan was stunned. ‘Not even that elder in my family told me how to fix it, but how come it’s so easy to fix for you?’
“Back then, you stopped in time, and your form wasn’t damaged. Now you just need to add weights to your left leg and readjust your balance.”
Xu Feiyan nodded slightly. This explanation seemed very simple. After thinking about it, she asked curiously, “Then what would it look like if my form was actually damaged?”
“One short leg and the other would obviously be longer.”
Xu Feiyan’s lips twitched slightly. She took a deep breath. “Then let’s start weight training.”
“What’s the hurry?” Gu Nan rolled his eyes. “Do you know how much weight to put? Do you know where to tie the weights to?
“Prepare the weight tools and a set of speed-measuring instruments. I’ll come back tomorrow evening,” Gu Nan commanded and left the training room without looking back.
Notes: [1]
Épée: Largest and heaviest of the three weapons used in fencing Épée – Wikipedia

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Familiar Mission
chapters.content:
Familiar Mission
“Twelve standard units of star iron. Thank you for your purchase…”
In the middle of the night, Gu Nan came out of the rare metals shop alone, complaining in his heart about the expensive last ingredient.
His pay as a personal coach was calculated by the number of lessons. He asked Wang Guodong for payment in advance, with the amount equal to three lessons, then ran over to buy star iron.
Wang Guodong was frank and straightforward. He agreed without another word—in reality, after Gu Nan helped him deal with a “scourge” like Xu Feiyan, this amount of money was nothing. He’d even be willing to double Gu Nan’s salary.
However, all the money Gu Nan currently possessed was only enough to buy twelve units of this material.
‘To purify it into star gold, at least half of the raw material will be lost… Who knows how many times this can still be used.’ Gu Nan pondered with some ridicule.
He actually had a selfish reason behind making an excuse to push Xu Feiyan’s coaching to the next time: he was in a hurry to buy star iron and search for missions from other worlds.
With his current Evil Value of 48, he was very likely to break through the 50 mark as long as he completed another mission.
Once he advanced to Prodigious Realm, he would finally have the strength to settle down in Star Realm and focus on his pursuits.
When he returned to the hidden cabin provided by Gu Nian, two people were already waiting there.
They greeted Gu Nan as soon as they saw him, “Mr. Gu, Eldest Miss wants to take Miss Bai back.”
Gu Nan glanced into the room. Bai Luoluo was lying in the incubator, submerged in a green nutrient solution.
All the injuries on her body had basically healed, and there wasn’t a single scar on her face.
Gu Nan sent her to Immortal Demon World after she fell unconscious, so her body was naturally left in Star Realm. Gu Nan wanted to protect the coordinates for Immortal Demon World previously, so he personally supervised her reincarnation process, but that didn’t matter now.
“Mm, you can take her back.” Thus, Gu Nan nodded. “Tell Gu Nian to inform me immediately if her condition changes.”
This concerned the “Evil Event,” so Gu Nan definitely wouldn’t treat it lightly.
“Yes.”
……
……
After sending Bai Luoluo away, Gu Nan took out the star iron he just bought and put it inside a jade vessel, then placed the vessel on the fire.
Star iron was a metal with a very special quality. It must be kept in a cold environment and will melt into liquid when heated even a little. If the temperature is slightly higher, it will quickly evaporate.
And the flame Gu Nan used was also very special. It was ignited using a special fuel called snow concentrate gel, which just so happens to be able to control the temperature and keep the star iron in a liquid state.
This step went quite smoothly. After a short moment, he was successful. Gu Nan then threw in some gold powder.
The gold powder was refined gold, which acted as an absorbent. As soon as it entered the liquid, the entire liquid began to shrink rapidly, and the original pitch-black color also began to rapidly turn into gold.
“Done… Contrary to expectations, it wasn’t difficult.” Only then did Gu Nan sigh in relief.
The entire purification process took less than two minutes, but the amount of technical skill involved wasn’t simple—at least, it would be very difficult for even official alchemists to pick out any mistakes in Gu Nan’s techniques.
After all, he practiced this many times in the Immortal Demon World.
The final result was similar to what Gu Nan expected. Only 8 units of star gold were extracted from the 20 standard units of star iron. The purification rate was merely 40%.
However, nothing could be done about this. Gu Nan quickly sorted out his mood and began to devote himself to painting the array’s patterns.
The method for receiving missions that Qin Xuanji provided him with was to find a platform that publicized missions to the outside world and receive those missions privately, then complete them.
The existence of world missions was very strange. They were generated by the world’s will, yet they also drifted away from the world’s will. A special person must “translate” a mission in order for cultivators to understand the content.
With the rising popularity of the reincarnation business, organizations specialized in translating these missions gradually formed and issued missions to the public, benefiting from the process.
One could indeed obtain benefits by completing a world mission, but most of these benefits would go to the translators themselves—for example, Radiant Tower and the organization that Gu Nan was about to make contact with.
As the inscription on the ground lit up, a golden beam of light gradually emerged, and a line of words was directly projected into his sight.
[Welcome to Astral Gate. Newcomer, please leave your code name.]
“Evil God.”
[Code name confirmed. You currently have Level E access. Please check the available missions.]
Astral Gate—that was the name of this organization. As an organization composed almost entirely of reincarnators, their system interface was very complete and could even be unilaterally operated by Gu Nan.
Gu Nan clicked on the missions list with his will, but a list of missions didn’t show up. Instead, another sentence appeared.
[We’ve detected that you are accepting a mission for the first time. You will be randomly assigned five available missions. You will need to wait one day to refresh the missions list.]
[We’ve detected that you are accepting a mission for the first time. To accept a mission, you will need to pay five units of star gold as collateral, which will be returned after you complete your first mission.]
Two messages popped up, which made Gu Nan’s eyelids twitch.
‘There are only five missions at a time to choose from, with a one day cooldown to refresh the missions list, and five units of star gold are even required as collateral… How despicable!’
One unit of star gold was only enough to open the Astral Gate twice, but this organization needed five units upon first meeting… ‘Fortunately, it’s just collateral and will be returned later.’
For the sake of earning Evil Value, Gu Nan didn’t worry about so much anymore. He immediately began to check the missions.
In Gu Nan’s opinion, none of the five missions were considered difficult. They belonged to the small-sized missions category. However, one of them attracted his attention at first glance.
[Mission Objective: Protect the White Dew Goddess]
[Mission Plane: Foreign Country, White Mist Plane]
[Mission Accepted: 3 times]
[Mission Information: Travel to the plane and protect the target character for five days. This mission is a collaborative team mission. The maximum number of reincarnators is 4]
Gu Nan frowned. The collaborative team mission had been accepted 3 times, which meant that 3 people had already accepted this mission, but someone didn’t agree to start the mission and wanted to wait for another person.
After all, the greater the number of people, the greater the chance of success.
However, what attracted Gu Nan’s attention the most was the mission content itself.
‘White Dew Goddess… This is a character in the game!’ Gu Nan couldn’t help recalling his previous life and all the time he spent inside the game.
‘There’s even a similar dungeon about protecting the White Dew Goddess in my previous life’s game, but I don’t know if it’ll be the same as this mission.’
Unexpectedly coming across a familiar mission, Gu Nan directly chose to accept without any hesitation.
[Mission successfully accepted. The number of people has reached the maximum. Please start the mission as soon as possible.]
After accepting the task, the light from the Astral Gate dimmed. After all, this was only a platform for accepting missions and not a reincarnation array.
Gu Nan activated the reincarnation array beside him and inputted the plane coordinates that he’d just received. The reincarnation ceremony appeared again.
Gu Nan’s body was stored in the endless void, while his soul was slowly drawn out, entering the reincarnation gate.
After his spirit traveled through the large blue gate, Gu Nan finally found the difference between this reincarnation and all the other ones, because the situation behind the gate was different from anything he had seen before.

chapters.title: Chapter 55: White Dew Town
chapters.content:
Inside Immortal Demon World.
In the quiet courtyard, Bai Luoluo performed a sword-dance alone. Her movements were clean and nimble, and there was nothing superfluous in the path her sword traveled.
If her current self was compared with her former self from a month or so ago, no one would believe that they were the same person.
While she was quietly practicing her sword, a dagger suddenly attacked, appearing behind her. Bai Luoluo’s reaction was also extremely fast. She countered with a sword strike in an instant.
Clang!
The two blades clashed and produced the sound of metal hitting metal. The attacker actually left as soon as the attack finished, not giving Bai Luoluo any chance to retaliate, and circled around so that the attacker was once again behind her.
Another strike fell. Bai Luoluo was forced to turn her head back again, but her opponent had circled to her left side this time.
After several times like this, Bai Luoluo finally couldn’t fend off the attacks anymore, and her longsword was sent flying far away.
Only then did Bai Luoluo say with a bitter expression, “Hall Master, why do you always use such… such…”
“Such vulgar tactics?” Yan Xiaoxiao asked with a smile as she picked up the longsword and handed it back to Bai Luoluo.
“Yes…” Bai Luoluo nodded softly.
“This is what my teacher taught me.” Yan Xiaoxiao’s smile disappeared slightly, and she said softly, “He told me that if you can win, then it doesn’t matter what methods you use, and if you can kill your opponent, then not even winning matters.”
Ever since she was taken in by the other party, Bai Luoluo had learned too many things from her, and she even wanted to become Yan Xiaoxiao’s apprentice.
However, her Sister Xiaoxiao always refused on the grounds that not even she herself had finished her apprenticeship yet, so Sister Xiaoxiao still had much to learn.
Although Bai Luoluo didn’t quite agree with these words, that didn’t stop her from showing a longing expression. “Sister Xiaoxiao’s teacher… What kind of person is he?”
“He’s probably… The greatest killer in the world.” A smile hung on the corner of Yan Xiaoxiao’s lips.
……
……
Gu Nan had reincarnated many times. Be it the Azure City plane, Langya World, or the mid-sized Immortal Demon World, he always arrived at the plane soon after passing through the reincarnation gate.
But this time was different. His soul was enveloped by a mass of power and transported all the way past “balls of light” of varying sizes.
Gu Nan knew that these were different planes.
‘Is the destination this time very far from Star Realm?’
One plane after another flitted across Gu Nan’s eyes. He seemed to be watched by countless eyes. Countless wills seemed to be slowly reaching out their tentacles, gradually approaching him…
Gu Nan never experienced this kind of thing before. An inexplicable sense of coldness began to appear in his heart.
But in a flash, he quickly came back to himself again.
Even if countless worlds’ wills existed here, and even if this place was the true reality of the world, they still couldn’t control him, because his advancement relied on the Evil God System.
‘Speaking of which, I left a small karma in Langya World back then. I wonder how that will affect me during advancement…’ While he was thinking this, Gu Nan’s soul was thrown into a ball of light, and his consciousness came back to a body.
“Oh, you finally woke up. Brother, the place you’re staying at seems quite far from here!”
As soon as Gu Nan woke up, he heard someone talking beside him. He must be one of the companions for this mission. He slowly opened his eyes and, sure enough, saw a man and two women nearby.
The previous voice clearly belonged to that man. Gu Nan looked up and saw a man with long hair and a bit of an artist’s aura.
But his manner of speech and attitude were very ordinary, as if he was the big brother next door going out to buy some vegetables.
“Now that everyone has arrived, let’s hurry.” The taller of the two women spoke, “I’m the first person who accepted this mission. I’ve found out some information earlier. You can call me Danny.”
Danny spoke the common language, but the three other members could hear that the pronunciation for her name was clearly different.
Gu Nan thought silently that this waa probably a cultivator from a plane that used a different language.
Then he also introduced himself: “Gu Nan.”
“Luo Sheng.”
“Lu Zhanyu.”
Gu Nan suddenly raised his head when he heard the last name and looked towards the last woman. Sure enough, she also looked towards him.
This time, their entire souls were reincarnated. Even if they changed bodies, the aura of their souls couldn’t be hidden. Thus, Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu quickly recognized each other after some thought.
When Gu Nan first left Radiant Tower, he met a pair of sisters by chance. They were entrusted by Gu Nian to resolve the problem of Bai Luoluo’s Dao Heart, but they couldn’t help in the end.
Lu Zhanyu was the younger sister.
She and Gu Nan stared at each other. Lu Zhanyu merely raised the corners of her lips and gave him a deep, meaningful look, then immediately glanced away.
Gu Nan also looked away as they both pretended not to know each other, but he was secretly vigilant in his heart.
This woman’s behavior was completely different from when he first met her. ‘If she doesn’t have multiple personalities, then that means she’s been putting on a play previously… She even needs to act in front of her older sister. Why is that?’
The four became acquainted like this, and Danny began to introduce their current mission.
“The plane I’m from isn’t far from here. There is also a legend about the White Dew Goddess left behind on my plane,” Danny spoke slowly, her tone slightly grave.
“According to records, protecting the White Dew Goddess was an event that happened in history a long time ago. However, the outcome at that time was failure. The White Dew Goddess was invaded by demons and fell from grace to become the current Moon God.”
“In other words, this plane is a single-chance fragmented plane. The plane can no longer be reset once we start the mission—we won’t have the opportunity to start over.”
The other three frowned simultaneously when they heard this.
Right now, Gu Nan also wasn’t a newbie anymore. He also knew a lot about planes.
Planes like the Immortal Demon World were already considerably complete, so the rules of those planes formed independent systems. Besides the size, they were no different from ordinary planes.
Small planes, on the other hand, were mostly called fragmented planes because their rules were incomplete. It was like the “Azure City” mission he finished—the events inside that plane constantly repeated themselves and was in an unlimited loop.
It was precisely because of this that reincarnators could fail the “Azure City” mission many times.
But this current mission couldn’t be reset, which meant that they couldn’t afford to fail—this part was different from the game. At that time, “Protect the White Dew Goddess” was just an ordinary beginner dungeon.
There was no more information from Danny’s explanation. After all, she was also here for the first time.
On the other hand, Gu Nan’s mission message finally arrived.
｢Dungeon’s Main Mission: Help the White Dew Goddess survive for five days
Mission Reward: Small｣
It was a very simple message. There were hardly any effective tips, but Gu Nan wasn’t nervous; rather, he became relieved as soon as he came to the town center.
“Dear adventurers, welcome to White Dew Town.” An elder with white hair and beard walked up to them and bowed. “The demons are coming, and the goddess needs your help.”This was exactly the same White Dew Town from Gu Nan’s memories. Not even the NPCs’ character designs had changed. Gu Nan even knew that this elderly mayor was actually a crossdresser…

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Demon Invasion
chapters.content:
Players are the most senseless group of people in the world. If they have enough time, they can ascertain every single detail about the game and thoroughly study the characteristics of every single NPC.
The Tier 2 dungeon named “Protect the White Dew Goddess” appeared early on in the game and could be reset indefinitely.
When players became strong enough to crush dungeons through brute force, of course people with time on their hands came back and started to thoroughly explore these dungeons one by one.
It wasn’t just attack methods and strategy—they explored everything from the background plot to even the easter eggs on passer-by NPCs.
So when Gu Nan saw that elderly town mayor, Moffett, he immediately felt at ease. If this was the same as the in-game dungeon, then he could clear it with his eyes closed.
While Gu Nan was looking around, the other three also began talking with the mayor in order to obtain more information on the mission.
Gu Nan listened for a while from the side. He was a little surprised to find that these people’s skill level was much higher than the people inside Radiant Tower.
Even Lu Zhanyu, who looked like a foolish girl earlier, appeared so capable and experienced now that she didn’t even seem like the same person.
‘Is it because an independent reincarnator must be self-reliant, so their abilities are stronger, or is it because the overall level of that branch of Radiant Tower is too weak?’ Such a question surfaced in Gu Nan’s heart.
Luo Sheng and Danny had already walked far.
Lu Zhanyu looked at Gu Nan doubtfully. “Aren’t you going to gather information on the mission?”
Gu Nan shook his head and expressed that he wasn’t interested— ‘What nonsense. I can even recite the lines of several key NPCs word for word, so what’s there to explore?’
Lu Zhanyu looked at him oddly, but ultimately didn’t say anything else.
Gu Nan’s image in her eyes was also somewhat mysterious. This had been the case ever since Star Realm. She didn’t expect that he would even be a reincarnator.
A moment later, the three met up again to exchange information, although everyone found similar things.
“The demon army will invade from the west. We have half a day to prepare,” Danny concisely concluded.
Luo Sheng nodded and added, “The town has items that can restrain demons. If we join the war, they can be provided to us for free.”
“But these items are limited, so we have to use them carefully,” Lu Zhanyu frowned as she spoke.
The three each spoke a sentence. Immediately after Lu Zhanyu finished, they turned their heads and looked at Gu Nan.
Although it was necessary to share information as team members, if Gu Nan wanted to obtain all their information without putting in any effort, then… Of course nobody would turn against him immediately, but they would definitely roll their eyes behind his back.
Lu Zhanyu’s eyes showed a trace of mockery. She really wanted to use this chance to gather information on Gu Nan.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, didn’t think about all that. In order to properly complete the mission, he didn’t mind giving some advice to the three party members.
“See that?” Gu Nan pointed to a little white dog by the road.
The other three simultaneously turned their heads and gave the little white dog a fright.
“What about that dog?” Luo Sheng looked curious.
“This kind of dog is called the Green Feather Dog. There are three in this town. On the first day, a Flying Devil will appear. If you use the Green Feather Dog’s neck fur, you can lure the Flying Devil over and kill it.”
Gu Nan didn’t even lift his eyelids as he continued, “If we don’t do this, we’ll have to waste a large amount of explosive potions to kill it. That would be a tremendous loss.”
The “walkthrough” was so detailed that it caused Luo Sheng and Danny to exchange glances. The latter said hesitantly, “This town isn’t big, so it won’t be hard to find the dogs. But… How did you know this?”
“Oh, a beggar passed by just now and told me,” Gu Nan casually made up an excuse.
All three of them stared at him with faces full of disbelief.
“Don’t believe me? Then there’s nothing I can do either.” Gu Nan shrugged. “That beggar left.”
……
……
Although they didn’t really believe Gu Nan’s excuse, it wasn’t hard to find three dogs, so they decided to trust him this once.
As mission companions, their respective positions were still pretty pure. They didn’t have any conflicts of interest with each other, so why would the other party have any reason to deceive them?
After collecting the fur from three dogs, the reincarnators then began to ask the townspeople what kind of help they could provide. They collected a pile of weapons, potions, and methods to restrain demons.
The three of them really were skilled. They knew that they wouldn’t use up all these items on the first day, so they found a place near the front line to serve as a temporary stronghold and item storage.
This would make it convenient for those who finished resting to rejoin the battle and would also facilitate the management of supplies.
This whole process was basically carried out by Lu Zhanyu and the other two, while Gu Nan was OB
[1]
the entire time.
Although Gu Nan knew what items would be used on the first day, he couldn’t say everything. That would seem too fake. What kind of beggar would know that much?
The first wave of demons attacked when night fell. The demons emerged like a tidal wave, making people’s scalps feel numb.
Every single one of these demons looked strange and frightening. There were six-headed ogres, Evil Eyes over ten meters tall, and giant spiders hundreds of meters long.
“So these are… demons?” Although Danny was knowledgeable, she had never seen such a scene before. Right now, her breathing couldn’t help quickening.
Luo Sheng’s face also looked a little pale. In contrast, Lu Zhanyu could still keep calm. After all, she had been raised in an influential family.
As for Gu Nan, he cared even less. If these people had witnessed the wars between different gods’ kingdoms, then they’d know that the current battle couldn’t even be considered a small-scale fight.
“Don’t be in a hurry to engage. This is just the demons’ vanguard. Let the NPCs… Let the natives exhaust these forces first,” Gu Nan calmly spoke, almost divulging too much.
Perhaps because they were infected by Gu Nan’s calm tone, his party members subconsciously chose to heed his words.
The town guards also poured out and rushed at the demon army from all directions. The ground outside the town was instantly dyed red with blood.
The demons didn’t make Gu Nan and his party wait too long. Just a few minutes later, four larger demons appeared. They were obviously demon leaders.
“Attack,” Gu Nan commanded out of habit. “Pay attention to the demons around them. Those are elite guards. Their stats are 30% higher than the ordinary demons.”
The three team members stared blankly.
After saying this, even Gu Nan shook his head slightly as he thought, ‘I’ve immersed myself too deeply in this play.’ Then he ran straight to the front line.
The goal of the first day’s attack was to help players adapt to the playstyle, so the difficulty wouldn’t be too high.
According to this world’s classification, the strength of a demon leader was roughly Innate Realm Fifth Stage, while Luo Sheng and Danny were both at Innate Realm Sixth Stage. Lu Zhanyu was slightly weaker, but she still had strength equal to a Fifth Stage expert.
If the demon leaders weren’t on the battlefield and if they weren’t surrounded by elite guards, then the four could clean up all the leaders in a few seconds.
Luo Sheng was a martial arts cultivator. He used a huge sword that could kill over ten demons with a single sweep. He charged into the fray directly.
On the other hand, Danny looked more like a spiritual-type cultivator. She chanted something, and balls of fire rained down around the demon leader, immediately causing miserable screams.
Lu Zhanyu’s strength was slightly weaker, but she cultivated both martial arts and mental-type secret techniques. Her figure was extremely nimble, cutting into the battlefield in a few steps.
All the demons that approached her became charmed, and they couldn’t come within 10 meters of her at all.
The three began to use their own methods to control the battle, then turned to look in Gu Nan’s direction—they were still very curious about this mysterious companion of theirs.
But what they saw was an exceedingly astonishing scene.
Notes:
[1]
OB (this was in the raws):
Short for Observer. Looking at events/battles in observer mode instead of actively participating in them.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Hook Up
chapters.content:
The target Gu Nan chose was the farthest away, and his speed wasn’t fast, so when the three looked towards him, he was just about to make contact with the demon.
Just when the three were waiting to see how he’d deal with the demon, Gu Nan unexpectedly disappeared from right under their eyes!
There was no prior sign, nor was there any internal energy fluctuation. Like a magic trick, he simply disappeared.
Lu Zhanyu, who had been paying the most attention to Gu Nan, froze and was almost caught by a demon.
Half a second later, Gu Nan’s figure appeared out of thin air again. He had actually circled around the demon leader and was now behind it, hitting it with a hard punch.
The demon leader didn’t even have a chance to react. Its brain burst directly from this punch, and the red and white liquid splashed all over the ground, silencing the surrounding demons.
“Roar!” Then louder roars sounded, but Gu Nan was already long gone by then.
The entire process didn’t exceed half a minute. The three onlookers were dumbstruck until Gu Nan called out, “What are you looking at? Kill your target quickly!”
……
……
Night fell slowly. The first attack was nearing the end, and three different waves of demon leaders had already appeared. Although they were stronger than the earlier ones, the four reincarnators could still deal with them easily.
Especially Gu Nan… No demon could withstand a single punch of his. That scene made Luo Sheng secretly wonder whether his giant sword could withstand a blow from Gu Nan.
“Is the Flying Devil you mentioned about to appear?” Lu Zhanyu couldn’t help asking Gu Nan curiously as the four stood inside the town walls.
They no longer doubted Gu Nan’s words right now, but they still didn’t have any idea of what Flying Devils were.
“How would I know? That beggar didn’t say,” Gu Nan rolled his eyes and casually replied.
Of course, he knew very well that the Flying Devil would appear when the demon wave only had 1% of troops remaining… ‘Here it is!’
A burst of high-pitched laughter rang out.
Gu Nan immediately became focused and hurriedly called out to the others, “Take out the Green Feather Dog’s neck fur!”
Before long, balls of green fur were placed in front of Gu Nan.
According to the principle in the game, the Green Feather Dog’s neck fur has its own energy absorption effect. Before it loses all vitality, it can spontaneously gather up energy, which is a fatal temptation to the Flying Devil.
A dark shadow rose and fell in the distant sky, then quickly flew in front of the four reincarnators. An astonishing aura filled the air.
“Prodigious Realm!” Luo Sheng immediately exclaimed.
“No, it’s pseudo-Prodigious Realm.” The nearby Lu Zhanyu said in a low voice, “It can only use rudimentary innate ability. Its actual realm hasn’t truly reached that step…”
The so-called pseudo-Prodigious Realm referred to someone who already had a basic innate ability, but whose cultivation realm was still lacking. In fact, Gu Nan was also currently at this stage.
However, even if it wasn’t a true Prodigious Realm creature, Lu Zhanyu’s expression still looked very ugly.
‘Firstly, pseudo-Prodigious Realms are still hard to deal with. Secondly… This is only the first day! To think that a pseudo-Prodigious Realm had already appeared. How will we deal with the next four days then?’
Luo Sheng had a grave expression, while Danny clenched her teeth and seemed to be considering how to deal with the situation. Only Gu Nan’s expression remained unchanged.
Most of the neck fur on the table was snatched away by the Flying Devil. The rest was picked up by Gu Nan.
The Flying Devil finally stopped and showed its figure—its skin was greenish, with a big bald head and ferocious-looking face. Two tusks protruded from its mouth. It was very in line with the image of devils in people’s impressions.
It stuffed the fur into its mouth and swallowed. Then it looked at Gu Nan and roared fiercely as a claw swiped at him.
“Be careful!” Lu Zhanyu and the others exclaimed at the same time. This devil clearly had an agility-type innate ability, and its raw strength couldn’t be underestimated either.
However, Gu Nan smiled nastily. The Dragon Heart Pendant on his neck suddenly lit up. His right hand reached out and graded the devil’s arm in an instant.
The Flying Devil was stunned. It couldn’t follow the other party’s movements at all and suddenly had a bad feeling in its heart.
Gu Nan grabbed its arm and directly lifted its entire body. He then slammed it heavily onto the ground behind him. A terrifying noise traveled out, and the smash cracked the ground.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom…
Gu Nan didn’t have any intention of stopping. The Flying Devil was flung back and forth like a ball. Gu Nan didn’t let go until five seconds had passed.
The Flying Devil could only lie on the ground, foaming at the mouth. It couldn’t even make a sound.
Gu Nan breathed out lightly, after which he lifted the Dragon Heart Pendant and grinned at the three onlookers. “Unconventional means… Get a good rest tonight. Tomorrow’s attack will be fiercer.”
……
……
Night had completely fallen. Gu Nan remained alone inside the temporary tent with his eyes closed, resting.
He dealt with the first day’s attack almost entirely by himself. Of course this wasn’t because Gu Nan was willing to help others; instead, he didn’t think it was necessary to use up the limited assistance items
[1]
on the first day.
Although it was a low level dungeon, the difficulty level of the dungeon named “Protect the White Dew Goddess” wasn’t low. His goal was to face the last two days with a party in good condition.
When carrying lower level players, a true top player would never only care about looking cool. Instead, he should try to reduce the mission difficulty as much as possible—of course, it would be even better if he could look cool along the way.
“Gu Nan?” A soft call came from outside the temporary tent.
Gu Nan couldn’t help revealing a trace of a smile. “Come in.”
Lu Zhanyu’s figure appeared. She seemed to be both complaining and asking, “Why did you choose to live here? Anyhow, the demons will only come tomorrow. You should get a good rest and nourish your spirit.”
They drove away the demons today, so they were already the heroes of the town. Of course they had a comfortable residence waiting for them.
“I’m just making it convenient for you to visit.” Gu Nan said with a small smile, “If I live over there, there will be many watchful eyes on me.”
This was actually just an excuse, because Gu Nan knew that a wave of demons would attack at night in the future. Thus, living in the temporary tent in advance was the only way where he could counterattack without the others suspecting that his response speed was too fast.
Naturally, Lu Zhanyu didn’t know about these things. When she heard Gu Nan’s words, an unspeakable emotion flashed through her eyes, but the corners of her mouth lifted into a smile. “Wanna hook up?”
Hooking up during reincarnation was very common. On one hand, missions were stressful. On the other hand, it wasn’t their own bodies anyways, so they wouldn’t lose anything.
“Okay, then take off your clothes.” Gu Nan’s gaze was flat, with an indifferent smile on his face.
The corners of Lu Zhanyu’s lips twitched, but she made no movement in the end. The two just stared at each other silently for three seconds.
Finally, Miss Lu couldn’t stand it anymore. She said in a low voice, “I want to tell you today that this mission isn’t as simple as you think.”
“Oh?” Curiosity finally appeared on Gu Nan’s face. He really wanted to know: ‘What else in this dungeon do I possibly not know?’
Lu Zhanyu hesitated. “It’s inconvenient for me to elaborate on the details. I hope that I’m just overthinking this… In short, be careful of Danny.”
Be careful of Danny?
This person’s series of behaviors flashed through Gu Nan’s mind, but he didn’t seem to see anything wrong.
After leaving these words, Lu Zhanyu turned and left. However, just when she was about to leave the tent, Gu Nan’s question made her stumble.
“Hey, you’re really not going to hook up?”
Notes:
[1] limited assistance items
: To clarify, he meant his teammates, not the consumable items, although it doesn’t seem like there’s much of a difference to him

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Hostile Agent?
chapters.content:
Early next morning, Gu Nan went outside the town as usual and started to lay out the defenses for a new day.
His three companions also seemed normal. Lu Zhanyu acted as though she had never been to his tent last night, and Danny’s expression gave no indication of her intentions.
The second day’s battle would be much more difficult than the first day’s, so players must use the support items inside the town.
“One high-grade Weakening Scroll, four Curse Crossbows, and a Holy Light Potion,” Gu Nan skillfully selected from the items. “Those will be enough.”
His companions watched him choose and listened to nouns they’d never heard of before jump out of his mouth one after another.
“Okay, I’ll explain today’s strategy.” Gu Nan gathered the three in front of him, as if he was clearing a dungeon in his previous life.
Noticing the increasingly odd gazes from his three team members, he could only begin with, “Last night, a beggar passed by my tent…”
“Why don’t you just say what the beggar told you?” Lu Zhanyu interrupted with exasperation.
Gu Nan gave her a look that said “Child, you learn fast,” and began to explain today’s strategy.
The lineup of the second day’s demon invaders wasn’t much different from the troop lineup on the first day. The only difference was that the monster types changed to larger, slower demons with rough skin and thick flesh, resembling moving mountains.
The Holy Light Potion should be provided to the NPC townspeople. After mixing the potion with water and having them soak their weapons in it, the townspeople would be able to deal great damage to the demons.
And this type of potion had no effect on players’ weapons, so players would need to operate the Curse Crossbows and shoot those demons to death with giant arrows.
After listening to Gu Nan’s explanation, Luo Sheng couldn’t help sighing. “To think the second day would already be this difficult… Truly, as expected of a five-star mission!”
“Five stars?” Gu Nan stared blankly.
“Don’t you know?” Danny added with a frown, “When you receive a mission from the Astral Gate, there will be an indicator of mission difficulty right beside the mission title. The more stars it has, the more difficult the mission.”
Gu Nan carefully recalled the scene back then. ‘It seems that there really was such a thing…’
But when he chose a mission, all his attention was focused on the words “Protect White Dew,” so he didn’t have time to care about the number of stars.
“It doesn’t matter. The difficulty level isn’t very important,” Gu Nan said as he waved his hand.
Black lines simultaneously appeared on his three companions’ faces.
……
……
All the battles went exactly as Gu Nan anticipated, from the type of demons to when they appeared. He even predicted the demon leaders’ strength level.
Whenever someone cast a suspicious look his way, Gu Nan would say, “There was a beggar last night…”
“Alright, alright! Who knows why there are so many beggars in this town!”
In response, Gu Nan shrugged and spread his hands.
Everyone has their own secrets. Since Gu Nan didn’t want to explain, of course nobody was stupid enough to ask.
Spells similar to prophecy or divination could also achieve this effect. The three of them were naturally happy to have such a teammate, so who would stand up and question him?
The four of them used the Curse Crossbows to kill normal demons and personally dealt with the leaders and elites.
The final boss was a Demon King that resembled a mountain of flesh. Originally, its skin was so thick that no one could hurt it, but after taking a Weakening Scroll to the face, there was no room for it to make a comeback anymore.
All of Gu Nan’s arrangements came in handy, and each item was used for just the right purpose—nothing was wasted. This made his three companions incessantly surprised.
Normally, they could still make it in time even if they started to consider countermeasures only after seeing the demons, but that would inevitably waste resources to sound out the enemy and cause unnecessary loss.
Gu Nan’s existence practically minimized the damage they suffered.
On the third day, Gu Nan was still the one in charge of strategy.
“That beggar visited again yesterday,” Gu Nan started this way. “Today’s demons are composed mainly of air units and can be dealt with by the mobile arrow tower. But the leaders and the boss are land units and don’t really have any weaknesses, so we can only rely on ourselves.”
“I remember there’s one last Weakening Scroll in the warehouse. Can’t we use that?” Lu Zhanyu raised a question.
Gu Nan raised an eyebrow and said with a slight smile, “There will be a use for that later—that’s what the beggar said.”
……
……
Under Gu Nan’s precise arrangements, the third day still wasn’t too difficult, but the four of them spent more energy than the second day.
The third day’s leaders and elites, as well as the final boss, were already terrifyingly strong. They practically reached the very peak of Tier 2. Not even Gu Nan could solo them, so he could only besiege them with the other three.
Of course, Gu Nan was still the main force. He was the only one who could withstand the boss’s attacks.
When the battle finished, the four reincarnators were all exhausted. Three was even a long gash on Luo Sheng’s right hand, which had hurt his tendon. It was bound to affect tomorrow’s battle.
Gu Nan frowned at this, but he also couldn’t do anything about it.
Although these three were relatively experienced, they still couldn’t compare with the game’s veteran players—at least in the area of surviving on the battlefield.
During the fourth day, an accident finally occurred.
