In a fight entirely similar to that of the previous day, a demon actually bit Danny’s neck when she became absent-minded, and she was seriously injured on the spot!
Fortunately, Luo Sheng risked his life to rescue her from the battlefield, but as the price, he also suffered heavy injuries.
So that night, Lu Zhanyu visited Gu Nan’s tent again.
“Do you believe me now?” Lu Zhanyu asked slowly with a solemn face as she stared at the completely expressionless Gu Nan.
“You mean Danny?” Gu Nan shook his head lightly. “I can’t think of any reason why she’d do this on purpose.”
If a reincarnator backstabs her companions, all it will lead to is mission failure. Moreover, it’d be impossible for her to gain any benefits after failing the mission.
Additionally, on the battlefield, countless changes can occur in a single instant, and they also reincarnated with their entire souls this time, so doesn’t she also fear suffering a huge loss after backstabbing her teammates?
If Luo Sheng hadn’t fought to the death to save her today, she would’ve died on the spot.
Lu Zhanyu’s expression looked a little strange. “They’re already sleeping in the same room tonight… That is Danny’s goal.”
Gu Nan was drinking water when he heard that and almost sprayed it on her face. “You mean, she came here to hook up?”
“Of course not!” Lu Zhanyu glared at him fiercely. “It’s very likely that she’ll kill Luo Sheng tonight, because she’s not on the same side as us!”
“She’s a hostile agent,” Lu Zhanyu concluded in a low voice.
Gu Nan raised a brow and finally realized what he had overlooked.
Not all participants in world missions would be in the same camp. Participants may even form two sides that are hostile to each other. But not even Gu Nan expected that hostile agents would actually disguise themselves as companions!
“There’s a spiritual secret art passed down in my family. From the start, I already sensed that her intentions were very mixed, and she was even vaguely hostile towards me,” Luo Zhanyu stated, and Gu Nan also nodded slightly.
‘If so, then this would make sense.’ But Gu Nan never knew that the dungeon for “Protect the White Dew Goddess” would actually have players fighting each other. If this was the case, then the difficulty level would also be ridiculously high.
‘If I think about it that way, then it also doesn’t quite make sense.’
‘That person… Back then, why did that person say that?’
“Let’s try to see if we can still save Luo Sheng. At the very least, we have to kill Danny, that scourge,” Lu Zhanyu urged.
Gu Nan suddenly raised his head and stared at her until her hair began to stand on end. Only then did he reveal a smile. “Okay, let’s go!”

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Poisonous Lu Zhanyu
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu reached the house, high-pitched howls were coming from the room.
As an old hand who had experienced many battles in his last life, Gu Nan naturally knew what these voices meant.
On the other hand, Lu Zhanyu blushed bright red. “This licentious couple…”
Gu Nan smiled but didn’t say anything as he pushed open the door.
Sure enough, those two were doing what everyone loved to do. The blankets had already fallen to the ground. The two were naked. They were both startled when they saw Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu enter.
“Gu Nan? W-Why are you guys here?” Luo Sheng was a little embarrassed, but he didn’t explode in anger. Perhaps in his view, this wasn’t such a big deal.
Before Gu Nan even opened his mouth, Lu Zhanyu was already speaking angrily, “Danny, don’t pretend anymore! You hostile agent!”
Only then did Luo Sheng’s expression change, and even his hands, which were hugging Danny, shrank back a little.
It wasn’t that he had never doubted her before. After all, her behavior today really was strange. However, firstly, he had sunk into the gentle and soft emotion called love, and secondly, the thought of Danny being a hostile agent never even crossed his mind.
But when he heard Lu Zhanyu’s words, the vigilance within his heart reappeared.
Danny looked stunned. It took her a long time to react. “You, you’re speaking nonsense!”
Lu Zhanyu sneered, “If you’re not a hostile agent, then how can you, a grand Innate Realm Sixth Stage expert, be injured by low-level demons on the battlefield?”
“I…” Danny’s face turned blue and white, but she couldn’t give any explanation.
Seeing this, Luo Sheng’s heart suddenly turned cold. He quickly climbed down from the bed, while Danny stared at him in a daze.
“You don’t have anything to say? Then die!” Lu Zhanyu looked very much like a hot-tempered little girl. She actually raised her hand and struck Danny’s forehead with her palm, instantly killing her.
“This…” Luo Sheng watched her, but he couldn’t respond in time.
Both he and Danny were seriously injured. Of course they wouldn’t be able to fight back, so he could only turn a pleading gaze to Gu Nan.
“She did the right thing.” Gu Nan was full of smiles as he said, “Since she’s a traitor, we must eliminate her immediately… Besides, we don’t have much time.”
“What?” This time, even Lu Zhanyu was stunned.
“The last wave… is already here.” As Gu Nan’s voice fell, the sounds of battle outside the town finally reached their ears.
……
……
“Gu Nan, it’s fortunate that we have you.” Outside the town, Lu Zhanyu looked at the traps and arrow towers that had been arranged in advance and sighed in relief when they blocked the demon invaders.
Her gaze looked a little blurred, as if she was admiring Gu Nan’s supernatural foresight.
Gu Nan smiled leisurely and said calmly, “Let’s attack. There’s no clever shortcut on the last day. Use up any of the remaining items we have. The rest is up to us.”
Danny was already dead, and Luo Sheng had basically zero combat power, so he stayed behind in the town to rest. Thus, only Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu could still fight.
Fortunately, the strength of the last demon wave wasn’t much stronger than before. It was even slightly weaker than the fourth wave.
After all, “Protect the White Dew Goddess” was merely a Tier 2 dungeon. It was impossible for a Tier 3 creature to appear, so designers could only get creative with the attack strategy in order to raise the difficulty.
From the start, the designer wanted to exhaust the players’ items and decrease the number of NPC townspeople, gradually taking away all the cards in the players’ hands.
And the last wave of attack accurately predicted players’ force of habit, trying to catch them off guard.
Once the demons break through the town wall and start fighting townspeople in the streets, the dungeon’s difficulty level will soar. After all, the demons were much better at one-on-one fights than NPCs.
But these methods had little effect in front of a player like Gu Nan.
At present, not only did they still have over half of the items remaining, but the town militia was still able to fight. The night attack didn’t have the desired effect either. Even if there were only two players left, it still wasn’t hard to defend the town.
As the number of demons decreased, the final boss appeared, but after being hit with the last Weakening Scroll, it was besieged on all sides by the town militia. Thus, this dungeon also came to an end.
In gaming terms, this was basically the CG phase right now. The players just needed to watch the play.
“Gu Nan, let’s keep in touch after we return to Star Realm!” Lu Zhanyu giggled in a little girl’s voice. “Can we complete the next mission together as well?”
“Okay!” Gu Nan readily agreed. “Cooperating with you is very delightful… Oh right, did you kill Luo Sheng yet?”
“Yup…” Lu Zhanyu blurted out a word without thinking, then froze.
Immediately afterwards, she revealed a somewhat forced smile. “What do you mean?”
Gu Nan had a sincere smile on his face. “I meant—did you kill Luo Sheng as well before you left the town? In any case, you’ve already killed Danny, so it’s not like killing him will affect anything.”
Lu Zhanyu’s smile gradually disappeared as she remained silent.
“That’s right. With your cautious nature, you probably disposed of his corpse as well?” Gu Nan continued talking to himself. “It wouldn’t be good if I found the body if I went to check on him after clearing the mission.”
Gu Nan’s voice echoed slowly, and Lu Zhanyu finally showed a new smile.
But this time, her smile was very calm, and her face held the same cold indifference that she had when she first came here. Anger, admiration, expectation—these emotions all disappeared without a trace.
“How did you find out?” She was purely curious.
“You asked me a question.” Gu Nan answered with the same calmness. “You asked me whether we should use up the last Weakening Scroll.”
Lu Zhanyu frowned in thought for a while. She guessed, “You think this is a waste of materials… so that’s why you suspect that I’m actually the hostile agent?”
“No, no, there are no hostile agents in this mission.” Gu Nan’s tone was very certain, “I merely felt that a person who simply wanted to complete the mission wouldn’t ask that.”
“You all should understand that it’ll be fine as long as you trust me, so why would you need to ask that?”
“Then you came to me later and said you were going to kill Danny. Only then did I understand.” Gu Nan stared into the girl’s eyes. “You were testing whether I have enough certainty to complete the mission, even with just two people.”
Self-mockery appeared on Lu Zhanyu’s face. “It turns out that I lost to your narcissism—to think you would even suspect a single question someone asked.”
Gu Nan shrugged noncommittally. “So, why exactly did you kill them?”
“Eh? You don’t know?” This time it was Lu Zhanyu’s turn to be surprised. “The rewards Astral Gate gives for team missions are fixed. The fewer people who participate, the greater the rewards per person.”
“In other words, the fewer people who survive, the more rewards each person gets.” Gu Nan suddenly realized and gave her a thumbs up. “Sure enough, a woman’s heart is the most poisonous.”
Lu Zhanyu’s lips twitched slightly. She felt speechless at Gu Nan’s way of praising people.
“So are you going to kill me now?” Lu Zhanyu looked up at Gu Nan and pointed to herself. “If you kill me, this woman with the blood of a snake and the heart of a scorpion, you can have the rewards all to yourself.”
“Of course not.” Gu Nan refused without hesitation. “Like I said before, our cooperation is very delightful!”
“We can still form a team in the future. I’ll take care of the mission, and you’ll take care of screwing over teammates.”
“If you’re discovered, I’ll just deny it and sell you out. Isn’t that wonderful

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Finally Advancing to Tier 3
chapters.content:
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed.
Main Mission Evaluation: B
Side Story Development: D
Map Exploration: C
Sin Value: B
Comprehensive Evaluation: B｣
+
｢Accumulated points: 100
Accumulated Evil Value: 3｣
+
When Gu Nan returned to Star Realm, the messages from the Evil God Temple gradually emerged.
Despite some unexpected developments, overall, Gu Nan was satisfied with this mission to “Protect the White Dew Goddess.” Not only did he successfully obtain the reward, but he even met a “reliable” fellow he can cooperate with.
That’s right. Although Lu Zhanyu’s way of handling matters wasn’t proper, and although she was even willing to sell out teammates to monopolize the rewards, Gu Nan doesn’t mind!
To be perfectly honest, he had seen even more immoral and outrageous things inside the game in his past life. It could be said that the vast majority of “Evil God Cultivation” players didn’t have any kind of three views. This kind of thing was simply too common an occurrence.
If the players in a dungeon were truly cooperating sincerely, then either there was no benefit from selling out their teammates, or the mission was indeed so difficult that it couldn’t be cleared if they were missing even a single person.
As for whether or not Lu Zhanyu will sell him out in the future… Gu Nan wasn’t afraid of that. He’d always been on his guard against everyone around him, so being vigilant against one more person wasn’t such a big deal.
But the most important thing was… he was about to advance to Tier 3 soon. Would he still fear Lu Zhanyu’s betrayal once he reaches Tier 3?
After receiving the rewards from this mission, Gu Nan already held 1,010 points and an Evil Value of 51, which just happened to meet the advancement requirements!
As his consciousness entered the Evil God Temple, Gu Nan sat quietly on the Evil God’s throne for a while. He gradually calmed his mood, then issued the command.
>｢Advance Tier｣
｢Exchanged item: Evil God Advancement. The player is currently a Tier 2 Evil God. Advancement requires 1,000 points and an Evil Value threshold of 50｣
｢Requirements met. Beginning advancement｣
｢The player is about to become a Tier 3 Evil God. Please select the core skill｣
>｢Shadow｣
Naturally, Gu Nan chose the “shadow” route that he was most familiar with in his previous life.
“Shadow”—or more precisely, “the law of shadow”—was one of the highest-ranked laws in the game. It was the flip side to the law of light and was also considered top-quality among all the core skills out there.
Of course, the higher the skill’s rank, the higher the requirements to control it, but a top player like Gu Nan certainly wasn’t worried about this.
As an inexplicable force entered his body, Gu Nan seemed to be back in the endless void, while darkness was approaching from afar and swallowing up the entire night sky little by little.
‘Is this… the power of shadow?’ Endless insights directly poured into Gu Nan’s brain, making him feel a splitting headache for a moment.
After all, reality was not a game. The body could be strengthened, but when Gu Nan began to enter Prodigious Realm himself, it was impossible for him to master the so-called “innate ability” without any foundation.
Unless he fully comprehended these insights and enlightenment, his power wouldn’t be able to keep up with his cultivation realm.
Of course, this wasn’t hard for Gu Nan.
For a high-end player like him, his comprehension was already top-tier to begin with, and his understanding of “shadow” was also far beyond that of ordinary people—he knew every single usage of the “power of shadow” like the back of his hand, so all he lacked was the theory behind the law of shadow.
And those insights from the Evil God Temple were there precisely to help him comprehend this law.
After this, even without the existence of the Evil God Temple, Gu Nan would still be able to comprehend the “law of shadow” on his own.
Gu Nan stood alone in the center of the empty palace, and the pitch-black shadow gradually spread out from underneath his feet until the whole palace was covered by it.
But at a certain moment, the shadow’s rate of expansion suddenly slowed.
In Gu Nan’s eyes, it seemed that some faraway force inexplicably descended upon him and tried to stop his advancement.
However, this force was too weak and disappeared in the blink of an eye as soon as it was washed away by the “law of shadow,” which was one of the primordial laws.
‘Could this be karma? I deliberately left some unresolved karma in Langya World, but I didn’t expect it to be so useless.’ Gu Nan washed away that force and shook his head a little inside his mindscape.
After a long time, Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes, and the shadow under his feet suddenly expanded, then retreated back into him.
“Shadow Form.”
He stretched out his right hand and gently grasped something. A pitch-black longsword gradually condensed. The sword was slender and narrow, glittering with a faint black gleam.
The familiar touch made Gu Nan smile. He held the sword and lightly stabbed forward, causing a strange ripple to echo through the palace.
The successful advancement to Tier 3 not only strengthened his body to an unprecedented height, but it also gave him the genuine “Power of Shadows” core skill.
Based on the cultivation theory in Star Realm, advancement from Innate to Prodigious Realm was a process of spiritual transformation.
Although the advancement principle behind the Evil God Temple was different, the final result was similar. Gu Nan’s spirit had been greatly strengthened, and the strength of his skill had also reached Tier 3. Now, he no longer needed to rely on the inferior version of the skill that required equipment to be equipped.
More importantly, due to the effect of “Shadow Earring,” his current “Power of Shadows” was actually Level 2!
As a core skill, “Power of Shadows” at Level 1 unlocked the “Hidden Shadows” skill, while Level 2 unlocked “Shadow Form.”
The function of “Shadow Form” was to manipulate shadows to create things. Not only could it create an incomparably handy weapon that could change shape at any time, but it could also turn into armor for defense. At the highest level, it could even create a humanoid clone.
“Shadow” was truly worthy of being one of the top core skills. Not only was it a powerful skill, but it was also ridiculously difficult to control. Ordinary players would need at least three to five years of practice to reach the level where they can create a clone.
But of course, this wasn’t anything difficult for Gu Nan.
After practicing all the variations of “Shadow Form,” Gu Nan’s consciousness returned to his body.
‘The next step is to pay a visit to Immortal Demon World. With my current strength, it’s no longer hard to hunt down Prodigious Realm cultivators, so I can earn a large amount of Evil Value and points this way.’ Gu Nan considered his next moves.
Although he had already advanced to Tier 3 and his Evil Value had also reached 50, this wasn’t enough by far.
Next, at the 100, 200, and 300 Evil Value thresholds respectively, he would unlock three more normal skill slots. Thus, he’d be able to buy and use normal skills, and even his core skill would be upgraded.
But if he wanted to advance to Tier 4, he’d need a full 500 Evil Value.
And the points he required would be astronomical, not to mention Gu Nan must still set aside some points to buy some Tier 3 equipment.
Equipment like the Observer Eyepiece and even the Four Element Crossbow had already reached the end of their useful lives. They were just waiting for Gu Nan to buy better items to replace them.
‘But before that, I have to visit the “Reincarnation” club first.’
Gu Nan didn’t forget that he had accepted the combat coach job in order to buy enough star iron to communicate with Astral Gate.
There were many powerful individuals in Star Realm. Gu Nan didn’t have enough power to act recklessly in Star Realm just yet, so he must abide by the rules there for the time being.
……
……
Just when Gu Nan was about to head to Immortal Demon World, two people secretly arrived outside Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters.
“Master, this is Azure Dragon Hall’s new headquarters,” A young man with a strong body stood beside a white-haired middle-aged man and spoke as he bowed.
“To change headquarters 5 times within the span of three days—the leader of this Azure Dragon Hall is also a cautious person,” The white-haierd man smiled with interest and said softly.
He then turned towards the young man. “The murderer who killed your Martial Uncle Han may be inside. Don’t you want to take revenge on him?”
Du Mian’s face suddenly twisted into a ferocious expression, but he soon calmed down. “I’m no match for that person, so I have to ask for Master’s help. Otherwise, I might not be able to catch up to him all my life.”
“Hahahaha!” The white-haired man laughed heartily. His laughter was full of joy as he slapped Du Mian on the shoulder with great force.
“That’s right. You know when to bow and when to stand tall.” The white-haired man said meaningfully, “If you were unwilling to admit defeat, you would always lose. Master is very gratified that you have learned to retreat!”
When Du Mian heard this, he was silent for a long time. Finally, he breathed out a long sigh. “I’ll have to trouble Master to kill this person.”
“No hurry.” The white-haired man waved his hand lightly. “Their leader won’t be able to escape. Why should we expose ourselves in advance before the other party even shows up?”
“The right way to go about this is to suppress the enemy by force

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Treatment
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan arrived at the “Reincarnation” club, he saw an unexpected acquaintance.
“Gu Nan, you’re here!” Wang Lizhi looked at him in pleasant surprise. “Miss Xu hasn’t arrived yet, but many people in the club want to meet you. Won’t you make an appearance?”
“Okay.” It didn’t matter to Gu Nan either way. He was just a little unscrupulous with his methods sometimes, not autistic. Why wouldn’t he be able to meet some new people?
There were very few students today. The public training room looked a little empty, but Gu Nan’s arrival made it lively.
“Coach Gu!”
“Coach Gu, I’ve wanted to meet you for a long time.”
“Thank you so much, Coach Gu! You’re our lifesaver!”
A circle of well-built combat coaches rushed up to surround Gu Nan and took turns shaking hands with him. They all looked as if they were about to shed tears of gratitude.
Gu Nan was a little speechless. ‘Looks like Xu Feiyan really tormented them greatly.’
After thanking him, most of the coaches went back to their work. Several stayed behind to ask Gu Nan for advice, and their attitude was very humble.
After all, he was a character who had managed to subdue Xu Feiyan. Who would dare act impudently in front of him?
Gu Nan also gave some casual advice. With his ability and insight, even if he didn’t have any actual strength, he’d still have enough knowledge and experience to guide these coaches.
Of course, no one here could see that Gu Nan had already advanced to Prodigious Realm, or else nobody would even dare to mention the words “give advice.”
“Miss Xu is here!” Someone shouted.
Gu Nan turned and saw that Xu Feiyan had arrived.
Xu Feiyan still wore loose sportswear. Combined with her cold and beautiful face, she really did have the charm of an icy beauty.
“Coach Gu.”
Gu Nan nodded lightly. “Did you prepare everything I asked?”
Before Xu Feiyan could respond, the young man who came with her interrupted, “All the weights, instruments, and equipment you requested are here, but I’m warning you: you will taste the consequences if you dare to speak without thinking!”
Xu Feiyan glanced at the young man somewhat helplessly. The young man was her older brother Xu Xun. As soon as he heard about her encounter yesterday, he firmly believed that the other party was a swindler and insisted on following her here to take a look.
And Xu Xun really did think so.
In his opinion, this Gu Nan had clearly heard the rumors from somewhere and knew that Xu Xun’s younger sister had a hidden injury, so he found the perfect opportunity to swindle her. He might even be a toad that wants to eat swan meat.
Thus, Xu Xun spoke provocatively in order to enrage the other party.
He wanted Gu Nan to angrily ask something along the lines of, “And who exactly are you?” As long as Gu Nan asked that question, he could then reveal his identity and teach this boy a lesson, and Gu Nan wouldn’t even be able to talk back!
Unfortunately, although his dreams were very nice, Gu Nan didn’t even glance at him.
He merely said indifferently, “Mm, come with me.”
……
……
“Do you know boxing? Practice a set first; let me see.” Gu Nan didn’t immediately start the “treatment” when they reached the training room. Instead, his first sentence was that.
“Okay.” Xu Feiyan gave a slight nod.
“You…” Xu Xun wanted to speak, but a glare from Xu Feiyan stopped him in his tracks, so he could only sit on the side and sulk.
Xu Feiyan very obediently practiced a set of boxing techniques, and throughout this process, Gu Nan’s gaze drifted between her legs, looking for the source of her lack of coordination.
But in Xu Xun’s eyes, he became even more certain that Gu Nan must be harboring wicked intentions. ‘If you can see the problem with your eyes, then what do you need so much equipment for?’
“Okay, stop.” Gu Nan handed her a leg ring. “Hang it on your left leg three centimeters below your knee and do that set of punches again.”
Xu Feiyan followed his words, but just as she was about to finish, she heard Gu Nan say, “Too low.”
So she could only raise it a little.
“Too much, a little lower.”
“Too low again… Okay, that’s it.”
Xu Feiyan’s expression looked a little odd.
On the other hand, Xu Xun couldn’t bear it anymore. He angrily ran over with a tape measure and said, “Do you think your eyes are rulers?! How can you tell if it’s exactly three centimeters…”
The second half of his sentence became stuck in his throat, because when he measured it with a tape measure, the position of the leg ring was exactly three centimeters from the knee.
Gu Nan remained expressionless. Having a precise sense of distance was a necessary quality for a professional gamer.
“Alright, Elder Brother. You can just watch from the side.” Xu Feiyan still had full confidence in Gu Nan as she pushed Xu Xun to the side.
Xu Xun rolled his eyes. “When a girl grows up, she won’t even care about her biological family anymore!”
Xu Feiyan didn’t quarrel with him and still shadowboxed as usual. After Gu Nan watched for a while, he asked her to change her leg ring.
“Change to this one, still in the old spot.”
“Hang this too, half a centimeter lower.”
“Replace the lower one…”
After adjusting the weights for nearly an hour, Xu Feiyan was already gasping for breath slightly. She had three weights on her left leg and also one on her right.
Only then was Gu Nan finally satisfied. “That’s good. Fix these four leg rings and practice that set of boxing moves five times a day. You can take them off in a week.”
“That’s it?” Xu Xun, who had been yawning continuously while he watched from the sidelines, couldn’t help blurting out when he saw Gu Nan suddenly stop.
Gu Nan ignored him, said goodbye to Xu Feiyan, and went straight to the door.
“Please wait, Coach Gu,” Xu Feiyan hurriedly stopped him when she saw him turning around to leave.
“What’s the matter?”
“After the problem with my legs is resolved, can you continue to be my personal coach?”
Gu Nan thought about it. He did still need a source of star gold, so he nodded. “Okay, but I won’t come often. At the very least, I won’t have time in the next week and a half.”
……
……
“Sister, do you really believe that fellow’s words?”
Xu Xun immediately became angry as he watched his sister carefully lift up her trouser legs and install the fastener on her legs.
In his eyes, that Gu Nan’s behavior was complete nonsense—the other party was simply pretending to be knowledgeable. ‘All he did was inexplicably have my sister shadowbox for an hour and hang a few weights. That’s it?’
‘If it truly was so simple, then my father would’ve cured my sister a long time ago!’
Xu Feiyan, however, didn’t refute him. Instead, she said calmly, “Anyhow, won’t we know whether he’s the real deal or a con artist in a week?”
……
……
In the Immortal Demon World, the manor headquarters of Azure Dragon Hall was already full of shouting and the sound of fighting. There were countless strong enemies, so even Bai Luoluo had to join the blood-soaked battle.
Fortunately, she was no longer a rookie after undergoing Yan Xiaoxiao’s training all this time. She didn’t hesitate at all when killing and took a life with every slash of her blade.
“Little Bai, go!” Yan Xiaoxiao split an enemy apart with her sword and took Bai Luoluo to a secret passage. “Leave now. I’ll follow right away!”
“Elder Sister Xiaoxiao, you’re coming with us too!” Bai Luoluo couldn’t help saying when she saw Yan Xiaoxiao turn around and go back.
But Yan Xiaoxiao ignored her. She gritted her teeth and walked to the spot right next to the secret passage, pushing the wall gently with her hand. The wall actually moved away to reveal a hidden room.
Bai Luoluo was stunned. ‘This is Sister Xiaoxiao’s room, but it actually has a hidden room? Just what did Sister Xiaoxiao hide inside?’
Through the faint light, she seemed to make out the shape of a coffin!
“Teacher, I’ll take you with me!” Yan Xiaoxiao held up the coffin with both hands as she spoke through gritted teeth.
‘Inside it… is actually Sister Xiaoxiao’s teacher? So he’s already passed away?’
Bai Luoluo’s imagination ran wild when she saw this scene. She didn’t know if it was her imagination, but she suddenly saw the coffin lid move a little!

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Battling the Demon Lord
chapters.content:
“Do you see that? All it took to plunge Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters into complete chaos was three small teams,” The white-haired expert told Du Mian while they stood on a high mountain outside the manor.
But Du Mian frowned slightly. “Their headquarters is already in such a mess, but that person still hasn’t shown himself. Is it because he’s not actually here?”
“Perhaps he’s not here, or perhaps he doesn’t care about Azure Dragon Hall.” The white-haired man’s voice was still calm without any ripples. “Of course, it’s more likely that he went into hiding.”
Du Mian’s expression suddenly paled, and he asked anxiously, “Master, do you mean that he’s already noticed us?”
“Of course he noticed.” The white-haired man shook his head with a smile. “But so what? I destroyed his organization and cut off his foundation—this is an overt plot.”
“If he doesn’t want to remain a coward all his life, then he will show himself sooner or later.”
As if to validate the white-haired man’s statement, the attacks inside the manor that were originally quick and violent suddenly seemed to be blocked by some force, and everyone inside froze.
An inexplicable wave of power swept through them, and an unspeakable sense of fear sprang up in everyone’s heart.
Du Mian also felt this wave, so a smile appeared on his face. He said loudly, “As Master expected, that person couldn’t help showing up in the end.”
However, the white-haired man, who had always looked calm and collected, suddenly changed his expression right then. “He advanced to Prodigious Realm!”
……
……
“Teacher… has advanced?” Yan Xiaoxiao looked at Gu Nan with pleasant surprise.
Originally, Gu Nan’s power was completely withdrawn into himself, but at the moment of reincarnation, his power entered this body through Gu Nan’s soul, and the fluctuation it caused couldn’t be hidden from others.
And Gu Nan also discovered an advantage of Prodigious Realm cultivators—they didn’t need to wait and recover their power after reincarnation. Their power would rapidly recover until it reached the limit that their soul could bear.
‘Reincarnation with half the soul… so it was like this.’
After reaching Tier 3, reincarnation felt very different than before. Many things he couldn’t understand back then were now clear to him.
‘With half of the soul as support, the other half of the soul is replaced with the world’s power. In this way, not only can this body inherit my entire power, but I can also receive one chance to escape death.’
‘But as soon as this body dies, the soul will be rejected by the world’s power, so it’ll be hard to enter this plane again.’
After seeing through the essence of half-soul reincarnation, Gu Nan finally turned his head and gave Yan Xiaoxiao a slight nod. “Enemy attack?”
“They… They’re from Limitless Demon Sect.” Yan Xiaoxiao gnashed her teeth. Azure Dragon Hall’s strength was practically uprooted overnight, and they suffered heavy losses.
It took great amounts of effort to gather this much strength, but after this battle, she’s afraid that the vast majority of this power will be lost.
Gu Nan seemed to see through Yan Xiaoxiao’s thoughts. He said with a faint smile, “As long as your own power is strong enough, you can make as many of these organizations as you want… Wait for Teacher to destroy the incoming enemy first!”
As soon as his voice fell, Gu Nan’s figure disappeared instantly, while Bai Luoluo stared in a daze.
Even though Gu Nan’s face was somewhat different from his original face due to reincarnation, Bai Luoluo still had an inexplicable feeling that Sister Xiaoxiao’s teacher… looks really familiar.
……
……
When his mind sensed an aura quickly approaching them, the white-haired man told Du Mian urgently, “Retreat to a safe distance first…”
Before he finished speaking, Gu Nan, who was dressed in a moon-white robe embroidered with golden threads, looked at him with a smile. “Demon Lord Wang Yutong?”
The Demon Lord narrowed his eyes slightly. After being silent for a while, he replied, “That’s right. To think that Fellow Gu has advanced from Innate Realm Fourth Stage to Prodigious Realm in a little over six months. You truly deserve to be called a genius!”
“You recognize me?” Gu Nan was truly curious now. He didn’t expect a native to know about his exploits from the past year.
“Back then, Daoist Gu had already comprehended a rudimentary innate ability while he was still in Innate Realm Fourth Stage and had successfully escaped from right under Daoist Wen’s nose. This cannot be hidden from us,” The white-haired Demon Lord leisurely explained.
Although Wang Yutong knew Gu Nan’s background very well, Du Mian’s heart shook violently upon hearing this.
‘It turns out that he had already comprehended a rudimentary innate ability while at Innate Realm Fourth Stage… No wonder he could defeat and even kill Martial Uncle Han with his meager Innate Realm cultivation!’
Du Mian even filled in the blanks about Gu Nan’s goals. ‘At that time, he must have been at the peak of Innate Realm and wanted to find a Prodigious Realm expert to test himself against. He wanted to use that life and death battle to break through!’
Even the Demon Lord thought so. He said, “My junior martial brother had inferior skills. This Lord has nothing to say about him dying at Fellow Gu’s hands. Daoist Gu has no grudge against my demonic path, so why don’t…”
“Why don’t you also follow your junior martial brother into the afterlife!” Gu Nan interrupted. A black sword had already condensed in his hand and stabbed towards the Demon Lord!
This sword strike was too fast. Not even the Demon Lord could dodge it.
But the Demon Lord was still the head of the demonic path. Even if he didn’t come from the upper world, his methods were nevertheless far superior to that of ordinary cultivators.
Calm and unhurried, he stretched out his right hand and gently touched the tip of Gu Nan’s sword with a finger, instantly blocking Gu Nan’s attack.
But before he could smile, Gu Nan suddenly grinned secretively. The Demon Lord immediately sensed danger and rushed to pull his hand back, but he was too late.
The longsword that had originally been repelled by Wang Yutong’s fingertip actually extended several meters out of thin air and stabbed into the Demon Lord’s fingertip.
Even Du Mian could sense some part of his master’s aura disappearing without a trace. Clearly, this sudden move had already destroyed one of Wang Yutong’s innate abilities.
Some anger finally appeared in the Demon Lord’s eyes, but his gaze remained calm. “Since Daoist Friend is determined to become enemies with this Lord…”
“Just fight if you want to fight; no need to prattle on!”
Gu Nan only retreated one step but unexpectedly stabbed forward with the extending sword again, this time aimed directly at the Demon Lord’s face.
The Demon Lord’s lips twitched slightly. He had never seen such an opponent before. ‘With our status and position, is there anything that can’t be resolved by sitting down and talking it out? Why are you so determined to fight like we’re mortal enemies?’
The grudge between Yan Xiaoxiao and the demonic path wasn’t anything major in the Demon Lord’s eyes. ‘If worst comes to worst, I’ll just give that small sect to Yan Xiaoxiao as a gift so that she can kill them all.’
As for whether or not that sect was actually innocent, Comrade Demon Lord didn’t care.
Gu Nan attacked six consecutive times with his sword. The Demon Lord didn’t use his fingers this time. Instead, he waved his hand lightly, and six vortices appeared in just the right places to block the path of Gu Nan’s sword.
“Gravitational vortex? Interesting.” Gu Nan gave a slight nod.
This Demon Lord’s core skill was “gravity,” which was already a very high-end law. Of course, the other party’s skill level was also quite good.
Only when a great skill was combined with superb control would it be able to produce excellent results.
But it was very unfortunate that he was facing Gu Nan, someone who understood the advantages and disadvantages of practically all the laws in the world and knew how to counter all of them.
The black sword in Gu Nan’s hand disappeared, and a humanoid shadow suddenly sprang up from behind the Demon Lord and punched down hard!
The weakness of a gravitational vortex was that the closer it was to the caster’s body, the harder it was to control—it could easily cause gravitational chaos. Thus, using a shadow double to fight him in close combat was undoubtedly the best choice.
“D**n it!” The Demon Lord finally became flustered. He never imagined that the other party could actually see through the weakness of his Demonic Gravitational Arts after only seeing it once!
And even the Holy Demon Finger was neutralized by the enemy’s stratagem, so his chances of winning were no longer high…
The Demon Lord made a prompt decision and suddenly pushed out a gravitational vortex. The shadow avatar was forced to dodge, and Wang Yutong took this opportunity to instantaneously break away from the battle.
He picked up Du Mian with one hand and rapidly retreated, leaving behind the words, “Fellow Gu, if fate permits, you might as well pay a visit to my sect’s sacred altar for a chat.”

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Aftermath of the Battle
chapters.content:
Gu Nan watched the Demon Lord’s figure gradually disappear, but he didn’t give chase.
The Demon Lord actually had a higher cultivation, but he lost because Gu Nan could see through all his attacks. Still, it would still be pretty difficult for Gu Nan to truly kill him.
In any case, Radiant Tower would be acting as the vanguard in the future. Why would he need to fight the Demon Lord to the death right now?
‘The most efficient method is to wait and collect the heads of demonic path experts in the future war.’
As soon as the Demon Lord retreated, the remaining demonic path small fries could no longer stir up any waves. In a moment, Gu Nan had slaughtered them all.
Yan Xiaoxiao began to instruct people to clean up the manor and repair the destroyed structures.
“Teacher, was that the… Demon Lord just now?” Yan Xiaoxiao came to Gu Nan’s side and asked with some difficulty.
Gu Nan’s fight with the Demon Lord wasn’t hidden from prying eyes. In addition, the Demon Lord’s conspicuous appearance made it easy for people to recognize him.
“That’s right.”
Yan Xiaoxiao took a deep breath and cupped her hands. “Congratulations to Teacher for stepping into the ‘Infinitesimal Stage’ as soon as he entered Prodigious Realm!”
The so-called Infinitesimal Stage referred to one of the smaller stages within Prodigious Realm.
There were three stages in between the Prodigious Realm and Void Cutter Realm: Origin, Infinitesimal, and Domain. Based on Gu Nan’s understanding, these stages actually correspond with the first three levels of one’s core skill.
With the Shadow Earring, his core skill was already Level 2, so he didn’t fall into a disadvantage even when he fought the Demon Lord—someone publicly known to be at the “Infinitesimal Stage.” Thus, Yan Xiaoxiao believed that Gu Nan’s cultivation was also at that stage.
“Not really.” Gu Nan shook his head. “Only my understanding of my innate ability reached Infinitesimal Stage; my actual cultivation hasn’t caught up yet.”
Yan Xiaoxiao almost couldn’t help rolling her eyes. ‘It’s way more terrifying that your comprehension of innate ability exceeds your actual cultivation, okay!?’
But she suddenly fell silent just then.
Gu Nan looked at her and asked with a slight smile, “What? Do you believe there’s hope for your revenge now?”
Yan Xiaoxiao still didn’t speak. Her usual smile gradually disappeared, replaced by the expression of the Polis Witch who had taken countless lives when she first appeared.
Gu Nan understood Yan Xiaoxiao very well.
This girl was a natural-born killer. The hatred of seeing her entire family slaughtered made her mature quickly, but it also made her walk down an extreme and obstinate path.
Although she’d put down her hatred for the time being per his persuasion, it didn’t mean that she ever forgot her hatred.
She put away the sword she used in the beginning and never unsheathed it again, not even when she was in a life and death situation just now. This meant that she was still trying her best to restrain herself.
She wanted to use her deep-seated hatred to nurse the vengeful sword in her heart. The day the longsword is unsheathed once more will be the day she achieves her Dao.
“Go get revenge,” Gu Nan said lightly.
Yan Xiaoxiao looked at him in a daze. ‘I thought Teacher would persuade me to be patient and wait until the sword in my heart has formed completely. I didn’t expect…’
“If you can’t even take revenge to your heart’s content, then what’s the point of practicing martial arts?” Gu Nan patted her head and smiled. “Never forget what made you first walk down this path.”
With Gu Nan’s voice, Yan Xiaoxiao seemed to return to that mansion a long time ago. She recalled the scene of blood splashing everywhere and the trembling from the depths of her soul.
……
Many bystanders were observing the battle at Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters, so it was impossible to hide the outcome.
The Demon Lord privately went to the South Central Region and tried to capture the emerging force “Azure Dragon Hall” in one go, but in the end, he retreated after suffering injuries—such news began to spread all over the world.
With the rumors growing more and more exaggerated, some places even claimed that the Demon Lord had suffered fatal injuries and was on the verge of death, and the downfall of the demonic path was just around the corner.
A meeting was taking place in the middle of the continent, inside Radiant Tower’s main headquarters in this world.
“It’s simply absurd! That Demon Lord is already an expert in the Infinitesimal Stage. He’s one of the strongest people among the natives. How can anyone injure him so easily?”
An old man whose face was full of wrinkles slammed his hand down on the table. He didn’t believe the rumors at all.
Together with him, a total of eleven people were sitting around a huge round table, discussing the incident. They all had different expressions.
“But this matter really is true—the Demon Lord retreated.” A woman in blue sitting across from the old man said leisurely, “According to our information, the person who fought the Demon Lord is at least at the Infinitesimal Stage.”
The old man looked gloomy. He knew he couldn’t refute the hard evidence right in front of him, so he asked instead, “Then you guys tell me: just where did such an expert pop out from? Don’t tell me that this world still contains a secret that we at Radiant Tower haven’t discovered yet?”
The elderly man’s last sentence made everyone’s expressions sink.
The reason Radiant Tower put so much effort and time into their preparations for this world wasn’t simply just to complete the mission.
After they dealt with the hostile reincarnators, this place would become a plane that would provide Radiant Tower with resources, allowing for a stable supply of various materials and human resources.
If this world still had undiscovered secrets and even hidden forces, then this matter really would require great attention.
“Everyone,” one of the women spoke up while everyone was still deep in thought, “I think… I might know that person’s identity.”
“What?!”
“Is that true?”
“Tang Xuan, have you received information from other channels? Is it reliable?”
A series of questions rang out, and Tang Xuan smiled wryly. She gently pushed forward the documents in her hands. “I don’t know if you remember that a genius once appeared in our branch office…”
As she spoke, the documents were distributed to everyone.
After reading Tang Xuan’s information, all the Prodigious Realm cultivators frowned.
What Tang Xuan showed them was Gu Nan’s past involvement with Yan Xiaoxiao.
Radiant Tower’s high-ranking members all knew that Gu Nan taught Yan Xiaoxiao in the past. Even the Demon Lord could find this information, let alone Radiant Tower.
It was also well-known that Yan Xiaoxiao was the Polis Witch and the Hall Master of Azure Dragon Hall.
“So… the mysterious person is Gu Nan, who has recently advanced to Prodigious Realm.” A young man with sword eyebrows and starry eyes shook his head with a bitter smile. “I did believe that he could advance to the next realm, but I didn’t expect him to be so fast.”
This young man, Yue Chenxing, once oversaw Radiant Tower’s operations in the southern region. He saw Gu Nan’s amazing accomplishments back then and greatly admired his talent.
“It’s a pity that he’s no longer one of us.” Another person nearby sighed softly. “Otherwise our mission will be much easier.”
The crowd also sighed helplessly.
Even among the people present, over half were still in Prodigious Realm’s first stage—“Origin Stage.” If an Infinitesimal Stage expert suddenly appeared, then the combat power on their side would rise exponentially.
Radiant Tower didn’t forbid members from leaving, so no one could say anything about Gu Nan’s departure. They could only lament that he left at a bad time.
Just when the meeting room became quiet, a middle-aged man with an elegant temperament knocked on the table and opened his mouth.
“Even if Gu Nan is no longer one of ours, that doesn’t mean we can’t bring him to our side.” The middle-aged man looked calm and collected, as if nothing could move him. “The fact that he fought the Demon Lord already revealed many things, including his allegiance.”
Everyone’s eyes suddenly brightened. They merely felt regret at letting a good talent go but failed to think of this.
Even if he was no longer in Radiant Tower, he could still be a comrade-in-arms!
That middle-aged man stood up slowly. “Everyone, the final decisive battle has come. It’s time to start the war between Prodigious Realm cultivators.”

chapters.title: Chapter 64: The Path of Revenge
chapters.content:
Just when the high-ranking members of Radiant Tower decided to start the final decisive battle in advance and intervene using Prodigious Realm powerhouses, a shadow quietly reached the southern region.
“Elder Sister Jiaqi, this is today’s information,” a young man with short hair spoke softly as he approached and placed a stack of documents in front of Mo Jiaqi’s desk.
“Okay, I got it.” Mo Jiaqi nodded and smiled at the young man. “Thank you, Zhao Mu.”
The young man named Zhao Mu seemed a little shy. He showed a bashful look and spoke in a rushed voice, “Sister Jiaqi, you should also get some rest!”
Mo Jiaqi was stunned. Recently, the war between the righteous and demonic paths was in full swing, so she was also very busy. She hadn’t had a good rest for a long time.
So she smiled again and patted Zhao Mu’s arm. “Alright, I’ll get some proper rest after I finish reviewing today’s batch of documents.”
Zhao Mu nodded excitedly when he saw that his suggestion actually had an effect. A strange feeling was gradually emerging in his heart.
‘Sister Jiaqi actually listened to my advice. Nobody else could persuade her. She…’
Just when Zhao Mu’s heart was surging, his eyes gradually widened when staring at Mo Jiaqi. This was because he saw a wisp of black shadow slowly climbing up along the foot of the table.
The dark shadow seemed slow, but it was actually very fast. Without giving Zhao Mu any time to react, it had already climbed up Mo Jiaqi’s neck in the blink of an eye. However, Mo Jiaqi seemed to be entirely unaware of this.
“Be care—” Before Zhao Mu finished speaking, he saw a scene that left him dumbfounded.
That shadow, which was wrapped around Mo Jiaqi’s neck, actually made a light slicing motion, and the latter’s head fell down just like that!
“S-Sister Jiaqi…” Zhao Mu froze, stupefied. He had never seen such a dreadful scene before!
Gu Nan’s figure also gradually emerged at this time. Only then did he notice the person standing beside Mo Jiaqi. “Eh? You’re also from Radiant Tower?”
Zhao Mu finally reacted and suddenly became furious. “You killed Sister Jiaqi. I will avenge her!”
While speaking, he had already lunged at Gu Nan.
Bam!
Gu Nan simply slapped him away, sending him flying into the wall. The slap fell on his face and completely deformed his face. Naturally, his chances of survival were slim.
“How stupid… Doesn’t he know that dying inside the plane only means she can’t enter this world again?”
……
……
Half an hour later, the manor housing Radiant Tower’s branch office was submerged in flames. None of the staff inside survived. The materials, scrolls, and all kinds of documents inside were all burnt to ashes.
Gu Nan brushed the dust off his clothes after he finished, leaving no trace behind.
He wanted to kill Mo Jiaqi because she was the one who slaughtered Yan Xiaoxiao’s entire family on Gu Nan’s orders.
As long as Mo Jiaqi remained in Immortal Demon World, the people from Radiant Tower might exploit this weakness to drive a wedge between him and Yan Xiaoxiao in the future.
And killing Mo Jiaqi was tantamount to destroying the evidence.
Even if Tang Xuan knew about this matter, she didn’t have any evidence, so her words alone would be useless.
He specially came here to destroy evidence in order to prepare himself for all eventualities. In fact, the current Gu Nan no longer needed anything from Yan Xiaoxiao. At most, he just wanted someone to help manage the organization.
During the war between the righteous and demonic paths, Gu Nan needed a reliable pair of eyes to collect intelligence and find suitable targets for him to hunt.
But after the war, it wouldn’t affect Gu Nan even if Yan Xiaoxiao found out the truth.
……
……
While Gu Nan was dealing with Mo Jiaqi, great changes finally came to Immortal Demon World.
The war between the righteous and demonic paths, which lasted nearly nine months, was finally about to enter the final stage—the confrontation between the most powerful forces on both sides: the showdown between Prodigious Realm experts.
September 15: The Sect Master of Heavenly Fire Sect, Daoist Yuli, used the Heavenly Fire to burn the demonic path’s army of 70,000 troops, shaking the world.
September 17: Daoist Yuli reappeared and was besieged by three Prodigious Realm masters from the demonic path, suffering serious injuries as a result.
September 21: Many demonic path masters infiltrated the righteous path’s stronghold in an attempt to assassinate high-ranking leaders, but they were met with an ambush by the righteous path and suffered heavy losses.
September 25: Joyful Union Dao’s Pure Land Bodhisattva fell.
September 29……
Once the war between Prodigious Realm masters was ignited, there was no longer any room for either side to hold back. The powerhouses on both sides threw themselves into the battlefield. In the short span of one month, nearly ten Prodigious Realm experts had already fallen.
This number was already the total accumulation of both the righteous and demonic paths over hundreds of years.
On battlefields that ordinary people couldn’t see, even more Prodigious Realm cultivators were constantly being killed or injured. Even the vast majority of famous native powerhouses died in those battles.
In a dense forest in the north of the continent, a team was hurrying along. They reached a hidden valley.
“Hall Master, the Yin Pagoda Sect’s last stronghold is up ahead. Their Saint, Saintess, and remaining guardian elder are all inside,” a man in black reported while bowing to a girl dressed in bright yellow.
“Do it,” the girl said calmly and emotionlessly.
This girl was naturally Yan Xiaoxiao. According to the intelligence she gathered, the Yin Pagoda Sect was the culprit that launched a surprise attack on her Yan family in the past and slaughtered them.
Ever since Gu Nan fought with the Demon Lord, Yan Xiaoxiao had embarked on the road to wipe the Yin Pagoda Sect from existence.
Commanding a team from Azure Dragon Hall, she conquered thousands of miles in a month, wiping out over 30 strongholds belonging to the Yin Pagoda Sect. She forcibly beat a mid-sized sect like Yin Pagoda Sect into an organization that only had a few members scattered about like stray cats or dogs.
Yan Xiaoxiao’s growth was too fast.
Half a year ago, she was just a little girl who could only do a little kung fu. But when Gu Nan came to save her last time, she was already able to fight on equal grounds with Innate Realm Sixth Stage experts.
And now, Yan Xiaoxiao no longer cared about those at Innate Realm.
After all, she followed a teacher who could crush those at the same level ever since he was Innate, and who dared to hunt down Prodigious Realm masters when he was only at the peak of Innate Realm. Thus, Yan Xiaoxiao already had her sights set on much higher realms.
All three of Yin Pagoda Sect’s Innate Realm Sixth Stage experts had died by her hands. All the direct blood relatives of Yin Pagoda Sect’s Sect Master were bled dry one by one, had their dried corpses beheaded, and were then offered as sacrifice.
And now, finally, one last location was left.
The Saint and Saintess were the last descendants of Yin Pagoda Sect. As long as she killed them, she would’ve severed Yin Pagoda Sect’s roots and completely erased them from the continent.
And with the lesson of Gu Nan and the Demon Lord’s battle still fresh in people’s memories, no Prodigious Realm master dared to intervene when Yan Xiaoxiao went out under the banner of Azure Dragon Hall…
The members of Azure Dragon Hall quickly obeyed their orders and went. On the contrary, Yan Xiaoxiao stood outside the stronghold and didn’t speak for a long time.
“Sister Xiaoxiao?” Bai Luoluo looked at her with some confusion.
“Little Bai, say… What else can I do after I get my revenge?” Yan Xiaoxiao’s voice sounded melancholy and even contained a little hesitance.
Bai Luoluo tilted his head and thought for a moment. “Sister Xiaoxiao can recruit more people into our Azure Dragon Hall! We will develop Azure Dragon Hall into the largest organization in the world!”
Bai Luoluo’s eyes lit up brightly as she said this, and she secretly added, ‘At that time, who will dare to bully us anymore!?’
Yan Xiaoxiao laughed involuntarily and reached out to rub the back of the little loli’s head.
“The strongest force in the world? I also want that… but…” Yan Xiaoxiao recalled the past. She remembered Mo Jiaqi and the day Mo Jiaqi introduced her to Gu Nan.
“But in this world, there’s a group of people who come from another world

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Buddhist Monk
chapters.content:
“Hall Master, we’ve captured Yin Pagoda Sect’s saint and saintess. Liu Qingsong, the sect’s guardian elder, was killed on the spot,” a man in black reported.
“Good.” Yan Xiaoxiao nodded and slowly walked towards Yin Pagoda Sect’s stronghold.
Corpses were already strewn about the residence. After all, the word “mercy” wasn’t in Azure Dragon Hall’s dictionary. There were no other survivors besides the two people they captured alive on the Hall Master’s orders.
“Polis Witch! You’ve committed heinous crimes and taken so many lives. You will certainly be punished by the wrath of Heaven!” Yin Pagoda Sect’s saint glared at Yan Xiaoxiao as soon as she appeared.
The saint was a youth who was only 13 or 14 years old. Because he had been pressed against the ground, his small face had already turned bright red.
Faced with the little saint’s condemnation, Yan Xiaoxiao normally would’ve ignored him and simply ended his life with her sword, but her mood was a little different today.
“The Yin Pagoda Sect killed several hundred members of my Yan family that day, so I’m avenging my parents now. What’s wrong with that?” Her serene eyes fell on the saint as she calmly responded.
The saint couldn’t help staring in shock when he heard that. After all, he was still young and had yet to manage any sect affairs. Of course he wouldn’t know about Yan Xiaoxiao’s background.
Yin Pagoda Sect had countless enemies and had also slaughtered many families.
For a moment, the saint was at a loss for words, but a voice traveled over slowly from afar, “Amitabha. Benefactor Yan
[1]
, please be merciful.”
A ray of golden light suddenly flashed across her eyes. Yan Xiaoxiao only felt a soft force blowing away the longsword she held to the saint’s neck.
When she looked at the newcomer, she saw a monk in unadorned clothes standing next to the saint and holding a string of prayer beads in his hand. His eyebrows were lowered, but his figure was as majestic as a mountain.
Yan Xiaoxiao snorted coldly. She raised her longsword and arrived in front of the monk in the blink of an eye.
“Amitabha!” The monk merely chanted one of the Buddha’s many names, and a wisp of golden light appeared out of thin air right in front of him. Yan Xiaoxiao’s sword was immediately blocked, unable to move a single inch.
“If revenge breeds revenge, will there ever be an end to it? Benefactor, is it worth it to create more sins through murder?” The monk placed his hands together in prayer, his head still slightly lowered. He sighed, “It would be better to let go.”
“Monk? Prodigious Realm?” Yan Xiaoxiao had frequent contact with Gu Nan, so she saw through the other party’s cultivation with a single glance. Her heart was slightly surprised.
Immortal Demon World also contained Buddhist sects, but Buddhism had always been in decline there. The Quanyin Temple, the leader of all the Buddhist sects, was the only one of the five righteous sects that didn’t have a Prodigious Realm cultivator holding up the fort.
But right now, a Prodigious Realm Buddhist arhat had personally appeared in front of Yan Xiaoxiao.
Yan Xiaoxiao was no longer ignorant about the world. She could recognize the appearances of both the righteous and demonic paths’ top figures, but she had no impression of the monk in front of her at all.
“Who are you?”
“This humble monk is Jing Nan.”
Yan Xiaoxiao’s frown deepened. She had never heard of this name before. ‘And actually, Quanyin Temple doesn’t even have a generation of monks whose names start with “Jing”…’
Did this Prodigious Realm master jump out of a rock?
No matter what the other party’s origin was, Yan Xiaoxiao knew that her path of revenge would probably be stuck at this last step—the strength of a Prodigious Realm cultivator wasn’t something that the current her could fight.
……
“A Prodigious Realm great monk?” At Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters, Gu Nan was also surprised when he heard Yan Xiaoxiao’s report.
Buddhist experts were truly rare. Let alone in the Immortal Demon world, he didn’t even see much of them in Star Realm. These great monks who particularly valued withdrawing from worldly affairs wouldn’t appear so easily.
‘But for a Prodigious Realm monk to suddenly appear in the Immortal Demon World, where Buddhism has always been weak…’
Gu Nan narrowed his eyes slightly. “Did you keep an eye on their whereabouts?”
Yan Xiaoxiao nodded. “He’s taking two children with him, so he can only use the official path. It’s easy to follow them.”
“Good, notify those in Radiant Tower of the news.”
“Yes.” Yan Xiaoxiao quickly accepted the orders and left. In fact, the only Radiant Tower member she could contact was Tang Xuan.
Ever since Gu Nan revealed strength at the Prodigious Realm, the people from Radiant Tower began trying to contact him, and Tang Xuan naturally became the person in charge.
Gu Nan also needed Radiant Tower’s help in order to find the right opportunity to hunt Prodigious Realm experts, so the two sides hit it off immediately.
Three of the demonic path’s Prodigious Realm experts who fell during this period had died in Gu Nan’s hands, giving him a wave of Evil Value and points.
Some gave more points and others gave less, but the amount of Evil Value was fixed—every Prodigious Realm expert gave three.
So Gu Nan now had 350 points, and his Evil Value had already reached 60.
After Yan Xiaoxiao informed Radiant Tower, Gu Nan no longer paid any attention to the matter. That monk wasn’t part of the demonic path. Killing him wouldn’t give any reward, so of course he didn’t care about the monk.
As for that saint and saintess, he wasn’t in a hurry to kill them.
In any case, they wouldn’t disappear. That monk would only be able to protect them for a while at most. When the war ends, it will be too easy to deal with them.
But Gu Nan didn’t expect to receive Tang Xuan’s reply in a little under two days.
The content of the letter was precisely to invite him to deal with the monk named Jing Nan.
……
Three days later, Gu Nan reached Luo City, the capital of Jin Country. Tang Xuan and two other high-ranking Radiant Tower officials were already waiting here.
The two senior executives were a man and a woman. The man was Yue Chenxing, who had praised Gu Nan at the beginning, and the woman’s name was Ye Zhiyu. She came from Ruby Fish Star’s headquarters and was one of the highest-ranking members in this mission.
“Tang Xuan, it’s already time. That Gu Nan still hasn’t arrived yet?” Ye Zhiyu asked impatiently with a slight frown.
“Maybe something happened on the road. Why don’t we wait some more?” Tang Xuan replied expressionlessly.
“
Hmph
! He could already escape from Wen Changfeng back when he was merely in the Innate Realm. What can possibly delay him?” Ye Zhiyu gave a light snort. “I think he’s simply looking down on us!”
Tang Xuan raised an eyebrow and was about to speak, but Yue Chenxing hurriedly came up to smooth things over and finally appeased them after much difficulty.
Yue Chenxing also felt a little helpless. Right now, Radiant Tower’s attitude towards Gu Nan could basically be divided into two factions.
Both sides agreed on borrowing Gu Nan’s help to complete the mission. However, a group of people wanted to make friends with Gu Nan and try to win him over as much as possible, while another group wanted to subdue him first and integrate him into Radiant Tower’s system for unified management.
Not much needed to be said about the first view, but the latter view was also pretty reasonable.
Gu Nan had been known as a genius ever since his debut, but he himself was very disagreeable and unreasonable. This kind of person was a double-edged sword; if they didn’t use it well, they would hurt themselves instead. Thus, they’d need to grind it well before using it.
Ye Zhiyu belonged to the latter group. She was born in a family of military officers in Star Realm and hated unscrupulous people like Gu Nan the most, so her words were very impolite.
After pacifying her, Yue Chenxing then tried to persuade her, “Zhiyu, we can say those things in private. But when Gu Nan arrives, you should…”
“What?” Ye Zhiyu interrupted coldly, “Don’t tell me he would dare to make enemies of my Radiant Tower? He’s nothing more than a cultivator who recently advanced to Prodigious Realm! Do you really believe that someone can actually step into the ‘Infinitesimal Stage’ as soon as he advances to Prodigious Realm?”
Yue Chenxing smiled bitterly. “That’s true, but…”
“There’s no ‘but’.” Ye Zhiyu waved her hand, “I’m the main commander of this operation. If Gu Nan doesn’t obey…”
Ye Zhiyu hadn’t even finished speaking yet when a light breeze blew past the three of them. A muffled sound was heard, and Ye Zhiyu was sent flying!
Notes: [1] Benefactor: Term used by a monk to address a layperson

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Independent Reincarnator
chapters.content:
Everything happened so fast that Yue Chenxing and Tang Xuan didn’t even have time to react, but Ye Zhiyu had already fallen to the ground.
What they didn’t expect was that Gu Nan had already appeared sometime when they were talking.
With a foot on Ye Zhiyu’s head and a light smile on his face, he looked down on them and asked, “What happens if I don’t obey?”
“Gu Nan, you…” Tang Xuan looked at Gu Nan, who suddenly appeared, and couldn’t speak for a while.
The current Gu Nan was too different from her impression of him.
Tang Xuan hadn’t actually met him in person after he left, so her impression of him was still that of a somewhat talented but weak junior.
Yet the young man in front of her was dressed in a moon-white robe embroidered with gold. His black hair was scattered at random, and his eyes were cold. His entire person was like a sharp arrow drawn from the quiver, so intense that people didn’t dare to meet his eyes.
‘Is this the real him?’ Tang Xuan inexplicably remembered Gu Nan’s calm expression when she took him to test his talent in the past.
Setting aside Tang Xuan’s complicated emotions, Ye Zhiyu finally came back to herself and suddenly fell into a rage. “Gu Nan, you’re courting death!”
A strong wave of flames surged up, and Ye Zhiyu’s entire body began to emit a red glow. The red glow possessed a terribly high temperature, and even the surrounding air was roasted and distorted.
This was Ye Zhiyu’s innate ability—Flame Ripple. If given enough time, she could release flame rays at extremely high temperatures, with each ray being fatal and hard to defend against. It was a very powerful innate ability.
“Trivial skill.” Gu Nan chuckled lightly. The shadows on the ground quickly covered Ye Zhiyu. Countless fine black threads shot out, and each thread just happened to hit the ripples.
So the Flame Ripple went out at a speed visible to the naked eye until Ye Zhiyu’s whole body was covered with shadows, without any hint of red.
“He really is at the ‘Infinitesimal Stage!’ Moreover, this is… shadow innate ability!” As the only Infinitesimal Stage master among the three, Yue Chenxing saw through Gu Nan’s cultivation realm at a glance and was shocked.
The so-called Infinitesimal Stage meant that cultivators had a perfect grasp of their own innate abilities and could freely adjust the intensity of their attacks, smoothly controlling their powers. It was just like Wen Changfeng back then: he could use air explosions to bomb someone or lift himself up with air pressure.
Gu Nan’s method, which perfectly neutralized someone else’s innate ability, was a high-difficulty skill, even among Infinitesimal Stage masters!
Ye Zhiyu, who was trampled underfoot by Gu Nan, was also dumbstruck right now. She never thought that her innate ability would be defeated like this…
Her Flame Ripple had always been famous for its high attack power. It would still be normal if her opponent dodged the attacks, but the other party forcibly suppressed her with his own innate ability.
This sense of powerlessness suffocated Ye Zhiyu’s heart.
……
In the end, Gu Nan didn’t give the killing blow. Under Yue Chenxing and Tang Xuan’s persuasion, he offhandedly let Ye Zhiyu go.
Ye Zhiyu also didn’t have the face to stay here any longer. She turned around and left without another word.
“No matter. I’ll inform her of our course of action later.” Yue Chenxing wasn’t worried about this. Instead, he looked at Gu Nan and said, “Brother Gu, many thanks for having mercy.”
Gu Nan had a good-natured expression as he waved his hand. “I’ve never liked senseless killing.”
Yue Chenxing and Tang Xuan both felt their lips twitch. They actually knew about Gu Nan’s past achievements…
Gu Nan had no feelings about that. From the start, he thought of himself as a normal person. He only killed to obtain rewards. Why would he kill someone if there were no rewards to be gained?
It was just like coming here to kill that monk. He wouldn’t have come if Tang Xuan didn’t mention that the other party had already joined the demon path.
“Based on our organization’s information, Monk Jing Nan is a famous independent reincarnator. He lives in Star Realm’s Sixth Region and rarely intervenes in the missions of large organizations. I don’t know what Satsuma Heaven used to convince him this time.”
Radiant Tower had been here for several years now, so of course they had long since uncovered the identity of the opposing reincarnator organization.
Satsuma Heaven was a reincarnator organization that only began to flourish in the past few decades. It mainly operated in the Sixth Region, so it wasn’t strange that Satsuma Heaven could get in touch with Monk Jing Nan.
“What’s Jing Nan’s level?” Gu Nan asked this key question.
“At least Infinitesimal Stage. Some people say that the core of his domain has already formed, so it’s only a matter of time before he steps into Domain Stage,” Yue Chenxing answered in a subdued voice.
Gu Nan couldn’t help rolling his eyes. “The four of us are going to kill an opponent like that? Forget it, let’s just go home and sleep.”
“Of course it’s not that simple… Listen to us first,” Tang Xuan interrupted.
“We dare to attack Jing Nan because he already has serious injuries…”
After hearing Yue Chenxing’s explanation, Gu Nan finally understood the source of their confidence.
Jing Nan himself had nothing to do with the world mission this time and didn’t intend to help Satsuma Heaven. The relationship between the two of them was more like cooperation. Satsuma Heaven would provide information, while Jing Nan came here to complete a different mission.
A heavily injured Jing Nan would at most still keep his cultivation realm, but his strength had almost deteriorated to Origin Stage.
In that case, attempting to kill him with the lineup of two Infinitesimal and two Origin Stage cultivators wasn’t an impossible task.
Gu Nan understood their intentions a little. “Is his mission related to that saint and saintess?”
“To be exact, it’s related to a treasure from the demonic path.”
……
“Master, thank you for saving us.”
Yin Pagoda Sect’s saint and saintess were both surnamed Zhang. He and his sister were Yin Pagoda Sect’s last remaining descendants now. Jing Nan led them out of the dense forest, and they fled all the way to Luo City. Only then did the saint feel renewed life after surviving the calamity.
“Amitabha. The Buddha enlightens all the people in the world. How can this humble monk not save someone at death’s door?” Jing Nan folded his hands together in prayer, although he was still expressionless.
The saint was still thanking him gratefully, but the saintess beside him, who had been silent until now, suddenly asked, “What did Master come here for?”
Jing Nan’s gaze turned slightly and fell on the saintess, showing a trace of approval. “Benefactor, may I ask for your name?”
“My name is Zhang Yao. This is my older brother, Zhang Tianxu.” Zhang Yao, the saintess, looked calmer than her brother. Her tone and expression don’t show any vexation, and no one would be able to tell that she had just escaped from death’s door.
Monk Jing Nan nodded slightly. “This humble monk has come here for an item called the Nine Profound Demonic Disk.”
“Demonic Disk!” Zhang Tianxu’s expression shook, and he hurriedly spoke, “Master, I know this treasure. Its last owner is a senior from my Yin Pagoda Sect!”
“Oh? Benefactor, do you know where it is?” A smile appeared on Jing Nan’s face.
“I know… eh? But it’s a demonic path treasure!” Zhang Tianxu was about to answer, but he realized something halfway through.
‘Why does this Buddhist master want to find a demonic path treasure?’
Without waiting for Zhang Tianxu to speak, Saintess Zhang Yao directly revealed the treasure’s whereabouts without any hesitation, “It’s here in Luo City. It was seized by Jin Country’s royal family a few years ago, but they can’t activate it. It should still be inside the royal family’s secret treasury right now.”
Zhang Tianxu turned his head and looked at his younger sister in confusion. A trace of helplessness flashed through his eyes.
In his opinion, since this master wants that treasure, they can use it as the price for asking this master to help them kill the Polis Witch…
Jing Nan nodded. “Benefactor, thank you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Jing Nan’s Turtle Shell
chapters.content:
“Oh Sister, why are you so muddle-headed?!” Zhang Tianxu sighed in disappointment. “That master was so powerful. If we asked him for help…”
“Why would he help us?” Zhang Yao curled her lips and asked indifferently.
Zhang Tianxu paused, then muttered to himself, “That master is merciful and compassionate…”
“Brother, if that master really was compassionate, then we would’ve died many times over by now.” Zhang Yao shook her head and said helplessly, “Don’t forget our identity.”
Only then did Zhang Tianxu’s heart sink. ‘That’s right. We’re Yin Pagoda Sect’s saint and saintess. In essence, we’re still part of the demonic path…’
Zhang Yao had already foreseen her brother’s naiveté, so she had no choice but to speak up just now. ‘If Brother actually finished his sentence… That master certainly won’t be merciful anymore.’
“Brother, let’s go.” Zhang Yao sighed.
“Ah? Where?”
“We’ll join the Limitless Demon Sect.” Zhang Yao’s eyes were full of resoluteness. “Azure Dragon Hall is still following us. Only the Limitless Demon Sect can save us now.”
……
Inside Luo City, Gu Nan and the group were heading for the imperial palace.
“The disk is hidden in Jin Country’s royal treasury. Jing Nan wants to purify the disk in order to earn merits and virtues. That’s his goal this time around,” Tang Xuan briefly explained Jing Nan’s mission.
Gu Nan thought for a moment and wondered, “So he’ll purify it. But what does that have to do with you all?”
Yue Chenxing next to him answered, “Three powerful demonic spirits are sealed inside it. Jing Nan can simply leave after purifying the treasure, but we’re the ones who have to deal with the remaining three demonic spirits.”
“Oh, so that’s why you guys decided to strike first and gain the upper hand by killing Jing Nan and snatching the disk?”
“That’s right.”
“Then I want the disk.”
“…Fine.”
……
“Who dares to trespass upon my great Jin Dynasty’s imperial palace?!”
“Amitabha. There’s an item inside your distinguished palace that has a fated bond with the Buddha. Benefactors, please give way.”
“Where did this bald donkey come from… Ah!”
……
“Jin Country doesn’t have any Prodigious Realm cultivators. The strongest experts inside the palace are only at the peak of Innate Realm. They’ve probably all died in Jing Nan’s hands by now.” Yue Chenxing couldn’t help frowning slightly as he stared at the tranquil palace.
Jing Nan arrived one step ahead of them, so there was no way he would arrive after them. The only possibility was that he had already snuck in quietly.
Tang Xuan’s expression looked a little grave. “What should we do then? The imperial palace has a complex layout. If the four of us have to search everywhere for him, I’m afraid we won’t make it in time.”
Ye Zhiyu also rejoined the party when it was time to carry out the mission. However, she never spoke a word and acted as though she was invisible, so of course she wouldn’t give Gu Nan any face now.
She was originally supposed to command the team, but she could only renege on that.
“What’s so hard about this? Can’t we simply force him out?” Gu Nan looked at them strangely.
“Ha! Easy for you to say!” Ye Zhiyu finally opened her mouth and sneered, “That Jing Nan monk is all alone in the world, so he doesn’t have any attachments. Just how will you force him out?”
Gu Nan shook his head, too lazy to speak. The Four Element Crossbow appeared directly in his hand. He raised it and fired a fiery red arrow, which flew straight towards the depths of the palace.
Although the Four Element Crossbow was only a Tier 2 weapon, its power was also affected by the player’s level.
With Gu Nan’s current Tier 3 strength, the crossbow’s current power wasn’t even on the same level as when he used it in the past.
A red line appeared in their sight, followed by a terrifying energy wave. An earth-shaking explosion came from the depths of the palace.
Blood sprayed through the air, broken limbs flew out, and miserable screams and angry shouts constantly sounded.
“This…” Tang Xuan looked at this scene, her heart freezing slightly. Now she understood what Gu Nan wanted to do.
Gu Nan didn’t even look at the palace. He shot several more arrows, which landed in several different directions. The successive waves of explosions plunged the whole palace into turmoil.
It has to be said that the efficiency of the imperial palace guards was still very high.
Someone immediately noticed the four intruders. “Who exactly are you? This is the court of the great Jin Dynasty. How can you…”
A thin teal line flitted across and directly pierced the person’s forehead, followed immediately by a whooshing sound—now that he was Tier 3, the wind arrow was already faster than the speed of sound.
There were only a few experts within the Jin Dynasty’s imperial palace. Jing Nan already dealt with them, so no one was there to stop Gu Nan’s party anymore.
Then Gu Nan took a deep breath and shouted firmly, “Jing Nan! If you don’t come out, we’ll slaughter everyone in the imperial palace!”
Just a moment later, a sigh came from the depths of the palace. “Amitabha. Since Benefactor is only here for this humble monk, why kill wantonly and bring harm to the innocent…”
Jing Nan’s figure slowly appeared in the air, holding a small black disk in his hand. The disk constantly emitted black qi, but the Buddhist aura on Jing Nan’s body purified it bit by bit.
Jing Nan’s mission would be complete once all the black qi was purified, but the three demon spirits sealed inside the treasure would also be released.
An idea immediately formed in Yue Chenxing’s mind after he heard Jing Nan’s words, and he hurriedly said to his three party members, “Don’t be in a hurry to attack. Since this monk cares about civilians, surely he won’t release the demonic spirits… Gu Nan! What are you doing!!”
Yue Chenxing originally wanted to persuade Jing Nan to join their side by mentioning the demon spirits, but who would’ve thought that Gu Nan… attacked instantly!
Gu Nan was like a shadow that couldn’t be caught, stealthily appearing behind Jing Nan. He gripped the shadow sword like it was a dagger and suddenly plunged it down.
“Amitabha!” Jing Nan didn’t dodge. He chanted a name, and the golden light all over his body brightened.
Gu Nan’s sword was blocked by this golden light, making a harsh sound upon contact.
“This is Jing Nan’s core innate ability. Its inherent attribute is gold. There’s nothing it can’t block.” Yue Chenxing exhaled heavily and helplessly said, “Let’s attack together.”
In the blink of an eye, the three Radiant Tower members launched simultaneous attacks. Ye Zhiyu condensed flame rays, Tang Xuan threw out metal blades, and Yue Chenxing created an ice pillar in each hand and smashed them toward Jing Nan.
The three of them each had their own methods, such as high-temperature rays, flying blades, or heavy hammering. They used three different methods to simultaneously attack Jing Nan.
When faced with a “turtle shell” opponent like Jing Nan, one must find and exploit the openings in his defense.
After all, they were all Prodigious Realm masters with good fighting instincts. Their cooperation was very tacit, without the need to discuss anything in advance.
But this was all useless, because Jing Nan still stopped all their attacks with a single “Amitabha.” He didn’t even open his eyes.
The three refused to give up and continued their fierce onslaught, but Gu Nan lowered his sword and stepped aside with a slight frown.
Most agility-type classes hate this kind of opponent who hides in a turtle shell. Although Jing Nan might not be very strong, Gu Nan’s attacks won’t break through his defense either.
Against such an enemy, Gu Nan could either break through his defense with brute force or find an opening in his defense.
Gu Nan contemplated for a moment, then took out a strange eyepiece from his pocket and slowly wore it on his left eye
