chapters.title: Chapter 68: Punching a monk to death
chapters.content:
The Observer Eyepiece was a piece of equipment that helped Gu Nan greatly but never played a pivotal role in any of his battles.
Throughout Gu Nan’s journey, most of his opponents were too weak. He didn’t need to specially look for openings in order to kill them, so the Observer Eyepiece never achieved the desired effect.
In fact, as part of the first wave of equipment purchased by Gu Nan, the Observer Eyepiece actually had a very high status in the game and could be considered a necessary equipment for beginners.
And the current situation confirmed Gu Nan’s foresight.
Without the Observer Eyepiece, he really wouldn’t be able to find a good method to defeat the other party in such a short amount of time.
After equipping the eyepiece, the passive skill “Insight” took effect immediately, and Jing Nan’s seemingly flawless “turtle shell” finally began to show some openings.
This feeling was akin to scanning the opponent and instantly finding several weak points in their defense.
“Here…” Gu Nan revealed a trace of a smile and rushed forward in a flash, throwing a punch at Jing Nan’s left shoulder.
Jing Nan, who had kept his eyes closed this entire time, finally opened them and leaned sideways slightly, forming his left hand into a palm strike to meet Gu Nan.
However, Gu Nan’s reaction was extremely fast. At almost the same time that Jing Nan moved, he had already turned his body. With nimble and flexible movements that resembled a dragon traveling up, Gu Nan’s fist changed its target to the top of Jing Nan’s head.
A serious expression appeared on Jing Nan’s face. His right hand was still controlling the disk, so he barely managed to raise his left hand to meet the punch.
Although his punch was blocked solidly by Jing Nan’s palm, a cold smile appeared on Gu Nan’s face.
Jing Nan felt a sudden chill when he saw Gu Nan’s smile. He suddenly noticed that some time during the fight, a humanoid shadow was already standing behind him. Now, it perfectly replicated Gu Nan’s earlier punch.
Its target—left shoulder!
It was impossible to dodge. After this punch landed, the sound of something shattering could be heard. Monk Jing Nan staggered back three steps, and even the golden light surrounding him dimmed a little.
Gu Nan stood still, seemingly resting, while the doppelganger created through Shadow Form transformed into a shadow and stood behind him.
“Shadow innate ability… and he can even create a clone!” Yue Chenxing sighed softly when he saw this scene. “As expected of the primordial innate ability that’s the flip side to the law of light.”
Monk Jing Nan’s expression turned grave. He looked a little bitter as his left hand twirled the prayer beads. “Amita—”
“Ta your mother! Die!” Gu Nan instantly powered up. His entire body turned into a shadow extremely hard to see with the naked eye, darting around Jing Nan at lightning speed and throwing dozens of punches every second.
He brought out his speed to the utmost and occasionally mixed in two real attacks among the countless illusory punches, which, combined with his coordination with his shadow double, beat Jing Nan until he was suffering unspeakable misery.
Tang Xuan, Ye Zhiyu, and Yue Chenxing had stopped attacking a long ago, because it was as if Jing Nan was surrounded by two dark shadows—they were unable to intervene in this kind of fight at all.
Ye Zhiyu suddenly had an indescribable feeling. Although she knew that Gu Nan was very strong, perhaps even a little stronger than herself, this…
The Prodigious Realm was a realm that covered an extremely broad range of strength levels. The difference in power even between those in the same stage within Prodigious Realm might be as high as heaven and earth.
‘A master like Jing Nan is already at the peak of “Infinitesimal Stage,” and his innate ability can cover his entire body. Yet such a powerhouse, who could step into Domain Stage at any time, was beaten so thoroughly that he couldn’t even fight back!’
What they didn’t know was that Jing Nan’s current situation was even worse than they thought.
Gu Nan’s physical body was too strong and too fast, so once he found an opening, a barrage of attacks would be waiting for his opponent.
Jing Nan had to fend off these attacks while simultaneously controlling the disk, so how could his defense still be perfect?
After only a minute, the “turtle shell” around Jin Nan shattered loudly. He hurriedly forced back Gu Nan and the shadow double with a palm and jumped out of the encirclement. “Benefactor, please listen to this humble monk’s words…”
“Die!” Gu Nan pounced on him again.
“Ben…”
“Die!”
Gu Nan and his shadow double were like two mad dogs, relying on their strong defense to rain a barrage of punches on Jing Nan’s head, not giving the other party a chance to speak at all.
Monk Jing Nan’s mouth twitched slightly. Without the golden light barrier, how could he possibly block Gu Nan’s attacks?
He fended off punches left and right for a long time, but several punches hit his face as a result. Half of his small face, which originally looked somewhat delicate and pretty, suddenly became swollen.
Jing Nan was unable to move quickly because he wanted to suppress the demonic disk. So when faced with this situation, he could only give a small sigh and throw the disk out with a wave of his hand.
Yue Chenxing jumped up and caught the disk with his hand while sighing with emotion, “You’re truly decisive… If you’d still refused to give up, then you might have died at… Hey Gu Nan, come back!”
While holding the treasure in his hand, Yue Chenxing’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets.
Gu Nan didn’t spare a glance towards his side. The shadow double slipped behind Jing Nan, once again surrounding him. Jing Nan, who had just breathed a sigh of relief, once again suffered a violent beating.
“Benefactor… don’t bully intolerably!” Although Jing Nan had the temperament of a Bodhisattva, even he was angered by this.
However, Gu Nan didn’t care. The enemy could talk as much as he wanted, but Gu Nan only cared about attacking.
This was a habit Gu Nan developed in the online gaming era. Dungeon bosses would always trash talk nonstop, so automatically filtering out boss dialogue was a necessary quality for a top player.
Jing Nan’s face was a little dark; even Yue Chenxing and the other two had dark expressions.
In their view, since they had already obtained the disk, why should they still fight Jing Nan? Making an enemy out of someone at his level for no reason certainly wasn’t worth it!
Of course they wouldn’t know that Jing Nan had long since turned into a pile of points and Evil Value in Gu Nan’s eyes.
Bam!
Another punch hit the bridge of the monk’s nose, and two lines of blood dripped down from his face. Jing Nan finally couldn’t hold on anymore and started to flee.
But with Gu Nan’s speed, how could Jing Nan possibly escape? Voluntarily pulling away would only give Gu Nan the chance to kite him to death.
While the shadow double slowed Jing Nan down by fighting him in close combat, the original harassed him with a crossbow from the back. Jing Nan suddenly felt that this situation was even more despair-inducing than being surrounded…
Six whole hours later, the poor monk was finally worn down and killed. Even until his death, he wasn’t able to leave Luo City.
Gu Nan was satisfied as he accepted the 3 Evil Value, as well as a whopping 150 points—‘It really does seem like stronger bosses give more points.’
“Where’s the disk?” Gu Nan returned to the trio and asked impolitely.
Yue Chenxing quickly handed over the disk in his hand, and Gu Nan casually accepted it.
“Hold on!” Seeing Yue Chenxing hand it over just like that, Ye Zhiyu hastily interrupted, “This is the only loot. Why should you monopolize it?”
Yue Chenxing couldn’t help rolling his eyes. ‘The hell would we even use this thing for? We might as well give it to this guy.’
But before he could say anything, Ye Zhiyu continued, “No one who cooperates with my Radiant Tower can monopolize the spoils of war!”
This time she learned her lesson and directly brought out the entire Radiant Tower as backing. In her mind, no matter how powerful Gu Nan was, he still wouldn’t dare to oppose Radiant Tower.
However…
Pa!
Gu Nan casually sent her flying with a slap, then spat disdainfully, “You never learn

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Tang Xuan’s Gift
chapters.content:
After the fight in Luo City, Gu Nan’s life once again became “peaceful”—he stayed inside the manor everyday, with people serving him. Someone even presented him with information about Prodigious Realm cultivators, so he only needed to go out and harvest Evil Value.
But just when he was enjoying his comfortable life, huge changes were occurring in the Immortal Demon World.
Radiant Tower’s years of preparation finally paid off. Its offensive had a thunderous momentum as soon as it launched, and with Gu Nan’s help, the experts of the six demonic factions fell one after another, having little power to fight back.
In terms of foundation, expertise, and degree of control over the natives—Satsuma Heaven couldn’t compare with Radiant Tower in any of those areas, so its defeat was already assured.
As time went on, the righteous path’s forces won consecutive battles. Although they also had Prodigious Realm casualties, that didn’t affect the overall situation.
Another month passed, and most of the demonic sects had already been destroyed. Demonic sects of all sizes had countless dead or injured members, and even the six major demonic factions had been broken up, its members scattered.
According to propaganda from the righteous path alliance, the demonic cultivators were nothing more than stray dogs now, fleeing in all directions in a panic. Righteous path cultivators only had to encircle and annihilate them.
“Teacher, there’s a letter for you from that place.” Yan Xiaoxiao suddenly walked in with urgent steps.
Gu Nan sat alone, sipping tea while reading over the battle report from the frontlines.
“Oh?” Gu Nan raised his eyebrow slightly, a little curious.
Radiant Tower hadn’t sent him a letter for a long time. It seemed that him unceremoniously teaching Ye Zhiyu a lesson still had some effect.
Of course, this was also because the situation forced its hand. Ever since the fight with Jing Nan, Gu Nan’s reputation had become well-known on both sides, so it wasn’t so easy to launch sneak attacks on demonic path masters anymore.
Moreover, it wasn’t easy to catch Prodigious Realm experts who wholeheartedly wanted to flee.
Even if people from Radiant Tower could keep up with the fleeing experts, they often couldn’t afford to wait for Gu Nan to arrive.
So Gu Nan stopped harboring any unreasonable expectations and peacefully waited for the main mission to finish so that he could obtain substantial rewards.
So why would Radiant Tower send him another letter at this juncture? Gu Nan opened the letter and suddenly laughed involuntarily, piquing Yan Xiaoxiao’s curiosity as well.
Gu Nan noticed her expression and passed her the letter. “Take a look.”
Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t hesitate and read the entire letter in a glance. She suddenly exclaimed, “The Demon Lord has been captured alive? They want to hold a righteous path ceremony?”
The letter informed Gu Nan that the Demon Lord had already been caught and that the righteous path would behead him as a sacrifice to their ancestors at the righteous path ceremony in three days.
The letter ended with an invitation for Gu Nan to attend.
“Teacher, will you go?”
“Of course… not.” Gu Nan shook his head firmly.
“Ah…” Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t quite understand Gu Nan’s thoughts. Now that the overall situation was set, the righteous path held all the power and influence.
‘With Teacher’s strength, he naturally doesn’t fear anyone, but participating in the righteous path ceremony is also a way to establish his status and position.’
‘As long as Teacher attends, he’ll obtain status befitting his strength and become famous overnight… As expected of Teacher. Not even this much fame and profit can move him…’
On the other hand, Gu Nan’s thoughts weren’t so complicated. He patted her shoulder and asked, “Have you found that pair of saint and saintess from Yin Pagoda Sect?”
“No.” Yan Xiaoxiao calmly shook her head. “The war situation is too chaotic right now, so we couldn’t find any trace of them. Perhaps they’ve already died in the skirmishes…”
Speaking of which, Yan Xiaoxiao suddenly revealed a small smile. “Teacher, in fact, I no longer care about my family’s former hatred.”
“It’s best if you can think this way.” Gu Nan nodded. “This world is very big. Strive to advance to Prodigious Realm as soon as possible… By the way, do you want to know why I won’t attend the ceremony?”
Yan Xiaoxiao couldn’t quite keep up with the way his thoughts jumped around and floundered before hurriedly shaking her head.
“They’re inviting me over to kill people, but I won’t kill if there aren’t any benefits.”
“Kill people? The big picture has already been set. Who else do they still want to kill?” Yan Xiaoxiao’s imagination immediately ran wild. She even thought that the remnants of the demonic path still existed and might make a comeback.
“Of course it’s to kill those righteous path cultivators!” Gu Nan answered, as though that was proper and to be expected.
“Don’t tell me that you believe we came from another world just to help people, do you?”
……
Three days later, at the righteous path ceremony.
Numerous righteous path heroes gathered. After a long ceremony to worship Heaven, the head of Heavenly Inquiry Sect personally beheaded Demon Lord Wang Yutong with his sword, putting an official end to the year-long war between the righteous and demonic paths.
The disciples from every sect held hands and celebrated, cheering that the era of the righteous path was coming.
However, they celebrated too soon. Countless unfamiliar killers suddenly appeared and purged the high-ranking members of the five righteous sects.
The battle lasted only a few hours, but all the seniors from the five righteous sects died. The righteous path withered from then on, now no better than the demonic path, whose remaining members had become street rats.
No one knew where these killers came from, and the few cultivators who knew about the existence of people from another world also unknowingly disappeared until none existed.
……
Gu Nan sat in the meeting room inside Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters, while a rare guest sat across from him.
“I thought you guys were busy hunting down the righteous path’s powerhouses, so you shouldn’t have the time to find me,” Gu Nan looked at the person in front of him with a light smile and said with a relaxed expression.
Thus was the first time that Tang Xuan visited Gu Nan’s lair, but if possible, she didn’t want to come over.
“Satsuma Heaven’s reincarnators have all retreated. It’s just a matter of time before we hunt down all the natives.” Tang Xuan’s face was calm. “For us right now, your attitude is key.”
“Me? I don’t have any attitude!” Gu Nan’s face looked innocent. “It’s none of my business whether you guys want resources or talents. I just want to raise a disciple over here while occasionally taking a vacation.”
Tang Xuan stared at him for a long time and said in a deep voice, “I hope you can remember what you said today. The matter regarding Mo Jiaqi…”
“I haven’t seen Mo Jiaqi for a long time,” Gu Nan interrupted and even spread out his hands in a shrug.
Tang Xuan gritted her teeth and felt a little resentful. Gu Nan, this person, was too cunning. Every step he took just happened to toe the line so that people either didn’t get angry or got angry but felt that the losses outweighed the gains.
Whether it was killing Mo Jiaqi or injuring Ye Zhiyu, those actions were all within the scope of the mission, and the organization didn’t suffer any substantial loss.
In these circumstances, the organization wouldn’t waste the effort to surround and kill him, a Prodigious Realm expert.
But how could she have known that digging out just the right amount of mission benefits was exactly what players excelled at, to begin with?
Since Gu Nan denied it, Tang Xuan didn’t say anything else and immediately got up to leave. But when she was about to leave, she suddenly smiled.
“By the way, when we were killing the righteous path cultivators, there was a person who claimed to know you, so I brought them here in passing. Just think of it as a farewell gift.”
“Hm?” Gu Nan was flabbergasted. After pondering for a long time, he really couldn’t think of anyone he knew from the righteous path.
And even if they knew him, why would Tang Xuan be so kind and send this person over to him?
But a moment later, Gu Nan couldn’t help laughing in spite of himself.
A carriage slowly approached. The curtain lifted, actually revealing a woman’s figure. There was a white light around this woman’s body, and few people could approach her.
But she looked unusually pale. Clearly, it wasn’t easy to maintain this white light. She was already at the end of the ropes.
It turned out that Gu Nan really did know this person—Goddess Sect’s Lin Jun.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Goddess Sect’s Secret Technique
chapters.content:
“Speak.” Gu Nan stared at Lin Jun, who was sitting in front of him with a slightly unnatural look, and asked calmly, “What can you give in exchange for your life?”
“Gentleman Gu…” Lin Jun bit her bottom lip a little and lowered her head slightly. Her expression looked weak, delicate, and easy to bully, but she also seemed like she was just barely propping herself up.
A black sword pierced her left shoulder in an instant.
Lin Jun looked up with stunned eyes, but Gu Nan was still sitting peacefully in the same spot. A shadow had appeared between them. The black sword came from precisely within that shadow.
Although she knew that the man in front of her was now an incomparable master at the grandmaster level, such strange and unpredictable means still made Lin Jun’s expression change.
However, what followed after that was Gu Nan’s cold words.
“You still have one last chance to say something.” Gu Nan’s gaze was ice-cold, as though the person in front of him was merely a skeleton. “If you can’t offer something I want, then you can join your colleagues.”
“Secret technique! I’m willing to offer my Goddess Sect’s secret meditative technique!” Lin Jun quickly shouted.
Gu Nan’s expression finally eased up, and he even showed a smile that resembled a spring breeze, just like when the two first met.
“Fairy, please speak,” Gu Nan said with a smile.
This was completely different from his tone and expression just now, which made Lin Jun suspect that the earlier events might just be a dream.
Fortunately, although the black sword had disappeared, the bloody wound on her left shoulder reminded her of the true colors of the person in front of her.
Lin Jun gritted her teeth and said, “My Goddess Sect’s secret technique can dispel people’s killing intent and help them clear their hearts and minds… Gentleman, you’ve seen it before.”
Gu Nan nodded very seriously this time. When he met Lin Jun before, the other party relied on that secret technique to stop Du Mian from immediately killing her.
“Dispel killing intent?” Gu Nan rubbed his chin, then tapped the table.
Another maid soon came in and bowed. “Master.”
“Send someone to the dungeon and bring two criminals up.”
“Yes.”
Lin Jun stared blankly at Gu Nan, not knowing what he wanted to do. However, she soon found out.
Two ferocious-looking men were soon brought up. Their expressions looked fearful, and they didn’t quite dare to look at Gu Nan. Clearly, Azure Dragon Hall’s dungeon wasn’t a nice experience.
“You two. I’ll free whoever can kill the other one.” Gu Nan casually threw down two long sabres and said indifferently, “Start.”
They reacted very quickly, picking up the sabres almost simultaneously and slashing downwards at each other.
These two were just ordinary Acquired Realm martial artists. They only knew the most basic hacking and chopping motions. But precisely because of this, every swing of their sabres drew blood, and they both fell down in a short while.
One had a gash on his face, and one eye had been cut apart. His opponent was in an even worse state. His thigh artery had been slashed open, and blood was surging out wildly. It looked like he wouldn’t be able to live for long.
But that one-eyed man refused to let him off. He walked forward with a nasty grin while holding the sabre.
“Stop him with your secret technique.” Gu Nan gestured towards Lin Jun.
“Understood…” Lin Jun already guessed this. She pursed her lips and began using her secret technique. A soft white light rose from underneath her feet and soon spread to the entire courtyard.
When the white light swept past Gu Nan, he only felt his heart become a little more at peace. This time, there was no reaction from the Evil God Temple.
But the one-eyed man froze and stared blankly at the dying enemy in front of him, unable to deal the fatal blow no matter what.
“How do you feel?” Gu Nan appeared beside him and asked softly.
“I, I can’t bear to…” That one-eyed man seemed to have become melancholy and moody. He murmured, “Look at him. He’s so pitiful. He’s dying anyway, so why do I need to deal the last blow?”
Gu Nan nodded. “Didn’t lose rationality, but experienced a severe change in mood… Looks like it’s a technique that induces emotions.”
Lin Jun originally felt happy because of the burly man’s words, but her face suddenly darkened slightly when Gu Nan made such an evaluation.
Even more unexpectedly, Gu Nan suddenly snapped the neck of the person on the ground with a kick, then looked at the one-eyed man.
“See that? He died at my hands. You didn’t kill him, so you didn’t fulfill my requirement. You still have to die.”
“Ah! What?” The one-eyed man immediately became enraged, and even his original melancholy faded a little. “That’s cheating! You…”
“Don’t worry.” Gu Nan smiled again and pointed to the maid near them. “See her? I’ll give you another chance. Kill her.”
The maid immediately became frightened and turned to flee, but the shadow on the ground tripped her.
Panic-stricken, she turned around. When the one-eyed burly man saw her flustered expression, his desire to kill rose again.
“Kill her, and I can live…” The one-eyed man began to glare at the maid fiercely.
Lin Jun frowned deeply from the sidelines, but she didn’t dare to physically intervene and stop him. She could only try her best to increase the intensity of her secret technique, and the white light under her feet became brighter and brighter.
The one-eyed man fell into a dilemma again.
He’d look ferocious one moment and compassionate the next. These emotions looked especially strange when they alternately appeared on his face, where one eye had already been cut apart.
Gu Nan coldly observed for a while. Then he simply walked over with a sabre and casually chopped off the burly man’s left hand with a swing of the sabre. The white light seemed entirely useless against Gu Nan.
“Ah!” The burly man screamed miserably. The fierce pain reignited the killing intent in his heart, and he once again raised the hand holding the sabre.
However, although he kept his arm raised for a long time, the blow never fell.
Gu Nan finally smiled and severed the man’s neck with one slash, then told the maid to clean up the mess, while he walked towards Lin Jun.
“Not bad. Can I learn it?” He asked with great interest.
This secret technique couldn’t affect him, but it could affect others and make them freeze in place while he killed them. This was equivalent to a crowd control skill, which was truly not a bad skill.
“Only those who use my Goddess Sect’s meditative techniques can cultivate it…” Lin Jun answered dully as she watched Gu Nan kill someone while her secret technique was still active.
Gu Nan had already expected this, so he didn’t say much. He just took Lin Jun along to look for Yan Xiaoxiao.
“Teacher, is she…” Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t know that Tang Xuan brought a gift over, so she believed that her teacher had found a wife. Her expression instantly looked a little strange.
Gu Nan casually threw Lin Jun at her. “From today on, you’ll practice killing inside the range of her secret technique. You can consider advancing to Prodigious Realm after you can fully ignore the effects of her technique.”
“Yes.” Yan Xiaoxiao’s expression suddenly became serious when they started talking about her cultivation.
“Oh, right.” Gu Nan changed the subject and asked, “Have you arranged everything on Bai Luoluo’s side?”
“The preparations based on the previous arrangements are complete. The plan starts today… But Teacher, we’ve made so many arrangements for such a grand plan, but if Little Bai’s heart isn’t determined enough, she might not…”
“If she can’t break out of this situation, then she can die inside it.” Gu Nan interrupted her with a smile, his tone emitting a coldness that chilled her to the bones

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Shi Family’s Siblings
chapters.content:
A longsword pierced through the man’s abdomen in the dark night.
“Why… Why did you of all people betray me?” Bai Luoluo’s voice trembled a little, just like how her hand was trembling as she held the sword.
“What right do you have to fight for the position of chief of the six departments?” The man countered with a sneer as he covered his abdominal wound with his hands, his eyes full of resentment. “Is it just because you’re a close friend of the Hall Master? You overestimate yourself!”
An explosion went off inside Bai Luoluo’s head, and she couldn’t hear anything anymore.
Ever since she left Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters and came here to be an ordinary assassin, she had never relied on any external help to reach her current position. She started from the bottom and slowly worked her way up, one step at a time.
She even believed that no one would know about her relationship with Sister Xiaoxiao, but unexpectedly, the person in front of her, whom she thought of as her best friend, actually hit the nail on the head.
As though he saw through Bai Luoluo’s thoughts, that man sneered again. “Do you really believe that we first met by chance?”
“We didn’t?”
“Don’t be silly. Which senior leader doesn’t know about your relationship with the Hall Master?! Vice Chief Huo ordered me to get close to you and keep you under tight surveillance!” The man’s voice was like a sharp arrow, passing right through Bai Luoluo.
Bai Luoluo lowered her head. Her eyes watered, but she forced the tears back.
It had been a long time since she had been this despondent.
Ever since she died in her previous life and transmigrated into this world for some inexplicable reason, she had told herself to be strong. She studied martial arts diligently and was even willing to become a cold-blooded killer because she just wanted the power to protect herself.
‘But is there no warmth at all in the world of assassins?’
She looked up at the man in front of her. He was her only friend and companion in her assassin career, and he was even the person whom she had entrusted a part of her feelings to, but now there was only coldness in his eyes.
Gradually, Bai Luoluo’s gaze became firm.
Another sword flashed past, and a bloody line suddenly appeared on the man’s neck.
“In this world, if you don’t kill others, they will kill you.” Bai Luoluo gazed up at the vast night sky and muttered, “Eldest Martial Sister, perhaps you’re right after all…”
……
……
｢Evil Event: Bai Luoluo’s Blackening Complete. Total Evil Value obtained: 4｣
While Gu Nan was sitting around, Evil Value fell from the sky.
‘Four? Not bad.’ Gu Nan nodded with satisfaction. Although this was a long-term event with quite a high difficulty, he didn’t personally participate too much in the event, so this reward was already quite good.
+
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed:
Main Mission Evaluation: C+
Side Story Development: B
Map Exploration: C
Sin Value: B-
Comprehensive Evaluation: C+｣
+
｢Accumulated points: 1000
Accumulated Evil Value: 30｣
+
What Gu Nan didn’t expect was for Immortal Demon World’s main mission rewards to also arrive right then, and the amount was very surprising!
30 Evil Value and 1000 points!
Although Gu Nan knew that Immortal Demon World’s enormous main mission would definitely give generous rewards, he was still a little happy to receive so many rewards.
He currently held 1500 points, and his Evil Value had also reached a shocking value of 97, which was only 3 short of unlocking the first skill slot.
‘Sure enough, these large-scale dungeons are the best source of Evil Value.’
When Gu Nan recalled how he had been working himself to death for so long before this, but this one mission gave him half of everything he had earned up to this point, his heart suddenly felt wronged… Fortunately, it was all his.
For the first time, he even felt that there were certain benefits to joining some large reincarnator organizations. For example, he could get these large-scale missions.
……
……
On a sunny morning, Gu Nan was already standing on the streets of Star Realm’s Ruby Fish Star.
Gazing at the scene of countless cars in front of him, Gu Nan felt as though he had returned to his previous life and couldn’t help sighing with emotion. ‘Sure enough, a scientifically advanced civilization is more suitable for retirement.’
Although the high status one could enjoy in Immortal Demon World was charming, in the end, that world still had all kinds of inconveniences.
While thinking, Gu Nan walked to the Gu family’s main gate.
Bai Luoluo’s body was still kept at the Gu family. Since the Evil Event was already complete, he could notify the Gu family to wake her up now.
“Please halt.” A guard walked up to Gu Nan with a cold expression. “Sir, this is the Gu family. May I ask who you’re looking for?”
“Gu Xingzhu.”
That guard looked at Gu Nan suspiciously, but finally nodded and said, “Please wait a moment, sir.”
Several people nearby also looked towards Gu Nan with odd expressions.
Gu Nan was dressed very normally, and there were no internal energy fluctuations around him. No matter how they looked, he didn’t seem like the type of person who could be acquainted with Gu Xingzhu.
The guard turned around to inform someone inside the residence, while a girl who entered at the same time as Gu Nan looked curious. “Hey, what’s your name? How do you know Gu Xingzhu?”
Gu Nan slowly turned his head and saw a girl in a white dress, which showed off her unique and youthful qualities. A young man in a well-ironed suit was even standing beside her.
Upon hearing Gu Xingzhu’s name, the young man’s gaze noticeably shifted to Gu Nan’s side.
“I don’t know her. I’m just looking for her to lead the way.” Gu Nan shook his head inside his mind. He was too lazy to attract trouble, so he casually made something up.
The young man’s gaze shifted away after hearing this answer, and he stopped paying attention to Gu Nan.
“Oh…” The girl also noticed this and was a little disappointed, but then an idea occurred to her, and she said with a playful smile, “I heard that there’s a person who always finds strange excuses to approach Gu Xingzhu recently. It can’t be you, right?”
Gu Nan glanced at her and was too lazy to speak again, so he simply shut up.
But when faced with a curious and stubborn person, the result would be the same no matter how Gu Nan responded.
“If you don’t answer, then I’ll take that as a tacit agreement!” The girl smiled and patted her brother on the shoulder. “Brother, this person is trying to snatch sister-in-law Xingzhu from you! Don’t you have any reaction to that?”
The young man shook his head helplessly. Of course he knew that his younger sister’s princess temperament had flared up again. She probably wouldn’t leave until she had teased this newcomer to her heart’s content.
The girl didn’t wait for her older brother to reply. She ran directly to Gu Nan while raising her head.
“Hey, I’m asking you a question! Do you know who we are?” She pointed towards the young man. “See him? He’s the young master of East City’s Shi family, Shi Tianjing. Are you scared now?”
Once she revealed that, even the guards near them couldn’t hold back their smiles.
They felt that this girl was obviously teasing Gu Nan, but Gu Nan also had no choice but to endure it— ‘This person looks like a country bumpkin who entered a city for the first time. Being teased by the Shi family’s young miss is his honor.’
Gu Nan was still ignoring the girl’s words. He didn’t even spare her a glance.
The guard who went to report came back in a hurry. His attitude also seemed more respectful now. “Miss Xingzhu invites you inside.”
“Mm.” Gu Nan nodded.
“
Hmph!
You still want to enter, even after ignoring me? I’m telling you, Xingzhu and I have played together since childhood. I don’t care why you’re looking for her. I…”
Bang!
Everyone heard a strange sound. Gu Nan had raised his foot and kicked Miss Shi directly in the abdomen. The force sent her flying, where she eventually fell to the ground.
“Too noisy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Master Gu
chapters.content:
For a second, silence seemed to have descended upon the Gu family’s front gates. Then Shi Tianjing became furious and raised his fist to punch Gu Nan.
“B*****d! How dare you…”
Gu Nan didn’t even turn his head. His figure merely swayed a little, and Shi Tianjing felt his entire person being thrown out by a great force.
The world spun in Shi Tianjing’s eyes. When he came to himself again, Gu Nan’s figure had already disappeared, while he was surrounded by a group of people.
“Young Master Shi, are you all right?” The Gu family’s guards looked at him with concern, and there was even someone who looked like a doctor next to them.
Shi Tianjing suddenly stood up and felt that he hadn’t been hurt, but a burst of dismay and embarrassment immediately hit him.
‘I’m an Innate Realm Fifth Stage martial artist, but someone actually took me down in one move. Plus, the other party clearly knows my identity, but he still dared to attack without any scruples!’
A dark glint appeared in Shi Tianjing’s eyes, and he decided to teach the other party a lesson. “By the way, where’s my younger sister?”
“When Miss Shi saw that you haven’t woken up for a long time, she said she’s going to look for ‘Brother Long’.”
“Long Quan?” Shi Tianjing’s eyes were slightly cold. ‘I’m fully capable of teaching that country bumpkin a lesson by myself. The only thing I’m worried about is the Gu family protecting him… that’s right, I can get Old Xu!’
……
……
When Gu Nan saw Gu Xingzhu, the latter had already heard what happened outside the door and was somewhat speechless.
This Gu Nan really was a scourge. He could cause trouble anywhere he went.
“What are you here for?”
“Wake up Bai Luoluo. It’s time.”
Gu Xingzhu’s expression turned a little serious. Reincarnation was illegal. Even the Gu family would experience some trouble if someone exposed them.
So when Gu Nian insisted on bringing back Bai Luoluo’s body back then, many people in the family criticized her.
“Also,” Gu Nan spoke up again, looking indifferent, “I want to speak with Gu Nian.”
“I’m afraid that won’t be possible.” Gu Xingzhu frowned and shook her head.
“Why? She’s not in Ruby Fish Star?”
“Of course… not.” Gu Xingzhu looked at him strangely. “Eldest Miss is busy with the Martial Arts Competition recently. We can’t even see her these days, let alone you.”
“Just go ahead and… Hmm?” Gu Nan suddenly paused before he finished speaking, because the Evil God Temple in his mind suddenly gave such a message—
｢Evil Event triggered: Chain Event——Ruby Fish Star’s Martial Arts Competition｣
Chain event?
Gu Nan was a little stunned. Chain events were quite rare, even in the actual game. They were a series of sequential events, and players could obtain Evil Value after clearing each event.
Such events were generally released as welfare. He didn’t expect to encounter one here.
“Martial Arts Competition?” Gu Nan touched his chin and decided to adjust the topic of his conversation with Gu Nian, focusing on this so-called Ruby Fish Star’s Martial Arts Competition.
Gu Xingzhu still thought he was talking to himself and nodded. “That’s right. Our family’s business group is the host for this year’s Ruby Fish Star Martial Arts Competition.”
“Mm, inform Gu Nian that I want to see her within twenty minutes.”
“You!” Gu Xingzhu suddenly looked angry and said in an icy voice, “Didn’t you hear me? Eldest Miss is very busy right now and can’t leave…”
“Just inform her.” Gu Nan’s expression was still calm, as if he was talking about a trivial matter like inviting someone for dinner.
Gu Xingzhu’s lips twitched slightly. She took several deep breaths, then sneered, “Okay. Don’t forget what you just said!”
She waved her hand and called over someone who looked like a butler, then left after whispering a few words in his ear—clearly, she didn’t want to see Gu Nan again. Even though she couldn’t afford to provoke him, she could still hide far away.
That butler was a middle-aged man with a mustache. With a professional smile on his face, he bowed and said, “Mr. Gu Nan, I’m Wang Dong. You can tell me anything you need.”
His smile was very professional, and his eyes were also smiling. However, it looked very stiff.
Gu Xingzhu had warned him, “This person is very troublesome.”
However, Wang Dong didn’t take her seriously, because he had been learning how to deal with people for half of his life.
However, the first sentence Gu Nan spoke made his face pale.
Gu Nan glanced at him with an odd expression. “Ah, Old Wang… Why isn’t your surname Gu?”
Wang Dong resisted the strong urge to roll his eyes and replied, “Sir, I’ve been surnamed Wang ever since I was a child. I won’t change my name just because I’m employed by a certain family.”
“Oh. I thought that for a family like the Gu family, they’d raise butlers from young.” Gu Nan recalled the clichés in the novels from his previous world.
Wang Dong had already recovered his calm. “The federation raises orphans until they become of age. In principle, private citizens aren’t allowed to adopt them.”
“Federation?” Gu Nan’s gaze flickered a little as he fell into thought.
A scientific and technological civilization like Star Realm, which even had the existence of a federation, still had certain advantages. At the very least, the foundation of its civilization was more firm than that of feudal civilizations, and it was more difficult to overthrow from within.
Gu Nan was already Tier 3 now. Soon, he would be Tier 4, then Tier 5. After completing the First Round and surpassing Tier 5, he would have to start establishing his own Divine Kingdom. Naturally, he had to consider these circumstances.
Evil Gods weren’t actually gods, but creatures somewhere in between gods and demons. However, they also possessed Divine Kingdoms. The entire Second Round focused on constructing a player’s Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan fell silent, and Wang Dong was also happy to see this.
This continued until Gu Xingzhu walked over with a twisted expression a while later.
She stood in front of Gu Nan with a cold face and hesitated for a long time before spitting out, “Eldest Miss says she’ll come over very soon…”
“Okay.” Gu Nan still reacted like this was only natural, which made Gu Xingzhu even angrier.
Originally, she wanted Wang Dong to stay, but a noise came from outside the door. A servant hurriedly ran over and whispered into her ear.
After Gu Xingzhu heard this, she suddenly showed a playful smile and ordered, “Let them enter.”
The servant left to carry out the order, while Gu Xingzhu turned to Gu Nan. “Hey, your trouble is coming. Shi Tianjing is bringing his gang of scoundrels over to demand an apology, and there are even people from the Xu family.”
Gu Nan was still expressionless.
“Looks like you don’t know what the Xu family is…” Gu Xingzhu began to explain, “There are many large and small families on Ruby Fish Star, but only the Xu family and Long family can compare with my Gu family.”
“I know you’re very powerful, but if you dare to even hit someone from the Xu family, then don’t expect Eldest Miss to protect you!” Gu Xingzhu sneered.
This wasn’t the first time she met someone like Gu Nan—someone who didn’t care about anyone in the world just because their cultivation was high.
The large families would naturally come out and teach such fellows a lesson. After all, this world couldn’t be controlled based on the whims of a single person.
While she was saying that, Shi Tianjing had already entered with a group of people, but the leader wasn’t him. It was another young man.
When they stopped in front of Gu Nan, Shi Tianjing merely sneered without saying anything.
A teen came up and said with a smile, “Brother, you even dared to hit our Young Master Shi. You’re very brave! Today…”
Pa!
While he was talking, he suddenly felt a pain in the back of his head, as if someone had slapped him. He immediately turned his head back in anger.
“Who hit… eh, Brother Xu.”
Standing behind him was precisely Xu Xun, the one currently leading the group. Xu Xun looked at Gu Nan with a face full of excitement, “Master Gu, I’ve finally found you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Gu Nian Arrives
chapters.content:
Gu Nan spent nearly two months in Immortal Demon World, so half a month had also gone by in Star Realm. Thus, the one week deadline he gave Xu Feiyan had long since passed.
Xu Xun had been holding back his anger ever since that day’s treatment, just waiting for the day when he’d finally prove that Gu Nan was a liar.
However, when his sister, who held out and didn’t bathe for a week, took off her leg weights and practiced her set of punches, the result almost made his eyes pop out of their sockets.
There was clearly no difference in her movements and footwork, but the power of her punches had increased by 30%!
One should know that Xu Feiyan was a martial artist at the peak of Innate Realm Sixth Stage. Unless she broke through to Prodigious Realm, it would be extremely difficult for her to make any further progress in her martial arts.
To think that merely wearing a few leg weights could have this kind of effect…
They even made a special trip to see the elder who first pointed out Xu Feiyan’s weakness. Even the elder clicked his tongue in wonder after hearing about it. He told Xu Feiyan to make friends with this person or simply lead him to their house so he could take a look.
The elder even said that this person might be the key to his sister’s breakthrough to Prodigious Realm.
With that remark, the entire Xu family launched into action and investigated openly and secretly for several days, but Gu Nan seemed to have disappeared from the face of the earth and couldn’t be found anywhere.
As for Gu Nan’s origin, they only knew that he was related to the Gu family, but the Xu family couldn’t investigate further without offending the Gu family.
Xu Xun had already given up, but he didn’t expect to run into this extraordinary person again here!
“Master Gu, do you… do you still remember me?” Xu Xun asked cautiously. He didn’t forget that his original attitude towards Gu Nan was quite bad.
‘I hope this Master Gu won’t get a bad impression of the entire Xu family just because of me.’
Xu Feiyan’s position in the Xu family was the same as Gu Nian’s status in the Gu family before she advanced to Prodigious Realm. Moreover, there was practically no internal competition among the Xu family’s younger generation.
Ever since Gu Nian advanced to Prodigious Realm, the Gu family had already started to suppress the other two families in terms of momentum. Now, the Xu family finally found an opportunity after much difficulty. All personal conflicts had to give way to the family’s benefits.
“No.” Gu Nan shook his head, but in fact, his memory was very good. He recognized the other party at first sight but felt it was troublesome and was too lazy to say more.
“That… I’m Xu Feiyan’s older brother.” Xu Xun smiled flatteringly.
“Oh.”
“…”
“…”
While the two of them were having this odd conversation, the group of young masters who came with Xu Xun was dumbfounded, especially Shi Tianjing. He originally expected Old Xu to back him up, but they actually knew each other…
“Old Xu, this person…” A dude asked tentatively.
Xu Xun’s expression suddenly changed. He stood behind Gu Nan and said, “Anyone who wants to look for trouble with Master Gu is also looking for trouble with me, Xu Xun!”
Shi Tianjing’s face alternated between turning blue and white. He gritted his teeth in silence. In his heart, however, he hated Xu Xun and Gu Nan bitterly.
Gu Xingzhu also watched this scene in surprise.
She was aware that Gu Nan and Xu Feiyan knew each other, but they were merely acquaintances. Why should Xu Xun protect Gu Nan to such an extent? This was simply an unreasonable endorsement of Gu Nan!
Just then, a voice came over from afar.
“Then I’ll look for your trouble—so what?”
All of Shi Tianjing’s original expressions disappeared when he heard this voice. His entire person calmed down inexplicably, but his expression was a little complicated.
He didn’t really want to see that person, but he had to admit that only that person could control the situation right now.
Everyone turned and saw a man and a woman slowly walking over.
The man was tall, with sword eyebrows and starry eyes. His appearance was extraordinary. The woman was delicate and lovely, but there was a pitch-black shoe print on her abdomen, which looked very out of sorts with her attire…
“Long Quan.” Shi Tianjing looked at the newcomer with complicated eyes, but in the end, he still took the initiative to greet him.
“Mm.” Long Quan nodded slightly. Although he was very dissatisfied that Shi Tianjing allowed Miao’er to get hurt, he was still Miao’er’s older brother, after all, so he couldn’t be too cold to Shi Tianjing.
Shi Miao’er finally saw Gu Nan again. All the anger in her heart instantly burst out. “That’s him! Brother Long, he’s the one who kicked me without even distinguishing right from wrong!”
Long Quan’s gaze fell on Gu Nan. He said coldly, “I, Long Quan, never treat anyone unjustly. Miao’er indeed has an unruly personality, but sir, isn’t it too much for you to use violence against a weak woman?”
Gu Nan didn’t even spare him a glance. He casually picked up the teacup on the side and took a light sip, then asked Xu Xun, “Who is this?”
“The Long family’s Long Quan.” Xu Xun didn’t respond to Long Quan’s initial provocation. At this time, his face also looked a little serious.
“Master, you don’t know this. People like our family’s Feiyan and the Gu family’s Gu Nian are seeds who have the highest possibility of advancing to Prodigious Realm. And such seeds… The Long family has two of them.”
“Is he one of them?” Gu Nan looked at Long Quan with great interest.
“That’s right.” Xu Xun gave a slight nod, then said, “But Master, don’t worry. You’re my Xu family’s esteemed guest. If someone dares to disrespect you, they would be making enemies of my Xu family… in a feud to the death!”
Long Quan finally frowned once he heard this. He didn’t know who exactly Gu Nan was, to actually make Xu Xun proclaim something like “a feud to the death.”
Of course he didn’t know; this concerned Xu Feiyan’s advancement, so anyone who hindered this matter would naturally become the Xu family’s mortal enemies.
However, Gu Nan waved his hand. “I meant that as long as I cripple this person, no one will dare to make trouble again?”
“You…” Long Quan’s expression suddenly changed. He was about to speak, but a sense of crisis abruptly emerged in his heart.
He wanted to get away but felt his steps become as heavy as boulders. He could only watch as a white light flew at him and hit his knee.
Crack!
The crisp sound of bone fracturing came, and everyone felt slight chills in their hearts. They saw Long Quan suddenly kneeling on one knee and clenching his teeth tightly. Blood slowly seeped out of the knee that was on the ground.
Only then did everyone see what had hit Long Quan’s knee just now—it was a small and exquisite teacup cover!
“This…”
“At the very least, Long Quan is still an Innate Realm Sixth Stage expert. How could this…”
“To think that the ceramic teacup cover can break the bones of an Innate Realm expert. Just what kind of strength does this person have?”
The young masters watching weren’t ignorant dandies, so they understood the horror of Gu Nan’s attack.
‘Where the hell did this person come from? It was one thing for Shi Tianjing, but not even Long Quan could fight back at all. Could it be…’
A terrible possibility flashed through everyone’s hearts. Gu Xingzhu was now looking at Gu Nan with frightened and strange eyes.
Just then, it seemed as if a breeze had swept over. The people present hardly felt it; only Gu Nan raised his eyebrows slightly and gently put down the teacup in his hand.
“Since you’re here, come out,” He seemed to be talking to the air.
Then, a clear figure walked out slowly and studied Gu Nan with astonishment. “It’s only been half a month since I last saw you. I didn’t expect you to have advanced to Prodigious Realm already… brother dearest.”
This person was precisely Gu Nian

chapters.title: Chapter 74: The Downside of Reincarnation
chapters.content:
Faint light shone through the window and lit up the spacious room. Gu Nan and Gu Nian sat across from each other.
“It’s indeed beyond my expectation that you can advance to Prodigious Realm at this time.” Gu Nian looked calm on the surface. Her expression gave nothing away, but in reality, she really felt quite helpless.
Even in all of Star Realm, Prodigious Realm cultivators were considered quite strong. This was especially true in the Ninth Region, where Void Cutter Realm experts were rare. Thus, Prodigious Realm cultivators were practically the strongest force that people could see.
That was why the distinguished descendants of Ruby Fish Star’s three major families competed to see who would be the first to advance to Prodigious Realm.
Even Gu Nian herself had to prepare and scheme for many years in order to make a breakthrough. For that goal, she even went so far as to reincarnate to several poor and remote planes to finally get what she wanted.
‘But this fellow in front of me…’ Gu Nian couldn’t help glaring at him bitterly, while Gu Nan’s expression said, ‘You’re making a big fuss out of nothing.’
Even with Gu Nian’s calm personality, she still had to take a deep breath right now to suppress the ripples in her heart. “What did you want to discuss?”
“I heard that your family is going to hold a Martial Arts Competition?”
“Mm.” A hint of exhaustion appeared on Gu Nian’s face when the Martial Arts Competition was mentioned. “I’ve been busy with this matter recently. Are you interested in participating? Oh, I forgot, you’ve already…”
“I’m interested!” Gu Nan nodded excitedly, lacking the slightest self-awareness of his identity as a Prodigious Realm expert.
Gu Nian’s expression darkened a little. “The Martial Arts Competition is only divided into two groups: Innate Realm and Acquired Realm.”
“I can pretend to be an Innate,” Gu Nan replied without hesitation.
Although Gu Nian could see through his breakthrough at a glance, this was because Gu Nian’s own martial arts technique was special. Plus, Gu Nan didn’t deliberately hide it either.
If necessary, Gu Nan could even go and buy a piece of concealment-type equipment—it was acceptable to invest some points for the sake of chain events.
Gu Nian, however, still shook her head. “If you participate, this Martial Arts Competition will become meaningless… How about I arrange for you to be a judge?”
“Judge?”
“That’s right. There are still twenty days before the start of the Martial Arts Competition, so it’s enough to build up your reputation.” Gu Nian revealed a light smile. “Just think of it as doing me a favor. If the Gu family produces another Prodigious expert, our family will be able to completely stabilize our position.”
Gu Nan rubbed his chin, pondering whether the deal was worth it or not.
He would obtain the qualification to participate in the Martial Arts Competition as a judge, as well as the convenience provided by the Gu family, at the cost of being completely roped in by the Gu family…
‘There doesn’t seem to be any problems with this. In any case, I can back out at any time!’
Gu Nan expressed his optimism about this deal.
……
“Eldest Martial Sister…
Wahh!”
As soon as she saw Gu Nian, Bai Luoluo threw herself into Gu Nian’s arms and began to cry bitterly.
“So fragile. Looks like you still need some treatment.” ‘Tesla Trooper’ Gu Yongxin Comrade
[1]
remarked.
Bai Luoluo’s pretty face immediately paled. Although she successfully experienced a blackening in Immortal Demon World, that didn’t mean that she liked that kind of life. After all, fundamentally, she wasn’t Yan Xiaoxiao.
The human heart has always been extremely complex. As someone who grew up in Langya World’s metropolis society, deep down, Bai Luoluo didn’t actually like fighting and killing.
It was one thing when she was still inside Immortal Demon world, but now that she had returned to Star Realm, she would naturally adjust back.
Of course, it was also impossible for her to return to her previous innocent self completely.
Bai Luoluo looked at Gu Nan with a somewhat complicated expression. She now knew that she didn’t actually transmigrate; instead, Gu Nan forcibly reincarnated her into Immortal Demon World.
If she connected this knowledge with the familiar figure on that day, the answer was self-evident. ‘So he’s Sister Xiaoxiao’s teacher…?’
“Rest well. There’s no need to rush the matter of cultivation; just let nature take its course,” Gu Nian said softly as she gently patted the back of Bai Luoluo’s head.
Compared with Gu Nan, Bai Luluo was actually her biggest karma. Now that the latter could get rid of the influence of the Pure Heart Dao, it was great news for Gu Nian.
After seeing Bai Luoluo, Gu Nan had nothing else to do.
He was about to return and continue his great cause of “grinding dungeons,” but Gu Nian stopped him.
“You want to reincarnate again?” She pulled Gu Nan aside and said with a serious expression, “I don’t know what benefits you can get from reincarnation, but reincarnation is by no means a shortcut to power.”
Gu Nan frowned slightly. “How so?”
“The more powerful the soul, the greater the pressure that will be placed on the world when the soul reincarnates, so the world itself will start to reject the soul. If you reincarnate too frequently or reincarnate for too long, your soul will be damaged.”
Speaking of this, Gu Nian stared at Gu Nan and said in a deep voice, “If you’ve reincarnated after advancing to Prodigious Realm, you should’ve already noticed it.”
Gu Nan thought about it carefully, and it really seemed to be as Gu Nian described.
After spending a month in Immortal Demon World, he often felt a sense of rejection from the world. Originally, he thought it was because of his Tier 3 body, but now that he thought about it, it was most likely a drawback of reincarnation.
This made him a little annoyed. Reincarnation dungeons were the main source of his Evil Value. If a limit was placed on that, it would greatly slow down his growth.
“I’ll have to wait a while before I can reincarnate again?” He asked.
“That’s right.” Gu Nian nodded slightly. “You should stay here for the time being. If we want to help you build up your reputation, you’ll need a suitable identity.”
“What identity?”
“My younger brother.”
……
Although Long Quan, the Shi family siblings, and even Xu Xun didn’t divulge that afternoon’s events, news about it began to spread at an alarming rate.
In just two days, the upper echelons of the entire capital all knew that Long Quan had suffered a major loss at the Gu family residence and even had one of his legs broken.
They also heard that the root cause of all this was because Shi Miao’er, the sister he spoiled the most, provoked someone she shouldn’t have provoked.
Just who was this person who shouldn’t be messed with?
Some people believed that the one she offended was Gu Nian herself—other people wouldn’t have the ability to attack Long Quan. Others felt that the attacker was one of the Gu family’s hidden cards who would show up to teach outsiders a lesson in Gu Nian’s absence.
These conjectures continued until Gu Nian made a statement in public, “The attacker is my younger brother Gu Nan. He just broke through to Prodigious Realm half a month ago.”
This was earth-shattering! It caused an uproar!
Who exactly was this Gu Nan? The Gu family actually had a second junior who advanced to Prodigious Realm?
The first piece of information that people found out from their investigations was Gu Nan’s identity. He was from a remote side branch of the Gu family. His parents were both dead, but his talent was outstanding.
Gu Nian discovered his talent a long time ago and hid him away to use as her personal force. Thus, he’d been cultivating in seclusion all the way until his advancement to Prodigious Realm.
Gu Nian had naturally prepared this information in advance. No one could prove or disprove it. It wasn’t convincing at all, but this also made it impossible for people to find inconsistencies—it had nothing
but
inconsistencies, so they didn’t even know where to start.
In any case, it was an indisputable fact that there was now a second Prodigious Realm powerhouse in the Gu family’s younger generation…
‘The world will change soon…’ Similar thoughts emerged in many people’s minds.
Even if Gu Nian advanced, some people still held firm to their beliefs and felt that she was merely a step ahead of her peers. Xu Feiyan was much younger than Gu Nian, and the Long family also had two seeds who had the most potential to break through to Prodigious Realm.
But when a second Prodigious Realm expert appeared in the Gu family, all these thoughts seemed to turn into a joke.
Of course, what they didn’t know was that Gu Nian’s move was so astonishing that even the Gu family fell into a state of chaos.
Notes: [1]
Tesla Trooper Gu Yongxin Comrade
: Tesla Trooper is a heavy Soviet anti-surface infantry unit in Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2. “Gu Yongxin” is a reference to Yang Yongxin, a doctor who used electroshock therapy to treat people with internet addictions. Because Tesla Troopers also shocked enemies with electricity as part of their attacks, people refer to Yang Yongxin as “Tesla Trooper” Yang Yongxin.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Let’s discuss it later
chapters.content:
“It’s simply absurd! Gu Nian, this girl, has really gone too far this time!”
“To claim that a Prodigious Realm cultivator with unknown origins is part of our Gu family—since when did our Gu family’s bloodline become this cheap?”
“That’s right! If we just needed Prodigious experts, we could’ve recruited a bunch of them from outside in the blink of an eye, not to mention that we old fellows aren’t dead yet!”
In the Gu family’s inner hall, a group of elders were sitting in a circle and voicing their dissatisfaction with Gu Nian’s approach.
Gu Nian wasn’t here, so in her place, a middle-aged man sitting near the door became the target of their “siege”—he was Gu Nian’s father, Gu Mingyuan.
Gu Mingyuan was the current head of the Gu family. Ever since Gu Nian advanced, he had been gradually delegating power and handing over the Gu family’s important matters to Gu Nian, while he concentrated on cultivation.
Power was the foundation of everything. The Gu family understood this very well, so it had developed such an inheritance model.
The Gu family had seven or eight old fellows just like him hidden away. They all possessed extraordinary strength and were the Gu family’s true trump cards.
Except for sometimes wandering around outside, these people were usually in closed-door cultivation, but when they received news about Gu Nan, none of them could sit still anymore.
Gu Mingyuan’s collar was held by an angry elder who was wildly criticizing him, but he could only force a smile. “Second Uncle, please calm down…”
“Calm down? How can I calm down!?” Second Uncle slapped the table in anger, making a handprint on the sandstone tabletop. “If I stay calm any longer, the Gu family will collapse in the hands of that precious daughter of yours!”
“How can it be that exaggerated? He’s nothing more than a youngster who just entered Prodigious Realm…” This accusation was a little serious, so Gu Mingyuan hurriedly tried to gloss over the matter.
Second Uncle continued angrily, “The Gu family has survived for hundreds of years, but I’ve never seen us recruit a Prodigious cultivator with a different surname into the family! Outsiders will inevitably harbor ulterior motives. Don’t you understand this? Have you forgotten our ancestral teachings?”
Gu Mingyuan was admonished so much that he didn’t dare to refute anything, so he was forced to keep smiling. However, he knew that the elders’ anger this time wasn’t without reason.
The Gu family was a family that rose abruptly during an era of war. From its founding until now, it had seen too many tragedies caused by internal strife within families.
So the ancestors left behind ancestral teachings strictly forbidding internal strife within the clan while also prohibiting the Gu family from recruiting Prodigious cultivators with foreign surnames.
Once someone reached Prodigious Realm, they would be able to overturn a war situation with their own power. If traitors this powerful appear inside a family, then no matter how strong the fortress, it would still fall.
Seeing that Gu Mingyuan had stopped talking, the surrounding crowd of elders started quarreling once again.
“Everyone, everyone.” Gu Mingyuan had no choice but to stand out. He clapped his hands and said, “Gu Nian did inform me about Gu Nan’s situation. There’s indeed no need to worry about his origins.”
“Why? Don’t tell me that a Prodigious powerhouse can simply appear out of thin air?”
“…That’s more or less correct.” Gu Mingyuan’s expression looked a little strange as he took out several files and distributed them to all the elders. “Everyone can take a look.”
Second Uncle grabbed the information from his hand and skimmed through with a single glance. His furious expression finally eased up a bit.
“So he’s an ascendant? And even one that Gu Nian single-handedly brought up. That does make me more reassured.” Second Uncle stroked his beard. “Wait, he’s been to Radiant Tower?”
“That’s right.” Gu Mingyuan nodded faintly. “Something happened during his ascension, and he was kidnapped to Radiant Tower. They were most likely targeting Gu Nian’s karma.”
A person next to him frowned. “Radiant Tower… Will there be problems?”
Second Uncle waved a hand before Gu Mingyuan could reply. “Radiant Tower has never actively intervened in the major planes. Besides, a Star Ruler is standing behind Radiant Tower. Would they even need to play tricks like this if they wanted to deal with our family?”
“That’s true…” The elder nodded thoughtfully.
Gu Mingyuan’s expression finally relaxed a bit. When Gu Nian first told him about this plan, he also had the same reaction as Second Uncle, right until he learned about Gu Nan’s origins.
Ascendants were indeed more reassuring.
These people came from smaller planes and were entering Star Realm for the first time.
It was impossible for them to be spies. Apart from their uncontrollable personalities, they weren’t not too different from adopted children.
But Second Uncle was obviously more stubborn than Gu Mingyuan expected. “That won’t work either. No Prodigious cultivators with a foreign surname may be recruited—this is the ancestral law!”
“Gu Nan is also surnamed Gu…” Gu Mingyuan argued weakly.
“Bullshit! Are these two Gu’s the same?” Second Uncle immediately sprayed Gu Mingyuan’s face with spit.
But his words reminded an old lady on the side. She suddenly interjected, “Since his origins are clean, why not recruit Gu Nan as a son-in-law?”
The entire inner hall suddenly fell silent, and after a moment, happy smiles appeared on the elders’ faces.
Once people got older, they always liked to pair up their offspring. This would never change, no matter the world.
The Gu family was a major family, so there was no such thing as marrying for love. Arranged marriages were common and insignificant matters. It wasn’t the first time they had done this.
“How about that girl Xingzhu? Looks like she’s quite close to him.”
“Her temper is a little fiery. I’m afraid there will be plenty of quarrels in the future… Gu Ying is better. Yes, Sixth Brother’s child…”
“That’s also true… Third Brother’s granddaughter also works! She’s fourteen this year, so it’ll be good to settle her marriage early.”
Gu Mingyuan’s face twitched a little as he listened to such discussions.
He was about to speak but heard Second Uncle slap the table next to him. “What nonsense are you all talking about!”
Gu Mingyuan couldn’t help letting out a sigh of relief upon hearing this. ‘At a critical time like this, Second Uncle is still the fairest…’
“At the very least, Gu Nan is also in the Prodigious Realm. He’s also someone Gu Nian single-handedly brought up. If we want to arrange a marriage, we should be considering Gu Nian first!” Second Uncle knocked on the table and spoke, his beard shaking with each word.
Gu Mingyuan almost tripped and fell onto the table.
Second Uncle’s words were unanimously approved by all the elders.
“Second Brother has a point. Little Gu Nian’s marriage is also a difficult problem! If we miss this chance, who knows when we’ll find a suitable candidate again?”
“A good point. We can also feel more at ease if Gu Nan joins the family…”
At this time, soft coughs suddenly came from the doorway: “
Cough cough
!”
The crowd was silent again and turned their heads to look. Gu Nian was somehow already standing over there, and next to her was a young man in white.
The elders, who had just read his information, recognized at a glance that this person was none other than Gu Nan, the one currently in the limelight.
The elders who had been discussing enthusiastically just now became very reserved all of a sudden. Second Uncle even put on a solemn expression as he gently stroked his long beard, looking like an immortal.
“So it’s Gu Nian… When did you arrive?” Second Uncle asked with a smile.
Gu Nian looked at him somewhat helplessly. “Second Uncle… We heard everything just now.”
“……”
……
No matter the society, it was a very common phenomenon that excellent women couldn’t get married easily.
The current Gu Nian and the future Xu Feiyan would both face similar problems.
With their status, it was practically impossible to find a suitable marriage partner who had enough weight. And just marrying them off to some random person would be too much of a loss, so it dragged on.
Sometimes in novels, a large family would spend decades of effort to train an elite pupil but ultimately decide to use her as bait to hook a wealthy son-in-law… This is complete bullshit.
Any family with a brain wouldn’t do so. What belonged to someone else would never be theirs. Relying on outside forces to support the Gu family’s development was akin to putting their entire lifeline into someone else’s hands.
People like Gu Nian—regardless of gender—would eventually wield power in the family as a leader and contribute their abilities to the family.
So she could either recruit a husband who would enter the Gu family and basically take the Gu surname, or she could enter a political marriage with someone who wouldn’t be able to truly wield power in the Gu family, which would continue until the next generation grew up.
Gu Nan only understood the twists and turns of this matter after listening to the elders’ conversation.
So he patted Gu Nian’s shoulder. “You guys can continue the discussion. Come find me when you reach a conclusion.”
Having said that, he turned around to leave, but Gu Mingyuan next to him suddenly called out, “Mr. Gu, please wait a moment.”
Gu Nan turned his head but didn’t say anything. He just gave Gu Mingyuan an odd smile, but his steps didn’t stop.
Gu Mingyuan frowned and stretched out a hand to stop him.
But just when his hand was about to fall on Gu Nan, Gu Nan’s whole person unexpectedly disappeared without any sound.
Gu Mingyuan was stunned and was about to step out to investigate, but Second Uncle pressed a hand on his shoulder.
“You can’t catch up.” Second Uncle shook his head slightly. “That is the law of shadow… The fastest law out of all three thousand laws.”
Gu Nan’s skill made many elders’ faces turn serious.
One of them asked, “Isn’t the law of wind the fastest one?”
“Of course not. The fastest thing in the world is light, and where there’s light, there’s shadow.”
……
“That’s pretty much it.” Gu Nian slowly spoke, “We’ll provide him with all the requirements for reincarnation, and he will support the Gu family.”
They had to rope in Gu Nan—since the crowd of elders could think of this, Gu Nian had naturally thought of it as well. In fact, she had already planned to do so a long time ago.
She had Gu Nan appear as a member of the Gu family’s branch family, after which she recognized him as her brother. This was tantamount to elevating his status to that of a main branch family member.
And it was only from Gu Nian’s mouth that the crowd of elders learned of Gu Nan’s true value—many of the details couldn’t be described in the files. Only Gu Nian herself knew those things.
“Advanced to Prodigious Realm in just a few months? Even for a reincarnator, this speed is quite excessive…” An old lady sighed softly.
She was also a reincarnator when she was young and had to fight to the death in different realms before successfully advancing to Prodigious Realm.
So she was very clear about the risks and benefits of reincarnation. Reincarnation wasn’t a shortcut, but a dangerous path.
The elders weren’t dissatisfied with Gu Nan’s condition. In their opinion, this much resources was nothing at all in order to recruit a Prodigious powerhouse.
After all, no matter how frequently someone wanted to reincarnate, they still had to take the state of their soul into consideration, so in reality, the actual resource consumption was very limited.
“It’s not a big deal if he’s merely keen on reincarnation,” Second Uncle concluded. “But he should participate in family affairs and not be isolated from the family.”
For an outsider, the easiest way to integrate into a group was to have him take over certain affairs.
If he wanted to accomplish those tasks, he would have to come into contact with people both above him and below him inside the family, so he would naturally become familiar with them after a while.
“The Martial Arts Competition will start soon. I plan to have him participate as a judge,” Gu Nian had been prepared for this and informed them of her previous idea.
“Feasible!” The elders looked at each other and nodded immediately.
That old lady thought for a while, then asked tentatively, “Little Nian, you really won’t consider marrying him?”
Gu Nian’s face turned a little dark. “Grandmother, I’ve already recognized him as my younger brother…”
“What’s wrong with that!” The old lady waved her hand overbearingly. “Who would dare to gossip about the affairs of two Prodigious cultivators?”
Gu Nian rubbed her brow, feeling an incoming headache. She hurriedly dropped a rubbish excuse of “I still have matters to attend to” and fled.
……
Gu Nian didn’t go too far before she met Gu Nan again. The latter had been waiting for her here.
“The elders have no more objections.” Gu Nian spoke up first, “What other requests do you have? We might as well put them forward together.”
Gu Nan and Gu Nian’s goal here today was to introduce Gu Nan to the elders while showing off his skills in passing in order to give the elders an idea, but they didn’t expect that the elders would be too satisfied…
“Requests, huh…” Gu Nan rubbed his chin. He really didn’t have any requests for the time being. “Let’s discuss it later.”
Gu Nian’s expression darkened slightly again.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Banquet
chapters.content:
After Gu Nan’s identity received the elders’ approval, the Gu family finally began to create momentum for Gu Nan with all their might instead of pushing the envelope as before.
So within a very short amount of time, not only was the matter of Gu Nan crippling Long Quan’s leg widely publicized, but his fabricated identity also began to spread at a godly speed.
Some people claimed that he was a secluded genius and a secret weapon the Gu family hid away, just waiting for the chance when he could make a critical appearance and decide victory or defeat in one fell swoop.
Others claimed that he was an anomaly. Originally, he simply belonged to an insignificant side branch of the Gu family, but step by step, he walked to his current position through his outstanding talent.
There were also people who said…
No matter which rumor people believed, for the various families living in Ruby Fish Star’s capital, another person had now been added to the list of people who shouldn’t be messed with.
And Gu Nian also began to take Gu Nan along to events in high society. Today they went to a banquet, tomorrow they cut the ribbon at an opening ceremony, and the day after that, they went to watch a Martial Arts Competition… In short, she wanted to make Gu Nan a familiar face in high society as soon as possible.
“Eldest Miss, Young Master Nan. Thank you both for attending my daughter’s birthday party…”
Wine goblets and gambling chips were intertwined at the scene of the banquet. A middle-aged man in a silver suit stood in front of the Gu siblings with a smile on his face. His attitude was extremely humble.
Naturally, Gu Nian was the one who dealt with this middle-aged man. This was the tacit understanding between Gu Nan and herself—after all, this was already the sixth banquet in only fifteen days, so even if they didn’t have any tacit understanding before, they did now.
The two were led by the middle-aged man himself. Gu Nian walked forward while being greeted by a chorus of “Eldest Miss,” while Gu Nan ran to one side and sat alone.
Gu Nian was naturally the center of attention everywhere she went, and many people also recognized Gu Nan because of his frequent appearances recently.
A few young girls next to him were holding glasses of wine. They turned their eyes this way.
“This is that person from the Gu family, right?”
“Yes! I heard that he’s a martial artist who can be called ‘Prodigious Realm,’ just like Miss Gu!”
“So incredible…”
Gu Nan naturally heard all these conversations, but he was too lazy to show any expression in response. He merely sipped mouthful after mouthful of his drink, which was… juice.
The role Gu Nan was currently playing was that of a genius youth with a cold and aloof temperament—in a sense, he was playing as himself.
“He’s so handsome, even when he’s drinking juice!”
Gu Nan’s hand stopped for a moment, then returned to normal.
These young girls came from big families but had little martial arts talent themselves, so they were completely raised as flower vases. They worshipped such genius youths like Gu Nan the most.
“You’re quite leisurely, hiding and watching from the sidelines every time,” Gu Nian had reached his side at some point and said with a light smile as she sat down.
“Not interested in dealing with them.” Gu Nan said very straightforwardly, then asked with some confusion, “You don’t need to go over there?”
“I’m just going through a mere formality today and meeting two people later while I’m here.” Gu Nian casually replied, “The Martial Arts Competition will start in a few days. The martial arts hall over there is going to accept a group of newcomers. Do you have time to go there and take a look?”
Gu Nan looked at her and seemed to be recalling something. “The martial arts hall is recruiting new people? All right, I’ll go tomorrow.”
After the matter was settled, Gu Nian didn’t stay by his side much longer and continued to participate in the banquet.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, unexpectedly met a pair of familiar faces after he sat alone for a while and greeted several waves of people.
“Young Master Nan…” Shi Tianjing was standing behind Gu Nan along with his sister. Shi Tianjing had a slightly cautious smile on his face while Shi Miao’er, his younger sister, still had an unresigned look.
Gu Nan turned his head and glanced at the two. “Oh, it’s you guys… What’s up?”
Shi Tianjing had all but lost his initial imposing manner. His smile looked a little fawning. “This humble one specially brought my sister over to apologize to you, Young Master Nan…”
While saying that, he squeezed Shi Miao’er’s shoulder hard.
Only then did the latter lower her head and speak in a low, muffled voice, “Sorry.”
Gu Nan ignored them and just casually waved his hand.
Seeing that Gu Nan didn’t reply, Shi Tianjing didn’t dare to say anything else and hurriedly took his sister away.
Only after putting considerable distance between them did Shi Miao’er shake off her brother’s hand with a resentful expression. “Elder Brother! Even if he’s in the Prodigious Realm, there’s still no need for us to humble ourselves this much, right?!”
“Like you weren’t the one who caused all this trouble,” Shi Tianjing retorted with a light snort. He was also in a bad mood after experiencing a tactful rejection.
“What do you mean I caused this? He was clearly the one who hit me first!” Shi Miao’er suddenly became angry, and even her voice got louder, scaring Shi Tianjing so much that he quickly covered her mouth.
Luckily they were far away, and it seemed like Gu Nan didn’t hear her.
When Shi Miao’er saw her brother acting like this, she stomped her feet in anger and walked away alone. However, their voices attracted another person.
A young girl with light makeup and a petite figure walked over and placed a hand on Shi Miao’er’s shoulder.
“What are you talking about?” Jin Dian’s expression looked eager for gossip. “Someone actually dared to hit our Miss Shi. Are they tired of living?”
Jin Dian was precisely the protagonist of today’s banquet and Shi Miao’er’s bosom friend.
The Jin family and the Shi family were of comparable status; they were both second-tier families in the capital. In these families, full knowledge of Gu Nan’s identity was limited to the decision-makers within the family.
As the daughter of an affluent family, Jin Dian only cared about perfume, sports cars, and other luxury goods. Where would she have the time to pay attention to matters between families?
When Shi Miao’er realized that Jin Dian didn’t know, she also didn’t want to mention the disgrace, so she simply replied casually, “It’s someone from the Gu family.”
“That fellow?” Jin Dian pointed to Gu Nan. She saw the Shi family siblings come from over there.
“Yeah… Don’t go looking for trouble!” Shi Miao’er hurriedly persuaded when she saw her best friend’s expression. “…So that you don’t offend the Gu family for no reason.”
Shi Miao’er’s coverup only made things worse. Jin Dian completely ignored her words.
“So what if it’s the Gu family? Can you be unreasonable as long as you’re from the Gu family?” Jin Dian snorted coldly. “Just you watch!”
Shi Miao’er watched Jin Dian’s figure leave and felt both a vengeance-like pleasure in her heart and also a hint of worry.
……
Jin Dian went to the back of the banquet and immediately found her target after she checked the guest list.
“Gu Nan? A nobody!” Miss Jin laughed disdainfully. “Hmph, to think he’d even hit a woman. Is he still a man?”
She casually beckoned a maid over and handed her a list that she had just written.
The maid took the list and easily remembered the names on it. She asked hesitantly, “M-Miss, do you want to inform e-everyone on this list?”
