“That’s right. Don’t miss a single person!” Jin Dian glared. “Find other people to help if you can’t finish in time. In any case, I want all the people on this list to be ready before the banquet starts!”
The maid hurriedly took the list and went down to prepare, but in her heart, she was speechless.
‘I wonder who offended the Miss, for her to actually mobilize such a huge network of people… If so many young masters and ladies band together, I’m afraid no one can afford to mess with them.’
A smile reappeared on Jin Dian’s face as she watched the maid leave. She threw the files on Gu Nan to the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Give me some face
chapters.content:
The Jin family’s birthday banquet finally began.
The guests gathered together, surrounded by distinguished friends. Gu Nan, however, still sat alone at the corner table, like a destitute companion.
However, the truly perceptive people would never think so.
This didn’t require any knowledge of Gu Nan’s identity. Anyone who could occupy a single table alone in such a banquet, with no one else daring to approach—this fact in itself was worth pondering.
When everyone had enough to eat and drink, the birthday girl of today’s banquet, Miss Jin, finally made her appearance.
She stood in the center of the venue and spoke with composure and assurance, thanking most of the people present—just like the most conventional banquet speech.
But at the end, she suddenly changed the subject.
“In addition to thanking everyone for coming to celebrate my birthday, there is one more matter to address today.” Jin Dian had a faint smile, but her words gave many people a bad feeling.
“My close sister, Miao’er, had a slight misunderstanding with a friend earlier. It just so happens that the gentleman in question is also present today…”
As soon as Jin Dian raised her hand, the lights in the hall began to slowly shift and soon fell on Gu Nan’s location, instantly making him the center of attention.
Jin Dian’s father Jin Qin, who had greeted the two Gu family siblings earlier, was currently below the stage. His expression suddenly sank.
What was even more awkward for the Jin family’s patriarch was that Gu Nian was standing right beside him, watching the scene with great interest.
He hurriedly clarified, “Eldest Miss, someone must’ve deliberately instigated this matter. This is a misunderstanding!”
Gu Nian waved her hand and laughed lightly. “Mr. Jin, there’s no need to be nervous. I don’t mind. It’s just that if you don’t put a stop to this farce quickly, I’m afraid that your beloved daughter… will be in danger.”
Cold sweat began to slide down Jin Qin’s forehead. Just when he wanted to climb the stage to stop Jin Dian, another person placed a hand on his shoulder.
“Old Jin, why worry about it?” The newcomer was a sturdy young man who looked seventy or eighty percent similar to Long Quan. “With Eldest Miss around, I’m sure that Gu Nan would never dare to be so wanton.”
This man was Long Quan’s older brother, Long Yi. Although he himself was not a seed candidate with the potential to step into Prodigious Realm, he was nevertheless a young master of the Long family with considerable standing and could be said to be one of the representatives of the Long family’s younger generation.
The seed candidates were busy burying their heads in bitter cultivation; how could they have the time to attend such a reception?
“Young Master Long…” Jin Qin’s heart was slightly reassured. At the same time, he also cast his gaze at Gu Nian.
Gu Nian, however, shrugged. “Don’t look at me. I can’t control him.”
Long Yi’s expression immediately darkened, and Jin Qin’s cold sweat flowed down again.
While they were talking below, onstage, Jin Dian had already summarized the feud between the two, “Miao’er has always been a little blunt and undiplomatic with her words and offended Mr. Gu Nan. Here, I will first apologize on behalf of Miao’er.”
Jin Dian adopted a humble attitude as soon as she started, while the surrounding crowd was entirely silent, as if no one had heard her last sentence.
The corners of her mouth curled slightly, and she immediately continued, “But Mr. Gu, you used violence on a lady like Miao’er just because of your martial arts cultivation. Shouldn’t you also apologize for that?”
When Jin Dian’s words fell, it was like the prelude to a war had been unveiled. Loud condemnations immediately rang out around them.
“She’s right, apologize!”
“You’re a man, yet you actually dared to use violence against Miss Shi. Do you have any shame?”
“
Ha
, a century-old family like the Gu family actually produced this kind of person. What a disgrace!”
Countless accusations and invective surrounded Gu Nan in an instant.
The people that Jin Dian could persuade were naturally young masters from families she was acquainted with, so their statuses were also comparable to her own. Thus, most of them didn’t know the specifics about Gu Nan.
And right now, none of them even thought about investigating further.
Jin Dian’s words were very clever. She had already placed herself on a moral high ground, completely oppressing the other party with the momentum of the situation and the audience.
‘Even if that person can fight, what can he do? Can he beat up everyone here?’
Everyone understood that the law wouldn’t be able punish the entire public. As long as enough people spoke up, Gu Nan wouldn’t be able to do anything.
There were also people who recognized Gu Nan’s identity and hurriedly tried to pull their companions back, but unfortunately, they were too late.
Gu Nan just sat in his seat, completely unmoved.
A young man couldn’t stand to watch anymore. He strode forward and stopped in front of Gu Nan, looking down at him condescendingly.
“Gu Nan, right?” This youth seemed to be the crowd’s representative. He said coldly, “Give me some face. Go apologize to Miss Shi, and this matter will be forgotten. Otherwise, even if you are a member of the Gu family…”
Gu Nan, who had been ignoring the crowd up until now, finally turned his head when he heard such a sentence.
Everyone just saw him wave his hand. A black shadow suddenly rose up from the ground and turned into a gigantic black palm, which slapped the youth hard and sent him flying away.
This slap was so powerful that the young man flew from one corner of the venue all the way to the podium, smashing through two layers of glass windows in quick succession before landing at Jin Dian’s feet.
Shards of glass were embedded in his face, and his left arm, which was hit directly, had twisted ninety degrees. He cut an extremely miserable figure.
Jin Dian’s face was full of bewilderment. She didn’t even realize what had just happened until she saw the tragic state of the young man on the ground and suddenly screamed.
But her scream soon came to an abrupt end, because she felt a sudden darkness in front of her. When she looked up, Gu Nan was already standing in front of her.
“Don’t… Don’t come over!” Miss Jin had lost all of her formerly imposing mannerism. Her small face was incomparably pale as she repeatedly backed up.
Someone below the stage roared, “Gu Nan, don’t bully intolerably!”
“That’s right! We have so many families here, you dare…”
Before those words even fell, black shadows simultaneously rose up behind the ones who spoke out, and giant hands grabbed them and threw them onto the stage.
Crash! Crash! Crash!
There were several consecutive sounds of glass being shattered, and several more unconscious people appeared at Jin Dian’s feet.
Gu Nan slowly turned his head and showed an inexplicable smile towards those onstage. Although he didn’t speak, everyone understood his meaning— ‘I dare.’
There were still some people who wanted to speak out, but they were pulled back by the people around them, who revealed Gu Nan’s identity through whispers.
One by one, the ones who wanted to speak out lost all color in their faces and hurriedly sat upright with lingering fear in their hearts.
‘So he’s that one… Fortunately, I didn’t speak out.’
“Young Master Nan, Young Master Nan…” Only then did Jin Dian hurriedly run up to the stage and bow repeatedly in apology. “It’s all my daughter’s fault. Young Master Nan, please give me some face…”
“This person also wanted me to give him face.” Gu Nan smiled as he pointed down at the first youth he slapped away, who was still lying on the ground even now. “See what happened to him?”
Faced with such a blunt threat, Jin Qin’s heart sank a little. For a moment, he didn’t know what to say.
He became the head of his family only through money and status. When had he ever seen someone completely unreasonable like Gu Nan?
“What about me? I wonder if Young Master Nan can give me some face?” A voice traveled over slowly.
The crowd turned their heads towards the new voice and saw Long Yi wearing a smile as he slowly walked up to the stage.
Gu Nan’s methods were too ruthless. Most of the people below the stage were angry, but they didn’t dare speak out. But when they saw Long Yi’s appearance, hope arose in their hearts.
‘He’s also from the three great families. This person won’t be able to act brazenly anymore, right?’
Crash!
The next moment, the giant hand appeared, and the last piece of glass was also smashed to pieces. Classmate Long Yi joined the rest and fell onto the stage.
“Who’s this?” Gu Nan asked Jin Qin, who was beside him

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Martial Arts Hall’s Recruitment
chapters.content:
There was utter silence at the Jin family’s banquet.
As he watched Long Yi fall, Jin Qin’s face showed an expression called despair.
And Jin Dian was currently severely regretting everything—no, she regretted it so deeply that her intestines had turned green. ‘If I’d known beforehand that it would end like this, I would never have helped Shi Miao’er out… This is simply a psychopath!’
‘He even dared to hit someone from the Long family. Then won’t I be in even more danger?’
She felt her legs tremble and wanted to run down the stage, but she was afraid of attracting that one’s attention…
She found the time to glance at the scene below and just happened to see Shi Tianjing’s extremely ugly expression as he pulled Shi Miao’er into the crowd for fear of being seen by Gu Nan.
The silence didn’t last long. Someone finally spoke out.
“Alright, don’t take it too far.” Gu Nian’s figure appeared beside Long Yi. After confirming that he wasn’t in critical condition, she shook her head helplessly.
Gu Nan didn’t retort. He smiled and said, “You can deal with this.”
……
The farce at the Jin family didn’t cause any trouble for Gu Nan.
In fact, he was only responsible for attacking and could leave and forget about it. The job of dealing with the aftermath was naturally given to Gu Nian.
As for how this would affect his impression in the eyes of the younger generations of those influential families… Have you ever seen players care about NPCs’ opinions?
Early the next morning, Gu Nan was ready to head out. He was going to host the recruitment of new members for the martial arts hall today.
Gu Nan remained indifferent to the vast majority of the Gu family’s affairs, but he was especially interested in the Martial Arts Competition.
After these situations appeared frequently, Gu Nian naturally handed over matters related to the Martial Arts Competition to him as much as possible.
The so-called martial arts recruitment referred to the major martial arts halls recruiting some good seedlings in advance before the start of the Martial Arts Competition.
These talented seedlings were either geniuses who became famous when young or contestants who distinguished themselves in the previous qualifiers.
However, because they weren’t selected after a formal competition, recruiting newcomers was rather risky. Carelessness would lead to error in judgment.
If the martial arts hall spent a huge sum of money to sign a contract with a player who then went on to get eliminated in the first round of the competition, then the martial arts hall would incur a big loss.
As a major family, the Gu family naturally had its own business and martial arts hall. The “Nebula Martial Arts Hall” Gu Nan was currently heading to was completely owned by the Gu family.
“Young Master Nan, the people of the martial arts hall are already waiting.”
When Gu Nan reached the door, an impeccably-dressed middle-aged man in a suit was waiting. He was even someone Gu Nan had met before—Wang Dong, the butler who once greeted him.
Wang Dong’s face was full of helplessness.
He originally thought Gu Nan was just an outsider, so all he had to do was to deal with Gu Nan politely. Who would’ve imagined that this young man would suddenly become a young master of the main branch?
‘And he’s even a young master with quite a high status…’
As the only butler in the family who had contact with Gu Nan before, Wang Dong was naturally sent as Gu Nan’s personal butler.
“Oh, Old Wang…” Gu Nan’s voice came from afar.
“Yes, Young Master. What can I do for you?” Wang Dong answered conscientiously as a butler with great professionalism.
“About that, how do you get to the Nebula Martial Arts Hall?”
“…Young Master, please follow me.”
……
As usual, Lu Danze came to the martial arts hall early in the morning to start the day’s training program.
He was a disciple of Nebula Martial Arts Hall. He was born in the slums, but his martial arts talent was quite good and he was also hard-working. He was already at Innate Realm Fifth Stage right now.
And he even qualified for the official Martial Arts Competition. In a sense, among all of Ruby Fish Star’s Innate Realm experts, he could rank in the top 1024—since there were only 1024 combatants in the official competition.
“Good morning, Senior Martial Brother Lu!” A girl with short hair walked in and happened to see Lu Danze’s figure, so she quickly greeted him.
Lu Danze also smiled. He was very fond of the girl named Gu Yang. Although she was born into such a big family, she didn’t act like she was superior to others.
“By the way, Elder Martial Brother Lu.” Gu Yang suddenly remembered something. “You went back early yesterday, so you missed this. The Hall Master said that everyone should assemble at the big training ground today!”
“Assemble? What’s the matter?” Lu Danze frowned slightly. The Martial Arts Competition was only a few days away. He wanted to use every minute and every second to train.
Gu Yang hesitated, then answered with difficulty, “It’s… There’s a young master in the family. He will be responsible for recruiting new people into the martial arts hall this year.”
It was no secret in the martial arts hall that Lu Danze held ill will towards the influential families’ young masters because of his childhood experience.
Sure enough, Lu Danze snorted coldly. “How much would those young masters and young ladies know about our martial arts hall? All they know how to do is give orders!”
Although she also agreed with his words, they were still talking about someone from her own family, after all. Gu Yang still had to defend Gu Nan, “It’s said that he’s a very powerful young master…”
Although Gu Nan’s existence had already been publicized by the Gu family, it was only limited to those in the upper class.
Someone like Gu Yang, who came from the side branch of another side branch of the family, would at most only know that Gu Nan was a young master of the main branch and was very powerful. Don’t count on her to know any other details.
Lu Danze obviously didn’t buy this. “How powerful? He merely had a good family background… If that Gu family’s eldest miss pays a visit, then I’ll accept it!”
As the strongest person among Ruby Fish Star’s younger generation, Gu Nian’s legend had long been the subject of enthusiastic discussions.
“Of course he can’t compare with Eldest Miss, but…”
“There’s no but.” Lu Danze waved his hand, put down the equipment in his hand, and sneered, “Let’s go. I want to see that young master!”
……
When Lu Danze went to the hall with a stomach full of inexplicable resentment, Gu Nan had already arrived.
“Where are the recruitment candidates?”
Lu Danze looked at the young man currently surrounded by the crowd. His expression looked calm (arrogant) and his tone was serene (haughty manner).
On the other hand, Lu Danze’s respected master Zhang Tao, the martial arts hall’s Hall Master, stood next to the young master respectfully.
Lu Danze’s heart couldn’t help exploding in anger at this scene.
‘My master is already an elder, yet he still has to fawn over a young man… Isn’t it just because he’s the Gu family’s young master?’
However, he wasn’t a little kid. He knew that it was useless to hold grievances. Only by improving his strength would he have the opportunity to voice his thoughts.
‘When I become a Prodigious Realm powerhouse in the future, let’s see if you’ll still be able to maintain such an attitude!’ Lu Danze couldn’t help vowing in his heart.
What he didn’t know was that actually, he had already seen it.
As the one in charge of Nebula Martial Arts Hall, Zhang Tao certainly knew Gu Nan’s identity. More importantly, he was also present at the Jin family’s banquet yesterday.
Towards this young man who could stand on equal ground with Eldest Miss and act wantonly, Zhang Tao humbled his attitude as much as possible. “The first batch of candidates are already waiting. Please follow me, Young Master Nan.”
“Mm.” Gu Nan nodded casually, looking absent-minded, but in reality, he attached great importance to this event.
As a top player, as long as it was related to the mission, nothing could be taken lightly. This was the basic quality of a top player.
Because you never know whether important information would be hidden in a seemingly unrelated thing.
Zhang Tao soon led him into a quiet room and then returned to the hall.
Zhang Tao waved the crowd away and said, “Danze, Lu Wu, you two come with us. Gu Yang, tell the first batch to get ready.”
“Yes!”
Gu Yang nodded quickly. The young man named Lu Wu bowed his head and just walked silently behind Zhang Tao.
Only Lu Danze’s face was a little unhappy. “Master, the Martial Arts Competition will start soon. I want to…”
Zhang Tao patted him on the shoulder and said, “I know you want to train more, but martial arts isn’t accomplished in a day or two… Many of the recruitment candidates might be your future opponents. Don’t you want to learn about them in advance?”
Hearing this, Lu Danze finally understood his master’s painstaking efforts. Although he still disliked that Young Master Nan, he nodded harder.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Lin Yunyun
chapters.content:
After Gu Nan entered the quiet room, the first thing he saw was an unexpected person.
“Bai Luoluo? What are you doing here?”
Bai Luoluo was holding a blue notepad and standing at the table with her big eyes wide open. When she saw Gu Nan enter, she quickly put the notepad on the table.
“I’m the martial arts hall’s record-keeper…” Bai Luoluo looked like this was to be expected, then added, “Don’t get me wrong, the owner insisted that I be the recorder!”
Gu Nan smiled and sat on the main seat, picking up the notepad and reading it.
As for Bai Luoluo’s words, he didn’t believe any of them. How remarkable would Zhang Tao be, to even know about Gu Nan’s relationship with Bai Luoluo?
Written in the notepad was naturally the list of new recruits today and their information.
After a simple glance, Gu Nan already had a rough idea.
At this time, Zhang Tao also entered, followed by his two best disciples. He came to Gu Nan and introduced them to him.
“Young Master Nan, this is Lu Wu and Lu Danze. They will also participate in the Martial Arts Competition this time. Please take care of them…”
Many people from Nebula Martial Arts Hall had entered the Martial Arts Competition, but these two had the highest chance of entering the top ranks. Zhang Tao was doing his utmost for the future of his disciples.
The judges of the Martial Arts Competition had great authority. Their comments could often determine a participant’s popularity level. For many people, this was even more important than victory or defeat.
Lu Wu and Lu Danze also bowed in greeting. The former was still expressionless, while the latter, although respectful, had some disdain in his eyes.
Of course he believed that his master was just being polite. ‘How can a mere young master of a noble family take care of me, a participant in the Martial Arts Competition?’
Gu Nan just nodded lightly. He wasn’t interested in paying attention to these small matters and said directly, “Let them enter.”
Zhang Tao didn’t dare to say anything more, so he instructed Gu Yang to let the first batch of candidates enter. Gu Nan also took out the Observer Eyepiece and wore it at this time.
Ruby Fish Star’s martial arts halls were more like comprehensive martial arts clubs.
Not only did it teach students martial arts and guide them, but it also signed contracts with students as an officially recognized organization. The martial arts hall would get a cut of students’ winnings in the various martial arts competitions and even from their commercial activities.
If martial artists were equivalent to idols in Gu Nan’s previous life, then the martial arts halls would be the entertainment companies.
The first candidate soon entered. She was a little girl in martial artist robes. She first bowed to this side and showed a sweet smile. “Hello, my name is Li…”
“Shallow steps, weak forearms, and unstable internal energy. There’s no hope of stepping into Innate Realm before the age of 25… Disqualified. Next.” Gu Nan’s indifferent voice sounded.
He didn’t even let her finish saying her name before she was directly eliminated.
All of these players’ characteristics were exposed under the Observer Eyepiece. Combined with Gu Nan’s experience, there was almost no possibility of misjudgment.
So not only did the little girl freeze on the spot in stunned silence, even Zhang Tao was a little bewildered.
He turned his head and said carefully, “Young Master Nan, Li Lan is already at the peak of Acquired Realm at the age of 16 and is the seed player of the group that will appear in the Martial Arts Competition the day after tomorrow…”
Gu Nan shook his head. “Her foundation is too poor. She won’t pass three rounds in the Martial Arts Competition.”
Listening to this resolute judgment, Zhang Tao had no choice but to wave Li Lan out.
Li Lan’s face alternated between blue and white for a while. She obviously didn’t expect that she would be eliminated so inexplicably. She could only stamp her feet angrily and leave with big strides.
Gu Yang, who was also in a daze, quickly opened the door for Li Lan and called to the next candidate.
The people waiting at the door were also startled by the speed, and a congratulatory look appeared on one person’s face. “Li Lan, it must be that the examiner had your information long ago and let you pass directly?”
This person seemed to be Li Lan’s old acquaintance. His tone was a little flattering, and the people around them also stared at Li Lan with envious gazes.
Unfortunately, his flattery came at the wrong time.
Li Lan’s face was gloomy as she snorted. “I didn’t pass… Who knows what the hell was going on with that examiner. I was eliminated as soon as I spoke!”
“Ah? Why should they eliminate you?”
Li Lan gritted her teeth and didn’t speak.
In fact, she knew that she didn’t lay a solid foundation because she overly pursued speed when advancing to the next cultivation realm. But a shaky foundation wasn’t irreparable. Was it necessary to eliminate her just because of this?
So she left quickly and angrily said, “Nebula Martial Arts Hall may not want me, but plenty of martial arts halls do. We’ll see who’s right!”
A genius like her who reached the peak of Acquired Realm at the age of 16 was naturally the best choice for the major martial arts halls, because she may advance to Innate Realm at any time and become the backbone of those martial arts halls.
People like Gu Nan, who dared to assert that she had no hope of reaching Innate before the age of 25, were still in the minority.
Li Lan’s departure did not affect the interview, nor did she affect… the elimination process.
……
“Young Master Nan, you’ve already seen all fourteen people in the first batch. Isn’t there even a single suitable person?” Zhang Tao helplessly asked as he stared at the series of crossed-out names on Gu Nan’s list.
Normally, the best candidates every year would all be placed in the first batch. This year’s situation was neither bad nor good. ‘There were no outstanding talents this year, but it also wasn’t to the extent of…’
Gu Nan waved his hand. “They were all geniuses created through flattery. They’re not worth the price.”
Gu Nan didn’t actually give everyone the “elimination” evaluation, but even if the candidate passed, Gu Nan still didn’t give them a high-grade contract. Those arrogant participants couldn’t accept it at all.
“Let’s inform the second batch,” Gu Nan said to Gu Yang at the door. “Forget it, let the people behind enter together. In any case, it’s no trouble.”
Gu Yang’s mouth twitched slightly. ‘If everyone did what you just did, then it really would be no trouble…’
But she didn’t dare to say that, so she obediently went to inform the second batch.
The room fell into silence again. Gu Nan closed his eyes and rested, while Zhang Tao’s expression didn’t look very good.
Nebula Martial Arts Hall was also considered a first-class martial arts hall, which was why they could gather so many talents. ‘But now, this Young Master Gu Nan pushed them all out…’
‘People outside are scrambling to recruit these candidates. With this, I’m afraid it’ll be difficult for us to win in the Martial Arts Competition next year.’
Lu Wu and Lu Danze, who were standing behind them, still looked calm. However, Lu Danze’s anger was almost uncontrollable.
In his eyes, Gu Nan had become the prime example of a layman trying to order professionals around. ‘He clearly doesn’t understand anything but still insists on running this interview!’
He looked around. Master was silent. Lu Wu, that piece of wood, only knew to bow his head, and Bai Luoluo was still writing something in the notebook.
So Lu Danze gritted his teeth and resolutely went to Gu Nan and said in a deep voice, “Young Master Nan, those are rare talents just now. Please reconsider!”
Before Gu Nan even replied, Zhang Tao’s face lost all color and he yelled, “B*****d! What are you? Get out of here now!”
While scolding Lu Danze, he carefully watched Gu Nan’s reaction.
This wasn’t because Zhang Tao was a coward. It’s just that the scene from yesterday was too astonishing. He saw the Long family’s Long Yi get slapped into critical condition…
This person didn’t even care about the Long family. Zhang Tao didn’t believe that his own face would be more useful than the Long family’s face.
Lu Danze’s expression turned ugly due to this scolding, while Gu Nan just looked at him indifferently.
Just then, a figure hurried in. This was a girl in plain clothes, with patches on her trouser legs. She looked quite pretty, but because she wore a braided pigtail, that made her suddenly look rustic instead.
“S-Sorry, I’m late…” The girl apologized repeatedly as soon as she entered.
Zhang Tao frowned and looked at her. “Are you the girl who decided to go to Tonghe Martial Arts Hall instead because you wanted to make more money? What are you doing here now?”
“I…” When the girl was criticized by Zhang Tao, her small face instantly turned red and she had to keep bowing. “It was all my fault earlier. Please, please give me a chance!”
Zhang Tao snorted coldly. “The path of martial arts needs a sincere heart the most. Since you like making money, then…”
“Wait,” Gu Nan’s voice sounded.
Zhang Tao immediately swallowed his words and looked at Gu Nan in amazement.
At this time, Gu Nan’s eyes were bright. He looked at her like she was a rare treasure. “What’s your name?”
The girl seemed to be frightened by this gaze. After a long time, she finally murmured, “Lin Yunyun

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Military Goddess
chapters.content:
From the first moment he saw Lin Yunyun, Gu Nan knew that this girl must be the key figure in the chain event.
This had nothing to do with a top player’s intuition. Instead, he knew this because the Observer Eyepiece showed that violent internal energy was flowing all over this girl’s body!
Up till now, although Gu Nan still hadn’t learned any internal energy techniques, through the influence of his opponents, he had a considerable understanding of internal energy cultivation.
In essence, it was a system that gathered high-quality energy. The high-energy spiritual Qi would circulate throughout the body to temporarily strengthen one’s physique.
When spiritual Qi became highly compressed, martial artists would even be able to manipulate it outside of their bodies.
But he’d never heard of anyone who could keep spiritual Qi in a wandering state forever—it was no longer wandering and could be called permanent instead!
“Student Lin Yunyun,” Gu Nan said with a smile, “have you felt pain all over your body ever since you started practicing martial arts, and it’s also particularly difficult to cultivate internal energy? Your cultivation only grew explosively in the last two years, right?”
Lin Yunyun was stunned by his words and subconsciously asked, “How… How did you know?”
It was no secret that she suddenly found it easy to cultivate in the past two years, but how could this person know that she felt pain all over her body when practicing martial arts?
In order to not worry her family, she endured great pain when practicing martial arts everyday and never told anyone… Why would he know this so well?
Gu Nan showed a smile. ‘As expected.’
In his opinion, Lin Yunyun clearly had a special physique. Her body could naturally accommodate an enormous amount of spiritual Qi. Therefore, before she filled her body with spiritual Qi, the progress of her internal energy cultivation would be extremely slow.
And once her body was filled with spiritual Qi, having spiritual Qi touch any part of her body would cause extreme pain to her muscles.
This would continue until her body began to saturate, after which the stored spiritual Qi would finally begin to nourish her body, making her cultivation advance by leaps and bounds.
“It doesn’t matter how I know. What matters is this: do you want to join Nebula Martial Arts Hall?” Gu Nan asked directly.
“Of course I want to!” Lin Yunyun nodded excitedly, and then felt a little sad, “But… I need money. The salary of a Grade C contract…”
“I’ll give you a Grade A contract,” Gu Nan said without hesitation.
“Young Master Nan…” Zhang Tao stared at him, dumbfounded. Even the last hope in his heart was dashed out. ‘It seems that Young Master Nan really doesn’t know how to recruit new people.’
Lu Danze was still standing to the side. He didn’t want to fight with Gu Nan in front of others, but his face still showed clear disdain.
“Really?! Thank you, thank you so much!” Lin Yunyun was pleasantly surprised. She quickly took the contract from Gu Nan and followed Bai Luoluo out.
After Lin Yunyun left, Zhang Tao sighed slowly. “Young Master Nan, even if you’re really optimistic about Lin Yunyun, there’s still no need to give her a Grade A contract… Even if it was merely a Grade B contract, I think she’ll still sign it without hesitation.”
Gu Nan looked at him with a gaze that asked, ‘What do you know?’
Gu Nan answered, “A Grade A contract is 10 years, while a Grade B contract is only 5 years.”
Zhang Tao choked and couldn’t speak for a moment. He was stunned. “Do you really value her so much?”
“Of course.” Gu Nan pointed to the notepad and said, “Look, she’s only in Acquired Realm Fifth Stage right now, but by the start of the Martial Arts Competition, she’ll be at least at the peak of Acquired Realm and might even have stepped into Innate already. Will you believe that?”
Zhang Tao naturally didn’t believe it. ‘The Martial Arts Competition is only a few days away. How can this possibly…”
“How can this possibly happen!” Lu Danze exclaimed. If cultivation was so simple, then wouldn’t the hard work of himself and others become a joke?
“It’s possible.”
To his surprise, a person who never opened his mouth so far spoke up at this time. That was his senior martial brother, Lu Wu, who was also the eldest disciple of Nebula Martial Arts Hall.
Lu Wu frowned at this time, as if he didn’t understand something. “That girl… The aura of spiritual Qi on her body is very terrifying.”
“The spiritual Qi’s aura?” Lu Danze would question Gu Nan, but he trusted his senior martial brother a great deal, so he also fell into deep thought at this time.
Gu Nan glanced at Lu Wu in surprise. ‘This person can see through Lin Yunyun’s problem. His perceptiveness is also a little abnormal.’
The spiritual Qi in Lin Yunyun’s body had almost completely sunk into her muscles and tissues. Only Prodigious cultivators and above would be able to see some clues.
‘This Lu Wu is very close to the peak of Innate Realm, so it’s a little strange… This Lu Wu is also going to participate in the Martial Arts Competition. Maybe he’s also connected to the mission.’
Gu Nan silently memorized his information, then continued with his interview.
With Gu Nan’s speed, the whole interview process proceeded quickly. The remaining three groups of people didn’t even take up an hour in total.
The result wasn’t much different from the first batch, and the elimination rate was still as high as 80%. The difference was that the people in these later groups didn’t value themselves as highly, so several people chose to sign the contract.
This made Zhang Tao’s face look a little better. At least they had some gains.
Lu Danze’s face had been gloomy from the start. Although Lu Wu endorsed this Young Master Nan and confirmed some of his decisions, it was still true that their harvest decreased greatly this year.
‘Can a single Lin Yunyun offset all those talents who had been pushed out?’ Lu Danze didn’t believe it.
Another interviewee was ruthlessly eliminated. Gu Nan gently rubbed his eyebrows and said, “Is there still one more? Let him in.”
“Wait a minute.” Zhang Tao hurriedly shouted to stop Gu Yang and said to him, “Young Master Nan, this last person has average aptitude, but he has a big background…”
Gu Nan glanced at him and looked at the information on the list.
[Hu Daobin, Acquired Realm Fifth Stage, 23 years old]
Even if he only looked at the paper, he could still tell that Hu Daobin’s aptitude was ridiculously poor. Normally, such people wouldn’t even be qualified to enter the list, and it was also impossible to invite them for an interview.
“He’s from the military.” Zhang Tao explained in a whisper, “His older sister is Hu Wei, the Military Goddess. He made some mistakes in the army and was driven out, so…”
Gu Nan raised his eyebrow. “So you’re planning to accept this person so that he can harm Nebula Martial Arts Hall?”
The so-called “made some mistakes” most likely meant Hu Daobin had run amok, committing outrages. There was no need to think about it at all.
Zhang Tao also smiled bitterly. Of course he knew that Hu Daobin probably wasn’t anything good, but in order to win the friendship of the Military Goddess, it didn’t matter if he had to endure everything Hu Daobin did.
Anyhow, it was just a way for Hu Daobin to avoid the limelight for the time being. Would Hu Daobin be willing to continue staying in the martial arts hall? Of course not.
However, Gu Nan smiled coldly and threw the list on the table. “Then there’s no need to meet him. Just tell him to get lost.”
“Young Master Nan…” Zhang Tao was stunned for a while. He didn’t expect that not only would his words not work, but they even had the opposite effect…
Actually, it didn’t matter whether he said it or not. Gu Nan wouldn’t possibly compromise with such an annoying matter.
It wasn’t like evil gods had to commit all the evils in the world. Wouldn’t that just turn into a weakness?
A qualified top player could make deals with NPCs because of the mission and even compromise, but it was impossible for him to respond because of the NPC itself.
Because the identities of NPCs were meaningless to players.
In plain words, Gu Nan can take advantage of others at will, but others absolutely cannot take advantage of him.
Gu Nan’s voice had just fallen when the door was pushed open, startling Gu Yang, who was by the door.
What appeared in front of the crowd was not the overly decadent and drunk young man in Zhang Tao’s impression, but a woman.
The woman wore a military uniform. Her face was resolute, yet still gentle and beautiful, and her eyes stared at Zhang Tao. Hu Daobin was standing beside her with a gloating smile on his face.
“To think I was worried that my useless younger brother would cause trouble.” The woman frowned and said in a deep voice, “Hall Master Zhang, is this what you promised me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Psychic Martial Arts
chapters.content:
“Commander Hu, please let me explain…” Zhang Tao felt like he was about to cry.
Gu Nan and Hu Wei were both masters he couldn’t afford to provoke. They even refused to listen to any advice of his and just had to make things difficult to de-escalate…
Hu Wei ignored him and cast her gaze directly toward Gu Nan. “Who are you? What right do you have to make decisions for the martial arts hall?”
Before Gu Nan could speak, Hu Daobin beside her stood up and spoke mockingly, “Elder Sister, this is the younger brother Miss Gu just acknowledged. He’s really impressive!”
Hu Wei’s cold expression didn’t change, even when she heard that. “Gu Nian? Hmph! She’s so busy holding the Martial Arts Competition that she doesn’t even have time to control her younger brother.”
Ever since Gu Nian advanced to Prodigious, all of the capital’s high level officials would call her “Eldest Miss.”
Hu Wei dared to call her by name. No matter whether she was Gu Nian’s enemy or friend, her identity definitely wasn’t simple.
But what did this have to do with Gu Nan? He just smiled and looked at this pair of siblings like he was looking at two fools, then turned to Zhang Tao.
“When did Hu Daobin’s name appear on the list?”
Zhang Tao didn’t understand why he asked this, but he subconsciously answered, “It was yesterday.”
Seeing Gu Nan nodding, Zhang Tao hurriedly came to his ear and said, “Young Master Nan, not only is Hu Wei a military genius, but she also became a commander at the age of 28, and her teacher is called the Spiritual Elder, Heavenly Enterprise Star’s
[1]
Lu Yiming—Elder Lu.”
“There is a rumor that…” Zhang Tao glanced at Gu Nan and decided to continue, “she can already fight against ordinary Prodigious cultivators.”
“Lu Yiming?” Gu Nan frowned slightly. He felt that the name sounded vaguely familiar, but he couldn’t remember where he had heard it for the time being.
Hu Wei’s expression changed. She pointed to Gu Nan and scolded, “Is Master’s esteemed name something that someone like you can…”
Bam!
Gu Nan waved his hand, and a dark shadow passed by, immediately swatting Hu Wei away. She smashed into the wall and embedded a human shaped groove in the wall.
“Be quiet.” Gu Nan pursed his lips and thought for a while. Finally he remembered who Lu Yiming was.
“So he’s Lu Zhanyu’s grandpa…”
Ever since the mission to protect the White Dew Goddess, Gu Nan especially investigated Lu Zhanyu. There was no mention of her being a reincarnator, but there was a lot of public information.
For example, she came from the famous spiritual martial arts family in Heavenly Enterprise Star. Her grandfather, Lu Yiming, was a first-rate Prodigious Realm Domain Stage powerhouse.
‘A Domain Stage master who specializes in mental attacks is still a little troublesome.’
While Gu Nan was thinking, the people around him were stupefied. Although they knew that this Young Master Nan was in the Prodigious Realm… his opponent was Hu Wei!
Even though she hadn’t broken through to Prodigious yet, many people felt that it was only a matter of time.
After all, she was over half a generation older than Gu Nian and the others. If she didn’t accept the Spiritual Elder as her teacher later in life and rebuild her martial arts path from scratch, then she might’ve stepped into Prodigious Realm even earlier than Gu Nian.
Let alone her own strength, just looking at her status alone… She had both the military and the Lu family behind her. Who would dare to attack her?
But Gu Nan did attack, and he even attacked so efficiently.
Zhang Tao was just thinking about what to say when suddenly, he felt a burst of suppression in his heart, as if he had been caught by some force. Something in his body seemed like it was about to leave.
Not only Zhang Tao, but everyone present, without exception, was completely controlled by this force.
Lu Wu’s formerly expressionless face looked grave; Bai Luoluo and Lu Danze’s cheeks were bright red, as if someone had covered their mouth and nose, and they couldn’t breathe.
Zhang Tao was a knowledgeable person, and he understood the situation at once.
“Is this… innate ability?!”
Only an innate ability would have such a terrifying might… He saw Hu Wei walk forward step by step. There was endless fury in her eyes, but strangely, she looked very calm and had no superfluous expression on her face.
In the midst of this suppression, Gu Nan stood up like it was none of his business.
“Comprehending an innate ability while still at Innate Realm? Not bad.” He looked at Hu Wei and casually assessed, “But this isn’t the law of the mind. At most, it’s just psychokinesis.”
Hu Wei raised her eyebrow and said in a deep voice, “It’s enough to deal with you!”
As soon as her voice fell, everyone felt the pressure suppressing them disappear, but no one thought it was because Hu Wei stopped attacking. There was only one possibility—all the pressure was now concentrated on Gu Nan!
Invisible to the naked eye, a heavy hammer that had quietly formed was slamming down towards Gu Nan.
Hu Wei was already sneering in her heart. ‘So what if you’re Prodigious Realm? With the secret techniques my teacher taught me, ordinary Prodigious Realm cultivators might not necessarily… Huh?
Gu Nan didn’t even lift his hand. The shadows under his feet rose up and directly smashed into the heavy hammer, completely engulfing the latter in an instant.
Gu Nan knew too well how to deal with psychic weapons. These attacks that possessed dual physical and law attributes might sound pretty on paper, but in reality, when faced with higher and purer laws, psychic weapons were as fragile as a piece of paper.
“My turn.”
These two short words were pulled out into several notes in Hu Wei’s ears. Her face suddenly changed color… ‘This is the effect of his speed approaching the speed of sound!’
Sure enough, Gu Nan’s fist arrived at the same time that she heard his words.
Bang!
A muffled sound came out. Although Hu Wei was beaten back three steps, she wasn’t hurt. She immediately sneered, “It’s useless. If the psychic shield can be broken with brute force, then…”
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Gu Nan didn’t stop; he threw dozens of punches in quick succession, and his speed became faster and faster. He attacked until Hu Wei found it hard to defend anymore. She had to kneel on one knee to hold him off with difficulty.
Although the shield could still hold out for a while longer, the powerful shocks alone gave her the urge to spit blood while also feeling bewildered.
‘Where the hell did this rascal come from? Since when did Ruby Fish Star have someone like this?’
“It’s just a psychic turtle shell. I’m much more familiar with it than you.” Gu Nan had punched to his heart’s content and finally stopped. “High energy consumption, difficult to control, and low resistance to laws… It has many weaknesses.”
At this time, veins were visible on Hu Wei’s forehead, and all her strength was used to maintain the shield. She couldn’t say a word.
Seeing Gu Nan stop, Zhang Tao hurriedly went forward to hold Hu Wei up and asked with concern, “Commander Hu, are you okay?”
“I, I… ugh!” Hu Wei wanted to say “I’m okay.” Unfortunately, after trying to talk for a while, she finally spat out some blood.
Hu Daobin watched this from the side with dazed eyes. Right now, he finally reacted and cried bitterly while hugging Hu Wei’s arm. “Sister, sister! Nothing must happen to you, sister, or else what would I do…?”
At this time, the door was pushed open again, and a figure rushed in, panting as she said, “Hu Wei, it’s all Long Yi’s scheme. Gu Nan is not a bad person, don’t… er…”
Halfway through the sentence, the visitor saw the scene inside the room.
Hu Wei was vomiting blood while someone supported her. Gu Nan, on the other hand, stood aside with a smile.
He looked at the newcomer. “Lu Xinyu? What good timing.”
“You…” Lu Xinyu didn’t know what to say for a while. She could only walk to Hu Wei first and heal her injury a little.
After a long time, she sighed in relief. “Fortunately, the internal organs weren’t displaced. It’s just a little bleeding.”
She helped the pale Hu Wei sit down.
Hu Daobin, who was crying on the other side, quickly stood up and said, “Sister Xinyu, you have to avenge my sister!”
“Him, it was him!” Hu Daobin pointed to Gu Nan and complained to Lu Xinyu, “He was the one who hurt my sister. Sister Xinyu, call those uncles from last time and break his legs!”
As soon as his voice fell, Hu Wei’s expression had already changed. She coughed up blood while saying with difficulty, “You… shut up!”
Unfortunately, it was too late.
Hu Daobin turned his head in amazement, but saw that Gu Nan was now in front of him. The shadow that darkened his vision made him panic.
“My sister is… How dare you…”
Crack!
Gu Nan suddenly raised his foot and kicked Hu Daobin in the knee, which directly twisted and fractured his right leg. A shrill scream was ripped from his mouth.
Lu Xinyu looked at Gu Nan with a complicated gaze.
Notes: [1] ‘Sky Enterprise Star’ has been changed to ‘Heavenly Enterprise Star’

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Little Bai, come out to greet the guests!
chapters.content:
Inside Nebula Martial Arts Hall, the onlookers had already left. People also helped Hu Daobin leave to stabilize his injuries, leaving only the few major players behind.
Gu Nan calmly sat in the main seat. Zhang Tao and Bai Luoluo stood on either side of Gu Nan, while Hu Wei kept glaring at him with a vicious gaze.
“What are you looking at? Want another beating?” Gu Nan glared back with no trace of politeness.
Hu Wei had never admitted to a loss in her life, so she immediately slapped the table and said, “Bring it on!”
“Alright, both of you can stop now. Don’t fall for the Long family’s trap,” Lu Xinyu urged the two, being forced to speak up as a peacemaker.
Hu Wei clearly held great respect for Lu Xinyu, so she sat back down resentfully.
But Gu Nan didn’t have such a good temper. He directly raised a brow. “There’s no need for you to teach me a lesson. If you have something to say, spit it out.”
“B*****d, you…” Hu Wei became angry again, and Lu Xinyu had to stop her with a bitter smile.
“One of you is Gu Nian’s friend and has gone through life and death with her, and the other is her younger brother. Is there a need to escalate the conflict to this point?” Lu Xinyu shook her head and said, “Look at this.”
As she spoke, she handed each of them an intelligence report.
Clearly written on it was the fact that Hu Daobin didn’t originally intend to enter Nebula Martial Arts Hall, but someone intentionally lured him over in order to instigate conflict between Gu Nan and Hu Wei.
According to the analysis, all the evidence pointed to the Long family’s Long Yi as the culprit.
“Long Yi, huh?” A trace of a smile appeared on the corners of Gu Nan’s mouth.
Of course he didn’t actually forget Long Yi; he pretended not to recognize Long Yi yesterday simply to look cool. But in the end, high sensitivity to information was also one of a top player’s basic abilities.
Additionally, it wasn’t like he couldn’t guess that someone might’ve lured Hu Wei over.
Just now, he asked Zhang Tao when Hu Daobin’s name first appeared on the interview list to confirm this suspicion, but he simply wasn’t able to guess the culprit’s identity earlier.
After all, he had too many enemies…
Now that this was confirmed to be Long Yi’s doing, things made sense.
Gu Nan didn’t believe that he had a main character’s fate, so his luck wouldn’t be terrible to the point of pulling aggro wherever he went. Besides the first time, which was an accident, traces of the Long family’s behind-the-scenes scheming could be found in all the subsequent conflicts.
The Long family’s strategy was also very simple.
‘So you won’t give in to anyone? You like to face-slap people? Then we’ll keep sending faces to your door for you to slap. After you’ve slapped the faces of everyone in the government, military, and major families, you won’t be able to live here anymore.’
Unless Gu Nan was strong enough to subdue the entire capital, otherwise… This game would still have to be played using one’s brain.
‘But do you really think I’ll follow your rules?’ Gu Nan smiled coldly and got up to leave.
Lu Xinyu also stood up. She still wanted to persuade Gu Nan and Hu Wei to reconcile.
“Gu Nan, you ultimately didn’t suffer any loss in this matter. Why don’t we each take a step back, and you can apologize to Hu Wei…” But halfway through, Lu Xinyu realized that she couldn’t continue anymore.
Because Gu Nan’s cold gaze had fallen on her face, as if he was looking at a corpse. She didn’t have the slightest doubt that the other party would punch her brains out the next second.
Fortunately, Gu Nan didn’t attack in the end. He just smiled and said, “In consideration of your younger sister, I’ll pretend you didn’t say this. If you dare to talk to me like this again, I’ll break your leg.”
Gu Nan left after throwing down such a sentence.
……
Inside the Gu family, Gu Nan was sitting in his room, while Wang Dong was standing beside him.
“Young Master Nan, here’s the information you wanted.”
Gu Nan took the information from Wang Dong. After reading it quietly for a few minutes, he frowned. “There’s so little information about Lin Yunyun?”
The documents in Gu Nan’s hands merely showed information about Lin Yunyun’s family and her participation in the Martial Arts Competition, which completely fell short of the Gu’s family’s intelligence-gathering ability.
Wang Dong also heard the recent rumors about Gu Nan having a brutal temperament. He hurriedly answered carefully, “This is all the information that could be found in this timeframe. If you need more, you can order the subordinates to investigate the rest.”
“Mm, investigate everything.” Gu Nan nodded slightly but didn’t say much. After all, he just assigned them this task during the day. The timeframe was too short, so he couldn’t be too demanding.
He turned to look at another file. This was the information he asked for… to look for the Long family’s trouble.
“Looks like you’re quite interested in the Long family,” a voice came from the side, and Gu Xingzhu’s figure walked in slowly.
Gu Nan responded without even raising his head, “Remember to knock next time.”
Gu Xingzhu’s lips twitched, and she snorted lightly. “Long Yi really handled it beautifully this time. He didn’t leave any evidence we can use against him, so we can’t even demand an explanation from him.”
After a pause, she added, “Eldest Miss wants me to bring you a message. She says you mustn’t be impulsive.”
Gu Nan, who was originally sitting quietly and calmly, suddenly frowned when he heard this.
Gu Xingzhu, however, revealed a small smile. ‘As expected, only the Eldest Miss can control him…’
But she didn’t know that Gu Nan’s thoughts were completely different from her conjecture.
Everyone in the Gu family believed that since Gu Nian brought him to Star Realm, he naturally had to obey Gu Nian’s command, but in reality, their relationship was merely one of mutual cooperation.
‘There’s no reason why Gu Nian wouldn’t understand this. Then why did she send this message? Purely to give advice?’
‘However, this kind of rhetoric will only have the opposite effect and might even anger me…’ Gu Nan rubbed his chin. Gu Nian’s abnormal behavior finally aroused his suspicions.
The earlier events began to play back in his mind. If he replayed things starting from Long Yi’s provocation… then the source of everything seemed to fall on one person.
Gu Nan picked up the document next to him, and sure enough, he saw a person who originally didn’t have to appear, but who also seemed to have appeared so naturally—
Shi Miao’er.
“Interesting.”
“By the way, Young Master Nan,” Wang Dong hurriedly spoke up when he saw this tense atmosphere, “two young ladies from the Lu family came to visit you just now. Should I let them in?”
“Two young ladies from the Lu family?” Gu Nan stared blankly for a moment, then immediately threw the matter with Gu Xingzhu aside.
‘It seems that what I said before I left worked… Did Lu Zhanyu, this little girl, really think that she won’t have to pay the price for trying to screw me over?’
Giving her a slight lesson would be considered a little punishment.
“Then let’s meet them.”
A moment later.
“We’re to see Bai Luoluo.” Lu Xinyu stood in front of Gu Nan with a warm smile on her face. “I heard that her condition has improved…”
Lu Xinyu and her younger sister Lu Zhanyu came from a spiritual martial arts family in another region and were good friends with Gu Nian.
They were originally invited to treat Bai Luoluo’s mental trauma but couldn’t find a good cure for the time being. Just when they finally found a solution, they were told that Bai Luoluo had already been cured by someone else.
And the one who cured her was Gu Nan.
Since Lu Xinyu used this excuse to visit, Gu Nan really couldn’t refuse.
“It’s true that her condition is slightly better, but the direction might not be right…” Gu Nan recalled what the little loli had experienced in Immortal Demon World. “Why don’t you take another look at her?”
As he said this, his eyes couldn’t help glancing at Lu Zhanyu.
However, this “black widow” who killed her teammates was currently staring at her nose. She fixed her gaze on the tips of her shoes.
A happy expression appeared on Lu Xinyu’s face. “Mr. Gu, if you don’t mind, that would be great!”
Although she actually wanted to pay a visit to sound out Gu Nan’s attitude, as a doctor, her concern for Bai Luoluo wasn’t fake either. She sincerely wanted to cure Bai Luoluo’s psychological trauma.
Some doctors disliked other doctors interfering with their patients. Because her family had a tradition of practicing medicine, Lu Xinyu paid great attention to this custom.
Gu Nan’s eyes were still fixed on Lu Zhanyu as he shouted behind him, “Little Bai, come out to greet the guests!”

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Source
chapters.content:
Probably because Gu Nan’s strange wording shocked Lu Xinyu for a while, she failed to notice who Gu Nan was staring at.
This continued until Bai Luoluo skipped out and looked at them in surprise.
“You guys are those two doctors from before, right?” She giggled. “I’m fine now!”
‘Even her memory is intact. It doesn’t seem like she recovered by forgetting the trauma. She really is fine now…’ Lu Xinyu had some doubts in her heart. ‘How in the world did he do this?’
Usually, Pure Heart Dao cultivators who encountered that type of problem could only recover gradually through the passage of time, coupled with the assistance of external objects, so as to achieve the effect of “reconstructing their three views”.
Of course, she didn’t know that Gu Nan simply took the patient to a place where time passed many times faster and directly “refreshed” her three views.
Out of responsibility to her former patient, she still asked, “Do you… want to do another examination?”
Bai Luoluo frowned a little. In fact, she didn’t really want to recall that original memory. Just because she walked out of her psychological trauma didn’t mean that she liked to keep looking back at that trauma.
However, Gu Nan nodded repeatedly. “Yes. After all, you’re the professionals. It’s better to check and make sure.”
“You’re too kind,” Lu Xinyu quickly replied modestly.
She was happy that she could ease her tense relationship with Gu Nan through Bai Luoluo. After all, her current visit to Ruby Fish Star was because she wanted to request something of Gu Nan.
Since Gu Nan had no objections, Bai Luoluo didn’t refuse and followed Lu Xinyu into the inner room.
Only Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu were left.
Gu Nan asked bluntly, “Mission?”
“Eh, how did you know?” Lu Zhanyu pretended to be surprised.
Gu Nan didn’t answer, because it was a matter of course. A scheming b***h like Lu Zhanyu would never have followed her older sister over if she didn’t have something to discuss with him.
Knowing that Gu Nan was hard to fool, Lu Zhanyu simply stopped acting.
“There was a mission originally… but I didn’t expect you to advance to Prodigious already. A meager reward like that probably won’t even enter your eyes anymore.”
“What kind of mission is it? Let’s hear it out first?” Gu Nan didn’t mind. In fact, he had been waiting for this opportunity for a long time. Even if Lu Zhanyu didn’t come, he would’ve gone to look for her instead.
Why did Gu Nan need Lu Zhanyu? This started with the system behind Astral Gate.
In short, the number of missions provided by Astral Gate was limited.
Only five missions would appear at a time. While it was true that he only needed to wait one day to refresh the mission list, however… each remaining mission needed 10 units of star gold!
If Gu Nan wanted to reset the entire list after only completing one mission, he’d have to spend 40 units of star gold… Highway robbery!
But there was nothing to say. While Astral Gate was an organization open to the public, it wasn’t a public welfare organization. Naturally, it would try its best to force the user to complete all the missions. It was impossible for Astral Gate to provide mission information free of charge.
And after advancing to Prodigious Realm, he could no longer reincarnate indefinitely either.
So on one hand, Gu Nan was considering getting some more star gold. On the other hand, he also wanted to accept some missions from external sources. Lu Zhanyu appeared at just the right time.
Lu Zhanyu’s expression turned serious when discussing the mission. “It’s also a protection mission, but it’s to protect a little girl this time…”
“Don’t mention useless information. How large is the mission plane?” Gu Nan interrupted.
“…Quite large. It’s medium-sized.” Even with Lu Zhanyu’s shrewd mind, she still stared blankly for a while. Between the mission objective and the size of the plane, she didn’t know which one would be considered more useless.
“Reliable!” Gu Nan said excitedly, “That will do. After I investigate a matter and kill several people, I’ll be ready to set off as soon as I return!”
……
On a dark and windy night, there was a cool drizzle over the brightly-lit capital. The city’s nightlife had just begun.
In a high-end private club, five or six young men and women were sitting around.
One of them was laughing heartily. “This is the latest news—don’t tell anyone I said this… That boy Hu Daobin had one of his legs broken by Gu Nan!”
“For real? Hu Wei, that crazy woman, didn’t go with him?”
“She did! I heard those two even had a fight.” The person revealed happily, “The result is still unknown, but now these two have a grudge against each other. Everyone knows that Hu Wei spoils her younger brother the most!”
Several people beside him immediately gave a thumbs up. “Young Master Long, you’re incredible!”
Long Yi was also very satisfied with his plan to get someone else to fight Gu Nan. He said proudly, “Of course. So what if Gu Nan can fight? He’s just a brainless ruffian…”
Before his voice fell, he suddenly heard a bang. The floor-to-ceiling glass windows around him suddenly shattered, and a figure was thrown inside.
When Long Yi turned to look, it was clearly the club’s security personnel.
“Who did this?! Are you tired of living? You dare to make trouble here?” Young Master Long flew into a rage. Right now, he was a little allergic to the sound of glass shattering.
The Long family held the majority of shares in this club, and it was usually managed by Long Yi. Now that he actually encountered this kind of thing right in front of his door, he couldn’t help but be angry.
At this time, several people in black suits hurried in and said anxiously, “Young Master, it’s that Gu Nan… Gu Nan is here!”
Long Yi’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets. Even his words seemed to be stuck in his throat. “Gu Nan? I-Is he crazy?”
There was no evidence to prove that he instigated this entire affair, so nobody could use this against him. But Gu Nan coming directly to his door was akin to provoking the entire Long family!
‘No matter how powerful Gu Nan is, can he withstand the Long family’s wrath?’
After feeling shock and anger, Long Yi quickly calmed down and said in a deep voice, “Long Quan, take everyone away first. I’ll find Sixth Uncle.
Hmph
! Sixth Uncle just happens to be here today. This Gu Nan really picked a good time!”
The Sixth Uncle he mentioned was precisely one of the Long family’s several Prodigious Realm masters.
Long Quan, who had always been silent, looked a little gloomy when he heard Gu Nan’s name again, but he still nodded. “Miao’er, you guys can come with me.”
Shi Miao’er looked like she had already fallen into a nightmare. At this time, she nodded rapidly, and several other people also hurriedly got up for fear that they’d run into that lunatic if they were too slow.
A moment later, they hid in the adjacent compartment as a temporary refuge.
Sounds from the fight downstairs continued to travel up and even seemed to be getting closer and closer. Shi Miao’er’s breathing became short, and her legs began to tremble.
“Brother Long, will we… be all right?” She couldn’t help asking.
“It’ll be alright.” Long Quan’s leg injury hadn’t recovered yet, but his expression was still firm. He comforted, “My Sixth Uncle is here today. If Gu Nan dares to come, he’ll just be walking to his death.”
A young man nearby added, “That’s right! Sixth Uncle advanced to Prodigious Realm twenty years ago. He’s only a step away from the Infinitesimal Stage. He can certainly make that Gu Nan…”
Boom!
Before he finished, he saw a dark figure directly smash through the wall and hit him.
This young man was just an ordinary Acquired Realm martial artist. How could he withstand such a powerful impact? He threw up blood from the impact, while Long Quan nearby changed his expression.
“Big Brother!”
The figure that smashed through the wall was actually Long Yi himself!
“Young Master Long, Young Master Long!”
“How?!”
Everyone was stunned. Now that the wall was smashed, they could finally see the outside situation.
Gu Nan was standing alone amidst the ruins. An elder was panting like a bull. His whole body was covered with wounds and looked extremely miserable.
The elder’s next words shook everyone’s three views.
The elder slowly let out a breath and said with a bitter smile, “Your Highness, you’re already an Infinitesimal Stage expert who’s not far from Domain Stage. Why bother lowering yourself to argue with a junior?”
Gu Nanli ignored him. A strange smile hung from the corners of his mouth when he saw Long Quan and the others, who had just appeared in his sight. His figure flickered and appeared in front of them in a flash.
Shi Miao’er seemed to have returned to that day. That nightmarish scene reappeared in front of her. She clenched her teeth and forced herself not to make a sound, but her teeth were clattering.
Several men and women around Long Quan had already been frightened silly.
Long Quan, however, held his injured older brother in his arms and looked coldly at Gu Nan. “Gu Nan, kill us if you have the guts. My Long family will fight you to the end…”
Bang!
Shi Miao’er suddenly felt something warm land on her face—some red and white liquid had splashed onto her face, which was a mixture of brain matter and blood.
Long Quan’s head had burst with a single punch!
“Ah…”
“Shut up!” Gu Nan grabbed the screaming Shi Miao’er. He stared into her eyes and asked, “Let me ask you something. That day when you first met me, why did you visit the Gu family?”
Shi Miao’er’s head was blank, and she subconsciously replied, “Miss Gu told me to find Xingzhu…”

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Fight
chapters.content:
Gu Nan never believed he was the smartest person in the world.
In fact, in his previous life, it wasn’t rare for NPCs to be smarter than players—after all, NPCs’ IQ could be adjusted, while people were born that way.
Players had their own methods for dealing with NPCs who were smarter than them. The easiest way was to simply kill them.
Gu Nan suddenly heard a furious roar behind him. Sixth Uncle saw Long Quan’s death and felt indescribable grief and indignation.
This was one of the Long family’s juniors with the most hope of stepping into Prodigious Realm, and he might even climb higher… But he died just like this?!
He held Long Quan’s headless body and glared at Gu Nan with red eyes: “I don’t care who you are. The Long family will never let you off!!”
Gu Nan smiled at him. “Don’t worry. After tonight, there won’t be a Long family any longer.”
……
Thunder rumbled.
Gu Xingzhu handed a stack of documents to Gu Nian and whispered, “Eldest Miss, he circled a name on here before he left.”
This was the information Wang Dong collected for Gu Nan.
“Oh?” Gu Nian took off the glasses on the bridge of her nose and asked directly, “Was it Shi Miao’er?”
“Er… Yes,” Gu Xingzhu replied in amazement. She looked at Gu Nian oddly. She didn’t know what kind of riddle game Gu Nian and Gu Nan were playing.
“So he understood after all.” Gu Nian sighed softly. “Inform our subordinates. Tonight will be a sleepless night.”
“Will something happen?” A keen look flashed through Gu Xingzhu’s eyes. It seemed that she heard the implications behind Gu Nian’s words.
Gu Nian didn’t answer. She just stretched out a hand and gently twisted her jade finger, covering the documents on the table.
Almost at the same time as her movements, another person hurriedly entered the room.
Gu Xingzhu’s expression darkened. Just as she was about to scold the person who barged in for disregarding the rules, she became stunned when she saw the newcomer. “U-Uncle…”
“Mm.” Gu Mingyuan just nodded, then immediately said, “Immediately inform all departments to encircle and annihilate the Long family. I’ve already reached an agreement with the high government officials.”
“Encircle and annihilate the Long family?!” Gu Xingzhu’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets.
Even if the Long family was weak now, it was nevertheless one of the three great families. How could they be annihilated so casually?
Gu Mingyuan didn’t have time to explain. He looked directly at Gu Nian and said, “Gu Nan killed Long Quan. This matter can no longer be resolved through diplomacy. I’ll take care of the Long family’s side. Go and calm Gu Nan down.”
At this point, he couldn’t help smiling wryly. “We never took this into account… No one could’ve imagined that he had already stepped into the Infinitesimal Stage. The Long family’s Sixth Uncle couldn’t even protect his own life.”
Gu Nian, on the other hand, didn’t have any expression. She calmly responded, “The stronger he is, the better it’ll be for us. No matter how much we give him, it’s only going from the left hand to the right hand and will still stay within the Gu family. As long as the Long family is destroyed, anything is worth it.”
……
Gu Nan sat safely in the ruins, surrounded by broken limbs and rivers of blood.
Shi Miao’er was sitting in a kneeling position beside him, her face deathly pale. Nobody knew what she was thinking.
‘Brother Long Quan is dead, Long Yi is dead, and even the Long family’s Sixth Uncle and my friends also died at this person’s hands…’ She had never seen so many dead people in her life.
“Why didn’t you kill me?” Shi Miao’er asked as she glared at Gu Nan coldly, feeling her heart turn into ashes.
“Don’t worry, I’ll kill you soon.” Gu Nan replied earnestly, “Someone sent you to me. I just want to see why she wants you to die.”
“Who?”
“Here she is.” Gu Nan pointed his head to one side.
Shi Miao’er turned her head and saw a figure approaching quickly. It was precisely Gu Nian.
Gu Nian’s steps seemed both slow and fast. In the blink of an eye, she had already reached Gu Nan and Shi Miao’er.
“I thought that if you guessed that I was the one manipulating everything, then you wouldn’t kill them.” She gave a light sigh as she stared at the corpses all over the ground.
“Isn’t this precisely what you wanted to see?” Gu Nan smiled.
That’s right. From his first meeting with Shi Miao’er to the Jin family’s banquet, then to the martial arts hall recruitment and Long Yi’s plot being exposed—all of this was Gu Nian’s scheme.
When Shi Miao’er said the words “Miss Gu”, the entire scheme was finally laid out in front of Gu Nan completely.
“Use Shi Miao’er to lure out Long Quan, so that I’ll appear in the Long family’s sight. That was your original purpose, wasn’t it?” Gu Nan sat on the ground and asked.
“That’s right.” Gu Nian replied calmly, “But I didn’t expect you to have already stepped into Prodigious Realm, which is why I added the latter half of the plan.”
“No wonder a busy person like you insisted on personally accompanying me to various events.”
Gu Nan was puzzled about that before. Even if she wanted to build his reputation and make him a familiar face in high society, still, there was no need for Gu Nian to personally accompany him again and again, right?
Only now did he realize that she had predicted long ago that the Long family would cause trouble.
Only when she was physically present would she be able to completely control the situation and guide events in the direction she wanted.
“So were you also the one who called over the Lu sisters?” Gu Nan thought of Lu Xinyu’s coincidental arrival. Although the result was different from expectation, their timing was truly opportune.
If Lu Xingyu hadn’t been there, Gu Nan and Hu Wei would’ve been even more out of control.
“Not really. They really did have something to discuss…” Gu Nian seemed willing to reveal everything, but at this time, she had a faint smile. “I just had her inadvertently discover a few things.”
Gu Nan shook his head. He wasn’t interested in the particulars of Gu Nian’s plan.
Now that his questions were answered…
Gu Nan suddenly opened his eyes and threw a punch at Gu Nian’s head with incredible speed. He didn’t hold anything back with this punch and even used the power of shadows. The speed of his fist even broke through the sound barrier.
But Gu Nian remained motionless and imposing, as though she was already prepared beforehand. The space in front of her rippled.
Gu Nan’s punch landed, and the waves of ripples suddenly expanded, resembling a water surface after impact and shaking quickly. However, Gu Nian herself was safe and sound.
But Gu Nan’s punch wasn’t a simple punch either. Endless shadows flowed out from his hands and directly soaked into the ripples.
Gu Nian’s expression gradually became grave. She knew that she was about to face a Gu Nan who would be using his full power.
The only factor she miscalculated in her entire plan was Gu Nan’s own strength.
“Infinitesimal Stage? Then let me see what’s so remarkable about your power of shadows…” There were no fluctuations in Gu Nian’s heart. Her entire person resembled a machine as she calmly raised her hand.
Endless shadows poured in, but there seemed to be an invisible barrier in front of Gu Nian. All forces dissipated immediately after entering this plane, until…
Crack
.
The sound of something breaking rang through the air. Gu Nian’s face was slightly pale, but her expression gradually calmed, and she pushed her outstretched hand forward.
Endless shadows rushed out in an instant. Gu Nan’s face changed slightly. In a flash, his figure reappeared 100 meters away, while Shi Miao’er was submerged in an instant.
“I didn’t expect your power to be this type.” Gu Nan couldn’t help looking at Gu Nian with a strange gaze.
He increasingly felt that although this world seemed like it had nothing to do with his previous life’s game, the power system was still the same as the game’s.
Otherwise, a civilization that cultivated “martial arts” couldn’t possibly have such a strange law appear.
The law of “duality
[1]
” was once jokingly referred to by players as “for every action there’s a reaction.” If one cultivated this law to the later stages, it even had the strange effect of “turning black into white.”
‘To think that this kind of power actually appeared on an NPC… Oh, this NPC is a little different. She’s a smart NPC.’
Notes: [1] Duality
:
The actual term used here is “projection” (the geometry definition: https://www.britannica.com/science/projection-geometry), but duality fits better with later chapters and is probably more understandable

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Qualifications
chapters.content:
How should an overly smart NPC be dealt with?
As mentioned before, players’ first thought would be to directly kill the NPC so that they could continue dealing with a group of stupid NPCs.
Gu Nan did the same. If he had a chance, he really didn’t mind killing Gu Nian, but the latter proved that it truly wouldn’t be easy to kill her.
Although she had just entered Prodigious Realm and was still in Origin Stage, the law of “duality” was strange enough for all kinds of wondrous applications to be derived from it.
This law alone was enough for her to fight against ordinary Infinitesimal Stage experts.
But unfortunately, Gu Nan was a veteran who had gone through hundreds of battles. The enemies he once faced far surpassed Gu Nian by countless levels.
Just when Gu Nian secretly breathed a sigh of relief, a pitch-black figure slowly emerged from her shadow, then moved suddenly and fiercely stabbed her in the heart with a sword.
The shadow sword pierced the girl’s heart and completely deprived her of her vitality.
Gu Nian looked at Gu Nan with a startled look. She didn’t seem to believe that he would really kill her. Her body fell slowly.
“Stop pretending.” Gu Nan said calmly, “For every action, there’s a mutually opposing force. Life and death are also mutual. An attack that missed the focal point cannot kill you.”
Gu Nan’s voice echoed in the air. Gu Nian’s corpse on the ground gradually dissipated, and a new Gu Nian walked out slowly from the side.
“You seem to know a lot about me?” Gu Nian’s eyes were curious.
Gu Nan was noncommittal. “I just know this world very well.”
He had seen many characteristics of the law of “duality” in his previous life. As for resurrection, that wasn’t such a big deal in the game.
Gu Nan wasn’t completely helpless against this power, but the emergence of this power made him truly interested in Gu Nian.
Certain difficult matters could be handed over to her in the future.
So Gu Nan stopped and took a look at Shi Miao’er, who had died a violent death.
A strange smile hung from the corners of his mouth. “Now, it’s time for us to discuss the conditions.”
“What conditions?” Gu Nian secretly sighed in relief, but her voice was still calm.
The power of shadows was indeed extraordinary. It was more mysterious and unpredictable than all the powers she had seen before. If Gu Nan still didn’t stop, then she didn’t know who the winner would be.
Her resurrection wasn’t unlimited.
“The Martial Arts Competition—I want to take charge completely.” There was no trace of any smile on Gu Nan’s face. If Gu Nian didn’t agree to this condition, he would attack immediately.
Players were a group of extremely pragmatic people. Someone used him? Gu Nan didn’t care.
Weren’t players used by NPCs every time they completed in-game missions for NPCs? But any NPC who dared to interfere with his mission must be hacked to death without any room for negotiation.
So this time, he didn’t mind acting as the vanguard for the Gu family on the condition that the Martial Arts Competition be handed over to him.
Gu Nian’s hair rose on end from Gu Nan’s stare. She could only promise, “Okay… What do you plan to do?”
Destroying the Long family was naturally the top priority, but the Martial Arts Competition was also the Gu family’s next main project. She couldn’t allow Gu Nan to mess it up.
How could Gu Nan know of the chain event’s final objective right now? He shook his head and replied, “You’ll know later.”
……
When Gu Nan returned to the Gu family, the Lu sisters were still waiting.
Lu Zhanyu still pretended not to know him, while Lu Xinyu’s gaze was a little odd. Bai Luoluo sat beside them with wide, innocent eyes.
“Although I don’t know what method you used to… Mm, to treat her.” For once, Lu Xinyu’s expression looked slightly dark. “I hope you can try a sunnier method next time.”
“For example?”
“For example, when I ask what her dream is, I hope that she won’t say she wants to be an assassin queen,” Lu Xinyu answered expressionlessly.
“Oh, isn’t that also quite nice?” Gu Nan said after thinking for a while.
“You…”
Lu Zhanyu quickly mediated, “Sister, I think we should stay for a while and help Bai Luoluo sort things out.”
It had to be said that Lu Zhanyu’s words were precisely what Lu Xinyu wanted, so she nodded immediately.
After the two left, Lu Zhanyu didn’t enter Gu Nan’s room again until the middle of the night.
“Tell me about the mission.” Gu Nan naturally didn’t sleep. When Lu Zhanyu came, he asked, “By the way, I don’t have much time. How much faster does time pass in that world?”
Lu Zhanyu explained the mission using the fastest possible speed. In fact, it wasn’t complicated. It sounded like an ordinary bodyguard mission.
Different from the “tower defense” type of mission when they protected the White Dew Goddess, this mission was more like the “Azure City” mission Gu Nan had seen before. Its objective was to protect a target NPC.
It was a little troublesome that Gu Nan had never seen this mission before in his previous life.
But then Lu Zhanyu told Gu Nan about an unexpected trouble.
“Time passes ten times faster in that world… But the time node when the mission starts is tomorrow night,” Lu Zhanyu said calmly.
It was impossible for relatively large planes to be resettable, so they only had one chance at clearing the mission. Thus, the plane coordinates would only appear during the mission’s specified time node.
Gu Nan calculated in his heart. If he entered tomorrow, it would be too late…
‘The Martial Arts Competition is… Hm? No wait, I have the final say on the start date of the Martial Arts Competition now!’
……
Early the next morning, Gu Nan had a restful sleep, but the rest of the Gu family was still busy.
Yesterday’s encirclement and annihilation of the Long family wasn’t very successful. After all, there were four Prodigious experts in the Long family. Besides the Long family’s Sixth Uncle, who died at Gu Nan’s hands, there were still three more.
And unfortunately, all three escaped last night.
Before catching or killing these three people, the Gu family wouldn’t dare to truly kill the Long family’s forces, or else these three would let go of everything and become assassins without scruples to assassinate the Gu family’s higher-ups one by one.
In the end, it was trouble caused by Gu Nan’s decisiveness.
No one expected that not only did Gu Nan kill Long Quan, but he even killed the Long family’s Sixth Uncle. The fall of a Prodigious Realm elder had already escalated the feud to an irreversible level, forcing the Gu family to take action earlier than planned.
It was precisely their lack of preparation that allowed the three Prodigious cultivators to escape.
