“What? You want to postpone the Martial Arts Competition?” Gu Xingzhu looked at Gu Nan in front of him and felt like her head was about to burst.
‘He actually wants to cause more trouble in such a tense situation. Does he really think…’
“How long do you want to delay it for?” Gu Nian was calmer.
“At least three days. The specific time will be decided after my return,” Gu Nan wasn’t polite at all and spoke in a commanding tone.
The veins on Gu Xingzhu’s forehead jumped violently, and even her breathing quickened. ‘Does this person actually know how important the Martial Arts Competition is to the Gu family?’
‘All of Ruby Fish Star’s martial artists are looking forward to this annual event. But you actually…’
“Okay.”
“Eldest Miss?!” Gu Xingzhu felt that this world was going crazy.
Gu Nan nodded with satisfaction and left, but Gu Xingzhu couldn’t help stopping Gu Nian to ask, “Eldest Miss, how can you go along with his insanity?”
Gu Nian smiled silently. “Unless you want him to crash the event, everything about the Martial Arts Competition will have to follow his instructions.”
“Why?” Gu Xingzhu couldn’t accept it at all. It was clearly a competition they worked hard to prepare, so why should they hand it over to Gu Nan just like that?
Gu Nian looked at her seriously. “I can guarantee that if you don’t listen to him, this Martial Arts Competition won’t be able to continue.”
……
Gu Nian was right. Although the two sides only had an oral agreement, Gu Nan was confident.
If he returned and found that the Martial Arts Competition had begun… Then he would most certainly start killing on the spot.
Although the Gu family benefitted the most from the Long family’s destruction, it wasn’t like Gu Nan didn’t reap any benefits from this—at the very least, he proved to everyone that he, Gu Nan, was an Infinitesimal Stage powerhouse and one of the most powerful people on this planet.
In other words, he was now qualified to negotiate with any organization and had become a genuine big shot.
But right now, this big shot was currently lurking in the shadows in front of a low bungalow, silently spying on a young girl’s martial arts practice.
Student Lin Yunyun was entirely unaware of this. As usual, she woke up early and did morning exercises. She endured the pain day after day and honed her internal energy.
Perhaps Gu Nan had brought her bad luck, because today was obviously not a good day. Not far away, a group of people with ill intentions were quickly approaching the bungalow.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Alley Girl Addicted to Drugs
chapters.content:
These people were dressed like thugs. They seemed to be loafing around nearby when they saw Lin Yunyun’s figure from a distance and immediately rushed over.
“Brothers, we’re in luck today! The Lin family’s girl is at home today. Let’s get some money from her!”
“Brother Ying, I heard she was accepted by a martial arts hall…” Someone nearby whispered.
“What are you afraid of?! We’re not stealing or robbing her—don’t tell me that the martial arts hall can even meddle in other people’s business? Besides, you guys don’t know this: this little girl can’t take a beating.”
“Heh heh! That’s true. It’s the first time I’ve seen a martial artist who fears pain so much.”
This group of people chatted as they walked over. Gu Nan, who was nearby, heard them and secretly snickered.
It was natural for Lin Yunyun to fear pain. Once her body received a hard hit, the internal energy hidden inside her body would continuously escape, causing severe pain.
Furthermore, this pain would continue to flow alongside her internal energy and spread throughout the rest of her body… This kind of pain wasn’t something that could be dealt with through willpower alone.
Lin Yunyun noticed their arrival. Her face suddenly lost all color, and she turned to run away.
Even the group of gangsters were stunned.
Brother Ying, the leader, quickly shouted, “Quick, chase her! Don’t let her get away!”
In fact, these gangsters couldn’t even be considered martial artists, while Lin Yunyun was still an Acquired Realm martial artist. Just because she was “afraid of pain”, she had to run from them.
Gu Nan shook his head slightly from his hiding spot, but a trace of doubt emerged in his heart.
‘This Lin Yunyun can’t even fight, so how did she qualify for the Martial Arts Competition?’
Lin Yunyun’s home was in the slums. Many of the roads led to dead ends. In a panic, the girl ran into a dead end and was cornered.
“Run! Why don’t you run some more?!” Brother Ying said viciously as he gasped for breath.
These ordinary people couldn’t compare with Lin Yunyun’s stamina; they were already tired from running.
Lin Yunyun pressed her back against the wall and tried to shout calmly, “Don’t… Don’t come over! Or else I’ll hit someone!”
This sounded a little laughable, but as the strongest person here, Lin Yunyun was qualified to say this. Even if she was surrounded, as long as she caught someone and gave them a beating, she could still beat them half to death.
“What are you shouting for?!” Brother Ying snorted coldly. “If you dare to attack, I’ll tell your father and older sister about everything!”
“D-Don’t…” Lin Yunyun’s voice suddenly weakened.
A cold smile appeared on Brother Ying’s face. He took out a large bag of white powder from his pocket and waved it lightly in front of him. “The goods just arrived today. I left it all for you. Aren’t I nice?”
“Why would you… give it to me? I don’t need it anymore!” Lin Yunyun’s gaze stared at that bag for a long time, but she still said through gritted teeth, “Plus, I don’t have money anymore…”
“You joined a martial arts hall. How can you not have any money?” Brother Ying continued to sneer. “All Martial Arts Competition participants have a signing bonus. You want to fool us?”
Lin Yunyun gradually clenched her fist and breathed heavily. “I need money… I need money to keep fighting in the competition… You guys are the ones who forced me…”
Her voice gradually lowered, carrying a strange sense of gloom that made Brother Ying feel uneasy.
He wanted to say something, but Lin Yunyun suddenly looked up, her eyes filled with red.
“You…” Brother Ying only had time to say one word before Lin Yunyun rushed at him and punched him on the bridge of his nose, while her other hand grabbed the bag of white powder.
Then she ate the powder like a vicious dog gnawing on food, even eating the packaging.
“D**n it! You druggie b***h!” Brother Ying stood up while covering his bloody nose with a hand. He said angrily, “Just you wait. In less than two days, you’ll be famous! Everyone will know about this!”
“Brother Ying, something’s wrong…”
“What’s wrong?” Brother Ying turned his head and looked at Lin Yunyun calmly. His expression changed slightly. “She ate it all… Will she die…”
The current Lin Yunyun had messy hair. The bag in her hand was already empty. Her cheeks were still stained with residual powder, and a strong emotion flashed through her eyes.
Even someone like Brother Ying could read that look. That was called madness.
“Run!” Brother Ying shouted suddenly. He was the first to turn around and run, but he suddenly felt a cold breeze behind him, and then a pain in his neck.
Like a nimble monkey, Lin Yunyun jumped onto his back in an instant and bit down on his neck!
“Ah!” The sharp pain in his neck made Brother Ying scream wildly. He kept beating Lin Yunyun, but the latter seemed to feel nothing.
‘Why isn’t she afraid of pain anymore…?’
The doubt didn’t reverberate through his mind for too long, because his consciousness soon ceased to exist.
After biting off Brother Ying’s neck, Lin Yunyun threw him aside and continued to pounce on the others.
Two short minutes later, the gangsters’ corpses had been thrown together. They were all bitten on the neck without exception.
Yet Lin Yunyun still seemed to be in a state of madness. She began to crazily bite, punch, and slam her head against everything in her sight.
The morning in the slum was quiet and peaceful. Nobody knew what had happened in this alley.
Except…
Gu Nan stood quietly, like a ghost, watching all this calmly from the side.
……
A person.
A person in white.
A person who looks very familiar and likes to wear white clothes.
Lin Yunyun didn’t know when this person appeared. Although she still had strength left, her instincts were warning her that this person could kill her easily.
She began to lie feebly on the ground, her eyes tightly shut. She didn’t even care in the slightest that she was showing a lot of skin—most of her clothes had either been torn up or eaten by her.
But that person seemed entirely unaware of it.
“I ask, you answer. I’ll kill you if you don’t answer.”
“…Okay.”
“How old?”
“Thirteen.”
“Why lie about your age?”
“To enter the martial arts hall, to buy better drugs, to win the competition, to make money.”
Lin Yunyun’s voice was very low, but her pronunciation was very clear. She used clear logic to tell Gu Nan what she wanted.
Gu Nan didn’t continue to ask questions. Instead, he bent down and took the wrinkled plastic bag from her hand. “When did you start eating this?”
“Last month.” Lin Yunyun didn’t even blink. She looked lifeless. “Hui Ying drugged me and a classmate. Only then did I discover that the pain would go away if I ate this.”
Gu Nan swiped a little powder and tasted it– ‘Yup, a kind of shoddy stimulant. They probably provided it to people in the slums to satisfy the cravings of some down and out drug addicts.’
These kinds of drugs were often effective, but they were extremely addictive and had adverse effects on the body.
Of course, for someone like Lin Yunyun, her internal energy was so vast that no drug could hurt her.
For Lin Yunyun, who had been surrounded by severe pain ever since childhood and tortured every single second, this thing was akin to an immortal pill that held a fatal attraction to her.
‘As long as the pain stops, even death is nothing.’
Gu Nan looked down at the dull 13-year-old girl and started smiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Unexpected World
chapters.content:
“Do you know? I’m quite rich.” Gu Nan persuaded, “Come with me. I can give you endless drugs.”
Perhaps because she’d just sated her craving, Lin Yunyun seemed very calm. “I… no longer need those.”
“Oh? Why?”
“So many people died. This can’t be hidden from the police.” Lin Yunyun seemed dejected. “It won’t be long before they find me, and father and older sister will also find out…”
Gu Nan stared at her in a daze. To be honest, he thought of many possible answers she could give, but he never thought it would be this.
Police?
At least a hundred people died yesterday during the attack on the Long family. Even he himself slaughtered so many people in the Long family’s club that blood flowed like a river, yet he didn’t see any trace of the police.
It could only be said that from the beginning, his position was already too high. But in reality, for civilians, the government was still the most authoritative institution.
Gu Nan didn’t know how to explain this to Lin Yunyun.
“You may not know who I am.” He threw the plastic bag aside. “But I’m not afraid of the police. If you’re willing to follow me, I guarantee that no one will dare to investigate you.”
Lin Yunyun raised her head and looked at him with a gaze full of disbelief.
Gu Nan shook his head helplessly and suddenly punched the wall next to him. The wall, which was already riddled with scars, suddenly collapsed, revealing the stunned family behind the wall.
A middle-aged couple and a boy who was seven or eight years old—a normal family of three.
“Who are you guys?” The man asked with a dark expression. Anyone whose house wall was broken down by someone wouldn’t be in a good mood.
Gu Nan gently waved his hand, and three pitch-black arrows shot out, directly piercing the three people’s foreheads.
“See that?” Gu Nan helped Lin Yunyun up, not caring in the slightest about her sorry appearance. “Murder isn’t a big deal. As long as you’re strong enough, no one will dare to trouble you.”
“But the police…”
“If there are, then kill them.”
Lin Yunyun looked down at her bloody hands and didn’t speak.
“You can no longer go back,” Gu Nan summarized everything with this sentence.
Thus, the girl who lived only thirteen years but spent thirteen years like hell on earth knew that she had indeed been forced into a desperate situation.
“What price do I need to pay?”
“I need your talent. Serve me for three years after you reach Prodigious Realm. Then I’ll set you free.”
……
Gu Nan sat alone in the room. Instead of bringing Lin Yunyun back, he asked her to go back to practice as if nothing had happened.
As for the corpses of those gangsters and the family, naturally someone would take care of them.
“Young Master Nan, the appraisal results have come out,” Wang Dong’s voice sounded more respectful than before.
Gu Nan gave a slight nod. He knew that as the fuse for the Long family’s collapse, his fight last night would be widely publicized, and the “fact” that he entered Infinitesimal Stage would be known to those in high positions.
To have Gu Nan become the target so that people wouldn’t think this was the Gu family’s plot—this was Gu Nian’s scheme.
Gu Nan didn’t mind this. As long as he can properly finish this event, he doesn’t care how many people are hostile to him or scheme him.
Now, Gu Nan had just obtained the detailed analysis of the powder Lin Yunyun ate earlier—the results were no different from his guess: gray powder, a very common addictive drug. To call it a “narcotic” would be speaking too highly of it.
“Without considering the side effects, how many more drugs have stronger effects than this one?” Gu Nan asked as he turned to Wang Dong.
“Four kinds, one of which is a specialty of Heavenly Enterprise Star. It takes cypress snow grass as the raw material and is not addictive,” Wang Dong obviously did his homework and replied without hesitation.
“Not addictive? Then that’s out.” Gu Nan waved his hand.
Wang Dong was a little surprised, but he still replied quickly, “There is another kind called ‘red powder’, which is very effective if highly concentrated. It’s just that the side effects are also very serious… It was originally used to artificially bring beasts into heat.”
“As long as it’s effective, it’s good. Side effects… Oh, aphrodisiac.” Gu Nan answered casually and only realized the side effect halfway through his sentence. “Just send her some gray powder periodically. Keep the red powder for now.”
It was one thing for Lin Yunyun to take drugs. She could simply find a deserted place and get high, but if the drug was switched to an aphrodisiac, then they wouldn’t be able to hide the results.
Besides, the previous matter concerning Shi Miao’er made him suspect something, but he still needed further verification… ‘Lin Yunyun is a good way to test that conjecture.’
Gu Nan lifted the corners of his mouth, and Gu Nian’s calm and indifferent face appeared in his mind.
“Yes.” Wang Dong bowed.
……
After Wang Dong left, Gu Nan stayed in the Gu family’s residence and didn’t go out again. He was waiting for evening to reincarnate with Lu Zhanyu and complete a mission.
As for the chain event, he felt that he had almost finished the preparatory work.
The Martial Arts Competition was basically in his control now. The more obvious key figures had also been controlled, so all he had to do was wait for the event to start.
At night, Gu Nan came to a desolate wilderness, where Lu Zhanyu was already waiting for him—of course they wouldn’t reincarnate in the Gu residence, so they had to choose a place no one would notice.
As a reincarnator, Lu Zhanyu looked particularly capable and indifferent. Seeing Gu Nan’s arrival, she immediately said, “Let’s go. The Astral Gate array is ready.”
Gu Nan nodded. They had to connect to Astral Gate first so that Lu Zhanyu could share the mission with him. Only then would he be able to get the plane’s coordinates.
Plane coordinates were very special existences that couldn’t be described with words and could only be used during reincarnation.
“Why do you still have zero stars?” When Lu Zhanyu saw Gu Nan’s Astral Gate profile, she couldn’t help wondering, “After the last mission, you should at least be one star now!”
“Oh, I forgot to collect the reward,” Gu Nan replied casually.
Lu Zhanyu’s expression turned dark. She worked herself to death to monopolize the rewards by killing two teammates, yet this person didn’t even care about the rewards at all?
Gu Nan really didn’t care about the rewards from Astral Gate. After all, his purpose was Evil Value, not some stupid stars.
After receiving the coordinates of the mission plane, Gu Nan said directly, “Let’s go. It’s almost time.”
……
It was still the familiar reincarnation process. The body was entrusted to the endless void, and the soul was constantly pulled towards the coordinate until it slowly fell to an established location.
Then it split into two parts, half of which was integrated with the origin of the world, while the other half became the mark of the soul.
‘So this is actually reincarnation with half of the soul?’ They couldn’t communicate in spirit form, so Gu Nan could only wonder in his heart.
His consciousness sank slowly into the new body. When he woke up again, he and Lu Zhanyu were lying on a grassland, while there were shouts and the sound of battle around them.
This seemed to be a battle between pursuers and fugitives, and Gu Nan was on the fugitive side.
“This is a little troublesome.” Lu Zhanyu also woke up and frowned. “This body’s karma is to kill a leader from the pursuing army.”
“Then kill them,” Gu Nan didn’t care at all and replied casually. At the same time, he also began to check his body’s memory.
Although he didn’t care about karma, he still needed to understand the world he just reincarnated into. However, he was stunned after scanning the body’s memories.
“This world…”
Just then, a burst of laughter came from a distance.
“Our Azure Dragon Hall has reigned over the world for twenty years. How can foreigners like you oppose it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Gu Nan’s “Protection”
chapters.content:
On the vast grassland, countless cavalry arrived in an instant. They wore uniform armor and called themselves the Azure Dragon Army.
A cavalryman whistled past Gu Nan and was flattened into a pancake by him. The movement was a little loud and scared Lu Zhanyu.
She looked at Gu Nan’s slightly gloomy face and wondered, “What’s the matter? Is your karma very troublesome?”
Gu Nan shook his head. The original body’s memories were still emerging slowly, informing him of the development of the world in the past twenty years and their current situation.
This was actually Immortal Demon World twenty years later!
The chaos in the world twenty years ago had now become a struggle between Southern Chen and Northern Jin; the war between the righteous and demonic paths twenty years ago had now become a war with the disciples of Four Gates all fighting against Azure Dragon Hall…
Too many things had happened in the past twenty years, and the changes made Gu Nan unable to react for a while.
But what puzzled him most was: ‘Why did Immortal Demon World suddenly jump ahead by twenty years?’
Even if time passed faster compared to Star Realm, the change still shouldn’t be so large. Moreover, the plane coordinates were also different from the original… ‘Is this a similar but alternate plane?’
‘That’s not right either.’ Azure Dragon Hall was personally built by Gu Nan, after all.
Gu Nan was still puzzled, but he heard a voice around him.
“What are you two staring blankly at? Quickly cover the Miss during her retreat!” A middle-aged man with a sharp mouth and cheeks, wearing ill fitting armor, scolded them.
Gu Nan slowly pulled himself out of his thoughts and turned to look at Lu Zhanyu. “The mission is to protect that Miss?”
“That’s right.”
Gu Nan nodded and looked back at the middle-aged man. “Lead the way.”
“What did you say?!” The middle-aged man was suddenly infuriated. “As her bodyguards, how can you two not even know the location…”
Smack!
Gu Nan slapped him in the face, directly twisting his head 180 degrees. His body fell heavily.
“Looks like he doesn’t know. Let’s find the location ourselves,” Gu Nan explained calmly, looking like he’d just done a trivial thing.
Lu Zhanyu was a little stunned. This was the first time she participated in this kind of mission with Gu Nan; the previous “tower defense” mission didn’t give Gu Nan room to display his usual style.
‘No wonder he isn’t worried about working with me… Could this actually be his true face?’ Lu Zhanyu looked at Gu Nan’s profile and felt an unspeakable feeling in her heart.
They began to wander around in the chaos. Fortunately, Azure Dragon Hall’s cavalry had a clear goal. As long as they judged the direction of the troops, it wouldn’t be hard to find the goal.
｢Main Mission: Protect Zhang Yueying for 30 days｣
There was merely one lonely main mission from the Evil God Temple. Nothing else was included. Clearly, this mission didn’t have many side quests, so there wasn’t much to gain from exploring the storyline.
After running all the way, they soon approached the edge of the battlefield. For a war of pursuit, this was actually the core battlefield.
“Miss, please hold on for a little longer. Reinforcements from Four Gates will arrive soon!” An old man with white hair and beard was valiantly fighting the enemy. He was bleeding all over, but his words were full of confidence.
The “Miss” he addressed was a girl in plain clothes. She held a thin sword in her hand, but she frequently stabbed the precise chink in the enemies’ armor, exhibiting a very high level of swordsmanship.
But in Gu Nan’s eyes, this swordsmanship looked a little familiar.
“Zhang Yueying, you traitor of Azure Dragon Hall. You might as well just give up and wait for death!” Someone in the Azure Dragon Army shouted.
The slender sword in Zhang Yueying’s hand didn’t tremble at all. She calmly replied, “Azure Dragon Hall has committed all kinds of evil, bringing disaster to the country and the people. It’s everyone’s duty to eradicate it!”
“Hahaha, to think a prostitute still wants to set up a memorial archway
[1]
!” A powerful voice traveled over, and the Azure Dragon cavalry slowly stepped aside, revealing a man in blue armor.
The old man’s face changed slightly. “Miss, it’s Huo Mingda, the commander of the Sixth Army. He reached the peak of Innate Realm two years ago and is one of the few experts in this world…”
“Old Man Bai, there’s no need for you to explain. Your family’s Miss knows much better than you.” Huo Mingda sneered, “Did you know that when she was in Azure Dragon Hall, she was actually one of the Five Saintesses…”
Slash!
Before Huo Mingda finished his sentence, a strange but light noise came from the battlefield, and he suddenly stopped speaking. In full view of everyone present, the head of the victorious general slowly slid down!
Everyone suddenly fell silent. Only then did they notice a figure standing behind him.
That person was dressed in white and had black hair. He looked indifferent, as if killing Huo Mingda was just like swatting a fly.
This was naturally Gu Nan. After he killed Huo Mingda, he kicked Huo Mingda’s head away, where it landed right next to Lu Zhanyu—this person was precisely the target of her karma.
At this time, Azure Dragon Army’s soldiers finally reacted and roared in anger one by one.
“He killed the commander!”
“Go, kill him and avenge the commander!”
“Kill!”
Gu Nan smiled coldly. The shadows under his feet suddenly expanded to include everyone around him, and sharp blades appeared out of thin air.
Countless soldiers only felt a pain under their feet. Their whole bodies were then pierced by shadow blades, and they lost all vitality.
With this move alone, hundreds of Azure Dragon Army soldiers died in Gu Nan’s hands. The dead were sliced smoothly and cleanly, leaving only pieces of flesh. Unexpectedly, no one had an intact corpse.
A large space was cleared around Gu Nan, yet no one dared to move forward for a while.
“I-It’s a grandmaster!”
“Retreat now! A grandmaster just attacked!”
Azure Dragon Army may be an army, but they were also martial artists. They had an unbelievably clear concept of “Prodigious Realm grandmaster”, which wasn’t an existence mortals could hope to oppose.
Perhaps Innate Realm experts could still be killed by an army, but once a cultivator entered Prodigious Realm, they’d be able to control the power of Heaven and Earth by activating their innate ability. After that, they wouldn’t fear a massive army anymore.
So Azure Dragon Army’s cavalry came quickly and also fled quickly. They scattered in a few minutes.
Old Man Bai and Zhang Yueying were still in a daze. ‘The Four Gates doesn’t have such a grandmaster… Is he someone who recently advanced to Prodigious?’
In any case, Old Man Bai hurriedly came up to salute and thank him, “Thank you for your help. Your Highness, may I ask which of the Four Gates you’re from?”
Lu Zhanyu came up and played along with his question, “We are not from the Four Gates, but… Hey!”
Halfway through her sentence, Gu Nan had already punched Old Man Bai in the face. With one blow, his facial features were completely deformed and his face sunk inwards.
Zhang Yueying’s expression changed. “You…”
However, the next moment, everything turned dark, and she lost consciousness.
……
When Zhang Yueying woke up again, she was lying flat in the carriage, and the man and woman who kidnapped her were sitting beside her and talking.
She dared not open her eyes immediately and simply eavesdropped on the conversation between the two.
“We need to protect her. Why are you so rough…” The female voice was complaining.
And the man’s next words made Zhang Yueying torn with anxiety.
“The mission’s only objective is to prevent her from dying. Wouldn’t kidnapping her and hiding in the mountains be the easiest way?”
‘I still have important information to hand over to Four Gates. How can I be kidnapped by these two?’
Notes: [1] A prostitute still wants to set up a memorial archway:
Did something bad but still wants a good reputation or still wants to take the moral high ground

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Plane Leap
chapters.content:
When Zhang Yueying had silently counted to 354, the carriage finally stopped, and a voice traveled into her ear.
“Since you’re awake, don’t pretend anymore. Get off by yourself.”
Zhang Yueying knew that she couldn’t hide from a Prodigious grandmaster, so she could only open her eyes bitterly and walk out of the carriage. However, the scene outside the carriage made her despair.
She, who had been born in the north, recognized this location at first glance—she had returned to the mountainous northern region, thousands of miles away from Four Gates’ headquarters in the south.
She sadly and angrily pointed to Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu. “Do you… Do you know what you’ve done?!”
“Azure Dragon Hall colluded with the Northern Jin Dynasty to lead wolves into the house in an attempt to start another war! The general at the northern border ordered me to head south with a secret message to ask the experts from Four Gates for help. But you guys brought me back to the north again!”
“You are the world’s sinners!”
Zhang Yueying’s words were filled with righteous indignation, and her face was full of righteousness. However, what greeted her was a sneer from Lu Zhanyu and Gu Nan’s expressionless face.
It had to be said that Gu Nan’s words opened a new way of thinking for Lu Zhanyu, which allowed her to understand that the so-called “protection” mission didn’t necessarily have to follow the target’s wishes.
‘Kidnapping the target also works!’
As for the common people of the world that Zhang Yueying spoke about… What did the life and death of this world’s common people have to do with them?
“Should I break her legs?” Lu Zhanyu looked at Gu Nan. “I think she has a strong desire to escape.”
“No hurry. I want to ask her something,” Gu Nan waved his hand and replied.
Zhang Yueying gritted her teeth. Lu Zhanyu’s indifferent attitude made her burn with fury, and her delicate little face was full of anger.
She could see that of the two, Gu Nan—the Prodigious cultivator—was the leader. Thus, she simply took out a seal and placed it in front of Gu Nan.
“This is the seal of the general of the northern border. Now you guys should believe me!” Zhang Yueying looked like she had taken out something wonderful.
The country always came first. She believed that anyone with a conscience wouldn’t coldly watch on while the nation was in danger.
For example, she herself also used to be a high-level figure of Azure Dragon Hall. It was precisely because she disapproved of Azure Dragon Hall’s collusion with foreign thieves that she decided to rebel… ‘No, I’m renouncing the dark to seek the light!’
Slap!
Gu Nan casually swatted the seal aside, where it fell to the ground. He said indifferently, “Tell me everything you know about Azure Dragon Hall.”
Zhang Yueying was stunned by his behavior. She stared at the seal and couldn’t speak for a while.
Gu Nan noticed her gaze. The corners of his mouth lifted upwards slightly. With a light wave of his left hand, the seal flew back into his hand.
“If you don’t cooperate with me, I’ll find someone to take the seal to Four Gates and order their troops to stand still and not to easily trust news from the frontline asking for help.”
Gu Nan’s words were like a heavy fist that accurately struck Zhang Yueying’s weak spot.
The girl who wholeheartedly wanted to save the country turned pale and finally realized how stupid her action of taking out the seal was.
……
“You’re saying that Azure Dragon Hall used to be the pillar of the southern region’s martial artists, but ever since the old hall master disappeared, it gradually started to commit evils?”
After hearing Zhang Yueying’s narration, Gu Nan’s face appeared curious.
According to the young girl, ever since the “Immortal Demon War” twenty years ago, the world had entered an era of decline. There were fewer and fewer powerhouses who held innate abilities—Azure Dragon Hall’s old hall master was precisely one of them.
Under the hall master’s leadership, Azure Dragon Hall began to rise abruptly. Their assassinations caused great trouble to the Northern Jin Dynasty, all the way until Azure Dragon Hall became a distinguished force in the martial arts community.
But two months ago, the old hall master disappeared without warning, and the huge Azure Dragon Hall began to split into several factions.
The one who currently controlled Azure Dragon Hall was Xue Haoran, the commander of the Azure Dragon Army and one of the four original deputy hall masters of Azure Dragon Hall.
“Twenty years later, the power level of this world has deteriorated instead…” Gu Nan combined Zhang Yueying’s words with his host body’s memories to come to this conclusion.
The so-called “martial artists with innate abilities” mostly likely meant Prodigious cultivators.
Back then, there were at least a dozen Prodigious cultivators in total from the righteous and demonic paths, and there were even powerhouses like the Demon Lord, but now…
Everyone knew that there were only three powerhouses in the world.
One was in Four Gates, one was an advisor to the Northern Jin Dynasty, and the other was the hall master of Azure Dragon Hall.
It was precisely because of the hall master’s disappearance that the Northern Jin Dynasty, which had stronger national strength, began to entertain the idea of invading the south.
“Have you seen your hall master before? Are they male or female? What’s their name?” Gu Nan pondered over the current situation and asked Zhang Yueying again.
“I don’t know.” Zhang Yueying shook her head. “Ever since I joined Azure Dragon Hall, the old hall master has always worn a mask. All I know is that she’s an old lady.”
Gu Nan’s lips twitched. “You’ve never even seen her face before. How do you know she’s very old?”
“She already had her innate ability twenty years ago. Don’t tell me that she can still be a little girl?” Zhang Yueying finally caught Gu Nan’s weakness and mocked mercilessly.
She figured it out. Someone most likely entrusted these two with the task of protecting her. Thus, they wouldn’t kill her, but they also wouldn’t listen to her.
Gu Nan couldn’t help shaking his head with a smile. Zhang Yueying may never know that what she inadvertently said was closer to the truth than she thought.
……
“Are you really planning to hide in the mountains for a month?” Lu Zhanyu asked Gu Nan with a frown.
In the distance, the two avoided Zhang Yueying’s sight.
If they reincarnated into this resource-rich plane but merely received a mission completion reward, then it would be no different from not coming here at all.
“I was joking.” Gu Nan shook his head.
Gu Nan didn’t care about the resources of this plane. He never had too much interest in resources. Whenever he ran out of money in the game, he’d just grab some from NPCs.
But this was Immortal Demon World twenty years later. He also wanted to see what his old acquaintances looked like now.
As for what he said in front of Zhang Yueying, that was just to make her nervous so that she’d tell the truth.
“Then where are you going next?” Lu Zhanyu asked.
“To Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters. I’m going to meet someone.” Gu Nan looked calm.
A place that was a tiger’s nest to others was simply like his own back garden to Gu Nan.
After all, although twenty years had passed in Immortal Demon World, Gu Nan was still the same Gu Nan.
He was practically invincible in this world twenty years ago, so now he was even more so.
Lu Zhanyu looked at him suspiciously and finally understood something. She asked in surprise, “You’ve been to this plane before?”
“Mm…” Gu Nan nodded, not hiding it. In any case, she’d find out sooner or later.
At the same time, he also wanted to ask Lu Zhanyu whether she had heard of a plane skipping ahead twenty years in the blink of an eye.
After Gu Nan mentioned the time skip, Lu Zhanyu suddenly had an odd expression.
“In that case, that reincarnation organization’s luck really was terrible.” She looked at Gu Nan and said with some schadenfreude, “They finally colonized this plane after much difficulty, but they just had to bump into a plane leap. All their previous hard work has gone up in smoke.”
“Plane leap?” Gu Nan raised his eyebrows. The combination of these two words felt a little strange.
“In simple terms, it means that the plane leaps from one level to another. After the jump, the world’s origin and time flow would change, and even the world’s rules may be different.”

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Goddess of Revenge
chapters.content:
A plane leap—this was a phenomenon unique to small- and mid-sized planes.
When a plane’s origin changes, the plane is prone to leaping to another level, and its nature also changes. This process is called a leap.
During the plane leap, the entire plane would be in a special high-speed state, and the time flow would also be particularly fast compared with the outside, which was the reason for the twenty-year time skip.
The tragedy of Radiant Tower was that once their reincarnators left, they lost this plane’s coordinates and could no longer re-enter.
However, the people inside wouldn’t be able to receive any news from outside. They could only watch their companions leave but never re-enter.
There was no time limit for reincarnation, but the soul itself had limitations. No human soul could persevere in reincarnating for 20 years.
“In other words, we’re the only two reincarnators left in this world?” Gu Nan understood the meaning of a plane leap and why Radiant Tower’s situation was tragic. The result was truly a pleasant surprise.
“Not necessarily.” Lu Zhanyu splashed cold water on his thoughts. “This is equivalent to a newly-formed plane. There are many missions. It’s normal to bump into other reincarnators.”
Gu Nan nodded slightly. No wonder they came here unexpectedly. It turned out that the probability was relatively high.
……
Two days later, Gu Nan and his party came to Azure Dragon City, the junction of the North and South regions.
“To think that an outside force can build a city. The dynasty’s power is indeed weak!” Lu Zhanyu looked at the towering city in front of her and shook her head with a smile.
She was also a senior reincarnator and had seen other worlds with a feudal civilization background before.
Zhang Yueying immediately glared. “When the old hall master was here, Azure Dragon Hall was a first-class world power. The Chen Dynasty’s emperor even wanted to confer upon her the title of prince, but the Hall Master refused!”
“An organization built entirely upon one person’s prestige is doomed to fall eventually. This current result is clear evidence!” Lu Zhanyu remarked lightly.
“You…”
“Alright.” Gu Nan waved his hand. “There’s nothing to argue about. Take us to Azure Dragon Hall.”
Zhang Yueying gave Lu Zhanyu an angry glare and led the way again. On the other hand, the disdain in Lu Zhanyu’s eyes suddenly disappeared after Zhang Yueying turned away, replaced with a thoughtful expression.
She whispered beside Gu Nan, “This woman… is hiding something.”
Gu Nan smiled and didn’t reply. He only needed a guide. As for anything else, he didn’t care.
……
Inside Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters in the center of Azure Dragon City.
A majestic man in purple and gold robes was sitting on the throne and looking around calmly.
“Xue Haoran, you traitor!”
“Xue Haoran, you colluded with the Jin Dynasty and betrayed the country for glory. You are pushing Azure Dragon Hall into a place of eternal doom!”
“Xue Haoran…”
The accusations echoed throughout the conference hall, but Xue Haoran never said a word and responded to everyone with silence. He didn’t speak until everyone had stopped after they grew tired of criticizing him.
He spoke slowly, “I didn’t summon you here to discuss what to do next.”
Xue Haoran scanned the crowd with calm eyes. “I just came to inform you that the Jin army will enter the city in the afternoon.”
“What did you say?!”
“Xue Haoran, have you gone crazy!?”
Everyone immediately exploded in anger.
Xue Haoran finally pulled a smile onto his face, but his eyes were cold. “If you have time to criticize me, you might as well use that time to think about how you’re going to survive.”
His words silenced everyone at once.
The Jin army was about to enter the city. At this time, it was probably too late to evacuate. Besides, all their families and roots were in Azure Dragon City. How many people would be willing to leave everything behind?
‘The country comes first—of course anyone can say that when they’re safe, but once they have to gamble with their own lives, how can you expect everyone to be a saint?’
Xue Haoran understood this truth, and the other three deputy hall masters who criticized him also understood, so they began to hesitate when they heard his words.
Xue Haoran’s smile became even more apparent.
He didn’t give the three any time to respond and struck while the iron was hot, “Han Youchan, you said I sold my country for prosperity. Tell me, exactly which country did I sell?”
Han Youchan, the only female deputy hall master, answered coldly, “Of course, it’s my Southern Chen!”
“Southern Chen, very good!” Xue Haoran sneered, “Han Youchan, look around you. Of the people present here, how many are southerners, and how many are northerners?”
This question was powerful. Not only Han Youchan, but the other two deputy hall masters also changed expressions, while the people present became even quieter.
Azure Dragon Hall first rose up in the north. Those who could stand in this hall today were all high-ranking members, many of whom were elders. Naturally, most of them were from the north.
Strictly speaking, they all belonged to the present Jin Dynasty.
It’s just that the old hall master supported Chen and opposed Jin, so no one thought about this at all until Xue Haoran pointed it out.
With this, many people wouldn’t even have a guilty conscience from switching sides… More importantly, once these words were spoken, Azure Dragon Hall could no longer be as united as before.
The three deputy hall masters’ hearts sank, and they felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
Xue Haoran watched the people’s expressions change. He knew that the plan to sow doubt into the people’s hearts had been successful. Now, he just had to issue a call for action…
“As long as the hall master doesn’t return, the Jin army won’t even think about safely entering my Azure Dragon City,” a soft but dignified voice came from outside the door, and a beautiful shadow figure slowly walked into the hall.
“Miss Lin.”
“Miss Lin…”
As soon as she appeared, someone rushed forward to greet her. It was obvious that she held a high status Azure Dragon Hall.
Han Youchan was one of them. She happily watched Lin Jun appear. “Miss Lin, you’re just in time! We’ll work together to control Xue Haoran first, and then discuss how to resist the Jin army.”
Xue Haoran was the strongest of the four deputy hall masters. Even if the other three joined hands, they could at most defeat him. It’d be difficult for them to stop him from escaping.
But if Miss Lin also joined, then it would be completely different.
Everyone who followed the old hall master back then knew that Miss Lin’s strength was unfathomable. Even the old hall master said that she might not be able to win against Miss Lin either.
If there really were other hidden Prodigious Realm masters besides the three at the top, then Miss Lin might just be one of them.
Xue Haoran watched Lin Jun approach step by step, but there was not much panic on his face. “Miss Lin, you should know who can save Azure Dragon Hall.”
Lin Jun was as calm and indifferent as before. “I only know that you have attracted a major enemy to Azure Dragon City now.”
Seeing this, Xue Haoran couldn’t help sighing. He wanted to respond, but another voice traveled over.
“Since Miss Lin insists on being the enemy of my great Jin, why should Deputy Hall Master Xue persuade her any further?”
This voice made the three deputy hall masters simultaneously turn pale, and even Lin Jun frowned slightly. There were so many people present, yet no one was aware of this person’s arrival. Even if he spoke already, they still couldn’t find his specific location…
A Prodigious Realm grandmaster had arrived!
‘Is it Qi Lengxuan, the Jin Dynasty’s advisor?’ This was the first name that appeared in Han Youchan’s head, while the other two deputy hall masters had the same thought.
Everyone’s hearts froze. They then saw Xue Haoran step aside with a smile. A figure was standing there quietly.
‘It’s a woman, not Qi Lengxuan.’ The three deputy hall masters had just breathed a sigh of relief when they quickly reacted, ‘No wait! Even if she’s not Qi Lengxuan, she’s still a Prodigious Realm master…”
The woman’s eyes swept over the people and finally fell on Lin Jun. “Goddess Sect’s Fairy Lin?”
Lin Jun looked up with some surprise. Nowadays, few people could recognize her roots.
Which family was this woman from?
It seemed that she saw Lin Jun’s thoughts. The woman sneered, “Of course Fairy Lin won’t know me. Even Yan Xiaoxiao probably doesn’t remember me anymore.”
“But it’s different for me.” The woman glared at Lin Jun coldly. “Azure Dragon Hall slaughtered my Yin Pagoda Sect—not once have I forgotten this hatred throughout these twenty years!”

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Senior, please spare me!
chapters.content:
When Zhang Yao declared her revenge inside the hall, someone finally recognized her identity.
“You… You were Yin Pagoda Sect’s saintess!” Someone exclaimed.
Han Youchan’s head shook, and the scene from twenty years ago seemed to reappear in front of her eyes. She had also participated in the war to destroy Yin Pagoda Sect.
‘That pair of saint and saintess… They were merely two children back then, but unexpectedly, they’ve already become Prodigious experts!’
By this time, she already felt a sense of crisis. If Xue Haoran was merely an internal threat, then Zhang Yao was a genuine outside threat, the kind who would never give up until all of Azure Dragon Hall was dead!
The hatred of having her sect annihilated meant there was no room for negotiation.
‘Unless the old hall master returns, I’m afraid there’s no way to end this on a good note.’
Seeing that no one dared to speak, Xue Haoran took two steps forward and said with a smile, “Miss Zhang is a favored disciple of the Jin Dynasty’s national advisor. She will only kill the chief culprits today. To everyone who didn’t participate in destroying the Yin Pagoda Sect back then, you should consider this carefully.”
‘To think that a Prodigious Realm expert is only a disciple… Just how strong is Qi Lengxuan?’
The gloom in everyone’s hearts worsened. Some people became restless, and even the other two deputy hall masters also started to consider retreating.
After all, they weren’t involved in that event twenty years ago!
Lin Jun knew that the people’s hearts had already scattered, so she said after a small sigh, “I’ll stop them. If any of you want to leave, go now.”
As she spoke, she made a mysterious hand seal, and a glittering white light enveloped the whole hall.
People felt their emotions become inexplicably suppressed, making it difficult to maintain killing intent.
Only Zhang Yao smiled. “As expected of a secret technique from one of the five righteous sects back then… Fortunately, Master is already prepared for this.”
She took out a black bead from her clothes and threw it out gently. The bead just floated in the air, emitting wisps of black Qi.
As soon as Lin Jun’s white light came into contact with the black Qi, it immediately retreated, as if it had encountered a natural enemy.
“This is… Five Elements Bead!” Lin Jun had a wide range of knowledge and recognized the origin of the bead at a glance. She suddenly understood everything.
‘No wonder Qi Lengxuan could still cultivate to Prodigious Realm, even in this era where demonic energy is scarce. It’s because he obtained the Five Elements Bead.’ Lin Jun’s expression sank slightly. The Five Elements Bead appeared, yet Yan Xiaoxiao wasn’t here…
The demonic Qi of the Five Elements Bead was in mutual opposition to her technique. It was impossible to say which one was superior.
But Qi Lengxuan was the one who stored that demonic Qi, while she was unable to advance beyond the peak of Innate Realm due to her technique. Naturally, she wasn’t a match for a Prodigious cultivator.
The demonic Qi drove the white light back little by little. Seeing that it was about to win completely, Zhang Yao had a smile on her face.
However, the demonic Qi suddenly paused, then rushed towards the door.
“This, this is…” Zhang Yao was stunned for a while. She couldn’t help looking in the direction of the demonic Qi and saw a young man slowly walking over with a black disk in his hand.
And those demonic Qi were absorbed by that black disc.
Zhang Yao suddenly remembered that her master often lamented that there was no future in the demonic path. He only had the demonic bead but not the corresponding demonic disk. Otherwise, his demonic skills would have reached major attainment long ago.
‘Could this be the long-lost demonic disk?!’
The events of that year resurfaced in her mind. At that time, she and her brother were pursued by Azure Dragon Hall, and then saved by a master who came for the demonic disk.
Later, she joined the Limitless Demon Sect but soon experienced the sect’s collapse and fled like a street rat. This continued all the way until the Jin Dynasty rose in power and Qi Lengxuan accepted her as a disciple.
Later, she also investigated the disk’s whereabouts. It seemed that the demonic disk was not taken away by that monk. Instead, it fell into the hands of the person behind Azure Dragon Hall.
‘Wait, could it be…’ Zhang Yao’s heart trembled, and a terrible possibility suddenly emerged.
Before she could speak, the Five Elements Bead shook slightly. The demonic Qi quickly gathered into a human shape.
This person was dressed in a gray robe and had a middle-aged appearance. His temperament seemed elegant. At first glance, he looked like a middle-aged scholar.
But nobody who recognized him would dare to judge him by his appearance, because he was precisely Qi Lengxuan, the Jin Dynasty’s great power.
“Hahahaha! Truly, it was effortless to obtain! Unexpectedly, the rumors were true—the demonic disk really is in Azure Dragon Hall!” As soon as Qi Lengxuan appeared and saw the demonic disk, he immediately laughed.
Everyone in Azure Dragon Hall felt their hearts sink even further. ‘If it was just one Zhang Yao, Miss Lin could still handle it, but even Qi Lengxuan appeared now. Is there still a way for us to survive?’
But they didn’t notice that Lin Jun had been staring at the young man ever since he appeared, looking like she’d seen a ghost.
“So this demonic disk is part of a set! No wonder I couldn’t open it back then.” Gu Nan played with the demonic disk in his hand, his eyes filled with curiosity.
In fact, he snatched the demonic disk in the beginning because he wanted to release the three demonic spirits and see if killing them would give any Evil Value. However, he tragically found that he had no supply of demonic Qi and couldn’t even open the demonic disk.
He couldn’t even copy Jing Nan and purify the disk. Thus, he could only put it on hold for the time being. Unexpectedly, it came in handy now.
‘No, actually, it’s still kind of useless…’ Immortal Demon World’s mission was already finished, so killing the demonic spirits wouldn’t give any Evil Value. At most, it might only satisfy Gu Nan’s collector hobby as a player.
Qi Lengxuan looked at Gun Nan with a smile and began to urge the Five Elements Bead. He said leisurely, “Come!”
However, the expected scene didn’t appear. The demonic disk was still firmly held in Gu Nan’s hand and remained motionless.
In this odd silence, Qi Lengxuan felt a few strange gazes directed at him. His mouth twitched slightly, and he made a hand seal with both hands, pushing them forward. “Go!”
The demonic Qi forming Qi Lengxuan’s figure suddenly turned into a huge illusory lion and pounced towards Gu Nan.
“Miss Lin…” A deputy hall master looked anxiously at Lin Jun.
‘It’s one thing for this young man to be killed, but he clearly has a demonic path treasure in his hand. If it falls into Qi Lengxuan’s hands…’
“No hurry.” Lin Jun shook her head firmly, her gaze still fixed on that person. ‘Although they have different appearances, their aura and temperament are too similar, not to mention he has the demonic disk!’
Qi Lengxuan transformed into a demonic lion and pounced. He was already considering his plans after obtaining the demonic disk—whether he should destroy Azure Dragon Hall first or return and enter closed-door cultivation first.
However, Zhang Yao’s shout brought his thoughts back to reality.
“Master, be careful! He is the person behind Azure Dragon Hall!”
The one behind Azure Dragon Hall? Qi Lengxuan was stunned. He was also someone who had experienced the war between the righteous and demonic paths, and a memory from twenty years ago gradually resurfaced.
‘Back then… Azure Dragon Hall started off as an assassin organization… But the reason it truly became famous was because… The one behind Azure Dragon Hall fought with the previous Demon Lord, and as a result…’
‘The Demon Lord fled in defeat!’
Qi Lengxuan’s heart seemed to be caught by some kind of fear, and a chill rose from his tail vertebrae and rushed straight to the top of his head.
But it was already too late for the demonic lion to stop.
He only saw the young man raise his hand leisurely, and an overwhelming darkness pressed down. Qi Lengxuan couldn’t take a single step, and his demonic Qi was also dissipating rapidly.
With the last of his strength, he finally managed to shout a sentence before his consciousness dissipated completely, “Senior, please spare me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Yan Xiaoxiao’s Whereabouts
chapters.content:
“Senior, please spare me!”
An incomparably decisive plea for mercy echoed throughout the hall, which immediately stunned everyone, even Zhang Yao.
‘Although that senior is very powerful, Master, you’re also someone who reigned over the world for over ten years… Did you really have to go that far!?’
The only person who wasn’t affected was probably Gu Nan himself. He didn’t pay attention to the other party’s words at all and continued to suppress Qi Lengxuan with shadows, then collected the Five Elements Bead.
In the blink of an eye, over half of the demonic lion had been whittled away. Qi Lengxuan could only grit his teeth and say, “Senior, please wait! I know where Hall Master Yan is…”
When he said that, Gu Nan finally stopped and didn’t completely erase the demonic Qi.
However, the Five Elements Bead was still in his hands. Under the erosion of the shadows, all the demonic Qi in the demonic bead quickly disappeared. Then the demonic bead shook slightly, and a human figure was shaken out.
This person’s appearance was exactly the same as Qi Lengxuan’s illusory figure earlier; even the clothes were the same. However, this was clearly his true body.
Lu Zhanyu amused by this. “To fuse your original body into an object. You really are creative…”
Fusing one’s body and bloodline with a treasure was a crooked path. While one’s cultivation might progress faster, there were also various disadvantages.
For example, the original body would also be greatly affected if the treasure was destroyed, which was why Qi Lengxuan had to plead for his life earlier.
Qi Lengxuan dared not retort and could only smile bitterly. It wasn’t uncommon here to cultivate techniques to fuse one’s body into treasures. It’s just that Lu Zhanyu, who came from Star Realm, would naturally look down on this kind of crooked path.
“Gentleman…” A light exclamation came from beside Gu Nan. Lin Jun finally confirmed Gu Nan’s identity, and her face was full of pleasant surprise.
Although his appearance had changed greatly, the aura from the power of shadows couldn’t be faked.
Gu Nan glanced at her and nodded a little. “Your cultivation hasn’t advanced a single inch in twenty years. As expected, your Goddess Sect really isn’t a decent sect.”
Lin Jun’s expression suddenly darkened. She thought the other party would encourage her…
Gu Nan ignored her and looked at Qi Lengxuan. “Talk.”
Qi Lengxuan had heard of Gu Nan’s fierce reputation before and didn’t dare to delay. He hurriedly explained, “Two months ago, a strange treasure appeared in the far north. The three of us went to investigate together. However, we ran into a natural barrier…”
Speaking of this, he glanced at Gu Nan carefully and continued, “This Junior was able to escape together with the old Daoist in the south, but Hall Master Yan was caught in it.”
“More like you two joined hands to trap her there, didn’t you?” Gu Nan smiled. “That girl is still too naive… Where is this?”
“In a remote place in the far north. This humble one can lead Senior there,” Qi Lengxuan immediately said respectfully.
“Okay, lead the way.” As Gu Nan spoke, he turned and left. As for the people in Azure Dragon Hall, including Xue Haoran and even Zhang Yao, he never took them seriously from beginning to end.
Zhang Yao may be Yan Xiaoxiao’s enemy, but what did that have to do with him? Let her handle the revenge herself.
“My Lord, please wait!” At this time, a deputy hall master stopped Gu Nan. He was one of the other two deputy hall masters and hadn’t heard the stories about Gu Nan from twenty years ago.
“Qi Lengxuan is the Northern Jin Dynasty’s advisor and a major trouble for our Azure Dragon Hall. My Lord, if you allow the tiger to return to its mountain today, I’m afraid you won’t be able to explain this to the Hall Master when she returns tomorrow.”
This deputy hall leader spoke with composure, but he was confident. ‘In consideration of the Hall Master’s face, even he will have to…’
Slap!
A clear sound rang out. Everyone saw only a dark shadow pass by. The deputy hall master had been swatted away and hit his head on a pillar. Blood instantly flowed down.
“My Lord…” Han Youchan was also about to speak but quickly held back when she saw this. The rest of the people also kept their silence.
‘This person may be connected to Azure Dragon Hall, but he clearly isn’t a good person…’
……
Azure Dragon Hall was located in the middle of the continent, so it was quite a long journey to travel to the far north. There weren’t any good methods of transportation in this world, so Gu Nan and the others had to take a carriage and travel slowly.
They didn’t reach their destination until over half of the mission’s timeframe had passed.
Of course, at this point, the mission didn’t hold much meaning anymore.
Originally, this mission should be for the reincarnators to protect Zhang Yueying and deal with the pursuers along the way, all the way until they reach a safe location.
This was originally a mission for Innate Realm martial artists. But after Gu Nan’s interference, the Jin Dynasty withdrew directly, so there were no pursuers anymore.
As for why the Jin Dynasty withdrew so obediently… It was because Qi Lengxuan sent a letter to the king of Jin. The letter only contained a few words. The general meaning was as follows:
[Yan Xiaoxiao’s teacher from Azure Dragon Hall has reappeared in the world. Your Majesty, if you don’t want the entire royal family to be slaughtered, you’d better withdraw as soon as possible.]
“My Lord, that strange treasure appeared right up ahead,” Qi Lengxuan stood beside Gu Nan and whispered.
Gu Nan looked up. In front of him was a camp that looked like it was recently built, but the layout was quite reasonable. Clearly, it had been made by experts to guard the treasure up ahead.
“Let’s go.” Gu Nan walked ahead, and the party hurriedly followed.
There were currently five people in Gu Nan’s party. In addition to Lu Zhanyu and Zhang Yueying, even Lin Jun followed them. She also wanted to see the place that trapped Yan Xiaoxiao for so long.
After the five approached the camp, some people soon noticed them. They walked over and saluted. “Martial Uncle Qi.”
Qi Lengxuan greeted them without saying much, then turned to Gu Nan and explained, “They are that old Daoist’s trusted disciples. He sent them to guard this place.”
Gu Nan nodded. People all over the world believed that the north and the south were like fire and water, but who would’ve thought that the two strongest cultivators from each side actually wore the same pair of pants and even addressed each other as martial brothers?
In fact, this wasn’t surprising. After all, there were only three Prodigious cultivators in this world. Why did they have to fight to the death? Wouldn’t it be better to enjoy life together?
Everyone else, such as Zhang Yao and the others, wouldn’t be able to threaten their status at all.
The old Daoist from Four Gates had also gone back and wasn’t here.
Gu Nan soon came to the place where the so-called strange treasure appeared. It was a bottomless green pool.
“The strange treasure is at the bottom of the pool.” Qi Lengxuan explained, “When we dived in together, we encountered an inexplicable suction force… Hall Master Yan was sucked away.”
Not even a Prodigious master would be able to survive at the bottom of this pool for two months. That was why he believed that Yan Xiaoxiao had already died and ordered the Jin army to go south to occupy Azure Dragon Hall.
Yan Xiaoxiao’s collection over the years was also very tempting to Qi Lengxuan.
Gu Nan stared at it for a while and dipped his hand in some pond water, but he didn’t find anything unusual. He simply said, “Wait for me here. I’ll go down and take a look.”
“Senior!” Qi Lengxuan hurriedly said, “The water pressure at the bottom of the pond is great. Senior, it would be better to wear metal armor…”
“No need.” Gu Nan waved his hand impatiently.
What armor could compare to his own body? Moreover, his core skill was now at Level 2. In this world’s terms, he was at Prodigious Realm’s Infinitesimal Stage. Thus, he had many methods of handling this situation.
He stepped into the pool and was immediately surrounded by shadows, which kept the water away from him.
The four people with him stared in dumbfounded silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Plane Teleportation Array
chapters.content:
In the game, there was a very obvious jump in strength every time a player’s Tier 3 core skills leveled up.
A Level 1 core skill was nothing more than an ultimate attack—it was gone after a single use. But from Level 2 onwards, players were given room for finer manipulation, so the skill’s upper limit was much higher.
For example, if Gu Nan’s skill was only at Level 1, then he’d only be able to wrap the enemy in shadows, but at Level 2, he could do outrageous things like “parting the water.”
Therefore, it made sense for this world to describe this stage as the Infinitesimal Stage
[1]
.
Gu Nan dived into the pool like this. The pond wasn’t vast; he could see the edge with a glance.
A faint light shone from the deepest region. Gu Nan entered along the light and found that there really was a cave at the bottom of the pool.
From a distance, he saw a bizarrely-shaped altar with some strange patterns at the top.
A black-robed figure was also standing on the altar.
“Teacher!?” A cry of surprise came from the altar.
The person trapped here really was Yan Xiaoxiao.
Although Gu Nan used a different body to reincarnate this time, the power surrounding him had yet to disperse. As the person who had the most contact with Gu Nan twenty years ago, it was impossible for Yan Xiaoxiao not to recognize him.
She quickly took off the mask on her face and ran off the altar. “Teacher, you mustn’t enter! This altar has an extremely strong barrier. Once you come in, you will… Eh?”
She saw Gu Nan standing in front of the barrier. The Dragon Heart Pendant on his chest shone faintly. With a single punch infused with the dragon’s power, the barrier was smashed.
Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t expect for the barrier that had trapped her for nearly two months to disappear just like that… ‘As expected, I still can’t catch up with Teacher, huh?’
Compared to her, Gu Nan’s thoughts weren’t as complicated. Just like back then, he reached out and rubbed Yan Xiaoxiao’s hair, showing a small smile on his face.
Twenty years had passed, but her appearance didn’t change much. She simply changed from a youthful girl to a workplace woman. She grew a little taller, and her temperament also became calmer.
After all, the life expectancy of Prodigious cultivators was often hundreds of years. A mere twenty years really was nothing.
“Did Teacher come back this time… in another body?” When the joy of meeting Gu Nan dissipated, Yan Xiaoxiao thought of this and asked with her head lowered.
“Oh? You guessed it?”
Yan Xiaoxiao nodded slightly. After all, she was someone who had experienced the war between reincarnators, and Gu Nan didn’t specially hide anything in front of her, so it wasn’t strange for her to guess the origin of those reincarnators from twenty years ago.
Gu Nan explained, “Indeed, we come from another world. We traveled here to complete some missions and will use different bodies every time.”
Hearing this, Yan Xiaoxiao’s eyes lit up. “Then… Can I also go to Teacher’s world?”
Gu Nan stared blankly. He really hadn’t considered taking Yan Xiaoxiao with him. On the one hand, he didn’t need it. On the other hand, he didn’t know how to take her away.
Unlike the original Langya World, Immortal Demon World had yet to be colonized and developed, so there was nothing like an “Ascension Center” here.
But he could consider it now. Yan Xiaoxiao had already advanced to Prodigious Realm, and he also needed manpower for the Martial Arts Competition.
‘But how?’
It seemed that she read Gu Nan’s thoughts. Yan Xiaoxiao pointed to the altar and said, “Teacher, look at this…”
……
A moment later, Gu Nan returned above ground to bring Lu Zhanyu down as well.
“T-This is a plane teleportation array?” Lu Zhanyu stood in front of the altar with round eyes and studied the inscriptions on it.
“If she didn’t translate wrong, it should be,” Gu Nan answered as he pointed to Yan Xiaoxiao next to him.
It wasn’t like Yan Xiaoxiao did nothing while she was trapped here for two months. While chipping away at the barrier’s power, she was also studying this altar.
The altar seemed to have existed for quite a long time. Those inscriptions were actually unknown characters. Fortunately, the owner of the altar left the corresponding means of translation.
With the inscription’s foreign language placed side-by-side with this world’s ancient characters, Yan Xiaoxiao studied these for two months and finally decoded some of the content.
The key part was the name and purpose of this altar.
“Plane teleportation arrays were used only in ancient times, when reincarnation had yet to be discovered,” Lu Zhanyu frowned and said thoughtfully.
To think there were actually ancient relics in this world. This shocked her so much that she even said the word “reincarnation” in Yan Xiaoxiao’s presence.
“At that time, people had just discovered the existence of different planes and used teleportation arrays to travel to those planes so that they could collect resources and sell them.”
“Later, there were more and more methods of traveling between planes, and it even became possible to reincarnate directly with one’s soul, so teleportation arrays were gradually abandoned,” Lu Zhanyu said with some emotion, as if she was witnessing the vicissitudes of history.
Gu Nan didn’t care about history. He only cared about whether this thing could be used. “Is it possible to activate it now?”
“It’s definitely possible, but I don’t know how.” Lu Zhanyu shrugged helplessly. “Besides people in the major ascension centers, who would study such things now?”
Gu Nan also scratched his head a little.
Yan Xiaoxiao couldn’t help interrupting, “The inscriptions here also recorded the method to activate the altar. It just needs some materials…”
“Out of the question,” Lu Zhanyu interrupted her without hesitation. “Who knows what era this kind of altar is from? I’m afraid the teleportation success rate can’t even reach 50%.”
Faced with Teacher’s companion, a senior from the “higher world,” Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t dare to refute for a moment, so she could only shut up.
“Can you improve the success rate by finding people from Star Realm?” Gu Nan asked with a frown.
“If they are professionals, then there’s certainly no problem,” Lu Zhanyu gave an affirmative answer, “but are you willing to reveal this plane’s coordinates? This is an undeveloped plane…”
“Just find the Gu family.” Gu Nan looked indifferent.
“Do you really trust the Gu family so much? They can’t possibly remain unmoved after seeing all the resources here…” Lu Zhanyu was puzzled. Based on her understanding of Gu Nan, this person wasn’t naive.
“Who said anything about letting the Gu family enter?” Gu Nan glanced at her. “I meant we can find an expert in arrays to come in and have the Gu family silence them after the job’s done.”
Lu Zhanyu: “……”
……
The process of saving Yan Xiaoxiao was nothing special. Instead, the plane teleportation array gave Gu Nan a pleasant surprise. But when they returned to the outside world, there was an even bigger surprise.
As soon as the three appeared, a longsword stabbed towards them. The target was Yan Xiaoxiao’s chest.
“Die!”
The sword came so suddenly that not even Yan Xiaoxiao could react in time. After all, she had been trapped for two months, and her power was extremely weak. She was also by Gu Nan’s side, so she inadvertently let her guard down slightly.
More importantly, the sword came from an unexpected person.
It was actually Zhang Yueying!
Notes: [1] Infinitesimal Stage:
Called that because it allows for finer/more detailed manipulation of one’s power

chapters.title: Chapter 94: The Past
chapters.content:
Zhang Yueying’s attack came too quickly and inexplicably. Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t even know she was here. The exhausted Yan Xiaoxiao couldn’t react at all.
Lin Jun and Qi Lengxuan had been standing nearby, but they also couldn’t stop the attack in time, so they could only watch the sword stab out.
Gu Nan stood behind Yan Xiaoxiao, expressionless. Nobody knew what he was thinking.
Clang!
The sound of metal hitting metal rang out, and the sword in Zhang Yueying’s hand was sent flying. She stared at the person beside her in a daze, the only one she hadn’t been on guard against.
Lu Zhanyu.
‘She couldn’t have possibly reacted in time, not unless…’ Zhang Yueying stared fixedly at the woman who always had a serene smile on her face. ‘Not unless she’d been on guard against me from the beginning!’
Her mind replayed all the recent events in an instant, but she couldn’t remember where she had exposed her true intentions.
It could also be said that Gu Nan put so much pressure on her that she completely forgot about Lu Zhanyu’s existence.
“You… When did you notice?”
“When you deliberately expressed your approval of Azure Dragon Hall instead of wholeheartedly rebelling against it.” Lu Zhanyu said with a smile, “That wasn’t what you said when you were being chased.”
Zhang Yueying stared blankly and finally recalled her firm attitude against Azure Dragon Hall on the battlefield.
But after discovering that Gu Nan was connected to Azure Dragon Hall, she deliberately adjusted her stance, making it seem like her rebellion was simply because she couldn’t stand the actions of those currently in power, and she actually admired the old hall master.
Unexpectedly, the subtle contradiction between her stances actually led to defeat.
It’s just… ‘To suspect me just because of this tiny thing—isn’t this a little too far-fetched!?’
“Even a tiny amount of suspicion is enough.” Lu Zhanyu leisurely put away her sword and glanced at Gu Nan, who was still expressionless.
She believed that Gu Nan also saw through Zhang Yueying’s ploy. After all, he had been the one to first teach her to be suspicious of everyone.
Yan Xiaoxiao also knew Zhang Yueying. She didn’t know what happened after she was trapped. She frowned slightly. “Zhang Yueying, why do you want to kill me?”
Zhang Yueying knew that she had no chance anymore, so she simply stopped pretending. She sneered and was about to speak, but Gu Nan suddenly opened his mouth.
“Someone else can answer this question.”
As soon as his voice fell, his figure suddenly disappeared and immediately reappeared. Unexpectedly, he was carrying a person in one hand—Zhang Yao.
The longer he stayed at Tier 3, the more proficient Gu Nan became in controlling the power of shadows. A junior like Zhang Yao who had just stepped into Prodigious Realm couldn’t fight back in front of him at all.
Qi Lengxuan’s face lost all color as soon as he saw Zhang Yao. “Unruly disciple! You…”
Gu Nan waved his hand and motioned for him to shut up. He pointed to Zhang Yueying and asked, “You placed her into Azure Dragon Hall. Have you been waiting for this day for a long time? Is she your younger sister? Or your daughter?”
Zhang Yao gritted her teeth so hard that she almost crushed them. A plan spanning twenty years had been so close to succeeding, but everything just had to fail because this person returned!
“Do you want to know?” Her face showed a sneer, refusing to back down. “Even if I die, I will take this secret to the grave with me. Don’t even think about finding out for the rest of your life!”
Click!
Gu Nan casually crushed her throat, looking puzzled. “Just don’t say it if you don’t want to. You make it sound like I have to know or something.”
“Mother!” In the end, Zhang Yueying’s sad cry still exposed their relationship.
“Are they really mother and daughter? Based on Zhan Yueying’s age, she should’ve been born when Zhang Yao was thirteen or fourteen.” Gu Nan rubbed his chin and completely ignored Zhang Yueying’s hate-filled glare.
The next second, shadows began to wrap around her, just like dark tentacles pouring into her eyes, ears, mouth, and nose, completely sealing her five senses.
“What are you doing?” Lu Zhanyu looked at him in confusion, and even Yan Xiaoxiao did the same.
“I need her to live for a while.” Gu Nan skillfully controlled Zhang Yueying and said with a smile, “It’ll be troublesome if she tries to commit suicide.”
“But… Why do these actions of yours look so practiced?”
……
After Zhang Yao was dealt with, Gu Nan only had to wait for the mission to end—with his Prodigious Realm strength, doing this kind of mission was a waste. Fortunately, he didn’t care about the mission reward and only cared about the size of the plane.
Gu Nan sat alone on the hill, quietly looking at the night sky in the far north. A gentle breeze blew, and a figure was standing behind him.
“Teacher.”
“Is your power the law of wind?” Gu Nan looked back and studied Yan Xiaoxiao, then shook his head. “Not quite right, it seems like a more refined law.”
To be able to sublimate one’s skill into the level of “laws”—this was a trait of geniuses, but it was also the special privilege of NPCs.
For example, if a player had Gu Nian’s law of “duality,” then at Tier 3, they’d only be able to get stupid skills like “fold space” and “accurate positioning” at best.
The current Yan Xiaoxiao was the same. She had already found her own path, so her power was no longer as simple as wind.
In contrast, it was much harder for players. Even a veteran player like Gu Nan still had to do things step by step.
Of course, Gu Nan’s understanding of various laws and skills wasn’t something NPCs could compare with.
“As expected, I can’t hide it from Teacher.” Yan Xiaoxiao smiled, then changed the subject, “So Teacher, were you the one who ordered people to kill my entire family?”
The topic changed abruptly, but Gu Nan didn’t hesitate and immediately answered, as if he was answering a simple question about whether he had dinner or not.
“Yeah. I asked Mo Jiaqi to do it.” Gu Nan nodded. “At that time, I didn’t expect that twenty years would pass in the blink of an eye. Did you find some documents left behind in Radiant Tower?”
Yan Xiaoxiao looked serious as she nodded slowly.
It was precisely because of the time skip that the reincarnators ended up leaving one by one. When Yan Xiaoxiao and the others began to take charge of Immortal Demon World, the truth about the past gradually surfaced.
It’s just that right now, this no longer mattered to Gu Nan.
Selling out an NPC really wasn’t a big deal for him. If Yan Xiaoxiao harbored killing intent, then he could just kill her. There was nothing more to it.
And since she brought it up herself, she obviously had other ideas.
Hearing Gu Nan personally admit it, Yan Xiaoxiao just lowered her head, her body tense. A long time later, she gently sighed, and her face also looked relieved.
“Want revenge?” Gu Nan had a playful smile on his face.
Yan Xiaoxiao shook her head a little. “I’m no match for Teacher, nor am I a good person. I lack both the ability and the motive to take revenge.”
The smile on Gu Nan’s face gradually disappeared. “Looks like twenty years of experience has made you smarter… So what exactly do you want?”
Hearing Gu Nan’s words, Yan Xiaoxiao suddenly smiled. “I want to stay here, Teacher.”

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Complicated Feelings
chapters.content:
The sunlight shone over everything in the endless blue sky. Gu Nan sat under the eaves of the Gu family’s residence and gazed at the faraway sky.
‘Being invincible… How lonely it is!’
After returning from Immortal Demon World, he got 5 more Evil Value and 100 points, which made his Evil Value break through the 100 mark and reach 102.
Since his Evil Value surpassed 100, he could now activate another skill slot. His constitution also welcomed another strengthening, and he also spent a grand 1000 points to improve himself.
500 points were used to upgrade the core skill. “Power of Shadows” became Level 2, and with the buff from the Shadow Earring, the skill level was actually equivalent to Level 3.
In other words, Gu Nan’s comprehension of “innate ability” was now the same as this world’s Domain Stage experts and could be considered among the strongest on this planet.
On the surface, there was only one Domain Stage cultivator in the entire Ruby Fish Star, which was the Xu family’s old man. The strongest members of the Gu and Long families were only at Infinitesimal Stage.
Another 500 points were used to buy the skill “Resistance.”
｢Resistance——Passive skill. Your body will resist damage, and any damage taken will be reduced by 50%｣
In the Evil God game, there were a large number of high-quality skills to choose from. As long as players could think of it, then it existed in the game.
But in reality, very few of these skills were truly useful. The reason was very simple—players only had three skill slots.
Many comrades who chose the agility development direction with dreams of chaining skills for stealthy infiltration, sneak attack, kidney attack, backstab, throat slash, and finally shadow steps were severely punished by the game designers.
They could only use three skills in total. Like hell they could chain so many skills!
After the predecessors’ bitter experimentation and exploration, the latecomers finally understood what kind of skill combinations were the most powerful.
And in these combinations, the skill “Resistance” appeared very frequently. Because in addition to the powerful effect of reducing damage by half, “Resistance” also had a hidden attribute.
“Your body will resist damage” —this meant that players became immune to most status effects!
From now on, Gu Nan would have nothing to do with status effects like stun, blood loss, and fainting. He’d be able to ensure that he could always maintain a good fighting condition.
‘It’s too bad that I can’t level up this skill until I reach 200 Evil Value…’ Gu Nan lamented.
He knew that although his strength seemed like it was soaring now, he was still far from the desired level.
He was only able to stand at the top of Tier 3 cultivators by using the Shadow Earring. This also meant that it’d be difficult for him to experience another leap in strength like this for a long time.
He wouldn’t be truly invincible at the same level until he reached an Evil Value of 300 and unlocked the core skill arcana.
As for this world’s Void Cutter Realm powerhouses… He wouldn’t dare to say whether they really were the equivalent of Tier 4 until he actually saw one with his own eyes.
In any case, if that realm really was equivalent to Tier 4, then even the current him would only be able to turn around and run after meeting one. There was absolutely no chance of winning in a direct confrontation.
“Young Master.” Wang Dong’s voice came from outside the door, “Eldest Miss told me to bring the person over.”
“Let her in.” As Gu Nan’s voice fell, the door was gently pushed open.
Lin Jun came in wearing casual modern clothes, walking quite awkwardly.
Looking at her, it was obvious that she had yet to adapt to Star Realm’s modern fashion.
It had already been five days since the completion of the mission in Immortal Demon World and his subsequent return to Star Realm.
Although Gu Nan assured Lu Zhanyu that he wouldn’t disclose the plane’s coordinates to the Gu family, the first thing he did after returning was tell Gu Nian the coordinates for Immortal Demon World.
Gu Nan actually didn’t care about a single world’s resources, but he wouldn’t let Lu Zhanyu know this. This was to discourage some of her ideas and schemes.
And selling Immortal Demon World to Gu Nian was out of consideration for his future path.
He was already Tier 3, which wasn’t far from completing the First Round… After the First Round, he’d have to start thinking about building a Divine Kingdom. Thus, it was better to prepare early and have a spare kingdom.
