“Gentleman…” Although Lin Jun wasn’t dressed in ancient clothes, her temperament and speech still contained a classical flavor that couldn’t be eliminated.
“Just call me Young Master.” Gu Nan waved his hand. “I have some tasks to do here. I happen to lack trusted aides, so I brought you up… Do you understand what you should do?”
“…I understand.” Lin Jun lowered her head slightly, blushing a little.
Gu Nan looked at her with some confusion. He didn’t know what exactly she “understood,” but that didn’t matter. She was originally brought up as a substitute for Yan Xiaoxiao anyways.
After the Gu family took over Immortal Demon World, they were ecstatic to see this piece of “virgin land.”
Most of the Long family was destroyed, but they didn’t dare to deal a fatal blow because the Long family’s higher ups had escaped and still weren’t captured yet. They also didn’t know where to put the people they obtained from the Long family, but now, it just so happened that they could reincarnate these people into Immortal Demon World on a rotational basis.
As long as those people weren’t allowed to touch the ceremony itself, the Gu family would still be able to hide the plane coordinates, which was akin to using the Long family as free labor.
With such great efforts to develop the land, the ancient altar was quickly reactivated, and Lin Jun was able to “ascend.”
“Sure enough, Xiaoxiao’s unwilling to come up?” Although Gu Nan had expected this for a long time, he still had some regrets when he saw that Lin Jun was the one who ultimately ascended.
No matter how he looked at it, an Innate Realm Lin Jun wouldn’t be as useful as Yan Xiaoxiao.
Lin Jun gave a small nod. “Xiaoxiao… would rather stay there.”
She paused and couldn’t help sneaking a glance at Gu Nan. She knew there was a more important reason, but she could only keep that inside her heart.
She once inadvertently learned the truth about Yan Xiaoxiao’s background. It turned out that her whole family was slaughtered, and it was actually on her own teacher’s orders…
Gu Nan shook his head and didn’t lament any further. “Since she wants to stay, let her stay.”
Twenty years later, Yan Xiaoxiao had indeed become a smart person.
She already knew the truth and didn’t necessarily hate Gu Nan, but she deliberately chose that time to reveal her cards in order to force Gu Nan to leave her behind, or at least give up the right to decide.
Yan Xiaoxiao knew that if Gu Nan really wanted to take her away, she would have no way to resist.
So she buried a thorn in Gu Nan’s heart. As long as the thorn was there, Gu Nan wouldn’t dare to keep her by his side and feel safe. Only then would she have the opportunity to stay behind in Immortal Demon World and do whatever she wanted to do.
“She sure thought things through.” Gu Nan’s mouth curled a little, and his smile was more or less mocking. “You can escape from me, but can you escape from her?”
If his guess was correct, then the Evil Value for the first event in the chain of events might fall on her…
Sure enough, the more scheming someone was, the more abnormal they were.
Gu Nan smiled and picked up the documents from the table, handing them to Lin Jun. “Look at this information first. What you need to do next is all in here.”
“This is…” Lin Jun looked at this thin stack of documents and was a little puzzled.
What was recorded were some deliberately selected behavioral patterns about a woman named Gu Nian.
Lin Jun had been in Star Realm for some time. Of course she knew who Gu Nian was and what kind of status she held in the Gu family…
‘Gu Nan actually wants to target her?’
As if he read Lin Jun’s mind, Gu Nan smiled and assured, “I’m not targeting her; I’m helping her.”
“To give her what she wants the most—this is called adapting to her tastes.”
Gu Nan’s meaningful words made Lin Jun feel uneasy. She began to look through the content of the files carefully.
She found that these materials summarized certain people Gu Nian had met, either during her many reincarnations or in Star Realm.
[Hundred Demons World, Mo Yao, Female, 13 years old.
Heavenly Fortune World, Qian Ling, Female, 14 years old.
Lonely Cloud World, Yin Qianrui, Female, 11 years old.
……
Star Realm, Shi Miao’er, Female, 15 years old.
Langya World, Bai Luoluo, Female, 14 years old.]
Strange ideas began to form in Lin Jun’s mind, but she didn’t dare to confirm them. She looked up at Gu Nan.
Gu Nan calmly looked into her eyes. “Gu Nian will return today. I also called over the girl named Lin Yunyun. You just need to follow the instructions I wrote down.”
“I understand…”

chapters.title: Chapter 96: “Censored”
chapters.content:
It was already late at night when Lin Yunyun reached the Gu residence.
The dark night veiled the earth. The 13-year-old girl stepped into the large residence step by step.
Her shadow stretched and elongated slowly under the moonlight. Her figure seemed a little mournful, but in reality, she wasn’t. Her arrival had nothing to do with anything poetic or romantic. It was simply because of… desire.
It was impossible for a tiger that had tasted blood to go back to being a vegetarian.
“Miss Lin?”
She saw an unfamiliar woman standing in front of her greeting her in a gentle voice. She felt at a loss.
‘Wasn’t that butler the one who contacted me? How come…’
She didn’t want… other people to see her appearance when taking drugs. At least, the fewer people who saw, the better.
Lin Jun smiled and reassured Lin Yunyun with her unique friendliness. A moment later, she led the girl slowly into a room with a smile. “Everything you want… is inside!”
Lin Yunyun took a deep breath and didn’t know what to say, but the fleeting pleasure that had sunk deep into her bone marrow began to reverberate in her body once again.
……
“Young Master, she went in,” Lin Jun stood beside Gu Nan and spoke softly.
Gu Nan nodded and stood up from his chair. In the Evil God Temple in his mind, the event concerning the “Martial Arts Competition” had already started.
On the third day of his return, Gu Nan personally kicked off Ruby Fish Star’s Martial Arts Competition, and the chain event also started. What he had to do now was to earn Evil Value for the first event.
He got up and walked out, but Lin Jun stood in front of him all this time, looking hesitant.
“Young Master, will you… kill Xiaoxiao in the future?” After a long mental debate, she still asked this sentence.
Gu Nan looked at her with great interest. “I thought people like you cared more about the suffering of all sentient beings rather than an individual’s life and death.”
“I’m no longer one of Goddess Sect’s goddesses.” Lin Jun shook her head.
“You didn’t have a choice before, but now you want to be a good person?” Gu Nan joked casually, then chuckled. “She thinks I can’t do anything about her if she stays there?”
When saying this, Gu Nan’s smile turned somewhat strange. “I’m actually not very interested in you guys, but that’s not necessarily true for other people.”
“The Gu family needs someone to take charge of Immortal Demon World. I’m already overseeing the Martial Arts Competition, so who do you think will go there?”
……
Gu Nian’s room wasn’t very spacious. In fact, compared to her status, an ordinary 1.5-meter-long bed seemed somewhat shabby—at the very least, she should be sleeping on a 500 square meter crystal bed.
But even such a simple layout was unimaginable luxury for Lin Yunyun.
She realized that this wasn’t the room that was prepared for her, so she became more and more careful.
Her eyes slowly scanned the room. Her clenched fist began to sweat, as if she could hear her own heartbeat. She finally found what she was looking for on the dressing table next to her.
It was a plastic bag containing white powder.
Lin Yunyun’s eyes lit up slightly, and she immediately let her guard down. Desire once again occupied her brain. As soon as she grabbed the plastic bag, she opened her mouth and chewed it down.
She didn’t know when it started, but she liked this rough way of “eating” more and more.
“Pah! Pah…”
However, as soon as she ate it, Lin Yunyun couldn’t help spitting it out—this wasn’t what she wanted at all; this was just flour.
“D**n it… Huh?” Lin Yunyun, who felt tricked, was about to get angry, but found a small glass bottle hidden inside the flour.
Inside the bottle was a handful of bright red crystals, shimmering in the light.
Lin Yunyun seemed to understand something. She hurriedly unscrewed the bottle cap and poured the crystals into her mouth. Unfortunately, the mouth of the bottle was too narrow, and only a few crystals fell out.
But even with such a small amount, as soon as they entered Lin Yunyun’s mouth, the girl felt that her head was about to explode, as if countless needles were about to erupt out of her cheeks and turn her into a hedgehog.
The girl could hardly stop herself from moaning. Over ten years of endless pain made her develop a strange hobby.
On the one hand, she was extremely eager to live like a normal person and use drugs to eliminate the pain. But on the other hand, she was also obsessed with intense sensory stimulation, even if that stimulation was the familiar pain she hated the most.
Her eyes were closed, her hand holding the bottle trembled slightly, and she clutched the bottle with such force that her knuckles were faintly white.
Bang!
The glass bottle shattered because it couldn’t bear her strength, which startled the girl out of her state of extreme excitement.
Red crystals flew everywhere; most of them landed on the ground. The glass shards cut her hands bloody, but she seemed entirely unaware of it.
The girl crazily picked up crystals from the ground to eat, and she even crawled on the floor and licked the ground until there was no residue on the floor anymore. She then started licking her palm with her tongue.
The broken glass shards cut her tongue, her mouth, and her lips, but she didn’t feel anything.
Her body was getting hot. The aphrodisiac component had begun its attack, but this desire was nothing compared to the floating feeling that was currently madly stimulating her brain.
The crystals on her hand soon disappeared. The girl was very sober, but she was filled with endless desire. She began to look around.
From the dresser to the bedside table, she searched, smashed, and destroyed the layout one by one, but the red crystals never appeared again.
Until… She lifted the quilt spread on the bed and stared in shock.
Countless blood red crystals, shining a strange light, were quietly spread out in front of her, glistening brightly.
……
“You were looking for me?” Gu Nian stood outside her own room and looked at Gu Nan in confusion.
Ever since Gu Nan revealed information regarding Immortal Demon World, the entire Gu family had shifted their focus. Almost everything regarding the Martial Arts Competition had been handed over to Gu Nan, while she took over the matter of colonizing this new plane.
It was a large-scale plane that few reincarnators knew about, yet it was rich in resources. No force would be able to resist the temptation.
She was awfully busy recently, but Gu Nan picked this time to look for her. It was probably an important matter.
‘What can it be?’
Gu Nan pointed to her room. “See that?”
Gu Nian paused slightly. Just when she was about to extend her senses to scan the room, she felt a sudden chill around her. She didn’t know when it happened, but she was now standing in utter darkness. No matter whether she looked up, down, left, or right, it was full of shadows.
“Domain Stage!” Gu Nian almost screamed and frantically urged her innate ability to counter it but found that Gu Nan had already locked the surrounding laws, and all the innate abilities she specialized in were disassembled one after another.
Gu Nian was speechless. She could only stare at Gu Nan with a complicated and surprised expression.
She was surprised that Gu Nan would actually attack her and also surprised at his rapid growth. It seemed that his breakthrough didn’t require accumulation at all. He had already reached this point in a few short months.
And…
“We’ve only fought once, but you actually saw through all my powers?”
Her several backup plans were completely sealed without even giving her a chance to use any of them, which made her feel frustrated and defeated.
How could she know that Gu Nan’s understanding of the law of “duality” exceeded her own? As long as he neutralized several basic laws, that was enough to negate most of her methods.
And locking other laws with one’s own power was also one of the characteristics of Domain Stage.
Gu Nan’s power of shadows had reached Level 3, so he finally gained this ability, which he immediately used to deal with Gu Nian.
“Did you really think that you can retreat fully unscathed after scheming me?” Gu Nan patted her face and said with a smile, “Even if I don’t mind, I still have to teach you a lesson.”
The next second, countless shadows poured into her mouth and swam around her body, dispersing her internal energy.
A grand Prodigious expert momentarily became an ordinary person. Because of the remaining shadows in her body, it was even hard for her to move.
Gu Nan picked up Gu Nian’s delicate body with one hand and threw her into the room.
“Enjoy it well, sister dearest.”
Note:
The actual chapter title is “Harmony,” which is euphemism for “Censored”

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Only lolis and lilies shall remain eternal
chapters.content:
The messy room, the half-naked girl, the enchanting blood-red crystals, and blood complemented each other. The girl was lying in this sea of red, with a dazed and ambiguous smile on her face.
This was the scene Gu Nian saw when she was thrown into the room.
Gu Nian only felt something explode in her mind. Shame, anger, reluctance, and countless other emotions poured into her heart simultaneously.
This was like a girl who pretended to be a good girl at home yet frequented bars everyday finding out that her father was the one who asked her out.
Even if her strength was overtaken by Gu Nan, it wasn’t like she couldn’t fight back. She had never felt so helpless as she did now.
A difference in strength could be made up for, but…
‘How did he know this?!’
She wanted to go out and ask, but when she looked back, she saw a piece of paper that slipped in through the gap in the door. On it were the names of girls she had come into contact with from childhood to now.
Without exception, they were all young girls aged 12 to 16.
The more she read, the further Gu Nian’s heart sank. Another list inexplicably flashed through her head—it was during the battle against the Long family. Gu Nan had circled Shi Miaoer’s on that list.
‘Did he begin to suspect me from that point on?’
……
“Young Master, Miss Bai is here.”
Next door, Gu Nan was playing with a white crystal. Lin Jun’s voice sounded outside the door.
“Come in,” Gu Nan’s voice contained some rare anticipation.
Bai Luoluo walked in suspiciously. She didn’t know why Gu Nan called her in the middle of the night.
Lin Jun, who followed her, had an odd expression. She could more or less guess what would happen next, so she didn’t want to stay and watch.
Gu Nan also finished adjusting the crystal at this time. The white crystal was an image projector, which projected an image onto the opposite wall—it was the scene inside Gu Nian’s room.
Lin Yunyun was lying on the big bed covered with red crystals, her face flushed with intoxication. The image of her trying to rub her body on the bed had a great visual impact.
“Ahhh! My eyes are going to fall out!” Bai Luoluo thought it was a bad image. She quickly covered her eyes and shouted.
Gu Nan smiled in spite of himself. “Don’t be in a hurry to cover your eyes. Look, don’t you recognize her?”
Hearing this, Bai Luoluo peeped suspiciously through her fingers and found a familiar figure.
“E-Eldest Martial Sister?”
……
Gu Nian had already walked to the bed, quietly staring at the girl in front of her. Her face had long since lost its calm expression. There was only an indescribably complicated feeling.
‘Since Gu Nan has already found out about this, I might as well… No, he definitely has another scheme! For example, he must be secretly recording right now… No, that’s not right. As long as that document is exposed, the results will still be the same…’
Gu Nian had never felt so conflicted before. Even when she discovered her strange hobby, she never hesitated as much as she did today.
No matter how immoral her actions were, it was no big deal if she did it behind closed doors, but it was another matter to be watched by someone else.
‘But… this little girl… really looks so charming!’
Based on Gu Nian’s experience of past relationships with countless women, the girl in front of her was at most 14 years old, and her addiction to drugs greatly stimulated Gu Nian.
Gu Nian tentatively touched Lin Yunyun’s face but found that her cheek was surprisingly hot.
“Is it red powder? No wonder…” Gu Nian touched some of the red crystals with her finger and immediately understood what had happened. “D**n that Gu Nan, he actually put this on my bed… Mmf!”
Perhaps because her actions woke Lin Yunyun, the girl suddenly sat up, hugged her, and began to crazily kiss the side of her face.
There was still blood flowing in her mouth, which dripped onto the bed, onto the surface of the red crystals, and onto Gu Nian’s chest, dyeing her white shirt red.
The faint smell of blood mixed in the air, and Gu Nian’s breathing became thicker and heavier.
Ever since Shi Miao’er died, she hadn’t been able to indulge herself for a long time. After all, she had no time to start on Bai Luoluo and didn’t have time to reincarnate again.
Most of Lin Yunyun’s clothes had already been torn off because of her wild movements. At this time, they slipped down with a gentle pull from Gu Nian, revealing Lin Yunyun’s pink body.
Gu Nian’s hand pressed on the girl’s waist, and her whole person began to press down on the girl.
……
In the next room, Bai Luoluo was already dumbfounded. She didn’t even know much about the affairs between men and women, let alone between women.
Lin Jun knew a little more, but as a goddess of Goddess Sect, she had never experienced it personally. At this time, she also blushed and wanted to escape, but she didn’t know how to speak up.
Only Gu Nan watched it calmly from beginning to end, with an interested smile on his face. There was no lust at all, as if he were appreciating a work of art.
“Should both justice and light eventually perish, only lilies
[1]
and lolis shall remain eternal,” Gu Nan nodded his head and repeated the famous proverb in the game.
Of course, it had been slightly modified by the players.
Bai Luoluo tugged on his sleeve. “W-What are they doing…”
She always thought it was something bad, but the strong curiosity in her heart drove her to keep watching, so she could only depend on Gu Nan to stop her with words.
Naturally, she expected too much.
Gu Nan smiled and said, “Of course they’re doing what everyone likes to do.”
Bai Luoluo tilted his head and wanted to ask again, but Lin Jun quickly stopped her— ‘Heaven knows what kinds of things Gu Nan will say if she keeps asking.’
In the video, the two women’s movements were becoming more and more intense.
As Gu Nian began to roll around on the bed, the red powder more or less entered her body as well, and the strong aphrodisiac began to take effect, gradually blurring Gu Nian’s consciousness.
“Do you know why your eldest martial sister helped you ascend?” Gu Nan suddenly asked.
Bai Luoluo was taken aback and shook her head in confusion. “Eldest Martial Sister treats me well…”
“Why would she treat you well?” Gu Nan smiled and answered his own question, “The answer is very simple. Maybe one day very soon, you will also be the person in that video.”
“You mean…” Bai Luoluo finally realized, and her face began to pale bit by bit.
She remembered that she was only 14 years old when she first met her eldest martial sister. At that time, Gu Nian took special care of her and sometimes even slept in the same bed with her.
‘Oh…’
When the past scenes floated through her mind, Bai Luoluo only felt goosebumps rise up, and the scene in the recording had also reached a climax.
There were no clothes on the bed anymore; only red and white were intertwined.
Although the crystal couldn’t transmit sounds, they could still hear loud moans from the next room over.
So Bai Luoluo’s cheeks also turned a little red, and even her body felt a little hot and dry.
A hand patted her shoulder. Bai Luoluo screamed with fear, then realized that it was Gu Nan’s hand.
Only then did she realize that from beginning to end, Gu Nan seemed to be watching quietly without any change in expression… She looked at Gu Nan suspiciously, and there were some bad associations in her mind.
‘Don’t they say that men get excited when they see a beautiful girl’s body?’
‘Don’t tell me he’s abnormal?!’
Bai Luoluo recalled Gu Nan’s previous behavior. No matter how she looked, he didn’t seem like a normal person. She couldn’t help nodding in her heart, agreeing with her own guess.
If Gu Nan knew her thoughts, he would’ve thrown her into the room without saying another word. Now, however, he just said with a smile, “You can’t tell your eldest martial sister about today’s events!”
“W-Why?” Bai Luoluo asked, although she really did want to pretend that nothing had happened.
“If she knows… Guess what she’ll do to you?”
Bai Luoluo thought for a while, didn’t speak, and hurriedly ran out of the room.
Note:
[1] Lilies:
Slang for lesbians

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Martial Arts Competition
chapters.content:
Her eyelids were heavy, but her head was very clear. Lin Yunyun even felt that her mind had never been more clear.
When she woke up from the big bed, of course nobody was beside her. The remaining red crystals were cleaned up, and the damaged furniture and items were restored to their original states.
Everything looked so natural, as if yesterday was just a dream.
But Lin Yunyun clearly remembered the indelible comfort in her body and that beautiful face.
“Who… is she?”
……
The person in Lin Yunyun’s thoughts was currently standing in front of Gu Nan with unmistakable anger on her face.
“Don’t you have anything to say?” Her voice shook slightly, as though she would explode any second.
Gu Nan raised his head, looked at her pretty face, and said with a smile, “Your figure’s not bad.”
Bam!
Gu Nian smashed the desk with a fist, breaking Gu Nan’s red cedar desk, and all the documents and materials fell. Only the tea cup Gu Nan took away in the nick of time survived.
“Youngster, don’t be so angry,” Gu Nan took a sip of tea with a smile and said leisurely.
Gu Nian gave him a death glare. She really wanted to punch him in the face, but… he was now Domain Stage.
His growth was too fast, which surpassed everyone’s imagination. The Gu family could no longer control him. If he wanted, he could even build a huge organization immediately from scratch.
Since Void Cutter Realm cultivators secluded themselves from the world in order to comprehend the origins of their innate abilities, Domain Stage experts were practically the peak of power in this world.
“Why did you have to… tell Luoluo about this!” Gu Nian took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing her anger, and asked through gritted teeth.
“Eh? But I told her not to tell you.” Gu Nan’s face was full of innocence.
Of course, with Bai Luoluo’s acting skills, it was only a matter of time before Gu Nian saw through her.
So Gu Nan followed up with, “As a powerful figure, no matter whether you like men or women; old or young—it’s all normal! Why repress your desires? Liberate yourself as much as you want, young girl!”
“It’s none of your business!” Gu Nian gave him a cold glare and left.
……
The repeatedly delayed Martial Arts Competition finally didn’t get pushed back yet again. It was held according to the time stated in the official announcements, which made the countless martial artists of Ruby Fish Star sigh in relief.
There were only 1,024 participants in the official matches, so the competition would merely last for three days.
On the first day, Lu Danze came to the stadium early. His senior martial brother Lu Wu, master Zhang Tao, and the people of Nebula Martial Arts Hall also accompanied him.
As the martial arts hall run by the Gu family, they were naturally given preferential treatment. They were led to the inner area by the staff early.
“Where’s Lin Yunyun?” Lu Danze looked around but didn’t see Lin Yunyun’s figure. He couldn’t help sneering, “She took the martial arts hall’s salary but didn’t even come. How shameless!”
Someone nearby remarked with a smile, “Senior Martial Brother Lu, the Gu family’s young master took a fancy to her. Why would she still care about the measly salary from us?”
Lu Danze also sneered. Back then, Gu Nan selecting Lin Yunyun after only a single glance made them have some unhealthy ideas about Gu Nan and Lin Yunyun’s relationship.
Gu Yang’s expression didn’t look very good. She reminded them, “Um… Lin Yunyun is already here. She’s over there.”
Lu Danze and the other person were stunned. Looking in the direction she pointed to, he found that Lin Yunyun was sitting in a daze at the back of the rest area, while Gu Nan was beside her.
“That’s the judges’ rest area, isn’t it? She’s just an Acquired Realm contestant. What right does she have to sit there?” Someone in the martial arts hall said angrily.
Although they also received preferential treatment themselves due to their connection to the Gu family, comparison was the source of envy. Lin Yunyun’s treatment made some people feel wronged.
“If you also have a pretty face and are willing to crawl over to the Young Master’s feet, then you can also sit there!” Someone answered somewhat explicitly, making several girls blush slightly.
“Everyone, shut up.” Zhang Tao scolded with a dark expression, “What kind of occasion is this? Is this a place where you can talk nonsense?”
“Okay…” The group of people suddenly stopped.
Lu Danze frowned and opened his mouth to speak, but Lu Wu placed a hand on his shoulder with a small shake of his head. Thus, Lu Danze could only angrily punch his own thigh and didn’t speak again.
While the people from Nebula Martial Arts Hall fell silent, a man and a woman slowly walked over.
“Hall Master Zhang?” A voice came from the side.
Zhang Tao turned his head in confusion and saw an energetic middle-aged man standing next to a young girl.
“Are you… Starry City’s Hall Master Lei?” Zhang Tao recognized the other party before long. For a moment, he felt flattered and quickly stood up straight to greet him.
Martial artists from the capital naturally weren’t the only ones participating in Ruby Fish Star’s Martial Arts Competition this time. People from over 30 cities on Ruby Fish Star were also participating.
Of course, be it the proportion of players or their average abilities, the capital still had an advantage.
But this didn’t affect Zhang Tao’s respect for Hall Master Lei. The reason was very simple—Lei Wuji was a Prodigious Realm cultivator, as well as one of the three vice leaders of the Martial Arts Alliance.
Although Nebula Martial Arts Hall wasn’t small, it couldn’t compare with Lei Wuji’s Extreme Thunder Martial Arts Hall.
Lei Wuji’s martial arts hall occupied the resources of an entire prefecture-level city. Both the quality of students and teachers far exceeded that of Nebula Martial Arts Hall. After all, the Gu family’s investment in Nebula Martial Arts Hall was limited.
When Zhang Tao turned his eyes to the silent girl’s face beside Lei Wuji, he couldn’t help smiling bitterly.
Lei Wuji grinned when he saw this. “Looks like Hall Master Zhang recognized my apprentice… Little Lan, why don’t you greet Hall Master Zhang?”
Only then did Li Lan take a step forward. With a standard smile on her face, she bowed and greeted, “Li Lan of Extreme Thunder Martial Arts Hall greets Hall Master Zhang.”
Li Lan was the first seed player Gu Nan disqualified when she was interviewing for Nebula Martial Arts Hall back then. Unexpectedly, she had joined Extreme Thunder Martial Arts Hall.
And it seemed like she was even being taught by Lei Wuji himself…
Behind Zhang Tao, the faces of everyone in Nebula Martial Arts Hall looked a little ugly.
She was good enough to be accepted as Lei Wuji’s disciple—can anyone still dare to say that her talent was subpar? But their Nebula Martial Arts Hall had precisely passed over such a talented seedling…
So, the number of resentful gazes cast in Gu Nan’s direction increased.
Zhang Tao’s face also looked a little awkward, but he was still a hall master. At this time, he could still keep a calm face. He knew that Lei Wuji definitely had a reason for approaching them.
Sure enough, Lei Wuji then opened his mouth, “I heard that my little apprentice intended to interview for your martial arts hall but was rejected?”
His words sounded like a direct slap to Zhang Tao’s face.
Zhang Tao also felt helpless. ‘This Lei Wuji really is as overbearing as the rumors claim…’
But what surprised him even more was that Lei Wuji then laughed. “Then I really must thank Hall Master Zhang. If you hadn’t gone blind, you wouldn’t have passed over such a good seedling to me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 99: One After Another
chapters.content:
Lei Wuji’s unbridled laughter attracted the attention of many people around him.
As an outstanding participant in the Acquired Realm group, many people recognized Li Lan. They immediately understood what happened when they recalled how Nebula Martial Arts Hall had rejected her earlier.
“Ha, who knows what Nebula Martial Arts Hall was thinking. They rejected Li Lan just like that.”
“Right? Now she’s been accepted as the apprentice to a Prodigious Realm master, thanks to them!”
“Speaking of which, didn’t Hall Master Lei say he won’t accept any more disciples?”
“Perhaps Li Lan’s talent was good enough to move him…”
The conversations came from all around them. Although the rest area was noisy, these voices were particularly harsh and kept drilling into the ears of everyone in Nebula Martial Arts Hall.
Lu Danze finally couldn’t stand it anymore. He suddenly stood up, pointed to Li Lan, and said, “It was Gu Nan who rejected you back then. If you have the ability, then look for him!”
“Lu Danze, what nonsense are you spewing?!” Zhang Tao suddenly turned around, his expression terrifyingly dark. He was so furious that he almost slapped Lu Danze.
Lu Danze had no more scruples after declaring that, so he continued, “Am I wrong? What does a young master like him know about martial arts hall recruitment? He recruited Lin Yunyun just to get a new mistress for himself!”
Lu Danze seemed to have caught an opportunity to finally vent his resentment.
He was a pure martial artist. He didn’t know the inside story of the Long family’s collapse, nor did he know much about Hu Wei’s power and status. He only knew that Gu Nan’s actions were completely like that of an amateur trying to interfere with professionals.
“Oh? Are you talking about me?” A flat voice came from behind him, sounding like he was asking a trivial matter like “Have you eaten yet?”
Zhang Tao froze. He quickly turned around to speak, but Lu Danze beat him to the punch, “That’s right! If you have the ability, then prove to me that you were right!”
He pointed to Lin Yunyun behind Gu Nan. “Prove that she really does have talent, and she wasn’t selected because of your selfishness. Don’t you agree, everyone?”
“Yes!”
Lu Danze’s last question was addressed to the people of Nebula Martial Arts Hall, and there was a burst of applause.
People nearby also spoke up. After all, most of the martial artists who were willing to come to the Martial Arts Competition hated people who abused their power and made under-the-table deals.
Lu Danze looked at Gu Nan provocatively, wanting to see how this young master would deal with this situation. ‘If I announce Gu Nan’s absurd story to the public, then even the Gu family will have to consider their moves carefully, right?’
Lei Wuji also watched the proceedings with great interest. He was very happy to see infighting among members of Nebula Martial Arts Hall.
However, nobody expected that Gu Nan didn’t speak at all. Instead, he landed a kick on Lu Danze’s knee.
Crack!
This kick looked slow, but its strength was extremely astonishing. Lu Danze’s right kneecap was instantly crushed, and his whole leg folded 90 degrees, bending at a horrifying angle.
“Ahh!!! You… Ahh!” Lu Danze exhaled in pain, but Gu Nan kicked again before he finished speaking.
In the blink of an eye, his left leg was also broken, and he fell onto his knees, but the way he knelt was frightening—his two lower legs were in front of his body.
“Young Master Nan!” Zhang Tao hurriedly stood in front of Lu Danze and begged, “Young Master Nan, Danze he…”
“Showing open contempt for a judge—he’s forbidden from participating in the Martial Arts Competition for life.” Gu Nan was expressionless as he calmly declared, as if the one who had just hurt someone seconds ago wasn’t him.
Zhang Tao suddenly looked dumbstruck.
Lu Danze felt he’d been struck by lightning. He didn’t even care about his leg injury anymore as he angrily pointed to Gu Nan and roared, “How can you do this?! What right do you have!?”
However, Gu Nan didn’t intend to continue speaking. He turned and left.
He didn’t need to explain himself to anyone. It was even more ridiculous for him to prove anything to Lu Danze.
If it wasn’t for the fact that he wanted the Martial Arts Competition to follow the predetermined process, he could even kill Lu Danze. What was there to prove?
“Sir, wait a minute!” At this time, Lei Wuji finally spoke up, “Sir, may I know what your identity is, to disqualify a contestant at will?”
He looked at Gu Nan’s back, and the smile on his face seemed certain of victory.
In Lei Wuji’s opinion, this young man really was too stupid—he openly angered the public… ‘Truly, he gave me the best ammunition to use against him.’
Although Lei Wuji was usually domineering, in reality, he was actually quite the meticulous person behind his rough exterior. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to run such a large martial arts hall.
Sure enough, his words immediately resonated with the countless people present. People kept voicing their agreement and demanding that Gu Nan give an explanation.
If he could disqualify Lu Danze this easily, then who’s to say that he won’t do the same to them in the future? Not to mention Gu Nan’s arrogance, which really infuriated people.
Gu Nan finally frowned, turning around again to walk towards them.
Lei Wuji’s smile became even more obvious. He wasn’t afraid of the other party biting back after being cornered. ‘After all, I have an absolute power advantage… Eh?’
Lei Wuji suddenly felt a pain in his abdomen. A black dagger had already embedded itself in his stomach. A strange yet majestic power constantly poured out, completely suppressing his own Prodigious Realm strength.
‘What’s happening? Is it because of this sword?’
Lei Wuji was a Prodigious Realm expert. When faced with a matter of life and death, he roared fiercely and countered with a backhand punch.
However, Gu Nan was even faster, punching him in the face. This Prodigious cultivator was immediately sent flying and fell straight into the crowd.
The power of shadows embedded in his abdomen was still madly destroying his vitality. Even if his life could be saved, his strength would suffer a huge decline.
The entire rest area fell silent. A Prodigious Realm master flew out with one punch from his opponent. This kind of scene was so unexpected that nobody had ever dreamed of it, and everyone instantly lost their voice.
Li Lan looked even more stupefied. She never thought that the master she regarded as the symbol of invincibility would be sent flying like a burlap sack…
More importantly, the culprit was this fellow!
Gu Nan’s move was too disruptive; seriously injuring Lei Wuji in the blink of an eye immediately attracted everyone’s attention. At once, several people stood up.
“Gu Nan! You’ve gone too far!” The one to stand up and accuse him was an old man with wrinkled face and gray hair. He was the leader of the Martial Arts Alliance and the respected elderly Hall Master Zhou Xuewen, who commanded great respect from all the martial arts halls.
Hall Master Zhou’s beard was trembling with anger. Lei Wuji could be regarded as his junior, but he had been seriously injured right in front of Zhou Xuewen’s face, and it was from a verbal disagreement!
Martial arts halls were special existences. They couldn’t compete with those big organizations, so it was even more vital for them to band together and stick up for each other.
He helped Lei Wuji up and was even more furious with Gu Nan’s heavy hand. “Is this how Gu Tianqi taught the younger generation?”
Zhou Xuewen had a very high seniority. Gu Tianqi was the Gu family’s Second Uncle.
The appearance of Hall Master Zhou gave everyone confidence. In the end, evil cannot prevail against good. Someone will always stand up and uphold justice!
At this time, a voice came from the door, “Well said, Hall Master Zhou!”
Everyone turned and saw a neat line of military officers standing there, all dressed in dark green uniforms.
The one who spoke up just now was precisely the young man standing in front of the military officers, while Hu Daobin stood beside the youth with a gloating smile on his face. It seemed that he wanted to see Gu Nan meet a bad end.
The young man said righteously, “Gu Nan, you are suspected of murdering three members of the Fan family. Come with us!”

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Those who object can die
chapters.content:
In the rest area, the young man in military uniform stood at the door with a sneer. He knew that no matter how powerful Gu Nan was, he’d have no choice but to concede defeat.
No one would dare to fight the military head-on.
Zhou Xuewen helped Lei Wuji up with an angry face.
On the other hand, Lu Danze was still on his knees, unable to get up. He could only shout, “Mr. Zhou, you must get justice for me!”
Zhou Xuewen nodded solemnly. “Rest assured. The Martial Arts Competition is such a serious matter. How can we allow him to act as he pleases?”
Lu Danze’s expression looked slightly better. Gu Nan’s merciless act of breaking both his legs made him hate Gu Nan completely.
‘Hmph! You’ve offended Hall Master Zhou this time. Let’s see how you handle this!’
Gu Nan’s calm gaze scanned the crowd, his face still expressionless.
From beginning to end, he never paid attention to these people. It’s like how there’ll always be monsters jumping out to stop you when you do a mission—that’s nothing special. If monsters jump out, just kill them.
So he clasped his right hand gently, and a shadow sword was already gripped in his hand.
The military youth’s face turned cold when he saw that Gu Nan really planned to fight. With a wave of his right hand, over a dozen machine guns were aimed at Gu Nan.
They were originally from the military and had nothing to do with the police—they were merely using the murdered family as an excuse to cause Gu Nan trouble.
“Major General Huang, please wait a minute!” Just as the two sides had their swords drawn, another voice called out, and a group of people reached the door.
This time, the newcomer was Gu Tianleng, one of the Gu family’s elders. He was the younger brother of Gu Nian’s grandfather.
Gu Mingyuan, Second Uncle Gu Tianqi, and the other Gu family members were focused on colonizing the newly-discovered plane, so the affairs of Star Realm were handed over to Gu Tianleng.
This elder was famous for his diplomacy ever since he was young. He was the best at dealing with diplomatic relations between all parties.
Sure enough, he gave the young man in military uniform a high hat with a respectful address as soon as he appeared, then said with an apologetic smile, “Our family’s Gu Nan is full of youthful vigor. Major General Huang, please don’t take it to heart. Let this old man talk to him first.”
Major General Huang disdainfully flattened his mouth and waved again to order everyone to put the guns away, silently agreeing to Gu Tianleng’s suggestion.
Over there, Zhou Xuewen snorted coldly. “There’s someone who wants to control the Martial Arts Competition. What’s there to explain?”
Zhou Xuewen’s status in the martial arts community was too high. Gu Tianleng quickly vowed, “Brother Zhou, please rest assured. After today, we won’t let Gu Nan interfere in the Martial Arts Competition anymore!”
Seeing his sincere attitude, Zhou Xuewen gave a cold snort and didn’t make a sound again as he continued to observe how Gu Tianleng would handle this.
After Gu Tianleng had calmed both sides after much difficulty, he finally looked at Gu Nan, but Gu Nan hadn’t even moved from his original position and was still holding a sword.
“Gu Nan! What are you still staring at?” Gu Tianleng’s expression was dark as he berated, “The Martial Arts Competition is a distinguished event for all the martial artists on this planet. It’s not something that can be changed by your whims! Return home and reflect upon your actions!”
Gu Nan didn’t reply; there weren’t any fluctuations in his gaze. When his eyes saw Gu Xingzhu standing behind Gu Tianleng, a faint smile appeared on his face.
The Gu family came so quickly. As expected, someone tipped them off…
It seemed that Gu Nian hadn’t told these people about his real strength. Otherwise, they wouldn’t be so stupid.
And the Gu family’s elders clearly didn’t understand what Gu Nan meant to them. They truly believed that he was just a guest hired by their family.
But this was entirely meaningless. Since when has Gu Nan ever cared about their lives?
“Since everyone is here, I’ll notify everyone at once,” Gu Nan started speaking as his eyes scanned the crowd, letting the shadow sword press against the ground.
“I’ll only say it once.” His voice was calm and cold. “How this Martial Arts Competition is run, as well as its time and location—is entirely up to me. Those who object can die.”
After his voice fell, the entire rest area fell silent. Everyone was shocked by Gu Nan’s ravings.
Gu Tianleng was the first to react. The veins on his forehead became visible as he roared, “What crazy things are you saying? You…”
Before he finished, a cold wind quickly reached him. The glint of a sword flashed past, too fast for the naked eye to see. Gu Tianleng’s entire person froze, as though someone had hit the pause button on a video tape; the scene looked very comical.
“Uncle…” Behind him, Gu Xingzhu looked up in bewilderment and realized that there was a thin bloody line on Gu Tianleng’s neck.
In the next moment, his head slipped off along the slanted line.
Gu Nan had killed him in a single strike!
“Gu Nan! W-What are you doing?” Gu Xingzhu’s hands trembled. She didn’t expect that Gu Nan would actually attack someone from the Gu family, and a fatal attack at that!
Gu Nan didn’t pay attention to her at all. His icy gaze shifted to Major General Huang.
Major General Huang suddenly felt cold and had an ominous feeling in his heart, but he still tried to calm himself down.
‘He won’t dare to attack me, or else he’ll be making an enemy out of Star Realm’s entire government. That’s simply looking for death!’
Major General Huang gritted his teeth and was still debating whether to say something. On the other side, Hall Master Zhou Xuewen was already furious and rushed towards Gu Nan.
“Openly killing and defying the law! Do you know what you’re doing?!” Zhou Xuewen glared at Gu Nan angrily. “Gu Tianleng was not only saving the Gu family, but also saving you!”
“Turn yourself in to the military immediately, or else the century-old Gu family will be destroyed by you!” When Zhou Xuewen saw Gu Nan standing still, he said coldly, “What? Do you still want to fight me?”
Gu Nan, who had been expressionless until now, almost laughed when he heard that last sentence.
Watching a humanoid monster jump up and down, and even say these strange words full of determination, was a little funny.
But laughter didn’t affect Gu Nan’s movements. The shadow sword in his hand slowly disappeared, but his palm was as fast as lightning as he directly slapped Zhou Xuewen’s face.
This honest slap to the face made Hall Master Zhou stumble, almost falling to the ground.
His old face was stunned and immediately turned red. He was in disbelief, both at Gu Nan’s incredibly fast movements and the fact that he even dared to attack.
‘This brat! Does he know who I am?!’
For a young martial artist like Gu Nan, a single sentence from Zhou Xuewen would be enough to ensure that no one on Ruby Fish Star would ever help him again!
Gu Xingzhu, who was beside them, was already speechless. Her mind was filled with thoughts of, “It’s over.”
If she had known that Gu Nan had this kind of temperament, she would never have brought the Gu family here!
After today, the Gu family would either have to sever all ties with Gu Nan or make an enemy out of all of Ruby Fish Star.
Hall Master Zhou was so infuriated that his hands trembled as he pointed at Gu Nan. “You…”
Slap!
Gu Nan gave another slap, which Hall Master Zhou also failed to dodge. This time he couldn’t speak anymore.
After years of living like a prince, he had long since regarded martial arts as a way to keep fit. In contrast, he had forgotten how to fight in battles of life and death.
But Gu Nan wouldn’t be polite to him. A grim smile appeared on his face.
This old man’s strength actually wasn’t bad. He was much better than Gu Tianleng. At the very least, he was already in the Infinitesimal Stage. It’s just that his vigor had declined a little due to age.
So Gu Nan gave up on using the shadow sword and decided to greet the other party with the punches that he was most adept at.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Kill
chapters.content:
After getting slapped twice in a row, Zhou Xuewen finally woke up, and his mind became clearer.
Anger had clouded his judgment just now. At the very least, Gu Tianleng was still in the Prodigious Realm.
‘But to think that he’d actually be killed in a single strike… And this young man is so fast that I didn’t even see him move.’
Hall Master Zhou’s heart sank slightly, but he was someone who had weathered storms before. At times like these, his bones grew harder.
Hall Master Zhou’s body began to emit blue light. This was his innate ability, which could resist attacks and even rebound damage.
He said coldly, “Gu Nan, I don’t care how talented you are, but you should know that one can’t go through the world using brute force alone…”
Bang!
Gu Nan suddenly punched him on the head. The blue shield blocked part of the punch’s strength, but Gu Nan’s terrifying power still made his head shake with dizziness.
Gu Nan gave another sneer, kicked him to the ground, then grabbed Zhou Xuewen’s calf with one hand and slammed him into the ground like a hammer.
Bang! Bang! Bang…
The dull sound of impact kept coming. Zhou Xuewen tried to resist at the start, but his head kept hitting the ground, quickly blurring his consciousness.
This was Gu Nan’s optimum response for handling opponents with an external shield.
Sharp weapons such as swords may not be effective. On the contrary, this kind of impact damage couldn’t be neutralized by the shield.
After hitting the ground dozens of times in a row, Zhou Xuewen’s head full of white hair was already full of blood. This Prodigious cultivator, whose strength was even comparable to that of the original Demon Lord, couldn’t even fight back in Gu Nan’s hands.
Gu Nan tossed Zhou Xuewen aside, then turned around with a cold smile and walked towards the door.
Major General Huang finally panicked. He quickly ordered the soldiers behind him, “S-Shoot him!”
Shooting in the city was against the law, but he didn’t have the time to worry about that. Right now, he could only hope that this scary fellow would die in the… ‘How is that possible?!’
Over a dozen high-energy laser beams shot out, but they dissipated completely before ever reaching Gu Nan.
Major General Huang stared at the scene in a daze. He finally realized that there was a shadow domain under Gu Nan’s feet. When the laser beams reached this territory, they immediately disappeared without a trace.
“This is… Domain Stage!” A knowledgeable person cried out in surprise. This effect could only be achieved through the territory created by a Domain Stage cultivator.
Hearing this, Major General Huang finally understood. He was a high-level officer in the army to begin with and only intervened to help Hu Wei, but who could’ve thought he’d meet such an abnormal monster here?
The second Domain Stage powerhouse on the entire planet!
No wonder killing Gu Tianleng was as easy as killing a chicken, and even Hall Master Zhou was slapped twice…
As the peak of power in this world, Gu Nan didn’t have to fear anyone!
Major General Huang turned and ran away. He knew that unless the Xu family’s old man came, no one else would be able to stop Gu Nan. He could only hope that the dozens of machine guns would stall the other party for even an instant so that he could escape…
As long as he fled into the military’s territory, which was protected by large-scale weapons of war, he would have some confidence of surviving.
However, as soon as he took two steps, the space in front of him darkened. Gu Nan was already standing before him, that calm and indifferent smile still on his face.
Major General Huang stuttered, “My uncle is the commander of a military district, you…”
Bang!
The next moment, his head had already burst.
Gu Nan calmly withdrew his hand and leaned aside in passing to avoid brain matter splashing onto him.
The death of Major General Huang silenced the entire area for a second, followed by a crazy roar from the soldiers. As soldiers, it was an insult to them for their commander to die right in front of them.
For these opponents who weren’t even in the Prodigious Realm, it was more efficient to kill them with swords.
So shadow swords appeared again, and fourteen soldiers were instantly decapitated.
Fourteen heads rolled down simultaneously, leaving only Hu Daobin—who hadn’t dared to rush up alongside the soldiers—standing in the same place. His legs trembled, and he looked pale.
He was truly afraid now. Even when his leg was broken right in front of his sister, he still didn’t believe that this person would dare to oppose the military!
“Y-Young Master Nan… My older sister is Hu Wei. She and Miss Gu are good friends!” He got smarter this time and decided to bring out Hu Wei’s friendship with Gu Nian at this critical time.
However… For the current Gu Nan, bringing out Gu Nian’s face really was useless.
“Thank you for your reminder.” Gu Nan smiled. “I’ll send your sister down to reunite with you in a little while.”
Hu Daobin was stunned when he heard that. Before he could reply, the shadow sword had already sliced his neck.
Another headless corpse slowly fell down. Gu Nan pulled out his sword and looked around. His gaze was still the same as before, but the effect was completely different now.
Everyone was glaring at him angrily before this, but now, no one dared to meet his gaze.
In all honesty, he killed people so ruthlessly and decisively that everyone became terrified.
In terms of blood relations, Gu Tianleng died; in terms of authority, Major General Huang also died; in terms of status, Hall Master Zhou Xuewen was still lying on the ground over there. Even if he could be saved, he’d probably still die soon.
Gu Nan just stood there, his expression unchanged. There wasn’t even a drop of blood on his shadow sword.
Seeing that no one dared to speak up anymore, he slowly walked back to the rest area and instructed Bai Luoluo, “Find someone to clean up this place. The Martial Arts Competition will proceed as usual.”
“Okay.” Bai Luoluo nodded. She was used to seeing blood in Immortal Demon World. This amount of slaughter was nothing to her.
‘It’s just that these people seem to have very powerful backgrounds… Will Gu Nan’s decisive killing lead to some kind of trouble?’
Gu Xingzhu watched Gu Nan pass by but couldn’t say a word. Her heart was heavy.
The fact that Gu Nan slaughtered many at the Martial Arts Competition couldn’t be hidden from the media and the public. This was different from the Gu family’s overnight encirclement and suppression of the Long family. This was simply slapping the government in the face.
If the government doesn’t come forward and respond, then it will have no prestige in the future.
‘And connecting all this with the identity of Major General Huang… I’m afraid that Ruby Fish Star, which has been calm for so many years, will attract countless eyes now.’
Gu Xingzhu’s heart was conflicted. She had no desire to speak with Gu Nan anymore and wanted to return home to report this shocking news to the Gu family as soon as possible.
‘The Gu family lost a Prodigious Realm elder for no reason, and Gu Nan is also such a troublemaker… It’s time to sever all ties with him!’
Gu Xingzhu believed this and felt that the Gu family would certainly agree with her.
While Bai Luoluo ordered people to clean up, she also tugged on Gu Nan’s sleeve and asked in a whisper, “Hey, if you do this, will someone look for our trouble later?”
Gu Nan waved his hand casually. “I’ll kill anyone who prevents me from holding the Martial Arts Competition.”
Gu Nan usually didn’t feel much about those NPCs, but during Evil Events, monsters who jumped out on their own to court death would, of course, only have one fate waiting for them—being killed off.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: The Gu Family’s Decisiveness
chapters.content:
Gu Nan’s wanton killing cast a shadow over the whole Martial Arts Competition. A large number of participants even withdrew in protest.
Regarding these people, Gu Nan was too lazy to care about them. Instead, their withdrawal was actually good for him—the original three-day competition was forcibly shortened to one day.
As far as Gu Nan was concerned, he only needed the Martial Arts Competition to be held. It didn’t matter who won, who lost, who became famous, and who suffered a blow to their reputation.
Based on Gu Nan’s experience, the vast majority of Evil Value in this event would involve Lin Yunyun, not the Martial Arts Competition itself.
Most of the Evil Events and missions in the game couldn’t be cleared by simply committing evil. Otherwise, players would be able to level up as long as they killed indiscriminately—how could it be that easy?
Either the mission objective was clearly given, as was the case with “Bai Luoluo’s Blackening,” or the player was allowed to freely explore and develop the storyline. However, there must still be a key condition.
To put it bluntly, a freeform event just meant that the mission objective was hidden.
Players can only get Evil Value through triggering the key condition. For example, Gu Nan recognized that Lin Yunyun was the key in this “Martial Arts Competition” event.
So he enticed Lin Yunyun to take drugs and sent her to Gu Nian’s bed…
“There’s a ruckus outside because of you, yet you’re still leisurely sipping tea here by yourself.”
A voice sounded beside Gu Nan, but he didn’t even lift his head. The visitor was Lu Zhanyu, who hadn’t appeared for a long time ever since they returned from Immortal Demon World.
Gu Nan yawned, a little bored. “I’ve only ever paid attention to the matters I have to do.”
“Didn’t you want to take full control of the Martial Arts Competition? But now that there’s no longer any opposition, it looks like you don’t care about it anymore?” Lu Zhanyu made herself at home, opening a chair and sitting down with a smile.
Gu Nan was too lazy to continue the conversation and just said bluntly, “If you have something to say, say it. If you don’t, then f**k off.”
It seemed that she already expected Gu Nan’s vulgarity. Lu Zhanyu reluctantly spread her hands. “Gu Nian told me to come… She says that after this matter, you’d better avoid the limelight for a while.”
Hearing this, Gu Nan couldn’t help glancing at her and curling his lips.
‘The fact that Gu Nian sent Lu Zhanyu over means that Gu Nian has already noticed the relationship between us… But she probably can’t guess how we met.’
Seeing that Gu Nan seemed to be unconcerned, Lu Zhanyu frowned. “You’ve killed a little too much this time… It’s not a big deal to kill Huang Qi—in any case, you’re a Domain Stage expert. However, killing Zhou Xuewen is very troublesome.”
Lu Zhanyu also came from a major family. The Lu family on Heavenly Enterprise Star was just a branch family; its main branch was actually in the distant Fourth Region, so Lu Zhanyu knew more about the twists and turns involved in interstellar politics.
While Huang Qi did have an uncle who was the commander of a military region, that uncle had countless nephews. He wouldn’t look for a Domain Stage expert’s trouble just for the sake of a dead nephew.
On the contrary, Zhou Xuewen had been running the martial arts hall all his life and had taught countless students. Who knows if there are several talented geniuses among his students?
These people only had one teacher, and Gu Nan even killed him when he was nearing retirement. This hatred must be avenged.
However, Gu Nan was still indifferent and said casually, “Wait till the Martial Arts Competition concludes. Then I’ll know where to go.”
Since it was a series of events, there must be new events after the Martial Arts Competition ends.
Lu Zhanyu frowned slightly. She heard the sound of footsteps at the door and had to shut up. After a flash, her figure disappeared completely.
“Young Master, the results of the Martial Arts Competition have come out,” Wang Dong reported respectfully, still in a black suit.
Gu Nan took the final result from him and asked with a light smile, “Why are you still here…? The Gu family still dares to work with me?”
Wang Dong’s expression remained unchanged, but he showed a meaningful smile. “Those old men may not dare to, but Eldest Miss dares.”
Gu Nan paused, then threw his head back and laughed.
“And here I thought she was wholeheartedly dedicated to the family. Turns out she’s the same as Lu Zhanyu. She’s not shy about screwing over her allies at all.”
……
At the same time, the Gu family’s hall was full of fierce quarreling.
The conflict between the two sides was nothing more than how to handle the Gu family’s relationship with Gu Nan going forward. This was a matter of life and death for the Gu family, so not only was the family’s seniors present, but some of the younger generation could also attend as non-voting delegates.
“Gu Nan is too domineering and will die sooner or later. If our family maintains close relations with him any longer, we will only encounter sudden and unexpected disasters!”
“He’s already a Domain Stage powerhouse. What can we do—fall out with him?”
“That’s right! Besides that person from the Xu family, no one else can restrain him. If he turns around and kills the Gu family, who can stop him?”
“Tianleng died in his hands. Are we just going to let that pass?”
“Then what do you want to do?”
The Gu family’s elders were divided into two groups, with neither side able to convince the other. Second Uncle Gu Tianqi sat in the main seat with a worried expression, feeling like a lot of his hair had turned white overnight.
He could be considered the true patriarch of the Gu family. Naturally, he knew that right now, the Gu family absolutely mustn’t fall out with Gu Nan, or else the Gu family would fall apart overnight.
No one could restrain someone like Gu Nan, who didn’t have any attachments but commanded power that was at the peak of this world.
‘But I also had the closest relationship with Gu Tianleng… Why did this b*****d advance to Domain Stage?’
If Gu Nan was only at the Infinitesimal Stage, perhaps the Gu family would’ve mobilized a long time ago and besieged him till he died. But after seeing Zhou Xuewen’s end, no one dared to attack him anymore.
The group of people gradually quieted down, because both sides realized that they couldn’t convince each other at all. It was better to let Gu Tianqi make a decision.
“Second Brother, you decide!”
“Yes, Second Brother, no matter how you decide to deal with it, we will support you!”
Gu Tianqi was silent for a long time. Eventually, he sighed. “Gu Nian, what do you think?”
Half of the people’s eyes dimmed, while the other half became smug. Everyone knew that Gu Nan was brought in by Gu Nian. Would her opinion even be a surprise?
The fact that Gu Tianqi chose to ask her opinion already made his own attitude clear.
There was no expression on Gu Nian’s face. She calmly spoke, “Regarding Gu Nan…”
“Wait a minute!” A crisp voice suddenly shouted, interrupting Gu Nian. A girl walked in slowly with a report in her hand.
“Xingzhu? What are you doing here…” An elder frowned.
The newcomer was precisely Gu Xingzhu. At this time, she looked full of confidence. She leisurely saluted and replied, “Grandpa, I just received the news that Zhou Xuewen is heavily injured and will die soon. The Seven Stars Team has heard the news and is rushing back to the Ninth Region right now.”
“Seven Stars Team?” The elder’s expression shook, and his gaze suddenly became solemn.
He was no stranger to the name “Seven Stars Team.” It was a team composed of seven Infinitesimal Stage experts who specialized in hunting and killing Domain Stage beasts throughout the universe.
They also originated from the Ninth Region, but the team’s current status and position was so many levels higher than the Gu family.
More importantly, of the seven team members, five were Zhou Xuewen’s direct disciples…
With this, Gu Nian no longer needed to speak anymore. Even Gu Tianqi turned his eyes to this side. Gu Xingzhu had a feeling of elation, and even her spirit radiated delight.
The current Gu Xingzhu resembled her younger self slightly. None of them had seen such a spirited and confident Gu Xingzhu, not since Gu Nian advanced to Prodigious Realm.
The elders seemed to have realized something. This girl was at odds with Gu Nian at the beginning, yet she seemed to have fully devoted herself to Gu Nian recently. However, deep in her bones, she likely still harbored the ambition to surpass Gu Nian.
Gu Xingzhu distributed the reports in her hand. When she passed one to Gu Nian, she deliberately paused slightly and showed a bright smile.
And Gu Nian just gave her a light glance, her mouth curling into a faint smile.
“It’s indeed the Seven Stars Team… They’re certainly strong, but will they be able to kill Gu Nan completely?” An elder asked this question.
If Gu Nan was allowed to escape with his life, the consequences would be unimaginable.
Gu Xingzhu seemed like she was already prepared for this question. She answered in her uniquely clear voice, “It’s the Seven Stars Team that wants to find Gu Nan. We don’t have to greet them ourselves… At the end of the intelligence report, I’ve already suggested a suitable candidate for this.”
The elders quickly flipped the report to the last page, and sure enough, information on another person was attached—
Lu Danze.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Orphan
chapters.content:
“The champion of the Innate Realm category: Lu Wu. The champion of the Acquired Realm category: Lin Yunyun. They’re all familiar faces!” Gu Nan looked at the results of the Martial Arts Competition in his hand and commented.
After Gu Nan’s meddling, fewer people were now following the Martial Arts Competition, which originally attracted much attention.
It was because too many people died or were injured that day, and they all came from powerful backgrounds. In addition, over half of the participants withdrew from the competition, so even if someone won the championship, it still didn’t mean much. Naturally, no one cared to follow such an event anymore.
“Young Master, will you personally present the awards?” Wang Dong asked cautiously.
Gu Nan was first appointed as a judge by Gu Nian. However, he was lazy and didn’t even attend a single match, hiding here to sip tea alone.
Anyhow, the Evil Event’s key condition was completed, so the result of the competition had nothing to do with Gu Nan anymore.
“Just find a random person to do it.” Gu Nan waved his hand.
“Yes.” Wang Dong nodded, but then he seemed to think of something. He hurriedly said, “By the way… Someone reported that Lin Yunyun used stimulant drugs during the match.”
“Of course she used them! Or else she wouldn’t even be able to fight any of her matches.” Gu Nan said impatiently, “Just kill anyone who objects.”
There was no doubt that Lin Yunyun had to take drugs before fighting a match. She must rely on this to relieve the pain, otherwise she wouldn’t be able to fight at all.
Gu Nan had to take the Evil Event into account before and couldn’t kill any participants. However, the event was about to conclude right now—he didn’t have to worry as much anymore.
“Understood.” Wang Dong nodded repeatedly. “I’ll have someone handle that immediately.”
……
After Wang Dong left, Lu Zhanyu appeared again.
Gu Nan asked with a surprised expression, “You still haven’t left?”
Lu Zhanyu rolled her eyes. With Gu Nan’s current cultivation, there was no way that he didn’t sense her presence. He was clearly trying to drive her away…
“There is someone—if he inadvertently offends you in the future, please spare his life,” Lu Zhanyu said quickly.
“Oh?” Gu Nan raised his eyebrows.
“He is our family’s younger cousin…”
“What makes you think I’ll listen to you?” Gu Nan raised his head slightly and smiled. “You have a grudge against this Lu Wu, don’t you? You want to use me to kill him?”
Faced with three counter questions, any words Lu Zhanyu still wanted to say were immediately swallowed, and her face twitched a little.
‘This fellow’s paranoia is really… Does he consider everything from the opposite direction first?’
In reality, Lu Zhanyu really misunderstood Gu Nan. It wasn’t that he considered things comprehensively; he was simply used to guessing at other people’s intentions with the greatest malice.
Lu Zhanyu, who wanted to scheme a little but ran into a wall in one second, could only leave without another word.
After Gu Nan sat still for a while, the Evil God Temple in his head shook slightly.
｢Evil Event completed: Martial Arts Competition. Total Evil Value earned: 10｣
The Martial Arts Competition officially concluded, so the Evil Value reward was also paid to his account. The reward this time wasn’t out of Gu Nan’s expectations.
The difficulty of this event was neither high nor low.
The Martial Arts Competition only had a location and time limit. Everything else could be controlled by the player, which reduced its difficulty level.
However, he also had to search for the key figure in this event, and a Prodigious expert like Gu Nian also participated, so the difficulty wasn’t low either. After an overall evaluation, he got 10 Evil Value.
In the next second, a notification regarding a new event notification appeared in the Evil God Temple.
｢Evil Event triggered: Adopt the orphan Lin Yunyun｣
“Lin Yunyun? Orphan?” Gu Nan raised his eyebrows slightly and shouted at the door, “Old Wang!”
Wang Dong hurriedly rushed in again, only to hear Gu Nan say, “Lin Yunyun’s family still has a deadbeat dad, right? Find someone to hit him with a car.”
Wang Dong didn’t say much this time and merely agreed. Lin Yunyun’s family was very poor. Killing an ordinary civilian was nothing to the Gu family.
“Young Master, Lin Yunyun also has an older sister…”
“Older Sister? How old?” Gu Nan asked after some thought.
“Seventeen.”
“Oh, then kill her in the car crash as well. Too old.”
……
In the white hospital, Lu Danze sat on the bed with an ashen face, an injury identification report in his hand.
The report said: “Fractured kneecap, unable to neutralize high-energy injury. Chance of recovery: low.”
With Ruby Fish Star’s medical technology, injuries like broken legs or fractured kneecaps were nothing. However, the power of shadows left behind by Gu Nan was resistant to many powers, which rendered most medical methods ineffective.
Thus, Lu Danze likely wouldn’t be able to stand up anymore, becoming a cripple.
“Son of a b***h!”
Lu Danze punched the bedding hard, crumpling the paper report, but he still couldn’t vent his anger.
To fall from a martial arts genius who might advance to Prodigious Realm to a cripple with broken legs only because of two kicks from that person…
“Why?! Why is that kind of scum Prodigious Realm? Is there still any justice left in this world?” Lu Danze clenched his fists with bloodshot eyes.
Just as he sat alone in the ward and roared wildly, a voice came from the side. “We can give you justice, but the question is, what can you pay in exchange?”
Lu Danze suddenly looked up and saw seven people standing in a row at the door of his ward. The first person was easily recognizable, because he actually had three hands.
……
No matter who died, the world would still continue on. Gu Nan’s killing was enough to shake the entire Ruby Fish Star’s upper society, but for ordinary people, this just meant that this year’s Martial Arts Competition was shorter.
After the Martial Arts Competition concluded, the military was silent. It was said that after Hu Wei heard the news, she left Ruby Fish Star overnight. Nobody knew where she went.
Zhou Xuewen was sent to the hospital as soon as possible, but because his injuries were too serious and because of his old age, he died after struggling for three days.
The Gu family made no comment on this. They neither broke with Gu Nan nor stood up for him. It was as if they had become a mere spectator.
However, Zhou Xuewen had great influence in all sectors of society, especially in the martial arts and Daoist circles. Many of his disciples spontaneously organized themselves, publicly demanding that Gu Nan be punished.
Some of them marched on the streets, some blocked the door of the Gu family, and others ran to the Xu family to ask the Xu family’s old man to “carry out justice on Heaven’s behalf.”
Naturally, this was useless. Politicians dealt with the protestors, and the Gu family and the Xu family would never pay attention to these people.
As for why no one went to Gu Nan directly… Firstly, no one was willing to court death, and secondly, there were too few people who knew him—Gu Nan’s whereabouts were a mystery, and he was difficult to track.
But today was different, because Gu Nan finally appeared at a more public location.
[Capital Adoption Agency]
Lu Danze sat in a wheelchair on top of a tall building nearby, nervously watching the adoption agency downstairs. Beside him stood a blue-haired girl in fashionable clothes.
“That’s him, no doubt about it!” Seeing Gu Nan’s figure, Lu Danze quickly opened his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Projectile
chapters.content:
“You mean, that Gu Nan ran to the adoption center just to adopt an orphan?” The blue-haired girl looked at Lu Danze with suspicious eyes, her face full of disbelief.
Based on the intelligence they gathered, Gu Nan was clearly a vicious and merciless murderer who killed without blinking an eye, yet he actually ran here to adopt an orphan?
Even when the other party appeared right in front of her eyes, the blue-haired girl still didn’t believe it.
If she wasn’t already aware of the grudge between Lu Danze and Gu Nan, she would even suspect that he colluded with Gu Nan to set a trap for her team.
“That’s definitely him!” Lu Danze said eagerly, “Gu Yang told me the news. This is the best chance we’ll get in a while. Who knows how long we’ll have to wait if we miss this opportunity!”
The girl furrowed her brows. Finally, she raised her hand to press an insignia on her chest.
At the same time, the corresponding insignias on the chests of the six people near the adoption center all lit up—this was their team’s unique communication method.
The meaning was… ‘Attack.’
……
Inside the adoption center, Ms. Zhang, the director, smiled bitterly as she reluctantly handed over a contract to Gu Nan, still trying to persuade him.
“Mr. Gu, according to the regulations, your age doesn’t meet the requirements to adopt someone…”
“Talk to Old Wang if you have a problem.” Gu Nan grabbed the contract, signed his name at lightning speed, and asked casually, “I can take her away now, right?”
Ms. Zhang looked at Lin Yunyun. The 13-year-old girl had an icy expression, but upon careful inspection, there was some hatred in the depths of her eyes.
In just a few short days, she had experienced all the misfortunes she could think of.
Her father and older sister had an accident and died before they could even be sent to the hospital. Her real age was exposed, and her Martial Arts Competition championship was revoked, so of course she wouldn’t get the bonus money.
To make things worse, the rumors that she took drugs made Lin Yunyun fall from a high-profile young genius to a street rat despised by everyone almost overnight.
Then she was immediately sent to the adoption center because of her age, and this man who wanted to adopt her quickly appeared.
Lin Yunyun wasn’t stupid. Of course she knew who had the power to make this series of events possible.
Ms. Zhang could only sigh in her heart as she stared at Lin Yunyun. She didn’t know what exactly had happened, but she’d nevertheless heard of these young masters’ styles.
‘He’s clearly a youth himself, yet he ran here to adopt a little girl… Isn’t his intention obvious?’
But in the end, he was still the young master of the Gu family. Ms. Zhang could only force back her disgust and finish up the adoption formalities for Gu Nan.
……
On the grass outside the adoption center, a dozen children were running around and playing, with occasional bursts of laughter.
The blue-haired girl pushed Lu Danze’s wheelchair as they slowly made their way over. She smiled at the children. “Children, this place will be dangerous soon. Everyone, be good and go back!”
As she spoke, a gentle force had wrapped around the boys and girls, lifting them up and placing them back inside the building.
After dealing with the children in the adoption center, she looked at Lu Danze. “I can’t guarantee your safety when we’re trying to kill a Domain Stage expert. Are you sure you want to watch?”
“Yes.” Contrary to expectations, Lu Danze was calmer now. He said in a firm tone, “My life has already been crippled. Why would I fear death? Right now, I just want to see what will happen to Gu Nan!”
Perhaps because she was touched by Lu Danze’s emotions, the girl named Lan Bing was silent for a while.
Then she nodded her head solemnly. “Rest assured. Karmic retribution won’t be lenient. Gu Nan has committed many atrocities. Even without us, he’ll die a violent death sooner or later.”
Lan Bing continued, “But if everything goes according to plan, he will continuously be caught up in fatal attacks, all the way until he dies completely… He’s here!”
As Lan Bing’s voice fell, the door was indeed pushed open. Gu Nan held Lin Yunyun’s small hand and walked slowly out of the adoption center.
“Why are you guys doing this?” Lin Yunyun asked with her head lowered. Bone-cutting indifference could be heard from her voice.
Gu Nan shrugged and answered, “Gu Nian told me to do it… She’s the person who slept with you that night. Do you remember her?”
Gu Nan’s expression didn’t even change as he casually threw all the blame onto Gu Nian. Lin Yunyun was clearly the key figure in this event. He might even need her cooperation later on, so it was better to not draw her hatred for the time being.
Lin Yunyun’s face darkened a little upon hearing this, then she nodded hard.
She never doubted Gu Nan’s words. No matter how she thought about it, Gu Nan had no incentive to treat her like this. On the contrary, that night…
It was more likely that a powerful figure like Gu Nian took a fancy to her and wanted Lin Yunyun to become her exclusive property.
The two walked for a while. Even when they were about to exit the adoption center, the Evil God Temple in Gu Nan’s head still didn’t issue an event completion notice, which confused him a little.
The “adoption” event wasn’t difficult. Normally, this event should’ve been judged as completed by now.
‘Could it be…’
Before he could finish that thought, a dark shadow flew in front of him. It was a delicate and small golden projectile aimed straight at his heart.
Its speed was unimaginable. Even Gu Nan couldn’t respond in time, taking a direct hit.
Lan Bing sneered, “Fourth Brother’s innate ability—Sure Hit. As long as the level of the enemy’s innate ability doesn’t exceed his by a large margin, the enemy won’t be able to dodge at all.”
Gu Nan, who was like an invincible God of War back then, had now taken a direct hit as soon as the fight started. Lu Danze’s eyes brightened, as though he finally saw hope.
But he was still a little puzzled. “Isn’t he at Domain Stage? Why hasn’t the projectile been blocked by his domain?”
“You don’t understand.” Lan Bing explained, “We’re hunted at least five Domain Stage experts… Using a domain’s power places a great strain on martial artists. How can they constantly keep it activated?”
“So that’s it!” Lu Danze couldn’t help looking excited.
“It’s not just that.” Lan Bing added, “Fourth Brother’s darts have paralytic toxins. Even Prodigious Realm beasts will be parallyzed for a moment… It’s even possible to capture him alive now.”
While saying that, she shook her head slightly.
As the brains of the team, she also prepared many contingency plans for this enemy, but who would’ve imagined that Gu Nan would be so useless and be captured with a single projectile from Fourth Brother?
In the end, Gu Nan was still someone who came from a backwater place like Ruby Fish Star. His horizons couldn’t compare with that of her experienced and knowledgeable team.
At the same time that the dart hit Gu Nan, a figure also arrived swiftly in front of him. It was the fourth member of the Seven Stars Team—a young man in casual clothes but wearing a strange crown. His appearance looked extremely mismatched.
He stood in front of Gu Nan and looked at the projectile, which had sunk three inches into Gu Nan’s chest. He couldn’t help sneering, “Someone like you attacked Teacher Zhou? Today, I’ll make you… Eh?”
Fourth Brother suddenly stopped mid-sentence, starting at the front with widened eyes.
He saw Gu Nan slowly raise a hand and pull out the projectile from his chest, casually tossing it to the ground.
Then, under Fourth Brother’s dumbfounded gaze, the wound quickly healed, and even the dark golden toxin was quickly expelled, slowly flowing down Gu Nan’s robe.
Hr raised his head with difficulty and saw a grim smile slowly appear on Gu Nan’s formerly expressionless face.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: New Weapon——Blade of the Sanguine King
chapters.content:
Outside the adoption center, the fourth member of the Seven Stars Team stood in stunned silence.
He didn’t understand how someone could still move freely even after being hit by his projectile. ‘Don’t tell me that this person’s physique is even stronger than that of the beasts in the endless void?’
This doubt didn’t stay for long. An ominous feeling emerged in his heart when he saw that smile on Gu Nan’s face.
The next second, he felt a sharp pain in his abdomen, and his entire person flew backwards and fell heavily to the ground, where he coughed up blood wildly, alarm bells going off in his head.
“Still not dead? Must be Infinitesimal Stage…” Gu Nan’s fleeting voice traveled into his ears.
He tried to get up but only felt a gale reaching his face. He barely managed to tilt his head to one side.
Gu Nan reappeared, the Dragon Heart Pendant on his chest still shining slightly.
His punch, which was infused with Dragon Power, hit the left side of his opponent’s face and actually tore off a portion of his face!
