Both skin and flesh had been torn off by the strong force, revealing countless pulsing blood vessels and broken facial bones.
Without the support of the eye socket, the eyeball naturally fell down, suspended by a few optic nerves that were still connected.
“Fourth Brother!”
“Fourth Brother…”
Sorrowful cries came, and several figures instantly appeared around Four Brother, fury and grief apparent on their faces.
Originally, the team members were scattered around, ready to intercept if Gu Nan started using his innate ability, but who could’ve thought…
Lan Bing was also among them. At this time, her face had long lost its previous indifference and she roared angrily, “Kill! Kill him! What bullshit strategy! Everyone, attack!”
The burly man with three hands rushed up first with a strange cry, “Ahh! I’ll start!”
His figure was four times the size of an ordinary person. In addition to the normal four limbs, a huge hand also grew from his back, which looked particularly frightening.
This burly man was Han Lingtian, the second member of the Seven Stars Team. He was gifted with tremendous strength ever since birth and had a frank temperament. He excelled at killing his opponents with brute force.
He was also one of Zhou Xuewen’s disciples. He didn’t know martial arts when he was young and was often bullied in his hometown. Later, the speed of his growth spiraled out of control once he embarked on the road of cultivation.
He had just stepped into the Infinitesimal Stage, but he was one of the most powerful team members.
At this time, he leapt up high, his three arms spreading out as they simultaneously attacked Gu Nan from three different directions.
However, Gu Nan still had a cold expression and raised his fist to punch forward without hesitation. His target was Han Lingtian’s face—Gu Nan actually ignored the other party’s attacks and wanted to trade injury for injury with the enemy!
Han Lingtian was quite a meticulous planner underneath his rough exterior. Even though he was extremely furious in his heart, his hand movements were unbelievably precise.
A punch to the face, a punch to the neck, and a punch to the heart.
He was certain that as long as his three punches landed, even a giant beast would suffer a serious injury.
‘This person actually dares to fight me head-on; I must teach him a lesson!’
Bam! Bam! Bam! Bam!
Both sides’ fists hit each other almost simultaneously, but the result was beyond everyone’s expectation—Gu Nan still hadn’t moved from his original position, while Han Lingtian was blown back, smashing into a nearby building.
“Second Brother, are you okay?”
Lan Bing hurried to check again, but Han Lingtian walked out of the rubble with bloodshot eyes, a hand covering his nose. He said with difficulty, “He is… very strong.”
Lan Bing’s anger deepened. “We underestimated him… But no matter how strong he is, he will die here today!”
“That’s right!”
“Boss, let’s attack him together!” The rest of the Seven Stars Team finally stabilized Four Brother’s injury and declared at the same time.
Leaving aside the excitement here for a moment, Gu Nan, on the other side, frowned and touched his face. He already had a strong physique to begin with. Combined with the passive effect of “reducing damage by 50%” from the Resistance skill, he couldn’t even be considered injured.
Furthermore, because of the Resistance skill’s effect, most of his sense of pain was blocked, so he didn’t feel it at all.
It’s just…
“My attack is too low!” Gu Nan shook his head.
He already felt this a little when killing Zhou Xuewen earlier—he felt that he had been paying too much attention to survival abilities. Consequently, his attack power began to fall behind.
It was no problem to choose the Resistance skill; the critical problem was that his weapon—the Four Elements Crossbow he used when he was Tier 2—could no longer keep up with the times.
So his consciousness began to sink into the Evil God Temple. He opened the equipment exchange list and selected a weapon.
He’d wanted to buy this weapon for a long time, and it also matched his attributes quite well. It’s just that he hadn’t encountered the problem of insufficient attack before this, so he never bought it until now.
After all… It was too expensive.
>｢Buy weapon: Blade of the Sanguine King. 500 points will be paid. Confirm?｣
>｢Confirm｣
Gu Nan clicked the confirm button with much heartache. After deducting 500 points, he only had 100 points left.
The Blade of the Sanguine King was also called the “Blood Blade” by the players. It was a genuine Tier 3 weapon, in every meaning of the phrase. Only Tier 3 evil gods could buy it. Be it price or attack power, it far exceeded that of the Four Elements Crossbow.
The Blood Blade’s attributes are very simple, and its effects are very clear, that is—extremely high damage!
｢Blade of the Sanguine King: High attack. Ignores external defense. Enhanced sharpness. Triggers the effect “Curse of Blood” on hit｣
There was also a line of small words after that–
｢This is a cursed divine weapon. Whenever your attack hits your opponent, you will take equal damage｣
100% ignore external defense, enhanced sharpness, and the Blood Blade’s high innate attack made the true value of this weapon far exceed its price.
So the game designer very considerately added a debuff to it. That is, it hurts both the enemy and the user.
Any player who attacks with this weapon will receive damage equal to the injury they inflicted upon the enemy, which greatly reduces the weapon’s overall utility.
However, the wisdom of players is infinite. They quickly found complementary attributes from other equipment and skills.
For example, Gu Nan had the effects of Resistance and Praise of Dawn. Not only could he reduce injuries by 50%, but the effectiveness of his self-regeneration was tripled!
‘Come, let’s trade injuries!’
……
Outside the adoption center, Lin Yunyun saw Gu Nan stare blankly into space for a moment, his gaze slack. Just when she was debating whether to speak up, she saw him come back to himself.
At the same time, he raised his right hand and actually produced a long blade out of thin air.
The whole body of this blade was blood red. The body of the blade was slender, emitting a faint yet crimson brilliance. It looked very enchanting.
Gu Nan had never used the Blood Blade in his previous life. This was the first time he held it in his hand. It had to be said that it felt quite good. Faint but bloodthirsty thoughts also entered his head.
“Then… Let’s start killing.” Gu Nan looked at the Seven Stars Team in the distance. His originally calm eyes gradually became a little crazy.
“Let’s go!” Lan Bing shouted in a hoarse voice as she placed Fourth Brother to the side and glared coldly at Gu Nan.
“Ahh!”
As soon as Han Lingtian wiped his nose, he rushed forward again with a strange cry—even when hunting giant beasts, he still assumed the role of a tank. Their little team has always had a clear division of labor.
The enemy this time was indeed powerful, but their Seven Stars Team wasn’t to be messed with either!
In Han Lingtian’s mind, he seemed to have returned to that golden age when their seven brothers and sisters traversed the stars and hunted one fierce beast after another. That was a magnificent period…
‘Huh? Why am I flying?’
In Han Lingtian’s vision, he seemed to be flying, and his sight was still flying up and down, even spinning around.
But in other people’s eyes, Gu Nan had nimbly approached him and swung the blade at his head.
Severing it in one strike!

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Taking a Life with Each Strike
chapters.content:
Gu Nan held a long, bloody blade in his hand. Blood gushed from the decapitated corpse and dyed half of his body red. He resembled a demon who walked out of the abyss.
After beheading the enemy in one strike, the Blood Blade pulsed with a crimson glow. Gu Nan felt his neck grow slightly cold, and one-half of his neck was also sliced through!
The effect of Curse of Blood had activated, and equal damage had fallen onto Gu Nan as well.
However, Gu Nan had the Resistance skill, which halved the damage and even shielded him from most of the pain, so the curse had no impact at all.
He pressed his left hand against his head, keeping it from sliding off and adjusting it back to an upright position. At the same time, the cut was rapidly healing, the muscle tissue was continuously regenerating, and the skin was also regrowing itself.
Why are the Blood Blade and the Dawn Sage’s Robe complementary equipment?
The reason was very simple. The effect of Praise of Dawn meant it would only take effect if the player didn’t receive any attack for three seconds, yet damage from Curse of Blood was judged as self-injury, not attack!
And the Resistance skill halved all damage no matter the source, so the three effects fit perfectly.
The remaining members of the Seven Stars Team were about to attack Gu Nan all at once, but after watching helplessly as Han Lingtian was beheaded in a strike, they froze on the spot for a while.
Han Lingtian died on the spot, while Gu Nan walked towards the remaining members step by step, one hand carrying the Blood Blade and the other hand pressing against his head to keep it in place.
As he walked, the wound on his neck was still bleeding, so the whole scene looked extremely creepy.
Gu Nan’s pace seemed both slow and fast. In the blink of an eye, he had reached an enemy.
This person was the youngest in the team. He was a genius worthy of his name. At this time, he was already prepared. He immediately unsheathed the longsword at his waist and rushed forward..
“Kill!” The young man shouted angrily, “Remember, the one who’ll kill you is called…”
Swish!
Gu Nan made a diagonal slash, cutting both the young man and his sword from the right shoulder to the waist—the youth’s words stopped abruptly without ever getting to say his name.
Simultaneously, a gash also appeared on Gu Nan’s right shoulder, but this time, it was far less serious than the injury on his neck; it was merely a bloodstain.
The youth’s physique and defense were far inferior to Han Lingtian’s, so the equivalent damage was far lower this time.
Under the effect of Praise of Dawn, the bloodstain didn’t even have time to spread before it started healing, disappearing in an instant.
Lan Bing’s scalp felt numb, but as the commander of the Seven Stars Team, she still calmed herself down.
“Everybody calm down!” She glared fixedly at Gu Nan with beautiful eyes. “That blade of his isn’t normal, but as long as we can avoid it…”
Before her voice fell, she felt a chill from above her head, so she subconsciously activated her innate ability, disappearing instantly and turning into a cloud of mist that floated to the side and finally reformed into a human shape.
When she reappeared, Lan Bing’s forehead was covered in cold sweat. She had traversed the sea of stars for over ten years and encountered many life and death situations, but she had never seen such a chilling scene before…
“Turning into mist? Interesting.” Gu Nan’s voice suddenly echoed from both nearby and afar, as if coming from all directions.
Lan Bing pressed down the fear in her heart. She was about to speak but realized that her surroundings were too quiet.
She turned suddenly and discovered an astonishing fact.
The rest of her teammates, including Fourth Brother, who had half of his face torn off, had all been bisected. None survived.
Only then did Lan Bing realize that Gu Nan had made six swings simultaneously just now. Taking advantage of his incredible speed, he struck six people at the same time.
‘If not for my special innate ability, which allows me to turn into mist and ignore attacks from swords or blades, then I’m afraid I would’ve also become one of the souls reaped by his blade.’
Her anger at seeing her companions wantonly slaughtered and the instinctive fear in the face of death surged into Lan Bing’s heart simultaneously, delaying her hand movement for a second.
Gu Nan’s blade fell again.
However, just when the blade was about to touch Lan Bing, something strange happened.
The space above Lan Bing seemed to be pulled apart, layer by layer. When the Blood Blade entered this odd space, it was just like entering the endless void. The strike couldn’t land on Lan Bing.
Lan Bing was surprised. She quickly turned herself into mist again and dodged to the side.
“Space,” Gu Nan’s face was a little grave as he murmured. The law of space had an extremely high rank, and the person who secretly made a move just now was also quite good.
Lan Bing also realized what had happened. A look of pleasant surprise appeared on her face. “Elder Xu, thank you for saving me!”
As if to echo Lan Bing’s words, a figure slowly appeared behind her. It was an ordinary old man in a normal gray shirt.
If you put him on the street, 90% of people would probably overlook him. However, he was a genuine powerhouse, both in Ruby Fish Star and in the Ninth Region.
He was the pillar of the Xu family, the only Domain Stage cultivator on Ruby Fish Star—Xu Yuanjun, or Elder Xu.
This Elder Xu first became famous when the Xu family had encountered a crisis that almost reduced them to a second-class family.
It could be said that Xu Yuanjun’s efforts to turn the tide allowed the Xu family to exist up until now and still stand as the top family in the capital.
Apart from Elder Xu, the number of Prodigious experts in the Xu family far surpassed that of the Gu and Long families as well.
“Xu Yuanjun?” Even Gu Nan had heard of his reputation before. ‘This person has space-type skills and doesn’t have a high attack, but it really won’t be easy to kill him.’
Even Gu Nan could only think one way, which was to brainlessly pursue the other party and kill him in a war of attrition.
But killing him wouldn’t give Gu Nan any benefits. Why waste so much effort? As a player, Gu Nan merely ignored the rules, but he never felt that he was someone who enjoyed killing.
‘Mm, definitely not.’
So Gu Nan calmed down and said, “If you save this woman, be careful that I’ll slaughter the entire Xu family.”
Lan Bing immediately glared at him, her anger surging up again.
‘This person really is reckless. How dare he threaten Elder Xu to his face? Even if he advanced to Domain Stage, he can’t possibly be a match for Elder Xu. There is a difference of decades of accumulation between them!’
Xu Yuanjun said helplessly, “Lan Bing is my good friend’s daughter. Since Your Highness has already killed Hall Master Zhou to vent your anger, is there a need to kill her too…”
Before he could say the last word, he felt his vision blur, and Gu Nan’s figure suddenly disappeared.
A slash to the head!
Unlike Lan Bing, Xu Yuanjun wouldn’t overlook Gu Nan’s power. His expression was grave, and the space in front of him stacked on top of each other, layer after layer, and pulled an endless distance between them.
This was the same as his previous trick, however…
Gu Nan wouldn’t fall for the same trick twice!
The moment before Gu Nan’s Blood Blade fell, the power of shadows suddenly burst out wildly and broke through the wall of space in an instant. Xu Yuanjun’s law of space was destroyed, so naturally the previously insurmountable distance between them also disappeared.
The old man’s face changed slightly, and he suddenly raised his right hand. His sleeve expanded infinitely and blocked the blade.
The next instant, his figure had reappeared ten meters away. Elder Xu wasn’t hurt, but a section of his right sleeve had been sliced off.
His brows furrowed into a knot and he wanted to speak, but Gu Nan’s figure had already reached him. Without giving him any chance to speak, Gu Nan slashed with his blade again!
“To think that he can keep up with teleportation using his own innate speed…” Xu Yuanjun saw what Gu Nan had done. He immediately felt shocked and baffled. ‘Is he even human?!’
In just one second, Gu Nan slashed thirty-one times, and Xu Yuanjun also teleported thirty-one times, just happening to dodge at the right moment each time.
However, when the last swing came, Xu Yuanjun paused a little, taken aback when he didn’t see Gu Nan chasing him.
Then he smiled bitterly and shook his head helplessly.
Lan Bing, who was still frozen in place over there, had already been beheaded by Gu Nan without even a chance to react—with the power of shadows at full power, she had no chance to turn into mist at all.
It turned out that after thirty-one displacements, Lan Bing just happened to be outside Xu Yuanjun’s domain now.
When the breeze blew by, the grass of the adoption center was already covered with blood and flesh. A faint bloody stench was blown up and drilled into the noses of the people around.
Xu Yuanjun stood in the distance, looking at Gu Nan with a frown.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Gu Xingzhu and Convictions
chapters.content:
After the tense standoff, Xu Yuanjun finally chose to retreat in silence.
Neither he nor Gu Nan could deal with each other, but in the end, he still had his family, his kin, to consider. Gu Nan, on the other hand… From the looks of things, Gu Nan didn’t really care about the Gu family.
When Gu Nan saw that Xu Yuanjun had the good sense to leave, he also didn’t have any intention of pursuing. He smiled as he put away the blade in his hand. His injuries had entirely recovered by now, and even the half of his neck that had been sliced off had healed. There weren’t even traces of a scar.
Xu Yuanjun was a very troublesome person. Since he was in the middle of an event right now, Gu Nan was in no hurry to deal with Xu Yuanjun.
As for the matter of exterminating Xu Yuanjun’s entire family… Killing them wouldn’t give Gu Nan any Evil Value, so what’s there to kill? A true top player would never waste any effort on matters that wouldn’t provide benefits.
Not to mention—the Xu family is Xu Yuanjun’s weak spot. Letting the Xu family live would be the most effective threat against Xu Yuanjun. A sharp sword hanging high above one’s head is often more useful than a sword that has already fallen.
The moment Gu Nan led Lin Yunyun out of the adoption center, a prompt came from the Evil God Temple once again.
｢Event Complete: Adopt orphan Lin Yunyun. Total Evil Value obtained: 8｣
‘Eight? Not bad. Now my Evil Value has reached 120…’ Gu Nan silently calculated the difficulty level of this event in his heart and finally nodded.
In general, the amount of Evil Value rewarded was calculated based on the event’s difficulty level. This was especially true for this kind of event with a clear objective.
The more enemies that appeared to hinder the completion of the event, the higher the Evil Value received.
So sometimes, players would deliberately get themselves into trouble, but there weren’t too many suitable opportunities like that. This time, Gu Nan hit the jackpot with the appearance of the Seven Stars Team.
Lu Danze was still frozen in his wheelchair, stunned. The heavy stench of blood on the grass hit his nose, almost making him throw up.
But this sensory stimulation couldn’t even come close to the chill in his heart right now.
He might not know much about the Seven Stars Team, but he just witnessed seven Prodigious experts die by Gu Nan’s hands.
Lu Danze couldn’t help falling into deep despair.
For the first time, he wondered if he really had the ability to reach Gu Nan’s level in his lifetime, and even if he did, what level would the other party be at that time?
But there was actually nothing to wonder about, because Gu Nan had already walked up to him, holding Lin Yunyun’s hand.
“You’re the one who brought them here?” Gu Nan asked as if he didn’t recognize Lu Danze at all. It was a tone of pure curiosity, without the slightest hint of a threat.
Without waiting for Lu Danze to answer, Gu Nan patted him on the shoulder. “Thank you so much for the gift! Sending a wave of monsters over to me.”
While saying that, he reached out and snapped Lu Danze’s neck.
Lin Yunyun looked up at him. “Your way of expressing thanks… is really unique.”
“Thanks.”
Lin Yunyun then felt a bit of a chill on her neck.
……
Of course Gu Nan wouldn’t hurt Lin Yunyun. On the contrary, he was quite eager to take her home and hang her on the wall, then wait for the mission event to refresh.
Speaking of which, the Evil God Temple had been silent after its last notification about the completion of the adoption event.
This series of events had obviously not been completed yet; many questions remained unanswered—such as Lin Yunyun’s origins.
Gu Nan didn’t believe that there would be someone whose body would be full of internal energy for no reason at all. Clearly, all of these events revolved around her, so there must be a story behind it.
The fact that the next event had yet to appear meant that he hadn’t satisfied the conditions to trigger it.
It’s just like how Gu Nan had to hear about the Martial Arts Competition from Gu Nian in order to trigger the first event about the Martial Arts Competition.
‘What can it be…’ Gu Nan sat in one of the Gu family’s lofts, stroking his chin and pondering.
……
For the time being, Gu Nan was stuck trying to find clues about the next event. However, the results of his battle with the Seven Stars Team spread at an unbelievable speed.
The rumors may have been spread by the Gu family, or the Xu family may have secretly played a role.
But the result was the same—the Seven Stars Team was completely wiped out, and Gu Nan’s fame resounded throughout Ruby Fish Star, even going so far as to spread to the different regions of Star Realm as well.
After the Gu family heard about the result, someone from the group of elders immediately came forward and captured Gu Xingzhu, sending her to Gu Nan.
Gu Xingzhu’s clumsy plan to kill Gu Nan using the Seven Stars Team couldn’t be concealed for long, so it was better to admit it early.
“So that’s how it is.” Gu Nan looked at Gu Xingzhu and smiled as he spoke to the Gu family elder beside him, “I’m a simple person—I don’t like to use my brain. If you guys didn’t mention this, I wouldn’t have thought of it… So I can deal with her however I want?”
Gu Nan pointed at Gu Xingzhu, who had her meridians blocked and resembled an ordinary young girl, tied up with a few hemp ropes.
The person who tied her was clearly a highly skilled teacher. The parts that should be exposed weren’t blocked by the ropes at all. Instead, the ropes actually made Gu Xingzhu’s flat body look exquisite.
“Of course, please enjoy yourself to the fullest,” this elder didn’t put on airs at all and even used a respectful tone.
“Anyways, thank you.” Gu Nan smiled and asked, “By the way, what’s your name?”
“…Gu Tianwen.”
……
With a face of awkwardness, old man Gu Tianwen left Gu Nan’s room. Now only Gu Nan and Gu Xingzhu were left.
Gu Xingzhu was gagged with a white handkerchief and sat curled up in the corner, completely devoid of her usual confidence and strength, looking pitiful.
Gu Nan casually took off the handkerchief and asked with interest, “Did Lu Zhanyu send you here? Is it purely to seduce me, or do you have a message for me?”
These words made Gu Xingzhu flinch. Her gaze was a little dull, and she could only force herself to say, “W-What are you talking about…”
“Don’t pretend anymore.” Gu Nan waved his hand. “You work under Gu Nian, so how can you get the news of the Seven Stars Team before everyone else in the Gu family does? It’s obvious that an outsider told you.”
“The only outsider here who has considerable power outside Ruby Fish Star is the Lu sisters, and of the two sisters, Lu Zhanyu is the only one with the motive to do so.”
“As for that Gu Tianwen, he’s either on your side or being used by you to send you to me.”
“You want to first immobilize me and then replace Gu Nian? This should also be Lu Zhanyu’s intention as well, right? She really is poisonous. She wants to make the first move just because Gu Nian has noticed something?”
Gu Nan analyzed with a smile. At the end, he also added a sentence, “You assume all the risk, while you have to share the benefits with Lu Zhanyu. You really are a selfless model citizen.”
The corners of Gu Xingzhu’s mouth twitched, and her face was a bit gloomy. She suddenly had the feeling of standing in front of someone else after being stripped naked. The other party’s gaze was so cold and piercing.
But after she was seen through, she instead relaxed again. She straightened her body and came up to Gu Nan’s ear, chuckling softly. “Don’t you want to know what I’m going to seduce you with?”
Gu Nan pushed her away and said righteously, “I won’t be interested in any methods from a woman your age. Please respect a lolicon’s convictions.”

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Clue’s Location
chapters.content:
When Gu Xingzhu left, her expression was even uglier than old man Gu Tianwen’s. Of course, her mood was not within the range of Gu Nan’s consideration.
It wasn’t like Gu Nan never touched women, but he just wasn’t interested in this kind of passerby NPC.
As a veteran player, he didn’t mind being addicted to female NPCs to the point of being unable to “extricate himself,” but it must at least be NPCs he was familiar with and conquered, after maxing their affection level.
In the next few days, Gu Nan began to wander around randomly and even made a trip to Lin Yunyun’s hometown, trying to find the trigger point of the next event, but there was no harvest.
Instead, he ran into several waves of “suicide attacks,” mostly from Zhou Xuewen’s disciples.
They probably saw themselves as the heroes in novels who believed that they could carry out justice in Heaven’s stead, but unfortunately, their actions were no different from suicide in Gu Nan’s eyes.
The military also sent over their response, which was quite interesting.
The letter came from Huang Wu, the commander of this region’s military. He was precisely Huang Qi’s uncle—Huang Qi was the one who wanted to take revenge for Hu Wei and brought along her little brother in the attack that cost both their lives.
The tone of Huang Wu’s letter was very polite. The general meaning was: “My nephew’s brain isn’t very good, so feel free to kill him—no need to be polite. But Hu Wei is very fond of her younger brother; you should be careful.”
It was indeed as Lu Zhanyu’s predicted. This Commander Huang didn’t really care about his nephew. He simply didn’t want to make an enemy of a Domain Stage cultivator and even took the time to write a letter to express his goodwill.
After all, reality wasn’t like a novel. The kind of scene where an organization’s elders popped out right after you beat up their disciples was rare.
That is, unless the other party feels that this is already an irreconcilable feud—such as the Seven Stars Team, or such as…
“Hu Wei?” Gu Nan chuckled and casually burned the letter, not taking it to heart.
With his current power, his survivability actually far exceeded his actual combat power, having long since reached a terrifying point. Even enemies who could be considered Tier 4 in the game would find it very difficult to kill him, unless their ability just happened to completely neutralize his own.
In the game, an agility-type Evil God who controlled shadows was one of the hardest builds to kill, not to mention that he also chose the Resistance skill.
Gu Nan’s search for the next event came up empty, so he had no choice but to try to find clues from Lin Yunyun.
He occasionally studied the origin of the girl’s strange physique, as well as the detailed characteristics of this physique. Sometimes he knocked Lin Yunyun unconscious and sent her to Gu Nian.
One can tell at a glance that this kind of odd lily woman who liked little lolis wouldn’t be anything good. Thus, it was very normal if the next event was triggered through Gu Nian.
Unfortunately, although his “video tape collection” increased in size, he still didn’t have a clue on how to trigger the next event.
Today, a Gu Nan who was a little irritable from being stuck without a clue fished out Lu Zhanyu again—of course it wasn’t to find someone to vent. He wanted to see if she had a new mission.
“You mean, you need a mission that requires a medium-sized plane, regardless of difficulty level?” Lu Zhanyu was puzzled by Gu Nan’s strange request.
“Mm.” Gu Nan nodded. “You don’t need to know the reason; you just need to know the requirements.”
Lu Zhanyu shrugged. “It’s not very common that one would describe the size of the mission plane beforehand, unless they’re looking for a mission in a known plane.”
“Is there a way?” Gu Nan clasped his hands together and asked with rapt attention.
If he could obtain this method, then it was fine even if he abandoned the chain events. In any case, he could still get the reward, and dungeons would also give points in addition to Evil Value.
Lu Zhanyu frowned in thought. “It’s not impossible… you just need a wide selection of missions to pick from. This requires you to have relatively high authority in the reincarnation organization’s platform.”
“Can I join the reincarnation platform directly?” Gu Nan remembered his situation in Radiant Tower and immediately asked.
“It’s possible, but an organization at Astral Gate’s level wouldn’t easily accept people, much less people in a remote region like the Ninth Region.”
Gu Nan nodded. “Looks like it’s time to switch maps.”
Lu Zhanyu gave him an odd look, not quite understanding his wording, but still said, “I know of a small reincarnation organization that has just been recently established. Are you interested?”
“Of course!” Gu Nan said without hesitation.
He couldn’t wait to find out the method to accept missions. Then he’d be able to directly look for missions without the help of another organization.
Only then did Lu Zhanyu reveal a smile. “That organization is in the Sixth Region. I can take you there… In exchange, can you do me a favor?”
“Okay.” Gu Nan nodded. It was only natural to complete quests in order to obtain information from NPCs. This was very much in line with a player’s system of values.
Lu Zhanyu began to talk about what she needed Gu Nan’s help with.
To put it bluntly, she wanted him to be a hired thug—to fight for the Lu family once and win a round in a match. This involved a fight over benefits between several branches of the Lu family. Since it wouldn’t look good if the Lu family’s members actually fought each other, they decided each branch’s benefits through proxy battles.
In fact, this was also one of the original reasons why the Lu siblings came to Ruby Fish Star.
During the incident with Hu Wei, Gu Nan didn’t give the older sister, Lu Xingyu, any face. However, Lu Xingyu still took the initiative to visit him because of this matter.
It was only later, when Gu Nan’s conflicts with the parties involved escalated further and further, that Lu Xingyu didn’t mention it again because she felt that nothing she could offer would move him.
“So, when do we leave? Where is it located?” Gu Nan asked.
“The sooner the better. Time is already very tight.” Lu Zhanyu answered, “The location is Heavenly Enterprise Star, the home turf of our branch of the family.”
Gu Nan was about to speak, but the Evil God Temple shook slightly at this time.
｢Evil Event triggered: Seize the Eye of Maes｣
A hundred curses immediately ran through Gu Nan’s heart… ‘It turns out that the next event is triggered by talking to Lu Zhanyu… or rather, by mentioning Heavenly Enterprise Star!’
‘You should’ve said so earlier!’
Gu Nan couldn’t help feeling pained when he thought about his repeated attempts to trigger the next event these past few days—they were all wastes of time.
But now that the clue finally appeared, he asked with a serious expression, “Have you ever heard of Maes, or the Eye of Maes?”
“Maes?” Lu Zhanyu thought about it but eventually shook her head.
……
“You’re going to Heavenly Enterprise Star?” Gu Nian stood in Gu Nan’s room and asked with a frown.
“Mm, at the invitation of the Lu sisters.” Gu Nan put down the document in his hand and rubbed his brow in slight exhaustion.
He had already checked the ancient records for seven hours, from ancient times to modern times, all concerning Heavenly Enterprise Star and the name “Maes.”
There were many matches for people or items that contained the name Maes, and he needed to check them one by one to see which one might be the target of his next mission.
Gu Nian’s expression didn’t look very good, but she didn’t look very disappointed either.
Recently, the Gu family put most of its efforts on colonizing Immortal Demon World and couldn’t pay as much attention to events in Star Realm. It would be quite convenient if Gu Nan, the unstable factor, was willing to leave on his own.
It’s just that…
“Why do you have to take Lin Yunyun away as well?” Gu Nian’s face was gloomy—this was what she really wanted to ask.
Gu Nan’s face couldn’t help revealing a smile. “What? Can’t bear to let her go?”
This kind of mocking tone made Gu Nian clench her teeth and grind them together. Ever since her secret was discovered, she had become increasingly unable to speak in front of Gu Nan.
In theory, this secret was nothing at all, but her heart just unconsciously felt weak after Gu Nan discovered her secret.
No matter how many schemes this “upgraded version of Lu Zhanyu” had, in the end, she was only a girl in her twenties.
Gu Nan stood up and patted her shoulder. “I’m definitely taking Lin Yunyun with me, but I can recommend you a new target!”
“There’s an older loli in Immortal Demon World called Yan Xiaoxiao who’s guaranteed to suit your taste.”
Gu Nian glared at him for a while, hesitation flashing over her face. Finally, she asked, “How big
[1]
?”
“At least D.”
“I’m talking about…”
“Oh, she’s not too young. But her strength surged when she was young, so now she still maintains a teenager’s body! She’s a legal loli!”
“……”
Notes: [1] “How big?”
can mean either “How old?” or “How big?”

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Starship
chapters.content:
In the endless sea of stars, a mid-sized starship quite gorgeous in appearance was slowly sailing through space.
Inside the starship, Gu Nan was gently flipping through an ancient text under the pale yellow light.
A moment later, he took off the gold-rimmed glasses on his face, rubbed his eyes somewhat tiredly, and then recorded something on the paper next to him.
“People, locations, and objects… There are 352 clues related to Maes, 41 of which might be connected to the Eye of Maes.”
After personally flipping through ancient texts and documents for many days, Gu Nan was finally able to find out clues related to Maes.
As a top player, whenever it came to mission clues, Gu Nan never liked to leave it to others. It’s not that nobody around him could do the job, nor was he a natural workaholic, but he simply didn’t trust others’ abilities.
He always felt that he would easily miss some important clues if he relied on someone else’s work, while he himself wouldn’t miss them—to put it bluntly, this was narcissism.
“U-Uncle Gu… the two Lu family sisters are looking for you,” Lin Yunyun’s voice traveled from outside, only to address him with some obvious stammering.
As Lin Yunyun’s adopter, Gu Nan decisively elevated himself by one generation, resolutely refusing to be called “Older Brother.”
After failing to induce the little loli to call him “Daddy,” his final term of address became “Uncle.”
When Gu Nan came to the outer room, the two sisters, Lu Xingyu and Lu Zhanyu, were already waiting here.
Lu Zhanyu brought Gu Nan aboard the starship when Lu Xingyu was still out looking for help, so today was the first time the two met after parting ways.
“Come, greet your older sisters,” Gu Nan said to Lin Yunyun.
Lin Yunyun greeted obediently, “I greet the Lu family’s Big Sisters.”
“Hello there!” Lu Xingyu also smiled back. She had a gentle nature, so she instantly took a liking to a little girl like Lin Yunyun.
“Alright, go play by yourself for a while.”
“Okay, Uncle
[1]
.”
Lu Xingyu: “……”
……
“In any case, the fact that Mr. Gu is willing to help out… Thank you so much!”
Although Lin Yunyun’s address made her a little confused, the look of delight on Lu Xingyu’s face was unmistakable; she had already heard about Gu Nan’s battle record.
Gu Nan’s reputation in Ruby Fish Star wasn’t too good, but Lu Xingyu was not an inflexible person. The Lu family was a genuinely influential family, so how could its children be naive?
Gu Nan smiled. “No need to be polite. It’s just a deal.”
Gu Nan would help them fight one match, and the Lu family would help Gu Nan find the Eye of Maes—that was the deal between the two sides.
As the next clue in the chain of events, the Eye of Maes appeared when Heavenly Enterprise Star was mentioned, so Gu Nan had reason to suspect that the clue was on Heavenly Enterprise Star.
And as the key figure of the event, Lin Yunyun naturally had to be brought along as well.
So… he’ll just have to inconvenience Sister Gu Nian to temporarily go to Yan Xiaoxiao to resolve her physiological needs.
Gu Nan and Lu Xingyu chatted for a while longer. The latter basically thanked him again, while Lu Zhanyu acted as a human sculpture all the way, not taking the initiative to speak.
She knew that Gu Nan would definitely blab, so her identity could be exposed if she was careless.
“It will take two more days to reach Heavenly Enterprise Star. Why don’t you come out for a walk?” Lu Xingyu suggested with a smile, “The scenery of this endless sea of stars is something that can’t be seen elsewhere.”
……
On the other side of the starship, a man and a woman from the Lu family were talking.
This starship was privately owned by the Lu family, and this trip not only carried Gu Nan and the Lu sisters, but also other children of the Lu branch family based in Heavenly Enterprise Star, as well as the helpers they had invited.
“Cousin Huaiyun, I heard that you’ve invited an interstellar hunter this time?” The woman gently leaned on the guardrail of the deck and asked with a light smile.
This woman’s name was Lu Jing. She was from a relatively remote branch of the Lu family. This time, she just came to watch the show.
The “Cousin Huaiyun” she spoke of was a relatively famous child of the Lu family who also came from Heavenly Enterprise Star. Both his connections and his own abilities were quite remarkable.
“Mm, a five-star star hunter,” Lu Huaiyun didn’t hide it and answered with a light smile.
Lu Jing was stunned by the words, then exclaimed, “Five stars! There aren’t many in the entire Ninth Region, right? Could that person be…”
Lu Huaiyun waved his hand. “Don’t blindly guess… It’s Guan Shanxue, the disciple of old Mr. Kang of Yin Yang Tower. He just advanced to five stars two months ago.”
“Oh…” Lu Jing seemed a little disappointed but soon became happy again. “Guan Shanxue is a Prodigious Realm cultivator who has been in the Infinitesimal Stage for many years, it seems that this time, Older Sister Xingyu will lose to you again, Cousin.”
Lu Huaiyun’s branch of the family didn’t have a good relationship with the Lu sisters’ branch of the family. Lu Jing deliberately said this to flatter him.
“Hahaha! That pair of sisters ran all the way to Ruby Fish Star. What kind of powerful helpers can they find in a backwater place like that?” Lu Huaiyun laughed heartily. “The real experts would never stay in an administrative star—they’re all out traveling, challenging themselves in the endless sea of stars to grow!”
There were countless relics and treasures in the sea of stars, so it could attract top martial artists. Lu Huaiyun’s words weren’t wrong.
Lu Jing praised him twice more and suddenly spoke up, “Cousin Huaiyun, I heard that Zhanyu brought a helper along, and that person even brought a little girl with him.”
“Oh?” Lu Huaiyun seemed as if he’d heard something interesting. He laughed brightly. “Good. Little Jing, your Cousin will accept this gift of yours!”
……
A few moments later, Gu Nan held Lin Yunyun’s hand and slowly walked through the aisle in the middle of the starship.
To the side was a transparent floor-to-ceiling window, reflecting the starry sea outside the window. In the end, Lin Yunyun was only a thirteen-year-old girl, so she had long since flung herself to the window, gazing enviously at the endless galaxy.
But to the rest of the passengers, her behavior resembled that of a country girl who clearly hadn’t seen much of the world—of course, she really hadn’t seen much of the world.
Her action fell in the eyes of the onlookers and triggered a burst of light laughter.
Lin Yunyun was originally enjoying the scenic view of the galaxy, but the laughter finally awakened her. She turned to look behind her, which turned out to be the starship’s dining room.
The original intention of this design was to allow guests dining in the restaurant to see the starlight as soon as they looked up.
The young girl saw the smiles on the dining room guests and finally realized that they had all witnessed her previous actions. She suddenly blushed.
On the other hand, neither Gu Nan nor Lu Zhanyu had much of a reaction. Lu Zhanyu didn’t react because she was quite a good actor and knew how to hide her emotions a long time ago, while Gu Nan…
“Zhanyu, I think you should take them on a tour first,” a voice rang out next to Lin Yunyun. It was a rather magnetic male voice that was trying to hide his laughter.
“It’s just the sea of stars. There will be plenty of opportunities to see it.” This man, dressed in a silver suit, looked down at Lin Yunyun again and asked, “Little Sister, don’t you think so?”
His gaze was a bit playful, making Lin Yunyun’s body shrink.
Lu Zhanyu, who was standing next to them, chuckled lightly. “Cousin Huaiyun, I advise you to put that thought away. There are some people you can’t afford to mess with.”
“Oh?” Lu Huaiyun’s eyes narrowed slightly, finally casting his gaze on Gu Nan. “What is this brother’s name?”
However, Gu Nan didn’t pay any attention to him; he was still looking at the starry scene outside the window.
Lu Zhangyu smiled. “This one is Gu Nan—Mr. Gu.”
Lu Huaiyun frowned slightly. He vaguely felt that the name was somewhat familiar but couldn’t recall where he had heard it for the time being.
And Gu Nan was still ignoring them, all the way until Lin Yunyun tugged on his sleeve.
Notes: [1] Uncle:
Lin Yunyun calls the Lu sisters “Older Sisters” but calls Gu Nan “Uncle,” making Gu Nan one generation above the sisters in terms of seniority, so proper decorum dictates that the sisters will have to address him respectfully due to seniority.
Makes things awkward because he used to be in the same generation as them, but he elevated himself by one generation when Lin Yunyun called him “Uncle”

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Crazy Warrior
chapters.content:
“U-Uncle…”
Gu Nan turned his head and looked at her in confusion. “What’s wrong?”
Lu Huaiyun almost laughed aloud when he heard this. ‘To think I actually took Lu Zhanyu’s warning seriously. It turns out that this fellow is even more of a country bumpkin, to be this fascinated by the outside scenery.’
And the tiny bit of wariness in his heart was naturally cast aside.
Gu Nan was indeed staring at outer space, but his thoughts weren’t quite the same as a normal person’s:
‘With my current physique… I should be able to survive in the vacuum, right?’ Gu Nan silently calculated in his mind.
This world’s Void Cutter Realm cultivators can cross through the void. However, this kind of situation never appeared in the game before, but his physique far surpassed that of an ordinary Prodigious Realm expert, so it shouldn’t be a big problem to survive in space.
But in the end, he wasn’t 100% certain, so Gu Nan turned his head and asked Lu Zhanyu, “How much force is needed to break this glass window?”
Lu Zhanyu was truly flabbergasted this time. She had been on 70 to 80 starships in her life, but this was the first time someone asked that question.
Before she could answer, Lu Huaiyun beside her replied with a chuckle, “If you really want to know, why don’t you try it out yourself?”
But he was already sneering in his heart. All the materials on this starship were specially made by the military, and the durability of the floor-to-ceiling windows were of the utmost importance, so these windows were extremely strong. ‘Exactly which backwater place did this country bumpkin come from?’
When he heard that, Gu Nan smiled and slowly turned his head around, his calm and indifferent gaze falling on Lu Huaiyun, making the latter’s heart vaguely wary.
“Makes sense,” Gu Nan’s tone sounded quite agreeable, but before Lu Huaiyun had time to relax, he felt his head suddenly tighten.
Gu Nan had appeared beside him at some point, grabbed his long hair, and smashed his head forward, slamming it onto the glass window.
Bang!
A dull thud echoed through the dining hall, and everyone froze.
But Gu Nan’s movements didn’t stop; he kept his hold on Lu Huaiyun’s head, using it as a weapon and continuously slamming it against the glass window.
Interestingly, the force and angle of each of his slams didn’t differ in the slightest.
The only thing that changed was Lu Huaiyun’s head—after continuous strikes, his skull had fractured piece by piece, deforming the shape of his head, which affected the force of the slams.
Boom! Boom! Boom…
The knocks echoed throughout the dining hall. Some people began to stand up, some people cursed, and others rushed towards this side.
Only Gu Nan continued to do his own thing, until…
“30% force, 25 times,” Gu Nan muttered calmly as he tossed Lu Huaiyun, who had a bloody face, to the side.
And in front of him, cobweb-like cracks had already appeared on the special glass that separated the starship’s interior from outer space.
When these cobweb cracks appeared in front of the crowd, the originally angry group instantly stopped in their tracks. No one dared to approach Gu Nan anymore.
……
In the dining room of the starship, Lu Huaiyun had already been sent down for treatment.
A dozen maintenance personnel currently surrounded the cracks that formed as a result of Lu Huaiyun’s head, sweating profusely as they hurried to repair it.
“Mr. Gu.” An old man in white had a bitter smile on his face as he said helplessly, “Please don’t do such a dangerous thing in the future… Not only is this irresponsible towards your own life, but you’re also putting the safety of the entire ship’s personnel at risk.”
This old man was the captain of the starship. When he heard that someone had smashed cracks in the starship’s window, his hair almost turned white with fright.
He hurriedly ran over with a dozen people, but fortunately, a disaster was averted.
Gu Nan still didn’t have much of an expression on his face when faced with the captain’s persuasion. Perhaps he didn’t hear this old man at all, because his gaze still rested on the cracks.
He had been paying attention to the repair process.
“Exactly! How can there be someone like this? How dare he beat Young Master Huaiyun like that…”
“This person is simply a terrorist! Who the hell let him onboard?”
“That’s right! We demand that he be kicked off the starship! Or else we refuse to go to Heavenly Enterprise Star!”
“I agree…”
Among the crowd that had previously gathered around, voices also began to come out and gradually transformed into a common will: to kick Gu Nan off the starship.
Lu Xinyu had already arrived and was currently trying to persuade everyone, while Lu Zhanyu, from beginning to end, acted like this was none of her business.
…Even if this entire mess might’ve been caused by a sentence of hers.
Just when the crowd’s clamor was getting louder and louder, a burst of laughter came from far and near, revealing this person’s brash and insolent nature and silencing all the other complaints.
“
Hahahaha
! How dare a group of trash like you speak out in front of the Crazy Warrior?”
The owner of this voice appeared in the form of a handsome young man with an orange afro and non-mainstream clothes.
But none of the people present dared to speak out after he appeared.
The reason was simple. This person was Lu Li. He once wandered through the sea of stars for seven years with only a sword. After returning, he became recognized as the strongest genius among the Lu family’s younger generation.
This time, Heavenly Enterprise Star’s branch of the Lu family aimed to settle its internal disputes with Lu branch families from other regions in the competition. Thus, all the other branch families spent all their efforts trying to find external helpers; only Lu Li’s branch towered above the others, imposing and motionless.
Because Lu Lu doesn’t need anyone else’s help—he is a top-tier Prodigious master himself.
After Lu Li appeared, he didn’t look at Gu Nan and Lu Zhanyu. Instead, he shouted behind him, “Guan Shanxue, your master was beaten and crippled. As your master’s dog, why don’t you come out and bark a few times?”
Seemingly forced into action by his words, another white-haired youth had no choice but to show himself.
This Guan Shanxue had a stiff expression as he explained in a serious manner, “Lu Huaiyun and I are friends. I accepted his invitation to fight for him in the competition, but I am not responsible for protecting him.”
While these two youths appeared one after another, Gu Nan’s gaze circled between them and showed a thoughtful expression.
‘Although these two spoke harshly to each other, their actual relationship should be quite good. It’s just…’
“What do you mean by Crazy Warrior?” Gu Nan interrupted the conversation between the two and asked Lu Li directly.
The frivolous expression on Lu Li’s face disappeared, and he said seriously, “Two days ago, the Central Region released a new cycle of the Star Rankings, and Your Excellency was listed on it, with the title ‘Crazy Warrior’.”
As he spoke, he handed a ranking document to Gu Nan.
Gu Nan took the ranking, only to find that the document was made of special material; it was unlike ordinary cloth. After opening it, he saw the glittering starlight flickering gently, and a list of names were written on it.
And Gu Nan’s name was written at the very end of that list.
[Gu Nan: Nineteen years old. Resident of Ninth Region’s Ruby Fish Star. Origins unknown, suspected of being from a foreign region]
[Reason for entering the Ranking: Within a few months after he appeared in public, his strength went from the Innate Realm directly to Prodigious Realm’s Domain Stage—the fastest breakthrough in the last century]
[Battle record: Single-handedly fought against the Seven Stars Team on Ruby Fish Star; battle concluded with the latter’s total annihilation]
[Title: Because he used a blood-red blade during the battle and his state resembled that of a crazy demon, he is granted the title “Crazy Warrior”]
[Innate Ability: Unknown]
[Special Skills: Unknown]
“To think that both innate ability and special skills are unknown. Looks like there are also times when Starry Ocean Pavilion doesn’t live up to its name,” Lu Zhanyu commented with a chuckle, having come over at some point and read the description on the ranking.
Lu Li and Guan Shanxue, however, didn’t laugh. If not even a large organization like Starry Ocean Pavilion could find out about this person’s abilities, then there was only one possibility.
Everyone who saw him attack in earnest have all died…
This was also the reason these two willingly appeared in front of this “Crazy Warrior”—they wanted to fish for information on Gu Nan.
As if he heard their wishes, Gu Nan spoke up, “Is there a way to contact the creator of this ranking? There’s a piece of information that needs to be corrected.”
“Oh? What kind of information?” Lu Li’s eyes lit up as he hurriedly asked.
“I’m eighteen years old right now, thank you very much.” Gu Nan’s face was full of earnestness. “I only turn nineteen in the second half of this year.”

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Love-Hate Relationship
chapters.content:
“So, what exactly is a Star Ranking?” Gu Nan asked while picking up the cup of coffee that the waiter brought over. He had taken Lin Yunyun along and was now sitting across from Lu Zhanyu.
Lu Zhanyu showed a rare serious expression. “Don’t take the Star Ranking lightly. This is created by an enormous organization based in the Central Region; the Star Ranking is Starry Ocean Pavilion’s signature…”
“Some more sugar please, thank you,” Gu Nan said to the waiter.
Bam!
Lu Zhanyu slapped the table angrily, shaking the coffee cups on the table. Lin Yunyun lowered her head, her shoulders trembling. It seemed that holding back her laughter was difficult.
After taking several deep breaths, Lu Zhanyu was finally able to adjust her mood.
Although she mocked Starry Ocean Pavilion earlier, as a reincarnator, her awe of this organization was ingrained deep within her bones.
Unfortunately for her, Gu Nan was destined to never be able to experience this kind of awe.
For players, all NPC organizations are divided into only two categories: those that can be destroyed now and those that can be destroyed in the future.
But it was only after Lu Zhanyu’s explanation that Gu Nan roughly understood the Star Ranking’s significance.
As the backbone of Star Realm, Prodigious cultivators often had many privileges and received a lot of attention. The Star Ranking was a list made specifically for Prodigious experts and commanded high authority, so it was very popular among martial artists.
After all, the things people want in life boil down to two things: fame and fortune. The Star Ranking just happens to represent the former.
In addition to the requirement of advancing to Prodigious Realm, the ranking also considered someone’s ability and battle record—it didn’t entirely rely on cultivation level to decide a person’s rank.
There were Prodigious masters of all stages on Star Ranking. There were even some in the Origin Stage, but most of these people had their own trump cards, so none of them were easy opponents.
Only people with particularly outstanding abilities can enter the Star Ranking.
The Star Ranking only recorded those who were still alive today and whose strength was still at Prodigious Realm. Together with the most recent addition, Gu Nan, there were only 461 names.
These 461 people represent the 400+ strongest Prodigious experts in the entire Star Realm.
It was no wonder that Lu Li and Guan Shanxue attached so much importance to Gu Nan, as it was no trivial matter to enter the Star Ranking while coming from such a remote region like the Ninth Region.
……
After parting ways with Lu Zhanyu, Gu Nan took Lin Yunyun back to his room, but they soon met an unexpected person in the hallway.
“Young Master Lu? What a rare guest.” Gu Nan looked at Lu Li, who was already waiting here for some time, and showed a strange expression.
Lu Li smiled. “Just call me Lu Li. I’ve heard my younger brother talk about Mr. Gu. Truly, knowing someone by their reputation can’t compare to personally meeting them.”
“Oh?”
Without waiting for Gu Nan to think more, Lu Li took the initiative to explain, “My younger brother is called Lu Wu.”
‘So it’s him…’ Gu Nan remembered that silent youth with unusually sharp perception in Nebula Martial Hall. Although he didn’t know why Lu Wu was in Ruby Fish Star, he knew that Lu Wu wasn’t an ordinary character.
He just didn’t expect that Lu Wu’s identity seemed to carry more weight than imagined.
He also remembered that Lu Zhanyu had paid him a visit just to ask him to take care of Lu Wu…
‘It seems that she deliberately brought up Lu Li because she knew I’d be suspicious. This woman really doesn’t miss any opportunity to find trouble for me.’
Thoughts flowed around in Gu Nan’s head, but his face didn’t change in the slightest. “What does Young Master Lu want with me?”
Lu Li said expressionlessly, “Does Mr. Gu know that someone has already laid out a trap in Heavenly Enterprise Star and is just waiting for you to step into it?”
“So?” Gu Nan raised his eyebrows and asked, equally expressionless.
Gu Nan’s attitude made Lu Li seem to understand something, and his face showed some coldness. “Looks like Mr. Gu is very confident in his own strength? I want to remind you—that that person invited someone from the Star Ranking to attack you…”
Gu Nan didn’t say anything more. He just shook his head, then led Lin Yunyun into the room and closed the door behind them.
He never liked to explain excessively to people.
Lu Li, on the other hand, sneered while also turning around and leaving. There was already someone waiting for him at the corner. It was Guan Shanxue, the one who made an earlier appearance.
“What did he say?”
“Heh, he didn’t even ask who was planning to attack him.” Some disdain surfaced on Lu Li’s face. “Nothing more than an arrogant maniac. Hu Wei will make him understand the price he’ll pay for arrogance.”
……
What happened on the starship didn’t have further impact.
While Lu Huaiyun certainly held an extraordinary position in the Lu family, it still couldn’t compare to someone like Lu Li. After Lu Li personally visited Gu Nan, everyone understood the Lu family’s attitude towards Gu Nan.
…Although their conversation wasn’t pleasant.
News of Gu Nan entering the Star Ranking spread, making him truly famous. The majority of the Ninth Region had now heard about the person who had the “fastest breakthrough in the last century”.
Two days passed quickly, and Gu Nan was able to leave the starship and set foot upon the long-renowned Heavenly Enterprise Star.
If Ruby Fish Star was a typical modern city, then Heavenly Enterprise Star’s cities had more of a steel jungle feel.
“There aren’t many residential areas in Heavenly Enterprise Star, so the city is highly utilized,” Lu Zhanyu, acting as a temporary tour guide, explained to Gu Nan and Lin Yunyun.
“So they even utilized the sky?” Gu Nan looked at the various oddly-shaped buildings in mid-air and asked softly.
“That’s right, those are all residences.” Lu Zhanyu shrugged. “So you should understand that the ground level where you guys will be staying… is very expensive.”
In this world of martial artists, living at a high altitude was quite dangerous. Because you don’t know when two flying people will appear one day and crash through the walls of your house.
Gu Nan was a VIP of the Lu family, so he could live in an extremely precious ground floor residence.
Of course, Gu Nan wasn’t too concerned about this. With his current physique, even if he was thrown down from a thousand meters in the sky, he could still get up and walk away like nothing had happened.
“Is there any news on the information I asked you guys to check?” Gu Nan asked. He was referring to the information he gave Lu Zhanyu about the word Maes.
“We’re still investigating. No valuable clues have emerged yet,” Lu Zhanyu answered.
Gu Nan nodded. After all, he had only arrived at Heavenly Enterprise Star not long ago, and the Lu family wouldn’t be able to move so quickly.
Letting the Lu family help look for Maes was an idea he had long ago. He was different from those players who’d already obtained clues but still insisted on conducting their own search. A top player wouldn’t do this kind of mechanical task that requires little skill.
He also wasn’t afraid that someone would dare to take his stuff… If there’s such a person, just kill them, and they’ll drop the item upon death.
“By the way.” Lu Zhanyu looked at Gu Nan oddly and said, “Gu Nian and Yan Xiaoxiao started fighting in Immortal Demon World…”
Long before the two left Ruby Fish Star, Gu Nan had Lu Zhanyu arrange for someone to be reincarnated into Immortal Demon World to act as their eyes.
Gu Nan certainly wouldn’t be foolish enough to truly hand Immortal Demon World over to the Gu family.
Gu Nan wasn’t surprised at all when he heard this. Instead, he started laughing. “Good, have your people start spreading rumors claiming that those outsiders from the Gu family are trying to destroy Immortal Demon World.”
“I want those two to have a love-hate relationship… Ah no, I meant, I want those two to mix like fire and water!”

chapters.title: Chapter 112: All Sides
chapters.content:
Actually, the situation over in Immortal Demon World had always been under Gu Nan’s control.
Although he himself was restricted by his Prodigious Realm soul and couldn’t personally monitor it, he could still find other people to reincarnate there and gather information for him.
Reincarnation was really an excellent investigation method. It was safe and efficient, and Gu Nan didn’t have to fear the fact that gathered information wouldn’t be able to be transmitted.
Ever since the Gu family found out about Immortal Demon World, they took the most efficient approach—namely, they cooperated with the native forces to start their invasion and colonization plan.
Although the average power of people in Star Realm far exceeded that of Immortal Demon World, reincarnators had to return to their home worlds regularly, so they had no choice but to support a native force to govern in their stead.
And because of Gu Nan’s legacy, Azure Dragon Hall became the best choice.
Originally, all this was going on in an orderly manner. Even Lu Zhanyu had given up on the thought of making trouble, but she didn’t expect a sudden change to occur.
“The Gu family used to support Azure Dragon Hall to continuously suppress other forces. Now that Azure Dragon Hall has fallen out with them, both sides are indeed in like fire and water…” Lu Zhanyu muttered, her expression turning increasingly strange. She asked curiously, “How on earth did you do it? Neither Gu Nian nor Yan Xiaoxiao seem like impulsive people.”
In her opinion, the cooperation between Yan Xiaoxiao and the Gu family was a mutually beneficial situation.
The Gu family could get a share of Immortal Demon World’s resources, while Azure Dragon Hall gained support in the form of reincarnators and could truly rule the world and enjoy immense authority.
Gu Nan just smiled without saying anything. Of course he couldn’t explain the reason behind this.
Gu Nian’s orientation was probably her only weakness. On one hand, she couldn’t suppress the desire in her heart, but on the other hand, she was determined to hide it.
This is why she chose to fall out with Azure Dragon Hall without another word as soon as the initial conflict broke out.
As for Yan Xiaoxiao, it was even simpler… ‘I treated you like a sister, but you actually want to bed me?’
……
Gu Nan was unwilling to explain more, and Lu Zhanyu left with a heart full of questions.
Lin Yunyun, on the other hand, came over and handed Gu Nan a cup of coffee, while the latter added three more bags of sugar in passing.
“Did anything strange happen during your cultivation recently?” Gu Nan asked with a light smile after he told Lin Yunyun to sit down.
Lin Yunyun looked at the three empty sugar bags in a daze and muttered, “There’s not much feeling… Feels like Innate Realm is just so-so.”
That’s right, Lin Yunyun successfully advanced to Innate Realm a few days ago.
But because her internal energy was too abundant, she didn’t feel any fundamental difference between the Innate and Acquired Realms—at most, she was able to use more internal energy.
Gu Nan stretched out a hand and patted her arm. The latter immediately cried out in pain.
“Doesn’t look like the internal energy in your body is accumulating anymore.” Gu Nan said, “The higher your realm and the stronger your control over internal energy, the more this pain will be alleviated.”
Lin Yunyun’s eyes instantly lit up. “Then I can… always be free of this pain in the future?”
“It’s theoretically possible.” Gu Nan nodded, then pulled out a bag of white powder. “But for now, you’d better eat.”
Lin Yunyun glowered at him bitterly, then quickly snatched the bag of powder and squatted in the corner, gnawing on it like crazy.
She still maintained her earlier habit of using a rather indecent posture every time she “ate”, even though she could enjoy it slowly now.
Soon, the only sounds left in the room were Gu Nan’s shallow breathing and the girl’s faint moan after eating.
……
On Heavenly Enterprise Star, in a quaint and isolated hut, a crane-haired old man was sipping his clear tea, his gaze falling on a distant place invisible to the onlookers. He sighed softly under his breath.
“It seems that Mr. Gu has no intention of settling this peacefully either,” the old man’s voice was calm; not much emotion could be heard.
“Yes.” Lu Li stood in front of the old man and said in a low voice, “Grandpa, why don’t we simply help Hu Wei…”
This old man was Lu Li’s grandfather, the true ruler of Heavenly Enterprise Star’s Lu family. His name was Lu Yiming, also known as the “Spiritual Elder”.
Lu Yiming managed Heavenly Enterprise Star for decades, almost single-handedly developing this steel planet from scratch. His iron-fisted approach was evident.
However, at this time, he gently waved his hand. “After the newest Star Ranking, Xu Yuanjun specially paid a visit to say that Gu Nan is not a good person… If Little Wei wants revenge, our Lu family simply won’t intervene.”
Lu Li frowned slightly. There were two ways to interpret the phrase “not a good person”—either the person’s personality wasn’t easy to get along with, or… the person’s strength wasn’t easy to deal with.
‘While I admit that the other party is certainly a troublesome opponent who entered the Star Ranking at a young age, in the end, this is still Heavenly Enterprise Star!’
When his grandfather developed the frontier back in those stays, it wasn’t like he didn’t kill people in the Star Ranking. Even today, there were at least three Domain Stage experts hiding on this planet.
Compared to Ruby Fish Star, which was Ninth Region’s administrative star, Heavenly Enterprise Star was closer to the frontier, and there were more powerful people coming and going.
“Grandpa, Xu Yuanjun hasn’t fought any battles in a long time. Could it be that he has regressed in strength and misjudged his opponent?” Lu Li asked with a frown.
“Regressed?” Lu Yiming couldn’t help throwing his head back in laughter. “You little fellow… when Old Xu got his title on the Star Ranking, your old man was still drinking milk as a baby!”
“What did I say just now? Old Xu specially visited me to say this.” This loud and boisterous old man stressed, “Specially, do you understand? He came here in person.”
‘In person? So what?’
Lu Li didn’t react for a moment, but the next moment, he was shocked.
‘Grandpa said Xu Yuanjun met him
after
the newest Star Ranking was released.’
In the past two days, there was no second starship traveling this path. In other words, Xu Yuanjun had run directly to Heavenly Enterprise Star using his own power.
The youth couldn’t help taking a deep breath. “Is this… the law of space?”
……
On the steel planet of Heavenly Enterprise Star, the most common structures were man-made buildings—cities of steel and concrete—while the least common things were undoubtedly the unmodified natural scenery.
But there was such a place near the Lu family residence.
This was a quiet valley. Crisp birdsong echoed in the mountains, giving a sense of indescribable peacefulness.
A man in green was walking in the valley. His steps were neither fast nor slow. He seemed to be admiring the scenery along the way, but his gaze always fell straight ahead.
Ahead of him was an enormous waterfall thousands of meters high; the splashing water reached even this man.
“That person has arrived. I wonder when Little Wei will leave secluded cultivation?” The man looked at the waterfall for a while and sighed somewhat helplessly.
Before the words left his mouth, he saw a magical scene appear in front of the waterfall.
The curtain of water raining down slowly pulled away, as if it was forcibly separated by some power. The waterfall slowly parted, revealing a figure behind the water.
The figure was clad in a simple military uniform. She looked somewhat fatigued, but her gaze gleamed with light.
If her acquaintances were here, they’d be able to recognize this person—it was the long-lost Hu Wei.
She had already stepped into Prodigious Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: A Note with the Word “Maes”
chapters.content:
Inside a cluster of tombs behind an ancient mansion on Heavenly Enterprise Star, a group of people in black were gathered in front of a tombstone, led by a young man in white.
The young man’s face was expressionless as he spat out one word: “Dig.”
The people behind him didn’t hesitate in the slightest and immediately started digging—at first they would hesitate, but they had done similar things countless times in the past few days, so they had long since become numb to it.
A few moments later, a coffin was placed in front of the group.
The young man waved his hand. A black blade flew out and split open the coffin’s lid, revealing the skeleton inside.
The young man dispersed the dust in the air and searched the coffin for a while, then shook his head. “Let’s check the next location.”
There was already a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood outside the tomb, with bodies strewn everywhere.
But the white-clothed youth completely ignored all this when he walked out. There was still a man on the ground who had not yet died, and he used the last of his strength to crawl up from the ground and glare at the youth viciously.
“Why… My Mai family has no enmity with you guys. Why did you slaughter my relatives and burn me…”
A black glint flashed through the air, and the man’s head had already landed on the ground before he even finished speaking.
In contrast, the youth leisurely dispersed the black sword in his hand, his steps not slowing at all throughout this.
To not allow offing stragglers to slow him down—this is where top players are superior to ordinary players.
And when a black-clothed person behind Gu Nan saw this scene, he sighed softly, “If you want to blame someone… then blame the fact that you had an ancestor called Maes.”
……
“Young Master, we’ve investigated all of the 12 remaining clues today.”
The black-clothed person, or rather, the leader of the Lu family members currently in disguise, stood in front of Gu Nan and carefully reported.
It wasn’t that this leader had a feeble nature; it’s just that Gu Nan’s methods over the past few days were too cruel and violent, so much so that even they were a bit overwhelmed by it.
The white-clothed youth was naturally Gu Nan.
He nodded to the leader to lead the group away, then sat in the mansion prepared by the Lu family, also feeling quite helpless.
It had already been four days since his arrival at Heavenly Enterprise Star, and after comparing the clues he found with information gathered by the Lu family, he finally narrowed it down to 44 plausible leads.
Gu Nan locked the word “Maes” onto ancient heroes and fierce beasts. These 44 clues were all centered around those two categories.
However, the result was… Gu Nan’s conjectures were wrong.
“Is it a living person’s name? Or is it a location name?”
Gu Nan was most afraid of these two scenarios. If it was the former, then there would be too many variables. People who weren’t local residents would never bother putting their names in the register. How could he even begin searching?
And if it turned out to be the name of a place, it would be too difficult to find information. Often, many name changes that location undergo become submerged in the flood of history, long since forgotten by modern-day people.
“Uncle.” Lin Yunyun had walked up to his side at some point and said softly, “I received an item today.”
Gu Nan turned his head in confusion and saw Lin Yunyun holding a small box. The box was entirely pink and looked full of girlishness.
Gu Nan also didn’t think too much about it. He casually opened the box and found a small paper slip lying inside, wrapped around some pink crystals.
A small line of words was written on the note:
[Military stimulant class drug: Maes]
……
In the quiet valley, Hu Wei and the man were walking side by side.
The man’s face was excited. “Little Wei, your gamble to advance to Prodigious Realm paid off, and your strength has soared. You can definitely avenge your brother now!”
But Hu Wei shook her head slightly. “Although my psychokinesis martial arts is special, it can only resist an Infinitesimal Stage cultivator at most. That person has already materialized a domain; he’s not so easy to deal with.”
The man was flabbergasted. Although he also knew martial arts, his heart wasn’t into it.
This man was named Tian Yuequan. He was merely an Acquired Realm martial artist, so he naturally wouldn’t understand the difference in power between Prodigious cultivators.
Hu Wei didn’t say anything more and just continued to walk forward, but soon stopped again.
Because an old man was already standing at the mouth of the valley.
“Teacher…” Hu Wei spoke with some difficulty. Her originally determined gaze lowered somewhat. She knew that her insistence on avenging her younger brother had wronged her teacher the most.
After all, she had forcibly accelerated her advancement despite having unstable foundations. This was akin to cutting off any hope of stepping into Void Cutter Realm—she had let down her teacher’s many years of painstaking teachings. Furthermore, her stubborn insistence on dealing with Gu Nan had also placed her teacher in a tough spot with his own family.
After all, Gu Nan was invited by Lu Zhanyu to the Lu family to help them fight a match.
But her mortal enemy had come to her home base—how could she let the other side off?
Lu Yiming looked at his favorite disciple, and after a long silence, he finally sighed softly. “This battle is your fate. I won’t help either of you. The master-student relationship between you and me ends here. You’re on your own now.”
After leaving such a sentence, Lu Yiming’s figure completely disappeared, not giving Hu Wei a chance to speak again.
Hu Wei looked at her teacher leaving in a daze, unable to come back to her senses for a long time.
Beside her, Tian Yuequan was also a little dazed. After a long while, he finally murmured, “How come Elder Lu… suddenly became so heartless?”
Hu Wei’s gaze gradually refocused. She took a deep breath and replied, “Teacher is warning me…. He doesn’t think too highly of my chances of winning. Perhaps the enemy is so strong that even he needs to be careful with his actions, and he doesn’t dare to gamble with the lives of everyone in the Lu family.”
Her words made Tian Yuequan unable to speak for a long time.
At that moment, another figure appeared beside the two. This person was wearing a black conical bamboo hat. He looked middle-aged, and his expression showed some distress.
When Tian Yuequan saw the man, he hurriedly bowed. “Yuequan greets Mr. Ye.”
The middle-aged man gave a small nod, smiling with his eyes, but his face still looked anxious. “So you’re the Tian family’s little fellow… You were only this tall when I first visited Heavenly Enterprise Star,” Mr. Ye said while gesturing twice at his knee.
Tian Yuequan looked a little embarrassed. He gave two dry coughs, not daring to speak again.
However, Hu Wei’s expression turned even uglier. “Mr. Ye, are you also here to persuade me to give up my revenge?”
“Yes.” Mr. Ye nodded slowly. “Gu Nan has already made it into the Star Ranking, with the title Crazy Warrior.”
He paused for a moment, as if he felt it was a bit cruel to tell Hu Wei this news. “A 19-year-old who received a title.”
Hu Wei had spent the recent period in closed-door cultivation, so this was her first time hearing about this. Her face suddenly sank, and she couldn’t respond for a while.
“Esteemed Guest, even you… aren’t certain you can defeat him?” Hu Wei turned her gaze to Mr. Ye, hoping she wouldn’t hear a certain answer from his mouth.
She still couldn’t believe it. No matter how talented Gu Nan was, how could he possibly be a match for the one in front of her?
The one in front of her had advanced to Domain Stage twenty years ago and was awarded the title of “Austere Sword Saint”, and he had been traversing the sea of stars for decades, but was he still no match for that guy who had only debuted a few months ago?
To her disappointment, Austere Sword Saint Ye Qinglan shook his head in the end.
“For those in the Star Ranking, one’s rank doesn’t decide victory or defeat. Everyone on the ranking is an outstanding genius. No one knows what kind of trump cards they hold.” Ye Qinglan calmly said, “I don’t fear Gu Nan, but neither can I be certain that I can kill him.”
Ye Qinglan’s follow-up explanation reassured Hu Wei a little.
‘It’s not that Mr. Ye doesn’t think he can defeat the other party, but his goal this time is to kill, which automatically raises the difficulty by several levels.’
To begin with, it wasn’t easy to defeat a powerhouse who had been granted a title, but actually killing the other party was even more difficult.
“But you can rest assured.” He added, “Since I promised your father I’ll help once, I will do my best this time.”
Hu Wei could only say a few words of thanks and ran out of things to say after that, so Ye Qinglan also left soon after.
“Little Wei.” Tian Yuequan looked at her dispirited expression and couldn’t help saying, “How about… I ask my family for help and destroy Gu Nan’s reputation?”
The Tian family was a well-known political family in Heavenly Enterprise Star. Rather than martial arts, Tian Yuequan was most familiar with political sabotage.
However, Hu Wei just shook her head. Then her gaze gradually became firm again, as if she had made some decision. She walked out of the valley on her own.
As Tian Yuequan watched her departing figure, his face showed some stubbornness.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Duel
chapters.content:
Inside the Tian family residence.
“Dad, you must help me this time.” Tian Yuequan stood in front of his old father’s desk with a serious look, as if he would kill himself if his old man didn’t agree.
Tian Tianrong looked at his only son helplessly and didn’t know what to say.
“How can I help? The struggle between two powerhouses on the Star Ranking—is this something we can interfere with?” Tian Tianrong slapped the table, hating the fact that his son can’t seem to grow a brain.
This was why he disapproved of his family leaving the military and joining the political arena back then. Consequently, very few of the Tian family’s younger generation are willing to learn martial arts now.
‘Why can’t they understand that power is everything in this world?’
Tian Yuequan was scolded so hard that he didn’t dare to raise his head, but his mouth was still saying, “Dad, you are the capital’s chairman… and it’s not like we need to fight; we can just say something.”
Tian Tianrong felt so angry that he became amused. “And two Star Ranking powerhouses will listen to my words… how? Did I become the chairman of the entire Federation or something?”
“Why won’t they listen!?” Tian Yuequan said with conviction, “Dad, as long as you speak up and request that Gu Nan and Mr. Ye have a fair fight, Gu Nan will still have to give you this face, right?”
“A fair fight?”
“That’s right. Mr. Ye is confident that he can win against his opponent. He just isn’t sure that he can kill Gu Nan,” Tian Yuequan repeated Ye Qinglan’s words from earlier today.
Tian Tianrong’s face gradually calmed down as he considered the pros and cons of this.
‘If it’s merely inviting both sides to a battle, then even if I’m unsuccessful, there still won’t be any loss for me. But if I’m successful…’ A name suddenly popped into Tian Tianrong’s head: Hu Wei!
‘Perhaps this is exactly the opportunity the Tian family needs to rejoin the military.’
As for how to lure Gu Nan to take the bait… Of course it was impossible to trick him with a few words. Tian Tianrong wasn’t stupid enough to believe that he can make a powerhouse on the Star Ranking give him face.
He lowered his head and took out a note from the drawer, on which was written a single word:
[Maes]
……
“All the information about the stimulant Maes is here,” Lu Zhanyu said as she sat under the dim light and moved over a large stack of documents.
