chapters.title: Chapter 161: Young Heroic Spirit Summoner
chapters.content:
Lin Duo really was in trouble, and it was even a matter of life and death. A high school girl like her shouldn't have encountered trouble like this.
Lin Duo's face suddenly flashed with panic upon hearing Gu Nan's pointed words, and she repeatedly shook her head in denial.
The people in the classroom didn’t have suspicious expressions after hearing this. Perhaps Gu Nan, a "King Level Heroic Spirit", had attracted most of their attention.
……
Half an hour later, Lin Duo stood alone in the corner of the school’s sports field, while Gu Nan stood quietly behind her in a gray suit.
"Mr. Gu Nan, how did you know I was in trouble?" Lin Duo showed a serious expression.
"Something unclean is clinging to you," Gu Nan casually answered without batting an eye, studying his surroundings with great interest.
This was the capital’s No.4 High School, so most of the people on the sports field were high school students.
All of them had youthful faces, but they were all surrounded by spirits of different sizes and shapes: there were some human-looking ones, some with animal faces, and some that just looked like swords.
A lively girl skipped past them while a scimitar floated behind her. This strange scene had just played out right in front of Gu Nan, but no one around her looked surprised.
Heroic Spirits were the core of this continent. This world’s entire power system was practically built around Heroic Spirits.
In fact, the locals didn’t call their own world Morningstar, instead directly referring to it as the Heroic Spirit Continent.
From their own cultivation to battles, and even wars between various organizations and nations, hundreds of millions of Heroic Spirits played important roles in all of those.
Gu Nan's words made Lin Duo feel cold and seemed to remind her of certain horrible experiences.
"Wh… What is it?" The girl's lips were white and her voice trembled.
"Nothing more than some cheap tricks; they’re not worth mentioning." Gu Nan didn't attach much importance to this and instead asked, "Have you ever heard of moon thrall or moon thrall’s child?"
Gu Nan's mission was to kill the moon thrall’s child. This mission only needed to be divided into two steps—finding the target and killing the target.
Lin Duo looked bewildered, then shook her head.
Gu Nan didn't think she would lie either, so he could only sigh secretly and consider finding information from other places.
The flow of time here compared to Star Realm was approximately 15 to 1. Gu Nan gave himself one month in Star Realm’s time to complete this mission, which meant he could stay in this plane for a little over a year.
At that moment, two men in black quickly approached Lin Duo.
"Miss Lin, you’ve had some time to consider now. What’s your decision regarding that matter?" Of the two, a bald man with sunglasses asked emotionlessly.
Lin Duo was like a cat whose tail had been stepped on. She suddenly exploded in anger. "That's a treasure my grandfather left me. I’ll never sell it to you guys!"
The bald man in black was was unconcerned. He merely smiled. "Then I’ll have to ask Miss Lin to consider this some more for a few more days."
He put a black cap on his head and added, "Our Heavenly King Corporation never coerces people to sell anything. Miss Lin can rest assured of this."
With that, he turned and left with his companion, as if he was only here to say these sentences.
Lin Duo watched the two leave and stood there with gritted teeth, but she didn't say anything in the end.
Gu Nan just watched all this. Since Lin Duo didn't speak, he wouldn't meddle in her business either. Although he was the Heroic Spirit summoned by Lin Duo, he wasn’t actually controlled by the latter.
However, there were no clues to his mission target at the moment, so Gu Nan chose to lurk in the shadows for the time being. He didn’t intend to show his hand too early.
……
In the quiet library, Gu Nan slowly flipped through an ancient text, a stack of books in front of him.
"Mr. Gu Nan, all the information you want to check is here!"
With a Bang, Lin Duo pursed her lips as she dropped another heavy stack of books onto the table, her face full of dissatisfaction.
‘Other people’s Heroic Spirits help their summoners grow and fight, but how come I have to help my Heroic Spirit instead…?’
However, Lin Duo was just an ordinary high school girl, and she didn’t have a tough personality. She could only sulk in her heart.
Gu Nan, however, didn't pay attention to her. He simply flipped through the texts. Compared with the last mission to find the Eye of Maes, this one went much smoother.
It was very easy to find clues pertaining to the phrase “moon thrall.” To put it another way, this topic was quite famous, so it could even be found in an ordinary high school library.
The moon thrall was one of the most famous Heroic Spirit kings in ancient times, but it hadn’t appeared for a long time, so not many people still remember it now.
However, it was still easy to find information on the moon thrall in the ancient texts.
"A spirit life form and a naturally formed Heroic Spirit. It’s most likely a creature unique to this plane." Gu Nan frowned slightly and concluded about the so-called moon thrall.
Heroic Spirits were existences unique to the Morningstar Plane. Of course most of them weren’t reincarnators. Instead, they were local or otherworldly powerhouses, or the projection of certain people’s strong wills.
For example, a swordsman grandmaster from another world couldn’t reach the peak of swordsmanship in his lifetime. A wisp of his obsession was chosen by the will of the Morningstar Plane and turned into a summoned Heroic Spirit.
This Heroic Spirit was based on that swordsman grandmaster—its original blueprint—but there was no mental connection between the two sides, and even their personalities differed.
The Heroic Spirit swordmaster merely inherited the actual grandmaster’s obsession and knowledge about swords. The rest of its mind wasn’t as complete, but in a way, its swordsmanship might even surpass the original.
Besides Heroic Spirits projected from someone’s obsession, there was another category of Heroic Spirits created naturally. Natural-born Heroic Spirits could already be considered living beings. Not only did they have a complete consciousness, but they were also capable of self-cultivation and self-growth, such as the moon thrall and reincarnated Heroic Spirits like Gu Nan.
Gu Nan put down the texts in his hand and slowly stood up.
In the end, this was just a high school library, so information on the moon thrall was limited to this. There was no more detailed information.
Lin Duo saw him stand up and showed a puzzled expression. "Have you finished reading?"
Gu Nan nodded slightly. "What's the matter?"
A blush appeared on the girl's face, and she said somewhat shyly, "The school is holding a Heroic Spirit Tournament the day after tomorrow. Um… Can you join me in the tournament?"
From the sound of it, the Heroic Spirit Tournament seemed like a competition in which summoners and Heroic Spirits participated together.
"Okay," Gu Nan replied casually. He wasn’t tight on time in this reincarnation, and he didn’t mind doing something irrelevant to the mission once in a while.
And as his summoner, Lin Duo might have a side quest on her.
He’d actually suffer quite a loss if he only cleared a single main mission, especially since he’d have to wait a long time to reincarnate again.
After agreeing to Lin Duo’s request, Gu Nan quickly left, leaving Lin Duo with only one sentence: "If anything bad happens, summon me."
It was common knowledge in the Morningstar Plane that a Heroic Spirit summoner could summon their Heroic Spirit back to their side.
"Ah? Where are you going…" Lin Duo hurriedly asked, but Gu Nan's figure had already completely disappeared.
Leaving the young girl alone wondering: ‘Didn’t the books say that all Heroic Spirits should follow their summoners around?’

chapters.title: Chapter 162: Han Feng
chapters.content:
Under normal circumstances, Heroic Spirits naturally followed their summoners wherever they went. Many Heroic Spirits weren’t even capable of thinking for themselves, so summoners had to continuously control them. They’d fall into confusion as soon as they left the summoner’s range.
However, a Heroic Spirit like Gu Nan was different. His behavior wasn’t controlled by his summoner, and he might even be able to control his summoner instead.
After all, those with power always had the final say in this world.
Gu Nan’s present form didn’t inherit all the power of his original body, but it was still on the level of ordinary Dao Lords. Plus, he still had access to all his skills, so it was enough for him to run amok.
He turned into a shadow and sped forward rapidly, soon coming to a corner that was blocked by figures—the two men in black who talked with Lin Duo before.
"Brother, are we really not going to use force? The time Young Master Han gave us is running out…" The other person looked slightly anxious as he asked the bald man.
The bald man, however, was very calm and curled his lips. "Our status is different now," he said. "We work for the Heavenly King Corporation, so how can we muddle along as we did before?"
As he spoke, a sneer appeared on his face. "Don't worry. Master Zhang's Heroic Spirit has been on that girl for seven days. He’ll be pulling up the net soon."
"Master Zhang?!” The person next to him exclaimed loudly, then hurriedly covered his mouth, as if that name represented something horrible. He looked very frightened.
The bald man nodded gravely. The next moment, the two men walked around a corner and found a figure blocking their way.
This person wasn’t tall. He wore a long gray suit and had no expression on his face.
But the bald man’s expression suddenly changed, because he clearly remembered that this person was standing beside Lin Duo earlier.
"Sir, who are you? Lin Duo's business has nothing to do with you. It’s best if…"
The bald man suddenly felt a pain in his chest before he finished his sentence. He hurriedly looked down and saw the stranger’s hand stabbed into his chest.
The next second, his heart was directly crushed, while Gu Nan slowly withdrew his hand, which wasn’t stained with any blood. All the blood was left inside the man's body, making the scene very creepy.
"Where is Master Zhang?" Gu Nan's cold eyes fell on the second person.
Not long ago, this person was just a street thug working under his big brother. When had he ever witnessed such a scene before? His face paled with fear on the spot. "I… I don't know! I really don't know! Big Brother, please don't kill me!"
Gu Nan lifted his foot and kicked. The man's right leg bone instantly made a sickening Crack, snapping into two in the blink of an eye.
The sharp pain from his leg made the man want to scream in agony, but shadows instantly clogged his throat, not allowing him to make any sound.
Gu Nan looked down at him from above. "If you don't know, then die… Think carefully before you speak. You only have one chance."
By the time his vocal cords were finally able to make a sound again, the man was already crying as he repeatedly said, "I know, I know it… Master Zhang met us in a bar. I'll take you there…"
……
In the evening, in a small bar called "Night Scene", Gu Nan sat alone in a private room with a glass of fruit wine in front of him, which was left untouched.
Moments later, the younger brother in black who claimed to be Ye Dong limped in.
"My Lord, Master Zhang said he'll be here soon." Ye Dong walked up to Gu Nan with a flattering smile and bowed.
Gu Nan just nodded slightly and casually asked, "What is the origin of this Master Zhang?"
Gu Nan had already asked about why Ye Dong and his elder brother were looking for Lin Duo, but Ye Dong couldn’t give the exact reason. The young master of Heavenly King Corporation wanted to buy something from Lin Duo, but the two brothers were just obeying orders, so they didn’t know much about the item.
The reason Gu Nan found them was to resolve Lin Duo's troubles.
After all, this was his summoner. Gu Nan didn't want to go out in search of mission clues in the future, only to be forced back to Star Realm because someone killed his summoner.
And trying to always keep Lin Duo by his side was too unreliable of a method.
Gu Nan didn’t actually have many ways to truly protect someone, and his enemies weren’t all fools. Once Gu Nan and Lin Duo’s relationship was exposed, it wouldn’t be difficult to kill Lin Duo.
True to his words, Master Zhang really was here soon.
Just a moment later, someone pushed open the door to the bar room, but Ye Dong’s face suddenly changed color when he saw the visitor. He quickly stood up. "Young Master Han…"
Gu Nan looked up. The newcomer was a young man in casual sportswear who looked quite outstanding. His appearance was in line with the Tall, Rich, and Handsome standards.
Young Master Han didn’t even spare Ye Dong a glance as he entered. Instead, he smiled at Gu Nan. "This humble one is Han Feng. Gentleman, what's your name?"
Gu Nan didn't answer him and asked, "Where's the person I'm looking for?"
Han Feng didn't mind his rudeness and answered calmly, "Master Zhang didn't dare to show himself in front of someone as powerful as you."
This Heavenly King Corporation’s Young Master Han Feng naturally wasn’t stupid. The fact that Ye Dong suddenly contacted Master Zhang instead of his older brother was unusual in itself.
Then, after a further investigation of Ye Dong and his brother’s movements, they easily found the bald man’s corpse, as well as the terrifying aura left by Gu Nan.
"It’s most likely a Tier 3 expert…" Master Zhang made such a judgment, which made Han Feng and the others fall silent.
They didn’t understand. It was just a single Lin Duo. Why would such a powerhouse step in for her?
However, neither was Han Feng someone who could be frightened away merely by the lingering energy at the scene. He decided to meet the other party personally.
Gu Nan's dangerous gaze fell on Han Feng, who only felt a chill rising on his back, and his trust in Master Zhang’s judgment rose a little more.
However, since he dared to show up here, he naturally had his own bargaining chips.
"You have to think carefully!" Han Feng raised his voice, as if trying to give himself courage. "Master Zhang’s Heroic Spirit is hiding on Lin Duo. I'm afraid you've also discovered this?"
From the first time Gu Nan saw Lin Duo, he knew that something unclean was clinging to her, but it was different from the species he was familiar with. It turned out to be a Heroic Spirit.
Han Feng deliberately mentioned this point because he hoped that Gu Nan would refrain from shooting the rat for fear of breaking the vase. As long as this person still wanted to save Lin Duo's life, he wouldn’t dare to oppose Han Feng. At least, not before meeting Master Zhang.
Sure enough, after he finished this sentence, Gu Nan fell silent, which made a smile appear on Han Feng's face again.
"Why do you want Lin Duo? You might as well say it. We may be able to cooperate…"
As usual, Han Feng grabbed his opponent’s lifeline and started negotiating, "As long as we can reach a consensus, Master Zhang will naturally show up."
What he didn't expect, however, was that the next moment, Gu Nan's hand suddenly shot out and twisted his head.
This Young Master Han Feng, who was as strong as an Innate Realm expert, had his head directly twisted 180 degrees. His two eyes stared at Ye Dong behind him, which frightened Ye Dong into screaming.
"If you’re dead, then he’ll naturally come out," Gu Nan casually dropped Han Feng's body and said with a straight face.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Faceless
chapters.content:
The instant Han Feng died, a wrinkled old man suddenly opened his eyes in a bungalow near the bar and blurted out, "Leave, leave now!"
A young attendant next to him asked in bewilderment, "Master, where are we going? We’re not waiting for Master Han anymore?"
The old man was precisely the Master Zhang that Ye Dong mentioned. He said with a dark expression, "Han Feng is dead… We need to go now. This place won’t stay hidden for long!"
His master’s message made the young man turn pale, and he dared not say anything else. He quickly packed up their things and prepared to leave.
Master Zhang finally calmed down a little when his disciple left in a hurry, but his expression was still ugly.
He didn't expect that the opponent would be so decisive, killing Han Feng as soon as they had a disagreement…
‘Isn’t he afraid that I’ll hurt Lin Duo?’
‘Or did we all guess wrong—he doesn’t actually care about Lin Duo’s life at all?’
‘That’s possible. For example, if he also wants that item, then… Hmph! I won’t let you get it so easily!’
A malicious glint flashed through Master Zhang's eyes.
……
"I'm back!"
A soft voice came from the front door of Lin Duo’s house. Lin Duo had already returned home, and it was her older sister Lin Ke who came back at this time.
"You're back…" Lin Duo looked listless as she walked out of the kitchen with a piece of toast in her mouth, which fell as soon as she opened her mouth, sending her into a flurry trying to catch it.
Lin Ke laughed as she watched her idiot younger sister and patted her head. "Where are Mom and Dad?"
"They called and said they won’t be back tonight." Lin Duo took another bite of toast, then stared at Lin Ke eagerly. "Sister, I'm hungry!"
Lin Ke immediately rolled her eyes and said helplessly, "I'll cook now… By the way, weren’t you going to summon your first Heroic Spirit today? Did you succeed?"
Normally, a high school freshman like Lin Duo would summon her first Heroic Spirit in school, but not all such attempts succeed. Only talented and hardworking students would be able to summon Heroic Spirits easily, but even then, the success rate was only around 20%.
Speaking of Heroic Spirits, Lin Duo suddenly became very happy. "Of course I succeeded! What's more, I summoned a King Level Heroic Spirit!"
"King Level?!” Lin Ke’s eyes widened, and she couldn't help suspecting that she had misheard.
She wasn’t a high school girl like her younger sister. As a Tier 2 Heroic Spirit summoner, she deeply understood the meaning behind King Level.
They were first-rate Heroic Spirits. Summoning them meant gaining endless honor and glory, as well as unimaginable power.
If not for the fact that it was impossible to take someone else’s Heroic Spirits or transfer Heroic Spirits between summoners, then summoning King Level ones may also represent a disaster.
"Then where’s your Heroic Spirit?" Lin Ke hurriedly asked.
"Well…" Lin Duo immediately faltered. "He had something to do and left…”
Lin Ke's gaze became strange, as if her little sister had said something stupid. "You mean, your Heroic Spirit didn't follow you? You’re not lying, are you…"
Her older sister's suspicious tone made Lin Duo angry from embarrassment. "Mr. Gu Nan is a very incredible person!"
But Lin Ke only shrugged helplessly. The two agreed that when the next opportunity arose, she would definitely introduce Mr. Gu Nan to her sister. Lin Duo then pursed her lips and went upstairs.
……
Lin Duo sat alone in her room, muttering, "Mr. Gu Nan is a King Level Heroic Spirit! Plus, he…"
She remembered what Gu Nan said to her when he was first summoned.
"Something unclean?" Lin Duo sat at the desk and took out a small box from her drawer, then stared at it.
This box was something she accidentally found when she went back to her ancestral home last time. Next to the box was a note left by Grandpa.
Lin Duo couldn't understand the words on the note, nor could she find a way to open this box.
But a few days ago, several people suddenly knocked on her door, wanting to buy the box in her hands, which piqued her interest in this box.
Lin Duo's eyes stopped on the box. She felt the inside of the box shake gently, but it also seemed to be just an illusion.
She felt her head turn heavy, and whispers stirred gently in her ear.
"Let me out… Let me…"
Lin Duo was so scared that she hurriedly threw away the box in her hands. Only then did she realize that her back had already been soaked in cold sweat. A cold breeze blew, making her body burst into chills.
Lin Duo swallowed and couldn't help taking a deep breath. "It was also like this last time… But there weren’t any strange voices last time…"
While thinking about this, she felt the coolness behind her getting heavier and heavier and subconsciously looked back.
The scene behind her made a chill shoot up from her tailbone all the way to the back of her head—a faceless woman was standing in front of her with her head lowered.
"Ahh!" Lin Duo exclaimed in horror. She picked up objects around her and threw them at the woman, then turned, trying to run for the door.
But as soon as she turned, she saw the same faceless woman again, except she wasn’t standing upright this time, but hanging upside down from the ceiling beam.
Messy long hair hung down, revealing a face as pale as white paper.
Lin Duo was almost suffocated. She felt her consciousness being constantly eroded, becoming blurred little by little.
Fortunately, her remaining consciousness reminded her of Gu Nan’s words before he left. With the last of her strength, her mind called upon her own Heroic Spirit.
Heroic Spirits could accept their summoner’s summons and directly return to the latter’s side, but at the cost of consuming vast amounts of energy that far exceeded that of an ordinary teleportation.
Ordinary Heroic Spirits simply couldn’t afford such a price. Only a Heroic Spirit at Gu Nan’s level could afford to squander energy like that.
The faceless woman slowly drifted near, almost touching Lin Duo, until a hand shot out from thin air and grabbed her neck.
Gu Nan's figure slowly walked out of the void, clutching the throat of the faceless woman with one hand. The woman began to struggle violently.
Her figure suddenly became blurred, then sharpened again, changing like this over and over.
She looked like she wanted to turn into spirit form to leave, but Gu Nan caught her, so she couldn’t escape.
"Mr. Gu Nan…" Only then did Lin Duo sign in relief. She quickly got up from the ground and hid behind Gu Nan. "J-Just what kind of person is she?"
"Person? She’s not a person." Gu Nan answered casually. This was precisely the reason he didn’t just snap her neck.
She wasn’t a person, so naturally her throat wasn’t a fatal weakness.
However, Gu Nan's words made Lin Duo's face pale again. She stammered, "N-Not a person, then could she be…"
Gu Nan turned his head to glance at the trembling Lin Duo, then lifted the faceless woman in his hand, almost sticking her blank face to Lin Duo’s face.
"Ahhhhh!" A series of screams came from the girl's mouth.
"She's just a Heroic Spirit," came Gu Nan's belated explanation.

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Hunt
chapters.content:
"Mr. Gu Nan, you’re really… really too much!"
Lin Duo's two eyebrows were so furrowed that they almost fused together. She glared at Gu Nan furiously, her little face red with anger.
Gu Nan shrugged noncommittally as he sat on a chair in front of Lin Duo's desk, while the faceless woman had been tossed aside. She currently had her head down, afraid to speak.
This was Master Zhang’s Heroic Spirit. She had acquired rudimentary awareness, but she was still far from being able to act independently.
So as long as Master Zhang wanted to save his Heroic Spirit, he must come here—this level of Heroic Spirit wouldn’t be able to withstand the cost of an emergency summon back to her summoner’s side.
Seeing that Gu Nan didn’t talk, Lin Duo could only sulk in the corner, but she couldn’t help her curiosity and soon ran to the faceless Heroic Spirit again.
Fear came from the unknown. Lin Duo didn’t feel so afraid anymore once she realized that this was just a strange-looking Heroic Spirit.
After all, many monster-type Heroic Spirits had the faceless woman beat in the terrifying appearances department.
Classmate Lin Duo, who was full of curiosity, poked the face of the faceless Heroic Spirit when she was sure that the Heroic Spirit didn’t dare to move.
"Hey… It's very elastic!" Lin Duo exclaimed with some pleasant surprise.
The faceless Heroic Spirit was captured by Gu Nan, so naturally she didn't dare to resist. She didn't have facial features either, so she couldn't even make scary faces to intimidate Lin Duo. She could only draw circles on the ground with bitterness.
"Faceless monster—a rare kind of Heroic Spirit. Their faces are the best defensive weapons, which can absorb most of the damage," Gu Nan explained. He didn’t read all those books in the library for nothing.
As he spoke, he also raised a hand casually, and a small black dagger immediately shot out and sank into the faceless monster’s face.
The faceless monster seemed to whimper, although nobody knew where the sound came from. Some light blue crystalline liquid oozed out of the part that had been stabbed by the small sword. It didn’t look scary. On the contrary, it looked rather beautiful.
The black dagger gradually turned into a shadow and dissipated, and the faceless monster’s wound healed quickly, as if it had never been hurt. Only a few drops of blue liquid on the ground proved that the earlier scene had happened.
Lin Duo, however, felt her mouth twitch a few times. She suddenly lost any interest in researching the unknown and hurriedly gave up.
Moments later, Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes, then picked up the faceless monster with one hand and said to Lin Duo, "I'm going to see someone. See you the day after tomorrow."
"Ah! S-See you the day after tomorrow…" Lin Duo didn’t fully process Gu Nan’s words yet and just replied subconsciously, but Gu Nan's figure had already disappeared without a trace.
Just then, there was a gentle knock on her door, and her sister's head poked in.
"Time to eat, silly Little Sister… Huh, why is your room so messy?" Lin Ke looked at her in confusion.
Only then did Lin Duo exclaim loudly. She remembered what she forgot to do… She actually didn’t call her older sister up to meet Mr. Gu Nan!
……
Night had fallen, and Gu Nan, carrying a faceless monster with one hand, jumped rapidly from roof to roof.
It wasn't until he passed a house that he suddenly stopped. With a vertical jump, he broke through the roof and landed inside the house.
Inside the house, Master Zhang was gaping at all this.
"You…" He watched Gu Nan land expressionlessly, still clutching his faceless Heroic Spirit with one hand, and hurriedly pleaded, "My Lord, please show mercy!"
He jumped up and said quickly, "This humble one is Zhang Yibai. I'm here with information on Heavenly King Corporation’s Han family!"
A faint smile finally appeared on Gu Nan's expressionless face. "You’re a smart person… Tell me."
Hear Gu Nan, Zhang Yibai finally sighed in relief and wiped the sweat from his forehead.
He knew that in front of true powerhouses, it was meaningless to beg for mercy or threaten them. His only key to survival was to tell them the information they wanted.
If not for his reluctance to part with his Heroic Spirit, he wouldn’t have run here full of wishful thinking. As it turned out, he was caught before he even decided to show himself.
"Mr. Han Jun is the grand Heroic Spirit summoner of Heavenly King Corporation. His 70th birthday is in half a month. Han Feng only wanted to buy the item from Miss Lin Duo because he planned to prepare a birthday present for his grandfather."
Zhang Yibai explained Han Feng's goal in the simplest words.
Gu Nan frowned and asked, "What's the item in Lin Duo's hands?"
Zhang Yibai gave him a careful look and whispered, "It's a young naturally formed Heroic Spirit."
Understanding flashed through Gu Nan's eyes, and he nodded slightly. Naturally formed Heroic Spirits were very rare, and correspondingly, most of them were powerful, so they were valuable commodities.
But…
"How did you guys know that Lin Duo has this?" Gu Nan asked.
"That, I don't know…" Zhang Yibai shook his head, but when he saw Gu Nan's frown, he hurriedly added, "But the Han family must know. After all, Han Feng was acting on his father's orders."
"Take me there,” Gu Nan said as he threw the faceless monster to Zhang Yibai.
Zhang Yibai agreed immediately, his thumping heart finally settling down. In his opinion, he had passed the most dangerous phase. At least this one wouldn’t kill him easily anymore.
This Master Zhang, who grew up in the slums, had always been proud of his ability to understand people.
He didn’t have any enmity or grudge with this Lord; rather, it was the Han family who had any enmity with him!
‘As long as I’m willing to switch to his side and help him deal with the trouble known as the Han family, then I might even be able to turn this disaster into a blessing…’
‘This is a Tier 3 bigshot, at the same level as the Han family’s elder, after all!’
……
In an elegant villa in the center of the city, a middle-aged man in indigo pajamas was sitting on a sofa, a naked girl with light makeup in his arms.
The young girl plastered her body to the middle-aged man's hand and let him play with her, laughing softly. "Boss Han, you…"
Before she finished speaking, she was interrupted by a ringtone from Boss Han’s cell phone.
Han Zong, who was originally in high spirits, immediately frowned a little when he saw the number displayed on his mobile phone, waving for the girl to step aside.
The girl flattened her mouth in displeasure but didn’t dare to say anything, so she scooted aside, still naked. Only then did Boss Han pick up the phone.
"Well, Zhang Yibai, have you found that brat Han Feng’s whereabouts?" Boss Han asked as soon as the call connected, without even waiting for the other side to speak.
"I’ve found him, but…" Zhang Yibai's voice faltered a little. "The situation is a little complicated. I'd better tell you in person."
Boss Han was concerned about his son, so he couldn’t spare the energy to waste any words on Zhang Yibai. He said impatiently, "Then what are you waiting for? Come over quickly; I’m at home.”
But he didn’t hear the expected agreement. After a slight pause on the other side of the phone, Boss Han heard Zhang Yibai say some strange words.
"My Lord, it's confirmed. He's at home…"
Boss Han stared blankly. Before his brain fully processed those words, his window glass had already shattered, and two figures stepped into his home.
One of them was a young man in a gray suit, with a bone-deep cold indifference on his face, while the other was Zhang Yibai, who had just talked with him on the phone.
Boss Han seemed to understand something, and a chill began to appear in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Side Quest—Twin Heroic Spirits
chapters.content:
The pitch-black dagger instantly sliced through the void. Boss Han couldn’t even say a word before the dagger pierced his throat.
His body slowly crumpled, blood pouring out of his throat and soaking the expensive carpet on the floor of the villa in the blink of an eye.
Zhang Yibai was a little dazed. He didn't expect Gu Nan to attack so quickly. There were so many things he didn’t have the time to say, and he didn’t even have a chance to show his own usefulness in front of Gu Nan.
He was even more confused: ‘This Lord seems like he only came here to kill people… If so, then what’s his actual goal?’
‘Whether it's for the sake of the naturally formed Heroic Spirit or whether he wants other resources, that information can always be tortured out of Boss Han by leaving him alive for the time being.’
On the other hand, the naked girl was already screaming, but she forcefully covered her mouth soon after for fear that Gu Nan would kill her as well.
Gu Nan didn't even look at Zhang Yibai and the girl. He just walked slowly inside the house. With a gentle flip of his hand, a small box appeared in his hand.
This was the box Lin Duo had just earlier today. For some reason, it was already in Gu Nan's possession.
When this box was in Lin Duo's hands, it often shook, making people feel that something inside wanted to come out. But it was incomparably still in Gu Nan's hands.
That is, right until Gu Nan took it out. The box shook a little more, pointing Gu Nan in a certain direction.
"Sure enough…" A smile spread across Gu Nan’s face. With his many years of dungeon-clearing experience, he knew missions could be hidden behind any abnormal occurrence.
Lin Duo's box was obviously abnormal. Naturally, it couldn’t hide from Gu Nan's eyes.
So he found the time to get this box and brought it to Boss Han’s villa in passing. As expected, it elicited a reaction from the box.
"My Lord." Zhang Yibai couldn’t help feeling anxious when he saw that Gu Nan didn't plan to leave. "Let's leave quickly, there are still many experts hiding here… Ah!"
Before he finished, black light flashed across the room, and the same dagger also appeared in his throat.
Zhang Yibai looked at Gu Nan in astonishment. He couldn't understand why the other party would attack him.
‘Doesn’t he intend to deal with the Han family? Doesn’t he need me to provide him information? Even if he needs nothing from me… I clearly didn’t show any signs of disloyalty, so why…’
Naturally, nobody answered Zhang Yibai's questions, nor would he find any answers on his way to the afterlife.
In fact, Gu Nan had no grudge against the Han family. He just wanted to kill all the Han family members who knew about Lin Duo in order to ensure this high school girl’s safety.
As for killing Zhang Yibai, it was also for the same reason. Since he no longer had any use but still knew about Lin Duo’s existence, then he could just die.
Gu Nan's figure disappeared around the corner, and the naked girl choked back her fear. She found some random clothes on the ground and wrapped herself in it, then ran out in a hurry.
……
The object calling to the small box turned out to be another box hidden in a room in the deepest part of the villa.
If not for the connection between the two boxes, it really wouldn’t have been easy to find this place. Even if he could enter this room, it would still be hard to find the other box.
But Gu Nan definitely wouldn’t miss the second box, because as soon as he stepped into this room, his eyebrows slightly wrinkled, and he swung a sword downwards at a corner of the room.
"Wait! Don't attack, I'm on your side!" A miserable shout came as a figure floated out.
The description “floated out” was appropriate, because this was an old man with white hair who only had an upper body; his lower body was a cloud of smoke, just like the ghosts from novels or comics.
This was a Heroic Spirit that didn’t belong to a single individual. Rather, it was a special Heroic Spirit that guarded these two boxes.
As a Heroic Spirit himself, Gu Nan was particularly sensitive to other Heroic Spirits. As soon as the two boxes neared each other, he sensed that the other party appeared from the other box.
"You’re the Heroic Spirit from these two boxes?" Gu Nan took both boxes in his hand, then looked at the bearded old man and asked.
"That’s right." The bearded old man raised his head. "I am the guardian of the Sun Moon Enchanted Box."
"Sun Moon Enchanted Box?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrow slightly. He looked down at the two boxes. Sure enough, although the boxes had similar styles, the patterns on them were different.
The box Lin Duo inherited from her ancestor should be the sun box. It had a rising sun pattern.
Seeing Gu Nan's expression, the bearded old man's face looked more lofty, like a mysterious expert. "Young people nowadays are really too impulsive! Well, why aren’t you coming over to give this old man a hand?"
Gu Nan remained expressionless, completely unaffected by his words, but he gently raised his right hand.
The bearded old man felt a pull, and his body quickly flew to Gu Nan while the latter grabbed his neck.
"How can the Sun Moon Enchanted Box be opened?" Gu Nan's flat voice asked.
Although he was a Heroic Spirit, the choking feeling was real. The bearded old man was immediately annoyed, and he only felt a rush of anger— ‘Is this really how you fucking ask for help?!’
So he angrily turned his head to the side without answering, secretly sneering in his heart.
‘This Sun Moon Enchanted Box is a treasure that’s been passed down for many generations. You have to receive both the acknowledgement of the two boxes and my acknowledgement before you can become the treasure’s owner. Only then can you open it. But this fellow in front of me…’
‘Hmph, a youngster who doesn’t know the immensity of heaven and earth!’
Gu Nan didn’t have much of a reaction at the old man’s lack of response—to begin with, it was just a casual question asked out of habit to see if he could trigger a mission.
Absentmindedly tossing the old man aside, he picked up the moon box from the villa in his right hand and then began to grip it tightly and forcefully.
When the elderly Heroic Spirit saw this, he almost laughed out loud.
‘This person… actually wants to open the Sun Moon Enchanted Box with brute force?! That’s simply…’
Crack.
A clear cracking noise came, instantly cutting off all of the old man’s thoughts and leaving his mind blank.
Crack, crack.
Two more cracking noises sounded, and in the spot where Gu Nan was gripping, two cracks had already appeared on the moon box, and they were still expanding.
"No… Please don't…" The elderly Heroic Spirit hurriedly floated in front of Gu Nan, his voice beginning to tremble, but he didn't know how to stop Gu Nan's action.
Gu Nan, of course, completely ignored his words, and the next moment, the moon box cracked open completely.
A wisp of smoke floated out of it, forming a little girl in mid-air with a pair of transparent wings behind her. She was lying flat down in front of Gu Nan.
And at the same time, the Evil God Temple in Gu Nan's brain shook gently, and a message emerged.
｢Side Quest: Protect the twin Heroic Spirits—the sun and moon spirits｣
Gu Nan suddenly felt refreshed. As expected, his trip here wasn’t wasted effort. Lin Duo’s strange ancestral box really did have a side quest!
Twin Heroic Spirits—sun and moon spirits?
Gu Nan looked at the little girl in front of her. Sure enough, there was a crescent moon mark on her forehead, and she was surrounded by the dense power of the moon.
If he only looked at the quality of this power, it was even purer than Yue Qianleng’s.
‘As expected of a naturally formed Heroic Spirit…’

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Sun
chapters.content:
Heroic Spirits were specialty products of Morningstar Plane that possessed both the characteristics of living beings and creatures of law. Some could come back from the dead, while others could reproduce naturally.
Gu Nan's side quest this time, the twin Heroic Spirits, belonged to the latter category. They were almost no different from living beings.
Gu Nan didn't know who forcibly sealed these two Heroic Spirits and even used a treasure like the Sun Moon Enchanted Box—an item that could give rise to a guardian Heroic Spirit was naturally a treasure.
But that didn’t matter. Since the side quest had nothing to do with the box, then Gu Nan didn’t mind destroying it.
Of course, while Gu Nan didn’t mind, someone else did.
After Gu Nan destroyed the moon box with brute force, the bearded old man’s image swayed and flickered, his form blurring until his entire body resembled a ghost.
He trembled as he fluttered in front of Gu Nan, crying while begging Gu Nan not to break the other box while hurriedly opening the seal of the sun box.
Since the bearded old man voluntarily opened the second box, Gu Nan naturally wasn’t interested in opening it with his bare hands again.
As soon as the sun box was opened, a puff of smoke also came out, but this time it was more lively and fiery.
This time, what formed in mid-air was a Heroic Spirit that looked like a small boy. He was already awake, staring at Gu Nan and the old man with big eyes.
After staring at the two for a long time, he finally confirmed that Gu Nan was the one in charge. His little face tightened and asked, "Who are you?"
"In a certain sense, I’m your father."
……
When Lin Duo returned to her room, she was still expecting to see Gu Nan already inside, waiting to give her a surprise.
The answer, of course, was that she thought too much.
"What even! And he actually claims to be my Heroic Spirit. He’s too irresponsible…" Classmate Lin Duo muttered and sat down on the bed resentfully.
The next moment, Gu Nan's figure slowly appeared in front of her while holding the hands of two children behind him—a boy and a girl—that looked like they were carved out of jade.
Lin Duo’s first reaction was slight embarrassment. After all, she had been caught red-handed speaking ill of Gu Nan, but her attention was soon pulled away.
"So!! Cute!!!”
After a heaven-piercing roar, the two children quickly fell into Classmate Lin Duo's hands. The heart of a young girl made her burst with amazing potential.
“What… What are their names?” Lin Duo asked Gu Nan while rubbing the two children’s faces.
"You can call me 'Moon', Big Sister," the moon spirit spoke before Gu Nan had a chance to respond, revealing a gentle smile.
"Ohh, whoa, whoa, whoa, what a nice voice!" Lin Duo couldn't resist the amazing charm of the sun and moon spirits, and her gaze shifted to the sun spirit. "What about you?"
The little boy sun spirit turned his head away coolly and completely ignored her.
Gu Nan answered for him, "Ri
[1]
."
Lin Duo stared at him blankly, getting the feeling that something didn’t sound right, but Gu Nan didn't give her a chance to say more. He said directly, "They are twin Heroic Spirits, you can sign a contract with them."
Gu Nan's main mission was to kill the moon thrall’s child. Protecting the sun and moon spirits was just a side quest. But before everything else, he first had to ensure Lin Duo’s safety.
So he decided to have Lin Duo sign a contract with the twin Heroic Spirits so that he could protect them together, and if necessary, he could sacrifice the Heroic Spirits to protect Lin Duo.
For a top player, sometimes it was acceptable to sacrifice a side quest for more profit.
"Ahhh! Is that really okay?!” Lin Duo’s head was completely overwhelmed by joy as she asked excitedly.
While a Heroic Spirit summoner could contract with multiple Heroic Spirits, this was bound to dilute the effect of the summoner’s blessings on the Heroic Spirits, so it was necessary to obtain the consent of the already-contracted Heroic Spirits before making contracts with new ones.
If the Heroic Spirit summoner forcibly signed a new contract without the old Heroic Spirit’s consent, it could easily result in the old Heroic Spirit’s betrayal.
As for Gu Nan, he had no such problem at all; he never expected Lin Duo to help him with any blessings.
Lin Duo was excited about this. Let alone the fact that “twin Heroic Spirits” sounded powerful no matter how she looked at it, she absolutely had to contract with them because they looked like a shota and a loli!
"Thank you, Mr. Gu Nan. You really are a good person!" Even though she was excited, Lin Duo didn't forget to send Gu Nan a good person card.
Gu Nan shamelessly accepted it, while the sun spirit curled his lips. "Is this idiotic older sister our contractor?"
Lin Duo's face suddenly darkened. Fortunately, the moon spirit saved the scene in time, "Big Sister, we’ll be relying on you in the future!"
‘As expected, little girls are cuter…’ Lin Duo complained in her heart.
But soon she would understand that the honest and frank boy was actually cuter.
……
Early the next morning, when Lin Duo went downstairs with the sun and moon spirits, her sister Lin Ke almost got breakfast up her nose.
"This… What is this? ! Who are they!" Lin Ke pointed to her sister. "Lin Duo, you’re not even that old! But you… But they…"
Lin Duo was taken aback, then immediately realized that her sister had misunderstood something, and her face turned bright red. "Sister, let me explain. They’re not…"
The sun spirit still had a cool look on his face, while the moon spirit tugged on Lin Duo’s clothes and mumbled, “Mom, I’m hungry.”
Lin Duo: "…"
……
After throwing the sun and moon spirits to Lin Duo, Gu Nan left her house again.
The sun and moon spirit protection mission didn’t specify a time limit, so based on Gu Nan's past experience, it would probably last until the end of the dungeon—upon clearing the main mission—or until the dungeon was forced to end early.
There was no reward for failing the dungeon’s mission, so now he had to find a way to complete the main mission.
At present, the main clue Gu Nan had was only the words “moon thrall’s child.”
He had already identified the moon thrall as a kind of ancient Heroic Spirit, but what did its child mean? Was it a descendant of the moon thrall, or was it a Heroic Spirit summoner connected to the moon thrall?
In addition, there was the moon spirit in the side quest. Since they both had “moon” in their names, did the moon spirit have anything to do with the moon thrall’s child?
All kinds of questions emerged in Gu Nan's mind. In the absence of sufficient information, Gu Nan was unable to make more judgments, but he planned to conduct an in-depth investigation now.
He found mentions of the moon thrall Heroic Spirit in Lin Duo's high school library, so Gu Nan immediately visited all the major libraries, trying to find more clues.
But disappointingly, he didn't find any new or useful information.
Perhaps modern data’s understanding of the phrase “moon thrall” was only to that extent, and there was no more in-depth information to be found anywhere.
Just when Gu Nan couldn't find a clue, a voice with a flattering smile sounded in his ear, "My Lord, are you looking for the moon thrall?"
The guardian Heroic Spirit of the Sun Moon Enchanted Box was currently a blurry-looking old man, floating around Gu Nan carefully.
The box was still in Gu Nan's hands. He forgot to return it to Lin Duo yesterday. Anyway, the latter's attention was glued to the sun and moon spirits, so she didn’t notice anything amiss.
"You know about it?" Gu Nan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"It’s also an ancient legend, so this old man naturally knows about it."
The old man subconsciously tried to look mysterious, but when he saw Gu Nan's dangerous gaze, he quickly smiled apologetically. "It's just that this old man is like this now… My Lord, please have mercy and save my life!"
T/N:
[1]
Ri (Sun):
In a certain context, can mean fuck
