chapters.title: Chapter 174: Invitation
chapters.content:
“Tian Tian?” Lin Duo, who was still holding a chicken leg, seemed a little flabbergasted and also pleasantly surprised.
When the apocalypse hit, people suddenly lost all contact with many relatives and friends. For example, Lin Duo and her older sister never heard from their parents after the apocalypse.
But in such a situation, no one had the heart to pay attention to the ones they could no longer contact. Everyone could only think about how to live to see tomorrow.
Under such circumstances, Lin Duo really was pleasantly surprised to hear news of Tian Tian again.
Tian Tian was her best friend and classmate in high school, so knowing that she was still alive was more important than anything else.
Lin Ke nodded. "She came here about three days ago. I wasn't at home either that time, but I saw her today."
"How is Tian Tian?" Lin Duo quickly asked.
"She didn’t look too good." Lin Ke recalled Tian Tian’s appearance when she showed up during the day and sighed. "Oh right, she said that if she doesn’t come find you three days from now, she wants you to please help her investigate a certain place."
……
Inside the central research lab, Gu Nan held a girl by the back of her collar and looked down at her from above. This was precisely Tian Tian, Lin Duo's best friend.
Tian Tian found it hard to suppress the fear in her heart. She never imagined that she would run into Gu Nan here.
‘Isn't he Lin Duo's Heroic Spirit? How could…’
"You said you’re Tian Yuan's daughter?" Gu Nan spoke with great interest. "Little girl, I regret to inform you that your father… is a Heroic Spirit."
"You’re lying!” Tian Tian glared hatefully at Gu Nan and shouted loudly, "My father has been a professor of the federation for over ten years. How can he be a Heroic Spirit?!”
Gu Nan shook his head lightly and casually threw her down. He waved his hand, about to cut her with a sword.
He originally wanted to see if Tian Tian knew something, but now, he’s afraid that she was simply Tian Yuan’s adopted daughter and nothing more…
‘Wait, why would Tian Yuan adopt a daughter?’
Gu Nan's movements suddenly stopped, and a sudden flash of inspiration seemed to hit his mind. A certain idea suddenly appeared, and his eyes couldn’t help falling on the little girl's face.
Tian Tian was startled by his gaze. That burning gaze seemed like a predator looking at its prey. It wasn’t the kind of gaze a little girl like her could withstand.
And at this time, Gu Zhaoyue also happened to walk into the lab and saw Tian Tian sitting on the ground. He immediately got a fright.
"Damn it, I've clearly forbidden…"
Gu Nan waved his hand to stop his sentence. Tian Tian probably entered the lab through a secret door Tian Yuan left behind.
Perhaps she found Tian Yuan's old notes, so she came to this lab.
Gu Nan offhandedly knocked Tian Tian out and asked, "What's the matter?"
Gu Zhaoyue quickly bowed. "My Lord, the other two large settlements hope to join hands with us. They hope that the leaders of all three camps can meet. Will you…"
"You can attend this kind of thing," Gu Nan said impatiently.
He knew why Gu Zhaoyue asked this.
The three largest camps in the capital, besides the Star & Moon Camp established by Gu Zhaoyue, were the Glory Camp and the Hero Camp.
These three camps could be said to control over 80% of the capital’s entire resources.
Such control naturally corresponded to amazing authority and status. Although Gu Nan could generously delegate power to Gu Zhaoyue, Gu Zhaoyue could never dare to truly think of himself as the boss.
He knew very clearly that power was the foundation of all this, and the power of the person in front of him was enough to easily destroy Gu Zhaoyue.
"Yes. Additionally, there's another matter…" After receiving Gu Nan's reply, Gu Zhaoyue added, "Glory just sent over some news. Moon thralls are gathering in a location in West City."
"The meeting of the three leaders is also to discuss this matter."
"Oh? Moon thralls gathered there naturally?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows alightly. He was very interested in this.
"It’s still unclear. I only know that the place is very dangerous. The people from Glory who went to investigate never returned,” Gu Zhaoyue reported the truth.
Gu Nan nodded a little. He had instructed Gu Zhaoyue a while back to pay attention to abnormalities. Gu Nan’s goal was an intelligent moon thrall, and once such a moon thrall appeared, it was bound to cause abnormal changes in the moon thrall population.
"I see, you can leave now." Gu Nan threw Tian Tian at him. "Take care of this little girl; don't let her die."
He paused, then added, "I'll be there for the meeting of the three camps."
"I understand." Gu Zhaoyue’s face showed some excitement. The leaders of the other two settlements were both stronger than him, so persuading Gu Nan to attend was a good thing for Gu Zhaoyue.
Gu Zhaoyue’s figure soon disappeared, and Gu Nan finally felt excited.
There had been no progress for half a month. Although Gu Nan could control his emotions, he would nevertheless feel a little agitated.
But it wasn’t like he could abandon this mission. Gu Nan knew that dungeon missions were his foundation. Star Realm could only provide him with Evil Value, but he couldn’t earn any points in Star Realm.
However, both Evil Value and points were indispensable in order to improve his strength.
Things were finally turning for the better—whether Tian Tian was a special existence remained to be tested, while there was probably something strange in West City as well, waiting to be explored.
……
At Lin Duo's home, after hearing her older sister's narration, she realized what place Tian Tian was referring to.
"The place she mentioned should be the forbidden area in the middle of the camp, right?" Lin Duo bit her finger, wondering, "Elder Gu said we must never enter there…"
Lin Ke also nodded. "I wonder what exactly is in it. Elder Gu’s action of forbidding everyone entry into that place really is strange."
The two sisters joined this camp relatively early.
However, that lab seemed to have existed ever since the camp’s inception, and no one had ever entered it—except Elder Gu himself.
To their surprise, the sun spirit suddenly spoke up, "That Gu person is hiding something."
Lin Duo rolled her eyes at him. "Little Ming, even though Elder Gu's orders are a little strange, he never forced us to do anything. How can you say that…"
The sun spirit frowned but didn't speak again.
However, the moon spirit added to her brother’s words, "My little brother and I once snuck near that place, and there was a strong aura of moon thralls there… We suspect that a group of moon thralls are being raised inside that lab."
"What did you say?!” Both of the Lin sisters immediately exclaimed.
If moon thralls were being kept right in the middle of a settlement for human survivors… Then the camp’s leaders were treating the lives of thousands of people too lightly!
"Impossible!" Lin Ke suddenly shook her head fervently. "Elder Gu could never do such a thing. What would he gain from this?"
At present, nothing inside a moon thrall’s body was useful, so it was meaningless to keep moon thralls in captivity.
"She's wrong," Little Ming interrupted. His indifferent tone and calmer expression gave the two sisters some hope.
"I'm the elder brother," he finished seriously.
"…This isn’t the time to care about this!!” Lin Duo slammed her hand onto the table in exasperation.
After a while, the atmosphere in the room finally became serious again. Lin Ke frowned. "If Little Ming and Little Yue's senses are correct… then we need to investigate what exactly is inside that lab."
"But how do we investigate?" Lin Duo pursed her lips. "Senior Gu won't let anyone enter. We won’t get to enter unless he leaves this camp for another matter."
Lin Ke said helplessly, "Yeah! But even if he has to leave, it’s not like he’ll let people know about his absence…"
However, there was a knock at the door right then, and a man's voice sounded from outside, "Your Excellency Lin Duo, Elder Gu wants me to inform you of a matter."
Lin Duo and her sister looked at each other, then opened the door and asked, "What matter?"
The man said respectfully, "Tomorrow is the day when the leaders of the three camps will meet. Elder Gu sent me to invite you to travel with him."

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Three Major Camps
chapters.content:
In the early morning at the Star & Moon Camp, faint light was scattered on the wet ground, making this tumultuous world show some rare tranquility.
Lin Duo walked out of the house and looked back somewhat hesitantly. "Big Sister, are you sure you don't want to go with us…"
After receiving the invitation from Elder Gu yesterday, Lin Duo didn't hesitate and agreed to attend the meeting. After all, compared with the twin Heroic Spirits’ speculations, Gu Zhaoyue's fame and prestige inside the camp was the real deal.
"Of course. Don't you remember that my Heroic Spirit is a possession type?" Lin Ke answered a little helplessly.
In the original continent, possession type Heroic Spirits were the most sought-after type. They could fully bring out a Heroic Spirit user’s fighting experience, so almost all of the true powerhouses had this kind of Heroic Spirit.
But in the apocalyptic era, the status of possession-type Heroic Spirit users plummeted.
The reason was very simple. Moon thralls were so infectious that any injuries in battle could turn a person into a moon thrall. Thus, Heroic Spirit summoners were reluctant to engage the moon thralls in close quarters.
On the contrary, summoning-type Heroic Spirit users became the main resistance against moon thralls because they could control more Heroic Spirits.
Heroic Spirits were immune to the infection. Even if some of them had low fighting experience or combat awareness, they were more than enough to deal with moon thralls.
Therefore, in the Star & Moon Camp, possession-type Heroic Spirit users like Lin Ke were more involved in logistics and teaching and wouldn’t casually venture outside.
Lin Duo also nodded helplessly but couldn't help saying, "Big Sister, don't sneak into that lab…"
After yesterday, Lin Duo and the others were all curious about the central lab, but Elder Gu’s invitation came first, so they could only set this matter aside for the time being.
"Okay…" Lin Ke pushed her younger sister forward. "Do I need you to tell me that? I won't do such a dangerous thing!"
Lin Duo had to leave. When she was gone, Lin Ke finally revealed a bright smile.
"If I can’t go, then can't I just find someone else who can?"
……
When Lin Duo arrived at the gathering place outside the Star & Moon Camp, there were already many people there.
The purpose of this meeting wasn’t simply for the three camps to meet each other, but it was also to discuss the investigation of the strange behavior of the moon thralls gathered in West City—Lin Duo had already heard about this.
Moon thralls were the enemy of all human beings. If they gathered together due to an abnormality, then of course it was necessary to investigate clearly, or else it would be too late if they just waited for bad things to happen.
"Hey Lin Duo, I didn't expect to see you here!" When a blue-haired young man saw Lin Duo’s arrival, he walked up in surprise and greeted her.
"Senior Zhang!" Lin Duo was also very surprised. "Are you in the camp too? I haven’t seen you here before…"
Senior Zhang smiled. "I only managed to escape from the moon thralls’ encirclement a couple days ago. Fortunately, I was taken in by Elder Gu. Otherwise I would’ve been in a tough spot."
The so-called encirclement referred to places in the city that were occupied by the moon thralls. It was generally very difficult to break through them and escape.
This Senior Zhang used to be Lin Duo’s classmate, so he was also acquainted with Lin Duo.
"From the encirclement? That’s awesome…" Lin Duo looked at him with some admiration in her eyes.
As Lin Duo began chatting with Senior Zhang, Gu Zhaoyue and Gu Nan were standing in a hidden place.
"My Lord, Lin Duo has joined the team," Gu Zhaoyue's voice was slightly low and constrained a hidden but deep curiosity.
This girl, Lin Duo, was recruited into the camp on Gu Nan’s instructions. He didn't know her before this.
And this time, Gu Nan mentioned Lin Duo by name again, insisting that they take her with them as well. This couldn’t help making Gu Zhaoyue curious— ‘Just what exactly is the relationship between Gu Nan and this little girl?’
"Mm." Gu Nan just nodded indifferently and didn't say much.
The reason he wanted to take Lin Duo with them was simple. Only by placing Lin Duo under his watch would her safety be absolutely guaranteed. Gu Nan didn’t trust other people’s ability to protect her.
When Gu Zhaoyue saw his reaction, he couldn’t help having some suspicions in his heart and spoke up, trying to test him, “That person is called Zhang Ying. He is a talented Heroic Spirit user well-known in the original capital. He broke out of a moon thrall encirclement two days ago and joined the camp."
"He has three Heroic Spirits that are quite good at fighting. Although he’s very young, his strength is already close to Tier 3."
When he said this, Gu Zhaoyue lowered his eyes but sneaked a glance at Gu Nan out of the corner of his eyes. He really wanted to see Gu Nan’s expression in order to discern if his guess was correct.
But it was a pity that Gu Nan had no expression at all. He looked like he was simply watching two strangers.
‘Did I guess wrong?’ Some doubts emerged in Gu Zhaoyue’s heart.
……
The meeting place of the three camps’ leaders wasn’t far from their respective settlements. Everyone arrived in just a few hours—if the spot was too far away, no one would dare to come here with a large group.
There were only a dozen people in the Star & Moon Camp, but their strength was mostly between Tier 2 and Tier 3, so they could be called an elite team.
Led by Gu Zhaoyue, they soon arrived at the scheduled place, while the other two camps arrived at about the same time.
The leaders of the Glory Camp and Hero Camp were a man and woman respectively. They couldn’t help frowning simultaneously when they saw Gu Zhaoyue leading the team.
The man was Zhu Long, the leader of the Glory Camp, and the woman was the founder of the Hero Camp. She had never revealed her real name and called herself "Caiyue".
When the teams gathered, they greeted Gu Zhaoyue, "Elder Gu, that one…"
Their main goal for this meeting was to meet the true ruler behind Star & Moon Camp. Otherwise, there was no reason to organize all this just to meet Gu Zhaoyue—after all, they already knew him.
But Gu Zhaoyue just smiled and replied, "You two don't have to worry. My Lord has already arrived."
The man and woman exchanged glances and looked around in confusion. At the same time, they fully spread out their senses but still didn’t find any abnormalities.
Just as they couldn't bear their doubts and were about to ask more questions, a voice traveled over leisurely from behind them.
"Let's talk over there."
The two suddenly turned, startling the man right behind them—a member of the Glory Camp.
Zhu Long frowned and asked, "Gao Xuan, did you see anyone talking just now?"
"No…" The member named Gao Xuan shook his head blankly.
His expression didn't look fake, and there was also no need to fake it. This made the two leaders feel their hearts sink and even get chills.
The next moment, something that made their jaws drop happened.
They saw a pitch-black figure actually stand up slowly from their two shadows and make an inviting gesture.
This shadow had no facial features at all and looked more like a humanoid created entirely out of shadows. It was precisely because of this that made people feel more terrified.
"Gentlemen, please." Gu Zhaoyue treated this scene as normal and said with a light smile.
The two could only exchange another glance. Fighting back the chills in their hearts, they both ordered their teams to settle down while they followed the shadow to the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Surnamed Zhao
chapters.content:
Zhu Long and Caiyue slowly followed the shadowy figure.
"You guys wanted to see me?" The shadow turned his head, and his figure was gradually revealed, turning into that of a normal human.
If they hadn't witnessed him stand up from their shadows, the two leaders would never have thought that he was abnormal.
The two looked at each other and said at the same time, "We’ve long heard your great name…"
Gu Nan looked at them suspiciously. "You guys know my name?"
Since coming to the Morningstar Plane, Gu Nan had only ever mentioned his name to Lin Duo. He didn’t even reveal it to Gu Zhaoyue. If these two knew his name, then he’d really have to reconsider them.
"Er…"
‘Looks like it’s just a courtesy greeting,’ Gu Nan thought.
Seeing this situation, Zhu Long nodded faintly at Caiyue, then said, "In that case, let's introduce ourselves first… I’m Zhu Long, captain of the federal government's First Special Police Brigade."
At the same time, Caiyue also spoke, "Fang Caiyue, Director of the government’s Special Operations Division."
"So you’re surnamed Zhao," Gu Nan deadpanned.
The two both stared blankly, but Zhu Long still spoke righteously, "The federal government was in chaos when the apocalypse hit, which led to the present situation. Now that the government’s chain of command has been re-established, I hope Lord can accept the command of the nation."
Fang Caiyue also said, "It’s every citizen's duty to maintain national stability… Of course, as long as the Star & Moon Camp can accept national command, the military certainly won’t treat you two badly."
Before Gu Nan could speak, Gu Zhaoyue beside him was already so angry that he laughed. "With just a single sentence, you want to take away the camp that I worked so hard to build?"
If he’d known beforehand that this was their purpose, Gu Zhaoyue would never have come. He was glad that he brought a lot of people this time, otherwise things might get ugly for him if they started fighting…
As if seeing through Gu Zhaoyue’s thoughts, Fang Caiyue revealed a meaningful smile.
……
Several people were currently standing in the middle of the Star & Moon Camp’s gathering place, constantly preaching something.
The leader was Gao Xuan, the person standing behind Zhu Long earlier.
"Everyone in Star & Moon, the catastrophe brought about by the moon thralls won’t last long. Have you ever thought about how you will live your life after the apocalypse is over?" Gao Xuan said this to all the people in the Star & Moon Camp.
"Brother Gao is right. The moon thralls are generally weak. When the federal government frees up its hands, it won’t be hard to deal with them."
"Yeah. Besides their large numbers and their infectious characteristic, the moon thralls aren’t much of a threat."
A few people seemed to be chatting casually. They discussed the moon thralls’ weaknesses one by one and seemed certain that the apocalypse wouldn’t last long and peace would come soon.
This argument was also quite popular. After all, humans were always more receptive to optimistic predictions, and not many people liked the current apocalypse.
At the very least, Zhang Ying looked very encouraged. Not only did he quickly become friends with Gao Xuan and the others, but he also went around persuading all the people in Star & Moon Camp.
His first goal was naturally his acquaintance Lin Duo.
"Lin Duo, you also don't believe the apocalypse will last much longer, right? If only the current government can stand and take the lead. I will definitely answer their call!"
"That’s true in theory…" Lin Duo subconsciously nodded. It’s just that she felt like something about his words was off but couldn’t pinpoint it.
Zhang Ying added, "And a warm-hearted person like Elder Gu must think the same way. What do you think?"
Lin Duo tilted her head in thought, but in the end she could only agree with him.
At this time, another figure walked over from the other two camps. Lin Duo felt that his appearance was very familiar, as if she’d seen him on TV before.
"Dear Heroic Spirit summoners of the Star & Moon Camp, many of you may know me. I am the mayor of the former capital. My name is…"
……
There was a burst of commotion from the camp. Gu Zhaoyue frowned and glanced over. With his hearing, most of the words could still be heard.
“Government… Mayor… A way out…”
There was no need to even think about it. Just a few key words like these were enough for him to guess what the other party did.
"You guys…" The old man was so furious that his nose almost became crooked. He never thought that the other party was actually trying to steal his people from right under his nose!
But since they claimed to act in the name of the government, their words were most certainly attractive to everyone in the camp…
Zhu Long's slightly dark expression turned a little apologetic, and he gave a military salute. "I'm sorry, Elder Gu. We must use extraordinary means in extraordinary times. After all, this is related to the national interest—"
The strange sound of a longsword entering his body interrupted his sentence. Zhu Long turned his head in astonishment, only to see Gu Nan's expressionless face.
The black sword rose gently. In front of Gu Nan, a Heroic Spirit summoner’s fragile body was as weak as paper and was instantly cut in half.
"Bastard!" Fang Caiyue's face changed wildly. Her body suddenly grew larger, and a green mist started to surround her.
She was an extremely rare possession-type Heroic Spirit user, but she didn’t fear the moon thralls’ infection because her possession-type spirit was of an even rarer variety.
A wind elemental!
Fang Caiyue's face began to twist. Her body turned into green ripples and quickly became a wind elemental, then swung her palm at Gu Nan.
Without any hesitation, Gu Nan countered with an even faster palm. A frightening amount of the power of shadows instantly poured out, completely suppressing the wind element.
It might not have been so easy if she really was a wind elemental, but the level of law a Heroic Spirit summoner could use via possession was truly too low.
Faced with Gu Nan's Tier 3 top-grade power of shadows, it could only be crushed.
Fang Caiyue was immediately beaten back to her original form and coughed up blood like crazy. Her entire person flew out and landed in the camp on the other side.
The people who were having a heated discussion were startled by this scene, and when they saw who had just landed there, they were even more shocked.
"Sister Caiyue!"
"Boss! What's wrong with you, Boss?!”
Gu Nan and Gu Zhaoyue's figures also walked out slowly from the side, the black sword in Gu Nan's hand still stained with blood. It was clear at first glance who had attacked her.
A person with bloodshot eyes rushed up to fight Gu Nan. "Don't you dare hurt our Boss—"
It was a pity that he didn't have the chance to finish his lines before Gu Nan sliced him in two.
"Kill them all. Don't let any escape." Gu Nan said to Gu Zhaoyue, "When you wrap up things over here, recruit all their survivors."
“Yes!" Gu Zhaoyue had just been schemed by Zhu Long and Fang Caiyue, so he was still full of anger, just waiting for a chance to vent.
He casually slapped a person to death, then shouted, "Kill! Kill them all!"
The two enemy camps suddenly lost their commanders and were caught off guard. Even though the overall strength of the Star & Moon Camp was slightly weaker, Gu Zhaoyue was still there, so they could definitely win this battle.
"Wait! !” A loud roar came from the crowd, and a slightly bald middle-aged man came along with a serious expression, his eyes almost blazing.
He was precisely the mayor of the capital.
"The Glory Camp and Hero Camp are protected areas recognized by the federal government. They are part of the military!" Mr. Mayor was outraged. "What are you planning to do?! This is a crime! You are commiting treason!"
Everyone's movements in the Star & Moon Camp couldn't help but pause.
It had been less than a month since the apocalypse broke out, and the authority of the federal government was still deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. What's more, the discussion and persuasion the two camps attempted earlier wasn’t completely useless.
Mr. Mayor felt a little relieved when he saw this. He knew that as long as he could persuade the majority, he would win.
Nobody could oppose a group.
Turning to Gu Nan, he said with a dark expression "Sir, I don't care who you are, your behavior has already—"
The dark tip of the sword came out from his back.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Persuasion
chapters.content:
The mayor of the capital died with unresolved grievances.
Gu Nan's swordsmanship wasn’t very good. In fact, he didn’t even know any swordsmanship to speak of. All he could rely on was pure speed—however, most of the time, speed was enough.
The mayor was pierced by a sword. He wasn’t even a Heroic Spirit summoner, so all his vitality was cut off instantly, and he turned into a corpse, falling down slowly.
While Gu Nan said nothing, the shadow clones began to slowly appear everywhere, hunting down people in the other two camps one by one.
Since Star & Moon Camp’s people couldn’t do it, then he’d do it himself. Gu Nan would never force other people with words; he was used to using his fists.
Fang Caiyue hadn’t died yet. She struggled to her feet and glared at Gu Nan coldly.
She was also a soldier, and her temperament was determined to the point of ruthlessness, so she was able to become the commander of the Special Operations Division.
"No one can fight against the country. You can destroy our bodies, but you will never defeat our will!" Fang Caiyue shouted powerfully.
Gu Nan shrugged and merely responded with a sword.
He had no interest in NPCs’ wills. Destroying their bodies was enough.
The slaughter still continued. Gu Zhaoyue originally wanted to take part in it, but Gu Nan's actions were too fast. In other words, the shadow clones were too efficient at killing.
In just a few breaths’ worth of time, over a dozen corpses were scattered on the ground, and the shadow clones had already finished their harvesting and turned back into shadows.
"M-Mr. Gu Nan…” Lin Duo stared in disbelief at Gu Nan's familiar and expressionless face.
Ever since he left that day, Gu Nan hadn’t appeared in front of her again. If it wasn’t for the Heroic Spirit contract, she might’ve even thought that Gu Nan had died in the apocalypse.
Even though it was confirmed that he was still alive, Lin Duo tried to summon Gu Nan countless times, but all of her calls were like pebbles falling into the sea.
She never thought that she would meet Mr. Gu Nan again in such a situation.
Lin Duo wanted to come forward to talk but was grabbed by a small hand. She turned her head in amazement and saw the twin sun and moon spirits standing beside her, shaking their heads gently.
The little girl didn’t know what to do for some time, while others in the Star & Moon Camp mostly kept quiet out of fear.
None of them knew Gu Nan and didn’t even know whether he was friend or foe, but the way he killed Heroic Spirit users like butchering chicken was enough to make them afraid.
The scene returned to silence, and after Gu Nan gave Gu Zhaoyue a couple of orders, his figure disappeared again, while Gu Zhaoyue began to organize people to explore.
The reason behind the moon thralls gathering in West City must be investigated. This was also the goal of Gu Nan’s current trip.
……
Inside the actual Star & Moon Camp, Lin Ke stood in a corner with little light, quietly watching a figure fade away, but her face didn’t look very good.
"Looks like there really is something wrong with that lab." A man stood beside Lin Ke, his eyes showing interest. "I’ve already sent three consecutive waves of people there… but none of them have returned?"
Lin Ke replied with a straight face, "Of course the place Gu Zhaoyue has under strict guard isn’t so simple."
The man glanced at her. "Since the apocalypse hit, our organization can no longer mobilize as many people. I hope you don't unnecessarily consume our human resources."
"What do you mean?!” Lin Ke was furious. "No.4 High School is the origination point of the moon thrall disaster in the capital. Shouldn't we investigate the secrets hidden by the Star & Moon Camp?"
The man just sneered without replying.
The moon thrall catastrophe caused chaos in the federal government, which created a great opportunity for their organization. It was only natural to investigate the Star & Moon Camp, but if he’d known that Gu Zhaoyue was temporarily away, then he would’ve informed the organization’s top level officials a long time ago.
At the very least, Gu Zhaoyue was still a Tier 3 figure. It seemed that the traps he left behind weren’t something a few little shrimps could handle.
‘This is all due to Lin Ke's selfish motives!’
‘Her younger sister is an important figure in the Star & Moon Camp. I heard that Gu Zhaoyue even personally recruited her. Of course Lin Ke doesn’t want to fall out with the Star & Moon Camp completely…’
The man's eyes flickered, hiding his thoughts.
……
Inside West City, the team from Star & Moon Camp was advancing smoothly, cleaning up the moon thralls along the way.
The current moon thralls were stronger than the originals, but their average level still wasn’t high. With this elite team’s power, it wouldn’t be long before they arrived at their destination.
However, in order to prevent accidents, everyone still took turns to rest, so as to ensure that the team always kept itself in pristine condition.
Once again, Lin Duo stepped down from the outer ring and went back to the inner ring to rest—in reality, she didn’t really have to rest. All her fights were entirely handled by the sun and moon spirits themselves.
Normal summoned Heroic Spirits generally weren’t very intelligent, so Heroic Spirit users needed to be on the battlefield to command them. This was also why they were inferior to possession-type Heroic Spirit users.
But the sun and moon spirits were different. Not only did these two kids have good brains, but they also had a lot of combat experience, so Lin Duo didn’t need to do a thing for the entire fight.
The reason she still stepped down from the outer ring was simply because she was afraid the sun and moon spirits would tire out and wanted to give them time to recuperate.
Zhang Ying stood beside Lin Duo, and when she stepped down, he leaned up to her and whispered, "Lin Duo, the person who appeared just now… Do you know him?"
Zhang Ying’s question was abrupt, but it made Lin Duo panic.
She didn’t need to think much to realize that Zhang Ying had heard the words she inadvertently blurted out when she saw Gu Nan earlier.
Looking at Lin Duo's reaction, Zhang Ying received his answer without having to listen to her answer.
He said in a low voice, "You have to think carefully, that person killed a government official!"
"But right now…"
Zhang Ying was very saddened. "How can a single person's strength defeat the entire nation? The federal government will definitely settle its debts after the moon thralls have been eliminated."
"Even if the government can be lenient…" Zhang Ying’s face was full of righteousness. "Is it even worthwhile for us to associate with people who are as arrogant as that?"
Lin Duo turned silent. Of course she couldn’t win a verbal argument against Zhang Ying, and even her heart didn’t agree with Gu Nan's wanton killing of the people in the other two camps.
‘After all, they’re the government’s army…’
But Gu Nan was her Heroic Spirit. This made her heart very conflicted, but she couldn’t come up with any countermeasures.
Zhang Ying asked again, "Lin Duo, tell me honestly, is that person deeply related to you?"
"Ah? How do you know…" Lin Duo was startled and subconsciously said.
Zhang Ying showed such a knowing expression. "Don't worry about this for now… Have you considered that you will also be dragged down if that person is designated as a wanted fugitive in the future?"
For Lin Duo, who grew up in peacetime, the word "wanted fugitive" was still very lethal. It meant that she’d have to say goodbye to the good old days.
Lin Duo never considered this aspect before, but now she really started to panic.
After all, she was just a lucky high school girl.
Not far away, the sun and moon spirits were watching this scene coldly. Little Ming, the sun spirit, seemed to frown. He tried to interrupt several times but was stopped by the moon spirit next to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: The Moon Thralls...
chapters.content:
"Why didn’t you let me speak up? No one knows better than us just how powerful that Gu Nan is,” the sun spirit whispered.
"If we have his help, the process of destroying the moon thralls will definitely go much smoother."
However, the little loli moon spirit shook her head slightly. "There was no such person in our ancestor’s prophecy… Only our contractor can end the moon thrall calamity."
"Prophecies are never entirely accurate!" The sun spirit rebuked tit for tat.
Although he never talked much in front of other people, he didn’t have that kind of bad habit when faced with the moon spirit, his twin. He even gave a harsh retort.
However, the moon spirit still shook her head slightly. "That guy… We don't know anything about him. It's better to keep our contractor away from him."
……
The trip into West City went smoother than expected. After just two hours, they arrived at the source of the abnormalities shown on the map.
This made everyone's spirit pick up slightly, and even Lin Duo, whose expression had been looking rather ugly, revealed some curiosity.
The cause of the moon thralls’ abnormal behavior was soon revealed to them. To everyone's surprise, it turned out to be a towering blue tree.
It looked like a gem, too beautiful to be true.
"This is a moon thrall… No, to be more accurate, it’s an existence entirely made from the power of the moon, just like the moon thralls," Gu Zhaoyue was knowledgeable and spoke up immediately.
Moon thralls, like many elementals, were creatures with only a single law. Their bodies were composed of the power of the moon, but because there was no moon element in the world, they weren’t considered elementals.
And the reason why moon thralls were called moon thralls was because they often worshipped the moon on moonlit nights due to the nature of their powers.
The composition of the mutant moon thralls had been contaminated, so they wouldn’t feel a special fondness for the moon anymore, but the giant tree in front of everyone recreated this scene.
Moon thralls covered the ground. Some glowed red while others glowed blue. They crawled quietly under the giant tree, kneeling.
The arrival of the line of people from the Star & Moon Camp seemed to have triggered these moon thralls. The sea of moon thralls all looked up towards the humans.
The continuously glowing light from the moon thralls made everyone’s scalps tingle.
"Run!" Gu Zhaoyue commanded.
There was practically no hesitation. Almost immediately, everyone began running towards the rear, as if they’d be torn to pieces if they even slowed down a little.
Lin Duo was still in a daze and was dragged away by the sun and moon twin spirits.
Quantitative change will lead to qualitative change. The number of moon thralls gathered here was too terrifying; even an elite squad would be instantly submerged.
"No wonder we didn't feel too much pressure on our way here…" Gu Zhaoyue inwardly sighed. "I'm afraid all the nearby moon thralls have crowded into this single area."
"It's just… What the hell is that?"
A picture of the giant tree flashed through Gu Zhaoyue’s mind, and he looked behind him again.
‘That person should have a way to deal with this many moon thralls, right?’
……
Gu Nan naturally had a way.
Even if the amount of moon thralls in this area was so dense that it’d be inconvenient to sneak in even with Hidden Shadow, Gu Nan still had many other methods.
He could use Shadow Form to create clones and lure the monsters away, then kill the moon thralls little by little. He could also use Shadow Form to forcibly break through, then switch places with his true body… But he chose the simplest method.
Fly in.
That’s right, moon thralls had a very embarrassing shortcoming—that is, because their overall strength was weak, even today, moon thralls with flight abilities had still yet to appear.
Heroic Spirit summoners in the Morningstar Plane didn’t temper their own bodies too much, so very few people had the ability to fly. This was true even among Tier 3 experts.
Heroic Spirits capable of flight weren’t uncommon, but they also had various shortcomings such as not being able to bring passengers, not being able to sustain their attacks for a long time, and only being able to fly at low altitudes.
Only Gu Nan, a visitor from another world, was familiar with flight.
Even in Star Realm, flight was almost an instinctual power among Prodigious cultivators.
Just like that, Gu Nan leisurely flew in from mid-air, and although the moon thralls on the ground started roaring, they couldn’t do anything about him.
It wasn’t like they were completely helpless. Many moon thralls were thrown up directly by their companions, trying to hit Gu Nan.
But Gu Nan wasn’t like the army’s fragile helicopters. So what if a few moon thralls could reach him?
Moments later, Gu Nan had stopped in front of the giant tree. "They’re not so much worshipping this tree as they are waiting for the fruits on it…"
Gu Nan could see them clearly. On the branches of the giant tree were many blue fruits, which looked like sparkling crystals. However, they were the same color as the giant tree, so it was difficult to tell them apart from a distance.
This towering tree was so tall that the moon thralls couldn’t reach these fruits, and they couldn’t even get close to the giant tree, so they could only wait for the fruits to fall naturally.
Even without using his senses, he could still feel the incredible power coming from the fruits.
‘Could a moon thrall’s child be created through this kind of fruit? How did this tree grow?’ Many questions flashed through Gu Nan's mind.
But Gu Nan's hand didn't stop. He stretched out his hand and picked a fruit from the tree, then threw it casually into the sea of moon thralls below.
The entire picture seemed to freeze for an instant, and in the next second, the moon thralls in this area—which numbered as high as 100,000—all rioted at once.
Screaming, roaring, and tearing sounds rang out everywhere, and countless moon thralls flocked to the place where the fruit fell.
The lucky moon thrall who was hit by the fruit directly swallowed it, but before it even had time to digest, it was instantly torn into pieces by its companions.
After all, those who relied entirely on luck wouldn’t get far in life.
One of the characteristics of moon thralls was that they could devour and assimilate each other.
However, they normally didn’t have the urge to devour their own kind. In ancient times, the number of moon thralls never reached such an absurd amount, so most people never realized they had this characteristic.
The only reason Gu Nan knew this was because Tian Yuan had used this method to forcibly implant the contaminated “infection” attribute into the moon thralls’ bodies.
Now, too, the power of that fruit hadn’t been digested yet; it was still contained in the lucky moon thrall’s body, so its corpse was constantly swallowed up and assimilated by its companions.
And the moon thralls who "ate" him were in turn torn up and eaten by more moon thralls…
The fruit’s nature as an energy source meant that no energy from the fruit was lost in this exchange—it was simply dispersed into countless moon thralls’ bodies.
This power held a fatal allure to moon thralls. The moon thralls’ attacks on each other continued. Over 100,000 moon thralls had become large chunks of mutilated flesh in just a few breaths.
The number of moon thralls was getting smaller and smaller, and the power of the fruit was becoming more and more concentrated. The final winner was about to be decided.
Gu Nan had been watching all this coldly. At this moment, he couldn't help but feel energized—could this fruit result in the birth of a child of the moon thrall?
With a thunderous roar, a huge moon thrall as tall as three or four people finally killed his opponent and enjoyed the power of the fruit by himself.
And the Evil God Temple in Gu Nan's brain also shook slightly, and a message arrived.
｢Side Quest: Level the moon thrall’s king to Tier 3｣
Gu Nan’s expression suddenly darkened. ‘It was only one word off. This is the moon thrall’s king!’

chapters.title: Chapter 179: A Scary Picture
chapters.content:
The appearance of another new side quest meant that the dungeon’s rewards would reach the next level. This should originally be a very happy thing.
However, there was something called the gap between expectations and reality.
Originally, Gu Nan was anticipating finishing the main mission in one fell swoop, but he didn't expect that the creature that finally emerged after eating the fruit wasn’t actually his assassination target.
However, one of the characteristics of a top player was that their mentality would never collapse. No matter how many traps the game has, if he steps on them all, there will always be a day when he clears the game.
Gu Nan quickly calmed down and carefully studied the "monster" in front of him.
The power of the bizarre giant tree’s fruit and 100,000 moon thralls were all concentrated into one body…
The final result was the winner in front of Gu Nan, whose body was twisting and changing crazily. Sometimes it became human, and sometimes it twisted in weird angles.
The monster’s shape even became flat for a while, then expanded rapidly.
Powerful energy fluctuations emanated from it, so terrifying that no surrounding creature dared to approach. Only Gu Nan observed it silently from beginning to end.
Gu Nan knew that just the fruit alone might not achieve this effect. The intense effect was also due to the enormous number of moon thralls gathered here.
Nearly half an hour later, the huge moon thrall finally gradually stopped morphing, and its figure also stopped at a height of nearly five meters.
Although it wasn’t as exaggerated as its rapidly expanding body during the transformation, it was still much taller than ordinary moon thralls, which made it extremely conspicuous.
Its appearance was also very different from before. It was no longer the almost humanoid appearance that moon thralls had, and there were no obvious animalistic features either. The strange thing was that it had some new additions.
Two arms and a pair of wings.
The Evil God Temple had labeled this fellow as the moon thrall’s king. Not only did it grow new arms underneath its ribs, but it also grew a pair of fleshy wings behind it, which looked majestic.
But from Gu Nan's point of view, the new creature wasn’t actually that strong. Rather, it seemed like it had barely reached Tier 2, which was equal to the current strongest moon thralls.
The fruit didn’t seem to have given him strength, but more like… evolution.
Gu Nan picked another fruit, threw it in front of him, and asked with a smile, "Still want to eat?"
The king of the moon thralls looked at the fruit in confusion, sniffed it twice with his nose, then shook his head and set aside the fruit. Instead, he smiled at Gu Nan fawningly.
Although his smile was slightly ugly, it was enough to make Gu Nan deeply moved.
‘He actually has intelligence?’
‘Does killing him count as completing the mission?’ Gu Nan's mind immediately came up with this idea, and his gaze suddenly turned dangerous, which scared the moon thralls’ king into shrinking away.
But Gu Nan immediately rejected the idea. First, this big fellow was the "king of the moon thralls" certified by the Evil God Temple, and second, it didn’t meet Tian Yuan's definition of the moon thrall’s child.
A human who still retains their intelligence throughout the entire infection process would be the moon thrall’s child.
Gu Nan picked up the fallen fruit from the ground and took the rest of the fruits from the giant tree—a total of five or six fruits—then left with the moon thralls’ king.
This big guy seemed happy to follow Gu Nan.
"For the time being, I’ll call you No.1… Forget it, let's call you Big Brother
[1]
," Gu Nan looked at the six fruits in his hand and said.
……
Inside Lin Duo's home in the Star & Moon Camp.
Lin Ke was sitting in front of the tea table at home with black tea in her hand, but she couldn’t drink it. In contrast, the man sitting across from her looked much calmer.
Just as Lin Ke's irritability became more and more obvious and the man opened his mouth to speak, the screen in front of them suddenly lit up, then dimmed.
The two perked up at the same time and hurriedly checked.
This was the last photo sent back by the person who went to explore the lab—the technology of Morningstar Plane hadn’t developed to the point of being able to broadcast live footage yet.
Two photos were quickly developed. The first one was actually pitch-black, bewildering them.
"How can it be all black? Unless he’s already entered the lab, and there’s a completely dark environment?" The man frowned and analyzed.
Lin Ke didn't speak but silently agreed with him. It was only when they saw the second picture that they gasped.
The perspective of the second photo was very strange. It seemed to be taken with the camera on the ground. At the front of the picture was a pair of legs that were still standing.
These were that explorer’s legs; the two were very sure of that.
And the camera was on the explorer’s forehead, which meant… his head had been cut off!
This detail made both of them feel chills at the same time, and the background of the second photo was even more alarming.
There were countless large cultivation tubes, some of which were empty, while others were still in operation. And placed inside them were… precisely moon thralls!
"To think he’s actually raising moon thralls in the middle of the camp… This Gu Zhaoyue really is bold!" The man couldn't help but grunt, but his voice was somewhat proud.
This alone was enough to instantly plunge the Star & Moon Camp into chaos. Furthermore, he might even be able to use this photo to negotiate with Gu Zhaoyue and turn him into one of the organization’s people!
Lin Ke was equally shocked by this, but she quickly frowned again. "Something seems off… Why is there no enemy in front of him?"
"Maybe it was a sneak attack from behind. What's so strange about that?" The man said dismissively.
In front of the explorer’s legs in the photo, only the explorer’s shadow was slowly stretching out, but there was no trace of the enemy. However, this wasn’t impossible to explain.
"That’s not quite right. After being beheaded, the head falls behind him, indicating that the enemy should be in front of him… could it be an invisibility-type ability?"
Lin Ke was still frowning, but before she could say anything else, a burst of footsteps sounded, and the figure of the man suddenly disappeared.
"I'm back…" Lin Duo's listless voice spoke as she slowly pushed the door open and entered.
Lin Ke acted like nothing had happened, casually putting away the two photos and coming over with a surprised look. "Why did you return so soon? I thought you guys were going to spend the night at that meeting place."
“Wah!” Lin Duo threw herself into her sister's arms, almost crying out loud. She was full of grievances and didn't know where to start talking.
The return journey was far faster than the journey there—after all, it was a desperate rush to run away, so none of them had the energy to pay attention to dangers in their surroundings.
With the help of the sun and moon spirits, Lin Duo had no difficulty running back to the camp. It's just that a very difficult adventure actually ended like this; it really made the girl full of helplessness.
Lin Ke comforted her, "I'll heat up dinner. Eat first, and we can talk slowly after eating."
Lin Duo just whimpered and nodded, while Lin Ke went to the kitchen.
Moments later, she picked up the food and turned around, only to find her vision go dark for a second—Lin Duo was standing right behind her.
"What are you doing?! You scared me…" Lin Ke rolled her eyes and placed a hand on her chest.
"I just want to see what yummy food we’re eating!" Lin Duo's mood seemed to have recovered, and a smile appeared on her face.
Lin Ke said helplessly, "Don't stick so close to me next time… Oh…"
Lin Ke seemed to understand something. Her left hand jerked involuntarily, causing the porcelain bowl to suddenly fall to the ground and shatter.
"That first photo… No wonder there was no one in front of him!"

Big Brother, Second Brother, Third Brother… Gu Nan is going by the Calabash Brothers naming convention again
