chapters.title: Chapter 180: Moon Thralls Footsteps
chapters.content:
Just as Lin Ke finally understood the meaning behind the photo, pondering the details, Gu Nan was sitting in his lab. A dark shadow stood beside him and was slowly reabsorbed into his body.
Shadow Form could be used in many ways. Gu Nan could only use it in battles before, but after his power over shadows reached arcana, the skill could be used for other things.
For example, he could conjure up many shadows and give them different commands, which was precisely what Gu Nan had done—one was permanently stationed by Lin Duo’s side, and one was also placed in the research lab.
However, unlike the shadow clones close to him—which felt like an extension of his body and could carry out extremely specific commands—shadow clones far away from the true body could only execute some simple commands.
The one beside Lin Duo received the order to protect Lin Duo from death, while the one in the lab received the order to kill all trespassers.
When Gu Nan reabsorbed the shadow clone into his true body, things that the clone heard and saw became memories Gu Nan could read and browse through.
"A few bugs…" Gu Nan's slightly cold eyes swept across the faces of the intruders but didn’t recognize anyone or find anyone of interest.
After being beheaded by the shadow doppelganger, their corpses remained in the laboratory. Gu Zhaoyue had taken them away to investigate.
Moments later, Gu Zhaoyue’s figure walked into the center of the lab and came to Gu Nan's side.
"My Lord, I finished investigating. Before the apocalypse, all these people came from an organization called Nighthawk," Gu Zhaoyue wasted no time with extraneous words and just reported directly.
"Nighthawk?"
Gu Zhaoyue nodded, then handed over a document in passing—oral narrations about an entire organization would never be more comprehensive than written words.
Gu Nan skimmed through the document, extracting all the information, and smiled faintly.
"An organization whose mission is to subvert the federal government but dares not to even engage in terrorist attacks?" Gu Nan commented contemptuously.
"Nighthawk" took absolute freedom as its organizational purpose and had always been fighting against the government, but the most striking thing they had done was just kidnapping a top-level rich official, and they even let him go in the end.
If it was Gu Nan, he would dare to say, "Give me thirty players, and I’ll steal even the head of state's wife for you."
Casually tossing aside the information about Nighthawk, Gu Nan said to Gu Zhaoyue, "Don't worry about them. Come and see our new comrade in the revolution."
"Big Brother." Gu Nan waved at the back room.
Gu Zhaoyue raised his head in disbelief, then his eyes almost popped out.
He saw a big fellow four or five times the size of an ordinary moon thrall with wings on his back and four arms, striding forward and pounding the floor.
"My Lord, this is… a moon thrall?" If not for the other party’s obvious aura, Gu Zhaoyue would hardly dare to believe it.
"This is the king of the moon thralls," Gu Nan corrected, "our king of the moon thralls, Big Brother."
Classmate Big Brother smiled at Gu Zhaoyue in a simple and honest manner, then watched Gu Nan eagerly.
Gu Nan waved his hand, and a giant hand of shadows grabbed a moon thrall from a tube and threw it in front of Big Brother. The latter grabbed the moon thrall and started munching away without saying anything.
This moon thrall was still alive, and when half of its head had been bitten off, it awakened completely and struggled in pain.
Its power naturally couldn’t match Big Brother’s. No matter how hard it struggled, it couldn’t escape the inevitable end.
It took almost three or two seconds for the moon thrall to be swallowed by Big Brother, not leaving a single bone. Only the shrieks that seemed to be still echoing and the blood all over the place could prove that it had ever lived.
Even Gu Zhaoyue, a Heroic Spirit, was shocked by this scene.
Because he clearly sensed that Big Brother’s strength increased a little after he ate that moon thrall.
‘He can enhance his strength by eating moon thralls?’
‘There are hundreds of thousands of moon thralls waiting outside!’
He couldn't help but look at Gu Nan. “My Lord, where did you find a monster like this? That tree…"
“But, it's not enough to just have one Big Brother…" Gu Nan ignored Gu Zhaoyue. After introducing Big Brother, he said, “Give me the addresses of the other two camps."
"My Lord, do you want to…”
Gu Nan didn't speak, but the endless bloodshed that seemed to be hidden in his eyes fully demonstrated what he planned to do.
……
In the Glory Camp, a group of people in military uniforms were having a meeting around the round table. There were men and women, old and young, but they all had one thing in common—they were soldiers!
It was no longer the amateur locusts who used to order around the experts, but real soldiers.
The apocalypse brought an unexpected advantage for the army. That is, those who just leeched off the army but didn’t contribute anything could no longer maintain their high positions, and only the truly capable got a higher position.
The eleven people sitting here were all leaders of their respective forces. They were the ones who slaughtered their way out with a bunch of soldiers when headquarters had fallen silent.
But at this time, the eleven soldiers all had expressions as heavy as water.
The news that Zhu Long and Fang Caiyue's teams were completely annihilated in West City finally traveled back.
Although there were no witnesses, the corpses were still lying there, and it was clear at first glance whether they died to moon thralls or human companions.
"Impudent! Too impudent!" An old man slammed the table angrily. "This Gu Zhaoyue is simply overstepping the law!"
"Elder Yan, the most important thing now is how we should deal with the Star & Moon Camp,” a young man beside him said with a frown.
In reality, Glory and Hero were all on the same side. Both camps had already chosen to unite, and Zhu Long and Fang Caiyue were their spokespeople.
"No one can doubt Zhu Long and Fang Caiyue’s strength. If the Star & Moon Camp can annihilate them all, then no matter whether it was a sneak attack or something else, we can't act rashly."
"Can't act rashly—don't tell me we have to sit here and wait for death?!”
"There are moon thralls in the area, so their main forces can't come here…"
As a result of the eleven-people conference, no one could convince anyone, especially when confronted with a dilemma.
"Don't argue anymore." In the end, the oldest and most prestigious old man spoke, and everyone kept silent.
"Elder He, please choose a countermeasure."
"Elder He, I will listen to you!"
Elder He’s eyes looked around the crowd, and he nodded a little. "Instead of arguing here, it's better to… Hmm?"
Before Elder He’s voice fell, all of them suddenly felt a light breeze. An additional figure had appeared on one side of the round table.
This person was dressed in a gray suit, expressionless, and holding a blue fruit in his hand.
The eleven soldiers stood up at the same time, and several people shouted, "Who are you?! How did you enter?"
That person’s calm eyes swept around the table, but he didn't answer them. He just showed a small smile. "These materials are pretty good. I hope Second Brother won't let me down."
As he spoke, he released the seal in his hand, and the smell of the fruit slowly began to escape.
The people present couldn't understand his words, but as the smell drifted away, everyone could clearly feel the shockwaves traveling through the distance.
Those were the moon thralls’ footsteps.

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Target, Research Lab
chapters.content:
Strange energy fluctuations slowly emanated from the fruit.
Although none of the people present recognized this fruit, that dense and heavy power was enough to make them apprehensive.
Neither questions nor curses could move Gu Nan. In the next moment, eleven shadow clones stood up behind everyone and sliced away…
"Hm? There's another one who ran away?" Gu Nan sat still, looking at one side.
A young figure was rapidly running away, but a shadow doppelganger caught up to him before he could run very far and hacked him to death.
With Gu Nan's present strength, dealing with these Heroic Spirit users whose physical strength were lacking was as easy as beating up children.
Gu Nan's true body floated up again, standing in mid-air, while the fruit was left on the table.
He wasn’t worried that someone would take it away, because no one can leave this camp alive anymore.
Attracted by the fruit’s power, countless moon thralls began to sprint towards the camp, and the people who dared to block their way were torn apart.
The people in the Glory Camp could be said to have suffered an unfortunate disaster. A flood of moon thralls swarmed in crazily. A large number of humans didn't even have a chance to escape and were directly drowned in the tide of moon thralls.
As for those with the ability to resist… Most of them were bitten to death and turned into moon thralls.
Most people were helpless in the face of an absolute quantitative advantage.
"Little Wu, run quickly…" A mother struggled to shout while trying her best to throw a little boy out, but before her voice fell, the moon thralls behind her had already dragged her into the swarm.
Listening to the clear chewing sounds behind him, Little Wu, who just turned seven, ran forward desperately with tears in his eyes.
He hung his head and didn't dare to look back. His heart was full of fear and hatred. The pain of helplessly watching his mother's tragic death made him extremely miserable.
‘I also want to become a Heroic Spirit summoner. I want to fight like my father, to…’ Little Wu came to a sudden stop before he finished that thought—he had reached the middle of the camp in front of the round table.
The fruit glowed faint blue, while Gu Nan stood quietly in mid-air.
Unexpected rescue from death’s door, a reclusive expert, the start of a good-for-nothing’s counterattack… Little Wu had never heard of any of these phrases before, but that didn’t stop his brain from thinking up similar scenarios.
He hollered at the sky, "Mister, please save me, I…"
Little Wu's voice hadn't spread far yet when a moon thrall appeared behind him, tearing him in half.
Gu Nan looked down in confusion, only to see a small figure being torn apart, and said with some regret, "I didn’t even get to see if it was a loli…"
……
Inside Star & Moon Camp’s lab, Gu Zhaoyue’s figure had long since disappeared, but Tian Tian was still tied to the central pillar, unable to rest all night.
The exhaustion made her both tired and hungry. Her lips were chapped, and she didn't want to say a word.
However, at this time, a big head swayed back and forth in front of her eyes while holding up a moon thrall corpse that had its head torn open, almost hitting her face.
"Get… Get lost!" Once again, Tian Tian was so nauseated looking at the brain that she vomited stomach acid. Then she roared at Big Brother, "How many times have I said that I won't eat this!"
Big Brother looked in puzzlement at the moon thrall corpse in his hand. With his simple intelligence, he still couldn't understand the concept of "taste".
Big Brother was similarly locked inside the lab by Gu Nan. Since he had no one else to talk to, he could only run over and play with Tian Tian.
When Tian Tian revealed her hunger and thirst, Big Brother smashed a glass tube without hesitation, ripped out the moon thrall inside, then tore it up and stuffed it in her face.
Classmate Tian Tian very cooperatively fainted.
When she woke up again, she was faced with such a situation—she had to communicate with Big Brother, whose intelligence was limited, in order to hold a discussion with unknown consequences.
……
The Glory Camp quickly collapsed, and the remaining humans kept retreating to the center of the camp. Many people discovered Gu Nan's presence, as well as that fruit.
Almost without much thought, they understood the culprits behind everything.
But so what? Gu Nan just stood quietly high in the air, unresponsive to any curses or pleas.
As for those who wanted to circle around him and approach the fruit, naturally, they all died.
It didn’t matter if they were men or women; children or the elderly—life was truly equal in front of Gu Nan—only death awaited them.
About half an hour later, Gu Nan stood up in front of the second tall moon thrall king, but this time the Evil God Temple didn't give out anymore side quests.
"Then… It's time for us to visit the next place, Second Brother."
A sinister and flattering smile appeared on Second Brother’s face. Its personality was quite different from that of Big Brother’s.
……
"Will you help me untie the rope?" Tian Tian said this to Big Brother with a pair of big round eyes, telling him that she needed help.
Big Brother scratched the back of his head blankly, having no idea what she was saying.
With Big Brother’s intelligence, at best, he could understand physiological instincts like hunger. Don’t count on him for anything more.
Tian Tian suddenly became anxious. She tilted her head back at the pillar while her hands flipped and turned, trying to attract Big Brother’s attention to the rope.
Big Brother obviously misunderstood her wish. He raised a hand and straight-up slapped the pillar.
His monstrous strength made the pillar sway, and Tian Tian’s entire person shook from the vibrations. She shook her head repeatedly to stop Big Brother from doing it again.
Big Brother seemed to realize that he had done something wrong and scratched his head in a simple and honest way.
……
Lin Ke sat alone at home, looking gloomy. Lin Duo had already gone to sleep, so she finally had a chance to do her own thing.
"An obvious quake came from the central laboratory, and even some residents nearby felt it," a voice rang in her ear. It was precisely the man in black from before.
"You…" Lin Ke’s expression, however, suddenly changed, then she forced herself to whisper, “Beholder, who allowed you into my house?!”
The man known as "Beholder" had a sneer on his face. "But I did enter. What are you going to do?"
The scowl on Lin Ke’s face slowly disappeared, but her eyes became dangerous—even if she had to expose certain secrets in front of her younger sister, that was still better than being threatened by this guy.
As if seeing her thoughts, Beholder gently coughed and said, "In a quarter of an hour, Lord Ghost Tree will personally explore the lab. That’s all I want to say.”
His indifferent voice fell, and Beholder’s figure suddenly disappeared without a trace, leaving only Lin Ke’s eyes that looked like they were about to shoot fire.
But a moment later, her figure quickly disappeared into the night as well.
After Lin Ke disappeared, a figure slowly emerged on the second floor. It was Lin Duo, with the sun and moon spirits beside her.
"Sure enough, Big Sister… really left to investigate the lab?" Lin Duo certainly didn't forget the words Tian Tian left her before.
"So, are we going?" The moon spirit’s soft voice rang in her ear, like a whisper from an abyss demon, full of temptation.
"Of course,” Lin Duo's answer was very firm.

chapters.title: Chapter 182: My Surname is Jiang
chapters.content:
Gu Nan's plan wasn’t going too well.
It was truly too hard to duplicate the scene of 100,000 moon thralls gathered in the same place. Who knew when that giant tree appeared and how long it took to gather all those moon thralls.
To make matters worse, those fruits had been slowly losing power ever since Gu Nan plucked them from the tree. Even though he used the power of shadows to seal the energy inside the fruits, Gu Nan didn’t have the time to wait any longer.
Their power would dissipate especially quickly after they were taken out, so he must choose crowded places where humans gathered and take advantage of all the humans being transformed into moon thralls in order to gather as much power as possible.
After nearly two hours of the same process, five moon thrall kings of different sizes were standing in front of Gu Nan.
They were all made using the human survivors gathered in the major survivor camps. It could be said that each moon thrall king was stained with the blood of thousands of people.
The Glory Camp and Hero Camp made Second Brother and Third Brother, the two biggest of the five.
The other three camps were much weaker, and the final Sixth Brother was merely as tall as two people, which wasn’t much stronger than ordinary moon thralls.
"The imperial capital doesn’t have any camp that can be considered large anymore!" Gu Nan shook his head with some helplessness. "Do I have to make do with this? No wait, there's actually one more…"
……
Lin Duo sneaked near the lab. It was pitch-black here, and it was the same black inside and outside.
Classmate Lin Duo gritted her teeth but ultimately didn't make a stupid move like turning on the flashlight. She felt for the side door and walked forward step by step, guided by the moonlight.
This used to be her school, but this formerly familiar road now looked so strange. She couldn’t reach the end, even after a long walk.
"Little Ming, Little Yue… Did I fall into an illusion?" She couldn't help calling for her spirits.
"No, you just can’t walk,” the sun spirit revealed himself and pointed out coldly.
Lin Duo's legs were shaking, so of course she couldn’t walk.
Lin Duo’s face blushed a little. Just when she was about to refute, she suddenly heard a loud noise in her ear, which scared her into hurriedly looking up.
In front of the lab door in the distance, an ancient tree was slowly spreading its roots and growing. The noise just now came from the gate falling down.
"This…” Lin Duo hurriedly held her breath, hiding in the dark and observing from there.
"Master Ghost Tree, should we deal with Lin Ke?" Beholder was standing beside a red-robed elder, asking respectfully with his head bowed.
The elder pushed up the glasses on his face and shook his head. "The lab is more important. Gu Zhaoyue will be back very soon."
He looked up at the shadows in the distance, his heart cold.
‘Although Beholder doesn’t know, how can I not know? This is the origin point of the moon thrall catastrophe in the capital!’
‘Little Xue, Little Tian…’
Ihe next instant, this old man suppressed all his emotions and said icily, "Let's go."
Inside the lab, Tian Tian finally managed to free herself after many hardships.
When Big Brother handed her the fourth moon thrall corpse, Tian Tian finally stopped herself from fainting and found a way to free herself.
Glass shards were embedded in the moon thrall corpses, which came from the shattered incubation tubes.
So Tian Tian choked back her nausea, grabbed a glass shard with her mouth, and cut the rope in front of her bit by bit. By the time she finally freed her hands, the corners of her mouth were all bloody.
She wiped her mouth with her hand and felt a burning pain, but she wasn’t depressed at all.
"Gu Nan!" That face floated up in Tian Tian's mind, and she couldn't help gnashing her teeth. "When I get out, I’ll definitely tell the entire world about your evil deeds. I…"
Boom!
The door of the lab was suddenly blown open, and Ghost Tree, the old man in red, came in with Beholder. When they saw Tian Tian's tragic situation, they seemed to understand something. They immediately asked nicely, "Little girl, were you captured?"
Tian Tian nodded blankly, feeling that her injuries were for nothing.
And sneakily following the two was Lin Duo. She felt that she was lurking quite well, and she even had time to poke her head out to see if her sister was inside.
"Hey, it's Tian Tian… Mmph!"
When Lin Duo saw Tian Tian's figure, she didn’t even have time to be pleasantly surprised before a hand suddenly covered her mouth and dragged her back.
She only had time to make a muffled sound, but when she saw the face of the person behind her, she immediately stopped struggling.
Lin Ke's face was terrifyingly dark, and she whispered in a cold voice, "Come with me at once. There are signs of moon thralls gathering here right now. If we don't leave now, it will be too late!"
With that, Lin Ke was about to drag Lin Duo away, but the latter quickly broke free, pointing to the laboratory and saying, "B-But… Tian Tian’s still in the lab…"
……
At the Star & Moon Camp, not far from the lab, Gu Zhaoyue was standing beside Gu Nan, looking at the glowing blue fruit in the latter's hand, speechless.
With his knowledge, he could discern Gu Nan’s goal from a glance, which was why he found this plan particularly unacceptable.
"My Lord, once the camp is destroyed, it will be difficult to build another one!" Gu Zhaoyue earnestly advised.
It was easiest to set up a survivor's camp in the early days of the apocalypse, but now, nearly a month after the apocalypse, it was almost impossible to do it again.
There were only so many humans in the capital, and if they still didn’t join a camp yet, then they were either extremely powerful or already dead.
Gu Nan's face remained expressionless. "It’s no longer necessary."
After the second side quest appeared, as Gu Nan's understanding of Big Brother deepened, his understanding of the whole dungeon also deepened.
The moon thrall king could eat other moon thralls to evolve, but there was an upper limit. Big Brother had been fed to a critical point and was only one step away from entering Tier 3.
What was this final step? Gu Nan, who possessed six other fruits, could easily think of it.
It seems that Big Brother is a fitting name, since he’ll be getting six more brothers.
The blue light intensified. Gu Nan, who had done similar things several times already, was naturally familiar with the process. And the movement from the other side of the lab was faithfully transmitted to him through a shadow clone.
It was close enough. Both sides were dancing in his hands.
"Then, I'll leave this side to you." Gu Nan revealed a meaningful smile, and his form gradually turned dark.
……
In the lab, Lin Ke finally summoned up the courage to speak when Ghost Tree turned back with a small smile. "What's the matter? You’re not letting that little friend come out and meet us?"
Lin Ke froze, while Lin Duo poked her head out from behind her sister and even greeted, "Hello, Mister!"
Lin Ke's mouth twitched uncontrollably. She really wanted to cover her younger sister's mouth, but when Tian Tian saw Lin Duo there, she exclaimed, "Lin Duo! It's Gu Nan, Gu Nan is behind everything!"
Lin Duo was startled by her and turned pale. She hadn't told anyone about Mr. Gu Nan.
"Gu Nan?" Lin Ke suddenly turned back and stared at her sister. She didn't forget Lin Duo’s boasts about her “King-Level Heroic Spirit”.
‘Does Tian Tian mean the central lab is Gu Nan’s doing? Then this matter…’
Her mind was full of thoughts at once, and Ghost Tree whispered from across the room, "So that person's name is Gu Nan… Wait, who’s here!"
As Ghost Tree’s voice fell, a branch appeared out of thin air to his right and whipped at the air.
A dark shadow was whipped out by him, which gradually condensed into Gu Nan's figure.
The latter looked at him with a little surprise. "Interesting, You’re the first person in this world who can force me out of hiding."
"You’re Gu Nan?" Ghost Tree lifted his glasses again, and his old face seemed to have some more wrinkles. "You're also the first person I can't extract any life force from… It seems that you really don't know me."
A crimson ancient tree seemed to spring up behind Ghost Tree, constantly extracting the life force around it.
This old man was very strange. Gu Nan thought for a long time but had no recollection of such a person. He asked curiously, "We have a grudge?"
Ghost Tree remembered his two dead children and how heartbroken he was when he received news of Jiang Xue and Jiang Tian’s mutilated corpses. His eyes also grew colder.
"Can't remember? Then let me remind you. " Ghost Tree, dressed in a red robe, took off his black-rimmed glasses with golden stripes and said expressionlessly, "My surname is Jiang."

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Ghost Tree
chapters.content:
The appearance of an old man surnamed Jiang made the atmosphere in the lab a little strange.
Lin Duo couldn't believe that Mr. Gu Nan would actually do such a thing. Lin Ke, on the other hand, was shocked by Gu Nan's connection to her younger sister. Only Big Brother scratched his head, entirely ignorant of what had just transpired.
Gu Nan still couldn’t recall who this person was.
When Jiang Tian and Jiang Xue, the two police officers, entered the lab back then, he didn't know their names, so naturally he wouldn't have been able to guess Ghost Tree’s identity.
However, this didn’t stop him from attacking. A sword of shadow instantly pierced Ghost Tree’s heart.
But Ghost Tree was immovable, a smile forming on his elderly face.
Gu Nan's sword seemed to be completely harmless to him, and the illusory ancient tree behind him slowly solidified until it turned tangible, standing in front of everyone.
This was a genuine peak Tier 3 Heroic Spirit summoner. In Star Realm terms, he was already on par with the Dao Lords.
People like him had already broken through the limits of Heroic Spirit summoners. His Heroic Spirit and his true body were constantly in a semi-fused state, so the Heroic Spirit could fight independently or attack through Ghost Tree himself.
One of the few Dao Lords in the Morningstar Plane actually appeared in front of Gu Nan at this moment.
"Dao Lord level?" Gu Nan frowned slightly. His Heroic Spirit form only inherited a portion of his original body’s power, so killing a Dao Lord wouldn’t be an easy matter.
With a wave of his right hand, longswords rained down on the ancient tree, with all fifteen consecutive swords stabbing the same spot.
The swords stabbed a big hole in the ancient tree, but the hole quickly healed before Gu Nan could make his next move.
"It's useless," Ghost Tree said expressionlessly, his eyes devoid of any emotion. "I extracted the vitality of tens of thousands of people. How can you possibly kill me?"
Gu Nan just looked at him coldly. If the enemy was already in an invincible position yet still insisted on chattering nonstop, then there was only one possibility—this enemy didn’t have the ability to kill him. At least, not yet.
‘He's stalling.’
Gu Nan saw through this and smiled slightly. He stood in place motionlessly, but his body gradually darkened.
Although with Gu Nan’s methods, he can always kill the monsters he wants to kill, there’s still the matter of a cost-benefit ratio.
‘It takes effort and time to kill the other party, and there’s no benefit to be gained. But even if I don't kill him, I won't lose anything. So why would I kill him?’
Gu Nan never felt that he was addicted to killing. He simply wanted to complete the mission.
Ghost Tree’s expression changed slightly when he saw Gu Nan leaving, and he couldn't maintain his confident look any longer. The ancient tree behind him suddenly spread out all its branches, emitting a scarlet brilliance.
Everyone present felt their heart turn cold, and something seemed to be flowing slowly from their bodies into the ancient tree.
Ghost Tree's expression was still gloomy. He could clearly sense the linked life forces of everyone here except Gu Nan.
Gu Nan's body continued to darken, but a red light started to glow underneath his feet. This was Ghost Tree’s Heroic Spirit domain.
Unfortunately, before the red light completely surrounded him, Gu Nan had already turned into a black shadow that then shattered, as if it had never been there in the first place.
"Damn it…" Ghost Tree couldn’t help cursing when he saw the other party escape when his domain was only one step away from surrounding Gu Nan.
His Heroic Spirit had excellent attack and defense, but its pursuit abilities weren’t sufficient. What he feared the most was if the other side didn’t thirst for battle and simply ran away.
So he tried to stall with words from the very beginning, but he didn't expect that Gu Nan was still able to escape.
……
Gu Zhaoyue stood next to Gu Nan's shadow doppelganger, watching the fruit glow a brilliant blue. The majestic energy coming from it made even him want to hide.
"Is this fruit from that tree? No wonder it can attract moon thralls…"
When Gu Zhaoyue sensed the faint aura of the moon thralls around him and connected that with the giant tree he saw before, he could guess the gist of the situation immediately.
Five tall moon thralls stared at them curiously with different expressions, making Gu Zhaoyue’s heart feel strange.
He didn’t know what Gu Nan was doing. For a long time, he couldn’t even understand Gu Nan's actions.
Loyalty for no reason and no cause didn’t exist in this world. Gu Zhaoyue was an ambitious person, or more accurately, an ambitious Heroic Spirit. He was simply fond of power and authority.
When Gu Nan could be his backing and provide him with power, Gu Nan would naturally have his loyalty, but it was different now.
Gu Nan wanted to destroy everything he held dear.
Gu Zhaoyue clenched both of his fists and hesitated.
His rationality told him that even if he destroyed this fruit, Gu Nan still wouldn’t let him and his camp off, but… ‘Don't tell me I have to just watch everything play out like this?’
"Grandpa Gu, what are you doing here?" A child’s voice came from the side.
Gu Zhaoyue suddenly turned his head and saw a five or six-year-old girl standing in the underbrush next door, hugging a small white dog in her arms.
The little white dog looked at Gu Zhaoyue and barked twice.
Gu Zhaoyue stared at them in a daze. He didn't actually know this little girl. She just felt vaguely familiar. But he knew that in this little girl’s eyes, he might as well be the savior of the world.
He raised his head to look at the blue fruit, his gaze gradually becoming determined.
……
"Lord Ghost Tree, the moon thralls are still gathering outside. The source of power they’re after isn’t far away from here. Do you think this is the work of that person?” Beholder walked up to Ghost Tree and whispered.
Ghost Tree's eyes lit up and he blurted out, "It’s most definitely him! Several camps have already been breached by moon thralls today, all of which were the result of a large number of moon thralls gathering around those camps. That Gu Nan must’ve done something!"
The people on the other side of the room, including Lin Duo, also heard the news. Lin Duo asked in confusion, "Sister, why are moon thralls gathering outside?"
Lin Ke’s face was pale. Before she could reply, the moon spirit beside her murmured, "It's the power of the moon fruit… He actually used the moon fruit here!"
As an eyewitness to the situation in West City, Lin Duo also understood what Gu Nan had done after an explanation from the moon spirit, and the fear in her heart grew deeper and deeper.
"Mr. Gu Nan, how… could he…"
She lost track of how many times she tried to use her own Heroic Spirit contract to contact Gu Nan, but her calls were like pebbles sinking into the ocean, eliciting no response.
"We must stop him!" The sun spirit that rarely spoke took the initiative to speak up right now. "If the power of all seven moon fruits are fused together, then the true king of the moon thralls will be born. When that happens, the moon thrall calamity will never end."
Lin Duo was taken aback to hear Little Ming say so many words at once, but she understood the meaning behind his words.
It boiled down to two words: “Stop him!”
Ghost Tree and Beholder’s figures had already disappeared, and Lin Duo and the others also prepared to catch up.
"Wait, I'll go too!" Tian Tian said from the side. The Lin sisters had no reason to stop her and immediately agreed.
But nobody expected Big Brother to stand out at this moment and grab Tian Tian with one hand.
"Hey, what are you doing?! Let me go, let me… Huh?"
Tian Tian struggled, but she immediately discovered that Big Brother simply placed her on his shoulder, then flashed everyone a simple and honest smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Enemy of the World
chapters.content:
The moon thralls had already started invading the Star & Moon Camp. Gu Zhaoyue knew that he had no other choice if he wanted to save the people in the camp.
Even if he destroyed the fruit right now, it was still impossible to stop the ceaseless tide of moon thralls. He could only choose to take the fruit away.
Only by letting the source of attraction appear in another place can the camp survive.
Gu Zhaoyue slowly approached the shadow in the center, his gaze not daring to leave that shadow for even an instant—Gu Nan’s prestige was too high in his mind, so he couldn't afford to be careless.
It took a long time for Gu Zhaoyue to finally circle behind the shadow and find an opportunity to make his move.
He punched the shadow clone with all his might, but the latter didn't even groan. It just turned into a ball of shadows and dissipated, while the fruit fell into Gu Zhaoyue's hand.
"This…"
Success came way too smoothly, almost making Gu Zhaoyue think that it was Gu Nan's trap. However, the fruit in his hand clearly exuded strong energy fluctuations.
"There’s no time. Even if it’s a trap, I still have to step into the trap!" Gu Zhaoyue gritted his teeth and began to fly away from the camp.
However, a scarlet branch whipped out and completely smashed all his plans.
Ghost Tree had arrived.
The red-robed old man slowly walked out under the night sky, the ancient tree behind him still as solid as ever. The terrifying ferocity he displayed made Gu Zhaoyue’s heart sink.
When he saw the fruit in Gu Zhaoyue's hand, his face turned even colder. "Where is Gu Nan?"
Gu Zhaoyue heard the other person's question, then looked down at the fruit in his hand. His heart was full of bitterness—this was truly terrible timing. No one would believe him right now if he said that he wasn’t on Gu Nan’s side.
But Gu Zhaoyue was nevertheless a cunning old man who had lived for thousands of years, and he reacted quickly.
Instead of handing over the fruit, he pointed in one direction and said, "He went that way. My Lord, please follow me. I left a tracking mark on him!"
"Oh?" Ghost Tree raised his eyebrows. Although his expression was still indifferent, his voice seemed to contain some interest.
A trace of satisfaction flashed through Gu Zhaoyue's eyes. Naturally, his words were all lies, but it was impossible for the other party to judge them as lies immediately, and as long as he led the way, then his goal would be achieved.
Right now, he single-heartedly wanted to protect the camp to prevent all his efforts from going to waste. He didn’t want innocent survivors in the camp to die because of Gu Nan's selfish desires.
‘In the end, I grew soft…’ Gu Zhaoyue felt a little helpless in his heart, but he didn't regret it at all.
‘If I truly lived like Gu Nan and lost even my most basic humanity, then what's the point of living anymore?’
“Oh?"
An “Oh?” similar to Ghost Tree’s came, but the direction was the exact opposite of where Gu Zhaoyue had pointed to—Gu Nan was standing there with his arms folded.
Gu Zhaoyue’s face paled, and in the next second, Gu Nan's figure suddenly appeared in front of him, stabbing him in the abdomen with a sword.
The power of shadows began to pour out crazily, and the darkness spread rapidly from the wound, covering most of Gu Zhaoyue's body in the blink of an eye.
"You don’t even have the right to be nourishment," this was Gu Nan's evaluation of Gu Zhaoyue—he was a Heroic Spirit and couldn’t even transform into a moon thrall. ‘What's the use of keeping him?’
Thump! Thump! Thump! Thump!
The sound of Big Brother’s heavy footsteps could be heard, and when Lin Duo and the others arrived, they saw the scene of Gu Zhaoyue being stabbed in the abdomen by a sword.
"Elder Gu!" Lin Duo immediately exclaimed, but her cry couldn’t change anything. Gu Zhaoyue was instantly torn to pieces.
Gu Zhaoyue was a kind of naturally-formed Heroic Spirit; he was the guardian of the Sun Moon Enchanted Box. He was actually a pure energy body and didn’t have a physical body.
Therefore, he was very resistant to physical attacks, but he was particularly vulnerable to Gu Nan's blow that contained the law of shadows.
All his energy was eroded by the power of shadows, and he shattered into pieces all over the sky.
The black pieces kept hitting her face as Lin Duo stared in a daze. Her emotions finally broke out, "Mr. Gu Nan, why… why did you do this?!”
Gu Nan coldly swept a glance over her. He slowly stepped out, but the sun and moon twin Heroic Spirits immediately blocked his way.
Gu Nan revealed an odd smile. These twins, which he released with his own hands, were now blocking his way. This really was interesting.
Of course, he’d gotten used to all sorts of bizarre missions, so Gu Nan was already immune to such things.
‘These two little fellows are one of my side quests, so I should leave them alive—they can be crippled as long as they don't die.’
"Gu Nan, you created the king of moon thralls with the moon fruit. If one day the moon thralls rule the continent, you will be the main cause of that disaster!" The little moon spirit loli shouted coldly.
Gu Nan smiled wordlessly. He just reached out a hand to grab her head.
The moon spirit reacted extremely quickly, as if she’d known in advance. Her body suddenly blurred, which made Gu Nan’s attempt fail.
"Interesting." Gu Nan smiled. These two little guys weren’t too strong, but their abilities were very strange.
The sun spirit also walked up and looked at him coldly. "Friends and allies deserting, becoming the enemy of both humans and gods—your death won’t be pretty."
Gu Nan didn't speak anymore. His gaze swept calmly across everyone.
Lin Ke was confused, Lin Duo was puzzled and dazed, the sun and moon spirits were indifferent, while Tian Tian harbored a bone-deep hatred—all their emotions emerged in his mind one by one.
Gu Nan shook his head gently. They might never understand that their views were meaningless to Gu Nan.
At the same time, a red light suddenly lit up behind Gu Nan. A branch suddenly whipped down and hit Gu Nan's back.
This blow was silent and didn't cause much damage to Gu Nan, but it succeeded in catching his attention.
Ghost Tree slowly walked over and smiled. "The moon thrall calamity has spread all over the continent. I didn't expect there to be a day when we at Nighthawk can also save the world."
Gu Nan also smiled. He let go of the moon fruit that he always held in his palm, letting it fall to the ground.
"Then, save yourselves first."
Red light shone from under Gu Nan’s feet. Ghost Tree’s Heroic Spirit domain was complete, but behind him, the cries of moon thralls began to ring.
The moon thralls were coming.
Ghost Tree seemed to understand something and looked at Gu Nan in disbelief. He activated the power of his domain to the extreme, and the branches flying all over the sky seemed like a flurry of dancing demons.
When the first moon thrall appeared, Gu Nan used Blink to directly teleport to the other side, and his figure instantly disappeared from inside Ghost Tree’s domain.
His domain might be able to limit the power of laws and even sense Gu Nan’s Hidden Shadow, rendering it useless, but the skills from the Evil God Temple could ignore that domain.
"No!" Ghost Tree roared in anger but could only watch Gu Nan jump away several times, his figure disappearing completely. However, there were more and more moon thralls gathered in the surroundings now.
There were moon thralls as far as the eye could see, covering everything in sight.
Except for Gu Zhaoyue, Gu Nan didn't kill anyone here, because they could all become nourishment.
Bursts of bloodthirsty roars came. Along with Big Brother, the other six moon thrall kings all arrived. The curtains to the final play were about to be lifted.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Big Brother
chapters.content:
Moon thralls were raging and blood was flowing.
The Star & Moon Camp, the last piece of Pure Land in the capital, ultimately failed to escape the calamity. Gu Zhaoyue's painstaking home was easily destroyed by Gu Nan.
Moon thralls had already rushed up to the moon fruit’s vicinity and could see this fruit, so they lunged forward crazily.
As usual, they tried to tear apart everything in front of them, but it was a little different this time.
A scarlet tree slowly spread its branches behind Ghost Tree. Any moon thrall who dared to approach him was easily torn into pieces.
Although the apocalypse was terrible, for someone as powerful as Ghost Tree, it was impossible for the moon thralls to kill him—not unless he wanted to die.
On the other side, moon thrall kings were a natural deterrent to ordinary moon thralls, so no moon thralls dare to approach them.
From Big Brother to Sixth Brother, the six moon thrall kings were all present. Some stood stupidly, some had their eyeballs rolling around. They all had different expressions, but all of them were staring at that moon fruit.
Even Big Brother, the one with the lowest intelligence, knew that the power of that fruit originated from the same source as his own power, and that fruit would be the root of his evolution.
But besides Ghost Tree and the moon thrall kings, the others weren’t so lucky. Moon thralls surged forth crazily from all sides. Even if they weren’t the targets, the moon thralls were still a fatal threat to those people.
Beholder wasn’t too strong to begin with. He began to feel overwhelmed as soon as he was surrounded by moon thralls.
"My Lord, save me! My Lord…" He could only ask Ghost Tree for help, but the latter didn't even spare him a glance, let alone place him inside the protective domain.
Beholder’s heart turned cold, but he lacked the power to resist in such a situation.
When his mind was distracted, his hand movements also started to deform. In the blink of an eye, he was torn apart by the moon thralls.
On another side, Lin Duo and the others were also flustered.
Lin Ke wasn’t that much stronger than Beholder, and she was also a possession-type Heroic Spirit summoner. She didn’t dare to rush forth in this situation at all, or else she’d be courting death.
In this critical juncture, the twin sun and moon spirits saved their lives.
The two children stood on either end of the team, and a pattern of the sun and moon could be faintly seen on the ground, keeping the moon thralls outside.
The thing that kept the moon thralls outside resembled a protective barrier. From the outside, it was just a thin film, which seemed like it could be easily broken.
Fortunately, the moon thralls’ target wasn’t them. After hitting the barrier, the vast majority of moon thralls chose to go around them or climb over the wall.
The number of moon thralls was so dense to the point where they were indistinguishable from each other, almost covering the entire protective barrier.
The Lin sisters and Tian Tian stayed inside the protective barrier just like that, not daring to move, because even the last bit of moonlight was covered by the bodies of moon thralls.
In the darkness, it seemed that even the passage of time had slowed down.
Lin Duo felt some sweat on her forehead and wanted to raise her hand to wipe it, but she couldn't lift her hand.
The pressure seemed as heavy as Mt. Tai, pressing down on her until she was out of breath. The completely dark environment also seemed to isolate her.
"We have to think of another way," the sun spirit’s weak voice made Lin Duo come back to her senses. "We can't maintain it for much longer, and…"
"And once the true king of the moon thralls descends, everything will be too late," the moon spirit finished for him.
She seemed to be in slightly better condition than the sun spirit, and her voice didn’t have that deep-rooted weakness, but she also sounded quite helpless. "The last time we saw the moon fruit, it was clear that it would take at least half a month to mature, but who could imagine…"
"That person took it down,” the sun spirit was gnashing his teeth as he responded.
They didn’t know that Gu Nan directly flew past all those moon thralls. They simply felt incredulous that he could snatch away those fruits while surrounded by that many moon thralls.
Lin Duo became more and more silent. In her heart, Gu Nan was the Heroic Spirit she summoned, so no matter what Gu Nan did, she shared some responsibility in that—even though she couldn’t control him at all.
On the other hand, Lin Ke was more concerned about their current predicament. She asked in the dark, "Is there any way to lure the moon thralls away, or should we try to move outward?"
"We can't move… Huh?"
The moon spirit stopped talking when she felt some light suddenly fall on her head.
Right now, even the dim moonlight felt like a lighthouse, illuminating the road ahead for them—the moon thralls scattered! They survived!
But soon, a big face appeared above them, revealing a simple and honest smile.
Only then did they discover that although the surging tide of moon thralls had slowed down, it was far from over. What really saved them was Big Brother.
While scratching the back of his head, Big Brother pointed a finger at Tian Tian with his other hand, then pointed to his shoulder.
"Are you asking me to sit on your shoulder?" Tian Tian stared blankly and asked in slight confusion.
Big Brother nodded repeatedly, although nobody knew if he understood Tian Tian’s words.
Tian Tian exchanged odd glances with her companions and hesitated a little—according to the two little Heroic Spirits, this was the king of the moon thralls!
"You might as well agree since it invited you," the moon spirit spoke like a small adult. "To think that the king of moon thralls will show affection towards a human… Why didn't our ancestor predict this in advance?"
Of course, no one could answer her doubts. Moments later, Big Brother contentedly carried Tian Tian and began to slowly walk forward.
Wherever Big Brother passed, no moon thrall dared to approach them. Lin Duo and the others could only follow them in order to not be besieged again.
As time went by, the creation of the seven brothers had come to an end. Although there were still moon thralls coming over, the power of the moon fruit had been spread thinly among hundreds of moon thralls.
And after this period of fighting, the strength of the surviving moon thralls in the central area had grown far beyond that of ordinary moon thralls.
Not even a trace of Beholder’s corpse remained, while Ghost Tree still stood by, coldly watching all this.
He was waiting. He concluded that Gu Nan wouldn’t create such a big battle merely to watch a play. ‘As long as Gu Nan comes back, there’s still a chance to take revenge!’
But Ghost Tree’s situation wasn’t very ideal either.
There were too many moon thralls. Even though he was strong, the large number of moon thralls still put great pressure on him. Heroic Spirits didn’t have any life force that he could extract, so they were one of the most annoying enemies for him.
The battering over a long period of time consumed most of his strength, and he even suffered some injuries.
At this moment, the last moon thrall victor was finally born!
With a shocking roar, the moon thrall king, who should be called "Seventh Brother" by convention, finally stabilized his own strength, then coldly studied his surroundings.
Including Big Brother, the other six moon thrall kings approached slowly, as if some kind of power was pulling them in.
Big Brother was the first to reach out and put his hand in the middle, then stared proudly at the rest of his companions. Moonlight scattered on his hand, which seemed to glow a faint white.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Greatsword
chapters.content:
In the face of Big Brother's movements, the other six moon thrall kings glanced at each other, then also stretched out their palms one by one.
Seven palms of different sizes gathered together, and the faint moonlight fluorescence became fiercer and fiercer. The light even looked somewhat harsh under the night sky.
When the seven moon thralls stood together, the gap between them became obvious.
Big Brother, who was created from 100,000 moon thralls, was not only the tallest, but also the strongest, so it was obviously the leader.
Second Brother, Third Brother, and the youngest Seventh Brother were in the second echelon because they were created from the three survivor camps. The rest weren’t worth mentioning.
Tian Tian stood by and watched this scene nervously. She knew that Big Brother seemed to have reached a critical moment.
Gu Nan had reappeared again at some point. He stood to the side and observed this scene with great interest.
"Is it really seven fusing into one? Looks like I named them quite fittingly
[1]
…" Gu Nan rubbed his chin. Look at this scene, the names he gave them in playful taste might really come true.
When the moonlight condensed to a critical point, Sixth Brother, the weakest one, suddenly felt a shock, then turned into a mass of white light and was absorbed by the other six moon thralls.
The remaining six moon thrall kings’ strength suddenly rose, and the most powerful Big Brother even broke through the threshold of Tier 3 directly, giving a loud roar.
｢Side Quest Complete: Level the moon thrall’s king to Tier 3｣
The words from the Evil God Temple made Gu Nan smile. Based on this dungeon’s difficulty, this meant a reward of at least 20 Evil Value.
It's just that it wasn’t a large-scale mission this time, so the reward would only be given when the main mission was complete.
Moreover, side quests were usually clues for the main mission, so now that this side quest was complete, a clue for the main mission should appear soon.
‘But no new NPC appeared…’ Gu Nan's eyes swept over Lin Duo and her companions, and the corners of his mouth smiled even more.
The "fusion" of the seven moon thrall kings continued. One after another, the moon thralls shattered and caused the remaining moon thrall kings’ strength to rise wildly.
In the end, even Second Brother and Third Brother shattered, leaving only Big Brother, which had swelled into a giant of nearly 20 meters high, and Seventh Brother, whose shape was almost the same as his.
Big Brother opened his eyes in confusion and looked at the big fellow beside him, as if wondering why Seventh Brother didn't break into pieces.
But just then, Seventh Brother’s originally stiff expression suddenly revealed a strange insidious smile.
It was a smile that shouldn’t have existed based on the moon thrall kings’ low intelligence. Big Brother didn't even understand the meaning of this smile, but he felt a pain in his neck.
Seventh Brother suddenly opened his mouth and bit him on the neck!
Big Brother immediately gave a pained roar and tried to pull his hand back, but Seventh Brother gripped that hand in a death grip, not letting him move at all.
He raised his hand to fight, but Seventh Brother’s movements were much more flexible than his. His every move was like a master who had been immersed in martial arts for hundreds of years, and Big Brother couldn’t even touch a hair on him.
After several seconds, Seventh Brother took another bite. This time, half of Big Brother's face was torn off, revealing the glittering and translucent blue veins underneath.
There was a loud scream from Tian Tian, who wanted to hurriedly rush forward but was caught by Gu Nan.
"Let me go! Put me—”
Crack.
The sound of bones breaking rang out as Gu Nan broke one of Tian Tian’s arms. He stared at the girl coldly. If he didn't have some suspicions about her identity, he would’ve broken her head instead of her arm.
The power of shadows sealed Tian Tian's mouth so that she couldn't scream in pain. She could only struggle in vain.
As if triggered by her friend’s misery, Lin Duo suddenly stepped forward. "Mr. Gu Nan… I-If you do this again, I will send you back to the Heroic Spirit Space!"
People in the Morningstar Plane believed that Heroic Spirits came from one of two places—the continent itself or the infinite Heroic Spirit Space outside the continent.
In reality, of course there was no such thing as the Heroic Spirit Space, but Lin Duo’s threat to Gu Nan was real.
Gu Nan gave her a cold look. Before he could respond, a voice had already sounded, "Hahahaha! Heroic Spirit, so you are a Heroic Spirit!"
Ghost Tree’s figure had already appeared behind Lin Duo at some time, looking deranged. "If I kill her, then you must return to the Heroic Spirit Space… I’ve waited so long for this moment!"
The red-robed old man was already a spent force at this time. The moon thralls had consumed too much of his strength, and he also had serious injuries.
But at this moment, he felt that all the waiting was worth it.
Gu Nan was actually a Heroic Spirit!
‘Yes, he’s very good at running away. Not even my domain can trap him. Revenge for my children had almost become an extravagant hope… but he’s a Heroic Spirit!’
‘Wouldn’t it be the best revenge to kill the Heroic Spirit summoner, send him back to the Heroic Spirit Space, and make all his efforts so far go to waste?’
‘This will make him feel far worse than just killing him!’
Ghost Tree’s thoughts turned sharply, but his hand movements didn’t stop. Countless branches instantly shot toward Lin Duo.
"Lin Duo!"
Lin Ke couldn't stop it at all. She could only watch this scene happen and let out a sad cry.
The sun and moon twin spirits were already standing in front of Lin Duo, their faces full of a dying will.
The purpose behind their awakening was to fulfill their ancestor’s will and resolve the moon thrall calamity. Even if they died, they must never let their contractor die.
However, Lin Duo's shadow on the ground suddenly began to boil at this time.
A dark shadow stood up from Lin Duo’s shadow and turned into Gu Nan's appearance in the blink of an eye. It was the shadow clone that he always kept by Lin Duo’s side, which played a crucial role at this moment.
This time, the branches pierced Gu Nan's abdomen without hindrance.
"Mr. Gu Nan…" Lin Duo looked at this scene in shock, unable to speak for a while.
Gu Nan's vitality, which was boundless to the point of terrifying, made Ghost Tree almost faint with excitement—as long as he sucked this fellow dry, it wouldn’t be impossible for him to step into that legendary realm!
Gu Nan's face, however, showed a grim smile, and a sword of shadow suddenly appeared in his hand.
This sword was very strange. Not only was its style quite different from usual, but it was clearly a greatsword that glowed with a faint white light.
Ghost Tree was someone at the Dao Lord level. He vaguely sensed that something was wrong, but he couldn’t see what was off.
Gu Nan, however, sneered. ‘A boss on his last legs dares to run up to me, someone who has an execute type skill. What kind of spirit is this?’
｢Righteous Judgment: In the name of justice, cause true damage to the target based on the amount of HP the target has already lost｣
Gu Nan's expression turned righteous, his entire person began to exude a radiance of justice, and the sword of shadow in his hand also seemed to be glittering—of course, this was all in his imagination.
But the skill effect wouldn’t be affected just because there was no special visual effect.
‘Take this greatsword!’
Gu Nan added the voice line in his heart.
When this sword fell, it was as if the whole world was shaking. Ghost Tree was instantly blown to pieces by the golden light falling from the sky.
Gu Nan was entirely unconcerned by this. For him, it was nothing more than the skill’s special effects causing the game screen to flash white for a second.
Lin Duo and her companions watched, stupefied. Their hearts were full of shock and they couldn't even speak.
There was only a strange but sinister voice speaking from behind Gu Nan, "As expected of My Lord, to think you still had such a secret skill… But I wonder how many more times you can use it?"
Behind everyone, Big Brother had already disappeared, leaving only Seventh Brother, who was back to normal size and had an insidious expression.
Upon closer inspection, Seventh Brother’s face looked somewhat familiar.
T/N:
[1]
Spoilers: In the Calabash Brothers, the seven brothers fuse together at the end to defeat the villain
