chapters.title: Chapter 187: Multiple Personalities
chapters.content:
That was Gu Zhaoyue's face.
Gu Nan slowly turned around. His face seemed a little surprised, but he also seemed to be expecting it and had a calm look in his eyes.
The wound on his body was slowly healing, but the speed wasn’t fast because Gu Nan didn’t have the Dawn Sage’s Robe on him.
The Morningstar Plane was quite unfriendly to reincarnators.
This was because it made reincarnators into Heroic Spirits, so it was almost impossible for reincarnators to bring their items and equipment over, which was why very few reincarnators were willing to come here.
Gu Nan couldn’t bring any of his nice equipment with him either. He could only rely on skills.
Besides his core skill the Power of Shadows, Gu Nan also had Resistance, Blink, and Righteous Judgment, almost all of which had extraordinary uses.
But Gu Zhaoyue was right about one thing. Righteous Judgment couldn’t be used at will.
Most of the player skills in the Evil God game had no cooldown, but there were other limitations.
Resistance was a passive skill, so it didn’t need to be mentioned. Blink required energy consumption, and Righteous Judgment was limited by the skill mechanism.
Righteous Judgment could only be used once on a particular target.
A veteran player like Gu Nan had already memorized the characteristics of each skill in his heart, but right now, he turned his attention to Seventh Brother—or Gu Zhaoyue.
"The fruit’s power protected your last strand of consciousness?" Gu Nan looked at him and raised a brow slightly.
If he thought about it, that was the only possibility—Gu Zhaoyue was drawn into the fusion of the moon thrall kings and took Seventh Brother’s place.
Gu Zhaoyue’s body was still making some abnormal noises, as though some kind of power was stirring inside him.
"Perhaps." There was only cold indifference on his face. "My Lord, did you ever predict that I would turn into this?"
Gu Nan sneered and responded with a sword without any hesitation.
This sword cut Gu Zhaoyue apart easily, but the latter seemed unharmed, and his cut body recovered in the blink of an eye.
"The true king of the moon thralls has an almost immortal constitution. Ordinary methods can't kill him at all!" The moon spirit shouted at Gu Nan.
No matter how many evil things Gu Nan had done before, right now the king of the moon thralls was the biggest enemy.
Gu Nan rolled his eyes: ‘Then why don’t you tell me how to kill him?!’
The coldness on Gu Zhaoyue's face grew, but just as he was about to make a move, his expression began to twist again. Not only did his facial muscles start contorting, but even his body twisted strangely.
Gu Nan took the opportunity to stab him a few more times, but that obviously didn't work either.
Moments later, Gu Zhaoyue’s eyes were blood red when he looked up again, and there was no intelligence in them at all.
As before, he roared angrily and lunged at them like a monster. His speed and strength didn’t lose out to Gu Nan’s at all.
So Gu Nan substituted himself, and his figure instantly turned into a shadow clone that was directly smashed by Gu Zhaoyue, while his original body appeared hundreds of meters away.
Gu Zhaoyue smashed into the shadow clone, but he didn't continue to look for Gu Nan's trouble. He seemed to have gone crazy and kept roaring up at the sky.
Lin Duo and Tian Tian had pale expressions. Only Lin Ke maintained some composure. She whispered to her two companions, "Come on, let's go!"
She wanted to leave with her sister a long time ago. If it weren't for Lin Duo's insistence on rescuing Tian Tian, she wouldn't be in this situation right now.
However, the second she opened her mouth, Gu Zhaoyue, who looked like a crazed demon, suddenly turned his head back, his crimson eyes landing on Lin Ke.
Lin Ke, whose back was facing him, felt chills all along her spine. She seemed to have fallen into an icy cellar, unable to say another word.
The next instant, under Lin Duo's horrified gaze, Gu Zhaoyue instantly appeared behind Lin Ke, grabbed Lin Ke's body from behind, and opened his mouth wide to bite down.
Although he was only the size of a normal human, his mouth was about half the size of his face when he opened his jaws. When he bit down, over half of Lin Ke’s head was bitten off.
Two-thirds of Lin Ke’s face ruptured, and a dazed expression could still be seen in her remaining half of an eyeball.
"Sis… Sister…” Lin Duo’s entire person froze. Her hands seemed to be shaking, or her whole body was shaking.
Gu Zhaoyue had completely lost his mind, and the beast-like personality of the moon thralls had gained the upper hand at this time.
He ate up Lin Ke’s body in a few bites, let out a howl of excitement again, then opened his maw to lunge at Lin Duo.
"Lin Duo!" A loud scream rang out. Tian Tian suddenly rushed up and pushed Lin Duo away, blocking Gu Zhaoyue with her eyes shut tightly.
The extreme pain she imagined didn't come. She opened her eyes carefully, only to see Gu Zhaoyue sniffing her face.
His eyes still emitted a scarlet light, but his expression seemed to be confused. He was sniffing with his nose, as if Tian Tian was a very delicious food.
Tian Tian suddenly had a creepy feeling, but before she could move, Gu Zhaoyue’s expression changed again.
What appeared this time was an expression Tian Tian was familiar with.
He raised his hand, scratched his head, and smiled a frank smile—even if his face changed, Tian Tian could still recognize him… This was Big Brother!
"Is… is that you?" Tian Tian asked in disbelief.
She never could’ve imagined that Big Brother’s consciousness still wouldn’t disappear, even after being torn apart and eaten.
Big Brother waved at her as the red light in his eyes gradually faded away. He smiled, then pointed behind Tian Tian.
"Are you telling us to leave quickly?"
Big Brother’s intelligence seemed to have improved drastically after becoming the true king of the moon thralls. He understood Tian Tian's words and nodded after a pause.
Tian Wei hesitated for a moment, then finally turned around, trying to help Lin Duo up.
But as she turned around, the look on Big Brother’s face began to change again, and he roared wildly. The red light in his eyes reappeared, and he started to bite down towards Tian Tian's neck again.
Tian Tian was too scared to move. The fangs finally stopped in front of her neck, making her hairs stand on end.
She turned her head with difficulty and saw that Big Brother’s face would sometimes be ferocious, sometimes soft, and sometimes simple and honest.
"Go…" A simple word came out of his mouth, but before Tian Tian could speak, another figure appeared beside them—it was Gu Nan.
Gu Nan pushed Big Brother’s head down, and sharp fangs instantly pierced into Tian Tian.
Big Brother’s furious roar rang out. Gu Nan threw a punch without looking, hitting Big Brother, who was pouncing at him, in the face and sending the latter flying.
By the time Big Brother flew back again, Tian Tian had already crumpled to the ground while holding her neck. The moon thrall’s infection was crazily eating away at her body and soul.
Big Brother’s personality finally got the upper hand completely, and he knelt with empty eyes, looking at Tian Tian on the ground.
Only Gu Nan had a faint smile. He was waiting—waiting for Tian Tian to change.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Conclusion
chapters.content:
Regarding the moon thrall’s child, Tian Yuan defined it as "a person who can still retain their consciousness even after being infected by moon thralls."
However, Gu Nan had proved through hundreds of experiments that infection only occurred after death, so there was only one possibility for this definition to be established.
Someone can regain consciousness after being infected.
From the moment he saw Big Brother, Gu Nan had already guessed this—no matter how shallow Big Brother’s intelligence was, it was still intelligence. Since Big Brother had intelligence, then what about the people infected by him?
But unfortunately, in Gu Nan's previous experiments, Big Brother seemed to have lost the ability to infect humans.
It wasn’t until all the moon thrall kings finished fusing together and Gu Zhaoyue displayed extremely high intelligence that Gu Nan’s hope was rekindled.
On the other hand, Tian Tian’s existence was something he had suspicions about since long ago.
Professor Tian Yuan was a moon thrall himself; Tian Tian couldn’t possibly be his biological daughter, so why did he adopt a human daughter?
Gu Nan didn't believe a flimsy excuse like how Tian Yuan was trying to "hide his identity” and blend into human society. The biggest possibility was that Tian Tian herself had a very important role to play.
Tian Yuan had discovered her a long time ago and didn't want her to fall into other people’s hands, so he simply adopted her himself.
And Tian Yuan already harbored doubts about the existence of the moon thrall’s child since long ago. If Gu Nan knew this, he’d be much more certain of his own judgment.
When Gu Nan placed Tian Tian in the lab and intentionally allowed Big Brother to come into contact with her, the speculation in his heart became more certain.
Tian Tian's special physique was probably a very simple one—it could make the moon thrall king feel affection towards her.
Gu Nan stood where he was. All his previous speculations flashed through his mind for an instant. His eyes were indifferent, waiting for the situation to develop.
Big Brother was holding Tian Tian's body, dazed and speechless.
Moments later, just as Gu Nan started to get impatient and wonder if the king of the moon thralls had also lost his infection ability, Big Brother finally moved.
He squeezed out a drop of blood from between his eyes, and it gently dripped onto the wound on Tian Tian's neck.
A strong heartbeat sounded, and a rosy color soon returned to Tian Tian's face, while Big Brother's face turned extremely pale.
Moments later, Tian Tian started waking up.
Her eyes were a little vacant and bewildered, but it was obvious that she still retained her intelligence.
Lin Duo, who was on the side, finally regained some sanity. She stared at Tian Tian's appearance and wondered, "Tian Tian, how… are you feeling?"
Tian Tian turned her head woodenly, glanced at Lin Duo, and then looked down at her hands. "I-I don't know either."
"You accepted the moon thrall king’s origin; you’re a moon thrall now," the sun spirit suddenly explained.
"Ah?! I became a moon thrall?" Tian Tian suddenly exclaimed. She never thought that she’d become a moon thrall after what seemed like a short nap.
"Don't worry." The moon spirit sighed slightly. "If you have the origin of the king of the moon thralls, you can command all the moon thralls on the continent… It turns out that the one who will end the moon thrall disaster is you."
She then turned to look at Lin Duo again. "Our ancestor said that our contractor is the key to ending the moon thrall calamity. Is this what our ancestor meant?"
If it wasn't to save Lin Duo, then Tian Tian wouldn't have run up to the moon thrall king, and the subsequent events wouldn’t have transpired.
"Can I… Can I really do it?" Tian Tian wasn’t too confident in herself. She turned to look at Big Brother, but the latter just showed a weak smile.
"Of course!" The moon spirit flatly replied, "As long as you can gather the moon thralls together or order them to stop attacking humans… Eh?"
Before she could finish her "beautiful wish," a black sword flew out without hesitation, piercing Tian Tian's forehead.
The scene suddenly quieted down. Lin Duo was shocked, the sun and moon spirits were shocked, and Big Brother stared at Gu Nan blankly.
Just like that, Tian Tian, humanity’s last hope and the one who possessed the moon thrall’s origin, was instantly killed by Gu Nan.
｢Main Mission Complete: Kill the moon thrall’s child｣
｢Side Quest Complete: Protect the twin Heroic Spirits—sun and moon spirits｣
+
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed:
Main Mission Evaluation: A
Side Story Development: B
Map Exploration: B
Sin Value: A
Comprehensive Evaluation: A-｣
+
｢Accumulated points: 1,200
Accumulated Evil Value: 115｣
The Evil God Temple shook continuously, and a series of notifications flowed out of it. Everything went as expected by Gu Nan. Tian Tian, who was given the origin by the moon thrall king, was the true moon thrall’s child.
And only then did Gu Nan finally understand the correct way to clear this dungeon.
Actually, he didn’t need to do so much at all. As long as he looked on as a bystander from the very beginning, the moon thrall’s child would naturally appear!
Gu Nan's interference of the original plot actually started with killing Tian Yuan.
If Tian Yuan didn’t die, then there would be no apocalypse at all, and the chaos in the continent would be controllable.
The moon fruits would still appear as usual, and Tian Yuan would most likely obtain the fruits. After Tian Yuan finished cultivating the moon thrall king in the research lab, he would naturally find a way to extract the origin from the moon thrall king.
He had even prepared the vessel named Tian Tian in advance. Why wouldn’t he do it?
So Gu Nan actually only needed to wait until the time was right, then kill Tian Tian.
Of course, if he did that, then his side story development rating would be very low, and the Evil Value obtained wouldn’t be as high as 115, which caused his total Evil Value to reach 440 in one fell swoop.
Anyhow, the Morningstar Plane’s mission could be said to have come to a successful conclusion… Although this conclusion might be a little different from what the world’s will wanted.
If the world’s will really was sentient, then it probably would’ve killed Gu Nan with a thunderbolt a long time ago.
Because it wasn’t a dungeon produced by the Evil God Temple but an external mission that the Evil God Temple incorporated, Gu Nan couldn’t choose to return immediately. His body still remained in the Morningstar Plane.
"Then, everyone, it's time for me to leave," Gu Nan, who was in a good mood, said goodbye to Lin Duo and the others.
The sun and moon spirits were speechless. All hopes of saving the continent were destroyed right in front of them, which also meant that their mission couldn’t be completed.
From now on, this continent was destined to suffer untold miseries, and it would take at least decades for humans to completely eradicate the moon thralls.
Lin Duo, however, seemed to have matured quickly after being hit by the death of her sister and the loss of her best friend.
She stood up and said, "Little Yue said her ancestor predicted that the key to eliminating the moon thrall disaster was me… I understand now. If I had died earlier, you would’ve disappeared, right?"
No trace of immaturity could be seen on Lin Duo’s face. There was only unspeakable sadness.
In her heart, it was precisely her act of summoning Gu Nan that killed her sister and Tian Tian, and caused chaos and brought about the apocalypse.
"So you want to kill yourself to banish me?" Gu Nan asked with great interest.
"No!" Lin Duo angrily replied, "You’ve already achieved your goal. Don't tell me you still want to leave so easily? I will live well so that you—"
Gu Nan’s sword pierced her chest.
The next moment, as Lin Duo's life was cut short, Gu Nan's body began to blur and pull away from the Morningstar Plane.
"If you won’t commit suicide, then what did you prattle on for?" Just before he left, Gu Nan looked at her strangely.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: King of the Northern Region
chapters.content:
Inside White Mist’s headquarters on Heaven and Earth Star’s planetary ring.
When Gu Nan reappeared, it was already nearly half a month after his disappearance.
He didn't actually stay in the Morningstar Plane for too long; he stayed there for a little over a month, but it was barely three days in Star Realm.
But after Gu Nan returned, he was forced to spend more time recuperating.
This time, Gu Nan truly felt the damage that reincarnation did to his soul. The damage on his soul gave him a splitting headache, and it was difficult to concentrate. Not even eating sweets could make it better.
"No wonder very few independent reincarnators exist anymore after reaching a certain level," Gu Nan couldn't help sighing slightly.
The essence of reincarnation was for one’s soul to leave the body and possess the body of a native in a smaller plane. When the reincarnator’s soul reaches a certain level of strength, reincarnation will inevitably damage the soul.
According to White Mist’s data, the severity of this damage depends on two factors: the percentage of soul power one invests in the reincarnation and the duration of the reincarnator’s stay in the smaller plane.
The higher the proportion of one’s soul used for reincarnation and the longer the duration of stay inside the reincarnation plane, the more serious the damage.
"After my soul recovers, I still need at least a period of rest before I can reincarnate again."
"Perhaps I should try some smaller planes. Although the rewards will be smaller, I won’t need to invest as much soul power."
"Since the mist mirror is here, there will be no shortage of missions."
Gu Nan adjusted his own mental state and also summarized the lessons learned from this mission, followed by checking the harvest.
With Lan Si continuously absorbing the Godstone, his Evil Value had already reached 445, which wasn’t far from the 500 threshold. However, the problem of a lack of points remained.
Gu Nan currently had 1,400 points, but it would take 2,500 points to advance to Tier 4, which meant Gu Nan still needed to farm more dungeons.
Corrupting a Godhead could only give him Evil Value, but without points, he wouldn’t be able to advance to Tier 4.
Gu Nan slowly walked out of the hall. There was no sunshine all year round on the planetary ring; there was only a gloomy night sky overhead.
An unfamiliar young girl was waiting outside the door, as if she’d always been waiting for him to appear. As soon as she saw him, she went forward and bowed. "Great Commander, the Second Commander asked you to please visit her as soon as you leave secluded cultivation.”
Gu Nan looked at her face, confirmed that this shouldn’t be one of Red Tail’s doppelgangers, and nodded.
……
Gu Nan saw Red Tail in a quiet room looking the same as usual, although her expression was more dignified.
Originally, White Mist’s affairs were jointly handled by the Sand King and Red Tail, but now that the Sand King had been replaced by Gu Nan, someone who didn’t handle any of the organization’s matters, daily affairs naturally fell on Red Tail's head.
And this was exactly what she wanted—some people in this world were obsessed with power, while others were obsessed with authority and status.
"My Lord, looks like your trip went smoothly," Red Tail chuckled when she saw Gu Nan appear.
Gu Nan had originally set aside an entire month for reincarnation, but he only used half of that time. Naturally, his trip seemed to have gone smoothly.
Gu Nan didn't want to explain too much and bluntly asked, "What's the situation here?"
"Five of the six great Dao Lords died, so Heavenly Mystery ended up seizing complete control of the experiments involving the children of destiny. Ye Chen, who’s known as the King of the Northern Region, has led his forces to invade the southern region… I don't know what Heavenly Mystery wants to achieve."
Red Tail summarized concisely, then added, "But these are only minor matters. There’s news from the Alliance."
She was naturally referring to the Bloodline Alliance. Red Tail said in an odd tone, "His Majesty, the King of the Deep Sea… seems to have returned already."
The King of the Deep Sea was the Tier 4 powerhouse who once used Qin Xuanji to attack Gu Nan from far away with the intention of snatching the Godstone.
Powerful existences at his level usually wouldn’t stay in a certain place for too long. Most of them were wandering outside, doing their own things. The one who attacked Gu Nan earlier might’ve merely been a portion of the power he left behind in the Central Region.
And now, this powerhouse came back—the reason he chose now of all times to return was self-evident. Clearly, this one attached more importance to the Godhead than Gu Nan expected.
Gu Nan couldn't help frowning slightly. ‘What does this world’s Void Cutter existence need a Godhead for? It’s not like he can use it…’
The gods’ power system strongly excluded foreign powers. If you obtain a Godhead, then you can either use it to light a divine fire or corrupt it—it can’t be used for any other purpose.
‘Unless…’
Gu Nan thought of a possibility but didn’t elaborate. He just looked at Red Tail.
"I thought you’d sell me out as soon as you received this information."
There had never been any mutual affection between Gu Nan and Red Tail. They were merely cooperating with each other—so if the risk of cooperation was too great, there would certainly be no need to continue cooperating.
But Red Tail just laughed, "This is the Sixth Region… It's not a backwater place like the Ninth Region. Even a Void Cutter existence can’t casually reach his hands into the Sixth Region."
"Although those two are away from Heaven and Earth Star all year round, they’ve always disliked outsiders secretly reaching into their territory. Plus, the King of the Deep Sea’s reputation is…"
She didn't say much, but she revealed a lot of information.
The Sixth Region was ruled by two Void Cutter figures. Of course, their true bodies wouldn’t be on Heaven and Earth Star, so the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord and the other Dao Lords could play with the continent to their hearts’ content.
However, although the natives of Heaven and Earth Star could play with their own world, outsiders were forbidden from interfering.
Gu Nan nodded, still in thought. Although there was someone above him to keep the King of the Deep Sea in check, he wasn’t stupid enough to think that he could just rest easy with that.
If the King of the Deep Sea really came here with his true body, then he could absolutely kill Gu Nan and still leave unscathed.
When those two Void Cutter rulers rush back, at most, they’d make the King of the Deep Sea pay some price as an apology. It was impossible for them to start a war with the King of the Deep Sea just because they lost some face.
Gu Nan’s only advantage was that the King of the Deep Sea wouldn’t be able to deal with him so conspicuously.
‘Just wait a little longer…’ Gu Nan thought, and a dark glint flashed through his eyes. ‘As soon as I reach Tier 4, I'll slaughter a wave of monsters at the Blood Alliance first.’
Gu Nan secretly swore viciously. His mentality was probably similar to this: he was chased by the police for three blocks, so after he levelled up, he returned and even bombed the police station.
If he wanted to advance, at present, what he lacked the most were points, so he couldn’t stop reincarnation for the time being.
In addition, he’d also need to start developing White Mist more. The advancement from Tier 4 to Tier 5 was also a process of accumulating Evil Value and points, which meant Gu Nan required a large number of world missions.
"How's the plan for the shell organization going?" Gu Nan asked another question.
"The current situation isn’t bad, but it will be a bit grim in the future." Red Tail looked a little helpless. "The civil war between North and South has practically escalated into a full-blown war, so it’s hard for the organization to develop steadily."
"The work of another child of destiny!" Gu Nan's eyes showed some interest.
One Lin Tian was already enough to create a mist mirror. As the first child of destiny to awaken, how many mirrors would Ye Chen, the King of the Northern Region, be able to create?
Just in time, his soul had recovered as well, although it would still take him some time to stabilize his soul before he could reincarnate again. Now was a nice time to collect the fish caught in the net—as for whether the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord had some plan involving Ye Chen… What did that have to do with Gu Nan?
"Give me the report on the shell organization’s situation."
"No problem." Red Tail chuckled and added, "My Lord, you’ve completed the world mission, so don't forget to collect the rewards!"

chapters.title: Chapter 190: I am the Walkthrough
chapters.content:
Gu Nan sat alone in the palace with a mist mirror in his hand. There was no trace of fog left on the mirror, and there was even a small piece of shimmering light.
This was what a mission completion reward from the world’s will looked like.
White Mist kept a great deal of detailed information on reincarnation. After an earlier period of research, Gu Nan was no longer the novice from back then who didn’t know a thing about reincarnation.
Each plane had its own world’s will, which would act in accordance with certain rules. When they find something incongruous in the world, they would make an external request.
These requests were received by outsiders in various ways, translated into missions, and completed via reincarnation—of course, if one had the ability, they could also tear a hole in space and directly travel to that plane.
There were various ways to translate the missions. White Mist, for example, made use of fate, and there were also strange methods that relied on faith, resentment, and even living organisms.
It didn’t matter whether the translator completed the mission personally or not. After the world’s request was completed, the reward would be given to the translator.
Gu Nan placed his hand gently on the mist mirror, and an unspeakable energy gradually emerged.
Everything Gu Nan did in the Morningstar Plane was replayed in front of his eyes again, all the way until Tian Tian became the moon thrall’s child and was subsequently killed by him.
‘As expected, the so-called world’s will isn’t actually a conscious force…’ Gu Nan ridiculed silently in his heart.
If the Morningstar Plane had the same consciousness as a human being, it would probably have kicked him out furiously after seeing everything he did in that plane, much less give a reward.
The energy from the plane spread along Gu Nan's hand and reached his brain in the blink of an eye, trying to enter his mind and soul.
At this time, the Evil God Temple actually shook again, and a piece of information was released.
｢Integrating external dungeon… Please name the new personal dungeon (incomplete)｣
When Gu Nan read this message and finally reacted, he almost blurted out “Fuck,” and countless curses ran through his heart.
‘It's actually a personal dungeon! How can a personal dungeon appear at this time?’
What was a personal dungeon?
Personal dungeon was just the game’s official terminology. If an old player who had been immersed in the Evil God game for many years saw this, he’d definitely tell you the answer in two words—Divine Kingdom!
During Tier 5, every player had to build multiple personal dungeons and then turn them into tangible existences.
Of course, the reverse could also be done. A player could find a dungeon and turn it into a personal dungeon that they could manipulate at will.
A player who completed any one of the above conditions would be considered to have built their Divine Kingdom and would step into Tier 6.
Gu Nan’s earlier obsession with Immortal Demon World was also due to this. He planned to adopt the latter method and wanted to turn Immortal Demon World into his own personal dungeon.
But the Evil God Temple was now telling him that there was already an incomplete personal dungeon here?
Gu Nan's current mood was like having an account that just unlocked a skill tree. He had just activated the first two rows of skills when the ultimate skill at the top revealed itself.
‘Hey! I haven’t even unlocked the skills before that. How in the world can I light up that ultimate skill?’
However, Gu Nan was someone who had experienced great storms and soon calmed down—setting aside the matter of advancing to Tier 6 for now, there was already a problem with converting the personal dungeon into a tangible existence. After all, the notification clearly said it was “incomplete”!
His consciousness quickly sank into the Evil God Temple. On the virtual control panel in front of him, there was already a column for "personal dungeon" with only one lone dungeon on it, waiting to be named.
｢Set name as “Morningstar”｣
To make it easier to remember, Gu Nan gave it the same name as the original plane.
The name of the dungeon quickly changed to Morningstar, and at the same time a progress bar appeared after it: 30%.
‘It’s already 30% complete?’ Gu Nan rubbed his chin, thinking rapidly.
In the game, there was only one way to build a personal dungeon or convert a dungeon into a personal one—the player must replace the plane’s original laws with the player’s own laws.
After the player reaches Tier 5, a progress bar will appear on all dungeons.
Players manipulate the laws in that plane to raise the progress bar. When the progress bar exceeds 80%, players can attempt to convert the dungeon into their personal dungeon.
But things seemed a little different now.
Gu Nan hadn't even reached Tier 4, so he couldn’t even manipulate the laws in that plane yet. How could he even get a progress bar?
‘No wait, the essence of substituting the plane’s laws with your own is actually taking control of the world’s origin… Could it be that when the world’s origin tried to give me a reward, the Evil God Temple directly swallowed it whole?’
The more he thought about it, the more this felt likely.
‘Other cultivators improved their own laws by observing and sensing the world’s origin, but I actually ate the world’s origin…’
‘The easiest way to verify this is to translate some smaller world missions for people to complete.’
‘Although a 30% complete Morningstar dungeon can't be unlocked yet, if it’s a smaller plane, the Evil God Temple might be able to eat up all of that world’s origin in one go!’
Gu Nan's eyes shone with excitement—personal dungeons weren’t only used to establish one’s Divine Kingdom. His lack of points might be resolved by this as well.
……
"Eh? Why are you back again?" Red Tail looked at Gu Nan strangely. ‘Didn't this person say he’s going to find Lan Si and help her deal with the King of the Northern Region?’
"Did anyone finish the world missions I gave you last time?" Gu Nan asked eagerly.
"Not yet." Red Tail shook her head. "Most people in our organization excel at creating mist mirrors and collecting ingredients. People who are good at doing missions are all rare treasures. How can they be so easy to find?"
Although the translation method was precious, once they obtained it, it would just become a common thing; it wasn’t hard to implement at all.
On the contrary, people who could complete missions were extremely precious in any reincarnator organization, and most of them worked in large organizations.
Red Tail couldn’t help chuckling upon seeing Gu Nan's expression. "I've received a lot of rewards from various worlds’ origins over the years, so the effect has weakened for me. I've already told them to prioritize the missions you translated last time."
Red Tail didn’t feel that there was anything wrong with Gu Nan’s eagerness.
After all, she knew very well how much a world’s origin could help Dao Lords—her reaction wasn’t much better when she first received a reward from the world’s origin many years ago.
So she advised, "Many missions are unique and cannot be attempted multiple times, so members are relatively cautious. It takes time for them to understand the mission information, prepare the necessary materials, and choose the right time to enter the plane."
Red Tail also used to complete missions before she was promoted and even achieved excellent results, so she was very clear about this process.
"So I advise you to deal with Ye Chen first. Catching another child of destiny will increase the number of missions members can choose from—"
Gu Nan waved his hand. "Call all the people in the organization who are responsible for carrying out missions here. I'll teach them how to clear the missions."
Red Tail stared at him in astonishment, and Gu Nan stared right back without hesitation, pointing to himself in passing.
"What are you looking at? I
am
the walkthrough."

chapters.title: Chapter 191: A Day in Chu Kangs Life
chapters.content:
Chu Kang was a White Mist member who was responsible for completing world missions, just like what Gu Nan and the others did in Radiant Tower back then.
But Chu Kang was very angry today.
There was a mission reward he really wanted in the batch of missions given by the organization just half a month ago, and the mission itself wasn’t too hard either. After preparing for a long time, he was about to start working on that mission, but he was suddenly asked to put everything down right now.
Why would they gather all the members responsible for completing missions? There must be other missions to complete!
"Amateurs ordering professionals around!" Chu Kang grumbled discontentedly, but he had no choice but to comply.
After all, these amateurs were his superiors.
Chu Kang was still full of impatience when he reached the meeting place. He just wanted to get this done early and return to preparing his own mission.
But just as he was about to push the door in, an acquaintance rushed out of it.
"Big Guan? You were also summoned?" Chu Kang spoke in surprise, as if this person shouldn't have appeared here.
The person in front of him was Guan Sheng, who was also one of White Mist's mission personnel, but he was much more famous than Chu Kang and was considered an ace in completing missions.
If Chu Kang didn’t have a good personal relationship with him, he wouldn’t even be able to talk to Guan Sheng.
But the current Guan Sheng was in a hurry. He just barely managed a smile and greeted Chu Kang briefly. The words "I have to go now" were practically written all over his face.
Chu Kang was used to this. Guan Sheng was usually a mission maniac and wasn’t interested in anything else.
‘Now that he was called here for no reason, he’s probably impatient to leave.’
He just didn't expect that when Guan Sheng turned to leave but realized Chu Kang was empty-handed, he hesitated and advised, "Don’t you usually also get tricky missions? It’ll be best if you bring along information on those missions… Oh right, this is only limited to the batch half a month ago."
After saying that, Guan Sheng hurried away, leaving Chu Kang with a face full of confusion.
‘Don’t tell me that the hard missions can be resolved as long as I bring their information here?’
Chu Kang shook his head as he pushed the door in and entered, but what he saw was a rather bizarre scene.
A young man in a white robe was sitting in the main seat, talking and occasionally writing something on the board behind him.
When Chu Kang entered, the young man was filling up a board with writing, then replaced it with a new board while the old board was taken away respectfully by a person next to him.
Chu Kang’s eyes almost popped out when he realized who that humble-looking figure was.
That was the head of their missions department, Mr. Zuo Chuanyuan—Elder Zuo!
Elder Zuo was one of White Mist’s elders, and he was also a bloodline user from the Central Region. Not only was he strong, but he was also an absolute authority in executing missions!
If not for the fact that there really were very few bloodline user reincarnation organizations, Elder Zuo staying in White Mist might even be considered a waste of his talent.
But such a distinguished elder was now respectfully receiving that board filled with handwriting and glancing around for fear of someone snatching that board away.
"Elder Zuo," Chu Kang hurriedly stepped forward to greet him. All the people present were from their missions department, so of course he’d greet his top boss first. "This is…"
When Elder Zuo saw him, he just nodded. "You’re here, have a seat first. Listen attentively and study hard."
After saying that, he buried himself in studying the board. Chu Kang was dumbfounded, and when he saw all the people next to him in similar states, he could only sit down patiently.
After Chu Kang sat down, he heard the white-robed youth in the main seat say, "Next one… White Bird City State—whose mission is this?"
As soon as his voice fell, the door was slammed open, and someone shouted, "Mine! My Lord, that's my mission!"
Chu Kang stared at the door with wide eyes. Guan Sheng had already run back in, sweat still on his forehead.
As Guan Sheng spoke, he hurriedly handed the information in his hand to the white-robed youth. Gu Sheng seemed glad that he had returned in time.
White Bird City State—Chu Kang had heard of this mission before.
The mission was in a small plane, but there was a Domain Stage expert watching over that plane, and the mission objective was to kill the son of a member of that city state’s legislature.
According to the information sent back by White Mist’s scouts, the legislative member kept his son under very strict and comprehensive guard, and the scouts couldn’t even determine the target’s name. They only knew the school he went to and some other basic information.
Based on the scouts’ investigation, there were currently 21 suspects who could be the assassination target—the legislative member’s son.
In order to not trigger the mission ahead of schedule, the scouts dared not investigate too deeply and could only send back this much information.
"Scheduled plan: Secretly investigate the background of the suspected targets one by one, or start with the legislative member himself. If you have any information about the target’s identity, please feel free to contact headquarters."
After reading the mission information, the white-robed young man then re-read the plan given by the missions department.
In the absence of detailed information, the missions department could only choose to approach it this way. This plan was personally reviewed by Chu Kang, and he didn’t believe it left anything out.
However, the youth’s next words almost made him furious.
"Who made this plan? What's the use of investigating the legislative member? Why not just go to the target and kill him directly?" The young man threw the file onto the table and said dismissively.
Chu Kang glared at him. He really wanted to stand up and interrogate the other person: ‘Do you really understand? Did you really read the information carefully? There are 21 suspects. As long as any one of them encounters an accident, the real target will be alarmed, and the defenses around him will tighten and render further assassination attempts impossible!’
‘What's more, even if you’re lucky enough to find your target, who can guarantee that the target will be unprotected?’
Most world missions were time-sensitive. After all, the reincarnation planes were also real worlds and were also moving along an established timeline.
If they didn’t find a suitable entry point, it might lead directly to mission failure.
A sneer had already appeared on Chu Kang's face. ‘This person is clearly an amateur.’
Based on his years of experience completing missions, that legislative member himself was obviously the key. If you find enough clues from him to confirm the target’s true identity, you can kill the target with one blow.
And there may be false information during this process, so this would test whether the person carrying out this mission had the ability to distinguish truth from lies.
But this wasn’t his own mission, so Chu Kang could only crush his anger. Even if others didn’t speak up, he believed that Guan Sheng would definitely speak up.
Guan Sheng really did speak up, but his attitude was so polite that Chu Kang thought it was the wrong person.
"There are 21 people suspected of being the target. May I ask—how can we confirm which one is the true target?" Guan Sheng half-bowed, as if he was a student asking a teacher a question.
The young man took his attitude for granted and answered, "But you don't need to confirm that? Why don't you just kill them all? Look carefully at the information of these 21 people."
"Sixteen are students of the same high school, four are teachers of this high school, and there’s only one unemployed person left."
"Take enough high-end explosives with you when you reincarnate. Find the unemployed person first, take him to the high school, and put all the explosives on him, then detonate it."
The young man knocked on the table and casually returned the file to Guan Sheng. "It doesn't matter how many people are protecting the target, as long as there are enough explosives."
"Next."

chapters.title: Chapter 192: The Heavily Injured Lan Si
chapters.content:
Chu Kang’s entire person was in a daze when he left the conference room.
"It's already night…" He looked up at the sky. His mind was still muddled, and he muttered to himself, "Oh right, we’re on the planetary ring. There's no day here."
This wasn’t Chu Kang's fault. Anyone would look like this after a whole day of having their beliefs torn down.
This was like the champion of an Olympiad competition being beaten to pieces in the field that he was proudest of after listening to an internationally renowned university lecture for a day.
"Big Guan, are we dreaming right now?" Chu Kang patted Guan Sheng's shoulder. "Why do I feel that the missions have suddenly become easy?"
Guan Sheng's situation was better than his. At least his mind was still clear. He sighed and said, "I don't know who that master is and whether he will come again… Forget it, I should finish these missions first!"
Classmate Guan Sheng, a mission maniac, took a booklet of missions and left excitedly.
Chu Kang looked down at the little notebook in his hand, which was also filled with ways to deal with each mission. Then he remembered that extremely youthful face, and his heart was still full of disbelief.
……
When Gu Nan returned to the palace, he really felt a little exhausted.
Even though those missions weren’t very difficult in his view, it was still mentally tiring to resolve so many missions in one day.
But if his guess was correct, then this small price was more than worth it!
Time usually flowed much faster in the smaller planes than in Star Realm, so the time required to complete the missions hardly amounted to anything in Star Realm.
Gu Nan took out the mist mirror again, and many bright spots were already lit up on it. Those were all indications that the smaller missions had been completed.
｢Integrating external dungeon… Please name the new personal dungeon (incomplete)｣
｢Integrating external dungeon… Please name the new personal dungeon (incomplete)｣
｢Integrating external dungeon… Please name the new personal dungeon (complete)｣
｢Integrating external dungeon…｣
The worlds’ origins were integrated, and a series of notifications emerged from the Evil God Temple. There were over a dozen missions this time, but only one was able to successfully establish a personal dungeon.
‘One is enough!’
Gu Nan's heart was slightly pleased, and he hurriedly opened the dungeon interface to see if the personal dungeon mentioned here was the same as the ones in his impression.
In the dungeon interface, rows of incomplete dungeons were still gray. The word “complete” on a single row stood out.
｢Personal dungeon (unnamed)—fixed dungeon.
Starting Members: 4 people
Dungeon Reset Period: 3 days｣
In his previous life’s game, personal dungeons were a very interesting way to play the game, and co-op between different players was basically done through this.
Personal dungeons could be divided into “autonomous” and “fixed” types based on whether players actually constructed it themselves or whether they converted it from a pre-existing dungeon, respectively.
Players used autonomous dungeons for advancement. If they wanted to level up to Tier 6 and complete the first First Round, then the best method was to use autonomous dungeons.
Although fixed dungeons could also be converted into a player’s private property as a personal dungeon, the biggest use for them wasn’t for advancement. Instead, it was… to farm points!
Of course dungeons are used for farming—the kind of farming that’s done again and again. Although personal dungeons won’t give Evil Value, a certain number of points can be obtained from them.
As soon as the fixed dungeon is activated, players can choose to enter it and complete the mission with their NPC companions or form parties with other online players.
Of course, there were no online players in this world. ‘If I start this dungeon, I wonder how my companions will be selected?’
In the original game, in order to enhance randomness, NPC companions were randomly selected from all over the world, so it might be a dungeon character players were familiar with or a completely unfamiliar NPC.
Gu Nan didn’t have time to ponder it some more. Anyhow, he’d know once he ran the dungeon once.
However, the palace’s main doors were suddenly pushed open, and Red Tail hurried in.
Gu Nan's mind quickly pulled away from the Evil God Temple. On the throne, he slowly opened his eyes and looked at Red Tail with a slightly displeased expression.
Aware of this, Red Tail didn't hesitate to get straight to the point, "My Lord, Lan Si suffered heavy injuries…"
……
Inside the Tang family residence on Heaven and Earth Star’s mainland.
Tang Xuan was anxiously standing outside the door, waiting for the situation inside to improve.
"My goodness, you've been pacing back and forth here at least twenty times. Can you stop for a while?" A young man in black asked from next to her.
His leisurely tone was in stark contrast to Tang Xuan's anxiety.
"What do you know?!” Tang Xuan glared at him fiercely. "If something really goes wrong, just prepare your own funeral."
"Wow, so scary!" The young man made a mockingly fearful expression, clearly looking unconcerned.
After a pause, he said to himself when Tang Xuan didn't respond, "That woman called Lan Si was the one who ran over here uninvited. Don’t tell me that we can be blamed for this?"
"No matter how powerful the person backing her is, he still has to be reasonable, right? We were handling a matter for the Merchant Alliance this time!"
The young man wasn’t concerned in the slightest, and he was even more disdainful in his heart.
His name was Tang Ziquan, a leading figure in the Tang family’s younger generation. He’d traveled with his family’s caravan through several regions of Star Realm, so both his experience and strength were far above those of ordinary people.
Unlike Tang Xuan, a free sprout that grew up without much help from the family, Tang Ziquan not only broke through Prodigious Realm early on, but he also had many fortuitous encounters, so he was a junior that the Tang family used all its resources to cultivate.
He had just returned to Heaven and Earth Star and had never experienced the farce that happened in the Tang family earlier, so he didn’t take Lan Si’s injuries to heart at all.
In his opinion, this was really nothing special.
It was all too common for several sides to fight over a resource. Other people wouldn’t hold back in the middle of the fight just because of Lan Si’s background.
‘Isn't this woman named Lan Si merely the head of a newly-established small organization? She even wants to follow our family’s lead and enjoy a piece of the pie.’
‘Yet she insists that we’re cooperating. Is she qualified to cooperate with us?’
She seemed a little strong when she first started fighting, but it didn't take long for her to be exposed—she turned out to be a chick with no combat experience!
Tang Ziquan, who had been fighting outside for a long time, despised the sheltered flowers that grew up in a greenhouse the most, so his mouth naturally wouldn’t be polite.
After casually egging her on a little, sure enough, Lan Si took his bait. As a result, she was badly wounded in the chaotic fight.
While the two were still talking, the door opened, and a doctor came out, gently shaking his head at Tang Xuan. "We tried our best… Whether she can wake up or not depends on providence."
Depends on providence—that meant the doctors were helpless.
Tang Xuan was stunned. She was just about to speak when someone on the other side came to report, "Eldest Miss, two people came to visit. They say they’re your friends."
The corners of Tang Xuan’s mouth twitched, and she didn’t know what to say for a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 193: My Surname is Gu
chapters.content:
Gu Nan stood in the Tang family’s lobby, feeling a little strange.
It was indeed unexpected that Lan Si would be seriously injured. Or rather, it never occurred to him that an NPC would court death to the point of being killed.
But when he thought about it, Lan Si’s personality was indeed like that.
At the beginning, when they were fighting proxy battles on Heavenly Enterprise Star, she might’ve died at Qin Xuanji’s hands if her brother didn’t intervene.
Gu Nan shook his head humorously. Fortunately, she had the Godstone… As the carrier of the Godstone, she couldn't even commit suicide, let alone be killed.
Suffering a serious blow this time may even help her mature.
"Where is she?" Gu Nan asked casually.
Tang Xuan, who was standing in front of him, showed a bitter smile. She knew the end result when Gu Nan made a scene in front of the Tang family back then. Now that something happened to Lan Si, it was hard to predict what Gu Nan would do.
"Her condition isn’t very good. The doctor said…"
"It's fine, she won’t die." Gu Nan waved his hand.
Tang Ziquan followed Tang Xuan, and when he saw Gu Nan's confident expression, his mouth showed a little sneer, but he didn’t speak.
Moments later, Gu Nan was in front of Lan Si's bed. The latter’s face was extremely pale, and even her breathing was weak.
‘The Godstone wasn’t triggered? Is the injury not heavy enough…?’
Gu Nan only took one look and already knew the reason why Lan Si was in a coma.
She suffered an injury to the brain, so she couldn't wake up, but the injury itself wasn't serious, so the Godstone didn't come out and heal her.
In the game’s terms, Lan Si was hit by a crowd control skill but didn’t lose too much HP.
But in reality, even if it was only a minor injury, once it damaged a vital spot, it was still enough to cause serious consequences.
Tang Xuan looked at his thoughtful silence and couldn't help saying, "She's just in a coma now. It's better to…"
"No matter," Gu Nan spat out the two words lightly, and a small black dagger appeared in his hand.
The dagger sank into Lan Si's heart, causing blood to splash out. Tang Xuan and Tang Ziquan, together with Red Tail who came along with him, suddenly looked dumbfounded.
Even Red Tail, who figured that Gu Nan would be able to cure Lan Si, didn't expect him to do it this way.
The next second, a golden light lit up on Lan Si's forehead, and an indescribably sublime aura flashed by. By the time the light disappeared, the wounds on her body had all healed.
"She’ll wake up later." Gu Nan looked at Red Tail. "What happened to her?"
"There are traces of destiny at work," Red Tail answered with a dark expression.
Ever since Gu Nan heard about Lan Si’s situation in the palace, he first asked about the events that led up to it.
It was a simple matter. Lan Si was ordered to set up the shell organization "Blue Lake." She had never been the leader of any organization before, so she could only seek help from Red Tail while cooperating with others to develop the organization.
She had no roots on Heaven and Earth Star, so naturally she was completely blind. In the end, she could only ask the Tang family for help—at least she knew them.
The Tang family knew that Gu Nan was backing Lan Si, so they were happy to help, but the result of cooperation wasn’t too good.
But what surprised Gu Nan the most was the person who wounded Lan Si.
This person was called Ye Long. He was born in the Northern Region and was precisely the younger brother of Ye Chen, the King of the Northern Region. This Ye Long was also a famous child of destiny on the continent.
But such a child of destiny wouldn’t easily form a connection with other experts. Moreover, a karmic connection would only be formed if Ye Long was guided along by the force of destiny.
As the initial user of the forces of fate and destiny, White Mist was very certain of this.
For example, the previous feud between Gu Nan and Lin Tian first happened through Fu Jing. Through her, the force of destiny naturally fell onto Gu Nan.
"No prior karmic connections were found on Lan Si. The force of destiny descended upon her directly, without any warning… This is the work of Heavenly Mystery," Red Tail explained expressionlessly.
"Good." Gu Nan revealed a small sneer. He didn’t kill the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord back then, but who would’ve thought this person would still dare to scamper about and cause mischief?
After a pause, Gu Nan added, "The net we’ve cast over Heaven and Earth Star can be pulled up now; you can start hunting the children of destiny… Can you guys handle that Ye Chen?"
"No problem. This is what we’re good at," Red Tail replied with a chuckle. "Regarding Heavenly Mystery…"
White Mist’s translation method depended on collecting the fate of children of destiny, so they naturally developed many methods to deal with the children of destiny. White Mist’s methods weren’t half-baked like those of the six great Dao Lords.
The six Dao Lords only learned how to set up the net but didn't learn how to pull up the net, which was why things ended up spiraling out of control.
The two spoke as if Tang Xuan and Tang Ziquan beside them didn’t exist.
Tang Xuan had long since gotten used to Gu Nan's atrocious character, but Tang Ziquan’s eyes looked slightly dark as he said, "You two are talking about Ye Chen, the King of the Northern Region? Just yesterday, three Dao Lords fell at his hands!"
After breaking through to the Dao Lord level, Ye Chen spent decades recuperating and building up the Northern Region like an iron barrel. Right now, he finally embarked on the road of outward expansion.
His move was thunderous, and in a very short time, the Northern Region’s army took over cities and seized territories everywhere.
The reason Lan Si was injured by Ye Long was because they were fighting over a resource.
In response to Tang Ziquan's words, Red Tail just glanced at him apathetically, then smiled slightly and didn't speak. Gu Nan, on the other hand, completely ignored him.
"I'll leave this side to you. When she wakes up, have her return to the organization to cultivate. I'm going to have a chat with Heavenly Mystery."
After leaving such a sentence, Gu Nan's figure suddenly disappeared.
……
Gu Nan was actually reluctant to waste time on Heaven and Earth Star now that he had a personal dungeon.
He only ever took action for Evil Value and points, and at most, he was temporarily a little more careful after catching the attention of a Tier 4 expert.
Reincarnation was in cooldown, Evil Value was being continuously provided by Lan Si, and earning points depended on the personal dungeon.
Knowing that the King of the Deep Sea had returned, coupled with this incident, Gu Nan decided to have Lan Si hide away first—even Heavenly Mystery was aware of Lan Si’s existence. Who can say that the King of the Deep Sea won’t notice her?
If Lan Si was caught by the King of the Deep Sea before Gu Nan could rise to Tier 4, the losses would far outweigh the gains.
As he thought that, Gu Nan had arrived at the Heavenly Mystery Dao Hall.
This time he didn't arrive using the starship but flew up directly with his own strength. So as soon as he arrived at the main gates, someone immediately came to stop him.
"Sir, who are you? If you want to enter my Heavenly Mystery Dao Hall, please report your surna—"
A sword of shadow cut through the air with a black light, and several guards’ bodies had already been sliced in half. Gu Nan’s expression didn’t even change at all.
He controlled White Mist, so he naturally knew that interfering in destiny required the support of an organization. It was very troublesome for a single person to control it alone. So even if he couldn’t kill Heavenly Mystery this time, Gu Nan still had to slaughter everyone in his Dao Hall.
If Heavenly Mystery was the only person left, he’d naturally have no way of interfering with fate anymore.
Gu Nan walked slowly into the Dao Hall, and when he passed their corpses, he also told a not-so-funny joke, "My surname is Gu."

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Star Ruler, Star Ruler
chapters.content:
Blood stained the planetary ring, and corpses were strewn everywhere.
Gu Nan was all alone, holding a single sword—actually, that wasn’t quite right, because in fact, dozens of shadow clones were marching forth synchronously, wantonly killing any living person in sight.
Be it the disciples of Heavenly Mystery Dao Hall or cultivators who came to seek information from the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord, none of them could escape death.
Although the latter group were actually innocent, what did that matter?
Gu Nan didn’t have time to make the effort to distinguish between who deserved to die and who was innocent. He would only take the most efficient route to settle things. As for things like morality and ethics, those didn’t apply to players.
"Who the hell are you? What grudge do you have against my Heavenly Mystery Dao Hall?!” A steward-like person, who seemed to be still alive after being struck by a sword, struggled to get up.
"Where's Heavenly Mystery?" Gu Nan asked emotionlessly.
The steward sneered, "The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord can divine everything under Heaven. How can he possibly be found by you?"
Gu Nan nodded in agreement, then cut off his head with a sword.
Gu Nan wasn’t an Eighth Grade Syndrome patient who believed that "the whole world should listen to me." Of course other people had the right to disobey him. Similarly, he also had the right to kill all disobedient people.
The fact that the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord could run away meant he had some ability, but that didn’t prevent Gu Nan from slaughtering his Dao Hall—although a monk can run away, the monk’s temple cannot.
The shadow clones’ massacre continued. Occasionally, someone managed to escape, but Gu Nan was unconcerned.
He slowly made his way into the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s study. Most of the books here had already been emptied. It seemed that the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord had indeed expected this.
This was normal. Almost anyone who knew Gu Nan wouldn’t be stupid enough to wait for death at home after injuring Lan Si.
"He ran away on his own and abandoned the Dao Hall’s disciples and grand-disciples in order to pull the wool over everyone’s eyes. He’s truly heartless!"
Gu Nan commented on the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s ruthlessness, but it never occurred to him that he was the one acting as the executioner.
……
The process of slaughtering everyone in Heavenly Mystery Dao Hall was lackluster; there wasn't any decent resistance at all. Furthermore, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord had retreated early on.
"He went to all this trouble—does he want to use this to break through to Tier 4?" In his spare time, Gu Nan considered the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s possible motives. This was probably the reason.
‘He could even abandon his own Dao Hall. Why else would he do that?’
But this was none of Gu Nan's business.
After locking Lan Si in a little black room to cultivate in earnest, Gu Nan left White Mist and hid in a small town on the mainland, disguising himself as an ordinary scholar.
The King of the Deep Sea had returned to Star Realm and might look for him at any time. At the very least, this was still a Tier 4 existence, so he should be given some respect.
Gu Nan's relationship with White Mist couldn’t be hidden from those who knew where to look. Staying in White Mist was tantamount to courting death.
"Personal dungeon…" After handling the other matters, Gu Nan could finally settle down and study his personal dungeon.
Earlier, he’d developed over a dozen personal dungeons at once, but only one of those progress bars had reached 100% and was shown as "complete.”
The small plane corresponding to this dungeon was called "Splendid World."
Splendid World wasn’t too small. There was only one planet in the plane, and the local civilization had developed into something half reliant on technology and half on supernatural powers.
Even in a modern city that resembled a forest of steel, there were still people with all kinds of powers. Moreover, everyone in this world knew about supernatural powers.
｢Name it “Splendid World” and start the personal dungeon｣
Gu Nan ordered the interface. Then he discovered that his consciousness had returned to his true body, and his soul began to pull out independently.
This process very much resembled reincarnation, but this time his soul didn’t travel to the void outside the plane. Instead, it came to a strange space.
A small ball of light broke away from his soul, and he could tell that it was the ball of light representing Splendid World.
And after releasing that ball of light, his soul became a very tiny dot of light and slowly moved towards the ball of light.
What surprised Gu Nan even more was that there were countless light balls and dots in this strange space.
As soon as Splendid World’s ball of light appeared, it immediately attracted many bright dots.
Around the ball of light, there were clearly four gaps for four bright dots to enter. Besides Gu Nan himself, who firmly held one of those spots, the other three spots caused fierce competition.
Gu Nan watched this scene in astonishment. He had never seen this in the game before.
No, it should be said that he had seen a similar picture before—it was a scene where a rich player built a map and other players rushed to enter the dungeon!
‘Could it be…’
The next moment, Gu Nan’s consciousness appeared in the office of a skyscraper, and three people were sitting in front of him with smiles on their faces.
A woman, an old man, and a little boy.
The woman was dressed fashionably in modern clothing and had thick eye shadow, but it didn’t give people a tacky feeling. Instead, it seemed extremely charming.
The old man, on the other hand, was dressed in clothes that were a little more dated. He wore a pair of gold-rimmed glasses and a black suit with two rows of buttons. He looked like a scientist from the old portraits.
The little boy was just a little boy, but his clothes were the weirdest—he wore half of a lady's sun hat on his head.
The reason why it was half was because the hat had been cut in half right down the middle, leaving only the left part, and the little boy actually wore it like this.
Gu Nan looked at the three strange people and coughed slightly. "How should I address you three?"
The woman smiled. "You may call me Zi Yi, Lord."
The little boy also smiled. His smile was very bizarre. The smiles on his left face and his right face were incongruous. It looked like two different people were smiling. "Zuo Zuo
[1]
, everyone calls me that."
It seemed that the old man was the most friendly, and his attitude was also the most humble. He repeatedly said, "This humble one is Qiu Wenran, who became a Star Ruler only 4,000 years ago. I don’t dare to address myself as an equal to my two seniors."
Hearing this, Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow, but he didn't reveal other expressions. He said flatly, "My name is Gu Nan."
Zi Yi and Zuo Zuo seemed to be quite famous. Since the old man Qiu Wenran thought of himself as a junior, the task of communicating with Gu Nan naturally fell to him.
"Lord Gu Nan, are you the master of this small world? May I inquire about this world’s original name…" In the middle of Qiu Wenran's speech, he waved his hand again and again. “Please don’t be offended, I'm just asking a random question."
Gu Nan waved his hand, then answered, "This is Splendid World."
Qiu Wenran and Zuo Zuo had no reaction, but Zi Yi said, "So it’s Splendid World… I came here over 600 years ago. I already liked it at that time, but I didn't expect for someone to take control of it in the blink of an eye."
"Splendid World is indeed good," Zuo Zuo also said. When he spoke, the expressions on the left and right sides of his face were completely mismatched. "Besides cultivation level restrictions being a little too low and restricting everyone to a maximum level of Prodigious Realm, the rest of this world is quite good."
Gu Nan looked at the three people talking, and after thinking about it, he asked, "So everyone… What’s the current situation?"
Hearing this, the three of them couldn't help but stare blankly. Finally, Qiu Wenran said with a chuckle, "Lord, you must be a person who is immersed in cultivation and doesn’t touch worldly matters. You already have the strength to take control of a world. Is this the first time you entered the Myriad Heavens Starry Road?"
Gu Nan nodded without saying anything.
He didn’t really understand the current situation, but one thing was certain: his three companions inside this personal dungeon… were three impressive Star Rulers!
T/N:
[1]
Zuo Zuo:
His name is just the character for left, twice in a row. Translated literally his name is Left Left
