chapters.title: Chapter 195: Starting Point Kill
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was actually very familiar with personal dungeons.
The Evil God game was a single-player game where certain content could also be played with other players, and personal dungeons were the basis for players to form parties.
From Tier 5 onwards, players would start to possess personal dungeons. Players could use their own laws to modify the dungeon, then put the modified product on a public platform for other players to challenge.
But before this kind of personal dungeon could be released to the public, the creator had to clear the dungeon once first. Moreover, after the dungeon was released, the creator would no longer be able to earn any rewards from participating in that dungeon.
The other was a random dungeon—that is, after the player makes the dungeon public, the system will randomly modify it so that not even the player will know what it’ll be changed into.
What Gu Nan was facing now seemed to correspond to one of the game’s random dungeons.
Gu Nan and his three companions stood on the roof of the building. There was a blood-red countdown timer in midair, which was counting down the last 30 seconds.
"You mean, the Myriad Heavens Starry Road will generate missions for this dun— for this small world based on my knowledge and experience?" Gu Nan asked with a strange expression.
"Exactly." Qiu Wenran nodded.
Gu Nan turned his head and focused on the timer, but his gaze became more and more odd.
After a cursory exchange with Qiu Wenran and the other two, Gu Nan received so much information at once that he still didn’t process it fully yet.
These three were indeed all Star Rulers at Tier 5 or perhaps even higher—they were genuine Star Rulers!
According to Qiu Wenran, he himself had been a Star Ruler for “only” 4,000 years, and he hadn't had time to choose which world to take charge of yet.
As for Zi Yi and Zuo Zuo, both of them were veteran experts on the Myriad Heavens Starry Road. They were genuine big shots.
‘The Star Ruler Realm corresponds to Tier 5, and starting from Tier 5, the player will begin to look for a dungeon to modify into their own Divine Kingdom… Sure enough, this process is exactly the same as the one in the game!’ Gu Nan secretly rubbed his chin and thought to himself.
‘Normally, I should only be able to enter this world after reaching Tier 5 and owning a personal dungeon, but since the Evil God Temple devoured this world’s origin, this step arrived ahead of schedule.’
‘This ahead of schedule caused me to meet fellows at Tier 5 or higher when I’m only Tier 3…’
Fortunately, according to Qiu Wenran, only a wisp of their consciousness entered the Myriad Heavens Starry Road; it couldn’t even be considered a portion of their soul, so Star Rulers couldn’t really hurt each other in this world.
Even if they were killed, their bodies would be recreated by laws in the blink of an eye, and they would be completely unharmed.
‘Even the mechanism where dungeons can be attempted infinitely has been retained. This really is similar…’ Gu Nan sighed lightly, and the countdown in mid-air was almost over.
The Myriad Heavens Starry Road replaced the game system, and Star Rulers replaced other players—only Gu Nan was still himself.
"If the missions really are created from my knowledge,” Gu Nan spoke up at the very last second, "then everyone, please be mentally prepared. This map might be a bit rough."
……
The next second, the countdown reached zero, and the curtain of blood suddenly descended.
The entire sky turned blood red, and the originally noisy city seemed to suddenly fall silent for a moment. A line of words was written in the sky with blood.
+
｢First Phase: Arrive at the destination
Victory Conditions: All four players must survive
Finish before the timer reaches zero
Power Restriction: Tier 2 ｣
+
Before Gu Nan could sigh with emotion at these familiar words, an inexplicable force descended upon them, and everyone’s strength instantly dropped all the way down to Tier 2.
Qiu Wenran and the two others were dumbfounded. It wasn't the first time they entered a mission world through the Myriad Heavens Starry Road, but how could there be a mission that would restrict their power to this extent?
They may not know what Tier 2 meant, but it was clear that their powers had just been suppressed to the Innate Realm.
They couldn’t even fly at Innate Realm!
Just as the three of them were still in a daze, Gu Nan shouted loudly, "Run!"
His three party members subconsciously looked up and saw Gu Nan running rapidly towards the edge of the roof, then jumping off directly. This made them frown at the same time.
This was the roof of a building nearly 100 meters high. Of course they wouldn’t normally care about the height, but their powers were currently only at Innate Realm…
In the instant it took them to hesitate, the crimson curtain in the sky suddenly thickened.
The next second, a meteorite fell from the sky and smashed into the roof of the building.
Gu Nan looked at the three people who’d been annihilated simultaneously and shook his head helplessly.
……
"What in the world is going on?!”
"Meteorites? Who would ever expect such a situation?!”
"Is something wrong with the Myriad Heavens Starry Road? It’s clearly screwing us over!"
Everyone had reappeared on the roof of the building, and the blood-red timer was counting down as usual. Qiu Wenran was angrily growling, while Gu Nan stood by and yawned.
"It's just a starting point kill. What's so strange about that? You'll learn after being screwed over once." Gu Nan waved his hand and said, "I’m afraid you'll go crazy when you encounter a destination kill later on."
In the end, Qiu Wenran was still an old monster who had lived for thousands of years. After he vented his anger, he also calmed down and apologized to the three people in embarrassment.
Zuo Zuo and Zi Yi exchanged glances and looked at Gu Nan simultaneously.
"We aren’t the owners of this world. Although we don’t fear physical death, the time that our consciousness can stay in the Myriad Heavens Starry Road is limited," Zi Yi spoke with a smile, wearing all purple clothes.
“So if you have any suggestions for this mission, you might as well say them, and we can discuss them together."
Zuo Zuo had spoken up this time. His left and right sides were independent of each other, and even the left and right sides of his mouth opened and closed at different times when he was speaking. But his voice just had to sound perfectly normal, like that of an ordinary child, so he looked very strange.
Gu Nan frowned slightly but didn’t refuse. Since the four of them were now teammates, they had a common interest, so there was really no need to hide anything.
"Right now, I also don't know any other information besides the starting point kill, so I can only test this map slowly… However, from the goal of the First Phase, this phase should be a parkour map."
"Parkour map?" Qiu Wenran obviously didn’t understand the meaning of those two words.
"It requires us to reach a specific destination, and there will be a series of obstacles and even enemies on the way there."
After Gu Nan finished this sentence, he added, "As for the meaning of parkour, you'll understand it after playing a couple of times. Let's talk about this starting point kill first."
Starting point kill was also a new term, but this one was much easier to understand.
"The meteorite is too fast. There’s no other solution besides directly jumping off the roof… In the end, we are too weak," Zi Yi said with a frown.
Everyone understood her unspoken words: they’d either be heavily injured or die after jumping directly from the building and landing from a height of a hundred meters. How would they be able to carry out the subsequent phases of the mission?
At the end of the day, these Star Rulers weren’t used to thinking about things from the perspective of an Innate Realm cultivator.
All their usual methods were suddenly ineffective. It was like a super hacker traveling through time to a primitive society—no matter how skilled the hacker, all their skills would be useless.
"If you want to land from a height of 100 meters at Innate Realm without dying, you’ll have to be a cultivator who specializes in cultivating the physical body," Qiu Wenran said seriously.
"I am," Gu Nan responded.

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Efficiency
chapters.content:
The meteorite fell and the building was smashed into dust again.
Only this time, Gu Nan and the others were already standing safely next to the building and watching it fall.
With his amazing physique, he jumped directly off the roof of the building, then caught his falling companions one by one.
‘The meteorite impact didn’t spread to the surroundings at all…’ Gu Nan rubbed his chin. ‘This really is in-line with players’ usual styles.’
This completely unscientific phenomenon could only appear in players’ self-made maps.
This was the map creator’s bad taste in wanting to make the starting point kill look cool without affecting subsequent progress.
"We only have three minutes." Gu Nan looked up at the sky, where the bloody countdown still existed. "The goal is the tip of the tower in the middle of the city."
With Gu Nan's words, his three teammates looked up and saw the tower in the center of the city. The top of the tower was flashing a red light.
Qiu Wenran breathed a small sigh of relief. "It's not too far away. Even if we’re only at Innate Realm, we can still make it there in time."
Most Innate Realm cultivators might not have strong bodies, but they weren’t slow. There was enough time to reach the tower if they ran at full strength.
"The hard part is climbing all the way to the tip. It’s unrealistic to go up from inside the tower." Zuo Zuo's expression, however, didn’t look so good. "Certain weapons of science and technology aren’t something that Innate Realm cultivators can fight against."
Qiu Wenran was indeed a little more inexperienced, which manifested in the fact that he didn’t seem to have experienced many planes yet. He failed to think of the unique characteristics of planes with relatively advanced science and technology.
Technology was rather unfriendly to low-level cultivators.
Any type of gun or similar weapon would stop them, or the city could seal the path to the top of the tower with a thick iron door—they would be caught unprepared against either of those things.
"Let's split up. Let's try all the methods we can think of," Gu Nan finally concluded, "to improve efficiency."
It was better to try four methods at once than to take turns.
……
Moments later, four people gathered at the top of the building again, waiting for the countdown to end.
Zuo Zuo and Zi Yi felt a little helpless. They were experienced Star Rulers who had passed through the Starry Road for many years, yet they had never seen such a strange little world before.
Killing enemies above their level, finding demons, exploring the dense forest… They had encountered all sorts of situations before, no matter how dangerous or demanding in brainpower, but there was nothing like this.
To say it’s hard, it doesn’t actually seem that hard. The goal was nothing more than to reach a destination, so it was clearly much easier than killing an enemy above their level.
But to say it’s easy, it’s actually not that easy either. They were always just one step short of the goal. Try as they might, they just couldn’t seem to reach the tip of that tower.
Qiu Wenran, the most inexperienced person in the party, was almost driven crazy by this map.
If he ran all the way there, he only had enough time to reach the bottom of the tower, but time ran out before he could go up. Robbery of vehicles would lead to police pursuit, and it would be impossible to enter the tower. If he killed the police, he would attract the attack of the modern army; tanks and helicopters would come out together.
"Why don't we try jumping over from the roof next to the tower?" Qiu Wenran, the old man, had begun to make blind suggestions.
Gu Nan rolled his eyes. "The top of the tower is over three hundred meters high. Are you planning to climb it from the outside?"
Qiu Wenran had nothing to say, so the four fell silent again. The countdown ended again, and the curtain of blood fell.
There was no need for anyone to speak—the four had already become familiar with this routine, and all of them ran in the same direction. Gu Nan took the lead in jumping off, followed by the other three.
But when Gu Nan landed this time, he suddenly had a flash of insight in his mind and blurted out, "I’ve got it!"
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Gu Nan was just a second too slow in catching his teammates, and three piles of flattened humans immediately appeared beside him.
……
"Lord Gu Nan…" Qiu Wenran's slightly resentful voice sounded beside him.
"Ahem, to risk your life for the sake of revolution is a good comrade," Gu Nan coughed awkwardly while standing in front of a white car, smashing through the window with one punch.
This was already a new round where the timer had reset. After Gu Nan’s monetary distraction caused his three teammates to fall to their deaths, they could only start all over again.
The four of them were acting together this time, because Gu Nan claimed that he’d already found a way.
The owner of the white car was startled. He was sitting in the driver's seat waiting for the red light to disappear, but he didn't expect the window to shatter.
"W-Who are you guys?!” He screamed panickedly. "Don't come here, I'm going to call the police!"
In response, Gu Nan grabbed him without hesitation, pulled him out of the car, and casually tossed him aside.
The four of them entered the car as fast as they could, but Qiu Wenran was still somewhat stunned. "Lord, aren’t we going in the wrong direction?"
"Of course… not." Gu Nan laughed lightly.
"Stealing citizens' vehicles will trigger police pursuit. Did you notice which direction the police came from?"
Qiu Wenran froze upon hearing that. He had always been taking the most intuitive method by rushing straight at the tower, but he didn’t pay attention to these details.
Zi Yi in the back seat asked, "Are we going to the police station?"
"Yes," Gu Nan replied absentmindedly while accelerating more and more, completely ignoring any pedestrians on the road. He rampaged all the way, hitting a passerby on the spot and sending him flying.
Qiu Wenran wanted to ask why they were going to the police station, but when he saw Gu Nan driving like this, his words became, "Your Excellency, although we are in a hurry, it’s not to the point where we…"
Bang!
A loud noise interrupted him. A woman had crashed straight into the windshield, and large cracks appeared on the glass. The blood on the woman's head dyed Qiu Wenran's sight red.
Gu Nan’s expression didn't even change. He suddenly braked hard, making the woman’s body tumble forward.
Then he changed gears beautifully, speeding up again and running over her body.
This set of actions was so practiced that everyone could tell he was an old hand at this and did such things often.
When Qiu Wenran looked back, he couldn't even see a trace of the woman anymore.
"Your Excellency, this…"
"To improve efficiency." Gu Nan was still looking ahead intently, doing everything possible to pick up speed.
"Mortals are mere ants. Why care?" Zuo Zuo smiled and spoke from the back seat. He seemed to admire Gu Nan's act just now.
Zi Yi also said, "These mortals will be trapped in this plane’s loop all their lives. It’s their honor to help us obtain this world’s origin."
Qiu Wenran listened to the words of the two people, and after a moment of silence, he nodded and sighed, "This humble one’s Dao heart was lacking."
He’d always revered his senior Star Rulers, so naturally he never doubted Zuo Zuo and Zi Yi’s words. Incidentally, he also began to regard Gu Nan with a kind of awe.
‘This one is also someone who treats human life like weeds. Perhaps he’s also an experienced Star Ruler who’s been around for many years. I wonder what his real identity is…’
"Here we are." Gu Nan slammed on the brakes, almost throwing the deep-in-thought Qiu Wenran out of the car.
But he didn't glance at his passengers, instead jumping out of the car’s front window directly and rushing to the police station.
A police officer tried to stop him with questions, but before he even said the first sentence, Gu Nan blew his head off with a punch.
But Gu Nan didn’t even use the front door. When he reached the front of the police station, he jumped to the roof, then ran forward along the roof.
Inside the car, Qiu Wenran and the other two also dared not delay upon seeing this scene. They hurriedly ran out and followed Gu Nan.
Since when had the police station ever encountered a situation like this before? It immediately fell into disarray, but Gu Nan ignored all the chaos and just kept jumping between roofs.
After a moment, they heard Gu Nan exclaim, "Found it!"
His three teammates turned to look and finally understood what Gu Nan was looking for.
It was the weapon that once participated in the encirclement of Qiu Wenran—a helicopter!

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Guests from the Central Region
chapters.content:
Deep in the endless starry sky, an enormous luxury starship was slowly leaving the void.
The starship’s arrival didn't make any noise—there wouldn't be any noise in the void anyways, but this starship was too large, making people unused to how silent it was.
There was also a golden symbol on the starship, which looked like some sort of strange hook.
A cultivator from the Central Region would recognize the meaning of this symbol at a glance—this was the mark of the Deep Sea Temple in the Central Region.
"To think that so much has happened on Heaven and Earth Star within a short 70 years."
Inside the ship, an old man in a golden robe was sighing with emotion as he gazed at the approaching Heaven and Earth Star.
At the old man’s side was a man in a black windbreaker, giving a helpless and wry smile. "We are unable to make any sense of the strange existence of children of destiny, so we could only avoid them for the time being."
The man in the black windbreaker was called Ping Jiushan. He was also a well-known Dao Lord on Heaven and Earth Star. It’s just that he gradually hid his whereabouts in recent decades due to the rise of the children of destiny.
However, what no one knew was that Ping Jiushan was a bloodline user who used to be an attendant in the Deep Sea Temple.
"Elder Feng, are you perhaps here for those children of destiny?" Ping Jiushan asked carefully.
In his impression, Feng Xu was one of the most senior elders of the Deep Sea Temple. The reason he came all the way to the Sixth Region could only be due to the bizarre phenomenon of the children of destiny; there was no other possibility.
However, Feng Xu chuckled while shaking his head. "Destiny is uncertain and unreliable. Although it can be useful for a while, it will not succeed in the long run… You can simply observe it failing on its own."
"Then Elder, you’re here this time for…" Ping Jiushan scratched his head, at a loss.
"His Majesty has already returned to Star Realm.” Feng Xu's expression gradually grew serious. "We have to find a person named Gu Nan."
Ping Jiushan froze in shock when he heard Feng Xu’s words.
Powerful Tier 4 figures rarely stayed in one place for long. Instead, they spent most of their time traveling back and forth between different worlds, looking for worlds’ origins to build their own laws.
The fact that His Majesty the King of the Deep Sea came back in person meant there was something in Star Realm he needed even more.
"Then… what happens after we find this person?" Ping Jiushan's voice trembled.
Feng Xu glanced at him, then answered in a low voice, "His Majesty will personally descend.”
……
Gu Nan didn’t yet know that the King of the Deep Sea had chosen the smartest way to catch his trail.
He didn't hastily rush into the Sixth Region, nor did he mobilize all his forces to conduct an all-out search for Gu Nan with great fanfare. Instead, he chose to send an emissary to secretly track down Gu Nan.
But this was none of Gu Nan's business. He was currently approaching his destination—the tower in the center of the city—from mid-air.
The roar of the helicopter resounded through the sky. Although Gu Nan was rather good at driving cars, his helicopter piloting skills left much to be desired.
The helicopter kept swaying from side to side in mid-air. Qiu Wenran and his two seniors could only cling to the handrail to ensure that they wouldn’t be flung off.
"Your Excellency! Shouldn’t we capture someone who can fly a helicopter…" Qiu Wenran shouted at Gu Nan through the strong wind, which deflected his voice.
Gu Nan still had time to free up a hand to wave at the three in the back of the helicopter. "Although I can't fly a helicopter well, I can shoot well!"
As Gu Nan's voice fell, he launched a miniature missile, taking out the helicopter blocking their way in an explosion.
As a top player, mastering all kinds of mini games was also a necessary skill, because you never know when the developers will spring a puzzle game on players out of the blue.
Therefore, Gu Nan had mastered a simple skill like aiming to the point of perfection.
After another exciting battle, Gu Nan's helicopter of four finally arrived at the tip of the tower in the city center, and Gu Nan jumped down without hesitation.
The instant his hand touched the tip of the tower, the world seemed to freeze again, and the countdown in mid-air slowly disappeared. New words began to appear.
The timer was down to the last ten or so seconds—Gu Nan's determination to improve efficiency proved to be the correct choice.
+
｢Victory conditions for the First Phase have been met.
Second Phase: Kill the crimson guards
Victory Condition: All four players must survive
Power Restriction: Tier 3 ｣
+
With the words’ appearance, Gu Nan and the others all felt the suppression loosen, as if some inexplicable restriction had been lifted, and a portion of their sealed power also returned to their bodies.
However, the tip of the tower gradually cracked open at this time. Gu Nan let go without hesitation, standing directly in the air—after regaining his Prodigious Realm strength, he was able to fly.
Gu Nan’s three teammates were also standing in the air beside him.
"Looks like Tier 3 refers to the Prodigious Realm," Zuo Zuo spoke up. When his strength returned to Tier 3, the disharmony between his two sides seemed to be even more pronounced. When he spoke, the lady’s sun hat on the left side of his head was gradually distorted, while the right face was normal.
Qiu Wenran also nodded. "It should be… I wonder what power system this term came from. Does it perhaps not originate from our world?"
When saying that, he couldn't help glancing at Gu Nan in astonishment.
All world missions in the Myriad Heavens Starry Road originate from the owner of that small world, so the term “Tier 3” might have come from Gu Nan.
But he wasn’t stupid enough to ask directly. This concerned one’s origins. If Gu Nan didn’t intend to answer, then rashly asking would only make an enemy of Gu Nan.
There wasn’t much time left for the four. Just a moment later, the tip of the tower had cracked open completely, and a crimson figure walked out from the inside.
"Hahahaha! This Lord has hidden here for 20 years, but to think that you guys discovered me! In that case, give me your lives!" The figure laughed as soon as he appeared, then shouted loudly.
"Who are you?" Qiu Wenran asked with a heavy voice.
However, the blood-red figure flew to Qiu Wenran and slashed down with his blade. Instead of answering, he said, "Damned fleas, always jumping around. I’ll kill you all!"
His blade was very strange. It looked more like a sickle, but it didn’t have such a large curve and also had a long handle.
"Good!" Qiu Wenran chuckled. "I’ll have to trouble everyone to provide support for this humble one. Let me fight this… Huh?"
Before he could finish his words, he saw the crimson sickle suddenly accelerate, while Qiu Wenran seemed to freeze and was directly beheaded in one strike.
Since a player died, they immediately failed the mission, and the blood-red curtain reappeared—fortunately, the First Phase had already been completed, so they just restarted from the tower tip cracking.
Otherwise, everyone would go insane if they had to redo the First Phase again.
Qiu Wenran’s body was reconstructed, and he stood there somewhat awkwardly, looking at Gu Nan and the rest with his face a little red.
Finally, Gu Nan asked with a small cough, "What skill was that?"
Qiu Wenran seemed to be frozen just now, standing there motionlessly as the blade arrived. This was obviously not normal.
But he scratched his head helplessly. "I only felt that my whole mind and body were sealed, and I couldn’t move at all… I couldn’t recognize this skill."
"Let me try," Zi Yi suddenly offered.
Qiu Wenran suddenly sighed in relief. "We can rest assured with Senior Zi Yi taking the lead."
On the other side, the tower tip had cracked completely, and the four of them were once again greeted with familiar laughter.
"Hahahaha…."

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Postponing the Mission
chapters.content:
Inside White Mist’s headquarters on Heaven and Earth Star.
Red Tail sat in a quiet room, holding some documents the organization recently obtained. She chuckled. "To think Feng Xu is actually the one who came. Looks like His Majesty really attaches great value to this Grand Commander of ours!”
She was also from the Bloodline Alliance, so Red Tail naturally knew what kind of figure Feng Xu was.
Setting aside his background for now, even Feng Xu’s position in the Bloodline Alliance was higher than hers—if they didn’t count certain secret matters.
Lin Yunyun was sitting beside her and spoke softly, "My Lord…"
"I said you can call me Mom when no one’s around," Red Tail interrupted her, then stretched out her hand to rub Lin Yunyun’s head.
Lin Yunyun bit her lip lightly. "Mom… how powerful is a Void Cutter Realm cultivator?"
"Very powerful, very powerful." Red Tail smiled and explained, "So powerful that any one of them can destroy a whole planet."
"Then… Why did Uncle provoke them?" Lin Yunyun frowned in confusion.
In her impression, that uncle seemed to have never encountered this kind of situation before.
"I also want to know." Red Tail’s graze gradually drifted away, becoming a bit fleeting. "Just what kind of item can make that one descend in person?"
……
"Gu Nan is connected to White Mist?" Feng Xu frowned after reading the latest information.
Ping Jiushan nodded. "According to our current information, Gu Nan probably went to White Mist as soon as he arrived at Heaven and Earth Star and even fought with the Sand King.”
"The result is… No one has ever seen any trace of the Sand King again," not even Ping Jiushan could help feeling a little terrified when he said this.
It wasn’t like he’d never heard about this battle before, but he just treated it as an interesting anecdote at the time. He didn't expect His Majesty to also be implicated in this matter.
‘Now that I’m thinking about it, could the Sand King have actually died in that fight?’
“The Sand King is dead." Feng Xu stroked his beard with narrowed eyes. "Yet White Mist still exists. Looks like that woman colluded with Gu Nan."
"You mean Red Tail?! How can that be possible—" Ping Jiushan immediately exclaimed.
"There’s nothing impossible about it. Red Tail is not a simple person." Feng Xu shook his head lightly. "But she won't admit it even if we ask her directly. Let's start from inside White Mist."
Feng Xu handed Ping Jiushan a piece of paper with a name written on it: Guan Sheng.
……
"Hahahaha! This Lord has hidden here for 20 years…"
The exact same lines were uttered from the enemy’s mouth, and the exact same crimson sickle fell.
Zi Yi was calm and unruffled, setting down thirty purple illusory shadows in front of her. Her defenses could absolutely be called airtight, but it was still useless.
The blood-red sickle sliced through thirty purple shadows in a row and instantly cut Zi Yi in two.
"Damned fleas, always jumping around. I’ll kill you all!" Came the familiar line.
The four of them were returned to the starting point again. This time, Qiu Wenran's expression turned even uglier. He didn't feel that Zi Yi’s death was anything to celebrate at all. Her death only showed how difficult the enemy’s attack was.
"Sealing all laws, a strike of certain death." Zi Yi was also frowning when she reappeared.
"The law of certain death…” Qiu Wenran gasped. There was no doubt that this kind of law was powerful. He didn't expect to encounter it here.
The so-called law of certain death was a law that declared certain death for the enemy after a condition had been met.
Escape was impossible, not unless they also possessed a law of the same level.
"What’s the condition that triggered certain death?" In a rare display, both sides of Zuo Zuo’s face looked symmetrical, like he was lost in thought.
At this time, Gu Nan suddenly interrupted, "It might be… forbidding flight."
Moments later, the four landed safely in front of the crimson guard, and the scarlet sickle never appeared again.
"It was as simple as that?! They utilized the law of certain death for such a trivial thing?!” Qiu Wenran looked like he was gnashing his teeth.
Actually, it wasn’t just him. Zuo Zuo and Zi Yi were in a similar mood. It’s just that these two were more shrewd and didn’t lose control of their emotions on the spot.
Gu Nan shook his head helplessly. In fact, the line "Damned fleas, always jumping around" had already hinted at this point, but because the solution was too simple, the three Star Rulers were unwilling to believe it.
But for Gu Nan, this answer was entirely normal—this was just the beginning of the Second Phase, so the system wouldn’t make life hard for the players right now.
Besides, it was nothing more than a rule inside the game—it didn’t matter to the game whether it used the law of certain death or not, so there was no need for the game to be stingy with resources and use this law sparingly.
It's just that the emergence of this kind of situation made Gu Nan even more convinced that this dungeon really was modified based on his memories.
‘That means… I'm afraid this boss won’t be an easy fight.’ Gu Nan secretly shook his head. He had zero confidence in these NPCs’ dungeon-clearing abilities.
An hour later, the four of them reappeared at the starting point of the Second Phase for the 29th time.
"Everyone, the amount of time I can stay in the Starry Road has reached the limit, so I can only continue next time," Zi Yi prevented the next attempt and said helplessly.
Star Rulers entered the Starry Road as wisps of consciousness, so they naturally couldn’t stay for too long.
Zuo Zuo gave a small nod. "This world… really is a little weird. Let’s return next time when we’re prepared."
"Then let’s plan to meet three days later. Is that inconvenient for anyone?" Zi Yi asked.
Zuo Zuo and Qiu Wenran shook their heads, but Gu Nan frowned. "Three days? The flow of time for each world is different. How can you determine the time?"
Zuo Zuo smiled. His right face had a kind smile and his left face had a twisted smile. "The flow of time is the same for the 36 Myriad Heavens and 72 Realms."
"So that’s it…" Gu Nan suddenly seemed to understand something.
……
Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes inside a small room. His mind was still thinking about the Myriad Heavens Starry Road, but his mouth was sighing slightly.
What caused the four of them to experience 30 consecutive party wipes in the Second Phase wasn’t a particularly strong enemy. Instead, it was a very simple game technique.
The three Star Rulers really were strong, and the fighting power shown by any one of them far exceeded Tier 3. Not even Gu Nan could say for certain that he could win against them.
Therefore, the crimson guard was beaten until he had no strength to fight back. However, everytime he was about to die, he would split into forty smaller guards.
All forty of these guards were different. They must be killed in a fixed order, or else they’d all self-detonate simultaneously.
"Is it really so hard to kill 40 mobs in order?" Gu Nan shook his head helplessly. Someone in the team always made a mistake at this stage.
But in fact, he also knew that it was extremely hard for NPCs to accept the game concept that they must kill people in a certain order.
The strong all had their own inherent knowledge about the world, so they couldn’t understand an excessively artificial design like this.
He opened the Evil God Temple to check. There was a new message inside, which wasn’t received when he was in the personal dungeon.
｢Completed First Phase of the mission in the ‘Splendid World' personal dungeon. Obtained 300 points｣
‘300 points, not bad.’ It was so high probably because it was the first clear reward; it definitely wouldn’t be as high the second time. Gu Nan knew this very well.
In this way, he had already saved up 1,700 points, and with Lan Si’s efforts, his Evil Value had also reached 450, which was one step closer to Tier 4’s threshold.
Gu Nan’s consciousness withdrew from the Evil God Temple. He thought about it, then wrote down three names—Zuo Zuo, Zi Yi, and Qiu Wenran—and sent them back to White Mist via a secret method, asking Red Tail to help investigate those three.
Gu Nan also held a deep curiosity about his three temporary companions.
However, someone suddenly knocked on his door at this moment.
Before Gu Nan could act, the door had been pushed open, and an unexpected person appeared in front of him.
This was a person who absolutely shouldn’t have appeared here—his left face was twisted and his right face was peaceful. It was Zuo Zuo.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Catching a Powerful Figure’s Attention
chapters.content:
Gu Nan's entire person stiffened for a moment, then returned to normal, but a shadow clone had already quietly drifted out far away, ready to switch with him at any time.
"Looks like you really don't want to see me." Zuo Zuo's smile was the same as before, half normal and half distorted. "Your true body is Tier 3? Truly surprising."
"Tier 3? You also surprised me." Gu Nan raised his eyebrows slightly, staring at this fellow in front of him. From his appearance to his aura, one could tell from a glance that he was unusual.
He looked slightly different from his appearance in the dungeon. The description “little boy” was no longer accurate for the real Zuo Zuo.
Because his left and right sides were completely equal, but they looked entirely different.
His left body was a blonde girl. Not only did she wear half a sun hat on her head, but she also had a white dress.
On the other hand, his right body was still a little boy with a peaceful expression. His entire person looked like two people were spliced together.
"There's nothing surprising about it." Zuo Zuo chuckled. "Everyone who has traveled beyond the Myriad Heavens Universe knows about the various Tiers."
‘Beyond the Myriad Heavens Universe…’
Gu Nan was silent for a moment, then yawned and sat down in his chair again.
"If you have something to say, just say it," Gu Nan said casually. He wasn’t stupid enough to ask pointless questions like "How did you get here?"
It was obvious that the other party would never tell the truth.
"I want to occupy a spot in all the smaller worlds you take control of in the future," Zuo Zuo said in a deep voice as his two faces showed different smiles at the same time.
"That's it?" Gu Nan's expression didn’t even change. In his view, this condition wasn’t even a condition at all.
After all, the other party was an existence at Tier 5 or perhaps even higher. Even if the Zuo Zuo that appeared in front of him wasn’t the true body, it was still enough to completely suppress Gu Nan.
Under such circumstances, Gu Nan didn't want to bet on whether he could escape successfully.
Zuo Zuo was noncommittal. Just as he opened his mouth to speak, his expression suddenly changed, and his figure instantly disappeared, leaving behind one last echoing sentence:
“Come to the Central Region after you step into Tier 4. Someone will meet you there."
This Star Ruler Realm powerhouse disappeared in the blink of an eye, as if he’d never appeared.
A strange smile appeared on Gu Nan’s face.
……
Three days later, Gu Nan was sitting quietly in the courtyard, boredly leafing through the intelligence reports in his hands. This was information White Mist sent over.
Regarding the three Star Rulers in the dungeon, only the name Qiu Wenran returned some results, but they still weren’t able to discover much.
They only knew that he was a powerful figure who became famous thousands of years ago and was active outside of Star Realm, so they could only find some fragmented records. They knew that there was such a person but couldn’t find any of his achievements.
As for Zi Yi, from her name to her identity, there was no trace of information anywhere.
On the other hand, although they also couldn’t find any information related to the name Zuo Zuo, his physical appearance was strange enough that the White Mist members actually did manage to find some clues about him.
It was a legend passed down from ancient times. It was a story that took place when the Central Region had just started to rise in power and influence and was gradually expanding outward.
At that time, the Central Region was undergoing rapid scientific and technological development, which continuously challenged the old system. Genius scientists emerged in an endless stream.
And there was a certain mad doctor who was obsessed with human body fusion experiments. The Federation ordered his arrest, and after finally being cornered, he resolutely chose to fuse his son and daughter together, using them as ingredients.
"Fusing siblings together? Who knows if it’s a true event or mere storytelling…"
Gu Nan mused as he rubbed his chin. After all, this was just an ancient legend. It had probably been exaggerated beyond recognition after tens of thousands of years.
After thinking about it, he finally set the information aside.
It’ll be best if he can uncover Zuo Zuo’s origins, but it’s no big deal even if he can’t.
He didn’t have any conflicts with Zuo Zuo currently, and they even had a common interest, so there was no need to worry right now.
However, another news White Mist sent over made Gu Nan frown slightly.
The King of the Deep Sea chose to send people to Heaven and Earth Star to secretly investigate his whereabouts.
As expected, none of the powerful figures who could advance to Tier 4 were fools. Since he couldn’t kill Gu Nan in a single blow using the epaulet he gave to Qin Xuanji, the King of the Deep Sea was determined to not leave any openings this time.
The fact that his true body returned to Star Realm meant he could attack with his full power at any time, even from a distance. All he needed was a medium to channel his powers through.
This would no longer be a blow that contained some of his strength, but an attack from the true body of a Tier 4 powerhouse.
"Once I meet the person he sent, I'm afraid it’ll immediately attract a Tier 4 attack. Looks like I still need to hide for a while."
Gu Nan's consciousness looked inside the Evil God Temple for a while. His Evil Value had already reached 455. The rate of increase was noticeably faster.
Locking Lan Si up and making her cultivate in earnest seemed to be effective—she might also be motivated by the experience of suffering a heavy injury.
After offhandedly destroying the documents containing information, Gu Nan slowly got up and opened the personal dungeon again.
Their agreed-upon time had already arrived.
……
In the depths of the endless starry sky stood a vast hidden palace. Endless starlight drew a sharp contrast with the dim interior of the palace.
The inside of this timeless palace was currently glowing with a faint red light, starting from the top of the palace and spreading all the way to the bottom.
When the red light had slowly spread out to the point where even the stars had to retreat, a figure walked out of the palace.
It was a woman in red. She wasn’t tall, but her brow was full of heroic vigor. Her red hair hung down like a bloody waterfall.
Just like that, she stood on the endless stars. After a long while, she sighed lightly. "He has returned."
"Your Majesty," a voice came from behind the woman in red. It was a middle-aged man wrapped in a red robe. "Do you want us to conduct an all-out search?"
"You guys won't be able to find him." The woman shook her head slightly. "Have Xue Yan travel to the Sixth Region and find a little fellow named Red Tail."
"Yes, Your Majesty," the middle-aged man replied, then added, "Your Majesty, bloodline user Red Tail is a descendant of the Indigo Mound tribe."
Red Tail indeed had a certain weight in the eyes of certain big shots. Even with the middle-aged man’s status, he still bothered to remember her.
"Oh? So that’s her… How very interesting." The woman in red smiled. Her face looked no different from a mortal’s.
"A descendant of the Indigo Mound tribe is looking for information on her tribe’s sworn enemy of many years ago. Has her identity already been exposed, or is this part of someone’s secret schemes?"
The woman in red didn't speak again. She simply stood on top of the palace, overlooking the billions of stars.
……
Gu Nan naturally didn't know that his decision to have Red Tail investigate certain people's information would end up catching the attention of a truly powerful figure.
Even if he knew, he’d probably still feel wronged—Zuo Zuo showed up as soon as he sent out the message asking for information.
But he didn’t have time to pay attention to this now, because after reopening the personal dungeon Splendid World, Zi Yi and Qiu Wenran quickly arrived by following the coordinates, while Zuo Zuo had disappeared.
Just like in Star Realm, he seemed to have completely disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Guan Sheng
chapters.content:
"What’s he doing? Did his internet go down?" Gu Nan muttered words that only he could understand.
Zuo Zuo actually disappeared entirely. It was clear that Star Realm was more important to him than this dungeon. To think that he even said something like “Take me with you in all future dungeons you’re clearing”—those words were clearly meant to stall for time.
Zuo Zuo didn’t actually care about this at all.
"Perhaps he encountered some temporary trouble. Let's start," Zi Yi didn’t seem to feel anything about this and said quietly.
Of course Gu Nan didn’t have any objections either. In fact, with their raw power, they were entirely overqualified for this dungeon. If not for the power restrictions, they could’ve crushed this dungeon directly.
The bloody countdown appeared in the air again. Reopening the personal dungeon meant that they had to start all over again.
Fortunately, they were extremely familiar with the strategy after having experienced it before. The parkour map in the First Phase was once again cleared by Gu Nan stealing a helicopter.
"Hahahaha! This Lord has hidden here for 20 years…"
The familiar laughter came again, but Zi Yi suddenly said, "I’ll handle this."
As she spoke, she had already jumped up abruptly, and the entire sky was instantly covered with purple stars, which then fell piece by piece towards the crimson guard.
Her murderous appearance startled Gu Nan and Qiu Wenran, who hurriedly hid to one side to watch the play.
In terms of a direct battle, of course the crimson guard couldn’t compare to a distinguished Star Ruler. A few seconds later, he had been smashed by the stars all over the sky until he was bleeding all over.
When the crimson guard had exhausted almost all his power and wanted to split into forty smaller guards, Zi Yi suddenly raised her hand.
All over the sky, the stars simultaneously lit up with a purple light and fell down, directly smashing the crimson guard into pieces and changing the blood-red words in the sky.
+
｢Victory condition for the Second Phase has been met.
Third Phase: Survive for three minutes.
Victory Condition: All three players must survive
Power Restriction: Tier 3 ｣
+
The entire battle didn't take more than a minute, but it was because Zi Yi found a suitable method. She relied on her heaven-opposing skill and forcibly terminated the crimson guard’s skill before he could split into 40 smaller guards!
‘This execution threshold is probably at a fucking 20% HP…’ Ten thousand curses were running through Gu Nan’s heart.
Killing the boss directly before his HP could drop to a certain level naturally meant they could avoid the boss’s subsequent skills. This was an extremely simple solution.
‘But you have to possess such a godly execute type skill in the first place!’
The execution threshold of Gu Nan's Righteous Judgment was nowhere near as high. Zi Yi was able to achieve the same result as an execute type skill purely by brute-forcing her way through the battle with her own laws, which were powerful to the point of heaven-defying.
‘After all, she’s a Star Ruler Realm NPC. None of them are fools.’ Gu Nan secretly shook his head. ‘They didn’t have time to process everything at the start, so they were stumped at first. But if they have a little time to think about it, they can easily think of a solution.’
Qiu Wenran, however, had already rushed up with excitement. "As expected of Senior Zi Yi. In three days, you’ve already mastered the law of the stars and integrated it into your own laws."
"This is nothing," Zi Yi replied emotionlessly.
This lady, who was prideful down to her bones, obviously couldn’t stand the fact that everyone was forced to end the mission early last time because of her. So this time, she cleared the Second Phase by herself.
……
At White Mist’s headquarters, Chu Kang excitedly walked out of the endless void. He had just completed a reincarnation mission, and it was easier than expected.
"That Lord, who on earth is he… No, it doesn’t matter who he is. If only he can give another lecture!"
Chu Kang remembered the scene from last time, and his heart couldn't help feeling full of anticipation. If there was a second chance, he would definitely give that Lord all the missions he could find!
"Guan Sheng, are you home?" Chu Kang knocked on Guan Sheng’s door right next to his, but no one responded. "How strange… Has he already gone to submit the mission completion report?"
Reincarnation missions wouldn’t take much time. Smaller world missions in particular would hardly take up any time here in Star Realm.
After getting no one response for a long time, Chu Kang suppressed his doubts and turned to leave, but he just happened to bump into someone at the corner.
"Ouch, you… Er, Guan Sheng?" Chu Kang was hit on the head and was about to speak when he saw the other person's face.
Guan Sheng was in a hurry and didn’t even have time to greet Chu Kang. He pushed him away and went straight to his room.
Chu Kang wasn’t bothered by Guan Sheng's rudeness at all. Instead, his eyes lit up and he quickly followed while asking, "Guan Sheng, Guan Sheng! You’re in such a hurry—did that Lord come again?"
He didn't forget the reason Guan Sheng was in a hurry the last time he saw him.
When Chu Kang mentioned that Lord, Guan Sheng's expression changed instantly, then returned to normal. He quickly said, "No… I'm in a hurry. Please get out of the way."
Chu Kang was pushed aside by him again, while Guan Sheng went into his room by himself.
Bang!
The door slammed shut. Chu Kang didn’t get anything out of this, so he could only shrug, but then his expression changed.
Because a sharp energy fluctuation had just come from inside Guan Sheng's room.
"Guan Sheng!" Chu Kang shouted. He violently kicked the door in, but Guan Sheng's figure had already disappeared.
Chu Kang looked intently at the ground, only to see a fine small circular array painted. Chu Kang wasn’t an expert on arrays, but even he could tell that this was clearly a teleportation array.
"The organization already has a teleportation array. Why did he need to set up a private one?"
Chu Kang's heart sank slightly, and he had a feeling that he seemed to have stepped into a maelstrom.
……
In the small room, Red Tail was still slowly reading through reports, with one hand gently on Lin Yunyun's shoulder, stroking her hair.
Lin Yunyun still didn’t seem used to such intimate actions yet. She kept her head down as her eyes passively read the information on the table.
"The Underworld Ocean Dao Hall has reopened. Hall Master Ping Jiushan reappeared in the public’s eye."
"The Underworld Ocean Dao Hall is located in the far north, and the King of the Northern Region, Ye Chen, personally led a punitive expedition…"
"The northern army suffered a devastating defeat, and Ye Chen's whereabouts are unknown. It is reported that he was seriously injured and is possibly dying."
“……”
These reports attracted Lin Yunyun’s attention. Even though she didn’t pay much attention to the situation in the mainland, she still knew how hot the person titled "King of the Northern Region" was today.
However, the King of the Northern Region, who had been undefeated ever since he entered the Dao, actually suffered a crushing defeat this time, and he even seemed to be missing?
As though she noticed what Lin Yunyun was looking at, Red Tail chuckled. "A lucky guy who relies on the power of destiny is nothing if he encounters a true powerhouse…"
Just as she was saying this, a piece of information emerged slowly. Based on the location, it came from within the organization.
Red Tail frowned slightly, getting an ominous feeling in her heart. She hurriedly picked up the report, but a moment later, she suddenly slammed her palm down on the table.
"Guan Sheng!"
Lin Yunyun was startled and hurriedly asked, "Mom, what's wrong?"
Red Tail's expression was a little dark. "Some people are just looking for death… Call someone in and send the news to the central mountain range as soon as possible. I hope it's not too late…"

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Pursuit
chapters.content:
Inside Splendid World, Gu Nan, Qiu Wenran, and Zi Yi stood side by side, watching as lava flowed throughout the city.
The Third Phase was survival; it was even simpler than they expected. The three of them easily passed after several tries. From beginning to end, the entire process didn’t take long at all.
To put it bluntly, the Third Phase rained down lava from the sky, which tested players’ defenses and reflexes, so it was a test of players’ actual power.
This was in line with the dungeon’s design. At the beginning, it flaunted its strength to players using a meteor, then delved into the second phase with an ingenious problem, which required players to be adaptive and perceptive. Finally, it gave a test of hard power.
But when it came to Gu Nan’s team, the last phase posed no difficulty whatsoever, because this party didn’t lack hard power at all.
Therefore, the three of them cleared the entire Third Phase with almost no trouble, and the dungeon soon came to an end.
‘Based on this difficulty level, the overall reward won’t be too high. I don't know if I can get to 2,500 points…’ Gu Nan muttered to himself in his heart.
He now had 2,100 points, which was 400 points short of the 2,500-point mark.
Earlier, the First Phase and Second Phase gave him 300 and 400 points respectively. The rewards for the Third Phase probably won’t be much higher than that, but it's reasonable to say that it won't be lower than the previous rewards.
Just to be on the safe side, Gu Nan could only take precautions in case he couldn’t get to 2,500 points this time, "Wanna clear it again?"
He was greeted by two people’s surprised gazes. Qiu Wenran said with a chuckle, "Your Excellency, we’ll be able to clearly see this world’s origin after clearing the world mission once. A second attempt is useless to us."
"It’s the world’s origin again…" Gu Nan finally understood a little. For this world’s powerful figures, this was probably the basis of their cultivation.
By observing different worlds’ origins, they would be able to refine their own laws and use that to perfect their own worlds.
This might be true for them, but not for Gu Nan himself. He didn’t forget how the dungeon clearly stated that the reset period was three days.
……
｢The Tier 3 mission in the personal dungeon Splendid World has been completed. Obtained 500 points｣
Gu Nan immediately checked the Evil God Temple as soon as he returned to reality and saw this message.
500 points!
With these 500 points, Gu Nan's points finally broke through the 2,500 mark, reaching 2,600 points, which was enough for his advancement!
"Next, I just need to wait for Lan Si's side…" Gu Nan glanced at his Evil Value in passing: 458. This was still far from the goal of 500.
But Gu Nan couldn’t do anything about it for the time being. Reincarnation was still in “cooldown,” and his soul wouldn’t be able to endure another reincarnation right now, so he could only wait patiently.
But at that moment, he found two consecutive messages sent from White Mist.
What was even stranger was that the content of these messages were similar. They both said that his location had already been exposed and that he should move immediately!
……
Near the central mountain range, Feng Xu’s figure appeared in mid-air and slowly landed on the ground.
There were very few people with him this time, and he didn't bring any entourage. Only Ping Jiushan and someone else was with him. The second person’s expression looked a little vacant—it was precisely Guan Sheng, who had escaped from White Mist.
Feng Xu and Ping Jiushan didn’t recognize Gu Nan. Even though they saw his appearance from the data, they still weren’t as familiar with him as Guan Sheng, who’d seen him in person, so it was only natural to take him on this trip.
"I’m afraid that Red Tail sent Gu Nan a message as soon as you escaped from White Mist. Are you sure he’ll still be here?" Ping Jiushan still wasn’t too sure they could actually find Gu Nan.
However, Guan Sheng replied expressionlessly, "My Lord gave me the order to delay him for a moment."
"That’s right." Feng Xu nodded lightly. "After learning Gu Nan's location, I’ve already sealed off this mountain range. As long as he escapes afterwards, he will trigger my tracking mark."
Ever since his early years in the Deep Sea Temple, Xu Feng had long been famous for tracking down and searching out people, which was why the King of the Deep Sea sent him this time.
"Then how did you stall him?" Ping Jiushan asked again.
Guan Sheng's blank expression turned into a smile. "I sent him a message in advance.”
……
It could be said that Guan Sheng was very good at playing with people's hearts. At least in this matter, his approach was very clever.
Even Red Tail didn’t expect Guan Sheng's little trick—she was too busy trying to prove her innocence.
Red Tail had a neutral stance where she wouldn’t offend either side.
She wouldn’t oppose a Tier 4 existence for Gu Nan, nor would she help the King of the Deep Sea encircle Gu Nan.
For her, it didn’t matter who won or who lost. She just needed to stand beside the final winner. Unfortunately, Guan Sheng ruined her arrangement.
White Mist was the one that revealed Gu Nan's position to Feng Xu. On the off chance that Gu Nan really did turn the tables and come back even stronger than before, would he believe her if she said that someone betrayed the organization and exposed his location?
So she was in a hurry to send a message to Gu Nan.
Of course, what Red Tail didn't know was that, in fact, no matter what she sent, he wouldn't believe everything she said.
"Two messages?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin, but his mouth was sneering.
When faced with this kind of inexplicable behavior, it was easy to infer that something went wrong inside White Mist, or it was a diversion intended to confuse him, or perhaps Red Tail chose to oppose him.
In this situation, no matter whether he listened to the messages or continued staying in the same place, both choices were risky.
So…… Gu Nan gradually turned into a shadow, silently lurking in the depths of the mountain range.
……
At a stream in the central mountain range, a girl in plain cotton clothing was walking in the wilderness, carrying a cloth basket on her back and picking wild fruits from the mountains one by one.
She didn’t look like anyone special; she simply looked like a village girl who came out to pick fruits.
But there were certain matters in this world that required nothing but luck.
A young man in a warrior’s outfit was lying unconscious in the stream. He had sword eyebrows and starry eyes. His figure was well-built, and he had a longsword at his waist.
Seeing this scene, the girl quickly put down her fruit basket and went forward. "Hey, are you still alive? Wake up…"
As though he’d been touched by the outside world, the youth began to stir faintly.
As soon as he opened his eyes and their gazes met, it seemed that a star suddenly lit up in the sky.
"So that’s it…”
……
"Still can't find him?" Feng Xu had already scoured the entire mountain three times over, but he still couldn’t find a trace of Gu Nan, which made him secretly frown.
Some cold sweat also began to gather on Guan Sheng’s face, and he began to worry that his clever trick might’ve had the opposite effect.
‘What if Gu Nan was too honest and frank, or what if Red Tail didn’t act as I predicted?’
“My Lord, do you want me to send people into the mountains to search?" Ping Jiushan whispered from the side.
"Mm." Feng Xu gave a slight nod, then asked, “There are many cultivators in the mountains. Did you predict this situation in advance and send them here, knowing that I would fail to find Gu Nan?"
How could Ping Jiushan dare to take credit for this? He quickly waved his hand in denial. "Of course not… They all came to chase Ye Chen."
"Ye Chen? That child of destiny?" Feng Xu’s expression changed a little, and his eyes narrowed slightly.
"Precisely him." Ping Jiushan smiled ingratiatingly. "He overestimated his capabilities and came to challenge you. After being heavily injured by you, he reportedly escaped into this mountain range."

chapters.title: Chapter 202: The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samara Awakens After 9,000 Reincarnations
chapters.content:
"The child of destiny is at the mercy of the fate of Heaven and Earth. As long as he doesn't die, his every move must coincide with Heaven’s will. This matter isn’t so simple,” Feng Xu said with a dark expression. Clearly, his understanding of children of destiny was far superior to the people on Heaven and Earth Star.
Ping Jiushan was unconcerned by this, but just as he was about to speak, a burst of starlight suddenly lit up in the sky.
"So that’s it…"
A light sigh rang in everyone's ears. Ping Jiushan and Guan Sheng didn’t understand the significance and stared at their surroundings in astonishment, but Feng Xu’s expression suddenly changed.
"My Lord, this is…" Ping Jiushan asked.
Feng Xu stared at the sky in a daze and managed to answer with much difficulty, "Someone is breaking through to Void Cutter Realm…"
……
Gu Nan was still transformed into a shadow, hiding in the deepest part of the mountain range.
Feng Xu and his group had passed Gu Nan several times, but he never revealed any sound, as if he’d really become just a shadow.
Gu Nan had always been confident in Hidden Shadow. It had never failed him ever since he transmigrated into this world, except for that one time an old man surnamed Jiang saw through it in the Morningstar Plane.
He wasn’t worried about his own safety, not unless the other party started using a Tier 4 existence to wantonly search for him.
But when the starlight lit up and the sigh echoed in his heart, he knew he couldn't hide any longer.
Not because of this sigh, but because of the notification from the Evil God Temple:
｢Evil Event triggered: Nun—The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara｣
……
Beside the stream, Ye Chen was starstruck as he stared at the girl in front of him, speechless.
His whole life was a life of constant struggle. From a good-for-nothing with no accomplishments to the preeminent King of the Northern Region, his life experience was enough to be adapted into a fantasy novel.
He also had no shortage of women, from childhood friends to royal princesses. Too many, too many girls fell in love with him. However, this was the first time that Ye Chen felt a rush of excitement in his heart.
This girl was like a gift from heaven, flawless and perfect. She immediately entered the depths of Ye Chen's heart.
"W-Why are you looking at me like this…?" The young girl lowered her head, blushing, and two red spots appeared on her cheeks.
However, a burst of hurried footsteps traveled over at this time. A group of people from the Underworld Ocean Dao Hall arrived and surrounded the two in the blink of an eye.
The leader said excitedly, "Ye Chen, you have nowhere to run now. Surrender immediately!"
Ye Chen stood up slowly, protecting the girl behind him, and sneered. "Even if a tiger falls, I, Ye Chen, am still not someone that people like you can bully!"
After all, he was still the King of the Northern Region. Faced with Ye Chen's resolute words, no one dared to come forward to fight him.
Ye Chen’s expression changed slightly. He suddenly slung the girl over his shoulder and tried to break through the encirclement.
"Damn it, he was bluffing!" The leader immediately reacted and ordered in a fluster, "Run! After him!"
Ye Chen revealed a contemptuous smile as he ran away with the girl on his shoulder.
‘If these fools can actually trap me, then I’d be too… Huh?’
Three figures blocked his way. Among them, Ping Jiushan had a sneer on his face.
But Feng Xu ignored him. His gaze was fixed on the girl on Ye Chen's shoulder, mumbling, "Buddha…"
Ye Chen’s expression immediately turned ashen when he was suddenly stopped by the three people. He naturally recognized Feng Xu. ‘It was hard to fend him off even in my heyday, so my current chances are even slimmer.’
With this delay, the pursuers behind him caught up, and the closest pursuer had already swung his blade down.
"Ahh!"
The girl immediately screamed, but a strange event occurred at this moment.
A ray of golden light began to shine from her forehead, and the blade swinging down crumbled into dust, while the golden light became more and more intense, brightening until it was so harsh that no one dared to stare at it.
If someone took another glance right now, they’d find a “卍
[1]
” symbol on her forehead.
A token slowly flew out from Feng Xu’s clothes, conjuring up a projection that was covered in armor resembling a navy uniform. It was a projection of the King of the Deep Sea.
“Your Majesty," Feng Xu and the other two greeted respectfully after hurriedly getting down on one knee.
"The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samara awakens after 9,000 reincarnations." The King of the Deep Sea sighed. "I didn't expect for this aphorism to be used here."
Then he looked up at the distant sky, his face expressionless under his armor.
"Heavenly Mystery? So it was you again."
"Waking up the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara early—you even dared to do this kind of thing that cuts off someone’s future?" The King of the Deep Sea’s voice seemed to contain a smile, as if he was gloating at someone’s misfortune.
Feng Xu quickly asked when he saw the King of the Deep Sea, "Your Majesty, that Gu Nan may be hiding in this mountain range."
"That little friend? He’s indeed in the mountain range, and he’s actually right here." The King of the Deep Sea nodded lightly. His power far exceeded Prodigious Realm, so Gu Nan naturally couldn’t deceive him.
Some sort of strange force slowly descended, and a shadow suddenly had nowhere to hide, revealing Gu Nan's figure.
Gu Nan's expression looked a little helpless. This wasn’t his fault at all. Who would’ve thought that something so inexplicable would happen and cause the King of the Deep Sea to appear?
But he was also much calmer now. He’d already personally met a Star Ruler whose actual realm might far surpass Tier 5. Would he still be concerned about a mere Tier 4?
Moreover, he wasn’t completely out of escape options. It's just that with the current situation, he was actually in no hurry to leave.
His gaze fell on the girl who was suspended in the air, with more and more Buddhist symbols floating around her.
This Evil Event was his best chance to step into Tier 4.
The power of the King of the Deep Sea had completely locked onto him, sealing all his laws. Gu Nan couldn’t resist at all when confronting a Tier 4 existence directly. He couldn’t utilize any of his laws right now.
He only had one shot at this.
As the girl's golden glow lit up more and more, Ye Chen's gaze also became more and more intoxicated, as though a certain power was drawing him to the girl.
The next moment, the girl suddenly opened her eyes.
"Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one" —Although there was no sound, such a sentence abruptly popped up in the hearts of everyone present.
The girl's eyes were full of indifference, as if she was gazing down from an endless height, overlooking all sentient beings.
She raised her hand to the sky, and the clouds split in two instantly. A purplish-black cloud was already floating above her head.
On the other hand, the golden light surrounding the girl gradually converged and landed on the earth at her feet.
Purple and gold; Heaven and Earth.
"To become a Buddha with a single thought or to become a demon with a single thought. Buddhist Ancestor, please choose,” a voice seemed to come from the horizon as a figure slowly walked out from there.
It was precisely the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord.
But he was no longer dressed like a scholar. His folding fan and silk scarf had all been tossed aside. Instead, he looked like a Daoist priest, wearing blue Daoist robes.
After saying that, he didn't look at the girl anymore but bowed to the King of the Deep Sea and said, "I greet Your Majesty."
The King of the Deep Sea was noncommittal and just commented, "To forcibly awaken the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara—who has yet to complete all 10,000 reincarnations—using an entire region’s force of destiny. What a cunning strategy!"
"I don’t dare claim the credit." However, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord just smiled. He turned to Gu Nan and saluted the same way. "Daoist Friend Gu, we meet again."
Gu Nan couldn’t make any expression right now, so he simply didn’t say anything at all and rolled his eyes in response.
The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord didn’t mind either. He asked the King of the Deep Sea another question, "I heard that Your Majesty once had a connection with the Buddhist Realm. What choice does Your Majesty think the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samara will make?"
"The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara will become a true Buddha after 10,000 reincarnations. Even if it has only been 9,000 reincarnations so far, it’s still not far from the goal," the King of the Deep Sea remarked lightly.
As if to confirm his words, the girl's body in midair shone. Her left side shone gold while her right side shone purple. The two colors were fighting each other.
However, it didn't take long for the golden light to start getting the upper hand. It began to push the purple light into a corner.
Wherever the purple light went, the girl's body began to burst into bloody holes one after another, and blood flowed down endlessly, while the girl's expression was always indifferent.
"It will fail." However, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord chuckled lightly. "If the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara will become a true Buddha after 10,000 reincarnations but awakens after only 9,000 reincarnations, then true Buddhahood will naturally be out of reach."
After saying that, he then glanced at Gu Nan again. "Daoist Friend Gu, what do you think?"
The King of the Deep Sea frowned slightly. The fact that the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord asked the same question twice seemed to make him realize something, and he slammed his palm down without even thinking. The terrifying power descended directly upon Gu Nan's head.
He only needed to leave Gu Nan barely alive in order to force the whereabouts of the Godstone out of him, but that didn’t mean he couldn’t harm Gu Nan.
Gu Nan looked at the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s smile, then sensed the power from the girl in the air, and also revealed a grin.
The next instant, he had already appeared in the air right behind the girl.
His power of law had been completely sealed, but Gu Nan still had skills and still had Blink, which could break through all seals!
The King of the Deep Sea’s expression suddenly changed underneath his armor. The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara hadn’t fully awakened yet and hadn’t recovered her peak power yet. Gu Nan was forcing her to make an immediate choice!
The King of the Deep Sea stretched out his hand to strike Gu Nan, but Gu Nan was even faster. Holding the sword of shadow in his hand, Gu Nan looked at the bloody holes on the girl's body and used a skill without hesitation.
Righteous Judgment!
T/N:
[1]
卍
: A sacred and auspicious symbol in Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism
