chapters.title: Chapter 203: The Buddha of No Return
chapters.content:
Righteous Judgment, which was dubbed the "greatsword" by players, was a very special skill because it caused true damage based on the amount of HP the target already lost.
And how was HP calculated in the real world?
Gu Nan didn't know the specifics behind the Evil God Temple’s calculation method, but he knew one thing—as long as the other party was injured and bleeding, this skill would definitely do damage.
With this female Buddha's current state, there was no need for a fatal attack. Even a slight interference was enough to consign her to eternal damnation.
Gu Nan understood the situation quite clearly—being able to accurately analyze the situation was also an essential quality for top players.
His sealed power of law managed to break free just a little, and the sword of shadow seemed dimmer than usual, but the white light on the sword’s tip revealed unspeakable power.
Gu Nan ruthlessly stabbed the sword down, but when the sword tip was about to touch the girl, the latter suddenly turned around.
Her tightly-shut eyes snapped open again, but this time they didn’t glow golden. Instead, they glittered with a purplish-black light, containing endless demonic intent.
Hints of purple infiltrated the golden "卍" symbol on the girl’s forehead little by little, turning the mark completely purple in the blink of an eye.
The power of the “greatsword” didn't make heaven and earth tremble this time. Actually, it didn't even injure the girl.
Because the instant she turned around, the energy surrounding the girl suddenly surged, becoming extremely powerful. It was so powerful that not even the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord, who was already half a step into Tier 4, could match her.
Perhaps only the King of the Deep Sea, who’d been unfathomable from beginning to end, could be a match for the current her.
Golden light flashed, and Gu Nan was instantly blown away. Most of his body was smashed to pieces. His injuries were even heavier than the ones inflicted by the King of the Deep Sea a while ago.
The girl had gone from a mortal straight to Tier 4. The power of Buddhist reincarnations was indeed extraordinary.
Gu Nan fell to the ground like a heap of mud, and even his skull had split into two. His cerebral cortex came into direct contact with the ground, giving him a strange sensation.
But thanks to an outrageous damage reduction skill like Resistance, Gu Nan wasn’t dead yet.
His consciousness was always awake, because he sensed the vibration from the Evil God Temple.
｢Evil Event Complete: Nun—The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara. Total Evil Value obtained: 48｣
……
"What a pity."
The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord gave a small sigh as he stared at Gu Nan, whose body had been completely smashed into a mangled heap.
The King of the Deep Sea also looked over there, but he just snorted coldly. "He overestimated himself!"
‘Now that the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara has reappeared in this world, not even I would dare to casually intervene. I wouldn’t even order my subordinates to intervene. After all, whether the other party becomes a demon or a Buddha has nothing to do with me.’
‘The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord dares to intervene only because it’s related to his breakthrough. He naturally dares to take any risk in order to break through to Tier 4.’
‘As for that brat who snatched the Realm Stone… A mere Prodigious cultivator actually dared to attack the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara? He really is tired of living.’
However, the King of the Deep Sea finally understood the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s goal at this time.
In fact, the entire thing was very simple. The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord found the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara’s current reincarnation, so he laid out a plan to awaken her using an entire region’s worth of destiny and fortune.
No matter how deep or profound the scheme, everything would become clear and logical as long as you knew the schemer’s goal.
However, before they knew about the existence of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara, be it Gu Nan, the other five great Dao Lords, or White Mist—none of them could understand the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s actions.
"The Buddha who has reincarnated 9,000 times is now destroyed in this single reincarnation. What a pity,” the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord lamented as he looked at the girl who was gradually floating towards the purple cloud in the air, shaking his head and sighing.
Every reincarnation of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara was a person with profound Buddhist affinity, and every reincarnation’s life ended in worship of the Buddha.
This obsession would accumulate for ten thousand lifetimes. If the Buddha could awaken after ten thousand reincarnations, then that would naturally result in the emergence of a Buddha among Buddhas, but unfortunately, this cycle was destroyed by the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord.
However, this obsession had already accumulated over nine thousand lifetimes, yet such an obsession hadn’t been purified by Buddhist rites. One can well imagine the result.
"You'd better consider how to save yourself first," the King of the Deep Sea said as he looked at the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord strangely.
However, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord laughed. "The day the Buddhist Ancestor awakens completely will be the day that this humble Daoist steps into the Void Cutter Realm. At that time, this humble Daoist can return to Starry Ocean Pavilion in a matter of seconds. Not even she will be able to catch up to me."
Perhaps because his long-cherished wish of many years—stepping into the Void Cutter Realm—was finally about to come true, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord let his guard down slightly, and his words weren’t as cautious as before.
Of course, the King of the Deep Sea had long known about his background, so there was no need for him to be cautious and try to hide anything.
The girl in the air flew higher and higher. The symbol on her forehead had turned completely purple, and her black hair was slowly getting longer, hanging down to her waist from both sides.
Her clothes also changed, turning into a black robe. She then slowly sat in a cross-legged position atop the purple cloud.
The purple cloud dispersed, only to reveal a huge black lotus. The girl sat on it, and the lotus slowly rotated beneath her.
The purple light in the girl's eyes finally began to dim until it completely dissipated. She looked no different from an ordinary person. Only then did she slowly look towards the audience of two.
She first gave the King of the Deep Sea a light nod, then looked into the distance at the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord. "This one will surely settle the debt with the Starry Ocean Pavilion one day."
The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord bowed, looking entirely unconcerned. "This humble Daoist and the three Pavilion Lords eagerly await your visit."
The young girl just gave a cold snort but didn’t say anything else.
However, someone shouted just then, "Don't go!"
The young girl looked to one side and saw a dazed Ye Chen. The latter’s face was pale white. Nobody knew what he was thinking, but he kept on murmuring, "Don't go, don't go…"
"You used the force of destiny to awaken me. Although it was not my wish, it was still karma." She looked down on him from above and waved her hand, creating a black lotus that fluttered down. "This can help you break through the shackles of destiny and advance straight to Void Cutter Realm."
As expected of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara. Even if she had just awakened, she could still bestow a treasure to help someone break through directly to the Void Cutter Realm.
But Ye Chen just stared blankly, unable to respond even when the black lotus landed in his hands. He kept repeating, “Don’t go…”
He currently had a splitting headache, and there seemed to be something in his mind that eagerly wanted to jump out, but he simply couldn't remember it. He just instinctively sensed that it had something to do with the girl.
‘If I let her go, I will definitely regret it.’
But the black lotus in his hands seemed to weigh tens of millions of pounds. All it did was land in Ye Chen’s hands, but the weight of that alone crushed him so that he couldn’t move a muscle; he couldn't even shout.
Ye Chen’s clearly abnormal behavior made the King of the Deep Sea mutter to himself silently, and he sent the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord an odd glance, but the latter just smiled and remained silent.
The young girl sat upright on the black lotus again, looking up at the sky. She seemed to announce something to the sky.
"From today on, the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara is dead. I control the Buddhist path of reincarnation."
"From today on, the Buddha of the Myriad Heavens will no longer enter reincarnation. Death will be the end for me."
"From today on, my name is Wu Gui
[1]
."
The young girl, or more accurately Demonic Buddha Wu Gui, declared to Heaven resolutely. Her voice instantly resounded throughout the entire Heaven and Earth Star and rang in everyone's hearts. Everyone on the planet heard her declaration.
At this time, however, a faint voice came from the direction of a heap of mangled flesh.
"Based on conventions, your older brother is probably called Wu Tian
[2]
."
T/N:
[1]
Wu Gui
: Wu Gui means “no return.” She picked this name because her soul won’t enter the cycle of reincarnation after death, so it will have no place to return to.
Incidentally, this chapter title also contains her name (Wu Gui), but because it referred to the “Buddha of No Return” as opposed to the “Buddha named Wu Gui,” the chapter title is translated literally
[2] Wu Tian
: I believe Gu Nan is referring to the show “Journey to the West: A Sequel,” where the main antagonist, Wu Tian, is a demon who proclaimed himself the Buddha, so both Wu Tian and Wu Gui are Demonic Buddhas and share the same last name

chapters.title: Chapter 204: One Person, One Sword
chapters.content:
Backing up to a moment ago.
The instant he read the message from the Evil God Temple, Gu Nan's consciousness dived into it and opened the game panel with the fastest speed in his entire life, then chose to advance.
The Evil Event “Nun—The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara" was the fastest event Gu Nan had ever experienced, but the reward was quite high.
Actually, he took a risk. If the Evil Value reward given by this Evil Event didn’t exceed 42, then he might’ve truly become a pile of bones.
Fortunately, the event content of "attacking a Tier 4 powerhouse" suddenly raised the difficulty level many times over, so it gave quite a high reward.
Gu Nan currently had 506 Evil Value and 2,600 points, while advancement cost 2,500 points, so it was just right.
The Tier 4 advancement process was even stranger than Gu Nan imagined.
As his arcana during Tier 3, the law of substitution became Gu Nan’s first exclusive law and directly became his main skill after advancing to Tier 4.
Under the torrent of the indescribable power of laws, Gu Nan's comprehension of "shadow" was rapidly improving, and he finally stepped into the ranks of Tier 4 in one fell swoop.
Fortunately, Gu Nan had the game experience in his past life. Although the essence of the law needed to be absorbed slowly, he was crystal clear on how to apply it.
Purely in terms of application and usage, those Star Rulers may not even be better than him.
"Tier 4." Gu Nan sat on the throne of the Evil God Temple, and shadow clones began to appear beside him one by one.
"Substitution." Gu Nan stabbed his sword out. Around a dozen shadow clones also turned into his appearance and made the exact same stabbing motion. The only difference was the very slight timing difference.
After entering Tier 4, the law of substitution wasn’t so simple anymore and had more varied usage.
His dozen or so shadow clones were substituted by Gu Nan at different points in time. During the time interval when he stabbed his sword out, his true body substituted a different shadow clone every single instant, turning that shadow clone into his true body at that point in time.
To turn illusions into reality. Such an ability almost resembled the power of creation. This was the true power of Tier 4.
……
Just when the young girl, Wu Gui, bestowed the black lotus upon Ye Chen and made a declaration to the Heavens, what accompanied the sound of Gu Nan's voice was the power of shadows that suddenly surged all the way to the sky.
The young girl's eyes slowly moved to that side, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord looked back in amazement, while the King of the Deep Sea reacted faster than either of them. He had already taken off in a flash.
It wasn’t because he was very vigilant. Rather, the thick killing intent directed at him from not far away left him with no choice but to respond.
Countless figures of Gu Nan appeared beside the King of the Deep Sea simultaneously. Every single one of them was real, reflecting his true body at some point in time, and every sword was deadly.
"Gu Nan!" The King of the Deep Sea thundered. His body suddenly swelled, and the anchor on his shoulder slammed down heavily.
The terrifying shockwave seemed capable of shattering even space itself. Gu Nan's shadow clones were naturally smashed to pieces, but at the same time, even more shadow doppelgangers crawled out from the King of the Deep Sea’s shadow.
The King of the Deep Sea’s gaze darkened slightly as he finally realized that he couldn’t afford to fight a prolonged battle with the other party, so he was determined to escape, even if he had to take full damage from this oncoming wave of attacks.
He tore open the void with his hands and prepared to jump inside without another word, but dozens of Gu Nan’s swords simultaneously stabbed his back.
Faced with the shadow swords, the armor on his body crumbled like paper and was pierced through instantly. Dozens of swords all stabbed into his body, and blood poured out crazily.
"Roar!"
The King of the Deep Sea roared like a beast, and at the same time, the aura of an ancient fierce beast appeared on him—as a bloodline user, most of the King of the Deep Sea’s bloodline wasn’t human.
However, he ultimately suppressed the impulse coming from the depths of his bloodline. Instead of turning back and engaging in a fierce battle with the enemy, he fled into the crack in the void, escaping to some unknown plane.
The shadow clones all over the sky slowly merged together, transforming back into one Gu Nan, who was standing right where the King of the Deep Sea had stood seconds before.
"He’s sure fast at running away." Gu Nan sneered, unconcerned with chasing after him.
After all, the King of the Deep Sea was still a Tier 4 expert and naturally had his methods when it came to running for his life. It would be difficult to actually kill him.
‘It’s just that he took dozens of my attacks. I’m afraid it’ll be hard for him to recover to his original state without decades of recuperation—but how can I give him time to recuperate?’
Although the monk can run away, the monk’s temple cannot.
The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord was completely stupefied as he watched this. At the very least, the King of the Deep Sea was still a veteran Void Cutter expert and a powerhouse who was awarded a Planet Rank seal by the Starry Ocean Pavilion. Such a person actually fled so decisively?
On the other side, Gu Nan's gaze had already shifted to him.
The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord felt like a poisonous snake had locked onto him, and he felt strange chills on his back. He quickly waved his hands placatingly. "Daoist Friend Gu, we have no enmity between us, so we might as well—"
Gu Nan swung his sword down without hesitation— ‘Why say so much rubbish? Only those I can’t kill have the right to negotiate!’
Layers upon layers of shadow swords appeared again. This one swing was divided into hundreds of instances. At every instance, Gu Nan’s true body substituted for a different shadow clone and participated in the attack on the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord.
This method of infinite replication made the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s scalp go numb.
He wasn’t the King of the Deep Sea and had no ability to tank these attacks, so he simply let himself be chopped to pieces.
Attacks from a Tier 4 powerhouse weren’t so easy to endure. Even if this wasn’t the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s true body, the power of shadows still traced his law back to its source and attacked his true body.
A stifled grunt of pain came from the starry sky, followed by a wave of spatial fluctuations. The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord had left.
Just as he said before, he went directly to the Central Region’s Starry Ocean Pavilion. That was the only place where he felt safer.
"Another one." Gu Nan still had a sneer on his face.
He wasn’t afraid of these Tier 4 experts running away, because these people all had their own roots. As long as they weren’t alone in this world, they’d be forced to show themselves sooner or later if he killed enough of their forces.
Feng Xu, Ping Jiushan, and Guan Sheng were originally standing beside the King of the Deep Sea, but they were currently shivering in fear. When they saw Gu Nan turn his head their way, they wanted to beg for mercy but were stabbed through the heart simultaneously.
After killing these three, Gu Nan's gaze finally fell on the girl named Wu Gui, the one who almost flattened him with just one attack.
Wu Gui was also glaring at him coldly, because it was precisely Gu Nan's sword that forced her to decide earlier than intended, which allowed her demonic side to gain the upper hand, resulting in her current miserable situation.
There was animosity on both sides, so it naturally led to a big fight.
Shadows reappeared, and countless swords shot straight at the girl. On the other side, Wu Gui gently tapped the black lotus under her, and demonic intent suddenly engulfed the sky.
Crack.
As if something in the void had just shattered, Gu Nan's shadow clones were swept clean, and Wu Gui’s demonic intent was also gone. The two’s attacks actually ended in a draw.
At this moment, however, two more auras descended. It was a man and a woman who were stepping out of the void.
Both the man and woman had pointed ears, fair skin, and similar appearances.
But it was the man who spoke with a dark expression right now, "The two of you entered our Heaven and Earth Star uninvited. Do you want us siblings to carry out our duties as hosts?"
This man and woman—older brother and younger sister—were the two Void Cutter rulers of Heaven and Earth Star!
T/N:
Sounds like substitution is both a skill and a law. Will be lowercase if it’s referring to it as a law and uppercase for the skill

chapters.title: Chapter 205: They Sure Fled Fast
chapters.content:
These two were the rulers of Heaven and Earth Star and the first two Void Cutter cultivators on this planet.
Luo Jie and Luo Fei were brother and sister. They were well-known Void Cutter experts even in the surrounding worlds. Their fame was due to their obsession over their territory.
They’ve always regarded Heaven and Earth Star as their own territory, and at the same time, they were extremely hostile to outsiders, so they had a very nasty attitude when they saw Gu Nan and Wu Gui.
Actually, it wasn’t limited to just Gu Nan and Wu Gui. Any Void Cutter cultivator who entered the Sixth Region without giving prior notice would attract their hostility.
This kind of behavior really stood out, because most Void Cutter existences wouldn’t be so territorial.
This was a world where individuals possessed great power. As long as the cultivator wasn’t dead, they could easily establish territories and organizations. Territories really weren’t worth caring about.
At this time, it was the older brother, Luo Jie, who spoke to Gu Nan and Wu Gui.
Luo Fei, his younger sister, also stepped forward. "We can pretend nothing happened if the two of you leave Heaven and Earth Star immediately. Otherwise—"
Before she could say what would happen otherwise, Gu Nan had already slashed with his sword.
Layers upon layers of illusory shadows reappeared, but this time the target changed to Luo Fei, while the young girl Wu Gui also attacked right then.
She waved her hand and sent out a palm strike. What was originally supposed to represent the Buddha holding the world in the palm of their hand now looked gloomy and sinister, containing endless demonic energy.
The target of her palm strike was the older brother—Luo Jie—so that he wouldn’t be able to help Luo Fei in time.
And after sending out this palm strike, Wu Gui immediately turned and left without any hesitation.
Of course nobody who could advance to Void Cutter Realm would be a fool. Luo Jie almost immediately understood the other party’s intention—this was betting that his younger sister would be killed in one blow, or at least seriously injured!
Only then would Wu Gui’s act of merely delaying him for one second have any meaning.
‘And only then will Wu Gui be able to fully escalate the enmity between us and that other enemy, which will make it easier for her to calmly escape!’
After understanding all of this in an instant, Luo Jie casually blocked the girl's attack, but a sneer appeared on his face.
‘If you think that my younger sister will be defeated so easily, then you’re underes—’
“Ahh!" A miserable scream came from behind him. Luo Jie turned his head back incredulously, only to see dozens of swords piercing Luo Fei's body. Every single sword had stabbed the same spot.
They were supposed to stab Luo Fei's heart, but since she dodged slightly, she was stabbed in the stomach instead.
But just how powerful was Gu Nan's blow? Even the King of the Deep Sea, a bloodline user, was seriously wounded in an instant, so one can only imagine the results here.
Although substitution became Gu Nan's exclusive law after he advanced to Tier 4, the enhancements to his physical body were nothing to scoff at either.
The Tier 4 Evil God physique had almost reached a jaw-dropping point. Gu Nan's physical body alone was enough to resist Tier 3 laws.
And the special function of the law of substitution was to give him the ability to stack a single attack dozens of times.
Because all the Gu Nan’s formed by shadow clones were substituted by his true body, they all carried out the exact same attack with the exact same motions.
The instant the first Gu Nan stabbed Luo Fei, the second Gu Nan also stabbed her, followed by the third and fourth…
The essence of Shadow Form allowed all the Gu Nan’s to overlap with each other, as if they were all one person—this was a result of Gu Nan's increased control over Substitution. The shadow clones no longer had to be spread out and could all overlap now, occupying the same space simultaneously.
So to outsiders, it really did seem as if he defeated Luo Fei with just one strike. However, what they didn’t know was that Gu Nan's every strike actually contained crit damage dozens of times stronger than his original attack.
The explanation might be complicated, but for Luo Jie, the whole thing was very simple.
His younger sister really was seriously injured in a single strike!
The fact that Luo Fei didn’t die instantly when hit by Gu Nan's terrifying strength was a testament to her core law being of a high enough rank. But even so, her body slowly fell down.
"Die!" Luo Jie roared angrily, and a lightning bolt suddenly struck down from the air, hitting Gu Nan right on the head.
This law of lightning directly shattered space, revealing gaping holes that led to the void; its power was indescribable.
If it was the Tier 3 Gu Nan, this single lightning bolt would be enough to seriously wound him to the point of death.
But when it struck the current Gu Nan, he didn't even bat an eye and allowed the sudden bolt to hit his head. He was entirely unscathed.
The strength of the Tier 4 Evil God physique really was unimaginable.
But when Gu Nan slowly walked out of the smoke and dust after that loud explosion, he found that the Luo siblings had already disappeared without a trace.
"As expected of Void Cutter cultivators. Every single one of them runs away faster than the previous one." Gu Nan sneered, but he was also unconcerned.
After reaching Tier 4, everyone had the ability to tear open the void, so it was very difficult for Tier 4 experts to truly kill each other.
This was also the reason why battles between Void Cutter cultivators were extremely rare.
In any case, no one could kill anyone else, so what was the point of fighting? At the same time, attacking the enemy's organization was also inconvenient, because if you destroyed your enemy’s forces, the other party could retaliate and destroy your forces too.
It was impossible for Void Cutter experts to always be guarding their territory, so enemies would inevitably find an opportunity to destroy that territory.
Gu Nan wasn’t worried about this kind of situation. He’d just advanced to Tier 4, so he would have plenty of methods to deal with these people in the future.
In the game, how to kill NPCs who could run away was also a topic many players researched.
"Your origin has been damaged, so you can't cross to another region with your physical body… Let's see where you can run to now."
……
"My Lord."
When Gu Nan arrived at White Mist’s headquarters again, Red Tail showed far more respect than usual—for those paying attention, what transpired in the central mountain range was no secret.
The King of the Deep Sea revealed himself, the reincarnation of a certain Buddhist ancestor awakened, and the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord broke through to Void Cutter Realm… She knew all about those events, including the appearance of the two rulers of Heaven and Earth Star.
Red Tail had stayed in Heaven and Earth Star for so many years, but the total number of Void Cutter experts she had ever seen in her life was still less than the number who appeared this time.
And more importantly, these Void Cutter existences all lost to Gu Nan, someone who just advanced to Void Cutter Realm not long ago.
‘As expected of the one with the fastest breakthroughs in history.’ Red Tail inwardly gave a wry smile. She naturally knew about Starry Ocean Pavilion's evaluation of Gu Nan.
"Take over Heaven and Earth Star immediately. Control the take off and landing locations of all starships. Destroy them all if you can't control them."
When Gu Nan said this, a small black dagger slowly appeared and landed in Red Tail’s palm. "The power of my law is sealed inside this dagger. Not even normal Dao Lords will be able to survive this attack."
Red Tail hurriedly accepted the dagger, which seemed perfectly ordinary to her senses, but when she tried to exert some force on the dagger, she couldn’t do anything to it.
Afraid to get too distracted, she spoke to Gu Nan again, "My Lord, those two also have a Dao Hall here. Do you want to…"
"Where is it?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows slightly. Those two naturally referred to the pair of Luo siblings, Luo Jie and Luo Fei. He didn't know that the two actually had some legacy here.
Red Tail chuckled. "Those two have always been strange. Their Dao Hall isn’t on the planetary ring, but on the mainland instead…"

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Taking Over Heaven and Earth Star
chapters.content:
On an isolated island at the southern edge of the continent, two youths were kowtowing every step as they walked towards the center of the island.
"Da Niu, can we really impress the immortals in the Heavenly Palace by doing this?" One of them had already kowtowed so much that his forehead was bleeding, and his knees were also scraped bloody. He couldn't help stopping for a short break while mumbling.
The young man named Da Niu, however, looked very thin, which was completely different from his name
[1]
.
"You will succeed if you are sincere. How can you impress the immortals if your heart isn’t firm when seeking the Dao?" Da Niu said quietly without ever glancing at his companion. He just continued to kowtow every step, pressing forth.
His forehead and knees were in even worse shape than his companion’s, but he didn’t seem to feel any pain at all.
"But…" Da Niu's companion rubbed his wounds and suddenly winced in pain.
"The Heavenly Palace is an island where immortals live. They can see our every move," Da Niu opened his mouth coldly again, immediately scaring his companion into silence, not daring to utter another word.
Just like that, the two approached the island’s center step by step, and after more than an hour, they finally arrived at the center of the island.
The central area looked impressive. Swaths of gorgeous palaces covered the land. Because they were located in between mountains and fields, the scene gave people a strong visual impact.
"So… So magnificent…" Da Niu's companion murmured aloud, looking up at the majestic palaces. He was unable to avert his eyes, so he didn't notice the fierce light in Da Niu’s eyes.
Da Niu was currently roaring in his heart: ‘I, the Thousand Yin Demon King, have returned! Luo Jie, Luo Fei, just you wait! The day I secretly take control of your Heavenly Palace will be the day… Eh…’
This Thousand Yin Demon King who had been reborn by taking over Da Niu’s body was flabbergasted when he saw the state of the Heavenly Palace.
An enormous sword thousands of meters long smashed down from the air, cutting the front, middle, and back palaces in half all at once.
"This…" Da Niu gawked speechlessly.
Although he absolutely hated that pair of siblings, he also knew that as early as that year, they were already the most powerful figures humanity had to offer. Now that so many years had passed, he was afraid that they probably would’ve stepped onto the altar already and ascended as immortals, existences that no mortal could ever hope to match.
‘Who is so bold, daring to even attack the territory of the two strongest people in this world?’
Sure enough, someone appeared on the palace grounds and shouted furiously, "Who attacked our Heavenly Palace? Are you tired of living?!"
The people in the Heavenly Palace were much more arrogant than people from the major Dao Halls. After all, this place was the legacy of two Void Cutter Realm existences. Even though they usually paid no attention to the secular world, no one dared to look down upon them.
There were as many as seven Dao Lords in the Heavenly Palace—this was the might of the Heavenly Palace.
However, all this seemed meaningless in the face of the newcomer.
Gu Nan's figure slowly emerged from the void. Ever since he advanced to Tier 4, he naturally gained the ability to tear open the void and could easily travel throughout the continent.
Furthermore, as long as he had the coordinates, he could even travel between regions and directly visit the Central Region of Star Realm.
In the game’s words, after Tier 4, players unlocked the ability to teleport to any point on the map, which was really starting to resemble the middle to late stages of the game.
"Looks like Luo Jie never came back here." Gu Nan coldly looked down at the palaces. If Luo Jie had returned to this place, then the people in the Heavenly Palace wouldn’t be here right now—they would’ve scattered and fled a long time ago.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Several more enormous swords chopped down one after another, smashing the Heavenly Palace into rubble. The Dao Lord who had opened his mouth just now was instantly cut into two pieces.
Da Niu hid to the side, staring at everything blankly. He looked especially dazed when he saw a Dao Lord powerhouse die in front of him just like that. This was someone that not even his peak power self dared claim he could win with certainty.
‘Has the world already become such a scary place?’ The Demon King, who had returned to this world after possessing Da Niu’s body, suddenly wanted to burst into tears.
On the other side, after Gu Nan got rid of the remnants of Heavenly Palace, people from White Mist soon came to clean up the battlefield.
……
"My Lord, at present, all the starships on Heaven and Earth Star are under our control. The Second Commander is currently checking the list of names submitted in the past two days, searching for… traces of those two."
San Wei stood in front of Gu Nan, cold sweat dripping down her forehead as she reported the current situation. Her original capable and experienced air was long gone, and she even stammered a little.
"Mm." Gu Nan just nodded calmly and said casually, "Just make sure that those two didn’t flee this planet. Control the situation on the mainland first. Have you encountered any trouble?"
Luo Fei was heavily injured by Gu Nan's sword, so her body wouldn’t be able to withstand the enormous pressure when jumping between regions. If she wanted to leave the Sixth Region, then she would need the help of a starship.
Therefore, controlling all the starships on Heaven and Earth Star could prevent those two from escaping.
"No," San Wei replied. "Since Ye Chen, the King of the Northern Region, went missing, there is no longer any resistance from the mainland. And all the Dao Lords submitted to us after the Second Commander destroyed two Dao Halls."
Gu Nan nodded again. His command to Red Tail was to take control of the overall situation in Heaven and Earth Star in the shortest possible time. Anyone who dared to resist could be killed.
This was actually done to hide White Mist’s existence.
Gu Nan still needed White Mist to create mist mirrors for him so that he could continuously harvest Evil Value, so he didn’t want anyone to pay attention to White Mist.
Since people already knew about his connection to White Mist, he might as well expand his territory to include the entire Heaven and Earth Star.
By making Heaven and Earth Star into a target for people to hit, White Mist could be hidden in the dark. So if someone wanted to attack him, White Mist wouldn’t be their first target.
"Where's Lan Si?" Gu Nan then asked.
"Miss Lan Si is still in secluded cultivation," San Wei hurriedly answered. After a pause, she added, "By the way, our people found a girl in the Heavenly Palace. From the Second Commander’s judgment, she might be those two’s daughter…"
Gu Nan paused, then asked, "Aren’t they biological brother and sister?"
San Wei also stared blankly when she heard this, then her expression turned strange. "That’s right… Their bloodline seems to be very special. In order to keep the family bloodline pure, they’ve always married within the family."
"How interesting." Gu Nan chuckled.
"Should I bring her over for you to see?"
Gu Nan waved a hand dismissively. "Forget it. Didn't I tell you before that White Mist should start collecting children from all over the world and train from an early age? Just add her in as well."
If there really was something strange about Luo Jie and Luo Fei's daughter, then it would naturally be revealed in time.
San Wei nodded and left, while Gu Nan stood up, casually tore open the void, and stepped inside.
After breaking through to Tier 4, it became much easier for him to control Shadow Form, and he was able to leave a mark in different planes. He could always return immediately if something happened here.
Gu Nan’s current destination was a special plane.
In fact, there were only two methods of reincarnation when categorizing them in terms of soul power invested—to invest all of one’s soul or to invest a wisp of the soul. It wasn’t like what Gu Nan believed before—that people could invest however much soul power they wanted.
Either all of the soul or a tiny bit; there was no in-between.
However, among Gu Nan's reincarnations over the years, one world was very special. It could use the world’s origin to replace half of the reincarnator’s soul, forming a very special "half-life" mode.
This was Immortal Demon World.
"Why in the world is it this way?" Gu Nan stepped into the void with such questions.

[1]
Da Niu
= “Big Bull”

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Repulsive Force
chapters.content:
Today’s Gu Nan was no longer the "young and inexperienced boy" who’d just transmigrated into this world and didn't even know what reincarnation was.
After continuous research helped by White Mist’s database, reincarnation didn’t have many secrets left in his eyes.
In essence, it was nothing more than a special method that transported someone’s soul to another plane. It was more like an alternative traveling method for cultivators who couldn’t yet tear apart the void.
However, when Gu Nan personally tore through the void and entered Immortal Demon World, his thoughts became somewhat different.
"This world is rejecting me?" Gu Nan left the endless void and slowly entered Immortal Demon World. He felt a clear sense of rejection from the world itself.
This kind of feeling had never appeared when he was at a lower level, or it might not have been as obvious before, but it could clearly be felt now.
Some kind of power was trying to push Gu Nan out of this world, and the longer he stayed here, the stronger this power became.
"I can stay for about three days; that’s more than enough." Gu Nan’s eyebrows wrinkled slightly as he estimated the amount of time he could stay in Immortal Demon World.
He didn't intend to interfere in the state of affairs here; he just wanted to observe this plane’s strange world origin.
Gu Nan quietly sat in a corner of Immortal Demon World. All the troubles in the world seemed to have nothing to do with him. His spirit slowly rose and he studied this world coldly.
Not long after he sat down, a wisp of soul slowly approached from the endless void, coming in this direction.
This was a reincarnator from another location, and their target was precisely Immortal Demon World.
The endless void—according to the Star Rulers, it should be called the Myriad Heavens Starry Road. There were large and small balls of light everywhere, representing the existence of planes.
And people’s souls were tiny dots of light, which suddenly disappeared into the balls of light.
Gu Nan saw it clearly. As the bright dot entered Immortal Demon World, an inexplicable force emerged from the depths of the world and enveloped the reincarnator’s soul.
After that, the two sides started to exchange energy, as Gu Nan had seen before.
Half of the reincarnator’s soul was stored in the world to ensure that the reincarnator’s soul wouldn’t truly die even if their physical body inside this world died, but the price was that they could no longer re-enter this world once they died.
"What exactly is the principle behind this strange setting?" Gu Nan's brows furrowed slightly, and the power of shadows began to course, gradually moving towards that cocoon.
The current him had already stepped into Tier 4, becoming a lifeform completely different from mortals, so his power of laws was very close to the power of genuine laws.
The shadows spread quietly, silently approaching that reincarnator’s soul, then suddenly pounced.
The next instant, the repulsive force acting on Gu Nan suddenly became stronger. Before he could even see the results, he had already been pushed out of Immortal Demon World.
……
Somewhere in the Gu family on Ruby Fish Star, Bai Luoluo was suddenly startled awake in the middle of a reincarnation, then looked around in disbelief.
"Weird, why am I still here?" Bai Luoluo was a little confused. Even after such a long time, she was still the little girl who was slightly muddleheaded.
She remembered that she was reincarnating into Immortal Demon World, but for some reason, she came back here.
‘Is it even possible for reincarnation to fail?’
……
After being expelled by Immortal Demon World’s origin, Gu Nan didn't stay around. Rather, he immediately returned to Heaven and Earth Star with an odd smile on his face.
Although it was just a glimpse, it was enough for Gu Nan to understand many things.
That familiar figure that clearly came from Ruby Fish Star, as well as the fascinating method where the world’s origin and the reincarnator’s soul made an exchange… ‘Well, the latter still requires more observation.’
"If only I could learn this method." Gu Nan couldn't help sighing regretfully.
If he could use his own laws to exchange for other people’s souls, this would be the most perfect method of building an organization.
Gu Nan had never considered managing his own organization before White Mist came along. The core reason was that firstly, there was no demand for it, and secondly, he didn't trust anyone.
But after understanding the world mission translation method, Gu Nan needed the existence of White Mist to collect children of destiny for him as materials in creating mist mirrors.
This was the demand.
And if he could learn from the strange settings of Immortal Demon World and find a way to exchange for a portion of someone’s soul, then he could give his subordinates more trust.
But Immortal Demon World’s origin was clearly very dissatisfied with Gu Nan’s peeping, so this matter couldn’t be rushed for the time being.
‘Experiment and observation—there must be a two-pronged approach.’ Gu Nan thought as he picked up a pen with his right hand, theatrically writing a title on the paper.
[Immortal Demon World Takeover Plan]
After writing the title, he thought for a long time and finally wrote only one line under the title: [Kill the disobedient ones.]
……
For the time being, Red Tail hadn’t yet received this “takeover plan” with only one line of content, but she knew Gu Nan’s attitude very well and was always carrying out his plans consistently.
In the span of a few days, three more Dao Halls on Heaven and Earth Star’s planetary ring had been razed to the ground, all thanks to Red Tail.
The prestige established by the Dao Lords for hundreds of thousands of years seemed like a joke in front of the pitch-black dagger.
"Have the Dao Lords all gathered here?" Red Tail asked indifferently as she sat in a quiet room, sipping green tea.
"All the Dao Halls on the planetary ring have already paid us a visit. A total of 63 Dao Lords personally visited, and another 15 sent representatives,” Lin Yunyun immediately reported.
Red Tail seemed to be developing Lin Yunyun’s ability to handle affairs and even allowed her to deal with important matters related to the Dao Lords.
If Gu Nan wanted to unify Heaven and Earth Star, the most important step was to control the Dao Lords. If he ruled the planet using these regional bosses, then the entire process would be much more peaceful and convenient.
Even better, most of the Dao Lords had Dao Halls on the planetary ring. As for the Dao Lords hiding on the continent, there was no need to pay attention to them.
‘Since they want to be hermits, they can be that for the rest of their lives. I’ve never counted on them to be influential anyways.’
Red Tail sneered, "Go tell them that the Lord will grace us with his presence in three days. Drive away all 15 of those representatives and have them inform their superiors that if those 15 Dao Lords arrive later than My Lord, they can get ready to collect corpses at their Dao Halls."
"I understand." Lin Yunyun had long gotten accustomed to Red Tail’s iron-fisted style. She quickly saluted and stepped down, her actions so capable and experienced that she didn’t even resemble her past self from a few days ago.
Looking at the girl's back as she left, Red Tail's eyes finally softened, but then it was filled with lust for power.
When Gu Nan was advancing to Tier 4 earlier, she thought her clever plan had backfired.
She finally had the Sand King killed after much difficulty, but the result was a new boss against whom resistance was even more futile.
But Gu Nan's absolute delegation of power to her made her heart feel at ease again. ‘This one is a genuine bigshot; he doesn’t have the leisure time to fight with me over status and authority.’
As long as she could handle all the matters he ordered, then he didn’t mind giving her exclusive authority and would even provide her with military force.
This was more like a kind of cooperation.
‘Isn't this precisely what I’m seeking, so much so that I ran here from the Central Region with much difficulty?’
Red Tail raised her head and looked at the distant night sky. ‘Perhaps I can go back to that place one day. If there truly is such a day…’
A cruel smile suddenly appeared on her calm face.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: The Dao Lords Decision
chapters.content:
Heaven and Earth Star was a planet with a very long history.
Of course, in a sense, every region’s history was the same length, from past to present. The only reason some regions could claim to have a profound history was because they still inherited the traditions from ancient times.
Heaven and Earth Star was such a planet.
The title "Dao Lord" had been used by residents of Heaven and Earth Star ever since ancient times. Later, the meaning of this title changed several times when Star Realm unified all its regions, but the title’s distinguished status remained unchanged.
Today, however, these formerly high and mighty Dao Lords were concentrated in a small courtyard.
This was something that rarely happened in the history of Heaven and Earth Star, which had existed for tens of thousands of years. The last time such a high "Dao Lord density” gathering had taken place was during the warring era with military meetings and other such occasions.
"Absurd! Simply absurd!"
In a small courtyard, Lin Yunyun just calmly stood in front of all the Dao Lords, her expression unchanged.
The previous exclamation came from an elderly man whose surname was Pan. There was no longer anyone who remembered his real name. Presently, people only knew him as the "Mystical Heaven Dao Lord.” He was the owner of one of the largest Dao Halls in the Northern Region.
Before his disappearance, even Ye Chen showed great respect for the Mystical Heaven Dao Lord and didn't slight him at all.
This wasn’t only because of his formidable strength, but also because Elder Pan was very helpful to Ye Chen before his rise to power and even used to be Ye Chen’s backing once upon a time.
This was not a special case.
This Elder Pan was famous for his generous, righteous, and forthright attitude. He was also highly respected among the Dao Lords. In the past, he often supported and guided the younger generations.
Even among today's Dao Lords, there were many who received his help.
"There are 15 Dao Lords in faraway regions, and it’s hard for them to make it here in time. Don’t tell me that Lord is going to kill them all?" In the face of Lin Yunyun's message, Elder Pan took the lead in asking that question.
Without waiting for Lin Yunyun’s answer, someone among the Dao Lords immediately followed up.
"That’s right! We Dao Lords usually have our own affairs to attend to; we aren’t idle people with ample amounts of free time. How can we all stay in our Dao Halls and wait for your summons?"
"Even when the esteemed Luo siblings ruled this region for hundreds of years, we have never heard of such a rule!"
"Even if His Excellency is in the Void Cutter Realm, doesn’t he still have to listen to reason?"
However, Lin Yunyun just watched them apathetically, even when faced with all these condemnations. When everyone finally stopped, she slowly spoke, "I've already delivered the message. Whether you listen or not is your business."
After saying this, Lin Yunyun left without looking back.
When had the Dao Lords ever been slighted like this before? Someone immediately shouted, "How presumptuous! You—"
However, he was stopped by someone, and he turned to look. It was Elder Pan, the Mystical Heaven Dao Lord.
"Elder Pan…"
Elder Pan shook his head slightly and rumbled, "Don't be impulsive."
That Dao Lord took a deep breath. He could only swing his hand hatefully.
A female Dao Lord next to him said, "Elder Pan is right. The whereabouts of the esteemed Luo siblings are currently unknown, so we must not directly oppose that one."
"Alas! If only that one can also ignore worldly affairs and delegate all the power to us, just like those esteemed Luo siblings did," the angry Dao Lord also shook his head and sighed at this time.
He was also from the Northern Region. His Daoist name was "Qing Shi," and he was an expert blade wielder.
Before Ye Chen’s rise, this Qing Shi Dao Lord was the most famous genius in the Northern Region, and his life experience was legendary.
It was precisely because of this that he could hardly accept such contempt from a junior.
But what he said was also true. In the era of Luo Jie and Luo Fei, these two siblings basically didn't care what the Dao Lords did; they only cared about their own affairs.
Moreover, if someone accidentally provoked a strong enemy from outside the Sixth Region, the siblings would even come out to uphold justice for the local Dao Lords; they were simply generous to the extreme.
Now, however, that Lord Gu Nan actually wanted to unify Heaven and Earth Star by force, and judging by his posture, he probably wanted to incorporate every Dao Lord into his forces, which was completely unacceptable to the Dao Lords.
‘This is the organization I worked hard to manage for over a hundred years, yet you want to take it away just like that? It's too much!’
“That Lord needs a stable Heaven and Earth Star that’s under his control." The female Dao Lord “Cang Lian” added, "As long as we can help him achieve this, our goals won’t conflict with his."
"That's right. The gaze of such a bigshot is no longer on this tiny piece of land. Why would he bother to make things hard for us?"
"That Red Tail is nothing more than a fox pretending to be powerful using the tiger’s power. We might even be able to take her place with some work."
Cang Lian’s words immediately gained many Dao Lords’ support. Anyone who could sit here today wouldn’t be a fool. Even the Qing Shi Dao Lord’s previous theatrics might have been an act too.
They naturally thought that such a high-ranking Void Cutter expert wouldn’t possibly snatch their food, not when he had much more tempting targets like Luo Jie and Luo Fei in front of him.
It's just that Gu Nan had just advanced, so his horizons couldn’t broaden so suddenly. That was why he was obsessed with territory.
As long as they could give him a stable Heaven and Earth Star to rule over, he would naturally be satisfied.
After some discussion, Elder Pan finally came out and concluded, "Since everyone has the same idea, three days later, we will persuade that Lord…"
……
In a remote town in the southern part of the mainland, a man sat in the small room of a hotel, coldly drinking his sorrows away.
"Brother…" With a melodic voice, the girl lying on the shabby bed slowly woke up and suddenly began to call him.
Luo Jie hurried to his younger sister's side, sighing in relief upon seeing that she finally woke up.
Luo Fei opened her eyes and looked around, gradually coming to her senses and realizing her own situation. "Brother, are we… still on Heaven and Earth Star?"
Luo Jie nodded gravely. "That bastard! He had people control all the starship landings and takeoff points, so we have no way to escape."
"It's all my fault that Brother is trapped here…"
"What nonsense! We’re just temporarily trapped here. When your injuries heal, where can we not go?"
Luo Fei gritted her teeth as her expression also gradually became determined. After all, she was a Void Cutter Realm figure. How could she cry like a little girl?
"What about the Heavenly Palace?" After regaining her senses, Luo Fei immediately asked.
"It’s already been destroyed. That person did it personally," Luo Jie answered darkly. "They even took Xin’er.”
Luo Fei's face suddenly paled, and her body swayed.
"Brother, we must save Xin'er!" Luo Fei grabbed Luo Jie's sleeve with a jerk, her expression stiff.
Luo Jie was silent for a moment and finally said, "Then there is only one way. I've visited Heavenly Palace Island. That place hasn’t been discovered yet."
Luo Fei was dazed. Of course she knew what her older brother was talking about.
Over the years, the siblings had always attached great importance to Heaven and Earth Star. Any Void Cutter cultivator who entered their planet uninvited would automatically draw the siblings’ hostility. This was all to protect that item.
"We've been hiding for so many years; it's time to end it." Luo Fei looked solemn. "Let’s have that fellow…”
“Be our first sacrifice."

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The Woman With No Shadow
chapters.content:
When Red Tail’s report was handed to Gu Nan, the latter was trying to enter Immortal Demon World for the fifth time.
Of course the result was a failure. The repulsive force of the world still existed, but it was getting weaker every time. After waiting for a period of time, it would be possible to enter again.
"63 Dao Lords with Dao Halls on the planetary ring have been gathered. Not bad." Gu Nan nodded slightly. "If these people are obedient, that can save a lot of time."
Gu Nan really needed to take control of Heaven and Earth Star as soon as possible not only to serve as a distraction from White Mist, but also to find Luo Jie and Luo Fei as fast as possible.
Although Gu Nan was certain that he could heavily injure or even kill these two if they met again, the problem now was finding them.
After all, battles in this world weren’t as simple as showing off your fighting strength, and the loser would commit suicide. If he wanted to kill the Luo siblings, he must find them first.
Once upon a time, many people were afraid of cornering or killing Gu Nan for fear that he might escape them, then retaliate against their organizations. But now the times had changed, and it was his turn to stand in the pursuer’s position.
But Gu Nan was different from those powerful figures—he didn’t care at all about his organization’s continued survival.
Even if someone actually managed to flatten White Mist with a slap one day, he would only need to spend some extra time to set up another organization. After all, the steps related to the translation method were all in Gu Nan's mind.
"Then, I hope you guys are obedient." A cold smile hung on the corners of Gu Nan’s lips as he stepped out and appeared on the planetary ring.
Space was something that could be manipulated at will for Void Cutter cultivators.
Since the King of the Deep Sea could instantly visit Heaven and Earth Star from the Central Region, Gu Nan could naturally do the same.
……
"Here he comes." Red Tail looked at the shadow descending from the air and whispered, "Why don’t you rest? Aren’t you exhausted these days?"
Lin Yunyun shook her head. She actually liked doing work, and it would be even better if the work didn’t require her to interact with people.
"Mom, aren't you going to greet him?"
"No need. Most bigshots don't care about common courtesies like these." Red Tail just smiled.
She believed that she was quite accurate in judging people, especially Gu Nan, who had hardly ever concealed his true thoughts and was always straightforward.
He didn’t even care about much of White Mist’s authority. Of course he wouldn’t care about a trivial thing like this.
But just because he didn’t hide his thoughts didn’t mean that this person was simple and could be manipulated.
Red Tail had seen many smart people in her life, some of whom survived and some of whom died. The proportion of the latter wasn’t actually lower than that of ordinary people.
In other words, intelligence was meaningless in the face of unmatched power.
As she walked to her own private room, Red Tail silently told herself: ‘I must take care not to step out of bounds and never let my desire for power affect the amount of loyalty I reveal.’
With that in mind, she pushed the door open, but she couldn't help freezing.
Because in front of her, a woman with a blank expression was sitting quietly in her seat.
This woman was dressed in bright yellow palace clothes, and her long hair was scattered at random on both sides, but it didn’t seem messy at all. Instead, it had a somewhat strange beauty.
Red Tail’s pupils contracted slightly. She hadn’t sensed the other party’s presence at all. Even with the other party right in front of her, she still couldn’t sense anything, as if this person was just an illusion.
"You are…"
"Hello, my name is Xue Yan." The woman's voice was very soft and polite, but her tone was still blank. "I want to ask you something."
"Hello… What is it?" Red Tail smiled and said hello, then turned on the light.
The white light finally revealed what she wanted to confirm, but the result wasn’t necessarily what she wanted—this woman named Xue Yan had no shadow.
……
"He’s here."
"That Lord is here."
The Dao Lords appeared one by one in the small courtyard, looking into the air. Although they couldn’t see anything, the energy fluctuations in the sky couldn’t be hidden.
They also knew that person intentionally released this aura to notify them in advance. Otherwise, how could they sense the appearance of a Void Cutter expert in advance?
Gu Nan slowly stepped out of the void, looking exactly the same as before. He still maintained the appearance of a mortal.
However, all the Dao Lords bowed down and greeted in unison, "We greet Your Excellency."
Gu Nan just waved his hand casually. "Let's get down to business."
Elder Pan, the Mystical Heaven Dao Lord, stood at the forefront of the Dao Lords. He glanced at Gu Nan's side and was relieved when he confirmed Red Tail’s absence.
‘That Red Tail thinks she can rest easy because of her high position… In the end, she’s too relaxed.’
Cang Lian, the female Dao Lord next to him, took the lead in saying, "Since Your Excellency sent down an order, we will naturally obey it, but one matter needs to be explained first. My Lord summoned us here in a hurry, and there are 15 Daoist friends—"
"They can do whatever," Gu Nan interrupted. "I'll set up a new organization. All the Dao Halls must join under a unified rule."
"Three days later, all the Dao Halls on the planetary ring that don't belong to us will be destroyed."
After a pause, Gu Nan's indifferent eyes swept across the crowd. "Does anyone object?"
There was an oppressive silence among all the Dao Lords. Some people changed expressions while others glared, but no one made a sound.
Elder Pan lowered his eyes and his hands seemed to tremble slightly.
This was not a discussion—this was an announcement!
‘So this is a true high and mighty Void Cutter existence?’
"That’s impossible!" The Qing Shi Dao Lord was the first to object. "The Dao Hall is our foundation. If we move it so casually, won’t the title of ‘Dao Lord’ become a joke?"
His expression looked like the matter was completely non-negotiable. "Even when the two esteemed Luo siblings were here, they never proposed something like this—"
Gu Nan's cold eyes glanced at the Qing Shi Dao Lord. The next moment, dark shadows gently circled around his neck. The head of this Dao Lord level genius suddenly fell off.
Even before he advanced, Gu Nan was still able to kill Dao Lords like slaughtering dogs. Of course the current him could do it with even less effort.
"Who else objects?" Gu Nan asked calmly.
Gu Nan's words didn't seem particularly cold, but the sense of apathy revealed deep in his bones was like a basin of cold water, which kept the Dao Lords from opening their mouths.
Elder Pan glanced at the decapitated head at his feet, but his expression didn't change at all. He just asked, "We have no objection, but this old man is curious about just one thing."
"What?"
"Will the leader of the new organization perhaps be… White Mist’s Red Tail?” The Mystical Heaven Dao Lord’s aged voice was calm, and his face revealed nothing.
But from the expressions of the people behind him, it wasn’t hard to tell that this question was the crucial question they wanted to ask.
It was nothing shameful to attach themselves to a Void Cutter Realm powerhouse. Rather, it would be stupid to oppose such a figure.
The only thing the Dao Lords didn’t want to see was for Red Tail to be an intermediary, so that this one’s intention couldn’t be directly conveyed to them.
"Of course… not." Gu Nan explained casually, "The leader of the new organization will be my apostle."

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Heaven and Earth Star Standing Committee
chapters.content:
"Qing Shi died in vain," Cang Lian remarked with a small sigh from inside the courtyard.
She and the Qing Shi Dao Lord could be considered acquaintances, but she never imagined that he would be killed over just one sentence.
Gu Nan had already left. They, the Dao Lords, also gradually dispersed, but many of them still gathered together to discuss the situation regarding the “post-Luo siblings era.”
Or rather, Heaven and Earth Star was truly about to become a world ruled by Gu Nan—that one’s background was naturally known to all, including his real name.
"Qing Shi’s temper has always been like this." Another Dao Lord also sighed. "He’s always been an advocate of ‘seeking peace through struggle
[1]
,’ but nobody expected for him to meet someone he can’t fight against this time.”
The Cang Lian Dao Lord nodded slightly. Seeking peace through struggle—everyone knew this logic, but in many cases, logic wasn’t useful.
‘It's just like how everyone was saying “our centuries-old organizations can’t be casually moved” before that one descended, but Qing Shi was the only one who spoke up in the end. Not even Elder Pan objected…’
She couldn't help glancing at Elder Pan. This Mystical Heaven Dao Lord was laughing and conversing with several people. He didn’t look like a friend had just died at all.
‘The position of liaison between us and that one naturally can’t fall into Red Tail’s hands, so who should that position be given to?’
‘The venerable and prestigious Elder Pan?’ A light smile hung on the corners of Cang Lian’s lips as she looked down at her charming and feminine body.
Out of all the suitable candidates, she was the only woman.
……
Red Tail felt her whole consciousness blurring, all the way until that woman left. Such a state was extremely unusual at her cultivation level.
She walked out of the door again. The cold moonlight hit her face, finally clearing her mind a little.
‘Is it an ability that affects the mind? I can't even remember what she asked…’
A bitter smile appeared on Red Tail's face. ‘Looks like I’ve attracted another powerful figure’s attention.’
‘What's her name again? Xue Yàn? Xue Yān?’ Red Tail found herself unable to remember the mysterious woman’s name, and even the woman’s appearance was quickly blurring.
She tried to write down some useful information in advance but discovered that her memories started dissipating even faster.
When the tip of the pen landed on the paper, her mind had gone blank.
The only thing she could remember was the sight that gave her chills—that woman had no shadow.
……
Three days later, the Dao Lords relocated all their Dao Halls to the continent in accordance with Gu Nan's order.
As for the rest of the Dao Halls on the planetary ring that either didn’t receive the order or didn’t have Dao Lords present, Gu Nan also kept his word and wiped them all out without fail.
Right now, only White Mist remained on the planetary ring, and the size of its territory had also shrunk.
Gu Nan took great pains to hide White Mist. Be it on the mainland or the planetary ring, enemies would inevitably search every inch of territory if they wanted to find White Mist.
But if the planetary ring looked desolate and empty, nobody would think to search there. This was a psychological blind spot.
When the generation who knows about Dao Halls on the planetary ring dies out, this secret can then be kept for a long time.
Lan Si also happened to come out of secluded cultivation on the same day, but this was just a coincidence. Not even Gu Nan anticipated that.
"So, you need me to take over an organization again?" She asked Gu Nan in a strange tone, but her expression was indeed much calmer than before.
She seemed to have matured greatly after suffering heavy injuries from a scheme and after working on her own.
Humans always needed to grow up slowly—with the exception of people like Gu Nan.
"Yup, this time it's an organization that will control the whole continent," Gu Nan answered with a smile.
Lan Si pursed her lips, anxious about whether she could succeed. "Why don’t you help me name it? The last name can’t be used anymore.”
Lan Si had previously established a small organization on the mainland called Blue Lake. Of course, this organization was dissolved as soon as she entered secluded cultivation.
Gu Nan had never been talented at naming things, so he casually said, "Heaven and Earth Star Standing Committee, or Heaven and Earth Committee for short."
"Then what’s my position?" Lan Si asked with wide eyes.
"Chairman."
……
Everything was progressing methodically without any chaos—after all, with Gu Nan's absolute strength as backing, whoever caused chaos was killed.
Per Gu Nan's bad taste, "Heaven and Earth Committee" was formally established and began to take over the administration and management of the entire Heaven and Earth Star. Lan Si became the chairman, while Red Tail was one of three vice chairmen.
As for the interstellar federation, it basically existed in name only, and even its officials had to accept orders from the Committee.
Of course, the fact that the federation’s forces were powerless here actually had little to do with Gu Nan. As early as the "Luo siblings era,” because of that pair’s exclusionary policies, it was already difficult for the federation to intervene in Heaven and Earth Star’s affairs.
Speaking of the Luo siblings, this gave Gu Nan some headache.
As time went by, the two seemed to have vanished from the face of the planet, never appearing again.
However, Gu Nan had already arranged shadow clones to watch over places they might visit or people they might care about. He would know immediately if they made any moves.
"Let’s not consider too much for the time being. There’s nothing I can do if these two are determined to hide. Leveling up is the most important thing."
With Lan Si’s continuous cultivation, Gu Nan's Evil Value had already reached 530. In contrast, he only had 300 points, which was only 200 points more than before.
Personal dungeons’ subsequent clear rewards would be greatly reduced after the first clear. Gu Nan had long known this fact.
However, to his surprise, after they cleared the Splendid World dungeon, opening it again didn’t take him to the Myriad Heavens Starry Road anymore, but to a separate small dimension.
Even Zuo Zuo and the other two had disappeared, and it became a solo dungeon, although the difficulty was still the same as before.
"Is it because the world’s origin has already been consumed, so Splendid World can’t enter the Myriad Heavens Starry Road again?" Gu Nan couldn't help recalling Zi Yi and Qiu Wenran’s explanation.
The Star Rulers’ explanation may not be correct, but their observation of the phenomenon wouldn’t be wrong—after all, the latter was the conclusion from many tests.
However, Gu Nan didn’t mind clearing it solo. Although the reward was pitiful, it was nevertheless a fixed income source. In addition, he also had people in White Mist complete more world missions as soon as possible.
He’ll have more test subjects when the next personal dungeon appears.
On the other hand, he never stopped exploring the laws of Immortal Demon World, but there still wasn’t much progress. This was a long-term project.
To facilitate his experiments, Gu Nan also arranged for some White Mist members to travel to Immortal Demon World to inquire about the local situation.
If necessary, Gu Nan didn’t mind returning to Ruby Fish Star to take control of the Gu family.
On this day, somewhere on the mainland of Heaven and Earth Star, Gu Nan was lying on the beach basking in the sun and waiting for his subordinates’ reports with boredom when Red Tail suddenly appeared behind him.
"My Lord, the envoys from Starry Ocean Pavilion are here," the first thing she said was enough to shock many people.
But Gu Nan just opened his eyes slightly and wondered, "What did they come here for?"
Red Tail's smile suddenly felt a little strained. "Of course it’s to… present you with a seal."
T/N:
[1] Seeking peace through struggle:
original sentence by Mao Zedong is “We love peace, but peace can only be obtained through struggle and will be lost if we compromise” (very rough translation). He means only the strong will be respected, so peace can only be won through war. In contrast, continuous compromise will not lead to peace

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Imagination Grandmaster Gu Nan
chapters.content:
Every Void Cutter existence was considered a true powerhouse. They were extremely difficult to kill, and they also had the ability to cut through the void and run away. Not even Star Rulers could restrict their travel.
Therefore, as the official organization of Star Realm in a certain sense, Starry Ocean Pavilion never spared any effort to show its respect for Void Cutter Realm cultivators.
Based on factors like one’s comprehensive strength and the organization they belonged to, Starry Ocean Pavilion would give seals of various ranks to Void Cutter cultivators—Meteor Rank, Planet Rank, and Star Rank.
Gu Nan was disdainful of this kind of rank division because such a division could no longer correspond to the power system in his Evil God Game.
In the game, there was no more content to show starting from Tier 4. Thus, players needed to integrate their previous gameplay and start to build their own laws.
Of course, there was still no shortage of Evil Value requirements.
Players could build an exclusive law at each of the 500, 1,000, and 1,500 critical Evil Value thresholds.
Among them, the exclusive law at the 500 Evil Value threshold was the core skill arcana, which allowed the player to advance to Tier 4. In contrast, the other two Evil Value thresholds required the player to extract and construct the laws themselves.
The number of points that needed to be spent here was naturally an astronomical figure.
Gu Nan didn’t know whether Void Cutter Realm cultivators here also had multiple exclusive laws, but in sum, they couldn’t simply be ranked purely by strength.
For example, the King of the Deep Sea who was critically wounded by Gu Nan’s single strike was a Planet Rank Void Cutter expert, yet he couldn’t even beat the Gu Nan who just advanced seconds ago.
"Planet Rank seal?" Gu Nan toyed with the seal shaped like a badge and smiled thoughtfully.
"Mr. Gu Nan could defeat the King of the Deep Sea, so you naturally have the right to possess it," Starry Ocean Pavilion’s envoy replied calmly, but her face didn’t have any expression at all, looking quite vacant.
Gu Nan's gaze swept past this girl, and he smiled. "It's indeed generous of Starry Ocean Pavilion to send two Void Cutter cultivators as envoys… What's your name?"
"Xue Yan."
The girl's eyes shifted to Gu Nan's face. Her expression couldn’t even be described as vacant anymore; it was simply lifeless.
If Gu Nan’s own laws didn’t clearly tell him that a Tier 4 expert was standing in front of him, he’d much more likely believe that this was a girl with dementia.
But the other envoy looked much more reliable.
This person was dressed in all black, standing beside Xue Yan but never speaking up; he just kept sizing Gu Nan up.
He looked like a young man, and his actual age wasn’t old either. He was just over 200 years old this year, which was considered very young by Void Cutter standards.
This person named Zhou Xiaojing was a direct descendant of a powerful figure in Starry Ocean Pavilion. He was a very famous cultivator, even in the Central Region.
Red Tail stood behind Gu Nan, her eyebrows furrowed into a knot as she stared at this girl envoy from Starry Ocean Pavilion.
The person in front of her felt vaguely familiar, as if she’d seen this girl a certain night in the past, but her memories were very fuzzy.
Red Tail couldn’t be sure that this girl was the same mysterious girl she met before. She realized that her memories had been tampered with, so it might have been another person’s ploy to make her believe they were the same person.
And… She looked behind Xue Yan, where there was clearly an elongated shadow.
‘So she has a shadow…’
Red Tail was even less confident about her own judgment.
"According to the rules, Starry Ocean Pavilion hopes that you can pay a visit to the Central Region," Xue Yan said expressionlessly, as if going through a mere formality.
"I’ll go when I have time," Gu Nan casually replied.
There were a pile of matters he had to attend to right now. Immortal Demon World, personal dungeons, the Luo siblings… Every matter would take up a large amount of his time. How could he have any free time to visit the Central Region?
Especially since right before Zuo Zuo left, he specifically told Gu Nan to visit the Central Region, so Gu Nan was even more reluctant to go.
‘Who knows what's waiting for me over there?’
Gu Nan wasn’t interested in the Star Rulers’ secrets; he just wanted to level up in peace.
Faced with Gu Nan's answer, Xue Yan still just nodded woodenly.
Zhou Xiaojing, however, surprised everyone by suddenly saying, “Those who don't visit the Central Region will not be a Void Cutter cultivator recognized by Starry Ocean Pavilion. Your Excellency should consider it carefully."
Gu Nan didn't even look at him. He just looked at Xue Yan and asked, "Anything else?"
"Nothing else." Xue Yan shook her head, then turned and walked away.
Zhou Xiao was stunned, but he finally couldn't hold back anymore. He said loudly, "Miss Xue, all Void Cutter cultivators have to visit Starry Ocean Pavilion before they can be officially granted seals. This is the Pavilion’s rule."
Xue Yan looked back. Her expression was still empty, but her eyes seemed to be a little confused.
"Is that so? Then what do you guys usually do if he doesn’t go." The interrogative sentence was uttered by Xue Yan without any inflection, making it seem more like a statement than a question.
Gu Nan looked at these two with some amusement. This Miss Xue Yan really was rather honest and frank. Wasn’t she making it obvious that she was someone who stepped into this matter at the very last minute?
Zhou Xiaojing felt so angry that his mind was frazzled. ‘How can the headquarters send such a person and even tell me to assist her in handling this matter?’
However, at least he was a professional. He quickly adjusted his mood and looked at Gu Nan gravely. "Mr. Gu Nan, all Void Cutter cultivators must be registered by Starry Ocean Pavilion, or else they’ll be regarded as foreign cultivators."
"If you insist on not going, then we can only invite you by force." Zhou Xiaojing looked prideful, there wasn’t much emotion in his heart.
He was merely trying to gain the upper hand through a show of strength. He would first make an excessive demand, then conveniently concede once the other side became angry at this demand they couldn’t possibly accept. This was a strategy where he would advance first and then back down slightly.
This wasn’t the first time Zhou Xiaojing had done such a thing. He knew that the arrogance of these Void Cutter experts must be worn down, otherwise it would be difficult for Starry Ocean Pavilion to handle matters.
Gu Nan looked at him, then lowered his head and considered for a moment. Finally… he drew his sword and chopped downwards.
The pitch-black longsword was drawn out of the void, and before anyone could react, it swung down directly on Zhou Xiaojing.
"Have you gone crazy!?” Zhou Xiaojing’s expression immediately changed. His figure flashed, and he was swept aside, all of a sudden pulling 10 meters away from the sword and managing to avoid Gu Nan's strike.
But he still had some lingering fear and shouted at Gu Nan, "Gu Nan, do you really want to make an enemy out of our Starry Ocean Pavilion?"
Gu Nan stood where he was, holding the sword in his hand as he said expressionlessly, “I imagined the future for a bit just now. We’ll probably still end up fighting, so let’s not waste any words."
Zhou Xiaojing almost coughed up a mouthful of blood in anger.
‘Do you understand the concept of advancing first and retreating later?’
‘Do you understand the concept of asking for a sky-high price at first and then lowering the price?’
‘You flipped the table before we even started negotiating—who plays the cards like you?!’
The corner of his lips twitched twice, and he finally flung his sleeve angrily. "You two lunatics can talk it out; do whatever you want!"
After throwing that sentence out, he turned and walked away without any hesitation—he just came to help Starry Ocean Pavilion send a message. Whether Gu Nan ultimately went or not had nothing to do with him, so he didn’t need to risk his life over this matter.
Gu Nan saw him leave but didn't put away his sword. Instead, he looked at Xue Yan.
Xue Yan nodded slightly. "Then, I will also be taking my leave."
She turned away for the second time, but when she was about to leave Gu Nan's sight, she turned around again. Gu Nan didn’t know if he was mistaken, but there was actually a slight smile in her eyes.
"I'm looking forward to your visit to the Central Region, possessor of the law of shadows.”

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Manipulating Destiny
chapters.content:
The two envoys of Starry Ocean Pavilion came and left quickly, only leaving Gu Nan with a seal.
"It doesn’t look like anything special." Gu Nan tossed this badge up and down a few times. It was engraved with some strange patterns, but there was no energy fluctuation from it at all.
Red Tail said from beside him, "It’s said that after Starry Ocean Pavilion activates the seal, it will have some wondrous functions like ultra-long distance communication."
"Oh. Then why didn't that person say so earlier? Really now," Gu Nan casually complained.
Red Tail's expression darkened slightly. ‘He originally planned to reveal that later as a bargaining chip, but who imagined that you’d just hack at him out of the blue…’
But she only dared to say this in her head.
Gu Nan played with the seal for a while and felt it was boring, so he put it away again.
"Are there any progress on recent matters?" Gu Nan asked again.
He was currently using Red Tail as a secretary. The matters he cared about had all been given to her to sort out before showing them to him, while Lan Si was his general representative for the Dao Lords below.
In the future, this part of the work might be done by Lan Si instead, but right now this "Chairman Lan" was already too busy dealing with her own affairs.
"There’s still no news regarding those two. I’ve already sent more people to keep an eye out on the ruins of the Heavenly Palace and on Luo Xin.”
What the Luo siblings would care about was nothing more than the Heavenly Palace and their daughter—Red Tail knew this without Gu Nan having to say anything.
"Regarding Immortal Demon World, our people are already starting to settle in and have already learned of the overall situation in that world," Red Tail reported as she handed a document to Gu Nan.
One or two sentences wouldn’t clearly convey the overall situation of a plane; only written documents could do it.
There were roughly three major forces vying for supremacy in today's Immortal Demon World.
There were the native forces located in the western part of the continent. Ever since the flames of war ignited two years ago, Azure Dragon Hall’s flag was once again raised high in order to resist the invaders.
In the east, one country and one sect were the two strongest powers, working together to oppose the powerful enemy in the west.
"The Gu family is probably supporting that country. As for this sect that rose inexplicably…" Gu Nan rubbed his chin. "If other reincarnators hadn't discovered this plane yet, then the Lu family likely stepped in to support that sect."
When Gu Nan was in Heavenly Enterprise Star, he didn’t deliberately hide the existence of Immortal Demon World and instead handed the monitoring task directly to Lu Zhanyu.
