However, the people and resources in Immortal Demon World no longer held much value for the current Gu Nan. He now had plenty of personal dungeons, so he had no shortage of materials with which to establish his Divine Kingdom.
Rather, he was fascinated by the strange half-soul exchange setting of the world’s origin.
"Have you ever seen anything like this plane’s ‘half-life' mode before?"
Red Tail shook her head. "This is the first time White Mist has seen such a plane… By the way, My Lord, we also discovered that the power of destiny is particularly active in Immortal Demon World."
"The power of destiny is active?" Gu Nan frowned slightly and asked, "What does this mean?"
"It means that this place is an exceptional harvesting ground for the force of destiny." Excitement appeared in Red Tail’s eyes.
……
Inside Immortal Demon World.
A young girl dressed in simple yet noble clothes slowly walked into the Great Yan Dynasty’s inner palace. The ruler of the Yan Dynasty, who was originally sitting high above everyone else, jumped up from the throne immediately.
King Yan quickly ran to the girl's side and smiled ingratiatingly. "Eldest Miss…"
However, the girl just waved her hand and casually said, "I can't stay here for long, so hurry up if you have something to say."
This girl was precisely Gu Nian, someone whom Gu Nan hadn’t seen for a long time. The current her was already a Prodigious Realm Infinitesimal Stage cultivator, so it was hard for her to reincarnate and stay in a plane for too long. This was also the reincarnators’ greatest weakness.
In fact, neither the country nor the sect on the east lacked high-end battle power, but there were too few native experts.
A force composed entirely of reincarnators was fine if used as a sharp blade as the vanguard, but to have only reincarnators support a prolonged war was much less likely.
Fortunately, Immortal Demon World was rich in resources. Even if they didn’t unify the world, they still wouldn’t make a loss from reincarnating here. Otherwise, the Gu family would’ve lost the ability to maintain their current stronghold a long time ago.
King Yan didn’t dare to complain when he saw Gu Nian’s expression and hurriedly replied, "It’s actually not very serious. It’s just that recently, some talented geniuses have appeared inside this country…"
"Isn’t that a good thing?" Gu Nian raised her eyebrows.
"Yes… but these genius youths all used to be good-for-nothings who then counterattacked." King Yan lowered his voice, “And it’s rumored that there are also many such cases in the west and inside Celestial Fortune Sect too."
Gu Nian's brows wrinkled. Genius youths were quite normal, and good-for-nothings counterattacking also wasn’t surprising, but a lot of these people suddenly appearing all over the world wasn’t normal.
"Give me all of these people's information." She ordered, but her expression looked a little dark.
"Is it a mutation inside the plane, or is some mastermind manipulating everything from behind the scenes?" Looking up at the sky, Gu Nian felt the rare sensation of not knowing what course to take.
……
The same scene happened in two other places in Immortal Demon World. It’s just that the protagonists became Yan Xiaoxiao and Lu Zhanyu.
Gu Nan guessed one thing wrong. It wasn’t the Lu family that actually got involved in Immortal Demon World, but Lu Zhanyu alone.
In this short period of time, she had already stepped into Prodigious Realm, and even her stage had caught up to Gu Nian—she was also at Infinitesimal Stage right now.
However, considering the qualities of her veteran reincarnator status, it wasn’t surprising that she could achieve this much—after all, reincarnators had the ability to exploit loopholes in the law of time.
"There's nothing strange about it," she said coldly to Celestial Fortune Sect’s Sect Master, an elder she selected herself. "It’s nothing more than some mischief caused by destiny."
"Order everyone to postpone all plans for the time being." Lu Zhanyu's face turned even colder. "It’ll be fine if this is a mutation originating from this plane, but if it's man-made… I'm afraid this plane has caught a powerful figure’s attention."
On the other hand, in the western part of the continent, Yan Xiaoxiao now had a more dignified temperament after fighting for many years, which gave people great pressure when talking to her.
Sitting on the throne of Azure Dragon Hall, she didn't have much reaction to the good-for-nothings’ counterattacks.
Yan Xiaoxiao didn’t understand destiny, nor did she understand anything about plane mutations. She simply didn’t care.
"A higher number of talented disciples will naturally be better for us. " She told her subordinates, "As long as they’re willing, they can take Azure Dragon Hall’s exam as soon as possible. We will not refuse anyone."
"Yes, Hall Master."
Hundreds of people beneath the throne bowed simultaneously in response to her order. This was the might of the number one Azure Dragon Hall.
Just as the three sides were reacting differently to the appearance of children of destiny, a figure was quietly standing on top of Immortal Demon World, overlooking all this.
Her expression looked wooden, and the expression on her face seemed to remain unchanged for thousands of years.
"A strange world." She murmured to herself, "Exchange half of the reincarnator’s soul? It’s indeed similar to that one’s half and half body. So then, what exactly do you want to do, Gu Nan?"
She looked up, as if she could see a mysterious smile on Gu Nan’s face in the endless sky.
The sunlight fell on her just like passing through the air. There was no shadow on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Scheme
chapters.content:
Gu Nan didn’t yet know that someone had already realized the connection between the strange phenomenon in Immortal Demon World and Zuo Zuo, whose two halves were different.
But even if he knew, he still wouldn't care. He never cared about what others thought.
Returning from Immortal Demon World again, Gu Nan was expelled by the power of the world, but he also learned more and more about the whole process of the half-soul exchange.
There weren’t many opportunities for Gu Nan to truly observe a world’s origin, because the Evil God Temple converted most of the world’s origin he received into materials he needed.
This led to the relatively slower progress when Gu Nan needed to understand the inner workings himself.
Fortunately, he had no shortage of time for the time being.
Meanwhile, White Mist immediately mobilized and began to invest a large amount of manpower into Immortal Demon World when the abundant force of destiny was discovered there.
So in a very short time, a large number of children of destiny were born, which greatly accelerated change in the general trend of that world.
Gu Nan didn’t pay much attention to this. For the time being, the natives of Immortal Demon World had nothing of value to him.
……
Both White Mist and the Heaven and Earth Committee stationed a considerable number of people at the ruins of Heavenly Palace Island to monitor possible movements.
Even Gu Nan stationed a shadow doppelganger here, lurking quietly.
But no matter how many people they stationed, they still couldn’t find any trace of the Luo siblings—because these two were currently three kilometers underground.
No matter how strong their detection methods, they were unlikely to detect enemies this far belowground, especially when the targets were two Void Cutter cultivators.
Luo Jie slowly walked into the dark underground passage while his younger sister Luo Fei was floating in the air, her entire body glowing faint white. She still had a ghastly wound.
Even now, the injury Gu Nan gave her still showed no signs of recovery.
This was the power of shadows superimposed tens of times, so the residual ultra-high concentration law of shadows completely suppressed the power of Luo Fei's own law.
In front of Luo Fei was an enormous silver crystal. There seemed to be an invisible bond between the crystal and Luo Fei, continuously transmitting power to Luo Fei.
With the continuous transmission of power, Luo Fei's aura became stronger and stronger, but her face was full of pain, and she couldn’t help giving some pained grunts.
Even a mighty Void Cutter Realm cultivator found this pain unbearable; the amount of pain was inconceivable.
Luo Jie’s eyes couldn’t help flashing with unbearable pain when he looked at his sister's slightly trembling body.
They discovered this secret stash many years ago but had always been afraid of using it impulsively precisely because of the high cost and the considerable risks.
‘This time, if not for Xin’er…’ Luo Jie remembered the fellow who hurt his younger sister and destroyed the Heavenly Palace, and his expression gradually became ferocious.
At that moment, Luo Fei suddenly stopped glowing and fell down.
Luo Jie quickly stepped forward to help his younger sister.
Luo Fei slowly opened her eyes and said weakly, "Brother, one more day… and I’ll be able to leave this place."
"But your body…" Luo Jie looked down at the sister in his arms. Her entire right hand was swollen with water.
This wasn’t some kind of illness. Rather, it was caused by the power of the crystal entering Luo Fei's body that couldn’t be completely absorbed.
Although this kind of power was formidable, it wasn’t something the human body could absorb at all. If this wasn’t the case, then they wouldn’t have made it their very last resort.
"No matter." Luo Fei's face appeared somewhat harsh. "Even the most basic level of control over this power will be enough to kill that person!"
Luo Jie was silent for a while. He knew that all the suffering his sister endured these days naturally had to be counted on Gu Nan's head.
"But we have to rescue Xin’er first." Ultimately, Luo Fei didn't completely lose her mind. She still remembered her daughter.
"Of course." Luo Jie finally smiled. "I've found a way to lure the tiger away from his territory."
……
Under Gu Nan's intentional guidance, even part of White Mist moved off of the planetary ring.
Today's White Mist was divided into two parts. Only a few departments related to reincarnation remain on the planetary ring while the rest had all moved to the mainland.
Gu Nan usually lived in White Mist’s station on the mainland.
On this day, everything seemed to be progressing as usual, but Gu Nan recently paid attention to one more thing—unifying Heaven and Earth Star’s continent.
Unification couldn’t be done in a single day. Even if Gu Nan had an absolute power advantage, Lan Si and her people would still encounter all kinds of trouble.
It was still alright if enemies resisted by force—they could simply suppress them. But it was a different matter if there were people who pretended to agree but never had any intention of obeying or people who took advantage of Lan Si to purge their own enemies.
No matter how much power and prestige a leader had, the subordinates would still have their own countermeasures, eventually making it so that the leader couldn’t even say anything.
Lan Si was very troubled by this recently. After all, she seldom encountered this kind of practical problem and had to ask Gu Nan for help from time to time.
Gu Nan was even less likely to understand these things. In the end, his response was always the same sentence: "Play around however you want. Even if you poke a hole in the sky, I can still mend it."
……
"Looks like that Miss Lan is indeed an inexperienced fledgling."
"Right? I thought that person’s dispatched representative would be a shrewd figure, but who would’ve thought…"
"Maybe she’s acting? Heheh, she might just be waiting to catch us red-handed when we start behaving unscrupulously!"
"Ha…"
Such remarks could be heard everywhere within the Heaven and Earth Committee. The Cang Lan Dao Lord couldn’t help but give a small cough when she heard these people talking again.
Those people were startled. When they looked back and saw someone coming, they hurriedly saluted. "We greet Lord Cang Lian."
"Mm." The Cang Lian Dao Lord nodded slightly, then added, "Don't talk about nonsense. You can all leave… Du Chuan, you stay."
The group exchanged glances with each other. They were afraid to say anything else and left one after another, leaving only a man named Du Chuan.
Du Chuan made sure there was no one else around before he whispered, "My Lord, rumors about Miss Lan are spreading everywhere right now. Even Elder Pan’s people are moving… It's time to act."
The Cang Lian Dao Lord gently flicked the tip of her hair and asked indifferently, "Are you sure the Tang family is connected to Lan Si?"
"Miss Lan once suffered grievous injuries and was saved by the Tang family." Du Chuan said seriously, "As long as we can trick the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall into seizing the Tang family’s property, Miss Lan certainly will not sit idly by…"
"Good." Cang Lian nodded and waved her hand. "Let's do that then."
After saying that, Cang Lian quickly walked away. She seemed reluctant for someone else to see her conversation with Du Chuan.
What she didn't see was that just after she walked away, Du Chuan turned and walked towards the opposite direction with a strange smile on his face.
As Du Chuan walked away step by step, cold sweat broke out. He had never tried to deceive a Dao Lord like this before.
‘In the end, I… didn’t bring disgrace to my mission, Lord Luo.’ He whispered in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Exhausting All Schemes
chapters.content:
Many seemingly complicated schemes weren’t actually all that complicated once the schemer’s goal became known.
And everyone had their own goals in that scheme. For example, Cang Lian’s goal was very simple—to be promoted to a higher ranking position.
Since Gu Nan's existence was already inevitable, it would be best if she was the highest-ranking subordinate under Gu Nan, becoming his direct representative.
In Cang Lian’s eyes, that Lord had obviously abandoned Red Tail or appointed her to be in charge of other affairs, while things on the mainland were left to Lan Si.
“Lan Si, who can’t compare to me at all in beauty, ability, or strength.”
"All she has is that one’s trust." A slight sneer appeared on Cang Lian’s face.
As long as she wore away at that one’s trust in Lan Si, she believed that with her own ability, she could completely replace Lan Si's position— ‘There’s nothing Lan Si can do that I can’t do.’
……
"Miss Lan, Miss Lan! There’s trouble…" A servant came in quickly from the door and said anxiously to Lan Si.
"What's the matter this time?!” Lan Si turned her head impatiently. She had to deal with all kinds of matters all day long, so her entire person was in an irritable state.
"It's the Tang family…" The servant finally got the chance to breathe. "There was a fight between the Tang family and the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall. It’s said that some people died. Even Elder Pan is there now!"
"What did you say?" Lan Si immediately stood up.
If she had to name people on this continent she still cared about—apart from Gu Nan—then they must be the Tang family and Tang Xuan.
Setting aside her many interactions with Tang Xuan, the Tang family helped her back when she was running Blue Lake, so she remembered this favor.
"What exactly is going on?" After gaining some experience these days, Lan Si could be considered a fledgling leader now, and she wasn’t as impulsive as before.
The servant hurriedly explained.
The whole story was also very simple. It was nothing more than people from the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall coming over to annex several of the Tang family’s resource locations on behalf of their Dao Hall. As a result, the two sides clashed.
Similar things had occurred countless times in the past few days. Usually, whichever family that refused to accept this would be directly suppressed… But this was the Tang family!
"Didn't I say that no one is allowed to touch the Tang family? How could this still happen?" Lan Si had a dark expression as she asked coldly.
Cold sweat broke out on the servant’s face, and Lan Si waved impatiently. "Forget it. Prepare the starship to the Tang family."
……
The scene had already been cleaned up when Lan Si hurriedly reached the Tang family, but her mood wasn’t so good because the dead bodies hadn’t been taken away yet.
One of the corpses was Elder Pan’s third disciple—Lan Si knew the matter would be difficult to resolve as soon as she heard this.
In the end, Lan Si wasn’t an apathetic character like Gu Nan, who wouldn’t even care about his own relatives. During this time, Elder Pan helped her greatly and also pointed out many of her mistakes.
So she held some respect and even fear for this elder who was her subordinate.
"Miss Lan." Seeing Lan Si’s arrival, Elder Pan took the initiative to stand up and salute. He didn't have much expression on his face, but the sadness in his eyes couldn’t be concealed.
Lan Si had never encountered such a situation before and could only say with a parched throat, "Elder Pan, I'm sorry for your loss…"
Cang Lian silently rolled her eyes from behind Elder Pan, thinking in her heart that this one was a little too inexperienced. ‘What kind of leader lowers her attitude at the very beginning?’
‘With an attitude like that, how will she speak on behalf of the Tang family?’
Things would be difficult if Lan Si continued to have a soft attitude.
So Cang Lian said, "Miss Lan, you've come just in time. This Tang family is so bold that they even dared to kill Elder Pan’s disciple. In my opinion, it’s better to destroy this whole family."
"How can that be?!” Lan Si immediately exclaimed.
At that moment, she heard a low cry from her side, "You’re… Lan Si?”
Lan Si turned to look, only to find Tang Xuan’s whole face covered in blood. Her four limbs were pierced through by sharp weapons, so she could only hang her head down.
"S-Sister Tang Xuan?!” Lan Si stared at the other side in disbelief, and even her voice was trembling.
The next moment, she flew to Tang Xuan's side, but a disciple of the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall next to her stopped her, "Miss Lan, this is the person who killed my Third Senior Brother. Please—"
"Get lost!" The furious Lan Si couldn't think at all. Terrifying divine power poured out instantly, and a brilliant blue radiance almost drowned the disciple.
Elder Pan’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, but he took a step forward and pulled his disciple out so that he wouldn't get hurt by Lan Si, who’d lost control of her emotions.
‘She’s not too weak.’ Cang Lian evaluated Lan Si’s power from the sidelines with great interest. Lan Si’s furious attack really did contain a bit of ferocity.
"Sister Tang Xuan, how… how are you?" The flustered Lan Si could only think of stopping Tang Xuan’s bleeding while asking.
Tang Xuan, whose face was still pale as ash, said with a wry smile, "It’s only right and proper to pay with my life for killing someone. I only hope you can persuade that Lord to leave my Tang family a way out."
Tang Xuan knew better than Lan Si what kind of figure the Mystical Heaven Dao Lord was.
In her opinion, her life was doomed the moment she killed the other party’s third disciple. Although she survived, she would have to pay the price with her life. ‘Even if Lan Si is backed by Gu Nan, will he be willing to offend a top Dao Lord just for me?’
But Lan Si said firmly, "No, I won't let you die!"
Before Tang Xuan could speak, the disciples of the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall over there became emotional, and one of them said, "Miss Lan, are you going to protect the murderer?"
"It turns out that they have a relationship with Miss Lan. No wonder this Tang family is so arrogant!"
"Ha, so what? The person who killed someone from our Mystical Heaven Dao Hall will naturally die. Even if we litigate this in court, our side will still be in the right."
Unabashed discussion could be heard, making Lan Si’s face turn green and white alternately.
"Everyone, shut up!" Elder Pan, however, frowned and shouted deeply. His disciple's excessive disrespect for Lan Si gave him some ominous premonitions.
But he also didn't think about retreating either. Firstly, he couldn’t chill the hearts of all his disciples. And secondly, Lan Si's recent performance really couldn't make him respect her.
After warning off his disciples, he cupped his hands at Lan Si. "Miss Lan, this person took my disciple's life. If you want to protect this person, please give an explanation to this old man."
Lan Si froze when she heard that. What kind of explanation could she give?
Tang Xuan was someone she must protect, but Elder Pan didn’t seem to have any intentions of giving in either…
So she hesitated for a moment, then finally couldn't help taking out a black dagger and began to call for its owner.
The next moment, a dark shadow gradually materialized from the dagger, forming a human figure.
‘Yes! That's it!’ The Cang Lian Dao Lord couldn’t help feeling happy when she saw this scene.
‘Faced with this kind of situation, Lan Si will almost certainly have to ask that one for help. But even if it’s that one, what can he do in this dilemma?’
At best, he’d just appease one party by virtue of his prestige, which would inevitably lead to dissatisfaction on the other side.
To put it another way, no matter how it ended, this matter obviously wouldn’t give that one a good impression, and Lan Si would seem more and more incompetent in his eyes…
Moreover, after some thought, Cang Lian knew that she would certainly take Elder Pan’s side if she was in Lan Si’s position. After all, one side was a top Dao Lord, while the other was just an unknown small family.
If that one wanted to control the mainland, then he must take people's hearts into consideration.
The Mystical Heaven Dao Hall had been doing its utmost to carry out his orders. If it couldn’t receive a good result after all that hard work, wouldn't it chill everyone's hearts?
The more she thought about this, the more certain Cang Lian was of that one’s actions, and even the corners of her mouth couldn’t help lifting up. Fortunately, she quickly hid her smile.
The shadow slowly materialized from the dagger and condensed into Gu Nan's figure. He coldly looked at the people around him.
Elder Pan was the first to bow down and say, "My young disciple died unjustly. My Lord, please give my Mystical Heaven Dao Hall justice."
And at this time, from behind Elder Pan, Du Chuan silently crushed the talisman tightly gripped in his hands all this time.
Two figures suddenly appeared in White Mist’s headquarters on the mainland. They were precisely Luo Jie and Luo Fei.
Luo Jie looked excited right now.
"That person has gone to the Tang family. Let’s save Xin'er right away!"

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Total Annihilation
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan appeared in the Tang family, it was right when both sides had their swords drawn and the atmosphere was the heaviest.
"My young disciple died unjustly. My Lord, please give my Mystical Heaven Dao Hall justice," Elder Pan spoke first while bowing, not giving Lan Si a chance to speak at all and setting the tone for this matter.
As his voice fell, all of Mystical Heaven Dao Hall’s disciples behind him also spoke in unison, "My Lord, please give my Mystical Heaven Dao Hall justice!"
There were nearly a hundred disciples of the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall present, and they were all elites. After all, Elder Pan’s core disciple had been killed, so any disciple with a little status would be present.
Tang Xuan felt a bitter pain when she saw this. The Mystical Heaven Dao Hall had too deep of a foundation. Even setting aside Elder Pan himself, their Dao Hall was still too strong for people to overlook.
The Cang Lian Dao Lord lowered her head slightly and subtly took a step back.
She knew better than anyone else why the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall was so powerful. Elder Pan's hundreds of years of teaching and accumulation had made the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall into an extremely cohesive Dao Hall.
To take the simplest example, one of Elder Pan’s disciples who had also reached the Dao Lord level was still part of the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall even now!
He was undoubtedly already strong enough to open his own Dao Hall, yet he was willing to stay by his teacher’s side. This was enough to illustrate the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall’s power.
‘Even if you’re a Void Cutter powerful figure, faced with such a strong Mystical Heaven Dao Hall, won’t you still need to consider people's hearts? You can’t do whatever you want now, right?’
However, Gu Nan didn't even look at them. He turned to Lan Si. "What's the matter?"
Lan Si took a deep breath, her heart settling down a little. Since Gu Nan was willing to listen to her side of the story, there was at least room to redeem this situation.
"Sister Tang Xuan accidentally killed Elder Pan's third disciple—" She knew that she didn't have many opportunities to speak, so she tried to explain concisely.
"It wasn’t an accident!" A powerful and resonating voice leisurely took over Lan Si’s sentence.
Everyone turned to the speaker and saw a person walk out from behind Elder Pan. He was dressed in a blue scholarly gown, with a bookish air about his face. He looked more like a scholar than a cultivator.
But those who knew his identity dared not treat him as a scholar.
He was the only disciple of Elder Pan willing to stay in the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall even after becoming a Dao Lord. He was known as the one skilled in the “three talents of poetry, calligraphy, and swordsmanship,” otherwise known as the Three Talents Daoist.
The Three Talents Daoist looked very young in appearance, and his personality was also as dauntless and proactive as that of a youth.
"My Third Junior Brother was working for the organization when he died in this woman’s hands. If My Lord and Miss Lan are determined to protect this person, I'm afraid it will chill the hearts of everyone here!"
Although the Three Talents Daoist had a grave and stern expression, there was a trace of self-satisfaction in his eyes.
‘So what even if you’re a Void Cutter expert? The book is right. Although heaven and earth may be vast, reasonableness is the most vast. Our side is in the right no matter how you look at this matter. What's there to be afraid of?’
Gu Nan’s calm gaze fell on him. He waved casually, and an attack containing the power of shadows instantly exploded on the Three Talents Daoist.
Boom!
This young Dao Lord seemed to have received a heavy punch and coughed up blood almost instantly, flying up and slamming into the ceiling on the other side.
Nobody knew if he was still alive when he finally fell, injuring several people.
"My Lord!" Elder Pan suddenly glowered furiously. No matter how good his self-restraint was, he still couldn't help flying into a rage at this time and practically wanted to interrogate Gu Nan.
Fortunately, his remaining rationality made him remember the identity of the person in front of him—this was a Void Cutter cultivator who could kill them more easily than killing chickens.
Gu Nan looked at Lan Si again and still spoke calmly without even changing his tone, "I asked what you want to do. I didn’t give you that dagger so you can use it as a cell phone; I gave it so that you can kill anyone who opposes you."
Gu Nan's voice echoed slowly, and Lan Si was still in a daze. Such an idea had never even occurred to her before, and it was hard to accept immediately.
The Cang Lian Dao Lord also stared at them with startled eyes. She really didn’t expect that Gu Nan would actually act like this!
Completely disregarding people's hearts, completely ignoring what subordinates think?
All the members of the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall on the other side were already extremely furious.
Not everyone was afraid of death, especially when the bullying was so blatant. Many people could be surprisingly tough in such circumstances.
"Fuck! So a powerful figure can be unreasonable?!”
"Brothers, we’ll fight to the end!"
"That's right! Our Mystical Heaven Dao Hall doesn’t have any cowards. Fight!"
"Shut up!" Elder Pan exclaimed with wide eyes after listening to the tumultuous noise in his ears. His shout managed to silence everyone.
Then he slowly turned around, forced himself to suppress his anger, and said in a low voice, "We, the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall, will withdraw from the Heaven and Earth Committee and seal our gates for a hundred years. My Lord, please allow us this."
"Elder Pan!"
"Master!"
All the disciples couldn't help crying out sorrowfully. One senior brother was killed and the other injured, yet Elder Pan was still forced to bow to the other party. When had they ever felt such humiliation before?
When Elder Pan finished this sentence, he kept a bowed posture. However, he waited for a long time, only to find that Gu Nan didn't even glance at him.
"Did you hear me? If you heard me, then do it," Gu Nan pointed to the people in front of him and said to Lan Si.
"Ah?!” Lan Si’s face was horrified. She didn't expect that Gu Nan’s threat wasn’t actually a bluff—he was serious…
Elder Pan was equally stunned. He said angrily, "My Lord cherishes the world. Do you not even have this much generosity—"
Boom!
A denser power of shadows emerged, directly blowing Elder Pan into a bloody mist mixed with pieces of flesh and blood, splashing all over the surrounding people.
The entire venue fell into a dead silence.
Only Gu Nan could still speak calmly, "See? If you don't kill them, they’ll kill you and the entire Tang family. Moreover, if you let one go, there will be one more person staring at the Tang family day and night, waiting for the chance to kill them."
Gu Nan's voice was like the abyssal devil's whisper, pushing Lan Si's bottom line down little by little until her heart was completely occupied by thoughts of killing.
Lan Si lowered her head and looked at the pitch-black dagger in her hand. A burst of information inexplicably flooded into her mind—it was about the dagger’s true power.
Gu Nan's figure had already drifted far away, landing at the edge of the group. Only his voice kept ringing in Lan Si's ear.
"As long as you have absolute power, how the world thinks of you is meaningless."
"If one person curses you, then kill one person. If a thousand people point their fingers at you, then kill a thousand. If you kill until all the remaining people fear you, naturally no one will oppose you anymore."
"The one who controls other people’s life and death receives the key to freely act as they wish."
The soft, beguiling rhetoric kept echoing in Lan Si's ears. The girl's eyes reddened further, and her body subconsciously began to move.
A moment before Lan Si threw herself into the crowd, Cang Lian quietly withdrew and appeared behind Gu Nan.
She knew that her plot had completely failed, but she might still be able to achieve her objective.
"Does Lord want to seal off this news or inform the organization as soon as possible that the Mystical Heaven Dao Lord gathered people to create a disaster, violating the organization’s regulations with only himself to blame?"
Cang Lian spoke respectfully, her expression looking a little pleased.
She believed that since Gu Nan was determined to wipe out the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall, she must block the news and pour dirty water on Elder Pan in passing.
No matter how many people ultimately believed her words, dead men tell no tales. It wasn’t like they could ask Elder Pan for his side of the story.
The Cang Lian Dao Lord revealed a smile. While everyone else was busy being shocked by Gu Nan's actions, she was the only one who thought about handling the aftermath. Wouldn’t this one like a smart person?
"Why?" But Gu Nan just looked back in genuine astonishment. He didn’t look like he was pretending at all.
Cang Lian was more surprised than he was and subconsciously explained, "If news about this matter spreads, then people might oppose…"
"Whoever makes trouble can be killed," Gu Nan waved his hand, entirely unconcerned.

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Law Nullification
chapters.content:
Two figures quickly searched White Mist’s headquarters. With these two’s Tier 4 powers, it hardly took them much time to find the person they were looking for.
A little girl as pretty as a porcelain doll who looked like she was carved out of jade was struggling to practice swordsmanship with sweat on her nose.
"Xin’er!"
Luo Fei immediately exhaled softly, and her figure instantly appeared in front of the little girl, her expression that of pleasant surprise.
She originally thought Gu Nan would keep Xin'er under strict watch and would never let her find Xin’er easily. She even thought he’d set an inescapable net to trap her…
‘Is he careless, or did he just not notice Xin'er’s identity from the beginning?’
"Mother!" Xin’er was also pleasantly surprised to see Luo Fei.
Although she was young, she also knew what happened in the Heavenly Palace recently when her parents were missing… ‘It's great that Luo Fei can appear safely now!’
Luo Fei hugged Xin’er in her arms while Luo Jie stood beside her and smiled with relief, as if a weight had been lifted off his shoulders.
Everything was good as long as their daughter returned to their side.
His younger sister had already taken the crystal’s power, so long as Gu Nan still dared to appear, she could definitely beat him easily!
However, neither of them noticed the shadow that crept up behind them, just waiting for the instant when they let down their guard.
……
The Tang family had become hell on earth.
Lan Si, who had completely fallen into madness, didn't have any reason to speak of when she killed—she even forgot to use her own divine power and was killing by entirely relying on the power Gu Nan bestowed upon her.
Unfortunately for everyone else, the part of his power Gu Nan hid inside that dagger represented his extremely strong physique.
Unbeatable strength and speed, as well as amazing physical resistance and regeneration—this was what the current Lan Si had.
She was like a ferocious beast in human form, madly destroying all living creatures in sight. She even accidentally injured many from the Tang family.
"Gu Nan, you…" Tang Xuan, whose injuries weren’t light, had reached Gu Nan's side at some point.
"Oh, it's you. Long time no see,” Gu Nan greeted her very naturally.
Tang Xuan’s lips managed to force a smile. "I thought you wouldn’t recognize me anymore now that you’ve reached your current position."
The Cang Lian Dao Lord behind Gu Nan was also speechless.
She didn’t understand Gu Nan's principles at all. He was someone who could even casually kill Elder Pan, yet he actually bothered to greet an ordinary Prodigious cultivator like Tang Xuan?
But if he greeted her for old time’s sake, then why did he completely ignore her plight earlier?
Of course she wouldn’t understand that for Gu Nan, it didn’t matter how powerful an NPC was. Whether or not he was willing to greet them depended on whether he remembered them or not.
Tang Xuan was an NPC related to many missions, so naturally she was qualified to make an impression in Gu Nan's memories.
But that was all. It was equally impossible for Gu Nan to take the initiative to help her.
Just when the two women each had their own ideas, Gu Nan’s expression suddenly changed, and his figure instantly disappeared, leaving behind two people staring at each other in dismay.
……
Within White Mist, the shadow quietly approached Luo Jie, who didn't sense anything until a sharp black sword stabbed straight into his body.
But it was already too late.
The pain from his back startled him slightly. The next second, the majestic law of shadows suddenly erupted.
The sword of shadow, superimposed tens of times, almost instantly tore through Luo Jie’s law and invaded his body unreasonably, trying to completely destroy his vitality.
Luo Fei reacted very quickly, stretching out her right hand in a rage and grabbing the shadow sword.
Her right hand had turned completely liquid and easily covered the blade. The sword of shadow was clearly created by the law of shadows, yet most of it melted instantly.
"Law nullification attribute?" Gu Nan appeared from a shadow clone, staring at this scene with some surprise.
He lost all control over the shadow sword. It seemed as if his connection to the law had been completely cut clean, and the sword of shadow was quickly corroded away.
"Interesting." A faint smile appeared on Gu Nan's face. He didn't mind losing that tiny bit of law. Rather, he was very interested in Luo Fei's right hand.
He didn't expect the two who returned to have this level of law.
Luo Fei looked at him coldly, then hurriedly supported Luo Jie, who was about to collapse—Gu Nan's "constant crit damage" wasn’t something most people could endure.
"Brother, are you okay?"
Luo Jie covered his wound with one hand, his eyes full of killing intent. "I'm fine… Quick, kill him!"
Luo Fei didn't hesitate again. She stuffed her daughter into Luo Jie's arms and suddenly disappeared. When she reappeared again, she was already beside Gu Nan.
It wasn’t surprising for Void Cutter cultivators to develop wondrous uses of their own laws. Gu Nan wasn't surprised either. He just stabbed back with a sword.
But Luo Fei didn’t dodge. Her right hand stretched out again, and Gu Nan's layers of illusory shadows were all extinguished by this one hand.
"It’s useless. Die!" Luo Fei sneered.
If not for how tyrannical this crystal’s power was, why would they have hesitated to use it for so many years? Would they have dared to take it out to deal with Gu Nan if they weren’t already sure of its overbearing power?
"So it really is law nullification… What a pity.” Gu Nan shook his head lightly. “What a pity that it doesn’t belong to you, so you haven’t fully mastered it.”
"It’s still enough to kill you!" Luo Fei gave an explosive shout as her palm struck Gu Nan in the heart, and then…
Nothing happened.
Luo Fei froze, and Luo Jie on the side also froze. The former struck him with another palm incredulously, using so much force that her swollen hand even burst a little and water splashed out, but Gu Nan still didn’t move.
The law nullification attribute was indeed powerful, but it was a pity that they met Gu Nan.
This fellow, who had once played till Tier 16 and was incomparably familiar with the laws of the world, knew very well that one of his skills was the bane of the law nullification attribute.
"This is impossible!"
Luo Fei's mind seemed on the verge of collapse. She couldn’t understand why the power she went through so much pain to obtain would be so weak in front of Gu Nan.
But everything in the world could be neutralized. Not even Gu Nan's strength was invincible, let alone a mere law nullification attribute?
Gu Nan's face began to show a nasty grin as he suddenly reached out and grabbed Luo Fei's hair.
"The law nullification attribute falling into your hands is truly a waste…"
Bam!
Gu Nan slammed his head into Luo Fei's forehead, his terrifying strength directly knocking her unconscious. A big bump swelled up on her head as Gu Nan dragged her unconscious body with one hand.
Luo Jie was simultaneously surprised and outraged. "Let her go! If you have a grudge, take it out on me—"
The sword of shadow flashed across his heart, and the sword tip—which had been superimposed tens of times—instantly penetrated his heart, cutting off all his life force, and Luo Xin also slipped down from his arms.
The little girl had been scared silly, and her face was as pale as paper, unable to speak.
Gu Nan glanced at her, then at Luo Fei, and nodded. "Mm, you’re still useful."
After saying that, he also picked up the little girl and slowly walked into a secret room inside White Mist’s headquarters.

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Mechanism
chapters.content:
Of the two Void Cutter experts, one died and one fell unconscious. The whole process happened so quickly that no one in White Mist sensed anything.
When Luo Fei groggily woke up, she was hanging from the ceiling of a dark little room. Her right hand had been cut off, and blood was still oozing from the wound.
The pain from her severed limb wasn’t enough to affect Luo Fei, but the scene in front of her tore at her eyes.
Gu Nan was sitting in front of her with one leg over the other, while Luo Xin had been placed on his leg while hugging Luo Fei’s severed arm.
"Tell me, where did the law nullification power come from?" Gu Nan stretched out his hand and rubbed Luo Xin's head, asking with a light smile.
"You…" Luo Fei wanted to spit on him, but her own daughter was in his hands…
Based on her understanding of this fellow, he would never have mercy on Luo Xin just because she was innocent.
"In the Heavenly Palace, three kilometers underground," Luo Fei quickly answered. Her expression looked detached, as though she was resigned to her fate.
Gu Nan nodded. "Take me there."
……
Moments later, Gu Nan took Luo Fei and reached the underground location inside the Heavenly Palace where Luo Fei first tried to fuse with the crystal.
Perhaps fusion wasn’t exactly the right word, because only Luo Fei gained some of the law nullification power; the crystal was still in good condition right here.
"Tsk tsk tsk, a law nullification crystal as tall as a human." Gu Nan clicked his tongue in wonder as he stared at this crystal in front of him.
Normally, a thumb-sized law nullification crystal was already enough to create a law nullification weapon. In that case, what about this one that was even taller than a human?
Anyone who proposed to cut it into a weapon was sure to be criticized to death. That was simply a waste of natural resources.
"Not bad." Gu Nan nodded with satisfaction. This was the first time he obtained something from the outside world that could truly strengthen his power without relying on the Evil God Temple.
"It's called the law nullification crystal? We siblings have studied it for hundreds of years and have never seen a law that isn’t affected by it. Why are you okay?"
Luo Fei, who had been standing behind Gu Nan all this time, finally couldn’t help asking.
Although she hated Gu Nan’s guts, as a Void Cutter cultivator, her strong thirst for knowledge temporarily dominated her thoughts.
Perhaps because he discovered something nice, Gu Nan was in a good mood and replied to her in great spirits, "Do you want to know? Forget it, you won’t understand even if I explain."
Luo Fei's expression darkened, gritting her teeth so hard she almost crushed them. If not for the fact that she couldn’t defeat him, she most certainly would’ve stabbed this guy to death.
Gu Nan naturally wasn’t making sport of her. It really was because Luo Fei couldn’t possibly understand even if he explained.
It was precisely Gu Nan's Resistance skill that weakened the effects of the law nullification attribute.
The reason why law nullification could be affected by Resistance involved the damage calculation mechanism. Only an ancient player like Gu Nan knew this clearly.
The first thing to understand was: how does the law nullification attribute achieve the effect of "completely nullifying laws"?
After players tested it out, the data interpretation of the law nullification attribute was roughly "weaken the target’s power of law by 100%."
In other words, as long as the target’s power of law exceeded 100% or if the weakening effect of the law nullification attribute itself was partially offset, then the law nullification wouldn’t take full effect.
And no matter whether players wanted something that directly added to their power of law or skills that reduced external damage, neither were hard to get.
Of course, it wasn’t like every type of damage reduction was effective on law nullification.
If the damage reduction effect was achieved through an equipment, or if the principle behind the skill was to create a protective barrier on the surface of the body so as to achieve a damage reduction effect, both would still be "nullified" together by the law nullification attribute.
Only Resistance, a skill that originated from inside Gu Nan and wasn’t influenced by the outside world, would be preserved during attacks from a law nullification attribute.
This extremely meticulous game algorithm could still act on this world, which showed that Gu Nan's earlier guess was correct.
The power system and laws in this world were the same as that of the game, but they simply manifested in different ways.
Ignoring Luo Fei's confusion and dissatisfaction, Gu Nan casually tossed her severed arm, which instantly sank inside the crystal and was quickly assimilated.
"It’s already developed this far? If a few hundred more years pass, it might even become a spirit made of this law," Gu Nan muttered.
Being able to devour power originating from the same source indicated that this crystal was actively gathering similar powers together and would spontaneously capture and absorb the power of law nullification from the outside world.
Gu Nan even suspected that this place used to be a law nullification crystal mine a long time ago. Because no one mined it for too long, the crystals finally gathered to form this thing.
Gu Nan walked up to the law nullification crystal and gently touched the crystal’s surface with his palm, which soon produced an eerie hissing sound.
That was the sound of Gu Nan's body being corroded, dissolved, and broken up by the power of law nullification. Ordinary people’s scalps would probably go numb just from seeing this scene.
Luo Fei also felt pins and needles on her scalp, but not because of this scene. Rather, it was because Gu Nan actually touched the crystal with his body.
She and her brother were the ones who first discovered the law nullification crystal. They deeply understood the horrors of this crystal—it could nullify almost all objects that touch it or even those in its close vicinity.
If they didn’t restrain it with an array and reinforce that array every once in a while, the crystal might’ve even melted through the ground.
‘But that guy… is actually touching it with his bare hand?’
Moments later, she saw Gu Nan pull his hand back. His palm was already in tatters, and even most of the bones were exposed. Countless tissues and blood vessels were damaged.
However, this injury was recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Its power is between Tier 4 and Tier 5." Gu Nan roughly calculated the strength of this crystal after personally experiencing its power.
It was basically an unstoppable power when facing Tier 4 cultivators. Moreover, if Tier 5 experts were caught off guard, they might still suffer a big loss as long as they didn’t have a corresponding way to neutralize this ability.
If he could control this power, then at least for a long time, Gu Nan would have another trump card to use.
As for how to use it… Wasn’t Luo Fei a great example? Just fuse it with one’s body!
"I can give you the method to absorb the crystal’s power," Luo Fei spoke up at the most appropriate moment upon seeing Gu Nan’s plan.
"As long as you let Xin'er go…" She gritted her teeth and added, "I can work for you for 50 years. When Xin'er grows up, our debt will be settled. How’s that?"
Gu Nan’s calm gaze studied her. His heart really wanted to say, ‘This is probably the so-called mother-daughter pair delivered to my door, isn't it?’
The next moment, the superimposed sword of shadow reappeared, directly piercing Luo Fei's forehead.
Looking at her slowly falling body that still had a look of disbelief, Gu Nan just gave a cold smile.
"Why should I trust you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 218: News from the Central Region
chapters.content:
Inside the Heavenly Palace, Gu Nan sat alone in the throne room, with the law nullification crystal right in front of him.
Gu Nan pressed one hand on the crystal, endlessly throwing the pitch-black power of shadows into the crystal. The shadows seemed like they had become a black chain.
Luo Fei thought that a fusion method was good enough to be used as a bargaining chip in front of Gu Nan, which was really naive.
With Gu Nan's knowledge and experience, it wasn’t hard for him to find a corresponding solution once he settled down to study something.
As for Luo Fei using herself to exchange for her daughter's safety, that was even more ridiculous.
Setting aside the fact that Gu Nan didn’t need her fighting power at all, even if there was a real need, he still couldn’t trust Luo Fei—it was impossible for NPCs whose affection levels had dropped to hatred to be recruited by players. This was a basic rule.
If an NPC really did surrender, then they must be a liar.
After a long time, Gu Nan slowly withdrew his hand. His power of shadows had almost been depleted, and he needed to rest for a while.
Under his constant effort, the originally clear interior of the law nullification crystal had produced many black lines, which look like a chained-up devil.
"My Lord, the Mystical Heaven Dao Hall has been cleaned up, and all opposition have been suppressed," Red Tail’s figure slowly appeared behind Gu Nan and reported in a low voice.
If someone compared the difference before and after Red Tail met Gu Nan, they would find that she was less charming and more indifferent.
Gu Nan gave both her and Lan Si a black dagger, but they contained different laws.
The power that Lan Si received originated from the Evil God physique, so once she accepted that power, her personality involuntarily became brutal and tyrannical.
The dagger that Red Tail received represented the law of shadows, which would make people cold and decisive.
However, Red Tail's strength and mentality were far above Lan Si, so the dagger’s influence on her was much weaker.
"Where's Lan Si?" Gu Nan asked absentmindedly, his eyes still tightly shut.
"Miss Lan has already taken over all the affairs of Heaven and Earth Star, and the cleanup progress… is much faster than before," Red Tail said vaguely, hidden meaning implicit in her words.
Gu Nan's lips curled into a small smile. He knew what Red Tail didn't say.
Since Lan Si accepted the Evil God’s power, it was within expectations for her personality to change greatly. As long as she didn’t hesitate about everything like she did before, the progress would naturally speed up.
As long as a person had strength, even if she did something wrong, there would still be someone doing everything possible to help remedy it.
Gu Nan also needed precisely this kind of Lan Si. In the future, she would need to invade other Divine Kingdoms on his behalf as an apostle. That would involve brutal wars fought to the death, so she couldn’t afford to hesitate at all.
Red Tail didn’t say anything else on this matter upon seeing that Gu Nan seemed to be satisfied with this. Instead, she talked about another topic.
"On Immortal Demon World’s side, the sowing of children of destiny has started, and it's smoother than expected." Red Tail's face seemed excited. "We've never seen a place so suitable for manipulating destiny!”
The forces of destiny and fate inside Immortal Demon World were so active that it hardly took them much effort. With a little guidance, a large number of children of destiny could be produced.
When these children of destiny grow up, fight each other, and produce the final winner, it’ll be time for White Mist to reap the harvest.
Gu Nan just gave a small nod in response. Harvesting fate was a long-term project; Immortal Demon World merely improved the efficiency of harvest. He didn't feel too overjoyed about that.
These days, in order to study the law nullification crystal, he even put aside his research into Immortal Demon World.
There were too many things to do, but Gu Nan could only do them one by one. Fortunately, very few people in this world could threaten him after reaching Tier 4, so there was plenty of time.
After a pause, Red Tail then said with an odd expression, "There's another matter that you might be interested in; it’s news from the Central Region."
"What is it?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrow. There were only a few people connected to him in the Central Region.
"Someone caused great havoc in Starry Ocean Pavilion. It’s said that the intruder shattered Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord’s soul while he was inside the Pavilion. Nobody knows if he’s currently dead or alive. And after that intruder caused such chaos, she was still able to float away easily; nobody could keep her from leaving.”
Gu Leng was stunned and asked with some amusement, "Is it that Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara?"
He could only think of one girl who had both the ability to do this and the motive to make a special trip just to cause trouble for the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord.
She could already fight Gu Nan to a standstill when she first awakened. If she had some time to settle down and consolidate her power, her strength would inevitably continue to soar.
The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord was also blinded by obsession. He practically used the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara as a stepping stone to break through to Tier 4, then ran and hid in Starry Ocean Pavilion, thinking that he’d be out of danger if he just hid.
But he didn’t expect for her to be able to break into Starry Ocean Pavilion and shatter his soul.
As expected, Red Tail gave a light nod. "That person looks like a young girl and claims to be Wu Gui. Now, her reputation has already spread all over Star Realm, and even several nearby large planes have heard about her."
"Heavenly Mystery was courting death; you can ignore him." Gu Nan said casually, "Keep an eye out on this matter’s aftermath.”
He was even secretly thinking, ‘Should I also take a stroll around Starry Ocean Pavilion in my free time?’
‘After I completely fuse with the law nullification crystal, whatever Wu Gui can do, I’ll also be able to do… It’s a pity that I have no enemies in Starry Ocean Pavilion. The King of the Deep Sea is one, but he’s in the Deep Sea Temple.’
However, because of Zuo Zuo's remark, Gu Nan had no intention of visiting the Central Region unless it was absolutely necessary—with his current Tier 4 cultivation, impulsively getting involved in the game between Star Rulers was also akin to courting death.
……
In Immortal Demon World, a woman stood quietly on top of a mountain. The sunlight seemed to go straight through her.
There was a young man beside her with a grave and stern expression, but his eyes couldn’t help glancing at the woman's back, where there was no shadow.
"This is the Immortal Demon Battlefield in ancient times," the woman spoke softly and expressionlessly. "The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara will find this place sooner or later. You just have to wait for her here."
The young man's expression remained unchanged. Ever since his rise to power as a youth, his life had always been smooth sailing, but he matured greatly after experiencing the recent ups and downs.
His power didn’t fall even now that he lost the blessing of destiny. In contrast, he felt more like he was living for himself.
He was Ye Chen, the former King of the Northern Region who once stood at the peak of all Dao Lords.
"The ancient Immortal Demon Battlefield… Can I trust you?" Ye Chen was silent for a moment and asked with a heavy voice.
Xue Yan's face remained blank. "You have no other choice."
"That’s true. It's an honor for me, Ye Chen, to carry out a powerhouse’s orders." Ye Chen smiled self-deprecatingly and rubbed his nose.
Xue Yan pushed lightly with her hand, instantly shattering Ye Chen's body. Only his soul was slowly cast down, falling into Immortal Demon World.
She took great pains to bring Ye Chen into Immortal Demon World completely, thus bypassing the world’s law of exchanging half of one’s soul. This allowed Ye Chen to fully assimilate into the world.
Only those who fully belonged to Immortal Demon World had the chance to become a true child of destiny.
"Those who attempt to manipulate destiny will surely suffer backlash from destiny." Xue Yan slowly turned her head and looked at the endless void, as if she could see the mastermind manipulating fate here.

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Three Months
chapters.content:
Time flew by. In the blink of an eye, three months had already passed since the establishment of the "Heaven and Earth Star Standing Committee."
Lan Si’s entire person seemed to have transformed after that vicious fight.
She quickly grew from an ignorant girl into an iron-fisted ruler, growing at a pace that rivaled her organization’s expansion speed.
In three short months, the Heaven and Earth Committee had already become the well-deserved overlord of Heaven and Earth Star. No individual or group dared to disobey its orders.
Of course, it was inevitable that some subordinates would agree on the surface but secretly oppose the Committee. It takes time and accumulation for an organization to gain complete control over all its members. This couldn't be done overnight.
Inside a lofty palace at the very center of Heaven and Earth Star’s continent, a man whose eyes were tightly shut was lying flat on an operating table inside a room that was painted white as new.
"Initializing reincarnation.”
"Infusing the power of shadows…"
"Beginning to infect the subject’s soul…"
"Drawing the third exchange array. Transferring the soul…"
"Failure."
The power of shadows, which had been maintaining a continuous output, seemed to pause slightly at this second and suddenly went berserk, pulverizing the man's body.
Gu Nan scratched his hair somewhat testily. "Another failure. I replicated the entire half-soul exchange process. Where exactly is the problem?"
"Fortunately, the fusion with the law nullification crystal is almost done, otherwise I would’ve accomplished nothing in these three months."
Gu Nan’s mood finally rose a little when he felt the beating of his heart.
He’d stayed on Heaven and Earth Star all three months. Most of his energy was only focused on two things—the fusion of the law nullification crystal and the half-soul exchange method.
The former progressed very smoothly. Gu Nan forcibly incorporated the law nullification crystal into his own body, and no accidents happened during that process.
The law nullification crystal that the Luo siblings couldn’t do anything about was nothing more than paper in front of Gu Nan, unable to resist at all.
But trying to replicate the half-soul exchange method from Immortal Demon World didn’t go as smoothly.
After three months of observation, Gu Nan knew exactly how the world’s origin performed an exchange with the reincarnator’s soul, but his own imitations failed, one after another.
"Either the raw material or location…" Gu Nan wrote down these two factors in his experiment notes.
His experiment only differed from the actual process in Immortal Demon World in two ways: the power of shadows replaced the world’s origin, and the experiment wasn’t conducted inside Immortal Demon World.
‘’I’ll visit Immortal Demon World and give it a try after I finish fusing with the law nullification crystal.’ Gu Nan gently closed his notes and silently decided.
At this time, the palace gates were slowly pushed open. Unsurprisingly, the one who entered was Red Tail.
Only two people knew Gu Nan’s location and might occasionally report to him—Red Tail and Lan Si.
"My Lord, Miss Lan Si started slaughtering people again," Red Tail poured out her grievances to Gu Nan as soon as she entered.
Ever since that day, Lan Si seemed to have become possessed by a demon. Her personality underwent a drastic change, and she often massacred people wantonly, truly befitting the description of "will kill even friendly forces when she goes berserk."
Many people, including Red Tail, were quite worried about this. If such a person was allowed to rule Heaven and Earth Star, they feared it wouldn’t be long before this planet fell into complete turmoil.
Gu Nan, however, wasn’t too concerned about Lan Si's new personality. After all, many players were like this.
Let alone killing NPCs—it wasn’t uncommon for players to run to the wild to kill other players if they were in a bad mood.
Moreover, Lan Si's drastic change in mentality seemed to be very beneficial to her absorption of the Godhead. Gu Nan's current Evil Value had already reached 884. Over half of the 300 or so increase in Evil Value was during the first month.
However, the growth in Evil Value also slowed down as Lan Si’s cultivation reached a bottleneck.
This Godhead’s potential was almost exhausted. After this, Gu Nan’s Evil Value will only have another chance to skyrocket if Lan Si makes a major breakthrough in the future.
But it was also true that Gu Nan couldn’t just sit idly by and watch the situation on Heaven and Earth Star worsen. He needed a stable Heaven and Earth Star to act as a target in White Mist’s stead, so he couldn’t possibly allow Lan Si to break it.
Now that the goal of "training" Lan Si had been achieved, it was time to transfer her to the next position.
"She can stop handling Heaven and Earth Star’s affairs. Didn't you mention last time that there was some trouble in Immortal Demon World? Send her there to help," Gu Nan casually said.
Red Tail was the one who brought up the trouble in Immortal Demon World not long ago.
To put it simply, the world's destiny was so active that the harvest of destiny was much more difficult.
A child of destiny who merely had a 3-star rating in White Mist’s internal rating system and who only had less than two years to grow often required White Mist to send out an Infinitesimal Stage cultivator to handle them, just to be on the safe side.
But the 3-star rating merely corresponded to someone who recently entered Prodigious Realm. White Mist had even fewer people who could deal with the higher 4-star and 5-star ratings.
Fortunately, a Dao Lord level child of destiny with a 6-star rating had yet to appear inside Immortal Demon World. Even those with 5-star ratings were wiped out by White Mist’s members before they could get the chance to grow.
At present, the situation was still under White Mist’s control, but their manpower was somewhat insufficient. They especially lacked top-level cultivators.
The closer someone was to Tier 4, the longer their "cooldown" period after each reincarnation. It would take more time for the reincarnator’s soul to heal. Not even Gu Nan could avoid this.
Red Tail finished reporting the recent matters and soon left, while Gu Nan calmed down.
Immortal Demon World’s peculiarity was once again displayed in front of his eyes. If he still couldn’t sense that something was fishy about this world, then Gu Nan would’ve completed all those missions in vain.
"Half-soul exchange, a particularly active force of destiny… Maybe another mission can be found there?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin. His instincts as a mission expert made him harbor some suspicions.
But there was no hurry. What he needed to do most right now was to accumulate more power.
After stepping into Tier 4, Gu Nan was practically invincible among those of the same level due to his Evil God physique and the buffs from his various skills. When he completely masters the law nullification crystal, nobody in Tier 4 will be a threat to him anymore.
But Tier 4 wasn’t Gu Nan's end goal at all. The imaginary enemies in his heart had always been at Tier 5 or even higher.
Different from the qualitative leap in one’s essence as a lifeform when advancing from Tier 3 to Tier 4, there actually wasn’t that big of a difference between Tier 4 and Tier 5.
Tier 4 required players to build their exclusive laws, while Tier 5 required players to use their laws to build their own worlds.
However, before the player’s own world is truly established and the player successfully completes the First Round by stepping into Tier 6, Tier 5 was merely a quantitative accumulation, so it wasn’t impossible to defeat Tier 5 enemies while only at Tier 4.
At least in his previous life’s game, it wasn’t uncommon for Tier 4 players to trounce Tier 5 NPCs by virtue of some extremely powerful laws.
Speaking of which, Gu Nan really had seen an extremely powerful law in this world before.
It wasn’t bad, even compared to his law of shadows. This law was currently held by a woman, and she also happened to be inside Immortal Demon World right now.

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Every action has an equal and opposite reaction
chapters.content:
Immortal Demon World.
Although only three months had passed in Star Realm, nearly three years had flown by inside Immortal Demon World.
It had already been over two years since children of destiny first appeared. The people here gradually got used to this phenomenon, and just like those on Heaven and Earth Star, they even began to take advantage of the children of destiny.
On the eastern side of the continent, a young man quickly walked into a secluded courtyard in the Yan Dynasty.
"Eldest Miss, we’ve finished capturing this month's children of destiny, with a total of 142 people caught," the young man reported to the empty courtyard as he entered.
His name was Gu Qing, the person most deserving of the title "rising star" in the Gu family these days.
Although reincarnation was banned by the official authorities in Star Realm, it really did give people a major boost in cultivation speed.
Ever since the Gu family secretly gathered some of its members and organized reincarnation trips for them, many people revealed amazing potential.
Gu Qing was one of them. He was originally a nobody within the Gu family, and his cultivation was merely average for an Innate Realm cultivator. To say he was talented was out of the question.
However, ever since he started gaining experience in Immortal Demon World, his actual cultivation level also soared. A month ago, he actually broke through to Prodigious Realm.
As of today, he was already the third junior in his family to break through to Prodigious Realm with the help of reincarnation.
But even so, Gu Qing still dared not show even the slightest disrespect to the "Eldest Miss" he just spoke to.
It wasn’t only due to the other party’s accumulated prestige over the years, but also because her own strength far exceeded that of these three rising stars.
To put it bluntly, even if all three of them attacked together, they would still be no match for the Eldest Miss.
Gu Qing's voice slowly echoed in the courtyard, but he didn't hear an answer. Instead, what greeted him was a gale from behind.
Gu Qing suddenly turned around and threw a heavy punch, only to see Gu Nian’s expressionless face.
Gu Qing's face showed slight surprise, but he didn't stop his punch and even added more strength to it. He felt that Eldest Miss was testing him.
But he soon regretted it, because he realized that the strength of Gu Nian’s counterattack was exactly the same as his punch.
In Gu Qing's senses, he felt as if he’d hit an invisible and soft wall that perfectly countered all his strength back onto his fist.
This kind of feeling was very strange. Gu Qing seemed to gain an inexplicable understanding in his heart at this instant.
"It's not the physical characteristics of the wall that countered my punch, but rather, the law of ‘countering' itself…" He rubbed his sore right hand. "Eldest Miss, is this your law? How scary."
"It’s a new application of my law that I recently developed," Gu Nian replied calmly, then looked into the air. "Every action has an equal and opposite reaction?"
Every action has an equal and opposite reaction; life and death are also equal and opposing forces.
Although much had changed with the passage of time, she still remembered a certain someone’s casual sentence back then and even successfully put it into practice.
After all, of everyone she’d ever met, he was the only person who recognized her law.
Gu Qing shook his head slightly and didn’t respond. Anyhow, it wasn’t like this was the first time his Eldest Miss had done bizarre things. He wouldn’t be surprised no matter what happened.
"I heard your report on the children of destiny. Let's handle it like usual. Take away as many of their fortune treasures as you can and give them to our people to use… There seems to be more and more children of destiny now?"
"Yes." Gu Qing’s expression looked a little grave. “Recently, their numbers are constantly rising and have grown by over 50% since half a year ago. Moreover, we recently discovered an organization named ‘White Mist’ that’s also been wantonly hunting down and capturing children of destiny."
"White Mist?" Gu Nian frowned slightly. "Don't clash with them for the time being. Have the people in Ruby Fish Star investigate this organization to see if they can find out about its background."
Gu Qing nodded, then added, "We also found a rather… special child of destiny."
"Special how?"
"It's someone who calls himself Ye Chen." Gu Qing said, "He’s been in the public eye for a little over two years now, but we only recently confirmed that he’s also a child of destiny."
Gu Nian was silent for a moment, then said seriously, "Children of destiny have very obvious characteristics. Why did we only discover him now?"
"We didn’t find any fortune treasures on him. His cultivation advanced very quickly was all. Only recently did we realize that he was one—right after he declared that he wants to set up a country belonging solely to children of destiny.”
"A country that belongs to children of destiny?" Gu Nian’s lips couldn’t help curling up. "Then how does he explain his lack of a fortune treasure?"
Gu Qing’s expression looked somewhat strange. "He says his situation is… rebirth."
……
No matter whether such a thing like rebirth truly existed or not, it was an indisputable fact that Ye Chen started from scratch inside Immortal Demon World and once again stepped into Prodigious Realm in just three years.
He even preliminarily recruited some children of destiny, gathering them by his side, and conquered a city in the center of the mainland, renaming it Wu Gui City.
After that, Ye Chen, who had already spent decades as the King of the Northern Region, quickly fell into the rhythm of conquering other cities.
In the following days, he led his subordinates and continuously expanded their territory. Before the three major forces could react, Ye Chen and his country had already seized a sizable amount of territory.
The force with the biggest reaction to Wu Gui City’s abrupt rise to power was Azure Dragon Hall in the West.
The reason was also very simple: it was because the current Wu Gui City was Azure Dragon Hall’s place of origin, where the earliest headquarters of Azure Dragon Hall was located.
Even though both the times and the people in Azure Dragon Hall had changed—they even moved their headquarters twice—the ancestral land still held great significance as a memorial site.
"We cannot lose our ancestral land! The so-called children of destiny are nothing more than lucky ones who are blessed by Heaven. What's there to fear?"
"Hall Master, we’ll immediately slaughter everyone in Wu Gui City as soon as you give the order!"
"Hall Master…"
The clamoring discussions in the main hall gradually dissipated, and Yan Xiaoxiao stood up wearily, staring blankly at the empty hall.
Her subordinates’ fury was right beside her ears, but she suppressed their discontent.
She didn’t explain anything when faced with her older subordinates’ resentful confusion, nor could she explain.
Although the generals below could be hot-headed, she could not.
‘It’s true that it’ll be easy to take over one Wu Gui City, but who’s going to guard against the dynasty and the sect in the East if we rashly send our troops out? Will you do it, or will I do it?’
Either one of the enemy organizations in the East had a higher number of powerhouses than Azure Dragon Hall. Yan Xiaoxiao knew this better than anyone else, but she couldn’t explain this to her subordinates.
‘Should I tell them that I went behind their backs and traveled to that dynasty and sect many times to investigate the enemies’ inside information?’
‘Or should I tell them that all the experts in those two organizations are actually reincarnators, and their actual strength is far superior to ours?’
"Not enough, it’s still not enough." Calculating the difference in strength between the two sides, Yan Xiaoxiao inwardly sighed. "I wonder when I’ll be able to finally drive all these people out of this world."
‘Back then… If I didn’t choose to stay in this world, then would I also have become one of them?’
Yan Xiaoxiao looked towards the east, her gaze faraway but somewhat grave and stern. The next moment, she suddenly turned around, as a figure slowly walked out from behind her.
"I thought I'd never see you again." There was a light smile on her face. It was a smile that could only be seen between friends.
"Looks like you’re very perplexed." Lin Jun's smile was as gentle as ever. "Do you want to have a chat with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 221: A Fragmented Divine Kingdom
chapters.content:
It really had been a long time since Yan Xiaoxiao last saw Lin Jun.
Ever since Gu Nan took the latter to Star Realm as a substitute for Yan Xiaoxiao, the two had never met again.
"So the family you’re in is behind the Yan Dynasty? Then what about the Celestial Fortune Sect?" Yan Xiaoxiao finally learned some secrets after chatting with Lin Jun for a while.
The three forces had been fighting against each other for so many years, so she naturally knew a lot about the two enemy organizations. But the specific identities of the masterminds behind them wasn’t something a person from Immortal Demon World could know.
Lin Jun was a very strange existence. Although much time had passed, her cultivation hadn’t changed at all, always lingering at the peak of Innate Realm. Even her appearance remained unchanged.
It was as if time couldn’t affect her at all, regardless of whether she wanted it or not.
"The mastermind seems to be someone from another planet."
"Planet? The upper world really is interesting."
"Yeah, it's very big there, and there are many incredible people."
"How enviable…"
In front of Lin Jun, Yan Xiaoxiao no longer seemed like the monarch who ruled half of the continent. She hugged her knees to her chest and crouched in her seat. Her posture was very graceless, but her smile was very brilliant.
After chatting for a while, they both fell silent at the same time.
Then Lin Jun asked while staring at her, "Have you ever thought about leaving everything here behind and departing with me?"
Yan Xiaoxiao was silent for a while and finally shook her head gently. "I don't want to go there."
"Is it because of… your teacher?" Lin Jun revealed a faint smile, tilting her head slightly.
"No," Yan Xiaoxiao answered without much hesitation. "Back then, I just wanted to see what it feels like to stand at the top of the world."
"And now?"
"Now it has already become an obsession."
……
When a person pours an enormous amount of time into something but never receives the expected return, some will stubbornly insist on seeing it through to the end, disregarding everything else around them.
Yan Xiaoxiao was like this, and Gu Nan was also like this—trying to understand the principle behind Immortal Demon World’s half-soul exchange had practically become his obsession.
Even if he knew that this was an insignificant matter—even if his subordinates weren’t absolutely loyal, it still wouldn’t hinder his leveling progress—Gu Nan still wanted to understand it thoroughly.
It was just like when a top player encountered a trashy map with an insanely high difficulty. Either he’d refuse to touch it from the beginning, or he’d clear it. Once he had invested time into it, he couldn’t help but want to clear that map.
Meals can be skipped, sleep can be lost, and even libido can be ignored, but this map must be cleared.
Gu Nan was now in this semi-crazed state. Fortunately, he hadn’t completely lost his mind, so he would still handle some serious matters while researching this.
Somewhere in the sky of Immortal Demon World, a figure directly tore open the void and slowly descended.
The only one able to do such a thing was naturally Gu Nan, who had already stepped into Tier 4.
The repulsive force from the world arrived as planned as soon as Gu Nan stepped foot into Immortal Demon World, but he didn't meekly endure it like usual.
He froze on the spot for an instant, and a glimmer of light flashed out from his heart. An indescribable force immediately circulated throughout his whole body.
The sense of rejection from Immortal Demon World actually dissipated by half under the gradual light given off by that mysterious power, and only a small portion remained.
"As expected, the repulsive force of the world also exists in the form of a law, so it’s also affected by the law nullification crystal." Gu Nan showed a satisfied smile.
The law nullification attribute could nullify all laws. Although it wouldn’t have any effect on existences at or above Tier 6 due to the limitations of the crystal’s grade, it was clear that Immortal Demon World had yet to reach that level.
The current Gu Nan had already fully absorbed the law nullification crystal into his own body and even used his heart as the vessel.
For the crystal that Luo Fei only dared to use her arm to absorb part of its power, Gu Nan dared to fuse it directly with his heart. This was the difference between their physiques.
The higher his level, the greater advantage the Evil God physique would bring Gu Nan.
After cleaning up the world’s repulsionary force, Gu Nan felt that the maximum time he could stay here was extended by at least a month. Only then did he land on the ground with satisfaction.
"My Lord, we’ve prepared everything you ordered." San Wei was already waiting there and hurriedly stepped forward as soon as she saw Gu Nan descend.
Red Tail had to oversee Heaven and Earth Star, so only a portion of White Mist’s members were here. San Wei was one of them.
"Good." Gu Nan nodded as he followed San Wei and quickly reached the lab he requested.
There was already an unconscious man ready here. This wasn’t a vessel for a reincarnator; this was just a normal person.
Because it was a given that all reincarnators in Immortal Demon World world only had half of their souls, they held absolutely no value as experimental material. He could only experiment on the natives.
"Let's start," Gu Nan casually said after a simple check of the equipment.
"Separating the outer layer of the subject's soul…Complete."
"Infusing the power of shadows…"
"Beginning to infect the subject’s soul…"
"Drawing the third exchange array. Transferring the soul…"
"Abnormality… Abnormality…"
After a series of familiar procedures, Gu Nan was stunned by the results. His attempt to infect the subject’s soul was neither a success nor a failure. Rather, it entered a strange state.
Unlike this world’s origin, the power of shadows didn’t displace half of the subject’s soul and then enter the target’s body as a separate force.
While Gu Nan's power did enter the experimental subject’s body, it was in a winding and twisting manner, and the power of shadows had fully fused with the subject’s soul.
"Did it work?" Gu Nan wasn't sure either. He could only say to San Wei beside him, "Wake him up."
Stimulants were quickly injected into the subject's bloodstream, and he began to stir faintly.
The second the man woke up, Gu Nan felt a wondrous sensation—he seemed to have become another person, easily reading the other party’s thoughts and emotions.
He could see everything the other party saw and perceive everything the other party felt. Gu Nan was like an omniscient god who knew this person even better than the person knew himself.
‘Isn't this just the status window in the game?’ Gu Nan sensed all the information about this man in his mind, and his heart was frantically roasting.
Players themselves had no status windows in the Evil God game, but after establishing their own Divine Kingdoms, players could check the status windows of individual units within the Divine Kingdom.
