Those status windows also appeared in the same form as the one right now. They presented all information directly inside the player’s mind rather than through the rather ancient “stats breakout” method.
The advantage of this method was obvious. The conclusions drawn from a large amount of data were far more complete than a few dry words, and it was impossible for players to mistake the identity of any NPC.
‘But… Why would the game’s way of showing the status windows of units inside a Divine Kingdom appear in Immortal Demon World?’
‘And why would Immortal Demon World’s half-soul exchange method be the same method as players pulling up status windows of units inside their Divine Kingdoms?’
Gu Nan frowned as his brain slowly connected several pieces of information. He seemed to have drawn a somewhat bizarre conclusion.
‘If we say that the essence of the half-soul exchange using this world’s origin is the same as the essence of players viewing a unit’s status window, then…’
‘Perhaps this place was once a Divine Kingdom, but it’s now fragmented.’

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Yan Xiaoxiaos Willfulness
chapters.content:
Gu Nan didn’t know what Star Rulers in the Myriad Heavens Universe called their own worlds, but he was more used to calling it the Divine Kingdom.
An experiment that made him waste three months finally reached this kind of conclusion, making Gu Nan feel both happy and a little speechless at the ridiculousness of the situation.
But if Immortal Demon World really was a fragmented Divine Kingdom, then his three months of work couldn’t be considered a waste.
‘After all, a fragmented Divine Kingdom… is still a Divine Kingdom!’
The gap between a naturally-formed plane and a Divine Kingdom was akin to the gap between a pebble that could be seen everywhere along the roadside and a half-carved gem.
Of course certain pebbles would contain gems inside, but wouldn't it be better to use a semi-finished gem from the very start?
As for the traces left behind by the predecessor who once ruled this world… As an old hand who experienced hundreds of Divine Kingdoms, Gu Nan expressed that he wasn’t pressured in the least by this.
In his early years, Gu Nan was once tempted to make Immortal Demon World into his reserve Divine Kingdom in the future, so he arranged a lot of chess pieces here.
Later, he temporarily lost interest in Immortal Demon World because of the appearance of personal dungeons, but it wasn’t too late to pick it up again.
Who knows whether Gu Nan's luck could be considered good or bad. He obtained a personal dungeon on the first day he started translating worlds’ wills, but he never saw another personal dungeon for three whole months after that.
In fact, this was normal. To fully devour a world’s origin meant that he needed to finish all of that world’s missions. How could that be so easy?
It really was pure dumb luck that he got a personal dungeon on the first day, and because of that, he unexpectedly met Zuo Zuo, which caused so much subsequent trouble.
Gu Nan couldn’t help feeling a headache at the thought of Zuo Zuo.
Even now, he still couldn’t quite understand why exactly he caught that fellow’s attention and what Zuo Zuo’s goal was.
‘Is it because of Star Realm? Unlikely. Star Realm never deliberately concealed its own existence, so Zuo Zuo could’ve found Star Realm a long time ago.’
‘Do I possess something else that can catch the interest of this high-ranking Star Ruler?’
"Lord San Wei." Gu Nan's subject had woken up. He didn’t recognize Gu Nan but recognized San Wei, so he hurriedly saluted.
San Wei ignored him and just waited for Gu Nan's command.
"Let him leave." Gu Nan casually ordered, "Look into this world’s historical legends, strange landscapes, or places like forbidden areas."
"Ah… Okay," San Wei was shocked by his strange request, but she answered quickly.
Based on Gu Nan's experience, only two reasons would result in a Divine Kingdom not splintering apart after the death of its ruling god. Either the god wasn’t completely dead, or something else took the god’s place and oversaw the operation of the Divine Kingdom.
Going by the fact that Immortal Demon World spontaneously exchanged half of the reincarnator’s soul, the second case seemed more likely.
Moreover, Gu Nan had a greatsword in his hand called Righteous Judgment. He was least afraid of powerhouses at death’s door. If they corner him, true damage will teach them how to behave.
And if something else really did take over this Divine Kingdom’s operations, then the overseer would definitely still be inside the Divine Kingdom, and the place the overseer was at would undoubtedly be a little strange. That location wouldn’t possibly be normal.
……
Inside Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters, Lin Jun and Yan Xiaoxiao's conversation continued on.
"Are you sure you can succeed?" Lin Jun's voice seemed very worried.
"Of course… not." Yan Xiaoxiao smiled a little helplessly. "But I still need to try, otherwise my life will seem meaningless."
From an ordinary girl of a wealthy family all the way to her current position, her legendary experience was more than enough to write two novels.
However, the higher her status rose, the heavier the emptiness in her heart grew.
She was already the Hall Master of Azure Dragon Hall—the most powerful woman in the world. But she had no relatives, no friends, and even no one that she could speak her mind to.
Fortunately, Lin Jun came today.
"Sometimes I’d wonder, was this how he felt back then?" Yan Xiaoxiao murmured softly. That person’s figure seemed to flash across her eyes again—that man who relentlessly pursued ever stronger power for all eternity.
"He sees human life as dirt and sees loneliness as nothing. He scorns all the rules of this world… If gods really do exist in this world, then they would probably look like that?"
Even though over twenty years had passed, Yan Xiaoxiao was still the person who understood Gu Nan the best in the world.
"He may indeed be." Lin Jun gave a wry smile. She knew more than Yan Xiaoxiao and knew exactly how Gu Nan left Ruby Fish Star and slaughtered his way to the Sixth Region.
She didn’t know what happened after that, but it probably wasn’t too different from before—he would always be the strongest person.
Yan Xiaoxiao seemed to have understood something. She stopped talking about this topic and even looked relieved, as if a heavy weight had been lifted off of her mind.
"Thank you." Yan Xiaoxiao said, "I've endured for so many years; it’s time to be willful for once."
Lin Jun stared at her blankly, wondering what she meant. She came here to persuade the other party to stop, not to…
But Yan Xiaoxiao had already stood up. She slowly walked out of the hall and ordered her attendants, "Summon all the officials in Azure Dragon Hall for me."
"Ah? Hall Master, what are you planning?" The attendant was startled and blurted out a question.
Yan Xiaoxiao ignored his disrespect and instead smiled. "A decisive battle."
……
A black-haired girl was sitting on a black lotus in the endless void, coldly glaring at the people in front of her. This girl was precisely Wu Gui.
Two people stood in front of her, a man and a woman.
The two had very different styles. The man was smiling like a Maitreya Buddha, while the woman's face was vacant, looking like a fool.
"The Immortal Demon Meeting is approaching. Buddhist Ancestor, please stay back." The man was all smiles as he looked at Wu Gui.
"Smiling Gentleman, Shadowless One." Wu Gui’s icy gaze swept over the two. "Don't think that this one won't kill you two just because you’re listed on Starry Ocean’s ranking."
"How can we juniors dare to compete with Buddhist Ancestor?" The Smiling Gentleman seemed to be always smiling. “We just want to ask Buddhist Ancestor to remain here for a while."
Before Wu Gui could respond, the woman beside him, known as the Shadowless One, interrupted, “Exactly how long do we need to keep her here for?”
The Smiling Gentleman stared at her in astonishment, his expression practically screaming, ‘Can you not be this blunt?’
However, since she’d already asked that question, he couldn't just ignore it. He maintained his smile and answered, "Since Buddhist Ancestor has already reincarnated for ten thousand lifetimes, you might as well meditate here for ten thousand years as well."
This wasn’t a very funny joke. The Shadowless One still had a blank expression, while Wu Gui’s expression didn’t even change.
But the next moment, a palm overflowing with demonic intent had already arrived before the Smiling Gentleman.
Buddhism was one of the few paths in the Myriad Heavens Universe that still valued cultivating one’s physical body. Therefore, Buddhist experts often fought with their bodies.
This palm was too fast and too sudden, and it was also too secretive and unpredictable. The Smiling Gentleman’s expression instantly changed, and he almost couldn’t maintain his smile anymore.
"Are you just going to keep watching!?" He snapped as his right hand clutched at the empty space. It was too late to dodge, so he could only draw out a long blade from the void and use it to block this palm strike.
But Wu Gui’s power far surpassed his imagination.
This single palm alone directly shattered his law, and his whole person entered critical condition. He could only flee towards the nearest world behind him.
Based on their earlier goal of trying to block Wu Gui’s way, this was precisely Immortal Demon World.
‘I really lost big this time! I didn't expect this old monster's strength to have actually recovered to this point…’ This was the Smiling Gentleman’s last thought before losing consciousness.
"Hopefully that one surnamed Xue is reliable and can at least hurt Wu Gui…"
On the other hand, Wu Gui’s expression didn’t even change after defeating an enemy with one palm. An opponent of this level couldn’t even enter her eyes at all.
But right at that moment, a searing and harsh light burst out from beside her.

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Final Glory
chapters.content:
"Are you awake? How do you feel?"
"Hey, your injuries are very serious, please don't move…"
"Here? This is Celestial Fortune Sect."
“……”
Dazed, the Smiling Gentleman blankly sat at the table as he felt his sudden drop in power. For a moment, he found this reality hard to accept.
Although he had expected that he was unlikely to successfully block the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara, even after joining forces with the Shadowless One, he still didn't expect for his cultivation to be directly knocked down by one realm.
The essential difference between Void Cutter and Prodigious cultivators was that Void Cutter cultivators already had their exclusive laws, and those laws were enough to interfere with reality without external help.
Now, however, his exclusive law had been forcibly shattered by Wu Gui.
The Smiling Gentleman, who was always smiling, really couldn’t smile right now. He didn’t know how much time and resources he’d need to repair his law, and what price he would have to pay…
More importantly, he didn’t even know how to leave this world!
Classmate Smiling Gentleman clutched at his hair anxiously. Even if Starry Ocean Pavilion could compensate him for this loss, he still had to contact them first.
Without his Void Cutter Realm strength, he couldn’t even tear through the barrier surrounding this plane… ‘No wait, the Immortal Demon Meeting will start soon. There’s still a chance!’
He soon remembered why he’d fallen into this situation in the first place.
‘That damned baldy… I hope the one surnamed Xue can give her a harsh lesson, or at least not let her enter this world unscathed!’ The Smiling Gentleman ruthlessly thought.
He had never held such high expectations for that unreliable companion of his before now—although she was indeed a little too blunt and straightforward, her strength was absolutely not weak!
After thinking things through slightly, the Smiling Gentleman finally recovered the aura of a senior expert. His face was serious and he said, "Call over the person in charge here."
Even without his exclusive law, he was still at the peak of Prodigious Realm, an expert among experts.
"Tell him that the opportunity to dominate the continent is just around the corner, but it all depends on whether he can grasp it."
Under the Smiling Gentleman’s infectious tone, the young girl who served him nodded in amazement, then quickly ran away.
Moments later, a woman slowly entered the room with a small smile. "Lu Zhanyu greets Mister."
……
White Mist’s encampment in Immortal Demon World was actually a small town they secretly occupied. It was in front of a canyon in the continent’s northwest.
On this day, Gu Nan’s head was buried in a pile of documents. Over half of the files in front of him were legends and folklore about the various forbidden areas and ruins on this continent.
Immortal Demon World’s history could be traced back to tens of thousands of years ago. Not even the locals knew just how many strange anecdotes had been passed down throughout the generations.
However, Gu Nan was earnestly reading through all the documents and traveling to the actual location to investigate and search one by one, all to determine the whereabouts of this world’s overseer.
This kind of work was boring and tedious, but Gu Nan enjoyed it.
He, who was already Tier 4, could ignore the limitations of space and truly "go wherever he wants,” which was no different from teleporting to any spot on the map in the game.
His current actions were no different from finding a clue in the game and then traveling to all the major maps to investigate.
Players had seen this kind of thing so many times that they didn’t care about it at all.
"Deathly Stillness, first seen 2,500 years ago. It’s said to be caused by the gathering of dead souls… Ascertain its exact location."
Even if the location didn’t seem to have any connection to the overseer, Gu Nan still had people in White Mist investigate.
As long as the location could be determined, he could then personally travel there and search, which wouldn’t take much time at all.
"My Lord, we’re almost out of manpower…" San Wei stood beside Gu Nan, her face full of a bitter smile.
White Mist didn’t have too many people they could send into Immortal Demon World to begin with, but Gu Nan gave too many orders during this time. It was impossible for them to finish every order.
The fact that San Wei was forced to complain to Gu Nan despite grealty fearing him showed to what extent the manpower within White Mist had been squeezed dry.
"Then continue to recruit people and have Heaven and Earth Star send people over as well. Even the locals here can be recruited."
"But… Reincarnation…” San Wei was a little flabbergasted. The secret of reincarnation had never been made public, but Gu Nan's words sounded like he wanted to wantonly recruit people.
As for recruiting the locals, it was even more necessary for Heaven and Earth Star to send people over, or else they wouldn’t be able to control that many people at all.
Gu Nan waved his hand, entirely unconcerned. He only wanted to accomplish his own objective. As for what impact that would have, that wasn’t his concern at all.
If worst came to worst, he didn’t mind cleaning up all the forces in Immortal Demon World and mobilizing all of this world's forces to help him find the overseer’s location.
"The overseer must exist…" The longer Gu Nan stayed here, the more certain he was of this.
……
Azure Dragon Hall wantonly mobilized its troops and devoted half of the continent’s strength to head to Wu Gui City full-force. This news spread in just two days and immediately shook the world.
The two forces that were most shocked by this were the dynasty and sect in the East.
The three major forces on the continent had kept each other in check for nearly a year, maintaining a tentative peace. Azure Dragon Hall had always assumed the posture of "shrinking its head into its shell.”
Azure Dragon Hall's high-end combat power was inferior to the other two forces, and it might not even be able to beat either one of them. The only reason Azure Dragon Hall could occupy more territory was nothing more than because the dynasty and sect lacked bottom-level manpower.
After all, thanks to Azure Dragon Hall’s propaganda back then, the reincarnators in the dynasty and sect didn’t dare to give the natives high positions. The truly critical positions had always been controlled by one of their own.
However, Azure Dragon Hall’s brazen invasion this time really confused both sides.
"Has that Yan woman gone crazy? She doesn’t want Azure Dragon Hall’s enormous territory anymore?"
"Hey, you don't say. Now that all the troops in Azure Dragon Hall are huddled together, they’re actually quite troublesome to deal with."
"I've heard that Wu Gui City occupied Azure Dragon Hall’s ancestral land. It was the site of their earliest headquarters 20 years ago."
"So that’s it! I told you…"
Similar conversations took place all over the continent. Although the words and titles were different, the general meaning was the same. This was the only reason Azure Dragon Hall would mobilize so many troops.
When they heard about Azure Dragon Hall’s ancestral ground, many people even fondly recalled the glory of those years.
When the dynasty and sect in the East had yet to rise to power, that era 20 years ago belonged to Azure Dragon Hall.
That female Hall Master led countless elites and regarded the whole world as their hunting ground. It was at that time that the unrivaled Azure Dragon Cavalry became famous throughout the continent.
Although the current Azure Dragon Hall was no longer the powerhouse it once was, the glorious era that belonged to this name still remained in people's hearts.
"Final glory?" Gu Nian chuckled lightly, once again reminded of that girl whose face was full of stubborness.
If she had to name one person in Azure Dragon Hall who was still worthy of her attention, then it would be the Hall Master herself.
Back then, she was led astray by Gu Nan and truly believed that Yan Xiaoxiao was a weak-willed character she could control at will. As a result, Yan Xiaoxiao successfully made a comeback at the most crucial moment.
"That kind of law," Gu Nian’s eyes narrowed slightly, "truly is a little troublesome…”
But she quickly hid her emotions and ordered the king of the Yan Dynasty, "Concentrate all forces and set off for Wui Gui City."

chapters.title: Chapter 224: All Gathered in Wu Gui City
chapters.content:
"Gather all our experts as soon as possible and make haste for Wu Gui City."
Lu Zhanyu’s order was issued rapidly. Faced with Azure Dragon Hall's abnormal behavior, the two actual rulers of the dynasty and sect in the East all made similar decisions.
‘Since Yan Xiaoxiao wants a decisive battle, then a decisive battle it is!’
Something like a decisive battle was absolutely not a loss for the two forces in the East.
The reason was very simple. Their people weren’t afraid of death at all. Death was just a matter of sending a new group of reincarnators here and arranging for the reincarnators who died to do work outside of Immortal Demon World.
But any death in Azure Dragon Hall meant a permanent reduction in their numbers. How can those who fear death beat those who don’t fear death? What's more, Azure Dragon Hall wasn’t even strong enough to win against them.
As for whether Azure Dragon Hall might play some tricks and turn to attack other places, they weren’t afraid of this at all.
As long as the strength in their hands wasn’t damaged, they could retake their lost territory in the blink of an eye. It wasn’t difficult to understand the logic of saving people instead of land so that the saved people could later retake the lost land.
"Y-You can't go there…" A slightly frightened voice sounded. It was the Smiling Gentleman who was shouting loudly at Lu Zhanyu.
At this time, the Smiling Gentleman looked so miserable that he wasn’t even worthy of being called a “Gentleman” anymore.
All the major joints of his body were accurately pierced by 26 bone nails, and his power of law was completely sealed. No matter his body or his soul, none of them could move at all.
This grand Void Cutter powerhouse was currently nailed to a wooden cross like a dead mouse and could only helplessly shout at Lu Zhanyu.
"Oh? Why?" Lu Zhanyu bent down with a smile, looking at the Smiling Gentleman’s profile. "Your Excellency Wang Bomian, the Smiling Gentleman from Starry Ocean Pavilion?"
Smiling Gentleman Wang Bomian’s pupils contracted, and another drop of cold sweat appeared on his forehead.
‘This woman even knows my real name. She’s clearly not not a simple character. It’s just that I don’t know who's behind her and why they would intervene…’
But Wang Bomian knew he couldn’t afford to hesitate.
If he couldn’t give enough valuable information, then this woman who was surrounded by a dangerous aura would definitely kill him without hesitation.
A dead Void Cutter powerhouse wasn’t much different from a dead ordinary person.
"I don't know if you've ever heard of the Immortal Demon Meeting," Wang Bomian tried to calm his tone and tried to say mysteriously.
He hoped to show his own value, or else Lu Zhanyu would definitely kill him before she left.
"Immortal Demon Meeting?" As expected, Lu Zhanyu revealed an interested look, and her hand movements also paused slightly.
"That's right!" Wang Bomian's voice also rose a little. "This plane is the battlefield of the ancient Immortal Demon War, and it’s also the astral world
[1]
of an extremely powerful Star Ruler."
"You're talking about the half-immortal, half-demon existence who almost took over Star Realm, right?" Lu Zhanyu seemed to say casually, without any fluctuation in her voice.
She picked up a bottle of medicinal powder in her hand and sprinkled it gently in front of Wang Bomian, where a small array had already been drawn.
Wang Bomian's eyes gradually showed a bit of horror, and his entire body trembled slightly. "W-Who in the world are you?"
"I'm just a trivial small fry." Lu Zhanyu smiled. "Only the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara—a Buddha who became a demon—will be interested in the Immortal Demon Meeting, isn’t that right?"
Wang Bomian was completely speechless. He felt as if he had just escaped from the tiger's jaws only to enter the wolf's den.
But at this time, Lu Zhanyu’s array had already been fully activated, and a blurry, oddly-shaped figure gradually appeared in front of Wang Bomian.
It was a strange flower whose bloody mouth was wide open, its edges lined with sawtooth-shaped barbs.
"At the very least, you were once a Void Cutter cultivator. Can’t let you go to waste.” Lu Zhanyu smiled and said, "Then you can take it from here, Lord Stephen."
After pronouncing the odd-sounding name, Lu Zhanyu turned around and walked away, where a gate was shining faintly with a golden light.
Wang Bomian’s last sentence was full of terror, "Astral Gate… You are…"
……
The mainland’s three major forces were all heading for Wu Gui City in the center of the continent, so without needing another reason, this city soon became the focus of everyone's attention.
Even the people in White Mist involuntarily paid more attention to this place while collecting and confirming information, so there was a lot of information about the central part of the continent.
And it was precisely because of this that a valuable piece of information was dug up.
"Land’s center, Immortal Demon Encounter, souls will return to their place…"
A prophecy that only gave eleven words and looked incomplete still revealed enough information to be taken seriously by Gu Nan.
This sentence came from ten thousand years ago, and even the words it used were barely translated by White Mist. The meanings might not even be correct. And there must be more to the prophecy, but that had already been lost.
But these eleven words had already revealed the most important information—the location!
‘If "land’s center" refers to the center of the continent, then the so-called "Immortal Demon Encounter" is probably what I’m looking for!’
“Wu Gui City?" A smile appeared on Gu Nan’s face, and his figure suddenly vanished.
……
There was a strange atmosphere inside Wu Gui City at this moment because the owner of this city, Ye Chen, who claimed he would build a country belonging to children of destiny, was ignoring his duties a little and doing something else.
"Boss Ye, this is it," a young man stood beside Ye Chen and said, pointing to some ruins in front of him.
He was one of the first children of destiny to follow Ye Chen and could be considered one of Wu Gui City’s higher ups. The reason he came here this time was because something strange appeared in the ruins.
"It's a statue." The young man explained to Ye Chen, "We don't know what it is, but when we looked at it, we felt our hearts tremble in fear."
"Fear?" Ye Chen's eyes narrowed slightly.
He also used to be a child of destiny, so he knew very well that those blessed by fortune should look down upon everything and have no fear. ‘What in the world can make their hearts tremble in fear?’
Step by step, the two walked into the center of the ruins. The young man suppressed his heart's pounding and said instead, "Boss Ye, Azure Dragon Hall’s army will arrive at our city gates tomorrow. What do you…"
"No matter," Ye Chen said without looking back, as if he didn’t take the famous Azure Dragon Hall seriously at all.
And he really wasn’t concerned about them. As someone who was once one of the world’s top Dao Lords, even if his strength hadn’t fully recovered yet, he still had the confidence to face any enemy.
‘A mere Azure Dragon Hall—I alone can sweep away all of their top-level fighters. What's there to fear?’
What he truly cared about was what that shadowless woman said.
‘She’ll probably appear only after I find that item, right?’ Ye Chen subconsciously cast a glance at the sky, his eyes flashing with blurred feelings.
The next moment, he saw the statue his companion mentioned.
It was an odd-looking stone statue, which seemed like two halves of children’s statues had been pieced together, with a girl on the left and a boy on the right—the boy's expression was gentle; the girl’s expression was crazy.
T/N:
[1]
Astral World:
The world that a Star Ruler controls

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Immortal Demon Meeting
chapters.content:
When Azure Dragon Hall’s main army gathered in front of Wu Gui City’s gates, the other two sides’ troops had also arrived and were even faster than Azure Dragon Hall.
Because the experts in the dynasty and sect were already concentrated in positions closer to the front line, it was much easier for them to rush here.
Inside Azure Dragon Hall’s main camp, all the top officials looked grave. Some even had worried frowns.
Although they admittedly felt an indescribable excitement when they heard that Yan Xiaoxiao was suddenly willing to go to war, the enemy’s strength was also beyond doubt.
"Hall Master, the Yan Dynasty and Celestial Fortune Sect’s masters have all arrived. Shall we…"
"No need," Yan Xiaoxiao interrupted him, her indifferent voice ringing in everyone's ears. "It's just one Wu Gui City. Five people will join me and directly enter the city."
……
Sending in an elite team for a swift strike was actually a very uncommon tactic.
The reason was simple. Powerful fighters almost always held high positions as well. How could they be willing to venture deep into enemy territory alone, bearing all the risks themselves, and become the blade used to assassinate the enemy’s leader?
If they all did this, then what would they need their troops for?
But on the other hand, once someone did this, it really could have an unexpected effect.
By the time people from the dynasty and sect received the news, the flag of Wu Gui City had suddenly changed hands, and this newly occupied city now belonged to Azure Dragon Hall again.
"What happened? What about Ye Chen?" Gu Nian asked with a frown.
The fall of Wu Gui City was so baffling that it made her suspect that all this was just Azure Dragon Hall’s performance, and that the so-called Ye Chen was simply a pretense.
"Our people inside the city couldn’t discover more information either. We only know that Ye Chen went somewhere beforehand and never showed up again."
Gu Qing's voice was also very confused. Even if Ye Chen was delayed by something, he wouldn't go so far as to even ignore his own home base, would he?
‘He meekly gave Wu Gui City to Azure Dragon Hall just like this?’
Gu Nian frowned heavily. She felt that this entire matter was getting more and more bizarre, as if an invisible hand behind them was manipulating everything.
And it was even quite an unbridled invisible hand, not at all afraid of them seeing through its intentions.
Yan Xiaoxiao inexplicably chose to fight a decisive final battle, but after the three sides gathered, Wu Gui City then inexplicably fell into Azure Dragon Hall's hands…
But just like before, even if she knew there was something fishy about all this, Gu Nian had no other choice but to march on.
It was precisely because something was fishy about this that she had to advance, or else someone else might succeed with her none the wiser. And if the other party really did have people who were far stronger than her, then there would be absolutely no need to be so secretive.
Gu Nian understood all the intricacies. However, to guard against the possibility that this might be a trap, she didn’t throw in all of her strength either.
"Gu Qing, Gu Sheng, come with me." Gu Nian chose to bring her family's two Prodigious Realm juniors and also advanced to Wu Gui City in the form of an elite team.
"Yes!"
……
Yan Xiaoxiao stood alone inside the ruins of Wu Gui City, coldly studying the two people in front of her.
Ye Chen and his companion Wuyun Zhuo—the youth who led him here—also looked at Yan Xiaoxiao coldly, but their mood was quite different.
"Y-You are Azure Dragon Hall’s Hall Master!" Wuyun Zhuo had seen Yan Xiaoxiao's portrait before and immediately exclaimed aloud.
"Wu Gui City has already changed hands. You guys still won’t surrender?" Yan Xiaoxiao calmly opened her mouth, but her question surprised Wuyun Zhuo.
"Impossible!" He almost blurted out, but after saying it, reason told him that it was true…
If Wu Gui City hadn’t already been captured, then why would Yan Xiaoxiao appear here?
His eyes began to redden. His hard work, his dream, his brothers… were destroyed by Azure Dragon Hall just like this?
"Go to hell!"
With a furious roar, Wuyun Zhuo threw a heavy punch at Yan Xiaoxiao, but as soon as he stepped out, there seemed to be an invisible wall in front of him, blocking his way.
Crack!
His fist hit the invisible wall, and they suddenly heard the sound of the bones in his hand cracking, but the pain in his hand couldn’t alleviate the rage in Wuyun Zhuo’s heart.
Ye Chen still maintained a cold expression. He couldn’t even appear when Wu Gui City was overtaken because the invisible barrier around this statue trapped them here!
"You already knew about the existence of this statue long ago?" Ye Chen coldly questioned Yan Xiaoxiao.
As a young genius who started out as a child of destiny, he’d always looked down upon such unscrupulous villains!
However, Yan Xiaoxiao shook her head slightly. She didn’t even look at him and just gazed at that statue.
"Someone called me over… I don't know who or why," she seemed to be explaining, but she also seemed to be talking to herself, "now I know."
She slowly walked towards the statue, and with her actions, the invisible wall seemed to disappear.
When she reached the statue, she slowly said, "Who are you."
Then, under Ye Chen and Wuyun Zhuo’s shocked gazes, tiny dots of light appeared out of thin air and slowly converged into a human figure.
Ye Chen's pupils contracted. This person was too familiar to him—it was the woman without a shadow!
Xue Yan still had a hollow expression. There was a new handprint on her chest that emitted a strange energy that seemed to belong to neither Buddha nor demon, but her gaze was somewhat fanatical.
"Come and fuse together with me, my younger sister…"
……
Gu Nian took her two family members all the way to the city gates, but she suddenly stopped right in front of Wu Gui City.
"Eldest Miss?" Gu Sheng looked at her in confusion. Gu Sheng was also one the Gu family members who recently advanced to Prodigious Realm, and her breakthrough was even earlier than Gu Qing's.
Gu Nian didn't answer, but her gaze fell on a spot not far from them. It was on the other side of the city gates, where a figure was slowly appearing.
Lu Zhanyu walked up to the three of them with a strange smile on her face. "Eldest Miss Gu, we meet again."
"So the one behind Celestial Fortune Sect was actually you." Gu Nian narrowed her eyes, also studying Lu Zhanyu.
She was very close with Lu Xinyu but wasn’t too familiar with Lu Xinyu’s younger sister, Lu Zhanyu. Gu Nian had met Lu Zhanyu on Ruby Fish Star a few years back, but she didn’t expect to see her here.
‘And she actually made the same decision I did to come here… Even if she came here alone.’
"It doesn't matter who it is." Lu Zhanyu pointed to the white light that suddenly lit up Wu Gui City. "What's important is that the Immortal Demon Meeting has already started!"
Gu Nian gave her a deep look and said seriously to the two behind her, "Let's go."
The next moment, the three people’s figures vanished at the same time and quickly headed for the center of Wu Gui City, while Lu Zhanyu also followed them with a light smile.
What these people didn't know was that after they left, another person stepped out of the void.
This person was dressed in a moon-white robe. He stared at Lu Zhanyu’s disappearing figure and rubbed his chin with great interest. "Immortal Demon Meeting?"

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Goodbye, Overseer
chapters.content:
｢Evil Event triggered: Immortal Demon Meeting｣
The completely unreasonable Evil God Temple once again sent such a notification to Gu Nan just as he appeared in front of Wu Gui City, watching Lu Zhanyu and the Gu family members disappear.
Clearly, this was another Evil Event right under his nose. Just like the last "Nun—The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara" Evil Event, there was no need for Gu Nan to make a wild guess and chase for clues, but it would most certainly be difficult.
It was indeed like this in the mid- and late-stages of the game.
Especially after the appearance of personal dungeons, Evil Events will gradually overtake normal dungeons as players’ main source of Evil Value.
At the same time, the difficulty of triggering Evil Events will also increase, requiring players to explore on their own. Often, Evil Events can only be triggered when the player is right in front of them.
An event chain like the one Gu Nan encountered before that guided him to a Godhead step-by-step would probably never happen again.
Moreover, he would never even have encountered that event chain back then if not for the fact that a Godhead was truly too valuable.
"But since an Evil Event was triggered right now, it means something good is nearby." Gu Nan also had a deep understanding of the pattern behind Evil Events’ appearances.
In the last "Nun—The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara" Evil Event, his rewards might’ve been even greater if he actually managed to kill her.
……
Lu Zhanyu and Gu Nian saw a very strange scene when they reached the ruins.
Yan Xiaoxiao and an expressionless woman were staring at each other, and between them, an invisible chain bound Yan Xiaoxiao’s entire body, preventing her from moving.
"Void Cutter…" Gu Nian's expression didn’t look too good. She had way too little information at hand, so little that she couldn’t predict what sort of situation she’d encounter at all.
‘A grand Void Cutter powerhouse actually appeared just like this. So then, just how many bigshots are hidden behind the scenes here?’
She almost had the urge to turn around and leave. There were some things in this world that she couldn’t covet. Fortunately, it was just a reincarnation plane, which made her feel lucky.
"Fuse together… with me…" Xue Yan's voice was still echoing slowly, but at this time, a hand print descended from the air.
Wu Gui’s figure appeared in the air, slamming her hand down.
White light suddenly lit up above Xue Yan's head, unexpectedly blocking Wu Gui’s attack completely. Be it demonic intent or Buddhist energy, both were destroyed in this endless light.
"Immortal Demon Meeting—so you are that immortal?" Wu Gui’s gaze was a little cold when she realized that her attack had no effect.
On the other hand, Lu Zhanyu beside her had an epiphany. "Someone already foresaw this day a long time ago and took away one of the two core people in ‘Immortal Demon Meeting' in advance… What a grand plan!"
"What exactly is the Immortal Demon Meeting?" Gu Nian asked with a frown.
Since her life wasn’t currently in danger, she felt at ease spectating from the sidelines.
"In this world, there’s a natural-born immortal and a natural-born demon." Lu Zhanyu explained, "Someone predicted that the day the immortal and demon meet will be the day when that one’s inheritance appears."
What she didn't say was that another mastermind had already seen through such an arrangement many years ago and had taken the "natural-born immortal" away from this world!
‘But for some reason, the natural-born immortal returned again…’
"None of you can stop me." The young girl Wu Gui was still sitting upright on the black lotus, looking solemn and serene as her hand slowly reached out.
Intertwined golden and purple flames began to light up on her hand. She gently pressed her palm down, and a giant hand appeared out of thin air, pressing down on Xue Yan's head.
But Xue Yan still didn’t move an inch, although the light on top of her head became more blinding. While her endless light was dissipating, it was also eroding Wu Gui’s demonic intent.
The two seemed to be caught in a tug-of-war to see who would give in first.
Throughout all this, Xue Yan was still diverting some attention to keeping Yan Xiaoxiao tied up, although a faint black light began to flicker around the latter’s body.
But at this moment, a fist abruptly punched Xue Yan in the lower abdomen, which still had a handprint with lingering demonic and Buddhist energy.
It was Ye Chen!
This child of destiny Xue Yan personally brought over finally made the choice that best suited his heart at this critical moment.
‘Wu Gui’s enemy is also my enemy!’
A black lotus shone dazzlingly in his arms. It was the same black lotus Wu Gui gave him back then, which he used at this time.
Only with the power of this black lotus could he possibly affect Xue Yan, who was at the Void Cutter Realm.
With a solid punch, the white light surrounding Xue Yan suddenly contracted, and her entire person was sent flying, but her expression was still vacant, and not even her gaze changed.
Ye Chen seemed puzzled, but Wu Gui’s reaction was much faster.
Almost at the same time that Xue Yan flew out, Wu Gui had already appeared in front of the statue, reaching her hand out to press on the statue’s forehead.
"Don't! She’s the one who brought me here…" Ye Chen suddenly calmed down and seemed to understand something as he immediately shouted, but it was too late.
Just before Wu Gui touched the statue, another shadow appeared in front of her.
It was a huge corpse flower, but only its upper body was flower-shaped. The lower body had an upside-down face, looking very strange.
"Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara… Let the great Stephen send you into reincarnation once more!" A horrifying sound came out from the human face as the giant mouth of the corpse flower bit down instantly.
"Astral Gate!" Wu Gui gave an angry snort and threw out another hand print, rushing forward without hesitation to fight the corpse flower with her bare hand.
But the boundless light appeared behind her again.
Xue Yan seemed to be completely uninjured. She lifted a ball of light with one hand and smashed it down expressionlessly.
She exhausted all schemes for today’s situation, all to wipe out the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara in one fell swoop!
Wu Gui’s eyes finally turned a little angry. She began to realize that from the moment she awakened, she’d already fallen into a countless number of people’s schemes.
‘Stephen wants the inheritance, while the Shadowless One wants this world, but I’m the only one who wants both, so they tacitly teamed up with each other to force me into a hopeless situation!’
From beginning to end, the two Void Cutter cultivators teamed up without any prior communication whatsoever, yet they displayed such flawless coordination.
"Is this the end?" The girl who transformed from a Buddha into a demon felt her mind clear up the closer she was to this life and death crisis.
She placed her palms together in front of her, half gold and half purple, half Buddha and half demon.
But at this time, a fist appeared without any warning, seemingly directly smashing through the void. At the same time, it also avoided the three fighting Void Cutter experts and headed straight at the statue.
When the corpse flower realized this newcomer’s intention, his human face suddenly started shouting loudly, his voice full of panic, "D-Don’t!"
Boom!
There was a quiet muffled sound, followed by the sound of something breaking, and the statue began to crack little by little under everyone’s gaze.
"No…" The inverted face stared with wide eyes, as if he couldn't believe the scene before him.
The inheritance… shattered!
A figure slowly appeared next to the statue. This person was dressed in all white. He stared at the statue that had been splintered into pieces and smiled with satisfaction. "Goodbye, Overseer."
Thus, inside this world, space began to shatter, heaven and earth stopped operating, and everything began to return to primal chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Light and Darkness
chapters.content:
From the moment he saw the statue, Gu Nan realized that the root cause of this entire event was probably himself.
Others might not recognize this strange-looking statue, but it was abundantly clear to him—it was a statue of Zuo Zuo, the one he met in a personal dungeon and somehow found him in person.
Gu Nan was very confused about the purpose of Zuo Zuo's personal appearance back when he was hiding from the King of the Deep Sea. He once thought that Star Realm’s coordinates attracted the other party, but he felt that this didn't make sense.
The existence of Star Realm, one of the 72 Realms, had long been known by all major planes. Why would Zuo Zuo need Gu Nan to lead the way?
It wasn’t until he saw this statue that Gu Nan realized that what Zuo Zuo found on Gu Nan wasn’t Star Realm’s coordinates—rather, it was Immortal Demon World’s coordinates!
Thinking about it, Immortal Demon World probably used to be Zuo Zuo's Divine Kingdom, or astral world. After he was forced to leave for unknown reasons, he still left his statue behind as the overseer of the Divine Kingdom.
Only an Immortal Demon World that made a plane leap without Zuo Zuo’s permission would be able to free itself from Zuo Zuo’s control. It wasn’t until the appearance of an anomaly like Gu Nan that Zuo Zuo was able to rediscover Immortal Demon World’s trail.
After collecting all the thoughts in his head, Gu Nan's fist remained frozen in its original position, but the statue had already disappeared, leaving only fragments on the ground.
Xue Yan and the other two beside him all froze for a moment.
And taking advantage of this opportunity, Wu Gui finally found the chance to break away from the deadly fight. Her figure flashed away, escaping from the crisis.
The ball of light in Xue Yan’s hand slowly went out. She looked at Gu Nan with a slightly complicated gaze.
On the other hand, His Excellency Stephen, whose upper half was a flower and whose lower half was human, was in a completely crazed state—he had gone to great pains to obtain the inheritance left behind by that one, but now…
The statue representing the inheritance was smashed by Gu Nan's punch!
Stephen’s lower half with the inverted human face glared at Gu Nan with bloodshot eyes, sounding like a demon climbing out of the abyss, “You! Are! Courting! Death!"
The terrifying corpse flower floated in the air. Immediately after, he seemed to have teleported, immediately reappearing above Gu Nan's head. His bloody maw snapped at Gu Nan.
Gu Nan just looked up coldly and stretched out his right hand, directly grabbing one of the corpse flower’s jagged teeth.
Even Wu Gui had to use demonic energy to resist the corpse flower, but Gu Nan directly caught him with his bare hand!
Stephen’s human face smiled coldly. ‘He’s gravely mistaken if he thinks that my fangs are just sharp… Huh?’
The law of shredding attached to his fangs that he was so proud of actually didn’t take effect at all, disappearing formlessly as soon as the other party casually gripped a fang.
The next second, his entire body felt weightless—Gu Nan had directly lifted him up by the fang!
This picture had an extremely rich visual impact.
Gu Nan grabbed a fang with one hand and lifted a corpse flower dozens of times larger than himself above his head, then ferociously smashed him back onto the ground!
Boom!
Stephen’s gigantic body crashed down, smashing a hole into the ground. The soaring smoke obscured everyone's line of sight.
A moment later, Gu Nan's figure reappeared in their sight, while Stephen was lying on the ground motionlessly.
In only a single exchange, Gu Nan had already put down this corpse flower using the suddenness of law nullification and the terrifying strength of his Evil God physique.
"Sure enough, another bigshot joined the fight, but who would’ve imagined…” A bitter smile appeared on Lu Zhanyu’s face, her eyes fixed on Gu Nan in the air.
"...that it would be him," Gu Nian finished Lu Zhanyu’s sentence with an indescribable tone.
To say whose mood was the most complicated at this moment, it would certainly be the Eldest Miss Gu Nian.
After all, she personally brought Gu Nan up from a small plane, but he shot up like a rocket to Void Cutter Realm in an extremely short time.
Gu Nian, who never admitted defeat, felt an indelible sense of defeat for the first time.
Even when Gu Nan’s cultivation easily overtook her own a while back, she still believed that she could catch up again. After all, the secretive nature of her law would be the biggest aid for her future breakthrough.
But now…
That distant goal was easily achieved by Gu Nan.
"Do you also want this world?" Xue Yan's calm voice rang in Gu Nan's ear. "Simply shattering the statue is nowhere near enough."
She had no need for the inheritance. She just wanted to fuse together with her “younger sister,” so she could still keep calm even after the statue was broken.
"The law in this world is fusion. If you want to control it, you must first understand it," another voice rang out and smoothly continued the conversation, as if it were the same person talking.
Gu Nan turned to look and saw that Yan Xiaoxiao had already reached his side at some point.
The current her had a cold and detached expression, and even her eyes were glowing with a faint black light, but then that disappeared, and she revealed a familiar smile Gu Nan knew very well.
"Teacher, I want to try," Yan Xiaoxiao, who had once again become the Yan Xiaoxiao that Gu Nan was familiar with, said something very strange.
But Gu Nan understood what she meant and just nodded slightly.
The next moment, as if a mysterious force had descended upon Yan Xiaoxiao, her energy rapidly soared, becoming almost exactly the same as Xue Yan.
At the same time, with a gentle wave of her hand, the darkness that seemed to have surged up from the deepest abyss completely surrounded Gu Nan's entire body, frantically drilling into his body.
Using some kind of special law, Yan Xiaoxiao’s cultivation actually temporarily advanced to Void Cutter Realm!
"Light and darkness; assimilation and permeation—two sides of the law of fusion?" Gu Nan was so familiar with the laws of the world that he saw through her law almost at a glance.
The core law in Zuo Zuo's Immortal Demon World was fusion, while Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao respectively inherited the two sides of "fusion"—the assimilating power of light and the permeating power of darkness.
It was no wonder that Gu Nan felt her law was a bit odd when Yan Xiaoxiao advanced to Prodigious Realm back then. Her law wasn’t like the normal law of wind; rather, it was the law of permeation.
Permeation, that is, to spread pervasively throughout everything.
The boundless darkness was like countless wildly wriggling worms, quickly drilling into Gu Nan's ears, nose, and eyes, as if to fill him up.
Unfortunately, before the darkness could come over him, Gu Nan's heart brightened slightly, the law nullification attribute instantly activating and wiping out the boundless darkness.
From the outside, it looked as if Gu Nan had a barrier around his body, isolating all the darkness outside.
"The power of law nullification," Yan Xiaoxiao and Xue Yan spoke at the same time, their voices already completely synchronized. Even their originally different voices gradually sounded similar.
At this time, the churning of heaven and earth had become more and more intense. Without anyone controlling the core law any longer, this world was already on the verge of collapse.
But this was a good thing for Gu Nan, because it meant that he could now take over this world.
"Let’s not waste more time." Gu Nan dispersed the darkness around him with a wave of his hand, and his face began to show a fierce smile.
"Won’t this place be mine as long as I kill the two of you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Tailor-Made and Decisiveness
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was actually very knowledgeable on how to take control of a world.
To explain it in the game’s words, it essentially involved turning a normal dungeon into the player’s personal dungeon. Gu Nan was already exceedingly familiar with this process.
Discover the dungeon’s core law, then kill the boss inside the dungeon who has the ability to control this law—this boss will often be the dungeon’s ruler.
Of course, Immortal Demon World was different.
Zuo Zuo had clearly already abandoned this place and re-established his astral world elsewhere. After the statue was shattered, only Yan Xiaoxiao and Xue Yan, the twins, could compete with him for the right to control this world.
As soon as Gu Nan's voice fell, his body exploded with power, and a fist mixed with the power of law nullification punched towards Yan Xiaoxiao, the nearest enemy, without hesitation.
"It's useless." As Yan Xiaoxiao's voice rang out, a dim light flashed from the shattered remains of the statue, inexplicably isolating Gu Nan.
Gu Nan was very familiar with this kind of power. It was the repulsive force from Immortal Demon World, except this time it isolated him from everyone else.
"If you want to control ‘fusion,’ you must first fuse completely with something. We are originally one to begin with, but who are you willing to fuse with?"
Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao said simultaneously, holding hands as if they were one person.
A person slowly appeared in front of Gu Nan. It was an unfamiliar Prodigious cultivator who didn't even know why he appeared here and was looking around in astonishment.
Information inexplicably entered Gu Nan's mind. Only when he decides to fuse together with the person in front of him will he obtain the right to fight for control over the law of fusion.
Gu Nan's expression looked a little ugly. He knew that, in fact, Zuo Zuo screwed him over this time.
In order to make his own arrangement a reality, Zuo Zuo deliberately set up such a strange condition, which was completely tailor-made for Yan Xiaoxiao and Xue Yan!
Besides the two of them, who else would be willing to fuse their own soul with someone else’s?
It was no different from when certain employers in Gu Nan's past life recruited civil servants—they directly stated that the candidate must have a certain surname, be a graduate of a certain university with a certain major, and the candidate’s height must be 1.75 meters and can’t even be one centimeter short.
"Don’t you guys feel like you’re obeying an imperial edict when you do this?"
Gu Nan rolled his eyes and said something that the two couldn't understand, then punched the person in front of him into smithereens without hesitation.
But the law of fusion was even faster. Without any delay, another Prodigious cultivator’s soul was caught and appeared in front of Gu Nan.
The person this time could be considered an acquaintance. It was precisely Gu Nian’s junior brother in the Gu family, Gu Qing.
He had even met Gu Nan before when he was in the Gu family. At this time, he immediately blurted out, "Young Master Nan…"
Bang!
Gu Nan didn’t have any scruples about killing acquaintances. Gu Qing's head was also blasted to pieces. His soul instantly scattered into nothingness, and the next fusion target reappeared.
The third one, the fourth one… Just like this, Gu Nan killed them one after another.
"Your actions are meaningless."
It was now Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao's turn to frown. They didn’t understand Gu Nan's actions. ‘Don’t tell me he still wants to wait for a suitable fusion target to appear?’
But in reality, nobody was a particularly suitable fusion target for Gu Nan. It would be the same no matter who he chose.
However, on the other side, a voice slowly spoke from among the spectators, “He might be planning to… kill everyone."
Lu Zhanyu’s face was pale as she stared at Gu Nan. She was the one who spoke just now. She, who once worked with Gu Nan on missions, knew Gu Nan's thought process better than anyone else.
‘As long as everyone is killed, there will be no fusion target for him anymore… He really is capable of doing such a thing!’
While she was talking, Gu Nan's killing was becoming more and more efficient—he still needed one punch to off Prodigious cultivators, but he only needed to move a thought to use his law to pulverize those below Prodigious realm.
"Slaughter the whole world?" Even Wu Gui raised her eyebrows slightly. Not even she had ever considered such a crazy notion before.
Gu Nan was still wordlessly killing everyone who appeared before him. He was indeed planning on doing exactly that.
There were obvious flaws in the law of fusion’s requirements. As long as less than two fusion targets remained in this world, then the law would naturally be unable to capture a second fusion target for Gu Nan, and it would naturally fail to meet its own requirement.
Under such circumstances, the law would automatically enter a sealed state, which players would then be able to manipulate at will—this wasn’t the first time players found loopholes in the system.
And in reality, Gu Nan actually needed to kill a lot less people than imagined.
Those who didn’t cultivate to a certain realm couldn’t be captured because their souls weren’t strong enough, and they would be directly annihilated in the collection process.
In other words, Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao were running out of time.
As if they realized this, the speed of the two women's fusion suddenly accelerated, but the next person to do something wasn’t Wu Gui, but Stephen lying on the ground.
This corpse flower pretended to be dead for quite a while, but then he suddenly jumped up. While Gu Nan didn't have time to pay attention to him, he tore open the void and shot into the portal.
Wu Gui shook her head slightly. She also broke through the void with a wave of her hand and offhandedly took Ye Chen with her while leaving.
The inheritance was destroyed, and it was meaningless for her to merely get this world, so she very smartly chose to leave—while Gu Nan was still uninterested in killing her.
Only Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu remained in the scene, looking at each other with bitter smiles.
They didn’t have the power to tear open space, so naturally they couldn’t escape. They could only wait for Gu Nan to “pull” them and become a departed spirit under his fist.
The two women both knew Gu Nan very well. Neither believed that he was someone who would care about old acquaintances.
As for reincarnation, it didn’t matter anymore—even this world was collapsing. How could they possibly take back the half of their souls stored inside the world’s origin?
Even the method of terminating reincarnation failed, so death seemed to be the only path that awaited the two.
"There's another way," Gu Nian said in a heavy voice.
Lu Zhanyu stared blankly for a few seconds, then turned to look at Gu Nian, who was looking at Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao, as well as the radiance given off by the statue’s pieces.
She understood the other party’s meaning. In the end, Gu Nian was still the more decisive one in this do or die situation.
"We have no other choice. There’s no other way out. Indeed, we can only fight for this miniscule chance," Lu Zhanyu smiled self-mockingly and looked at Gu Nian again.
Gu Nian’s eyes contained only decisiveness. She stretched out her right hand and placed it in front of Lu Zhanyu, who took it without hesitation.
Just like Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao, the two of them slowly walked to the front of the statue fragments, and an inexplicable force began to descend upon them.
Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao opened their eyes in astonishment, only to see an indescribable and mysterious connection appear between Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu, which was still rapidly strengthening.
A pair of unexpected competitors.
If they wanted to have a chance of survival under Gu Nan's hands, they had to personally enter this fusion competition!
As long as they started the fusion process, they could at least ensure their souls’ safety; the law of fusion wouldn’t directly "sacrifice" them to Gu Nan.
Now it was a race to see whether Gu Nan would finish killing off all living creatures in this world first or whether they would finish taking control of this world’s origin first.
But at this time, a scene that no one expected happened.
When Gu Nan destroyed yet another fusion target, the law of fusion seemed to freeze slightly in between captures, then slowly materialized a figure.
And the soul that appeared this time was a giant corpse flower—this was Stephen, who’d just fled into the void!
"Why…" Stephen’s inverted human face exclaimed in disbelief. He couldn’t understand why the law that could only act upon this world would also affect him, someone who had already torn through space and left.
But his confusion didn’t affect Gu Nan's actions at all.
The heart symbolizing the power of law nullification was beating slowly. Gu Nan raised his fist and began to show a nasty grin on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Corpse Flowers Death
chapters.content:
Immortal Demon World was like an inescapable cage. Even though Stephen had already torn through space, some kind of force still pulled him back.
His status as a Void Cutter cultivator didn't allow him to avoid this disaster. Rather, it just gave him some privileges—his actual body returned as well, not just his soul.
Without giving him any time to think, Gu Nan's fist had already reached him.
In order to bring out the law nullification attribute’s special characteristics as much as possible, he had already abandoned the shadow sword and even stopped using the “infinite crit damage” attack from the law of substitution.
At this stage, the law nullification power was undoubtedly his most powerful attack, and only a few special powers could neutralize it.
Unlike certain people, Gu Nan never hid his trump cards one after another. Rather, he preferred to use his full power to kill the enemy as soon as he attacked.
This habit was based on the foundation that Gu Nan had enough diversified methods to pick from.
Either kill the enemy in one blow, or make the enemy expose as many weak points as possible, then attack those weaknesses. This was Gu Nan's logic.
Boom!
The fist hit Stephen without hindrance, and all of the latter’s laws and defense became a joke.
Fortunately, because of the special constitution of the giant corpse flower, he wasn’t killed in a single blow. He merely roared in pain as the tentacles in the middle of his body began to wildly whip around in the air, forming many ripples in the air.
"Your Excellency… There’s no need for us to fight to the death…" His human face coughed up a mouthful of blood and managed to say with some difficulty.
Boom!
What greeted him was still a punch.
Gu Nan never even thought about cooperating with Stephen. He only believed in his own judgment. He knew how to take control of a world better than anyone else.
Unless he had the power to directly subdue the entire world, he could only follow the preset rules. You can take advantage of loopholes in the rules, but you can't violate them.
Another punch flew at him, and Stephen’s entire body was blown away.
If not for the barrier isolating the two of them from the rest of the world, Gu Nan could even use the corpse flower to hit cattle from all the way across the mountain and kill Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu using the aftershocks of their battle.
Even just the aftershocks from a battle between Void Cutter cultivators wasn’t something Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu could endure.
Although Gu Nan was in a killing frenzy, his mind remained clear from beginning to end and he was able to calmly analyze the present situation.
The fact that Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu actually made the decision to fuse together with each other was indeed a surprise to him.
Moreover, judging from their progress, these two sensible women showed unimaginable decisiveness when faced with the choice of life or death.
At first, they were nearly a hundred steps away from the ball of light, but they had already walked half of that distance in the blink of an eye.
Yan Xiaoxiao and Xue Yan, on the other hand, started only fifteen steps away from the goal, but now they still had one last step to walk.
After being thoroughly thrashed by Gu Nan, Stephen finally understood that he couldn't just sit still and wait for death.
He stood up again in a rage, and several tentacles whipped towards Gu Nan. "Bastard! The great Stephen will make you… Ah!"
Gu Nan seemed completely unaffected by the heavy tentacles from the corpse flower, simply allowing them to whip his body.
The next moment, he grabbed two tentacles and ruthlessly pulled them back, ripping the tentacles from the main body and even bringing some of the corpse flower’s flesh along.
This Lord Stephen’s upper half was a corpse flower plant, and that enormous maw was made of fiber, but his lower body was that of a certain animal. It was clear that the tentacles belonged to the animal half.
The tentacles were torn off by Gu Nan, revealing the flesh and blood still squirming inside, which exposed Stephen’s actual identity.
A fellow who was a fusion of two living creatures; that was also why he came here—only half-and-half existences like him and the half-Buddha half-demon Wu Gui would be interested in the law of fusion.
How could normal people be willing to fuse together with someone else?
Gu Nan's figure blurred and appeared in the sky above Stephen again. With a light wave of his right hand, a huge shadow sword suddenly appeared, ruthlessly piercing the latter's flesh.
Stephen didn't even have a chance to scream this time. Gu Nan finally activated his own law of substitution.
The law of shadows that had been superimposed dozens of times directly destroyed the corpse flower’s whole body from the inside, making the latter instantly explode into countless pieces of flesh.
A distinguished Void Cutter powerhouse died in Gu Nan's hands just like that. Even until he died, he wasn’t able to cause many ripples at all.
But this wasn’t his fault. Faced with Gu Nan, this kind of bug-like existence, not even the great Lord Stephen could do anything.
A while back, Luo Fei dared to challenge Gu Nan as soon as she obtained the law nullification power. One could well imagine how powerful it was.
And Gu Nan's compatibility with the law nullification attribute far surpassed Luo Fei's—the reason was very simple, because he had the Evil God physique!
By using the power of law nullification, he could nullify all laws and force the opponent into the same state as himself—that is, they can only use their bodies’ physical strength to fight.
And speaking of the strength of one’s physical body, Gu Nan really hadn’t lost before.
After getting rid of Stephen, new opponents began to appear in front of Gu Nan once more, but Wu Gui and Ye Chen never reappeared.
‘Why was Stephen pulled back, but neither of those two were pulled back?’ Gu Nan, who continued his killing spree, still had the leisure time to think about this problem in his mind.
‘It's not due to their cultivation realms, nor the nature of their powers. Could it be… the soul?!’
The experiment he repeated for three months in a row appeared in Gu Nan's mind again, which gave him an epiphany.
Everyone who entered Immortal Demon World had half of their souls replaced by the world’s origin. Presumably, the natives also received the same treatment from the world. Half of their souls were taken away as soon as they were born.
Precisely because of this, the world could pull their souls here to fight Gu Nan.
But Wu Gui entered by directly tearing a hole in the void, and Ye Chen must’ve kept his original soul intact, but Stephen was different.
He entered through Lu Zhanyu’s Astral Gate from the Myriad Universe Starry Road!
"Keep half of all the residents’ souls as a means to control them. It truly is… perfect!" Gu Nan's desire to control Immortal Demon World was getting stronger and stronger.
The living conditions of people inside the Divine Kingdom was a joke to players. They merely want the Divine Kingdom to provide them with power.
To perfectly control all residents’ souls and extract their powers at will…
If such a powerful setting truly existed, it would definitely be the ideal Divine Kingdom every player dreamed of!
Thinking of this, Gu Nan's actions, which were already approaching the limits of speed, accelerated a bit again. In his calculation, his killing spree was approaching the end.
Immortal Demon World had quite a high population, but how many cultivators were strong enough to be pulled here?
Those who were qualified to have their souls pulled here were at least in the middle of Innate Realm. Even if eligible cultivators from all three superpowers here were summed up, the number wouldn’t possibly exceed 100,000 people.
And with Gu Nan's speed of killing several people instantly like this, it really wouldn’t take long at all.
But although Gu Nan killed quickly, others were faster than him. On the other side, Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu held hands and had already reached Xue Yan's side.
They were only one step away from the world’s origin.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: Taking Control
chapters.content:
"You two…" Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao spoke simultaneously. They clearly felt incredulous about the sudden increase in competition.
"The essence of fusion is to link your souls with each other and connect your minds together," Lu Zhanyu said softly as she continued to take a step forward.
"You two were originally born as one. Your wills influenced each other, but instead you kept your remaining ego. How can the two of you fuse completely when you’re like that?" Gu Nian finished her words and stepped forward as well.
The two of them gently placed their clasped-together hands on that ball of light.
The final step that Xue Yan and Yan Xiaoxiao still couldn’t take seemed unable to obstruct Gu Nian and Lu Zhanyu at all.
"Why." Xue Yan stiffly turned her head. She knew that she had no distracting thoughts, so the problem was definitely Yan Xiaoxiao.
Yan Xiaoxiao didn't speak, but her originally blank expression began to contort, looking like she was both crying and smiling.
"Teacher…"
When she uttered that word, the connection between her and Xue Yan collapsed with an explosion, and all the black light on her body disappeared, only leaving behind an ordinary-looking girl.
She, who originally should’ve erased all her emotions, still had one last remaining ego inside her heart. It was the part that belonged to Gu Nan.
That eternally unreachable teacher who first led her onto the path of killing had been deeply imprinted in her personality.
The next moment, Gu Nan began to stop, because as the ball of light was touched, no new opponent appeared in front of him anymore.
"In the end, we won." Lu Zhanyu began to smile. She, who had taken control of the world’s origin, could clearly feel her power expand.
This feeling of controlling the entire world was really too wonderful.
But only she herself knew exactly how high of a price they paid for this. From this moment on, her life would forever be connected with another person’s.
Bam!
Lu Zhanyu's smile was still frozen on her face, but her head had already been smashed apart. Gu Nan’s figure appeared beside her as Lu Zhanyu’s blood splashed all over Gu Nian’s unsuspecting face.
"Who said that you won’t be killed as long as you controlled the world’s origin?" Gu Nan shook his hand and muttered to himself with some confusion.
Even the statue Zuo Zuo left behind could be smashed. What use would just controlling the world’s origin be?
Gu Nian watched all this with a dumbfounded expression. Lu Zhanyu's soul was directly destroyed, and their connection from the deepest part of her soul made her suffer a heavy blow as well.
Her face quickly aged and even withered. Her body also gradually dried up, then drifted away like dust in the wind.
"But you two really did me a great favor." Gu Nan revealed a smile as the law of shadows instantly invaded the world’s origin.
This time, his objective wasn’t to control it, so he didn't attract the world's rejection. Instead, he simply did something he was very skilled at.
Just like the three months of experiments he repeated, the power of shadows engraved a mysterious pattern—it was precisely Immortal Demon World’s array for capturing souls!
The world’s origin used this array to take away half of all its residents’ souls. Now, Gu Nan used the same method to take those souls away from the world’s origin.
In the blink of an eye, the world’s origin was directly emptied, and the surviving reincarnators inside Immortal Demon World immediately returned, while the indigenous people were completely unaware of what just transpired.
Gu Nan finally showed a satisfied look. His three months of hard work wasn’t in vain after all. It came in handy at this time.
Then the law of shadows started to take control of the world again, and this time there was no resistance from the world’s origin.
It could no longer forcibly provide Gu Nan with fusion targets. Just like the rules in the game, it began to enter a self-sealed state and could only wait for Gu Nan to control it bit by bit.
However, unlike Lu Zhanyu, who could freely control it, not only could Gu Nan not freely control it, but trying to control the world’s origin actually occupied the vast majority of his law of shadows.
"The majority of your power should already be sealed right now…" Xue Yan’s empty voice was like a gust of cold wind, calm yet secretive. It made people’s entire bodies feel cold.
Yan Xiaoxiao, who still had a tiny connection to Xue Yan, instantly changed her expression. “Teacher, leave quickly!”
But all her strength actually came from Xue Yan. Now that the power connection between the two was severed, she couldn’t do anything at all.
The next moment, endless light resurfaced. Xue Yan was already right next to Gu Nan. "Fuse together with me…"
"Manipulator of shadows, our powers both originate from the same source…”
Bam!
Gu Nan punched her in the face, but in a rare occurrence, she wasn’t sent flying. He just broke her nose, and Xue Yan's face instantly bled profusely.
"Quite tough! As expected of the law of light…" Gu Nan shook his hand a few times and commented.
Light and shadow were indeed two sides of the same coin, but the Xue Yan in front of him clearly walked a different path compared to him.
She wanted to turn her entire body into light. If she becomes a Star Ruler in the future, she might really just achieve the level of "the light is me, and I am the light."
"Ah—"
A scream came from Xue Yan's mouth, and her body exuded boundless brilliance, which enveloped Gu Nan in an instant.
"Teacher…" Yan Xiaoxiao stood by in a daze. Her connection with Xue Yan had completely disappeared, so she didn’t know what was happening inside.
But she could guess.
‘Now that Teacher fell directly into Xue Yan’s radiant light without any strength to fight back…’
But before she could despair, the endless brilliance retreated, revealing Gu Nan's perfectly intact body.
"What the hell… is your body made of!” Xue Yan's extremely weak voice was full of rage.
She couldn’t imagine that her own invincible law of light would fail to even erode the enemy’s skin when the other side was clearly powerless right now!
On the contrary, she actually fell into a weakened state because she overused her law of light.
Gu Nan, who was still controlling the law of shadows to invade the world’s origin, shrugged.
With the 80% damage reduction from Resistance, not even the law nullification attribute could hurt him, let alone this degree of erosion.
Originally, he wanted to wait until after he’d completely taken control of the world’s origin to deal with Xue Yan, but since she delivered herself to his doorsteps, he naturally had no reason to refuse this gift.
The heart inside his Evil God physique thumped slightly, and his right hand, infused with the law nullification attribute, stabbed directly into Xue Yan's chest, instantly killing her.
……
An hour later, deep in the endless starry sky, a red-haired girl slowly opened her eyes.
"Xue Yan is dead." Looking somewhat puzzled, she frowned and said to herself, "He didn't intervene in that world, or else I would’ve known… So who killed Xue Yan?"
Behind her back, countless armored servants silently knelt on one knee.
"Your Majesty, should we…"
The girl shook her head gently. "Have Starry Ocean Pavilion handle it. Star Realm has been peaceful for too many years."
……
Inside the Myriad Heavens Starry Road, Zuo Zuo was looking into Immortal Demon World from the outside with a chuckle. There was an odd smile on the left side of his face that resembled an eerie girl’s face.
"To think you have this sort of law… You’ll be of great help to me." He reached out and grabbed something gently, and a wisp of soul was caught in his hand. Zuo Zuo’s figure then vanished instantly.
It’s just that the soul he grabbed showed Gu Nian’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Handling the Aftermath
chapters.content:
｢Evil Event Complete: Immortal Demon Meeting. Total Evil Value obtained: 150｣
As the dust settled, information came from the Evil God Temple in due course. Gu Nan's QQ coins… no, Evil Value, arrived in his account.
This was Gu Nan’s first Evil Event since he reached Tier 4, and the reward was far richer than before, but it wasn’t beyond Gu Nan's expectations.
As players leveled up, the event rewards would inevitably increase.
Of course that wasn’t because the game wanted to make it easier for players to level up, but because the higher the level, the more difficult it was to trigger Evil Events, and their difficulty levels would be higher, so the rewards would increase accordingly.
After getting this reward, Gu Nan's Evil Value had already surpassed the 1,000 mark in one fell stroke, and with Lan Si’s efforts during this period, it reached 1,044 Evil Value.
And he also had 2,400 points right now, which was from basically sucking the personal dungeon "Splendid World” dry.
‘It’s barely enough to build the second law…’ Gu Nan silently calculated in his heart.
But it wasn’t the time yet. Matters in Immortal Demon World should be handled first.
He looked at Yan Xiaoxiao, who was perfectly intact next to him, and revealed some confusion. "I thought you’d also disappear along with her when Xue Yan died."
Gu Nan was still far from thoroughly understanding the Immortal Demon World that Zuo Zuo left behind, and there was still much about the extremely rare law of "fusion” that he needed to study.
Just like how Gu Nian instantly aged and withered away when Lu Zhanyu's soul was destroyed by him, both sides of a soul fusion were indistinguishable from each other.
Xue Yan was already completely dead, yet Yan Xiaoxiao could still survive. This was truly strange.
"From the moment she was taken away, it was a foregone conclusion that only one of us would survive,” Yan Xiaoxiao recounted in a calm tone, but her voice sounded quite helpless.
If there was no Gu Nan, maybe she and Xue Yan would’ve suddenly drawn their swords at each other at the last second before the fusion.
Yan Xiaoxiao read all of Xue Yan’s memories. There were certain things that Xue Yan, who had little worldly experience, didn’t understand, but Yan Xiaoxiao understood them very well.
‘That one in the deepest part of the starry sky…’
That apathetic figure dressed in red involuntarily flashed through her mind again.
"So is Teacher going to kill me?" Yan Xiaoxiao withdrew her gaze and looked at Gu Nan with a light smile.
Gu Nan shook his head. Who was still alive in the current Immortal Demon World was meaningless to him. He also didn’t care about Yan Xiaoxiao's life and death.
Gu Nan looked down at the world’s origin in his hand. It was being slowly eroded by the power of shadows.
Because Gu Nan emptied all the captured souls inside the world’s origin, it could no longer provide him with a fusion target and automatically entered a sealed state where Gu Nan could slowly take control.
"It's just a little slow…" Gu Nan muttered to himself.
Judging from this takeover speed, it would take at least several years for him to truly control this world’s origin.
Fortunately, he was doing this inside Immortal Demon World, where the flow of time was ten to one with that of Star Realm.
At the end of the day, it was because his level wasn’t high enough. After all, converting a dungeon into a personal dungeon was something that Tier 5 players did. It was still a little too early for the current Gu Nan.
If Gu Nan was already Tier 5 right now, the time needed would be greatly reduced.
However, it was also necessary to sort out this place before truly taking control of Immortal Demon World.
In the Evil God game, there were many playstyles regarding Divine Kingdoms. Besides the "combat style" gameplay given out by the game’s official channel, players could freely develop their own ideas.
Those who liked scenery and landscapes could build marvelous buildings, develop new races, and manage the Divine Kingdoms as they wished using beauty and aesthetics as the standard.
Those who liked to manage and operate their Divine Kingdoms could personally develop civilizations and guide the people of the Divine Kingdom onto the direction players want. Concepts of race, ethnicity, aesthetics, and values… Everything could be decided by you.
The faction who valued combat effectiveness was simpler and more direct. This type of player’s only purpose was to increase the average fighting strength of the Divine Kingdom’s residents so that they could provide a source of strength for the player ruling that Divine Kingdom.
So Gu Nan currently needed to manage this world ahead of time and raise high-level cultivators.
Of course, there would be matters both large and small that would need to be handled if he wanted to manage and operate the Divine Kingdom. It was certainly impossible for Gu Nan to handle everything himself. He needed an assistant or even a group of assistants to aid him.
"So…" He turned to look at Yan Xiaoxiao. "Would you like to become this world’s administrator?"
……
