Red Tail looked surprised when Lan Si appeared in front of her on Heaven and Earth Star.
“You returned so quickly. Did Lord settle all the matters in Immortal Demon World? We can no longer contact that side."
Lan Si shook her head slightly. She’d just been randomly kicked out of the reincarnation process. Even now, she still didn't understand what had happened.
Now, however, her brain seemed to be a little easier to use, and she heard some other meaning from Red Tail's words. She looked up and asked, "Did something happen here?"
Red Tail was silent for a while, then smiled bitterly. "Nothing has happened yet, but I'm afraid it won't be quiet for long."
While saying so, she picked up an odd-looking letter paper from the side and handed it to Lan Si, with the large words "Starry Ocean Pavilion" written on the cover.
"This…" Lan Si looked up in astonishment. She was no longer the ignorant girl from back then and knew all too well what these three words meant.
"Starry Ocean Pavilion and the federation issued a joint order requiring all Prodigious Realm cultivators to travel to the Central Region for certification, and ‘cultivating without a license' will be prohibited in Star Realm in the future." Red Tail’s expression looked very helpless.
Lan Si had never been to the Central Region before, so she felt incredulous about such an overbearing order.
"Who knows just how many Prodigious cultivators there are in the other eight regions—yet they actually dare to do this?" Her voice rose slightly. "Will anyone really listen to them?"
"Based on their habits, they’ll send an inspection team to each region." Red Tail clearly knew Starry Ocean Pavilion’s style. "At least two Void Cutter experts will be leading each team.”
……
In Immortal Demon World, Gu Nan looked at this broken world and couldn't help shaking his head slightly.
"The world’s origin sealed itself, so contact with the outside world has also been temporarily cut off."
In today's Immortal Demon World, Void Cutter cultivators could still forcibly enter from the outside, but it was impossible for those below Void Cutter Realm to enter—after all, this world no longer accepted reincarnators.
Not even Gu Nan himself could conveniently leave Immortal Demon World before he had a tentative grasp over the world’s origin, nor was he interested in other matters for the time being.
The only thing he truly cared about on Heaven and Earth Sar was the steady stream of Evil Value from Lan Si.
Under his arrangement, Yan Xiaoxiao had gone to clean up the aftermath, and the civilization on Immortal Demon World would soon usher in a worldwide peak and revolution.
It would be a completely alien and incomprehensible social system belonging solely to players.
"Start the reconstruction of the Divine Kingdom first, wait until everything is on the right track and the world’s origin can be preliminarily controlled, then consider matters over there."
Gu Nan made a decision quickly, but before that, he had something else to do.
His consciousness rapidly sank into the Evil God Temple, and Gu Nan called up his own game panel—since Evil Value exceeded 1,000, he could already build his second exclusive law now!

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Law of Resurrection
chapters.content:
｢Beginning construction of the second exclusive law｣
｢To extract from existing laws, please select from your known abilities｣
｢The selected abilities are as follows: Praise of Dawn and Resistance. Confirm?｣
｢Please determine the ratio of each ability inputted…｣
｢Constructing exclusive law…｣
A series of notices popped up while Gu Nan was operating the game panel in the Evil God Temple. He was currently building an exclusive law and had already entered the waiting stage.
The construction of laws was a very interesting mechanic in the Evil God game.
What kind of laws a player could construct depended entirely on the materials invested and the ratio of the inputted abilities. And the source of the materials was the equipment and skills that players held.
Thus, constructing one’s desired law became a science.
Fortunately, Tier 4 was just the beginning of the game, so players were brave enough to experiment—even if they had to scrap the save files entirely, it still wasn’t a big loss.
After the blood and tears of countless predecessors, players finally summed up the following three rules:
1. Never invest more than three abilities at a time, or else it’d be no different from buying lottery tickets.
2. The constructed law is related to the types of abilities inputted, but they’re not absolutely related.
3. The ratio of inputted abilities is very important! Very important! Very important!
If you throw in too many abilities at once, the final product will be a law that basically has no connection whatsoever to any of the ingredient abilities, and it might even deviate to form a type of ability you’d never imagined.
The final law doesn't depend entirely on the type of abilities thrown in. Just because two high-damage abilities were thrown into the mix doesn’t mean the end product will definitely be an attack-type law; it could also be a healing law.
On the other hand, the ratio of inputted abilities was sometimes more important than the invested abilities themselves. The ratio was what truly determined the direction of the end product.
Of course, having said so much, all this was actually meaningless for Gu Nan.
He didn’t need to experiment at all. The formula he adopted had naturally been tested countless times in his previous life, and the result was completely certain.
｢Construction of the second exclusive law ‘resurrection' has been completed｣
Gu Nan's eyes lit up as he immediately opened his own panel to check. Sure enough, he saw the law of resurrection lying there quietly.
The law of resurrection wasn’t actually the law that Gu Nan originally planned for himself, but one that he decided to build at the very last minute after he got Immortal Demon World.
The law of resurrection was derived from the two abilities of "Praise of Dawn" and "Resistance." The name sounded like it had a recovery effect, but in fact, it had nothing to do with recovery.
This law wasn’t supposed to be used on Gu Nan himself, but for others!
The correct way to use resurrection was: people Gu Nan killed with the power of shadows or people who had the law of shadows successfully infused into them shortly after their deaths could be resurrected using Shadow Form.
This kind of narrative seemed a little complicated, but it was actually very simple—this was a necromancy law.
As long as Gu Nan personally killed them or discovered their corpses shortly after they died, he could resurrect them as his own shadow clones and command them.
Based on the game, the revived shadow clones would retain their core abilities after resurrection, but besides some special circumstances, most of them wouldn’t retain any memories of their former lives.
If a monster had a relatively higher level, it would possess a certain degree of intelligence after resurrection, but this intelligence would come from the law of resurrection and wouldn’t have much to do with their actual intelligence while alive.
Gu Nan's will returned to reality. He felt the aura of this new law and revealed a satisfied smile.
"Thanks to this, I won’t have to worry about finding enough people to manage the Divine Kingdom."
Of course Gu Nan’s decision to build a law of resurrection at the last minute wasn’t for fun. His ultimate goal was to run his own Divine Kingdom—reincarnators were ultimately unreliable, and natives were disobedient, so he could only create his own servants.
Actually, the law of resurrection was a little unsuited for players like himself who walked the route of strengthening themselves. Usually, only players who picked summoner playstyles would choose this law.
Because the resurrected servants wouldn’t be of much help in combat. They were only used for management.
So Gu Nan actually lost out on a law.
However, if other players had such an opportunity, they would absolutely be willing to do it—this was an opportunity to start running a Divine Kingdom at Tier 4!
It was a pity that he didn’t have this law when he killed Lu Zhanyu, Gu Nian, and Stephen before. Otherwise, bringing them back to life would be equivalent to having many subordinates.
……
In a small manor in Wu Gui City, Gu Nan sat leisurely in a rocking chair with a book covering his face.
It was currently noon. Sunlight shone down, making people feel lazy.
More than two months had already passed since that great battle. The world’s origin was stabilizing once again, and the turmoil in heaven and earth was gradually recovering.
The chaotic battle, known as the "Great Annihilation," was said to have been an all-out fight between several top-level cultivators. Their battle tore the sky apart, split the earth, and dimmed the sun and moon. Even the sun disappeared for several days.
To the public, Azure Dragon Hall’s Hall Master was the final winner of that battle—after all, she was the only one who returned alive.
"Teacher…" Yan Xiaoxiao stood beside Gu Nan and lifted the book covering the latter's face as she said helplessly, "The Yan Dynasty and Celestial Fortune Sect have both announced their surrender. Should we accept them?"
"Of course!" Gu Nan spoke decisively but yawned again. "Try to resolve it peacefully. Don’t kill too many people."
Yan Xiaoxiao looked like she’d seen a ghost and gave him an odd look, as if she didn’t recognize him.
Gu Nan noticed her gaze and explained, "Even a civilian is worth one basic unit of divine power. What a pity it would be to kill them… You can just understand it as me being merciful and compassionate."
The power of the living creatures inside the Divine Kingdom directly corresponds to the maximum power players can receive from the Divine Kingdom.
And in a good place like Immortal Demon World, Gu Nan could directly extract power from the natives, which meant that he could always get the maximum possible power!
While players didn’t have to take NPCs’ lives seriously, they were absolutely stingy when it came to their own possessions and would turn on whoever touched their belongings without a second thought.
Of course Yan Xiaoxiao didn't understand his words, but she understood his general meaning. ‘Basically, the lives of the populace are useful to Teacher…’
"Are there many cultivators left?" Gu Nan asked.
"There are, but there aren’t a lot of powerful ones left, especially Prodigious cultivators…” Yan Xiaoxiao gave him a strange look as she answered.
She knew better than anyone else just whose hand those powerful cultivators died in.
"I see." Gu Nan frowned a little. "Then we can only find a way to raise them again."
Yan Xiaoxiao's eyes lit up. "Those reincarnators from earlier left behind a lot of cultivation methods. If we establish a unified country and carry out a plan to raise cultivators with our national power, the strength of cultivators will certainly improve quickly!"
As the ruler of Azure Dragon Hall for over 20 years, Yan Xiaoxiao had certainly considered this problem before.
She’d even thought about what kind of system she would set up if she ever got to own a unified empire, so as to achieve the best effect of promoting talents and getting the largest number of core forces.
"No, we don't need a unified empire." But Gu Nan clearly didn’t intend to use her suggestion.
Gu Nan looked at her and asked, "Do you know which place produces the largest number of powerful experts?"
Yan Xiaoxiao stared blankly. Her years of experience meant she wasn’t ignorant. Subconsciously, she answered, "The battlefield…"
"That's right. It’s battlefields, not schools."

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Building the Divine Kingdom from Zero
chapters.content:
What is the most efficient way to improve the strength of people inside the Divine Kingdom?
This problem had also been widely discussed by players. However, unlike the creation of exclusive laws that had standard answers, this one was purely a matter of wisdom.
Players valued three indicators: the average strength of people inside the Divine Kingdom, the number of powerful experts among the people, and the percentage of power the player could draw from their Divine Kingdom's citizens.
The first two indicators determined the maximum available power a player could possibly get from their Divine Kingdom, while the third indicator determined the actual power a player would get.
Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom was even more convenient. Immortal Demon World’s special origin allowed him to directly collect his people’s power in the future, regardless of whether they were willing or not.
"With Wu Gui City as the boundary, divide the continent into two pieces and set up fifty city states on each side," Gu Nan's voice had no emotional fluctuations.
"Hold a competition of strength between the East and West sides once every six months. The losing party randomly selects a portion of the population in each city state and exiles them to the opposite side as official sparring partners."
"No matter which side, they both have to accept our administration. Those who dare to resist will have the same ending—they’ll become sandbags."
Gu Nan told Yan Xiaoxiao his vision for the Divine Kingdom’s future as concisely as possible.
Simply put, it meant doing everything possible to force everyone to cultivate hard. Although they wouldn’t die if they didn’t cultivate hard, their fates might be even worse than death.
It wasn’t just the two sides of the continent that had to do this. From the continent’s two sides to among the city states, and even within the city states—all of them will follow this set of procedures.
In the end, the participants who fight on behalf of each of the two sides must be the result of layers of selection.
Yan Xiaoxiao gradually understood Gu Nan's plan, but the expression on her face was sluggish rather than excited.
"The scope of everyone's activities will be limited to their own city state, and travel between the city states will be controlled by us. Those who leave the city without authorization will be killed."
"By us… Do you mean Azure Dragon Hall?" Yan Xiaoxiao had a bad feeling.
"Of course not," Gu Nan replied without hesitation. "Azure Dragon Hall will be the main force of the 50 city states in the West. I will provide you with the manpower to assist you later."
If it wasn't for this purpose, he wouldn't have specially constructed the law of resurrection and wasted a perfectly good law slot.
As if reading Yan Xiaoxiao's thoughts, Gu Nan smiled again. "You have to understand one thing. What I need is an aloof and detached god, not a human who’s influenced by the secular world."
Yan Xiaoxiao lowered her eyes and murmured to herself, "God, huh… What if I choose to be a human?"
"Then I’ll find someone to replace you. You will belong to a city state together with the people in Azure Dragon Hall." Gu Nan said, "You should be glad. You can still stand here because I have no better choice for the time being."
Gu Nan didn’t mince words about his dissatisfaction with Yan Xiaoxiao. In fact, be it Gu Nian or Lu Zhanyu, even Lan Si was more suitable for this job than Yan Xiaoxiao.
But unfortunately, these three were either dead or unable to remain here long-term, so they weren’t fit to do this.
Managing the Divine Kingdom was a long-term and extremely tedious job. There were too many matters to deal with, so it was impossible to rely on reincarnators.
Yan Xiaoxiao's scope of sight was still too low. She hadn’t experienced the baptism of countless worlds, so naturally she couldn’t have an attitude of ignoring human lives.
Yan Xiaoxiao fell silent again upon hearing Gu Nan's very straightforward words and remained silent for a long time.
"I once taught you how to kill people, and I also taught you how to kill your own people. Now I'll teach you another lesson," while Gu Nan said this, their figures had already vanished.
The next moment, they appeared on the Western part of the mainland, inside the newly-built headquarters of Azure Dragon Hall.
"Hall Master."
"Hall Master."
Azure Dragon Hall's executives soon noticed the two newcomers and greeted Yan Xiaoxiao one after another, their faces filled with joy.
They had good reason to be happy. They inexplicably won the battle in Wu Gui City. The nation and sect in the East were now leaderless, just waiting for them to harvest and control those forces.
The day when Azure Dragon Hall could unify the world was just around the corner. The first female Empress in the continent may soon be born, and all of them will be ministers of the Empress. How can they not be happy?
"Hall Master, when shall we depart for the East?" A middle-aged man walked up with obvious excitement, not hiding his ambition at all.
This man's name was Dong Xing, one of the most famous generals in Azure Dragon Hall, and he was also one of the people who were most keen on war.
There really was no need for him to hide his ambition. Azure Dragon Hall had struggled for over 20 years, and the fruit of their labors was finally ripe now. Was there any reason not to pluck it?
‘Although the Hall Master seems a little strange recently and has been a little hard-to-find. She even brought over a pretty boy today?’
Dong Xing cast a glance at Gu Nan next to Yan Xiaoxiao, and a small smile appeared in his eyes.
‘Hall Master has been single for over 20 years. Now that the world is at her fingertips, it's indeed time for her to relax.’
However, the expressionless young man's first words stunned him a little, "See that? A worm who’s destined to die actually dares to call himself your brother."
"W-What did you say?!” Dong Xing suddenly became furious. Although he didn’t quite understand this person’s meaning, that aloof and indifferent look irritated him at first sight.
The next second, he saw the young man wave a hand gently, and a ball of black mass appeared inexplicably. Then his vision faded to black, and he completely lost consciousness.
Dong Xing's head exploded, while Gu Nan's expression remained unchanged.
On the contrary, with his death, a shadow gradually rose from his corpse, quickly turning into a pitch-black human figure and bowing. "Master."
This was, of course, the application of the law of resurrection. Gu Nan studied the Dong Xing created by Shadow Form. Actually, he wasn't too satisfied. He could only say that this was barely usable.
The law of resurrection driven by the power of shadows was somewhat lacking.
Not only did these servants merely possess the most basic intelligence, but even worse, only their outer skin could be simulated. Their insides were just a mass of shadows, and any slight movement would betray their inhuman identities.
He never personally used the law of resurrection in his past life. In the hands of those summoner-type players, they naturally had all kinds of abilities to supplement this skill and perfect it, but Gu Nan didn’t have this time.
‘In the end, it was merely a last-minute decision… Let’s just make do. Anyhow, it'll basically only be used inside the Divine Kingdom.’
While Gu Nan was observing the shadow servant he created, Azure Dragon Hall’s headquarters had already exploded into chaos—Dong Xing was killed right in front of their eyes, which was unacceptable to anyone present.
"Hall Master, who is he?!”
"Now that our great undertaking is almost complete, Hall Master, you can’t wait to eliminate your old brothers?"
One after another, questions and denunciations filled Yan Xiaoxiao's ears, making her heart more and more conflicted.
"Teacher, can’t you… spare them?" Yan Xiaoxiao understood what Gu Nan wanted to do ever since she saw Dong Xing's appearance after his death.
"You are the god who will manage these mortals." Gu Nan looked at her coldly. "Feelings like sympathy, mercy, pity, vanity, and anger are all unnecessary."
As he said this, Gu Nan's shadow clones rushed out endlessly, killing the top officials of Azure Dragon Hall one by one.
Yan Xiaoxiao could only watch this scene silently. She knew that she was powerless to resist. She had always been a smart person.
"If I lose even those emotions, then what will I have left?" She looked up and asked, seemingly talking to herself.
"Power beyond your imagination."

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Around the Corner
chapters.content:
Both in terms of her own circumstances and external opportunities, Yan Xiaoxiao had the opportunity to go far in life.
The more complex the law, the easier it was to advance to Tier 4, and her own law of permeation was undoubtedly one such law.
Moreover, she temporarily reached Tier 4 in the earlier battle by borrowing Xue Yan’s power, which was a precious experience that normal people couldn’t even dream of.
Just how useful was that Tier 4 experience? Its usefulness could be seen from how she entered Domain Stage directly in two short months.
So from all angles, Yan Xiaoxiao would be a good administrator for the Divine Kingdom. All she lacked was mentality.
As for mentality, that could be trained.
Gu Nan really was too skilled at slaughtering people’s entire families. In just a few minutes, all of Azure Dragon Hall’s top officials became his shadow servants; none escaped.
Gu Nan needed the first batch of manpower to assist Yan Xiaoxiao in controlling the Divine Kingdom.
In terms of both their strength and their influence on Yan Xiaoxiao, the people in Azure Dragon Hall were better off dead than alive—Gu Nan could still afford this magnitude of loss to his Divine Kingdom.
When these people lined up neatly and stood in front of him, Gu Nan said to Yan Xiaoxiao, "They’ll be your team. I don't want to see any living people in the wild three months from now."
……
Just as Gu Nan started managing his Divine Kingdom, Red Tail and Lan Si on Heaven and Earth Star were trying various ways to contact him.
"Still a failure. Immortal Demon World’s coordinates haven't changed, but all reincarnation attempts have failed. It’s as if that plane has been sealed off," Red Tail’s face was a little dark as she said that.
The inspection team from Starry Ocean Pavilion was arriving soon. Things would be troublesome if she still couldn’t manage to contact Gu Nan by the time they arrived.
For her, it didn’t matter whether Gu Nan chose to obey Starry Ocean Pavilion or turn against them. In any case, Starry Ocean Pavilion wouldn't trouble an insignificant character like her.
However, with Gu Nan away, the pressure to decide fell onto her.
If she chose to resist, Starry Ocean Pavilion would immediately teach her what power means; and if she chose to obey, who can guarantee that Gu Nan won't blame her when he returns?
"How long until they arrive?" Lan Si was silent for a moment, then suddenly asked.
She tried to use the dagger and Godhead left by Gu Nan, but all the messages she sent were like pebbles sinking into the sea; she didn't receive any response at all. It was as if Gu Nan had vanished into thin air.
If not for the fact that she could still use the black dagger, she would’ve truly believed that Gu Nan had died in Immortal Demon World.
"Half a month at most." Red Tail said in a heavy voice, "Starry Ocean Pavilion has always been swift and decisive, and their Void Cutter cultivators are even more so."
Void Cutter cultivators were all very busy, and they were only helping Starry Ocean Pavilion because they were forced to. Otherwise, they’d never willingly handle such a trifling matter.
Lan Si’s expression didn’t look too good either. The past her would never have imagined that Starry Ocean Pavilion would do something like this—after all, forcing all Prodigious cultivators to register themselves was just too inconceivable.
How many cultivators were hidden amongst the people and even in space?
Not every region was like Heaven and Earth Star, where all the cultivators were concentrated on one planet.
For example, many resources in the Ninth Region were in space, so most of its cultivators were in space as well. How would Starry Ocean Pavilion manage these people?
But the current Lan Si understood something—it didn’t matter if they were hard to manage. Everything would work out if Starry Ocean Pavilion simply killed all the dissenters.
Of course it was satisfying when she was the one doing this, but it wasn’t so fun anymore when she was on the receiving end.
"Let’s prepare for the worst." Lan Si gave a small sigh, then turned to leave. What rose in her eyes was a flame that had never appeared before.
When a person had gotten used to being one of the strong but then saw someone far stronger than herself, she would show unimaginable ambition.
And in the past, the only thing Lan Si lacked was ambition.
……
Deep in the starry sky, a starship was traveling between regions. Its huge body gradually appeared in the Sixth Region.
"It hasn’t been long at all. I didn't expect to visit this trashy place so soon again," Zhou Xiaojing muttered as he sat on the starship, chewing on a foxtail grass.
He once visited the Sixth Region together with Xue Yan to distribute a seal to Gu Nan, which left some bad memories.
But this time, he was here on behalf of Starry Ocean Pavilion to supervise all of the Sixth Region’s Prodigious cultivators to travel to the Central Region for registration.
That's why he was on a starship—while Void Cutter cultivators could tear open space to travel, the staff below them couldn’t.
"I heard that Luo Jie and Luo Fei were killed, and now the Sixth Region has changed hands?" A person next to him asked upon seeing Zhou Xiaojing’s expression.
This person was also a young man. He wore a round red hat and looked unremarkable.
But to be able to talk to Zhou Xiaojing like this, his identity went without saying—this was another Void Cutter powerhouse!
"Mm, a person named Gu Nan. Just entered Void Cutter Realm," Zhou Xiaojing answered casually, then added, "He’s a psycho."
"Oh? Then he’s not easy to deal with?" The young man in a red hat became interested and sat up.
With his understanding of Zhou Xiaojing, only a strong opponent could garner such an evaluation from him. Weaklings didn’t need any evaluation at all.
Zhou Xiaojing shook his head and didn’t elaborate. He just said, "Just take a look at the information. The King of the Deep Sea lost to him, and that Buddhist Ancestor is also said to have fought with him.”
With Starry Ocean Pavilion’s ability, the details of the battle on Heaven and Earth Star naturally couldn’t be hidden from them.
Before sending out the inspection team, all information regarding the Sixth Region was also presented to the team.
Of course, it was another matter entirely whether these high-and-mighty Void Cutter experts would be interested in reading the information that those at the bottom put their lives on the line to collect.
After hearing Zhou Xiaojing's response, Wang He, the young man in a red hat, finally changed his expression slightly.
The King of the Deep Sea was nothing. He merely lived longer than most. After entering Void Cutter Realm, bloodline users no longer had much of an advantage over regular cultivators.
What really moved Wang He was "that Buddhist Ancestor."
The young girl Wu Gui wreaked havoc in Starry Ocean Pavilion and even killed the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord right in front of a Pavilion Lord. This also caused quite a stir inside Starry Ocean Pavilion.
Many people even believed that the reason for their comprehensive action was because the Pavilion was furious over this matter.
Registering all Prodigious cultivators was obviously a precursor to a grander plan, and it wouldn’t be as simple as just registering everyone.
"The Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara awakened in the Sixth Region. Could Gu Nan have something to do with that?" Wang He asked in a low voice.
Zhou Xiaojing was taken aback and suddenly felt that it really was possible. Heavenly Mystery hadn’t been killed yet when he first visited the Sixth Region, so he didn’t make the connection between Wu Gui and Gu Nan at all.
Now that Wang He mentioned it, that question instantly broke through a blind spot in his thinking.
"It seems that we really need to properly investigate this Gu Nan." Zhou Xiaojing's face grew serious.
"Isn't he hard to deal with?"
"That's why this time, the Pavilion sent us… four."

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Duanmu
chapters.content:
Immortal Demon World.
A little over a month passed in the blink of an eye, and Gu Nan’s envisioned layout of 50 city states on each side was starting to take shape. Even the dividing line had been established.
Of course, the dividing line Gu Nan drew was obviously more symbolic than anything.
People couldn’t leave their city states at all in the system Gu Nan set, and travel between all city states had to go through the shadow servants. In that case, what was the use of a dividing line?
Ever since Gu Nan slaughtered Azure Dragon Hall’s top officials, the speed with which Yan Xiaoxiao handled matters was clearly much faster.
But correspondingly, she revealed less and less emotion and gradually grew unconcerned about slaughter—or perhaps she’d always been such a person, someone who only cared about those she wanted to care about, except now everyone she cared about was dead.
Gu Nan was very satisfied with this.
He’d never liked testing people. Even if the other party had a 99% probability of making the right choice, there was still that 1% chance the person might make a wrong decision.
Instead of leaving that last 1% up to chance, it was better to not even give people a choice from the very beginning. Through external conditions, he forced her to take the road Gu Nan wanted her to take.
Perhaps Yan Xiaoxiao’s scope of sight might not be high enough, but she possessed one quality that Gu Nan appreciated very much—that is, being smart, or being able to adapt to circumstances.
She would never do anything irrational. Even when she wanted to stay behind in Immortal Demon World back then, she still tried to leave a thorn in Gu Nan's heart so that he would make a conscious decision to not use her.
As for now, she wasn’t even qualified to leave a thorn in his heart.
Even if she stepped into Void Cutter Realm, Gu Nan could still kill her with a wave of his hand. What’s the point of worrying about her?
After obtaining the law nullification crystal, Gu Nan's sight was already set on Tier 5 Star Rulers. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have used up a law slot to construct the law of resurrection.
"Teacher, the city states have basically been established, but the 'travel restriction order' hasn’t been implemented yet. We are short-handed."
Yan Xiaoxiao stood beside Gu Nan, reporting with a frown, "The main reason is… Our people aren’t strong enough."
The travel restriction order naturally referred to the ban on leaving one’s city state, but it was obviously too early for this step right now.
Azure Dragon Hall had a little over a hundred top officials. This may seem like a large number, but it was completely inadequate when these people were scattered all over the continent.
Moreover, these people possessed only very simple intelligence, and they were actually weaker than when they were alive. It was even more impossible for them to guard the wilderness and enforce the travel ban.
No matter how well the city states were built, there were still plenty of loopholes to smuggle people in and out. In the first place, Gu Nan never believed that a ban on paper would make everyone obey.
He’d much rather prefer to allow a small number of people to sneak out, then send shadow servants to hunt them down—these people could also provide power to Gu Nan.
Moreover, if those who snuck out decided to return to the city states, Gu Nan would simply treat them like normal citizens.
In Gu Nan's vision, the city states were used to raise mid-level forces, while the wilderness, which was full of fights to the death, was more suitable for cultivating top-quality fighters.
"Let's leave it at that for the time being. There's no hurry to publish the status hierarchy either. Let people get used to the city state system first." Gu Nan replied with a small smile, "I will resolve the manpower problem."
He specially constructed the law of resurrection because of the unique characteristic of shadow servants.
In essence, those shadow servants were part of his power of shadows, so he could freely take them with him and travel back and forth between planes at will.
In other words, Gu Nan could cultivate shadow servants in other planes, then take them into his Divine Kingdom.
"It's time to go back for a while." He raised his right hand, which had a world’s origin floating quietly above it. It’s just that the world’s origin was covered with thick black fog, completely obscuring its original appearance.
……
On Heaven and Earth Star, Starry Ocean Pavilion’s inspection team had just arrived. As the one in charge on that planet, Red Tail was forced to personally greet them.
"So you’re saying that you can't contact Mr. Gu Nan for the time being?" Wang He was all smiles as he stared at Red Tail, but his gaze was a little unkind.
"Yes." Red Tail took a deep breath and barely managed to keep a calm tone.
She was also someone who’d seen much of the world, so she wouldn’t lose her cool just because a Void Cutter cultivator appeared, but right now… there were four Void Cutter existences in front of her eyes!
She’d met Zhou Xiaojing before, so she naturally recognized him. Although this Wang He didn’t have a famous reputation, he didn't look easy to deal with either.
‘But most importantly…’ Red Tail snuck a glance at the remaining pair out of the corner of her eyes. An expressionless man and woman were standing to the side.
These two were too famous!
‘I can't believe they actually came here!’ Red Tail screamed wildly in her heart. Starry Ocean Pavilion was paying a little too much attention to Gu Nan, and this kind of treatment was by no means what she wanted to see.
Wang He silently stared at Red Tail for a long time. Finally, he just waved her away without saying much.
"Gu Nan isn't here. Could he be deliberately avoiding us?" Zhou Xiaojing immediately asked from the side once Red Tail left.
"It's also common for Void Cutter cultivators to travel to other planes. This doesn't mean much." Wang He shook his head slightly. "But it’s a little too coincidental that he disappeared now of all times."
Starry Ocean Pavilion required all Prodigious cultivators to register but deliberately ignored Void Cutter cultivators—they were actually quite helpless about this as well.
After all, Void Cutter experts could break through the void and leave Star Realm at any time, and they could also return from other planes at any time. How could Starry Ocean Pavilion possibly hunt them down and force them to register?
That operation was too difficult, so much so that even Starry Ocean Pavilion was helpless.
"We must find Gu Nan. Heavenly Mystery mentioned him many times before he died," the man on the side suddenly spoke, but his expression remained stiff, as if his facial muscles were incapable of moving.
Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing both fell silent at the same time, then responded in unison, "Naturally."
But Wang He couldn’t help silently cursing, ‘This person was reportedly at the scene when that Buddhist Ancestor wreaked havoc inside Starry Ocean Pavilion. Looks like he lost some face there and is still holding a grudge.’
"The Pavilion wants us to thoroughly investigate all Prodigious cultivators. Based on news from the other regions, this job will take at least a month, so we can wait for Gu Nan."
When Wang He said that, the expressionless man gave a light nod after listening, then continued relaxing with his eyes closed.
Instead, the woman next to him spoke—not to Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing, but to the man: "Dad, Little Yin is causing trouble again. I'll go take a look."
"Mm." The man also nodded. "Lock your younger sister up for a few days. Don't think that you can do whatever you want just because you’re no longer in the Central Region."
The woman soon left, and she didn't forget to apologize to Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing when she left. She was unreasonably polite.
Wang He exchanged a glance with Zhou Xiaojing and saw the helplessness in each other’s eyes.
Going on a mission with this father-and-daughter pair was absolutely something they both loved and hated. The love was because both of them were strong, and as long as you could find the right way to interact with them, you would get along very well with them.
The hate was because this pair would definitely bring baggage in the form of a child. And to be perfectly honest, not a single person in that family of three was normal.
"Then we'll go make arrangements first." Wang He saluted the man. "If we find Gu Nan’s trail, we’ll have to trouble Your Excellency Duanmu to attack."
The man named Duanmu Sen nodded slightly. There was nothing to critique about his manners. "No need to be so polite. I’m just doing my job."

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Unexpected Guest
chapters.content:
"Little Yin, what are you doing here again?!” A low shout came from behind.
Duanmu Yin pouted as she reluctantly looked back.
Her older sister Duanmu Nianlan had a stiff expression exactly like their father’s; it was as if the two of them were carved out of the same mold. Duanmu Nianlan was currently staring straight at Duanmu Yin.
"I'm not doing anything. I'm… I'm just strolling around!" Duanmu Yin’s expression looked like she’d been wronged.
Duanmu Nianlan completely ignored her plea of innocence. She was earnestly bowing, and the target of her bow was actually two ordinary White Mist members.
"I'm very sorry. I hope my younger sister didn't cause you guys any trouble," her tone was also very calm, without any embarrassment.
One should know that this was a Void Cutter existence. To think that she would apologize so sincerely like this; she really didn’t fit the high-and-mighty description of a “Void Cutter existence.”
"Eh… It’s really no trouble at all." One of them hurriedly waved his hand.
They didn’t know the true identity of the person in front of them, only that she was one of the organization’s honored guests.
The other person also showed a similar expression. "Yeah, your sister is very cute. We all like her very much."
As soon as his voice fell, although he and his companion didn't feel like they said anything wrong, Duanmu Yin had already facepalmed helplessly.
Duanmu Nianlan's expression changed, and she shouted furiously, "You dare flirt with my younger sister? Die!"
Before the two of them could react, she had already punched that person in the abdomen. How terrifying was the strength of a Void Cutter cultivator? Even without using any laws, the punch was enough to tear apart someone’s insides.
This punch directly pulverized all of that person’s internal organs. His body swayed a little, then fell down.
His companion was completely dumbfounded and said in a daze, "My Lord, he didn't mean it like that… He just…"
Duanmu Nianlan withdrew her hand with a dark expression. Hearing his words, she immediately asked, "Then what did he mean?"
"He just…” The dead person’s companion gave her a careful look and whispered, "simply wanted to compliment your sister."
"Is that right?" Duanmu Nianlan frowned slightly, then turned to look at her younger sister. "Little Yin, is he telling the truth?"
"Yes…" Duanmu Yin answered weakly.
So Duanmu Nianlan was silent for a moment, then bowed at the corpse in front of her. "I misunderstood you and accidentally killed you. Please forgive me, I'm sorry!"
After her incomparably simple words, she said to her younger sister, "Okay, now come back home with me."
……
"Don't sneak out to play again, do you hear me?"
"I know, I'm going back to my room to rest."
"Mm, go to bed early."
Duanmu Yin waved impatiently and walked into her own room, then immediately opened her window and jumped out without another word.
"It’s truly a pain to have two family members with brain problems!" Duanmu Yin complained while walking back in the direction she came from.
"Because of their special bloodline, does everyone in that family have personality defects?"
"What a strange family. I really don't know how the little girl who originally owned this body survived for so long…"
“Whatever."
“I need to find that fellow as soon as possible. Whether or not I’ll be able to restore my strength to Void Cutter Realm depends entirely on him.” Duanmu Yin looked up, her eyes shining with a deep light completely unlike that of a little girl.
……
Gu Nan once again set foot on Heaven and Earth Star, appearing inside a research lab in White Mist that he specially prepared for himself.
There were still a few living people left over from his previous experiments. They were the test subjects he prepared for the half-soul exchange experiments—of course, they were already dead now.
He didn’t expect to be gone for that long either, and nobody dared to enter his lab, so these people literally starved to death after the nutrient fluids were used up.
After Gu Nan returned, he immediately noticed the repeated summons from Lan Si and Red Tail.
He was like someone whose phone battery had died. After he finally turned it back on again, he found a series of short messages and missed calls inside.
At the same time, the shadow clone he left here was also reactivated—because Immortal Demon World was cut off from the outside world, his connection with his shadow clone was also severed.
Countless memories and messages poured in, and Gu Nan immediately learned about the situation here.
"Four Void Cutter cultivators? A little interesting. Right when I was worrying over the lack of shadow servants… Mm, there's also a familiar aura?"
With the strength of Gu Nan’s current soul, not even the influx of such a large amount of information could bring him much pressure, and he soon found a small abnormality.
The shadow clone lurking in the dark found a figure whose aura was very similar to a certain person from his memory.
But… That person should never have appeared here.
At that moment, the door of the lab was pushed open with a bang. A petite figure stood at the door, which coincided with the one in Gu Nan's memory.
It was precisely Duanmu Yin.
"Miss Duanmu." Gu Nan smiled lightly and slowly stood up. "Or should I call you… Your Excellency Zi Yi?"
……
"Little Yin is gone again." Duanmu Nianlan walked out of her younger sister's room. Her face still looked stiff, and her emotions couldn’t be discerned.
Duanmu Sen gently put down the book he was holding. "Find her and bring her back. Remember to be polite if she causes trouble for other people again."
"I understand." Duanmu Nianlan nodded. "Our Duanmu family has always valued diplomacy over violence, and we will never bully others."
Duanmu Sen nodded with satisfaction. Compared with his second daughter, who always made him angry, this eldest daughter of his caused no trouble at all. Plus, she was very sensible, so he could rest assured.
‘Just like today—she accidentally killed someone yet again because of her younger sister, but since she apologized so sincerely, I'm sure the other party won't blame her.’
‘No one has come to our door with complaints yet, so I’m certain that no one blames her.’
……
Gu Nan and Duanmu Yin sat across from each other in the lab.
The latter said with a heavy voice, "I don't have much time. That woman with a brain problem will come and take me away soon, so listen to me first."
"Speak," Gu Nan expressed his attitude in one word.
Duanmu Yin, or Star Ruler Zi Yi, who once fought in the Splendid World personal dungeon alongside Gu Nan, took a deep breath.
"Zuo Zuo killed my true body, and Qiu Wenran is probably already in trouble too," she revealed some earth-shattering news as soon as she opened her mouth. "I managed to leave this split soul of mine behind with much difficulty. I need your help."
Gu Nan frowned tightly but didn't speak. He was considering the truthfulness of the other party’s words.
Duanmu Yin stared fixedly at his eyes and said loudly, "He’s trying to kill everyone who has ever seen you inside the Myriad Heavens Starry Road. You must be hiding a big secret!"
Without waiting for Gu Nan to respond, she quickly said, "My consciousness will soon fall into a deep slumber, and this girl will reawaken."
"On a moonlit night, help me kill those two Duanmu people and pour me their blood."
She finally paused here, then said the last sentence, "If you don't want to end up as Zuo Zuo’s food, then do as I say!"

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Clue
chapters.content:
Duanmu Yin's crisp voice echoed throughout the silent lab, but the only response that greeted her was Gu Nan's expressionless face.
"Perhaps you’re mistaken about something." Gu Nan stood up after hearing her explanation, scratching his head slightly.
"What did you say?" Duanmu Yin said with a cold face, "Are you even aware of just what level of existence Zuo Zuo is? You—"
Stab!
Gu Nan's shadow sword pierced her chest, depriving her of all vitality in front of Duanmu Yin's disbelieving eyes.
This girl who claimed to be a split soul of Zi Yi slowly collapsed in front of Gu Nan.
Gu Nan slowly walked up to her corpse and looked down at it. The power of shadows in his hand spilled down uniformly. There was no emotion on his face.
Gu Nan didn't believe a word Duanmu Yin said.
Of course, he knew that there must be credible parts to her story, but for players, if the known facts weren’t enough to judge the truthfulness of each sentence, then it was better to not believe the NPC’s entire story.
Under Gu Nan’s control, the power of shadows containing the law of resurrection slowly took effect on the girl's dead body.
He was trying to manually manipulate the law of resurrection in order to have a more meticulous revival that would retain the deceased soul as much as possible.
A very important feature of the Evil God game was that it was extremely concerned about details and authenticity. Besides the Evil God Temple, players could hardly feel that this was a game.
Not only did the disciplines in the game all have their own serious setups, but even the applications of the various laws could be manually manipulated, unlike skills, which were activated with the click of a button.
Gu Nan had used the law of resurrection over a hundred times, which was enough for a top player like him to sum up the rules behind this law.
The soul wouldn’t dissipate immediately after death, and the more intact the corpse was, the slower the soul would dissipate.
To create a body through resurrection, he first had to repair the damaged parts with the power of shadows, then slowly replace all of a carbon-based lifeform’s biological operations bit by bit. Only then would the whole resurrection process be completed.
Usually, Gu Nan wasn’t willing to do this, because it would make him very tired, and he’d need to expend a lot of energy.
"It’s a good thing that this body is only at Innate Realm, or else who knows how long it would take. Her soul might’ve even vanished by the time I’m done," Gu Nan muttered to himself.
After all, he was a player who walked the combat route. Even if he had played the necromancer route of patching up corpses all day before, the cleverest housewife cannot cook without rice—he currently had too few skills in this area.
After a moment, Gu Nan finally sighed in relief and slowly withdrew his hand.
“Tell me, how much of your memories did you retain?" Gu Nan's voice contained rare traces of exhaustion. This kind of extremely delicate and entirely manual manipulation of law really wasn’t something humans should be doing.
"Yes, Master," Duanmu Yin stood up and answered emotionlessly.
Compared with those "shoddy" resurrection jobs in Immortal Demon World, her body was much more normal. At first glance, she looked no different from before her death.
Because the corpse was well-preserved and hadn’t been sliced apart by shadow clones, this shadow servant even inherited an intact body. It’s just that her heart no longer beat and her blood no longer flowed.
In place of her blood was pitch-black shadow, which made her whole person look a bit dark.
If you cut her open right now, you’d find balls of black shadow inside all the blood vessels in her body, both large and small.
"I'm… Zi Yi… Zi Yi's clone. My true body is in Zi Luo Heaven, injured," Duanmu Yin seemed to be trying hard to remember. Her words were intermittent.
Gu Nan nodded slightly. It was impossible for shadow servants to lie to him. This proved that the previous Zi Yi was indeed not telling the truth.
Her true body was clearly still alive, although perhaps she really was injured by Zuo Zuo. However, this was normal. If it was Gu Nan in her position, he would certainly hide his own condition as well.
"With the clone’s help… heal the true body…"
"What else?"
"Zuo Zuo… strongest under the Thirteen Heavens.”
"What are the Thirteen Heavens?" Gu Nan asked with a frown, but after Duanmu Yin thought for a moment, she finally shook her head slowly. Clearly, she didn’t retain this part of her memories.
The memories she could still retain were almost certainly memories that left the deepest impressions on her back when she was alive, as well as memories of matters she was most concerned about.
If a memory was general knowledge, then it was normal for her to forget it.
Words began to pour out of Duanmu Yin’s mouth again, but most of them were either useless information or nouns that Gu Nan couldn't understand at all.
Until she mentioned a topic that suddenly caught Gu Nan’s attention.
"Gu Nan… entered Starry Road early… secret."
"Think a little more carefully about this one," Gu Nan hurriedly interrupted her, his heart sinking slightly.
The fact that the shadow servant said such a sentence meant that Zi Yi actually saw through his true cultivation realm as well—among the three Star Rulers back then, the junior Qiu Wenran was probably the only person who truly believed that Gu Nan was also a Star Ruler.
"Star Ruler, truly a dangerous thing." Gu Nan's gaze was slightly cold. But even so, he still couldn’t give up on personal dungeons. Even if he was drinking poison to quench his thirst, he must still drink it.
He couldn’t level up without points, so wouldn’t he be stuck at Tier 4 forever?
"Lead him… find… Duanmu family's ancestral tomb… site of the lost…" Duanmu Yin finally managed to utter these words and couldn’t give more details.
However, Gu Nan was relieved. His biggest fear was not having any clues at all. As long as there was a path in front of him, he could always find out more while walking on that path.
"The Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin. This directional clue was enough.
Zi Yi clearly didn’t just randomly choose to possess this girl; rather, it was intentional.
At that moment, the lab door was pushed open again, and Duanmu Nianlan appeared at the door, while there was a member of White Mist beside her trying desperately to persuade her.
"My Lord, this is the organization’s forbidden area. You—"
"Little Yin, it's great that you're okay," Duanmu Nianlan completely ignored him and said with relief.
It’s just that when combined with her eternally stiff expression and toneless voice, it sounded very strange.
Gu Nan glanced at her, then manipulated the shadow servant to go forward and ask, "Sis…ter, where is our family’s ancestral tomb?"
"Ancestral tomb?" Duanmu Nianlan revealed some rare hesitance. "Of course it's in our home back on Floral Jasper Star. Why do you ask?"
Floral Jasper Star was one of the main planets in the Central Region. This Gu Nan knew.
A location clue like this was already enough.
A smile appeared on Gu Nan’s face, and even Duanmu Yin, his shadow servant, started smiling eerily. This smile really looked a bit scary when it mysteriously appeared on a young girl’s face.
The next moment, Gu Nan's fist had already descended. The blow carrying the power to nullify all laws suddenly rained down with unparalleled strength.
"You…" Duanmu Nianlan reacted extremely quickly. Although she just said one word, her whole body had already moved.
She immediately returned a punch. There seemed to be some kind of illusion behind her. It was an imposing and solemn image of a god, glaring at Gu Nan coldly.
Eastern Shinto!

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Cant be Resurrected?
chapters.content:
The West had gods, while the East also had Shinto.
Gu Nan had naturally learned about the power system in the Myriad Heavens Universe. He knew that Eastern Shinto was completely different from the system of gods in his memory.
Although both cultivation paths drew support from the power of faith and even seemed like they had the same ultimate goal, there was a great difference between them, especially before Tier 5.
Gods only became gods after Tier 5, while Shinto users could use the power of faith from the very beginning!
An inexplicably imposing aura began to emerge, gradually enveloping Duanmu Nianlan. Not even the law nullification attribute could break through it instantly.
The law nullification attribute wasn’t invincible. A special type of existence like the power of faith could weaken its nullification power.
And this small delay was enough to make a difference in a fight.
The power of law nullification failed to nullify all of Duanmu Nianlan’s strength, and her fist, which shone a lustrous radiance, slammed into Gu Nan’s fist.
Crack!
Crack!
Two cracks rang out at the same time. Gu Nan took a step back. His hand bones had already been smashed to pieces, while a huge crack also appeared on the divine avatar behind the other party.
Duan Nianlan's expression was serious as she said in a low voice, "As long as faith isn’t extinguished, my Shinto golden body can repair itself. You, however…"
Bam!
Gu Nan smashed his fist down onto Duanmu Nianlan’s shoulder. Thus, the godly avatar behind Duanmu Nianlan continued to crack, and Gu Nan’s hand bones also had no chance to heal.
"You…" Duanmu Nianlan glowered at him. She could only watch as afterimages flew up and down and punches continuously rained down onto her body.
At Gu Nan’s current level, the mortal world’s martial arts and fighting techniques were nothing more than jokes.
A Tier 4 Evil God physique, coupled with his agility route, made his speed so fast that the enemy couldn’t even respond. Enemies simply couldn’t avoid his attacks.
In just the blink of an eye, Gu Nan had thrown three hundred and ninety-two consecutive punches, pulverizing the divine avatar into smithereens. Duanmu Nianlan, on the other hand, already had a bloody nose and a swollen face, and her body was full of bloody holes from the enormous strength contained in the punches.
Both of Gu Nan's hands were also a bleeding mess, and their original shapes couldn’t even be seen anymore. They resembled two lumps of flesh.
But Gu Nan's hands were rapidly recovering, while the shattered godly avatar wasn’t so lucky.
Duan Nianlan didn't have a chance to speak at all before Gu Nan smashed her heart apart with another punch.
"The first one," Gu Nan counted expressionlessly while the power of shadows spilled down. The law of resurrection activated once again, trying to turn her into a shadow servant.
To his surprise, he actually failed this time…
“Resurrection can actually fail?" Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow. This was the first time he’d heard of such a thing, but the motionless corpse in front of him proved this wasn’t a joke.
‘Is it because she was too strong, or is it because of Shinto?’ Gu Nan guessed in his heart, but his intuition told him that he’d overlooked something.
……
Duanmu Sen suddenly opened his eyes near the lab, and a terrifying aura immediately surged up, making even the air rumble.
"Your Excellency Duanmu?" Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing’s figures instantly appeared, inquiring with bewilderment.
Their immediate appearance wasn’t because they were prepared in advance. Rather, Duanmu Sen's sudden explosion was so astonishing that it was impossible for people not to notice.
"Someone… killed Nianlan." Duanmu Sen's eyes were red and his tone was full of incredible killing intent, but there was still no expression on his face.
"What?!” Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets. A distinguished Void Cutter existence died right under their noses just like that?
It wasn’t surprising that the enemy was strong. What was truly terrifying was that the other party could kill Duanmu Nianlan so quietly, without alerting them at all…
‘Doesn’t this mean that the other party can secretly kill us as well?’
But soon, they no longer had to worry about that, because a shadow had already emerged from behind Zhou Xiaojing. It seemed that their enemy didn’t intend to kill them quietly. Rather, he planned to kill them openly.
Gu Nan, who was in assassination mode, didn’t use the power of law nullification—that would force him out of Latent Shadow’s concealment and force him to reveal himself.
A sword of shadow appeared silently, and the law of substitution took effect again. The infinitely-superimposed images of Gu Nan stabbed their swords out, all of them hitting Zhou Xiaojing right in the neck.
Gu Nan's memory had always been quite good. He remembered his first fight against Zhou Xiaojing very clearly.
This person obviously had a law related to space and must be dealt with early, or else there would be many problems in the subsequent battle.
The law of shadows was truly too suitable for assassination, and Gu Nan himself also played as an assassin before, so Zhou Xiaojing didn’t even get to make a sound before his entire body collapsed to the ground.
When faced with Gu Nan, Void Cutter experts didn’t seem any harder to kill than ordinary people.
However, there was one thing Void Cutter cultivators were definitely better at than ordinary people—they would never hesitate in the face of death.
Wang He and Duanmu Sen attacked almost simultaneously, and a blade and a punch instantly arrived in front of Gu Nan.
At the same time, Wang He was still shouting, "Gu Nan, you dare go against Starry Ocean Pavilion? The entire Heaven and Earth Star will be implicated by your decision. Have you thought it over?!”
But Gu Nan just sneered. As for how powerful Starry Ocean Pavilion was… Sorry, he only trusted Wu Gui, living proof that it was possible to oppose Starry Ocean Pavilion and survive.
What's more, from the moment he refined Duanmu Yin into a shadow servant, it was impossible for Gu Nan to reconcile with them. The only path left was to beat Starry Ocean Pavilion into submission.
Looking up, he saw that Wang He and Duanmu Sen’s attacks were right in front of his eyes.
Wang He's blade looked like a seemingly ordinary dagger, just like a roadside warrior’s dagger, but Gu Nan could sense a strange energy from it.
This was a blade capable of directly cutting the enemy’s soul. Once cut by it, his physical body wouldn’t be the only injury.
Duanmu Sen's punch, on the other hand, was almost the same as his daughter's. It was overwhelming and heavy… No! Even more overwhelming! Even heavier!
A Shinto user’s golden body really was extraordinary. After being condensed to the extreme, there was almost nothing it couldn’t break. Its biggest flaw was that it was too difficult to cultivate.
But for an old monster like Duanmu Sen who had lived for countless years and enjoyed innumerable resources from Starry Ocean Pavilion, he had no shortage of time or resources!
But still, not even these attacks could threaten Gu Nan.
No matter how powerful the attack was, it would only be effective if it landed. This wasn’t a turn-based game where you could hit someone just by using a skill!
Gu Nan disappeared instantly with Blink, his figure reappearing behind Wang He. The law nullification attribute directly nullified the laws surrounding the latter’s body.
"What kind of power is this…" Wang He was even more miserable than Zhou Xiaojing. He died under a completely unknown power.
Moreover, after losing the protective laws around his body, his body simply couldn't endure Gu Nan's punch, and he was directly pulverized by this punch.
Flesh and bones were sent flying, and he didn’t even have an intact corpse—while the power of laws can be condensed and concise, the power from one’s physical body was bound to be explosive.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, stood motionless in the same spot. The power of shadows began to spread out, and two shadow servants started to rise up from Zhou Xiaojing and Wang He’s corpses.
Oh right, Wang He didn’t even have a corpse anymore. It was more appropriate to say the shadow servant crawled out of a pile of mangled flesh and blood.
"It's not because of strength. Then it really is because of Shinto?" Gu Nan looked at the two completely normal shadow servants and couldn't help frowning slightly.
He was still thinking about why Duanmu Nianlan couldn’t be resurrected.
"Corpse manipulation technique?" Duanmu Sen looked at the two shadow servants with a stiff expression.
Gu Nan could only roll his eyes at Duanmu Sen’s creative imagination. At the same time, he silently ordered the two shadow servants to attack Duanmu Sen.
"Law of resurrection… It's time to test its combat capability."

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Live Combat Test
chapters.content:
Boom! Boom!
As two muffled sounds rang out, the two figures that just finished condensing in midair were easily blasted apart by two punches from Duanmu Sen, turning into two balls of black fog.
Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head slightly.
Those two balls of black fog were precisely the shadow servants of Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing. These two Tier 4 shadow servants didn't have any effect at all when facing Duanmu Sen and were blown apart almost instantly.
"Sure enough, it’s a law for bullying newbies…" Gu Nan shook his head a little as he gave this evaluation.
It was within expectations that shadow servants’ strength would decrease from when they were alive, but the Tier 4 shadow servants were far weaker than their former selves.
Even if Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing were slightly weaker than Duanmu Sen, they weren’t so weak that they’d be killed in a single blow—in terms of their actions just now, they were entirely delivering themselves up for Duanmu Sen to kill.
"The shadow servants don’t have high intelligence, which doesn't match their Tier 4 power!" Gu Nan, who also played the summoning route before, saw through the problem at a glance.
When faced with opponents of the same realm, the shadow servants’ measly intelligence wasn’t enough for them to judge what action to take because they couldn’t react quickly enough.
Only when facing weaker opponents or when possessing a huge numerical advantage would these shadow servants be able to truly bring out all their strength.
Duanmu Sen looked at Gu Nan from a distance and said coldly, "Hmph! Your corpse manipulation technique is nothing more than—"
Before his voice fell, Gu Nan's figure had suddenly appeared behind him, and a heavy blow smashed down on the back of his head.
Clang!
The sound of a metallic impact rang out. Duanmu Sen’s entire body was blown away, but he quickly steadied himself and didn't seem to be hurt.
Duanmu Sen's Shinto golden body was more compact than his daughter's, and his strengthening direction also seemed to be different—his strengthening was aimed more at improving defense.
Duanmu Sen still had a wooden expression, but before he could speak, Gu Nan launched another lightning-fast punch.
After repeating this several times, Gu Nan suddenly stopped. Instead, a long blade came out of Duanmu Sen’s abdomen.
"Wang He!"
The power of the familiar soul-cutting sword made Duanmu Senton roar with rage, but he immediately remembered—Wang He was already dead.
He suddenly turned around and saw "Wang He" standing behind him with dark skin that was torn in certain places, revealing patches of darkness underneath.
Even half of Wang He's face was cracked open, and black fog was slowly repairing his body.
But it was precisely such a Wang He whose hands didn’t tremble in the slightest as he stabbed Duanmu Sen while fixing his gaze tightly on him, watching Duanmu Sen’s every move.
"But their attack didn’t drop too much," Gu Nan concluded from the side.
For a gamer like him, the primary concern of any ability must be its actual combat usefulness.
Even if it was the law of resurrection specially built for managing his Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan would still try to use it in actual combat—in a top player’s eyes, there were no useless skills, only players who didn’t know how to use them.
Many people considered resurrection as useless in actual combat, but after Gu Nan's simple test, he still found some advantages.
For example, the most intact qualities shadow servants retained from their living selves were their abilities’ special attributes and their attack power rather than defense. In fact, they didn’t actually need defense either, because the nature of shadow servants meant they were immortal.
Although Duanmu Sen killed them once, pure physical attacks couldn’t destroy their souls, which were protected by the law of resurrection. Thus, he couldn’t completely destroy them.
As long as Gu Nan was willing to supply them with the power of shadows, they could totally be resurrected again.
Duanmu Sen, whose soul was injured, launched another fierce punch. The shadow servant Wang He didn’t even have time to say anything and was instantly smashed to smithereens, but his figure immediately condensed back together.
"It’s just that it’s too energy-consuming…" Gu Nan sensed the skill’s energy consumption while reforming Wang He and shook his head again.
Although this measly power consumption was nothing to him, he could achieve far better results if the same power was in his hands instead of Wang He’s.
The greatest purpose of the law of resurrection was probably to provide him with a diverse range of methods.
Gu Nan manipulated Wang to "seek death" while rubbing his chin and muttering, "Anyone with strange and interesting laws in the future can be refined into shadow servants."
It had to be said that the summoning playstyle still had some merits.
With the death of one "Wang He" after another, Duanmu Sen was gradually weakening—in a sense, the soul-cutting sword was the bane of his Shinto golden body, especially after the soul-cutting sword fell into Gu Nan's hands.
The soul-cutting sword originally had the characteristic of hurting both the enemy and the user, but now it could be used freely without regard to the user’s injuries, which made it much more powerful without much effort.
"Ah!"
Classmate Shinto cultivator Duanmu Sen was roaring furiously. He had never seen such a shameless fighting style like Gu Nan's before.
Gu Nan could clearly fight him head-on, yet he just focused on using up Duanmu Sen’s stamina with the corpse manipulating technique’s puppets, which didn’t fear death. But he’d immediately run far away whenever Duanmu Sen chased after him.
‘It’s simply… simply…’ Duanmu Sen, who had lived his entire life honorably, didn’t know how to describe it at all.
If Gu Nan knew his thoughts, he’d definitely tell Duanmu Sen very candidly— “It’s called the monster farming playstyle.”
What players want the most is to find a way to drop monsters’ HP without sustaining any injuries in the process, because once found, they can then repeat this process indefinitely until the monster dies.
And Gu Nan's sufficient speed guaranteed that he wouldn’t fear “drawing aggro.”
Just a few minutes later, Duanmu Sen finally couldn't stand such "humiliation” anymore. He suddenly whistled at the sky, and the avatar behind him suddenly radiated golden light.
"There’s nowhere to run!"
Duanmu Sen's speed suddenly accelerated, instantly arriving in front of Gu Nan with unparalleled golden brilliance.
But Gu Nan was even faster, countering with a punch without hesitation, which hit Duanmu Sen right in the face.
After Duanmu Sen ignited most of his power of faith to increase his speed, Gu Nan suddenly stopped running! And before the other party could adjust to this sudden change, Gu Nan directly attacked.
Just like his daughter earlier, even if he had a Shinto golden body, he still couldn't endure Gu Nan's strength. After the collision, waves of cracks appeared on the avatar behind him.
Gu Nan's wounds were even heavier. Duanmu Sen's backhand punch practically pierced his chest. Over half of his ribs were broken, and blood spilled out endlessly from his mouth.
But Gu Nan seemed like he couldn’t feel pain, throwing yet another simple, unadorned punch with a crazy smile on his face!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The two exchanged injuries several times in this instant. Duanmu Sen was originally at peak condition, but Gu Nan forcibly knocked him down from there. The godly avatar behind his back began to totter, on the verge of collapse.
And Gu Nan's body was also full of broken bones. A portion of his right face had even sunken inwards, but he still acted as if felt nothing.
What was even more eerie was that his injuries were still rapidly recovering, and the smashed flesh on his face was growing at a speed visible to the naked eye, becoming as good as new in the blink of an eye.
He walked forward slowly and looked at Duanmu Sen, who’d already exhausted all his strength, with a sneer.
However, Duanmu Sen's expression seemed no different from when they first met. He said in a cold voice, "Gu Nan… We’ll never let this matter go!"

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Starry Ocean Pavilion’s Style
chapters.content:
Gu Nan sat alone in a room inside White Mist’s headquarters, toying with two strange beads in his hand.
Of course Duanmu Sen eventually died, but he didn't die by Gu Nan's hand. Instead, he blew himself up—as expected of a resolute and unyielding person who lived an upright life.
Just as Gu Nan initially suspected, Duanmu Sen couldn’t be refined into a shadow servant either.
However, after four Void Cutter cultivators died and the inspection team they brought over was also wiped out by Gu Nan, people from White Mist found these two beads while cleaning up the battlefield.
"The material is very similar to their Shinto golden body," Gu Nan picked up a bead and knocked it on the table, easily making such a judgment.
He’d fought both the Duanmu father and daughter, so he was extremely familiar with this sort of material synthesized using the power of faith.
"Can you remember anything?" He showed the beads to Duanmu Yin and asked casually.
Duanmu Yin was already a shadow servant, but due to Gu Nan's "meticulous" creation, she still retained much of her memories.
Fortunately, this clone Zi Yi chose wasn’t very strong. Otherwise, Gu Nan wouldn’t be able to let her retain many memories, no matter how much energy he put in.
Take Wang He and Zhou Xiaojing, for example. Gu Nan found out afterwards that their intelligence wasn’t actually low, perhaps because they were Void Cutter cultivators when alive.
But this intelligence had nothing to do with their memories. Rather, it was more like the law of resurrection directly created their intelligence.
Duanmu Yin stared at the beads for a long time and finally said, "Shinto cultivators will not leave the sacred grounds. These beads should be parts they split out from their Shinto golden bodies."
Gu Nan immediately understood upon hearing her explanation.
No wonder those two couldn't be refined into shadow servants after death. This wasn’t their whole body at all; it was just a part of it.
"Floral Jasper Star, huh?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin and murmured to himself.
Even without the Evil God Temple’s reminder this time, Gu Nan also knew that the "Duanmu ancestral tomb" the clues pointed to was bound to contain a big secret.
‘Perhaps Zuo Zuo also wanted me to visit this place when he told me to travel to the Central Region earlier…’
Gu Nan had encountered too many similar situations when he was in the game. When all the evidence points to the same place, then that place is either a mission or a trap.
As for how to determine whether or not it’s a trap, players have an easy solution—as long as an event can be triggered there, then it’s definitely not a trap!
In other words, as long as it can trigger events, players will still step inside, even if it’s also a trap!
As long as he went to Floral Jasper Star and found the Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb, he’d be able to trigger the event after collecting enough clues.
If he still couldn’t trigger any events in the end, then Gu Nan would choose to turn around and leave, leaving all progress stuck at the last step.
"My Lord, everyone from Starry Ocean Pavilion has been cleaned up," the shadow servant of Wang He appeared beside him and reported in a low voice.
The inspection team sent by Starry Ocean Pavilion was cleaned up by a group led by the two shadow servants.
Even if they were weaker than before, they were still more than enough to handle Tier 3 cultivators.
Gu Nan waved a hand to dismiss him, but Red Tail appeared timely. "My Lord, I'm afraid the events here can't be hidden from Starry Ocean Pavilion."
Her face was full of worry, as if she was very concerned that Starry Ocean Pavilion’s army would arrive tomorrow.
Actually, let alone hiding the events here—news had already spread back to the Central Region the instant Gu Nan attacked Starry Ocean Pavilion’s team.
After all, Star Realm was a semi-technological plane. Even Qin Xuanji could manage to contact the King of the Deep Sea back then. It was impossible for the powerful Starry Ocean Pavilion to be lacking in means of communication.
But Gu Nan wasn’t worried about this in the slightest. "Starry Ocean Pavilion won't be stupid enough to continue sending people here to die. I'll visit the Central Region in a couple of days. By then, it'll be easy to decide which side you want to stand on."
After Gu Nan’s trip to the Central Region, either he’d have surrendered to Starry Ocean Pavilion, or Starry Ocean Pavilion would’ve silently acknowledged his existence. Of course Red Tail wouldn’t have to struggle over which side to pick by then.
Gu Nan's blunt and straightforward words frightened Red Tail. She shook her head repeatedly, but Gu Nan interrupted her.
"I don't need your loyalty. I just want you to manage White Mist into the organization I want and provide me with what I need," Gu Nan said thus.
"In exchange, I will become your backing."
Red Tail gradually fell silent. She believed that Gu Nan only said this because he was about to leave, so he spoke honestly and laid out all the cards on the table. A purely transactional relationship was more conducive to him controlling White Mist.
What she didn’t know was that Gu Nan had always viewed White Mist like this. For players, most interactions with NPCs were transactions, which was no different from completing missions and getting paid.
"I see." Red Tail finally nodded, then smiled. "Then… My Lord, I wish you a smooth trip in the Central Region."
……
Gu Nan didn’t immediately leave for the Central Region after handling matters on Heaven and Earth Star. Instead, he first returned to Immortal Demon World.
This time he didn't come back alone, but took Lan Si along with him.
With Gu Nan's current strength, it wasn’t too difficult to take another person along and travel between different planes. It’s just that it consumed a lot of his law of shadows.
"This will be my future Divine Kingdom. Cultivate here for the time being and learn how to manage the Divine Kingdom," Gu Nan told Lan Si.
Heaven and Earth Star was no longer safe, and Lan Si possessed an important item like the Godhead, so she naturally couldn’t be allowed to remain on Heaven and Earth Star.
On the other hand, Lan Si's cultivation was also entering a bottleneck, and the rate of increase in Gu Nan's Evil Value had slowed down considerably. It might be possible to speed it back up by using the ten times faster flow of time in Immortal Demon World.
Lan Si just nodded silently. "Who should I learn from?"
After a drastic change in temperament, Lan Si seemed to have gained considerable enthusiasm for wielding authority as well, showing a clear desire for control more than once.
"You’ll be learning from someone who had a similar experience as yours twenty years ago," Gu Nan answered with a smile.
……
After leaving all the shadow servants inside Immortal Demon World and handing Lan Si over to Yan Xiaoxiao, Gu Nan tore open space again and started heading for the Central Region.
Void Cutter beings were completely different lifeforms from Prodigious cultivators. Prodigious cultivators couldn’t even cross between the various regions within Star Realm, yet Void Cutter existences had the ability to leave the entire Star Realm.
Gu Nan was standing in the endless starry sky using just his physical body. After finding the Central Region’s coordinates, the power of shadows instantly broke through the law of space, and he stepped through the portal.
However, the instant he entered the Central Region, three rays of lights—gold, blue, and purple—simultaneously lit up in front of him and suddenly descended with unparalleled ferocity!
Gu Nan didn’t even have time to speak before he was directly submerged by these three rays of light.
Three figures stood in front of the portal Gu Nan opened.
They were two men and one woman in Daoist robes. Besides the colors being different, their clothes looked exactly the same, and even the folds were in the same position.
"Gu Nan? Nothing impressive."
"To think you came to our Starry Ocean Pavilion looking for trouble when you’re this weak?"
"Haha! He didn't really think we were just going to sit back and wait for him to come, did he now?"
The three of them sent telepathic messages to each other in space and smiled at the same time.
Among them, the woman who spoke at the end smiled the most gorgeously, not hiding the mockery in her eyes at all.
"The last fellow who was known as a heavenly genius was eighty years ago, right?"
The woman sneered. "Do these backwater fools think we’ll just keep sending people to die? Our Starry Ocean Pavilion’s style has always been to stamp out the danger swiftly and decisively!"
After dropping such a sentence, she looked up to tell her two companions to leave, only to find that they were staring at something behind her in horror, as if something terrifying was there.

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Yue Jiu
chapters.content:
When facing the legendary main character, villains in popular novels circulating throughout the world would always send opponents who just happened to be slightly stronger than the main character, but not by too much.
And these opponents would keep giving valuable experience to the protagonist, all the way until the protagonist grew into an unstoppable force, then obediently raise their hands in surrender.
Starry Ocean Pavilion had been in Star Realm for tens of thousands of years. Let alone knowing about such stories—they had even killed countless people resembling these main characters.
Therefore, the woman in gold believed that they would never make such a mistake. If they attacked, they’d make sure to kill Gu Nan in one blow!
They had been lurking here in waiting ever since they received news from the Sixth Region and guessed that Gu Nan might visit the Central Region soon.
‘Now we’ve finally caught our prey… But, what do their expressions mean?!’ The woman in gold couldn’t help feeling chills when she saw her two companions’ expressions.
She thought the three of them were lions chasing after a rabbit, but nobody expected that this rabbit could bite back.
"Look out!" The voices of her two companions finally came, followed immediately by their assistance, but it seemed a little late.
Her waist gradually started to feel an icy chill, and she felt as if there was a poisonous snake coiled around her body, slowly crawling up along her body.
