Naturally, this was just her hallucination, because Gu Nan's sword merely brushed past her body lightly. The chilly feeling didn’t remain for long and went straight for the man in blue beside her.
Gu Nan's grasp of the situation had always been top-notch. He was the kind of person who could make the most correct judgment in any battle.
So in the face of the three-person ambush, he instantly determined who was truly the biggest threat to him.
"Not good, his target is me!" The man in blue was busy trying to help his companion, but he didn't expect Gu Nan to suddenly change target and come at himself.
He waved his hands and laid out a layer of azure illusions in front of him. At the same time, his body suddenly retreated explosively, trying to escape.
However, the Gu Nan who finally revealed himself didn't give the other party a chance to survive at all. Under the power of law nullification, he almost instantly broke through the azure illusions and threw a punch right into the enemy’s face.
The man in blue was clearly different from the Duanmu family's father-and-daughter pair. Rather than taking the Shinto route and possessing an unparalleled physical body, this cultivator’s strongest point was his laws.
But it was a pity that none of his laws had any effect in front of Gu Nan's law nullification attribute.
The moment Gu Nan's fist smashed into his face, his face sank inwards at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the scene seemed to freeze at this instant.
"No!"
With his one remaining eye, the man in blue could see his two companions shouting from behind Gu Nan.
It was a pity that sound couldn’t be transmitted in space. No one could even think of sending telepathic messages at such a critical moment, so their final shouts were doomed to be inaudible to him.
Bang!
Gu Nan punched out again, hitting the other side of the blue-robed man's face and directly blowing his brains out.
No matter how much vitality a Void Cutter cultivator had, it was still impossible for him to survive in this situation, because even Gu Nan's strength itself had started to possess the unique characteristics of “law nullification.” Thus, the blue-robed man’s soul also exploded and scattered into nothingness with this punch.
The power of the law nullification crystal was unparalleled, but Gu Nan would’ve taken this route even without its existence.
In his original plan, his second or third law slot would be used to construct either a law that would turn his body into a law or simply construct the law nullification attribute.
Both of the above routes had the same goal, which was to help Gu Nan break through his opponent’s laws, restrict his opponent from escaping, and win through sheer physical strength.
When one’s power reaches a certain extent, even their physical body is enough to affect laws.
The blue-robed man was killed directly by Gu Nan in merely one exchange, but the entire process of Gu Nan stepping foot into the Central Region, getting ambushed, then countering and killing one ambusher actually happened in the blink of an eye.
It happened so fast that the remaining two couldn't react in time.
When they next saw the scene, Gu Nan had already turned his head toward them with a cold smile. Only then did they discover that Gu Nan wasn’t unscathed; his injuries were shockingly severe.
His heart, throat, and right face all had a huge bloody hole, which was clearly the result of the earlier sneak attack by the three of them.
In fact, anyone would feel that the three’s preparations were foolproof.
Their plan was extremely secretive, and no one was aware of their ambush. Moreover, they especially picked the instant when Gu Nan was traveling through space to attack, since he was the most unguarded at that time.
The three of them immediately launched all-out attacks as soon as Gu Nan appeared. No matter which angle they looked at this from, there was no reason Gu Nan should survive.
One should know that these three still dared to ambush Gu Nan even after knowing full well that Duanmu Sen and the others had died at Gu Nan's hands. This was enough to prove their strength!
If fighting one-on-one, none of them were weaker than Duanmu Sen.
And once the three of them joined hands, they could complement each other using their strongest skills, which would increase their total combat prowess far beyond that of any individual person!
However, no one expected that Gu Nan would actually survive full-powered attacks from the three of them and would still have the spare energy to immediately counterattack and kill one of them…
The next moment, Gu Nan's figure instantly disappeared, and the remaining man and woman suddenly became extremely vigilant, standing back to back and looking around warily.
However, even after the two of them waited for a long time, Gu Nan still didn’t appear again. Instead, a faint sigh rang out from the bottom of their hearts.
"To remain calm in the face of death and exhibit such decisiveness… He’s indeed extraordinary." A middle-aged man slowly walked out of the void with some regret on his face. "As expected of the person who could make the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara return without accomplishing her goal."
His hand was still glowing faintly, as if he had attacked just now.
When the man and woman saw the middle-aged man appear, they quickly went forward to salute and greeted, "We pay our respects to Pavilion Lord Jiu."
Starry Ocean Pavilion only had three Pavilion Lords, and members of the Pavilion also addressed the three Pavilion Lords differently.
This Pavilion Lord Jiu’s real name was Yue Jiu, but both inside and outside Starry Ocean Pavilion, he was called "Pavilion Lord Jiu" instead of "Pavilion Lord Yue.”
"Pavilion Lord Jiu, can Little Huo still be saved?" The woman in gold didn’t have the heart to worry about etiquette and asked directly. Little Huo was naturally the man in blue.
However, Yue Jiu gave a small sigh and replied, "I was a step too late."
He was indeed a step too late, or else even if he couldn't save the man in blue, he still could’ve killed Gu Nan—after all, injuries were still injuries. No matter how fast Gu Nan’s regeneration speed was, those injuries would certainly affect his combat effectiveness.
Hearing Yue Jiu's answer, the woman in gold couldn't help tearing up.
The three of them had traveled through the starry sea unhindered for hundreds of years, but they didn't expect that because of today's carelessness…
"Lord Jiu, do you know where Gu Nan ran off to?!” The man in purple on the other side forcibly suppressed the grief in his heart and asked with reddened eyes.
"Why? You don’t think enough people have died yet?" Yue Jiu scolded lightly, his cold expression shutting the two up.
After a moment's silence, he spoke again, "You two can return to the Pavilion first. Someone else will naturally take care of Gu Nan."
"Yes, Pavilion Lord…" The man and woman could only agree helplessly, but when they simultaneously turned around and exchanged glances, they both saw the unwillingness and hatred in each other’s eyes.
However, what they didn't see was that Yue Jiu's lips also curved up slightly after they turned around.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Find Ying Ge
chapters.content:
The man and woman had already disappeared into the endless starry sky, leaving Yue Jiu alone amongst the resplendent stars.
However, just a moment later, a figure appeared behind him again. It was someone completely unexpected—someone who should never have been seen together with him.
It was Wu Gui, the reincarnation of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara who chose to become a demon, as well as Ye Chen, who followed her.
She was the exact same Wu Gui who wreaked havoc in Starry Ocean Pavilion a while back and killed the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord, making Starry Ocean Pavilion lose face.
But this same Wu Gui was now standing next to one of Starry Ocean Pavilion’s three Pavilion Lords. Their relationship was completely unlike what some people believed—that they’d start fighting as soon as they ever met.
"You could’ve killed him," the first sentence out of Wu Gui’s mouth was a questioning statement. Her expression looked indifferent.
Yue Jiu, on the other hand, changed to a smiling face at this moment. "What would I gain from killing him? If he truly grows to that point, it's not like my Starry Ocean Pavilion will be his first target."
"It seems like you understand him well." Wu Gui’s expression still looked indifferent, but her eyes were somewhat hesitant.
She paid little attention to Gu Nan. Even though Gu Nan was already quite strong back when she’d just awakened, she still didn't take him seriously.
Because this awakened Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara knew very well that her own strength would recover at a speed far beyond ordinary people’s imagination, enough to leave everyone else behind in the dust.
It wasn't until they fought again in Immortal Demon World that she truly realized that this young man wasn’t so simple. He could even be the representative of certain powerful existences.
Yue Jiu, however, just smiled without saying anything in response.
Very few people knew that this high-ranking Pavilion Lord of Starry Ocean Pavilion was already paying attention to Gu Nan back when he first became famous.
Even Gu Nan’s title during that time was personally set by Yue Jiu himself, and he was also the one who created that seal for Zhou Xiaojing to give to Gu Nan.
The fact that Xue Yan suddenly inserted herself in the middle of all this was another matter entirely.
Of course, in terms of Gu Nan's cultivation speed, the honors that Starry Ocean Pavilion provided for other powerhouses, such as titles and seals, had all become jokes.
Oftentimes, as soon as they gave him that honor, Gu Nan would’ve done something even more shocking. Their plans couldn’t keep up with Gu Nan’s changes.
From Yue Jiu's perspective, although the current Gu Nan was powerful, he wasn’t so powerful to the point where not even Yue Jiu could defeat him.
‘But it’s only been how long?’ Yue Jiu, who personally witnessed Gu Nan’s growth, couldn't help shaking his head slightly in his heart. He didn't think it necessary for Starry Ocean Pavilion to make an enemy of such a person.
Just as he could cooperate with Wu Gui, he could also cooperate with Gu Nan, as long as it was necessary for both sides to cooperate.
"However… It also depends on whether or not he can survive this tribulation." Some coldness emerged in Pavilion Lord Jiu’s heart.
"The Celestial Temple will open up this year. I want a spot in that,” Wu Gui stopped discussing Gu Nan’s matter and instead told him her request.
The words "Celestial Temple" made Yue Jiu frown slightly. This was why he didn’t really like dealing with certain old monsters—because they knew too much.
Starry Ocean Pavilion’s prosperity was largely due to its long history and mysterious nature.
"The Celestial Temple should be useless to you though?" Yue Jiu asked in a low voice.
Wu Gui didn't speak. She simply turned her head slightly and motioned for Ye Chen beside her to speak.
Ye Chen also didn’t disappoint, showing the bearing of a young genius. His greeting was neither servile nor overbearing, "Ye Chen pays his respects to Pavilion Lord Jiu."
……
Floral Jasper Star.
As one of the main planets in the Central Region, Floral Jasper Star was an administrative planet with highly developed science and technology. This planet was more prosperous than Ruby Fish Star, and it was also protected by powerful cultivators who weren’t any weaker than the ones on Heaven and Earth Star.
On this planet where martial arts flourished, all kinds of martial arts competitions were frequently held, and people would choose to resolve their conflicts—big or small—through duels.
Even if you went to the market to buy food and the vegetable seller shorted your change by 20 cents, you could also resolve it through a duel—the winner would have the final say in this dispute.
“Martial arts is a gift Heaven bestowed upon the people,” the older generation of Floral Jasper Star would often say.
So until now, the most frequently spoken sentence here was still, "Let's duel!"
On this day, it was still a “rich” day filled with martial arts competitions. Zhou Jingwen walked on the road carrying a heavy backpack and kicked the pebbles on the side of the road.
"Life… is really boring!" Zhou Jingwen, a high school girl, looked up at the sky and expressed such laments.
It had nothing to do with her gender. Like all children this age, Zhou Jingwen was eager for adventure, excitement, and everything that could spice up her life.
But this idea just lingered in her mind for a while at most before it was soon washed away by cruel reality.
Even if she cultivated martial arts, she still had to go home and obediently do her homework.
"Ouch!" Zhou Jingwen, who was walking on the road, was suddenly tripped by something and fell forward. Fortunately, she still had some martial arts skills, so she didn't fall flat on her face.
She turned around resentfully, trying to see what tripped her, but when she saw what was at the intersection, she got a fright.
That was clearly a person!
No, to be precise, it should be a humanoid creature, because this person’s neck and chest clearly had large bloody holes!
‘How can anyone still be alive in this situation?!’
But she saw that the other party was slowly moving, seemingly trying to crawl up bit by bit.
"D-Don’t tell me it’s a zombie from the movies?!” Although Classmate Zhou Jingwen had never seen any peerless experts before, she did watch many movies.
"Not at all."
A cold but clear voice came, and Zhou Jingwen looked up in horror, only to see that the person had already stood up and was staring at her with calm eyes.
Only then did she realize that not only was he stabbed in the neck and heart, but he was also missing a piece of his head, and she could even see his brain moving inside his skull.
Zhou Jingwen, who had never seen such a scene before, felt like she was about to throw up.
She wondered if it was the effect of makeup, but the strong stench of blood made her realize this was real.
"Is this Floral Jasper Star?" The voice came again, and this time Zhou Jingwen saw clearly. It was clearly the weirdo in front of her who was talking.
‘How in the world can such a person who has lost half of his head speak so calmly!’
Zhou Jingwen fought back the urge to close her eyes. After exclaiming in her heart, her eyes then lit up involuntarily.
‘Who said that I have to live out the rest of my life in such a boring manner? Isn't there a peerless expert who fell from the sky right in front of me?! I didn't expect such a miraculous encounter to happen to me, Zhou Jingwen!’
Thinking of this, the young girl immediately ignored the blood on the other person's body and grabbed his arm for fear that he would run away.
"Y-Yes, Senior!" Zhou Jingwen's eyes were full of excitement. "Senior, you must’ve been hunted down by your enemy, which is why you fell down to our planet, right?"
"Senior, are you most in need of medicine right now? If you need my help with anything, please let me know!"
However, the senior in her eyes shook his head slightly and replied, "I don't need medicine. If you’re interested, you can help me find a name."
This person was naturally Gu Nan. When he said this, he was looking at the Evil God Temple in his mind.
｢Evil Event triggered: Find Ying Ge｣

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Seclusion
chapters.content:
Evil Events were a very unique setting in the Evil God game.
Like other games, the Evil God game also had its own mission system. However, the designer displayed originality in designing the mission system into the format of "Evil Events."
Different from the ordinary process of "receiving missions—completing missions," almost all Evil Events had to be triggered. Players must find the correct trigger before they could receive missions.
But conversely, players could also use this logic to judge which events would be beneficial to them.
Evil Events will reward Evil Value, so the goal of Evil Events must be related to that—in other words, it can help the player level up.
This was evidenced by the original event chain involving the Godhead.
So for a veteran player like Gu Nan, Evil Events were more like road signs indicating that something nearby could help him level up.
"Ying Ge?" Gu Nan murmured the name aloud, his brows wrinkling slightly.
Just from a name, he couldn’t even determine whether the other party was a person or an object, so he could only look for it slowly. However, for experienced players of the Evil God game, finding a needle in a haystack was a common occurrence, and they’d long gotten used to it.
In fact, his top priority right now was to nurse back his health.
The people from Starry Ocean Pavilion actually weren’t stupid. The three fellows who dared to ambush him indeed had some ability.
The three’s combined assault was extremely powerful, and they also picked the instant when Gu Nan was traveling through space and couldn't escape, almost instantly critically injuring him.
But unfortunately, Gu Nan had a godly skill like Resistance, so the so-called critically injured state couldn’t actually affect his fighting strength.
It was precisely this skill that allowed Gu Nan to have the characteristic of "even if I only have one HP, my attack power is still the same as when I’m at full health" commonly seen in traditional games.
This was the main reason he could make a comeback. Otherwise, if someone else was so heavily injured, they wouldn’t be able to resist at all.
To make matters worse, after he "insta-killed" the man in blue, he already sensed a more dangerous person approaching before he even turned to look.
Fortunately, the law of shadows had extremely high sensing ability, which allowed Gu Nan to escape in advance.
But the person also left some means to suppress Gu Nan's self-recovery ability when he realized he wouldn’t be able to catch up to Gu Nan. This prevented his injuries from recovering quickly.
"Not right, it's more like the wound is continuously deepening." Gu Nan sensed his injuries and made his own judgment.
His self-recovery rate hadn’t slowed down, but every time the wound recovered a little, it would deepen again, and so on.
Although the recovery speed was still slightly faster, the time till a full recovery had been greatly delayed.
Gu Nan habitually tried to scratch the back of his head, but he had already lost a piece of his head, and his hand found empty space. "A strange law. This is a bit like… curse?"
There were all kinds of laws in the world. Not even Gu Nan dared to claim he knew all of them. He could only say that he had seen most of them.
This strange phenomenon was similar to the curse of "deepening injuries" in his impression.
……
Gu Nan was now in a single-story house, and Zhou Jingwen was laboriously carrying a lot of items inside. The pile was full of medicine, food, and drinks.
"Senior, why don’t you eat something first!" Zhou Jingwen leaned in ingratiatingly. She felt that Gu Nan had just finished running away from his pursuer, so he must be at the stage where he most needed to replenish energy.
Contrary to belief, Gu Nan didn't ignore her—he’d always felt that his personality was quite normal. He looked at the food in her hands and said, "They don’t taste good."
“……”
As a matter of fact, Gu Nan's Evil God physique had long since stopped absorbing energy through food, so consuming food would only satisfy his taste buds.
So for Gu Nan, not eating anything that didn’t taste good was actually the truth.
Naturally, medicine wasn’t needed either. His recovery speed wasn’t actually suppressed. It’s just that his wounds were constantly expanding. This little medicine was like splashing a cup of water on a burning cart of firewood; it was entirely inadequate.
"I don't need these." He casually pushed aside the medicine with his hand and pointed his half-open head at Zhou Jingwen. "Help me find clues on ‘Ying Ge,’ and I will reward you."
Zhou Jingwen, who originally had a gloomy expression, suddenly felt her eyes brighten after hearing these words.
Wasn’t this exactly why she wanted to befriend him?!
Classmate Zhou didn't mind Gu Nan’s cold attitude at all and even made up an explanation that "all powerful experts should be like this, unreasonable and only talking about benefits!”
"I understand!" She said excitedly, "I'll be back this time tomorrow. Senior, please give me this chance, please!"
She said while doing a 90-degree bow, which made Gu Nan feel a little strange, reminding him of people from a small country in his past life.
However, he had seen many civilizations from various worlds, so he didn’t care about this.
Zhou Jingwen soon left, leaving Gu Nan alone in the small one-story house.
It was already evening when he descended upon Floral Jasper Star, and now the sky was even darker. When Zhou Jingwen got home, her parents would probably give her a firm scolding.
As night fell, Gu Nan just sat quietly in the dark, enjoying the tranquility brought by the night.
"That fellow… I really might not be able to beat him in a direct battle." Gu Nan's gaze flickered and he sighed softly in the dark.
He was naturally referring to the person who cursed him at the end of the previous fight.
Gu Nan's law nullification was practically invincible among Tier 4 experts, but in the end, it wasn’t truly invincible. He didn't expect to meet someone with the ability to suppress that power so soon.
Curses could indeed suppress the law nullification attribute. This was related to the mechanism behind how curses took effect.
Curses continuously took effect on the target. Even if Gu Nan tried to keep his law nullification power active for a long time, the curse would still continue to take effect. Thus, unless he resolved the root cause of the curse, such an act was meaningless.
And that person’s own strength was probably also at the peak of Tier 4. It was likely that not even Starry Ocean Pavilion would have many such people around.
But Gu Nan was still fearless—just because he can’t beat the other party in a direct battle doesn’t mean he can’t beat the enemy in a sneak attack!
With Gu Nan's skillset, not being an assassin was the greatest waste. As long as he could successfully launch a sneak attack, the damage output from his first wave of attacks was more than enough to make an opponent at his same level suffer a big loss.
Speaking in the game’s terms, Gu Nan was like a player who specialized in assassination skills, while Yue Jiu was a black mage covered in godly equipment.
Although Gu Nan didn’t have much chance of winning against Yue Jiu in the arena, in the wild, he had plenty of ways to grind Yue Jiu’s health bar to zero.
"After this wave of injuries heals…" Gu Nan's gaze was icy and dark. "Oh, do the mission first. Maybe I can unlock the third law slot."
Although it was a bit unpleasant to suffer a loss at an NPC’s hand, a top player’s rationality still prevailed.
The Evil Event was right in front of his eyes; there was no reason why he shouldn't do it. Besides, if he could unlock the third law slot, he could literally hang the other party upside down and crush him.
Gu Nan just didn't expect that plans always couldn’t keep up with changes. Merely the second day after he landed on Floral Jasper Star, an uninvited guest paid him a visit.

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Strange Woman
chapters.content:
Early next morning, just as sunlight started filtering into the house, Gu Nan, who had been meditating for the entire night, got up slowly. Before he could do anything, there was a knock on the door.
"Who?" Gu Nan didn't make a sound, and the power of shadows gradually expanded.
However, the door was already pushed open before his shadows could reach it. The newcomer was naturally not Zhou Jingwen—she didn’t have the guts—it was a woman Gu Nan had never seen before.
She appeared to be roughly seventeen or eighteen years old and was dressed in plain casual clothes, with her hair carelessly falling onto her shoulders. There seemed to be some knots in her hair. It seemed that the girl wasn’t interested in taking care of it.
Her appearance was also normal. If he had to say something that was special about this person, it was probably her pair of fiery red eyebrows.
This strangeness became very conspicuous on an otherwise ordinary face.
Gu Nan also didn’t know why he studied this woman's appearance so carefully. It was as if she was born with a kind of ability—as long as she stood there, she would be branded into the souls of all living beings who gazed upon her.
"Who are you?" Gu Nan asked in a heavy voice. This strange phenomenon gave Gu Nan a bad feeling.
"Red, my name is Red," nothing about the young girl’s voice or intonation sounded unusual, but her sentence structure was a bit strange, as if she hadn’t spoken for a long time.
Gu Nan sized her up, then asked, "What do you want?"
"I heard you’re looking for ‘Ying Ge.' Help me do something, and I can tell you where ‘Ying Ge' is."
Red’s voice was still very calm, and there was no difference in tone or timbre from the previous one; it was just like a synthetic one.
"Alright," Gu Nan immediately agreed with almost no hesitation. He didn't even ask what she wanted him to do.
This came from the players’ habit to always accept missions first. Whether it could be completed or not was another matter—if it couldn’t be completed, then it could just sit in the mission panel forever.
Red seemed to be an eccentric person as well. She wasn’t concerned about Gu Nan's credibility and immediately said, "Ying Ge is in the deepest part of the Duanmu family's ancestral tomb. It’s a curved blade."
"Again with the Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb?" Gu Nan nodded.
Although he already knew about this clue before, Red’s words cemented the connection between the ancestral tomb and Ying Ge, so her words still had great effect.
"When Ying Ge’s owner wakes up, protect her. That's what I want you to do."
"If I have to protect her for a long time, then your information is not worth this price," Gu Nan frowned and said. He was telling the truth.
He didn’t want to casually violate the agreement. Gu Nan was a very trustworthy person when completing missions.
Reputation was the foundation of one’s fame. Carelessly consuming one's own reputation will lower the player’s fame within the entire NPC faction, which would result in being unable to receive many specific missions in the future.
Red was a very interesting person. She thought for a moment and answered, "Ying Ge’s owner has the ability to enter the Starry Road. You can also enter together with her as your reward."
"Deal!" Gu Nan's eyes suddenly lit up.
……
In the evening, Zhou Jingwen excitedly ran into the single-story house, holding a thin piece of paper in her hand, which looked like it had been torn off from somewhere.
"Senior, I found a clue on Ying Ge!" She started shouting as soon as she entered.
Zhou Jingwen was a very clever girl. She knew that her words didn’t have much credibility, and Senior might not necessarily believe her either, so she simply tore off the relevant page in secret and brought it with her.
She handed the piece of paper to Gu Nan. The information on it was quite detailed.
"Ying Ge" was a curved blade that became famous in ancient times, but its history from back then had been lost. The last time it appeared in public was over 600 years ago.
At that time, a Prodigious cultivator obtained it and achieved eleven consecutive kills against experts of the same level, winning the championship of the global martial arts tournament that year. That anecdote was passed on with approbation for a while.
The paper didn’t mention any keywords Gu Nan expected, such as “demonic weapon” or “cursed reputation.” Ying Ge seemed to simply be a very normal and powerful weapon.
"Such a normal weapon doesn't look like a mission item…” Gu Nan rubbed his chin, getting the feeling that this pattern wasn’t quite right.
However, since this was what the information said, Gu Nan could only respect the facts.
"Can you find out where it was last seen?" Gu Nan placed the piece of paper down and asked casually.
"Not yet…" Zhou Jingwen seemed a little embarrassed, but this wasn’t beyond Gu Nan's expectations either—she was a powerless ordinary person with neither status nor authority. The fact that she could find information on Ying Ge in just one day was already pretty good.
Besides, Gu Nan just received information on Ying Ge’s whereabouts, so he didn't mind Zhou Jingwen’s inability to find Ying Ge’s location.
"Then you don’t need to look for that. Do you know of the Duanmu family?" Gu Nan changed the subject.
Zhou Jingwen shook her head again, which made Gu Nan frown a little. He originally thought that the Duanmu family should be quite famous… ‘Could it be that Zhou Jingwen's standing is too low to know about the Duanmu family?’
As if aware of Gu Nan's thoughts, Zhou Jingwen quickly said, "Senior, I'll definitely ask around properly when I get back!"
Gu Nan nodded and absentmindedly condensed a small black dagger, handing it to Zhou Jingwen. "Keep this dagger close to you, and you will gain unparalleled talent."
Zhou Jingwen practically jumped up with excitement. She bowed repeatedly. "Yes! Thank you, thank you, Senior…”
Zhou Jingwen couldn't wait to go back to test the dagger’s effects after receiving it, and Gu Nan also didn't intend to keep her for long. It’s just that there was a somewhat strange smile on his face as he watched her leave.
"Ying Ge’s owner? If I kill her before it awakens and give Ying Ge to a new master—I wonder if that will work…"
Gu Nan quite liked testing the rules’ limits and loopholes, but he didn’t intend to take risks himself, so Zhou Jingwen became the best substitute.
If possible, Gu Nan didn’t mind giving Ying Ge a new and more obedient master—obedient to Gu Nan, that is.
With such plans in mind, Gu Nan once again entered meditation, mobilizing the law of shadows in an attempt to resist the curse and see if he could speed up his recovery.
Shinto cultivators were tough opponents, and the power of faith could also weaken the effectiveness of law nullification, so Gu Nan didn't intend to look for the Duanmu family's trouble while he had such serious injuries.
After all, he was probably going there to dig up their ancestors’ graves.
……
While Gu Nan was quietly secluding himself on Floral Jasper Star, a quarrel also broke out inside Starry Ocean Pavilion.
"Gu Nan is already heavily injured. What are you guys still hesitating about!?”
"He killed someone from our Starry Ocean Pavilion. Don’t tell me you’ll allow him to leisurely walk around the Central Region, free and unfettered?"
The gold-robed woman and her companion were arguing with a group of people, but it was clear that no one else agreed with them.
"That's a dangerous person who still managed to kill Lan Po even when seriously injured!" An old man spoke up gravely. "Until we confirm that he has lost his fighting strength, the Pavilion won’t send too many people after him."
"That’s right." A person next to him knocked on the table and continued, "Jin Yi, I understand your feelings very well, but we can't risk the lives of our Pavilion members."
The gold-robed woman named Jin Yi exchanged a glance with her purple-robed companion, her expression livid.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Price
chapters.content:
Most Void Cutter Realm cultivators cherished their own lives greatly.
As long as they were willing, powerful figures of this level could totally run to a remote small plane and rule as the local tyrant there until the end of their lifespans.
A Void Cutter cultivator who didn’t want to fight was very hard to kill, unless the opponent had a method to kill them in one blow. Otherwise, they could tear open space and escape at any time, making it impossible for pursuers to catch up.
But it was extremely unfortunate that Gu Nan was exactly the kind of person who could kill a Tier 4 expert in one blow.
Before this, not many people knew that Jin Yi and her two companions went to ambush Gu Nan, but now many people knew about it.
A three-person ambush actually ended with the target countering and killing one ambusher. What did this mean? Either the other party had methods to restrain Void Cutter cultivators, or his speed was so fast that Lan Po didn’t even have time to escape into the void!
Besides, not even Pavilion Lord Jiu could kill the other party, so these people in Starry Ocean Pavilion had enough of an excuse to shirk responsibility.
No organization could be monolithic. The more powerful the organization, the more this was the case. This included Starry Ocean Pavilion, the overlord of Star Realm.
"Jin Yi, what do we do now?" The man in purple asked.
The man in purple robes was named Zi He. It was certainly no coincidence that the three of them each wore a specific color, and even their surnames were those colors
[1]
.
The three of them were adopted by their master from an early age and were taught this cultivation path suitable for three people to cultivate together, so they also decided to use the three different colors as their surnames in passing.
They could be considered genuine childhood friends, so one could imagine their hatred for Gu Nan, Lan Po’s killer.
Jin Yi's face was cold as she replied icily, "Of course, we’ll find him… and kill him!"
……
Floral Jasper Star.
A figure was ruthlessly thrown onto the ground with a loud noise. For a moment, the figure’s breathing was extremely weak. Seeing that the person’s vital signs were quickly fading, all the onlookers hurriedly came forward and surrounded them.
"Zhou Jingwen, we’re all classmates here. You are too ruthless!" One of them coldly criticized Zhou Jingwen.
"That’s right. You clearly could’ve held back. Why did you beat up Li Yu to this state?"
Faced with the crowd’s criticisms and interrogations, Zhou Jingwen just stood in the ring and sneered at the people below. "In a duel, life and death are ruled by fate. Have you forgotten something that’s even in elementary school textbooks?!”
Floral Jasper Star was famous for "dueling." Everyone who wanted to become a martial artist believed dying in the ring to be the highest honor.
Of course, although people said that, in real life, very few duels would result in death if the opponents were merely sparring. People usually held themselves back.
People who were as heavy-handed as Zhou Jingwen were usually venting their anger.
Moments later, Zhou Jingwen sat alone in the lounge, wearing only chest bandages and shorts, her hair soaked with sweat.
"Hoo!"
She let out a deep breath, took off her gloves, and wiped the sweat on her forehead. Only then did she feel her blood heat up and her body become warm again.
She picked up the pitch-black dagger from the side. The latter looked perfectly normal, as if it was merely a toy sword.
But Zhou Jingwen, who had just experienced the previous matches, wouldn’t think so.
She had no grudge against Li Yu. Furthermore, they didn’t really even know each other. It's just that Zhou Jingwen's parents and Li Yu's parents were good friends, so her parents often compared the two of them.
Be it cultural classes or martial arts classes, Li Yu had always been better, so Li Yu became the "other family’s child
[2]
" spoken of in Zhou Jingwen's family.
For the most part, Zhou Jingwen's resentment against Li Yu came from this.
But not even Zhou Jingwen herself felt that it was necessary to beat Li Yu into such a state just because of something like this…
"Is it because of this?" Zhou Jingwen stared blankly at the dagger Gu Nan gave her, which was quietly lying on her palm. That kind of deep black seemed to pull her in.
Zhou Jingwen still remembered that when she stood in front of Li Yu, everything around her seemed to disappear, leaving only the enemy in front of her.
Her strength became greater, her thoughts became clearer, and even her eyesight became better… Only her blood seemed to be getting colder and colder, burning coldly.
When she came to her senses again, Li Yu had already collapsed outside the ring, blood continuously spilling from her mouth.
"Is this the price of power?" She clenched one hand into a fist, but her gaze gradually became firm. "If so, then… please continue."
……
In the small single-story house, a small smile emerged on Gu Nan’s face.
He could naturally use the power he bestowed upon others to sense events in the outside world, and he observed Zhou Jingwen's entire transformation.
Someone who was unwilling to remain idle was incapable of resisting the temptation of power. Even if she knew she would lose herself in it, she would still throw herself into it like a moth to a flame.
However, Zhou Jingwen was just a leisurely chess move on his part to sound out the strange woman named Red, so he didn’t need to care about her too much.
He was making good progress with using the power of shadows to eliminate the curse. In other words, that kind of mysterious power was indeed the law of curses from Gu Nan's memories.
After a simple test, Gu Nan found a way to handle it.
The power of shadows exploded out, and the effect of "deepening injuries" was suddenly erased for a certain instant.
Although the pressure from all sides made the curse take effect again in the blink of an eye, that was already enough. Just how powerful was Gu Nan's regeneration? In merely an instant, over half of his injuries had healed.
His head had basically recovered completely, and although the other two wounds were still empty on the inside, no traces of them could be seen from the outside.
"Unfortunately, this loophole can’t be used repeatedly." Gu Nan got up, moved his hands and feet, and complained in his heart, "Curse users are really annoying."
Even in the game, curse users were still the most annoying route.
This kind of ability didn’t have remarkable attack or defense, but it had one advantage—it had a long range.
If a player chose the curse route, then starting from Tier 2, they would have the ability to kill people from thousands of miles away. They could kill someone just by stabbing a straw doll at home.
As the player’s level rises, this ability will continue to strengthen, and the distance from which the curse can take effect will become longer and longer, even to the extent of spanning space.
That was also why curses could weaken the effectiveness of law nullification.
The enemy is attacking from who knows how many worlds away. If you can’t even find the enemy, then how can you nullify their power?
But conversely, once curse users stop hiding themselves and make their existence in society public, then for assassins like Gu Nan, their defenses were no thicker than a piece of paper.
Although he only found one loophole, it was enough for Gu Nan's injuries to almost recover completely, and the rest of the wounds could wait for the curse to dissipate on its own.
Even though curses were powerful, they also had strict rules and restrictions. After knowing the other party’s methods, Gu Nan had plenty of ways to counter them.
"It's time to find the Duanmu family." Gu Nan's figure moved slightly, instantly turning into a mass of shadows and disappearing from the room.
Although he told Zhou Jingwen to look for the Duanmu family, he never had any intention of fully trusting anyone. The missions ultimately had to be completed by him.
"Shinto cultivators need a steady supply of faith, so it’s definitely impossible for them to be some kind of secluded family." Gu Nan sneered a little in his heart. "In that case, it’s easy."
T/N:
[1]
Their surnames are literally colors:
Jin = gold (Jin Yi)
Lan = blue (Lan Po)
Zi = purple (Zi He)
[2] Other family’s child
:
When Asian parents compare their children to other family’s children because they’re dissatisfied their children aren’t performing as well

chapters.title: Chapter 246: On How to Find the Duanmu Family
chapters.content:
Floral Jasper Star’s nightlife was very lively.
Science and technology didn’t just bring people more convenience in martial arts cultivation, but also the richness of entertainment life, as well as… depravity.
Ren Jixuan was sitting alone in the middle of the red-light district, looking slightly out of place.
He was the grand genius young master of the Ren family who advanced to Prodigious Realm at 23 years of age. If his little sister didn’t forcibly drag him here, why would he come to a place like this?
‘I’ll stay for another half hour, then return home to cultivate.’ Ren Jixuan silently made up his mind, and his indifferent gaze swept through his surroundings.
Most people who would visit this place were the same age as him, but in his mind, Ren Jixuan never considered them his equals.
‘How can these people who have lost themselves in pleasure be qualified to be my equal?’
If one day he entered Void Cutter Realm, then the gap between him and the rest of these people would be the gap between a god and mere humans.
"Are you Ren Jixuan?" A voice asked from behind Ren Jixuan, which made him look back in amazement. He seemed confused that someone would talk to him.
There weren’t many people here who recognized him as Ren Jixuan, and among those, there were even fewer people who dared to come up and talk to him.
Ren Jixuan looked back and saw an ordinary young man.
Seeing that he didn't answer, the young man asked again, "Are you Ren Jixuan? Do you know of the Duanmu family?"
"The Duanmu family." Ren Jixuan's gaze sharpened slightly, and his eyes suddenly became serious.
The Central Region was very prosperous, but even here, Void Cutter cultivators were still existences that transcended the world.
A family or organization that had the backing of a Void Cutter existence was on a completely different level compared to a force that didn’t have one. In other words, a Void Cutter existence itself was enough to support an organization.
And the Duanmu family was a powerful family with two Void Cutter powerhouses.
"Looks like you do know." Perhaps his own reaction fell into the other party’s eyes. The young man clapped his hands happily and asked, "So then, can you take me there?"
Ren Jixuan never imagined that someone would one day ask him to be a guide for them.
"Why did you find me?" Ren Jixuan asked. This person made him feel very strange. Instead of responding positively, he tried to gather more information this way.
What he didn't expect was that the young man actually pulled out another person from the side.
Ren Jixuan didn’t know this man, but he looked vaguely familiar. He seemed to be the boss of some martial arts club and had probably met Ren Jixuan in person once before.
"He didn't know about the Duanmu family, so I asked him to find someone who does." The young man then added, "If the person he found knows, then he’ll be fine. But if the person he found also doesn't know, then I’ll kill him."
That boss of the martial arts club shot Ren Jixuan a helpless smile. Don't ask him why he believed Gu Nan's words—because when he answered that he didn't know, Gu Nan killed his "predecessor" right in front of his eyes.
Ren Jixuan felt his lips twitch slightly. He finally understood what the other party meant.
"You—"
Boom!
Before Ren Jixuan could do anything, a shadow suddenly flashed past and instantly sent him flying far away, knocking down several tables in a row.
People in the nightclub were startled, especially those at the affected tables. They suddenly stood up one by one, glaring at the young man.
This young man was naturally Gu Nan. He was currently using the simplest method to find the Duanmu family’s residence.
"Fuck! If you’re gonna fight, don’t you know to take that outside?!”
"You’re really not afraid of death! Do you know what this place is? You even dare to mess around in Boss Nie’s bar?"
"Boss, a troublemaker’s here!"
The youths who came to the nightclub for excitement mistakenly believed a fight had broken out. So while some glared at them, others were watching the fun.
The legendary Boss Nie came over quickly. Nobody needed to call him over at all. He had already hurriedly walked to this side—he was already sitting at the bar, so of course he came quickly.
Boss Nie was a very sturdy man who wore a thin tank top. One could tell from a glance that he was a formidable fighter.
He didn't see who was sent flying out, so he frowned at Gu Nan. "My friend, this humble one is Nie—"
The next second, a sword slashed past, and his voice came to an abrupt end. His head had already slipped down slowly.
The entire nightclub seemed to instantly fall silent. The clamoring voices stopped immediately, and only the rhythmic music was still playing in the background.
"Ahh!!! Murder!" A girl's scream finally set off the crowd.
The terrified stream of people didn't affect Gu Nan at all. He slowly walked forward and soon arrived at the palace where Ren Jixuan landed, picking up this genius young master with one hand.
"Where is the Duanmu family's residence?" He continued to ask. Of course Ren Jixuan wasn’t dead—Gu Nan wasn't stupid enough to kill the clue with his own hands.
……
Zhou Jingwen quickly entered the small single-story house.
"Senior, the sword you gave me, is it… Senior?!”
The pitch-black dagger in her hand slipped to the ground, making a crisp clang. Zhou Jingwen stared at the empty room in front of her, and her entire person fell into a daze.
‘Senior left… Why did he leave?!’
‘I've only just realized the beauty of power. Why… take it away again like this?!’
Zhou Jingwen hit the wall with a hard punch. Several cracks suddenly appeared on the wall, while blood also spilled out on the back of her hand.
"Why…"
Both her eyes were red. Her heart was extremely unwilling while also containing deep-rooted regret— ‘Senior must’ve left because I collected too little information earlier, and he wasn’t satisfied… Wait!’
"Ying Ge, the Duanmu family…"
……
Underneath the blue robes, there was a corpse with a slightly distorted face—his head was blown off when he died, so even if it had been repaired, it would still look somewhat weird.
Jin Yi and Zi He slowly got up from the front of Lan Po’s funeral hall.
"His destination is Floral Jasper Star." Zi He slowly walked out and said with a low voice, "I went back to the Sixth Region to check, and the time-space passage he chose landed in a very remote location, with only Floral Jasper Star nearby."
"I heard that the Sixth Region is that person’s territory?" Jin Yi’s eyes showed some coldness.
"Let’s not get sidetracked from our main goal." Zi He knew exactly what she was thinking. "What's the point of destroying his mortal organization? If we attack now, it will only expose ourselves."
It was too easy for Void Cutter cultivators to build their own organizations. It was just a matter of how much time it would take. Destroying Heaven and Earth Star would have no effect at all on Gu Nan.
Jin Yi also understood this. Her mind was merely consumed by hatred for a moment. Then she asked with gritted teeth, "Floral Jasper Star? What does he want to go there for?"
"Don’t forget," Zi He explained, "the Duanmu family's father and daughter were among the four who went to the Sixth Region as part of the inspection team."
Jin Yi's eyes suddenly lit up, and she said loudly, "Shinto cultivators won't truly be killed if their true bodies aren’t destroyed. He must want to head to Floral Jasper Star to kill them completely!"
Although they didn’t know what sort of grudge Gu Nan had against the Duanmu family, it didn’t affect their judgment.
With such heavy injuries, he certainly wouldn’t be able to travel through space, so he would have to remain in Star Realm still, and he might likely be on Floral Jasper Star right now!
In all likelihood, that person was still lying dormant and recovering from his injuries, so he wouldn’t dare to look for the Duanmu family’s trouble right now. However, the Duanmu family would never miss such a good opportunity if they knew about it!
Others in Starry Ocean Pavilion might not want to provoke such an opponent, but the Duanmu family had already made an enemy of the other party.
‘If the Duanmu family doesn’t attack Gu Nan when he’s seriously injured, then don’t tell me they’ll wait for him to recover and knock on their door?’
"Let’s move right away!" Jin Yi said quickly, "We'll arrange for people to seal off Floral Jasper Star, then contact the Duanmu family immediately!"

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Sword or Fist?
chapters.content:
The Duanmu family was a very special existence on Floral Jasper Star.
The special characteristic of Shinto cultivators determined that the Duanmu family couldn’t completely withdraw themselves from the outside world. Instead, they must be exposed to people, especially ordinary people.
Because the source of their power came from faith. Although unlike the gods, their power of faith didn’t manifest to the point of having people worship them, it was still impossible to seclude themselves from the world.
Therefore, their territory was quite easy to find. There was an entire city on Floral Jasper Star that belonged to their sphere of influence.
"This is Three Leaves City. The Duanmu family is the de facto ruler here," Ren Jixuan explained cautiously, "but they did a good job covering it up on the surface. Very few citizens know about them."
Gu Nan nodded slightly. If it wasn’t necessary for faith to be highly manifested, then the Duanmu family could even gather the power of faith from citizens who were entirely unaware of just who they were worshiping.
For example, a person who believed in Buddhism worshiped the Buddha one day and had his wish granted the next day. As long as he was earnest and sincere in redeeming his vow to the deity, the power of faith would be created.
And as long as Shinto cultivators intervened in this process a little, they could guide the power of faith to converge onto themselves, even if the Buddhist believer didn’t know about their existence at all.
"The residence of the Duanmu family's top level is just ahead."
"Do you know where their ancestral tomb is?"
"Ah? Ancestral tomb… This…"
"Forget it, you can return," Gu Nan said casually and waved him away. A place like the ancestral tomb was unlikely to be known to outsiders.
Ren Jixuan sighed in relief and hurriedly saluted. "Yes. Junior will take his leave now."
If at first he was still unconvinced and felt that Gu Nan only defeated him by relying on a sneak attack, then he no longer harbored such thoughts after Gu Nan obtained the Duanmu family’s location and brought him here.
This person brought him here by tearing through the void!
Ren Jixuan couldn't understand at all. ‘All I did was pay a rare visit to a nightclub. To think I’d actually attract the attention of a Void Cutter cultivator…’
Fortunately, the other party didn’t seem to want to find trouble for him and purely wanted him to lead the way.
In fact, Ren Jixuan should count himself lucky. If Gu Nan's goal this time was to sneak in, then a "guide" like Ren Jixuan would definitely be silenced.
Fortunately, it wasn’t an infiltration.
The Duanmu family’s residence looked just like that of a normal wealthy family. It was part of many villas by the sea. Even at night, the amount of light and voices were still the same as during the day.
Boom!
A super-long gigantic sword over 200 meters tall fell heavily from the sky, immediately making a clean cut through dozens of buildings. A large number of the Duanmu family’s disciples were killed or injured.
"Enemy attack! Enemy attack!"
"Inform the family head immediately!"
The Duanmu family reacted quickly. Almost simultaneously, someone was shouting information loudly, and their sound was amplified through scientific equipment and special arrays.
The internal communication system of a genuine powerhouse must be a combination of both technology and metaphysics, so as not to be countered by the enemy from any one aspect.
But this sound soon stopped, because Gu Nan’s figure was already out of sight when they looked up again.
Gu Nan had always liked to do things in the most direct and efficient way. It was the same with finding the Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb.
Duanmu Sen and his daughter definitely knew where their ancestral tomb was, but that was meaningless, because it was impossible to capture Shinto cultivators and torture the information out of them.
Gu Nan's current understanding of the Myriad Heavens Universe was quite deep, so he knew the characteristics of various schools.
Shinto cultivators were famous for having many clones, and at the same time, they weren’t easy to kill.
If you plan to subdue a Shinto cultivator to interrogate them for information… Sorry, they might just kill themselves and reshape their bodies elsewhere in the blink of an eye.
However, just because Void Cutter Realm Shinto cultivators couldn’t be tortured and interrogated didn’t mean that other people in the Duanmu family couldn’t be either.
This was one of the methods Gu Nan thought of. If the other method didn’t work, then this method would be his safety net.
For once, shadow clones didn’t directly surge forth. Gu Nan had already turned into a shadow and stolen into the inner part of the Duanmu family’s residence. Only then did countless shadows sneak away.
Following the sword Gu Nan dropped from the sky earlier, the Duanmu family as a whole fell into chaos.
Especially after he disappeared, the chaos became more obvious—nobody believed that the enemy had left after merely throwing down one sword; he was clearly lurking in the shadows somewhere, waiting for the chance to strike again!
It was precisely amidst such chaos that the shadow clones snuck in one after another and found people from the Duanmu family one by one to ask the same question.
"Where is the ancestral tomb?"
The shadow clones’ voices were mostly hoarse because ultimately, the vocal cords simulated by Gu Nan still couldn’t compare with the originals.
Anyone who couldn’t answer this question was killed without hesitation to deepen the fear amongst the Duanmu clansmen.
People were always more vulnerable to the influence of the outside world when under sufficient panic, and even today's moonlight very cooperatively turned bleak.
"Who are you? Don’t you know that this place is…"
"Don't kill me! I really don't know, I’m telling the truth…"
"Youngster, what grudge do you have against the Duanmu family? You might as well…"
Numerous disorderly words and endless slaughter played out, yet Gu Nan's expression was unswerving from start to finish. He had already followed some of the Duanmu family’s people and found two acquaintances.
"Eldest Miss, there are enemies…" Before a servant could finish speaking, he was instantly split into two halves by the shadow that followed.
"It's you!?” A soft shout came from the front. It was Duanmu Nianlan.
She was one of the Duanmu family’s two Void Cutter cultivators. The expression on her face at this time was much more vivid than what Gu Nan saw before.
If he had to describe it, then this one might be her true body, while the previous one was at best a puppet—the kind she controlled from thousands of miles away.
But Gu Nan just revealed a strange smile as his figure instantly disappeared.
Blink!
By the time Duanmu Nianlan turned her head back, Gu Nan's sword had already slashed down, chopping heavily onto her shoulder. The sword strike that was superimposed dozens of times practically cut her body apart.
"How can this be…" Duanmu Nianlan sensed the heavy injury she received with much disbelief.
Although she didn't have time to activate her Shinto golden body, why was this person’s swordsmanship also so powerful?
The methods Gu Nan used this time were completely different from the last time they fought—he was clearly a cultivator who strengthened his physical body, so how could he also know laws of space and swordsmanship?
Duanmu Nianlan's realm wasn’t so low that she couldn’t distinguish between teleportation and pure speed. That was why she was particularly surprised.
In fact, which skills Gu Nan used to fight monsters had always been decided after detailed analysis of the specific situations.
When faced with unknown enemies, he’d always started off with law nullification, which had the widest range, but this wasn’t as effective on Shinto cultivators.
On the other hand, his self-recovery was still suppressed by the curse, so he couldn’t forcibly exchange HP with the enemy. Instead, it was better to use a sword.
When Duanmu Nianlan was in pain, she immediately raised her head to the sky and gave a shrill whistle. The golden brilliance emerged from her whole body, and a glowing godly avatar appeared behind her.
But Gu Nan moved even faster. He used Blink several times in a row to attack. Every sword just happened to land exactly on the previous wound. Every strike was a solid critical hit, which made Duanmu Nianlan's golden light sway around her.
In just one exchange, he gouged out a bloody gash in Duanmu Nianlan's shoulder, and golden blood flowed out slowly.
But Gu Nan quickly stopped, because he knew very well that Duanmu Nianlan wasn’t his only enemy here.

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Overwhelming Tactical Victory
chapters.content:
The second Gu Nan stopped, a force attacked from behind him. It was precisely Duanmu Sen.
Duanmu Sen’s true body still looked solemn, but his gaze was calmer and more dignified, his eyes bright and full of expression.
Gu Nan seemed to have anticipated it long ago. The instant Duanmu Sen appeared, his figure had already disappeared again, teleporting behind Duanmu Sen.
Duanmu Sen reacted even faster, turning around to throw a punch behind him—although he was in a hurry, it wasn’t like he didn't see the fight earlier.
But unfortunately, this punch of his still struck empty air, because Gu Nan never planned to attack at all. He just borrowed Duanmu Sen as a springboard and immediately Blinked outside the door.
"He ran away?" Duanmu Sen frowned and gazed over there. Gu Nan left his sight after several more teleportations.
He didn’t quite understand why the other party slaughtered his way to their door with such great fanfare, yet hardly accomplished anything substantial. He just ran away after massacring some people?
As for the loss of their clansmen, it would be a lie to say that Duanmu Sen didn’t feel any heartache, but he was also far from concerned.
The lifespan of Void Cutter cultivators was too long. The ones who died were merely ordinary people. They’d be able to raise a few more generations of those after a few decades, so what was there to care about?
Even their attitude towards Duanmu Yin was like this. Despite knowing she died at Gu Nan's hands, the Duanmu family’s father and daughter still weren’t in a hurry to take revenge. Instead, they chose to take a long-term approach.
"Nianlan, are you okay?"
Duanmu Nianlan shook her head slightly. Her shoulder’s injury wasn’t light, but it wouldn’t affect her fighting strength for the time being. Right now, she was more concerned about the enemy’s plans.
Duanmu Nianlan was extremely competitive. Counting this time, she had already lost to Gu Nan twice in a row.
There was no clear hierarchy between Void Cutter Realm cultivators. Everyone had a chance of defeating their opponent—it all depended on their own methods and real-time battle performance.
But that Gu Nan’s methods were too varied and fickle. If in their first fight, he relied on absolute strength—taking her Shinto golden body’s attacks head-on with his physical body—then in their second fight, he relied on extreme skill.
In such a high-speed battle, every sword struck the exact same location. ‘Unless he’s an expert who devoted himself to swordsmanship for many years, how can it possibly be done?’
"Father, do you think that person deliberately drew us out?" Duanmu Nianlan put aside her thoughts and immediately thought of this possibility.
The other party deliberately drew out the two Void Cutter experts on their side. No matter how she looked at it, he seemed to have an ulterior motive.
"It's very possible…" Naturally Duanmu Sen could also think of this, but suddenly he said, "Watch out!"
Only when Duanmu Sen gave a loud shout did Duanmu Nianlan realize that a blurry and indistinct shadow was already standing behind her. It had emerged from within her own shadow.
The shadow quickly condensed into a blade emitting strange energy and ruthlessly stabbed Duanmu Nianlan in the back.
Wang He’s soul-cutting blade! In the same location as the other attacks!
Only now did Duanmu Nianlan understand why Gu Nan was determined to leave a wound on her body—the soul-cutting blade completely ignored the enemy’s physical body, but it could be defended against by using her Shinto golden body. Thus, these powers would neutralize each other.
But what if there was a gap in her Shinto golden body’s defenses?
Now Duanmu Nianlan knew the result.
The soul-cutting blade pierced her shoulder without hindrance, accurately hitting Duanmu Nianlan's soul. Her entire person froze in place, and her pupils suddenly slackened.
Just a single blow made Duanmu Nianlan fall into an unprecedented critical condition.
The soul-cutting blade was even more powerful in Gu Nan's hands than in Wang He’s—the shadow servants only had their intelligence weakened; their attack power and attributes weren’t impaired.
When Gu Nan took over the shadow servant’s ability, the actual effect was naturally more terrifying.
Duanmu Nianlan only felt her vision start to dim. Her body began to sway weakly, almost falling to the ground.
But her mind was incomparably clear. Gu Nan's tactical intent at every step of the battle were all clearly displayed in front of her eyes.
Create a wound via a sneak attack, then enlarge the injury with that strange swordsmanship while simultaneously diverting her attention.
His sword was very powerful. If he could hit her vitals even once, he might just critically injure her.
‘But precisely because of this, I didn’t protect my shoulder as carefully, or else I wouldn’t be repeatedly struck in the same spot—instead of forcing the other party to attack my vitals, it was better to let him attack my shoulder.’
But just when she thought he was trying to wear her down through repeated injuries, he suddenly left, making them think he wanted to lure them away.
However, his ultimate attack appeared before that thought even left her mind.
Soul-cutting blade! It must hit a weak point in her golden body to maximize the damage.
‘Unfortunately, he just artificially created a weak point in my defense…’
These disorderly thoughts constantly reverberated throughout Duanmu Nianlan's mind, but she felt her eyelids getting heavier and heavier. Even Void Cutter cultivators were helpless in the face of fatal injuries.
In the outside world, Duanmu Nianlan's Shinto golden body was fading fast, revealing her original figure—a young girl in a normal short jacket. The shadow clone rolled her up, and the girl's body fell into Gu Nan's hands.
"Now then, we can finally have a good chat." Gu Nan looked at Duanmu Sen with a light smile.
The latter was glaring at him with a dark expression.
"Where is your family’s ancestral tomb?"
……
Countless hidden fleets were gathering in the space around Floral Jasper Star, secretly surrounding this place.
"We’ve arrived at Floral Jasper Star. Are all the starships in place?" Jin Yi stood in a starship expressionlessly and asked a man in front of her.
As a Void Cutter existence, she had the ability to stand directly out in space, but the man in front of her couldn’t—he was the captain of this starship and was only at the Infinitesimal Stage of Prodigious Realm.
"Answering My Lord, we’ve sealed off all the space routes around Floral Jasper Star." The captain replied respectfully, "As long as it’s a starship, it’s impossible to leave this region safely."
There were only a limited number of space routes suitable for starship navigation in space. It was impossible to simply pick a random route and go, which also gave others the possibility of setting up blockades.
However, this captain left himself a path out by cleverly adding, "As long as it’s a starship."
The implication was that if the other party was also a Void Cutter cultivator, then their blockade would be a joke—what was the point of sealing off the space routes when Void Cutter existences could directly travel between worlds?
Jin Yi naturally understood his meaning and waved impatiently.
She was a mighty Void Cutter powerhouse. How could she not know this?
It’s just that she judged that the other party was seriously injured and unable to endure the pressure of tearing open space, so he would have to leave through a starship. That was how this scene came about.
The tables had turned. Just like how Gu Nan sealed off all the starship routes to deal with the heavily injured Luo Fei back then, now it was his turn.
"Just wait here. If any starship dares to leave, stop them all,” Jin Yi said overbearingly.
Countless starships entered and left Floral Jasper Star every day, but just because of a single sentence from her, all of them had to stop. This was Starry Ocean Pavilion’s might.
"Let's go." Zi He was already waiting on the side. When they finished setting up the starship blockade, the two of them left immediately, descending to Floral Jasper Star.
The two of them had lived in the Central Region for hundreds of years, so of course they didn’t need a guide to lead the way, unlike Gu Nan. They went straight to the Duanmu family’s residence.
Unfortunately, what appeared before their eyes was already in ruins.
"Dammit, we were a step too late!"

chapters.title: Chapter 249: My Name is Ying Ge
chapters.content:
"What in the world do you want to find?!” Duanmu Sen had a gloomy expression as he asked, unable to suppress the rage in his voice. If the other party didn't have his daughter, he would’ve already punched Gu Nan.
Void Cutter existences seldom valued familial ties, but this daughter of his was different… Anyone who raised a Void Cutter Realm daughter would absolutely treat her like a precious treasure!
"Ying Ge, do you know this name? It should be an item," Gu Nan answered while studying the Duanmu family's father and daughter with great interest.
One was beside him, and the other was slung over his shoulder.
Now that he’d seen their true bodies, it seemed these two weren’t actually much different from normal people. Perhaps the ones they sent out to complete missions were all clones.
"I don’t know!" Duanmu Sen suppressed his anger. "I can take you to the ancestral tomb and you can search it slowly, but can you let me take a look at my daughter first?"
He didn't forget that Gu Nan had critically wounded Duanmu Nianlan using the soul-cutting sword. He didn’t even know if she was still alive right now, and even if she was, she might die any second.
However, Gu Nan just shook his head lightly. "If you want your daughter back safe and sound, then find what I want as soon as possible."
Gu Nan certainly wasn’t stupid enough to hand over his bargaining chip. Furthermore, he wouldn’t even let Duanmu Nianlan out of his reach.
The law of shadows wasn’t enough of a guarantee, since it was possible for enemies to forcibly cut off his connection with it. Only the Evil God physique could put Gu Nan completely at ease and ensure that he could kill Duanmu Nianlan at any time.
Veins bulged out on Duanmu Sen's forehead, and he shouted furiously, "I don't know any Ying Ge at all. If you want to find something, just take it!"
Like hell he cared about some ancestral tomb. No one from the Duanmu family had been buried here for hundreds of years now, and normally, there wasn’t even anyone to sweep its floors clean. The ancestral tomb was purely decoration.
What era was it now? People had long since stopped believing in earthen burials. Moreover, Shinto cultivator families had their own burial method.
Even if the "Ying Ge" the other party mentioned might be a treasure, so what? Can it be more valuable than a Void Cutter Realm daughter?
So Duanmu Sen’s words were completely genuine. He dearly wished Gu Nan could find whatever item he wanted and leave quickly.
“Oh,” Gu Nan responded, still taking his time searching through the cemetery—in fact, he wasn’t deliberately being slow. Rather, it was just his customary meticulousness.
A top player’s habit ensured that he must comb through every single detail when completing missions.
But unfortunately, Gu Nan still didn’t find any clues even after completing a full circle around the cemetery while carrying Duanmu Nianlan. There was nothing that resembled "Ying Ge" here.
Even though Gu Nan held one item after another in his hand, the Evil God Temple didn't give any event completion notice at all, which meant that none of them were Ying Ge.
"What can it be? Right…" Gu Nan suddenly remembered that he seemed to have forgotten a rather useful person.
The power of shadows flashed in front of his eyes, and a figure was quickly formed—this was a pretty young girl, although her skin looked a little dark because she was a shadow servant.
"So it really was you!" Duanmu Sen's eyes seemed like they’d spit out flames again. This was his other daughter, Duanmu Yin.
Although he already expected this somewhat, it still felt terrible to see his daughter’s killer summon his dead daughter after refining her into a puppet.
‘Fortunately, she’s not the most important daughter…’ Duanmu Sen could only comfort himself this way. As long as Duanmu Nianlan still had any hope of being saved, he wouldn’t turn on Gu Nan easily.
"This is the Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb. Do you have any memory of Ying Ge?" Gu Nan asked.
Duanmu Yin was refined into a shadow servant through extremely delicate technique, so quite a few of her memories from before death were preserved, many of which came from Zi Yi.
A wisp of Zi Yi’s soul possessed Duanmu Yin in order to lure Gu Nan to the Duanmu family's ancestral tomb, so perhaps she would know something about Ying Ge?
"I don't know of any Ying Ge…" Duanmu Yin shook her head decisively, which meant that she didn't even have an impression of these two words.
But then she added, "But I seem to know where to go from here."
……
The Duanmu family's residence really did look a little miserable.
Gu Nan's first sword was still alright, but he later fought Duanmu Nianlan. Both sides used the power of laws, and the collateral damage alone was enough to demolish everything around them.
Neither Zi He nor Jin Yi’s expressions looked good. The Duanmu family's buildings were reduced to ruins, which felt like a heavy slap to their faces.
Actually, arriving too late wasn’t the only problem. The fact that the Duanmu family's residence could be reduced to this sorry mess hinted at another possibility.
His injuries might not be as serious as they thought, and he might still have enough fighting power. Otherwise, how could he attack the Duanmu family?
And how could the Duanmu family's two Shinto cultivators just sit back and watch their family headquarters be flattened like this?
"It might not necessarily be Gu Nan." Jin Yi was silent for a long time, then finally found a reason, "Perhaps the Duanmu family just happened to encounter some other enemies…"
Not even she herself believed what she was saying, but Zi He agreed, "That’s right. Let's search first."
It didn’t matter what the reason was. What mattered was that the two of them were already here. If they were scared back without even being able to see the enemy’s face after making such a fuss about coming here, then how would these two still have any face left?
It was impossible for Starry Ocean Pavilion to be unaware of the fact that they mobilized so much manpower and resources to surround Floral Jasper Star.
The fact that Starry Ocean Pavilion turned a blind eye to their willfulness here was actually a form of compensation in and of itself. If they went back with their tails between their legs, then they’d never be able to bring up revenge again.
"Um… May I ask, is this the Duanmu family's residence?" A voice came from behind the two and made them turn their heads back in astonishment.
It was a girl who looked very normal. They couldn’t see anything unusual about her, be it her cultivation or anything else.
But the fact that she appeared here and asked such a question was abnormal in itself.
"Who are you? Why are you looking for the Duanmu family?" Jin Yi exchanged a glance with her companion and asked coldly.
“My name is Zhou Jingwen…" When Jin Yi fixed her stare on Zhou Jingwen, she felt like her heart was suddenly crushed by a heavy stone, and even her breathing became a little difficult.
Her rationally told her that she must never reveal Senior’s existence, but the inexplicable pressure made her involuntarily tell the truth.
"It’s a senior—"
"What kind of senior?" Jin Yi didn't even wait for her to finish and interrupted directly.
"A senior with only half a head."
……
Right as Zhou Jingwen reached the Duanmu family's gates and just happened to run into Jin Yi and Zi He, Gu Nan had also arrived at a strange place with three “people”—the Duanmu family’s father and two daughters.
Shadow servant Duanmu Yin didn’t lead Gu Nan to any place inside the ancestral tomb. Instead, she stopped at the door.
To be precise, she led them to the space underneath the door.
Boom!
Accompanied by Gu Nan's punch, a large hole was smashed into the ground in an instant, and the space underneath was indeed hollow.
The bleak moonlight shone inside. Gu Nan sent Duanmu Yin down first to scout ahead and soon confirmed that there was no danger inside. However, there was a little girl of twelve or thirteen years old.
Gu Nan’s pupils couldn't help contracting when he saw this girl.
This face, he’d seen it before.
"Who… are you?" The little girl had big beautiful eyes, and her common language was a bit shaky. It seemed that she hadn't spoken in a long time.
"What's your name?" Gu Nan sidestepped the question.
"My name is Ying Ge."

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Unexpected
chapters.content:
"My name is Ying Ge."
Gu Nan subconsciously checked his Evil God Temple when he heard this sentence, but there was still no event completion notice.
‘Why is it like this?’
This question only lingered for a moment before his experience as a top player allowed him to quickly find two possibilities.
Either the little girl in front of him was lying, or she was indeed called Ying Ge, but wasn’t the Ying Ge he was looking for.
He once again turned his attention to the girl named Ying Ge. Gu Nan knew that she was definitely a very important character as soon as he saw her face.
Her face was almost identical to someone else’s. No, to be exact, it was half a person. It was the left side of Zuo Zuo's face.
This little girl who called herself Ying Ge looked exactly like Zuo Zuo if the female left side of his face was restored whole.
‘Why did Zi Yi bring me here to find someone who obviously has a connection to Zuo Zuo?’
‘And what goal does that woman named Red have?’
These two thoughts echoed in Gu Nan's head and were then tossed aside—he wasn’t interested in NPCs’ conspiracies. He only cared about his own mission.
"It's still ahead…" Duanmu Yin's voice rang in Gu Nan's ear, shocking him.
He looked up. Unexpectedly, there was an entirely silver coffin behind the little girl.
The thoughts that hadn’t dispersed yet returned instantly. Just because Gu Nan was too lazy to think too deeply about NPCs’ matters didn’t mean that he couldn’t truly see through certain things.
‘This Ying Ge isn’t the one Zi Yi is looking for. Zi Yi should be looking for this coffin! As for the little girl called Ying Ge… Is it the woman named Red?’
Gu Nan began to realize that he seemed to have been drawn into two missions at once, one from Zi Yi and the other from Red.
The two missions had different goals, but they overlapped at one spot—that is, the Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb.
Gu Nan didn't ponder this further and quickly walked up to the silver coffin with Duanmu Nianlan slung over his shoulder, lifting the coffin’s lid with a wave of his hand.
A corpse was lying inside. The insides of coffins naturally contained corpses.
It was a corpse of an indescribably handsome man who looked to be in his mid-thirties. He was at the age where women of all ages would be smitten by his good looks.
No one knew how many years he’d been buried for, but not only did his appearance remain the same, even his skin showed no signs of decay.
But this handsome-looking uncle’s image was only ruined by one thing—a crescent-shaped blade was stabbed into his heart.
Gu Nan had done missions for so many years. It was impossible for him to lack the ability to make such a simple connection. This curved blade was clearly the item he was looking for!
He raised his hand to pull out the curved blade, but two shouts of alarm came from behind him at the same time.
"You can’t!"
"Please don't!"
The first came from Duanmu Sen, and the second actually came from the shadow servant Duanmu Yin.
Gu Nan's hand stopped just as he gripped the blade’s handle, but he didn't pull it out immediately. He turned around and asked, "Why?"
Both of them seemed to give simultaneous sighs of relief, and Duanmu Yin said quickly, "In my memory… Something very bad will happen if that crescent blade is pulled out…"
Everything about shadow servants was fixed. They would neither recall more memories nor forget the ones they retained.
Duanmu Yin couldn’t remember Zi Yi’s goal anymore, but she still remembered that the curved blade shouldn’t be pulled out.
On the other hand, Duanmu Sen was still human, and his memories would fluctuate. In the end, this was still his Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb, so seeing this scene finally allowed him to recall something.
"You must not pull it out. Once we lose its suppression, the Blood Ancestor will immediately revive!" Duanmu Sen said with a grave expression.
"Blood Ancestor?" Gu Nan glanced at that handsome uncle, then transferred his consciousness to the Evil God Temple.
Still no notification.
He was almost certain that the crescent blade in front of him was "Ying Ge," because there were two ancient characters on the body of the blade, which were still vaguely recognizable.
But the Evil God Temple still hadn’t judged his mission to be complete yet, so there was only one possibility.
In the game, the criteria by which the system determined mission completion might not be completely described in the mission’s instructions.
For example, two missions could both have the same goal of "finding XX,” but one mission might only require the player to see the target, while the other might require the player to obtain it.
The condition for mission completion was clearly more stringent this time. Even though Gu Nan had already grasped the target, that still didn’t count as clearing the mission.
Gu Nan fell silent, seemingly hesitating. As a shadow servant, Duanmu Yin didn't feel much, but Duanmu Sen became anxious.
"The Blood Ancestor is a great demon from ten thousand years ago. It’s said to be as immortal as the stars themselves. It’s most certainly a Star Ruler level existence. If—"
Before he could finish, Gu Nan had already pulled out the crescent blade with a whoosh, causing Classmate Duanmu Sen's face to pale.
Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head slightly.
On one side, there was the heinous demon who would plunge the world into chaos, while on the other side, there was his mission… Did he even need to think about it? What did world chaos have to do with Gu Nan?
When Gu Nan held the crescent blade in his hand, as he thought, the Evil God Temple finally shook slightly.
｢Evil Event Complete: Find Ying Ge. Total Evil Value obtained: 300｣
Gu Nan’s eyes almost popped out after seeing this short line of words.
300 Evil Value!
