chapters.title: Chapter 257: Novices?
chapters.content:
Wave control was a science.
In almost all competitive MOBA games, there was an emphasis on wave control, or wave management. However, because of the differing rules, the method and purpose of wave management were also different.
Gu Nan was proficient in almost all kinds of games, and this was naturally no exception.
He remained in front of the "minion wave" in a place not too near or too far away, floating in the air with the help of the law of shadows. He didn't make a move and just observed the field.
The two enemies on the opposite side, one old and one young, weren’t sure what he was doing, so they didn’t rush to take action for the time being and started waiting instead.
According to the normal train of thought in this world, the warring parties should be minions fighting against other minions and champions fighting against other champions, which was why the young man hurried to instantly kill a soldier before he started fighting champions.
In this way, when one side’s champions are forced to retreat due to injuries or are simply killed, then the other side’s champions can help their own minions and win the battle.
"Do you also think so?" Gu Nan had also heard Zi Dian and Ying Ge’s strategy before and only felt that it was a little laughable. Right now, he was asking Wu Gui.
Wu Gui nodded. "Immortal Kingdoms exist in the Myriad Heavens Universe. This is how wars between Immortal Kingdoms are fought."
Gu Nan, however, was noncommittal and only said, "The goal of war might be victory, but that’s not our goal right now."
Wu Gui paused slightly at that. Before she could react, Gu Nan's figure had disappeared and reappeared in front of a minion below.
That minion was already critically injured and seemed to be one step away from death. Therefore, Gu Nan only needed to exert minimal effort, and the minion’s head fell off with almost a gentle push.
The next second, two figures simultaneously materialized beside him. They were precisely the enemy champions.
"Die!" The young man's speed was obviously faster, and his whole body began to glow again. Clearly, this was his ability.
"Movement acceleration, attack bonus, pseudo-dash."
Gu Nan's indifferent gaze swept past him, immediately determining the characteristics of the other party's light-transforming ability.
Immediately afterwards, he instantly learned the Blink ability with a thought. His figure disappeared in front of the two opponents and reappeared behind Wu Gui, who was in front of the minion wave.
The two enemies were clearly taken aback for a second, but they quickly controlled their emotions. They weren’t in a hurry to pursue Gu Nan at all.
The older one was Star Ruler Mi Luo, and the younger one was Star Ruler Mi Tian. As for their relationship, probably no one would be able to guess—they were twins.
The “Mi duo” were also “veteran players” of Champions World. They understood very well that they must never go beyond the "battle line" to pursue enemies, otherwise the losses would outweigh the gains.
The troops from both bases were divided into various types, but ultimately, they could be divided into ranged and melee categories.
Crossing the battle line will immediately attract the attack of enemy archers. Under "Prodigious suppression," these ordinary minions could even hurt Star Rulers.
On the White Base’s side, Gu Nan couldn’t help frowning slightly when he briefly sensed the energy consumption.
As he expected, a single Blink consumed far more energy than it did in the outside world. Based on this scale, he could only use twenty consecutive Blinks at most.
But in actual combat, other abilities were just as energy-intensive, so the actual number of times Blink could be used was less than twenty.
"Big Brother, what should we do?" Star Ruler Mi Tian, who didn’t look older than twenty, asked the elderly man next to him.
This pair of twins who looked two generations apart in appearance could communicate with each other just fine.
Star Ruler Mi Luo answered, "That person learned a movement ability, so his attack power is bound to be insufficient. We will attack the soldiers directly."
Both of them had entered Champions World many times before, so they knew a lot about the abilities that could be learned.
The abilities that could be ranked up using skill points consist of two actives and one passive. Of the three abilities, one would certainly be attack, one would be defense, and the last one would be a movement ability, which could be adjusted based on each person's situation.
The other side learned a movement ability as soon as the battle started, so he would never be able to beat the two of them in attack power. Moreover, they also had the attack bonus from the black lane.
This was equivalent to giving up a wave of soldiers… ‘He’s obviously a novice!’
The twins glanced at each other and silently rejoiced at their good luck.
Almost in the blink of an eye, the two started pushing the wave. Their attacks kept hitting minions from the White Base, making these ordinary people suffer unspeakable misery.
"Brothers! Persevere!" A leader shouted from within the troops.
He originally would’ve added, "The esteemed champions will soon help us," but he really couldn't say that now—Gu Nan and Wu Gui were just standing quietly to the side with no intention of helping.
"Aren't we going to attack?" Wu Gui looked at the calm Gu Nan and couldn’t help asking.
In reality, she didn't understand Gu Nan's actions at all, but reason told her that since the other party knew more than her, he must have his reasons for not taking action.
Otherwise, how could she be the type of person to obediently listen to others?
"You can attack, but remember not to attack the minions." Gu Nan said casually, "Time your attacks to when they kill the minions. They won’t be able to fight back then."
……
On the white lane.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian’s current situation was practically the same as Gu Nan’s, except they were the side pushing the wave, while their two opponents were being beaten back.
"Their coordination is just so-so. They’re probably a patchwork team thrown together at the last minute." Zi Dian took care of another enemy minion with his sword and said, "Looks like those two went to the other lane.”
Ying Ge nodded silently. Ying Ge and Zi Dian’s previous explorations didn't yield much, but it wasn’t like they didn’t encounter anyone.
What they met was a team with tacit coordination, but the two sides only fought briefly, so they couldn't draw too many conclusions back then. Now, however, they could make a judgment.
"I hope they don't get pushed back too badly," Ying Ge said with a heavy voice as she slashed out with the crescent blade in her hand. A faint blood-red mist flowed out.
Her own strength no longer mattered inside the Myriad Heavens Starry Road. Everything was shaped by the laws of this plane, plus she still had her knowledge and experience.
When she said this, the bloody mist from Ying Ge’s blade slammed into the enemy’s city wall, creating a hissing sound.
This was her attack ability, which dealt unimaginable damage to the city wall!
……
On the black lane.
Wu Gui had been fighting the enemy champions all this time, while Gu Nan spent most of his time watching from the sidelines, only moving out to deal the last blow to dying enemies.
Because of their strategy, it didn't take long for the “minion wave" to be pushed towards them, and it was harder for Wu Gui to attack now—there were too many enemies.
This wave of minions were all from the Black Base. They surged forth towards Gu Nan like a tide.
"This offensive wave might be able to shave off 10% of the enemy city wall’s energy," Star Ruler Mi Luo’s elderly face was smiling so much that his wrinkles were practically pushed together.
Truthfully, he had never seen such a cooperative opponent before. Only one attacked the champions, while the other one basically spectated the entire time… If this went on, it wouldn’t be long before they could break through the city walls!
Once the city walls are breached, they’ll have the ability to directly attack the White Base, which is equivalent to winning half of the battle.
On the opposite side, Wu Gui had already retreated to Gu Nan's side. At this time, she could only give a light sigh. "Let’s retreat first. We can just defend the city walls."
"You go back." But Gu Nan shook his head. "I'll pull the wave."

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Level 2 Rush
chapters.content:
In the entire Myriad Heavens Starry Road, there were probably very few people who could match Gu Nan's understanding of last hitting and minion waves.
It wasn’t that Star Rulers were too stupid. Rather, they didn’t understand these kinds of rules at all, and it was even more impossible for them to dedicate time to research the gameplay under these rules.
Gu Nan naturally had his considerations when he had Wu Gui attack the enemy champions.
He considered the number and frequency of the minion waves in Champions World.
Based on Ying Ge and Zi Dian’s experience, there were only six minion waves here every day, and they were concentrated in the period from noon to dusk, so the frequency naturally won’t be low during this time.
Therefore, under Gu Nan's intentional control, when the “Mi duo" finished pushing, the second minion wave on both sides had already spawned and were about to arrive.
Under Wu Gui’s astonished gaze, Gu Nan actually dashed forward and rushed towards the Black Base troops.
Even Mi Luo and Mi Tian were taken aback by his actions. They almost thought that this fellow who’d been “taking it easy” all this time finally burned out his brain and wanted to rush forward to court death.
One should know that all of them were Level 1 right now. They would probably die in the blink of an eye if they directly faced off against such a large group of mortal troops.
Of course Gu Nan wasn’t planning to court death. He stopped in front of the minion wave with great precision to ensure that all the enemy troops could see him, but he was still slightly outside their attack range.
Next, he made an outrageous move—with a Blink, Gu Nan teleported directly behind the commander of the Black Base’s troops.
On the other side, the “Mi duo" sneered simultaneously.
"And here I thought this person came up with some good method… In the end, a beginner is still just a beginner." Star Ruler Mi Tian shook his head first, not bothering to hide the mockery in his eyes.
The fact that the other party could enter this world naturally meant that he was also a Star Ruler, but they didn’t expect him to be so naive.
‘Does he think he’s the only one who can think of a trifling tactic like beheading the enemy commander? When he tries, he’ll realize that the commander is far harder to kill than ordinary soldiers, and once killed…’
‘Sorry, all the soldiers will go berserk, which is not worth the cost at all.’
What the two didn't expect, however, was that after Gu Nan approached the commander of the Black Base, he had no intention of killing the commander and instead lifted him up with one hand.
The effect of "Prodigious suppression" was always there, weakening champions’ attack power and defense when facing mortals, but the champions’ actual strength hadn’t been suppressed.
Even if Gu Nan didn't have the Evil God Physique, it would still be easy to lift a mortal up.
So under the dumbfounded gazes of all the Black Base minions, Gu Nan didn't kill the commander. He… He kidnapped the commander!
"What does this person… want to do?" The two Star Rulers were equally confused.
In their field of vision, Gu Nan was running around in a circle holding the enemy commander in one hand, while troops from the Black Base were constantly chasing him.
Star Ruler Mi Luo seemed to react. "He’s stalling for time!"
"Isn't stalling helping us?" Star Ruler Mi Tian couldn't help laughing involuntarily. He really didn't know what to say about this beginner.
One should know that the second wave was arriving soon. Once the two waves of allied forces join together, their offensive would only be more fierce, and the attack on the enemy city walls would only intensify.
……
Yang Guang, dressed in armor and armed with a spear, walked on the lane with his head held high.
He was in very high spirits. After all, the greatest wish of his life was just around the corner, just like the tall city wall that had already appeared before his eyes.
Although the esteemed champions who descended weren’t too reliable, the education he received since childhood made Yang Guang temporarily forget this matter.
"Ah Guang, there's going to be a war!" Yang Quan, his younger brother, said excitedly as he stood beside Yang Guang with the same expression on his face.
Yang Guang was so moved that words almost failed him, so he just nodded vigorously.
"Ah Quan, I… Hey, what's that in front of you?!” Yang Guang was just about to speak with his brother when he saw a large mass of black shadows fly past the other side of the city wall.
Yang Quan looked over there in astonishment. After a long time, he finally answered, "It seems to be… an esteemed champion!? Hurry! Let’s inform the commander. We must rush there immediately!"
……
The second minion wave arrived a little faster than Gu Nan expected, but this didn’t affect his movements.
He led the Black Base’s army around in a small circle again, then finally tossed the enemy commander back.
When the second waves arrived, the positions of the frontline minions on both sides actually stopped just outside the attack range of the city wall.
"Perfect!"
After completing this series of actions, Gu Nan immediately praised himself shamelessly.
Wu Gui very cooperatively played the straight man, "What's the use of this?"
"Now that I’ve controlled the waves to this level, our two opponents can no longer last hit," Gu Nan explained with a sneer and added, "Follow me!"
On the opposite side, Mi Luo and Mi Tian were still entirely unaware. They waited until the two armies made contact with each other again, then immediately went forward to continue pushing.
Despite being close to the enemy's city wall, it was still possible to attack the melee troops.
They just didn't expect that this time, the other side’s two champions seemed to have gone crazy. As long as they dared to come forward to "last hit," those enemy champions would immediately pursue them relentlessly, launching fierce attacks.
This time, the two enemy champions attacked together, pursuing Mi Luo and Mi Tian as far as over half of the Black Base’s wave. They were extremely arrogant.
When the two Star Ruler brothers wanted to counterattack, those two always shrank back immediately, but unfortunately, Mi Luo and Mi Tian couldn't chase them… After all, they were still right underneath the enemy’s city walls.
The two Star Rulers who were originally in high spirits finally began to realize the disgusting feeling of having their minion wave stuck under the enemy’s tower.
"So that’s it… You planned this?" Wu Gui looked back at the city wall and felt an epiphany.
Gu Nan smiled. "Wave management is just a means to an end. Do you know how much money they’ll lose out on in this wave?"
Wu Gui shook her head very honestly, but although she didn't understand, Gu Nan understood it well.
Each side had around 500 minions in a single wave, of which about 5% were truly "valuable."
A small number of minions will be "marked" by the world right before they die. This kind of mark wasn’t obvious and required careful observation on the champion’s part.
Last hitting ordinary minions was worth only one champion coin, and sometimes there was no money at all. However, marked minions were worth at least 30 champion coins.
"The total value of a minion wave is around 1,000 champion coins, while the 25 valuable minions account for 75% of that income," Gu Nan said thus. "I call this kind of minion marked minions."
"In the first wave, in order to push the wave, the enemy champions missed a large portion of the minions. Moreover, they only dealt the final blow to around ten marked minions, and this was even divided between two people.”
"I, on the other hand, have already killed 14 of the 16 marked minions that appeared." Gu Nan's smile remained unchanged as he pointed to the front. "In the remaining wave, I can absolutely last hit every single one."
Wu Gui glanced between Gu Nan and the minion wave. "But if the other side continues to attack the minions, our city wall will be in danger when their next minion wave arrives."
Wave control playstyles were most afraid of mindless pushing. Although Wu Gui didn’t know this, she had extremely rich combat experience and could analyze it by herself.
"We just need to get rid of one of their champions," Gu Nan seemed to already have a plan.
"How?"
"Rush to Level 2."

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Instant Kill
chapters.content:
"Level 2 Rush" was a common saying in competitive games, but the “2" had different meanings under different rules.
The rule of Champions World was that as long as a minion dies, a nearby champion can gain experience, no matter who killed the minion. So if one wanted to rush for Level 2, they could only push the wave.
In fact, when over half of the first minion wave from the White Base had been cleared, the two enemy champions had already risen to Level 2.
There were obvious signs when champions leveled up. Of course Gu Nan and Wu Gui wouldn’t miss those signs.
However, it was too bad that Mi Luo and Mi Tian didn't have the money to rank up their abilities because of their terrible last hitting skills.
This was a very simple arithmetic calculation.
It takes 1,000 champion coins to rank up an ability by one level. Each champion was given 300 champion coins when the battle started, so they only needed to earn another 700 coins.
Every minion wave was worth 1,000 champion coins, but there wasn’t enough time for Level 1 champions to last hit every single minion, so they could only focus on last hitting the marked “high monetary value” minions.
The "Mi duo" killed roughly 5 marked minions per person, which was worth 150 champion coins. Including the 300 coins received at the start and the coins earned with the accumulation of time, the number of coins in their possession wouldn’t be over 500.
But what about Gu Nan?
As the marked minions fell down one after another, he killed nearly 23 marked minions, and he already had 989 champion coins.
The lost income from the two marked minions he missed when he was first adapting to the rhythm of battle had now been made up by time.
In front of the White Base’s city walls, another minion was about to die. A faint white light lit up on him; this was a special mark from the world.
Gu Nan’s expression changed slightly. He was quite far away from that minion. Under normal circumstances, he definitely wouldn’t make it.
That was also why it wasn’t easy to last hit in the early stages of the game. A full line of 500 vs. 500 minions stretched across the land for hundreds of meters. This wasn’t something that could be done simply by clicking on a screen. How could it be so easy to last hit minions?
This was a real battlefield; it wasn’t an exaggeration to say that countless changes took place in an instant.
However, Gu Nan didn't intend to let that dying minion go. His figure disappeared instantly and appeared directly behind the minion with a Blink—this was the final last hit before he rushed to Level 2. How could he let it go?!
The power of shadows emerged for the first time. A sword of shadow suddenly appeared in Gu Nan's hand, directly chopping off the minion’s head with a slash.
At the same time, Gu Nan's champion coins also jumped to 1,019. Having already risen to Level 2, he bought a skill point as fast as possible and added it to Shadow Sword Overlay.
｢Shadow Sword Overlay: Cast a shadow sword attack, causing three times the damage to the target. This ability can only be used twice in a short time｣
It was just Shadow Sword Overlay at Level 1, so its power was clearly not as terrifying as Gu Nan's original version, and there was also a limit on the number of uses in a short period of time, but it was already enough right now!
Under Mi Luo and Mi Tian’s stunned gazes, Gu Nan teleported behind Mi Luo with another Blink.
Gu Nan, who caught the opportunity, didn’t choose to use his ability directly. Instead, he stabbed Mi Luo in the back with a sword.
Gu Nan's action was too sudden, so until this sword pierced his back, Mi Luo couldn’t react in time at all. And the instant the tip of the sword sank into Mi Luo’s back, Gu Nan finally used the ability Shadow Sword Overlay.
Without Gu Nan needing to take any action, his body seemed to be manipulated by some kind of force. The sword that had been thrust forward was instantly drawn back, and his arm thrust at Mi Luo again.
Only this time, the sword of shadows was stacked on top of each other, as if layers of shadows had superimposed themselves, making a deep cut in Mi Luo’s back.
Originally, it was impossible for Gu Nan to make a second thrust so soon due to having to draw back his sword, but he made clever use of a rule of Champions World.
The abilities here were produced by the world itself rather than operated by the champions themselves. In other words, the champion only needed to click on the ability, and it would be used automatically.
This was also a means to balance the power gap between Star Rulers, but now it was used by Gu Nan to cancel the motion of drawing back his sword after stabbing out—allowing him to reset his attack!
Mi Luo, this elderly Star Ruler who was just stabbed twice, finally couldn’t help roaring in rage. He swiftly turned around, swinging the long blade in his hand at Gu Nan.
However, Gu Nan moved even faster, as if he had already expected this counterattack long in advance. He actually used Blink against the enemy in front of him again.
This Blink basically didn't produce displacement, but it succeeded in allowing him to appear behind Mi Luo again!
The sword of shadows in his hand thrust out again, precisely stabbing the same spot as the previous wound, followed by a Shadow Sword Overlay in the same way, piercing Mi Luo’s back for the fourth time.
This time, the sword stabbed the already-deep injury, causing fatal damage to Star Ruler Mi Luo.
The shadow sword with thrice the damage hit the target twice in a row, and there were even two auto attacks mixed in during this period, all of which were completed by Gu Nan the instant he attacked.
Four blows in an instant!
The poor Star Ruler Mi Luo didn't even get to see his opponent before that last sword sliced off over half of his shoulder, while his heart, which Gu Nan had always been aiming at, also broke apart, spraying blood profusely.
After all, Mi Luo was merely a Level 2 champion right now, which was equivalent to someone who just entered Prodigious Realm, and he wasn’t even in good condition to begin with. How could he survive such an attack from Gu Nan?
The elderly Star Ruler Mi Luo struggled twice, then finally found it difficult to maintain himself, falling directly from the air.
As soon as he died, the curtain of blood in the sky flashed slightly, and a white pillar of light lit up from the sky, cutting through the blood-red curtain to shine on Gu Nan.
Gu Nan saw his champion coins increase by 500.
A champion was worth 500 coins. This deal definitely didn’t lose out to last hitting!
"Brother!" Star Ruler Mi Tian, who was next to them, only had time to scream. He quickly lunged at Gu Nan, but the latter teleported behind Wu Gui again with another Blink.
Shadow Sword Overlay and four consecutive Blinks had already consumed most of Gu Nan's power of shadows, so he had no choice but to pause for a rest.
When he glanced at the opposite side again, Gu Nan found that although Star Ruler Mi Tian was gnashing his teeth furiously, he ultimately didn’t do anything hotheaded like brashly coming forward to throw his life away. In contrast, he even retreated slightly and landed on the ground.
After all, he was someone in the Star Ruler Realm. Although it was possible for him to be caught off guard by Gu Nan’s scheme, it wasn’t likely for him to act impulsively—after all, his brother was merely dead; it wasn’t like he couldn’t resurrect.
Moreover, this Star Ruler Mi Tian was quite smart—because he chose to land.
"Too bad." Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head a little. These Star Rulers might not be familiar with the rules of MOBA games, but their grasp of the battle situation was still first-class.
"If he didn’t land, then it won’t be long before you can kill him as well, isn’t that right?" Wu Gui asked from the side.
She was absolutely right. Since Gu Nan could use Shadow Sword Overlay to kill Star Ruler Mi Luo, the younger brother Mi Tian naturally couldn’t escape either.
The only difference was that the other party would be more prepared, so Gu Nan would need to spend some more time to kill him. As long as Gu Nan recovered his condition a little, it wasn’t hard to kill the enemy.
But the situation became different again now that the other party chose to land among the minions.
If Gu Nan tried to hunt down Star Ruler Mi Tian right now, not only would he face the counterattack from the enemy champion, but he would also have to fend off the attacks from all the surrounding minions!

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Give me the kill
chapters.content:
Champions World was more like the holographic games in Gu Nan's past life, which were different from competitive games played using a keyboard and mouse.
One of the biggest differences was that under normal circumstances, the majority of minions’ attacks against champions wouldn’t hit their marks.
After all, champions were all Prodigious cultivators capable of flying in the air. How could minions hit them from the ground? Even for long-range archers, shooting the arrow upwards would still greatly reduce its power.
In a normal laning phase, champions wouldn’t casually cross over the battle line, because if they went too deep into enemy territory, the enemy could flank them and force them to land on the ground. But it was actually alright if they just went over the line a little.
As long as they weren’t held up by the enemy, they had nothing to fear even if they drew the minions’ aggro.
Therefore, when Gu Nan controlled the wave to be directly underneath the tower, they were able to aggressively stop the enemy from last hitting—they were backed by the city wall, so even if they recklessly crossed the battle line, it was still impossible for the "Mi duo" to flank them!
But similarly, it was also because of this setting that Star Ruler Mi Tian basically received the minion wave’s protection once he chose to land among friendly minions.
At this time, if Gu Nan went to kill him again, the Black Base minions would certainly not be polite to him.
"But his actions are tantamount to completely giving up on last hitting," Gu Nan remarked with a smile.
Of course the reason all the champions unanimously decided to float in midair at the start of the battle wasn’t purely to look flashy. Only a bird’s-eye view of the battlefield would allow them to easily observe the overall situation and see where they could last hit.
Once a champion landed on the ground battlefield, they’d only be able to see their immediate surroundings, and the number of last hits they’d be able to get in would be particularly pitiful.
"What do we do next? Keep pushing?" Wu Gui seemed to become a curious child, needing to consult Gu Nan every step of the way.
She’d gradually gotten used to Gu Nan's choice of words, and she also asked insightful questions.
Star Ruler Mi Tian hid amongst the minions firstly to protect himself and secondly to slow down the rhythm of their push. If they wantonly attacked the enemy minions, they might just fall prey to a sneak attack from Mi Tian.
"Push," but Gu Nan answered without hesitation.
The purpose of wave control was to keep the enemy from last hitting and perhaps even rush to Level 2 to kill the enemy. Now that the tactical objectives had already been achieved, there was no need to continue.
While saying this, Gu Nan handed something to Wu Gui. Surprisingly, it was a giant basket packed to the brim with swords.
These longswords were all weapons used by mortals, and the materials were of such poor quality that Wu Gui could casually snap them with one hand.
"This is what you found in the base?"
"Yup."
After receiving an affirmative answer, Wu Gui shot Gu Nan a strange look, up until Gu Nan flew up to the enemy wave and mercilessly threw the sword down.
The slightly blunt sword actually pierced straight through an enemy’s body under the workings of Gu Nan’s terrifying strength and gravity.
The battlefield fell silent momentarily. A weapon falling from the sky made many people subconsciously look up.
When they saw Gu Nan's figure and identified which side he belonged to, there was a burst of cheering from those belonging to the White Base, while the Black Base’s troop morale dropped yet again since Mi Luo’s death.
The differences between Champions World and pure competitive games were reflected in every minute detail, and morale was also a very important factor.
Low morale also played a role in the White Base minions being pushed back so easily.
"Isn't there Prodigious suppression?" Wu Gui had reached Gu Nan’s side at some point. She also tested it out by throwing a sword down, and the result was generally the same.
"Prodigious suppression only suppresses Prodigious Realm power used directly against them." Gu Nan aimed a sword at another enemy and impaled him to death. "But it was the sword that killed them, not us."
Wu Gui paused slightly, considering his words for a long time. There didn’t seem to be anything wrong with what he said.
"Then why didn't you do this before?"
"Since it’s the sword that killed them, the money won’t belong to me either!"
……
On the white lane.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian were still pushing the opponents’ minion wave, practically beating the two enemy champions down so much that they couldn’t even lift their heads and slowly wearing away the health of the city wall.
This was also not the first time the two of them had entered Champions World. Although they might not have studied the art of “wave management” in-depth, they were still able to comprehend the basic principles from experience.
At this time, their wave stayed near the front of the enemy's city wall to ensure that the enemy wouldn’t dare go out while also making it easy for them to last hit.
At the same time, because of the lane’s attack bonus advantage, they could organize an attack on the city wall every two waves, putting great pressure on the Black Base.
This was precisely the tactical victory that Mi Luo and Mi Tian wanted to achieve the most, but Gu Nan single-handedly controlled the waves, completely destroying their plan.
Just as Ying Ge and Zi Dian were relentlessly attacking, white light suddenly flashed over the other end of the bloody sky, landing on the side belonging to the White Base.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian, who were both “old hands” here, couldn’t help feeling stunned. They looked at each other in surprise, then couldn’t help staring over there.
Of course they knew this was a sign that an enemy champion had been killed.
"The two enemies on that lane are obviously veterans, yet one of them actually died to a pair of novices?" The petite Ying Ge flung her cloak and even forgot about pushing the wave to ask.
Zi Dian's face appeared somewhat helpless, and he also sheathed his sword. "The origin of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara is fairly clear. If I really have to name someone who can accomplish such a thing… I'm afraid there’s only that little fellow."
It wasn’t wrong for these two, who’d lived for tens of thousands of years, to refer to Gu Nan as this.
The two fell silent for a moment. They didn't know how Gu Nan did it, so they became more and more curious about this guy with mysterious origins.
"Why do you think that one asked him to protect me?" Ying Ge casually stabbed the crescent blade into her own body.
The curved blade named Ying Ge sank into the girl’s abdomen, but it didn't cause any scars. Instead, it was like a drop of water falling into the sea, merging with her body.
But Zi Dian just shook his head slightly. "She has ruled over Star Realm for several eras, but there are very few examples of her meddling in the internal matters of Star Realm. However, she made an exception this time."
Although Zi Dian was only calmly stating facts, Ying Ge had been with him for many years. Their minds were already connected, so she knew exactly what he was talking about.
"There aren’t many matters that can elicit that one’s concern." Ying Ge’s eyes seemed to flicker with a faint crimson light. "That Gu Nan, he recognizes me… my face, that is."
……
On the black lane.
After Gu Nan and Wu Gui gave up the income from last hitting and adopted the “dart throwing” method to push the wave, the speed at which they cleared the enemy minions suddenly rose by more than one grade.
Only Gu Nan, someone who finished killing all the marked minions, would dare to sacrifice all that income like this. Otherwise, pushing the wave like this would do more harm than good.
But if Gu Nan and Wu Gui merely lost out on some income, then Star Ruler Mi Tian’s situation could be described as “wants to cry but has no tears.”
Mi Luo, his older brother, hadn’t even respawned yet. Mi Tian was originally hiding among the minions and believed himself to be safe for the time being, at least until the next minion wave arrived…
But who knew that these two fellows would actually bring over some mortal weapons!
When all the minions from the Black Base fell, Star Ruler Mi Tian’s location was also exposed, leaving him with nowhere to run or hide.
He could only watch as Gu Nan and Wu Gui simultaneously rushed towards him. Gu Nan was even saying something:
"Give me the kill."

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Tower Dive
chapters.content:
After successfully pocketing the kill for Star Ruler Mi Tian, Gu Nan's champion coins exceeded 1,000 again. Of course Wu Gui didn’t try to steal his kill, and it wasn’t like she would’ve been able to anyhow.
Although he didn’t have enough experience to rise to Level 3, Gu Nan already had enough to buy a skill point and learn the Evil God Physique ability.
In Champions World, a champion’s ability rank couldn’t exceed the champion’s level.
If Gu Nan had enough skill points, then he, who was currently Level 2, could totally rank up all his abilities to Level 2.
"Should we clean up the second minion wave before those two rush back?" Wu Gui asked upon seeing Star Ruler Mi Tian die.
Gu Nan glanced at her, knowing that all Star Ruler Realm existences had top-tier comprehension and learning abilities.
After merely watching him handle the battle a few times, her understanding of minion waves had already grown to the point where it wasn’t inferior to that of ordinary players.
Under normal circumstances, taking advantage of the enemy champions’ respawn time to swiftly push the wave was indeed the best choice, but the current situation clearly wasn’t normal.
Gu Nan, who possessed three abilities, was already fully capable of soloing two enemy champions.
"I’ll circle around them. You freeze the wave
[1]
near the city wall," Gu Nan gave Wu Gui such instructions.
Freeze the wave—this was another unfamiliar concept. Wu Gui stared blankly and asked, "What should I do?"
"Remember how I controlled the wave earlier?"
……
Yang Guang was very excited right now.
The second wave of White Base soldiers that he was part of had been winning battles ever since they came to the frontlines, especially after the death of Star Ruler Mi Luo.
‘As expected of an esteemed champion!’
After witnessing Gu Nan's heroic deeds, Yang Guang's impression of him changed greatly.
The originally heinous behavior of bullying his younger sister suddenly seemed like an esteemed champion's magnanimity in not bothering with trifling matters, and he even felt glad that he didn't try to rashly interrogate that champion.
"Ah Quan, you’re absolutely right!" Standing on the battlefield, Yang Guang beheaded another enemy while exclaiming to his younger brother Yang Quan, "After all, he’s an esteemed champion!"
A somewhat wry smile appeared on Yang Quan’s face. Of course he knew what his eldest brother meant, but it would be unreasonable to say that he had predicted this.
Compared to his eldest brother, Yang Quan had read more books and knew more about champions.
‘The past legends of champions’ deeds never mentioned anything like what this one did…’
While the two were conversing, a loud whistle came from the rear. The two brothers looked back in shock. That whistle came from the commander’s tent. To them, its meaning couldn’t be more clear.
Enemy attack!
To be able to launch a sneak attack directly on the commander’s tent… ‘Could it be that the enemy has a third champion?’
Yang Guang and Yang Quan wanted to rush back immediately, but in the military that valued strict discipline above all else, they couldn’t move freely without orders, so they could only wait anxiously.
Fortunately, they didn't have to wait long. A messenger soon arrived.
"Pass along the military order: everyone…" This messenger, whose voice was supposed to be in a cadence all the time, sounded somewhat helpless right now, "return to the base!"
……
On the other end of the black lane, the second minion wave had set off a long time ago, but Star Ruler Mi Luo, who came back after respawning, wasn’t in a hurry to move.
He’d been to Champions World several times. Although he wasn’t like Wu Gui, who had a "good teacher" like Gu Nan to study under, he was by no means stupid.
The other party was only able to instantly kill him by learning two abilities, and after killing him and his younger brother, the enemy would get another 1,000 champion coins.
‘In other words, now the other party already has three abilities…’ When he thought of this, Star Ruler Mi Luo suddenly felt a slight headache.
In order to stop continuously feeding the opponent coins from his death, Star Ruler Mi Luo wisely did not move forward immediately, instead choosing to wait for his younger brother.
Star Ruler Mi Tian was killed quite soon after him, so their respawn times were naturally close together. The two quickly set off from the base, heading for the city walls on the frontlines.
"Brother, that person probably has three abilities now. Should we wait by our own city wall first?" The young-looking Star Ruler Mi Tian didn’t handle matters in a youthful way at all. Instead, he was very cautious.
Star Ruler Mi Luo also nodded. "If the opposite side advances here and starts pressuring our city wall, we can take advantage of the chaos to level up and wait for the third wave of soldiers… Watch out!"
Star Ruler Mi Luo gave an explosive shout, but his hands couldn’t react in time. He could only watch Gu Nan appear instantly and then ruthlessly slash his younger brother's back with a sword.
Four strikes in an instant again! And it was four strikes with the strength bonus from the Evil God Physique ability!
Poor Star Ruler Mi Tian—he was chosen as Gu Nan’s first target because of his dash ability. His last thought was:
‘How can he appear here?’
……
On the white lane.
No matter which lane, minions spawned at the same rate. Ying Ge and Zi Dian had just finished taking advantage of the second wave to wear down a good chunk of the enemy’s city wall when two more white flashes lit up the crimson sky.
This time, it was clear that two champions had been killed in quick succession.
"Two more. This is really…" Ying Ge had slaughtered so many people that her eyes were scarlet, and even her pupils turned blood-red, but she was still so stunned by this scene that she turned around to look.
The third wave hadn’t even arrived, yet the enemy side had already died four times… This kind of speed really seemed like the other side was just throwing away their lives.
On the other hand, the most that Ying Ge and Zi Dian—who clearly had the geographical advantage—could do was to pressure their enemies and wear down the city wall slightly.
After all, they were all Star Rulers. Even if the enemy champions weren’t very familiar with the rules and couldn’t cooperate very effectively, it was still easy for them to not die.
"Looks like we can relax a little this time." Zi Dian, on the other hand, couldn’t care less; he was even happy to see this.
Compared with Mi Luo and Mi Tian, this uncle-and-loli combo clearly had a more distinct division of labor.
Ying Ge was responsible for keeping an eye out for enemy champions’ attacks, while Zi Dian put most of his energy into last hitting. Although he couldn’t kill every marked minion like Gu Nan did, his skills were still much better than the Mi duo.
Based on this speed, he only needed to farm two more waves to buy his first skill point.
Just when the two were methodically last hitting and suppressing their enemies, a voice suddenly sounded in their ears right as the third minion wave arrived:
"Clear all minion waves and prepare for a tower dive
[2]
."
Ying Ge and Zi Dian looked down in astonishment; even their movements froze. They found a familiar figure among the newly-arrived third wave.
"Gu Nan?! How can he be here?" Ying Ge almost forgot to throw out the crescent blade in her hand. This scene was truly too unexpected.
Although Champions World didn’t limit the number of champions on each lane, it was almost the default rule to have two people per lane.
The reason was very simple—because two people were more than enough to defend against three champions. They could always support each other and run away. However, it would be too difficult for a single person to defend a lane from two people’s bombardment; that person might even be killed if they weren’t careful.
So it was impossible for anyone with even a little common sense to assign three people to one lane.
However, Ying Ge quickly understood.
This time, they weren’t simply three people. The opponents had already fed them four champion kills. If this advantage was concentrated onto a single person…
Before she could think this through, when the last minion from the Black Base fell and the city wall began to attack the White Base’s troops, Gu Nan's figure had abruptly dashed out.
T/N:
[1]
Freezing the wave
:
Stall the wave in an area just outside the tower range and continue to maintain it in that state for a while
[2] Tower dive
:
An attempt to kill the enemy when they are under their own tower, without dying

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Gank
chapters.content:
The two Black Base champions defending the white lane were two Star Rulers who were complete strangers before this.
There were very few occasions where Star Rulers teamed up to begin with, so there were many loners in the Myriad Heavens Starry Road. But they just had to meet the perfectly-coordinated Ying Ge and Zi Dian combo right at the start, making these two feel somewhat helpless.
This also wasn’t the first time that the two from the Black Base had entered Champions World. They knew very well that coordination between champions in a team of two would impact the battle greatly.
Therefore, from the beginning, the two of them never planned to seek any meritorious achievements. Rather, they simply sought to not make mistakes, which was why they hid behind their city wall all this time.
This tactic seemed to be very effective. At least so far, the Ying Ge-Zi Dian team that had tacit coordination between them could only attack the city wall but couldn’t kill these champiions.
However, this deadlock was broken when the opponent’s third wave arrived.
Those two champions were still hovering in the air when they suddenly sensed a fluctuation of laws among the minions on the ground.
"Prodigious Realm power, it’s a champion!" One of the Star Rulers was immediately startled. Right when he wanted to call out to his companion to be careful, he saw the one-eyed Star Ruler beside him stare behind him with horror.
Before he could do anything, he felt a sudden pain in his back. The terrifying strength behind the attack practically swatted him out of the air.
But it wasn’t over yet. He didn't have time to turn around at all before another series of attacks descended.
The tearing pain on his body made the Star Ruler both surprised and furious. He knew that he had little health left, but he just couldn’t figure out…
‘How can there be such a powerful opponent?’
‘We’re still within our city walls!’
He was absolutely right. Almost at the same time he died, a beam of light suddenly shot out from the city wall and slammed into the enemy behind him.
For champions at this stage of the game, the city walls still held considerable attack power.
Even if Gu Nan had circled around Mi Luo and Mi Tian and killed them again, successfully ranking up his Evil God Physique to Level 2, he still couldn't withstand the damage dealt by the city wall.
The laser beam pierced through his chest. The searing heat from the high-energy attack left a scorched mark on Gu Nan, and even his tissues began to char.
But he still didn't intend to leave. His gaze shifted to the one-eyed Star Ruler beside him who was still alive.
The latter’s mouth twitched slightly. He had nowhere to escape, so he could only lift his hand helplessly and strike at Gu Nan.
At the start of the battle, almost everyone picked offensive abilities in order to gain a pushing advantage, so the one-eyed Star Ruler could only try and see if he could kill Gu Nan right now.
Of course this was impossible.
A Gu Nan with three abilities unlocked was much more flexible than he was. Before the other party’s attack even reached him, he had already “Blinked” behind the enemy, continuously swinging his shadow sword down.
This time, however, his Shadow Sword Overlay had gone into cooldown, so he had to tank another attack from the city wall.
After tanking three consecutive laser beams, Gu Nan finally succeeded in killing the one-eyed Star Ruler, while he himself was also riddled with holes.
"Can't tank it, can't dodge it. It really is a Prodigious killer," Gu Nan spent the last of his strength to instantly leave using Blink while muttering.
The city wall’s laser beam was mostly composed of the power of laws, yet it also came preinstalled with the “law nullification” characteristic, so most of the damage directly acted upon Gu Nan’s body.
It was fortunate that Gu Nan ranked up his defensive ability twice, or else he probably wouldn’t even be able to tank one hit.
However, another 1,000 champion coins were deposited into his account, and he also reached Level 3 from the EXP gain, which made Gu Nan feel gratified after all was said and done.
Two more streaks of white light flashed across the sky again. Ying Ge and Zi Dian helplessly exchanged a glance. They finally knew why the two enemy champions on the other lane kept dying so miserably and frequently.
‘This Gu Nan has clearly unlocked three abilities—he can kill enemy champions by himself!’
Neither of them provided any help during the entire "tower dive" process. At best, they merely helped push the wave forward, giving Gu Nan a chance to approach the enemy.
In the game’s jargon, Gu Nan’s development had far outpaced the other side now that he had six kills under his belt.
That, combined with the fact that his ability configuration was that of an assassin to begin with, enabled him to achieve such an unimaginable result.
"But with your current injuries, I'm afraid it’ll take a long time to recover, won’t it?" Ying Ge asked Gu Nan just as he returned to their side.
Gu Nan, who’d continuously tanked the tower shots, really did look a little miserable right now.
The city wall’s laser beam contained a disintegration attribute, causing Gu Nan's entire left hand to be riddled with densely-packed small holes. This appearance alone was enough to drive those with trypophobia crazy.
And although champion fountains existed in Champions World, they were only good for respawning champions and didn’t have any effect like accelerating healing.
"Yeah, it’ll take at least a few days to recover," Gu Nan agreed.
While it was true that the Evil God Physique was very powerful, without Praise of Dawn to speed up recovery by three times, it was impossible for injuries like this to recover quickly.
Ying Ge secretly sighed in relief. In the end, this Gu Nan wasn’t monstrously invincible. "Then you—"
However, before she could finish, Gu Nan's figure had already shot out again. He threw himself at the enemy’s city wall while leaving such a sentence:
"You guys keep pushing, I'll go execute myself
[1]
first."……
When Gu Nan respawned from the fountain and returned to the black lane, Wu Gui had fully carried out his instructions, concentrating all subsequent minion waves in front of the city wall.
There were already four White Base commanders standing beside Wu Gui, which meant that she’d frozen four waves in front of the city wall.
Mi Luo and Mi Tian had already returned to the frontlines, and they were staring at the White Base’s city walls with conflicted expressions.
They didn’t know how the opponent kept all these soldiers right in front of the city wall without advancing forward, but this situation made them very miserable.
Their own soldiers constantly entered the city wall’s attack range and were then killed by the city wall and the enemy soldiers’ coordinated attacks, while the enemy soldiers suffered few casualties.
Correspondingly, the two of them couldn’t earn experience and champion coins either, so they could only watch as more and more enemy waves gathered in front of the city wall.
They tried all kinds of methods, but they still couldn't stop their own soldiers from advancing. No matter how they threatened or cajoled, they couldn't stop these ignorant masses who’d been brainwashed.
It wasn’t until the fifth wave when the two finally realized… It was the commander!
“Esteemed champions, what exactly do you two want to do?!” The Black Base commander who’d finally been detained glared at Mi Luo and Mi Tian.
The two brothers, one old and one young, glanced at each other and thought, ‘If we knew what the enemy wanted to do, then we wouldn’t be standing here!’
But no matter what, they couldn’t sit idly by and watch their own soldiers throw their lives away meaninglessly.
At that moment, a shadow slunk to the sky above the enemy’s city wall. The obvious law fluctuation startled the two of them. They knew that that guy had returned.
"You’ve worked hard." Gu Nan looked down with satisfaction. Four minion waves were gathered together on the ground.
"Why did it take you so long to return this time?" Wu Gui was a little baffled. She saw the white flashes light up the sky a long time ago.
Gu Nan didn't say he "returned to the city for free" for a wave, which wasted some time. He just said, "Cut them loose. We'll head straight to the high ground this wave."
"How do we cut them loose?"
Gu Nan glanced back at her. Then, with a casual wave of his hand, the four commanders were flung directly off the city wall, smashing into the ground in front of the Black Base minions.
T/N:
[1] Executed
: If a champion dies and hasn't been damaged nor been inflicted with a debuff by an enemy champion in the last 15 seconds (in this case dying to the tower/turret/city wall). In some cases it could be strategically advantageous for a player to purposefully be executed as an alternative to dying from an enemy champion; in doing so, the enemy receives no gold.
Gank
:
To ambush unsuspecting enemies. Portmanteau of 'gang kill'

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Legendary
chapters.content:
Near the White Base’s city walls, the two armies that were originally confronting each other simultaneously fell silent.
Commanders! The commanders of the White Base!
For the Black Base minions, the enemy commanders were their goal and meant military merit and honor!
At this moment, their own commanders’ orders and being under the enemy city wall—none of those could win against their desire for military merit. And as long as one person did it first, the rest of the minions would pounce like wolves.
The White Base minions went without saying. The only reason they were forced to stay near the city wall was because someone detained their four commanders.
"Kill them!"
"Save the commanders! Charge with me!"
Frenzied shouts came from both sides at the same time. The minions on both sides collided head-on without hesitation. Thus, the White Base’s advantage of accumulating four minion waves quickly revealed itself.
Due to the lack of effective commands, the Black Base’s army was quickly infiltrated, and almost all the soldiers on that side were forced to fight alone against two or three enemies at once.
"Big Brother, let's withdraw quickly!" At the sight of this situation, Star Ruler Mi Tian immediately knew things weren’t progressing well, so he hurriedly suggested.
The other party suddenly tossed all their commanders out, setting off a decisive battle between the two sides. After connecting this with the earlier shadow suspected of being Gu Nan, how could these two still not understand Gu Nan’s intentions?
This was a guy who had four champion kills in his hands. At the present stage, no one was a match for him.
They didn’t yet know that Gu Nan took some time to gank a wave just now and got two more champion kills on the white lane. If they knew this, they probably would’ve run away even faster.
Star Ruler Mi Luo’s expression also looked ugly. He retreated with his younger brother without another word, but he wasn’t optimistic.
After all, once they started accumulating their own waves, they would expose their locations again.
But for some reason, even until they retreated all the way underneath the Black Base’s city wall, Gu Nan's figure still didn't appear again. This finally allowed the two to rest assured.
……
Gu Nan, who’d already gotten six champion kills, really was in no hurry to kill them. Or rather, he had more important things to do right now.
"See that minion? He has an obvious mark before death. Killing him is worth 30 champion coins."
"You couldn’t even see that? Are you blind?"
“……” Classmate Wu Gui had a dark expression.
Under Gu Nan’s "guidance," she quickly learned how to last hit. Actually, she was already learning pretty fast, but Gu Nan's requirements were truly too high.
But they had to be high, because Gu Nan's goal was to have her buy the second skill point during this wave.
As a top player, Gu Nan knew very well that in order to win, when his own development had already exploded, giving up a part of his income to develop a teammate was the right way to go.
Moreover, he definitely wouldn’t lose out by giving up some income to Wu Gui, because her defensive ability was a godly tower dive ability.
｢Protection of Buddha’s Heart: Block the next incoming damage and reduce subsequent damage by 50%. This ability cannot be used on the same target in a short time｣
Active defense abilities were uncommon, but they were undoubtedly quite powerful.
Under Gu Nan's practically hands-on guidance, Wu Gui finally dealt the final blow to enough minions and barely managed to collect 1,000 champion coins.
Gu Nan couldn't help secretly wiping away some cold sweat. Too bad Champions World didn’t have the concept of an assist, or else he wouldn’t have had to work so hard.
While guiding Wu Gui, Gu Nan also didn't forget to take the time to push the wave and try to preserve his four waves as much as possible.
Whether or not they could destroy the enemy’s city wall in one fell swoop depended entirely on these minions.
……
Underneath the Black Base’s city wall, Mi Luo and Mi Tian were observing the battle with grave expressions. A large wave of White Base minions were rushing over.
"Today's last wave of troops hasn't arrived yet. Looks like we can only try our best to defend," Star Ruler Mi Luo rubbed the wrinkles on his face and said with a heavy voice.
Star Ruler Mi Tian snorted coldly. "That guy is indeed very powerful, but his mistake is that he shouldn’t have exposed the method to accumulate soldiers."
To think it was possible to accumulate soldiers like this. When they first discovered it, the shock this pair of brothers felt was indescribable.
This practically toppled the rules of the entire Champions World.
Once more people learn this method, all future battles in Champions World will just turn into both sides accumulating one giant wave of soldiers, then fighting to the death.
It was the same even now. Star Ruler Mi Tian sneered. "As long as we can make it through today, we'll gather six waves of troops tomorrow and set out together. He's just asking for trouble."
Once both sides had six waves, it would obviously be more difficult for the other party to exert their individual strength, and Mi Luo and Mi Tian could also get the chance to develop well.
And once everyone has three abilities in hand, the other party won’t get to be so arrogant anymore!
The two Star Rulers had such plans. However, just as the White Base minions were about to arrive under the city wall, a panting voice came:
"Be, be careful!"
The two turned to look and saw one of their companions. The one-eyed Star Ruler, who was supposed to be on the white lane, was currently hurrying over.
The one-eyed Star Ruler hadn’t learned any movement skills yet, so he ran here with his own two legs. Even flying was too slow.
"The enemy with the sword can kill people inside the city wall!" The one-eyed Star Ruler saw the enemy troops at first glance and loudly shouted a warning, even forgetting to greet them.
The “Mi duo” could no longer hear his specific words.
Because just as his voice traveled over, a terrifying law fluctuation also appeared behind them simultaneously, so only the words "inside the city wall" could be heard from the distance.
The jet black sword of shadow descended. This time, Gu Nan didn't even need to use his ability to reset his attack. Using his abilities twice was enough to instakill one person.
Seeing that figure appear again and instakill his teammate right in front of him, the one-eyed Star Ruler almost stomped his foot in anger.
‘Just a step late, if only I got here earlier…’
"I'll kill you!" This enraged roar came from Star Ruler Mi Tian. This time, it was his turn to watch his brother be killed. The irritation from being suppressed all the time finally exploded in his heart.
But things in this world could never be resolved just by exploding with anger.
The income gap between them was too big. Even if Gu Nan was in their place, he still wouldn’t be able to think of any good solution, let alone Star Rulers unfamiliar with the game.
A few seconds later, the sword of shadow swiftly swung down, and Star Ruler Mi Tian followed in his older brother's footsteps, feeding another kill to Gu Nan.
Another two kills, another 1,000 champion coins!
Up till now, Gu Nan already had eight kills in his hand. Based on the game’s calculation, he now had a Legendary kill
[1]
.
Of course, Champions World wasn’t so leisurely as to keep track of this, and Star Rulers wouldn’t possibly care about these honors either. They only cared about victory.
After beheading Star Ruler Mi Tian in a single slash, Gu Nan tanked three more laser beams.
Even when his body was surrounded by Protection of Buddha’s Heart, which blocked most of the damage for him, the price of tower diving during this phase of the game was still too high. Gu Nan was already an arrow at the end of its flight.
So Gu Nan could only Blink away after casting one last glance at the one-eyed Star Ruler.
