chapters.title: Chapter 264: Counterattack
chapters.content:
Under the enemy city wall, Gu Nan had already returned to Wu Gui’s side once again with Blink. Then he gazed at the opposite city wall and couldn't help sighing slightly.
"There's a little trouble. A third person came here."
Gu Nan was talking about that one-eyed Star Ruler. After another wave of solo tower diving, he was once again left with heavy injuries, so he couldn’t attack that person anymore.
Moreover, Protection of Buddha’s Heart also had a cooldown, so it couldn’t be used on him again for a period of time.
"Is it someone from the other lane?" Wu Gui quickly realized, raising her brow.
Gu Nan nodded wordlessly. These Star Rulers really weren’t simple characters. Even if he used his ample experience to suppress them for a while, their understanding of the situation was still not far behind his.
After Gu Nan went over to the other lane for a tower dive, the one-eyed Star Ruler quickly realized that the same thing might be done here, so he hurried to this lane.
It’s just that he was a little late, but despite this, he still brought Gu Nan a lot of trouble.
Because in the following city siege, the difference between having an enemy champion assist with defense and not having one was simply unreasonable.
"I'll tank the city wall’s attack and kill him!" Wu Gui suggested without hesitation.
She also understood this situation, so even if she had to give up her own life, she still must trade kills with that enemy champion. They’d only have a chance of breaking through the city’s defenses if that person died.
However, Gu Nan shook his head slightly. "He knows that we can tower dive, so how can he still be on the city wall?"
Wu Gui stared blankly. When she glanced at the city wall again, the one-eyed Star Ruler had indeed already disappeared. She gazed down at the battlefield with a frown. The two sides had already started fighting on the ground. The enemy champion seemed to be hiding among the minions.
Even without the minion waves on the ground, there were still a small number of minions stationed inside the city wall to serve as the last line of defense.
If the enemy champion didn’t exist, Gu Nan and Wu Gui could totally wipe out these minions swiftly and then take part in the siege.
"We’ll push the wave. As long as he dares to show himself, you’ll use your ability to pull aggro, and I'll kill him." Gu Nan told Wu Gui, "If he doesn't show himself, then we’ll clear the wave."
As long as they cleared all the enemy waves, the one-eyed Star Ruler would have nowhere left to hide.
So the two came to the forefront of the battle line, attacking the enemy minions while paying attention to the enemy's movements.
This time, however, the two of them were searching in the open, while the enemy was hiding in the dark. Law fluctuations periodically appeared on the frontline, but when the two tried to give chase, the enemy had long since disappeared.
"What is he doing?" Wu Gui frowned a little. She didn’t understand why the other party exposed his location from time to time but didn’t make any substantial moves.
‘Is he trying to interfere with our wave-clearing efficiency?’
"He’s last hitting," Gu Nan answered with a heavy expression. Even in such a chaotic situation, he still found the one-eyed Star Ruler’s true goal.
"He probably dealt lots of killing blows in the other lane." Gu Nan stared at the law fluctuation that appeared yet again. "He wants to wait until he gets his second ability. That way, it might even be possible for him to fight us head-on."
Gu Nan understood that the reason he could suppress these Star Rulers was because he could bully them for having no abilities or having only learned one attack ability.
Once the opponents also learned a variety of abilities, Gu Nan wouldn’t be able to get instant kills anymore.
And inside the enemy’s city walls, not being able to instakill them was akin to not being able to do anything to them.
Wu Gui also frowned heavily. She realized how crafty the other party's choice was—it just happened to take advantage of their weak point. If they allowed the other party to survive this wave, then their own advantage over the enemy would shrink.
After thinking for a moment, she suggested, "I'll lure—"
"No need," Gu Nan interrupted her. "This person wants to compete with me in last hitting. In that case, let’s have a contest."
……
Yang Guang was already standing underneath the city wall belonging to the Black Base, raising his spear high and shouting excitedly.
He learned martial arts from an early age, and his martial arts skills were also famous in his village. It’s just that he never had a chance to step onto a bigger stage before, but now the moment he was waiting for finally arrived.
"Kill! Follow me and kill them!" Yang Guang pointed his spear to the front. Several soldiers immediately charged forward with him. His younger brother Yang Quan was naturally among them.
Ground battles in Champions World weren’t done with all the troops as a single unit. Rather, the soldiers mostly moved as small teams when fighting in skirmishes.
And on their way here, Yang Guang had already been appointed as the captain of a six-soldier team because of his outstanding performance earlier.
"Ah Guang! Move back!" The team didn't charge long before Yang Quan's voice rang out from behind him.
Although Yang Guang was the team captain, he didn’t doubt his younger brother’s judgment at all and withdrew without another word while calling out an order for his companions to do the same.
Sure enough, the enemy’s formation suddenly packed together before long, and the number of enemy troops in front of them instantly became denser.
If they hadn't retreated in advance, they would probably have been surrounded.
"Ah Quan, you’re great!" A companion next to him still held some lingering fear as he patted Yang Quan on the shoulder and praised him with a smile.
Yang Quan’s fair and clear face showed a peaceful smile, but he didn’t speak.
Unlike his older brother Yang Guang, Yang Quan's martial arts skills weren’t very outstanding, but he was well-read on books on the art of war since childhood, so he was very familiar with the enemy’s formation changes and battlefield situation, making him an excellent commander.
At this moment, he was trying to arrange manpower to consolidate their formation when he heard a muffled grunt from the front.
"Ah Guang!?” When Yang Quan looked up, the sight tore him apart. It turned out that an arrow had lodged itself in Yang Guang’s stomach, instantly sinking into it.
The team immediately panicked, hurriedly rushing forward to snatch Yang Guang back. The group surrounded Yang Guang protectively.
"Ah Guang! Are you okay, Ah Guang?" Yang Quan shook Yang Guang's body, trying to keep him awake. If he passed out at this time, it really would be over.
Yang Guang covered his wound with one hand. He kept on throwing up blood, and even his gaze was slackening.
Yang Quan was about to go crazy. He tore off his soldier’s uniform and tried to stop the bleeding, but it was simply useless. Vaguely, he saw a mysterious light float up above his brother.
"This is…" Yang Quan looked up in amazement. He had never seen such a thing before.
At that moment, an inexplicable fluctuation appeared beside the two, and a one-eyed person revealed himself. He was precisely the one-eyed Star Ruler from the Black Base.
"Another one." The one-eyed Star Ruler chuckled. Some gratification shone through in his eyes. Of course he also found the world’s mark on certain dying minions, and he was obviously very satisfied with another 30 champion coins entering his account.
Yang Quan didn't recognize the other party, but that strange fluctuation made him immediately understand the newcomer’s identity.
Champion! The enemy champion!
His critically injured older brother was still in his arms, but the enemy he couldn’t win against was right in front of him. This unsolvable dilemma plunged Yang Quan into deep despair.
Right now, Yang Quan dearly hoped that a champion would appear in time to save them.
But reason told him that in such a chaotic battle, it was likely that not even the esteemed champions could do anything…
‘Will there be a miracle?’
Yang Quan couldn't help raising his head and saw Gu Nan's figure still floating high in the sky. He seemed to notice the situation here and sent out a black light with a flick of his hand, which shot straight at them.
Yang Quan's heart suddenly found some hope again. ‘Even if, even if it just stopped the other party for a second, this will give the esteemed champion a chance to come here, won't it?!’
But the one-eyed Star Ruler was sneering in his heart.
He was a powerful Star Ruler figure, so he knew the situation far better than Yang Quan. ‘It’s merely a simple application of the other party’s passive law. It's impossible for it to affect me, and even if it hits ordinary soldiers… Huh?’
In the enemy champion’s one good eye, the black light quickly turned into a small sword and instantly cut off Yang Guang's head.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Yang Quans Realization
chapters.content:
The battlefield under the city wall seemed to fall silent at a certain instant.
Time seemed to freeze. This feeling gradually faded when Yang Guang's head landed on the ground, and the frozen scene started moving once again.
This seemed to be a brief interlude on the chaotic battlefield; only the few parties involved realized its significance.
The one-eyed Star Ruler was practically dumbfounded. It was true that the thought of a champion laying their hands on their own soldiers just to deny the enemy the final blow never occurred to him.
In fact, these Star Rulers had never placed enough emphasis on the importance of last hitting.
This could also be seen with Mi Luo and Mi Tian. It was clear that their last hitting skills weren’t bad, but they just had to focus on killing people instead.
After all, in real wars, nobody had ever heard of slaying the insignificant foot soldiers first and leaving the commander alone.
But in the end, the one-eyed Star Ruler was still a Tier 5 existence. After staring blankly for a few seconds, he quickly reacted and abruptly disappeared.
Anyhow, this wasn’t the first time the other party had brought him surprises—plus, if he didn’t leave now, he might end up just like Yang Guang.
If the one-eyed Star Ruler was just surprised that "You can do this kind of thing?”, then Yang Quan’s three views had practically collapsed.
He was more rational than his older brother Yang Guang, so he had a higher tolerance for some of the esteemed champions’ more unreasonable actions.
But what he could tolerate definitely didn’t include attacking friendly soldiers, especially his older brother!
Fury suddenly rushed through Yang Quan's brain, and he felt as if something shattered.
Things that clearly seemed fishy but were somehow ignored by the past him all welled up in his mind.
‘It’ll be more effective to gather soldiers and attack together. Why couldn’t I think of such a simple principle before?’
‘If even I can read about the art of war, then why would all these commanders and generals in the base naively send out only one wave of soldiers each time?’
‘And why does the White Base and Black Base have to fight for so many years without cause or reason? Why can't we sit down and hold peace talks?’
No one could answer Yang Quan's doubts. Everyone else seemed to ignore all these strange circumstances.
Although Yang Quan was situated in a hot-blooded battlefield, his heart felt ice-cold.
He looked up into the distance. It seemed as if an invisible hand was manipulating everything from the normally crimson sky.
No matter what Yang Quan thought, denying was as normal as can be for Gu Nan. He didn’t mind using this method to prevent the one-eyed Star Ruler from last hitting at all.
As long as the one-eyed Star Ruler couldn’t deal enough final blows before the minions guarding the city were cleaned up, he wouldn’t dare to show himself in front of Gu Nan and Wu Gui, and the siege wouldn’t be affected.
Boom!
Gu Nan swung another shadow sword at the city wall. Even with Prodigious suppression, the obvious shaking revealed the damage to the city wall.
A large number of EXP from champions and minions allowed Gu Nan to reach Level 4, which was equivalent to the Dao Lord level in the outside world.
If he could reach Level 5, then he would regain his Void Cutter Realm cultivation and obtain his ultimate “Righteous Judgment” at the same time, after which his fighting strength would experience another qualitative leap.
However, the amount of experience required to reach Level 5 was more than the total experience needed for all four previous levels, so there was no chance of reaching Level 5 for the time being.
The one-eyed Star Ruler was still lurking among the minions guarding the city, but he’d been unable to efficiently last hit ever since Gu Nan took action. He was perfectly suppressed by Gu Nan's denying.
The number of White Base minions who died at Gu Nan's hands had already exceeded ten, and the amount of space that the one-eyed Star Ruler could hide in had also shrunk step by step.
When the last minion guarding the city fell, the one-eyed Star Ruler finally had no place to hide and reluctantly withdrew behind the city wall.
The city wall probably couldn’t be defended anymore, but he wasn’t stupid enough to be buried along with the city wall.
……
Ying Ge and Zi Dian charged for a while on the white lane, then returned to the rear while waiting for the last minion wave of today to arrive.
They were already quite familiar with this. They also encountered similar situations when they entered Champions World in the past, but…
White fireworks suddenly exploded in the blood-red sky, gorgeous and dazzling.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian gazed up in amazement. White fireworks meant that the Black Base’s city wall had been destroyed. The enemy’s city wall on this lane was clearly still in good condition, so there was only one possibility…
"They destroyed the city wall in just one day?!” The astonishment in Ying Ge’s eyes was hard to hide. This was completely contrary to common sense.
If killing enemy champions could still be explained by Gu Nan’s strong personal ability, then how could the destroyed city wall be explained?!
At the current stage, no matter how powerful they were, no champion could tank several laser attacks from the city walls!
"Not unless a large number of soldiers arrived under the city wall at the same time." Uncle Zi Dian's face was also full of doubts, but his judgment was quite close to the truth.
Ying Ge was silent for a long time before muttering, "We have to step up our game too… There’s only one enemy champion in this lane right now."
With the tacit understanding of two people who’d been living together for ten thousand years, Zi Dian naturally understood what she was saying.
……
On the black lane, there were still many White Base minions left after Gu Nan destroyed the city wall, so he continued to head for the Black Base headquarters.
Right then, two lights flashed through the sky almost simultaneously, one white and one black.
Gu Nan glanced up, and the corners of his mouth couldn't help curling into a smile—his allies on the other lane killed the fourth enemy champion at the expense of one of them dying.
When the one-eyed Star Ruler ran here to bring the news, there was only one person left to defend the other lane. Once he was also killed, the enemy’s city wall would suffer.
The terrain in Champions World wasn’t complicated. Knocking down the city wall was basically opening the main gates to the Black Base, just waiting for Gu Nan and the others to pay a “personal visit.”
The last surviving wave of White Base minions marched in unchallenged. They were far smaller than the city’s main gates and couldn’t be stopped at all.
Countless people in the Black Base fled in all directions, and there was quite a feeling of invading soldiers entering civilian villages.
However, the soldiers in the White Base were clearly disciplined. Even in the face of the Black Base they had a feud with, they still didn’t plan to kill indiscriminately. Instead, they headed straight to the soldier’s barracks.
Soldiers were constantly pouring out of the Blase Base’s barracks. They were the garrison forces responsible for defending the Black Base headquarters.
Wu Gui was about to go up and help when Gu Nan pulled her back. "The wave is too small; we can't finish it all at once. Let's stir up trouble."
"How to stir up trouble?"
"Murder and arson." Gu Nan explained indifferently, "Can these soldiers still maintain their calm when they see their loved ones being killed and their homes being burned?"
"When they’re busy scattering in all directions and lose their military formation, we’ll be able to attack."
Wu Gui nodded. "That makes sense."
"Despicable and shameless!" Another voice sounded from behind the two. It was a young man who was glaring at Gu Nan with a face full of rage after hearing his words.
This was Yang Quan.
The current Yang Quan had messy hair and bloodshot eyes. He felt that his whole person was about to fall apart, and something seemed to be bursting out in his heart.
However, this had another meaning in the eyes of Gu Nan and Wu Gui—this person looked as if he was about to disintegrate into pure laws.

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Concept of Time
chapters.content:
"Interesting," Gu Nan gave such an evaluation.
What did it mean for a person to disintegrate, and to disintegrate into laws on top of that?
Either this person had thoroughly transformed into laws and his grade as a lifeform had entered a new realm, or he was made of laws to begin with, and now he was crumbling away.
Gu Nan, who seemed to be omniscient ever since entering Champions World, finally saw something that attracted his attention, which made Wu Gui feel somewhat relieved.
"The Myriad Heavens Starry Road, otherwise known as the Inner World, is like this." Wu Gui explained, "Everything here is composed of laws. That’s why they can be reset indefinitely and always correspond to the real planes on the Outer World."
Gu Nan nodded slightly, thought for a moment, then asked, "There are also some planes in the Outer World that can reset spontaneously. Is that also related to the Inner World?"
"Mm." Wu Gui seemed to have found a rare opportunity to be a good teacher, "At the junction of the Outer and Inner Worlds, there are some small planes whose laws are chaotic, to the extent where inner and outer are reversed."
As early as when Gu Nan first entered Star Realm and was taken to Radiant Tower, he had already witnessed a plane that could be reset.
At that time, people in Radiant Tower had their own explanation for this phenomenon, which was naturally completely different from Wu Gui’s explanation. Considering the status and power of both sides, of course Gu Nan was more willing to believe Wu Gui.
Seeing the world through the eyes of small fries was akin to a blind man touching an elephant
[1]
—they could only perceive a small part of the world’s true nature, and the rest would have to depend on guesswork.
The two talked as though nobody else was present, not bothering to hide anything in front of Yang Quan at all. However, the information revealed from their words gave Yang Quan a splitting headache.
He seemed to understand something, yet it also seemed like he understood nothing.
Those fragmented pieces of information swam around inside his mind, as if something was coming out but was suppressed by an invisible force.
Fortunately, soon Yang Quan didn't need to struggle any longer. Gu Nan had already run a sword through his chest, then tossed him into the Blase Base’s residential area.
An unstable mass of laws like him was most suited to be a human bomb.
Sure enough, it didn't take long before the “human” part of Yang Quan disappeared completely. The power of laws in his body was no longer restrained and exploded with a boom.
The energy storm that only Prodigious cultivators or above could perceive silently swept through the Black Base.
Mortals were eroded and disintegrated in the blink of an eye as soon as they came into contact with it. Not even the surrounding buildings could escape.
"He sure helped us a lot,” Gu Nan commented with a smile. Originally, he wanted to stir up trouble himself, but now that he had Yang Quan, the effect was even better than he expected.
Before Wu Gui could speak, the bloody sky suddenly darkened, and the scenery in front of Gu Nan instantly dissipated.
When he reappeared, Gu Nan was already in a pitch-black void, surrounded by his three companions—Wu Gui, Ying Ge, and Zi Dian.
"Wow, those four withdrew? What a wise decision." Ying Ge immediately realized what happened when she saw this and laughed.
"Their city wall was destroyed in one day. They didn’t have much hope left." The handsome uncle Zi Dian shook his head helplessly. "It's better to quit early to save some astral world origin."
After hearing the two’s conversation, Gu Nan and Wu Gui also understood. Gu Nan understood a little more than Wu Gui.
They surrendered! Or rather, the other side respawned just in time to see an energy storm erupt right in the middle of their base… Their battle spirit probably crumbled.
Gu Nan was naturally happy to see this kind of action that saved everyone some trouble.
+
｢Dungeon’s main mission has been completed:
Main Mission Evaluation: A
Side Story Development: B
Map Exploration: B
Sin Value: B
Comprehensive Evaluation: B+｣
+
｢Accumulated points: 350
Accumulated Evil Value: 50｣
+
The long-unseen dungeon completion prompt finally came from the Evil God Temple again. It’s just that the reward made Gu Nan frown slightly.
The reason he frowned was because… Why was it so little?!
He rarely encountered double-digit rewards ever since he advanced to Tier 4. After all, the difficulty level was proportional to the player level. Naturally, the reward was the same.
It didn’t make sense!
Gu Nan already had 1,350 Evil Value to begin with, and he still hoped to break through the 1,500 threshold this time. By that time, he would just need some more points to construct the third law.
But he didn't expect this Champions World to be so stingy…
Next to him, Zi Dian seemed to understand Gu Nan's thoughts upon seeing his expression. "World origin received from groups of planes like Champions World has always been incomplete, and the lower the ranking, the more so."
For Star Rulers, what they truly needed was world origin. The reason they came to the Myriad Heavens Starry Road was also to plunder world origins to nourish the astral worlds they rule over.
Wu Gui knew the principle behind this very well. "Groups of planes divide up the world origin, but they complement each other. The more times we plunder it, the more complete the world origin we receive."
Gu Nan didn't quite understand her words, but the meaning was clear—this was a mission chain. The more times it was completed, the higher the reward.
"Let’s end it here this time." Ying Ge, whose height only reached Zi Dian's waist, concluded, "My ability to bring you guys to the Inner World needs some time to adjust after use. I will inform you of our next visit…"
"When will next time be?" Gu Nan asked.
"About five years later." After that, she saw Gu Nan’s "You’ve got to be kidding me" expression and spread her hands in a shrug. "That’s already very fast for existences like us."
Uncle Zi Dian also came up and patted Gu Nan on the shoulder as he said with a smile, "We are people with lifespans as long as the world. There’s no need to worry about something like time."
Wu Gui wasn’t surprised in the least. She and Gu Nan already had a previous disagreement about the concept of time.
Gu Nan took a deep breath. It was only due to Ying Ge’s special ability that they could travel to the Myriad Heavens Starry Road. If he couldn’t force the other party, then he could only drop the subject.
However, he felt that he really needed to adjust his own concept of time.
In his past life’s game, players couldn't possibly spend hundreds of years on something because they didn't actually have such a long lifespan, but now he did.
The current Gu Nan was still a player, but he was already a player with a long lifespan.
Perhaps finding and investigating some clearly-visible rules outside of the game rules he was familiar with, such as the Inner World, might also be able to help him grow.
After returning to Star Realm, the four still found themselves on Floral Jasper Star. Ying Ge and Zi Dian disappeared in the blink of an eye.
In the Outer World, Ying Ge was still just a little girl with no strength. She didn’t dare to expose her existence for too long.
On the other hand, Buddhist and demonic intent circled around Wu Gui when she returned to the Outer World. The young girl stared at Gu Nan and asked, "Are you interested in stirring up trouble for some people?"
Before this, Gu Nan probably couldn’t even enter her eyes at all. However, Gu Nan’s existence seemed to have already become an established fact after what happened in Champions World.
"Who?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow.
"Starry Ocean Pavilion."
T/N:
[1] Parable of the blind men and the elephant
: From Wikipedia -
“A story of a group of blind men who have never come across an elephant before and who learn and imagine what the elephant is like by touching it. Each blind man feels a different part of the elephant's body, but only one part, such as the side or the tusk. They then describe the elephant based on their limited experience and their descriptions of the elephant are different from each other. The moral of the parable is that humans have a tendency to claim absolute truth based on their limited, subjective experience as they ignore other people's limited, subjective experiences which may be equally true”

chapters.title: Chapter 267: Ying Ges Surprise
chapters.content:
Wu Gui held a grudge against Starry Ocean Pavilion—this was something Gu Nan knew a long time ago.
In the past, the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord schemed Wu Gui and forcibly awakened her from the cycle of reincarnation. Only then did he obtain the opportunity to reach his Dao and step into the ranks of Void Cutter Realm cultivators.
He originally thought that after gaining a benefit at Wu Gui’s expense, he would still be absolutely safe as long as he hid inside Starry Ocean Pavilion, but he never expected Wu Gui to chase him all the way to Starry Ocean Pavilion and eventually kill him.
This incident caused a big ruckus at the time, and Starry Ocean Pavilion lost a lot of face. Only then did it announce its plan to register all Prodigious cultivators in Star Realm.
It was also precisely because of this incident that Starry Ocean Pavilion’s higher ups, who’d been relaxed for hundreds of years, suddenly became vigilant. This was why they reacted so quickly when Gu Nan made another move.
When Wu Gui started speaking, the events leading up to this matter had already flashed through Gu Nan's mind.
Just like how it was best to have a certain degree of understanding of NPCs’ background stories when carrying out missions, Gu Nan had always attached great importance to this.
"Didn’t you already take your revenge on Heavenly Mystery?" Gu Nan thought for a moment and asked, "But you still want to find trouble for Starry Ocean Pavilion. You have other plans?"
Gu Nan was suspicious of the other party’s goal, but Wu Gui just shook her head slightly, apparently unwilling to elaborate on this subject.
"You just have to answer me—are you interested in participating?"
"Heh… No."
Gu Nan chuckled coldly and answered casually. He knew Wu Gui only asked because she felt that he was also Starry Ocean Pavilion’s enemy, so perhaps they both shared a common goal.
But in fact, Wu Gui was overthinking this.
Players in a hurry to take revenge on NPCs are unheard of, because all players understand that as long as they keep playing, they’ll surely become stronger than everyone else one day.
It was precisely because of such confidence that even if a boss easily crushed them, players could still calmly retreat to level up, buy equipment, and come back to challenge the boss again.
Leveling up by beating monsters was common sense. Conversely, being beaten by monsters also wasn’t anything worth getting angry over—of course he’d be hit if he pulled aggro.
Wu Gui seemed to expect Gu Nan's rejection. In a rare occurrence, she revealed a strange smile and wordlessly cast a glance at Gu Nan.
This glance seemed to contain some deeper meaning, but she didn’t say anything else and quickly turned to leave, making Gu Nan unable to guess her plans for the time being.
Gu Nan was still affected by Yue Jiu’s curse in Star Realm. His recovery speed was still suppressed, so for the time being, it wasn’t convenient for him to visit Starry Ocean Pavilion and try to wreck it.
What Gu Nan truly needed to do right now was nothing more than two things.
One was naturally to wait five years until Ying Ge could once again open the path to the Myriad Heavens Starry Road and take him to the Inner World. As for the other priority, Gu Nan felt it was indeed necessary to calm down and immerse himself in some experiments and research.
……
Immortal Demon World.
In the blink of an eye, over a year had already passed since Gu Nan left Champions World and returned to the Outer World.
And over a year in Star Realm translated to 12 whole years in Immortal Demon World, where time flowed ten times faster.
The various political and administrative systems Gu Nan introduced had been implemented quite well, and Immortal Demon World was getting closer and closer to the Divine Kingdom he envisioned.
Starry Ocean Pavilion placed the entire Star Realm under supervision, and the order to register all Prodigious cultivators—which everyone thought was doomed to fail—was actually forcibly carried out.
Starry Ocean Pavilion's determination this time seemed particularly firm.
Be it bribes, cover ups, or secret plots, all of them were suppressed at lightning speed, and at that time, the entire nine regions were stained with blood.
In a little over a year, Star Realm had completely transformed into a world where people could only "cultivate with a license," and those Prodigious experts who couldn’t produce their licenses would be treated as unlicensed criminals and interrogated.
Even the Void Cutter figures sent by Starry Ocean Pavilion to the major regions seemed to have no intention of returning.
Besides its headquarters in the Central Region, Starry Ocean Pavilion stationed at least two Void Cutter cultivators in the other eight regions. Some regions even had periodic personnel rotations to ensure that someone would always be stationed there.
If the previous forced registration farce still made people feel that Starry Ocean Pavilion was throwing a tantrum, then this series of purposeful actions were enough to make many people realize something.
"This is… They’re going to war?"
Gu Nan flipped through the intelligence reports from Star Realm and also understood the meaning behind Starry Ocean Pavilion’s actions.
"Probably. Since that younger brother of mine has returned, he won't give up so easily." Ying Ge sat across from Gu Nan, sipping a cup of coffee. "It's getting harder and harder to find this place."
She was currently in Immortal Demon World, so it wasn’t easy to drink a cup of coffee. However, it was much harder to locate Immortal Demon World’s coordinates.
"That means my efforts over the years have paid off,” Gu Nan replied with a light smile.
After returning to Star Realm, Gu Nan looked around for a way to move Immortal Demon World in order to void its old coordinates.
After all, this was his Divine Kingdom. Gu Nan didn't want too many people to pay it a visit before he could advance to Tier 5 and ultimately make a mess of this place.
Over the years, Gu Nan spent most of his time in Immortal Demon World, so much so that he rarely visited Star Realm anymore. Heaven and Earth Star naturally fell into Starry Ocean Pavilion’s hands, but he didn't care.
Immortal Demon World was here, and Lan Si was also here—Gu Nan was too lazy to bother paying attention to much else.
After all, as long as he had enough time, he could totally establish another White Mist. There was no need to insist on keeping the original team from White Mist.
The only people who still had contact with him right now were people like Ying Ge and Wu Gui.
He and Wu Gui had nothing to say to each other, but Ying Ge often visited him under the guise of a normal little girl.
Although her strength still hadn’t recovered much, she could travel freely between various planes just like Void Cutter cultivators. This seemed to be a characteristic of her nature as a lifeform.
"Did you want something from me?"
"Nothing!" Ying Ge picked up a fruit and stuffed it into her mouth. "Zi Dian went out again. I'm afraid of being killed, so I came here to hide for a while."
Ying Ge’s true body clearly wasn’t anything normal—everything she ate, she swallowed it whole without chewing at all.
"Oh right, I see you every time I come here. Don’t tell me you stayed here all the time and never went out?!”
Gu Nan nodded without much hesitation. For a player like him who had a half "shut-in" attribute, staying at home was all too normal.
Ying Ge, however, stared at him in surprise as if she’d discovered a new continent. "Aren’t you at Void Cutter Realm right now? Don't you have to collect world origins to refine your own laws?"
Normal Void Cutter cultivators were essentially the same types of lifeforms as Star Rulers. They could continuously advance by collecting world origins.
Of course, Star Rulers plundered world origins in order to construct or perfect their own astral worlds, while Void Cutters mainly observed the world origin and wouldn’t easily incorporate it into themselves.
Seeing Gu Nan's silence, Ying Ge's surprise deepened. "It can't be true… Don’t tell me you walked all the way to Void Cutter Realm without any guidance from others?"
"With the exception of a few enemies, everyone who could give me guidance was hacked to death by me."
“……”

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Zi Luo Heaven
chapters.content:
Ying Ge didn't stay for long and soon left Immortal Demon World. Clearly, it didn't take much time for Zi Dian to handle his affairs. But she gave Gu Nan a plane’s coordinates before she left.
"The largest neutral trading plane of Myriad Heavens Universe? Zi Luo Heaven?" Gu Nan memorized the coordinates, but he was silently pondering the subtleties behind this description.
This was the second time he’d heard of the name Zi Luo Heaven—the first time was from the mouth of the shadow servant Duanmu Yin. After Zi Yi was injured, her true body hid in Zi Luo Heaven.
On the other hand, Ying Ge’s unintentional words really did suddenly enlighten Gu Nan somewhat.
He felt that his path was getting narrower and narrower, and he often seemed to have lost his goal. Right now, he relied entirely upon the Myriad Heavens Starry Road as the source of his Evil Value.
Previously, he always believed that it was a problem with the Evil God Temple where it couldn’t provide him more help. But now that he thought about it carefully, it seemed that he also had a misconception.
The Evil God Temple was just a system incapable of sentient thought; it couldn’t always guide Gu Nan forward.
In fact, from how it gradually reduced the possible sources of Evil Value as Gu Nan's realm increased, it was actually guiding him in an obvious direction.
Everything it did was to tell Gu Nan one thing—after Tier 4, world origin was equal to Evil Value and points.
At this stage, Gu Nan's advancement journey finally seemed to have the same destination as the cultivators in this world. They ultimately pursued the same thing.
This matched Gu Nan's original conjecture. In essence, the game’s power system was the same as that of this world, so the resources required by players and cultivators were naturally the same as well.
"It’s such a simple idea, yet I only realized it just now? Watson, you found the blind spot…"
Gu Nan muttered a roast of unknown significance, but his thoughts became clearer and clearer.
These years of research gave him a new understanding of the true nature of the world.
The Outer World was the real world. Planes at the Heaven or Realm level only differed in their names. Their essence was still the same—planes whose laws were complete. However, planes at the World level had all kinds of defects.
On the other hand, the Inner World was the hub that controlled all the planes. It contained the most fundamental laws of each plane, and the corresponding plane was constructed by these laws.
Looking back now, he earned Evil Value via the Evil God Temple’s “summoning” at Tier 1 but had to reincarnate by himself after Tier 2. And once he reached Tier 4, even reincarnation lost its effectiveness.
Perhaps the real turning point wasn’t coming to larger worlds, but his own advancement.
Gu Nan's consciousness once again entered the Evil God Temple. This familiar hall was the same as usual, but it looked somewhat unfamiliar in Gu Nan's eyes.
Perhaps this place shouldn’t be called the Evil God Temple, but the Evil God Training Center, with the goal of cultivating a true Evil God.
"Teacher, the first martial arts tournament between the two alliances has ended. This is the ranking."
Yan Xiaoxiao’s voice called Gu Nan back to reality as she handed him a list, but Gu Nan wasn’t too interested in looking at it.
He was still immersed in his thoughts. It’s just that the real observations and impressions of Immortal Demon World made him smile slightly.
It was enough as long as the rules of the game still applied here. He didn’t spend so much effort studying this world in order to abandon the rules of the game.
Only by deeply understanding this reality could he better replace it with the game’s rules, and then defeat one enemy after another using those familiar rules.
Gu Nan lowered his head to glance at the list, then put it aside.
The Divine Kingdom was still in its foundational stages, and too many things had yet to be perfected. Similarly, his goal wasn’t to determine some champion, but rather…
"As I said before, allocate a certain number of opposite gender mates to fighters with excellent rankings, so that their bloodlines and genes can be passed down as much as possible."
Yan Xiaoxiao nodded without much expression. She had gradually adapted to Gu Nan's attitude already.
Selecting the best individuals in a group and then trying to breed them was a solid "pig-raising" technique.
Gu Nan remembered the coordinates Ying Ge gave and said, "I’ll leave on a trip soon. Is there anything else?"
"Nothing big… Oh right, Lan Si entered closed-door cultivation to break through to Void Cutter Realm," Yan Xiaoxiao answered after some thought.
Gu Nan nodded without saying anything. Lan Si advancing to Tier 4 soon was good news, and it was also within his expectations. Her talent was very good to begin with. In the past, her growth was just held back by her personality.
With the Godhead’s help, it was normal to make a breakthrough after cultivating in Immortal Demon World for ten years.
……
At the other end of the endless void, a black-haired figure in white clothes slowly stepped out of the void and entered a strange world.
There was no outer space here, nor was there any concept of a planet. The entire plane blended together, and the earth seemed to have no end in sight.
This was Zi Luo Heaven, the famous neutral trading plane.
"Welcome to Zi Luo Heaven, Your Excellency," someone immediately greeted Gu Nan from a distance as soon as he arrived. That was a woman in white formal attire. Her expression was respectful.
Gu Nan descended by directly tearing through the void instead of taking a starship, which was enough to show his identity—a Void Cutter existence.
Even in an enormous plane like Zi Luo Heaven, Void Cutters still weren’t cabbages that could be commonly found on the side of the road. Instead, they were fighting forces Star Rulers valued and were existences that mortals needed to look up to.
The woman lowered her head slightly while standing in front of Gu Nan, but she felt a little excited.
Although many Void Cutter cultivators visited Zi Luo Heaven, the territory of Zi Luo Heaven was so vast that she didn’t manage to meet many at all.
This woman didn’t dare to harbor any ill intentions towards Void Cutter figures. She was an idle guide who wandered around the plane’s borders, making a living as a guide for powerful figures.
There were too many possible benefits if she could converse with a Void Cutter powerhouse. If there was hope, she didn’t even mind selling out her body for cultivation resources.
The more neutral a plane like Zi Luo Heaven was, the more apparent the law of the jungle and the more blatant equivalent exchange was.
"My Lord, do you need—"
"No need," a voice behind Gu Nan directly interrupted the woman's words.
This voice made the woman freeze. When she looked behind Gu Nan, she saw a young girl whose height only reached her waist.
This girl didn’t have the aura of a cultivator, but her expression was ice-cold, and the blood-red cloak behind her gave people an inexplicable sense of suppression.
"Yes, sorry to have bothered you…" The woman didn’t dare to say more. She quickly retreated with her head lowered.
"Hmph! Vixen!" Ying Ge’s loli face snorted coldly in the direction the woman retreated to.
Gu Nan looked back at the Ying Ge behind him and wondered, "How come you also followed over?"
"Someone might have set their sights on us. It's safer to follow you," Ying Ge explained without hiding anything. "You promised to protect me!"
"Haha." Gu Nan responded with a friendly smile.
Players' promises to NPCs were worth absolutely nothing. If necessary, they could go back on their word at any time, so Gu Nan couldn’t even be bothered to argue with her about whether he truly did promise that.
By contrast, he was more concerned about another matter. The flames of gossip lit up in his eyes. "Won't Zi Dian be jealous if you run over to my side? You two must’ve had a lover’s quarrel, right?"
"Hey hey hey!" Ying Ge suddenly glared at him. "Just what kind of relationship do you think we have?! I’ve always regarded that uncle as my father!"
Gu Nan showed an enlightened look and gave a heartfelt sigh. "So he was a stepdad."

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Visiting Astral Gate Again
chapters.content:
In the end, Gu Nan wasn’t able to learn the true relationship between Ying Ge and Zi Dian from his questions.
Of course, neither the anger nor shame that Ying Ge revealed could be trusted—Gu Nan didn't believe even a single punctuation mark of hers. These Star Rulers’ true attitude towards others could only be seen from their actions, not their words.
Zi Luo Heaven was a large plane in the truest sense, but its absolute volume actually wasn’t big, It was far smaller than even a plane like Star Realm.
This was because the spatial characteristics of Zi Luo Heaven were completely different from the planes Gu Nan saw in the past.
There was no such thing as a planet or outer space here. The sky was above their head and the earth was below their feet, which was the "round heaven, square earth" concept in the truest sense.
"You drove away the guide who delivered herself right to my door, so are you ready to be a guide now?"
Ying Ge patted her flat chest and said confidently, "All the major organizations have a branch in Zi Luo Heaven, and their locations haven’t changed in tens of thousands of years. Where do you want to go? Just tell me."
Gu Nan thought for a moment. "What’s the best place to earn origin crystals?"
Origin crystal was the common currency for both Void Cutter and Star Ruler cultivators. It might not have much purchasing power for some extremely rare objects, but its innate value wasn’t low.
"Of course that's… Astral Gate."
……
Gu Nan and Ying Ge slowly walked out of a teleporter in Zi Luo Heaven. Gu Nan was still holding a round bead that glowed faintly blue.
"So this is an origin crystal?" Gu Nan tossed the round bead up and down in his hand with a somewhat curious expression.
Something like money was rarely seen even at the Prodigious Realm, because Prodigious experts all had different cultivation paths. Without a common pursuit, it was naturally difficult for currency to exist.
But it was a different story for those above Void Cutter Realm.
At least for those at Void Cutter and Star Ruler Realms, they both had a common pursuit—world origins—but Void Cutter cultivators mainly observed and deepened their comprehension of it, while Star Ruler cultivators also needed to absorb it.
And origin crystals, as their name implied, were crystals condensed from world origins.
Origin crystals were very troublesome to make, and the power required of the producer was very demanding. Ordinary Star Rulers couldn’t even unseal them, let alone duplicate them.
Therefore, the purchasing power of origin crystals was slightly higher than its actual value. Among that, the manufacturing process accounted for a considerable part of that gap.
In addition to its function as a circulating currency, origin crystals could also be converted into highly active world origins, which was the main way of "cashing" origin crystals.
Such an unusual monetary system was the result of tens of thousands of years' development in the Myriad Heavens Universe, and it was still popular all over the world today.
In Gu Nan's hand was one such origin crystal, but it was of the smallest denomination and contained only one unit of world origin.
In Zi Luo Heaven, Void Cutter and even Star Ruler powerhouses weren’t allowed to teleport within the plane without permission. They must use Zi Luo Heaven’s teleportation arrays.
And teleportation arrays naturally charged a fee. Gu Nan didn’t even know what origin crystals looked like. Of course he asked the rich and imposing Classmate Ying Ge to help out.
"By the way, why do you still have origin crystals despite having been sealed for so long?"
"None of your business!”
Gu Nan could only shrug at Ying Ge’s uncooperative attitude. However, this brief interlude didn’t affect their arrival at the border of a large organization.
Astral Gate.
Zi Luo Heaven was indeed a top-notch neutral plane. Gu Nan could even find a remote organization like "Radiant Tower" here, not to mention Astral Gate.
Astral Gate was a major organization well-known throughout the entire Myriad Heavens Universe, and it was famous for its openness in accepting members. Anyone could join.
Moreover, this organization’s internal structure also had a developed exchange system to ensure that members could trust each other.
Even a small fry like Lu Zhanyu could gain a Void Cutter powerhouse’s recognition through her own ability after entering Astral Gate. This was enough to illustrate the problem.
How do they ensure the trust between members? It’s simple—Astral Gate just hunts down rule breakers and slaughters their entire family.
The truly large organizations and forces basically all use this method to ensure the loyalty of their members.
After Gu Nan walked out of the teleportation array, he found himself inside a city. Countless pedestrians of different cultivation realms walked along in the streets.
Gu Nan swept a glance over them. There was almost no difference between cultivators and mortals, who were mixed together. He even saw a Void Cutter export walking on the streets.
Only within an extremely powerful organization could such a structure be formed.
"I'm going to join Astral Gate. Do you want to go together?" Gu Nan glanced at Ying Ge.
"Of course! What will you do if I got abducted because I didn’t follow you?" Ying Ge gave him a look that screamed, "Are you kidding me?"
She continued, “Plus, I’m an 11-star member of Astral Gate, so I can carry you!"
A completely open organization like Astral Gate was indeed extremely popular with wandering cultivators. Even Ying Ge spent some time in this organization.
Ying Ge took Gu Nan to Astral Gate’s main hall. Here, just like what Gu Nan saw at the Heavenly Mystery Dao Hall, the space was divided into separate blocks.
The current Gu Nan had long gotten used to this. He knew that the interior of Starry Ocean Pavilion was bound to have this kind of arrangement as well. The Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord learned it from there.
"Welcome back, 11-star member Blood Song."
Gu Nan and Ying Ge entered at the same time, so they were assigned to the same block of space. A soft female voice rang out in front of them.
"Change code name to Ying Ge
[1]
," Ying Ge’s first sentence was to change her previous code name.
She didn't explain why she did this, but Gu Nan could guess—she probably didn't want her past acquaintances to know her current identity.
"Code name change confirmed. New code name recorded," the female voice quickly responded to Ying Ge’s request. The voice always sounded soft and mellow, but its tone seemed to remain unchanged from beginning to end.
Ying Ge was clearly very familiar with Astral Gate and said without hesitation, "I want to recommend a new member."
However, the response given by Astral Gate surprised her a little.
"Command confirmed… No suitable target detected."
"Welcome back, normal member Evil God."
The latter sentence was obviously said to Gu Nan. As early as Tier 3, Gu Nan had the experience of coming into contact with Astral Gate and left a record inside.
Ying Ge stared blankly, then reacted to what happened, pointing to Gu Nan as she burst out laughing.
"Hahahaha! Normal member! And Evil God, what a shoddy code name!"
Gu Nan had long gotten used to Ying Ge’s theatrical antics, so he didn't take it to heart. He just casually picked a code name back then, but it was inappropriate now.
As he leveled up, he may come into contact with people from the World of Gods at some time. Wasn’t using the code name “Evil God” just asking for trouble?
Gu Nan glanced at Ying Ge and asked, "Can the code name be changed at will? What happens if multiple people pick the same code name?"
Ying Ge was still howling with laughter. She finally managed to speak with difficulty, "You can change it if you don’t think it’s too much trouble. And it doesn't matter if your name is the same as someone else’s. Astral Gate records your law origin as identification, not your code name."
Gu Nan nodded. "Change code name to… Ying Ge's Daddy."
The laughter finally came to an abrupt end.
T/N:
[1] Ying Ge
:
Yine Ge means “Shadow Song”
Xue Ge means “Blood Song”

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Ghost Sea World
chapters.content:
"Welcome, Ying Ge's Daddy. As you are only a normal member, the missions list is temporarily inaccessible."
The soft female voice echoed throughout the space belonging to Astral Gate, but Ying Ge's expression turned darker and darker. If not for the fact that she hadn’t recovered her strength yet, she would’ve jumped up and shattered Gu Nan's kneecap.
"Bastard! Change your name right now!"
"You see, I don't even have the authority to accept a mission. Help me level up first," Gu Nan said earnestly.
His goal in coming to Astral Gate—or rather, Zi Luo Heaven—was to accept some missions to earn origin crystals and exchange them for active world origins.
This was something normal Void Cutter cultivators often did. Gu Nan wanted to see what kind of response the Evil God Temple would give if he followed this pattern.
Gu Nan had some levels at Astral Gate a long time ago, but that was back when he was Tier 3.
Astral Gate had two completely separate ranking systems for people below and at or above Void Cutter Realm. The stars he had when he was Tier 3 must be converted to the new system proportionally—but Gu Nan's measly stars could only be converted into the rank of a normal member.
Fortunately, he now had a noble 11-star member to give him a referral.
Ying Ge asked with a gloomy expression, "Will you really change your name after I refer you?"
"Of course. I always keep my word."
"You can’t change it to one of my relatives again!"
"Not a problem."
Moments later, Classmate Gu Nan, a newly-promoted 5-star member, chose to change his code name again.
"An 11-star member really is high up, to directly pull me up to 5 stars…" Gu Nan muttered. "Change code name to Ying Ge’s Next-Door Neighbor Uncle Wang
[1]
."
……
Ying Ge’s resentful glare remained fixed on Gu Nan's back when they left Astral Gate, as if to burn a few holes into him.
Gu Nan didn’t care about this at all. Just because he usually liked to do things in the most straightforward way didn’t mean that he didn’t know how to do things in a roundabout way.
It's just that he didn’t feel the need to circle around things if he could simply kill the NPC instead.
Besides, players were all pros at teasing people with these kinds of strange game IDs.
After successfully becoming a 5-star member, Gu Nan's authority was indeed much higher, and he easily found a mission that suited him and paid well.
Hunt down the traitor Xin Berg.
No matter how powerful an organization like Astral Gate was, there would still be traitors. After all, when tangible benefits were right in front of people’s faces, there would always be people unable to restrain their desires.
Xin Berg was a Prodigious Realm cultivator whose strength was approaching the Dao Lord level. He killed his teammates during a mission, then absconded with the stolen mission item.
Now Astral Gate had pinpointed his location. He was currently inside a small world.
……
Ghost Sea World.
When Gu Nan stepped into this world with Ying Ge, he immediately felt that this name was very suitable for this world.
Ghost Sea World was a very strange plane. It was similar to Zi Luo Heaven in that the land was flat, and there was no such thing as a planet.
But the ground here was a boundless sea of ghosts, with countless vengeful souls churning about. Once someone fell into it, it would be hard for even Void Cutter existences to survive.
Both cultivators and mortals could only live on floating islands high above the ghost sea.
"Greetings, Your Excellency. I am the 6-star member Symphony.” People from Astral Gate were naturally already waiting here when Gu Nan and Ying Ge arrived through the teleportation array. They immediately greeted him.
Pinpointing Xin Berg's location was clearly no easy matter. There were over ten people standing in front of Gu Nan at the moment.
The leader was a man in a black tailcoat. He was the one who spoke just now.
When members of Astral Gate greeted each other, the lower-ranking members would usually take the initiative to introduce themselves and report their star rank. The man codenamed "Symphony" was already a 6-star member.
Just looking at the number of stars, he was even higher-ranked than Gu Nan. But of course, the status of a Prodigious cultivator couldn’t compare to that of a Void Cutter powerhouse.
"Hello, everyone." Gu Nan nodded slightly at everyone. "I'm ‘Ying Ge’s Next-Door Neighbor Uncle Wang’."
Gu Nan announced this long name without pause. Beside him, Ying Ge’s expression suddenly darkened, and Symphony also couldn’t help staring blankly.
"L-Lord Wang…"
"Mm, this is Ying Ge," Gu Nan very politely remembered to introduce Ying Ge to everyone.
“……”
Moments later, the pursuit team led by Symphony all had awkward smiles on their faces as they stood beside Gu Nan and Ying Ge, while Gu Nan was earnestly reading the information on their target.
Of course Astral Gate also had information on Xin Berg, but it certainly wouldn’t be as detailed as what they had here.
Xin Berg, a relatively Western name, meant that the other person didn’t come from a large plane.
In the Myriad Heavens Universe, only small planes had different civilizations, and even black and white races were hard to find here.
The information from the pursuit team also confirmed this point. In fact, Ghost Sea World was Xin Berg's hometown, so after he had nowhere else to go, he finally decided to return here.
He wanted to use Ghost Sea World’s special terrain to stall for time.
"Stall for time?" Gu Nan finally raised an eyebrow and asked when he read this.
"Yes." Symphony explained gravely, "Xin Berg betrayed the organization for a bottle of celestial water. He rapidly grew in strength after defecting. The last time we fought, I was no longer a match for him…"
Symphony was a veritable Dao Lord. The fact that he couldn’t defeat Xin Berg, even with coordinated support from the other team members, meant that Xin Berg was only one step away from Void Cutter Realm and may even break through at any time.
No wonder Astral Gate directly assigned the mission to a Void Cutter member as soon as it learned of the situation, so as to not send several Dao Lords and give the other party free experience points.
However, no matter how fast Xin Berg's strength rose, it was still nothing to Gu Nan. He asked directly, "Where is the target now?"
"At present, we can only confirm that the target is on one of the three floating islands." While speaking, Symphony gave the names of the three floating islands. "We didn't dare to startle the target before this, but now that My Lord has arrived, we can seal off the floating islands."
Gu Nan gave a small nod. When faced with a target they couldn’t capture, of course they couldn’t rashly tighten the net.
"Have the people in charge of these three floating islands come see me. Completely seal off the floating islands and forbid anyone from leaving," Gu Nan instructed quickly.
Symphony and the others nodded in unison, but at that moment, a crisp voice rang out from next to him.
"No! You absolutely can’t seal off the floating islands!"
Gu Nan looked up and saw a pretty young girl quickly walking over with a frosty expression.
"Symphony, have you forgotten what I told you?!” As soon as the girl appeared, she shouted at Symphony.
Her righteous expression made Symphony feel somewhat ashamed, and he even glanced at Gu Nan anxiously.
"Sealing off a floating island for a long time can easily cause ghost Qi to flow in reverse. Such a phenomenon will devastate all life on the floating island. Who among you can shoulder this responsibility?"
The girl spoke without hesitation and exposed the facts that Symphony hid.
"Is that right?" Gu Nan's voice asked.
His calm gaze made Symphony even more uneasy. After all, it was true that this was his transgression.
In order to complete the mission, he concealed the truth that would cause a great disaster… If this caused the one in front of him to believe that Symphony was deliberately trying to pin responsibility for the disaster onto Gu Nan, then he wouldn’t ever be able to wash himself clean of that crime, not even if he jumped into the Yellow River.
The young girl, on the other hand, watched this scene with satisfaction. She believed that Symphony, this nasty person, would surely get his just deserts.
"Yes, but—" Symphony quickly replied, as if trying to find an excuse for himself, but was interrupted by Gu Nan.
"In that case, won’t the target die if we simply seal off all three floating islands?" Gu Nan looked puzzled. "What a waste of time this is."

[1] Uncle Wang
: A generic surname for a neighbor, like Neighbor A

chapters.title: Chapter 271: Zhu Qin
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan's voice fell, everyone present also seemed to fall silent. Both Symphony and that girl stared at him like they’d seen a ghost.
It was no wonder they were like this; Gu Nan's words were too shocking.
Dumbstruck, the young girl stared at Gu Nan for a while and finally realized that this guy in front of her wasn’t actually joking, so she quickly left after throwing down a vicious sentence, "How absurd!"
Symphony smiled somewhat awkwardly, both surprised at this Lord’s ruthlessness and glad that it was such a person who came to finish this mission.
If the newcomer’s personality was too gentle, then that little girl would probably be able to easily suppress the newcomer using her identity, after which his mission would lose all chances of success.
"It’s not so easy to seal off the floating islands either." Symphony explained with a bitter smile, "After all, we need to ask the islands’ respective rulers to willingly seal off their own islands…"
"Then find someone from other floating islands to do it." Gu Nan’s expression seemed to say
you are so stupid
.
"We’ll kill the powerful figures on those three floating islands, leaving behind prime territory for others to take. Don’t tell me not a single other floating island will be tempted?"
Symphony stared blankly again. He finally realized that the one in front of him truly planned to go through with this and wouldn’t even hesitate to incite a war in Ghost Sea World.
‘And from a feasibility perspective, it might actually be possible…’
Symphony hurriedly shook his head and threw this terrifying thought out of his mind.
Unlike the other party, he didn’t believe himself to be someone without any bottom line. To cause tens of thousands of innocent people to be buried alongside the target just to kill one person… At the very least, he certainly wouldn’t do that unless as a last resort.
However, Gu Nan's icy gaze fell straight onto his face. "Any other issues?"
"This…" The cold indifference in Gu Nan's eyes made Symphony feel like an invisible hand had gripped his heart, making it hard to speak.
He knew that the other party would very likely turn against him if he couldn’t give a satisfactory answer. Even if the other party couldn’t kill him due to Astral Gate’s rules, the consequences would still be unenjoyable.
A cold sweat broke out on Symphony’s forehead, but he quickly responded, "Sealing off all three floating islands is too inefficient and time-consuming… We've already grasped some clues on the target, so we might as well try those first."
He spoke at lightning speed and finally managed to persuade Gu Nan a little. Gu Nan gave a nod, signaling for him to continue.
Symphony breathed a small sigh of relief. He was from a major Heaven level plane and had met many Void Cutter cultivators before, so he had some knowledge on the various types of cultivators.
Among Void Cutter powerhouses, some were easygoing and approachable and could even make friends with ordinary people, while others were cold and aloof, showing a complete disregard for human life.
Symphony believed that this person in front of him belonged to the latter category, so he didn't even try to use anything like righteousness to persuade Gu Nan. Instead, he used the word “efficiency” to persuade him.
……
Ghost Sea World had innumerable floating islands, and they varied in size.
The large ones were as big as a city in Star Realm, while the small ones were only the size of a few soccer fields—one could see the edge at a glance.
Gu Nan, along with Symphony and the others, was now waiting for news on a medium-sized floating island named Yantai.
They found Xin Berg’s trail on all three floating islands. People had seen Xin Berg appear on all three islands, and there were even people with connections to him.
They didn’t dare to inadvertently alert the target before this, but now that Gu Nan was overseeing the mission, they could naturally test the waters.
As long as Xin Berg dared to show his face on this floating island, Gu Nan could kill him in an instant.
While they waited for news, Ying Ge naturally followed Gu Nan, staying by his side. She had little interest in Gu Nan's mission. In contrast, she was more interested in that girl from earlier.
"What's that little girl’s name?" Ying Ge asked Symphony cheerfully.
"She looks bigger than you," Gu Nan cut in before Symphony even opened his mouth.
"
I
have lived for tens of thousands—"
"She still looks bigger than you—I mean chest."
Ying Ge turned her head away with a gloomy expression, viciously glaring at Symphony. This young man felt chills in his heart, so he hurriedly revealed the girl’s origins.
Actually, it wasn’t complicated.
The young girl was called Zhu Qin. She also belonged to Astral Gate, but she wasn’t a participant of this mission. Instead, she was a native of Ghost Sea World.
Ghost Sea World was truly a very small plane. Zhu Qin immediately realized that people from Astral Gate had arrived as soon as they entered this world. This was how the two sides came into contact with each other.
This kind of situation wasn’t uncommon. After all, Astral Gate had members from every major plane. When someone went to a plane for a mission, sometimes members whose hometowns were from there would also help out.
Of course, they may also have the opposite reaction. Zhu Qin was one such example.
She held a rather uncooperative attitude towards the actions of Symphony and his team. For example, when Symphony once wanted to lightly seal off a certain floating island, she strongly opposed it.
Zhu Qin's opposition wasn’t a joke. She had a solid backing.
She herself was just an ordinary Prodigious cultivator, but her identity wasn’t simple at all—in a simple sentence, she was a princess of Ghost Sea World.
Although Ghost Sea World wasn’t big, it also had a government, and it was even a feudal empire.
The current emperor was Zhu Qin's biological father, so she was a veritable princess.
"But being the princess of a tiny trashy place like this won’t be much use, will it?" Ying Ge wasn’t muddleheaded at all. She knew very well that Zhu Qin's meager status was nothing to an organization like Astral Gate.
Symphony gave a bitter smile. Before he could speak, a person next to him explained, "It's all because she has a good sister!"
This person was the same as Symphony. He was a team member who came to carry out the mission to hunt down Xin Berg and clearly also held a lot of resentment against Zhu Qin's repeated attempts to hinder their mission.
"Her older sister is a Void Cutter cultivator, but she’s not a member of Astral Gate," Symphony added. This was the real answer.
Void Cutter cultivator!
During the mission, Astral Gate would shield the members performing the mission from retribution, but what about after the mission?
What if Zhu Qin didn’t like one of their team members and insisted on having her older sister teach them a lesson after the mission was over? Then their team really would be caught unprepared.
What's more, Zhu Qin's sister was naturally also born in Ghost Sea World.
If their team stirred things up a little too much here and elicited the dissatisfaction of a Void Cutter cultivator, then things might not necessarily be on their side.
Fortunately, Gu Nan arrived. Only Void Cutter cultivators would be able to not fear retribution from Zhu Qin’s sister and use all possible methods to hunt down Xin Berg.
"Why doesn't she cooperate?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin. He didn’t seem to be asking anyone in particular. Instead, he seemed to be talking to himself, "To protect the environment? Save the world? Doesn’t quite seem like it."
After listening to Symphony’s explanation, Gu Nan wasn’t concerned about Zhu Qin's older sister, but about another problem instead.
"Check Xin Berg's actions over the years and see if he ever met Zhu Qin." Gu Nan turned to Symphony. "Or check for any connection between her older sister and Xin Berg—that must be investigated too."
When Gu Nan said this, his gaze fell to the distance, revealing a bit of coldness.
He had never been afraid to infer others’ motives with the greatest amount of malice.

chapters.title: Chapter 272: Visit
chapters.content:
They soon received news from those searching the Yantai floating island. Unsurprisingly, there were no valuable clues.
The mark Xin Berg left here was that he once had a one night stand with a female student. But even when Symphony’s people captured that female student, Xin Berg still didn’t make a move at all.
"Restrain that student. Chop off two fingers and send it to her parents. Just announce that she’s been kidnapped for ransom and make a big deal of it," Gu Nan ordered calmly.
Although Ghost Sea World was a feudal society, its level of science and technology wasn’t low.
The three floating islands they suspected Xin Berg might be hiding in were all in the same area. Making a big deal of it here meant Xin Berg would hear about this.
Of course, it was best if it could alarm Xin Berg, but it also didn’t matter if it couldn’t. This move was merely an afterthought.
Symphony quickly mobilized his team, but his thoughts were preoccupied by what Gu Nan said earlier—the relationship between Xin Berg and Zhu Qin or even her older sister.
‘Come to think of it, it's not impossible…’
……
The clues from the other two floating islands still needed some preparation before they could truly start testing them out.
So Gu Nan and Ying Ge were temporarily separated from Symphony’s team.
"Do you really think Zhu Qin has a connection to the target?" Ying Ge circled around Gu Nan, asking such questions.
"We can’t rule out this possibility." Gu Nan thought for a moment and said, "But this has nothing to do with you, right?"
"I'm also here to complete the mission! What do you mean, it has nothing to do with me?"
"Haha." Gu Nan expressed his attitude clearly with two words.
"Alright, alright." Ying Ge made a
well, whatever you want to believe
expression. "What are you going to do next? Wait for further news?”
Gu Nan just shook his head in response to this question.
Ying Ge’s gaze had been sizing him up nonstop. All of Gu Nan's facial expressions, movements, gazes, and even his subconscious habits were captured by her.
For this descendent of the Blood Ancestor’s self-inheritance, although her body changed from generation to generation, her will was still the same as that of the first generation.
Of course she didn’t deliberately stay by Gu Nan's side purely for fun.
Gu Nan's bizarre behavior in Champions World also piqued Ying Ge’s curiosity. She wanted to know what exactly was so strange about Gu Nan.
‘That one must have her own considerations in driving him over to my side. Perhaps I can glean her goal from Gu Nan.’
"Since Zhu Qin seems suspicious, why don’t we just ask her?" Gu Nan gave such an answer.
……
Inside an exquisite villa in the central part of a city on a certain floating island.
Zhu Qin pushed the door open and quickly walked in with a frosty expression, as if someone owed her five million dollars.
Of course, with her status, it would actually be easier to resolve if the problem was merely someone owing her five million dollars.
"Bastard! Fool! Psychopath!" Zu Qin immediately flew into a furious rage as soon as she entered the room and threw the objects around her. "How can there be such a person?!”
The room wasn’t empty. A young man and young woman were already inside.
The man chuckled slightly when he saw Zhu Qin acting like this. "What happened now? Who dares to provoke the anger of our Royal Highness?"
Zhu Qin glared at him and snorted coldly. "Another person from our organization came over, and he's a lunatic! He told them to seal three floating islands as soon as he arrived!"
"This kind of person actually exists?" The man was amused. He shook his head, laughing in spite of himself. "What a wild imagination he has! Brother Xin truly made the right decision in leaving your organization early on."
The woman beside him also remarked with a smile, "Little Qin, your organization really is interesting. A random newcomer wants to seal off three floating islands?"
This made Zhu Qin frown slightly. She wanted to retort but didn’t know where to start.
These two were her half-brother from the same father but different mothers—Zhu Wen—and his fiancée Yan Xuexin. They were also rather impressive cultivators.
It’s just that the two of them were born in such a small plane like Ghost Sea World, so their horizons naturally weren’t very broad.
They weren’t like Zhu Qin, who was able to join Astral Gate early on with her sister’s support. Only then did she learn how big the outside world truly was.
While it was true that the person she met today was indeed a psycho, Astral Gate was by no means a simple organization, but a real behemoth.
Thinking of Big Brother Xin’s defection from the organization and how he was still being hunted down, Zhu Qin felt another wave of inexplicable irritability.
Of course Zhu Wen and Yan Xuexin couldn’t understand Zhu Qin’s thoughts, but their suggestions were genuine and sincere.
"Little Qin, your organization keeps sending people over. Big Brother Xin will be exposed sooner or later." Zhu Wen said seriously, then lowered his voice, "Why don't we manipulate some matters from within the organization—"
"Absolutely not!" Zhu Qin got a fright and hurriedly interrupted Zhu Wen. Her attitude was even firmer than before.
After all, stopping Symphony’s plan was because of her sense of social responsibility, but stopping Zhu Wen was purely because she didn’t want to court death.
It was one thing to refuse to cooperate with the mission team, but if she publicly obstructed Astral Gate’s operations, it would trigger retaliation from the organization.
Zhu Qin even somewhat regretted letting her brother and sister-in-law meet Big Brother Xin.
These two couldn’t help with much, but the consequences of their provocations might just be fatal.
Zhu Wen and Yan Xuexin clearly disapproved of Zhu Qin’s cautiousness. Yan Xuexin chuckled. "Little Qin, you don’t usually stay in this plane for long, so don't sell us short."
"That's right." Zhu Wen put down his wine glass with an invigorated expression. "The items that Sister Yue brought back over the years have helped our overall strength increase greatly. Our growth is not something you can imagine!"
Zhu Yue was Zhu Qin's biological older sister, a Void Cutter genius who walked out from Ghost Sea World.
As a powerful Void Cutter cultivator, it naturally wasn’t hard for her to support her hometown.
"And Little Qin, don't forget," Zhu Wen added, "even Sister Yue acknowledges Brother Xin's genius."
Zhu Wen tried his best to persuade Zhu Qin, hoping that she would agree to help instead of just secretly giving them inside information like this.
He just didn't expect that a shadow had secretly infiltrated the villa already.
"So your paranoia turned out to be right!" Ying Ge said calmly. Rather than admiring Gu Nan’s correct guess, her tone was more mocking.
Zhu Qin and the other two suddenly turned around. They saw Gu Nan standing quietly at the door with Ying Ge.
Zhu Qin naturally recognized Gu Nan at a glance. She exclaimed furiously, "It's you! Hmph, do you think finding us will force us to reveal Brother Xin’s whereabouts?"
With her older sister as backing, Zhu Qin naturally wasn’t worried about people from Astral Gate making things difficult for her for no reason.
Next to her, Zhu Wen was even more confident in his backing. He believed that even if an outside organization was a dragon, it still had to coil up and shrink back in Ghost Sea World—his own territory.
So he said leisurely, "I don’t know if Your Excellency—"
Zhu Wen's voice didn’t get to travel far before a jet-black shadow instantly lunged at them, splitting into three and charging at the three of them.
Zhu Wen and Yan Xuexin didn't even grunt in pain before they were directly submerged by the shadow, while Zhu Qin also failed to react in time, but the pendant on her chest lit up with a white light, gradually revealing the figure of a woman.
At this time, Gu Nan's satisfied voice rang out, "Now this is the person I was looking for."

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Xin Berg
chapters.content:
Inside Zhu Qin's villa, Zhu Wen and Yan Xuexin had completely lost all vitality. They had no way to survive being submerged in Gu Nan’s power of shadows.
But Zhu Qin, who wasn’t much stronger than them, didn’t die instantly. Instead, the pendant on her chest protected her.
To block Gu Nan's blow with only a sliver of her will—the other party’s identity was self-evident. This woman was Zhu Qin's older sister, Void Cutter Zhu Yue.
It was clear that this Void Cutter cultivator was no ordinary person. Her long straight hair fell down to her waist, and her plain clothes were deathly pale. Even her skin was sickly pale.
If there was a description that fit her best, it would most certainly be the phrase "female ghost."
Zhu Qin, however, was long used to her sister's appearance. When she saw her sister show up, she immediately shouted, "Sister! This is the person! He’s here to find Brother Xin!"
After finishing her sentence, Zhu Qin gave Gu Nan a slightly smug look.
This kind of expression was like two children fighting and one side suddenly becoming confident upon seeing an adult on their side arrive.
But what Zhu Qin didn't expect was that the one in front of her was also an adult, and furthermore, he was precisely here for her family's adult.
Zhu Yue, who resembled a female ghost, stared at Gu Nan cautiously. With her knowledge and experience, it was impossible for her to not figure out the other party’s identity after trading blows.
"Your Excellency is?" Zhu Yue's voice also seemed like it floated up through the deep abyss, revealing a cold indifference hidden in her bones.
However, judging from the fact that she was still helping out her hometown and relatives, she was clearly not a completely indifferent and detached person. After all, she just recently entered Void Cutter Realm.
Gu Nan didn't speak. His heart thumped slightly, fully activating the law nullification attribute.
The Zhu Yue that descended here through her younger sister’s pendant was nothing more than a clone, but the strange energy fluctuations Gu Nan emanated immediately made her wary.
But her vigilance had absolutely no effect.
After over ten years of cultivation in Immortal Demon World, Gu Nan had long since returned to his peak condition. When facing the clone of a newly-advanced Void Cutter cultivator, his law nullification power was practically unmatched.
Tendrils of ghost Qi started to float up from Zhu Yue's body, but Gu Nan just reached a hand out and made a casual grabbing motion, clawing through all her ghost Qi and even grabbing Zhu Yue's clone.
Gu Nan gripped the neck of Zhu Yue’s clone with one hand and asked calmly, "Where is Xin Berg?"
Zhu Yue's clone still looked indifferent. After all, this was just a clone. Although she could tell that the other party's strength was far above her own, she was still trying to negotiate with Gu Nan.
In her view, people from Astral Gate were by no means immune to bribes. As long as the benefits outweighed the risks, the other party would make the right choice.
"Your Excellency—"
However, Gu Nan blocked all Zhu Yue's words with only one sentence: "I'll kill your entire family if you don’t tell me."
……
Xin Berg was a mixed race. His mother was white, so he was half white.
Perhaps it was this half of his ancestry that made him taller than his peers from an early age, whiter in complexion, and even lighter in pupil color.
At this time, Xin Berg was sitting leisurely in his own home, with a glass of scarlet fruit wine in front of him that he sipped occasionally.
Of course he knew people from Astral Gate were on his tail, and he had long expected this ever since he killed his companions and snatched the celestial water.
"Astral Gate really deserves to be called a colossal organization. This is really troublesome," Xin Berg drank another mouthful of fruit wine while muttering to himself with a slight headache.
Very few people knew that it wasn’t the first time Xin Berg had done such a thing.
He makes his fortune by continuously joining major organizations, and when he comes across a suitable mission target, he would suddenly and violently betray the organization and snatch away super valuable resources in passing.
There were actually many people like Xin Berg in the Myriad Heavens Universe, but many of them were also dead now—this was truly a high-risk career.
