However, Xin Berg also had his own reliance—that is, he had a wide network of connections and could always find people willing to help him.
Of course, Xin Berg wasn’t stupid enough to ask the same person for help every time. In fact, this was the first time he’d ever asked his hometown for help.
"If all goes well, I’ll soon be able to step into Void Cutter Realm with the help of the celestial water. When that time comes…" Xin Berg was clearly drinking fruit wine, which didn’t have a high alcoholic content, but his gaze started turning hazy.
But in the end, he was still someone who wandered on the edge of life and death all year round. Almost the instant his consciousness clouded over, his entire person sobered up, alarm bells ringing in his heart.
‘To sink me into oblivion so soundlessly, and using such a familiar method too…’ Xin Berg smiled wryly in his heart. When he came back to his senses, he found that all the traps and alarms he placed near the house had been deactivated instantly.
"Miss Yue… I didn't expect this." Xin Berg turned to one side.
Four figures were slowly walking over from that side, one of which was precisely Zhu Yue.
Of the four, Xin Berg only recognized two. Besides Zhu Yue and her younger sister Zhu Qin, the other two were a young man in white and a man in a black tailcoat.
To be precise, there were five people, because the young man in white was also holding a little girl’s hand.
Xin Berg knew very well that these two were probably from Astral Gate.
He clearly expressed all his feelings with the sentence “I didn’t expect this”—to think that Zhu Yue would actually betray him and help Astral Gate. He truly didn't expect this.
‘Is Astral Gate really this powerful?’
Xin Berg didn't have much time to ponder this. He saw the young man in white ask the one beside him, "Is he Xin Berg? Can you confirm it?"
The man in the tailcoat answered respectfully, "His appearance and energy signature both match. It’ll be ideal if we can capture him alive and have the organization confirm his identity."
But Xin Berg just sneered.
People from Astral Gate were simply too arrogant. Even Zhu Yue understood that they had to stealthily approach him and launch a sneak attack. Why couldn’t these people understand?
Although he didn’t have the ability to face a Void Cutter cultivator in a direct confrontation yet, it wasn’t impossible to escape from right under that person’s nose.
Xin Berg took out a small bottle from somewhere and threw it onto the ground with great force.
The person by Gu Nan’s side was naturally Symphony. As soon as he saw Xin Berg's move, he immediately turned pale with fright. "Not good, that's the residue from the celestial water!"
Celestial water was an extremely unstable high-energy substance. If it was thrown down like this, a violent explosion would immediately occur… Huh?
Under Symphony’s stunned gaze, Gu Nan suddenly stepped forward, grabbed the small bottle with one hand, and crushed it.
The celestial water splashed in all directions, but under the absolute isolation of the law nullification power, it reacted like an ordinary potion and slowly dripped onto the ground.
Drip, drip.
The sound of dripping liquid was particularly distinct in this silent situation.
Zhu Qin covered her mouth and tried not to cry out, but her eyes were suffused with pain; Zhu Yue couldn't help shaking her head slightly, as if she felt sorry for Xin Berg.
Xin Berg himself, on the other hand, fell into deep despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Blasphemy is Sin
chapters.content:
"Sister, why in the world is this?!” Zhu Qin’s face was full of stubborn defiance as she shouted at her sister loudly.
During normal times, perhaps not even she herself would believe that she’d ever hold such an attitude towards the older sister she respected the most.
At this time, the two had already returned to their villa. Unsurprisingly, Xin Berg was taken away by people from Astral Gate after having the bones in his hands and feet broken on the spot.
But Zhu Qin still couldn’t understand why the sister she believed to be omnipotent would personally lead their enemies straight to Brother Xin’s hideout just because of one sentence from that person…
"That person is very strong." Zhu Yue’s face was expressionless as she said quietly, "If I didn’t help him find Xin Berg, then he would’ve made good on his threat."
Zhu Qin was dazed. She seemed to be trying to recall what specific “threat” Gu Nan promised, and she quickly thought of it.
……
"That Zhu Yue actually gave in so fast. How boring!" Ying Ge muttered very resentfully, dissatisfied that she didn’t get to watch a good show.
The main purpose of her visit was to further observe Gu Nan. As a result, because the opponent was too weak—or perhaps too "sensible"—she didn’t get to learn anything useful about Gu Nan at all.
Xin Berg didn't cause any more ruckus. No matter how many methods he had, they were all still limited to Tier 3. The celestial water was his final trump card.
Even this plan was casually defused by Gu Nan. What else could he do to turn the situation around?
Right now, Gu Nan had already sent this traitor off to Astral Gate, which would execute him after confirming his identity. Then Gu Nan's mission would be considered complete.
Missions of this level really weren’t hard for Gu Nan.
He was too lazy to even bother searching for clues bit by bit and directly found the other party’s biggest backer instead. Everything was good if this backer was obedient. Otherwise, he’d just have to go on a killing spree.
After Gu Nan returned to Astral Gate’s office in Zi Luo Heaven, the mission reward had indeed arrived in his account.
"Welcome back, 5-star member ‘Ying Ge’s Next-Door Neighbor Uncle Wang'," the gentle female voice rang out again, reading out the long code name without pausing.
Gu Nan didn’t even glance at Ying Ge’s flaming eyes beside him. He simply minded his own business and accepted the mission rewards.
As an open organization, Astral Gate naturally couldn’t engage in calculating how much each member contributed to the mission. Instead, they only gave out two kinds of rewards.
One was physical objects or currency, and the other was points that corresponded to the member’s level.
For example, Gu Nan earned 120 units of origin crystals as well as 5 points—he could upgrade his membership level every time he accumulated 100 points.
It was a very simple and clear rule, which was exactly why it was suitable for people who’d complete one mission and leave. This was an open organization’s logic.
Then, Gu Nan separated 100 units of origin crystals in his hand and exchanged them for active world origins, which was the purpose of his trip.
"Highly active world origin—how will the Evil God Temple respond to it?" With such a question, Gu Nan gently reached his hand out and touched the origin in front of him.
This wasn’t the first time Gu Nan or even the Evil God Temple came into contact with something like world origins.
Back at White Mist, the reward given to the mission translator for the completion of missions from different worlds’ wills was precisely world origin.
But regarding that kind of origin, the Evil God Temple’s feedback was personal dungeons—even now, there were still a pile of personal dungeons with the word "incomplete" lying in Gu Nan's dungeon panel.
On the other hand, although it was also a world origin, the origin of Immortal Demon World was very normal. Once Gu Nan controlled it, he was able to control that world.
Otherwise, Gu Nan wouldn’t be able to adjust Immortal Demon World’s coordinates. It’s just that he still wasn’t strong enough, or else he’d be able to hide Immortal Demon World in the blink of an eye.
Now, what exactly would this highly active origin—obtained using the Myriad Heavens Universe’s common currency of origin crystals—be recognized as?
The Evil God Temple quickly gave its answer. It shook slightly, conveying a message Gu Nan never expected.
｢Discovered fragments of an ownerless divine fire. Do you wish to corrupt it?｣
Dumbfounded, Gu Nan stared at this prompt, and his heart felt like a thousand horses were galloping through it. A thousand thoughts could only be summed up into one sentence: ‘So a world's origin was actually divine fire; why didn’t you say so earlier!’
At this time, Gu Nan finally discovered the Evil God Temple’s greatest use: that is, to translate everything in this world into game terms that he can understand.
Godhead, Divine Kingdom, and divine fire—these were all things that only existed in the game. The World of Gods here may also have them, but Gu Nan had yet to come into contact with that world.
The relationship between the three was simple.
Godhead was a god’s core. The gods used it to manipulate their divine power.
Divine Kingdom was the foundation by which someone could ascend to godhood. It was also the source of their divine power.
And divine fire was the proof that a god could rule over a Divine Kingdom. Divine fire existed everywhere inside one’s Divine Kingdom, and it was also a god’s exclusive law. A god could only control the changes in their Divine Kingdom by using divine fire.
The so-called "igniting one’s divine fire" didn’t mean igniting it inside one’s Godhead, but inside their Divine Kingdom instead. Moreover, once a god died, the divine fire in their Divine Kingdom would go out, and the Divine Kingdom would naturally become an ownerless world.
Gu Nan was extremely familiar with these three things. Now that the Evil God Temple told him that highly active world origins were "fragments of an ownerless divine fire," Gu Nan immediately understood.
Divine fire represented a god’s exclusive law. Wasn’t that the equivalent of the world origins that Star Rulers controlled?
And world origins not controlled by a Star Ruler would naturally be "ownerless divine fire."
No wonder he only received personal dungeons through the translation method. That’s because the world's will didn’t actually reward people with genuine world origins and merely displayed it for cultivators to observe.
Only by directly plundering it could cultivators truly strip away a world’s origin, no matter whether it originally had another owner or not.
In the eyes of Ying Ge next to him, Gu Nan's expression changed rapidly, sometimes surprised and sometimes between laughter and tears, as if he’d encountered a helpless matter.
Of course she wouldn’t know that merely matching a noun with a familiar game term gave Gu Nan a deeper understanding of this world.
‘As expected, this world really does correspond to the game. Even the loopholes that were originally in the game settings have been resolved one after another…’ Gu Nan couldn't help feeling this way.
In the game, dungeon worlds didn’t count as Divine Kingdoms, so naturally there was no divine fire in them.
However, in this real world, dungeons were also real planes, which meant they existed as ownerless Divine Kingdoms. This was why Gu Nan failed to come to this realization at first.
In his perception, a concept like an "ownerless Divine Kingdom" didn’t exist at all.
But everything became clear now.
｢Corrupt the divine fire｣
Gu Nan's consciousness sank into the Evil God Temple and quickly ordered.
Evil Gods were existences that opposed the gods. Gods represented the world’s most orthodox of laws, while Evil Gods wanted to corrupt them. Be it divine fire or Godheads, it was the same.
The world origin gained from 100 units of origin crystals was obviously not much; it didn't take long for the Evil God Temple to give another notice.
｢Divine fire corrupted. Obtained 20 Evil Value and 200 points｣
Gu Nan, who was in the Evil God Temple, couldn't help showing his joy at this time—at this moment, he seemed to truly understand that sentence.
The sentence that appeared every time on the game’s login screen.
｢Blasphemy is Sin｣

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Changes in Starry Ocean Pavilion
chapters.content:
｢Blasphemy is Sin｣
In a certain sense, this was Gu Nan's purpose. Since he obtained the identity of an Evil God, he naturally had to stand on the opposite side as the gods.
His consciousness returned from the Evil God Temple. Gu Nan's gaze swept around. Ying Ge was still staring at him calmly, and Astral Gate’s enormous hall still shone a brilliant gold.
Everything still seemed the same, yet Gu Nan knew that things were different now.
The Evil God Temple used hard facts to prove to Gu Nan that the path he took wasn’t fundamentally different from the path of people in this world. This means…
‘NPCs, are you ready to fight over items with players?!’
……
"You mean, you want to settle in Zi Luo Heaven?" Ying Ge asked, staring at Gu Nan with some surprise.
The two were currently sitting in a small shop. Gu Nan was leisurely drinking a cup of green tea, while Ying Ge sat across from him with an odd expression.
Gu Nan revealed a clear intention in their chat just now—he planned to settle in Zi Luo Heaven.
"There should be a lot of Void Cutter cultivators willing to settle in a major plane like Zi Luo Heaven, right?" Gu Nan noticed her strange tone and couldn't help asking.
A large plane meant more resources. Any Void Cutter figure who intended to advance further would naturally have more opportunities in a large plane.
"Normally, yes." Ying Ge explained, "But it’s an unusual period right now. Star Realm is going to war, after all…”
Star Realm was going to war—of course Gu Nan knew this. He’d already discovered some signs from Starry Ocean Pavilion’s actions long before he came to Zi Luo Heaven.
However, now that Ying Ge mentioned this, Gu Nan also understood what she meant.
War was imminent, so wasn't this an opportunity for Void Cutter and Star Ruler cultivators like them?
No matter Star Realm or the side trying to invade Star Realm, both would definitely need to recruit people. And wouldn’t they need to pay money in order to recruit people?
"I understand." Gu Nan gave a small nod. If the opportunity presented itself, he didn’t mind returning to Star Realm.
……
Star Realm, Starry Ocean Pavilion.
The headquarters of Starry Ocean Pavilion was located on the most prosperous planet in the Central Region, Heavenly Kingdom Star.
For cultivators in the outer regions, Heavenly Kingdom Star was truly worthy of the name “Kingdom of Heaven.” This place was indeed a paradise for cultivators.
But on this day, something not very heavenly was happening in heaven.
In a small room in Starry Ocean Pavilion, Yue Jiu, one of the three Pavilion Lords, was confronting a man and a woman. It's just that Yue Jiu's calm face contained a smile, while the man and woman standing across from him were livid.
"A powerful enemy is approaching, Old Yue. At a time like this, you still have the energy to attack us?" The man stared at Yue Jiu silently, but his eyes were full of disappointment.
Yue Jiu steadfastly returned his gaze and said nonchalantly, "It’s precisely because a powerful enemy is approaching that Starry Ocean Pavilion only needs one Pavilion Lord… and neither of you are fit for that role."
Perhaps because she was angered by Yue Jiu's attitude, the woman on the side was still unyielding despite having fallen into a trap. "Yue Jiu, you know better than us exactly who is behind Starry Ocean Pavilion!"
But Yue Jiu just threw his head back and laughed. "You two fell into this trap, yet there’s been no response from that one. Do you still not understand?"
The man and woman exchanged a glance, their hearts sinking even further. Of course they understood that Star Realm was that powerhouse’s astral world. How could she not know what was happening in Starry Ocean Pavilion?
But if she knew… then the situation was even more terrifying.
"Stop wasting time on idle chatter. Let’s get rid of them quickly,” a voice came from behind Yue Jiu. Wu Gui was walking over with Ye Chen in tow.
In a little over a year, Ye Chen had already broken through to Void Cutter Realm. Starry Ocean Pavilion’s secret techniques were indeed extraordinary.
Wu Gui once caused a ruckus inside Starry Ocean Pavilion. Regarding this Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara, the male and female Pavilion Lords naturally recognized her.
But the two actually sighed in relief upon seeing Wu Gui appear.
Even if Wu Gui was also a top-notch Void Cutter cultivator, it was still not quite enough for Wu Gui and Yue Jiu alone to completely kill them.
As if seeing through their thoughts, Yue Jiu just smiled. "We’re still waiting for two more… Oh, they've arrived too."
He pointed to the other side, where two more people were slowly coming out of the shadows.
It was also a man and a woman this time, but the man looked a lot older. His face was clearly middle-aged, and his figure was a little fat.
As soon as he walked up to the crowd, he smiled like an unscrupulous businessman. "Shang Rong, subordinate of Lord Zuo Zuo, greets everyone."
"Shang Rong, the Business Stele of the Five Steles. So you’re also one of that Lord’s subordinates," Yue Jiu clearly recognized the name Shang Rong and immediately said.
He turned his gaze to the woman who appeared together with Shang Rong, whom he also couldn’t see through.
"Might this one also be one of the Five Steles…?"
"No." The woman revealed a bland smile and denied, "My name is Gu Nian."
……
Of course Gu Nan, who was far away in Zi Luo Heaven right now, wouldn’t know what just transpired in Star Realm, but even if he did, he still wouldn’t care.
Gu Nan was currently throwing himself into his grand level-up plan with great joy. How could he have the energy to care about other things?
Ying Ge had already left. She also had her own matters to handle; it was impossible for her to always observe Gu Nan. Besides, all she could do here was suffer indignities.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, was trying to learn more about the relationship between active world origins and his Evil Value and points.
The so-called active world origin was actually an artificially-manufactured product.
Inside the Myriad Heavens Starry Road, also known as the Inner World, world origins were far more easily found and obtained. Powerful Star Rulers plundered world origins from there.
These Star Rulers usually sealed low-level origins for use as resources to trade with other people.
The first origin crystals also came from this.
In fact, the active origins that Void Cutter cultivators used were actually origins that large organizations unsealed and then delivered to its members—it was precisely because of this that active origins must be used immediately, or else it would soon lose its effectiveness.
On the other hand, both Void Cutters and Star Rulers had a limited demand for world origins, both in terms of quantity and type.
Essentially, world origins were laws, and a law that suited the cultivator would certainly be much more effective in raising one’s cultivation. If the law wasn’t suited to the cultivator, then they could only try to comprehend by analogy.
However, nobody knew what type of law was inside an origin crystal before it was unsealed, so they could only count on luck when unsealing.
Based on Gu Nan's estimate, ordinary Void Cutters would need about 10,000 units of origin crystals to meet the requirement for constructing a law.
Of course, this didn’t include any failures during construction and the portion used for research. In fact, research was the biggest expense for most people.
By comparison, Gu Nan also realized his own advantages.
With the existence of the Evil God Temple, he didn’t need to put any time and effort into exhausting research. Furthermore, the Evil God Temple welcomed all types of origins. No matter what type of law, the Evil God Temple could accept them all!
This was the heaven-defying ability that truly distinguished him from other Void Cutter cultivators, allowing him to rapidly improve his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 276: Third Law, Deity’s Descent!
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was incomparably familiar with the rules of the game world, and the Evil God Temple was akin to a translator that could translate everything in this world into game terms for Gu Nan.
After learning that world origin was the same as divine fire, Gu Nan could truly be considered to have embarked on a broad road with a brilliant future.
Ever since he transmigrated to this world, he hadn’t been able to harvest Evil Value to his heart’s content like this!
Gu Nan, who was staying in Zi Luo Heaven for the time being, seemed to have returned to his days in the game, immersing himself in a large pile of missions everyday to find missions that suited him and also gave high rewards.
Perhaps this was the most suitable life for Gu Nan, a mission expert.
In just three months, Gu Nan's Evil Value reached 1,700, and he also accumulated nearly 4,000 points.
Now his Evil Value had exceeded the 1,500 mark, but Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry to construct the third law.
If this was before, he probably wouldn't have chosen to wait and would’ve tried to advance earlier. But now that there was a stable source of Evil Value and points, Gu Nan had other ideas.
He wanted to gather 4,000 points in one fell swoop and acquire a heaven-defying third law!
｢Divine fire corrupted. Obtained 40 Evil Value and 400 points｣
After absorbing another wave of active origins, Gu Nan earned more Evil Value and points. And after this wave, he finally saved enough points.
Gu Nan’s consciousness immediately sank into the Evil God Temple and started to construct his third law.
｢Beginning construction of the third exclusive law｣
｢To extract from existing laws, please select from your known abilities｣
｢The selected abilities are as follows: Law Nullification Weaponry, Giantification, and Destruction. Confirm?｣
｢Abilities not found. Do you wish to buy them?｣
｢Purchase confirmed. Please determine the ratio of each ability inputted…｣
｢Constructing exclusive law…｣
As Gu Nan's orders were issued one after another in the Evil God Temple, ability after ability was thrown into the mixture, and the construction of the law was proceeding slowly.
There were two main factors as to why the third law Gu Nan wanted to construct required so many points.
Firstly, this was a law that required three skills to construct. Secondly, Gu Nan didn’t own any of these three skills previously, so he had to buy them all.
Buying three brand-new skills that he normally never used was undoubtedly a very expensive decision.
But Gu Nan did just that… Why? Because he has money!
Based on his current progress, by the time Gu Nan accumulated 2,500 Evil Value, he should also have earned enough points to level up to Tier 5, so he could afford to invest heavily in the third law.
After all, at his level, there were fewer and fewer occasions where his old equipment and skills could come in handy.
For example, the effect of Praise of Dawn could be suppressed by a single law of curses from Yue Jiu, and enemies would also gradually find ways to counter Blink.
After reaching Tier 5, even the damage reduction effect of Resistance would be suppressed. This was the suppression of abilities caused by the increase in one’s level, which wasn’t something he could salvage.
Therefore, it was necessary for Gu Nan to continuously acquire new and more powerful abilities.
｢Construction of the third exclusive law ‘Deity' has been completed｣
After inputting a specific ratio of the ingredient abilities, the third law was completed without any accident!
The third law was called "Deity," which was a law made entirely for battle. Different from the previous two laws, it had a short description.
｢Deity: You will naturally possess divinity, and you can transform into a deity for a short time｣
The game’s descriptions always liked to act mysterious. If one were to use a more familiar game language, then this law had two effects: one active and one passive.
The passive was possessing divinity, while the active was transforming into a deity.
Divinity was the unique characteristic of gods, and it was quite useful under certain special circumstances. It also had some unexpected effects when judging whether enemy abilities’ effects would be triggered or not, so the Deity law contained a pretty good passive effect.
Even less needed to be said about the active effect. This was the biggest reason Gu Nan chose this law!
Transforming into a deity wasn’t the same as transforming into a god—rather, it was an honest-to-god deity! Super-high resistance, health, and destructive power, as well as an invincible existence that can crush laws with their physical body alone!
Because of this overly powerful effect, the active effect of the Deity law was often dubbed by players as a "deity’s descent to the mortal realm.”
The phrase "descent to the mortal realm" fully expressed how this law wasn’t something that should even appear in the mortal realm in the first place.
After his consciousness returned to his body, Gu Nan stood up slowly. Now that the third law was successfully constructed, even Gu Nan couldn't help smiling slightly.
He walked out of his room. This was the residence he bought in Zi Luo Heaven, located in an area only Void Cutter cultivators could live in. The decor was naturally extremely luxurious, and it was even equipped with professional servants, maids, and housekeepers.
"Master." Seeing Gu Nan's appearance, a maid quickly stepped forward. "Lord Roman had someone deliver two boxes of pastries, speciality products of Blue Demon World."
“Got it," Gu Nan replied casually.
Roman was a neighbor who lived next door, a strange Void Cutter cultivator who didn’t seem cold and detached at all and was quite enthusiastic towards ordinary people.
He was even more enthusiastic towards Gu Nan, someone with the same cultivation realm as him. From time to time, he would drop by and say hello, send over some small gifts, and even invite Gu Nan to go on missions together.
If he didn’t know that Roman had several concubines, Gu Nan would’ve thought he was gay.
Ignoring what Roman sent, Gu Nan soon came to Astral Gate’s missions hall and began a day's mission search.
This time, he found a mission that rather interested him from the pile of missions.
To be precise, it was a chance for him to settle a personal vendetta while earning origin crystals.
"King of the Deep Sea?"
……
"King of the Deep Sea?"
"That’s right. I saw him advance to Void Cutter Realm with my own eyes. The King of the Deep Sea was precisely the one hunting him down back then. If such a mission appears in front of him, he won't mind completing it while taking care of an old enemy in passing."
"Based on our investigations, he frequently appeared in some small planes recently. We suspect he joined an organization and is accepting missions to earn origin crystals.”
"As long as we lure him here, the four of us will attack together. We must kill him instantly."
A group of people were sitting around a table inside Starry Ocean Pavilion, discussing a "small matter" with seriousness.
Exactly who were the people sitting here?
The current and only Pavilion Lord of Starry Ocean Pavilion—Yue Jiu; the reincarnation of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara—Wu Gui; one of the Five Steles and a top Void Cutter cultivator—Shang Rong; as well as Gu Nian, who was said to be Lord Zuo Zuo’s trusted aide.
However, these people—four of the world's top powerhouses—were discussing an insignificant King of the Deep Sea, a weak Void Cutter whom Starry Ocean Pavilion only rated as “Planet Rank.”
The voice of doubt just now came from Yue Jiu.
"Just who is that Gu Nan, for us to attach so much importance to him?" While Yue Jiu still remembered Gu Nan, he clearly didn't take the other party very seriously.
For him, Gu Nan was merely the previous ruler of the Sixth Region who once slipped away from right under Yue Jiu’s nose; he had some ability, but that was all.
But at present, Yue Jiu’s three accomplices took the trouble to go around in a big circle, all to discreetly lure Gu Nan into a trap using the King of the Deep Sea.
In Yue Jiu's eyes, this kind of caution was completely unnecessary.
The four of them gathering together to ambush one person was the same as killing a chicken with a knife used to butcher cows. Any two of the ones present here could entrap Gu Nan entirely and doom his fate.
But Yue Jiu wasn’t stupid either. The fact that Wu Gui, Shang Rong, and Gu Nian all showed the same caution towards Gu Nan despite coming from different places was enough to illustrate the problem.
‘Could there really be something strange about this Gu Nan?’
Yue Jiu had such questions in his heart, but on the surface, he said, "In any case, since all three of you intend to kill this person, Starry Ocean Pavilion will certainly give its full cooperation."

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Here to kill someone
chapters.content:
After the four of them agreed on a plan, they soon dispersed to their respective destinations.
Shang Rong and Gu Nian naturally left together, traveling through the endless starry sky, but Gu Nian suddenly spoke, "I'm stopping by the Ninth Region for a while. Please inform me if something happens here."
Shang Rong was still a little unfamiliar with the term “Ninth Region,” but he quickly reacted, "Okay."
Shang Rong, together with four other people, was known as the "Five Steles," which was well-known throughout the Myriad Heavens Universe.
The Five Steles was a very famous ancient inheritance that could be obtained by only five people in each generation, each of whom would pick the path that suited them best, and every generation walked different paths.
An inheritance that actually changed from generation to generation. This was the biggest peculiarity of the Five Steles inheritance.
Shang Rong's position under Zuo Zuo wasn’t low, or else he wouldn’t have been selected as the vanguard of Zuo Zuo’s invasion of Star Realm, but he never put on airs in front of this woman.
In fact, in all the years that Shang Rong worked under Zuo Zuo, he’d never seen his Lord attach so much importance to a single person.
‘What exactly is so amazing about this woman called Gu Nian?’ Like many of Zuo Zuo's subordinates, Shang Rong was bound to have this curiosity.
Zuo Zuo's unique half-male and half-female form made his subordinates straight-out dismiss the possibility of "beauty," which narrowed down the possible answers.
"The Ninth Region?" Shang Rong looked at Gu Nian’s disappearing figure and murmured to himself.
He wasn’t worried that Gu Nian wouldn’t make it on time because of this delay. This distance was no different from making an U-turn for Void Cutter cultivators.
What he truly cared about was how Gu Nian wanted to visit the Ninth Region as soon as she entered Star Realm. Perhaps he might be able to uncover her origins by investigating the Ninth Region.
……
In the Ninth Region, Gu Nian was walking on Ruby Fish Star’s familiar streets, yet it felt as if it were a lifetime ago.
In less than two years, she actually stepped to Void Cutter Realm in one fell swoop. Even though she’d always believed that such a day would come, she never thought it would come so soon.
"Speaking of which, maybe I actually need to thank that guy?" Gu Nian chuckled slightly, but her smile didn’t reach her eyes.
She recalled that person again, the person she accidentally met when reincarnating and then personally brought to Star Realm.
It was precisely that guy—who walked so fast that people couldn’t even catch up to him while running—who stirred up this world so much that even the one behind her was paying attention to him.
In the blink of an eye, Gu Nian had already reached the Gu family’s front gates. Although they were still the familiar gates and walls, they felt a little unfamiliar to Gu Nian.
After all, she was now a Void Cutter cultivator, a completely different lifeform from ordinary people. What's more, she’d been missing for nearly two years. Who knows who’s in charge of the Gu family right now?
But this wasn’t important. In any case, the Gu family would have another new ruler as of today.
"Who are you?" A voice rang out beside Gu Nian. It was a man in gray standing in front of the gates, looking at her warily.
Even for the poorest and most barren Ninth Region, Starry Ocean Pavilion still sent two Void Cutter cultivators, and this man was one of them.
It wasn’t that this Void Cutter discovered Gu Nian’s trail. Rather, he happened to be visiting the Gu family as a guest today and ran into Gu Nian when leaving. He immediately realized that something was off about this woman.
Gu Mingyuan, Gu Nian’s father, was accompanying the Void Cutter in gray and sending him out. The instant he saw Gu Nian, his face almost looked like he’d seen a ghost.
But Gu Nian didn't look at her father. Her gaze slowly landed on the man in gray, and she revealed a strange smile.
"Life and death, death and life."
As if imbued with special magic, six words emerged directly from the bottom of the gray-clothed man’s heart.
He seemed to be transported into a space containing only black and white, with death on the left and life on the right, while he was standing on the border between them.
The man was a little startled. Just when he wanted to mobilize his own law, he saw life and death reverse suddenly, changing into reincarnation.
The space of life and death made a light seal, and his consciousness completely disappeared.
In Gu Mingyuan's eyes, Gu Nian seemed to have only looked at the man in gray, and this Void Cutter cultivator began to slowly fall to the ground until he was completely dead.
……
Star Realm, Central Region, Heavenly Kingdom Star.
As one of the leaders of the Bloodline Alliance, although the King of the Deep Sea might not be the strongest, his status was absolutely top-notch, so his temple was naturally on Heavenly Kingdom Star.
Gu Nan was already on Heavenly Kingdom Star at this time. After all, it didn’t take much time for Void Cutter cultivators to travel through space.
But Gu Nan didn’t immediately accept the mission upon finding the mission to “Kill the King of the Deep Sea” in Astral Gate. Instead, he also did some investigation.
He made a trip back to Immortal Demon World. While managing the Divine Kingdom, Yan Xiaoxiao was simultaneously keeping a close eye on the situation in Star Realm at Gu Nan’s request.
The news he received from Yan Xiaoxiao's side was that Starry Ocean Pavilion just underwent a great change. Yue Jiu became the only Pavilion Lord, and signs of the approaching war were becoming clearer and clearer.
A more typical sign was the frequent assassinations of Void Cutter experts recently, as well as certain Prodigious cultivators in important positions.
Under such circumstances, the mission to "Kill the King of the Deep Sea" didn’t seem surprising.
If the invading forces could kill all the Void Cutter cultivators in Star Realm merely by throwing money at mercenaries, then they’d certainly be eager to issue assassination missions.
"It’s also possible that some people want to snipe me," Gu Nan muttered in his own language.
It wasn’t like he hadn’t considered this possibility. This mission just happened to appear in front of him. Was there a possibility of it being deliberate?
However, with his current strength, even in the face of a veritable Star Ruler, he still didn’t have much fear—as long as it wasn’t the existences that had their own astral worlds.
His Evil Value breaking through the 1,500 threshold didn’t only bring an increase in strength from the third law, but his Evil God physique had also been strengthened to a considerable extent.
And speaking of the King of the Deep Sea, Gu Nan really was interested in having a chat with him.
The reason he first came into contact with the other party during the mission chain was because Qin Xuanji, the spokesperson of the King of the Deep Sea, was also eyeing the Godhead.
According to them, that object should be called a Realm Stone, but its essence didn’t change.
Later, to acquire this Realm Stone, the King of the Deep Sea even personally hunted down Gu Nan. Ultimately, he ran into a Gu Nan who advanced to Tier 4 and was chopped up by the ten times crit damage from the law of substitution.
Since then, the King of the Deep Sea never appeared in front of Gu Nan again, and Gu Nan also couldn't spare the time to take revenge for the time being, so he’d been dragging it out until now.
But it was time now. Plus, Gu Nan really wanted to know where this bloodline user got that information.
Lan Si and her older brother also came here for the Godhead. Could the King of the Deep Sea possibly be connected to the World of Gods?
All these suspicions needed to be confirmed by the King of the Deep Sea himself. And now, Gu Nan was standing in front of the gates to the Deep Sea Temple, calmly staring at this solemn palace.
"Your Excellency, who are you?" Someone noticed Gu Nan’s existence and asked cautiously.
"I’m here to kill someone," Gu Nan replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 278: I dont really care
chapters.content:
The King of the Deep Sea was very upset recently.
Originally, he hid away in another plane after the fight with Gu Nan and made up his mind to not return until he could confirm that Gu Nan hadn’t appeared for a long time or was dead.
Anyhow, it wasn’t anything strange for Void Cutter figures to not return for decades at a time.
He naturally knew about Star Realm's recent situation. However, his status wasn’t comparable to that of normal Void Cutter cultivators. He had plenty of resources in his hands, so why would he need to take advantage of the war to make money?
For an existence like him, he was all too eager to avoid the chaotic war and bury his head into the ground like an ostrich, then come out again as a peaceful and happy gentleman once the war was over.
But for some reason, both the Bloodline Alliance and his Deep Sea Temple had been experiencing some frequent problems lately.
They weren’t really big problems, but they became big once they all piled up. In short, he had to return and handle them personally. He couldn’t get by using a remote-controlled clone any longer.
Not even Void Cutter powerhouses could escape wishful thinking.
‘That Gu Nan didn't come to look for my trouble for so long and was even chased by Starry Ocean Pavilion earlier, so he probably doesn’t have the time to pay attention to me, right?’
‘And the troubles at the Deep Sea Temple and the Bloodline Alliance are all trivial matters. That person doesn’t have the ability to manipulate things on this level, does he?’
‘Besides…’
When the King of the Deep Sea started finding excuses for himself, he’d actually already made up his mind.
So he returned, and at the same time, he set foot onto a dead end.
"We’ll deal with the Floral Jasper Star Chamber of Commerce like this. If there are still people with objections, make it so that they won’t be able to voice those objections," the King of the Deep Sea calmly gave out orders while sitting on the high throne, unable to sense anything amiss.
But the next moment, a strange fluctuation traveled over from the temple gates, which immediately made his expression change.
This old Void Cutter expert was very experienced. Almost immediately, he subconsciously tried to tear open space, but the enemy was faster than he expected.
An ordinary fist shot out of the void. The strange light on the fist shattered all of the King of the Deep Sea’s defenses and slammed into his chest.
And the King of the Deep Sea?
Faced with such a blow, the powerhouse who once chased Gu Nan down like prey didn’t even have the chance to react right now as his chest caved in rapidly.
The King of the Deep Sea looked quite good. He was in a navy uniform and even wore armor. But in front of Gu Nan's punch, whether or not he had armor both resulted in the same ending.
Boom!
The King of the Deep Sea was directly blasted into the ground, and his chest seemed to be hit by a meteorite, a large portion of it caving inwards.
"Do you know about Godheads?" Gu Nan stood in front of the King of the Deep Sea and flatly asked this question, as if he was asking
have you eaten today?
The King of the Deep Sea stared blankly for an instant but quickly reacted. This might be his only chance to live.
"I know—"
Boom!
Another punch landed on his head, directly blowing apart his entire head. Then Gu Nan gently shook his head. "Your answer was too slow."
A slow answer meant he thought about it before answering, and needing to think before answering meant he was making it up. This was the criteria Gu Nan used in judging NPCs’ answers.
Just as Gu Nan killed the King of the Deep Sea, a burst of applause came from the side. It was Starry Ocean Pavilion’s only remaining Pavilion Lord, Yue Jiu.
"How astounding. I didn't expect you to make such rapid progress even in this realm." Yue Jiu studied Gu Nan with a somewhat surprised gaze.
He was one of the first people to notice Gu Nan, so he was well aware of Gu Nan’s progress along the way.
He previously felt that he’d already placed too much importance on Gu Nan from the perspective of the entire Star Realm war. After all, for existences on that level, even the strongest Void Cutter cultivator was still a weakling.
Yet the one behind Shang Rong and Gu Nian specifically asked them to kill Gu Nan. This was truly a strange request.
But after seeing how much more progress Gu Nan had made, Yue Jiu was forced to admit that it was reasonable to kill this person as soon as possible.
If they gave him time to grow, he’s afraid that it wouldn’t be long before killing Gu Nan was beyond his ability.
"Something the matter?" Gu Nan gave Yue Jiu a strange look and asked casually. He wasn’t afraid of the other party now, and he wasn’t in a hurry to take revenge either.
He didn’t even have to think to know that the one in front of him wouldn’t possibly be Yue Jiu’s true body—no curse user would be stupid enough to meet people using their true body.
Yue Jiu sighed regretfully. "What a pity. Too many people noticed your talent."
The instant his voice fell, Yue Jiu’s figure had already drifted away with the wind, while an inexplicable law approached Gu Nan.
Gu Nan knew that this was the effect of Yue Jiu’s curse. But this time the nature of the curse was no longer “deepening injuries,” but “weakening” instead!
After all, Yue Jiu was one of Starry Ocean Pavilion’s Pavilion Lords and a peak Void Cutter expert. His power of law wouldn’t be easy to endure.
The curse of "weakening" fell upon Gu Nan, who felt the vitality throughout his entire body rapidly slip away. He felt like he’d suddenly aged several decades, and he couldn't muster any strength at all.
Fortunately, his Evil Value made a breakthrough earlier, so his Evil God physique had also been strengthened, or else the situation would be more dire.
Gu Nan coldly assessed the situation, prepared to activate Deity’s Descent at a second’s notice, but he wasn’t in a hurry to use it.
Yue Jiu started with "weakening" in order to weaken Gu Nan’s condition, which meant he must have other helpers—although it felt good to throw an ultimate at the enemy as soon as the battle started, he still had to figure out where the other enemies were.
Shang Rong, who’d just personally witnessed Gu Nan's physical strength, wasn’t stupid enough to rush up to die. Instead, he hid someplace far away and slashed out a blade of light with a wave of his hand, which swiftly flew at Gu Nan.
If one looked carefully, they’d find that although this blade of light looked simple, it was very unique inside.
Its internal energy wasn’t stable and unmoving. Rather, the energy continuously circulated inside, allowing every location to bring out far greater power than the original attack.
This was Shang Rong’s law of business, namely, the law of circulation.
"Aren't you going to attack?" Shang Rong glanced to his side, where Gu Nian had naturally also arrived, but she didn't seem to be in a hurry to make a move.
"It’s fine if we just stall him." Gu Nian said softly, "Don't forget, our goal is Immortal Demon World."
Shang Rong's gaze flickered slightly. "That said, we also can’t let go of a chance to kill him if possible."
"Things might not be that simple."
As if to verify Gu Nian’s words, tens of thousands of Buddhas suddenly rose from the ground, each of them lightly sounding the wooden bells in front of them. Countless chanting voices surrounded Gu Nan and the others.
Since Wu Gui intended to attack, this scene wasn’t strange, but Shang Rong couldn't help frowning slightly. He felt that something was off.
The next moment, he suddenly understood. "Not good, her target is—"
"Bastard!" Yue Jiu's flustered voice came, and his panicked figure appeared in midair. Countless Buddhist chants seemed to condense into a tangible force, surrounding and trapping him.
Simultaneously, the curse of "weakening" he imposed on Gu Nan also disappeared.
Gu Nan’s expression still remained unchanged, letting the blade of light slash him. A gash appeared on his waist, but he didn’t seem to feel anything.
His gaze swept over Shang Rong and Gu Nian, eventually landing on the girl who gradually revealed herself and stood opposite of Yue Jiu.
"Is this what you meant when you mentioned attacking Starry Ocean Pavilion?" Gu Nan remembered what Wu Gui said to him when they returned from Champions World.
"Yes." Wu Gui’s face was still calm and indifferent, but she looked a little uncertain. "You seem like you already knew which side I’d pick?"
In Wu Gui’s eyes, the reason Gu Nan could remain so calm and unmoving was clearly because he was certain that Wu Gui would attack Yue Jiu, which naturally meant he already knew which side Wu Gui was truly on.
Gu Nan, however, just smiled and activated the “Deity" law.
"I don't really care about that."

chapters.title: Chapter 279: I know it better than you
chapters.content:
Gu Nan indeed didn’t foresee that Wu Gui would attack Yue Jiu. He didn't even know the other party was here, so how could he even guess that?
However, Gu Nan didn’t actually need to doubt Wu Gui’s true allegiance—she’d met Ying Ge. This alone was enough to prove that she was opposed to Zuo Zuo.
"So Zuo Zuo was even able to incite Starry Ocean Pavilion to rebel…" After seeing Shang Rong and Gu Nian over there, how could he still not understand what was happening?
Gu Nian died in Immortal Demon World but was now back from the dead. Who else besides Zuo Zuo could do such a thing?
Gu Nan's cold gaze swept over the two as his body began to glow with a faint golden light that gradually intensified. Yan Xiaoxiao had already sent over an alarm from Immortal Demon World.
‘Sure enough, Zuo Zuo’s goal is still Immortal Demon World?’
"Be careful." Gu Nian's attention never left Gu Nan. She immediately alerted Shang Rong as soon as she saw this change.
"I'll fight him." Shang Rong nodded calmly. Of course he wouldn’t go as far as to underestimate Gu Nan, but he also wasn’t too afraid. After all, he was also one of Lord Zuo Zuo’s subordinates… ‘Wait a minute, what is this?!’
Before Shang Rong could land on the ground, he saw a scene that left him stupefied.
The golden glow that slowly enveloped Gu Nan's entire body and suddenly shone brightly and then went out. Gu Nan's body enlarged to multiple times his original size, and his entire body glittered gold.
The current Gu Nan was over five meters tall. His originally slightly stocky figure suddenly turned into that of a muscle-bound man. His upper clothes burst apart completely, revealing his well-built chest.
But none of this was the reason for Shang Rong's shock. He was astonished at the terrifying might contained in the other party’s casual gestures!
Gu Nan was slowly making his way forward, walking on the void. With every step, the space around him was crushed to pieces with a rumble, and a harsh golden light burst out.
The entire place was filled with such an endless golden light. The tens of thousands of Buddhas that were originally floating around them were completely crushed into the ground; most of them dissipated in the wind.
The aura Gu Nan gave off was too majestic. He was like a blazing sun. Just the energy waves he naturally gave off was enough to destroy the Buddhas.
Wu Gui stared at this situation with a dumbfounded gaze. In the end, she could only sigh speechlessly. The Palm-Sized Buddha Kingdom she painstakingly set up was shattered before it could actually be put to good use.
However, Yue Jiu, whose true body was forced out of hiding by Wu Gui, fell into deep despair at that moment.
The reason was very simple—he was Gu Nan's first target!
Gu Nan's footsteps seemed to be both slow and fast, arriving in front of Yue Jiu in the blink of an eye. His entirely golden arm slammed down hard on Yue Jiu's head.
‘Why? Why me?!’
Yue Jiu simply couldn't understand. ‘Shang Rong and Gu Nian are clearly here to kill Gu Nan, but all I did was lend a hand in passing, so how come his first target is me?’
‘Just because I offended him before?!’
The space around Yue Jiu shattered completely, making it impossible for him to escape by tearing through space. He, who’d fallen into a desperate situation, finally displayed the mental fortitude fit for a Pavilion Lord of Starry Ocean Pavilion.
‘Since I can’t escape, then I’ll fight to the death! Even if it costs me my life…’
Yue Jiu resolved fiercely in his heart while throwing countless curse laws at Gu Nan. However, he originally thought he could at least hinder the other party's laws for a while, but his curses didn't take effect at all.
Gu Nan's palm fell and directly blasted Yue Jiu's head apart!
Gu Nan, who transformed into a deity, perfectly embodied the concept of killing Void Cutter cultivators as easily as butchering chickens. Yue Jiu—the mighty Pavilion Lord of Starry Ocean Pavilion and a top Void Cutter powerhouse—ended up just like the King of the Deep Sea.
As for the curses Yue Jiu threw out right before he died, they naturally all fell on Gu Nan without fail.
Weakening, aging, confusion, exhaustion… If any of them hit normal Void Cutter cultivators, it would be enough to make them lose 90% of their combat power, yet Gu Nan tanked them all.
These laws didn’t even make a splash when they landed on the body of a deity and were snuffed out without a trace.
Gods were merely living creatures whose rank as a lifeform was higher than that of mortals, while deities were veritable gods unaffected by the laws of the mortal realm. In a certain sense, this was the true "law nullification."
One could only neutralize "Deity’s Descent" through pure physical attacks or by creating an environment that was extremely unsuitable for deities to fight in.
But neither of them was easy.
After killing Yue Jiu with a palm strike, Gu Nan once again cast his gaze on Gu Nian and Shang Rong.
Yan Xiaoxiao's plea for help was getting stronger and stronger. Of course he knew something was wrong with Immortal Demon World right now, but what he knew even more was that he must deal with these people first.
He couldn’t maintain the Deity’s Descent status for long. If he didn’t kill as many enemies as much as possible during the duration of his ultimate move, then was he waiting to be slaughtered by the enemy after the ultimate move ended?
So Gu Nan didn't waste any time. His form turned into a golden streak of light and shot straight at Shang Rong.
Shang Rong looked at the golden figure rapidly flying at him. Wherever the figure went, space shattered. His scalp felt numb, and his head was about to explode.
If Zuo Zuo didn’t have such a high prestige in his mind, he would’ve cursed a long time ago.
‘You want me to stop such an opponent from traveling through space?! I'd be thankful if I can even survive this!’
However, Shang Rong ultimately wasn’t Yue Jiu. The latter’s true body had been forced out of hiding by Wu Gui a long time ago, which made it impossible for Yue Jiu to dodge Gu Nan’s attacks. Although Shang Rong was also here in his true body, at least there he still had some hopes of turning the situation around.
Shang Rong couldn’t spare any thought to maintain the unruffled demeanor of "one of the Five Steles" any longer. He threw out a blade of light in passing, then turned and ran away without a second thought.
But how could his speed compare with Deity’s Descent?
A weight that felt like the sky was collapsing emerged behind Shang Rong. Shang Rong looked back in despair and saw that Gu Nan’s figure had already reached him.
The blade of light that could still cause considerable damage just moments ago couldn’t even cut through the other party’s skin right now.
Faced with this scene, a trace of understanding suddenly emerged from Shang Rong's hopeless heart, and a word popped up—deity.
Just like a deity, the opponent’s ability was unparalleled. Any person or object that tried to stand in front of the deity’s path would be crushed to pieces without hesitation.
Just as Shang Rong expected, Gu Nan's punch suddenly fell down, and the target was precisely Shang Rong's head.
However, the instant his fist touched Shang Rong, a voice that contained a certain magic sounded again.
"Life and death, death and life."
But the black and white space between life and death didn't fall on Gu Nan. Rather, Shang Rong was the one to experience it this time. His vision was both dark and bright, but he actually didn't die at Gu Nan's hands.
‘Did that punch seemingly disappear, or did I already die once and then come back to life?’
Gu Nian’s strange voice that traveled into his ears just now made Shang Rong believe it was the latter. Before he could wake up from the joy of a narrow escape from death, he discovered that Gu Nan had disappeared again.
This time, Shang Rong knew what happened without even having to think.
"Not good! This was a diversion!" He turned to look at Gu Nian’s side, but it was too late.
On the other side, Gu Nian felt the power crushing down onto the top of her head. A trace of helplessness couldn’t help appearing in her eyes.
"You even know about returning to life after death?"
"As I said, I know ‘duality’ better than you do."

chapters.title: Chapter 280: Suicide
chapters.content:
Gu Nan had always fought with a clear tactical intent. Then, by concealing his true target, he misled the enemy into making a false judgment, finally deceiving the enemy into walking towards ruin step by step.
Despite being fully aware that Immortal Demon World was being invaded, Gu Nan didn't hurry back to save it. This was all to kill or injure as much of the enemy’s effective forces as possible.
Of course Yue Jiu had to be killed first, because his class as a "curse user" caused more trouble to Gu Nan than other enemies of the same realm.
Therefore, Gu Nan did just that as soon as he transformed. He was so fast that not even Gu Nian had time to save Yue Jiu.
Of the remaining two opponents, it was much easier to decide who to kill first—when facing an enemy with a Tier 4 law of duality, he didn’t need to put any thought into the kill priority at all.
If he killed Shang Rong first, then Gu Nian would resurrect him without hesitation. Back when she was Tier 3, Gu Nian could only use the opposing nature of life and death to revive herself, but at Tier 4, she could use it on other people as well.
Of course a veteran player like Gu Nan understood that in sum, "duality" meant "everything was mutually opposing."
Life and death; creation and destruction; time and space; action and an opposite reaction… Perhaps the first pair Gu Nian realized was life and death.
But “duality” also wasn’t truly invincible. Although it could affect Shang Rong out of thin air, it also had its own weakness—that is, there was a lag.
The higher the enemy’s power level, the longer the preparation time needed to use the law of duality. In other words, this was a law that couldn’t withstand assassination.
It was also by taking advantage of this that Gu Nan created a diversion to trick Gu Nian into using up the life and death seal she prepared beforehand, after which he suddenly changed his target to her.
"I know ‘duality’ better than you do."
A golden fist slammed down along with this sentence, but the second before this, Gu Nian made an inconceivable move.
She suddenly slapped her temple, instantly blowing out her own brain.
She killed herself!
Shang Rong stared at this scene in shock, not understanding the meaning behind Gu Nian’s move. ‘Don’t tell me that in order to not die at the enemy’s hands, you have to kill yourself instead?’
Gu Nan, however, withdrew his hand and muttered, "Seeking life in death? A smart NPC sure is troublesome."
Even with Gu Nan's knowledge and experience, he also had to admit that committing suicide was the best choice Gu Nian had.
As long as she could avoid Gu Nan's exalted Deity law, she would at least have a chance of reviving herself, even if she had to pay an extremely high price for it.
But if she was killed by Deity’s Descent, then she was afraid that not even “duality” would be able to do anything.
Gu Nian was gone, yet Shang Rong didn't seize the opportunity to escape, so clearly, only one ending awaited him.
As deity-mode Gu Nan punched down, this world-famous powerhouse, known as one of the "Five Steles," turned into dust in the blink of an eye.
The next moment, Gu Nan directly tore open the void and descended upon Immortal Demon World.
……
Similarly, two Void Cutter invaders had also entered Immortal Demon World.
One of them was a good friend of Shang Rong’s named Qin Fengye—the “Extinction Stele” of the “Five Steles.” She was a gorgeous but gloomy woman.
The other one wasn’t even human. Instead, he was a strange creature with a snake’s head, a person's upper torso, and a lizard's lower body.
For Zuo Zuo, who lived in a region outside Star Realm, it didn’t seem strange to have this kind of subordinate.
The snake-headed person named "Baili Tuo" was currently inhaling the smell of Immortal Demon World with an intoxicated expression.
"The living… The smell of the living!" Baili Tuo usually lived in an uninhabited plane and was released only when carrying out missions, so his vicious nature naturally came out at this time.
"You can eat as many humans as you want after we acquire this world’s origin," Qin Fengye's cold voice rang out, finally calling Baili Tuo back to his senses.
"Don’t forget what you just said…" Baili Tuo’s forked tongue slipped out and licked his lips.
Qin Fengye stopped paying attention to him and rushed forward in the blink of an eye. She knew that this world’s origin was right up ahead, so there was no need to look for it.
Immortal Demon World used to be Zuo Zuo's Dao Hall. If not for the fact that Zuo Zuo was otherwise occupied right now, why would he need to go to this much trouble just to get it back?
When she recalled Zuo Zuo’s situation, Qin Fengye’s gaze couldn’t help turning slightly cold. After all, the woman who could snatch away Star Realm from her Lord’s hands ten thousand years ago was definitely not simple…
If not for that woman’s unexpected actions, they wouldn't even need to use Immortal Demon World’s origin.
Qin Fengye stepped straight into a manor, putting aside all her thoughts for the time being. Her figure headed straight in a certain direction.
Standing here, she could clearly sense this world’s origin. ‘As long as I obtain this origin, My Lord will be able to easily overwhelm that one… Hmm? Who’s this?’
"Who are you?" Qin Fengye asked with a heavy voice as she coldly gazed at the woman who suddenly appeared in front of her eyes.
Their information said that there was no second Void Cutter cultivator in Immortal Demon World, but the law fluctuations from the person in front of her was clearly that of a genuine Void Cutter cultivator.
"Lan Si," the woman's indifferent voice answered. Astonishingly, this was the Lan Si who entered secluded cultivation after ten-plus years of earnest cultivation.
While Gu Nan stayed in Zi Luo Heaven for several months, several more years had passed in Immortal Demon World. Lan Si finally made a breakthrough and stepped into Tier 4 in one fell swoop, completely fusing with the Godhead.
"Why are you wasting time talking to her?! Kill her!" Baili Tuo’s gloomy voice traveled over from behind Qin Fengye as he arrived and lunged straight for Lan Si.
But Lan Si moved even faster. With a wave of her hand, a blue light instantly wrapped around Baili Tuo.
Baili Tuo froze slightly. He tried to tear apart the enemy's power using his own laws, but this blue light was like the toughest cloth. He couldn’t rip it apart no matter what he tried.
The next moment, a choking sensation not even he could endure traveled over, and he realized what this blue light was.
Heavy water! This was extremely heavy water!
Every drop of water was as heavy as a meteorite. What would it feel like to have all these water droplets gather together and cover one’s entire body?
Now Baili Tuo knew. He felt like his entire person was buried alive, and it even felt like he was buried in the center of the earth’s core!
‘Thankfully, our side has two people…’ Baili Tuo turned his head with difficulty, only to see Qin Fengye rapidly moving away.
"You stall her, I'll grab the origin," Qin Fengye was way more direct than Baili Tuo, and her actions were just as decisive. She disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Tens of millions of curses ran through Baili Tuo's heart. At this moment, he dearly wished he could immediately free himself and hack this teammate of his to death.
Fortunately, Lan Si was also distracted by Qin Fengye's surprising act, which saved Baili Tuo from being crushed to death.
Lan Si turned around somewhat anxiously. She realized that the other party's purpose was to seize some kind of object. Now that Gu Nan was away, she was naturally responsible for stopping the other party.
On the other hand, Qin Fengye's thoughts were much simpler.
What did Baili Tuo's life and death have to do with her? As long as she seized Immortal Demon World’s origin, even if she had to sacrifice Baili Tuo, Lord Zuo Zuo would still reward her highly!
‘There, right in front of me!’
A world origin that was originally blue but was now pitch-black from being corroded by the power of shadows was already laid out in front of Qin Fengye.
But Qin Fengye was also famous throughout the Myriad Heavens Universe. Even at this final moment, her mind still didn't relax at all. She was on guard against any traps that the enemy might have left behind.
Even her action of seizing the origin was swift and cautious. She even wrapped her right hand in her own law, then stretched out her hand to snatch the origin.
‘Even if there are traps, even if this hand gets crippled, I must still grab that origin!’
Qin Fengye resolved viciously in her heart and stretched out her hand, pressing down on the origin without hesitation.
It worked! She seized the origin!
However, an inexplicable might suddenly appeared in the sky at this moment, which almost made Qin Fengye feel like the sky was collapsing.
She glanced up subconsciously. A huge golden palm suddenly slammed down, directly crushing her into the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Ruthless
chapters.content:
Gu Nan, who was over five meters tall and resembled a small giant, gradually emerged from the sky and landed next to Qin Fengye's corpse.
Qin Fengye was also a top-notch Void Cutter expert, but she couldn’t resist at all when faced with deity-mode Gu Nan.
Deity’s Descent didn’t just give Gu Nan resistance against laws, but it also further strengthened his agility and strength.
The Gu Nan who transformed into a deity had already reached a limit in his physical strength. Under divinity’s influence, his physical body alone was enough to shatter space.
An existence the mortal realm couldn’t withstand—that was a deity.
Gu picked up Qin Fengye like a chicken, tossed her aside, then raised his hand and pressed it into the origin.
"No!" This roar came from Baili Tuo. The snake-headed person finally found an opportunity to escape while Lan Si was distracted. But before he could rejoice, he saw this scene.
He didn’t know who Gu Nan was, but he knew perfectly well what Gu Nan was doing.
He planned to destroy this origin!
That’s right. Gu Nan wanted to destroy this origin that was both the symbolic and actual foundation of Immortal Demon World!
A golden hand mercilessly stabbed into the origin ball of light. The origin, which was clearly intangible, actually gave off a shattering sound like a tangible object.
In the past, Gu Nan still needed to research and analyze what a world origin was, but it was completely unnecessary now.
Because the Evil God Temple told him that a world origin was divine fire, which was a term he was familiar with.
Gu Nan didn’t know how to handle world origins, but he knew how to handle divine fire!
Gu Nan's hand stirred gently, and the origin that once tormented him suddenly turned from black to blue, then back to black, and finally, the two colors each occupied half of the origin.
The sound of something breaking in space became more and more obvious, and the origin was about to shatter.
A gust of wind swept over. Baili Tuo saw an opportunity and appeared behind Gu Nan with a flicker, slashing his blade down on the back of Gu Nan’s neck!
While it was true that Baili Tuo was rash, he was also a top Void Cutter expert, so his grasp of the battle situation was absolutely top-notch.
This golden guy instantly killed Qin Fengye upon appearing, but then he busied himself with destroying the origin. What did this imply?
‘This implies that the other party doesn’t have much time. Destroying the origin is his top priority at the moment, so of course I have to interrupt that!’
In Baili Tuo's not-too-clever head, he didn’t even have time to consider his own safety. All he could think of right now was— ‘Kill! Live human! Food!’
His blade fell unimpeded, hitting Gu Nan's neck hard.
Baili Tuo's face revealed some joy, but his expression changed in the next second.
Clang!
Baili Tuo's broadsword successfully cut Gu Nan, but the latter didn’t even move. Not even his golden skin was damaged at all. Instead, the law on Baili Tuo’s broadsword disappeared, and his blade broke!
"This is…" Baili Tuo seemed to realize something, and his eye twitched like crazy, but it was too late to escape.
Gu Nan coldly turned half of his body to the side. The hand inside the origin remained unmoved, while he casually flicked his left hand and whipped Baili Tuo in the face.
This Void Cutter figure didn't even have time to turn his head before his entire head was sent flying.
No, to be precise, his head plus the space where his head used to be were both shattered by Gu Nan's blow.
Baili Tuo's headless corpse slowly fell down, but there was still a black hole in the space his head used to be, as if someone had dug out a piece of the picture. It looked incomparably eerie.
Gu Nan's indifferent gaze turned back to the origin again. Immortal Demon World’s origin had become distinct. The left side was blue and the right side was black, corresponding to the part Zuo Zuo left behind and the part Gu Nan already corroded, respectively.
Under the manipulation of Gu Nan's deity physique, these two parts were gradually separating, and this origin seemed like it would split into two halves.
This was Gu Nan’s goal. He was trying to tear down Immortal Demon World’s origin and destroy the part belonging to Zuo Zuo, leaving behind only his own.
With his current understanding of origins, coupled with the powerful strength of the deity physique, it might just be possible.
But Gu Nan soon revealed a regretful expression, because he realized that his goal probably couldn’t be achieved—the reason was simple: there wasn’t enough time.
While Gu Nan wasn’t familiar with a world’s origin, he was all too familiar with divine fire, especially in a world that once had an owner like Immortal Demon World. The world’s origin was just highly concentrated divine fire.
Once he started, Gu Nan only needed a single glance to tell that it would take him at least a day to completely separate Zuo Zuo’s power from the world’s origin.
But how could his Deity’s Descent state last so long?
Right now, Gu Nan could already feel his power gradually fading. This "transformation" was nearing its end.
With no other alternative, Gu Nan could only suppress the regret in his heart and make an astonishing decision—he suddenly threw a punch straight at the origin!
"Teacher?!” Yan Xiaoxiao's figure rolled out from the side, staring at Gu Nan in shock.
In fact, she had always been hiding on the sidelines in order to act as the last line of defense. If Gu Nan hadn't appeared, perhaps the one to risk her life to stop Qin Fengye would’ve been her.
But it was precisely because of this that Yan Xiaoxiao couldn’t understand Gu Nan's act.
This punch of his truly intended to destroy the origin!
‘Why? Why would he go to such great lengths to protect the origin, only to destroy it with his own hands? And doesn’t Teacher know that once the origin is destroyed, this world will… fall apart?’
At the very least, Yan Xiaoxiao was someone who almost fused with another person and almost gained control over this world’s origin, so she understood the importance of the origin.
But Gu Nan didn't hesitate in the slightest. With a heavy punch, the blue and black origin finally began to dissipate.
"Tsk tsk, how ruthless…" As the origin dissipated, an illusory figure finally emerged, floating in front of Gu Nan.
"To stop me from taking back my origin at all costs, you’d even destroy this world?" The figure quietly looked at Gu Nan.
The left and right sides of this figure were completely different. On the left, there was a crazed-looking girl, while on the right, there was a gentle and peaceful-looking boy.
This was Zuo Zuo’s shadow. After many years, Gu Nan finally saw him again, this Star Ruler he accidentally met through a personal dungeon when Gu Nan was still Tier 3.
Now, however, Gu Nan didn’t have much fear when he saw Zuo Zuo.
For one thing, he now had a deity’s physique, and his own power was much stronger than before. For another, this illusion in front of him was just a residual piece of soul Zuo Zuo left behind in Immortal Demon World.
If Zuo Zuo could take the time to visit in person, even a clone would be enough to forcibly seize the origin back. He wouldn’t need to take so many twists and turns at all.
"I might still be able to preserve this world, but I can’t leave the origin for you." Gu Nan smiled. "Besides, you'd better worry about yourself first."
"Oh?" Zuo Zuo's expression was still calm. Not even the girl's face changed much.
"Next round will be that woman’s turn, won’t it?" Gu Nan smiled and added, "I hear you have an older sister?"
Zuo Zuo's expression finally froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Too Late
chapters.content:
The world was crumbling apart, and heaven and earth were collapsing.
The scene that occurred when Gu Nan first seized the origin was being repeated even more violently right now, and even meteors started to rain down from the sky.
Yan Xiaoxiao's eyes were bloodshot and her heart was dripping with blood.
It took her over ten years of hard work to build up the two major alliances and 100 city-states with great difficulty. But under this apocalyptic scene, she’d be lucky to preserve even one-tenth of that.
And if this situation continued, then the entire world would completely fall apart within an hour, and everything would die out.
Zuo Zuo's figure had long since disappeared. Of course he couldn’t give Gu Nan any reply, and Gu Nan also wasn’t purely trying to disgust the other party. Rather, Gu Nan was trying to divert Zuo Zuo's attention.
Zuo Zuo’s current situation was actually very easy to guess.
His war against Red had reached the most critical moment, and he realized that the victory he was originally almost certain of actually still needed some help to achieve. Therefore, he once again had a demand for certain objects that he originally abandoned.
After all, Immortal Demon World was Zuo Zuo's former Dao Hall, and its origin was admittedly what Zuo Zuo needed right now. So then, could Zuo Zuo have left behind other arrangements in Immortal Demon World as well?
The reason Gu Nan didn’t hesitate to destroy the origin at the cost of also destroying his future Divine Kingdom was because he wanted to completely dispel Zuo Zuo's desire for Immortal Demon World.
Under such circumstances, using Ying Ge’s existence to divert Zuo Zuo’s attention was undoubtedly the best choice.
As for whether revealing this kind of information would lead to Red’s defeat… What did her life and death have to do with Gu Nan?
In fact, Gu Nan actually wanted these two to kill each other so as to give him time to grow.
The golden light on Gu Nan's body finally began to fade rapidly. His figure and strength also returned to normal levels. This was also the reason why Gu Nan was in a hurry to destroy the origin—after he exited deity mode, he wouldn’t be able to destroy the origin even if he wanted to.
A world’s origin wasn’t like a glass ball that could be broken by any random person.
"Teacher, is there… truly still a chance to save this world?" Yan Xiaoxiao had naturally also heard Gu Nan’s conversation with Zuo Zuo, so she asked slightly apprehensively.
She witnessed Gu Nan's power decline with her own eyes. ‘Perhaps the Teacher from a few minutes ago might be able to do it, but now…’
"Of course." Gu Nan answered bluntly, "Of course… I can't do it."
Yan Xiaoxiao's mouth twitched slightly. If the one in front of her wasn’t the teacher she respected the most, she really wanted to punch him in the face right now. After all, the sky was still raining down meteors.
"It depends on her." But Gu Nan wasn’t joking. He pointed seriously to one side, where Lan Si was standing.
Lan Si was immediately startled. She also never expected that the mission of saving the world would fall to her.
When Lan Si’s dumbfounded expression fell into Yan Xiaoxiao's eyes, she even believed that Gu Nan was talking nonsense, but Gu Nan spoke before she could ask again.
"You've been fusing with the Godhead ever since you were Tier 3. Now that you’ve broken through Tier 4, the Godhead will draw closer to you of its own accord, and your divinity will begin to be generated," Gu Nan spoke frankly with assurance.
It wasn’t uncommon for people to inherit Godheads in the game. There weren’t many cases where players could intervene, but there were too many instances of native NPCs accidentally acquiring Godheads.
So Gu Nan was quite familiar with the growth and development of people who became gods this way.
They were still human at Tier 3, but at Tier 4, they would begin their transformation into gods. The first wisp of divinity would be born inside the Godhead, truly producing an ability that belonged to the race called “gods.”
The reason Lan Si could suppress Baili Tuo so easily was also related to the Godhead. Otherwise, it was impossible for a newly-advanced Tier 4 like her to do such a thing.
"So, so then?" But Lan Si didn’t understand what Gu Nan was saying. Her expression still looked dazed.
"Tier 4 means you can mend the sky!" Gu Nan looked frustrated at how slowly Lan Si was catching on. "Back then, Rolensia also mended the sky before she became a god. Don’t tell me you don’t even know about that?"
"Ah? Mend what?"
"Oh, it should be called repairing the Stone of the World in your world."
Lan Si finally understood what he meant after Gu Nan used language from the game.
In the World of Gods, people believed that everything in the world evolved from the Stone of the World, which was also the world’s core.
The world outlook in the game was naturally the same. Rolensia, the God of Luxuriant Blossoms that Lan Si formerly worshiped, once participated in the work of repairing the Stone of the World when she was in the half-god realm.
Of course players wouldn’t adopt such a lengthy phrase like "repairing the Stone of the World." Instead, they used a very visual "mend the sky" to describe it, and Gu Nan also blurted that out without thinking.
Lan Si grew up in the Kingdom of Luxuriant Blossoms, so of course she was familiar with the past achievements of her Mother Goddess.
It’s just that although she’d heard about this back then, she wasn’t familiar with the process at all!
"It's very simple." Now, it was time for an old hand like Gu Nan to give directions. "The divine power of water naturally contains the law of creation. If you use your divine power to repair the cracks in this world, the kindling may be born again."
The kindling was also a unique saying from the game, which generally referred to an unlit divine fire—that is, the natural world’s origin here.
Lan Si understood this time. As long as she kept repairing this world, the origin that Gu Nan shattered might still reappear again.
This process sounded very simple. In reality, the difficulty lay in the fact that other people didn’t even have the ability to repair the world at all. Only Lan Si's divine power of water could do it.
Yan Xiaoxiao only had a half-baked understanding, but she was the most anxious and impatient one here, so she immediately urged, "Won’t you try it?"
"I’ll try."
……
Above the endless void, inside the palace that seemed to be eternally located in the starry sky, two figures were calmly confronting each other.
One was Zuo Zuo, who was only as tall as a child. Half of his body was a boy and the other half was a girl. The other person was a woman covered in red makeup.
If Gu Nan was here, he would’ve recognized her. This was the woman who told him Ying Ge’s whereabouts and asked him to protect her.
She called herself "Red."
At the moment, Red quietly sat on the throne, while Zuo Zuo stood in front of her motionlessly.
As if something had drifted into the silent palace, Zuo Zuo slowly opened his eyes. "A child heard that I actually have an older sister. Perhaps this is good news?"
"Belated good news," Red answered leisurely without even bothering to lift her eyelids.
Zuo Zuo glared at her coldly, and the ferocious girl's face on his left side was becoming more and more gloomy and twisted.
He had never underestimated his opponent of ten thousand years ago. After all, she was the one who pushed him into the abyss with a gentle push at his proudest and most complacent moment.
Only then did she obtain this Realm Level world as easily as taking a pie.
In Immortal Demon World, she was the one who took away one of the twins he arranged ahead of time, so that he wouldn’t be able to acquire a complete world origin, and by the time he wanted to settle for an incomplete one, he couldn’t even get that.
And now, his older sister who should’ve died ten thousand years ago was still alive…
The coldness in his left eye became more pronounced, and he even started wondering whether the little fellow containing a trace of Immortal Demon World’s aura that he accidentally met was also this woman’s arrangement.
‘Did she set up all the pieces, just waiting for me to take the bait?’
"Is that little fellow your underling too?"
"No." On a rare occasion, Red opened her eyes with a strange smile. "That is a porcupine. At first, you feel that his spikes sting a little when touched, but by the time you realize his threat, it’s too late."

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Raising Livestock
chapters.content:
Gu Nan didn’t yet know that a certain existence he met only a few times had already labeled him as a "porcupine."
Of course, even if he knew, he probably wouldn't care much either, because he was extremely eager to be a porcupine so that nobody would dare to scheme him.
But at the same time, Gu Nan also wanted to scheme others—simply put, only he was allowed to bully others, but others weren’t allowed to bully him. Let alone bullying, even hindering his progress wasn’t allowed.
As time went by, Gu Nan temporarily set aside the matters in Star Realm. He concentrated on staying in Immortal Demon World and guiding Lan Si on how to "mend the sky."
