Lan Si’s breakthrough to Tier 4 still brought some benefits to Gu Nan.
She didn’t only gain the ability to “mend the sky” after reaching Tier 4, but she also fused with the Godhead, bringing Gu Nan another sharp increase in Evil Value.
1,960—this was Gu Nan's current Evil Value.
Lan Si’s breakthrough gave him a little over two hundred Evil Value. In total, the Evil Value contributed by this Godhead had reached nearly a thousand. This Godhead could be regarded as having successfully completed its mission.
And Lan Si was currently trying hard to fulfill her mission.
As Gu Nan's half an apostle, she naturally had to devote her energy to the Divine Kingdom. Originally, when she was in secluded cultivation, all the tedious affairs in the Divine Kingdom were given to Yan Xiaoxiao. Now it was her turn to make up for it.
Little by little, the work of repairing Immortal Demon World progressed forth. With Gu Nan's precise command and the miraculous effect of the divine power of water, they actually did manage to persevere.
The cracks in the sky were mended one by one, and the fragmented space was also healing. Yan Xiaoxiao had long since left to organize the people and rebuild their homes.
Regrettably, just as Yan Xiaoxiao had anticipated, over half of Immortal Demon World’s residents died or suffered injuries in this natural disaster. Less than 10% of the population survived perfectly intact.
"This is nothing." Gu Nan very calmly motioned with his hand. "Pair men and women together and force births. Humans have a one-year maternity cycle, and their growth cycle is only fifteen to twenty years. We can afford the wait."
Time flowed ten times faster in Immortal Demon World than in the outside world. Of course they could afford the wait.
However, the "force births" Gu Nan mentioned was shocking enough.
Even Yan Xiaoxiao, who’d known Gu Nan's strategy for a long time, couldn't help but feel horror at this time—no ruler would treat his people like this.
This wasn’t governance; this was "raising livestock."
Gu Nan was raising people like how one would raise livestock. When he needed more population, he would choose the means of "forced coupling," regardless of each individual’s personal wishes.
Yan Xiaoxiao fell silent. She seemed to still be digesting the intent behind Gu Nan's words, but Gu Nan didn’t care at all.
He really did have nothing to say. All the players in the game did this. In fact, after their Divine Kingdoms stabilized, players would even limit the population’s lifespan. Ordinary people who exceeded a certain age would be directly executed.
If the resources supplied to the aging population were instead used to raise people at the prime of their lives, higher energy gains could be obtained.
"Science and technology, cultivation methods, and basic resources can all be provided by us." Gu Nan said thus, "The people just need to cultivate."
"Cultivation will be their only goal in life. It will bring them a longer lifespan, more resources, and the power to dominate other people."
"People of low ranks will be dominated in exchange for resources to achieve a higher rank—this will be the basic law of the Divine Kingdom."
Gu Nan described the world he envisioned in the simplest language possible. That would be an efficient world where the entire population pursued cultivation.
Nobody would enjoy the pleasures of life, and nobody would have time to relax. Vanity, ambition, and the love and hate between people will all become their motivation to forge ahead.
"Why… make such a world?" Yan Xiaoxiao asked blankly. She really couldn't figure it out. What was the point of such a monotonous and boring world?
"I need it," Gu Nan answered confidently.
His Divine Kingdom’s overall strength determined the extent of his future strength. This reason was more than sufficient.
Because Gu Nan had a need for it, he needed to take control of a world, raise all the people inside like livestock, and even try every means possible to brainwash them so that their only goal in life was to cultivate to a higher realm.
Yan Xiaoxiao wasn’t a modern person who had accepted the concept of "everyone is equal," but she still felt somewhat uncomfortable with this plan.
Seeing her hesitation, Gu Nan simply turned to Lan Si and said, "When the Divine Kingdom’s repair work is finished, you can also participate in raising the people."
Gu Nan didn't tell Lan Si to directly take over that work—her management ability wasn’t good enough to take charge of such a project yet.
However, as long as Lan Si participated, Yan Xiaoxiao would be forced to make up her mind. In all likelihood, she probably didn’t intend to turn against Gu Nan yet.
Compared with Yan Xiaoxiao's dilemma, Lan Si was much more direct and simply responded with, "Okay."
……
When Gu Nan left Immortal Demon World, more than a month had passed outside. In other words, he’d spent an entire year in Immortal Demon World.
This couldn’t be helped. A destroyed world’s origin was no laughing matter. If Gu Nan didn’t supervise the process, even Lan Si and Yan Xiaoxiao might be in danger.
In passing, Gu Nan went to Star Realm for a stroll. The current Star Realm was more chaotic than before. The flames of war had already begun to ignite in the various regions.
This was obviously Zuo Zuo’s hand. He was trying to weaken Red’s power through these methods.
Like the gods Gu Nan knew, Star Rulers also had to strengthen the laws they could control by having the residents of their astral world contribute power.
Of course it wasn’t impossible to rely entirely on oneself, but it was hard for one person’s power to compare with the entire world’s power.
Wu Gui had already disappeared without a trace, but Gu Nan didn't have time to look for her. In any case, now that she could no longer find Immortal Demon World’s coordinates, which side she supported had nothing to do with Gu Nan.
After a moment’s consideration, Gu Nan's figure quickly disappeared again, traveling through space. When he reappeared, he was already inside his own residence in Zi Luo Heaven.
It had to be said that Gu Nan was becoming more and more skilled at the operation of "tearing open the void." He could even control his precise landing point, and the spatial deviation was less than one meter.
"Continue to earn origin crystals and rush to 2,500 Evil Value as soon as possible to advance to Tier 5." Gu Nan didn't need to think much and soon defined his next goal.
He had a hunch that using origin crystals to exchange for active world origins to increase Evil Value might become ineffective after Tier 5.
There was no need for others to explain this time. Gu Nan himself knew the principle behind this.
Other Star Rulers could absorb world origins to consolidate their own powers and astral worlds, but Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was different. In the game, the best advancement method after Tier 5 had always remained unchanged—that is, slaying gods.
"Finding the World of Gods also needs to be put on the agenda."
Gu Nan knew better than anyone else that he would eventually have to visit the World of Gods. Only the gods there were his best prey!
It didn't take long for Gu Nan to return to Zi Luo Heaven, but suddenly a roar traveled over from outside his residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: The Price for Helping
chapters.content:
Zi Luo Heaven was open to the public, but at the same time, it was also a society with a strict hierarchy.
So almost everyone who frequented the area near Gu Nan's residence were in this cultivation realm, and there were also very few conflicts normally. He didn’t expect to encounter such a thing as soon as he returned.
"Master…" The maid ran over nervously and quickly reported, "There seems to be several Lords searching o-outside…"
Gu Nan frowned slightly, waved for the maid to leave, and walked outside himself.
Sure enough, as the maid said, a small team was carefully searching outside. Although they tried to be discreet due to having apprehensions about the identities of the residents here, in the end, they still made a lot of noise.
And that loud sound from before didn’t sound like it was caused by a search at all.
"What happened?" Gu Nan asked Roman next to him.
This neighbor of Gu Nan’s wasn’t like him. Roman had settled in Zi Luo Heaven all year round, and he spent most of his time at home doing indecent things. At this time, of course, he was also disturbed.
From Roman’s somewhat ugly expression, he’d obviously been interrupted when he was in the middle of something.
"They’re from the Seven Stars League." Roman explained with a heavy voice, "They claim they’re looking for a woman who stole something, but who knows if that’s true or not…"
Gu Nan had stayed in Zi Luo Heaven for quite a while now, so he naturally knew what the Seven Stars League was.
Although Astral Gate was open to the entire public and recruited people from all planes, that didn’t mean their internal structure was lacking in cohesion like scattered sand.
In fact, inside Astral Gate, there was also a distinction between core members and outer members. Only the truly loyal members could join Astral Gate’s core organizations, and those like Gu Nan could only stay on the outer edges forever.
There were many internal organizations in Astral Gate, numbering over a hundred in total. The Seven Stars League was one of them, and it had an impressive reputation for its fighting prowess.
Gu Nan couldn't help chuckling when he heard Roman’s words.
Seven Stars League hadn’t gotten so bored that it would run to the Void Cutter cultivators’ residential area and rummage through it for no reason. In all likelihood, Roman’s happy time had been interrupted, and his heart was filled with anger.
At this moment, Seven Stars League’s team members also saw Gu Nan, and soon someone came up to ask him if he’d seen a woman.
The attitude of those in the Seven Stars League was very respectful and professional. Not only did they take out detailed information on the person they were looking for, but they also had images and photos.
Gu Nan glanced at this woman with an average-looking face named "Fang Jing" and shook his head.
He really didn’t recognize this person, but he was also a little baffled—even with such detailed information, this woman was still able to run away. ‘Is the Seven Stars League too useless, or is there something strange about this woman?’
Void Cutter cultivators appeared one after another, and the staff of Seven Stars League also went up to ask them, only to be disappointed. Nobody could provide valuable information.
It was only after they left that Roman sighed with emotion, "This woman is not simple! If someone wasn’t already helping her, then I must add her to my collection!"
This was the area where Void Cutter figures gathered. A woman who was able to hide her whereabouts here would certainly not be simple.
When he said this, Roman’s eyes were filled with light.
Roman was a very strange Void Cutter cultivator. He didn't grow up fighting battles to the death on a small plane. Instead, he was born in Zi Luo Heaven, so his personality wasn’t very bloodthirsty.
He was extremely obsessed with all kinds of women, but at the same time, he wasn’t a disloyal and fickle person, and he was sincere to every single woman around him.
Roman’s collection referred to keeping a woman by his side, then using his long lifespan to keep her company throughout her life, and finally making her a specimen to add to his permanent collection after she died from old age.
Gu Nan wasn’t interested in Roman’s special hobby, so he calmly went back to his house.
But not even Roman noticed that the instant Gu Nan closed his door, the power of shadows had completely surrounded the entire room.
A woman was standing in front of him.
Gu Nan might not have recognized this face before today, but he just saw an image of her face. Moreover, he was all too familiar with her energy signature.
Appearances could be changed and names could be faked, but the unique energy signature from one’s soul couldn’t be covered up.
Gu Nan once had direct contact with the other party’s soul, so this flimsy disguise couldn’t fool him.
"So it's you!" Gu Nan sealed off the surrounding area with the power of shadows while saying, "Last time you could find me in Star Realm, and this time you could find me again… What's your relationship with that uncle named Zi Dian?"
Gu Nan's two questions seemed entirely unrelated. The only connection seemed to be that they both asked about the most crucial matter.
The person who appeared before Gu Nan was precisely the Star Ruler Zi Yi, who had entered a personal dungeon with him and then forcibly cleared a phase with her overwhelming ability.
And when Gu Nan returned to Star Realm, Zi Yi once sent out a tendril of her soul to possess Duanmu Yin, trying to lead Gu Nan to the Duanmu family’s ancestral tomb.
Gu Nan had every reason to believe that her target was Zi Dian.
Zi Yi wasn’t surprised by Gu Nan's questions. Since she revealed herself, she was naturally prepared for these questions.
Zi Yi's appearance gradually reverted to her original state, and she selectively answered the latter question, "Zi Dian is my son."
"Aiya!" Gu Nan suddenly clapped his hands together. "I really didn't expect this answer. Looking at the two of you, I thought you were his daughter."
No matter how one looked at it, Zi Dian, who looked like a middle-aged uncle, seemed much more mature than Zi Yi, even in terms of personality.
Besides, the trope of the daughter saving her father seemed way more reliable!
In the face of Gu Nan's exaggerated antics, Zi Yi remained indifferent. "They know you’re in Zi Luo Heaven, so they had me find you."
"Their location might’ve already been exposed. Zuo Zuo’s people will find them soon. You can help—"
"Why should I help?" Gu Nan interrupted before she could finish.
Zi Yi was dazed. It seemed that she didn't expect Gu Nan's answer to be so blunt and direct. "That one in Star Realm asked you to protect the current Blood Ancestor, and you agreed."
"Can't I renege on the agreement?" Gu Nan asked with an odd expression.
Players never cared about what they promised. If NPCs wanted them to accept a mission, then they could only give the appropriate reward.
Of course, at the end of the day, it was because Ying Ge’s ability to enter the Myriad Heavens Starry Road was now useless to Gu Nan—he could advance to Tier 5 through origin crystals alone, and the efficiency wasn’t low either.
Furthermore, once he entered Tier 5, he’d be able to enter the Inner World himself. What would he still need Ying Ge for?
To abandon anything useless—players consistently treated any equipment, pets, and NPCs with such an attitude.
This was the first time Zi Yi saw someone who spoke so honorably about reneging. She took a deep breath and stared at Gu Nan. "Will it benefit you in any way for Zuo Zuo to take away Star Realm?"
"It won’t hurt either." Gu Nan looked indifferent. Anyhow, Immortal Demon World’s origin had already been shattered, and its coordinates had also jumped to who-knows-where. Zuo Zuo wouldn’t be able to make trouble for him.
Faced with such an unresponsive fellow, Zi Yi was completely helpless, and her face gradually showed an angry look. "Then what do you want to be willing to help?!”
"Very simple!" Gu Nan answered, as if this was proper and to be expected as a matter of course, "Just give me money. I need… 100,000 units of origin crystals."
Zi Yi’s eyes widened, and then, as if afraid Gu Nan would renege on this too, quickly agreed, "Deal!"

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Dream World
chapters.content:
A hundred thousand origin crystals—this was what Gu Nan needed at present.
The exchange ratio of origin crystals for active world origins was 1:1, so he was only limited by the number of origin crystals and nothing else. However, with the increase of Gu Nan's Evil Value, the benefits brought by active world origins were gradually weakening.
Based on Gu Nan's estimate, the last 500 or so Evil Value he needed to advance to Tier 5 roughly translated to about 100,000 origin crystals.
But after reaching Tier 5, Gu Nan suspected that active world origins would no longer have any effect on raising his Evil Value—from the Evil God Temple’s stingy temperament, it was normal that he’d need to change the method used to acquire Evil Value at every new level.
Now that Gu Nan looked back, everything was particularly clear.
Tier 1 was normal dungeons, Tier 2 was reincarnation, Tier 3 was Evil Events and personal dungeons, and Tier 4 was active world origins. Although there were some interruptions, the crux of the matter really was like this.
If not for the influence of a Godhead during this period, Gu Nan might’ve spent even more time pursuing the aforementioned activities and realized this pattern earlier.
But it didn’t matter now. The current Gu Nan was only 100,000 origin crystals away from Tier 5.
So Gu Nan's offer to Zi Yi was exactly 100,000 origin crystals; any more would be useless. He wouldn’t be able to spend it.
As for accepting Zi Yi's "employment" to help save Ying Ge and Zi Dian, Gu Nan had no psychological resistance—in any case, both Zi Yi’s mission and Astral Gate’s missions were missions, and Zi Yi's mission wasn’t anymore troublesome than Astral Gate's!
"Then it's settled." Gu Nan said thus to Zi Yi, "Can you pay everything upfront first?"
"In your dreams!"
……
In a remote little world, Gu Nan and Zi Yi appeared in a loft.
"You really won’t consider paying upfront?" Gu Nan was still working tirelessly to persuade her, "If you pay upfront, my strength will increase, and the rescue will be more assured!"
Zi Yi remained expressionless as she calmly walked out of the room, leaving a message, "I'm going to prepare the materials. We leave in three days."
As for Gu Nan's "suggestion" of paying upfront, Zi Yi completely ignored it.
"What a pity." Gu Nan shook his head.
Paying upfront would greatly improve Gu Nan's strength—this was true; after Gu Nan's strength improved, the chances of a rescue would also improve greatly—this was also true.
It’s just that Gu Nan’s claim that he would still help after his strength improved and after Zi Yi paid in advance was, of course, nothing more than a casual remark.
With players’ moral integrity levels, it was all too normal for them to take the money and not do the mission. And after taking the money, some even hacked the NPC to death to loot equipment.
However, Gu Nan wasn’t being serious either, because he knew that it was basically impossible for Zi Yi to pay in advance.
The reason was very simple: both sides were the best choice right now; it wasn’t a purely unilateral market.
Out of certain considerations, Zi Yi could only ask Gu Nan for help right now. And as for Gu Nan, it would be extremely difficult to find another mission that rewarded 100,000 origin crystals besides Zi Yi’s.
The purchasing power of origin crystals was very strong, especially for Void Cutter cultivators. Under normal circumstances, a Void Cutter would at most spend hundreds of origin crystals a year.
Although Gu Nan could eat active world origins like candy, other Void Cutter experts couldn’t do the same. It took them years to learn from each observation.
At the end of the day, Zi Yi was still a Star Ruler existence, which was why she could take out 100,000 origin crystals at once. She had quite the deep pockets.
After Zi Yi left, Gu Nan also settled down and began to prepare for this mission—analyzing and assessing each mission in advance had been Gu Nan's habit for many years.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian’s situation really wasn’t good.
Ever since Zuo Zuo learned of Ying Ge’s existence, he’d always been purposefully searching for them, but he hadn’t made much progress.
After all, Zuo Zuo only just found out about Ying Ge, while Ying Ge was hiding in the dark and had made preparations for such a situation well in advance, so it was even more impossible for her to reveal any traces.
But Zuo Zuo was still someone capable of fighting with Red over Star Realm. He had too many methods. Even if he couldn’t find Ying Ge’s whereabouts for the time being, he could nevertheless still achieve his goal.
He didn’t need to find Ying Ge; he just needed Ying Ge to die.
Thus, Ying Ge and Zi Dian were currently trapped—trapped in dreamland.
"Dream World…" Gu Nan flipped through the document in his hands, but his brow wrinkled slightly, because this small plane was too special.
Dream World was a small world located on the edge of the Myriad Heavens Universe. Like all small worlds on the fringe, it was at the junction of the Outer World and the Inner World.
But what was special about Dream World was that it exhibited the characteristics of the Inner World. It was still a normal world that couldn’t be reset, yet it held the characteristics of the Inner World itself.
Yes, it was just a "World" Level plane, but it had the characteristics of the Inner World—that is, the "hub” of the world.
The balls of light in the Inner World were the cores and inner manifestations of all the countless planes in the Myriad Heavens Universe, which was why the Inner World was called the “hub” of the world, and the same was true of Dream World.
Here, one could find manifestations of the dreams of countless living beings in countless worlds.
To put it simply, all living beings gathered on this plane by means of “dreaming.”
Gu Nan didn't particularly understand the principle behind this, but it didn't hinder his current mission—find Ying Ge and Zi Dian inside Dream World and kill them.
As long as he killed the living beings trapped in Dream World, he would be able to destroy their dreams, allowing them to escape. This was the simplest way.
But the more troublesome thing was that when people dreamed, their minds wouldn’t necessarily be lucid, and most people might even completely lose their sense of judgment, only acting according to their instincts.
What was instinct? “If you want to kill me, then I'll kill you”—that was instinct.
But if you tried to explain to them just then: “You’re actually dreaming, and I’m killing you to save you…” That would sound like utter nonsense. Nobody would believe it.
"Communication is impossible. We can only kill them." After combing through the mission information, Gu Nan quickly determined his victory condition.
And what was the condition for defeat?
Awkwardly enough, the condition for defeat was also Ying Ge and Zi Dian being killed.
Living creatures trapped in Dream World could be killed via special methods that would simultaneously erase their consciousness and cause their true bodies to enter a state of brain death.
To put it simply, what entered Dream World was a sliver of a living being’s soul. Since it was the soul, there was certainly a way to trace it back to its origin and destroy the person’s true body.
What Gu Nan and Zi Yi had to do was find and kill Ying Ge and Zi Dian before they could be killed by Zuo Zuo’s people.
"This really is hard…" Gu Nan shook his head helplessly. Such a victory and defeat condition meant that not only was this mission full of difficult battles, but luck was also involved.
The luck component meant there was a time limit. Gu Nan and Zi Yi must race against time to find Ying Ge and Zi Dian.
If they were unlucky, maybe Ying Ge would’ve already died at the hands of Zuo Zuo’s underlings before Gu Nan and Zi Yi even entered Dream World.
Sure enough, it wasn’t easy to earn 100,000 origin crystals.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: Nightmare
chapters.content:
Of course 100,000 origin crystals weren’t easy to earn. Even with Gu Nan's monstrous mission completion speed, this was still equivalent to over half a year's worth of effort. But now he wanted to complete all this in one mission, so it would certainly be difficult.
Three days flew by, and Zi Yi returned to the loft, informing Gu Nan that they could begin.
They were now located in a small plane near Dream World, which could be regarded as the foothold to enter Dream World—Dream World was a plane that not even Void Cutter existences could enter directly.
Zi Yi had started preparations to enter Dream World as soon as she received the news, but after she contacted Gu Nan, it still took three more days to open the passageway.
One could imagine how difficult it was to enter Dream World with one’s true body.
After all, one’s true body would allow their consciousness to stay awake, which was a great advantage in Dream World. Fortunately, Zuo Zuo’s people were also facing the same problem, so everyone was on the same starting line.
"Be careful of Dream World’s nightmares," when entering Dream World, Zi Yi specially told Gu Nan.
"I know." Gu Nan nodded. He wasn’t an arrogant fellow who looked down on everything. On the contrary, before every mission, he would conduct a detailed analysis of the mission background, so naturally he wouldn’t miss information as important as this.
Nightmares were the only native creatures of Dream World, and they were also a sort of strange existence halfway between illusion and reality.
Because of the special nature of Dream World, this plane was often used to assassinate some powerhouses who were otherwise hard to kill. This was also the start of dream masters.
The reason why these dream masters could accomplish such a feat was due to the existence of these "nightmares."
The entire process was also very simple: find a way to make the enemy dream, wait for the enemy’s soul to appear in Dream World, and then lure the "nightmare" over to eat it.
People eaten by "nightmares" would also die immediately, and their souls would be completely annihilated.
From this perspective, dreaming was a very dangerous thing. Fortunately, "nightmares" wouldn’t take the initiative to attack dreamers, not unless it was guided by a dream master, or… outsiders entered Dream World.
"Nightmares’ attacks mainly target people with distracting thoughts." Zi Yi obviously knew more about this topic than Gu Nan. "The two of them who are dreaming don't have to worry too much about this, but we, on the other hand, are in a more dangerous situation."
Dreamers act on instinct, so of course they wouldn’t have many distracting thoughts.
"Let's go. We can spread out a little to increase the chances of success," since Gu Nan seemed to be prepared in advance, Zi Yi also didn't say much and bluntly suggested.
Dream World was very special. This entire plane was an empty space, but its interior was split into large and small pieces, some of which even overlapped.
Merely trying to find their way inside Dream World was enough to give many people headaches.
In this situation, the only way to find Ying Ge and Zi Dian was to search through each of these areas piece by piece. There was no better way.
The first piece of space was a relatively small area. With the two’s speed, they finished searching it in a short period of time.
"Not here."
"I don't see them in my section either."
"Let's move to the next area." Zi Yi also wasn’t too concerned. Dream World had at least a few hundred separate areas. They would be way too lucky to run into Ying Ge and Zi Dian in the first area.
"Wait." Gu Nan didn't leave immediately and instead casually sent an attack at a certain corner.
Soon, a muffled roar came, pouncing at Gu Nan and Zi Dian. This kind of roar that sounded halfway between illusion and reality made Zi Yi’s expression instantly change.
Nightmare!
Gu Nan, this guy, actually discovered the nightmare of this area and deliberately woke it up!
Zi Yi didn't understand what Gu Nan was doing at all, but of course that didn't affect her action—running for her life. Nightmares were practically immortal in Dream World and would soon come back to life if killed, so fighting them was meaningless.
Fortunately, there was only one nightmare in every area of Dream World, and nightmares couldn’t travel to different areas. After the two quickly left the area, that nightmare could only roar angrily.
"What the hell are you doing?!” Zi Yi asked angrily. She didn't understand why Gu Nan would do such an extra thing. Was it for fun?
"To make trouble for Zuo Zuo’s people, of course!" Gu Nan answered simply, not feeling like he was in the wrong at all.
Zi Yi paused slightly, then understood Gu Nan’s meaning a little. Nightmares were usually in a deep slumber, so the two intruders had always moved carefully, for fear of startling awake the nightmare.
Once the nightmare woke up, it was hard for it to fall asleep again. Often, it was necessary for the nightmare to "feast" in its own area.
The method dream masters employed to kill the enemy was also finding a way to wake up the nightmare in the area where the enemy's soul was located, then having the nightmare eat the enemy.
"Will Zuo Zuo’s people… really just happen to be behind us?"
"Who can say?" Gu Nan shrugged. "But unless they take the exact same path as us and are always in front of us, they’ll eventually come across areas we’ve already been to."
"As long as a portion of the nightmares can hinder their actions, it’ll be our win." Gu Nan chuckled. "An effort as slight as lifting one’s finger, is every citizen’s responsibility."
Zi Yi, of course, didn't understand the second half of Gu Nan's last sentence, but she still understood his meaning.
In any case, the two of them wouldn’t lose out by waking up nightmares, so it really was as easy as lifting a finger.
On the other hand, Ying Ge and Zi Dian wouldn’t travel to different areas and would always remain in the same area, so the only other people to search the areas one by one were Zuo Zuo’s subordinates. This truly was a good deal for them.
Of course, this would inevitably lead to the death of a large number of innocent people, but was Gu Nan someone who cared about this?
Zi Yi understood Gu Nan's meaning, so whenever they searched an area, the two would deliberately wake up the nightmare right before leaving.
With the two’s abilities and the preparations they made in advance, there wasn’t much danger—right until they entered a new area.
This was also a small area, but unlike before, there were lots of distinct village houses located here.
The space inside Dream World should usually be chaotic, indistinct, and muddled. There was only one reason why tangible objects would appear here—the nightmare here was awake!
"Look out!" Zi Yi warned immediately, and her figure suddenly disappeared.
Gu Nan frowned at the spot where Zi Yi disappeared from. This wasn’t any kind of movement technique he recognized. Rather, it seemed that the space itself had been moved elsewhere.
"A nightmare that’s already awake?" Gu Nan’s power of shadows reverberated, and the heart in his chest thumped slightly.
After such a long recuperation, the cooldown of Deity’s Descent was already over, but Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry to use it.
Under Gu Nan's wary gaze, a nightmare arrived.
Gu Nan only felt that the picture before him changed, and he was already in another scene.
The nightmare’s attack extracted the scenes buried in the deepest part of people's hearts, making people sink into them for eternity. If they stayed in the illusion for too long, then they would naturally be trapped inside forever.
The illusion could be one's own, or it could be someone else's. The scene Gu Nan currently experienced was obviously someone else's memory.
He appeared on a snow-capped, misty mountain top, and in front of him was a person he didn't expect.
Red.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Gu Nans Weakness
chapters.content:
Inside Dream World, three figures entered a certain area near Gu Nan and Zi Dian, and the scene suddenly became chaotic.
“Another nightmare that’s awake, this is already the sixth!" One of the men exclaimed angrily.
They were precisely the three dream masters who received Zuo Zuo’s order to find Ying Ge. But they encountered a series of troubles not long after they started their search.
Dream masters were a very special profession. They weren’t very strong; of the three, only one was at Void Cutter Realm. But they were a group of people who understood dreams the best.
In a special place like Dream World, they weren’t even afraid of those Void Cutter cultivators who were normally extremely powerful, because this was their home field.
"Those two must’ve done this!" Another man beside him spoke in a heavy voice. His face looked somewhat similar to the previous man. Perhaps they were brothers.
“They woke up the nightmare before they left the area," an old voice rang in the two’s ears. It was their party’s third member who spoke.
This was a white-haired old lady whose face was full of wrinkles, but she looked full of spirit.
This was a Void Cutter dream master known as "Grandma Tu.” She and the Zhao brothers beside her were constantly making seals to pacify the restless nightmare.
Dream masters really did have many methods to deal with nightmares, so they could handle nightmares easier than amateurs could.
After finally pacifying the nightmare with much difficulty, the eldest of the Zhao brothers went up to Grandma Tu and suggested, "Grandma, it won’t do if things continue like this. Should we create some trouble for those two first?"
Dream masters were truly powerful inside Dream World. Even the eldest Zhao brother, a mere Prodigious cultivator, could sense Gu Nan and Zi Yi’s existence.
Grandma Tu's face was expressionless. Her mouth curled up slightly as she replied, "They are already in trouble."
……
Standing in front of Gu Nan was indeed Red.
But to be precise, this person wasn’t the Red that Gu Nan met before. Rather, this was a much younger Red.
Her childlike face and petite figure all indicated her true age—even powerful Star Rulers seldom maintained a young child’s appearance.
"Are you leaving?" The young Red coldly eyed Gu Nan as she asked in a low voice.
Red seemed to recognize Gu Nan, but Gu Nan knew that the one Red recognized wasn’t himself, but the original owner of this illusion.
In other words, Gu Nan took that person’s place here.
‘Who is it?’
Ying Ge, Zi Dian, and even Zi Yi were possible. It might also be the memories of someone who visited Dream World before and just happened to have Red in their memories.
An inexplicable mix of emotions welled up in Gu Nan's heart. Guilt, pity, remorse… This was also the emotions of the illusion’s original owner. Gu Nan, who’d learned about Dream World beforehand, naturally wouldn’t be confused by this.
Dreams were places very suitable for killing people without leaving any trace, so they’d been studied a lot. The methods to deal with nightmares’ illusions had long been summarized.
Ultimately, it boiled down to a single word—disbelief.
As long as one’s will was firm enough to not be fooled by the illusions, they would be able to quickly escape.
But memories were gradually gushing out— ‘About this place, about myself, and about the girl in front of me… Red, so she really was called Red even ten thousand years ago?’
The scene before Gu Nan’s eyes seemed to blur for an instant, then immediately became clear again.
The next second, Gu Nan had already swung his fist without hesitation, hitting child Red’s delicate little face.
In this illusion, the power of shadows, the law nullification attribute, equipment, and skills were all sealed, but at least Gu Nan still had his own body, and he could still fight with his fists.
Young Red seemed to have never expected the other party to attack, and attack her on top of that. She looked at Gu Nan with an incomparably shocked and despairing gaze.
The inexplicable sense of guilt deepened, almost crushing Gu Nan until he couldn’t breathe, as if attacking Red was some kind of reprehensible crime.
However, this artificially-imposed sense of guilt didn’t affect Gu Nan's actions at all. His eyes remained indifferent and calm, and his fist didn’t tremble at all.
Crack!
Another punch landed, and the poor child's skull broke instantly. Her entire body was sent flying by Gu Nan’s punch and crashed heavily into the snow.
There was blood on her face, while white snowflakes fell on her cheeks. The mixture of white and red gave the picture a strange sort of beauty.
"Wh—" Red, who fell to the ground, was still staring at Gu Nan. Her voice was full of incomprehension, but soon came to an abrupt end.
Because Gu Nan had already slammed his foot down on her neck, snapping it.
Whose illusion this was, and what relationship that person had with Red—Gu Nan didn’t care about these at all.
Gu Nan wasn’t a curious child, nor did he aspire to be a famous detective. He just wanted to finish his mission and get paid.
"You… You actually killed her?!” A voice came from beside Gu Nan.
Gu turned to look. It was Zi Yi, and behind her was a group of unfamiliar people.
Zi Yi’s attire was somewhat different from today's Zi Yi, but her face wasn’t much different. Perhaps it was because ZI Yi froze her appearance ever since she reached a certain realm.
While Zi Yi was roaring at Gu Nan, Gu Nan had this thought in his heart: ‘If the role I’m playing isn’t Zi Yi, then who is it?’
This thought only lingered for an instant before Gu Nan's body moved again. Another punch!
His emotions became increasingly intense. Gu Nan even had a feeling that his body was going to explode. The countless emotions directly projected into his mind were enough to make people’s consciousness hazy.
But Gu Nan didn’t feel dazed. He was as awake as ever.
The punch landed squarely on Zi Yi's face. Gu Nan took her all the way to the middle of the group, then swung his fist relentlessly around him.
……
On the other side, it was far easier for the three dream masters to find Ying Ge and Zi Dian.
The three didn’t need to manually search around at all. They could search the entire area directly through a secret technique, which was even more efficient than searching by themselves.
"Zi Yi, a Star Ruler born in Zi Luo Heaven. She’s very experienced, but she has never found a suitable astral world," Grandma Tu took advantage of this opportunity to tell the Zhao brothers about their opponents.
"She’s actually a Star Ruler?" The second Zhao brother muttered in a low voice. After all, the two brothers were merely Prodigious Realm cultivators. Faced with an enemy two realms above them, they weren’t too confident.
In theory, a Star Ruler without an astral world of their own was essentially just a Void Cutter cultivator with more complete laws, but… that was still a Star Ruler!
If you insisted on dividing people based on cultivation realms, then the two powerhouses currently confronting each other in Star Realm were also just Star Rulers. It's just that their astral worlds were strong enough for them to crush most other people.
Grandma Tu naturally understood the second Zhao brother’s thoughts. She added, "That’s why we definitely can’t target this person to break through their defense."
"Oh? Isn’t the other one also difficult to deal with?" The older Zhao brother asked.
Through Dream World, they already knew the enemy’s identity. The name Gu Nan was well known among Lord Zuo Zuo's subordinates.
Many people were puzzled or even panicked by the failure of Gu Nian and Shang Rong’s operation.
Even Lord Shang Rong, one of the “Five Steles,” died at Gu Nan’s hands. Apart from Lord Zuo Zuo personally making a move, can anyone else defeat him?
But Grandma Tu revealed a mysterious smile. "Gu Nan, he has a weakness."
"What weakness?" At this moment, the curiosity of the Zhao brothers was fully piqued.
"He’s young."

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Confrontation Within a Dream
chapters.content:
"He’s young."
Grandma Tu’s powerful and resonating words left the Zhao brothers somewhat confused. To already be so strong at a young age—wasn’t this a strength instead?
Although many young people were short-tempered and even impulsive, that one had no such problems at all, and his tactics and wisdom even surpassed many cunning old foxes.
"Gu Nan doesn't have the problems specific to young people, but in the end, he’s still young." Grandma Tu explained in a low voice, "Being young means that he can't possibly know what happened back in those years, so he’ll be curious."
"And in front of nightmares, curiosity is fatal."
……
Grandma Tu was absolutely right.
Zi Yi had already broken out of the nightmare’s attack and even drove away that nightmare, but the attack Gu Nan received continued.
The nightmare itself was like a huge bubble, and its attack was also very interesting. It would separate a portion of the bubbles on its body to trap the target in a bubble.
Dream World was indeed a very special place. Gu Nan, who was here in his true body, was nevertheless dragged into the nightmare’s bubble just like a defenseless soul would be.
Zi Yi, who’d broken out of her own bubble, could also see the illusion Gu Nan was currently experiencing through the fragmented scenes inside that bubble.
She recognized at a glance whose illusion it belonged to—Zuo Zuo!
To be precise, it was Zuo Zuo’s previous self. Back when Zuo Zuo was still a normal boy, during that winter, he experienced an unforgettable choice.
Zi Yi's thoughts also seemed to have returned to that winter. She personally witnessed Zuo Zuo defeat Red, then resolutely embark on a journey to find his older sister.
Then they never saw each other again, because the next time they met, Zuo Zuo had become that half-male half-female abomination.
Oh, back then, his name wasn’t Zuo Zuo. Even this name appeared later on.
Zuo Zuo, which meant there was no right
[1]
.
‘Gu Nan, can he bear the weight of Zuo Zuo's emotions? Faced with such a dilemma, can he maintain a clear conscience and ultimately break out of the illusion?’
Zi Yi was very worried about this… up until she saw what Gu Nan was doing in the scene projected onto the bubble.
A punch! Another punch!
Gu Nan had completely inherited Zuo Zuo's past body, a body without any power of laws and without any comprehension of laws. He only had his own fists!
Red’s neck was snapped, and Zi Yi was also beaten black and blue by him. Not even the ten-plus people who followed Zi Yi here could escape his fist.
Of course, in a situation where an overwhelming power gap didn’t exist between the two sides, it was somewhat difficult for Gu Nan to solo a dozen or so people, and he was currently being beaten by the group.
In the face of Red's death, the remaining ten-plus people were extremely furious. They poured all their anger into their fists and then subjected Gu Nan to a severe beating.
But Gu Nan didn't even pay attention to that.
Two of his front teeth had been knocked out, half of his ear had been torn off, and his left leg had a broken bone from being kicked. Even the simple motion of moving had to be done by his right leg jumping and hopping about, which looked particularly comical.
But Gu Nan’s expression didn't even change. He simply focused on hitting people—find a person, beat them to death, then move on to the next one.
Of course Zi Yi was the first to fall; she was Gu Nan's first target.
Then the second one, the third one…
And Zi Yi, who was outside the bubble, was completely flabbergasted. She couldn’t imagine Gu Nan's actions at this time, which was completely contrary to common sense!
When inside an illusion, breaking out of it wasn’t as simple as just chanting "these are all fake."
Even if it wasn’t one's own memories, all of the original owner’s memories and emotions would be poured directly into the target. There was no room for resistance at all.
……
"Grandma, you intend to make Gu Nan sink into Lord Zuo Zuo’s memories?" The second Zhao brother soon understood Grandma Tu’s plan and asked in amazement.
"No, it’s to have him sink into one of those memories." Grandma Tu laughed leisurely.
"Emotions are directly instilled, while memories are poured in heuristically." Grandma Tu clearly understood nightmares very well. "The nightmare’s attack is the highest attainment of us dream masters!"
After all, the Zhao brothers weren’t at Void Cutter Realm yet, so their understanding of nightmares—the specialty product of Dream World—still paled in comparison to Grandma Tu.
However, they both still nodded in agreement. If Grandma Tu’s words were true, then nightmares were indeed powerful.
For dream masters, how to make the target permanently sink into the illusory dream had always been their biggest concern.
Using memories from the target himself made it easy for the target to see through the trap because of flaws in the details, while there was a problem of "immersion" when using someone else’s memories.
How can they make the target believe that he truly is the person in the memory instead of merely being inside an illusion?
The general consensus was to use emotional agitation to trick the target into pondering the unfamiliar memory, and in the process of thinking, the memory belonging to the original owner would be implanted into the target bit by bit.
“The war between My Lord and that one in Star Realm is already famous throughout the Myriad Heavens Universe. Who isn’t curious about their past?"
Grandma Tu had a confident smile on her face. "Unless it's someone who already knows their past. But because of Gu Nan's youth, he certainly won’t know. This is his greatest weakness… Eh?"
Grandma Tu froze before she could finish speaking.
The Zhao brothers were still nodding along next to her, looking at their senior with great reverence. They were immediately frightened by this scene and believed that someone had launched a sneak attack on Grandma Tu.
This was Dream World. No matter how strange the event, it still wouldn’t be surprising.
"Grandma, are you okay?!” The older Zhao brother immediately rushed up and shook Grandma Tu's body hard. If the latter really was trapped in a dream, then this method would be effective in breaking her out in the early stages.
"I… I'm fine." Grandma Tu, with a head full of silver hair, only felt that her body was about to fall apart from the shaking, so she hurriedly answered with difficulty.
Only then did the Zhao brothers sigh in relief. They were about to ask her what had happened, but Grandma Tu spoke up on her own.
"Gu Nan… broke out." Grandma Tu’s voice contained some helplessness.
The Zhao brothers also stared blankly. For a while, they didn’t know what to say. It wasn’t a big deal for people to break out of nightmares’ illusions. After all, this was a profession with a lot of unpredictable variables.
However, Grandma Tu had been confidently analyzing Gu Nan's weakness just seconds ago, yet the other party broke out in the blink of an eye. How embarrassing was this?!
Grandma Tu's expressions kept changing for a while, and finally she said heavily, "I’m going to see how exactly he broke out of the illusion… Mm, it's also to prepare for our next attack."
Although it was just an excuse Grandma Tu casually found, it was still somewhat reasonable.
Dream masters could directly communicate with Dream World’s origin, which was how Grandma Tu could specially prepare this "luxurious banquet" for Gu Nan through the nightmare.
Now she wanted to communicate with Dream World again to obtain Gu Nan's actions inside the illusion. Naturally, it wasn’t difficult.
"I’ll substitute myself into that one's perspective. In this memory, the first person he met should be her…" Grandma Tu substituted herself into Red’s point of view in an attempt to watch Gu Nan's actions from beginning to end.
But she could only see the beginning, not the end.
Because what greeted her was a fist as big as a sandbag.
T/N:
[1] Zuo Zuo
: His name is “Left Left” basically
