chapters.title: Chapter 289: Found
chapters.content:
"The nightmare’s attack isn’t as scary as I thought…" Gu Nan soon broke away from the illusion while making an offhand remark doubting the illusion’s power.
In the information he obtained before, nightmares were very dangerous. Void Cutter cultivators who entered Dream World with their true bodies frequently died from nightmare attacks.
Zi Yi shot him a strange look while thinking, ‘If everyone did what you just did, then no illusion will have any effect.’
Indeed. If everyone went on a killing spree without another word like Gu Nan did, then this kind of illusion meant to befuddle and confuse the target really wouldn’t have any effect.
But why was he able to do it?
Zi Yi also didn’t understand. How could anyone be so resolute, so much so that he kept all of Zuo Zuo’s memories out of his mind? Was he really not curious at all?
That was a peak-level existence second only to the 13 Heavens. Zuo Zuo was an ultra-powerful Star Ruler who could ignore Red’s home field advantage and directly suppress Red even inside Star Realm!
It was such a powerful figure’s past, plus several people Gu Nan knew were also in that scene… Even if he was only a tiny bit curious, Zuo Zuo’s memories would flood his mind like a tidal wave.
At this moment, Zi Yi had already realized that the appearance of such an illusion probably wasn’t a coincidence. In all likelihood, someone deliberately designed this trap.
"This is the work of a dream master." Zi Yi said to Gu Nan, "Zuo Zuo rules over Nirvana Heaven, but I didn't think that he’d even have dream masters serving him…"
Gu Nan originally didn't know about special existences like dream masters, but he took the time to learn about them earlier because he was about to enter Dream World.
Only people born with the ability to use the law of dreams could become a dream master after special training.
A profession like this that had stringent requirements of both a person’s talent and training would naturally be scarce, so Zi Yi couldn’t find any dream masters to help her for the time being. She didn't expect Zuo Zuo to actually have dream masters among his subordinates.
"Nirvana Heaven?" Gu Nan, on the other hand, captured a different piece of information.
"You should’ve heard of the concept of the 36 Heavens and 72 Realms, right?"
"Mm."
After hearing Gu Nan's affirmative reply, Zi Yi sighed instead. "That was the saying back in those years. Now, there are only 29 Heaven Level planes left, and Zuo Zuo’s Nirvana Heaven is one of them."
The phrase “36 Heavens and 72 Realms” had now become nothing more than a general reference. The statuses of the astral worlds were ultimately determined by the power of the Star Ruler in charge of that world.
After ten thousand years, some Heaven Level planes were eliminated from the ranks, while other Realm Level planes ascended to Heaven Level, finally stabilizing at 29 Heavens.
Gu Nan listened to Zi Yi's explanation and nodded silently. He discovered that Zuo Zuo and Red’s identity contrast didn’t seem to be what he expected.
Based on the conventional pattern, Red was the ruler of Star Realm, while Zuo Zuo should undoubtedly be the villain lurking in the dark, trying to seize her base.
But in reality… Zuo Zuo was a Star Ruler whose rank was even higher than Red.
It wasn’t so much a conspiracy to snatch away Red's base as it was an invasion—a blatant invasion that didn’t bother to hide its intention.
"So that means you and Zuo Zuo have always known each other?" Gu Nan remembered that back when he first met them inside the personal dungeon, these two actually pretended they didn’t know each other.
"Of course," Zi Yi casually admitted. "It's no secret that Zuo Zuo is in Nirvana Heaven. We all thought he had forgotten about the past, but who knew…"
In the end, the war in Star Realm involved the feud and enmity from ten thousand years ago, but Gu Nan just waved a hand.
He had absolutely no interest in the background stories of these NPCs.
"Continue," Gu Nan said.
Zi Yi originally thought he wanted her to continue talking about the secrets from ten thousand years ago, but before she could speak, Gu Nan's figure had already dashed away.
Now that the nightmare had been driven away, they naturally had to continue searching.
"What a strange person…" Zi Yi shook her head, then also turned and ran to a different side, but she immediately paused again.
Two familiar figures were wandering around in that direction.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian!
"Found them!"
……
"They found them," Grandma Tu's voice rang out in another area at the same time. "Someone is attacking dream spirits. It must be them."
Dream spirit referred to the dreamer’s soul when inside Dream World. This was also a term unique to dream masters.
Dream masters had the ability to communicate with the will of Dream World, so Grandma Tu immediately sensed the abnormality.
"Then Grandma… Should we chase after them?" The second Zhao brother asked carefully from the side. Normally, the decision to chase the target wasn’t something they’d even have to think about, but the opponent this time really was a little strange.
He didn't forget that when Grandma Tu tried to check Gu Nan’s illusion, she almost fell flat on her butt.
Sure enough, Grandma Tu didn't make an immediate decision, but after hesitating for a long time, she still said, "Chase!"
……
This was the first time Gu Nan had fought against Ying Ge and Zi Dian. To be precise, it was only Zi Dian—although Ying Ge's strength recovered quickly, she was still a little short of Void Cutter Realm.
In front of powerful figures like Gu Nan and Zi Yi, Ying Ge might as well have no fighting strength.
However, the power Zi Dian displayed was somewhat beyond Gu Nan's expectations.
This swordsman who’d slumbered for ten thousand years once revealed the sword intent he nurtured over ten thousand years that even Gu Nan marveled at. Unexpectedly, the current him was still just as strong.
Zi Dian stood in front of Ying Ge, wielding a single sword. As a dream spirit, he didn’t recognize Gu Nan and Zi Yi. He would only fight according to his instinct.
Without invoking any laws, the purest sword in the world slashed down instantly with amazing speed!
The purple sword light cut Gu Nan, leaving a bone-deep wound, and blood immediately splashed out.
Gu Nan paused slightly in surprise, waiting for the Evil God physique to heal the injury. Then he saw Zi Dian’s figure swiftly flying at Zi Yi.
Zi Yi was surrounded by dark purple lines. They glowed slightly, and Zi Dian’s sword immediately bounced off, but Zi Yi herself was also pushed back.
Although she was already at Star Ruler Realm, she never had an astral world of her own and had also been heavily injured by Zuo Zuo previously. At this time, she couldn’t get the upper hand when facing Zi Dian.
"So he’ll even slice his own mother when he goes crazy, tsk tsk."
When a mocking remark reached her ears, Zi Yi couldn't help turning her head to glare at Gu Nan. However, Gu Nan's figure had already disappeared.
Gu Nan had a naturally keen grasp of the battle situation. He knew what he had to do, and he knew even better that his skillset was the most suited for being an assassin!
Target, Ying Ge!
Zi Dian suddenly turned around, stabbing his sword at a place next to Ying Ge, but it was still too late. Or rather, it wasn’t too late, but Gu Nan directly ignored his attack.
Gu Nan emerged from the darkness. In order to pursue the ultimate speed, he didn't even use a sword. He stretched out his hand and directly gripped Ying Ge's neck, giving it a gentle twist.
The "crack" sound of broken bones rang out very clearly at this time, and the petite Ying Ge slowly crumpled to the ground.
Zi Dian’s sword easily pierced Gu Nan's chest, but Gu Nan just grinned, and his figure suddenly disappeared, leaving only Zi Dian and Zi Yi facing each other.
Zi Yi’s mouth twitched slightly. She stared at the figure overflowing with sword intent in front of her and suddenly felt a little pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Kills
chapters.content:
Gu Nan leisurely drifted to one side, completely ignoring the "mother and son deathmatch" behind him.
Gu Nan only cared about his own reward; Zi Yi's life and death wasn’t within the scope of his concern—the rescue mission was issued through Astral Gate, so even if Zi Yi died here, Gu Nan would still be able to receive his origin crystals.
Now that Ying Ge had already been rescued, as long as Zi Dian's dream spirit was also killed, then Gu Nan's reward wouldn’t be able to run away.
Even if Zi Yi intended to contest that, Astral Gate would also be responsible for investigating the mission progress.
Boom!
In the face of Ying Ge’s death, Zi Dian’s dream spirit that was only acting on instinct almost completely gave up on his swordsmanship. He simply used his sword like a knife, hacking at Zi Yi with great force.
His sword would cause a terrifying shockwave every time it landed. The entire Dream World seemed to be shaking.
Zi Yi, whose injuries were already quite serious, could only grit her teeth and endure it. She was powerless to fight back, but at least she could still withstand it. As long as she survived this wave of Zi Dian’s attacks…
Boom!
Another blow fell. Zi Yi was only distracted for a second, yet she was suddenly slashed by this sword. The purple smoke around her couldn’t help swaying.
"This rascal grew stronger again…" Zi Yi also didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. If she entered Dream World to rescue them only to die at her own son’s hands, then that would really be an astronomical joke.
‘But the truly hateful one is Gu Nan!’
Zi Yi once again recalled this “mercenary” of hers. He actually abandoned her and ran away by himself. He didn’t have the professional integrity of a mercenary at all.
Of course she wouldn’t understand. When there weren’t extra rewards to be earned, players would always ignore an NPC’s life and death. They would only squeeze dry all remaining value from every single NPC.
However, luck obviously didn’t intend to make things this easy for Gu Nan. Three figures suddenly broke in from the other side of this area. It was Grandma Tu and the Zhao brothers.
"That's the target’s companion." The older Zhao brother immediately recognized Zi Dian’s identity at a glance.
The one Zuo Zuo wanted to kill was Ying Ge, so the person they were looking for was naturally also Ying Ge, but Ying Ge was gone right now.
Ying Ge existed here as a dream spirit. When she died, of course her soul immediately returned to her true body, so she didn’t leave behind a corpse.
Therefore, the three dream masters who arrived late didn't realize that their mission had already failed. Rather, their eyes lit up.
‘Now that we’ve found the target’s companion, the target won’t be far away!’
But right at this moment, a shadow suddenly emerged from behind the three. A sword of shadow suddenly chopped down while making a strange twisting motion.
Three hits in one slash!
Gu Nan's strike clearly intended to slay the three enemies simultaneously!
Dream masters’ true bodies weren’t much stronger than that of ordinary cultivators. With Gu Nan's current strength, he could indeed accomplish such a thing.
The Zhao brothers didn’t even grunt as both of their heads fell to the ground—they were nothing more than two Prodigious cultivators. Faced with Gu Nan’s sword, they couldn’t even turn around.
But Grandma Tu didn't die from this blow. After all, she was a Void Cutter expert, and they were currently inside Dream World, her home field… And most importantly, she was expecting this attack!
That’s right. Even if there was no trace of Gu Nan at the scene, Grandma Tu still didn’t let down her guard at all.
So the instant the shadow appeared, Grandma Tu's figure suddenly blurred, turning illusory. She seemed to have merged with Dream World for a second, which was just enough to avoid this slash.
But soon she reappeared nearby, her forehead full of cold sweat. She had a lot of lingering fear in her heart.
However, now wasn’t the time for lingering fear!
Although the first slash missed, Gu Nan's figure followed her relentlessly, just like a shadow. He floated up to Grandma Tu with precision and stabbed his sword out, targeting the other party’s throat.
In fact, it didn’t matter where he stabbed her. As long as the sword pierced Grandma Tu, she would be directly torn to shreds by the boundless power of shadows.
However, Grandma Tu smiled coldly. What looked like a normal smile actually revealed a clear meaning: “But this is Dream World!”
If this was the outside world, an existence like Gu Nan would be able to kill her as easily as killing a chicken, but inside Dream World, it wasn’t impossible to completely turn the tables around.
With a wave of her hand, Grandma Tu had already connected to the will of Dream World. A strange fluctuation landed on Gu Nan, and at the same time, that nightmare also began to rush at him again.
Dream masters normally controlled nightmares to kill their enemies. Now that Grandma Tu was here in person, it was naturally easier for her to control nightmares.
After that strange fluctuation fell onto Gu Nan, the scene before his eyes began to change.
It was clearly only an instant, but it felt as if time had been stretched indefinitely. Grandma Tu’s figure began to distort. She would change into a beautiful woman one second, then transform into someone familiar to Gu Nan the next second.
The list of people started from the very moment he transmigrated into this world—Gu Nian, Lin Feng, Yang Lan… All the way until the end. Even Red, Zi Yi, and Ying Ge were included.
Among the people Grandma Tu transformed into, there were men and women, as well as the old and the young. All of them had crossed paths with Gu Nan at one point or another, and all of them appeared without fail right now. Perhaps not even Gu Nan himself could remember all these people.
Grandma Tu's gloomy eyes stared at Gu Nan.
Of course she knew what Gu Nan was going through. As long as even one of these people could make his heart waver, then this tiny weakness would be magnified countless times until it filled Gu Nan’s mind.
And as long as it could affect the other person's mind even for an instant, it would be enough for the nightmare to swallow him.
‘So what if your determination is strong? These are all your own memories—don’t tell me there isn’t a single person from your memories who can influence your emotions?’
The sword glinted as it swung in an arc. Gu Nan's hand didn't tremble in the slightest, and his movements also didn't pause. The sword of shadow directly beheaded Grandma Tu, and the nightmare over there suddenly stopped its attack.
The answer was, of course, none.
None! Ever since Gu Nan transmigrated to this world, there was not a single person who could influence him!
He was like a traveler who was always looking into the distance, walking through every inch of land step by step. The people he saw and the events he experienced have all been tossed behind him.
This is a person who will never look back.
A moment before her consciousness disappeared, Grandma Tu vaguely saw a trace of Gu Nan's innermost thoughts. Thus, this kind of understanding emerged in her heart: ‘Everything was in vain.’
After cutting apart the illusion in one slash, Gu Nan still had the time to glance at her and mutter, "Isn’t this illusion a little too weak…? Does the Evil God physique even come with preinstalled immunity to willpower checks?"
Illusions didn’t exist in the game, and even if it did, it would simply be a check of the player’s willpower stat. It wasn’t like the game could make players overcome the illusions by themselves, so Gu Nan really didn’t know much about illusions.
Three dream masters were killed by Gu Nan in the blink of an eye. On the other side, the mother-son battle between Zi Yi and Zi Dian finally came to an end as well.
Of course the victor was Zi Yi. No matter what, she was still a Star Ruler, and she was also incomparably familiar with Zi Dian’s methods.
It’s just that she also paid a high price for the sake of victory, which could be seen from her extremely pale face.
"Now that the mission is completed, we can go back to settle the payment," after Zi Dian fell, Gu Nan leisurely walked up to Zi Yi and said righteously.
"You still dare to mention payment?!” Zi Yi was truly surprised by Gu Nan's shamelessness. "Did you make any major contribution to this battle?"
"I have more kills than you."

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Tier 5
chapters.content:
No matter who had more kills, it wouldn’t affect Gu Nan’s rewards.
Based on Astral Gate’s logic, even if Gu Nan killed his employer afterwards, it would still have nothing to do with his mission—unless his mission was to protect a target.
Of course, such behavior would also be recorded. If someone wanted to hire Gu Nan again in the future, the potential employer would be informed of this record.
But this was no longer important either, because 100,000 origin crystals were in hand now, so Gu Nan had no need for missions anymore.
When Gu Nan exchanged 100,000 origin crystals for active world origins all at once, even the spirit of Astral Gate Hall paused.
"Ying Ge’s Next-Door Neighbor Uncle Wang, please confirm your exchange request."
In Astral Gate’s entire history, there had probably never been such a strange exchange like Gu Nan’s. He actually exchanged for 100,000 origin crystals’ worth of active origins at one time.
It was hard for both Star Rulers and Void Cutters to use such a huge amount of world origins, and doing so in one exchange was even more inconceivable.
Active origins weren’t collectibles. They would quickly lose their effectiveness if not used in time. Who could use up so much at once?
If he had the opportunity, Gu Nan would tell them that the Evil God Temple could.
The Evil God Temple swallowed the active origins exchanged from 100,000 origin crystals without hesitation, then began to slowly digest it.
So when Gu Nan looked at the Evil God Temple, from time to time, there was a notification of ｢Corrupting the divine fire｣ as his Evil Value slowly increased.
"It’ll take around two or three days." Gu Nan glanced at the growth rate and immediately determined.
Active origins were divine fire, and the Evil Value gained from corrupting the same amount of divine fire would eventually slow down or even decrease—this was within Gu Nan’s expectations.
In fact, even when players slew gods in the game’s later stages, they would also experience a reduction in Evil Value earned if they killed too many gods of the same level.
This setting was made to urge players to constantly challenge new heights, and it could also be said to prevent players from taking advantage of loopholes.
Without this kind of design, it was definitely possible for players to raise gods in captivity to farm Evil Value.
But as a result, Gu Nan suddenly had a lot more free time for a short while. He stayed in his residence inside Zi Luo Heaven, quietly waiting for the day his Evil Value would reach 2,500.
However, he did receive a guest while waiting.
"What a rare guest!" Gu Nan looked at the Zi Dian in front of him and exclaimed with his face full of surprise.
Gu Nan's residence in Zi Luo Heaven was no secret. After all, he found it right under Ying Ge’s eyes, and even Zi Yi could find it easily.
However, the fact that Zi Dian actually visited him alone still surprised Gu Nan.
"Did something happen to that brat Ying Ge?" This was naturally Gu Nan's first reaction. "I'm not interested in accepting another mission."
"She's fine." Zi Dian replied, "I'm just here as bait to attract some people's attention."
Gu Nan suddenly realized, "You two are finally willing to part."
Zi Dian smiled mildly. "Of course I learned a lesson after someone killed her right in front of my eyes."
He was referring to what happened in Dream World. Although it was a dream, it didn’t mean that the two dreamers couldn’t understand what happened after the incident, and they were able to clearly recall events from the dream.
This guy in front of him seemed to be a natural assassin. Even with Zi Dian’s protection, Ying Ge still died without being able to fight back at all.
Afterwards, Zi Dian felt some lingering fear but also rejoiced that this person hadn’t been employed by the enemy.
"You came all the way here just to talk to me about this?" Gu Nan didn't pay much attention to Zi Dian's statement and asked bluntly.
With his current strength, he no longer feared any Void Cutter cultivator, not to mention he also had Deity’s Descent as backing.
Even after advancing to Tier 5, this transformation-type godly skill could still bring him great benefits. After all, it was his third law.
Zi Dian shook his head, then stood up. "I just came to confirm your allegiance, and now I’ve confirmed it."
As this sentence fell, Zi Dian’s figure disappeared from Gu Nan's residence. Gu Nan shot him a curious glance. Not even he himself was aware that he had any allegiance. How could this person be so sure?
After Zi Dian left Gu Nan's side, his figure appeared next to Zi Yi.
"How is it? Is it possible for him to take Zuo Zuo’s side?"
"Don't worry." Zi Dian shook his head lightly. "He doesn’t seem to be interested in our fight. And now, he isn’t even interested in origin crystals anymore."
……
No matter what Zi Dian confirmed, Gu Nan's advancement wouldn’t be hindered by anyone.
Perhaps the Evil God Temple was still digesting a portion of the active origins it had “eaten,” but his Evil Value had already reached 2,500, and he also had enough points.
Gu Nan's will sank into the Evil God Temple. His heart was calm.
｢Advance Tier｣
With Gu Nan's order, the Evil God Temple abruptly changed.
On Gu Nan's status panel, the three laws of substitution, resurrection, and Deity lit up one after another, finally surrounding "shadow" in the center and respectively connecting to it.
In the eyes of people from this world, the process of advancing to Tier 5 entailed the Void Cutter cultivator thoroughly refining their own laws and finally achieving perfection.
But in Gu Nan’s case, it was the process of combining each of the three laws he selected with his core law of shadows.
Among them, substitution originated from the law of shadows in the first place, so it was naturally the easiest to combine; resurrection was also driven by the power of shadows, so it wasn’t hard to fuse either; only the Deity law progressed extremely slowly.
However, a gradually weakening connection between the three laws and his core law was a deliberate move on Gu Nan’s part.
No matter how slow the progress, there would always be a day when the laws finished merging. No matter how powerful the law, there was still no escaping the Evil God Temple!
When the Deity law was completely taken over by shadows, the golden body symbolizing the "Deity" icon had already turned jet black.
Gu Nan had no doubt that if he activated Deity’s Descent right now, he would become a blackened version of a deity.
The moment the three major laws completely fused with the law of shadows, Gu Nan's Evil God physique immediately received another strengthening, and the strengthening effect was even greater than before.
An indescribable force erupted from within his body. Gu Nan felt like his entire body was swollen, as if he would explode instantly.
If normal people encountered this kind of situation, they’d probably be worried to death out of fear that they would explode, but Gu Nan remained calm.
He had experienced such a situation too many times. Once players reached a certain level, something heaven-defying like the Evil God physique would have such an effect every time players leveled up.
｢Advancement Complete｣
Two calm and emotionless words appeared on the Evil God Temple’s notification panel. Gu Nan took a deep breath. He knew it wasn't over. Rather, it was just the beginning.
His consciousness returned to reality inside Immortal Demon World. Lan Si had worked her heart out but only managed to repair an embryonic form of the world’s origin, which she called the "Stone of the World." It was currently floating in front of Gu Nan.
Even throughout Gu Nan's many years of gaming history, he’d never encountered such a good opportunity before.
The instant he advanced to Tier 5, a perfect Divine Kingdom had already been placed right before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Divine Kingdom Construction
chapters.content:
Exactly how strong was Tier 5?
In fact, compared to Tier 4’s Gu Nan, there really wasn’t a qualitative leap.
His physical power was strengthened and his laws were transforming into shadows—all these things paved the way for his future path, but they had far less impact on actual fighting strength than one would expect.
Enemies he could defeat now that he was Tier 5 could also be defeated when he was at Tier 4 by utilizing tactics; enemies he crushed during Tier 4 would similarly be crushed now that he was Tier 5.
But there was still an essential difference between Tier 4 and Tier 5. This difference didn’t lie in strength, but in qualification.
Tier 5 meant that Gu Nan was qualified to dip a finger into Divine Kingdom construction.
｢External kindling detected. Do you wish to light the divine fire?｣
When this world’s origin—which was still in an embryonic form—appeared in front of the Tier 5 Gu Nan, the Evil God Temple immediately asked.
The Evil God Temple was like a loyal assistant, dutifully translating external information for Gu Nan while also accepting all external power. It never made mistakes.
｢Yes｣
Gu Nan didn't even think about it and directly gave an affirmative answer.
As for waiting until the origin grows stronger? No need! Gu Nan firmly believed that once he officially established his Divine Kingdom, this world would grow stronger at a pace far faster than before.
Of course Gu Nan didn’t hide his return from Lan Si and Yan Xiaoxiao. They were currently standing next to Gu Nan.
At this moment, the world in front of their eyes suddenly changed.
The sky seemed to darken all of a sudden, and the originally damaged sky also quieted down at this moment. Then it started to repair itself.
Gu Nan and the other two stood at the very center of the continent. An exquisite, majestic, yet sinister temple was erected out of thin air.
"This is…" The two women stared at this scene in astonishment.
Lan Si wasn’t as surprised. It wasn’t like she’d never witnessed a divine miracle before back in the Kingdom of Luxuriant Blossoms, but Yan Xiaoxiao was a completely different story. She couldn’t comprehend this at all.
‘It's not a trick of the eye, and it's not an illusion. It's a real palace…’
The two subconsciously took a few steps forward and finally saw the words on the palace plaque—although they didn’t recognize the language, the meaning of these three words fell directly into the deepest part of their hearts.
Evil God Temple!
An inexplicable shadow seemed to slowly emerge from the back of the palace, shrouding the two women’s minds.
Gu Nan, however, ignored their thoughts. Now that the Divine Kingdom was finally at hand, it meant that his game progress had entered an entirely new stage.
From this moment on, his advancement path would no longer be directly strengthening himself. Instead, it would be indirectly strengthening himself by building a powerful Divine Kingdom.
｢Evil God Temple: Core structure. The foundation of the Divine Kingdom. Level 0｣
This notice automatically jumped out when he looked at the Evil God Temple.
This Evil God Temple was the exact same as the one inside Gu Nan's mind, but now only its shadow was left behind in his mind. Its tangible body had suddenly appeared in the Divine Kingdom.
If Gu Nan wanted to complete the First Round by advancing to Tier 6, he just needed to level the Evil God Temple to Level 1.
But this level-up wasn’t simple at all. It required Gu Nan to have at least six Level 0 structures.
After officially establishing the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan's panel in the Evil God Temple suddenly changed, and certain data that had never appeared before were finally revealed.
｢Wood: 0
Ore: 0
Sulfur: 0
Crystal: 0
…………......｣
Mercury, gems, gold… A series of resources appeared on the interface, and the number behind them was, of course, all zero.
However, Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry. Such Level 0 resources could easily be collected, even from the mortal realm, so there was no pressure at all.
The data after that represented the amount of power the Divine Kingdom could provide for Gu Nan.
｢Divine Power: 1｣
Of course this wasn’t trying to say that the entire Immortal Demon World was only worth a divine power of "1.” Rather, it meant that for the current Level 0 Evil God Temple, the maximum divine power was 1.
In terms of Gu Nan's current strength, it would take at least 1,000 divine power for it to be slightly helpful to him in battles.
Gu Nan's first construction target was the "Resource Market."
Rookie players often wanted to build the Barracks and Research Institute as soon as possible, but a top player like Gu Nan knew that the most time-saving structure was definitely the "Market."
Because although the resources required by Level 0 structures were all very common, they often required many types of resources, and they had to be transported to the Evil God Temple in order to take effect, which would undoubtedly waste a lot of time.
And the role of the Resource Market was to exchange resources of the same level. Of course, the exchange price was definitely not 1:1.
For example, the exchange ratio of wood to gems could get as high as 5:1. Five units of wood could only be exchanged for one unit of gems. On the other hand, the exchange ratio of gems to wood was also the same 5:1. No matter how one looked at it, this was a greedy merchant.
But in order to save time in the early stage, it didn’t matter if he was ripped off slightly.
"Wood 500 units, ore 300 units, gold 50 units…"
Gu Nan wrote down a long list and handed it to Yan Xiaoxiao.
Yan Xiaoxiao stared blankly at the list for a long time. "Teacher, how much is one unit? And wood… What type of wood does it want?"
"How much doesn't matter, and the type also doesn't matter." Gu Nan waved his hand and said, "Collect as many resources on that list as you can and bring them to the Evil God Temple."
The resources required by the Evil God Temple weren’t limited by type, such as types of wood; it had a set of algorithms to evaluate them. Excess resources could also be converted by the Market in the future.
There was nothing to worry about on the resources side. Instead, Gu Nan had a severe shortage of the most important material in constructing a building—points.
A considerable number of points was needed to establish a Resource Market.
How considerable? Exactly 10,000.
The points Gu Nan earned as a byproduct from using 100,000 origin crystals to exchange for Evil Value had already long been used up when he advanced to Tier 5, and now Gu Nan was a penniless wretch.
If he added up all the points he spent from Tier 1 to Tier 5, it would probably barely reach ten thousand, but now even a single structure required ten thousand points!
This was frigging inflation!
As an experienced player, Gu Nan had naturally anticipated the astronomical prices that many beginner players grumbled over, so he wasn’t surprised right now.
This was deliberately designed by the game developers to prevent players from saving money in advance and skipping the initial stage of the Divine Kingdom’s development by relying on points they’d previously saved up.
But Gu Nan had actually mastered the way to harvest points after Tier 5 a long time ago.
That was a personal dungeon.
For players, personal dungeons were used to interact with other players, but in the game, personal dungeons were used to print money for the developers.
"Lan Si, come with me," Gu Nan's voice traveled over from far away, and his figure had already entered the Evil God Temple.
Lan Si didn’t understand his intention and glanced back at Yan Xiaoxiao, who was also at a loss, so she could only follow Gu Nan's footsteps and enter the Evil God Temple.
Gu Nan stood quietly in the center of the spacious and empty Evil God Temple, while there was a red gate next to him.
"So you’ve successfully advanced to Tier 4, very good." Gu Nan beamed at her. "It's time to test your strength."
After a slight pause, Lan Si immediately became spirited. Over the years, Gu Nan had always been the one providing her with cultivation resources. She had been waiting for this opportunity for a long time!
She needed a chance to prove that she was by no means a good-for-nothing who only took resources and never gave back.
"How can I help? Murder or arson?" Lan Si subconsciously asked.
Gu Nan cast her a glance. "Youngsters shouldn’t be so impulsive… Behind this door is ‘Splendid World.' You’ll know what needs to be done after you enter."
"Okay!" Lan Si nodded vigorously, then walked towards the door.
"Inside, you can resurrect upon death. I hope you can make good use of this ability. In addition…"
Lan Si walked forward quickly, throwing only one sentence behind her, "I won't die even once!"
Five seconds later, Classmate Lan Si walked out of the door with a dark expression.
"In addition," Gu Nan patted her shoulder a couple of times, "this map has starting point kill."

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Indigo Mound
chapters.content:
Five seconds ago, it would’ve taken Lan Si about half a day to understand what "starting point kill" meant.
However, after experiencing the terrifying meteor at the beginning of "Splendid World," Gu Nan didn't even have to explain it. She understood just from hearing the name.
"That… What should I do?" Lan Si didn't clarify what "that" referred to, but her meaning was obvious.
Gu Nan naturally remembered the walkthrough for Splendid World. After telling Lan Si a rough outline, she was sent off to continue dying.
This dungeon wasn’t simple, and the difficulty level of a solo run was far greater than imagined. Back when Gu Nan took the three Star Rulers along for the first clear, they experienced many party wipes.
Even if Lan Si had a walkthrough guiding her, she still had to pay enough tuition fees.
Lan Si’s figure disappeared from the Evil God Temple. When Gu Nan looked back at the other side of the hall, a dungeon interface was there instead. The first personal dungeon that lit up was now red.
Red meant someone was currently inside, trying to clear it.
This was the role personal dungeons played inside the Divine Kingdom. After the dungeons were set, players’ apostles would enter the dungeons repeatedly. Each dungeon clear would provide points for the Divine Kingdom.
Splendid World was originally a four-person dungeon, but Gu Nan just had Lan Si as an apostle at present, so she could only farm it alone.
Under Yan Xiaoxiao’s direction, a group of shadow servants had already started collecting and transporting resources. Soon, all kinds of resources would be continuously transported to the Evil God Temple.
There was no need to worry about resources for the time being. It was fine even if it took some time. The construction of the Divine Kingdom wouldn’t happen overnight.
At present, Gu Nan urgently needed to recruit more apostles for himself and unearth more personal dungeons.
There weren’t really special requirements for recruiting apostles. As long as Gu Nan himself agreed and the target also agreed, the target would be able to become his apostle—this was much easier than the requirements for normal gods’ apostles. When gods recruited apostles, the strength of the candidate’s faith and piety was the most important consideration.
Evil Gods and gods had many similarities, but they also had a core difference—Evil Gods didn’t require faith.
From divine fire to Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan's path seemed no different from that of ordinary gods, but when it came to things that involved faith, his requirements were far less cumbersome than that of the gods.
As for the source of personal dungeons, Gu Nan knew that a long time ago. He simply needed to translate the wills of various worlds.
In this field… Gu Nan thought of a suitable candidate, and his figure instantly disappeared from the Divine Kingdom.
……
Star Realm.
Red Tail stood on the soil of Heavenly Kingdom Star and couldn't help giving a small sigh, feeling very complicated.
She originally thought she’d never return to this place again in her lifetime, and even if she did, she would never return with the identity and posture of a loser.
A traitor, to be exact.
The translation method was secret knowledge that belonged to the entire Indigo Mound tribe and not her own possession, so it was naturally treason for her to reveal the translation method to an outsider.
There didn’t seem to be anything wrong with this logic, but Red Tail knew better than anyone else that this was merely a joke.
It was true that the translation method was very valuable, but it wasn’t so valuable that anyone who revealed it to an outsider must die.
Even in Star Realm, there were many powerful figures who knew this secret knowledge, and many of them even learned it from members of the Indigo Mound tribe.
Were they also considered traitors?
Of course not. On the contrary, the reason these people all held high positions within the tribe was precisely because they successfully earned the support of powerful existences by using their tribe’s resources or even their own bodies.
The Indigo Mound tribe had many resources like the translation method whose sole purpose was to be offered as tribute to powerhouses in exchange for their protection.
And being able to climb up the social ladder by gaining these powerful figures’ favor depended on the untiring efforts of the tribe members.
Today's Indigo Mound tribe was a strange group that constantly “bet on” different powerhouses.
"You won't die. You will be locked in the tribe’s underground water prison forever, despicable traitor," a younger woman who somewhat resembled Red Tail calmly pronounced.
Red Tail glanced at her, then chuckled silently.
Of course the truth of the tribe wasn’t revealed to every single tribe member. This girl who could be considered her niece was obviously still in the stage of youthful ignorance.
Perhaps one day, when she was being offered as a gift to some powerhouse, she would finally understand the tribe’s secret.
Red Tail wore a pair of shackles on her wrists, and all of her power of law was sealed. She silently followed the girl, all the way until they arrived at a quiet and secluded spot deep in the mountain.
In the distant past, this Indigo Mound Mountain was once the holy land of the beastkin race, but now? Nothing more than a slightly fancy brothel.
A trace of a sneer appeared in Red Tail's eyes, but her footsteps didn't stop. From the front, a woman was walking towards them. The woman was dressed in all green, with her beautiful hair casually falling down to her waist. She walked with a strange sort of seductive charm.
"Mother." The girl leading Red Tail bowed slightly in front of the woman.
"You can leave the rest to me."
"Yes."
A moment later, the woman in green reached Red Tail and said with a smile on her face, "Speaking of which, Sister Red hasn’t been back for a hundred years, right?"
Red Tail glanced at her coldly. "I was just here."
"Oh, I forgot about that matter with Starry Ocean Pavilion…" The green-robed woman continued chuckling lightly while pursing her lips.
Previously, Starry Ocean Pavilion mobilized its members to enforce the requirement that all Prodigious cultivators must travel to the Central Region to register themselves. Red Tail naturally also came here. But nobody knew if the woman in green truly forgot or if she deliberately brought it up.
The green-robed woman and Red Tail were from the same generation. Her name was naturally not as simple as “Green Tail.” Her name was Su Yufei.
In the Indigo Mound tribe, having a formal name meant the person had already been "married off." This was the case for Su Yufei.
In fact, Red Tail was the only person in their generation who was still using her tribe name.
"If you want me to return, then just say so. Why the need to even use a flimsy excuse like treason?" Red Tail ignored Su Yufei’s words and instead asked disdainfully.
"Sister Red, that's just because we miss you, you know…?" Su Yufei pulled Red Tail’s sleeve and gently shook it. She didn't look like a mother at all and looked more like an innocent little girl.
But what she said next wasn’t innocent at all.
"The decision to brand Sister Red as traitor was done with unanimous consent from all six elders." Su Yufei leaned into Red Tail's ear and chuckled. "I’m afraid that this time, Sister will have to spend her old age here."
Red Tail, who was always calm and composed, finally couldn’t help turning her head around. She stared blankly at Su Yufei’s face, as if trying to find some evidence that she was lying.
But, no.
There was no need for her to lie, because Indigo Mound Mountain was just around the corner, and the tribe’s attitude towards her would soon be revealed.
Red Tail took a deep breath, feeling a little helpless as her gaze landed on the quiet mountain top. She was powerless to resist the tribe’s decision, and all the freedom she enjoyed so far was due to the goodwill of a senior, but now…
She hadn't forgotten who she bet her money on. Although that one had disappeared for a long time, he was still a Void Cutter powerhouse.
What made the tribe so determined to capture her?

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Golden Giant
chapters.content:
In a secluded cabin on the peak of Indigo Mound Mountain, six extraordinarily beautiful women were sitting around.
It seemed this many people rarely ever gathered inside the cabin, and it felt a bit crowded right now.
More importantly, a senior and a youngster were also sitting beside these six people. The senior was calm and composed, but the youth looked a little impatient.
As if sensing the young man's mood, one of the women spoke up, "The person has already been brought over to Indigo Mound Mountain. Elder Qian and Young Master Jin, please keep calm…"
The young man known as Young Master Jin just gave a cold snort, while the old man laughed. “Then I’ll have to trouble the six elders."
"No no, we don’t dare call it trouble…"
"It’s an honor for our Indigo Mound tribe to work for Elder Qian."
The six women quickly replied. In their eyes, the accompanying Elder Qian seemed more intimidating than the young man, even though he looked very approachable.
……
It was normal for members of the Indigo Mound tribe to fail in their “bets.” No matter whether the person they bet on died or turned against the tribe member, the tribe still wouldn’t punish its people over it.
If they even had scruples about betting, then how would they be able to win big with only a small investment?
The current Starry Ocean Pavilion had already fallen into turmoil, and Yue Jiu's bizarre death was still a mystery. No outsider knew who exactly killed him.
Star Realm’s impression of Gu Nan was still frozen at the moment where he single-handedly slaughtered his way to the Central Region and was ambushed as soon as he arrived, vanishing without a trace after that.
But in the end, he was still a Void Cutter powerhouse. As long as there was no proof of his death, who would take the risk to capture Red Tail?
This was also what perplexed Red Tail, despite much thought.
"Let's go." Su Yufei seemed to suddenly become cold, pushing the dazed Red Tail along. "You'll know when you get up there."
Hearing the hidden meaning in her words, Red Tail nodded slightly, and they walked step by step to the peak of Indigo Mound Mountain.
Of course someone was already waiting for them here. They were Indigo Mound tribe’s six elders, including the senior who had a favorable impression of Red Tail, as well as the elder and youngster.
"Pavilion Lord Qian." Red Tail bowed down in fear and trepidation; even her hands were trembling. It’s just that there wasn’t much panic in her eyes, only some confusion.
Red Tail didn’t recognize that young man, but she was very familiar with the old man.
This was an old man who had a head full of white hair, and even his beard had turned white. Many people had already forgotten his identity, but Red Tail, who grew up hearing stories about him, hadn’t forgotten.
The old man's name was Qian Han. It was a very simple name, but he had an identity that was by no means simple—the previous Pavilion Lord of Starry Ocean Pavilion.
That’s right. Before Yue Jiu and the other two Pavilion Lords, Starry Ocean Pavilion only had one Pavilion Lord—this old man named Qian Han.
Back in those days when his fame had reached its peak and he was just one step away from controlling the entirety of Star Realm, he suddenly handed Starry Ocean Pavilion over to three juniors and left by himself.
Some people claimed he did that because he had already found his advancement path, while others maintained that it was because being invincible was too lonely, so he simply abandoned Starry Ocean Pavilion and traveled to the outside world…
Very few people knew that he actually went to the depths of the starry sky.
……
Meanwhile, deep in the starry sky.
"You really wronged Qian Han by having him do this kind of thing that’s clearly beneath him." There wasn’t much ridicule Red’s eyes, and even her tone was calm, but something about it just made people feel like she was being mocking.
Who was Qian Han?
He was the person who had always stood behind Red, and he was also the person who suddenly betrayed her at the most critical moment.
Red had never been a fool. Starry Ocean Pavilion was just a pretense she threw to the public to deceive her enemies. Her real elite forces were all concentrated in this palace of hers.
But not even she ever imagined that Zuo Zuo, who hadn’t stepped foot in Star Realm for ten thousand years, would have a hidden chess piece called Qian Han.
Thus, she successfully became a loner overnight and was forced to lead the fight against Zuo Zuo alone.
"I didn't ask him to do it." But Zuo Zuo shook his head. "I gave him the path to advancement, and in exchange, he backstabbed your 9,000 elites. That's all."
Zuo Zuo was telling the truth. The relationship between him and Qian Han was nothing more than a business transaction, not a superior-subordinate relationship. Otherwise, Qian Han would’ve also participated in ambushing Gu Nan and snatching Immortal Demon World’s origin back then.
"So what exactly does he want to do?" Before she even finished asking this question, Red’s gaze fell on the young man next to Qian Han. "The golden giant clan?"
……
Qian Han slowly lifted Red Tail up from her kneeling position and smiled. "You need not be polite. This old man just came here to ask my lady about a person’s whereabouts."
"Ah… Who is it?" Red Tail put on a curious expression, but in fact, she knew full well who he was talking about.
Besides him, who else among her acquaintances would catch the attention of the one in front of her?
"Gu Nan." The familiar name traveled into her ears, but it wasn't Qian Han who spoke. Instead, Young Master Jin next to him quickly walked up to her while cutting in.
He grabbed a fistful of Red Tail’s hair, his eyes full of ruthlessness.
"You are his most important subordinate in the Sixth Region. Don't tell me you don't know where he is!"
Red Tail’s eyes revealed a trace of helplessness. She knew that since the young man before her dared to interrupt Elder Qian’s words, he definitely wasn’t someone she could afford to offend, but the problem was…
She truly didn’t know.
"Red Tail, you have to think carefully before speaking," a soft but indifferent voice came from the front.
Of course Red Tail recognized her. Among the six elders, this was the one who didn’t like her.
It's just that the present situation endangered their entire tribe, so she wasn’t even in the mood to gloat over Red Tail’s misfortune. ‘She probably just wants to push me out as a sacrifice to avert disaster.’
Red Tail's eyes passed the other elders again. Their gazes were similarly indifferent, including the elder who always held goodwill towards her.
Red Tail understood this indifference well. Personal feelings were nothing at all when faced with the entire tribe’s continued survival.
"I don't know," so Red Tail shook her head and answered quietly.
If she knew Gu Nan’s whereabouts, perhaps she would’ve sold him out without hesitation, but unfortunately, she really didn't know.
Qian Han shook his head somewhat regretfully, while Young Master Jin smiled grimly. "Very good."
Young Master Jin kicked Red Tail in the knees, immediately forcing her to her knees, while Young Master Jin raised his palm high.
Under the gazes of Red Tail and Indigo Mound tribe’s six elders, Young Master Jin’s body suddenly grew to several times a person’s height, and his body was suffused with a fantastic golden color.
"The golden giant clan…" One of the six elders exclaimed in surprise.
Su Yufei, who had been standing next to them with her head bowed up until now, suddenly looked at Young Master Jin with a certain light in her eyes.
Golden giant—this was one of the otherworldly clans. There were only legends of them in Star Realm; no one had ever seen one before!
Such an existence was precisely the type of powerful figure that the Indigo Mound tribe liked the most.
The mighty power surrounding Young Master Jin’s body was getting heavier and heavier, so crushing that even breathing became difficult. The one who bore the brunt of the pressure was Red Tail.
Of course Red Tail knew the other party was trying to bully her into submission…
‘But I seriously don't know!’
Classmate Red Tail really wanted to cry but had no tears. She felt that she had suffered a calamity that had nothing to do with her.
"Wait,” Qian Han suddenly spoke up at that moment.
"Hmm?" Young Master Jin glanced at him in confusion, his gaze questioning.
With his family background and tyrannical nature, not even Qian Han could completely restrain him.
But Qian Han remained calm and explained, "The one we’re looking for is here."

chapters.title: Chapter 295: Don’t try to negotiate
chapters.content:
Gu Nan had arrived.
There was no need to doubt this, because he appeared out of thin air just like this and stepped into the cabin on the peak of Indigo Mound Mountain, standing before everyone.
"Your Excellency is Mr. Gu Nan?" Qian Han immediately came forward upon seeing Gu Nan appear.
However, Gu Nan didn't even spare him a glance. His eyes only fell on the Red Tail behind Qian Han.
At this time, Red Tail was still kneeling on the ground, with her long black hair gripped in Young Master Jin’s hand. She looked lovely and pitiful.
But Gu Nan didn't take any pity on her. Not even his gaze wavered as he walked up to her step by step.
"Are you willing to become my apostle?" Gu Nan asked like it was mere formality.
"I’m willing!" Red Tail immediately shouted. She didn’t know what an apostle was or what she needed to do, but she knew this was her only lifeline at the moment.
Behind her, Young Master Jin was still in the form of a golden giant. His entire person looked imposing and extraordinary. He glared at Gu Nan and said, "Gu Nan? You arrived just in time. Since you are a descendant of my golden clan, immediately return to the clan with me!"
Descendant of the golden clan?
When these five words came out, not only Su Yufei and the six elders were taken aback, but even Red Tail stared at Young Master Jin with an odd expression from her spot on the ground.
Nobody understood Gu Nan’s past power better than her. How could that incomparably gloomy, sinister, and secretive law have any relation to the golden clan?
Only Young Master Jin himself was extremely certain.
Because he saw with his own eyes the video that Qian Han sent him. It was the scene of Gu Nan killing Yue Jiu after activating Deity’s Descent.
That’s right. Although nobody else saw Gu Nan kill three top-level Void Cutters in one fell swoop, this couldn’t be hidden from Qian Han's eyes.
This old man—who already stood at the top of the world many years ago and even betrayed the ruler of Star Realm—had always been silently observing events in Star Realm.
When the words "golden clan" fell into his ears, even Gu Nan couldn't help glancing at Young Master Jin.
He was simply too lazy to acknowledge these NPCs; it wasn’t like he really couldn’t hear them. Now, when he glanced at Young Master Jin, he easily realized where the misunderstanding was.
Speaking of which, his appearance after using Deity’s Descent was indeed somewhat similar to the golden giants’ true bodies, but there was still an essential difference between the two.
Golden giants were just golden in body; ultimately, they were still beings of flesh and blood. The body of a deity, on the other hand, was completely formed from laws.
But this no longer mattered, because after stepping into Tier 5, his Deity law was completely dominated by the power of shadows, so it was impossible for him to ever transform into a golden deity. At most, he’d only be able to transform into a black deity.
So Gu Nan still didn't speak. He simply stepped forward and threw a punch at Young Master Jin.
This punch looked perfectly normal, and it wasn’t even that fast. Young Master Jin couldn’t help revealing a small sneer.
‘This Gu Nan wants to fight me without even transforming into his true body first. He’s truly…’
‘Huh…? Why has this punch already arrived?’
By the time Young Master Jin finished his thoughts, the seemingly unhurried punch landed on his face with astonishment.
His face registered a shockingly sharp pain. Young Master Jin only felt that his whole face seemed to have caved inwards, and his body involuntarily flew back.
But in the eyes of the six tribe elders and Su Yufei, the body of this golden clan member who was insufferably arrogant just seconds ago was rapidly shrinking while flying away in the air.
Gu Nan’s one punch had directly punched him out of his true body state!
This also showed that Young Master Jin wasn’t actually a pure-blooded golden giant, or else his true body should be that of a giant.
Boom!
Young Master Jin crashed into the ground, smashing a deep pit into the cabin floor. His facial bones were completely broken, and his face was covered in blood.
He hadn’t fully lost consciousness yet, but he was almost there.
After all, Gu Nan had already advanced to Tier 5. Like normal Star Rulers, there was no essential change in the power of his laws, but unlike them, his Evil God physique did experience changes!
At Tier 5, the Evil God physique became stronger, more extreme, and more mysterious.
Its strength still couldn’t compare with Tier 4’s deity mode, but its speed wasn’t inferior in any aspect—the seemingly slow speed Young Master Jin saw was actually a manifestation of extreme speed.
Qian Han, who was planning to come over to stop them, froze at this moment.
He had already lifted a foot forward, so right now he maintained that position with a foot lifted, as if frozen. It looked a little comical.
But nevertheless, he was still Qian Han. Just a moment later, he casually withdrew his foot and began to study Gu Nan carefully.
Qian Han was very knowledgeable and also insightful, so he was extremely certain that Gu Nan’s punch just now didn’t contain any force of law behind it, just pure strength.
But his reason was also roaring: ‘Can such a level really be reached with just pure strength?’
Gu Nan was still ignoring everyone's attitude. After confirming Red Tail's wishes, he did only two things—sweeping away obstacles and taking Red Tail away.
"My Lord, please wait a minute!" A ringing voice shouted out. Su Yufei’s figure was already in front of Gu Nan, blocking his way.
An elder behind her almost jumped up in fright. "Yufei, have you gone crazy?!”
But Su Yufei said quickly, "Did My Lord look for Red Tail because of the translation method? Our tribe holds a more complete version of it. As long as My Lord—”
"Is she telling the truth?" Gu Nan didn't wait for her to finish, instead turning to ask Red Tail directly.
Red Tail’s expression at this moment looked like she wanted to swallow Su Yufei whole. This was a blatant attempt to pull the carpet out from under her feet!
‘If Gu Nan feels that the value of the Indigo Mound tribe far exceeds my own, then I can naturally be abandoned at will.’
"Yes…" But Red Tail didn't have the courage to lie, and there was also no need to lie, because Su Yufei could take out the complete translation method in a few minutes.
Gu Nan nodded with satisfaction and said to Su Yufei, "Bring it."
Su Yufei's tense expression finally relaxed, and she felt that she had made a correct gamble. As expected, this one came here for the translation method.
A suitably charming smile appeared on her face as she leaned close to Gu Nan. "This translation method is a secret of your servant’s
[1]
tribe! But if My Lord wants it, he only needs to—"
Bang!
Before she even finished listing her condition, Gu Nan's fist had already landed on her face.
Su Yufei's head wasn’t as hard as Young Master Jin's. Faced with Gu Nan's punch, her head directly burst open and her body softly collapsed to the ground.
Gu Nan withdrew his fist. There wasn’t even a trace of blood on his jade-white skin.
At his level, his body wouldn’t be contaminated with dust, and the dirt of the secular world couldn’t leave a mark on him at all.
Su Yu's death caused the cabin to fall silent again, while Gu Nan shifted his gaze to the six elders.
"Take out the complete translation method." Gu Nan's serene and indifferent voice rang out, "Don't try to negotiate; you guys know the outcome."
Thus, the six elders of the Indigo Mound tribe all fell silent.
Of course they knew the outcome. Su Yufei's headless corpse was still lying there, which was the best proof.
T/N:
[1]
Your servant
: Humble self-reference by young women
