chapters.title: Chapter 296: Otherworldly Clans
chapters.content:
Gu Nan understood the principle of "equivalent exchange," but he’d always maintained a relatively approving attitude towards it.
For players, if everything was an equivalent exchange, then what meaning was there in playing games?
Players were more willing to be a swarm of locusts, frantically plundering everything in sight and strengthening themselves with the highest efficiency, never taking into account the thoughts of the plundered.
‘I only need to buy scrolls, equipment, and potions if I can't beat the monsters. If I can already beat them, then of course I'll just kill them and take the dropped items.’
The six elders looked at each other. They had already realized what Su Yufei’s courting-death actions had caused, but right now, it was more important to survive this.
"Yes. My Lord, please wait a moment. We will offer up the translation method immediately…" Finally, one of the elders came forward.
Gu Nan nodded slightly and didn't say much else. He’d always been very patient with the things he needed.
In the Indigo Mound tribe, a complete translation method was what he needed, and so was Red Tail. What he wanted wasn’t only the translation method itself, but also Red Tail’s talent.
After managing White Mist for hundreds of years, Red Tail was quite experienced in running a reincarnator organization.
If she was to rebuild White Mist, she’d definitely be able to do it much more efficiently than if Gu Nan attempted it himself, which was his ultimate goal.
Gu Nan needed a large quantity of mist mirrors to open up enough personal dungeons for him. But it was a pity that there were no more talents like Red Tail in the Indigo Mound tribe.
The reason was very simple. Besides her, members of the Indigo Mound tribe merely treated the translation method as a tribute to be offered up, and no one had ever used it themselves.
……
Deep in the starry sky.
"Truly unexpected," Red’s calm voice contained some rare surprise. This surprise was naturally aimed at Gu Nan.
At Red and Zuo Zuo’s level, it wasn’t hard for them to see through Gu Nan’s true cultivation realm after he attacked.
"He’s probably the youngest Star Ruler ever." Zuo Zuo lamented with a small chuckle, "What a pity…"
Of course Red knew what he was regretting. Such a talented person had once crossed paths with both of them, but neither of them grasped the opportunity.
The opportunity to recruit him, as well as the opportunity to kill him.
And now, it was impossible to recruit or kill him.
Star Rulers were all equal. Very few Star Rulers would willingly serve other Star Rulers. And of course, it was much harder to kill Star Rulers than it was to kill Void Cutters.
Red fell silent, but Zuo Zuo continued to speak, "He just came back to take away his own things… You still have a month at most. If she doesn't make a move, you will no longer have a chance."
The confrontation between the two had been deadlocked for many years. Of course they weren’t just standing here foolishly. Zuo Zuo had been incessantly putting pressure on Star Realm.
So Zuo Zuo knew very well that Red was a spent force and wouldn’t be able to last much longer. If Ying Ge wanted to make a move against him, now was the last chance.
Red stared at him silently, and her eyes seemed to contain a smile.
"You're scared."
……
The complete translation method was quickly placed in front of Gu Nan, and Red Tail became an "appraiser" again.
The person who brought the translation method to Gu Nan was Bai Qing, the elder who always had a favorable impression of Red Tail.
"I'm sorry, Your Excellency. Besides Red Tail, no one else in the tribe has ever established a reincarnator organization before…" Bai Qing said pitifully, but her heart was full of regret.
Only after learning Gu Nan's specific requirements did she realize just how lucky Red Tail was—so being the leader of an reincarnator organization was her real value!
Gu Nan was a little regretful that he was only able to get one Red Rail, but he still nodded and accepted the translation method, then turned to leave with Red Tail.
But Qian Han's voice rang out at just the right time, "Your Excellency Gu Nan, this old man has something to tell you. Your Excellency, please wait a moment."
At this time, Qian Han was bowing down slightly while standing next to Young Master Jin—to be more exact, he was standing next to Young Master Jin’s corpse.
Even his skull had caved inwards from the punch. Even with a golden giant’s vitality, the most he could do was last a few minutes longer. Right now, the god of death had already silently descended upon Young Master Jin.
Qian Han felt extremely helpless when he realized that Young Master Jin was beyond saving. After all, he was the one who took the video of Gu Nan and went to find the golden clan.
Now that such an event had transpired, if he didn’t give a proper explanation or compensation, how could the golden giants let him go?
He had already planned things out. No matter how Gu Nan answered, he had a way to lead the conversation to the desired follow-up topic…
But in reality, Gu Nan’s response never came no matter how long he maintained the bowed position. Qian Han raised his head in slight bewilderment. Gu Nan’s figure had already disappeared from view a long time ago.
"Elder Qian…" Bai Qing stood beside him and said awkwardly, "That one has already left."
……
Gu Nan didn't care at all about what Qian Han had to say. He paid a visit to Star Realm and left with what he wanted—that was all.
"My Lord, you killed a golden giant just like this…" Red Tail said somewhat uneasily from next to Gu Nan, "After all, that's an otherworldly clan."
"Hmm, what's that?" Gu Nan asked. His entire knowledge regarding the golden giants was basically limited to the appearance of Young Master Jin’s true body.
Red Tail stared at him like she’d seen a ghost. ‘To think this one actually didn’t know anything!’
"There are many fantastic races that live outside the Myriad Heavens Universe. They are called otherworldly clans."
Red Tail had never traveled outside the Myriad Heavens Universe in her life, and her true body had never even left Star Realm before, but this didn’t affect her understanding of the outside world.
Gu Nan, however, knew more about this topic.
‘Beings that live beyond the Myriad Heavens Universe? Perhaps they’re connected to the World of Gods. After I settle matters here, I can investigate that,’ Gu Nan rubbed his chin and thought.
His musings didn’t affect Gu Nan's actions. He had already taken Red Tail inside the Divine Kingdom’s Evil God Temple. A faint purple light shone down, covering Red Tail.
Red Tail didn't resist when the purple light fell on her. Instead, she calmly accepted the baptism of that sinister energy.
Just a moment later, she opened her eyes again. Traces of purple were now mixed in with her originally dark pupils.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, nodded with satisfaction. At present, Red Tail had successfully become his second apostle. There were no requirements for the recruitment of apostles. It only needed the target’s submission.
But this submission was by no means superficial, or else it wouldn’t be acknowledged by the Evil God Temple at all. Even if someone could deceive the Evil God Temple for a while, once they started harboring disloyal thoughts, they would immediately be removed from the ranks of the apostles.
"My Lord." Red Tail, who regained consciousness, prostrated herself to show her absolute obedience to Gu Nan.
"Mm." Gu Nan just nodded calmly. "Your mission is to rebuild White Mist. Take the complete translation method with you, select suitable target planes as soon as possible, and establish White Mist branches in various locations."
Red Tail knew what Gu Nan needed her to do a long time ago, so she nodded at this time.
Then Gu Nan continued, "Do you know any relatively famous mission experts?"
Gu Nan wanted to recruit apostles to farm dungeons for him. The most suitable targets were naturally people who completed missions in reincarnator organizations.
Red Tail stared blankly, then quickly answered, "Yes, I know someone who is very suitable. It’s just that…"
"Just what?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows.
"She has already washed her hands of this business for many years. Right now, she’s living in retirement with numerous children and grandchildren. I’m afraid she won’t be willing to come out of retirement."
"That’s quite alright. Just kill her entire family."

chapters.title: Chapter 297: Acquaintances at the Banquet
chapters.content:
Each field had its specialists.
Gu Nan himself was a top-notch missions player, so he knew very well how much an apostle who specialized in completing missions would improve the efficiency of dungeon farming.
Although Lan Si was trying very hard, she obviously still had a long way to go before she could clear Splendid World, even if she had the walkthrough.
For novice players, walkthroughs were sometimes no different from a foreign language they couldn’t understand.
The candidate Red Tail recommended was Guan Hongchen, a woman who was a contemporary of Red Tail. Guan Hongchen worked together with Red Tail as a reincarnator in her early years, which was why the latter thought highly of Guan Hongchen’s mission clearing abilities.
Later, Red Tail left the Central Region for Heaven and Earth Star to take charge of White Mist, and she didn’t hear any news about Guan Hongchen for a long time.
It wasn't until many years later that she occasionally heard that Guan Hongchen had already washed her hands of the reincarnation business and retired.
……
Central Region, Peach Blossoms Star.
The Central Region had many administrative planets suitable for settling down in, and among these planets, Peach Blossoms Star was definitely one of the most famous ones.
What did Peach Blossoms Star have the most? It had the most number of powerhouses living in seclusion.
Here, one could find experts from all walks of life, even some old fellows who had already retired from the martial world. For one reason or another, they all stayed away from disputes and settled down here, living in seclusion.
In fact, the name Peach Blossoms Star was coined by a Void Cutter recluse thousands of years ago with the meaning of “the peaceful and prosperous peach blossom utopia.”
All the policies and laws on this planet were prepared for those living in seclusion.
No matter what identity or faction you used to belong to, after coming to Peach Blossoms Star, no one here will care.
This was a place for people to start over. Even Starry Ocean Pavilion’s tough policies from earlier ultimately failed to spread to Peach Blossoms Star.
"Quite an interesting place," Gu Nan couldn't help commenting with a chuckle after learning about the history of Peach Blossoms Star.
In his eyes, such a place that didn’t care about someone’s history was very suitable for designing missions and storylines in. If he was a game designer, he would definitely arrange several classic NPC storylines here.
Red Tail stood beside Gu Nan and explained softly, "Many people regard Peach Blossoms Star as their final destination. When they no longer have the energy to advance forward, they’ll come here to enjoy a life in retirement."
Peach Blossoms Star was such a retirement star. This was also the case for Guan Hongchen, whom Gu Nan was looking for.
Guan Hongchen wasn’t weak. In her early years, she was a genius Prodigious Realm cultivator, but she never had the opportunity to step into Void Cutter Realm.
She wasn’t a bloodline user like Red Tail, but a pure-blooded human. As she got older, her determination to advance further gradually died out, so she came to Peach Blossoms Star to live in seclusion.
Actually, it wasn’t completely accurate to say she was living in seclusion. Guan Hongchen didn't even change her name. Her acquaintances could still ask around and find out her whereabouts.
It’s just that due to the special situation of Peach Blossoms Star and the fact that she didn’t have enemies who held a bone-deep grudge against her, she was able to enjoy peace and happiness over the years.
Since they were looking for Guan Hongchen, Red Tail was naturally responsible for trifling matters like investigating her specific situation.
So after Red Tail finished gathering information, she took Gu Nan to a banquet.
"How lively."
"Today is the one-month birthday of Guan Hongchen's oldest grandson, so a banquet was specially held to entertain relatives and friends." Red Tail did investigate thoroughly. She even knew the reason for the banquet.
The two slowly walked into the venue. At the door, Red Tail even took out two invitations as part of their disguise.
The Indigo Mound tribe really was quite influential within the Central Region. Even in a "retirement center" like Peach Blossoms Star, Red Tail could still mobilize a lot of manpower.
Ever since the events on the peak of Indigo Mound Mountain, Red Tail had long since stopped being a traitor of the tribe.
"The one at the door just now is Guan Hongchen’s son." Red Tail leaned into Gu Nan's ear and whispered, "Guan Hongchen only has a son and a daughter. The daughter is obsessed with martial arts, so the family business can only be inherited by her son."
Gu Nan nodded. Of course he understood Red Tail’s unspoken implication—the son was a good starting point if he wanted to coerce Guan Hongchen into submission by threatening her family.
"They can attack now," Gu Nan said calmly.
Red Tail raised her head with a slightly dazed expression, shivering involuntarily despite not being cold.
She thought that when Gu Nan said "kill her entire family,” he only meant to use that as a last resort to coerce Guan Hongchen, but who would’ve thought…
"Gu Nan?!” A surprised shout came from the side.
Red Tail suddenly turned her head in that direction like she’d seen a ghost.
‘There’s actually someone who knows Gu Nan in a place like this?!’
Even Gu Nan himself was slightly surprised. He had the ability to instantly scan the entire banquet and clearly see everyone’s faces, but he usually didn't have the leisurely mood to do such a thing.
But after this shout rang out, Gu Nan’s incredibly powerful mind lightly swept through the entire banquet, immediately taking in everything about the situation at once.
Zhang Dongsheng ran over delightedly. Like an old friend who hadn’t seen Gu Nan for many years, he didn’t hesitate to greet Gu Nan.
It was true that they hadn’t seen each other for many years, but the old friends part might not necessarily be true.
Like Tang Xuan, Zhang Dongsheng was once the person in charge of Radiant Tower’s asteroid belt branch office. It’s just that he didn't participate in the Immortal Demon World mission, so he didn't have much interaction with Gu Nan.
However, the two really did know each other, but Gu Nan didn’t expect for him to appear here.
"Something the matter?" Gu Nan only used three words to fully express his indifference.
However, Zhang Dongsheng didn’t mind. Perhaps in his impression, Gu Nan had always been this kind of person. He was still trying to exchange pleasantries while inviting Gu Nan over to sit with him in passing.
"Zhang Dongsheng, what are you doing over there!" A man’s shout came from the same direction, and Zhang Dongsheng could only hurry back after saying goodbye to Gu Nan.
He came quickly and left just as quickly. Red Tail was still surprised that Gu Nan actually had acquaintances, while Gu Nan completely ignored this scene.
He was simply waiting for the plan to commence. To him, it didn’t matter at all whether unrelated NPCs appeared in a mission.
On the other side, Zhang Dongsheng hurried back to his own table that had five men and one woman seated around it. They were Zhang Dongsheng's current teammates.
"What are you trying to pull?! Senior Guan will meet us soon. Where are you running off to at such a critical time?" A bearded man scolded in a heavy voice. He was the one who called Zhang Dongsheng back just now.
But Zhang Dongsheng said quickly, "Captain, remember what I told you guys before? I met a mission genius in the asteroid belt division!"
"You mean, that was him just now?" The woman next to him shot him a glance. "How can there be such a coincidence…"
Another person interjected, "A mission genius from the asteroid belt division? Haha!"
Although he didn't say it, his laughter fully expressed his opinion.
The leader with sideburns studied Zhang Dongsheng with a doubtful gaze. Clearly, he didn't believe it either. After all, the reputation Gu Nan left back then was too brief to be known to everyone in Radiant Tower.
But Zhang Dongsheng returned his captain’s gaze without flinching at all. Perhaps his determination moved the other party, and the captain finally spoke.
"Since you’re so certain, ask him to come over and meet us." The captain said flatly, "Senior Guan might not necessarily be willing to help us. If he can help instead, then that will be a pleasant surprise."

chapters.title: Chapter 298: Guan Hongchen
chapters.content:
Zhang Dongsheng was very excited.
Unlike Gu Nan, Tang Xuan, and the others who left Radiant Tower, he ultimately chose to stay at Radiant Tower all along.
But he worked his way up step by step from a small asteroid belt branch to Ruby Fish Star’s branch office, then finally to the Central Region. Now that he was a member of Radiant Tower’s Central Region office, he could be considered to have reached the pinnacle of his life.
The seven-member team he currently belonged to—each of whom was at least Prodigious Realm Infinitesimal Stage or above and each of whom had special skills—was an elite team in the truest sense.
But it was precisely such an elite team that suffered repeated setbacks in a certain mission. Finally, under their captain’s leadership, they could only seek help from a senior.
Reportedly, this Senior Guan was the one who mentored their captain and taught him the basics of completing missions back then.
Right now, they didn’t know if Senior Guan would even be willing to help with this terrible mess. But he didn’t expect to run into Gu Nan here. This was truly a pleasant surprise!
Zhang Dongsheng didn’t forget that back when Gu Nan was still at Innate Realm, he was already clearing Radiant Tower’s missions as easily as playing around.
Right up until he left, Gu Nan's mission completion rate was 100%!
The longer Zhang Dongsheng stayed in Radiant Tower, the more he realized just how terrifying the past Gu Nan was—it wasn't about how powerful he was. Rather, he was too much of a jack of all trades; there were so many different types of missions, yet none of them could stump him.
Yet in such a situation, Gu Nan voluntarily delivered himself right to Zhang Dongsheng’s doorstep. It was simply too perfect!
"Gu Nan, do you have time to chat?" Zhang Dongsheng asked calmly as he strolled up to Gu Nan again, smiling like an old friend.
"No."
"Ah… Haha, your cold humor is still the same as before!" Zhang Dongsheng tried his best to smooth things over. "It's our captain who wants to meet you. An Wende, a Domain Stage expert with the title of ‘Ghost Sword’."
Seemingly hearing his own name, the bearded An Wende turned his head to glance in Zhang Dongsheng and Gu Nan’s direction.
He was waiting for Gu Nan to twist his head to look his way, and then he could give a nod at just the right moment.
Not only did this express his respect for talents, but it also displayed his status. An Wende had been a captain for many years, so he was already extremely familiar with this routine.
What puzzled him, however, was that Gu Nan didn't seem to hear Zhang Dongsheng at all. Let alone look back, Gu Nan didn't even lift his eyelids.
"Gu Nan?" Seeing his motionless appearance, Zhang Dongsheng shouted again, "You busy bee, you can at least find the time to meet our captain, can’t you?”
Gu Nan finally turned his head slowly. "It's not that I don't have time; it's that you guys no longer have time."
Before Zhang Dongsheng could understand his meaning, a loud noise had already traveled over from outside.
The glass at the entrance of the hall shattered into pieces with a loud bang. At the same time, the doors and windows were broken through. Broken glass shards flew everywhere, making everyone scream and curse, yet the more dreadful event had yet to come.
One by one, figures dressed in black rushed in rapidly, holding standard long blades in their hands. They started slashing crazily at all the guests present.
"This…" Zhang Dongsheng was dumbfounded by this scene. For a moment, he was speechless.
Red Tail, on the other hand, glanced at Gu Nan with a strange expression, because this was exactly what Gu Nan ordered—the massacre must not be carried out with modern weaponry. The scene must be bloody and cruel enough in order to put the greatest amount of pressure on Guan Hongchen.
Many people had the same reaction as Zhang Dongsheng. To be honest, such a vendetta massacre scenario rarely ever happened in Peach Blossoms Star.
After all, this was Peach Blossoms Star! These people were killing so wantonly—weren’t they afraid of the Three Elders’ wrath?
The Three Elders of Peach Blossoms Star referred to three powerful senior Void Cutter cultivators. Even Starry Ocean Pavilion had to take into consideration their connections and strength. They were the foundation of Peach Blossoms Star's transcendent and impartial status.
The crazed slaughter continued; the guests had already fled. Captain An Wende was surprised at first, then ecstatic.
‘We encountered this sort of matter as soon as we arrived. This is an opportunity!’
An Wende knew that these intruders’ overall strength wasn’t actually that strong. Of the Prodigious cultivators leading them, not a single one of them was at Domain Stage. Many of the intruders were even at Innate Realm.
‘Isn't this a favor delivered straight to my door?’
"Attack!" An Wende shouted lightly as his figure rushed out first. With a wave of his hand, he murdered a black-robed killer.
The other members of the elite team naturally followed their captain’s footsteps and joined the ranks of people resisting the killers, with only one exception.
That was Zhang Dongsheng. He was still standing next to Gu Nan, not daring to move at all.
Based on Gu Nan’s words just now, these killers were clearly his doing!
Zhang Dongsheng didn’t know Gu Nan’s current cultivation realm, but Gu Nan had already stepped into Prodigious Realm back when he was still at Radiant Tower.
‘Gu Nan’s current cultivation probably isn’t too far behind mine, so I must keep a close eye on him.’
But to his confusion, Gu Nan didn't seem to make any moves and just quietly watched all this.
"My Lord, should I…?" Red Tail asked in a low voice. She couldn’t help feeling a little anxious when she saw over half of the people in black be killed or injured in the blink of an eye. If she joined the fight, then the situation would surely turn around in an instant.
"No matter." But Gu Nan just waved his hand.
He didn't expect too much from Red Tail’s people. The purpose was just to draw Guan Hongchen out.
If it was something like exterminating an entire family, his shadow clones could also do that, but they would make too much noise. He was afraid they’d scare the target away.
Even now, Guang Hongchen still hadn’t shown up. Sure enough, this was a cool-headed woman, just as he expected.
The killers in black were quickly dealt with. Not only did An Wende and his team help out, but some of the guests also came to their senses to help kill the black-robed intruders.
Plus, Guan Hongchen also had some powerful experts stored up in her family, so this meager number of killers wouldn’t be able to stir up too much wind and waves.
A mere moments later, the situation was completely under control, and the host family finally appeared on the scene, led by a gorgeous and mature-looking woman.
"That's Guan Hongchen." Red Tail informed Gu Nan, completely ignoring Zhang Dongsheng. "Her husband's surname is Zhu. Her husband died a few years ago, so she is currently in charge of the Zhu family."
While Red Tail was speaking, An Wende had walked up to Guan Hongchen and greeted her, "Senior Guan."
"So it’s Little An." Guan Hongchen quickly recognized An Wende but cut in before he could open his mouth, "I'll catch up with you later."
An Wende hurriedly nodded in agreement. Since something like this happened to the Zhu family, of course Guan Hongchen didn’t have time to talk with him right now.
Guan Hongchen truly handled the situation incredibly and quickly calmed down everyone at the scene. Immediately after that, she slowly walked over to Gu Nan's side, staring straight at Red Tail.
"Lord Red Tail, you still refuse to leave me alone, even after all these years?" Her polite tone revealed a sense of alienation. Clearly, her relationship with Red Tail wasn’t as simple as that of former comrades.
Red Tail chuckled. "No matter how you feel about that past matter, I'm afraid you’ll have to come out of retirement today."
Before Guan Hongchen could respond, An Wende, who was on the other side of the room, saw that this woman was actually his competitor and immediately shouted, "Senior, if someone is using your family to threaten you, you can always return to Radiant Tower and see who dares to openly oppose Radiant Tower!"
Radiant Tower's reputation was still very useful in Star Realm, so when An Wende pulled out the banner of his organization, he suddenly felt more confident.
While speaking, he kept casting meaningful glances at Zhang Dongsheng, trying to signal with his eyes.
‘Who knows what this bastard is doing, to actually run to the other side. If this makes Senior Guan misunderstand, won’t we have brought trouble to ourselves for no reason?’
When Guan Hongchen heard An Wende's words, she gave him a calming look and immediately said to Red Tail, "You’ve been away from the Central Region for so long. Have you forgotten where we are right now?"
"Hmm?" Red Tail raised an eyebrow and was about to speak, but Gu Nan’s indifferent voice interrupted her.
"Someone’s coming."
As soon as Gu Nan's voice fell, a figure suddenly appeared out of thin air. This was an elderly man with white hair and a childlike face. He had a frivolous smile on his face. It was clear that he was still a child at heart.
Guan Hongchen’s expression immediately relaxed when she saw this elderly man appear.
"Hahahaha!" The old man stood in the air just like this. His gaze swept over Red Tail as he laughed brightly, "Peach Blossoms Star has only been enjoying peace for a few decades, but to think someone would run wild once again… Huh?"
Before the old man could finish, his expression suddenly changed. He saw a young man below wave a hand gently, and then all his hairs stood on end, alarm bells going off in his heart.
The next moment, a giant hand made of shadows suddenly appeared in the air and slapped down without warning, directly swatting the old man to the ground like a fly.
Guan Hongchen stared at this scene like she’d seen a ghost. Then she saw that young man get up slowly and appear in front of her with only one step.
"Now we can have a nice chat."

chapters.title: Chapter 299: On the Right Track
chapters.content:
There was always a clear goal behind everything Gu Nan did.
He needed to make Guan Hongchen into his apostle, so everything he did served this purpose.
If necessary, he didn't mind killing all of Guan Hongchen's family and only leaving her eldest grandson alive in order to force her to complete missions for him.
Now, however, he found a more efficient method.
One of the Three Elders of Peach Blossoms Star was still lying amidst the rubble. The entire scene was silent; only the sound of Gu Nan’s unhurried footsteps could be heard.
Even his footsteps sounded no different from ordinary people’s, which showed that after Gu Nan leveled up to Tier 5, he had indeed withdrawn all of his power inside himself.
Now, unless he attacked of his own accord, no one would be able to tell that he was actually a grand Star Ruler.
But he did attack, and he even swatted away one of Peach Blossoms Star's Three Elders directly with that one blow, which made Guan Hongchen feel her scalp go numb. She knew that today's matter probably wouldn’t end well.
As for An Wende and his team, they couldn’t even speak right now. They didn’t know who Gu Nan was, but they knew at least one thing—the old man who appeared just now was at Void Cutter Realm!
For their team composed entirely of Prodigious cultivators, Void Cutter powerhouses already seemed like unbeatable bigshots. But now, this bigshot was slapped into the ground like one would swat a fly!
Zhang Dongsheng was equally dumbfounded, but he always had this expression, so he didn’t look as conspicuous here.
Guan Hongchen took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down. “Your Excellency, may I ask what commands you have…?"
"Work for me, or else I'll kill your entire family," Gu Nan's "command" was concise and comprehensive.
"This…" For a while, Guan Hongchen didn’t know how to respond. She had never seen such an unreasonable person before, and she also never thought this would happen to herself.
Her eyes swept over Red Tail next to Gu Nan and finally understood why Red Tail had said that just now.
"Wait a minute!" But a voice interrupted Guan Hongchen’s response.
Of course this wasn’t An Wende, who was scared to death. Rather, the old man had managed to crawl out of the rubble. Bloodstains could still be seen on the corners of his mouth.
After all, he used to be a top Void Cutter cultivator, and Gu Nan’s power of laws didn't improve much after breaking through to Tier 5, so he couldn't kill the enemy in a single blow.
So the old man glared at Gu Nan. "Young man, I—"
Bang!
Another palm strike landed, but this time Gu Nan personally attacked. His speed was so fast that his palm seemed to skip over space, falling directly on the old man's head.
The old man's head exploded in an instant, and a cloud of bloody mist burst out in midair, dimly floating down to the ground.
So a far more terrifying deathly stillness enveloped everyone.
When this scene fell in Guan Hongchen's eyes, she didn’t ponder for long before sighing slightly. "I’m willing to follow My Lord."
……
After witnessing Gu Nan kill one of Peach Blossoms Star's Three Elders in an instant, Guan Hongchen had completely lost any thought of resistance and just silently followed Gu Nan.
However, she wasn’t worried about the other party having ulterior motives. With this one’s power level, the only thing he valued about her was probably her mission expertise.
As Guan Hongchen expected, the other party took her to an unknown small world and finally revealed his purpose.
"I need you to help me clear a dungeon. The walkthrough is already available, and an assistant will also be assigned to you." Gu Nan led Guan Hongchen, who had become an apostle, and stopped in front of the Splendid World dungeon.
Lan Si had been beaten within an inch of her life by Splendid World, and even now, she had yet to clear the first phase. She currently stood beside Gu Nan with a dark expression.
Guan Hongchen sensed the terrifying power emanating from Lan Si’s body, which was as deep as the sea and surged like the tides. She couldn't help replying cautiously, "I understand. I will properly assist this Lord."
Gu Nan was too lazy to care about which of the two was the assistant. It didn’t matter as long as they could clear the dungeon.
"Whenever the dungeon is cleared, you can regularly select some resources from here and send them to Star Realm."
Of course Gu Nan understood the principle of motivating people through benefits, but he wouldn’t allow Guan Hongchen to leave his Divine Kingdom for the time being. Not even apostles were completely loyal.
Even gods who had the faith of their followers still experienced cases of betrayal by their own apostles, let alone players whose apostles didn’t have any faith.
"Yes." Guan Hongchen appeared very clever and readily accepted all of Gu Nan's orders.
Although she didn’t quite understand the meaning of "dungeon," she could understand Gu Nan's intention—if she wanted to see her family again, then she had to do her best to complete the mission.
"Oh, right," Gu Nan suddenly spoke again. If Red Tail was here, she would definitely feel a lingering fear toward those two words. "Do you have other friends who are also good at this field?"
"This…" Guan Hongchen paused a little. She seemed slightly hesitant to sell out her acquaintances so thoroughly like this.
“This dungeon can accommodate up to four people."
"I know some people!"
……
Red Tail was already looking for a suitable plane in preparation to rebuild White Mist. After settling Guan Hongchen’s matter, Gu Nan could rest for a short while.
The construction of one’s Divine Kingdom wasn’t a matter that could be done in one or two days. Gu Nan already knew this from experience back when he was still playing the game.
The Evil God game focused on a fast pace in the early phase in order to attract players. However, in the Divine Kingdom management and construction phase after Tier 5, the pace suddenly slowed down, and the theme became "killing time" instead.
This was also in line with the consistent style of game companies—for players who were already engrossed in the game, they always tried their best to keep the existing player base.
Gu Nan's present goal was to upgrade the Evil God Temple from Level 0 to Level 1. That would be the equivalent of owning a Level 1 Divine Kingdom, and it would officially mark his completion of the First Round.
But if he wanted the Divine Kingdom to provide fighting strength for himself, then he’d have to wait until it reached at least Level 3 or Level 4.
A Level 1 Evil God Temple needed to have six Level 0 basic buildings.
At present, all kinds of basic resources were continuously transported to the Evil God Temple, and over half of the construction requirements for the "Resource Market" had been met.
Due to the underdeveloped science and technology inside the Divine Kingdom, the resources of "wood" and "ore" were far in excess of the required amounts. Fortunately, the Evil God Temple could collect resources and convert them into data, or else they wouldn’t even be able to store all of this.
Contrary to expectations, Guan Hongchen, who was motivated to "clear dungeons," recommended many candidates to Gu Nan.
Unlike administrators like Red Tail, Guan Hongchen was someone who only completed missions. Of course her circle would be dominated by other mission experts, so she knew a lot more of those people than Red Tail did.
Gu Nan personally undertook this task. After several twists and turns, he slaughtered two entire families and eliminated several weak candidates from the list. Finally, he chose a father and son pair and added them to the ranks of his apostles.
After putting together the full four-person team to clear Splendid World, he also received news from Red Tail. She had picked a small plane with an obvious difference in time flow as a base for White Mist and requested Gu Nan’s help.
Just as the construction of the Divine Kingdom was slowly advancing and everything started on to get on the right track, a figure arrived at the very edge of the Myriad Heavens Universe.
This was Qian Han, and the place he arrived at was a golden ocean.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: Yeah
chapters.content:
The so-called otherworldly clans didn’t actually live in outer space. The world outside the Myriad Heavens Universe was also composed of various planes, but they merely belonged to other plane clusters.
For Void Cutter cultivators, travel between different planes was already quite an easy feat, so there was no lack of people with ambitions of exploring the outlands. These people would personally travel outside the Myriad Heavens Universe.
Qian Han was such a person.
Although he was the manager of Red’s palace in his early years, Red herself was away from Star Realm most of the time, so he naturally had plenty of time to travel.
It was in such a situation that he discovered the domain of the golden giants clan.
"Esteemed Jin Wuyin, this is the image data of Gu Nan's transformation," Qian Han stood in front of a tall golden man and said respectfully.
He couldn’t afford to be disrespectful, because he knew that not only was the one before him the chief of the golden giants clan, but he was also a Star Ruler in the truest sense.
The golden giants clan had existed proudly outside the Myriad Heavens Universe for tens of thousands of years. If they didn’t have the protection of a Star Ruler, they would’ve been conquered by other powerful forces a long time ago.
Golden giants were born with immense strength, and their bodies were invulnerable to many attacks, so they possessed strong resistance to laws. They could be said to be a race favored by heaven and earth.
But the more gifted the race, the harder it was to maintain its independent and autonomous status, because their very existence was enough to attract a lot of coveting eyes.
Qian Han carefully studied the other party. Originally, with his status, he didn't have any hopes of meeting this one in person, but now the other party directly demanded to meet him personally because of the matter with Young Master Jin.
If possible, Qian Han never hoped to meet the chief like this.
"Judging from the image alone, it's indeed similar," even the chief of the golden giants clan made this judgment. "But the image doesn’t have his aura. That is the most telling indicator."
When Gu Nan transformed into a deity, all the external objects around him that were connected to laws were completely suppressed. The image in Qian Han's hand was left by technological methods, so it was impossible to record his aura.
Qian Han explained this with a bitter smile, trying to describe Gu Nan’s strength in that fight, but he didn't know where to start.
Because every time he recalled that scene, he could only think of a single description—deity-like.
Jin Wuyin stood up slowly and said in a low voice, "No matter who he is, anyone who kills my clansmen for no reason must pay the price… Where is this person?"
"Er… This old man doesn’t know," Qian Han answered honestly. Who knew which plane a Void Cutter cultivator was currently in?
But patriarch Jin Wuyin was obviously not a reasonable person. He picked up Qian Han by the collar and glared at him icily. "If you can't find his trace within three months, I'll kill you in his place."
……
Of course Gu Nan wouldn’t know that someone might be dying in his place. He was currently traveling to a small plane called "Crescent Moon World" with Red Tail.
Crescent Moon World was a small plane that was discovered only recently. Due to the scarcity of various natural resources there, not many people were interested in it.
However, it was located in a remote location in the Myriad Heavens Universe, so time flowed much faster there. The ratio of time flow in that world was 60:1 compared to Heaven and Realm Level planes. It was a plane very suitable for cultivating talents and harvesting them at fixed intervals.
"Crescent Moon World’s human civilization is still in the feudal era, but its power level isn’t low. It’s most suited for raising children of destiny," Red Tail explained the benefits of Crescent Moon World.
Crescent Moon World seldom communicated with the outside world, so it was basically a closed-off small world, but the power system was quite good. Its strongest existences were close to Void Cutter Realm.
The reason why it was “close to” was because the power system here was quite different from the outside world after thousands of years of closed-off development.
The first two realms—Acquired Realm and Innate Realm—were the same, but after Innate Realm, they had Astral Qi Realm and Transcendent Realm.
"Astral Qi Realm cultivators can fly by manipulating their qi; that realm corresponds to our Prodigious Realm. And when one reaches the peak of Transcendent Realm, it’s said that they can break through the void, which should be their description of Void Cutter cultivators."
Red Tail had clearly done enough homework and already knew a lot about Crescent Moon World. If she was given a little more time, maybe she would’ve finished setting up an organization here as well.
"Mm. Let’s find a Transcendent Realm martial artist first and test their abilities," Gu Nan said with great interest. He wasn’t as busy as normal Star Rulers.
Moreover, rebuilding White Mist was one of the important steps in the construction of his Divine Kingdom. Getting started was always the hardest part, so Gu Nan didn’t mind doing the first step himself.
As long as they successfully conquered Crescent Moon World, it would be much more convenient to conquer other planes with the help of powerful figures from this plane.
Crescent Moon World had only one continent shaped like a crescent moon, and it was currently in the period where the royal family’s influence was weak and countless outstanding heroes were rising up. Disciples of various large sects had come out of their mountains one after another, hoping to achieve greatness.
Gu Nan and Red Tail’s first stop was Mt. Dahang, where two of the eight great sects in the world were located. It was truly a holy land for martial arts.
"Luminous Temple and Zhongli Sword Sect," Gu Nan muttered the names of the two sects while walking through the mountain and fields.
One was a sword sect and the other was a Buddhist temple, both of which were the top sects of Crescent Moon World and had the protection of Transcendent Realm martial artists.
"Let's go to Zhongli Sword Sect first." The mountain breeze blew on his face. Gu Nan didn't hesitate for long and soon decided.
Most Buddhist techniques had their own mystical elements, so they weren’t suited for serving as case studies to observe the average abilities of cultivators here. In contrast, sword cultivators were slightly better.
Dahang Mountain wasn’t large, but Zhongli Sword Sect occupied a large area. They even owned a village at the foot of the mountain.
If normal guests wanted to visit, they must start from the Guest Pavilion at the foot of the mountain and climb up step by step, so as to show the status of the eight great sects.
But Gu Nan was here to cause trouble, so he didn’t pay so much attention to this. He descended directly from the air with Red Tail, but then stopped and looked up at the sky ahead.
That was the location of the most iconic building of Zhongli Sword Sect—Heavenly Sword Tower.
"The Transcendent Realm martial artists here don’t yet have the ability to tear apart space, so the chances of them remaining inside the sect are very high," Red Tail noticed Gu Nan’s action and said.
"Indeed." Gu Nan said with a smile, "Their true bodies aren’t here, but they can return at any time."
Red Tail paused slightly, then also stared at the tower shaped like a giant sword, seeming to understand something.
The next second, the figures of the two disappeared without warning and appeared in the main hall down below, where a bunch of people were standing in groups of two or three. They were holding a martial arts tournament.
When Gu Nan and Red Tail appeared, a young man had just knocked away his opponent’s longsword with his own sword and revealed a victorious smile.
"Junior Brother Yan, you still need to diligently practice your Cloud-Piercing Sword Style!" The youth swung his sword beautifully, then looked at his opponent and said.
He was planning to appreciate the frustration and unwillingness on Junior Brother Yan’s face after suffering a defeat, only to discover that the other party was staring at him in horror.
The young man seemed to understand something and suddenly turned to look behind him, only to see a man and a woman standing there quietly.
"W-Who are you guys…" The youth blurted out.
However, before his voice fell, he found that his line of sight began to float upward, and a sharp pain came from his face as his whole person flew out instantly.
In the onlookers’ eyes, the newcomer merely gave him a cold look, and the youth was directly slapped away.
"Who is the Sect Master?" Calm words came from the man's mouth.
An elderly man with an aged face and shrewd eyes slowly got up and stared at the other party gravely.
"As one of the eight great sects of the world, my Zhongli Sword Sect has the protection of a Transcendent Realm founder," the old man immediately brought out his backing. "Your Excellency came to my door and bullied my sect’s disciple. Do you want to make an enemy of my sect’s founder?"
The old man's voice echoed throughout the hall. He could see that the other party’s strength was unfathomable, so he didn't say anything extra. He knew that only the founder could suppress the other party.
To his surprise, however, the man remained expressionless and only one word popped out of his mouth:
"Yeah."

chapters.title: Chapter 301: Zhongli Sword Sect
chapters.content:
The scene became a little quiet and awkward.
Even the old man, who was the sect master of Zhongli Sword Sect, never thought that the other side would give such an answer.
He also wanted to say something else, but he saw the other party lightly point a finger, and a huge black sword appeared out of thin air, flying over everyone's heads in a slanted path.
The old man only felt a strong wind hit him, then sensed chills behind him. He hurriedly turned to look, only to see that the Heavenly Sword Tower behind him had already been hit.
The next moment, the sword tower that originally reached the clouds unexpectedly broke apart from the middle, starting from the cut caused by the diagonal slash.
"This…" The old man’s face paled, but then he quickly shouted, "Quick! Activate the array to welcome our founder!"
As his voice fell, three people immediately jumped down and quickly stood behind him. The three white-haired men were equally old, but they were full of vigor.
The four each held a sword colored gold, silver, purple, and blue respectively, and stood to form a square, pointing to the distant sky.
"Zhong!"
"Li!"
"Heaven!"
"Array!"
Accompanied by four light shouts, four rays of light—each a different color—rose into the sky, setting off fearsome waves of power. All the disciples around them couldn’t help feeling overwhelmed by emotions.
Their hearts were also filled with anger when the intruders bullied them right in front of their doorstep, but they were limited by their lack of strength and could only watch the strong enemy show off his military strength.
However, the actions of their sect master and three elders invigorated them— ‘That’s right, we still have our founder! The Transcendent Realm founder said to be invincible in the legends!’
For a moment, some people even began to feel gratitude towards Gu Nan and Red Tail. Thanks to these two, they could witness their founder’s elegance!
"It's a receiving array." Red Tail commented from the side, "By dividing the reception device into four parts and letting four Prodigious cultivators operate each part separately, they were barely able to muster enough energy to activate the array."
With Gu Nan's present-day knowledge, of course he knew what a receiving array was.
Star Realm had something similar, but that was for Dao Lords who couldn’t break through space themselves, so they used this method to get around the problem and achieve the goal of traveling through space.
As for true Void Cutters, they themselves could already manipulate space at will, so of course they didn’t have a use for this method.
Just from the present scene, Gu Nan and Red Tail could judge that the Transcendent Realm experts in Crescent Moon World indeed lacked the basic characteristics of Void Cutter cultivators.
"Perhaps they’re existences between Prodigious and Void Cutter Realm? I still have to look at a living example to know for sure." Gu Nan's gaze didn't fluctuate. He just calmly looked up.
Up there, the four-colored light had completely converged into one point, opening a door of light in the sky. A figure with a sword on his waist suddenly appeared.
"Du Xian, the unworthy disciple from Zhongli Sword Sect’s 398th generation, respectfully welcomes the founder’s arrival!" Among the four elders, the sect master spoke with a clear voice.
There was a burst of noise among the disciples.
"Founder!"
"It really is the founder! I’ve seen the founder’s portrait before…"
The figure in midair stepped forward lightly, suddenly standing protectively in front of everyone from the Zhongli Sword Sect, facing Gu Nan.
This founder of the Zhongli Sword Sect really did have an extraordinary appearance. His face clearly looked young. His clothes were whiter than snow, with a sword hanging from his waist in a silver scabbard. His plain and simple appearance revealed a trace of elegance.
More importantly, he was a powerhouse standing at the peak of the entire world all year round, which made his bearing extraordinary and refined. He didn’t look like a mortal at all.
Therefore, this founder caused numerous screams as soon as he appeared.
"Zhongli Suwen." He calmly cupped his hands while holding his sword and reported his name, then said, "Your Excellency—”
"The reaction speed is too slow." The flat six-word evaluation traveled over from behind him, which made Suwen's words get stuck in his throat, and he subconsciously wanted to draw his sword.
But the other party’s action was far faster than he thought. As a swordsman, he couldn’t even draw his sword before a sharp pain traveled over from his elbow joint.
Crack!
Suwen's right hand was gripped, while his left hand was directly broken, forming an inverted 90-degree angle that looked grisly.
"The physical condition is close to Void Cutter Realm," Gu Nan continued to conduct the evaluation, then pushed Suwen forward.
Suwen was completely baffled by this situation, but he was also a powerful figure who slaughtered his way to this level step by step, so his will was extremely firm.
Feeling the force freezing his entire body in place disappear, he didn’t have time to think much deeply and instantly drew his sword with his still-intact right hand. In a single instant, his sword had already stabbed Gu Nan's throat!
"The destructive power is much stronger than that of ordinary Dao Lords, but there’s still a gap compared with Void Cutters… The speed barely meets the standard."
Before Suwen could smile, he realized that the other person's voice was still calm, and the sword he stabbed the other party with actually only left a pale, shallow mark on the skin, without even managing to pierce the skin!
"This…” Suwen's present mood could only be described as "fuck my life."
As for Gu Nan's evaluation, that naturally also fell into his ears. The only one that seemed to be a good assessment was "The speed barely meets the standard."
‘What do you mean barely meets the standard?!’
‘The total number of people who reached Transcendent Realm can be counted on ten fingers, and among them, I’m known for my speed!’
But then he remembered what this person had just shown—that extraordinary and unpredictable speed—and no longer seemed surprised. ‘Such a terrifying martial artist, is this the legendary realm where one can break through the void?’
Gu Nan casually swatted aside the longsword with his hand and glanced at Red Tail. "How is it?"
Red Tail was recording something with her head lowered. She quickly shook her head and sighed. "The Transcendent Realm is obviously higher than the Dao Lord level, and in terms of attack, they’re not too inferior to Void Cutter cultivators either."
"Based on my assessment, when facing over four of such opponents, ordinary Void Cutter figures will have to avoid their attacks temporarily," she finally made such an evaluation.
Of course Gu Nan didn’t evaluate Suwen just now because he was bored. He was providing accurate information to Red Tail so as to judge the true combat power of Transcendent Realm fighters.
If Gu Nan had to do such a thing himself, he definitely wouldn’t be able to do it well—what did he know about an accurate evaluation? In any case, everyone was at the level where they’d be offed in one punch.
"Then clean them all up." Gu Nan nodded. "Have Lan Si do it."
There were eight major sects here, which meant there were at least eight Transcendent Realm martial artists. Normal Void Cutter cultivators wouldn’t be able to handle them, so they must all be cleaned up in order to successfully rebuild White Mist.
"Yes." Red Tail wasn’t surprised, because she already realized how terrifying Lan Si was after her breakthrough. That kind of strange ability might be able to trap even the strongest Void Cutter powerhouses.
Gu Nan and Red Tail talked as though there were nobody else present, while Zhongli Sword Sect’s disciples, including the four elders, looked deathly pale.
Because Suwen, their founder, was currently staring straight ahead with a grim expression while holding a sword in his right hand. And his left hand was still bent at an unnatural angle.
When Gu Nan's conversation ended, he suddenly said, "Senior’s martial arts has already reached a realm not even gods or ghosts can predict. If Senior intends to return to the martial world, my Zhongli Sword Sect is willing to pave the way for Senior!"

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Regional Management Platform
chapters.content:
Suwen was indeed a smart person, or rather, anyone who could stand at the top of the world wouldn’t be a fool. However, it just so happened that Suwen had this opportunity.
Faced with someone whose strength far exceeded his own and who was probably in the realm only spoken about in legends, Suwen took the initiative to pledge his loyalty without hesitation!
Although saying this in front of so many people was enough to completely destroy his image as the founder, despite looking young, Suwen was actually an old monster who had lived for hundreds of years, so why would he care about this?
To save his own life and seek higher status and more power for his sect was what someone in his position should consider.
Suwen’s conjecture was absolutely correct. Without his words, Gu Nan would’ve already made a move and eliminated Zhongli Sword Sect by now, then returned to his Divine Kingdom to have Lan Si come over and clean up the rest.
But now that Suwen expressed the intention of pledging his loyalty, it truly saved the sect.
If they wanted to place the work of rebuilding White Mist inside a small plane where time flowed relatively faster, then they must rely on local forces.
Besides Void Cutter cultivators, those who wanted to enter “World” Level small planes could only rely on reincarnation.
And although a powerful Star Ruler like Gu Nan was able to bring some people into this world with him, the number he could bring naturally wouldn’t be very high. It would never reach the standard of establishing an organization.
So Gu Nan looked around and finally nodded. "Alright."
……
Gu Nan had already returned to the Evil God Temple inside his Divine Kingdom, while Lan Si stopped trying to clear the dungeon for the time being and went to Crescent Moon World to help Red Tail set up her organization.
With her current Tier 4 strength, it was indeed a waste for her to devote herself to clearing dungeons.
After all, "Splendid World" was only a low-level dungeon, and the highest level of power allowed inside was merely Tier 3. No matter how high one’s actual strength was, it made no difference.
With three professional mission experts, the speed of the dungeon run was over twice as fast as before. The first phase hardly hindered them at all and was quickly cleared.
On the contrary, the three were slightly stuck in the phase where their battle power was tested.
"My Lord." Seeing Gu Nan appear, a father and son pair who just came out of the dungeon hurriedly saluted.
The father and son's names were Lei Qi and Lei Ba
[1]
. They didn’t sound like father and son and sounded more like brothers, but their relationship was indeed father and son.
Lei Qi’s appearance was a middle-aged man with an anxious face, while Lei Ba’s appearance was a little boy who looked around ten years old with a figure similar to Ying Ge. When he saluted Gu Nan, he was still a little overcautious.
But it was precisely such a child whose ability in completing missions completely crushed a rookie like Lan Si.
Admittedly, this was partly a matter of talent, but another part was that Lei Ba’s real age was actually far older than Lan Si—this pair of father and son weren’t human beings, but elemental creatures.
They were thunderstorm elementals, the accompanying elemental beings of thunder titans. They were able to take on human form after their strength reached Prodigious Realm.
Gu Nan nodded slightly in response to the father and son’s salutes. The Evil God Temple was still very quiet.
Later, Yan Xiaoxiao came to see Gu Nan.
Ever since Gu Nan accepted Immortal Demon World as his Divine Kingdom, the newly-born origin quickly stabilized, and space inside the Divine Kingdom no longer collapsed as often as before.
So the prerequisite work that must be done before the Divine Kingdom’s construction slowly unfolded under Yan Xiaoxiao's direction once again.
"When the previous natural disasters occurred, many people lost their chances of escape because of the city-states’ restrictions." Yan Xiaoxiao stood beside Gu Nan and reported, "So there is great resistance to the re-implementation of the city-state system right now."
Human nature determined that while maintaining a certain concentration, society would inevitably spread out to the surrounding areas, be it population or industries.
Therefore, the completely closed-off city-state system essentially went against the laws of nature. Formerly, it was only able to be implemented due to the strong pressure Gu Nan applied.
"No matter, just try your best. There’s no need to force it too much." Gu Nan seemed particularly accommodating this time. He actually didn’t adopt any enforcement measures. Even Yan Xiaoxiao was surprised.
In her impression, Teacher had always chosen to kill dissenters in such situations.
After killing half of those who refused to obey, the rest would naturally obey.
Gu Nan smiled but didn’t elaborate. Of course it wasn’t out of kindness. Divine power was one consideration, but the real reason was that his Divine Kingdom had already been established, so he would soon be able to get the structure used to manage the Divine Kingdom’s populace.
The reason he had to resort to a series of measures and even construct the law of resurrection to manage the Divine Kingdom back then was because he was only Tier 4 at that time.
At reaching Tier 5, players essentially wanted to play base building games. How could they possibly run over to personally communicate with the Divine Kingdom’s residents?
Regional Management Platform, a Level 0 structure. As long as he had this, the city-state system wouldn’t need anyone to manage it at all. It could be done in a few clicks.
Using the shadow servants, resources were continuously transported to the Evil God Temple, and there were already enough resources to build the “Market,” so it wasn’t impossible to build a second structure too.
"So now, all that’s left is to wait for enough points to be accumulated."
……
The Divine Kingdom’s construction was being developed step by step, resources were constantly transported over, the dungeon of Splendid World was gradually cleared, Crescent Moon World had completely fallen into Gu Nan's hands, and a new White Mist had been established.
In a blink of an eye, another half year passed, and with "Splendid World" being cleared once again, the points in the Evil God Temple jumped to 10,000 again.
"Another 10,000. Then following the previous plan, the ‘Regional Management Platform’ will be chosen as the second structure." Gu Nan didn't hesitate much and quickly decided.
This was already his second 10,000 points. The Resource Market had already been established long ago, and all kinds of basic resources could be exchanged there.
｢Target Structure Chosen: Regional Management Platform
Construction Conditions: 10,000 points, 500 units of wood, 400 units…｣
As the Evil God Temple gave out a long list, a large number of resources were deducted, and a delicate stone platform the size of a lectern slowly appeared in front of Gu Nan.
"My Lord, what is this?" Lan Si also saw this scene. It wasn’t the first time she’d witnessed a "divine miracle," so she wasn’t too surprised.
"You'll know once you look outside." After the second structure was constructed, Gu Nan was obviously in a good mood and answered with a light chuckle.
After that, he ignored Lan Si and came to the Regional Management Platform.
The countertop was made of stone, but at this time, it showed a bright screen, which seemed like a high-tech product.
On the screen was a scalable map, which was the topographic map of the Divine Kingdom.
The Regional Management Platform was also a Level 0 structure, so it couldn’t yet do something as heaven-defying as changing the terrain, but its only function was enough for Gu Nan to use right now.
Gu Nan casually found the location of a city-state, then lightly drew a circle around the city-state on the screen. The word “seal” appeared in red around the circle.
Lan Si wasn’t in a hurry to go out. She was following Gu Nan and naturally saw this.
She vaguely understood Gu Nan's intention, but she couldn't help feeling that this was a little absurd. She hurriedly flickered and tore open space, her figure appearing directly above that exact city-state.
So Lan Si saw a scene that made her gasp in surprise.
The golden light was like a barrier, enveloping the entire city-state and plucking it right out of the ground together with the vast ground underneath it. All of this was quietly suspended in midair.
There were countless people crying out in fear and clamoring both inside and outside the city, which were already two separate worlds.
T/N:
[1] Lei Qi and Lei Ba
:
Lei Qi = Thunder Seven
Lei Ba = Thunder Eight

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Life-Death Stone
chapters.content:
The upheaval in the Divine Kingdom continued as one city-state after another was covered by that golden light, just like being wrapped in a golden dome.
People inside the city couldn’t leave, and people outside the city couldn’t enter.
Countless people were dumbstruck as they stared at this scene. Many had left the city-states and gone to the wilderness, trying to find some resources that weren’t available in the city or to get some air. As a result, they were forever separated from the city-states.
Lan Si silently returned to the Evil God Temple. Yan Xiaoxiao, on the other hand, had long since left to deal with the mess Gu Nan had suddenly sprung on them, which really brought her a lot of trouble. She was under a great deal of pressure.
On the Regional Management Platform, there were already 50 "golden domes" from east to west, which looked quite spectacular.
After a long time, Yan Xiaoxiao finally walked back to the Evil God Temple, her face full of exhaustion.
She also became Gu Nan's apostle, and because of her special relationship with the Divine Kingdom, she could be regarded as half of the Divine Kingdom’s master, with considerable privileges in management and administration.
Only Yan Xiaoxiao could manage the vast Divine Kingdom and make everything clear and orderly.
But this time, even she was out of her depth.
"Teacher, nearly one-tenth of the Divine Kingdom’s people are stranded in the wild, and most of them are martial artists…" Yan Xiaoxiao asked, "Should we give them a chance?"
"Give them what chance? It's not like they can't survive in the wild." Gu Nan, however, replied indifferently, "In the future, you should also slowly get used to managing the populace using the Divine Kingdom’s structures to reduce contact with the populace."
In his previous life’s game, residents of the Divine Kingdom were just a bunch of numbers in players’ eyes. No one was bored enough to talk to them.
On the contrary, administrators like Yan Xiaoxiao basically existed inside every Divine Kingdom.
Players were only ever enthusiastic about something for all of three minutes. It was unrealistic to expect players to persevere in managing the Divine Kingdom for a prolonged period of time, so a full-time administrator was essential.
That was the significance of apostles. Some of them specialized in fighting, some specialized in farming dungeons, and others were good at management and administration.
So Gu Nan turned his attention to his own list of structures. The third structure he planned to build was precisely the “Apostle Hall.”
The Apostle Hall was a structure specifically prepared for apostles. Not only could it quickly recover apostles’ injuries, but it could also train their various abilities.
After reaching higher levels, the Apostle Hall could even resurrect dead apostles.
The structures in the Divine Kingdom that could most effectively enhance the strength of its population and strengthen the Divine Kingdom’s fighting power were "Populace Training Camp" and "Divine Servants Institute."
However, the Evil God Temple was still Level 0 right now. Even if he took out divine servants, they still wouldn’t have much use. It would be better to build the "Apostle Hall" first.
Only by strengthening the power of apostles would they be able to better earn points for Gu Nan.
Matters in Crescent Moon World were progressing rapidly. Six months had passed in the Divine Kingdom, only a little over half a month had passed in the outside world, while three years had already passed in Crescent Moon World.
With Lan Si's help in cleaning up the Transcendent Realm martial artists, plus Zhongli Sword Sect’s voluntary help as the local boss, the reconstruction of White Mist went very smoothly.
In just three years, Crescent Moon World’s martial forces had been basically wiped out, and the world was only waiting for Red Tail to integrate and unify it.
Gu Nan sat inside the Divine Kingdom, but he didn’t overlook a single piece of this information and absorbed them one by one.
However, when his gaze fell on the words underneath the "Apostle Hall," he couldn't help but stare blankly at the first line of the required materials list. There was a line of words in parentheses behind the 10,000 points.
The words in parentheses were "10 units of life-death stones."
Gu Nan had also seen this scene many times before. This was a random event that could be triggered during the construction of structures where certain special materials could be used in lieu of points.
Of course the management of the Divine Kingdom wasn’t completely monotonous and boring; all kinds of random events existed solely for the sake of enriching players' gameplay.
Events where certain event materials could be used to replace other required materials were quite popular among players in the early stages of their Divine Kingdoms, because everyone was short on points at this stage, so they were extremely eager for such an exchange.
"Life-death stone?" Gu Nan repeated this somewhat strange name, wrinkling his brows slightly.
With his present knowledge, he was already very familiar with certain popular materials. At the very least, there were few materials in Star Realm that he didn’t know about.
Gu Nan searched through his memories for a while, but there really was no memory of any "life-death stone." He also asked Red Tail, Guan Hongchen, and the others, but they also didn’t have any clue.
"Is it really an item not from Star Realm?"
Gu Nan shook his head as his figure disappeared from the Evil God Temple in a single step.
……
Zi Luo Heaven.
Gu Nan hadn't been back here ever since he advanced to Tier 5. Now, because of a "life-death stone" that he didn’t know the origins of, he once again set foot onto this land.
It was still the same old residential area belonging to Astral Gate, as well as the familiar maid whose name Gu Nan couldn’t recall.
After reaching Void Cutter Realm or beyond, there was indeed a huge chasm between cultivators and mortals. They were practically like two different species. This was particularly noticeable in their lifespans.
For example, the lifespan of the several maids hired by Gu Nan was at most 100-200 years, and the amount of time they could serve him might not even be 50 years.
Maybe Gu Nan will only see a pile of bones when he returns from closed-door cultivation one day.
Gu Nan quickly left and headed for Astral Gate, trying to obtain some news on life-death stones there. As a result, he ran into his “old neighbor” Roman as soon as he walked out the door.
"Huh, Your Excellency Gu Nan? Long time no see!" Roman greeted Gu Nan with much joy, although such a short span of time was far from a “long time” for a Void Cutter cultivator like him.
Gu Nan nodded, and after exchanging some pleasantries with him, he casually asked for news on "life-death stones."
"Life-death stones? This is a specialty product of Nirvana Heaven!" Roman was well informed and immediately answered.
With Roman’s explanation, Gu Nan also slowly understood what the life-death stone was.
This was a kind of crystal that naturally contained the laws of life and death upon formation. Even in the Myriad Heavens Universe, it was considered a relatively scarce resource. The only place publicly confirmed to have a fixed supply of this resource was Nirvana Heaven.
Perhaps other small planes would also occasionally produce this, but information on those planes would certainly be concealed as soon as they were discovered and wouldn’t be publicized at all.
"Nirvana Heaven, huh…?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin, feeling some irony about the situation.
If he remembered correctly, wasn’t Nirvana Heaven Zuo Zuo’s astral world? ‘To think that after going around in a big circle, I still ended up having to get involved in this matter.’
But this time, it couldn’t possibly be someone's plot; it should just be a coincidence. The resources needed to construct the Divine Kingdom’s structures weren’t something outsiders could control.
"Gu Nan, do you need life-death stones?" Roman easily guessed Gu Nan's needs and added, "This kind of thing is very hard to buy with just origin crystals. But it just so happens that someone is organizing an invasion of Nirvana Heaven recently, so you might as well try your luck there."
After a pause, he then added, "Do you remember the Seven Stars League that came to investigate last time? The missions they issue to the public are still relatively reliable, and they’re guaranteed by Astral Gate, so you won’t have to worry about being ripped off."
Gu Nan nodded and expressed that he would consider Roman’s suggestion. Then he asked, "So what's this about an invasion of Nirvana Heaven?"
Roman burst out laughing with great schadenfreude. "That one in Nirvana Heaven has ideas about Star Realm, yet there’s still no result even after things have dragged on for so long. Now, he just invited trouble for himself!"

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Seven Stars League
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was a little surprised at Roman’s explanation, but then he came back to his senses.
The horizons of Void Cutter experts were no longer limited to one realm or world. Rather, they surveyed the overall situation in the Myriad Heavens Universe. This was especially true for Roman, a powerful figure living in Zi Luo Heaven.
News of Zuo Zuo's invasion into Star Realm might be able to remain a secret at first, but as time went on, it was almost inevitable that the news would leak.
Be it the actions of his subordinates or his arrangements in Star Realm, they were bound to be discovered over time.
Not to mention that Red never had any intention of hiding this matter.
As long as the public was kept in the dark at the beginning, as time dragged on, the target of those who wanted to profit from someone else’s misfortune would shift—since the two sides were at a standstill, of course Nirvana Heaven was way more tempting of a target than Star Realm!
Although Star Realm was also considered a large plane, there was still a gap between it and Nirvana Heaven, one of the strongest planes under the Thirteen Heavens.
Zi Luo Heaven, inside a station belonging to the Seven Stars League.
"Please wait for a short while. The organization will send someone to review your application right away." A young girl led Gu Nan into the hall, then saluted respectfully.
Gu Nan just nodded wordlessly. At this time, he had arrived at the Seven Stars League to apply for temporary participation in the counterattack against Nirvana Heaven.
Borrowing the strength of an organization was essential. If Gu Nan searched for the life-death stone by himself in a vast plane like Nirvana Heaven, he might not even see a trace of it after searching for a year.
It was much more convenient to have the Seven Stars League determine the location of the life-death stone first, and then plunder it.
The so-called "review" was naturally the Seven Stars League’s internal assessment—they were planning to invade a major "Heaven” Level plane on this trip, so of course the team members must be very carefully selected.
Gu Nan sat for a while. The people from Seven Stars League hadn’t arrived yet, but the girl brought another person in.
This was a teen who looked a little shy. To come here now of all times—he probably also had the same goal as Gu Nan.
The girl guide soon left, leaving only Gu Nan and the boy in the hall. The latter didn't seem too comfortable with this atmosphere and couldn’t help taking the initiative to greet Gu Nan.
"Hello, my name is Lou Wanying," the boy stood up and introduced himself, his face still a little nervous.
Gu Nan raised his head, glanced at this boy whose name was somewhat feminine, and nodded. "Gu Nan."
Lou Wanying seemed to relax a little and smiled. "Did Your Excellency Gu Nan also come for Nirvana Heaven? Maybe we can become teammates!"
His demeanor still seemed a little childlike, but Gu Nan didn’t see anything strange about it—if he was a Void Cutter cultivator who grew up in a plane like Zi Luo Heaven and lived a smooth-sailing life, then such a thing wasn’t impossible.
The two didn’t have a chance to deepen their conversation, because a man and a woman were already briskly walking over from a distance, both wearing the uniform of the Seven Stars League.
"Apologies, we’ve kept you waiting,” the woman spoke first as soon as they reached Gu Nan and Lou Wanying.
"No no, I also just arrived." Lou Wanying hurriedly waved his hands, suddenly exposing his naive nature.
But the woman didn’t mind. She first gave her name, followed by a brief introduction of their team.
The woman was named Jiang Tingwei, and beside her was her younger brother Jiang Zheng. Besides the two of them, their team also had another permanent member.
For small teams entering a large plane, the most optimal number of teammates was three to five people. However, because of Nirvana Heaven’s dangerous reputation, they hoped to recruit one or two more temporary members.
"I will need to test your strength. This is also because we are responsible for the safety of the team’s other members. Please forgive me." Jiang Tingwei had a standard smile on her face. Although it didn't make people feel closer to her, it also didn’t make them dislike her.
Lou Wanying nodded vigorously. "Of course… Will the test be right here?"
Jiang Tingwei was about to nod when she heard some clamor outside, and two people immediately rushed in. The woman who had led the way before was following in a panic.
"Mr. Xu, you can't go in! Mr. Xu…"
“Xu Yan?” Jiang Tingwei looked over with a frown. This person could also be considered an acquaintance of hers, but she normally didn’t have many interactions with him. She didn't expect him to barge in here today.
The girl behind Xu Yan stepped back upon Jiang Tingwei's signal, but Xu Yan immediately announced, "Big Sis Jiang, today I'm here to present you with a good teammate!"
As he spoke, he patted the man in black beside him. "This is my brother, you can call him 'Black Hawk.' His strength is absolutely not weak! It just so happens that our team has no intention of entering Nirvana Heaven, so you guys lucked out!"
The fact that Jiang Tingwei's team intended to enter Nirvana Heaven wasn’t a secret within the Seven Stars League.
"First come, first served." Jiang Tingwei frowned. She pointed to Gu Nan and Lou Wanying and said calmly, "We only need two people. If they are unqualified, then I’ll consider your friend."
Xu Yan already knew that Jiang Tingwei was very principled, so he was unconcerned. Instead, he turned to size up Gu Nan and Lou Wanying.
Three people, two spots. He just had to squeeze out one of these two.
The man known as "Black Hawk" was expressionless, but his gaze very obviously fell on Lou Wanying, and Xu Yan beside him immediately got the message.
Gu Nan was dressed in plain clothes, and he couldn’t see the least bit of energy fluctuations from Gu Nan.
‘But how can anyone who can stand here be an ordinary person? I can tell at first glance that he’ll be hard to deal with.’
In contrast, the more naive Lou Wanying was clearly a more appropriate target.
So Xu Yan said with a smile, "We cultivators ultimately talk with our fists. Why don't we have a match between Black Hawk and this little brother?"
He naturally said this to Lou Wanying, who didn't even think about it and immediately agreed, "Okay!"
Lou Wanying’s extremely decisive response caught Xu Yan slightly off guard, actually making him less certain of his choice.
Being naive only meant the person was inexperienced, but it didn’t necessarily mean the person was weak. Maybe there was another possibility—Lou Wanying was a core disciple of a certain powerful organization who’d just left the mountain to gain experience!
"Then let’s start," at this time, it was Black Hawk himself who responded.
Of course Xu Yan wouldn’t object again after seeing Black Hawk personally speak up. He just looked over at Jiang Tingwei with a chuckle. "They both consented to the match. Big Sis Jiang won't intervene, will she?"
Jiang Tingwei was still frowning. She would’ve preferred for Lou Wanying to stay out of trouble, but this was somebody else's choice and she couldn’t intervene, so she was forced to nod.
So everyone backed off, leaving room for Black Hawk and Lou Wanying—it was just a simple match, not a duel to the death, so they weren’t worried that it would make too much noise.
Before the match could start, Xu Yan’s expression changed slightly, as if he’d received a message, and he walked up to Black Hawk's side.
"My people discovered some information." He whispered to Black Hawk, "This person’s name is Lou Wanying, and there’s no information on him. He’s probably the core disciple of a powerful organization."
For these people, no information itself was a kind of information, which could reveal many problems.
Black Hawk nodded silently. "What about the other one?"
"His name is Gu Nan, and he lives in a public area. He should be from a small plane." Xu Yan said quickly, "If you can't defeat Lou Wanying, you can change your target and challenge him instead."
"Okay." Black Hawk's eyes flickered, and it seemed that he was more confident.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Nirvana Heaven
chapters.content:
Inside the station belonging to Seven Stars League, Black Hawk was calmly studying his opponent. No matter how he looked at it, this big boy who was all too eager to start seemed to match their conjectures.
A genius cultivator that a certain powerful organization trained in secret. He had the power of a Void Cutter, but he rarely ventured out into the world.
It was definitely like this.
Xu Yan, who was on the sidelines, became increasingly certain that his conjecture was extremely correct, so he suddenly shouted, "Wait!"
