This loud shout came very abruptly and stopped Lou Wanying, who was already prepared to attack. He immediately glared resentfully at Xu Yan.
This feeling was like a person who was just about to open their mouth to sing at a karaoke when someone suddenly cut off the song.
It was no longer convenient for Xu Yan to say anything to Black Hawk, and it was even more impossible to say that Black Hawk would surrender right now. He could only express his attitude again in his own way.
He wanted to pave the way for his backup plan.
Xu Yan came up to Gu Nan and said to him, "Since that little brother accepted the challenge, then for the sake of fairness, Your Excellency also has no reason to stay out of it, right?"
"No matter whether that little brother wins later or my friend wins, the loser should still have a chance to challenge Your Excellency."
Xu Yan stared at Gu Nan with bright eyes. It seemed that as long as Gu Nan uttered a "No," he would immediately provoke public anger.
Xu Yan's words were very clever. He didn't explicitly say who would be defeated, so it seemed like he was speaking up for both participants in the match, making him look like a fair person.
Even Lou Wanying felt there was some truth in this statement when he suddenly heard it. He didn't mind the match, but there was no reason for a third person to take advantage of the situation created by this match!
Xu Yan's heart suddenly relaxed greatly when he noticed Lou Wanying's gaze.
As long as Lou Wanying approved of his words, then his plan was a success. No matter what attitude this Gu Nan had, it was impossible for him to wash his hands of this matter!
But the other party’s reaction was somewhat unexpected.
Gu Nan frowned, then turned to Jiang Tingwei and asked, "Do you only need two people?"
Jiang Tingwei seemed as if she couldn’t see the "schemes and intrigue" happening right in front of her. She nodded calmly and answered, "That’s right. There are only two vacancies on our team."
"Good," Gu Nan replied. Then his figure suddenly disappeared right under Xu Yan's stunned gaze.
The next instant, he’d already reappeared behind Black Hawk, grabbed the latter's hair with one hand, and forcefully slammed his head into the ground!
How fast was Gu Nan's speed?
As early as Tier 4, Gu Nan was already able to overwhelm other Void Cutters in terms of speed with just his body alone, so it was even easier now that he’d advanced to Tier 5.
Black Hawk was a grand Void Cutter expert, but he only felt his vision blur for a second, and then his entire head flew down rapidly, making close contact with the floor.
Bam!
A muffled and incomparably ghastly sound could be heard. Gu Nan dusted his hands off and walked back while blood continuously seeped into the ground behind him. Black Hawk was lying softly on the floor, motionless.
"There are only two people now." Gu Nan said to Jiang Tingwei, "Let's go. I'm in a hurry."
It all happened so fast. Xu Yan only just reacted, and he was already staring so hard his eyes almost popped out.
‘Black Hawk… was actually… defeated in one blow!’
Xu Yan stared at Gu Nan like he was a monster, but he didn't dare utter a word. He hurriedly ran to Black Hawk to check his injuries.
Lou Wanying was similarly stunned. His gaze kept flickering between Gu Nan and Black Hawk, and he seemed shocked by Gu Nan's brutality.
Even Jiang Tingwei, who’d always been calm and unruffled, couldn't help looking at Gu Nan with astonishment. After a long time, she said, "Please follow me, gentlemen."
She even forgot about the test she was supposed to administer. Clearly, this expert of the Seven Stars League wasn’t as calm as she appeared.
……
Gu Nan and Lou Wanying followed the Jiang siblings and soon reached the inner hall. There was already a girl waiting here. She immediately started shouting when she saw the four people coming over.
"Big Sis, Big Sis!" The girl jumped up and looked at Gu Nan. "Are they the new teammates? Hello, my name is Situ Jing, pleased to meet you!"
The last sentence was directed at Gu Nan and Lou Wanying. The girl named Situ Jing wasn’t introverted at all.
"H-Hello, I'm Lou Wanying." Lou Wanying was obviously more shy when facing girls.
Gu Nan continued his previous routine of nodding and introducing his name. Then he glanced at Jiang Tingwei. "When will we leave?"
"We can leave right away if you two don’t have any problems with it. Unforeseen events might occur at any time for the two currently deadlocked in Star Realm." Jiang Tingwei said seriously, "I’ve heard about all your requirements, and I already found a good spot."
The situation in Star Realm had been at a standstill for so long that no one knew when an unforeseen event might occur. As long as those two powerhouses even changed a single thought of theirs, it might spell the difference between life and death for this team.
"I have no problem with it!" Lou Wanying answered immediately. That eager expression surfaced again.
Gu Nan, of course, was even less likely to have a problem with this, so after sharing the coordinates, the five immediately set off for Nirvana Heaven.
……
"So this is Nirvana Heaven!" Situ Jing didn't have the bearing of a Void Cutter expert at all. She was staring up at the sky with keen interest. "Sure enough, it's the same as what the books said…"
Nirvana Heaven’s biggest characteristic was that the sky here was forever both black and white. Half was day and half was night. They were distinctly separate from each other, and the border in between them wasn’t blurred.
Every once in a while, the black and white would even switch places, but this was also a sudden change, and there was no gradual process at all.
As soon as Gu Nan saw this strange scene, he was immediately certain that this was Zuo Zuo's astral world. Wasn’t this kind of half-and-half sky just like Zuo Zuo himself?
"Nirvana Heaven is divided into sixteen domains. We’re currently in Qinggu Domain, and the Ancient Castle up ahead is the target of our operation this time," Jiang Tingwei informed everyone about the enemy’s situation.
The Ancient Castle was their target this time; it contained all the items the three parties needed.
Gu Nan wanted the life-death stone, Lou Wanying wanted a special spring water called death spring, while Jiang Tingwei's three-person team wanted the head of a Void Cutter cultivator inside the castle.
Of course Jiang Tingwei didn't pick her temporary team members randomly. She fully took care of the needs of all three parties so that they could work together and wouldn't dissolve into internal strife before the battle due to disagreements over how to distribute the spoils.
The reason Gu Nan and Lou Wanying had to wait a while earlier was precisely because she was confirming the information of all parties.
"There are four Void Cutter cultivators guarding Ancient Castle, and there’s also a protective barrier." Jiang Tingwei had a grave expression. She said in a low voice, "Taking into account the needs of our three parties, our strategy will tentatively be—"
"I'll smash open the barrier. You guys can mount a sneak attack on the target when those four Void Cutter cultivators come out," Gu Nan interrupted.
Jiang Tingwei took a deep breath. There were no problems with what he suggested. If they couldn’t even kill their target through a sneak attack, then their operation would be a joke. It’s just that…
“This is a Void Cutter Realm barrier. What if it doesn’t break? Won’t we inadvertently alert the enemies inside?!” Situ Jing always spoke her mind and had already blurted out.
Before she finished speaking, Gu Nan had already taken a step toward the other side, and his figure instantly appeared in the sky above Ancient Castle.

chapters.title: Chapter 306: The Legendary Auction?
chapters.content:
It was currently daytime in this area of Nirvana Heaven where Ancient Castle was located.
But in such "broad daylight," a figure suddenly appeared in the sky, which of course immediately alerted the guards in the castle.
"Who are you?!” An explosive shout came from below without a hint of politeness. No matter how they looked at it, a fellow like him didn’t look like a good person at all.
And Gu Nan indeed didn’t come here to be a good person. He quickly flew down and suddenly stopped at a certain point. There was a thin barrier in front of him.
Not far away, Situ Jing hadn’t even reacted to what happened yet; she didn't understand what Gu Nan was doing at all, while Jiang Tingwei was staring at Gu Nan's actions intensely.
Lou Wanying had a similar reaction. On the contrary, Jiang Zheng, who’d kept silent all this time, suddenly said, "His judgment on the position of the barrier is very accurate. He’s absolutely not a cultivator who specializes purely in tempering his physical body."
The protective barrier was created from the power of laws. A cultivator who only tempered their physical body wouldn’t possibly be able to find the position of the barrier.
"Let’s just see what level his strength has reached…" Jiang Tingwei's face also showed some helplessness when facing her younger brother. "We might be able to bask in his light this time."
Situ Jing heard some hidden meaning from the Jiang siblings’ conversation. She looked over just in time to see Gu Nan punch down.
There was no loud noise like she expected, nor were there any astonishing energy shockwaves. Just like this, the barrier that should’ve caused them a great deal of trouble was silently shattered.
"Sure enough, he’s strong…" Lou Wanying exclaimed in admiration, not seeming dispirited at all. Instead, he looked at Gu Nan with eyes that burned with fighting spirit.
"Get ready to attack!" Jiang Tingwei was still very clear-headed. She clearly still remembered the goal of her three-person team.
Sure enough, four figures simultaneously appeared the instant the barrier shattered, surrounding Gu Nan.
"Your Excellency, who are you? What's your grudge against my Ancient Castle?" One of them asked coldly. Clearly, the barrier broke so fast that they didn't even understand the situation yet.
If they knew that the barrier was shattered with a single punch, maybe none of the four would dare to show themselves.
As soon as his voice fell, another Void Cutter cultivator’s expression rapidly changed, because he clearly sensed the space surrounding himself be torn up instantly, and four figures simultaneously attacked.
It wasn’t just one enemy, but five!
Jiang Tingwei's team attacked with two swords and one spear. Coupled with Lou Wanying's simultaneous attack, they all aimed at the three-person team’s assassination target.
The weapon Lou Wanying used was very strange. It was somewhat similar to Gu Nan's shadow sword. It is a longsword formed from golden light.
However, the sword of shadow was developing in the direction of turning into laws, while Lou Wanying’s golden sword seemed to trend towards becoming a tangible object. Extremely authentic metallic patterns could even be seen on it.
The Void Cutter cultivator who was ambushed by four people suddenly fell into desperate straits, but the one who moved the fastest wasn’t actually those four, but Gu Nan.
Almost at the same time that the enemy started speaking, Gu Nan had grabbed an enemy beside him with one hand, pulled him in front of Gu Nan, and then punched him in the abdomen.
So under everyone’s surprised gazes, that poor Void Cutter didn't even get to speak before his body was instantly pierced through. Then he was casually tossed aside by Gu Nan like a dead dog.
Let alone their enemies, even Gu Nan's temporary teammates were surprised by his bold feat of killing Void Cutters like killing chickens. Situ Jing’s spear even missed its mark a little due to shock.
Fortunately, their opponent was ambushed by four people, so his escape route was completely blocked off. The space around him was also completely sealed, so he could only fight like a cornered beast.
Gu Nan’s expression didn’t even change after using a single punch to kill a Void Cutter expert who couldn't react in time.
With his current strength, there really was nothing commendable about bullying a Void Cutter cultivator. At the very least, he was still a Star Ruler, although he had yet to receive any boost in power from his astral world.
In the blink of an eye, the enemy who was cornered by four people also suffered a fatal wound.
The Jiang siblings’ two swords seemed to be some kind of combination attack, which could not only cause damage but also froze the opponent in place.
Situ Jing, on the other hand, was the opposite. Her spear wasn’t fast, but it had an amazing sharpness. Once it pierced the enemy, it would cause frightening injuries.
Their three-person team was formed through such perfect complementarity.
That opponent also saw this and knew that he had to escape as soon as possible, so he suddenly bit the tip of his tongue and spewed out a mouthful of essence blood, forming a bloody mist in front of him.
The bloody mist wrapped around the Jiang siblings’ two swords, forcibly creating an opening for him to escape. This was an opening that he risked his life to create!
This person no longer had time to think. He dashed away quickly to escape the encirclement, but he didn't expect a ray of golden light to be waiting for him.
It was Lou Wanying!
The golden sword fell abruptly, carrying an incomparably tyrannical pressure with it, which pressed the enemy down!
The Jiang siblings’ two swords suddenly changed, drawing a strange pattern in the air and shattering the enemy’s protective laws, creating the best opportunity for Situ Jing to deal the final blow.
Situ Jing also didn't let them down. Her large spear instantly pierced the enemy's chest, utterly decimating his insides and killing him completely.
The four sighed in relief. They turned to the side and saw that yet another Void Cutter enemy had fallen, while Gu Nan had grabbed the last one and was inquiring something.
"Where is the resource storehouse?" Gu Nan's voice was very calm, not sounding like he’d just killed several Void Cutters at all.
"Hmph!" The other party gave a cold snort, his expression full of disdain. "I'm only able to have today’s achievements because of the castle lord’s great kindness. If you want to kill—"
Bang!
Before he could finish, Gu Nan had already slapped his head to pieces. It wasn’t like the storehouse could run away, and these four might not necessarily be the only people to know of its location either.
Another Void Cutter expert died by Gu Nan's hands. His four teammates who stopped their actions on the other side all looked at him strangely.
There was an upper limit to the absolute power of Void Cutter cultivators. Even if some people were particularly strong, it was just because of the special application of their laws.
Just like Yue Jiu, Starry Ocean Pavilion’s Pavilion Lord who died at Gu Nan's hands earlier. His law of curses was enough to make many powerful figures in the same realm helpless against him, but it also had its own weaknesses.
But Gu Nan seemed to have surpassed this limit and reached a completely different realm from them.
Jiang Tingwei stared at him in dumbfounded shock, and a terrifying conjecture that didn’t occur to her at first gradually appeared in her mind.
"Seal off this area to prevent someone from taking the resources and escaping." Gu Nan said expressionlessly, "We’ll go and find a guide."
"Okay." Jiang Tingwei nodded, surprised by Gu Nan's meticulousness, and motioned for her younger brother to carry out the blockade work.
When they plundered from other places before this, they never considered the possibility of weaklings stealing valuables.
But Gu Nan had experienced hundreds of battles in the game. He didn’t know how many times he encountered situations where he finally killed the boss, only for weak mob monsters to snatch away the mission item. Of course he would guard against this.
Ancient Castle's situation was better than they thought. Clearly, not everyone was so tough and unafraid of death. Instead, someone came up to pledge his loyalty soon after they arrived.
It was a man who claimed to be "Wu Jing." He once worked as a manager in Ancient Castle and was familiar with its internal affairs. He skillfully led Gu Nan and the others to the resource storehouse.
"You seem like you do this kind of thing often?" Lou Wanying asked curiously.
Wu Jing smiled awkwardly. "Wars often break out in our area, and Ancient Castle has changed hands several times in recent years… Many more people only come here for the resources."
Wu Jing, a Prodigious cultivator, actually wasn’t too nervous in the face of five Void Cutter invaders. It seemed that he often encountered such situations.
The location of the resource storehouse was hidden well, but there was no decent protection. If the enemy could slaughter their way to the storehouse, then there wasn’t much meaning to placing guards here.
Wu Jing soon handed over a list of items to everyone, and the two mission items, the death spring and the life-death stones, were especially extracted.
"We can take the extra resources to Zi Luo Heaven and divide them equally there. We can exchange them for origin crystals if we don’t have a use for them." Jiang Tingwei expertly distributed the spoils. "You guys can check what you need."
"There’s no mistake! This is a high-quality death spring!" Lou Wanying nodded with satisfaction.
And a pile of sparkling and translucent white crystals were also piled in front of Gu Nan, but his face wasn’t happy.
Because the Evil God Temple clearly told him that only a small part of these life-death stones barely managed to meet the standard.
Gu Nan picked out that portion of the life-death stones and found at most 5 units here, which was half of his own needs.
Clearly, it wasn’t that easy to substitute something for 10,000 points.
"Not enough." He shook his head and looked at Jiang Tingwei. "Are there whereabouts of any life-death stones of higher quality and more quantity?"
"It’s still not enough? Let me check…"Jiang Tingwei said.
Before she could reply, Wu Jing next to her quickly cut in, "Does My Lord need top-quality life-death stones? There is one in the capital city of this domain. An auction will be held there at the end of the month, which is precisely to auction it off at a high price!"
Seeing that Gu Nan wasn’t satisfied with the resources, he was afraid that this one would stay behind and continue to plunder the castle, so he hurriedly came up with an idea.
"Okay, you can find someone to lead the way." Gu Nan nodded.
Jiang Tingwei immediately spoke, "Then let's hurry over together. We'll use these resources as a price offset to bid for the life-death stone. If it's still not enough, we'll find a way."
Jiang Tingwei didn’t like to take advantage of her teammates. She decided in her heart that this time it was a cooperation among three parties. Now that both of their parties had achieved their goals, there was no reason to leave Gu Nan hanging.
Taking these resources out as auction funds seemed to be a matter of course for her.
Lou Wanying also had no doubts and said firmly, "That's exactly how it should be!"
"No need." But Gu Nan waved his hand. "I won’t be buying it."

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Conjecture
chapters.content:
The four suddenly became speechless when they heard the words "I won’t be buying it."
And after getting his guide, Gu Nan didn’t intend to go together with them and left directly with the guide.
After looking at each other for a while, Jiang Tingwei took the lead and said, "Since Gu Nan can resolve it by himself, let's return to Zi Luo Heaven."
Situ Jing and her younger brother Jiang Zheng naturally followed her lead, but Lou Wanying frowned. "But if we leave like this, aren’t we abandoning our teammate…?"
Seeing that he seemed a little uncomfortable, Jiang Tingwei advised, "With his strength, I don't think we can help him much. On the contrary, when we meet a powerful opponent, we might even become a burden for him."
Jiang Tingwei finally persuaded Lou Wanying with the most important word—strength. The four didn't stay here any longer and soon returned to Zi Luo Heaven.
There may be unforeseen events from the two leaders in Star Realm at any time. Of course they didn’t want to stay in Nirvana Heaven any longer than necessary.
Lou Wanying left on his own, while inside Jiang Tingwei's three-person team, the relatively simple-minded Situ Jing also left without much thought, leaving only the Jiang sister and brother.
"Say, could that Gu Nan possibly be…" Jiang Tingwei asked in an uncertain tone.
In front of her younger brother, Jiang Tingwei no longer had a stiff expression and instead revealed a somewhat worried expression, which she rarely did. Very few people knew that although Jiang Tingwei made the decisions in their team, the taciturn Jiang Zheng was actually their team’s real strategist.
"To treat Void Cutter Realm as nothing, yet such a powerful person doesn’t have an obvious reputation. I’m afraid there’s only that possibility left." Jiang Zheng sighed lightly. "He is a Star Ruler."
After getting the same answer from her younger brother's mouth, Jiang Tingwei finally confirmed her guess and sighed.
Just like that, a Star Ruler had wandered in front of herself and the others. If he had any evil intentions… Fortunately, it was over. She felt lingering fear just from thinking about it.
……
On the other hand, after Lou Wanying left the Seven Stars League, he entered a remote Daoist temple and asked an unkempt Daoist in front of him, "Master, where did such a strong fellow come from?"
Lou Wanying was merely a little simple-minded, but he wasn’t truly stupid. Looking back carefully afterwards, he could also understand that Gu Nan's strength was somewhat unreasonable, completely exceeding expectations.
After hearing Lou Wanying recount everything, the unkempt Daoist Lou Wanying addressed as his master also looked puzzled as he stroked his beard with some force. "Gu Nan?"
"Master, even you haven’t heard of him?"
"Your master isn’t an immortal. How can I know every person under the sun?!” The unkempt Daoist replied grumpily on the surface, but his heart sank slightly.
At his realm, he knew that mysterious experts wouldn’t appear out of thin air for no reason at all. The Myriad Heavens Universe was only so big, and even powerful people had their own roots.
An exceedingly strong powerhouse who mysteriously appeared… If he wasn’t someone famous in disguise, then there was only one possibility left.
"In short, just don't provoke him," the Daoist solemnly told his disciple.
……
In Nirvana Heaven, Gu Nan had already reached the capital of Qinggu Domain and found a house to stay in.
Distance didn’t mean much at all for cultivators above Void Cutter Realm. They could even travel between different planes at will, much less inside a plane.
Instead, it took some trouble to find the coordinates of the capital.
"My Lord, the auction will begin in three days,” a young girl said slightly nervously as she stood before Gu Nan.
Her name was Long Xuan, a girl with a pair of exquisite dragon horns and dragon blood in her veins, who was given to Gu Nan by Wu Jing as a guide.
Before this, of course Long Xuan was indoctrinated on how powerful Gu Nan was, and since she was given as a gift, there was no possibility of going back.
"In three days? Who is holding the auction? Where did they store the auction items?" Gu Nan asked one question after another.
He had no intention of participating in the fight between Zuo Zuo and Red. He just wanted to get the items he wanted and get out of here as soon as possible.
If he could determine the exact location of the life-death stone, he didn’t mind stealing it directly.
Of course it was more reliable to steal things he couldn’t afford. Anyhow, Nirvana Heaven was Zuo Zuo's territory. His fame within Zuo Zuo’s camp will probably never get to the positives in this lifetime, so it was better to make good use of this opportunity to plunder.
Long Xuan's nervousness became more severe, and she even began to stutter, "I-I heard the seller is very mysterious… They are holding simultaneous auctions in the capitals of all sixteen domains! They invested a lot of money into the auctions!"
Even Gu Nan couldn't help being slightly taken aback.
Holding simultaneous auctions in all sixteen domains was equivalent to spreading one’s influence throughout the entire Nirvana Heaven. This kind of scale really wasn’t a normal kind of big.
The seller could do such a thing, yet the public didn’t even know the seller’s identity or where they got the goods from. This seller was indeed extraordinary.
But then Gu Nan shook his head again. The identity of the seller had nothing to do with him. All he cared about was high-quality life-death stones.
"Then I’ll just wait for a while. It's only three days." No matter how much of a hurry Gu Nan was in, he hadn’t reached the point where he couldn’t even wait for three days.
……
In a remote small plane deep in the endless starry sky, Qian Han’s head was bent over a pile of documents. He wore a pair of reading glasses and carefully examined the files one by one.
With Qian Han's current strength, his eyesight naturally wasn’t damaged in the slightest. This pair of reading glasses was just a habit left behind from his early years.
It was his habit to look up important materials personally. He would slow down his reading speed by changing the font so as to ensure that he wouldn’t miss any information.
"Gu Nan… What a terrifying young man." After a long time, he slowly took off his reading glasses, closed the files and hid them, and then sighed with emotion.
After returning from the golden giants clan, Qian Han knew that it was already impossible for him to escape, so he had no choice but to help them get rid of Gu Nan.
Since an existence like Jin Wuyin was determined to hold him hostage, Jin Wuyin naturally had plenty of ways to track him down.
So Qian Han found a small plane with a faster time flow, dug up Gu Nan's past information bit by bit, and then analyzed it word by word.
Such a meticulous analysis caused Qian Han to reach a rather terrifying conclusion.
There was definitely more to Gu Nan than meets the eye. He absolutely wasn’t as simple as just having a fast cultivation speed.
If one analyzed Gu Nan’s every move starting from his first public appearance, one would find that he almost always had a clear-cut goal behind his every action. He was just like a sword that pointed directly at the enemy’s vitals.
It's just that his goals often weren’t logically connected to his improvement in strength, which made people overlook this point.
But by looking at all of Gu Nan’s experiences at once, one could see that this situation was repeated again and again. It couldn’t possibly be a coincidence!
"This conjecture is still missing a critical link. It seems that he has a way to improve his strength from these irrelevant events… What is it?" Qian Han tapped his finger lightly, but his mind couldn't help thinking of Jin Wuyin.
‘That's right! Golden giant!’
‘If I have to name one thing in the world that I can’t understand, isn’t an otherworldly clan the greatest possibility?’
‘Gu Nan may actually be the descendant of a golden giant and may have even unexpectedly awakened some strange talent specific to his clan. That’s why he can improve his strength so quickly.’
‘As for those seemingly unrelated events… In all likelihood, they’re the secret technique of the golden giants clan!’
The more Qian Han thought about it, the more plausible it seemed. He’d already combed through all of Gu Nan's background, and the only remaining question was his abnormal cultivation speed, but the golden giant’s bloodline perfectly explained this.
At this time, another piece of information was sent to him with a red “urgent” stamp at the top.
Qian Han's gaze sharpened slightly, and he casually opened the information. The document started with such a sentence: "Traces of someone suspected of being the target were found in Nirvana Heaven. Accuracy Rating: A."

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Unforeseen Event
chapters.content:
Qian Han had built up his forces in the Myriad Heavens Universe for many years, so he naturally had an elite intelligence team under his command, which collected and analyzed all kinds of information for him.
And information the intelligence team gave an accuracy rating of A for could basically be confirmed as truth.
Qian Han opened the intelligence report and swiftly scanned it. Just a moment later, he couldn't help feeling energized—there was a 90% chance the target described in this report was Gu Nan!
He suddenly appeared in Nirvana Heaven, forcibly smashed apart the protective barrier with just the power of his physical body, and easily killed four Void Cutter cultivators…
Plus, it wasn’t hard to check the identities of his companions either. All of them were Void Cutter experts from Zi Luo Heaven. Didn't Gu Nan appear in Zi Luo Heaven before?!
Even with Qian Han's calm and experienced personality, at this time, he actually beamed with joy. Gu Nan's brief but frightening background truly gave him too much pressure.
He was extremely afraid that someone as goal-oriented as Gu Nan would refuse to interfere with any worldly matters and vanish without a trace from now on.
As for the power Gu Nan displayed, he wasn’t surprised. After all, information obtained from words wasn’t as impactful as personally witnessing the event.
Besides, Qian Han suspected Gu Nan of belonging to the golden giants clan. In that case, wouldn’t it be perfectly normal for him to have superb physical abilities?
Gu Nan didn’t hide his purpose and whereabouts from Wu Jing, so that information naturally fell into Qian Han's hands as well.
"Life-death stone, the capital of Qinggu Domain?" Qian Han revealed a trace of a smile as his figure slowly disappeared from his original location and quickly left this plane.
……
Three days wasn’t long, nor was it short.
Gu Nan sat quietly in the house, and soon the day of the auction arrived. In the past three days, he also didn’t stop making discreet inquiries into the auction.
Unfortunately, there was still no news about the mysterious seller, let alone finding out where the goods were stored.
Or rather, for auctions of this level, the auction items were definitely secretly stored in other planes, where they would be slowly transported into Nirvana Heaven once the auction began.
Thus, unless someone could snatch the treasures from right under countless powerful people’s noses, there was no need to worry about security.
When it was time for the auction, Gu Nan tore open the void directly and descended at the scene, but he didn’t bring the half-dragon girl, nor did he have any admission ticket.
However, there was no chance of a cliche drama like "being refused admission" happening—anyone who could arrive using this method was bound to be at least Void Cutter Realm!
Do Void Cutter experts need a ticket to enter?
Seeing Gu Nan's arrival, two people immediately went up to him. After greeting him, they respectfully handed a black label with a number on it, and one person then led Gu Nan into the venue.
Gu Nan was led to a quiet room, which was clearly on the second floor of the venue. Through windows on the floor, he could get a panoramic view of the entire scene.
Before long, the lights in the venue began to dim, and all of them focused on the central stage. An enchanting woman with a lithe figure and a snake’s lower body slithered up to the stage.
A lot of clamoring instantly came from the audience as they laughed boisterously and made a lot of noise.
After all, there were only a few Void Cutter figures here, so the main participants in the auction were still the large number of Prodigious cultivators, and this lamia woman was obviously popular and well-received among them.
"That's Leng Yedie!"
"Didn’t a certain bigshot take her away? To think she would be the auctioneer here…"
"What’s taken away can also be given back! Tsk tsk, I really want to know who this auction’s mysterious seller is. What an expensive auction!"
Similar conversations kept popping up, mostly expressing surprise at the capabilities of the auction organizers.
Leng Yedie was a celebrity in Qinggu Domain, which was why she was the auctioneer here. That meant the other domains naturally had similar candidates acting as auctioneers—this auction was simultaneously held in all sixteen domains!
Just when people were constantly sighing in amazement at the seller's wealth and power, Leng Yedie finally spoke cheerfully from the stage:
"Ladies and gentlemen, fellow cultivators…"
The opening was nothing special, but Leng Yedie's voice was soft and tactful, yet it contained a strange feeling of disharmony that tickled people's hearts.
Gu Nan, however, sat in the room on the second floor, his face expressionless from beginning to end as he coldly looked down at the auction.
The opening was over, and the first auction item was being brought up slowly, but this wasn’t Gu Nan's goal.
According to the auction list, the life-death stone he needed would be the fourth item to appear on stage.
At this moment, however, he smelled a strange fragrance slowly emanating from the room, and an illusion began to appear in front of his eyes.
It was a Buddha in a golden kasaya, saluting him with both hands placed together.
"Amitabha. Benefactor, please go to hell."
……
The auction wasn’t progressing very quickly, but the atmosphere was very enthusiastic. Leng Yedie was clearly an excellent auctioneer. Not only could she whip up the mood, but she could also drag out the auction and raise the price as much as possible.
So the first three items alone had already sold at sky-high prices, and when the fourth item was ready to be unveiled, the atmosphere at the scene had also reached its peak.
"Life-death stone! Life-death stone!"
"Stop talking and just bring the top-quality life-death stone up already!"
The first three rounds of auctions had completely heated up the atmosphere, and the audience was more and more engrossed in the auction items.
Life-death stones were a specialty product of Nirvana Heaven, but that didn’t mean there was no demand for them from the locals!
On the contrary, the outside world would only use life-death stones on special occasions, while many locals took advantage of life-death stones to cultivate or even create new techniques, so life-death stones had become a routine necessity for them.
Leng Yedie lived up to their enthusiasm. A crystal stone almost as big as a palm was slowly moved onto the auction table.
The shouting from below became more and more exuberant, but Leng Yedie didn’t read the classic auction item intro.
Instead, she covered her mouth with a chuckle. "Everyone, let me tell you something else: in these simultaneous auctions across sixteen domains, the fourth auction item for all sixteen domains is a life-death stone!"
Her words puzzled everyone, and even the clamoring died down a bit. Simultaneously auctioning life-death stones—what did this mean?
On the stage, Leng Yedie’s laughter didn’t stop, but it began to reveal a coldness that wasn’t there before. "Of course life-death stones… are used for the formation cores of the Grand Nirvana Killing Formation!"
As her voice fell, endless crimson light surged up from the ground, and killing intent that overflowed to the heavens enveloped the entire scene. The crimson light was most intense on the center stage where Leng Yedie was located.
Only then did people discover that the three treasures previously auctioned off were also glowing blood-red as they automatically flew out from the hands of the three buyers… Clearly, they were auxiliary materials for the grand formation!
"Trap! This auction is a trap from beginning to end!" Someone realized that something was wrong, but their reaction seemed a little slow.
"Grand Nirvana Killing Formation? Isn't this an ancient formation?! To think there are still people who know it…"
It wasn’t like the cultivators of Nirvana Heaven had never considered the possibility of the mysterious seller harboring ill intentions, but so many powerful figures had joined the auction. Who could’ve imagined that the seller would truly dare to attack them?!
Someone else began to ask the person on stage, "Leng Yedie, your family and sect are all here. What's in it for you?"
But Leng Yedie just sneered. The seductive aura around her slowly faded. Finally, she placed her hands together, as if in meditative prayer.
"The Buddha is merciful. Since Benefactors aren’t willing to place down the butcher’s knife, then you might as well go to hell."
She said this with both coldness and compassion; two completely different auras were revealed at the same time.
The audience was unable to respond for a while. The scarlet light that kept on appearing from the ground sealed their laws and gradually devoured their power.
Someone began to glance back at the second floor, where all the bigshots were sitting. ‘Don’t tell me they’ll just sit back and watch this happen?’
Of course Leng Yedie noticed their actions, but she didn't do anything. The sneer on her face just became more pronounced.
Those Void Cutter cultivators were naturally their priority targets. Another large formation had already silently activated just to trap them.
If all went well, the Void Cutter experts should all be trapped inside the Buddhist Realm.
‘Now we just need to place the life-death stone at the formation core and activate the Grand Nirvana Killing Formation… Eh?’
When Leng Yedie turned her head, she was shocked to find a figure standing right next to her, playing with the life-death stone in his hand with great interest.
……
Beyond the endless starry sky, a young girl was sitting on a black lotus, chanting something.
A figure appeared in front of her and whispered, "Buddhist Ancestor, an unforeseen event has occurred in Nirvana Heaven… Someone broke out of the Buddhist Realm."
"Oh?" The young girl slowly opened her eyes and said indifferently, "Just in time. This one has finally returned to Star Ruler Realm. Let's see how strong this troublemaker is."

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Start of the Decisive Battle
chapters.content:
Buddha.
The endless Buddhist chants; the boundless Buddhist kingdom.
The entire auction site seemed to have transformed into a kingdom of tens of thousands of Buddhas. Innumerable Buddhist intent seemed to be hidden throughout the space, and one Buddha after another appeared in the surroundings as golden lotuses bloomed in large numbers.
But the background of such a scene was the horrifying killing formation dyed an endless crimson. The brilliant red light and Buddhist intent were perfectly combined.
In all of heaven and earth, there was only one person who could do such a thing—the young girl Wu Gui, who returned through reincarnation and transformed from a Buddha into a demon.
Wu Gui had been plotting this event for Nirvana Heaven for a long time, so she was already well-aware of the terrain here. At this time, she arrived at the location of the unforeseen variable with a single step.
Thus, an incomparably familiar figure that she didn't want to see at all appeared in front of her.
Leng Yedie was still staring blankly, dazed. When she saw someone take away the life-death stone, she suddenly changed color, showing anger. "You are—"
Before she could finish, she was blocked by an invisible force and gently pushed aside.
Such a gentle method naturally came from the Wu Gui behind her. If Gu Nan was the one who made a move just now, then she would’ve already lost her head.
Leng Yedie turned in astonishment and saw Wu Gui. Immediately, she panicked so much that she didn’t even know where to put her hands. When she saluted, she stared straight at Wu Gui, just like a believer on a pilgrimage.
"How come it's you again?" Wu Gui looked like she had a headache. She felt that every time she wanted to do something, she would always run into this guy in front of her.
Gu Nanwas currently verifying the quality of the life-death stone in his mind. The life-death stone in front of his eyes met the Evil God Temple’s requirements, both in terms of quality and quantity. The "Apostle Hall" structure could be constructed now.
Gu Nan, who was in a good mood, still had time to wave the life-death stone around and replied, "I need this. I heard that you guys have it here, so I came."
I need this. You guys have it, so I came to take it.
This reasoning, which sounded perfectly logical, was very acceptable to Wu Gui. She’d long been accustomed to Gu Nan's style.
"But I’m using this to kill people. If you take it, then what will I do here?" Wu Gui asked with a faint smile, but her eyes kept studying Gu Nan.
Her strength was quickly and continuously recovering. In recent days, she finally completely rebuilt her own laws and returned to Star Ruler Realm, so she was just looking for an opponent to try her hand.
There was no insurmountable gap between Star Rulers and Void Cutters, but there were still some differences.
Especially for a reincarnated old monster like Wu Gui, she had too many ways to take advantage of her superior cultivation realm.
But the next second, she realized something was wrong.
Gu Nan tilted his head, and his gaze suddenly became dangerous. A strong wind immediately rushed at her.
A punch without any embellishment smashed straight at Wu Gui’s face!
Gu Nan's Evil God physique after advancing to Tier 5 was already not much weaker than his previous deity mode in Tier 4. At most, it only lacked the overbearing pressure that oppressed everything.
But although his punch was fast, Wu Gui’s reaction wasn’t the slightest bit slow either.
Her whole body glowed a brilliant gold. Three pairs of arms suddenly appeared behind her back, and two heads also appeared on either side of her head—three heads and eight arms, the Buddha’s true body!
It's just that her Buddha's body was very strange. Of the two heads, one was a Buddha and the other a demon. One had a relaxed and serene expression, while the other looked ferocious and frightening.
Even for the arms behind her, half made Buddhist hand seals while the other half used demonic path seals.
Faced with Gu Nan's punch, Wu Gui didn’t intend to hold back any power at all. 1,298 Buddhist and demonic intents instantly layered on top of each other as she pushed both her hands outward.
Gu Nan's current soul was extremely powerful, so he’d already captured this entire scene in his mind, but he paid no regard to it and continued swinging his fist forward.
The fist and palms collided, but no sound traveled out. The surrounding space collapsed instantly, and tendrils of darkness quickly overflowed from all around them.
Neither of them cared about limiting the collateral damage, so the pitch-black darkness that was still mere tendrils an instant before suddenly spread all over the scene in the blink of an eye.
Hundreds of Prodigious cultivators, including Leng Yedie on the side, were directly crushed into dust without even getting to scream.
The Void Cutters were also struggling just to stay alive. The battle between these two Star Ruler powerhouses at their full power shattered space itself, which nearly destroyed the Void Cutter cultivators present.
After a long time, the darkness finally receded slowly. The characteristics of space fracturing naturally separated the two, but no one gained the upper hand in this fight.
However, it was clear to Wu Gui that the other side actually had the upper hand.
She was only able to block her opponent’s attack by mobilizing all of her laws, while the other party just used the strength of his physical body… Even from a stamina perspective, the opponent still had the advantage.
Gu Nan also didn't continue attacking. He’d never had any interest in enemies like this who couldn’t be killed in one punch but also didn’t drop anything upon death.
Instead, Wu Gui stood still, staring at Gu Nan with eyes full of disbelief.
She wasn’t someone like Qian Han, who remained at Void Cutter Realm for his whole life. She knew the difference between a Star Ruler and a Void Cutter very well.
Even if Gu Nan didn’t deliberately use his law, that feeling of perfected attainment and laws was undoubtedly that of a Star Ruler!
So Wu Gui fell silent. She studied Gu Nan with a hesitant look. "You… advanced to Star Ruler Realm?"
"Mm." Gu Nan nodded casually and turned to leave. He even opened a crack in space already.
But then he suddenly stopped, because he realized that this world was showing signs of collapse.
……
On the other side of the Myriad Heavens Universe, in the deepest part of Star Realm, Red’s face was pale, while Zuo Zuo still stood in front of her coldly.
As the exceptionally strong Star Ruler who ruled over Nirvana Heaven, Zuo Zuo's strength was already above Red’s to begin with, and that gap wasn’t small.
If it were two Star Rulers with similar strength, they would’ve already crumbled from the pressure if they tried to remain in someone else’s astral world for several years like him.
But using his own strength, Zuo Zuo managed to suppress Red inside her home field of Star Realm for several years, leaving the entire Star Realm riddled with holes…
If Gu Nan hadn't appeared out of nowhere, maybe Red would have completely fallen by now.
Of course, if there was no Gu Nan, maybe Zuo Zuo wouldn’t have been able to find Immortal Demon World at all and wouldn’t have returned to Star Realm.
Ignoring all these “what-ifs” for the time being, a figure was currently standing between Zuo Zuo and Red inside Red’s palace. She wore a blood-red windbreaker and had a petite figure. She was precisely Ying Ge.
"My dear younger brother… You haven't changed at all in all these years!" Ying Ge covered her mouth and smiled, but the smile didn’t reach her eyes. Her gaze merely contained deep-rooted killing intent.
The boy half of Zuo Zuo's face became more and more kind, while the girl half of his face became more and more ferocious and even began to laugh wildly. "You still dare to appear in front of me?"
His two halves seemed to be out of harmony, and two voices appeared alternately.
"You're just a fake! A defective product!"
"I am the perfect one!"
"What are you trying to prove by running here now?!”
"Do you want to say that you succeeded? Ridiculous… Ridiculous! As long as… As long as I kill you…"
Zuo Zuo's voice began to separate on both sides, shrill and penetrating one second and deep and gloomy the next. But in the end, his voice settled into the tone of a normal middle-aged man.
"As long as I kill you, no one will know who I am."

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Zuo Zuo’s Origin
chapters.content:
"It’s starting," Wu Gui’s voice was calm, yet it was also somewhat melancholy.
Clearly, not even she got to witness the collapse of a “Heaven” Level astral world very often.
At her side, the space fractured by her fight with Gu Nan didn’t show any signs of automatically repairing itself. Instead, it cracked apart even further.
A faint scene seemed to be projected into the sky of Nirvana Heaven. It was the scene currently happening inside Red’s palace.
It’s just that people in this world could only see Zuo Zuo's "first person perspective." It seemed that he had indeed reached the most critical juncture and nearly fused with his astral world.
……
"Who are you?"
"What are you afraid of?"
"Do you really believe… that no one knows?"
One question after another constantly popped out of Ying Ge’s mouth. Zuo Zuo's expression distorted more and more, and even his body began to twist and warp.
His voice, however, remained that of a middle-aged man, "Know? Who knows this? As long as I kill you…"
A sneer appeared on Ying Ge’s face. "Listen carefully to your voice right now! You may be able to fool the world, but can you fool us? My dear… Father?"
As Ying Ge’s voice fell, Zuo Zuo’s movements suddenly jerked, and then he roared like he’d gone crazy, "Kill! Kill you! I'm Zuo Zuo, I'm the lord of Nirvana Heaven. I… Where's my power?!”
Zi Yi and Zi Dian, the mother-and-son pair watching this from a corner of Zi Luo Heaven, sighed at the same time when they saw this. "So it really is him."
Only Red looked unruffled. She just stood up calmly and spoke indifferently.
"That year, when the fusion experiment reached the final step, you were fatally injured and dying. You couldn’t even preserve your soul."
"So you cut your son and daughter apart and fused their respective halves together, after which you poured your own soul into the new vessel, living as a parasite on your son’s main soul.”
"But you never could’ve imagined that the experiment you held such high hopes for was still stuck at the final step even now, trapping you in this half-human half-ghost state for ten thousand years."
"What you also didn’t expect was that the other halves of the son and daughter you abandoned back then spontaneously combined and even fused together perfectly, without any signs of rejection."
Red seemed like she was narrating something completely unrelated to herself, exposing Zuo Zuo’s past deeds to the public bit by bit, but this was akin to plunging the tip of the sharpest blade into Zuo Zuo's body.
Red walked up to Ying Ge's side and stroked her long blood-colored hair. "I gave her the Blood Ancestor’s origin and had her cleanse herself of your influence from generation to generation. Finally, she was able to completely rid herself of the part that belongs to you guys…"
……
Inside Nirvana Heaven, Wu Gui revealed a look of sudden realization. "So Zuo Zuo has always been two people. No wonder…"
After all, she wasn’t personally involved in that past incident, so her understanding of Zuo Zuo wasn’t as deep as those involved. It wasn’t until she heard Red's narrative that she gradually understood.
Zuo Zuo was indeed the one from back then, but his body contained two souls—father and son. The son was the main soul and the father was the secondary soul, so Zuo Zuo would often behave abnormally.
Wu Gui set aside all kinds of thoughts, only to find Gu Nan studying his surroundings, looking entirely unsurprised.
"You're not surprised? You knew this a long time ago?" Her eyes narrowed slightly. If Gu Nan knew about it in advance, then maybe he…
"Know what?" Gu Nan gave her a confused look and immediately realized, "Oh, you’re talking about Zuo Zuo… Not interested."
Gu Nan used a firm "Not interested" to block all of Wu Gui’s suspicions at the bottom of her heart.
Of course Gu Nan wasn’t interested in this kind of cutscene CG. He was busy observing the situation in Nirvana Heaven. If this place really collapsed, then it wasn’t a bad idea to collect it as a personal dungeon.
Players were able to do more in the Divine Kingdom stage, and conquering other dungeons was of course one of them.
But just then, the sky above the two gradually cracked again, and a ray of golden light slowly shone through.
……
Ying Ge forced Zuo Zuo into a corner as soon as she appeared and even exposed his origins to the public. It could be seen that his urgent need to kill Ying Ge earlier was absolutely the correct decision.
But on the other hand, Zuo Zuo was still a powerful Star Ruler. He wasn’t so weak as to allow the entire situation to completely collapse because of a sentence from Ying Ge.
In fact, even now, the initiative was still in his hands. As long as he could overcome his heart demon of ten thousand years, he could still get back his own power.
"My… My power…" Zuo Zuo's two voices were constantly intertwined, sometimes young and sometimes mature.
At that moment, he suddenly raised a hand and stabbed it directly into his chest!
In his thoracic cavity, under the complex web of blood vessels, a red and blue heart was beating. At this moment, the red part was completely stripped away.
Ying Ge’s expression turned grave. She also didn't expect for the other party to actually destroy his own core so as to obtain a temporary peace.
This was burning his own lifeboat!
The energy surging around Zuo Zuo gradually subsided, and his eyes slowly calmed down as well. He stared at Ying Ge icily. "You have people in Nirvana Heaven."
He could clearly sense the power coming from his astral world weakening at an extremely fast rate, and even his connection to it became erratic.
"It's all thanks to you." Ying Ge sneered. "If you hadn't stayed here for several years, Wu Gui wouldn’t have been able to arrange everything so calmly inside Nirvana Heaven."
Although Zuo Zuo’s presence in Star Realm suppressed Red completely, it also caused him to neglect Nirvana Heaven.
"So it was her." Zuo Zuo nodded. He gently opened his palm and instantly destroyed the red and blue heart.
Ying Ge and Red froze at the same time. They thought that Zuo Zuo would become hysterical, would bite back like a cornered cat, or would destroy indiscriminately, but it never occurred to them that he might do this.
This is… suicide?
Unlike other powerhouses, Zuo Zuo’s vessel was fused together from two bodies. He would fall apart immediately once his core was destroyed.
However, just as they were staring blankly, an inexplicable law fluctuation suddenly appeared behind Red.
Red, who’d been deadlocked with Zuo Zuo for several years, was already a spent force. She was instantly pierced by this law, leaving a bloody hole in her chest.
Ying Ge whirled around in alarm. Zuo Zuo's original body had already disappeared upon being destroyed, but behind Red, there were two halves of a body.
The two halves each only had one side, as if someone had made a clean cut down the middle with a sharp knife.
"What kind of law is this…" Dumbstruck, Ying Ge stared at this scene. With her ten thousand years of knowledge, she actually didn't recognize the root law behind this eerie scene.
Until finally, a cold voice arrived belatedly:
"Life and death, left and right."
The voice seemed to ring out of thin air, but Ying Ge suddenly turned around, because she clearly recognized that the timbre was from Zuo Zuo’s female half!
"There was a third soul… Who are you?!” Ying Ge finally realized that something was wrong. Everything before had gone too smoothly, so smoothly that it was unbelievable.
Since Zuo Zuo already knew about her existence, would he not have a backup plan?
The woman who obtained half of Zuo Zuo's body didn't answer her. She just minded her own business and tried moving her new hand and foot.
Zuo Zuo looked down at Red and finally revealed a victorious smile. "That little fellow isn’t the only genius to appear in such a good place like Star Realm… You missed too many."
Of course Red was also surprised, but the situation felt more comical to her. "You gave her half of your body. Do you think you can still take it back?"
But Zuo Zuo laughed. "I still have Nirvana Heaven. What can she use to fight against me? Do you think that you can completely destroy my astral world with just a Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara… Huh?"
Even if he only had a weak connection with Nirvana Heaven, Zuo Zuo still sensed an astonishing law descend upon his astral world with alarming clarity.
……
Nirvana Heaven.
Gu Nan and Wu Gui looked up at the same time. A huge golden figure appeared at the junction of the black and white sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon
chapters.content:
Golden light spilled down. Jin Wuyin was like an invincible giant, descending with terrifying might.
As a golden giant with the purest bloodline, Jin Wuyin could always remain in his true form. On the contrary, the human form he normally used was the result of deliberately restraining his powers.
Qian Han stood quietly beside Jin Wuyin with a smile on his face, looking at Gu Nan and Wu Gui below.
‘Even if you're as cunning as a fox, this old man still caught you!’
Now that he was collecting the fruit of his victory, even the extremely shrewd Qian Han couldn't help feeling some joy in his heart. He really put too much effort into finding Gu Nan's whereabouts.
"A Star Ruler level golden giant?" Wu Gui frowned slightly. Jin Wuyin fully displayed his own power, which allowed her to see his background at a glance.
This situation made Wu Gui somewhat perplexed.
‘Since when were Star Rulers so worthless that they keep on appearing one after another?’
Under normal circumstances, even in the Myriad Heavens Universe, the probability of seeing a Star Ruler was infinitesimal.
If Prodigious cultivators stood at the peak of the secular world and Void Cutter cultivators had taken their first step out of the mortal world, then Star Ruler cultivators were lifeforms on a completely different level from the first two.
Perhaps Void Cutters may still need mortal organizations to handle matters for them and collect cultivation resources, but Star Rulers didn’t need that at all.
Most of their energy was spent in the Inner World, looking for a suitable astral world in the Myriad Heavens Starry Road.
In other words, Star Rulers were more concerned about the world itself and not the people living inside it.
"You are Gu Nan?" As soon as Jin Wuyin appeared, he asked with a thundering rumble, followed closely by his fist.
A question was a question, but he didn’t plan to pause his hand movement just to ask a question.
Gu Nan also didn’t pause. He retaliated with a punch of his own without hesitation and even threw himself forward, heading straight for Jin Wuyin.
"Golden giant, you came just in time!" On the contrary, Gu Nan was actually a little happy that Jin Wuyin delivered himself right to his door.
This wasn’t like the time when he first saw Young Master Jin. Back then, he was busy building his Divine Kingdom and had a thousand things to do, so he didn't have the energy to care about anything else.
But the foundation of Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was already established now, and he had a stable source of both resources and points, so he naturally had more energy to consider other matters.
The world outside the Myriad Heavens Universe, for one. Subduing certain suitable otherworldly clans to serve as his apostles, for another.
Punch against punch!
How strong was Gu Nan's Tier 5 Evil God physique? Not even Wu Gui could oppose him with just her Buddhist true body alone. She had to bring out her Buddhist and demonic intent to barely withstand it.
On the other hand, as the chief of the golden giants clan, Jin Wuyin’s body was his most powerful weapon!
Different from the fight against Wu Gui earlier, this time the collision of the two punches caused an ear-piercing explosion.
Then the two each took a step back and landed on the ground with enough force for their feet to sink into the ground, sending a cloud of smoke flying up.
This punch was an honest to god collision; it didn’t end at merely destroying the opponent’s laws. The terrifying force gave both sides rather serious injuries.
Gu Nan's right hand was almost completely broken; bones were jutting out from his elbow. Jin Wuyin, on the other hand, fared no better. His hand was badly mutilated, and his wrist was broken at a strange angle.
"You’re absolutely not from my golden giants clan. Who are you?" Jin Wuyin’s right hand trembled slightly, unable to hide the surprise in his heart, as he asked loudly.
He originally believed that Gu Nan was a descendent of his clan and wanted to subdue him and bring him back to the clan, so he didn't use his full power.
But even without his full power, it was still impossible for a golden giant to fight him to such a standstill without transforming into their true body—unless the other party wasn’t one of the golden giants in the first place!
But Gu Nan's right hand was recovering rapidly. Almost in the blink of an eye, the bones had healed completely and the skin was also growing quickly.
This made Jin Wuyin, whose injuries recovered extremely slowly, stare so hard that his eyes almost popped out.
For a naturally-gifted race like them, the stronger their bodies, the longer it took them to recover from injuries. On the contrary, if one’s physical strength came from various external buffs, then there would be no limitation in this respect.
"The golden clan… Are you guys interested in becoming my apostles?" Gu Nan asked with a light smile, but his hand didn’t hesitate as he directly activated a law.
He knew that Jin Wuyin didn’t use his full power in the earlier punch. It was quite troublesome to deal with Jin Wuyin in Gu Nan’s normal state.
So he threw out a skill without hesitation—Deity’s Descent! A Deity’s Descent strengthened by the power of shadows!
Rays of black light lit up from behind Gu Nan. An incomparably majestic and gloomy aura flowed out little by little, almost covering the whole world.
"This…" Wu Gui stared at this scene in shock. Behind her, the Asura half of her avatar suddenly jerked like it was about to break away from her control.
She was originally happily watching from the sidelines when Gu Nan suddenly did this. That gloomy aura spreading crazily almost drew out her demonic nature!
The terrifying black fog was still pouring out endlessly, almost completely wrapping Gu Nan up.
His body quickly grew in size and even turned a dark color. His originally black pupils also contained hints of purple now.
And the black fog surrounding his entire body finally gathered behind him, turning into pairs of skeletal wings—twelve wings exactly, no more and no less. They looked sinister and frightening.
Even Gu Nan didn't recognize himself after this change. He looked back in astonishment and muttered, "The hell is this? Twelve-Winged Skeletal Angel?"
Even in his past life’s game, there weren’t many people who truly used the Deity law.
This thing required a large investment in the early stage and had a long cooldown time. It belonged to the "five seconds as a real man" category of skills, so not everyone liked to use it.
And after Gu Nan leveled up to Tier 5, this skill was further strengthened by the power of shadows, so not even Gu Nan himself could predict the current appearance of Deity’s Descent.
However, he soon knew the answer, because Jin Wuyin and Wu Gui blurted out almost simultaneously, "Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon!"
Nine heavens as Heaven, and nine abysses as Earth. The power of shadows had a dark attribute to begin with, so the deity that should’ve been in the nine heavens naturally fell into the nine abysses after being dominated by the power of shadows, turning into a demon.
In the Myriad Heavens Universe’s original records, the Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon was exactly what Gu Nan resembled right now.
"Heavenly Demon?" Of course Gu Nan heard Jin Wuyin and Wu Gui. He glanced at his dark purple skin and felt the increase in power the twelve wings behind him brought, and pretty much tacitly admitted to this.
Wu Gui unobtrusively retreated a step. This situation had already exceeded her expectations, but it also explained her long-standing question.
Gu Nan actually advanced at a pace even faster than the speed at which she recovered her own powers. How was that possible?
‘So he’s the reincarnation of a Heavenly Demon!’
‘Now that he’s returned to Star Ruler Realm, he finally displayed the power of his past life!’
With such thoughts in her heart, one doubt after another seemed to be cleared… Wu Gui studied Gu Nan with a deep gaze.
Jin Wuyin, on the other hand, felt his lips twitch slightly. He wanted to run away, only to realize that the surrounding space had been frozen by that majestic aura, so there was no escape.
Under such circumstances, he turned and ran without another word—although space was sealed off right now, his incomparably strong body could at least still run!
Thus, the Qian Han beside him was exposed. Facing this white-haired old man who’d broken out in a cold sweat, Gu Nan revealed a "kind" smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Punched to Death
chapters.content:
"Golden giant, Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon…"
Zuo Zuo, who was in Star Realm, felt his mouth start twitching when he sensed the auras from his own astral world.
‘How come these things that haven’t been sighted in hundreds of years all decided to appear at this critical juncture?!’
Even if they were awfully busy fighting each other and didn’t have time to rob Nirvana Heaven together, the collateral damage from their battle alone was enough to affect him.
His connection to his astral world was already weak to begin with. Now, it was even harder for him to receive any power from his astral world.
Zuo Zuo, who only had half of his body left, swept his gaze across the three women around him, his expression turning more and more grim.
Gu Nian, who used her unique law to resurrect Zuo Zuo at the cost of taking away the other half of his body, would naturally become his enemy and fight with him over control of the remaining half of his body, not to mention there was also Red and Ying Ge.
In short, everyone in this place was his enemy.
‘Then, let’s fight the decisive battle…’
……
In Nirvana Heaven, the Gu Nan who transformed into a Heavenly Demon neutralized Qian Han with a casual blow, instantly shattering all of Qian Han’s laws.
Gu Nan already discovered that the most powerful part of his deity mode—or rather, Heavenly Demon mode—lies not in the strength itself, but in its ability to naturally seal off space.
In the past, Wu Gui went through a great deal of effort in order to temporarily seal off Yue Jiu’s escape routes with her Buddha Kingdom.
But after Gu Nan used his Deity law, the law nullification attribute that came preinstalled in the deity’s aura was enough to completely solidify his surrounding space.
Because of this, Qian Han had no chance to escape at all, and Jin Wuyin could only run away with his legs.
"Can you really escape though?" Looking at the Jin Wuyin that almost disappeared from sight, Gu Nan merely smiled coldly. He took a step out and instantly appeared behind Jin Wuyin.
Jin Wuyin looked back in inconsolable horror, wondering why Gu Nan could still teleport. Since space itself was solidified, Gu Nan shouldn’t be able to use any spacial abilities either.
But he understood in the next instant—this wasn’t teleportation at all, just pure speed!
A more terrifying speed had yet to come. Without Jin Wuyin noticing in the slightest, Gu Nan's fist had landed on his face and instantly knocked him into the ground.
Gu Nan's Heavenly Demon body was also completely composed of laws. Not only did his fist contain a terrifying strength, but it also held countless laws of the nine abysses.
Corrosion, dissolution, erosion, disintegration… Many malicious yet efficient laws constantly emerged on Jin Wuyin’s face.
The mighty body of this golden giant seemed to turn into a law testing machine, testing the strength of all these laws.
Jin Wuyin was directly knocked down by this punch, and even his face showed signs of bone fractures. For a while, even getting up was hard for him, so punch after punch continuously hit their mark.
Gu Nan had already discovered that his Deity law underwent some changes after his advancement to Tier 5.
During Tier 4, the Deity law mainly reinforced his physical body, while the Tier 5 “Deity’s Descent” seemed to pay more attention to damage inflicted by the laws that were attached to the attack.
Gu Nan's experience was extremely rich, so he understood what was going on in the blink of an eye—his current Evil God physique had already reached the maximum possible limit before the First Round!
The First Round was a threshold. Before stepping past this threshold by advancing to Tier 6, there was an upper limit to his physical strength, and the deity’s power could only be reflected in laws.
But this also showed that the strength of Gu Nan's current physical body was already at the very peak of those in his same realm, not counting those Star Rulers who had their own astral worlds.
In the end, Jin Wuyin was still a golden giant. Even though he couldn’t fight back at all under Gu Nan's blows, he had no intention of giving up.
Taking advantage of a gap between Gu Nan's attacks, he finally managed to just barely block a punch, then immediately got up and fled.
Although his body was already covered with wounds, he still hadn’t given up hope yet—‘This guy caused such a big ruckus. Why hasn't the Star Ruler of this astral world appeared yet?!’
‘Hey! Your home is going to be smashed to pieces!’
Jin Wuyin frantically fled while cursing this place’s "incompetent Star Ruler" in his heart.
He, who lived outside the Myriad Heavens Universe all year round, truly didn’t know about the major events in the Myriad Heavens Universe.
……
Zuo Zuo, who was cursed as an "incompetent Star Ruler" by Jin Wuyin, was in much worse shape than Jin Wuyin.
With only half of his body left, even his strength was halved, and he couldn’t receive assistance from Nirvana Heaven. Right now, he was in imminent danger.
Fortunately, among his opponents, Gu Nian hadn’t finished familiarizing herself with her new body yet, Red was seriously injured by his sneak attack just now, and Ying Ge’s strength only recovered to Void Cutter Realm.
It was precisely such a trio of the old, the weak, and the crippled that left Zuo Zuo with a glimmer of hope of survival.
Zuo Zuo suddenly froze briefly under the three’s flurry of attacks. A dark shadow emerged in front of him, blocking the three’s attacks, while he tore open space and stepped into the void.
He didn't even care about taking back the other half of his body and turned to run away!
Gu Nian followed him into the crack in space without even thinking about it. Ying Ge frowned slightly, then gritted her teeth and also tried to follow them inside, but she was stopped by Red.
"Let him go." Red's face was extremely pale, but her voice was calm, "Let's destroy Nirvana Heaven instead. We can let those two fight to their hearts’ content."
Ying Ge’s eyes suddenly brightened as she understood Red’s meaning.
A body couldn’t be divided into two for a prolonged period of time. For Gu Nian and Zuo Zuo, only one of them could live. They were natural enemies. As long as Red and Ying Ge took control of Nirvana Heaven and prevented Zuo Zuo from receiving extra help from his astral world, neither side would win!
……
In Nirvana Heaven, Jin Wuyin’s body was already about to collapse. His escape only resulted in taking a few less hits; it was impossible for him to escape Gu Nan’s utterly terrifying speed.
This golden giants clan chief really could take a beating. Even though his whole body was enveloped by the power of laws and his breathing was getting weaker, he could still speak.
"Your Excellency, the golden clan has no enmity with you…" Before he could seemingly admit defeat or even surrender, Gu Nan's fist fell down again.
This punch seemed to trigger a qualitative change, tilting Jin Wuyin’s head and twisting his neck at an unnatural angle.
The next moment, endless darkness poured out from Gu Nan’s body and crazily swallowed Jin Wuyin up.
"You’re not going to leave him alive?" Wu Gui had already come to his side at some point.
"I'm going to visit the golden giants clan. It's enough to have one guide leading the way." Gu Nan pointed to Qian Han, who was still locked up over there.
Since he was interested in the golden clan, of course it was impossible for their patriarch to live. He didn’t need a leader with strong authority over the clan.
"Too bad. Zuo Zuo didn’t actually die." Gu Nan shook his head again.
If the Star Ruler wasn’t dead, then no one could take away his astral world, not unless Gu Nan found this world’s origin. But in the enormous Nirvana Heaven, this would be quite a huge undertaking.
Besides, if Zuo Zuo was defeated, many people would probably be interested in Nirvana Heaven.
Perhaps even now, people in the Myriad Heavens Starry Road were already fighting over this. If Gu Nan spent all that time and effort to search for the origin inside Nirvana Heaven, only to have someone snatch away the origin directly inside the Starry Road, then it would truly be wasted effort.
Gu Nan still maintained the body of a Heavenly Demon. After Tier 5, it seemed that even the transformation time was lengthened. He picked Qian Han up, planning to return to his Divine Kingdom.
"This person, can you give him to me?" A distant voice traveled over from the sky. Red and Ying Ge had arrived. "I can also provide the location of the golden giants clan."
Upon seeing Red arrive from a distance, despair filled Qian Han’s eyes.
Red’s voice was no different from back then, just like when Gu Nan first met her, but Gu Nan was no longer the same.
"Why?" Gu Nan placed Qian Han down next to him and asked.
Red said calmly, "He betrayed me and knows some of my secrets. I won't let him live."
Gu Nan scratched his head and stared at her like he was looking at a fool. "Since he’s so valuable, you want to take him away with just a sentence?"

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Shatter Everything
chapters.content:
Red quietly stared at Gu Nan without responding.
She was already a Star Ruler ten thousand years ago. In all likelihood, no second person had ever dared to speak to her this way in these ten thousand years.
But the logic was very simple. You have to give money when you take something, unless she could also kill the seller like Gu Nan did.
Even Wu Gui and Jin Wuyin could recognize the Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon. Red was no naturally no exception.
She even knew better than anyone that this Heavenly Demon was by no means Gu Nan's true body. At most, it was some kind of ability. Back then, she saw Gu Nan transform into a deity with her own eyes.
Of course Gu Nan—who could also transform into a deity—couldn’t possibly be the reincarnation of some Heavenly Demon.
It was precisely this understanding that made Gu Nan's current attitude so perplexing to Red—anyone who possessed even a little foresight should understand that using Qian Han to make friends with Red was the choice with the greatest profit.
Furthermore, she might even agree if he offered to exchange an insignificant Qian Han for some interests in Nirvana Heaven and Star Realm.
‘Why on earth is he so stubborn about Qian Han?’
Gu Nan stared Red in the eye without flinching. Even though he knew that he who had yet to complete the First Round still couldn’t confront Red head-on for the time being…
But it was possible for players to give back what they already gobbled up!
"Then try it." Of course Red didn't say "What do you want?" or anything like that. Rather, she simply chose to attack.
Someone with her status never compromised, not even when facing Zuo Zuo, so how could she give in to Gu Nan?
Indescribable law fluctuations directly emerged near Gu Nan, frantically surging towards him.
What greeted Gu Nan’s eyes was a red that almost drowned out the entire world. It was an overwhelming red that hid the sky and covered the earth.
Red’s law was just red!
Ying Ge stood by Red's side and looked down at the Gu Nan who was instantly drowned out by red. She couldn't help wondering, "He was dealt with so easily? This doesn’t seem very real…"
She and Red could barely count as contemporaries, so she knew the terror of this attack. Very few of her enemies could escape when caught inside this blood-red color.
This kind of red screen wasn’t an ordinary technique. It was an abstraction taken from Red’s origin law. In other words, this technique was a law that had practically become a tangible existence.
There weren’t many people in the Myriad Heavens Universe who could turn their own laws into a tangible image with their own power.
But with her understanding of Gu Nan, Ying Ge felt that the other party wouldn’t be killed so easily.
"It's indeed not that easy," Red’s voice was still calm, but there was a hint of astonishment. Only when she fought Gu Nan personally did she realize how difficult this guy was to deal with.
In her senses, the blood-red color surrounding Gu Nan was being torn apart at an incredible rate, leaving her with almost no time to replenish the loss.
‘He can actually tear apart laws directly… What kind of monster is this?’
Red had never seen a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon before, but she was certain that Heavenly Demons most assuredly did not have such an ability.
Surrounded by the red curtain, Gu Nan’s body emitted a dense black light, but the red was constantly pressing down on him, while Gu Nan was using the dumbest method to break through.
Relying on his physical body alone, he broke up this red curtain one punch at a time.
Gu Nan estimated that Red’s level was probably between Tier 7 and Tier 8. However, because Zuo Zuo suppressed Star Realm for many years, she couldn’t bring out her astral world’s full power, so now she was only using her own strength.
But her personal strength alone was enough to suppress the lower-leveled Gu Nan and render most of his laws ineffective.
Red’s substantive law was like the hardest steel and also the most pliable silk, which possessed both hardness and supple strength, making it extremely difficult to destroy.
If he wanted to challenge an opponent several levels higher, he could only rely on his exceptionally strong physique!
The Heavenly Demon state showed no signs of fading at all, so Gu Nan increased the speed of his punches and punched more and more wantonly. In the end, he was already using both hands and feet, and even his entire body became a weapon!
The red color was still continuously invading his space. Perhaps this kind of enemy that was everywhere might make people despair greatly, but Gu Nan very much welcomed such opponents.
Because he didn’t need to make any judgments at all—punching or kicking anywhere at random would land hits on the target!
Bang!
Like the sound of bubbles bursting, the speed at which Red repaired the red curtain finally failed to catch up with Gu Nan's destruction, and the red curtain was completely smashed through by the latter.
Under Ying Ge’s stupefied gaze, black fog constantly evaporated off of Gu Nan, as if it was burning up. He crazily charged out of the red curtain and shot at Red point-blank, just like a sharp arrow!
Ying Ge shouldn’t have been able to see his movements clearly, but time seemed to slow down, and Gu Nan drew a trail in front of her eyes.
Breaking out of the red curtain and then swinging a punch at Red’s face.
Red looked up. Waves of red ripples appeared before her, hovering in the air and blocking Gu Nan's punch like a shield.
Gu Nan didn't even need to think. His figure instantly appeared in another direction, launching a kick at Red, and the same ripples emerged again.
The third punch, the fourth kick… Gu Nan happily carried out these seemingly useless attacks. His movements even accelerated further without the slightest pause.
In Ying Ge's line of sight, Gu Nan seemed to have split into countless clones that launched simultaneous attacks on Red from all directions. As a result, she and Red now seemed to be surrounded by the red ripples instead!
"Go!" A shout sounded beside her ear. Ying Ge looked back in shock, only to see that Red had already opened a space passage, planning to return to Star Realm.
Ying Ge felt chills on her back and suddenly understood what Red meant. She hurriedly stepped into the passage, and then heard a soft sound…
A red shield was shattered!
Ying Ge truly was surprised this time. She knew Red for so many years, but she’d never heard of anyone physically shattering tangible laws.
Gu Nan's figure pounced at them again with an insane smile on his face. The black fog surrounding him became more and more violent and unrestrained. His expression seemed to speak of his imposing manner—the will to shatter everything!
Red’s eyebrows wrinkled slightly. She sent Ying Ge away with a wave of her hand, while she herself raised her hand to block Gu Nan's punch. A red luster started to shine on her hand.
Crack!
