The red light was suddenly beaten back, while Red’s expression froze slightly. She clearly felt a burst of monstrous strength traveling up her arm. The force of the shock directly broke her left hand.
Fortunately, this force also pushed Red away from Gu Nan. She crashed into the space passage, which made Gu Nan unable to give chase.
However, Gu Nan just stood beside the dark crack and watched the two leave, merely revealing a sneer.
The shadowy Heavenly Demon state had already hit its time limit and slowly dissipated at this time, revealing his original appearance. When he turned around again, Wu Gui was long gone, leaving only Qian Han behind.
But Qian Han, this old man, didn't plan to run away, because he discovered his own value after witnessing that fight just now.
"My Lord." Qian Han showed a humble smile. "This old man has managed Star Realm on that one’s behalf for a thousand years. As long as My Lord is interested in Star Realm, this old man is willing to serve My Lord."
The value he discovered was to defect once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Apostle Hall
chapters.content:
Star Realm.
Red returned here with Ying Ge but immediately started coughing repeatedly. Blood also began seeping out of the stab wound Zuo Zuo inflicted earlier.
"How are you?" Ying Ge hurriedly held her anxiously. "Gu Nan… is already strong enough to fight you? Has he already found an astral world?"
Red shook her head. "I don’t know if he has an astral world, but it’s true that I can’t do anything about his Heavenly Demon true body without the support of Star Realm… I underestimated him."
When Star Realm wasn’t supplying her with power, she was nothing more than a slightly powerful Star Ruler. She wanted to suppress Gu Nan with just her own power, but she didn't expect to be suppressed by the other side instead.
"He fought very smartly." Red added, "He should’ve seen through my cards, which is why he adopted this fighting style."
Ying Ge stared blankly. She really couldn’t associate Gu Nan's crazy appearance earlier with the phrase "clever tactics."
However, she nonetheless realized that Gu Nan defeated Red by taking advantage of the present situation in Star Realm.
"Next time…"
"Next time, the situation may not necessarily be like this anymore." Red sighed lightly.
……
In Nirvana Heaven, Qian Han's face was full of sincerity. No trace of reluctance could be seen.
It wasn’t due to how brilliant his acting skills were. Rather, he sincerely wanted to join Gu Nan’s side, at least for now.
It was far from the first time he’d done such a thing. After betraying Red by acting as a double agent for Zuo Zuo, Qian Han no longer had a place in Star Realm. Taking refuge with Gu Nan was indeed his only choice.
"What's your use?" Gu Nan asked thus. This question sounded mocking, but Gu Nan was genuinely curious.
Red wasn’t willing to offer a price, so whether Qian Han could save his own life depended on himself right now.
Qian Han didn't even have to think about it and quickly responded, "My Lord, I'm a top Void Cutter cultivator, and I'm very familiar with Star Realm. I also know about the entire Myriad Heavens Universe."
After a pause, he added, "I basically managed Star Realm for a thousand years. I have the experience of managing an entire astral world… My Lord, with your strength, I think it won't be long before you need a manager."
Qian Han wasn’t sure whether Gu Nan already possessed an astral world, so he very wisely changed his wording.
"Why should I ask you to help manage my astral world? To make it convenient for you to turn traitor again?" Gu Nan gave him a meaningful stare and asked with a faint smile.
Qian Han wasn’t surprised at all. He knew that with his "criminal record," the other party was bound to be suspicious.
So he bowed deeply. "This old man was only given a chance to defect because that one delegated power for too long. With My Lord’s vigilance, don’t tell me he’ll also give this old man a chance to turn traitor?"
He actually advised Gu Nan to guard against him… and also threw in some flattery in passing.
Gu Nan laughed silently, casually grabbed him, and stepped into his Divine Kingdom. "I hope you won't regret it."
……
In an obscure small plane deep in the starry sky, the two halves of Zuo Zuo's body were facing each other.
"What do you want?!” Zuo Zuo glared resentfully. The half of his body that originally belonged to him was calmly returning his gaze.
He was constantly on the move after escaping from Star Realm and had already switched dozens of small planes already. He confirmed that Red didn't chase after him, but instead, this woman was always following him.
She neither attacked nor said a word. She just followed him. But whenever Zuo Zuo wanted to turn around, she would immediately avoid him.
Zuo Zuo's eyes turned slightly cold. He knew that he had to take back his body as soon as possible, or else both of them would die from possessing incomplete souls.
But the other party didn’t seem to be in a hurry at all and played guerrilla warfare with him just like this.
Zuo Zuo knew better than anyone else that the enemy wanted to engage in a battle of patience with him. Perhaps the other party was even more anxious than he was. As long as he steadied his mind and calmed down…
But how could he calm down?!
The scheme he plotted for many years failed due to some random, inexplicable reasons, causing his astral world to fall into other people’s control, and he was even forced to give half his body to someone else.
No matter how rational he was, it was still hard to control his anger at this time!
"You're starting to feel anxious," unhurried words came from the front. Gu Nian’s voice began to resemble her original one. This was the beginning of her soul influencing the body.
Zuo Zuo took a deep breath and said in a heavy voice, "You and I will join hands to get Nirvana Heaven back first. I can share half of the astral world’s power with you."
As long as they could put down their prejudices, they could combine into a temporary whole. Both of them would benefit from recapturing the astral world.
Gu Nian was silent for a while. Just when Zuo Zuo began to get impatient, she asked, "How can I trust you?"
Zuo Zuo's heart relaxed slightly. Sure enough, no one could resist the temptation of a complete astral world. "To show my sincerity, control of the new body can be given to you."
Hearing this, Gu Nian's single eye seemed to light up and she replied quickly, "Okay!"
Zuo Zuo didn't waste time and flew directly to the opposite side, but he was sneering in his heart.
He didn't lie. He did intend to give control of the body to Gu Nian, but once he recaptured Nirvana Heaven…
Thunk!
Under Zuo Zuo’s incredulous gaze, Gu Nian formed a knife with her hand and viciously chopped down on Zuo Zuo’s neck.
This hand chop was obviously premeditated, causing Zuo Zuo to stumble and tearing a hole in his neck.
"What is this?" Zuo Zuo's voice grew colder.
Gu Nian smiled. "I'd rather kill you than trust you."
……
Inside the Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan casually threw Qian Han into the Evil God Temple and had him begin the process of becoming an apostle, while Gu Nan himself had already run to the construction interface.
Regarding the problem of Qian Han's loyalty or lack thereof, Gu Nan wasn’t actually very worried.
It wasn’t that he had any confidence in Qian Han, but rather, the characteristics of an apostle meant that Gu Nan didn’t fear betrayal.
The Evil God Temple judged apostles by quite a strict standard. As long as the apostles harbored any disloyal intentions, Gu Nan would immediately receive a warning. If it was slightly serious, the apostle would even be directly kicked out of the ranks of apostles.
Therefore, Gu Nan wasn’t worried about the kind of person who finally defected after lurking for many years. Instead, fellows who’d rather die than surrender or people who would turn traitor in the blink of an eye gave Gu Nan more of a headache.
What's more, Gu Nan had an even better way to restrict Qian Han.
The transformation into an apostle was quite convenient. Not long after, Qian Han stood in front of Gu Nan again with an even more respectful expression.
"My Lord…"
"Mm, go in and try it," Gu Nan said to him and pointed to the building ahead.
Qian Han turned his head and saw a delicate little house. Words he didn’t recognize were written on the plaque, but he somehow understood their meaning.
Apostle Hall.
Qian Han cast a glance at Gu Nan but dared not ask further questions, so he walked in while feeling like he’d “ventured deeper into the tiger’s den.”
After Qian Han walked into the Apostle Hall, he saw one projection after another floating in front of him, and the last one was actually himself!
"This is…"
Gu Nan stood outside the Apostle Hall. A series of data appeared on the page.
｢Name: Qian Han
Combat Power: 128
Administration: 105
Strategy: 99
……
Loyalty: 60 ｣
Gu Nan’s mouth revealed a small smile when he saw that loyalty was only at 60 points, and he clicked on an option on the page—Tier Restriction.
｢Tier Restriction: Tier 3!｣
Thus Qian Han, who was inside the Apostle Hall, ushered in a horrifying experience that he would never forget for the rest of his life. He only felt that his whole body’s strength was being drained away, and his realm fell wildly until it was only at Prodigious Realm…

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Black Hole Plane
chapters.content:
‘To think a method of limiting one’s realm exists in this world…’
Qian Han, who was in the Apostle Hall, felt like his three views had collapsed.
‘Limit one’s realm… Limit one’s realm!’
Qian Han, who once managed an astral world, immediately realized that if other Star Rulers learned this method, then from then on, all the Void Cutters would become slaves of the Star Rulers.
The reason why Void Cutter cultivators enjoyed high and aloof statuses was precisely because they had the means to protect themselves.
Even if it was a powerful Star Ruler, as long as they didn’t have the ability to seal off space or kill Void Cutters instantly, they might still be unable to stop Void Cutters from escaping.
And once a Void Cutter expert disappeared from their sight, finding them again was by no means an easy task.
But if Star Rulers had the ability to restrict someone’s realm, they could completely suppress all the Void Cutters at Prodigious Realm and make them lose their most critical self-preservation ability!
Just like right now…
Qian Han walked out of the Apostle Hall lifelessly, looking like a dispirited, lonely old man. After losing his Void Cutter power, he could already foresee his own fate.
He would probably be kept inside someone’s astral world as a complete encyclopedia of knowledge until the day the Star Ruler no longer needed his knowledge, and he would be secretly executed like a dog…
In any case, Qian Han would definitely do it this way if he was the Star Ruler.
Gu Nan, however, ignored him. He just called Yan Xiaoxiao over and had her take Qian Han around to familiarize him with the Divine Kingdom’s situation.
He recruited Qian Han as an apostle not only for knowledge like Qian Han believed, but also for Qian Han to manage the Divine Kingdom for him.
Although Yan Xiaoxiao was familiar enough with Immortal Demon World, her knowledge was ultimately still limited to one world, and she also didn’t have a Void Cutter expert’s aloof and detached mentality, so she wasn’t the most suitable "manager."
Moreover, Gu Nan also wouldn’t allow his Divine Kingdom to be under one person’s complete management. If he was worried about betrayal, then he shouldn’t give others the opportunity to betray him. Qian Han's previous words weren’t unreasonable.
In the empty Evil God Temple, Gu Nan stood alone in front of the Apostle Hall, suddenly feeling refreshed.
After coming to this world for so long, he always saw specious things that appeared plausible but were actually wrong. Only the familiar figures from the Apostle Hall in front of him made him feel like everything was under control.
The Apostle Hall didn’t only contain Qian Han’s data. It had detailed data on everyone who became an apostle.
｢Name: Yan Xiaoxiao
Combat Power: 98
Administration: 99
Command: 102
……
Energy: 65
Loyalty: 95 ｣
Yan Xiaoxiao’s information didn’t differ from Gu Nan's expectations. Except for one "Command" stat—which was of little use at present—that was over 100, the rest were below 100.
In Apostle Hall’s data, the maximum value for energy and loyalty were 100 points, and there was no upper limit for the other stats.
However, 100 was a threshold. Once the stat exceeded 100, the calculation algorithm became completely different, and the ability increased almost exponentially.
For example, Yan Xiaoxiao had 98 points in Combat Power, but she could at most fight three 90 point enemies. However, an apostle with a Combat Power of 105 could casually beat ten Yan Xiaoxiao’s.
So don’t be fooled by how Qian Han's Combat Power of 128 was only 30 points higher than Yan Xiaoxiao. In fact, the gap was unimaginably large.
Yan Xiaoxiao's loyalty reached a height of 95 points, so he didn’t need to worry about that for the time being. Instead, her energy was only 65, which showed that the work burden on her recently was a little too heavy, so finding someone to share her burden was a high priority.
Next was Guan Hongchen, Lei Qi, and Lei Ba. They didn’t have any stats that exceeded Gu Nan's expectations, and their loyalty values were all above 80. There was no sign of betrayal for the time being.
Divine Kingdom construction belonged to the base building category of games, and the role of the Apostle Hall was similar to the "hero altar" in some games, while apostles were analogous to the hero generals under the base’s lord.
In fact, after surpassing Level 3, the Apostle Hall could indeed summon apostles directly.
The Apostle Hall could also be used to train apostles, but this role was of little use for the time being—Gu Nan had no money.
……
On the edge of the Myriad Heavens Universe, Gu Nian and Zuo Zuo were still fleeing and giving chase respectively. They were about to leave the Myriad Heavens Universe.
It's just that the present situation had turned into Gu Nian single-heartedly trying to escape while Zuo Zuo constantly pursued her. Their time was running out.
Zuo Zuo's neck wound was still deepening, but he didn’t seem to notice at all and continued pursuing with a cold expression.
In fact, Gu Nian’s earlier sneak attack didn’t give her much of an advantage. At best, she caused some minor injuries to Zuo Zuo, which was far from her goal of "killing the other party."
And after Zuo Zuo freed himself from Red and Ying Ge and only had to fight one Gu Nian, he actually still had a huge advantage, even without the support of Nirvana Heaven.
That body belonged to him in the first place, so he had a far better understanding than the other person; he’d been a Star Ruler for ten thousand years and was incomparably familiar with this level of power; he even had considerable understanding of the other party’s mysterious and unpredictable law…
His only disadvantage right now was that the other party was hell-bent on running away!
"Exactly how long do you plan to keep running?" Zuo Zuo's cold voice rang out again, but Gu Nian didn’t even pause. She continued to jump towards the next plane without looking back.
Zuo Zuo could only suppress his continuously surging negative emotions and carefully chased after her—in the end, Gu Nian’s previous "kill you" still affected him.
Zuo Zuo felt like this was an unlucky year for him.
Originally, with his foundations, that war should’ve been a certain victory for him. His strength was above Red to begin with. Even if someone made trouble in Nirvana Heaven, he could still casually extinguish them.
Only Ying Ge’s appearance truly hit his fatal weak spot, and she even appeared when he was preoccupied using his full power to suppress Red. It was hard to get off after riding a tiger—it was impossible for him to stop halfway, so he was forced to self-destruct his core.
However, Zuo Zuo still wasn’t out of backup plans. He resurrected himself with Gu Nian’s special law, gaining a chance to stake it all on a final battle.
As long as he could get back even a little power from Nirvana Heaven, then it would be a battle of attribution to see whether Wu Gui’s destructive power was stronger or whether Red and the others could manage to survive longer.
But of all things, he just had to run into Gu Nan’s great battle with Jin Wuyin… This was like the last straw that broke the camel’s back, crushing all of Zuo Zuo’s plans.
And now that he broke away from Red’s pursuit, he didn’t even have the energy to care about his astral world. He just wanted to get his body back.
However, Gu Nian displayed an attitude of “only one of us will live in this life and death struggle” and refused to communicate with him at all. If this continued, he might actually become the first Star Ruler in history to self-destruct.
Zuo Zuo suppressed all emotions and stepped into the crack in space, prepared for a possible ambush. Although Gu Nian had never done such a thing before, no one knew if she was deliberately lulling him into lowering his guard.
To his surprise, this time Gu Nian didn't actually continue to flee.
"We’re here." Gu Nian chuckled slightly, but it looked somewhat bizarre when it was done with only half of a body.
Zuo Zuo frowned slightly and looked around, but he found nothing out of the ordinary. This was a normal small world. Perhaps it had some special laws, but wasn’t she thinking too highly of herself if she wanted to beat him with just that?
Zuo Zuo didn’t feel like any advantage could offset the gap in experience and knowledge between himself and her.
"I've experienced hundreds of reincarnations before. I found this place accidentally." Gu Nian said slowly, "I didn't understand what was here at that time, and it wasn’t until I left Star Realm later on that I finally found some clues…"
Before she could finish, Zuo Zuo's expression changed slightly, because he saw Gu Nian casually throw a beam of light at the ground.
With this light beam, this world erupted like an enraged lion. Countless laws surged wildly towards Gu Nian’s body, and Zuo Zuo, who was right beside her, naturally couldn’t escape either.
The innumerable laws wrapped around each of the two separately like two giant eggshells and quickly dragged them into the ground.
"To think there’s still an undiscovered black hole plane… You lunatic!"
But Gu Nian's crazy laughter just came from the front. "See you in a thousand years, Lord Zuo Zuo!"

chapters.title: Chapter 316: The Dangerous Edge of the World
chapters.content:
Gu Nan leisurely sat in his courtyard in Zi Luo Heaven, basking in the sun and flipping through a newspaper.
That’s right, newspaper.
This newspaper called "Myriad Heavens Daily" published stories on the daily events, big or small, that happened in the Myriad Heavens Universe. As for its legitimacy and credibility, one could tell by reading its name.
To be able to claim such an eye-catching name without being swallowed up by bigger organizations, the newspaper company’s background must clearly be extraordinary.
In today's Myriad Heavens Daily, the great war between Nirvana Heaven and Star Realm occupied the front page.
The war between two astral worlds that could be considered major planes was an event one might not even encounter in ten thousand years. Now that it finally came to an end after several years, of course a detailed account would be given.
From the beginning of Zuo Zuo and Red’s history with each other all the way until the final decisive battle between them, the newspaper dug up many details. Ying Ge and Gu Nian both appeared in the article, and even Gu Nan was mentioned.
"I thought it was a war not many people knew about; I didn't expect the entire world to be paying attention." Gu Nan’s mouth curled into a smile, feeling quite strange in his heart.
The longer he stayed in Zi Luo Heaven, the more he felt that “it was a small world.”
As one of the major planes, Zi Luo Heaven was also a prominent plane open to the public. A lot of information would be concentrated here, so its residents could see the whole world without ever setting foot outside their homes.
Like the decisive battle between Red and Zuo Zuo, for example. In the eyes of the parties involved, it might as well be the end of the world, but in the Myriad Heavens Universe, it was just the topic of idle conversation during teatime.
And powerhouses with the ability to intervene in this war wouldn’t foolishly assume more risk by entering the fray before a winner was decided—they could simply wait for the dust to settle and then carve up the loser's territory.
In any case, the winner would definitely be greatly weakened by that time. How much strength would the winner still have left to fight over a piece of the pie?
Therefore, wars between astral worlds really weren’t worth the cost. If they weren’t absolutely certain of victory, Star Rulers wouldn’t casually start wars on such a scale.
After reading the content of the daily newspaper, Gu Nan not only understood the origins of Zuo Zuo and Red, but he also saw all the twists and turns of the final decisive battle.
"So Zuo Zuo's trump card was actually Gu Nian…" Gu Nan couldn't help laughing involuntarily. He really wanted to tell Zuo Zuo that this woman who’d been his sister for a short while was a real poisonous snake.
Anyone who dared to use her should be prepared to be bitten back at any time.
As for Zuo Zuo’s current situation, there was no mention in the daily newspaper, only that it was still under investigation.
The daily newspaper mentioned Gu Nian’s special law, the relationship between Ying Ge and Zuo Zuo, and, of course, the “Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon” in Nirvana Heaven.
This was probably the first time that Gu Nan entered the eyes of all major forces in the Myriad Heavens Universe with the identity of a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon.
News of a Heavenly Demon's appearance attracted a lot of attention. No one believed that this Heavenly Demon just happened to be passing by. Instead, they preferred to regard him as Red’s trump card.
……
"So he’s a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon."
Jiang Tingwei placed her newspaper down and said suddenly from inside the Seven Stars League.
No wonder he had such immense physical strength… The Myriad Heavens Daily also unearthed many details about Gu Nan, this Heavenly Demon. From the time he first became famous in Star Realm, many details were written on the front page.
For the front page of a newspaper where space was extremely expensive, this kind of treatment was comparable to a powerful Star Ruler.
Situ Jing and Jiang Zheng, her younger brother, were sitting beside her. Situ Jing exclaimed, "So that Gu Nan is a Heavenly Demon! Should we report him?"
"Are you crazy?!” Jiang Tingwei was frightened by her and blurted out.
Jiang Zheng cut in from the side, "Heavenly Demons aren’t necessarily evil. Moreover, he’s at least Star Ruler Realm. No organization will have the leisure to randomly make an enemy of him."
Be it deities or Heavenly Demons, they were more like a special race in the Myriad Heavens Universe—an exceptional race that was born strong and had its own inheritance hidden within its bloodline.
For creatures like them, powerful organizations would only try their best to recruit them. How could they provoke these races for no reason?
"Oh, that’s true… I heard a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon is also hiding in Milky Way Heaven, and I haven't seen anyone try to exterminate that one in the name of justice," Situ Jing muttered.
Milky Way Heaven was one of the Thirteen Heavens, a powerful and influential plane in the truest sense and the pinnacle of all planes. It’s said that the Star Ruler of Milky Way Heaven had a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon subordinate.
"We’ll pretend nothing happened. This is not something we can get involved in." Jiang Tingwei concluded, "Let's keep looking for missions to do and avoid Nirvana Heaven for the time being."
……
Gu Nan got up from his residence and didn’t linger for long. With a single step, he’d already left Zi Luo Heaven, heading straight for the edge of the Myriad Heavens Universe.
The Myriad Heavens Universe was very big. The planes inside it were like bubbles all squeezed inside a small bottle.
Some planes could be traveled to directly, while others could only be reached after stopping at a few intermediary planes.
The plane Gu Nan was currently heading to was a place called Tiluo World that required several stops to reach. When he arrived, Qian Han had already been waiting here for a while.
"My Lord." Qian Han revealed a flattering smile upon seeing Gu Nan and hurriedly came up.
Qian Han’s Tier 4 cultivation was temporarily restored right now because Gu Nan was heading to the golden giants tribe, and only Qian Han could lead the way.
Apostles’ cultivation restrictions were only valid inside the Divine Kingdom. However, Qian Han's loyalty had soared ever since he discovered Gu Nan possessed such a method, and now it was at 75.
Part of it was also because he couldn’t play any tricks right in front of Gu Nan’s eyes.
Tiluo World was a very small plane, almost smaller than the Ghost Sea World that Gu Nan had previously visited, but the density of powerful figures here had reached an alarming level.
All Gu Nan did was casually stand here, yet he unexpectedly ran into several Void Cutter cultivators.
As if seeing Gu Nan's question, Qian Han volunteered, "My Lord, Tiluo World is a plane on the frontlines. The neutral region is right up ahead after leaving this world, and after that, you’ll reach the World of Gods."
"You know the World of Gods?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows.
Qian Han nodded seriously. "Like us, the World of Gods is a natural cluster of planes and has the protection of a plane wall. It’s very difficult for outsiders to enter… But their powerhouses often come out."
Gu Nan learned a little more about this world from Qian Han's introduction.
The Myriad Heavens Universe and the World of Gods were both places where a multitude of planes naturally “gathered together.” People referred to them as “plane clusters.” The plane clusters were each surrounded by a plane wall, so it was very hard for people who didn’t originate from that plane cluster to travel in and out of the plane wall.
However, for the powerful people inside the plane clusters, the plane wall might as well not exist at all, and they could enter and leave at will. It could be described as a protection blessed by heaven.
Gu Nan felt some headache over this. If he couldn’t enter the World of Gods, that wasn’t good news for his plan to hunt gods.
"However…" Qian Han looked around again. "The density of strong experts here is indeed higher than usual. It may be that some extraordinary treasure has appeared."
As soon as his voice fell, a strange power seeped into the sky, turning into raindrops and falling down. Every drop contained the rich aura of laws.
A Void Cutter cultivator in front of Gu Nan and Qian Han couldn't avoid it in time, and a drop of rain containing laws fell onto his head. His entire person started aging rapidly, turning white-haired in an instant and finally dying of organ failure.
"This… This is the law of aging?" Qian Han was astonished.
"It's time!" Gu Nan grabbed Qian Han and raised the old man over his head to block the rain. "This is fucking Valen’s power… What the hell is this god-awful place?!”
God of Time Valen! A Tier 11 major god!

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Passing By
chapters.content:
Gu Nan held Qian Han over his head to block the rain and quickly fled in one direction.
The instant the Rain of Time fell, Gu Nan probably reacted the fastest in the entire Tiluo World—he blocked the fastest and also ran the fastest.
There was no helping it. Truly, Gu Nan was way too familiar with this skill. Almost at the same time that energy appeared, he had already sensed it.
Valen, the God of Time, was an extremely well-known god, even in his past life’s game. He was a Tier 11 major god level character.
For Gu Nan, Tier 11 meant that the other party was already in the Second Round—this wasn’t like the First Round, which was merely a different gameplay style, but the Second Round, which ushered in a genuine qualitative change!
Not to mention that Gu Nan hadn’t even finished the First Round yet—he was one last step away from it.
While Gu Nan escaped, Tiluo World was in a mess under the baptism of the Rain of Time.
Anything the raindrops touched had their time snatched away at a frightening speed. Buildings were weathering, creatures were aging, and even laws themselves were undergoing minor changes.
‘It's much weaker than in the game. Is it because of the plane wall’s influence?’ Gu Nan dashed away quickly in an attempt to run outside the Rain of Time’s range while secretly thinking.
Gu Nan was probably more knowledgeable about the gods than anyone else in this world. For a major god level existence like Valen, Gu Nan knew almost every single technique of his.
The Rain of Time was one of Valen's signature skills. It had a wide range and a nasty effect; it could definitely rank among the top ten most disgusting skills.
However, the Rain of Time that Gu Nan saw now was much weaker than in the game, both in terms of range and effect.
Qian Han was raised over Gu Nan’s head. Although Gu Nan picked a good path and tried his best to avoid the Rain of Time with the help of various buildings and covers, many raindrops still hit Qian Han.
After the Rain of Time stole a great deal of time from Qian Han, the wrinkles on his already aged face increased at a rate visible to the naked eye.
The lifespans of Void Cutter cultivators depend on the extent they comprehend their laws and completeness of their own laws.
As a top Void Cutter who lived for a thousand years, Qian Han was already one of the people closest to Star Ruler Realm in this world and had an extremely long lifespan, but under the effect of the Rain of Time, he was about to reach the end of his life in the blink of an eye.
But Gu Nan didn’t have time to care about this. If not for such a good shield like Qian Han, he would be "caught in the rain" himself.
‘What? He’s still needed to lead the way to the golden giants’ territory? Who cares about that at a time like this? It can’t be helped if Qian Han dies. As for his knowledge… We’ll just see if there’s an opportunity to resurrect him later.’
Gu Nan instantly made a decision, and his pace accelerated slightly.
After running for a long time, Gu Nan suddenly felt the ground in front of him light up—he had left the range of the Rain of Time.
Gu Nan lowered the Qian Han that was raised over his head and saw that the old man had no vitality left and was already a corpse, so he was casually tossed aside by Gu Nan.
He looked back again. Astonishing changes were taking place in the area affected by the Rain of Time.
All the buildings had been completely weathered and eroded. In contrast, some plants and trees were still reproducing from generation to generation. From seeds to saplings, to towering trees, and finally withering away in the blink of an eye.
The power of the Rain of Time was already weakening, but it was still enough to go through the entire life cycle of a thousand-year-old tree in the blink of an eye.
"Valen… Why did he attack?" Gu Nan was very puzzled. Even in his previous life’s game, there were very few plotlines involving the major gods.
The twelve major gods were already at the top of the pyramid in the game’s background setting. Plotlines wouldn’t casually touch them.
The power of the plane wall was indeed strong. The Rain of Time that should’ve lasted a little under fifteen minutes instead stopped after only a few minutes. The land in front of Gu Nan fell silent again.
Around Gu Nan were also a few survivors who just happened to be on the edge of the Rain of Time and were lucky enough to escape. They all stared at the destruction with lingering fear in their hearts.
When an area was affected by the Rain of Time, one could only escape using their physical body. Any law would be drowned out by time, and even if someone barely managed to open a crack in space, it would still be washed away instantly.
Right at this time, two people stood up from the rubble up ahead. They were a man and a woman holding a silver paper umbrella, which protected them.
"Senior Martial Sister! We’re saved, we’re saved!" The man excitedly pulled on his martial sister and shouted loudly. It seems that he didn't have too much experience surviving calamities like this.
"What are you shouting for! Hurry up and put away your umbrella…" His martial sister said quickly while casting a wary look at their surroundings. Sure enough, she saw many pairs of eyes focus on them.
Just what kind of treasure was this umbrella, to be able to survive such a terrifying spell?
Many of those gazes contained obvious greed.
"This is an umbrella Senior Lu gifted me. Who can snatch it away…" The man was entirely unconcerned. He immediately saw the person ahead and exclaimed, "Mr. Gu Nan?"
Gu Nan had naturally noticed the only two survivors among the ruins a long time ago, and he also recognized the man.
He was actually the stranger Gu Nan met when heading to the Seven Stars League to temporarily join a team—Lou Wanying.
So Gu Nan just gave a small nod but said nothing. Lou Wanying, on the other hand, was very enthusiastic. He pulled his martial sister along and ran to Gu Nan’s side. "Mr. Gu Nan, are you also here to look for the time treasure?"
When he said the words "time treasure," the number of gazes focused on them clearly increased significantly.
It seemed that this was the reason for the abnormal density of strong experts in a frontline plane like Tiluo World.
"Gu Nan?" When Lou Wanying’s senior martial sister heard this name, she gave a slightly blank stare, then said, "He’s the one you went to Nir—Mmph!"
The martial sister only started to say the name before she quickly covered her own mouth.
The world was already abuzz with news that the Star Ruler of Nirvana Heaven was suspected to have fallen, so the appearance of the Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon naturally couldn’t be hidden either. Of course Lou Wanying’s master could also guess that Gu Nan was the Heavenly Demon.
So the senior martial sister tugged hard on Lou Wanying's sleeve, but the latter didn’t budge. Instead, he said solemnly, "Martial Sister, I don't care what you guys think. Mr. Gu Nan is my friend!"
"How about it, Mr. Gu Nan, would you like to join us?" Lou Wanying invited Gu Nan, "Senior Lu's umbrella can guide us!"
Before Gu Nan could speak, he suddenly had a strong feeling in his heart, as if there was a voice constantly calling for him to join the ranks of Lou Wanying’s companions.
As if the legendary protagonist was about to embark on a journey, preparing to recruit companions one after another.
‘Is this… the main character halo?’
Gu Nan indulged his imagination a bit, but soon his gaze shifted to the silver umbrella. This silver umbrella carried an indescribable aura, like some kind of extremely obscure law of time.
Gu Nan originally thought it was residual aura from the Rain of Time, but now, after careful examination, he found that it came from another source.
Another controller of time?
"Mr. Gu Nan?" When Lou Wanying saw that Gu Nan didn’t respond for a long time, he couldn’t help but add, "Legend has it that the time treasure can allow people to bypass the laws of time and space, giving people more cultivation time out of thin air! If I can have three to five more years to cultivate, then—"
"No." Gu Nan gave an odd smile, then walked away while waving his hand. "I'm just passing by."

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Befallen by Disaster
chapters.content:
Immediately rushing up upon sighting a boss or treasure in the wild was something beginner players did.
Players like Gu Nan always had to first measure the risks and benefits, as well as… whether the final harvest would be useful.
Gu Nan lost all interest in the time treasure after Lou Wanying explained its effects, and Valen’s unexpected appearance made him extremely vigilant.
Major god level existences already had the possibility of seeing through his identity as an Evil God, as long as he revealed enough information about himself.
Gu Nan, who was still on the frontlines just now, decisively hid back inside Zi Luo Heaven after abandoning the newly-accepted apostle, Qian Han. He was currently in his residence, waiting for news from other people.
Sure enough, the front pages of all of today’s newspapers were about the event that occurred at the frontlines.
Of course Valen didn’t attack because he was bored. Rather, it was a reason not even Gu Nan expected. He was fighting someone, and his opponent was one of the Thirteen Heavens—Clockwork Heaven’s Lu Wen.
"Clockwork Heaven’s Lu Wen… No wonder that umbrella contained the aura of another law of time."
Gu Nan continued to flip through the newspaper, and at the same time, he expressed sympathy for his bad luck.
Even in the frontline planes, this level of fighting between one of the Thirteen Heavens and a major god was also basically a once-in-a-century encounter, but he just happened to run into it.
Tiluo World was just one of many frontline planes. It was probably only affected by the aftershocks of the two’s battle.
As for the conclusion of this matter, no newspaper could give a clear answer. They didn’t even know who won or lost. After all, the people involved in this matter were too high of a level.
On the contrary, there was a follow-up article on the war between two astral worlds that once attracted the attention of everyone in the Myriad Heavens Universe, but it was immediately squeezed into an obscure corner of the newspaper when the powerhouse from Clockwork Heaven made a move.
Star Realm had been tentatively stabilized, while four Star Rulers had already appeared inside Nirvana Heaven, all of whom were bigshots with astral worlds at or above the Realm Level.
Who would ultimately win Nirvana Heaven, or whether they’d end up dividing it up among themselves, depended on their subsequent "discussion."
As for the current situation of the two Star Rulers personally involved, there was no need to say much on Red’s side, but the question of Zuo Zuo’s whereabouts had attracted many people's guesses. However, they didn’t have a definite answer yet.
In theory, if Zuo Zuo had completely fallen, then Nirvana Heaven should’ve collapsed directly, and its origin should’ve scattered in all directions, attracting many Star Rulers to try and snatch a piece for themselves.
On the other hand, if he was still alive, then Nirvana Heaven should be perfectly intact, and no one would be able to seize it.
But the current Nirvana Heaven was neither. The origin had begun to emerge naturally, but it didn’t scatter… Many weaker Star Rulers and even Void Cutters who were waiting for an opportunity to make a move were all extremely disappointed.
The Star Ruler was one with their own astral world. Nirvana Heaven’s strange current state made everyone confused about Zuo Zuo’s current situation.
It wasn't until someone dug up some ancient records that a fairly reasonable conclusion was drawn—Zuo Zuo was probably sealed inside a black hole plane!
Black hole plane—this was a special existence only mentioned in ancient records.
These planes had very special laws. Once any power reaching Void Cutter Realm appeared, it would be sealed by the plane inside itself, and the power would be completely isolated from the outside world.
This feature, which absorbed everything regardless of the source, was very similar to a black hole, so it was named after it.
"He was sealed?" After seeing this conclusion, Gu Nan didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
However, there were also people who refuted this view. For example, some people argued that the characteristics of black hole planes were very distinctive, and a grand Star Ruler Realm figure would find clues soon after entering. How could Zuo Zuo fall victim to the plane by displaying enough power to trigger the sealing?
The arguments on all sides didn't attract much attention. After all, the key point was who would ultimately obtain Nirvana Heaven. Zuo Zuo, the down-and-out Star Ruler, was no longer within the scope of people's concerns.
Gu Nan placed the newspaper down and quickly threw all these things to the back of his mind.
He didn't have much interest in the feud between Zuo Zuo and Red in the first place. After advancing to Tier 5, not even a powerful Star Ruler like Red would be able to kill him when he was in the Heavenly Demon state, which meant that he truly had the power to protect himself now.
At present, the most important matter was to complete the construction of six basic structures and upgrade the Evil God Temple to Level 1, thus completing the First Round.
After completing the First Round and stepping into Tier 6, Gu Nan’s physical body would no longer be limited by the maximum physical strength allowed for beings before the First Round, and not only would his Evil God physique welcome another improvement, he would also be able to bring out more power from his Heavenly Demon state.
……
Time quickly flew by; two months passed in the blink of an eye.
In the past two months, Gu Nan spent most of his time in Zi Luo Heaven, collecting first-hand information from the frontlines—after all, a powerful major god had made a move. To say that Gu Nan wasn't curious at all was impossible.
But perhaps because newspapers wouldn’t contain too many insider secrets, the public news still contained no information on those two bigshots’ specific situations.
However, another wave of Rain of Time appeared a few days ago. There weren’t many casualties this time, but the implications behind this were thought-provoking.
In just two months, a bigshot on the level of the Thirteen Heavens actually attacked twice!
On the other hand, nearly two years had passed inside the Divine Kingdom, and the fourth and fifth structures "Populace Management Platform" and "Divine Servants Institute" had also been completed, and he’d almost saved up enough points for the sixth structure as well.
Populace Management Platform, as its name implied, was a structure used to manage the Divine Kingdom’s populace, while the Divine Servants Institute was the place where basic soldiers were produced. Divine servants were the most primitive troops of the Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan didn't encounter any lucky random events while constructing them, but overall, the speed still satisfied him.
‘I should have enough points saved up by today.’ Gu Nan estimated in his heart.
At that moment, a maid hurriedly ran to him. "My Lord, Lord Roman came over personally. He said he has an important matter to discuss with you…"
Roman? Important matter?
Gu Nan rubbed his chin and expressed doubt at this neighbor's so-called important matter.
……
"In short, it's like this!"
Inside Gu Nan's house, Roman slapped a paper notice on the table. "Didn't you ask me about the frontlines before? As soon as I received the information, I immediately sent it to you… How about it? Aren’t I a good brother?"
"This really is an important matter…" Gu Nan agreed with some surprise.
Roman nodded with satisfaction at his attitude.
In fact, the message on the notice he brought was very simple. The Star Ruler of Clockwork Heaven, Lu Wen, issued a summons to the entire Myriad Heavens Universe.
He called on all experts who were at least Void Cutter Realm to head to the frontlines. Of course the reason wasn’t some nonsense like justice for their home country, but rather… to seize a treasure!
The secret treasure people talked about for two months finally appeared, and it was a blessed land named "Time Arena"!
"Time Arena…" Gu Nan repeated this familiar name and suddenly felt like he’d returned to his previous life.
Seeing him like this, Roman thought he was tempted and continued with a smile, "If you’re interested, then try it! I really envy you youngsters—"
Bang!
At that moment, the door to Gu Nan's house was suddenly pushed open, startling the maid outside. Four serious-looking cultivators quickly walked in, wearing the uniform of Astral Gate’s core members.
Their eyes swept over Gu Nan and Roman and quickly locked onto Gu Nan. "He is the target. Take him away."

chapters.title: Chapter 319: Saint Corridor
chapters.content:
Compared with Astral Gate, an influential organization with branches in many planes, the Radiant Tower Gu Nan once stayed in was just a small fry.
There were many different opinions about Astral Gate’s backer. There was no single theory everyone agreed upon, but at least one thing was certain—it was very powerful.
As an organization open to the public, Astral Gate had outer members like Gu Nan, and at the same time, it naturally also had core members—cultivators who truly belonged to Astral Gate.
While enjoying more benefits from the organization, they must also accept the organization’s dispatch.
Standing in front of Gu Nan right now were four core members of Astral Gate. They wore special uniforms, and there was a strange celestial array in front of their chest that shimmered faintly.
The other three core members quickly stepped forward as soon as their leader's voice fell, while the leader himself brought up the rear, probably afraid that Gu Nan would break through their encirclement and escape.
"Wait a minute!" Gu Nan hadn’t even responded yet when Roman interrupted from the side, "Since when did Astral Gate become so rude and unreasonable? Why do you guys want to arrest him?"
Roman's words weren’t really wrong. Large organizations could be tyrannical, but they couldn’t write that tyranny right on their faces. Sometimes it was still very important to have a justifiable cause behind their actions, no matter how flimsy.
But this time, the four didn't care about this at all. The bearded man who spoke earlier said, "Don’t meddle in things that aren’t your business."
"You…" Roman was angered speechless and didn’t know what to say for a while.
If not for the fact that Astral Gate’s uniform had its own distinctiveness where the starlight couldn't be faked, he would’ve thought these people were pretending to be members of Astral Gate.
He turned his head and whispered, "Gu Nan, they are indeed people from Astral Gate. You must not resist. After you leave, remember to blow things out of proportion so that even if someone wants to harm you, they still—Gu Nan!"
Gu Nan’s figure had already rushed out before Roman could finish giving advice, instantly appearing in front of a person and reaching a hand out to press down on his head.
Crack!
The clear and crisp sound of fractured bones rang out inside the room, giving everyone chills. That person’s head was directly pressed down into his own body by Gu Nan.
The whole scene seemed to freeze for an instant. Immediately afterwards, Gu Nan reached out a hand and snapped the neck of the person on his left with a
crack
.The next second, Gu Nan grabbed the remaining person’s hair with his right hand and forced the opponent’s head down while simultaneously kneeing him in the face.
A terrifying strength traveled over, causing the enemy’s head to explode, and his corpse slowly crumpled, leaving only a piece of scalp with some hair still attached to it that Gu Nan gripped in his hand.
Blood and brain fluids flowed everywhere, and the scene suddenly became deathly still. Only the sound of blood dripped down.
In just one encounter, three not-very-weak Void Cutter experts were instantly killed by Gu Nan, and he even did it using pure physical strength, without any law fluctuations.
In the face of absolute speed, extraordinary laws and the ability to tear open the void were all useless!
As for Roman and that bearded man, they were simply stunned speechless.
Gu Nan's attacks left a much deeper impact on them—there was no law fluctuation, which meant it wouldn’t attract the attention of cultivators inside the city, which meant Gu Nan could kill people at will inside the city and walk away as if nothing had happened.
Gu Nan stepped out, appearing in front of the bearded man. He gripped the other party’s neck and asked, "Why do you want to arrest me?"
Roman had asked almost the same question just now, but the result was completely different.
"It was Representative Duan Wenqi from our organization who personally ordered us to take you there…" The man was almost crying. "We really don't know anything else!"
In fact, the man had already recognized Gu Nan's identity by now. To kill Void Cutters like killing chickens with physical strength alone—didn’t this match the description of the Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon from the news recently?!
Representative Duan's order was so urgent that they didn't have time to investigate the target in detail.
They only knew that the target's name was Gu Nan, and they also knew that there was a Heavenly Demon with the same name recently… But these two seemed completely unrelated; who had the free time to connect the dots and guess that they were the same person!?
The man's back was already soaked with cold sweat, and he didn’t even dare to escape by opening a passage through space—he could imagine that he might be directly torn apart before he could even enter the passage.
"Representative?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin.
Astral Gate was a parliamentary system with only 17 representatives in total. This Representative Duan Wenqi was already an absolute higher up. Why did he want to arrest Gu Nan?
Gu Nan’s instincts told him that this matter was most likely related to the frontline planes. The only one who could contact him like this was probably Lou Wanying.
Gu Nan let go of the man and patted his shoulder. "Go back and tell that representative that I will pay him a personal visit in a couple of days."
……
Inside the Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan immediately returned to the Divine Kingdom after sending away the people from Astral Gate.
Sure enough, it didn't take long for 10,000 more points to be accumulated. As long as Gu Nan could construct his sixth Level 0 structure, he would be able to complete the First Round and step into Tier 6 in one fell swoop!
Looking back, of the five Tiers before the First Round, Gu Nan actually spent the shortest amount of time in Tier 5.
This was because he’d already prepared a Divine Kingdom for himself before Tier 5. This was the most time-consuming part about advancing to Tier 6.
On the contrary, the construction time after getting their Divine Kingdoms was almost the same for everyone.
Gu Nan opened the list of structures, did some simple allocation of resources, and immediately selected a structure—Saint Corridor.
Saint Corridor—this wasn’t the structure Gu Nan originally had in mind. He originally wanted to build a "Training Camp," but because of the Time Arena incident, Gu Nan changed his plan at the last minute.
Under normal circumstances, the Saint Corridor wouldn’t be built in the Divine Kingdom’s early stages. Players would only consider building it when their Divine Kingdoms were at least Level 3.
Of course this wasn’t to say that this structure was useless. On the contrary, its function was so important that no player could give up.
The Saint Corridor could provide the player with a saint clone that would inherit part of the player's abilities and could be controlled by the player himself.
Simply put, this was an officially-recognized alt account.
But for players who’d completed the First Round, the existence of this alt account was extremely necessary.
On one hand, it was easier to go places with this alt account because the player wouldn’t be instantly discovered as soon as they descended upon a plane; on the other hand, it was also easier to hide players’ identity as an Evil God.
The saint clone had absolutely no connection to Evil Gods!
If he wanted to head to the frontlines, it was very possible for him to run into Valen, the God of Time, so Gu Nan couldn’t afford to be careless.
Let alone a mere Tier 11 major god, Gu Nan even slaughtered the Tier 15 God of Light and Justice many times in his past life, but the current him had just reached Tier 6.
Nothing special happened during the construction of the Saint Corridor. A circular corridor with a silver humanoid sculpture in the center appeared inside the Evil God Temple.
Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry to summon the "alt account." What he had to do next was the main event.
Now that six basic structures had been built, the Evil God Temple could be upgraded!

chapters.title: Chapter 320: The Man with a Dragon on His Shoulder
chapters.content:
Yan Xiaoxiao and Lan Si walked side by side outside the Evil God Temple. They seemed to be discussing some of the Divine Kingdom’s management problems.
Ever since he discovered Yan Xiaoxiao's lack of energy, Gu Nan told Lan Si to take over the burden as soon as possible—she was full of energy and usually maintained an energy value of at least 95.
The two had just dealt with some affairs outside and were habitually walking towards the Evil God Temple. Both management platforms were here, which were the items they had the most contact with inside the Divine Kingdom.
But just as they were about to arrive, they discovered that the ground was shaking slightly, and the Evil God Temple in front of them had grown in size without any warning, pushing away everything around it.
"This…" Lan Si stared at this scene in amazement. Over the years, she had also seen her fair share of strange events. It wasn’t like it was hard to accept seeing something created out of thin air. It’s just that such a scene was getting closer and closer to what she saw and heard in her early years.
‘Wasn’t this what divine miracles looked like back when I was in the Divine Kingdom of Luxuriant Blossoms?’
"Teacher made another breakthrough."
Yan Xiaoxiao, however, was quite happy. She’d gradually accepted her status as the administrator of the Divine Kingdom. Being in charge of an entire world was also consistent with her pursuit.
The changes in the Evil God Temple continued, but it was much gentler than before.
The two women waited until the ground stopped shaking completely, then started forward and slowly walked into the Evil God Temple, where they saw Gu Nan standing quietly up ahead.
"Teacher…" Yan Xiaoxiao called out carefully, afraid to disturb Gu Nan's breakthrough.
Gu Nan turned his head, looking like he’d just returned to his senses, and casually greeted, "Oh, you’re here."
The two women exchanged a glance. Gu Nan’s bearing truly didn’t seem like that of a Star Ruler Realm powerhouse. Of course they wouldn’t know that Gu Nan was busy activating the Saint Corridor just now.
As for himself, although he had indeed reached Tier 6 and could officially be called a “god,” it wasn’t like Gu Nan was an inexperienced novice who hadn’t seen the world. Was this anything worth getting excited about?
A silver light shimmered from not far away. Only then did the two women discover an elegant circular corridor inside the new Evil God Temple. The silver light was emitted from the statue in the center.
The silver light gradually faded, slowly forming a human figure. The person was dressed in a silver robe. His expression was refined and serene, but his face was an exact copy of Gu Nan’s.
The next moment, his expression suddenly changed, looking indifferent while also a little prideful, as if he would only respond with: "Oh, that’s cool" to everything.
Gu Nan had taken over this saint clone.
……
Not long after Gu Nan left Zi Luo Heaven, he came back again. However, it was no longer with his true body this time, but using the saint clone instead.
He guessed that the people from Astral Gate found him because of the matter regarding the frontline planes, and he also just happened to be interested in the Time Arena.
And if he wanted to participate in that event, this saint clone was enough.
The power of the saint clone would always be at the very peak of Tier 4—that is, the strongest level in the mortal world. However, since it also inherited Gu Nan's laws and extremely strong physique, its actual combat power naturally far exceeded Tier 4.
But it was true that this kind of combat power held no room for further growth. No matter how much he upgraded the Saint Corridor, the strength of the saint clone would still remain at Tier 4. At most, it would inherit more of Gu Nan’s techniques.
This touched upon a basic principle from the game: “God cannot be created.”
Tier 4 was merely taking a single step beyond the mortal world, so someone at that level could be called a “saint,” while starting from Tier 5, players could be regarded as gods. All they lacked was a handful of divine fire.
The same was also true of the Myriad Heavens Universe. Cultivators who were at least Tier 5 were collectively referred to as Star Rulers, even if the power range among Star Rulers was as high as the distance from heaven to earth—some Star Rulers were even weaker than top Void Cutters, while others could fight against major gods who were all at least Tier 10.
Star Ruler Realm represented a completely different level. So even Zuo Zuo, who was known as one of the strongest under the Thirteen Heavens, only had top Void Cutters under his command but didn’t have any Star Ruler subordinates.
It was like how with the exception of the major gods, the World of Gods never had any gods that attached themselves in servitude to other gods’ Divine Kingdoms.
‘Therefore, those interested in Clockwork Heaven’s summons will probably at best be normal Star Rulers without their own astral worlds?’ Gu Nan secretly calculated in his heart.
Gu Nan appeared inside his home in Zi Luo Heaven. The blood here was already cleaned up, and even a young girl was especially waiting for him.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan, please follow me." The girl's appearance was refined, but there was no expression on her face. Even her voice seemed calm and even indifferent.
Her tone was far less arrogant than that of the previous four, but it revealed an unquestionable and imposing aura—this was the result of being in a high position for a long time.
"Lead the way." Gu Nan didn't start anything this time. Plus, he also did want to meet the person behind this.
The young girl led the way very straightforwardly, and with a swipe of her finger, a silvery white road appeared in front of them, pointing to an inexplicable distance.
This ability was no longer a Void Cutter’s instinctual ability to tear open space, but a finer manipulation of space.
Gu Nan slowly followed the girl inside. After reaching the end of the road, they arrived at a damp courtyard, where two people were already waiting for him.
A calm-looking, respectful old man and a handsome man in his thirties in a black suit.
The old man was also wearing the uniform of Astral Gate, but his clothing was purple, which was the exclusive uniform of representatives.
Gu Nan instantly recognized his identity—Duan Wenqi, the parliament representative who ordered his arrest.
Gu Nan's eyes swept over the two, waiting for them to speak first, but the one who made the first move wasn’t them, but the girl who led the way.
She took one more step forward, and her body suddenly swelled up, turning into a silver dragon 100 meters long, coiling in the sky and then falling down.
Falling onto the shoulder of the man in the suit.
The hundred-meter-long giant dragon landed on the man's shoulder with its feet together, making for a very bizarre picture, but there was a strange sort of harmony between the two.
"I'm Lu Wen," the man took the initiative to speak. He had a gentle smile on his face, looking just like a normal person.
But the fact that he could stand here and was also named Lu Wen only meant one thing—he was the Star Ruler of Clockwork Heaven, the supreme powerhouse who could fight with a major god!
But no matter how high his status or power, Gu Nan could still keep calm because he was using an alt account right now.
"Something the matter?"
His impolite attitude made Duan Wenqi’s expression change slightly, but Lu Wen remained calm. "I hope you can do something for me."
"What is it?"
"Help a child defeat other opponents in the Time Arena and obtain the sand of time."
Gu Nan smiled silently. "He invited me before, but I refused."
Duan Wenqi interrupted from the side, "If you still refuse right now, I'm afraid the consequences won’t be something you want to see."
"Haha." Gu Nan expressed his attitude with two unique words.
However, Lu Wen waved his hand. "I’ve never liked forcing people to do things. The sand of time can be given to you as a reward. It’s very helpful for starting up one’s astral world."
Duan Wenqi’s expression didn’t change much when he heard this. He was also a powerful Star Ruler, and his realm wasn’t lower than Red’s. Naturally, he could see through Gu Nan’s current identity as a mere clone.
"What if I still refuse?" Gu Nan asked after some thought.
"Then I can only express my regret and find someone else to help." Lu Wen sighed. "Although it may be someone that little friend doesn't know, he must win the sand of time."
"Then it's settled!" Gu Nan said with a clap of his hands, "I'll just wait outside to rob Lou Wanying instead."

chapters.title: Chapter 321: Requesting Reinforcements
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan's voice fell, the scene began to descend into a strange sort of silence.
Some astonishment appeared in Lu Wen’s eyes, while Duan Wenqi looked at Gu Nan as if he was looking at a fool. Even the silver dragon on Lu Wen's shoulder couldn't help glancing down, her huge eyes staring at Gu Nan.
She didn’t have a deep understanding of human society, so she didn’t quite understand the meaning behind the other party’s words just now.
‘It sounds like he wants to do something bad, but why did he say it aloud? Shouldn't he say nothing so that he can bide his time and do it secretly?’
But then Lu Wen immediately laughed involuntarily. An old monster like him who lived for countless years could certainly understand Gu Nan’s true meaning.
To put it mildly, the young man in front of him was sounding him out and testing his limits. But to put it bluntly, Gu Nan was simply confident in his own backing.
He only dared to act so unbridled because he just came here as a clone, and no one knew the location of his astral world and true body.
"In that case, this one wishes you a smooth trip." Lu Wen’s reaction was still as mysterious as ever, not giving away his true thoughts at all. It was as if nothing could set off any waves in his heart.
Gu Nan nodded, then left without another word.
"This Gu Nan should be the Heavenly Demon people were talking about recently, but from his appearance, he doesn’t really look like one…"
After Gu Nan left, Duan Wenqi actually smiled a little, gazing at the direction Gu Nan left in and shaking his head. He didn’t look like he was fuming at all, which was his expression just seconds ago.
But Lu Wen refuted, "Not necessarily. I've seen the Heavenly Demon in Milky Way Heaven a few times, and they usually look no different from ordinary people."
Duan Wenqi took out a stack of documents from somewhere, all of which were information on Gu Nan. Even small details like the fact that he came from Langya World had been thoroughly unearthed.
After all, Gu Nan went to Star Realm through an ascension center. Even Radiant Tower knew about this, so if Astral Gate wanted to investigate, this was no secret at all.
Only the events that happened before his ascension couldn’t be known, because hundreds of years had already passed since then on such a small plane like Langya World. There were absolutely no traces left over from back then.
Such a small plane like Langya World couldn’t even bear the weight of investigative techniques to look back in time.
"His origins are clear, but he grew by leaps and bounds as soon as he entered a Realm Level plane. Apart from being the reincarnation of an ancient powerhouse, there’s really no other reasonable conclusion," Duan Wenqi threw the documents aside and reported in a low voice.
"I don't care about his origins, but Lou Wanying must be able to get the sand of time," Lu Wen said seriously.
Duan Wenqi nodded silently. Of course he knew that Lou Wanying was a very important piece in this one’s plan. They must help him get the treasure, but at the same time, they couldn't make that help too obvious.
Gu Nan was originally the best candidate. Lou Wanying already knew him, and he was also strong enough for the task, but unfortunately…
"I'll find the next candidate," Duan Wenqi said thus.
Lu Wen nodded lightly, and the giant silver dragon unfolded its wings and covered the sky, casting a shadow over their heads.
……
Inside the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan's true body opened his eyes.
Of course the saint clone didn’t return to his Divine Kingdom. He wasn’t a fool. Returning to the Divine Kingdom right in front of Lu Wen’s face—wasn’t that just asking to expose his Divine Kingdom’s coordinates?
In fact, even if the alt account died outside, Gu Nan still didn’t intend to recall it back here again—safety first.
As for the Time Arena, Gu Nan was telling the truth. If the sand of time was destined to be acquired by Lou Wanying, then he really didn’t intend to enter the Time Arena. He could simply wait outside.
Perhaps other people might still worry about Lou Wanying using up this treasure as soon as he obtained it, but Gu Nan had no such worry.
Because he knew all too well what the Time Arena was and what the sand of time was used for.
In the game, the Time Arena was a famous blueprint dungeon. As the name implied, it didn’t drop Evil Value or points, and the reward for clearing it was blueprints for Divine Kingdom structures, which was the sand of time that Lu Wen mentioned.
The blueprint could be used to build the corresponding structure in the Divine Kingdom—that is, the Time Arena. Its function was to shorten the training time for troops’ skills, and it could be regarded as a very practical structure when the Divine Kingdom went to war.
Moreover, the Time Arena wasn’t a basic structure and could only be built from external blueprints.
"A blessed land?"
Gu Nan remembered this world’s term for structures and couldn’t help shaking his head with a chuckle. In a certain sense, there was nothing wrong with calling the Divine Kingdom’s structures blessed lands.
Anyhow, they were all special areas inside the astral world that could provide special enhancements to the astral world.
The difference was that most of the blessed lands were scattered around normal cultivators’ astral worlds, while Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom structures were all concentrated inside the Evil God Temple.
Gu Nan moved the saint clone to one of the frontline planes and chose to stay dormant for a while. He used this time to ask around for first-hand information while also waiting for the result of the "treasure fight."
As long as the sand of time didn’t fall into the hands of someone from the World of Gods, then Gu Nan would be able to seize it, no matter who currently had it. In any case, Star Rulers who didn’t own an astral world wouldn’t be able to use the sand of time.
At this time, a message from someone he hadn’t seen for a long time reached the Evil God Temple. It was sent by Red Tail, whom Gu Nan ordered to rebuild White Mist.
She went to the extremely remote Crescent Moon World. If she wanted to return to the Divine Kingdom, she needed to call Gu Nan first so that she could return by borrowing his power.
Moreover, Red Tail was still just a Prodigious cultivator, and if she stayed in Crescent Moon World for a long time, her lifespan wouldn’t be enough to support that.
So Red Tail didn’t stay any longer after she established a basic foundation for White Mist there. Instead, she asked Lan Si to take her to Skeletal Realm and remotely control the situation in Crescent Moon World through reincarnation.
And the message from her was a call for help.
This matter was pretty simple. She re-established a small reincarnator organization in Skeletal Realm and used the members there to control Crescent Moon World.
But after a little while, her organization quickly caught the attention of the locals there, and now the new White Mist was being targeted.
The one eyeing them was another reincarnator organization suspected of having Void Cutters among their ranks, which was why Red Tail anxiously asked for help.
Gu Nan shook his head slightly after reading it. The establishment of reincarnator organizations was already a relatively mild way of encroaching on local interests, but he didn’t expect for some people to still covet it.
Lan Si needed to help manage the Divine Kingdom, so she didn’t have time to be a bodyguard for Red Tail. The shadow servants were also unqualified due to their low intelligence. After leaving the Divine Kingdom, they were merely robots that could only obey orders.
It seemed that it was extremely urgent to find a group of powerful apostles who wouldn’t easily betray him.
The construction of a Divine Kingdom required a lot of manpower, which Gu Nan had long expected. Therefore, the gods in the game often accepted some innately gifted races under their command.
Originally, the golden giants were a good choice, but it was a pity that he ran into a fight between major god-level powerhouses, causing even Gu Nan himself to almost die there, and Qian Han, who led the way, did lose his life.
Right now, the world outside the Myriad Heavens Universe had already attracted a lot of attention, so if Gu Nan went there again to recruit apostles, that would be no different from walking right into a trap.
"Let's deal with the problem in Skeletal Realm first and look for any desperate Void Cutter cultivators in passing. I can consider recruiting another otherworldly clan after the Time Arena concludes."
With Gu Nan’s decision, the saint clone that was already on the frontlines immediately moved. After several consecutive leaps, he arrived at Skeletal Realm, in front of an organization called Flying Clouds.
"Who are you?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 322: White Bones Realm
chapters.content:
White Bones Realm
[1]
.
White Bones Realm was a newly-promoted large astral world that its Star Ruler, Daoist White Bones, raised from just a small plane all the way to a “Realm” Level plane, becoming one of the main worlds.
Therefore, although Daoist White Bones was very young compared to other Star Rulers, he was actually quite strong, and his management of the astral world was also very strict.
White Bones Realm was somewhat similar to Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom. The whole world was divided into 196 cities surrounded by rings that radiated outwards starting from the center of each city, forming circle after circle.
Red Tail’s current location was the 21st Ring of White Bones Realm’s Zuofang City.
The 21st Ring was already close to the edge of Zuofang City and was a veritable suburb. Red Tail chose this place as White Mist’s headquarters precisely because of its remoteness.
But Red Tail was starting to hate her own insight right now.
"Commander, let's evacuate first. Resources can be collected again if they’re lost, but people will be gone forever if they die!" A young man stood before Red Tail, earnestly trying to persuade her.
This young man's name was Bai Xuesheng. Not only did his name sound a little feminine, but even his appearance was quite androgynous.
It was precisely his appearance that made him the laughingstock of his family since childhood. In a fit of rage, he embarked on the road of reincarnation and joined White Mist.
In White Bones Realm, no one who could take the surname “Bai
[2]
” was from a small family. The current Bai Xuesheng could be considered one of the higher ups in White Mist.
But Red Tail just maintained a calm and collected expression and didn't respond. She waited until even Bai Xuesheng's throat turned dry from speaking, then asked, "Did Old Mo and the others ask you to persuade me?"
Old Mo and the others were also White Mist’s higher ups. However, Bai Xuesheng wasn’t surprised by this question; he had a clear conscience. "Yes, but this is also my wish."
"I have my own plans. You all can take shelter in Zuofang City for the time being." Red Tail shook her head.
"Grand Commander!" Bai Xuesheng grew anxious and wanted to say something else, but Red Tail drove him out with a firm wave of her hand.
He walked to the door dispiritedly, where several people were waiting outside for the outcome. The leader was a middle-aged man with a face full of beard stubbles. He was precisely the Old Mo that Red Tail mentioned.
"How did it go… Ah." Someone asked from the side but immediately understood from Bai Xuesheng’s expression that it probably didn’t go well.
Old Mo also gave a small sigh, not knowing what to say. How could such a smart person like the Grand Commander be so muddle-headed when it came to this?
It was true that they raked in a lot of resources in recent months and even had a fortuitous encounter in a certain plane. Once they abandoned these resources, they probably wouldn’t encounter such luck ever again.
But wasn’t this still better than getting wiped out?
They’d already received Flying Clouds’ ultimatum, so the enemy would probably arrive tonight at the latest. Plus, White Mist was in such a remote location; no one would care if they died here.
The group fell silent for a while. Finally, Old Mo instructed, "Tell the brothers under us to disperse back into the city. Let's try to persuade the Grand Commander one last time. If she still doesn't want to go, then—"
"Then we’ll take her away, even if we have to kidnap her!" Bai Xuesheng said flatly.
From a young master who originally knew nothing but cultivation and even possessed a slight inferiority complex to his current self, he’d changed to such an extent in just a few short months.
This was all thanks to the Grand Commander, so he would never abandon her and flee by himself at this time.
"That's right!" Old Mo also nodded seriously. After having someone relay his orders to his subordinates, he pushed open the door.
"Grand Commander… Huh? Who are you?!” He couldn’t help blurting out a question upon seeing a strange scene when he walked into Red Tail’s room.
Red Tail stood to the side respectfully, while a person in a silver robe was sitting in her original spot. A silver mask covered his face, so they couldn’t make out his expression.
"Grand Commander?" The silver-robed person chuckled when he heard how Old Mo addressed Red Tail. "I didn't expect you to still have the original organizational system on your mind, even after all these years."
Back when they were in Star Realm, White Mist had two commanders. This strange title wasn’t commonly used.
"It’s just a silly personal preference," Red Tail blinked a few times and replied with a light chuckle.
Only then did Old Mo and the others discover that Red Tail, who was still gloomy and worried only seconds ago, actually looked very relaxed right now. She was even in the mood for jokes.
Then she looked at Old Mo and Bai Xuesheng and introduced, "No need to be nervous. This one is from headquarters. He is…"
"Silver Mask," the silver-robed man supplied casually.
"Mm, Lord Silver Mask," Red Tail played along. Although she didn’t know Gu Nan’s intention, since he even concealed his appearance, she naturally couldn’t reveal his name.
Old Mo and Bai Xuesheng exchanged glances, then stared at that silver-robed man with strange expressions.
This was the first time they heard about their organization having something like a headquarters. No one would’ve believed it if this information didn’t come from the Grand Commander’s mouth.
"Is there a new mist mirror here?" The silver-robed man was naturally Gu Nan’s saint clone. He sat quietly in his seat and asked casually.
Mist mirrors were products of White Mist’s translation method. Cleaning up the mist on the mist mirrors was equivalent to translating the different worlds’ wills.
As long as someone completed the mission issued by a world’s will, Gu Nan would be able to obtain a part of the world's origin to build his personal dungeon.
Simply put, the mist mirror was the reason he had to rebuild White Mist.
"Yes. All the mist mirrors are gathered here." Red Tail hurriedly nodded. Not only were the mist mirrors collected through reincarnation stored here, even the ones made in Crescent Moon World were gathered here.
Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom had yet to reach the level of a Heaven or Realm Level plane, so one couldn’t directly reincarnate into a smaller plane from within his Divine Kingdom. All the previous mist mirrors he held were brought over by Lan Si from Crescent Moon World.
It was much easier now. As long as Red Tail periodically sent someone to reincarnate into Crescent Moon World, they could bring back the mist mirrors.
"Go get it," Gu Nan said matter-of-factly.
As soon as his voice fell, a voice full of anger traveled over from the opposite side, "A powerful enemy is right around the corner, yet My Lord isn’t thinking about how to preserve the organization and only cares about mist mirrors?!”
It was Bai Xuesheng who spoke. He stared at Gu Nan without flinching, as if Gu Nan must give an explanation for this.
He’d seen too many people in his family ignore the overall situation in favor of their own selfish interests. Such people were termites that ate away at the organization from the inside!
What he didn't expect was that the silver-robed man didn't even look at him. Instead, his Grand Commander glared at him furiously. "Shut up!"
"I—"
Before he could speak again, Red Tail had already whipped out two complete mist mirrors and handed them to Gu Nan.
"There's another plane in the harvesting stage. If it goes well, the harvested destiny will be enough to make another one." Red Tail added happily, "Fortunately, we didn't abandon this place, or else there would be nowhere to store the collected destiny, and it would’ve all been wasted."
Bai Xuesheng, Old Mo, and the others stared at each other. They realized this was the reason the Grand Commander insisted on staying behind instead of leaving.
"Grand Commander, I'm afraid the people from Flying Clouds will arrive soon. Should we make some preparations?" Old Mo asked as he pulled the furious Bai Xuesheng behind him.
He could tell that it was impossible for Red Tail to evacuate now, so they could only prepare for battle… He just hoped that this Lord who came from their headquarters could be a little reliable. Of course, what he really hoped for was for Flying Clouds to have no Void Cutter existences.
After thinking for a while, Old Mo added, "As long as there are no Void Cutters in Flying Clouds, we might still be able to fight—"
"There are two," that silver-robed man suddenly cut in before the Grand Commander could speak, and his tone was extremely certain.
Old Mo’s expression couldn’t help darkening slightly.
Who could know the exact number of Void Cutter enemies?
They were only able to venture a guess based on information collected from various sources and analyzed that Flying Clouds was too confident in this operation, so perhaps the enemy still had powerful cultivators as trump cards… But how in the world could this Lord who came from their “headquarters” be so certain?
Bai Xuesheng, who was on the side, was already so angry that he smiled. "May I ask how My Lord knows this?"
So they saw the silver-robed man pick up a mist mirror, instantly clear away all the mist on it with a gentle swipe of his hand, and offhandedly answer, "I just killed them."

chapters.title: Chapter 323: The Ingenious Use of Transcendent Realm Martial Artists
chapters.content:
Red Tail gave Gu Nan two coordinates, one of which was the location of Flying Clouds.
