Therefore, Gu Nan naturally visited Flying Clouds first. No matter whether Void Cutter enemies existed or not, it would simplify matters if he slaughtered them all first. Otherwise, he’d have to wait for them to come to his door. How troublesome would that be?
Inside Red Tail’s room, Bai Xuesheng and the others had already withdrawn. They were busy trying to confirm Flying Clouds’ current situation.
With Gu Nan's present realm, he could translate the two mist mirrors almost instantly.
He handed the two pure white mirrors to Red Tail. "I didn't kill all the mission personnel in Flying Clouds. You can find someone to absorb those members into White Mist."
Red Tail stared blankly, then reacted with repeated nods while her heart shivered slightly. She felt that this was Gu Nan expressing his dissatisfaction—dissatisfaction with their excessively slow mission completion speed right now.
Even though she came to White Bones Realm only a short while ago and could only recruit mission personnel from large planes, it was obviously impossible for her to say these reasons out loud.
In reality, she was overthinking this. From Gu Nan’s perspective, doing a good job or doing a bad job didn’t exist for NPCs—everything was "as it should be."
As for why he specifically urged her to pick up the pace for missions, it was simply because he just happened to glance at the personal dungeon interface and saw several of them close to 100% completion. If they put in some more effort, he might just acquire a second personal dungeon.
Even in the Divine Kingdom, personal dungeons had cooldowns. Guan Hongchen and the others had already gotten very skilled at farming "Splendid World." If a new dungeon was acquired, the growth rate of points would definitely double.
"Wait," Gu Nan stopped Red Tail just as she prepared to leave, "are there any Void Cutters in desperate straits around here, or any who intend to sell themselves in order to take revenge against a powerful enemy?"
If there were suitable candidates, Gu Nan didn’t mind selecting some local apostles.
Red Tail pondered this, but after a long time, she shook her head awkwardly. "Even in such a harsh place like White Bones Realm, there are still very few Void Cutters in desperate straits…"
She was telling the truth. With Void Cutter cultivators’ ability to enter and leave large planes at will, it was indeed hard for them to be backed into a corner so much.
Even if they greatly offended someone, as long as they weren’t dead, they’d still be able to slip away to other planes. How many planes were in the Myriad Heavens Universe? Perhaps not even the Star Rulers of the Thirteen Heavens knew the answer to that. Where would pursuers start looking for them?
Only Void Cutters in situations like Qian Han’s—where he was targeted by a Realm Level Star Ruler and also ran into someone like Gu Nan who could seal off space—would have no choice but to surrender.
Otherwise, how many cultivators who could cultivate to Void Cutter Realm would be willing to subordinate themselves to others?
For example, the Void Cutters in Starry Ocean Pavilion and Zuo Zuo's "Five Steles" were all raised from an early age. The shadow of a Star Ruler hung over their entire cultivation journey, and their own base or family was in the Star Ruler’s astral world in order to ensure their loyalty.
Gu Nan could only sigh helplessly, but at the same time, he held higher hopes for getting some otherworldly clan apostles. He was just waiting for those two bigshots to finish fighting.
However, Red Tail immediately said, "My Lord, are you looking for some Void Cutter level cultivators to stay here permanently?"
"Mm." Gu Nan nodded.
If White Mist didn’t have the protection of Void Cutter experts, then some other trouble would inevitably befall it in the future. He couldn’t run here to deal with it every time, nor could he guarantee he could arrive before it was too late every time.
So Red Tail suggested, "My Lord, do you still remember that Crescent Moon World has a kind of Transcendent Realm cultivators? They don't have the ability to break through the void, but three or four of them acting together can also fight those Void Cutters…"
Hearing this, Gu Nan suddenly raised his eyebrows and said, "They’re perfect for this!"
……
Three days later, Gu Nan was already in Crescent Moon World, while Red Tail also came with him after finishing up matters in White Bones Realm.
"My Lord, the current Transcendent Realm cultivators in Crescent Moon World have already been summoned." Red Tail handed Gu Nan a list. "Not counting those we potentially overlooked, there are fifteen people under our control."
"That many?" Gu Nan wondered. He remembered that when he came here, there were only eight large sects in this world, with one Transcendent Realm cultivator per sect, but there were actually so many now?
But Red Tail just explained with a smile, "Decades have already passed in Crescent Moon World. We gave out better cultivation techniques, and there was also no infighting amongst themselves, so more and more people were able to reach Transcendent Realm."
Gu Nan nodded and took the list without saying anything else.
Over such a long time, they had more than enough time to finish studying the essence of the so-called "Transcendent Realm." If Void Cutters were beings that reached a higher level as a lifeform, then Transcendent cultivators were more like people who took a crooked path that deviated from the main one.
Without a correct direction, they stepped onto the wrong path. As a result, they weren’t good enough to take a high post but were too proud to accept a low one.
It was far easier to reach Transcendent Realm than it was to reach Void Cutter Realm. Although their combat effectiveness wasn’t that much worse, their nature as lifeforms was still far from that of Void Cutters.
They had yet to surpass the limits of humanity, so their lifespans were still rather short, and they were still unable to control space.
However, such existences were indeed best suited for protecting White Mist. Gu Nan didn’t actually need them to travel through space; he simply needed them to contribute their fighting strength.
It was true that Gu Nan didn’t think of this group of special military strength at first. After all, he was a player, not an omniscient and omnipotent god.
As for Crescent Moon World, he only took a cursory glance at it back then and didn't take it seriously at all. On the other hand, Red Tail personally stayed there for nearly 30 years and was more familiar with it.
"The World’s Strongest Martial Arts Tournament?" After briefly scanning the list, Gu Nan saw some other words after the names.
It was a brief description and competition schedule for the "World’s Strongest Martial Arts Tournament." Even the seeded players had been decided upon.
Red Tail smiled while explaining, "Martial arts prevails in Crescent Moon World. People often argue about who the strongest martial artist in the world is and even rank them. It can be seen that they attach great importance to this false reputation."
"Luring them into a martial arts competition by using the title of “world’s strongest” is the best way to determine these people’s actual fighting strength, and we might even see secluded experts we previously overlooked."
There was no doubt about Gu Nan's wisdom. He immediately understood this plan’s benefits after Red Tail said the simple phrase “world’s strongest.”
By using the tournament to rank these martial artists, not only could they figure out the participants’ trump cards, it would also make it more convenient for future management of Crescent Moon World—in the future, the treatment of the world’s strongest would of course be better than the world’s second strongest.
If Gu Nan handled this matter himself, he might still have thought of such an idea; it’s just that as he leveled up, he paid less and less attention to these trivial matters.
This was probably one of the shortcomings of players: when their level exceeded the other party’s by too much, most people were too lazy to follow the walkthrough and simply preferred to crush enemies directly using force.
"Then let's do that." Gu Nan casually handed the list back to Red Tail. "Just say that I will also be there to watch the top 16 matches, and I’ll select some people to take to the Upper World with me."
"Take them to the Upper World?" Red Tail stared blankly, then reacted and smiled. "In that case, I'm afraid even those old monsters hiding in the mountains will have to run out now."
Gu Nan just waved his hand and asked Red Tail to take some more time to prepare thoroughly. They must be sure to catch all the Transcendent cultivators in Crescent Moon World in one fell swoop.
Anyhow, the flow of time here was 60 to 1, so he had plenty of time.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: Assassination
chapters.content:
Crescent Moon World was impassioned.
Just when the World’s Strongest Martial Arts Tournament was about to commence, the Martial Arts Alliance suddenly announced its postponement, which puzzled and even enraged many people who felt like they’d been played.
However, when they received news that experts from the Upper World would be watching the tournament in person and might even take some outstanding martial artists with them to the Upper World, the entire Crescent Moon World fell into a fervor.
In fact, in Crescent Moon World’s legends, Transcendent Realm’s highest attainment had always been the ability to shatter space.
But in reality, nobody with that realm had appeared in thousands of years. The last time someone was suspected of reaching that realm was decades ago, when the world was unified and the Martial Arts Alliance was established.
The Martial Arts Alliance currently ruled the world. Only four of the eight major sects from the past still remained, all of which became subordinates of the Alliance.
Zhongli Sword Sect, the first sect to side with Gu Nan, was naturally one of them, and it was also the most powerful sect in the current Martial Arts Alliance.
Several young men and women were gathered together inside Zhongli Sword Sect, discussing something, while a swordsman in white sat in the seat of honor. He was Zhongli Suwen, the founder.
Decades had passed, yet Suwen still possessed a young appearance. It’s just that he had a few more white hairs on his head.
"Martial Grandfather, is the recent news true? Shattering space, wow!" One person asked excitedly.
"Could it be false information the Alliance deliberately spread to attract participants for the tournament?" Another woman spoke; her guess was half right.
"Martial Grandfather…"
"Alright, alright." Suwen waved his hand helplessly. "I specifically rushed back to the sect to tell you guys that it's all true. Sign up for the tournament immediately."
These two men and two women in front of him were all disciples and grand-disciples of Suwen, and three of the four had already reached Transcendent Realm. The present Zhongli Sword Sect was prosperous and thriving.
As soon as Suwen's voice fell, the four people suddenly quieted down, all with incredulous looks on their faces.
"So it’s actually true?!”
"Do people capable of shattering space really exist in this world…?"
"Of course it's true." Suwen smiled freely. "Your Martial Grandfather saw it with my own eyes decades ago… If that one truly came back, then shattering space is just an afterthought."
The young people suddenly exploded with questions again, pestering Suwen to tell them stories. But Suwen didn't mention the past and just told them to work hard.
"I’ve long been unable to see through that one’s realm. In all likelihood, he returned to this world to find good seedlings to raise as successors, so you youngsters may have greater chances of catching his attention than old fellows like us," Suwen surmised.
In his view, Gu Nan most likely returned here to accept new disciples and such. After all, there was no way he’d want their measly strength otherwise.
Of course Suwen didn't know that his last guess actually hit the mark.
The four disciples and grand-disciples naturally didn’t doubt their Martial Grandfather’s speculations. This was the most reasonable explanation.
Suwen encouraged them one by one and finally said to the last girl, "Ah Xiu, you became a disciple the latest, so your cultivation is still a little short of Transcendent Realm, but you have the most talent. You must fight hard this time, okay?"
"Yes, Martial Grandfather!" The young girl named Ah Xiu nodded repeatedly as she answered with a youthful voice.
She looked only 15 or 16 years old, but she was already close to the peak of martial arts. Such talent really was enviable.
Suwen nodded with satisfaction and let the four people go back to prepare. After they left the room, another woman started talking to Ah Xiu.
"Martial Sister Ah Xiu, you must work hard!" The woman laughed playfully. "If you can step into Transcendent Realm in one fell swoop before the Martial Arts Tournament, your chances of victory will be much more certain."
Ah Xiu looked a little distressed. "Sister Xiaoqing, I also really want to break through… but every time I’m about to truly step into Transcendent Realm, there always seems to be a voice in my heart telling me that this is not the right path."
However, her senior martial sister Lu Xiaoqing just revealed a satisfied look and pulled Ah Xiu forward. "Come with me. Sister Lu will help you find fortuitous encounters!"
……
The city whose name was already changed to “Martial Alliance City” was located at the center of Crescent Moon World. Sumptuous newly-built houses stood in the middle of the city.
It’s said that this was where the Martial Arts Alliance was first established. Now, it was the headquarters of the Alliance, a holy land of martial arts in the hearts of cultivators all over the world.
"Sister Xiaoqing, where on earth are you taking me…" Ah Xiu, who was pulled along by Lu Xiaoqing, had already taken several twists and turns within this place, nearly bumping into people several times.
They were in the Martial Arts Alliance’s headquarters right now! Everyone who lived here was a bigshot, one of the higher-ups of the Alliance. If someone caught them sneaking in here…
At the thought of this, Ah Xiu immediately tried to dissuade her bold senior martial sister again, "Martial Sister, let's hurry back. What if someone sees us…"
"Hurry back where? You don't want to break through?" Lu Xiaoqing’s face was full of frustration that Ah Xiu didn’t meet her expectations.
"Break through?" Ah Xiu stared at Lu Xiaoqing in a daze, wondering what this had to do with her breakthrough.
Did she want to ask the seniors here to give Ah Xiu pointers? But which of these seniors could compare with their Martial Grandfather?
As if seeing through her thoughts, Lu Xiaoqing smiled mysteriously. "Naturally, no one here could give you pointers in the past, but this time is different! Why do you think the Alliance suddenly changed its mind?"
Ah Xiu was gifted with intelligence at an early age. She immediately understood her senior martial sister’s words and said excitedly, "It’s, it’s definitely because that senior who can shatter space returned already. Maybe he's right here!"
……
Ah Xiu and Lu Xiaoqing guessed right; Gu Nan was indeed here.
Not only was he in Crescent Moon World, but he was also very easy to find—a new courtyard with the largest, most luxurious, and most nouveau riche vibes was built here, and it was placed right in the center of this region.
Anyone who was even slightly familiar with the Alliance wouldn’t be able to miss it.
The two women were naturally no exception. They quickly snuck inside, and Ah Xiu immediately heard Lu Xiaoqing exclaim, "It's Senior Red Tail! I met her once with Martial Grandfather!"
In front of them, a silver-robed person lay leisurely on a recliner, while Red Tail was standing in front of him, reporting something in a low voice.
"This means that person is…" Ah Xiu set her eyes on the silver-robed man but couldn’t see anything out of the ordinary about him. He just seemed like a normal person basking in the sun.
Lu Xiaoqing excitedly got up, about to pull Ah Xiu along to pay their respects.
She believed that with her junior martial sister's innate talent and comprehension ability, Ah Xiu could definitely enter that one’s discerning eye—if even Ah Xiu couldn’t, then she was afraid no one in the world could!
However, at this moment, Ah Xiu suddenly pulled her back. She glanced around warily and whispered, "Martial Sister, there are other people here…"
"Other people?" Lu Xiaoqing was taken aback.
"Quick, kill her!"
"Our mission will be complete after killing her. Then return immediately and don't linger in this plane!"
"Okay!"
The rustling dialogue sounded behind the two, but they couldn't understand the conversation.
The next second, four figures flew out from behind them, heading straight for Red Tail!

chapters.title: Chapter 325: Natural-Born Child of Destiny
chapters.content:
"Look out!"
Ah Xiu's senses were sharper than her senior martial sister's. She had already rushed out and shouted a warning almost as soon as the four attackers appeared.
The four people who appeared out of nowhere were faster than Ah Xiu imagined. They were all extraordinarily skilled and practically reached Red Tail in the blink of an eye.
A trace of anxiety entered Ah Xiu’s eyes. Although she was young, she already had a lot of combat experience, so she could tell the four enemies’ general cultivation realms from a glance.
None of them were weaker than her, and they even seemed to have a combination attack. They were clearly assassins specially trained for assassination!
"Most of this world is under the Alliance’s control. Exactly what organization can train assassins like these?!”
Ah Xiu tried her best to chase them, only to find that they’d thrown her far behind them. She couldn’t help feeling endless astonishment.
‘There are four such assassins, while Senior Red Tail doesn’t seem to have reached the Transcendent Realm yet…’
She anxiously looked back, hoping her senior martial sister could quickly help Senior Red Tail out, but all she saw was an unfamiliar face with an icy expression.
"Martial Sister…"
Lu Xiaoqing sneered and said disdainfully, "I thought it would take some effort to find the target, but I didn't expect it to be so easy! Looks like bringing a little girl like you along as a cover was an unnecessary move."
Ah Xiu couldn't help feeling chills all over when she heard her senior martial sister’s unfamiliar tone.
Only then did she realize that these people had been following her, and the reason her senior martial sister brought her along was to have an excuse if they were discovered!
‘She wasn’t looking for the legendary senior at all! She’s clearly looking for Senior Red Tail!’
But Lu Xiaoqing ignored her and just fixed her gaze ahead, where Red Tail was now surrounded.
An unexpected powerhouse who could "shatter space" really did upset their plans, or else they wouldn't have been in such a hurry to attack, but their mission hadn’t completely failed yet.
After all, this was merely a powerful cultivator from a small plane, while their goal was just to assassinate Red Tail. As long as they could kill her, it didn’t matter if all of them died!
However, right as Lu Xiaoqing thought this, she heard a voice from behind her, "Reincarnator?"
It was now Lu Xiaoqing's turn to freeze in shock. She never thought that someone in such a small plane would actually know about reincarnation!
‘Don’t tell me that the so-called powerhouse who can shatter space is also a reincarnator?’
She hurriedly looked back, but it wasn’t the silver robe that greeted her, but four familiar figures—her four companions were actually caught in a giant hand made of shadows and thrown onto the ground.
And only behind them was the expressionless face of the silver-robed man.
"What plane are you guys from?" He asked leisurely.
But Lu Xiaoqing didn't speak. She just stared at the other party with a gloomy expression. In any case, her current body was a reincarnation. Dying here wasn’t anything to fear. Rather, she should take this time to think up countermeasures.
However, Gu Nan had no intention of waiting at all. He gave her a sunny smile, then stepped on the head of a person on the ground, instantly crushing it like a watermelon.
"You…"
The person died on the spot, and the tendril of his soul that reincarnated here vanished simultaneously. But before it dissipated, its little connection with the reincarnator’s main world was keenly captured by Gu Nan.
He followed that connection and quickly locked onto the coordinates on the opposite side, nonchalantly asking, "This is… Major Martial Realm?"
The Myriad Heavens Universe had over a hundred Heaven and Realm Level main worlds, and their coordinates had long been made public.
After tracing the connection back to the opposite side’s coordinates, Gu Nan could immediately tell what plane it was as long as he compared it with the publicly-known coordinates of all large planes.
Martial arts was probably one of the most popular cultivation paths in the Myriad Heavens Universe, and the number of martial artists even surpassed Daoists. Furthermore, there were even two Realm Level large planes solely for martial arts.
In order to distinguish them, people called the first martial arts plane to exist the Major Martial Realm, while the martial arts plane that ascended to Realm Level afterwards was called the Minor Martial Realm.
These people before Gu Nan were clearly reincarnators from Major Martial Realm who came to Crescent Moon World to complete a mission.
Ever since Gu Nan arrived at Star Realm, he’d always been the one reincarnating to other worlds, all the way until he advanced to Tier 4 and was no longer restricted from traveling between planes.
Therefore, Gu Nan had never experienced this strange feeling of running into a reincarnator as a half-native before, so he studied them with great interest.
Lu Xiaoqing, on the other hand, was already frozen.
How could she still not understand after seeing such a scene? This wasn’t some reincarnator; this was clearly a Void Cutter powerhouse!
They just wanted to finish a mission. Who could’ve imagined they’d run into such a bigshot here?
As a reincarnator, Lu Xiaoqing originally shouldn't have been so alarmed, but the deep-rooted fear of Void Cutters made her tremble involuntarily.
"What is the name of your organization?" Gu Nan's voice was still serene.
"We…" Lu Xiaoqing almost wanted to reveal the name of her organization, but her remaining rationality told her that since the other party was a Void Cutter, she absolutely mustn’t stay here any longer!
With a single thought, she’d already destroyed that wisp of her own soul, and her body collapsed softly.
Ah Xiu exclaimed in shock from the side, while Red Tail also walked over briskly.
But Gu Nan wasn’t really surprised. No Prodigious Realm reincarnator was a fool. Being able to read the situation was the simplest of matters for them.
The longer she stayed here, the more likely it was for experts to find clues pointing to her organization, so it was better to return early.
"Unfortunately, this plane is too remote." Red Tail saw this scene and naturally understood what just happened. She shook her head with a sigh. "If we had more of their souls, we might just be able to find where they came from."
Gu Nan, however, shook his head and went back to his long recliner, his eyes staring at the blue sky in thought.
Red Tail didn't know what he was thinking, so she didn't say much more. Instead, she glanced at Ah Xiu and asked with a smile, "Little Sister, are you also here to assassinate me?"
"O-Of course not!" Ah Xiu gave her a look that said
are you kidding me
while repeatedly waving her hands.
She explained how the entire thing started and constantly stressed that "Martial Sister isn’t a bad person; she must’ve been possessed by a ghost"—in her eyes, perhaps her senior martial sister was just unconscious.
In a sense, her senior martial sister really was possessed by a ghost, except there was no possibility of recovery once the ghost possessed her.
"So you're here to ask your seniors for pointers?" Red Tail stretched out a hand to pinch Ah Xiu's cheek. This girl seemed to possess an inexplicable approachability and warmth that made it hard for people to harbor ill intent towards her.
Ah Xiu hurriedly nodded, staring at Red Tail with big sparkling eyes while involuntarily sneaking a few glances at Gu Nan in passing.
That earlier scene where Gu Nan instantly captured those four still lingered in her heart. She couldn’t even see how the other party did it… ‘As expected of someone in a realm that can shatter space!’
Thus, she saw Red Tail walk up to that silver-robed senior and whisper something. She thought Senior Red Tail was helping her persuade that senior, and her heart was full of hope.
Of course Ah Xiu wouldn’t know that what Red Tail actually said was, "My Lord, this girl should be a natural-born child of destiny from this plane. Should we kill her to make a mist mirror?"

chapters.title: Chapter 326: Ah Xius Fate
chapters.content:
Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes and gave Ah Xiu a cold look.
That kind of indifferent gaze felt like he was looking down on an ant, making Ah Xiu somewhat uncomfortable. No one had ever looked at her with such eyes before.
She felt a little uneasy in her heart, wondering if the matter with her martial sister gave this senior a bad impression of her.
Of course she was overthinking this, because Gu Nan looked at everyone like this.
"A natural-born child of destiny?" Gu Nan broke out of his original thoughts. With his present knowledge, he naturally knew about destiny.
Destiny was nothing more than the manifestation of the will of the plane itself—the will of the plane could be manifested, but no one could guarantee that it would be completed.
As long as the external force was strong enough, the will of the plane could be casually trampled upon.
White Mist’s translation method created children of destiny in a certain area by leading around the will of a plane. It would then harvest those artificial children of destiny.
Of course natural-born children of destiny could also be used and was even a ready-made material. It would be a shame to waste it.
"Let her participate in the Martial Arts Tournament. Set her up to win first place and make her destiny peak," Gu Nan casually instructed, then quickly closed his eyes again.
"Yes."
Red Tail nodded, then turned to Ah Xiu and said with a smile, "My Lord’s meaning is that as long as you can win first place, he will accept you as his disciple."
"First… place?!”
……
Gu Nan was lying alone in the courtyard after Red Tail and Ah Xiu left, basking in the lazy afternoon sunshine, but his thoughts never stopped.
The appearance of reincarnators from the Major Martial Realm made him realize a loophole in his past thinking.
Gu Nan always thought that no one would be able to find his Divine Kingdom again after he adjusted its coordinates several times, but he overlooked another possibility—reincarnation!
If the Divine Kingdom plane spontaneously disseminated its will to the outside world and issued missions, that was equivalent to broadcasting its coordinates for all to see.
Sooner or later, certain powerful figures would notice this strange plane as time went on.
Gu Nan even suspected that maybe this was the fundamental reason why Heaven and Realm Level planes were recognized as main worlds that couldn’t be reincarnated into while other planes could only be reincarnated into.
"I must study the essence of a plane’s will when I have time." Gu's Nan frowned slightly.
As the construction of the Divine Kingdom advanced step-by-step, he seemed to get busier again, and there was a gradually increasing number of matters of all manners that he had to handle.
It wasn’t this troublesome in his previous life’s game. Ultimately, it was because there were too many living beings and organizations in the Myriad Heavens Universe, and there were also too many powerful people here.
……
After letting down all the martial artists in the world once by delaying the tournament, the Martial Arts Alliance finally didn't repeat their mistake and held the World’s Strongest Martial Arts Tournament as scheduled.
Such a martial arts competition really satisfied all the spectators. Countless masters they ordinarily would never be able to see fought in the arena one after another with their special skills.
Not only did the various sects’ younger generations participate, but even old fellows like Suwen joined—after all, they were the ones most qualified to compete in the tournament to decide the world’s strongest!
As round after round of fighting ended, the situation gradually became clear, and the top 16 were decided.
Transcendent Realm masters were indeed much stronger than ordinary Prodigious Realm cultivators. They possessed offensive and defensive abilities comparable to that of Void Cutter experts; even without the support of laws, it wasn’t something ordinary people could withstand.
Therefore, this phase of the Martial Arts Tournament was basically a fight amongst Transcendent Realm powerhouses. However, this wasn’t without exception.
“As expected of someone naturally blessed by destiny." Red Tail looked at the last name on the top 16 list and said with satisfaction, "Ah Xiu defeated a Transcendent Realm cultivator in the last round."
Gu Nan nodded; he also saw that match. As a mortal, Ah Xiu was only able to defeat her opponent by utilizing swordsmanship, tactics, willpower, and even some geographical advantages.
It could be said that she far surpassed her opponent in everything except actual cultivation.
"But isn’t this also the limit? Not even children of destiny are without limits," Red Tail continued.
She was an expert at toying with destiny, so she knew the limitations of this power. At the very least, it couldn’t raise people’s cultivation realms out of thin air.
Additionally, if the person the power of destiny converged upon was too useless and incompetent, then the destiny surrounding that person would dissipate on its own.
Although Ah Xiu didn't have this problem, she was born in Crescent Moon World—the strength of her destiny held her back instead.
The plane itself was warning her that Transcendent Realm was the wrong path, so she couldn't break through Transcendent Realm no matter what she did.
"If the wrong path won't do, what about the right path?" Gu Nan asked with a smile.
"The right path…" Red Tail stared at Gu Nan blankly. The thought of using a Void Cutter as material for making a mist mirror had never occurred to her.
Even the Indigo Mound tribe, who developed this translation method, had never entertained such a crazy idea!
Gu Nan put down the document detailing Ah Xiu’s background and casually said, "Her life thus far has been too smooth-sailing. How can she bring out the full power of destiny like this? Go help her."
"Yes."
……
Zhongli Sword Sect.
"Ah Xiu, you’re too incredible! You actually defeated Elder Qin!" A girl around Ah Xiu's age said excitedly while tugging on Ah Xiu's sleeve.
Elder Qin was one of the elders in the Martial Arts Alliance, as well as the Transcendent Realm opponent Ah Xiu defeated in the competition.
But Ah Xiu just smiled awkwardly. Even her smile seemed a little forced, because it irritated her injuries.
She was only able to advance to the top 16 by giving it all she’s got, and she was injured all over as a result. But her upcoming opponents were all stronger than Elder Qin. Winning first place truly was extremely difficult.
‘What in the world is that senior thinking?’
Ah Xiu couldn't help thinking in her mind, but before she could figure it out, she heard a loud scream from her companion.
"W-Who are you guys? Who allowed you to break into my Zhongli Sword Sect?!”
Ah Xiu looked up in astonishment and saw a group of people push open the door and file in, all with sneers on their faces.
"Zhongli Sword Sect’s Suwen harbored ill intentions and sent assassins after the Alliance Leader. We are also here on orders. Ladies, please don’t make this hard for us," the leader said expressionlessly.
"Nonsense!" Ah Xiu's companion shouted, "Martial Grandfather is an elder of the Alliance. How can he send assassins after the Alliance Leader?!”
The leading man just replied coldly, "The Alliance will give you justice in this matter. All you have to do right now is come with us."
Ah Xiu’s friend still wanted to say something, but Ah Xiu’s heart sank—she did see her senior martial sister assassinate Senior Red Tail with her own eyes!
‘Don’t tell me the culprit they found from their investigation is actually Martial Grandfather…?’
Ah Xiu's thoughts swirled around in her head. Seeing that the other party was already rushing at them, she drew her sword on the spot without much thought.
……
The next day, the Martial Arts Alliance announced to the world that Zhongli Sword Sect attempted to assassinate the Alliance Leader, and the Alliance sent troops to encircle and annihilate the sect.
As the principal offender, Suwen was killed on the spot, and all the high-level members of Zhongli Sword Sect were arrested, including three Transcendent Realm cultivators.
Only Suwen's favorite disciple, Ah Xiu, was still at large. She became a wanted fugitive all over the world.
Three days later, the World’s Strongest Martial Arts Tournament officially ended. Sect Master Qin of Venerate Heaven Sect won the title of the "World’s Strongest." A mysterious senior took him to the upper world together with nine other Transcendent Realm participants, attracting the envy of countless people.
Right as the ten martial artists from Crescent Moon World reached White Bones Realm, Gu Nan's saint clone had already appeared on the frontline plane, Tiluo World.
The Time Arena was finally about to open.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Glazed Jade Bones
chapters.content:
The Time Arena was a rather unconventional kind of dungeon where time seemed to completely freeze for the outside world.
In other words, in the eyes of the outside world, it would appear as if a winner was decided as soon as this dungeon activated, so they didn’t have to wait at all.
In order to seize the Sand of Time, Gu Nan needed to make some preparations.
Tiluo World.
Gu Nan stepped out of the space passage. The place was already quite lively. The summons from Clockwork Heaven very effectively attracted a group of Void Cutters and even Star Rulers who had yet to acquire their own astral worlds.
Not everyone knew that the Sand of Time could only be used on one’s astral world; most people still had a superficial understanding of blessed lands.
"It's open! It's open!" Someone's voice traveled over from the side.
Gu Nan looked up and saw a faintly-glowing blue bead floating in the air.
That was none other than the Time Arena. The true body of this peculiar dungeon was a round bead. The dungeon was hidden inside the bead.
Countless figures started to fly up, scrambling to be the first person to enter the bead. Gu Nan, however, wasn’t in a hurry—although the dungeon just opened its doors, they were still a long way off from its official activation.
Gu Nan's gaze swept through the crowd, seemingly looking for someone. As people continued to leave, Tiluo World emptied up significantly. Thus, he heard a voice from behind without even having to search for the person.
"Mr. Gu Nan?" Lou Wanying saw Gu Nan at a glance and led a group of people over.
The group had a total of four people. Besides Lou Wanying himself and Fang Yanqing, his senior martial sister who met Gu Nan before, there were two new companions.
"You came just in time. I was looking for you," Gu Nan immediately said when he saw Lou Wanying.
Lou Wanying was very happy. He thought that Gu Nan had finally come around and decided to enter the Time Arena with him.
It wasn't that he wanted to cling to a powerful teammate. Rather, he was very confident in ultimately winning the treasure due to his family’s inheritance and Senior Lu, so he was eager to bring Gu Nan, his former teammate, along for the ride.
"Who are these two?" Gu Nan asked as he pointed to the two new companions beside him.
Lou Wanying originally wanted to invite him to “join the party,” but he decided to introduce them first when he heard Gu Nan’s question.
His two new companions were also a man and a woman. The woman was petite and had the appearance of a little girl. She was said to be the only daughter of the Star Ruler of White Bones Realm, Bai Qiaozhen.
It was a bit of a coincidence for Gu Nan to meet her here. He’d just left White Bones Realm not long ago and immediately ran into the daughter of the Star Ruler of White Bones Realm.
The other companion was a gorgeously dressed young man whose face was full of arrogance. He looked at Gu Nan the way a young master from a city would look at a country bumpkin.
His name was Luo Ze, and he was indeed a young master. He was from Clockwork Heaven, and his grandfather… was also a Star Ruler.
Star Ruler subordinates existed in exceedingly powerful planes like the Thirteen Heavens, just like how the World of Gods also had subordinate gods in the major gods’ Divine Kingdoms.
"Clockwork Heaven?" Gu Nan’s gaze fell on Luo Ze, and a cold smile appeared on his face.
He specifically came to Tiluo World just to find Luo Ze. Since he refused Lu Wen’s request, this Star Ruler of Clockwork Heaven must’ve found someone else to help Lou Wanying.
If he wanted to get the Sand of Time, he first had to disrupt Lu Wen’s plan.
"That’s right. You’re Gu Nan? I've heard of you." Luo Ze was tall and quite handsome, so he looked down at Gu Nan condescendingly at this moment.
Gu Nan, however, ignored him and looked up. Now that he found the person from Clockwork Heaven, was Lu Wen watching them right now?
If he was, then Lu Wen should be making his move around now.
The arrogance on Luo Ze's face grew, but his thoughts weren’t actually careless in the slightest. Instead, he was already clutching a talisman that his grandfather prepared especially for him.
On the surface, Luo Ze looked like an arrogant young master and even took the trouble to always maintain this image in front of Lou Wanying, but in reality, he was extremely perceptive and coolheaded, or else he wouldn't have been picked to carry out this mission.
In order to send him to Lou Wanying’s side, they even arranged a chance encounter before finally managing to get him to join Lou Wanying’s party by having Bai Qiaozhen introduce him to Lou Wanying.
As for Gu Nan, grandfather only gave one order: ‘Provoke him! Provoke him at all costs, then use grandfather's talisman to kill him!’
‘After all, Gu Nan was actually that one’s first choice, but he was too brain-dead to agree to it, which is why I got this chance instead. If he suddenly changed his mind, then won’t I suffer a complete loss?’
‘An opportunity to fulfill that one's orders doesn’t come often!’
Lou Wanying saw the atmosphere between the two turn a little tense and hurriedly stood between them while saying to Gu Nan, "Mr. Gu Nan, Luo Ze, he…"
"Get out of the way!" Luo Ze didn’t wait for him to finish and had already pushed Lou Wanying aside. He glared at Gu Nan. "I heard you’re the reincarnation of a Heavenly Demon or something? Ha, this young master doesn’t care what kind of demon you are—"
Before he could finish, he saw a hand suddenly reach over and fall on his face with terrifying force.
When Gu Nan realized Lu Wen didn’t seem to be paying attention to them, he seized the opportunity to slap Luo Ze and send him flying far away.
But Gu Nan didn’t tarry and immediately went over to that side. This Luo Ze definitely wasn’t weak, and he seemed to have refined his body through a secret technique to make his physique much stronger than that of ordinary cultivators.
Lou Wanying seemed stunned by Gu Nan's move and was speechless for a while. Instead, his senior martial sister Fang Yanqing blocked Gu Nan’s way.
"What are you doing?!" Fang Yanqing glared at Gu Nan furiously. "Even if Luo Ze's attitude wasn’t too good, how can you just casually hit people?"
However, Gu Nan didn't even spare her a glance as his left hand grabbed her by the hair and flung her to the side with great force.
Fang Yanqing shot out like an arrow, precisely piercing the building next to them and turning it into rubble.
During this time, Gu Nan had already arrived in front of Luo Ze and lifted him with one hand. The latter was looking at him with a frightened expression, but the talisman in his hand had fallen to the side.
Even the most powerful talisman took time to activate. The most awkward thing about Luo Ze’s current situation was that Gu Nan's movements were so fast that he couldn't react at all.
"W-Wait!" Luo Ze shouted, trying to attract Gu Nan's attention. As long as he used words to stall the other party for a few seconds, he could take a few steps over and try to grab the talisman again.
His physique was far beyond normal, so Gu Nan's earlier slap actually only caused him some minor injuries but didn’t affect his movement.
‘As long as I can snatch back the talisman and summon grandfather’s power, I’ll definitely… Ack!’
Luo Ze suddenly felt a sharp pain in his stomach before he could finish those thoughts and involuntarily coughed up a mouthful of blood. Gu Nan’s fist had hit him squarely in the stomach, almost blasting apart his abdomen.
"You… I'll kill you!"
Luo Ze was in so much pain that he couldn't control himself and finally threw all his bullshit rationality aside. He no longer bothered with hiding his true power and frantically activated his laws.
A jade-white light glowed from his body, revealing all the bones in his body. On the contrary, his skin and flesh began to turn transparent.
"Glazed Jade Bones." White Bones Realm’s Bai Qiaozhen, the little girl who’d been watching from the side all this time, finally revealed a look of realization.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: The Invincible Power of Space?
chapters.content:
Out of all of Lou Wanying’s companions, Bai Qiaozhen was probably the one who had the clearest grasp of the situation.
She didn’t know the inside story between Gu Nan and Clockwork Heaven, but she did know about Gu Nan and Luo Ze’s identities.
While the Thirteen Heavens were certainly mysterious, that only applied to the aloof and untouchable Star Rulers of the Thirteen Heavens. The other people in the Thirteen Heavens were still mere mortals.
She knew Luo Ze wasn’t a simple figure. He used such a roundabout way to approach Lou Wanying by having her act as an intermediary—Luo Ze’s motive definitely wasn’t as simple as merely wanting to be Lou Wanying’s friend.
And that Gu Nan was said to be the reincarnation of a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon who was incomparably strong. Some people were even calling him the strongest person under Star Ruler Realm. It’s just that nobody knew when he’d be able to take that final step into Star Ruler Realm.
She could tell from a glance that these two weren’t on friendly terms, although she didn’t know what caused their conflict. But this was none of her business; Bai Qiaozhen only wanted to take this opportunity to see both sides’ trump cards.
Luo Ze had already shown his cards right now—not even Bai Qiaozhen expected that he was actually cultivating Glazed Jade Bones!
Glazed Jade Bones was a body refining technique from ancient times. There were many such secret techniques in the Thirteen Heavens, but very few people actually cultivated them for real.
Ancient techniques weren’t necessarily stronger than modern techniques, and they also had various flaws.
For example, this "Glazed Jade Bones" was indeed a top-tier body refining technique in terms of strength, but very few people were willing to cultivate it because it was extremely difficult to cultivate.
The difficulty wasn’t because it needed a lot of precious resources or innate talent, but rather, the need for “ruthlessness.”
To cultivate "Glazed Jade Bones," one must scrape off their own flesh and directly soak their bones in a special medicinal liquid and cultivate for a full 81 days!
In these 81 days, the cultivator must constantly scrape new flesh off of their bones to prevent any new skin or flesh from growing.
And for a living person, it was impossible to scrape off all of their flesh at once, so a person could only cultivate one part of their bones at a time… How many people could persevere in the face of such pain?
But the cultivator would naturally gain incomparable power in exchange for such pain.
It was said that after cultivating the Glazed Jade Bones to major attainment, the cultivator’s bones would be able to resist weapons of the same realm, becoming impervious to sword or spear in the truest sense.
From the moment Bai Qiaozhen saw the Glazed Jade Bones, her gaze toward Luo Ze had changed a bit, looking at him with some respect.
‘Since it’s the Glazed Jade Bones, I’m afraid it’ll be hard for this Gu Nan to kill Luo Ze—’
Crack!
Gu Nan kicked Luo Ze's leg, instantly fracturing the bones that were still glowing jade-white just seconds ago, while Gu Nan himself finally turned his head to look at Bai Qiaozhen. "What kind of bones did you say this was?"
This little girl seemed to mutter something earlier, but he didn’t catch everything she said.
Bai Qiaozhen, on the other hand, was gaping in shock, too stunned to answer him.
Unbearable pain traveled up from his leg, but Luo Ze actually felt more pain in his heart.
‘Glazed Jade Bones… was actually shattered in one kick? Then what was the point of me silently enduring this pain for all these years?’
For a while, Luo Ze was actually a little lost despondent.
But Gu Nan didn’t care about his thoughts and threw another punch that hit Luo Ze's chest, forcibly breaking several of his ribs. The glow from the Glazed Jade Bones dimmed even further.
Glazed Jade Bones could only withstand attacks from weapons of the same realm, while Gu Nan's Evil God physique was able to twist weapons of the same realm into pretzels.
"Mr. Gu Nan!" A loud shout came from behind Gu Nan; Lou Wanying had finally spoken up.
He raised his own golden sword and said sternly, "Mr. Gu Nan, this is the last time I’m calling you that. You hit Luo Ze for no reason—"
Wham!
Gu Nan's fist came in contact with his face, and Lou Wanying instantly flew out backwards, the golden sword falling to the side.
After blasting away Lou Wanying with a punch, Gu Nan went back to Luo Ze's side again, planning to break his spine.
From beginning to end, Gu Nan's goal had always been to disrupt Lu Wen's plans by killing Luo Ze. As for Lou Wanying, the one Lu Wen designated as this generation’s main character, Gu Nan didn’t take him seriously at all.
Even main characters still had to follow the basic rules.
A soft sigh rang out above the endless sky.
Surrounded by the mysterious law of time, Lu Wen was still keeping his attention on the God of Time Valen, but Lou Wanying's unexpected injury caused him to sense something.
Lu Wen diverted a sliver of his attention to Lou Wanying’s group and instantly understood what just transpired in Tiluo World. He told the giant dragon on his shoulder, "Go help him."
The giant silver dragon was still standing on his shoulder. Her huge body swayed gently as she asked in confusion, "Didn't he say he would rob the item only after they win it? Humans are all liars."
Lu Wen revealed a helpless smile. "He did say he would rob it afterwards, but he never said he wouldn’t kill people beforehand."
The silver dragon fell silent for a while. Finally, she wordlessly spread her pair of silver wings, instantly cutting through space and falling into the mortal world.
In Tiluo World, Gu Nan held the half-dead Luo Ze with one hand while his other one methodically broke all the bones in Luo Ze’s body.
At the very least, this Luo Ze was still a peak Void Cutter expert, so just breaking his spine wasn’t enough to put him out of commission.
Lou Wanying and his senior martial sister were both heavily injured from Gu Nan’’s beatings. Only Bai Qiaozhen was still on the side, unharmed.
So, taking advantage of the time where Lou Wanying was unconscious, a silver color descended from the nine heavens above. The energy from an indescribable law enveloped Gu Nan’s body.
Gu Nan’s expression changed slightly, and his figure had already disappeared in that instant. Immediately after he left, his original location was sliced in half; the entire space directly broke apart.
The Luo Ze that Gu Nan tried to kill for half a day but still couldn’t deal with was actually sliced apart.
This silver dragon was clearly a natural-born god who was born with Star Ruler Realm power. All she lacked was higher realms.
The silver dragon's huge body circled around in midair for a while and finally came to a slow stop in the air. She actually stood upright like a person, staring at Gu Nan quietly.
"Sure enough, humans don’t keep their word," her voice was very cold and clear, yet it also contained a natural nobility that made people involuntarily feel ashamed of themselves.
Gu Nan didn't even have the desire to respond to her. He turned around and was about to open a passage to leave—he had come to kill Luo Ze, and his goal had already been achieved.
But at that moment, he found that the space in front of him suddenly became incomparably tough, making it very hard to open a passage in space. The sense of danger in his heart reappeared.
So Gu Nan's figure disappeared once again, and the space he was originally at also split open immediately afterwards.
The silver dragon just floated coldly in midair, yet her power of space was able to follow Gu Nan like a shadow, keeping him busy.
"The power of space is practically invincible against opponents of the same realm, not to mention Gu Nan is still one step short of Star Ruler Realm." Bai Qiaozhen could see the situation clearly from the side and couldn't help sighing.
Of course she could tell that this huge dragon was none other than that one's beloved pet and one of the legendary dragons of creation, the Dragon of Space!
But what she didn't expect was that Gu Nan suddenly turned at the next second and dashed towards the ground, picking up a figure in the blink of an eye—Lou Wanying!
He raised the unconscious Lou Wanying in front of him like a shield. Thus, the rupturing space that was following him came to a stop in this instant.
The silver dragon in the air was silent for a while but quickly spoke again, "It's useless. You can't escape from this space, and using him as a shield will only delay the inevitable for a little longer."
Along with her words, the cracked space quickly changed directions, bypassing Lou Wanying and directly pouncing on Gu Nan.
But Gu Nan moved even faster. He gripped Lou Wanying with one hand as his figure rushed forward. In one-thirtieth of the time it took to blink, he’d already appeared in front of the giant silver dragon.
The giant dragon's eyes suddenly widened and her originally upright body bent abruptly—Gu Nan's unforgiving fist had smashed into her soft belly!
"Who said I’m going to escape?"
Gu Nan sneered, swinging Lou Wanying around like a stick to prevent the space fractures from approaching him while simultaneously throwing a kick at the silver dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Lacking Fine Control
chapters.content:
"Roar!"
A furious roar resounded throughout Tiluo World. The silver dragon thrashed madly in the air, causing a fearsome power of space to spread in all directions, almost tearing all their surroundings to pieces.
Fortunately, the furious silver dragon was no longer in the right state of mind to consciously control her laws—the power of space she instinctively wielded wasn’t very condensed, or else her attack just now would’ve been enough to pulverize Lou Wanying.
But Lou Wanying was nevertheless unconscious throughout this exchange and could only tank all attacks with his Tier 4 body, so in the end, the power of space instantly inflicted heavy injuries upon him.
However, Gu Nan was no longer inclined to worry about Lou Wanying's survival and casually tossed him aside while Gu Nan himself stuck close to the silver dragon's belly, his figure swaying unpredictably in all directions.
The sharp pain brought the silver dragon back to her senses, but she received a few more punches to the stomach in the process. For a while, she was at a loss on what to do.
The enormous silver dragon was called Long Ling’er, a name given by Lu Wen.
Long Ling'er wasn’t actually very old when considering the lifespan of the dragon race. She also hadn’t experienced many battles yet and mostly relied on her instincts to fight.
In contrast, Gu Nan's combat experience was way too rich.
Not only did he know all of the dragon race’s weaknesses, he was also incomparably familiar with the law of space.
The law of space was indeed quite powerful and possessed very interesting playstyles in terms of both attack and support, but the dragon before him was obviously still a beginner at it.
Regarding this kind of newbie who only knew how to "tear apart space," merely sticking close to them was enough to stump the opponent.
The current Long Ling'er was like a human holding a sharp knife while a bee buzzed wildly over her stomach and even stung her every once in a while. This annoyed her immensely, but at the same time, she also didn’t dare slash it with her knife.
If she really did swing her knife down, the probability of cutting the opponent was very low, but in contrast, she would almost certainly cut herself!
That’s right—Gu Nan was bullying Long Ling'er by using her lack of experience and inability to finely manipulate her own law against her. She simply couldn’t get a good grasp on his position.
Long Ling'er was still in a daze, but Gu Nan's movements didn’t pause. He used both his hands and feet to land strikes on the giant dragon's abdomen.
If not for a dragon’s strong physique and Long Ling’er’s naturally monstrous strength, he probably would’ve torn a hole through her stomach by now.
Long Ling'er finally couldn’t help giving a sharp hiss as her figure quickly shrunk. She actually changed into human form, taking on the appearance of the young girl that Gu Nan met earlier.
With the space freed up from shrinking her body, she quickly laid a spatial barrier between her and Gu Nan. Only then did she have time to gasp for breath.
"So you’re not too stupid." Gu Nan chuckled and ignored her again, turning around to tear open a spatial rift and stepping inside.
The Long Ling'er who’d been beaten to such an extent couldn’t even take care of herself, let alone continue to seal off their surrounding space.
……
After killing Luo Ze, Gu Nan's saint clone left Tiluo World directly and hid in a random plane, attentively watching the frontline situation.
Gu Nan had little doubt that the sand of time would fall into Lou Wanying’s hands.
Although he didn’t know why Valen made a move, it almost certainly wasn’t to acquire the blueprint—a major god of his level absolutely didn’t lack special structures inside his Divine Kingdom.
Since Lu Wen wanted to obtain the sand of time for Lou Wanying, could Valen also have a junior he wanted to look after? How could there be such a coincidence?
Based on Gu Nan's understanding of Valen, this rascal most likely found out about Lu Wen's plans and came all the way over to join the fun while causing some trouble for his opponent in passing.
As one of the younger generation within the twelve major gods, Valen had a mischievous personality that liked to join in on the fun, so his figure could often be seen everywhere. Gu Nan had witnessed this a long time ago in his previous life.
But a concept like the Myriad Heavens Universe didn’t exist at all in his past life, so Valen’s troublemaker tendencies were limited to the World of Gods, often provoking the wrath of gods and humans alike.
The wait turned out to be three days. Countless glowing figures threw themselves into the round bead on the frontline.
Gu Nan wasn’t physically present at the frontline, so he simply couldn’t tell who entered, and towards the end, he was too lazy to even watch.
In any case, the unconscious Lou Wanying would definitely be saved and transported into the Time Arena, but Gu Nan just didn’t know who would be entering with him—now that Luo Ze died, Lou Wanying would most certainly need another helper.
Lu Wen knew Gu Nan would try to seize the treasure, so he would definitely prepare a backup plan to deal with Gu Nan.
Gu Nan also knew that Lu Wen knew this, so he killed Luo Ze at the very last minute without giving Lu Wen time to arrange other plans, forcing him to prematurely use that backup plan of his.
But in the end, this only worked because he was strong enough to stop Luo Ze from releasing the godly skill called “summoning one’s parent” while also giving the Dragon of Space a vicious beating. Only then was he able to leisurely make his escape.
Lu Wen most certainly had Star Rulers under him, but they might not dare to show their faces too blatantly on the frontlines lest they be hit by the Rain of Time.
He probably wouldn’t even have sent Long Ling'er unless as a last resort.
Gu Nan calmly watched the frontlines. The Time Arena was about to activate soon, and due to the nature of the frozen time inside it, it would end in a flash immediately after starting, and the result would appear instantly.
‘When that happens…’
"Gu Nan," a clear voice rang out beside Gu Nan.
The latter suddenly turned around and saw a petite figure.
Bai Qiaozhen was studying Gu Nan with a smile, seemingly very interested in him. She actually didn’t follow Lou Wanying inside the Time Arena.
"How did you find me?" Gu Nan asked expressionlessly, completely unfazed by this princess of White Bones Realm in front of him.
Bai Qiaozhen stared at him with amusement. "You’re the one who ran into my family's territory, yet you’re asking how I found you?"
Gu Nan looked down and realized that the space rift he casually opened just happened to lead him to White Bones Realm. This wasn’t surprising—he left White Bones Realm just earlier, so he absentmindedly picked this place to return to now.
Normally, not even a powerhouse like Lu Wen could spy on other people's astral worlds at will. At most, he could only watch from outside the plane if some major event occurred.
But as the only daughter of the Star Ruler of White Bones Realm, it really wasn’t hard for Bai Qiaozhen to find him.
After understanding this, Gu Nan turned around and left. Since Bai Qiaozhen didn’t have anything he needed, he also lost all interest in engaging in “dialogue” with her.
Bai Qiaozhen couldn’t help feeling somewhat baffled when she saw this. But she wasn’t in a hurry either. She simply came up to Gu Nan's side and asked, "You’re looking at that blessed land, aren’t you? Don’t tell me you want to seize it?"
Her guess was quite accurate, but in all likelihood, anyone who still refused to enter the blessed land and just watched from the outside almost certainly had this goal in mind.
Gu Nan wasn’t the only person who harbored such thoughts.
Gu Nan continued to ignore her. He felt that there was no need to answer people who had no value.
After being ignored for the second time, the corners of Bai Qiaozhen's mouth finally twitched slightly, and she couldn't help but threaten, "Don't forget where we are! If you don't answer me properly again…"
"You can try," Gu Nan finally turned his head and also answered Bai Qiaozhen for the first time, only these were three words she never wanted to hear.
Bai Qiaozhen didn’t feel the slightest ounce of killing intent from him when he said this, but for some reason, she felt that she truly would die.
When she came back to her senses, Gu Nan's figure had already vanished, and the bead on the frontline was radiating a golden light.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: The So-Called Oriole Behind
chapters.content:
The special nature of the Time Arena made fighting over this dungeon’s final reward a very dangerous thing.
Not only did one have to deal with competitors inside the dungeon, but afterwards, the winner also had to face the people outside who never even entered the dungeon…
Fortunately, not many people knew that this dungeon’s winner was decided instantaneously, and not everyone was keeping a close eye on the bead. Most people left with a sigh after learning they arrived one step too late.
So when the bead lit up for the second time and everyone inside was thrown back out onto the plane they entered from, only then did people realize.
"The blessed land is open again! Seize the treasure!"
"Are you stupid? This is clearly a sign of the blessed land closing completely. Someone already took the treasure!"
"Who ultimately took the treasure?"
Several major frontline planes instantly exploded with chatter. These planes weren’t large to begin with, so it was clear from a glance who had gone to which planes. Sure enough, someone immediately shouted.
"It's Lou Wanying! The disciple of Zi Luo Heaven’s Daoist Xuanqing. Lou Wanying, he's in Tiluo World!"
Lou Wanying was naturally no fool. He’d been preparing to flee the instant he left the Time Arena.
However, his movements were slower than usual because two heavily injured people who needed to be taken care of were also with him, and he had to bring both of them along as well.
One of the two was his senior martial sister Fang Yanqing, and the other was a senior he ran into inside the Time Arena and quickly became acquainted with.
If these two didn’t risk their lives to fight for him, he probably wouldn’t have been able to snatch the treasure…
Thinking of this, Lou Wanying’s eyes reddened slightly as he said loudly, "Martial Sister, Senior Hong, you guys must hold on! I'll take you back to Zi Luo Heaven. Master will definitely be able to save you guys!"
"That's him! He’s Lou Wanying!" Just then, someone beside him shouted loudly upon recognizing Lou Wanying.
The Time Arena didn’t limit the number of people who could enter. It would simply disqualify most people in the first round, but they still knew who ultimately held the treasure.
Inside White Bones Realm, Bai Qiaozhen was likewise watching the frontline situation, and when she received news that the treasure had fallen into Lou Wanying's hands, a look of realization dawned on her face.
"Eldest Miss, should we order our people to make their move?" A middle-aged man appeared behind Bai Qiaozhen and asked in a low voice.
"What's the hurry?" Bai Qiaozhen replied indifferently, "None of the people from Sumeru Heaven, Thunder Realm, and White Origin Heaven have made a move yet, plus there’s also that Gu Nan…"
There weren’t many large planes interested in the blessed land, but that number also wasn’t small.
Bai Qiaozhen could tell at a glance which major astral worlds sent people to watch the situation in Tiluo World, but she wasn’t too concerned about these people. The only person she was truly concerned about was Gu Nan.
Although White Bones Realm was a newly-promoted astral world, its strength and foundation far surpassed that of ordinary Realm Level planes. Thus, it was considered among the top ranks of all Realm Level planes.
So Bai Qiaozhen wasn’t afraid of clashing with other astral worlds. On the contrary, she was most worried about Gu Nan—this guy even dared to beat up that one’s dragon…
At the same time, similar conversations were taking place inside several other astral worlds.
"Let's wait and see."
"There’s no rush to make a move. We’ll make our move after those people are weakened from fighting each other."
"How can we, people from a main plane, mix among those commoners to seize the treasure?"
……
In Tiluo World, a few people immediately surrounded Lou Wanying, sizing him up maliciously.
"Daoist Friend Lou, so many people already know that you took the treasure. You won’t be able to protect it anyways, so why not hand it over peacefully?"
Lou Wanying looked around coldly, and without wasting time, he unsheathed his golden sword and stabbed directly at several people.
"Daoist Friend Lou…"
Lou Wanying’s strike was too sudden. The person who spoke up just now couldn’t even react in time and was almost stabbed through the heart, only managing to dodge with great difficulty.
But Lou Wanying didn’t back down after gaining momentum. A searing golden radiance shone from his sword as the power to cut apart all laws exploded at full strength, seemingly containing an indescribable and unknown power.
The power brought by this outburst was far beyond what the previous Lou Wanying could do, almost reaching the peak of Void Cutter Realm. His sword mercilessly pierced the opponent's throat.
The others couldn’t help being slightly taken aback. Be it strength or style, this strike was entirely different from the Lou Wanying they’d seen before.
Lou Wanying stared at them with cold indifference. How would they know what price he had to pay to bring out the treasure after acquiring it?
‘Even Martial Sister and Senior Hong…’
Thinking of this, Lou Wanying's gaze became determined, and he said to the people before him, "This treasure is something my senior martial sister and Senior Hong desperately obtained using their lives. It doesn’t only belong to me, so I will never let anyone else snatch it away!"
His powerful and resonating words rang out. The Void Cutters surrounding him didn’t dare come forward to fight him. Instead, they actually retreated a few steps and started observing the situation.
At this moment, a black shadow suddenly slashed across the sky, flying directly at Lou Wanying.
Lou Wanying’s nerves were extremely tense right now and his vigilance was stronger than ever, so he turned his sword around and stabbed behind him without even needing to think.
However, he didn’t expect for the other party to casually catch the golden sword with their hand.
The terrifying power of laws raged wildly on the sword while supreme sword Qi shot out in all directions, but it didn’t even leave a mark on the opponent’s hand. Just like that, the enemy firmly caught the golden sword.
Lou Wanying looked up in shock and saw Gu Nan's face.
He was utterly furious when he recalled how he once even invited the other party to go to that blessed land to win the treasure together. ‘If you wanted the treasure, then you could’ve just gone together with me back then. Why are you trying to snatch it away right now?’
"Mr. Gu Nan! Even you want to seize it—"
Boom!
Gu Nan smashed his fist into Lou Wanying’s face, causing blood to blossom and splash from his nose, instantly knocking him out.
"Not dead yet?" Gu Nan looked at him strangely. To not have his head blown off directly by Gu Nan’s punch, this Lou Wanying's head might really be a bit strange.
But he also wasn’t inclined to ponder it further, so his right hand stabbed into Lou Wanying's chest and pulled out a golden ball of light.
No one knew better than Gu Nan where the sand of time was hidden.
At the same time, the crowd watching this from the sidelines also shifted their gaze to Gu Nan.
"Gu Nan? Why would he run out first? Isn’t he afraid of everyone focusing their attacks on him?" Bai Qiaozhen frowned at this scene, extremely puzzled.
In her view, the stronger the person, the later they would choose to show themselves.
Because they were the strongest, their appearance would most likely cause the rest of the competitors to unite against them. On the contrary, if they showed up later, the rest of the people would’ve almost finished fighting, making it convenient for them to make their move.
Anyways, it wasn’t like the treasure could grow legs and run away.
In Thunder Realm, a golden-haired youth standing inside the void couldn’t help but snicker, "So this is the reincarnation of that Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon? He doesn't even understand the principle of ‘the mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.’ He truly is a Heavenly Demon whose mind is chaotic and muddled!"
In White Origin Heaven, a woman in palace clothes said flatly, "That Gu Nan won’t be able to get away. Prepare to seize the treasure. That one still has a trump card."
……
Order after order was issued inside the major planes. They were either to continue waiting on standby or to prepare to launch a surprise attack. Everyone’s target was naturally Tiluo World.
And inside Tiluo World, the sand of time had already fallen into Gu Nan's hands. Just as he casually opened a spatial rift and was about to leave, another aura suddenly burst forth.
The old man Lou Wanying referred to as “Senior Hong,” who’d been lying on the ground all this time, suddenly opened his eyes at this moment.
His body exploded, and a half-real, half-illusory shadow stood in front of Gu Nan.
"My Lord predicted long ago that you’d show up." Elder Hong's illusion laughed lightly. "The Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon possesses monstrous demonic Qi and an invincible physique, but it never occurred to you that your bane would exist in this world."
"Illusory Spirit Physique, this really can be considered the bane of body refining experts." Bai Qiaozhen couldn’t help sighing slightly when she saw this from White Bones Realm.
The Illusory Spirit Physique wasn’t any sort of remarkable constitution. People with this physique simply lacked a physical body, so physical damage would be significantly reduced.
But most of the powerful figures in this world used the power of laws to fight enemies, so what use did the Illusory Spirit Physique have?
But it just so happened that Gu Nan, the reincarnation of a Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon, walked the body refining path, which was why the Illusory Spirit Physique perfectly countered him.
"Get ready to strike." Bai Qiaozhen shook her head. "In the end, Gu Nan… was still too impatient. He only needed to wait a little while longer, and that Illusory Spirit Physique would’ve been forced to deal with someone else first."
However, just then, Gu Nan stared at Elder Hong expressionlessly and raised his right hand.
Far away beyond the endless void, Gu Nan's true body inside his Divine Kingdom suddenly opened his eyes, and a wave of power descended directly upon Tiluo World in an inexplicable manner.
Since apostles could borrow some of their god’s power, a god’s incarnation in the mortal world could naturally also borrow the main body’s power, just with some limitations.
Just because Gu Nan usually only used the alt account’s power to fight didn’t mean that his true body was asleep!
Faced with this Illusory Spirit Physique that suddenly appeared, the power of shadows from his true body instantly fell upon Tiluo World through his clone, landing right on that Senior Hong.
Unimaginably majestic shadows erupted forth. Senior Hong couldn’t even say anything before his soul was directly obliterated.
After all, this power came from a Tier 6 law!
Everyone who was about to enter Tiluo World simultaneously froze in shock, then watched as down below, Gu Nan stepped into a spatial rift with the treasure.
Bai Qiaozhen, the youth from Thunder Realm, the woman in palace clothes from White Origin Heaven—one after another, these orioles stared at each other blankly.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Divine Kingdom Contribution Points
chapters.content:
A young girl whose whole body glowed silver slowly walked out from underneath a blue curtain of water.
Her hand touched her stomach, as if she still felt phantom pain there, but she also knew that she had completely recovered from all her injuries. Still, that feeling of pain couldn’t be erased from her mind.
Ever since the young girl first gained self-awareness, she’d never been beaten up this badly.
"How do you feel?" Lu Wen still looked calm and serene, as if Gu Nan seizing the sand of time was just a trivial matter.
"I’m fine now," Long Ling'er replied with some lingering fear.
Whenever she recalled the earlier scene again, she felt like her stomach wasn’t stung by a bee, but bitten several times by a poisonous snake…
"But he snatched that item," Long Ling'er was still a little indignant when she thought about the sand of time.
"It doesn't matter." Lu Wen, however, just shook his head with a smile and didn’t elaborate further. Instead, he had Long Ling'er mull over the earlier battle.
"The Gu Nan who went there was just a clone who’s far less powerful than you, yet he was able to suppress you so completely that you couldn’t counterattack at all. Have you thought about why that is?"
Long Ling'er fell silent for a moment before answering, "I lack combat experience."
She knew this very well, and she even knew that if Gu Nan didn’t snatch the sand of time, perhaps she would’ve been its first user.
Lu Wen smiled. "Then go and work on what you’re lacking."
"Okay." Long Ling'er nodded and actually headed outside. Her figure soon vanished from this room, heading to an unknown plane.
After Long Ling'er left, another person walked out from behind Lu Wen. It was Duan Wenqi of Astral Gate.
As soon as Lu Wen saw him appear, he greeted him with a smile, "Someone from your Astral Gate stole my item. You must give me an explanation!"
Duan Wenqi was a representative of Astral Gate and also a famous Star Ruler. The Nine Heavens Dragon World he controlled was only one step away from ascending to a Realm Level plane.
What few people knew was that he and Lu Wen—one of the Thirteen Heavens—had been close friends since they were young and still were today.
Coupled with Lu Wen’s own easygoing personality, the two didn’t actually have a superior-subordinate relationship but instead got along as close friends.
Compared to Lu Wen, Duan Wenqi's personality was a bit more old-fashioned. He solemnly replied, "I will give you an explanation."
Lu Wen was taken aback, then patted Duan Wenqi’s shoulder helplessly. "No need to take it seriously. It’s fine to just give him the sand of time. We have more serious business to attend to."
"What is it?"
Lu Wen replied a light sigh, "It's time to teach the child to kill people."
……
Gu Nan's true body was sitting in the Evil God Temple inside the Divine Kingdom, playing with a grain of golden sand in his hand. This was the sand of time he snatched from Lou Wanying.
After leaving Tiluo World that day, the saint clone made several consecutive jumps between planes and finally lost the group of pursuers behind him.
After several more days of laying low to confirm that no one knew the clone’s location, Gu Nan’s main body finally went to that small plane to take the sand of time back with him.
As for the saint clone, he was still ordered to remain in the outside world—since the saint clone made contact with a major god-level existence, he can forget about ever entering the Divine Kingdom again.
Now that he acquired the sand of time, Gu Nan had no intention of waiting any longer and threw it into the Evil God Temple with a wave of his hand.
｢Blueprint detected—Time Arena. Begin construction?｣
The prompt from the Evil God Temple came as usual, and Gu Nan immediately confirmed construction. Soon, an exquisite mini arena was set up inside the Evil God Temple.
This arena was pitifully small, even smaller than the other structures in the Evil God Temple. The entire arena couldn’t even fit a single person.
However, Gu Nan knew that structures placed inside the Evil God Temple would be shrunk down like this.
If placed in the outside world, this Time Arena would probably be as big as a mountaintop, and the space inside would be far bigger.
The Time Arena was a Level 3 special structure, so it could naturally shrink the space inside it.
The function of the Time Arena was also very powerful; apostles could enter it and engage in nonstop simulated battles to hone their skills. The price was naturally the points that would be consumed.
And due to the nature of the structure itself, this training process would consume almost no time at all.
In other words, this was a place where players could spend money to feed apostles experience to level them up, but divine servants and the Divine Kingdom’s residents couldn’t use it. Not even Gu Nan himself could use it.
Apostles, divine servants, and the Divine Kingdom’s residents—these three types of living beings constituted the ecological system within the Divine Kingdom. The three categories also had their own corresponding Divine Kingdom structures, and there was rarely any mix-up.
‘The apostle system should also be further perfected,’ after acquiring the Time Arena, Gu Nan thought of this first.
The Evil God game in his past life boasted a high degree of realism, so apostles, beings whose roles were similar to that of “heroes,” naturally didn’t always remain loyal.
In addition to the "loyalty" attribute, there were other hidden factors.
For example, apostles like Guan Hongchen, Lei Qi, and Lei Ba were basically working for Gu Nan for free right now. Their reward was mostly resources produced inside the Divine Kingdom.
Although it wasn’t bad in terms of value, since they still couldn’t leave the Divine Kingdom, it was the same as having nowhere to use it. Moreover, most of these resources couldn’t be directly used for their own cultivation.
This model might be alright for a short period of time, but if this went on for hundreds or thousands of years, no apostle would be able to endure it.
This was also the problem Gu Nan needed to solve—how to manage the apostles.
Real gods wouldn’t encounter this situation, because their apostles were all fanatical followers who worshipped them. Let alone working for nothing, those apostles were even willing to offer their lives for their gods.
So as Evil Gods, while players abandoned the attribute of faith and enjoyed the convenience of being unfettered by it, they naturally also lost some of the benefits associated with faith.
But this naturally couldn’t stump players. After all, managing NPCs was much easier than managing players.
Red Tail was in White Bones Realm. Just as she finished helping the ascended Transcendent Realm fighters from Crescent Moon World settle down here, several messages suddenly popped into her mind.
｢Rebuild White Mist. Gained 300 Divine Kingdom contribution points｣
｢Assist in the ascension of Crescent Moon World’s martial artists. Gained 50 Divine Kingdom contribution points｣
｢……｣
There were nearly a dozen messages in total that actually listed out all the things Red Tail had done recently. Each of them was marked with the corresponding contribution point.
Of course it wasn’t all gains. For example, her act of requesting help consumed some contribution points, but of course the amount was far less than her reward for establishing White Mist.
"This is…” Red Tail read through the messages and instantly understood.
She knew that Gu Nan planned to manage them—the apostles—through this method.
Red Tail had managed a reincarnator organization for many years and was no stranger to this model. In fact, many people could do something like this, but the key was what one could buy with contribution points.
As long as the potential benefits were tempting enough, any method could be used to get people to work.
‘I must go back and take a look when I have time,’ Red Tail thought.
She originally didn’t plan to rush back. The people from Crescent Moon World had just come to this plane. Although they were settled in, she still needed to remain here and supervise things.
But the next second, a figure in blue appeared before her. It was none other than Lan Si.
"I've come to take you back to the Divine Kingdom."

chapters.title: Chapter 332: The Function of Special Structures
chapters.content:
The Evil God Temple was filled with people as far as the eye could see.
Ever since Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was established, so many apostles had never gathered here at the same time.
