Guan Hongchen, Lei Qi, and Lei Ba were in charge of grinding dungeons; Lan Si and Yan Xiaoxiao were in charge of managing the Divine Kingdom; Red Tail was in charge of White Mist.
"It's rare for you all to be gathered together," Gu Nan said as such to the crowd. "Some of you probably don't even know each other, right?"
Hearing this, the more honest Guan Hongchen and others nodded. She even wanted to proactively strike up a conversation with Lan Si and get closer to her, but Gu Nan's next words scared her away.
"It’s good that you don’t know each other. You guys have no need to know each other." Gu Nan said blandly, "Line up and enter."
Under Gu Nan's order, the group of apostles walked inside the arena en masse with faces full of confusion.
Among them, Red Tail was the most perplexed. She spent the least time within the Divine Kingdom and didn’t fully understand the fantastic features of the Divine Kingdom's structures.
It wasn't until she walked inside that she realized the inside of the arena was actually astonishingly large despite looking like the size of a model from the outside.
Before she could get ready, an invisible force had already thrown her into the arena.
At the same time, the arena refreshed, creating a huge beast out of thin air. Even with Red Tail's knowledge, she actually couldn't recognize this beast.
"Roar!"
The giant beast, however, didn’t care what she thought and immediately lunged at her, startling Red Tail.
In fact, this giant beast wasn’t very strong. It was at the peak of Prodigious Realm at most, but because its understanding of laws was too shallow, it couldn’t even be considered a Dao Lord.
At the very least, Red Tail had Dao Lord level power, but unfortunately, she lived a life of luxury for many years and hadn’t fought anyone in a long time, so for a while, she was actually suppressed by this beast.
It was only after ten or so minutes that Red Tail gradually steadied her mind and instantly killed the giant beast, while she herself also suffered considerable injuries.
"Is it trying to improve our fighting abilities through continuous combat?" Red Tail quickly surmised, but the truth seemed to be a little different from what she thought.
There was no one at all to help her recover from her wounds, nor was there any post-battle analysis. She was immediately thrown back into the arena right after killing the first beast.
Everything seemed to return to square one. Even the monster didn’t change; it was still the same one—Red Tail clearly remembered that this giant beast had a scar on its hind leg.
"This…"
……
Gu Nan stood outside the Time Arena, gazing at the apostles trapped in rows of "time capsules" with a smile on his face.
The monster prepared for every apostle would teach them the skill they lacked the most at the moment. They would only be released if they met the Time Arena’s requirements.
Only in this kind of repeatedly reset battles could they realize their weak points and overcome them.
If this process was repeated enough times, they would approach the next realm step by step, slowly accumulating experience until the day they naturally advance to the next realm.
Since Gu Nan specially summoned all the apostles here, of course he had to properly demonstrate the power of the new structure.
Without making Gu Nan wait for long, the time capsules shattered one after another as the apostles stepped out of them one by one. Almost all of them had pale, exhausted faces.
"How does it feel?" Gu Nan asked them.
"Very tiring, but also very rewarding," Red Tail was the first to answer, and her expression perked up. "After I finish digesting the gains from today and have the chance to enter this two more times, I’m confident I can break through to Void Cutter Realm."
She was originally a Prodigious cultivator who accumulated ample experience over many years and was only a step away from Void Cutter Realm. It’s just that she was in a management position for most of these years and had too little experience fighting battles to the death.
"Is this tempering ourselves through our souls? It’s indeed very effective," Yan Xiaoxiao also agreed, but then she smiled wryly. "But I might have to take a long rest after this."
She had to manage the Divine Kingdom, so she already had quite the heavy burden on her shoulders. Gu Nan’s move this time practically wore her out.
There was no way to rest inside the Time Arena. Every round was a fight to the death where they must struggle desperately to survive.
This would continue all the way until their mind reached its limit and they were basically only relying on their instinct to fight—this was when they could grow the fastest.
But if they tried this a few times in reality, their bodies would’ve broken down a long time ago. Conversely, some other simulated battle spaces weren’t capable of letting their bodies also fully experience that kind of despair. Only the Time Arena could do both.
Because the apostles actually fought in the Time Arena with their real bodies—it wasn’t a simulation!
Every time they died, they actually died for real. It’s just that their time would subsequently be reset, and they would be resurrected. It wasn’t like what they thought at all—that only their souls entered the simulated battles.
Guan Hongchen and the others also spoke up. Their eyes now contained longing for the future. They thought they were going to spend their whole lives “farming dungeons," but who knew there would be something like this?
If they could achieve Void Cutter Realm, then even if they had to invest several decades here, it would still be a sweet deal!
Gu Nan was satisfied. "In the future, the Time Arena will open once a month. Only one person can enter each time; the highest bidder wins it. You all can talk it over amongst yourselves."
The Time Arena cost points to open, so of course he couldn’t use it excessively.
……
Construction of the Time Arena caused the work enthusiasm of all of Gu Nan's apostles to suddenly skyrocket.
Not only did the accumulation of points speed up a notch, even Lan Si and Yan Xiaoxiao also abruptly accelerated the development of the Divine Kingdom.
Regarding some of the occasional dissidents, the Yan Xiaoxiao who originally advocated a gentle appeasement policy also became firm-handed.
The Divine Kingdom's contribution point system immediately established a competitive relationship between all the apostles under Gu Nan who originally had different divisions of labor.
However, the next matter Gu Nan had to deal with was unrelated to them all. Instead, it was in Crescent Moon World.
Red Tail sent over news from Crescent Moon World: Ah Xiu, whose family and sect Gu Nan destroyed a while back, was finally showing signs of a breakthrough right now.
In today’s Crescent Moon World, twenty years had already passed since the World’s Strongest Martial Arts Tournament.
As a fugitive wanted by the Martial Arts Alliance, Ah Xiu went into hiding for twenty years and visited almost every corner of the world during that time.
With the passage of time, this sole surviving member of the formerly prosperous Zhongli Sword Sect gradually faded from people’s memories.
Only Red Tail, who’d been continuously observing her through reincarnators, knew that time didn’t break this young girl and instead made her more resilient and tenacious.
But as Ah Xiu grew stronger, even Red Tail's people found it harder and harder to find her trail. Finally, five years ago, Ah Xiu disappeared completely from their sight.
It was only a few days ago that news related to her suddenly came out. It wasn’t about her personally, but about her disciple.
"A young man named Yun Tianyang showed up at the border and eliminated a group of bandits who once attacked Tianshui Prefecture’s Yun family a few years back. He used precisely the sword style of the former Zhongli Sword Sect."
"Can you confirm he’s Ah Xiu’s disciple?"
"There is no guarantee." Red Tail shook her head. "This Yun Tianyang may have been taught by Ah Xiu, or he may have just accidentally acquired the former Zhongli Sword Sect’s inheritance."
"Then we’ll find a way to confirm it." Gu Nan said with a smile, "Spread news that we plan to eliminate Tianshui Prefecture’s Yun family. If he really is Ah Xiu's disciple, she will definitely make a move."

chapters.title: Chapter 333: A Pair of Master and Disciple
chapters.content:
Crescent Moon World, the border of the Western Region.
The Western Region had always been a bitterly cold place. Yellow sand as far as the eye could see and snow falling in September were commonplace, but it was precisely this difficult environment that raised a group of bloodthirsty martial artists.
Yellow Springs Inn
[1]
—in any other place in the world, no one would ever give such an ominous name for an inn, but they could here in the Western Region.
Because this inn was located on the border of the Western Region. Danger lurked around every corner outside the inn.
Taking another step forward would lead the traveler to the Yellow Springs—this was the meaning behind the inn’s name.
"Have you heard? Something will happen in Tianshui Prefecture again."
"It's the Yun family, right? The bigshots in the Alliance are going to single out that family."
"Yeah, I really didn't expect that kid Yun Tianyang to actually be cultivating the sword technique of the former Zhongli Sword Sect… Since he’s a surviving member of that traitorous sect, it's not surprising that he’s being purged by the Alliance."
"Hmph! Isn’t this just because it’s easy to bully that Yun kid? If the Alliance really is so powerful, then why don’t they go after that Zhongli Goddess?"
Inside the inn, burly Northwestern men were drinking unfiltered rice wine and wantonly throwing around rebellious words, but no one took it seriously.
Everyone in the Western Region lived their life on the blade’s edge. Who cared about some Martial Arts Alliance?
But Tianshui Prefecture belonged to the Northwest, while Yun Tianyang also came from the Western Region and made a name for himself with his strength, so he was well-liked by many people here.
But now he was implicated because of the sword technique he used, and even his family was about to be massacred. This made some people in the Western Region very indignant.
Just then, a servant rushed in from the doorway while shouting, "Latest news, latest news!”
"What news? Hurry up and tell us. Is there a result from Tianshui Prefecture?" Someone immediately asked from the inn’s lobby.
Truly, Yun Tianyang’s matter was the most eye-catching event in the Northwest recently. When they heard there was news from Tianshui Prefecture, everyone instantly thought of Yun Tianyang.
The servant didn’t leave them hanging either and immediately answered, "That’s right! I heard that in order to capture Tianshui Prefecture’s Yun family and bring them to justice, the Alliance sent out Venerate Heaven Sect’s Elder Mo Yundi this time…”
"Ah, Mo Yundi! Legend has it that he’s already close to Transcendent Realm, right?"
"That’s right! That Yun Tianyang is also extraordinary. He fought with Mo Yundi for hundreds of rounds and finally lost by a single move!"
"Hoh? He was just a half-grown brat a few years ago, and now he's so powerful? Wait a minute, you said the Yun kid lost, then isn’t the Yun family…"
"Heheh, this is the most exciting part. It’s said that just when it seemed like Yun Tianyang was about to be cut down by Elder Mo Yundi…"
……
"Mo Yundi was beheaded in a single strike," Red Tail stood in front of Gu Nan and reported the result of this operation.
"Was it Ah Xiu?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow and studied the corpse in front of him with interest.
It was none other than the corpse of Venerate Heaven Sect’s Mo Yundi. He was originally quite a handsome middle-aged uncle, but now his head was separated from the rest of his body, having died miserably.
"None of the witnesses we planted survived, but someone nearby saw that the one who attacked was a woman," Red Tail answered. There wasn’t much surprise in her tone. Rather, she seemed to be eagerly awaiting something.
In fact, they had long anticipated this result. The purpose of sending out Mo Yundi, someone much stronger than Yun Tianyang, was to lure Ah Xiu out of hiding.
But Yun Tianyang’s strength was a bit unexpected.
They originally thought that Mo Yundi could easily win against Yin Tianyang, but they didn’t expect that he only won by a fluke in the end.
With Yun Tianyang’s age and growth rate, Mo Yundi would probably be no match for him in a couple of days—of course, he no longer had that chance now.
"Go there in person and see if this Yun Tianyang is also a child of destiny," Gu Nan casually instructed.
Red Tail nodded. With Gu Nan personally backing her up, she wasn’t afraid of Ah Xiu. To put it bluntly, Ah Xiu was at most a newly-advanced Void Cutter, while the one in front of her had killed more Void Cutters than the number of Void Cutters she’d seen.
But she also had some misgivings, "Since Ah Xiu could kill Mo Yundi in one strike, could she have already advanced to Void Cutter Realm?"
Ah Xiu was someone favored by the plane itself, so it was impossible for her to walk the wrong path and enter Transcendent Realm. Either she had already advanced to Void Cutter Realm, or she was still at Prodigious Realm.
If it was the latter, she shouldn’t be able to kill Mo Yundi so easily.
"Not yet, but she’s only half a step away." Gu Nan glanced down at the corpse on the ground again and smiled lightly.
With Gu Nan's current knowledge, it was no longer a difficult task to distinguish a cultivator’s cultivation realm. Even with just a corpse, he could easily discern how far the killer’s laws had accumulated.
To be honest, Ah Xiu's breakthrough was by no means easy. She didn’t have any well-trodden paths to follow, nor any previous sage's techniques to draw inspiration from. It was entirely up to her to explore and discover her future path.
It was also because there was no cultivation technique to reference that her breakthrough became a gradual process, unlike ordinary people who ascended to Void Cutter Realm in one step.
"By transforming the sword path into laws, her power is already very close to Void Cutter Realm. She’s much stronger than the Transcendent Realm warriors here. She’s just short of the threshold and doesn't have the characteristics of a Void Cutter yet."
Red Tail remained silent. She knew that Ah Xiu’s current level wouldn’t satisfy Gu Nan.
What he wanted was a genuine Void Cutter child of destiny. Ever since this translation method came into existence, such a high-level material had never been used to make a mist mirror before!
"Go help her some more." The faint smile remained unchanged on Gu Nan’s face. "What kind of child of destiny lives like a street rat? Ruling over the world—now
that’s
someone blessed by destiny."
……
"Master, you're really incredible!"
"That Mo Yundi was so arrogant, but wasn’t he still killed in one slash?"
"Master, did you achieve the legendary realm capable of shattering space?"
In a hidden forest in the Western Region, a young man in blue healed his injuries and immediately jumped up, asking nonstop questions while circling around his master.
The master he addressed was a woman dressed in light yellow gauze. The woman's face looked delicate and her figure was lithe, but her eyes always contained a cold glint that discouraged people from approaching her.
However, this youth in blue didn’t seem scared at all and kept circling around the woman.
These two were naturally Yun Tianyang and Ah Xiu. They had just killed people from the Martial Arts Alliance in Tianshui Prefecture, so naturally they had to lie low for a while and send Tianshui Prefecture’s Yun family to a safer place in the meantime.
Ah Xiu looked at her disciple helplessly, then waved her hand. "Can’t you be a little more serious? Don’t wander around all day…"
Speaking of this disciple of hers, she was satisfied with both his talent and diligence, and his personality was also quite pure-hearted… But his chatterbox tendencies really gave her a headache.
Yun Tianyang grinned. "Isn’t it just because I’m too excited?! Master, you’re already this powerful, so why don't we slaughter our way to Martial Alliance City and take revenge for Martial Ancestor?"
He didn’t know about his master’s identity when he was young, but as news about the former Zhongli Sword Sect became more and more widespread, he naturally learned a little about these inside stories.
Ah Xiu, however, shook her head as she recalled the silver figure in a small courtyard in Martial Alliance City twenty years ago.
"It's not enough. I'm still not strong enough."
T/N:
[1] Yellow Springs (Road)
: Symbolizes the road to the afterlife
