chapters.title: Chapter 334: Silver Robe, Silver Mask
chapters.content:
The entire world kept an eye on the battle in Tianshui Prefecture.
Against surviving members of the long-destroyed Zhongli Sword Sect, not only did the Alliance fail to fulfill its previous promise of capturing the Yun family, but even Elder Mo Yundi from the Alliance was killed.
This dealt a great blow to people’s trust and confidence in the Alliance, and the prestige of the Martial Arts Alliance suffered considerably.
Twenty years ago, the Alliance successfully held the World's Strongest Martial Arts Tournament, and many of its powerhouses ascended to the Upper World. These powerhouses were certainly enviable, but their departure also suddenly weakened the power of the Martial Arts Alliance.
The strongest martial artists and the higher ups were taken away in one fell sweep. Even Red Tail didn’t remain here for long and only exercised remote control over the Alliance through reincarnation, so the inside of the Alliance descended into great chaos for a while.
And when several major forces finally managed to regain control of the situation, the Alliance could never return to its former glory anymore.
Without Red Tail—someone who could force all the higher ups into submission—internal strife was inevitable. So compared to twenty years ago, the Alliance’s control over the world was actually much weaker.
And the Tianshui Prefecture incident seemed to be the last straw. The seemingly prosperous Martial Arts Alliance seemed to become unstable overnight, tossed about by wind and rain.
But at this critical juncture, the Alliance made a decision that stunned countless people.
It strictly forbid everyone from mentioning topics related to the "Zhongli Goddess." Even a verbal discussion was considered a rebellion!
When this order came out, all the martial artists in the world were in an uproar.
Some said that the Martial Arts Alliance was out of their minds. If someone disobeyed the Alliance, then they should find a way to kill her. What good would ordering their own people to shut up do?
Others claimed that vile characters were stirring up trouble inside the Alliance. Otherwise, the Alliance wouldn’t have gone so far as to persecute people over their speech.
But even more people saw a great mansion on the verge of collapse; they saw the frailty behind the behemoth called the Alliance…
……
"Alliance Leader Qin, please reconsider! This order is tantamount to self-destructing…"
"That’s right. If the Alliance Leader wants to take the life of that Zhongli Goddess, then old fellows like us can just do it. Why the need for this gag order?"
"Alliance Leader, please withdraw the order!"
In the headquarters of the Martial Arts Alliance in Martial Alliance City, a group of white-haired old men were trying to persuade a middle-aged man.
Every one of these people was a pillar of the Martial Arts Alliance, a Transcendent Realm grandmaster. It’s just that they didn’t ascend to the Upper World twenty years ago because of their old age.
The one they surrounded was Qin Yuezhi, the current Alliance Leader of the Martial Arts Alliance and also the Sect Master of Venerate Heaven Sect.
Qin Yuezhi forced a smile onto his face as he tried to persuade these elders one by one.
He was the direct disciple of Venerate Heaven Sect’s previous Sect Master. Although he was powerful and had extraordinary talent, his seniority really wasn’t too high. Everyone before him was his elder.
Now that they came to find him because of his "unwise order," Qin Yuezhi really couldn’t kick them all out.
After trying his hardest and successfully persuading all of the old ancestors to return, Qin Yuezhi finally sighed in relief. At the same time, a red-clothed figure also appeared in front of him.
Qin Yuezhi didn’t dare show disrespect and hurriedly saluted. "My Lord."
Even as the Alliance Leader of the Martial Arts Alliance, Qin Yuezhi still didn’t dare show the slightest disrespect to the person before him—because she was the one who single-handedly established the Martial Arts Alliance!
Red Tail nodded slightly. "Continue to target Yun Tianyang. This time, send a Transcendent Realm expert over to provide support."
"Yes," Qin Yuezhi answered, but then said, "My Lord, even a lion must use its full strength to fight a rabbit. That Yun Tianyang is only one step away from Transcendent Realm. What if…"
But Red Tail just laughed. "That’s exactly what we’re trying to determine—whether that ‘what if’ exists or not."
……
Two months after the gag order was issued, an elder of the Martial Arts Alliance—the Transcendent Realm martial artist Li Jin—received an order to personally head to the Northwest to capture Yun Tianyang and his master.
Although Li Jin was extremely talented in martial arts and entered Transcendent Realm at the age of 40, he had a ruthless temperament and lusted after money and women. His arrival could be considered a disaster for the Northwest.
In just half a month, countless families in the Northwest were wiped out and a large number of innocent martial artists died violent deaths—all so Li Jin could acquire ten thousand taels of gold and a house full of beautiful wives and concubines.
Everyone in the Western Region lived in fear, panicking at the slightest sound. The gag order became more prevalent, almost to the point where people could only communicate with their eyes, too afraid to even speak.
The Martial Arts Alliance’s reputation in the Northwest plummeted even further. While hating Li Jin, many people also began to hate the Martial Arts Alliance as well.
Finally, in the third month of Li Jin's arrival in the Northwest, a major event transpired—Yun Tianyang and his six companions infiltrated Li Jin's residence and killed him in one fell swoop!
To think that a powerful Transcendent Realm grandmaster would actually die in his own residence like this. Once news of this spread, it immediately shocked the world.
The next day, Yun Tianyang led a group of martial artists and launched an attack on the Northwestern capital, Daming City, raising the curtain on the armed resistance against the Martial Arts Alliance.
In this battle, Yun Tianyang himself displayed the strength of a Transcendent Realm martial artist and became a genuine grandmaster level expert.
His six companions also revealed impressive strength. Almost all of them were close to Transcendent Realm and had the makings of a group of young heroes.
Some meddlesome people even started calling them the "Northwestern Seven Tigers.” For a while, their fame was unparalleled.
……
"I personally watched the fight between Yun Tianyang and Li Jin from the sidelines. Yun Tianyang broke through mid-battle," Red Tail dutifully reported what she saw.
"Is he also a child of destiny?" Gu Nan asked.
"No." Red Tail, however, shook her head. "There was the aura of destiny lingering on him, but it felt more like it came from an external source… Ah Xiu's surplus destiny probably fell onto him."
Gu Nan couldn’t help laughing involuntarily. He didn’t expect that Ah Xiu’s power of destiny had become dense enough to share with others.
Red Tail added, "Ah Xiu is still one last step short of her breakthrough, so they plan to develop peacefully for a while after conquering Daming City."
"How can they be allowed to settle down?" Gu Nan curled his lips into a smile. "We’ve gotta give the children some pressure… I'll head there myself."
……
Daming City.
The head of the “Northwestern Seven Tigers”—Yun Tianyang—was in the courtyard, practicing his punches at a leisurely pace. Six other young men and women were also in the courtyard.
"Boss Yun, when are we going to slaughter our way to Martial Alliance City?"
"Exactly! Old Yun, one word from you, and the brothers here will definitely jump into scalding water and plunge into raging fire for you!"
"You two," a woman next to them said helplessly, "you’re already famous martial artists. Can’t you be a little more civilized!?"
The previous one snickered, but a bald man rubbed his smooth head and replied, "But I, Mo Wentian, am precisely that kind of person. If you want me to learn to put on airs like those powerful figures, that won’t happen!"
Hearing his companions bickering, Yun Tianyang slowly withdrew the strength in his fist and cut in helplessly, "Let’s not be rash. My master just entered closed-door cultivation again, and we also need some time to recuperate."
"Also, my master said that…" Yun Tianyang hesitated for a moment before continuing, "we cannot underestimate the Martial Arts Alliance. There may be enemies inside that not even she can handle."
The remaining six people were stunned when they heard that. They actually knew how strong Yun Tianyang's master—the woman known as the Zhongli Goddess—was.
"Boss Yun, if you fought your master right now, could you beat her?" The one who spoke earlier asked carefully.
Yun Tianyang instantly answered with a bitter smile, "I can't even withstand one strike of Master’s… The stronger I grow, the more I feel that Master's realm is unattainable."
Mo Wentian slapped his own forehead and exclaimed in shock, "Doesn’t that mean that the Martial Arts Alliance also has this kind of invincible expert?”
"Yes." Yun Tianyang nodded. "Master told me that I should run as far away as possible if I ever saw a silver-robed person wearing a silver mask."
Just then, a manservant ran in and shouted, "Young Masters, someone outside is asking for an audience!"
"Who is it?"
"Uh… The person didn't give a name. I only know that it’s a strange person wearing a silver robe and a silver mask."

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Soldiers at the City Walls
chapters.content:
Silver robe, silver mask—four simple words plunged the small courtyard into dead silence.
The manservant who came to report was startled by this bizarre scene. He didn’t know what was happening.
Amidst the silence, Yun Tianyang was the first to react and dismissed the servant with a wave of his hand.
When only the "Northwestern Seven Tigers" were left in the courtyard, Mo Wentian couldn’t contain himself any longer and whispered, "Is the person outside the one that your master warned you of?"
"It's possible." Yun Tianyang said heavily, "I think it's better to have someone test the waters first. We can—"
"Old Yun, watch out!" Before he could finish, he saw Mo Wentian throw himself right behind Yun Tianyang, vigilantly watching someone.
Yun Tianyang suddenly turned his head and saw a silver figure already standing at the doorway.
This person was dressed in a silver robe and wore a silver mask, making it impossible to see his appearance, yet Yun Tianyang couldn’t help feeling chills up his spine.
"Where’s Ah Xiu?" The silver-robed person’s gaze swept through the small courtyard, completely disregarding these Northwestern Seven Tigers and inquiring about Ah Xiu's whereabouts straightaway.
No trace of power could be seen from this silver-robed intruder. He looked like a normal person who’d never practiced martial arts before, but Yun Tianyang didn’t dare underestimate him in the slightest.
A normal person didn’t have the ability to soundlessly appear in front of him without anyone noticing.
"My master is in secluded cultivation, attempting to break through to the realm capable of shattering space!" Yun Tianyang answered in an icy voice, hoping that his master's realm would be able to deter the intruder before him.
But unexpectedly, the silver-robed man just burst into loud laughter. "If your master only entered secluded cultivation just now, she’ll never be able to take that last step for the rest of her life. I’d better help her out."
Before others could say anything, Yun Tianyang was already frowning heavily as rage surged in his heart. He gave a cold snort and replied, "My master's cultivation is none of your business!"
"That's right!" On the side, Mo Wentian also rubbed his bald head and stepped forward. "Old Yun's master has already honed her martial arts to the peak. What does someone like you know—"
He didn’t get to finish before a silver figure flashed across the space in front of him. Mo Wentian only felt a pain in his abdomen before his entire line of sight floated high up.
‘Am… Am I flying right now?’
This was Mo Wentian’s last thought, and then everything went blank.
But in the eyes of Yun Tianyang and the others, the figure of the silver-robed enemy simply flickered slightly. Next thing they knew, Mo Wentian had already been kicked in the stomach and was sent flying across the courtyard.
He only flew for a few seconds when a cloud of bloody mist exploded from his stomach—his internal organs had been completely pulverized by the monstrous strength and he was no longer alive.
Everyone in the courtyard froze in stunned silence for a second, followed by Yun Tianyang's angry roar, "You’re courting death!"
He instantly unsheathed his longsword and thrust it out without thinking, aiming straight at the silver-robed enemy’s back.
Not only did this strike contain the essence of everything he learned in his entire life, it also harmonized with his current mental state and intent, so it could be said to be the strongest attack Yun Tianyang had ever made.
As his sword stabbed out, Yun Tianyang couldn’t help having this thought: ‘Faced with this sword, even Master will have to respond carefully…’
Clang!
The sound of metal hitting metal rang out. That silver-robed man was too lazy to even dodge and simply allowed the longsword to hit his back, but Yun Tianyang couldn’t even sink his sword in by half a centimeter.
‘Just what kind of monster is this!?’
Yun Tianyang’s heart shivered slightly. He finally understood why Master always admonished him to run as far away as possible if he ever encountered this person.
Before that thought fell, Yun Tianyang felt his vision darken, as if a fist had imprinted itself on his face…
……
Yun Tianyang slowly regained consciousness after a long time and immediately felt a wave of piercing pain travel over from his face.
He subconsciously raised his hand to feel his face but found that his entire nose had already caved inwards. His originally handsome face was probably completely ruined.
But the disfigurement was just a minor matter. What he found the hardest to accept was the fact that blood was already flowing like a river in the courtyard. The corpses of his six brothers and sisters were lying neatly in front of him.
The six of them were either pierced through the stomach, or their heads were blown out, or their limbs were torn apart. There wasn’t a single intact corpse here.
"Old Mo! Little Feng! Everyone… Everyone…" Yun Tianyang shot to his feet and called out for his companions one by one, but he would never receive a response.
"Ahhh!" Yun Tianyang howled madly, torn with rage and grief.
Three days later, the disfigured Yun Tianyang raised the banner of rebellion alone and led a group of martial artists who’d just gathered together, slaughtering their way towards the middle of the continent, with his blade pointing straight at Martial Alliance City.
After experiencing this catastrophe, Yun Tianyang's temperament changed greatly, becoming more reticent. Yun Tianyang—who was originally described as being as gentle as jade—suddenly became violent and ruthless, often beating and cursing the soldiers under him.
But at the same time, his own martial arts skills also skyrocketed fiercely.
In just one month, the rebels had captured sixteen cities belonging to the Martial Arts Alliance. Seven Transcendent Realm experts died by Yun Tianyang’s hands.
What was even more surprising was that these seven Transcendent Realm martial artists almost seemed to be lining themselves up for Yun Tianyang to kill—only one person showed up each time to fight Yun Tianyang.
Every time he attacked, Yun Tianyang's strength grew. Now, the former head of the "Northwestern Seven Tigers" already had the reputation of the world's strongest expert.
In many people’s eyes, only Qin Yuezhi, the Alliance Leader of the Martial Arts Alliance, was qualified to fight Yun Tianyang.
……
Right when the world was in chaos, a figure slowly emerged from deep in the mountains in the Western Region.
This person was dressed in bright yellow gauze and stood amidst the wind and snow just like this, but not a single snowflake landed on her. This was the one people called the "Zhongli Goddess"—Ah Xiu.
"I’m still a step short," she gazed up at the snowy sky and murmured softly under her breath. The longsword on her back seemed like it would never be drawn, yet it contained a boundless sword intent.
She entered secluded cultivation this time because her disciple was implicated by her and nearly had his family destroyed. She wanted to use the pent-up frustrations in her heart to break through that final hurdle.
But things turned out contrary to her wishes. In the end, she still couldn’t take that last step and was stuck right in front of that door.
This wasn’t the first time Ah Xiu had encountered such an experience in the last twenty years, so she didn’t dwell on it and walked down the mountain step by step.
Only after she reached the foot of the mountain and inquired about her disciple’s current situation did Ah Xiu receive a shock. ‘It turns out that so many things actually happened in the world while I was in closed-door cultivation.’
"The six people who were called the Northwestern Seven Tigers along with Tianyang were killed by a silver-robed person…"
"Tianyang went crazy and ordered all his troops to head straight for Martial Alliance City…"
"In one month, he conquered sixteen consecutive cities and killed seven Transcendent Realm grandmasters…"
One by one, Ah Xiu verified the authenticity of each piece of information and put the puzzle together, making her feel almost overwhelmed for a while. It wasn’t until the end that she realized something wasn’t right.
Because the last piece of news was that the rebel army led by Yun Tianyang was already at the gates of Martial Alliance City!
"It must be that person's plot!" Ah Xiu hardly needed to think too deeply. After learning that a silver-robed man had appeared, she was immediately positive of this.
‘With that person’s power, he could easily kill a Transcendent Realm martial artist even 20 years ago, let alone now?’
‘That means he deliberately sent out his subordinates for my disciple to kill. What in the world is his goal… No, I must rush over and get to the bottom of this!’

chapters.title: Chapter 336: A Sword in Her Heart
chapters.content:
Hundreds of thousands of rebel troops stood outside Martial Alliance City, practically surrounding this city that had towered in the world for decades.
Among the rebels, a man on a tall horse slowly stepped out—he was Yun Tianyang.
"Tell Qin Yuezhi to come out!" Although Yun Tianyang was visiting Martial Alliance City for the first time, he didn’t hold the slightest respect for this city that symbolized the holy land of martial arts.
In response to such a remark, someone on the city wall naturally countered, "Impertinent heretic! Alliance Leader Qin rules over the world's martial artists. Is he someone you can just casually meet?”
The corners of Yun Tianyang's mouth curved into a cold smile. It actually looked a bit scary when placed on his noseless face.
"Attack the city." He didn’t even deign to respond and directly ordered his troops to attack the city with a wave of his hand.
"Wait!" A loud voice came from the city; it was Qin Yuezhi who spoke. "Yun Tianyang, do you dare to fight with me?"
Yun Tianyang laughed heartily, but then his smile faded and he answered icily, "Come!"
……
When Ah Xiu rushed to the battlefield, Yun Tianyang and Qin Yuezhi were in the middle of a full-blown battle. The two of them were fighting with true fury, attacking each other without holding back in the slightest and hardly caring about their own defense.
Yun Tianyang had already received several punches to his chest that almost made him cough up blood, and Qin Yuezhi's arms were full of wounds, all inflicted by swords.
Ah Xiu sighed in relief when she saw Yun Tianyang still alive and well upon her arrival, but then she felt like something was wrong.
"Watch out!" Her voice didn’t have time to travel across the battlefield before a ray of light shot towards them directly from Martial Alliance City and precisely struck Yun Tianyang in the heart.
The scene seemed to freeze at this second; even Qin Yuezhi was a bit dazed. It was only when Yun Tianyang's figure slowly collapsed that he finally came back to his senses.
A cold glint flashed through Alliance Leader Qin’s eyes. He was just about to go up and deal the final blow when a silhouette flashed across his eyes, and a woman had already appeared, propping Yun Tianyang up.
"Master, in the end, I still let you down." Yun Tianyang covered his chest with one hand and strained to speak, "I originally wanted to kill Qin Yuezhi and force that person to fight me. Then Master would be able to wait for an opportunity to strike, but I didn't expect…"
At this point, Yun Tianyang could no longer continue. He didn't expect that even when he risked his life to fight, ultimately, he couldn't even see the final opponent's face…
"Why are you so stupid?" Ah Xiu propped him up, a few ripples appearing in her otherwise calm gaze.
Yun Tianyang coughed out a few mouthfuls of blood and suddenly pulled himself together, his voice rising a few notches.
"Master, look behind us! The Martial Arts Alliance is bringing the world great suffering. It’s tyrannical, domineering, and not supported by popular sentiment! As martial artists, if we don’t fight to protect the people’s lives, then how are we any different from countryside farmers?”
Ah Xiu turned her head back in a daze. She saw the hundreds of thousands of troops from the Northwestern Army; she saw pair after pair of eyes filled with an unwillingness to resign themselves to their fate, yet they also contained hopeful longing for the future.
"Fighting to protect the people's lives?" Ah Xiu murmured softly, "You're right."
She slowly stood up and drew the sword she’d been nurturing for twenty years out of its scabbard. That sword nurturing technique she carefully prepared for a powerful enemy also seemed to dissipate as she unsheathed it.
But Ah Xiu didn't feel the slightest ounce of regret, because she knew that she no longer needed that kind of thing.
The sword nurturing technique nurtured the momentum of her sword, continuously accumulating power over many years to finally unleash a single world-shaking blow. But she already had the great momentum of the world behind her.
Such a momentum was irreversible!
And in the eyes of Red Tail and the others inside Martial Alliance City, the already dense Qi surrounding Ah Xiu was fiercely released but immediately pulled back inside her body, seemingly absorbing the destiny of the entire Northwestern Army.
At this moment, Ah Xiu seemed to have become the spokesperson of the Heavenly Dao. Every single movement of hers possessed an unstoppable majesty.
Qin Yuezhi, who was standing in front of her, couldn’t even speak anymore. In fact, he couldn’t even escape as his whole body was instantly sliced in half.
Unsheathing her sword and killing the enemy—everything seemed so natural, as if it was only right and proper. It almost seemed like Qin Yuezhi was born to die at this moment.
"Master?!" Yun Tianyang was startled. The terrifying power of this sword had completely surpassed his imagination.
But a burst of joy surged up in his heart immediately afterwards. Yun Tianyang finally realized what happened: ‘She broke through! Master finally achieved a breakthrough!’
Yun Tianyang, who was extremely familiar with his master’s frightening power, could scarcely imagine what kind of realm she could reach after successfully taking this last step.
‘It doesn’t matter whether Master has reached that legendary realm capable of shattering space. She’s absolutely not someone a ragtag group like the Martial Arts Alliance can stop!’
However, just as Yun Tianyang was overwhelmed by emotions, an unhurried voice rang out in front of them:
"Ready your sword. Don't disappoint me."
Yun Tianyang turned his head and saw the silver-robed man on his mind day and night just standing calmly in front of them.
His tone, which seemed eager to fight Ah Xiu, perplexed Yun Tianyang. ‘My master has stepped into the realm of legends, so shouldn't he be appalled or even fearful?’
Ah Xiu held her sword in one hand and asked lightly, "Senior has already entered this realm twenty years ago. To arrange this situation so painstakingly—could Senior be using a fight with Ah Xiu to reach further enlightenment in martial arts?"
Ah Xiu could only think of one possibility behind this mysterious person’s actions: he was deliberately raising her—raising a battle-worthy opponent!
Yun Tianyang was also a very smart person and instantly understood what his master meant. For a while, he felt like he’d plunged into an icy abyss.
‘All of this—was it all part of this person's plan?’
However, the silver-robed man shook his head slightly. "I simply want to help you, that’s all."
Ah Xiu snorted coldly and valiantly attacked with her sword without another word.
This ethereal strike was far more terrifying and unpredictable than the previous one.
This instant, Ah Xiu's attack finally managed to create the power of laws. It was entirely different from this world’s martial arts, yet it represented the essence of the world!
At this moment, Yun Tianyang was the strongest martial artist who was the closest to this attack. Thus, he became the representative of the world, feeling the wondrous power from this sword.
‘This is not a power that a mortal can grasp…’ For some reason, such a thought crossed Yun Tianyang's mind.
Under his expectant gaze, this sword finally stabbed the silver-robed man—to be exact, it stabbed a finger extended by the other party.
The sword collided with the fingertip with a palpitating muffled sound, and then Yun Tianyang saw Ah Xiu's sword break, starting from the middle.
The sword broke!
Yun Tianyang was slightly shocked, and he hurriedly looked up, only to see a few drops of blood flow out from the silver-robed person’s outstretched finger.
"After all, it’s a Void Cutter that broke through by herself. It can actually hurt me?" The silver-robed man stared at Ah Xiu with interest, while the injury on his hand recovered in the blink of an eye.
Yun Tianyang's face paled as he fell into deep despair. He didn’t know how they’d be able to kill such an opponent.
On the other hand, Ah Xiu's gaze remained firm as she turned to Yun Tianyang and said, "Watch carefully—Master will teach you the last sword art."
Yun Tianyang was slightly taken aback, but then he saw Ah Xiu place her right index and middle fingers together, pointing at the silver-robed man.
Yun Tianyang felt a strong sword intent gather on Ah Xiu’s two fingers. Hope rekindled in his heart. "Could this be the legendary having a sword in one’s heart…"
Ah Xiu fixed her gaze on her fingertips and said softly, "This sword—"
Bam!
A silver figure flashed by; the silver-robed man had punched Ah Xiu in the back of her head, directly knocking her out.
"You can come with me now that you’ve broken through," a calm voice sounded beside Yun Tianyang's ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: A Living Mist Mirror
chapters.content:
Crescent Moon World.
When Ah Xiu regained consciousness inside the headquarters of Martial Alliance City, the flames of war that engulfed the world had long since subsided, and this city once again became the holy land of martial arts in the hearts of the people.
In fact, it became even more "holy" than before the chaos, because many people witnessed the Zhongli Goddess—who cut down Qin Yuezhi in one strike—be taken away by a mysterious silver-robed person.
Thus, in rumors within the martial arts community, this "Silver-Robed Ancestor" gained multiple identities as the founder of the Martial Arts Alliance, a powerhouse from the Upper World, and the world's strongest expert.
"Are you awake?" A soft voice rang in her ears. Ah Xiu opened her eyes to glance to the side and saw Red Tail staring at her with a calm smile.
"Senior Red Tail…” Ah Xiu was in a trance, as if she’d gone back twenty years to that afternoon when she snuck into the Alliance headquarters with her senior martial sister.
Now that twenty years had passed, she was no longer the young girl from the past, but Senior Red Tail didn’t seem to have changed at all.
"If you're awake, then let’s get started!" Red Tail’s smile grew brighter and brighter, and her tone was cheerful, but Ah Xiu felt the atmosphere was somewhat oppressive.
Along with Red Tail's words, the ground underneath Ah Xiu lit up. She was actually lying on top of a strange array.
The complex and extremely arcane patterns made even Ah Xiu dizzy when she stared at them—this had nothing to do with her cultivation realm. As someone who lived in an ancient era, of course she never learned plane geometry.
With a thought, she subconsciously used the power of the law she’d just comprehended, creating a sword intent out of thin air.
But this sword intent was created for only a few seconds when someone’s will directly crushed it, not leaving even a trace behind.
Ah Xiu immediately felt a stab of sharp pain in her mind. Her head felt as if it was being torn apart; the destruction of her sword intent had injured her considerably.
Only then did she realize that the silver-robed senior was standing off to the side, looking at her blandly.
He wasn’t wearing that mask right now, so Ah Xiu could finally see his face— ‘H-He’s actually this young?’
But soon, Ah Xiu no longer had the time to lament Gu Nan's youthfulness, because she realized that the array under her feet was getting brighter and brighter, while some sort of strange mist was lingering around her.
This mist was actually the power of her destiny, which was temporarily manifested under the effects of the special array.
The mist gently circled in the air, gradually condensing into the shape of a mirror. Ah Xiu, on the other hand, only felt her eyelids getting heavier and heavier. As she was already injured, her consciousness began to fade.
When her consciousness became blurred, a wisp of her soul left her body and went straight into the mirror.
"Sure enough, she has to be awake for it to work." Red Tail couldn’t help sighing with emotion when she saw this.
Of course she and Gu Nan didn’t wait until Ah Xiu woke up just so they could greet her. In fact, Red Tail already tried to extract Ah Xiu’s destiny from her body to make a mist mirror.
But this never-before-seen Void Cutter Realm child of destiny was indeed very different.
Usually, Red Tail sealed the child of destiny’s consciousness, cutting the connection between their soul and the outside world, and then extracted the power of destiny from them.
But Ah Xiu’s destiny had already initially fused with her soul, so it couldn’t be completely separated.
In other words, after stepping into Void Cutter Realm, she was already half of a spokesperson for the plane. It was no longer as simple as merely being favored by destiny.
So Red Tail could only wait for her soul to reawaken, and then find a way to also extract her soul along with her destiny and put as much of that into the mist mirror as possible.
Ah Xiu's soul was already Void Cutter Realm, so only Gu Nan could carry out this operation. Furthermore, they didn’t even know if this would actually work…
The power of destiny slowly condensed, wrapping around Ah Xiu's soul to form a ball as both entered the mirror that was still forming.
"My Lord?" Contrary to expectations, Red Tail actually felt like something was wrong when she saw that things were going unusually smoothly and couldn't help glancing at Gu Nan.
"The level of the translation method is too low. Looks like it already reached its limit trying to handle a child of destiny of this level." Gu Nan led all the destiny into the mist mirror at once and shook his head.
This translation method from the Indigo Mound tribe was originally created for Prodigious Realm children of destiny. This was true even for the complete version within the tribe.
Gu Nan borrowed an entire world’s destiny to forcibly push a child of destiny to Void Cutter Realm, but regrettably, the other parts of the translation method couldn’t keep up.
They were able to seal her soul but couldn’t actually extract Ah Xiu’s destiny from her body; and while making the mist mirror, the mirror would’ve been overwhelmed by Ah Xiu’s enormous destiny and burst had Gu Nan not personally carried out the process.
In fact, no translation method could possibly have a part involving Void Cutters—those who would research translation methods and had a use for them were bound to be cultivators below Void Cutter Realm, so how would they be able to create a Void Cutter Realm version of the translation method?
Only a special case like Gu Nan would go back and research the translation method even after his realm far surpassed it.
"Let's see if the mist mirror made from a Void Cutter can bring some pleasant surprise, otherwise the gains really won’t outweigh the losses."
Leaving aside the troubles of artificially creating a Void Cutter child of destiny, merely this series of complex operations after acquiring the Void Cutter Realm ingredient would be enough to stump a genuine Void Cutter like Lan Si—only Gu Nan could successfully complete it.
Thus, it directly lost any scalability; the production efficiency was way too low.
The light from the array slowly disappeared, and tranquility once again returned to the small courtyard. Ah Xiu's body had already turned to dust as a small mirror fell to the ground.
Red Tail took two steps forward and picked up the mirror. The mirror was covered with a faint layer of mist. It seemed no different from a normal mist mirror.
In fact, the mist on this mirror was actually a little thinner than normal, and one could make out the rough outline of the mirror. Red Tail could actually see a blurry reflection of her own face on it.
Red Tail raised the mirror a little higher and carefully examined it, as if trying to find something out of the ordinary with it.
Right just then, a woman's face suddenly appeared from the mirror and lunged at her!
This shocking turn almost made Red Tail fling the mirror away in fright. Finally, she managed to calm her mind after much difficulty. Cold sweat had actually broken out on her forehead.
"My Lord, look." She hurriedly handed the mist mirror to Gu Nan, pointing to the human face on it.
Gu Nan looked down and saw that it was precisely Ah Xiu’s face, only she had completely lost her rationality. It seemed like only her instincts remained.
She was like a ghost sealed inside the mirror, frantically trying to escape from it to no avail. She could only engage in futile struggle.
Gu Nan smiled and gently placed this mist mirror on the ground. Red Tail stared at him in confusion. Just when she opened her mouth to ask, she saw the mist mirror jump violently.
The crisp sound of the mirror hitting the ground reverberated throughout the small courtyard for a long time, but Red Tail felt the atmosphere turn a little eerie.
With her power, she had long since lost any need to be scared of ghosts, but this scene in front of her was way too creepy.
"How interesting." Gu Nan, however, picked up the mist mirror with interest and casually erased the mist on it and handed it to Red Tail. "Find people to complete the missions on this as soon as possible."
"Yes," Red Tail hurriedly agreed, and as she took the mist mirror, she could still feel it shaking gently.
Ah Xiu's face was clearly reflected in the mirror.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Target: Silver-Robed Ancestor
chapters.content:
Red Tail was indeed a talent.
The complexity and covert nature of reincarnator organizations rendered many management-type talents incapable of actually being a competent leader at those organizations, but Red Tail could.
Even the White Mist organization she newly rebuilt in White Bones Realm displayed astonishing efficiency.
In just three months, most of the world missions on the Void Cutter Realm mist mirror had already been completed.
While this was certainly attributable to White Mist’s reasonable distribution of mission personnel, Gu Nan’s vigorous support also played an important role—during the same three months, he cleaned up six reincarnator organizations in White Bones Realm and annexed them into White Mist.
If not for Bai Qiaozhen finally paying him a personal visit to ask him to curb the speed of White Mist’s expansion a little, he might just have absorbed all the mission personnel in White Bones Realm.
Ever since that battle in Tiluo World where Gu Nan displayed Star Ruler Realm power of law, the voices discussing him in the Myriad Heavens Universe abruptly stopped.
After all, this was still a Star Ruler. Even if he may not have his own astral world yet and his power had yet to experience a qualitative leap, he still wasn’t someone that normal Void Cutters could compare with.
Of course, if the forces under Gu Nan wanted to develop in White Bones Realm, they still had to respect the attitude of Daoist White Bones and couldn’t be too arrogant.
So White Mist’s final size became a collection of several reincarnator organizations that gathered up a large number of mission personnel to wholeheartedly clear missions "translated" by the Void Cutter Realm mist mirror.
On this day, Gu Nan's true body was sitting comfortably within his Divine Kingdom when a message suddenly came from the Evil God Temple.
｢Personal dungeon ‘Crescent Moon World' is complete｣
Gu Nan was slightly taken aback, then hurriedly opened the personal dungeon interface. Sure enough, Crescent Moon World, which wasn’t even in the list of personal dungeons earlier, was now listed at the top of all the dungeons.
Its icon had turned a bright color, mirroring the "Splendid World" beside it.
"The destiny from a Void Cutter Realm mist mirror is more concentrated, so the majority of the missions generated also focus on Crescent Moon World?" Gu Nan immediately realized what was going on.
The mist mirror made from Ah Xiu had a far greater number of missions than normal mist mirrors, although there was little change in difficulty level.
But Gu Nan just knew that there were more missions—he didn’t expect for this series of missions to directly push the completion rate of Crescent Moon World's personal dungeon to 100%!
The current Crescent Moon World personal dungeon was still in an unactivated state. Gu Nan himself must clear it with a full party first before he could have the apostles raid it.
Almost without any hesitation, Gu Nan immediately decided to head to the Inner World to clear this dungeon.
After all, he would need to upgrade the Evil God Temple to Level 2 and also earn more Evil Value if he wanted to advance to Tier 7.
Evil Value could probably only be obtained by slaying gods, while points would have to be earned from personal dungeons.
After the Evil God Temple actually materialized inside the Divine Kingdom, the personal dungeon interface also displayed more information, giving a clear overview of the "Crescent Moon World" dungeon.
Gu Nan directly skipped all of the background introduction; he only knew that the setting was similar to the real Crescent Moon World.
The maximum party number was three people. The final mission target was to… kill the Silver-Robed Ancestor?
Gu Nan stared blankly at that for quite a while before he went back to read the mission background, which was to help the Zhongli Goddess and the Northwestern Army overthrow the tyrannical regime of the Martial Arts Alliance.
Gu Nan couldn’t help laughing involuntarily. This was a very strange feeling.
It was just a mission, so he didn’t mind which side he was helping. But he was a little curious—would the Silver-Robed Ancestor inside the dungeon be designed based on Gu Nan himself?
If the boss perfectly inherited Gu Nan’s strength, then the mission difficulty might be a bit outrageous.
……
The Inner World.
Gu Nan's soul once again stepped into this place after many years, this time finally not by relying on another’s help but by his own strength.
The essential difference between Star Rulers and Void Cutters was that the laws Star Rulers constructed for themselves were already complete. As such, those laws could be acknowledged by the world, and they were even qualified to rule an entire world.
When he entered the Myriad Heavens Starry Road again, Gu Nan's view of this was very different from before.
The worlds that turned into balls of light and the Star Rulers that turned into bright dots were the same as before, but Gu Nan could see more this time.
Most Star Rulers didn’t bother to conceal their own auras, so Gu Nan could even tell which astral world certain Star Rulers came from.
Of course most Star Rulers didn’t have their own astral worlds yet and were in the Inner World precisely to find the right plane and capture its origin.
There were also Star Rulers who already owned astral worlds, working with others to clear missions from other planes and capturing those worlds’ origins as a reward to enrich themselves.
But all these people had nothing to do with Gu Nan. He simply wanted to find two random companions here to clear the Crescent Moon World personal dungeon.
The Crescent Moon World dungeon expanded, forming a delicate ball of light. Several bright dots immediately flew towards it, two of which seized the first opportunity to enter the ball of light.
The scene before Gu Nan’s eyes shifted, and he was now inside an inn. By his side sat a man and a woman.
Of the two, the woman had a delicate and pretty face and was wearing a strange cloak with arcane characters drawn all over it like an incantation.
The man, on the other hand, had the head of a leopard, and his body was covered with golden fur. Surprisingly, he wasn’t a pure-blooded human.
As soon as the leopard-headed man saw Gu Nan, his eyes lit up. "So it's His Excellency Gu Nan!"
"You recognize me?" Gu Nan's gaze moved on the leopard-headed man.
"I naturally recognize you." The leopard-headed man laughed. "Your Excellency’s battle in Tiluo World shocked many people!"
Quite a few people were actually interested in Gu Nan, this "Nine Abyss Heavenly Demon" who suddenly appeared out of nowhere. After all, if they could subdue him when he was still at Void Cutter Realm, then this would be a strong fighting power capable of further growth.
It was only when Gu Nan revealed Star Ruler Realm power of law in Tiluo World that many people stopped having such thoughts.
Gu Nan nodded noncommittally, not having much of a reaction to the leopard-headed man’s words.
The three introduced themselves after that. The woman called herself Nie Shuangshuang, while the leopard-headed man was just called Leopard Gold. He admitted that he had no astral world yet and very casually expressed hopes that Gu Nan and Nie Shuangshuang could recommend him one.
"Let’s stop wasting time and just get started," Nie Shuangshuang interrupted him.
Gu Nan naturally agreed. The three of them walked out of the inn, and a line of crimson words had already appeared in the sky.
｢Final Goal: Kill the Silver-Robed Ancestor｣
｢First Phase: Assassinate Martial Arts Alliance expert Li Jin
Power Restriction: Tier 4 ｣
Gu Nan, who personally experienced this period of history in Crescent Moon World, could naturally tell that this mission wanted them to follow Yun Tianyang and Ah Xiu’s journey—starting with assassinating Li Jin—all the way to the final goal of killing the "Silver-Robed Ancestor."
This was an all-too-normal RPG dungeon that had no bizarre settings. In other words, the difficulty was probably in the combat aspect.
Thinking of this, Gu Nan spoke up, "Let's just kill that Silver-Robed Ancestor now."
Leopard Gold and Nie Shuangshuang glanced at him, but neither was very surprised. Instead, Nie Shuangshuang replied, "Might as well."
"This plane allowed us to keep our Void Cutter Realm power, which is enough to kill any opponent of the same realm." Leopard Gold also laughed.
It was common knowledge that Star Ruler Realm enemies could never appear in the Inner World’s missions. Additionally, the actual Star Rulers couldn’t stay in the Inner World for long, so of course they had to hurry up.
"Then let's see what the Silver-Robed Ancestor is capable of." Gu Nan's gaze flickered as he stepped out and descended upon Martial Alliance City.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Unstable Aggro
chapters.content:
Martial Alliance City.
With the spatial rift opened by Gu Nan, Leopard Gold and Nie Shuangshuang also reached the city.
Nie Shuangshuang glanced at Gu Nan with some confusion and asked, "You've been to this world before?"
"Mm, I've been here before." Gu Nan said casually, "This place is called Martial Alliance City. There’s a Silver-Robed Ancestor inside."
His two companions didn’t doubt him. After all, there were countless planes, so it wasn’t strange to have been here before, especially since this world was captured by Gu Nan.
"This is a world of martial arts. The Silver-Robed Ancestor should be someone walking the body refinement path."
When considering how the Silver-Robed Ancestor might be based on himself, Gu Nan ultimately decided to remind his two companions after some thought.
"No matter how strong he is, he’s nothing more than an expert from such a small plane. We can simply be careful," Leopard Gold responded with a cheerful smile. Although he said they should be careful, he didn’t actually take the enemy seriously at all.
Nie Shuangshuang was noncommittal, but judging from her unhesitating movements, she most likely didn’t take Gu Nan’s warning to heart either.
This was normal. They were all grand Star Ruler characters. Why would they care about someone from an obscure small plane?
In all likelihood, not even Gu Nan would’ve taken this fight very seriously either had he not known the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s origin. So they were doomed to pay the price for underestimating their opponent.
The three of them had just appeared in front of Martial Alliance City when a silver figure suddenly flickered past and appeared in front of Leopard Gold, who was in the lead.
A sneer appeared on Leopard Gold’s face. Gu Nan, on the other hand, sighed in relief—judging from the speed alone, this Silver-Robed Ancestor wasn’t an exact copy of Gu Nan and was far inferior to his saint clone.
If it was his own saint clone, he was afraid Leopard Gold wouldn’t even have a chance to react.
But similarly, the three of them also weren’t at the peak of Tier 4. Gu Nan estimated that his current power was about the same as the other side’s.
A trace of helplessness flashed through Gu Nan’s eyes. With his experience, he more or less understood the hardest part about this dungeon.
On the other side, Leopard Gold and the Silver-Robed Ancestor had already exchanged blows, while Nie Shuangshuang didn’t rush to attack and carefully observed the opponent instead.
Leopard Gold had no intention of holding back and slashed out with his claws as soon as the enemy appeared.
He made a grab for the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s head with his right hand, which rapidly turned into gold mid-attack. He eventually went so far as to transform his entire hand into a leopard claw made of gold.
Cultivators’ laws were completely constructed after reaching Star Ruler Realm, so unlike Void Cutters, fights between Star Rulers wouldn’t accidentally destroy their surroundings.
They had enough control to apply their laws purely to killing their opponent and nothing else.
Leopard Gold’s golden claws looked ordinary, but in fact, they carried the two laws of "sharpness" and "indestructibility," which was useful for both offense and defense and could be considered one of his trump cards.
To use this attack as soon as he started fighting—it was true that he didn’t seem to be taking this lightly.
But the Silver-Robed Ancestor didn’t dodge. Instead, he seemed determined to land his punch, even if he had to tank Leopard Gold’s blow with his head.
Leopard Gold was very unused to this kind of fighting style that exchanged injury for injury. But since it came to this, he also had no intention of backing down. He just shifted his position slightly so that the incoming punch wouldn’t hit his vitals, but the strength behind his claws increased slightly!
Since he was in the Inner World, he didn’t fear death. Even if he injured the enemy at the cost of dying himself, there were still two fresh troops on his side to continue the fight.
The two attacks collided almost simultaneously. Leopard Gold’s expression couldn’t help changing slightly when he felt the terrifying strength traveling up from his shoulder. Fortunately, the enemy's wounds were more serious than his.
After all, Leopard Gold was a Star Ruler. Even if he was limited to just Void Cutter Realm right now, his laws were still infinitely close to being complete.
The golden claws swiped down, slicing open over half of the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s head, all the way until they could even see the fractured nasal bones.
However, just as Leopard Gold revealed a faint smile, he felt a pain from his abdomen. That Silver-Robed Ancestor seemed completely unaffected by those heavy injuries and actually landed a kick to his stomach just now!
Leopard Gold’s body involuntarily flew out, while the Silver-Robed Ancestor actually followed him like a shadow, swinging another fist down on Leopard Gold’s head.
Finally, Nie Shuangshuang couldn’t continue watching from the sidelines anymore. Her left hand gently drew a circle, and a ray of light appeared between the Silver-Robed Ancestor and Leopard Gold, which then exploded and blasted the two apart.
Simultaneously, Gu Nan's figure appeared behind the Silver-Robed Ancestor and swung his fist down in almost exactly the same attack as the opponent’s earlier punch. His target was precisely the back of the Silver-Robed Ancestor's head.
But the Silver-Robed Ancestor reacted too quickly, immediately swinging a punch behind him. However, Gu Nan seemed to have anticipated this a long time ago. His fist suddenly changed paths and swung down towards the side instead.
Thus, the Silver-Robed Ancestor also changed the path of his attack. The two of them changed their attack paths three consecutive times, and finally, Gu Nan stopped his change at the very last second and turned it into a straight punch.
This punch finally became inescapable, hitting the Silver-Robed Ancestor right in the face.
Just how powerful was a punch at Gu Nan’s full power? The Silver-Robed Ancestor’s head was already sliced in half; this time, it was directly blasted apart, his head suddenly exploding.
Leopard Gold and Nie Shuangshuang were slightly stunned. They didn't expect victory to come so easily, but Gu Nan shouted again.
"Don't just stand still! Attack him!"
Only then did the two seem to wake up from a dream and realize the enemy was still alive, but they were already too late. The Silver-Robed Ancestor dodged, and in the blink of an eye, he was already on Martial Alliance City’s walls. Then he made a jaw-dropping move.
He actually tore open a spatial rift and ran right into it!
"What's going on here? A being created by laws is actually capable of running away?!" Seeing the Silver-Robed Ancestor turn tail and run, Leopard Gold almost spat out a mouthful of blood.
He was also considered an experienced Star Ruler and had completed many missions in the Inner World, but he’d never seen such an enemy before.
They hadn’t even fought for two minutes, yet the other party had already fled without another word, and he even escaped in such a way that made it impossible for them to give chase. Even if the other party was still in this plane, they didn’t even know which direction he went, so naturally there was no way to find him.
"Let's start over." Gu Nan shook his head and explained, "The difficulty of this boss lies in the unstable aggro. He will escape as soon as we display overwhelming power, so he must be killed in one blow."
Gu Nan could already tell that not only did the Silver-Robed Ancestor created by this plane inherit his own attributes, he also inherited Gu Nan’s combat awareness and fighting style.
Combat awareness was the straightforward fighting style players had, while fighting style—to put it bluntly—was six words: “If you can't beat them, run.”
Hearing Gu Nan's words, Leopard Gold and Nie Shuangshuang both nodded.
Although they didn’t quite understand what a "boss" was, they understood Gu Nan’s basic meaning—this enemy was very cunning.
They also didn’t expect to clear the mission on the first try, but fortunately the first try didn’t take long, so they simply had to redo it.
However, this Silver-Robed Ancestor was harder to kill than expected. The three tried over ten times, but time and again, the enemy managed to slip away. They couldn’t even force the Silver-Robed Ancestor to use his power of law.
Later, the three of them gradually started to get familiar with each other’s methods and started coordinating their attacks, which flustered the Silver-Robed Ancestor and inflicted increasingly heavier wounds on him, but they still didn’t succeed in killing him.
Even Gu Nan realized for the first time that he was actually this hard to kill when all his abilities were taken into account.
Without overwhelming power far beyond the enemy’s level to directly crush him, they could only make attempt after attempt to see if they could kill the Silver-Robed Ancestor by a stroke of luck on one of these tries.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: “Good Samaritan” Gu Nan
chapters.content:
After yet another failed attempt where the Silver-Robed Ancestor escaped without hesitation, Leopard Gold was the first to give up.
"This Silver-Robed Ancestor is too slippery. I, Leopard, lack the ability to kill him, so I won't waste your time anymore," Leopard Gold said in a low muffled voice.
Soon afterwards, his figure slowly dissipated as his soul left Crescent Moon World.
He had given up on this mission.
It didn’t require much energy for Star Rulers to wander about the Inner World, but it was different once they entered a plane. Every moment they spent inside the plane consumed soul power.
Leopard Gold wasn’t very strong to begin with and belonged to the category of Star Rulers who didn’t have their own astral worlds yet, so he decided to cut his losses as soon as he determined that the mission was hopeless. He was actually quite decisive.
Gu Nan secretly sighed. ‘This is the systematic problem with randomly formed parties!’
Once they encountered overly difficult content, it was very likely for someone to leave the party.
Nie Shuangshuang, on the other hand, was clearly used to this already. She asked, “Do we keep fighting?”
Gu Nan naturally nodded, but Nie Shuangshuang suggested, "Let's stop here for today. I'll go back and prepare a little."
……
Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes from inside the Divine Kingdom, then sighed slightly.
He, Leopard Gold, and Nie Shuangshuang were ultimately unable to clear Crescent Moon World on the first try.
Leopard Gold chose to cut his losses in time, and Nie Shuangshuang also didn’t continue trying to clear the mission—this wasn’t actually because the high and mighty Star Rulers lost their patience. Rather, it was because this kind of attempt was too inefficient.
Nie Shuangshuang expressed that she would go back to prepare for a while, planning to devise two attacks capable of dealing explosive damage in a short time.
This was also a move to sharpen the axe in order to split the wood faster, so Gu Nan naturally wasn’t against it. He also didn’t need to clear the dungeon on the first try.
The two agreed to meet in the Myriad Heavens Starry Road again in a month.
Moreover, they were now one party member short. Gu Nan began to consider whether to recruit another random passerby or personally find someone to clear the dungeon.
Many of the people he knew actually weren’t weak, but they didn’t have much of an advantage against the Silver-Robed Ancestor, whose design was based on Gu Nan himself.
Only now would Gu Nan lament: ‘Why in the world did I make myself so powerful?’
It hadn’t even been two days since Gu Nan returned to the Evil God Temple when Red Tail sent another message over—an uninvited guest had dropped by White Bones Realm.
……
In White Bones Realm, Bai Qiaozhen stared at the woman before her with a helpless expression. "Your Excellency…"
"You can call me Ling'er,” Long Ling'er interrupted expressionlessly. She was currently using her human form that looked like a young girl, so Bai Qiaozhen could see her expression.
Bai Qiaozhen took a deep breath. The number of extraordinary occurrences in White Bones Realm this past year had almost caught up to all the abnormal events in the previous twenty years combined.
Her father, Daoist White Bones, was an "iron-fisted monarch" who exercised strict control over his astral world, but he obviously couldn’t personally attend to everything due to his identity and status, so that task fell to her instead.
If it was an ordinary powerful figure, then she naturally had subordinates who could handle it. But both the earlier Gu Nan and this Dragon of Space currently standing before her were obviously not ordinary people.
A single Gu Nan already gave Bai Qiaozhen quite a headache when he stirred up great trouble in White Bones Realm a while back, but she didn't expect another troublesome person to appear so soon.
"Why does Miss Ling'er want to visit my White Bones Realm?" She considered for a moment and finally chose to ask directly.
Long Ling'er also didn't let her down and gave a rather clear answer, only this answer might not necessarily be what Bai Qiaozhen wanted to hear.
"I came to find Gu Nan. I want to fight him," Long Ling'er answered matter-of-factly.
"....Why?!"
"He defeated me before," Long Ling'er explained with four brief words. In reality, she meant that if she wanted to hone her combat awareness, then she had to crawl back up from the exact same place she’d fallen down at.
Bai Qiaozhen tried hard to keep the anger from showing on her face. "Then can you guys fight somewhere else?"
Long Ling'er thought for a moment. "Yes."
Bai Qiaozhen immediately sighed in relief. As long as these two didn’t destroy her family’s astral world, she didn't care if Gu Nan lived or died.
However, a voice cut in beside her before she could say anything, "This isn’t a bad place to fight either!"
Gu Nan's saint clone had arrived, still in that same gaudy silver robe.
Bai Qiaozhen's expression instantly darkened and she said angrily, "Do you want me to kick all of your subordinates out of this realm?”
In theory, as the Star Ruler’s spokesperson, Bai Qiaozhen wouldn’t kick people out of the astral world just because a powerful pursuer was on their tail.
After all, they could provide power to the Star Ruler as long as they remained in the astral world, so if Bai Qiaozhen expelled them just because someone was chasing them, then Daoist White Bones would lose face as the ruler of White Bones Realm.
But she couldn't restrain herself at all when faced with a shameless person like Gu Nan!
"Oh, I was just kidding," Gu Nan absentmindedly replied, then glanced at Long Ling'er. "You want to fight me?"
Long Ling'er just nodded wordlessly.
"Aren't you afraid I’ll beat you to death?" Gu Nan's voice was as serene as usual, but his words were somewhat frightening.
Long Ling'er thought for a moment and answered, "He gave me something that can resurrect me."
This "he" naturally referred to Lu Wen. As one of the Thirteen Heavens who controlled the law of time, he absolutely had the ability to rewind time as long as prior arrangements were in place.
Thus, Gu Nan discarded the thought of killing the opponent with one punch—this kind of opponent who didn’t fear death had to be handled differently.
Gu Nan's gaze fell on her, and he suddenly thought of something. "Come with me."
After saying that, he turned around and walked into a small plane. Long Ling'er hurriedly followed him inside.
But before she could even see what the new plane looked like, a sharp pain had already traveled over from the back of her head.
He actually ambushed her!
The rage of being tricked surged up in her heart. Long Ling'er instantly transformed into her true body. A mysterious, razor-sharp power of space flowed out in all directions, bent on cutting Gu Nan to pieces.
However, Gu Nan didn’t dodge, so much so that most of his body was directly torn apart, but his fist hit the giant silver dragon's body.
This wasn’t a normal punch; it also contained the formidable power of shadows!
Since he didn’t borrow the power of his true body inside the Divine Kingdom, this attack only used Tier 4 law of shadows, but it was still enough to pierce the spatial barrier that Long Ling'er hastily put up.
He didn’t use the power of laws the last time they fought because he feared that killing her in one punch would provoke the Lu Wen backing her—it wasn’t because Gu Nan couldn’t kill her!
So this punch directly blasted her head apart.
As soon as Long Ling'er was killed, a strange force flung Gu Nan away, while the silver dragon's giant body quickly recovered and was as good as new in the blink of an eye.
Long Ling'er stared at Gu Nan in a daze, watching his half of a body also quickly heal itself. For a while, she didn’t know what to say.
She didn’t expect to be killed in a single exchange after the other party stopped holding back.
"Again," she said in a low voice.
She lacked experience, but her combat IQ was actually very high. She immediately realized the mistake she made earlier.
The opponent's physical body was too powerful, so she mustn’t give him a chance to get close to her. She should’ve fought while keeping her distance!
……
Four hours later, Long Ling'er, who’d been kited by Gu Nan for the entire afternoon, finally couldn't stand it anymore and roared, "Don't run if you have the guts!"
Of course Gu Nan wouldn’t listen to her, so he fired shadow arrows from an extreme distance, draining Long Ling’er’s power one arrow at a time and literally grinding her health to zero.
The newly-resurrected Long Ling'er rushed up to Gu Nan with a dark expression, but he didn’t actually run this time.
"Want to learn how to fight? I can teach you," Gu Nan proposed with a smile.
Long Ling'er had long since lost her initial naiveté. She stared at Gu Nan warily and asked, "What are your conditions?"
"Haha, why would I have any conditions? By the way, can you enter the Inner World?"
Although her face was full of disbelief, she still answered after some slight hesitation, "I can… You’re really willing to teach me?"
"Yup, I won’t charge any tuition fees and will also be responsible for finding you practical combat targets." Gu Nan said with a smile, "What a good Samaritan I am."
Long Ling'er thought for half a day and didn't think Gu Nan had anything to gain by lying to her, so she nodded. "Then what should I call you? Teacher?"
In her eyes, fighting techniques should be something very profound, so someone willing to teach it to her should be addressed respectfully.
"No, you can just call me Lei Feng
[1]
."
T/N:

Lei Feng
: A soldier in the People’s Liberation Army who was portrayed as a selfless and modest model citizen whose example people were encouraged to follow

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Long Linger’s Origin
chapters.content:
Long Ling'er was standing in the middle of a group of strange shadow warriors in White Bones Realm, struggling to defend herself against attacks from all sides.
These shadow warriors would attack with any part of their bodies, including their heads, limbs, and joints. All Long Ling'er had to do was stop them from breaking through her defense.
The reason Gu Nan could casually break through the spatial barrier she put up multiple times was because flaws existed in her defensive barriers.
The shadow warriors attacked in such a way that allowed Long Ling'er to become aware of her weak points.
This was one of the training methods Gu Nan designed for her.
At the same time, because such training required too much fine control, the two had to return to White Bones Realm—the small plane’s laws were incomplete, which was very inconvenient for comprehending the finer manipulation of laws.
Bang!
A light sound rang out. Long Ling'er’s barrier was broken yet again by a shadow warrior’s elbow strike. All the shadows stopped moving simultaneously, as if they were frozen in this moment by some power.
Gu Nan slowly walked over from the side and pointed at the warrior who broke the barrier, especially his elbow that broke the barrier.
"Only five shadow warriors attacked this time, yet you merely lasted ten seconds, which is even worse than your score against seven warriors earlier. Do you know why? This is the result of being caught off guard by surprise attacks."
Of course Long Ling'er knew. She complained resentfully, "What kind of person can snap out their humerus in a fight…"
That shadow warrior's so-called elbow strike actually meant popping out the humerus bone from the arm to attack. This kind of attack that surpassed the limits of human anatomy was why Long Ling'er couldn’t react in time.
However, Gu Nan fell silent when he heard that. He stretched out his right hand and exerted a little force. His elbow joint naturally broke, and the bone inside his arm popped out.
But even with such a gruesome scene, not much blood actually flowed out. On the contrary, the bone in his right arm snapped right back into position again with a casual press of his left hand.
Long Ling'er, who was watching this from the side, was so stunned that her eyes almost popped out of their sockets.
Only then did Gu Nan say, "At our level, no form of attack should come as a surprise. In a real battle, a single mistake will be enough to kill you."
Long Ling'er also understood this, so she nodded quietly, but Gu Nan then added, "Let’s stop the training here. I'll take you to an actual battle."
The reason he said this was because one month had already passed since they started training.
Gu Nan put quite the effort into teaching Long Ling'er. After all, he was counting on her help to deal with the Silver-Robed Ancestor for him.
On the other hand, he also wasn’t too worried about the problem of "helping a potential enemy."
He and Lu Wen didn’t really have any grudges between them. It was nothing more than how Lu Wen lost some face because he wanted Gu Nan to help Lou Wanying but was ultimately declined.
Gu Nan snatching away the sand of time later on wasn’t a very big deal either—Lou Wanying couldn’t use it in the first place, and Lu Wen’s goal wasn’t the sand of time to begin with.
"An actual battle?" Long Ling'er felt some rare excitement when she heard these words—Gu Nan trained her using all kinds of methods during this past month, putting her through unspeakable misery.
The current Long Ling'er felt like she’d never craved a fight as much as she did now.
"Who are we killing?" She asked with wide eyes.
Gu Nan smiled. "Me."
……
Inner World, Crescent Moon World.
Gu Nan directly brought Long Ling'er into Crescent Moon World’s dungeon this time, while Nie Shuangshuang had been waiting in the Inner World for a long time now and entered as soon as Gu Nan opened Crescent Moon World’s dungeon.
The three of them met at the initial inn, while Nie Shuangshunag instantly recognized Long Ling'er.
"The Dragon of Space?"
"Oh? Do you also know her?" Gu Nan was a bit surprised. He thought that since Long Ling'er usually always stayed by Lu Wen’s side, not many people would recognize her.
Nie Shuangshuang was silent for a while, then explained, "Reportedly, when Lu Wen ascended to the ranks of the Thirteen Heavens back then, the two great Daos he comprehended were time and space. But he could only choose one of them when ascending to Unified Dao Realm, so he used a secret technique to preserve the space Dao…"
She stopped when she got here and just quietly stared at Long Ling'er.
Gu Nan, however, had a sudden realization. Only after hearing Nie Shuangshuang’s explanation did he understand Long Ling'er’s origin—she wasn’t actually part of the dragon race, but a manifestation of the law of space!
No wonder she could manipulate the power of space to such an extent.
In the game’s background, only one person could possess a specific Tier 10 or above law at a time.
For example, if the Goddess of Darkness—a major god who was at least Tier 10—already possessed the law of darkness, then it was impossible for a second major god-level god of darkness to exist in this world. Unless the former died, the other gods of darkness would forever be stuck below Tier 10.
The same applied to the Myriad Heavens Universe. Here, people referred to powerhouses on the level of the Thirteen Heavens as “Unified Dao Realm” cultivators, meaning they had already unified their bodies with their Dao.
Correspondingly, they could only merge with one Dao, and once someone ascended to Unified Dao Realm by unifying with a particular law, then no one else would be able to ascend to Unified Dao Realm using that same law anymore.
So be it the Thirteen Heavens here or the Twelve Major Gods in the World of Gods, their internal relations weren't necessarily very harmonious—after all, some of them were blocking others from reaching Unified Dao Realm just by being alive.
On the contrary, there was no such problem between the two plane clusters—for example, Clockwork Heaven and the God of Time both ruled over the law of time, yet both were above Tier 10.
Gu Nan reached the Third Round—Tier 16—in his previous life, so of course he knew this set of rules like the back of his hand. Only it never occurred to him that Long Ling’er was actually an existence Lu Wen used to lay claim to the Dao of space.
In this regard, Lu Wen really was a genius.
There were many people who comprehended two great Daos at once, especially time and space, which were two sides of the same existence. But the number of people who could really use their comprehension of two Daos to their advantage was few and far in between.
For example, the god known as the Ruler of Light and Justice was someone who occupied two great Daos and possessed the characteristics of both light and justice. He became the undisputed strongest among the Twelve Major Gods, but no one knew how he did it.
Although Lu Wen wasn’t able to unify two Daos, he laid claim to the great Dao of space in another form—he condensed his own comprehension of space and created a new independent consciousness, which was Long Ling'er.
As long as Long Ling'er could grow stronger in the future and perhaps even reach Tier 10, Lu Wen would gain a natural ally. The benefits were certainly great.
All these thoughts flashed across Gu Nan's mind for an instant, while Long Ling'er was noncommittal.
Nie Shuangshuang wasn't the first person to say this to her, and her origin wasn’t considered a secret among the more veteran Star Rulers.
"Where’s the one we’re going to kill?" Long Ling'er didn't pay much attention to Nie Shuangshuang and merely asked Gu Nan eagerly.
Gu Nan casually opened a passage in space and headed straight for Martial Alliance City. "Come with me. This time we'll try to clear it in one go."
Nie Shuangshuang followed him inside first. She always appeared calm, but her movement at this moment betrayed her.
Having suffered so many defeats at the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s hands, to say she wasn’t frustrated at all was certainly impossible. And now, the best helper arrived.
With the Dragon of Space, they could perfectly neutralize the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s habit of tearing open space to flee at the slightest sign of danger.
T/N:
Using Dao interchangeably with laws, can also mean paths
