chapters.title: Chapter 342: Unwarranted Disaster
chapters.content:
While Gu Nan was busy leading his party around in the Inner World, another incident occurred in the Myriad Heavens Universe.
This matter received quite a bit of attention and even triggered heated debate for a while, because it was the follow-up to the earlier story of a Heaven Level plane being divided up.
Nirvana Heaven’s origin automatically revealed itself after Zuo Zuo disappeared, yet it didn’t dissipate.
This made it awkward for many Star Rulers hoping to get some crumbs, but those truly powerful Star Rulers were happy because such a large origin was the perfect size for them to fight over.
In the end, the main part of Nirvana Heaven’s origin was divided into three portions, each of which was taken away by a powerful Star Ruler.
They were Moonlight Heaven’s Star Ruler Fairy Moon; Ying Yang Rotation Heaven’s Star Ruler Wang Chong, as well as White Bones Realm’s Daoist White Bones.
The reason Gu Nan received no pressure from the Star Ruler of White Bones Realm lately despite stirring up all kinds of trouble here was because Daoist White Bones was busy fighting over Nirvana Heaven’s origin and had no time to deal with him.
But what many people didn't expect was for the remaining portion of Nirvana Heaven’s origin to ultimately be seized by a Star Ruler whom people suspected didn’t even own an astral world yet.
This person was the actual reincarnation of a great power. She was Wu Gui, who was both a demon and a Buddha.
In the past, the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara’s Myriad Buddha World was also a large world that was about to ascend to a “Realm” Level plane. It left a deep impression in many people’s memories.
But she died right before her world could ascend and was forced to walk the path of ten thousand reincarnations in hopes of fully resurrecting someday, yet even that plan was ultimately destroyed by the Heavenly Mystery Dao Lord. The struggles she went through made many people sigh with emotion.
Myriad Buddha World naturally still exists today, but Wu Gui had already fallen to the demonic path, so whether she could take control of her former world once again was still unknown. That was why people suspected she didn’t have an astral world yet.
But it was precisely such a person who snatched a portion of the world’s origin from right under three powerful Star Rulers’ noses. Most onlookers simply didn’t understand what she wanted to do.
Only a very small number of people who understood Zuo Zuo's roots knew she’d set her sights on Zuo Zuo's law of fusion and was trying to fuse her own demonic intent with her Buddhist heart.
Starting from the time she invaded Immortal Demon World a while back, Wu Gui's goal had never changed.
Since Gu Nan destroyed Zuo Zuo’s inheritance, she could only set her sights on Zuo Zuo himself to obtain the law of fusion.
She refused to become Zuo Zuo's subordinate and wait for Zuo Zuo to reward her after making meritorious achievements. On the contrary, she’d much rather find some way to kill Zuo Zuo, then somehow snatch his world’s origin.
Wu Gui was sitting on a black lotus in Star Realm. The purple and gold light on her body constantly flickered, seemingly trying to merge together.
After a long time, she finally opened her eyes slowly and shook her head. "It's still a bit short."
Red was standing right in front of her. "There is no shortage of the law of fusion inside the origin, but it’s too inaccurate to attempt to comprehend them out of thin air. What you lack is a target you can consult as reference."
Wu Gui nodded slightly at Red’s words. She knew what Red meant—she needed a genuine materialization of the law of fusion as a vessel for her to comprehend. Ultimately, a world's origin was too hazy and indistinct.
"A vessel of the law of fusion…" Wu Gui contemplated with rapt attention, as if considering where to find the law of fusion.
This kind of law was too rare. Even with her knowledge, she only knew that Zuo Zuo possessed this law. For a while, she couldn't think of a second person.
"He died and his inheritance was destroyed, but his former astral world from many years ago still exists." Red's speech was still unhurried, "First, we need to find Gu Nan."
Wu Gui smiled. "He caused quite a stir in Tiluo World. I heard he’s in White Bones Realm now?"
Gu Nan received considerable attention earlier, so his location instantly became public knowledge after he appeared several times in White Bones Realm.
But Red said, "White Bones Realm isn’t a nice place… He’s most likely going to encounter trouble. What good timing—you can help him out."
……
Inside White Mist’s headquarters in White Bones Realm.
Red Tail sat in a large conference room. With her were elders from White Mist such as Bai Xuesheng, as well as a Transcendent Realm martial artist who ascended from Crescent Moon World.
This Transcendent Realm martial artist was called Qin Du, the winner of the tournament back in Crescent Moon World. After ascending to White Bones Realm, he became the spokesman for the ten ascendants.
The current upper echelon of White Mist was divided into two factions—the original elders and the ascended martial artists.
However, this time was a rare occurrence where the two sides didn’t actually try to tear each other apart. Instead, both sides had equally gloomy expressions.
Because two corpses were placed at the end of the room. They were two Transcendent Realm martial artists from Crescent Moon World.
"They were killed in Zi Luo Heaven. According to the survivor who escaped, the other party provoked them quite deliberately. They didn’t steal our goods either; they just wanted to kill our people."
"Later, we received information that the perpetrator isn’t someone from White Bones Realm," Bai Xuesheng informed everyone in a heavy voice. Although he certainly didn’t get along with this group of ascendants, he also never wanted an outsider to wantonly kill members of White Mist.
"The killer was a Void Cutter cultivator. Our two protectors couldn’t escape, and even when they went all out in a last-ditch attack, they only managed to injure the other party.”
"Which organization are they from? Why would they do this?" Red Tail frowned heavily. She really couldn’t think of anyone White Mist had offended.
It wasn’t very likely for an organization like White Mist, whose business was primarily reincarnation, to offend other forces—unless they were in the same profession.
But ever since Gu Nan swept away multiple reincarnator organizations here, White Mist's reputation in the reincarnator circle had spread, and no one dared to mess with them at all.
So they didn’t expect to be ambushed this time when they sent people to Zi Luo Heaven to purchase and escort some goods.
"It's Mountain River World." Bai Xuesheng explained, "White Bones Realm offended too many people in the past when it ascended to a Realm Level plane. Mountain River World has never stopped targeting us all these years."
White Bones Realm wasn’t a laxly managed astral world like Star Realm—large internal conflicts were almost nonexistent here, which allowed it to constantly focus on external threats instead.
It was precisely because of this that White Bones Realm was able to successfully advance to the ranks of a Realm Level plane, but at the same time, it also blocked the paths of countless astral worlds and made countless enemies. Mountain River World was one of them.
Bai Xuesheng was a native of White Bones Realm, so he knew the most about these historical grudges.
‘This really is an unwarranted disaster…’ Red Tail lamented in secret. ‘It’s a pity My Lord is still in secluded cultivation, or else he most assuredly wouldn’t allow them to run wild.’
"Let's just make a note of this grudge for the time being—there will be a chance to get even later." Red Tail decided, "During this time, everyone should avoid leaving White Bones Realm if possible. Even they won’t dare to—"
"Grand Commander!" Mo Wentian hurriedly barged in. "Someone’s knocking on our door outside. They claim that we hurt their people and want us to give an explanation!"
Red Tail suddenly changed color, showing bewilderment. "Are they seeking death? They dare to run to White Bones Realm to cause trouble?"
They could only accept their bad luck if White Mist members were injured outside, but if enemies came knocking on their door, then there was no way Daoist White Bones wouldn’t intervene to keep order!
Bai Xuesheng, however, stood up with some panic. "Daoist White Bones, that senior… might have run into some trouble."
……
In Crescent Moon World, Gu Nan and Nie Shuangshuang had a smoother trip than expected after getting the help of the Dragon of Space.
The Silver-Robed Ancestor could no longer stir up too much trouble after his spatial manipulation abilities were restricted—after all, any move he could possibly make was within Gu Nan's calculations.
In the end, they successfully decapitated the Silver-Robed Ancestor after only three tries. Nie Shuangshuang left with satisfaction, and Gu Nan also started to contemplate what kinds of apostles to recruit to deal with this dungeon.
Relying on the current mission personnel undoubtedly wouldn’t work.
"I'll head back to White Bones Realm. Let’s fight again there," Long Ling'er said as such. Perhaps killing the familiar Silver-Robed Ancestor gave her a confidence boost.
"Okay." Gu Nan nodded, then his soul left the Inner World. The main part of his soul returned to his Divine Kingdom, while a small part reentered the clone currently in closed-door cultivation inside White Bones Realm.
The next second, the saint clone in White Bones Realm heard a loud noise.
"This time, seven realms are simultaneously laying siege to White Bones Realm. All unrelated persons can get lost! But the people from White Mist must stay behind. My Lord said Gu Nan stole a treasure from his brother. Have him hand it over, and then get lost!"

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Rending Mountain Venerable
chapters.content:
The current White Bones Realm was already filled with battle cries.
Not only this urban area White Mist was in, but all the major cities in White Bones Realm suffered an all out attack from the alliance of seven major astral worlds.
These seven astral worlds were all enemies of White Bones Realm. Some, such as Mountain River World, were feuds formed back when White Bones Realm ascended to a Realm Level plane, while others were enemies that Daoist White Bones provoked due to his tyrannical attitude.
Fang Hou stood before the gates of White Mist’s headquarters, coldly watching his subordinates surround the place as a sneer appeared on his face.
He was the one who shouted that threat just now. He was one of the top Void Cutters in Mountain River World and also the right-hand man of the Star Ruler of Mountain River World, Rending Mountain Venerable.
Speaking of whom, Rending Mountain Venerable was a very good friend of Lou Wanying’s despite their large age gap and had noticed Gu Nan as early as when Gu Nan seized the sand of time from Lou Wanying.
The Star Ruler Realm strength that Gu Nan displayed might deter others, but Rending Mountain Venerable didn’t take it seriously at all.
He himself was a Star Ruler with a powerful astral world. Back when he was at the peak of his strength, his astral world was only a step away from advancing to a Realm Level plane, and he was strong enough to fight Daoist White Bones head-on.
Even if the power of his astral world was now weakened, it still wasn’t something a newly-advanced Star Ruler could compare to.
But Gu Nan hid inside White Bones Realm all this time after stealing the sand of time. It was impossible for Rending Mountain Venerable to run to Daoist White Bones’ territory to kidnap someone, so at most, he could only order his people to secretly engage in petty acts of vengeance.
This continued all the way until seven large planes simultaneously besieged White Bones Realm. He decided to deal with Gu Nan in passing during this attack.
Fang Hou coldly watched his people wantonly pour into the manor. Although he looked calm and collected on the surface, he’d already made preparations in secret.
He would immediately notify Rending Mountain Venerable as soon as Gu Nan showed up.
Silver light flashed inside the distant manor, causing Fang Hou's eyes to light up. He was just about to send the message when he saw the space above his head opening up and the body of a giant silver dragon flying out.
Fang Hou immediately froze. He was also quite knowledgeable, so how could he not recognize this Dragon of Space?
This dragon was bound to be on Lu Wen’s shoulder whenever the ruler of Clockwork Heaven showed himself; this had long been common knowledge.
"Hm?" The silver dragon landed here, saw the situation in the manor, and actually grunted in dissatisfaction, causing Fang Hou's heart to tremble slightly.
‘If I get involved with this dragon…’
At this time, Fang Hou suddenly sensed his surroundings turn quiet. A golden light and Buddhist mantras then arrived simultaneously. Countless Buddhas had already emerged around him, all chanting from scriptures while the beat of wooden bells overlapped, layer upon layer.
Fang Hou only felt a splitting headache when the Buddhist mantras entered his ears, finding it difficult to put together even the slightest thought.
The next moment, he seemed to see the world turn itself upside down, and his own head also crashed down towards the ground.
The strong sense of weightlessness finally brought Fang Hou back to his senses. When he finally had a clear view of his situation, he couldn't help blurting out, "Palm-Sized Buddha Kingdom!"
Wu Gui’s figure seemed like a giant. Fang Hou was currently inside the Buddha Kingdom in the palm of her hand, while Wu Gui was planning to flip the Buddha Kingdom upside down and smash it into the ground!
‘How can there be… this kind of Buddha?!’
Fang Hou’s entire person had already been smashed to a pulp before he could even finish his final thought. When facing the current Wu Gui, this Void Cutter who was quite strong didn't even have a chance to escape.
Fang Hou finally managed to send the message out, but not in the way he wished. Rather, his death immediately alerted Rending Mountain Venerable.
The next second, the hearts of everyone present sank in unison as a pressure as heavy as a mountain suddenly fell on everyone.
A yellow-robed figure appeared in the sky above White Mist. It was a middle-aged man with an unwavering expression. His face was angular, as if carved by a knife.
He was none other than the Star Ruler of Mountain River World, Rending Mountain Venerable.
"Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara." Rending Mountain Venerable's gaze was icy as he shot Wu Gui a glare and threatened in a deep voice, "You dared to touch my subordinate. Aren’t you afraid this one will send you back into the cycle of reincarnation so you can experience it ten thousand more times?"
How could Wu Gui take this sort of provocation to heart? She just revealed a cold smile, not in a hurry to make the first move.
Rending Mountain Venerable’s gaze moved away from her but didn’t even spare Long Ling'er a glance, as if she didn’t exist at all.
"Where is Gu Nan? Have him come out." Yi Shanzun waved his sleeve and commanded coldly, "This one is short on time because I still have important business to attend to. Tell him to hand over the treasure he robbed from Brother Lou, and this one will let him g—"
He didn’t even finish before suddenly sensing a burst of killing intent behind him. He swallowed back the rest of his sentence and threw a punch behind him without any hesitation.
Rending Mountain Venerable’s punch contained immense strength, like a large mountain crashing down upon the enemy. It carried an astonishing momentum.
However, his sure-hit punch actually missed its mark: the enemy didn’t actually appear from behind him, but from an incredible angle—his shadow!
Dressed in a silver robe, Gu Nan stood up from the opponent’s shadow, holding a pitch-black dagger in his hand that he thrust straight at Rending Mountain Venerable's heart.
"Mountain!" A soft shout echoed in Gu Nan's ears.
Gu Nan suddenly felt as though an enormous mountain was pressing down on his head, and his body suddenly became heavier.
But the dagger… still hit its mark!
Gu Nan seemed to be completely unaffected by the pressure. The dagger was still quickly stabbed into Rending Mountain Venerable’s heart with ruthless precision.
After landing a hit on the first try, Gu Nan immediately jumped away without the slightest hesitation, while the sound of fracturing bones began to come from his head. The terrifying pressure was already about to crush his skull.
Crack.
A piece of Gu Nan's forehead suddenly sunk inward as blood gushed out nonstop, looking incomparably gruesome.
But Gu Nan seemed unable to feel it at all and just stared at Rending Mountain Venerable in amusement. "You know you have an urgent matter at hand, yet you still dared to provoke me? You’d better consider how you’re going to get away first."
The entire operation where seven planes attacked White Bones Realm seemed hasty and unorganized. It was clearly a spur-of-the-moment decision. Gu Nan didn’t believe that Rending Mountain Venerable could afford to waste much time here.
On the other side, Wu Gui also sneered. "Daoist White Bones’ injury is not as serious as you all think."
Daoist White Bones was injured precisely during the earlier fight over Nirvana Heaven’s origin. As someone who experienced that fight firsthand, Wu Gui naturally knew more about this than anyone else.
Rending Mountain Venerable fell silent for a while, but he finally stopped hesitating after he saw Gu Nan mobilize his laws to offset most of the crushing pressure, causing his wounds to heal rapidly.
He opened a passage in space with a wave of his hand and announced in a cold voice, "I’ll deal with you after I kill that scumbag, White Bones."
However, before Rending Mountain Venerable could step into the spatial channel, he felt the silver figure before his eyes flicker.
The jet black dagger suddenly stabbed out towards him, but Rending Mountain Venerable was prepared this time. A cold smile appeared on his face.
An inexplicable throbbing emerged from the space between the two as the fearsome power of a law’s origin swept across the space. It was as if a mountain was placed in front of Rending Mountain Venerable, and he was trying to shatter it.
Shatter Mountains and Rivers!
But this power had yet to truly land when another inexplicably oppressive aura emerged. Along with it, black light appeared out of thin air.
The power of mountains and rivers entering the black light was like a pebble sinking into the sea, not even causing a ripple.
By the time Rending Mountain Venerable looked again, Gu Nan's figure was long gone. Only the wreckage of a destroyed spatial passage remained.

chapters.title: Chapter 344: A New Goal
chapters.content:
Rending Mountain Venerable was probably Tier 7.
Gu Nan already had an accurate assessment of the other party's strength after merely exchanging blows for an instant.
Among these Star Rulers from the Myriad Heavens Universe, those with Realm Level astral worlds were usually Tier 8; some might even be Tier 9. Although Red suffered heavy injuries in the past, her current strength was still above Tier 7.
Since Rending Mountain Venerable was once strong enough to attempt to ascend his astral world to Realm Level, he must’ve reached the peak of Tier 7 in the past, but the backlash from the failed ascension inflicted heavy damage to his astral world, so it wasn’t easy to recover his strength.
His current strength was probably only in the middle echelon of Tier 7.
If Gu Nan’s true body came over, he had full confidence he could fight the enemy to a standstill or even suppress the other party despite being one level lower. After all, the outcome of battles didn’t depend solely on power, but also on how people mobilized that power.
But since only a Tier 4 clone was here, there was no hope of suppressing the other party. However, he could still make use of his own advantage to stall the enemy.
Gu Nan's advantage, which was simultaneously Rending Mountain Venerable’s disadvantage, was undoubtedly speed!
Rending Mountain Venerable's face was ashen. He’d already realized Gu Nan’s intentions— ‘Gu Nan is relying on his speed and occasional bursts of his law to stall me!’
In a direct confrontation, with Rending Mountain Venerable's enormous strength that resembled a landslide, it would take at most fifteen minutes to smash Gu Nan to a pulp.
No matter how fast the Evil God physique recovered, it still couldn’t keep up with the damage from being crushed by an enormous mountain.
However, the problem was that Rending Mountain Venerable had no time right now!
Gu Nan would block his path as soon as he tried to leave—he would temporarily borrow his main body’s power every time. It was as if a Tier 6 Evil God was preventing Rending Mountain Venerable from escaping.
At this moment, Rending Mountain Venerable finally understood what Gu Nan's earlier words meant. Instead of thinking about how to kill Gu Nan, he should actually consider how he was going to get away.
‘If by any chance the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara was telling the truth, then once this drags on for too long…’
When he thought about how Daoist White Bones would wake up soon, while he himself was still trapped inside White Bones Realm by Gu Nan… Just that thought alone made Rending Mountain Venerable shudder.
So Rending Mountain Venerable once again attempted to leave while saying to Gu Nan, "If you step aside, then we’ll wipe the slate clean between us from now on!"
His only response was Gu Nan’s dagger.
"You should consider it carefully. If that scum White Bones can’t manage to kill me, then you’ll have made an enemy of me for no reason!”
He was greeted by the same dagger.
"If you still refuse to step aside, then this one will kill everyone in this White Mist of yours!"
Gu Nan didn’t even deign to respond with a change in expression. He simply struck whenever the enemy tried to leave, stopping him through various unfathomable means.
Rending Mountain Venerable had an icy expression, but ultimately, he didn’t attack the people from White Mist. Since such a threat couldn’t sway Gu Nan, he didn’t have the time to waste on killing some mortals.
He’d already lost count of the number of times Gu Nan stopped him from leaving, while Gu Nan had also tanked countless hits from that immense strength akin to landslides.
In the end, the clone’s Evil God physique was only a counterfeit, so it couldn’t repair such injuries in time. The clone’s entire body looked like it was about to fall apart, but Gu Nan still didn’t care.
Solely in terms of running away, Rending Mountain Venerable was even inferior to the Tier 4 Silver-Robed Ancestor. After all, Rending Mountain Venerable lacked that kind of extreme speed, and in the Inner World, Gu Nan also couldn’t borrow his true body’s Tier 6 power.
"What the hell do you want before you’re willing to get out of my way?!" Rending Mountain Venerable snarled angrily. He couldn't even figure out why Gu Nan was doing this.
‘What in the world will he gain from screwing me over?!’
Rending Mountain Venerable’s voice just fell when a deathly pale light flooded the extremely distant sky, and an aloof, detached voice rang out:
"Seven rats."
Rending Mountain Venerable's heart froze, and in his soul’s senses, the other six invaders vanished almost simultaneously, unwilling to linger for even a second longer. In the split second he was distracted, a man with long, snow-white hair was already standing in front of him.
‘This scumbag White Bones actually looked for me first…?’
To have luck this bad, even Rending Mountain Venerable was speechless.
As soon as Daoist White Bones showed himself, a claw made of white bones appeared out of thin air, swiping down at Rending Mountain Venerable’s head.
Rending Mountain Venerable’s expression turned grave. He didn’t dare be careless in the slightest. An enormous mountain that seemed solid emerged from view, protecting his head.
However, the claw of white bones pierced through this colossal mountain as easily as paper.
He was already weaker than Daoist White Bones to begin with, not to mention this was still White Bones Realm, the opponent's home turf!
The claw fell; five finger bones embedded themselves into the top of Rending Mountain Venerable's head, as if he was born with a bony white claw on his head. It looked quite comical.
At the same time, a spatial rift suddenly opened up behind Rending Mountain Venerable. A throwing knife came out of nowhere and blocked Daoist White Bones’ follow-up attack while pulling Rending Mountain Venerable into the passage.
The only people who would help Rending Mountain Venerable at this juncture would be his six companions.
Daoist White Bones watched them disappear. Some sickly paleness finally appeared on his face, but his expression remained calm. He even had time to turn around and thank Gu Nan.
"Many thanks. I owe you a favor this time," this pretty boy who was nearly two meters tall and whose white hair fell to his waist said earnestly.
Gu Nan wasn’t polite at all. "I might have you return it soon. Don’t go back on your word when the time comes!"
"I won’t." Daoist White Bones shook his head.
Daoist White Bones didn’t stay for long. His astral world had just been invaded, so he still had a ton of matters to deal with. At the same time, he also needed to recuperate from his injuries and digest the gains from his fight in Nirvana Heaven.
On the other hand, when Long Ling'er saw Gu Nan's appearance, she wasn’t in a hurry to spar with him either.
Gu Nan's current appearance was truly too miserable. Not only was he beaten to the point where all the blood vessels in his body had burst, but more importantly, his energy was extremely chaotic and seemed like he might suddenly die at any second.
It certainly wasn’t a problem to borrow his true body’s power through the saint clone once or twice, but such frequent usage like what Gu Nan just did had long since overloaded this clone.
After this fight, he was afraid the saint clone would have to recuperate for a while.
But it was just as well, because only Gu Nan’s main body could accomplish what he wanted to do next. It was time for the clone to rest for a while.
His next goal was to collect enough Evil Value necessary to advance to Tier 7 for himself, as well as apostles strong enough to farm Crescent Moon World’s dungeon.
And where could Evil Value be harvested? Which place had an abundance of natural mythological creatures Gu Nan was familiar with?
Of course it was the World of Gods!
Gu Nan set aside his thoughts and shifted his gaze to Wu Gui at the side. "What did you want to see me for?"
Of course he wouldn't think that Wu Gui just happened to pass by and kindly stepped in to help when she saw people bullying his subordinates.
"I need a vessel of the law of fusion." Wu Gui didn't hide her goal and said bluntly, "Zuo Zuo's former astral world is in your hands. It might contain something he left behind."
Even though Zuo Zuo's inheritance was destroyed, what Wu Gui currently needed was just an item that once contained his law of fusion, which was much easier to find.
Unfortunately, Gu Nan knew that since Immortal Demon World had already transformed into his own Divine Kingdom and all the laws were reset, it was impossible for Wu Gui to find what she wanted in there.
However…
"You said you need the law of fusion?" Gu Nan thought for a moment. "I know another person who also touched upon a portion of the laws in this area."
"Who?" Wu Gui raised an eyebrow.
It would naturally be best if she could find a second person who possessed the law of fusion, but even she and Red couldn't think of one, yet Gu Nan actually did?
‘It’s only been how many years since he started cultivating…?’
"Have you heard of Count Fersen, the Living Dead?" Gu Nan said with a smile, "I can take you to him. It just so happens that we have the same goal."
Of course Wu Gui had never heard of this name, but this didn’t stop her from feeling tempted. "Where is he?"
"In the tomb of the Legend Rank necromancer Sandro, located in the Undead Kingdom on an abandoned main plane—he’s buried next door."

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Human Smuggling
chapters.content:
Ultimately, the matter with White Bones Realm was just an accident.
If Daoist White Bones was uninjured, then those seven Star Rulers would never have the guts to invade White Bones Realm with such great fanfare.
To put it bluntly, they ran here hoping to strike it rich after learning about Daoist White Bones’ possible injury.
As long as the seven of them advanced and retreated as a group, escaping wouldn’t be much of a problem. Daoist White Bones didn’t have the ability to trap them here.
But who knew a variable like Gu Nan would pop up? As a result, Rending Mountain Venerable was separated from the group.
He originally believed that he could deal with Gu Nan swiftly, but he didn’t expect that not only could he not kill the other party, but eventually, he couldn’t even make a quick getaway.
After Rending Mountain Venerable was rescued, Gu Nan's saint clone stayed in White Bones Realm to recuperate, while Wu Gui went to make preparations for the upcoming long journey.
Of course traveling to the World of Gods couldn’t be done impulsively. Advanced preparations were very necessary.
Gu Nan naturally knew that place like the back of his hand. In contrast, Wu Gui needed to investigate properly. She couldn’t just run in blind.
On the other hand, crossing the dimensional wall between the Myriad Heavens Universe and the World of Gods was also a difficult task.
The dimensional wall was one of the plane cluster’s self-defense mechanisms. Breaking through the wall wasn’t impossible, but they more or less had to prepare a little.
Gu Nan's true body was still inside the Divine Kingdom, directing the progress of the apostles’ dungeon farming while also trying to get Lan Si and the others to team up to attempt Crescent Moon World’s dungeon.
The result was unsurprising. It didn’t matter whether they headed straight for the final boss or followed the regular route by clearing the earlier phases; clearing the dungeon seemed completely hopeless.
The dungeon’s earlier missions didn’t actually play a very important role. They simply gave players advanced notice of the final boss's ability and strength through a variety of hints so that players could prepare beforehand.
But the problem was that, due to their lack of strength, the apostles led by Lan Si couldn’t bring out the full power of Tier 4 even if they possessed Tier 4 power inside the dungeon.
Not even Gu Nan and two Star Ruler existences could do much against the Silver-Robed Ancestor, much less Lan Si and the others.
Let alone trapping the Silver-Robed Ancestor, Lan Si refused to even touch the dungeon again after experiencing several effortless party wipes at the hands of the Silver-Robed Ancestor.
This was purely a matter of strength, so Gu Nan didn’t insist on making things difficult for them. He just had the apostles continue farming Splendid World.
On the other hand, Gu Nan needed to consider the requirements for his advancement to Tier 7.
The requirements on the Divine Kingdom’s side were nothing new. The basic requirement was to upgrade six structures to Level 1 in addition to building the first advanced "Barracks" and conquering a dungeon plane.
As for Evil Value, he needed to reach 5,000 to advance, which was double Gu Nan's current Evil Value of 2,500.
But this condition just looked scary, because after completing the First Round, both points and Evil Value experienced some explosive inflation.
A full 2,500 Evil Value gap may seem unreachable, but in reality, it was probably just a matter of one or two Godheads.
And a veteran player like Gu Nan knew exactly how much Evil Value each god’s Godhead was worth, guaranteeing that nothing would be wasted.
The reason he set the Undead Kingdom as his target this time was precisely to achieve that goal in one battle and get enough Evil Value in one fell swoop.
After all, in his present environment, it was necessary to cross the dimensional wall in order to slay gods, which wasn’t an easy task.
……
Three months later, in the frontline plane Heavenly Province World.
Heavenly Province World was one of several fairly well-known frontline planes. Unlike the sparse population of other frontline planes, Heavenly Province World was a fairly lively world, enjoying a level of prosperity that even surpassed some astral worlds not on the frontlines.
"Welcome to Heavenly Province World." A young girl stood in front of Gu Nan with a humble and respectful expression. "Please do not fly here, Your Excellency."
"Hm?" Gu Nan raised a brow.
Flying bans were usually only found in large planes on the level of Zi Luo Heaven. To think that a mere frontline plane like Heavenly Province World would actually enact such a law.
The young girl looked slightly apprehensive. This special rule of Heavenly Province World had already cost many staff members’ lives.
And if the other party was a considerably powerful cultivator, then it was impossible for Heavenly Province World’s backing to trouble that cultivator over this issue, so those staff members would’ve died in vain.
Gu Nan looked down from the air. It was an extremely prosperous modern city, a bit like the "steel jungle" of planes with advanced technology, but with more metaphysics mixed in.
In the end, Heavenly Province World was still a frontline plane, so it was very small. It was only the size of one city; all of its prosperity was concentrated in this area.
"Take me to this place." Gu Nan nodded and landed on the ground, handing an address to the young girl.
The young girl sighed in relief, as if rejoicing the fact that she’d stumbled upon a reasonable cultivator, and hurriedly answered, "Yes, My Lord. Please follow me… By the way, you can call me Little Yu."
Gu Nan didn’t have much of a reaction to this; not even his expression changed. The young girl who called herself Little Yu also didn’t mind. She would often encounter this kind of powerful figure.
The address he gave Little Yu was sent over by Wu Gui after some investigation—it was a company that specialized in human smuggling.
The Myriad Heavens Universe had a very strict procedure in place for those who wanted to cross the dimensional wall. People weren’t allowed to enter the World of Gods privately and had to go through a vetting process.
This was a decree jointly issued by the Thirteen Heavens. No one dared to violate it.
The reason was very simple—it was purely to prevent traitors. The World of Gods, with faith at its core, was simply too comfortable for Star Rulers. A considerable number of cultivators were happy to head over there to develop.
Although power was important, the worship of tens of thousands of people prostrating themselves was also tempting, since it was most able to display a Star Ruler’s status. Not everyone could resist the temptation of having fanatical followers.
However, as long as there was a decree, people who violated the decree in order to seek benefits would undoubtedly exist as well. This was the case with the human smuggling company Gu Nan was currently heading to.
They were able to help cultivators enter the World of Gods, but the fees they charged were also quite exorbitant.
"My Lord, we’ve reached your destination," the voice of the young girl, Little Yu, rang out. She quickly retreated after bringing Gu Nan to a skyscraper over a hundred stories tall.
After Gu Nan walked in, the receptionists were three young and beautiful women wearing neat uniforms.
"Hello, may I ask…"
"Twenty-second floor, I have an appointment," Gu Nan didn't wait for the receptionist to finish before directly interrupting her.
But the woman at the front desk looked down and then showed a regretful look. "I'm very sorry, Your Excellency. His Excellency Yan Weng on the twenty-second floor instructed us that your appointment has been rescheduled to tomorrow, so we’ll have to trouble you to please return tomorrow."
Gu Nan frowned slightly but didn’t say anything. He just turned around and walked towards the elevator next to them.
"Your Excellency, please stop. You’re not allowed to head up without an appointment… Security, security!" The girl at the front desk shouted loudly, but Gu Nan didn’t deign to even turn his head back.
Meanwhile, in a quiet room on the twenty-second floor, the old man called Yan Weng stood up with a smile and shook hands with a young girl in a blood-colored robe.

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Lu Xinhuan
chapters.content:
On the 22nd floor, Yan Weng shook hands with the girl in the blood-colored robe, then said with a light smile, "Miss Lu, your luck is really good. The two slots that someone reserved earlier just happen to be heading for the Undead Kingdom."
The crimson-robed young girl nodded with a smile. "I've really troubled Elder Yan. We truly do have an urgent matter this time. I’m very sorry for holding up Elder Yan's business."
Yan Weng hurriedly responded with some superficial courtesies, but he also knew that the other party was just being polite and wouldn’t truly care about the two customers whose spots they took.
The background of this young miss was so high that he wouldn’t even be able to talk to her if it weren't for the special nature of his line of work.
Not only did this young girl called Lu Xinhuan possess considerable Void Cutter Realm strength, but she was also one of the vice presidents of Qinghe Realm’s Commerce Association.
Qinghe Realm was one of the largest commercial planes in the entire Myriad Heavens Universe. Its reputation was on par with Zi Luo Heaven, a plane filled to the brim with various organizations.
However, the unusual thing about Qinghe Realm was that the forces within the realm weren’t scattered at all. Rather, the entire realm formed a Commerce Association. The power of the whole realm was gathered together in the form of commerce.
In other words, commerce was the special management style of Qinghe Realm. Therefore, the one standing behind a vice president like Lu Xinhuan was undoubtedly the Star Ruler of Qinghe Realm, Zhong Qinghe.
Just as the two were exchanging pleasantries and Yan Weng was planning to get up and send Lu Xinhuan off, the phone on his desk rang.
……
"Sir, you can't go up there." A tall security guard blocked Gu Nan’s path. Although he was called a security guard, he was actually a cultivator with a rather high realm who held a flying sword in his hand.
Gu Nan had seen his fair share of all kinds of cultivators in the Myriad Heavens Universe, but people who used the legendary flying swords really weren’t too common, so he subconsciously cast a couple more glances at it.
"Your Excellency, I’ve already informed Mr. Yan Weng on the 22nd floor. He said he will come down immediately after handling the matter at hand."
The receptionist girl also rushed over and stared at Gu Nan as she said, "Your Excellency, we ask that you wait for a little while. Please don’t make things difficult for us."
As she said this, she very calmly blocked Gu Nan’s way, but she wasn’t actually nervous.
In fact, due Heavenly Province World’s special nature as a frontline plane, someone would run to their world to cause trouble every two days or so. Oftentimes, people would mistakenly believe they were strong enough or possessed a background that allowed them to do whatever they wanted. In the end, all of these people would be thrown out of the plane.
The lives of insignificant characters like the receptionist were of little concern to the higher ups, but any trouble that occurred inside this building would make the bigshots lose face, so troublemakers weren’t tolerated here.
There were also passersby who heard the commotion and thought it was another fellow with an inflated ego, so they immediately paused to watch a good show.
Gu Nan raised his head. A distance of twenty-two floors couldn’t obstruct his sight at all. He saw what was happening on the 22nd floor with a single glance.
Two people were talking on that floor, and no one had any intention of coming down at all—of course, even if someone really planned to head down, Gu Nan couldn’t be bothered to wait any longer.
He casually sliced open a rift in space with one hand, actually planning to head to the 22nd floor directly.
However, the security guard didn’t show any fear or reverence upon seeing the other party use Void Cutter Realm powers. Instead, he warned in a heavy voice, "Sir, the use of spatial transfer is not allowed within the plane. Please immediately—"
But before he could finish, his shadow suddenly stood up and pushed him from behind, actually pushing him into the ground and turning him flat.
It was as if the guard had become a two-dimensional existence, stuck to the ground like a sticker, unable to move.
At the same time, his shadow turned corporeal. It almost seemed like he swapped places with his shadow, which looked very eerie.
Gu Nan's current power was already enough to accomplish some unimaginable feats when facing low-level characters.
This shadow swap immediately discouraged all would-be meddlers.
Yan Weng and Lu Xinhuan were indeed both still there by the time Gu Nan reached the 22nd floor in a single step. The two also had different responses to his appearance.
Lu Xinhuan just carefully studied him from the side, as if Gu Nan's face looked somewhat familiar.
Yan Weng, on the other hand, frowned slightly and asked, "Sir, do you want something?"
After asking that, he didn’t wait for Gu Nan to answer before adding, "If you’re here for your reservations, please leave. I will contact you again tomorrow. I have valuable guests to entertain right now. It won’t be good for either of us if this matter blows up."
Yan Weng stared at Gu Nan indifferently. After all, he was in the human smuggling business, which was a direct violation of the laws, so no one dared to blow things up and risk exposing their dealings to the public.
"Are you this company’s boss?" Gu Nan asked bluntly.
This question was somewhat out of Yan Weng's expectations. He didn’t quite understand why Gu Nan asked this.
"Yes."
Thus Gu Nan nodded and didn’t choose to directly kill Yan Weng. He asked, "When will the flight to the World of Gods leave?"
Yan Weng's face became slightly livid when he realized the other party didn't take his words to heart at all. "Didn’t you hear what I just said? I'm telling you now, your booking is cancel—"
"Wait!" A soft shout sounded in his ears; it was Lu Xinhuan who spoke.
Yan Weng was taken aback and stared at her in confusion, but he saw Lu Xinhuan take a deep breath and say, "Elder Yan, there should be others in this batch of bookings, right? Let's buy someone else's spot."
"This…" Yan Weng was a little speechless for a while. He didn't quite understand why Lu Xinhuan was doing this.
More importantly, all the bookings in this batch besides Gu Nan and Wu Gui were already set, so rescheduling them would be very troublesome.
But Yan Weng wasn’t a greenhorn. Lu Xinhuan’s strange change in attitude made him realize something. Cold sweat immediately broke out on his back.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan, I greet you on behalf of my family’s lord." Lu Xinhuan gave a deep bow, showing extreme respect to Gu Nan.
"Who is your family's lord?"
"Zhong Qinghe of Qinghe Realm." Lu Xinhuan didn’t seem averse to mentioning Zhong Qinghe by name and smiled. "During the earlier battle in White Bones Realm, my family's lord even said that within ten thousand years, another Realm Level plane will be created in the Myriad Heavens Universe."
Many people paid attention to the invasion of White Bones Realm by seven other planes. Some people naturally noticed Gu Nan's performance in all this.
With merely a lower-level clone, he forcibly trapped Rending Mountain Venerable inside White Bones Realm by repeatedly borrowing his true body’s power. This was already enough to catch the attention of many Star Rulers.
"Are you also heading to the Undead Kingdom? We also have some forces over there. You can join us if you don't mind,” Lu Xinhuan invited.
"Might as well." Gu Nan nodded. Having the help of some forces in the World of Gods was indeed much more convenient than acting on his own there.
On the other hand, when Yan Weng heard the name "Gu Nan," he finally realized which person he was offending.
‘Why would a Star Ruler bigshot run to my humble abode for an illegal crossing!’ Yan Weng simply wanted to cry.
"I understand." He acted as if the previous unpleasantness never happened and piled smiles on his face. "Please wait a moment, My Lord. I will guide you there immediately."
"Miss Lu, why don't you also join us and head over?" Yan Weng turned to Lu Xinhuan again and said with a troubled smile, "Everyone else has already arrived. If you want to buy two spots, I'm afraid you'll have to discuss it with them…"
Gu Nan cut in from beside them before Lu Xinhuan could respond, "What’s there to discuss? Won’t it work out if you just kill two?"

chapters.title: Chapter 347: One More Person
chapters.content:
Yan Weng chose the underground of a rather remote mountain village as the smuggling ship’s location. Nobody would be able to find its exact location if he didn’t personally lead the way.
"My Lord, I’ve already stationed someone to wait over there. Your companion will be directly informed of the location once she arrives," Yan Weng came to Gu Nan's side and said ingratiatingly.
After understanding the premise of "I absolutely cannot offend Gu Nan,” Yan Weng had already waited alongside Gu Nan for a long time, but they never saw any sign Wu Gui.
Gu Nan finally grew impatient of waiting and just had Yan Weng lead the way without waiting for Wu Gui.
He and Wu Gui initially agreed on a time, but the latter didn’t show up at all. She was most likely delayed by something.
Gu Nan was very patient when it came to doing missions, but not when it came to other things, especially when an NPC stood him up.
After all, Wu Gui's existence was only a support. Although it was certainly nice to have a helper, Gu Nan wasn’t too concerned even if there wasn’t one.
If this mission required Wu Gui, then he definitely wouldn’t be this calm and would’ve gone looking for her whereabouts through various clues a long time ago.
On the other side, Lu Xinhuan was followed by a small girl who looked slightly younger than her.
The little girl wore a strange gauze dress that continuously produced some clouds and mist that curled around her.
Gu Nan couldn’t help casting a few more glances at this strange kind of special effects clothing. If not for the fact that "special effects fashion" also existed in the game, he would’ve suspected that he’d discovered an Easter egg
[1]
.
"Big Sis Lu, is that person really as powerful as you say he is?" The girl in green hid behind Lu Xinhuan and whispered with her head down, as if someone would eavesdrop on her if she stood straight.
Lu Xinhuan didn’t have the heart to tell her that if that person wanted to eavesdrop, he’d be able to hear them clearly even if they ran down the mountain to talk.
‘But with that one's status, I don't think he’d do such a thing as eavesdrop on little girls.’
"Very powerful," Lu Xinhuan answered with a smile. "Your daddy said that ten thousand years later, this person might just grow as powerful as him."
Zhong Die, the young girl in green, played with her fingers. "Ah, ten thousand years… Then he’s not powerful yet, right?"
"Even right now, he’s still more powerful than your Big Sis Lu." Lu Xinhuan rubbed the little Zhong Die's hair. "You’ve got to be good this time—you have to listen to me when we’re outside. You must not say whatever comes to your mind."
"I know…"
A few moments later, the group of four walked through the underground passage and stopped in front of a strange starship. Some people were already waiting around it.
Yan Weng immediately said, "Three Esteemed Guests, please wait a moment."
He didn't even clarify what they were waiting for before hurriedly running to the group of people, as if afraid Gu Nan would ask more questions.
Lu Xinhuan couldn't help laughing. "Lord Gu Nan, looks like your joke earlier scared him."
Gu Nan glanced at her and said expressionlessly, "I wasn’t joking."
Lu Xinhuan was taken aback. She didn’t think Gu Nan was actually serious and thought he just said it to threaten Yan Weng… but when she thought about it carefully, this one really was qualified to say such things.
In this world, the vast majority of rules no longer applied to Star Rulers.
As existences that transcended the mundane world, Star Rulers weren’t bound by most rules. It was even more laughable to say that they would be bound by things like morality or laws.
They were existences who could even recreate the world itself, so they didn’t need to compromise on anything except things that could threaten their lives.
As one of the vice presidents of Qinghe Realm’s Commerce Association, Lu Xinhuan’s status could be likened to Yan Xiaoxiao and the others within the Divine Kingdom, so it wasn’t like she never met Star Rulers before.
It’s just that even among Star Rulers, people so thoroughly detached from the secular world were still quite rare. Most still retained some traces of their humanity.
For example, it was impossible for Star Rulers like Zhong Qinghe—who had a ton of children—to completely transcend the mundane world, or else where did Zhong Die come from?
Just when the three were waiting for Yan Weng to finish negotiating, a spatial crack opened above them and immediately alerted the other people present.
They were trying to enter the World of Gods illegally. If this was exposed, everyone would be wiped out!
"Who is it?!”
"Elder Yan, what's going on here?"
"Stop him, don't let him come out!"
The underground cavern that wasn’t too spacious to begin with was suddenly filled with all kinds of noise. The scene was simply like a group of brothel patrons being caught red-handed by police just as they were about to head home.
There were even people floating in the air, ready to attack anyone who came out of the spatial passage, but it didn’t take long before they shrunk back.
Because the first thing that came out of the passage was a slender palm emitting golden light, but another burst of monstrous demonic intent surged up before the palm fully arrived.
The next moment, Wu Gui’s figure completely appeared. At her side was a sword-wielding uncle with a pale complexion.
Gu Nan recognized this person as well. He was the swordsman uncle Zi Dian, who was trapped and sealed in Star Realm for ten thousand years together with Ying Ge.
His own name was Zi Dian, and the sword in his hand was also called Zi Dian.
The entire body of this sword was suffused with purple crackles of electricity, while a drop of blood slid down the sword.
Combined with Wu Gui’s astonishing demonic intent, it was obvious that they’d just finished a big battle and rushed here before they could even pull back their attacks.
"There was a bit of a delay," Wu Gui said as she brought the considerably-injured Zi Dian to Gu Nan.
"Mm, let’s set off since you’re here now."
Gu Nan glanced at her and was too lazy to ask what happened. This person had been hanging out with Red recently, so in all likelihood, something happened to Ying Ge and Zi Dian.
Wu Gui then pointed to the Zi Dian beside her. "I also need to bring one more person."
"That’s fine." Gu Nan's face was indifferent. He didn’t mind at all how many people he took with him. Anyhow, he could always abandon these teammates at a moment’s notice and leave.
At that time, abandoning one person and abandoning two people made no difference at all.
Although Gu Nan didn’t mind, the Yan Weng who just walked back to their side seemed to be struck by five lightning bolts—he finally persuaded two people to give up their spots after much difficulty, but how come there was one more person when he turned around?
But he also didn’t dare complain in the slightest. He might not have recognized Gu Nan at first, but he recognized this one at first glance: the fusion of Buddha and demon—this was the reincarnation of the now-famous Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara!
"My Lord, this…" Yan Weng’s old face had a troubled expression. He didn’t even know what to say.
This was human smuggling, not tourism. How could they just add passengers so casually?! Of course, he absolutely didn’t dare voice this to Wu Gui. He could only go back and continue to persuade other customers.
It didn't take long for some of the people on that side to cause a ruckus.
"You just told us to give up two spots, and now you want us to give up yet another spot? Old man, don't be too greedy!" An elegant and youthful-looking girl had a face full of anger at this moment.
"That's right. You’re so amazing just because you’re the reincarnation of a great power?" Another person also spoke up, but their voice was much quieter. They clearly recognized Wu Gui.

[1] Easter egg
: Hidden game feature or surprise

chapters.title: Chapter 348: I cleared this dungeon before
chapters.content:
Regarding Gu Nan, many people now knew that he’d already advanced to Star Ruler Realm.
After all, he displayed that power once in Tiluo World, and although the recent events in White Bones Realm hadn’t really spread yet, lots of people still knew about it.
But not many people truly understood Wu Gui’s actual strength and inside information.
Many believed her strength to be between that of Star Rulers with and without astral worlds. Furthermore, some actually believed she hadn’t even ascended to Star Ruler Realm yet.
If she hadn't captured a portion of Nirvana Heaven’s origin, her reputation would likely be even less well-known.
But even so, the person who dared to challenge Wu Gui to her face clearly wouldn’t be ordinary either.
Yan Weng’s face was full of anxiety, but he also didn’t dare run over and ask Gu Nan for help, so he could only keep trying to earnestly persuade the others.
In fact, Yan Weng didn’t have many available spots for each human smuggling flight. The maximum number of passengers per trip wouldn’t exceed ten, and he only had eight spots this time.
Besides Gu Nan and his group, the people over there were divided into two groups with three people on each side, which just happened to correspond to the remaining six spots.
After Lu Xinhuan and Zhong Die joined, the two sides each gave up one spot with great reluctance after Yan Weng finally managed to persuade them. But when they heard Yan Weng still wanted more, they immediately couldn’t endure it anymore.
Lu Xinhuan first greeted Wu Gui and also showed due respect. Of course, it wasn’t as exaggerated as when facing Gu Nan.
Then she pointed to Yan Weng's side and explained, "Of those two groups of people, one side is from Major Martial Realm, and the other side should be locals from Heavenly Province World."
In a sense, Gu Nan and Wu Gui’s network of contacts were too high level and directly involved Star Ruler Realm, so Lu Xinhuan was actually more familiar with small fries like these.
Gu Nan also had a run-in with people from Major Martial Realm before. People from that realm once reincarnated into Crescent Moon World to carry out a mission.
"Let's go," Gu Nan immediately said. Since everyone had arrived, he had no intention of waiting any longer.
Lu Xinhuan glanced at him and knew that this one probably didn’t care about her explanation at all.
Wu Gui naturally had no objections. The group quickly reached the ship. Gu Nan patted Yan Weng's shoulder. "Who has a problem?"
The beautiful and youthful young girl dressed in modern clothes raised her head and spoke up, "Even if you guys are strong, don’t you also have to listen to reason? Don’t you understand the principle of ‘first come, first served’?!"
Her two companions also stood behind her supportively, staring at this side warily. Of course, they were mostly watching Wu Gui.
All three of them were Void Cutters. After all, those willing to head to the World of Gods were all people who had confidence in their own strength.
Even if the three of them couldn’t defeat the reincarnation of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara, it was always possible to stall her for a while. And under these special circumstances, even if the other party might be a Star Ruler, they should still compromise, right?
After all, once things spiralled out of control, nobody would be able to board the ship.
The young girl acted this way precisely because she was certain of this. After being firm and unyielding for a while, she then said with a smile, "But it’s not necessarily impossible for us to give up another spot—"
Her voice came to an abrupt end here. Because under the faint lighting, her shadow on the ground suddenly rose up and turned into several shadow tendrils that dragged her entire body into her own shadow.
The young girl's life force, soul, and laws all disappeared at the same time. It was as if someone completely erased all traces of her existence in the human world.
The two behind her paled, but then they felt a chill under their feet. The same shadow tendrils were already behind their backs…
"There are enough spots now. Let's go," Gu Nan said to the few people around him.
After the three were swallowed by their shadows, three spots suddenly became available, and people from the other group were even spared the awkward situation of being forced to give up a spot.
The scene fell dead silent. Wu Gui, Lu Xinhuan, and the others naturally weren’t surprised. The remaining group of three all had tense, vigilant expressions, while Yan Weng had a bitter smile.
He was already considering how to emphasize his lack of involvement in the deaths of the three just now.
Only two people's gazes remained on Gu Nan. One was the little girl Zhong Die. She had yet to experience much of the world, so she didn’t think killing three people like this was anything shocking. Rather, she felt that this person was indeed powerful.
The other was Zi Dian. His thoughts were much more complicated. When he first met Gu Nan, the other party was just a normal Void Cutter, but now he was already a famous Star Ruler powerhouse whose name shook the Myriad Heavens Universe.
He knew that Gu Nan’s realm advanced rapidly in his early years, almost as if cultivation realms were nonexistent and breakthroughs were as simple as eating a meal, but he didn’t expect that not even Star Ruler Realm’s harsh requirements could stop Gu Nan’s rapid growth.
Regardless of what Zi Dian was thinking, the group finally set foot on the starship.
……
The process of the starship breaking through the dimensional wall and entering the World of Gods was uneventful.
In fact, what was needed to temporarily break through the dimensional wall wasn’t some unique secret technique; it was merely a special material.
People in the Myriad Heavens Universe called it a space-time crystal. With this special crystal, breaking the dimensional wall wouldn’t be a difficult task.
But this resource was quite rare and was generally controlled by the Thirteen Heavens. Yan Weng also happened across a piece by chance, which was why he entered this business.
"The World of Gods!" Gu Nan stood upon the land full of dried-up bones in the Undead Kingdom. Staring at this familiar scene, his gaze suddenly drifted a little.
"So you’re from the World of Gods." Wu Gui stood beside him and revealed a look of realization.
She personally witnessed Gu Nan advance to Void Cutter Realm, so of course she didn't believe he was the reincarnation of some Heavenly Demon. She was also quite curious about Gu Nan's origins.
Only now, when she saw Gu Nan's "I'm back” expression, did she finally determine his origin.
‘So he’s a visitor from another world!’
Gu Nan didn’t refute this. He just smiled and said, "You can think of it that way."
He sighed with emotion. If he had just transmigrated here initially, his development probably would’ve been much smoother.
Not long after, a young man dressed in a gray robe trotted over. He was probably here to welcome Lu Xinhuan and Zhong Die.
"My Lords, why don't you come with us to the lodgings first." Lu Xinhuan asked with a smile, "May I inquire about your destination…?"
"Sandro’s tomb. Oh, the people here probably call it the Sacred Catacombs of the Undead," Gu Nan said casually.
"The Sacred Catacombs of the Undead?" The young man next to him revealed an odd look. "As far as I know, the locations of the Three Holy Lands are continuously changing. Among them, the Sacred Catacombs even has nine entrances, some of which are fake, but even that isn’t fixed, so we don’t know which entrances are real at any given moment."
This wasn’t Lu Xinhuan’s first time visiting the Undead Kingdom, so she also heard the legend of the Three Holy Lands before. "It’s indeed hard to determine which entrances to the Sacred Catacombs are real at this particular moment. My Lord might as well—"
"All nine are real. You guys can just find one at random and take me there," Gu Nan cut her off expressionlessly.
"What nonsense are you talking about?!" The gray-robed youth's voice suddenly rose, and the expression on his face turned a little mocking. "We’ve researched the entrances to the Sacred Catacombs for hundreds of years, and even the natives here think so… For what reason do you dare assert this?"
Gu Nan glanced at him and said blandly, "I cleared this dungeon before."

chapters.title: Chapter 349: The Undead Kingdom
chapters.content:
The Sacred Catacombs of the Undead—of course Gu Nan cleared this dungeon before.
In fact, he knew a little about any slightly famous dungeon in the World of Gods and even personally cleared most of them before.
"The nine entrances to the Sacred Catacombs actually correspond to nine tombs. It’s just that they’re all placed next to each other." Gu Nan explained, "You guys think only Sandro was buried there, so of course you can only enter from one entrance."
To put it bluntly, the Sacred Catacombs of the Undead was nothing special. It was nothing more than nine great powers of the necromancy class all buried together. Each entrance corresponded to one necromancer, so each had to be opened in a different way.
But the legend circulating throughout the Undead Kingdom believed only the legendary necromancer Sandro was buried in the Sacred Catacombs, so people attempted to open all the entrances using only Sandro’s method. Naturally, they could only open one entrance this way.
Gu Nan’s confidence stunned the gray-robed youth.
But ultimately, it wasn’t easy to change deep-rooted notions. The youth stared at Gu Nan doubtfully and muttered, "You say it like it’s true…"
Gu Nan didn’t speak again. With his personality, he normally wouldn’t even have bothered with an explanation.
Perhaps returning to the World of Gods made him feel like he was back in the game, so his speech and mannerisms also became more laid-back.
Even when faced with clueless NPCs, he didn't mind taking on the role of an elder and imparting some game knowledge to them, even if they might not understand it.
……
A while later, the group arrived inside a city built entirely from white bones. It looked extremely magnificent, yet slightly dilapidated.
This city didn’t really have a resounding reputation—it was simply called Skeleton City. However, it was one of the few major cities in the Undead Kingdom, so its actual status far exceeded its reputation.
"The three of you can rest here. Du Ke will immediately notify you of any news regarding an entrance to the Sacred Catacombs of the Undead," Lu Xinhuan guided Gu Nan and the others to a separate courtyard and said with a light smile.
Du Ke was the gray-robed youth from earlier and had already left to handle other matters.
In reality, with Lu Xinhuan's status, there was no need for her to personally act as a guide for Gu Nan, but perhaps because of her business background, she paid more attention to these kinds of details.
After Lu Xinhuan left, only Gu Nan and his two companions were left in the courtyard.
Zi Dian was the first to speak up, "There’s something strange about this World of Gods. The space here seems to be particularly strong and difficult to break."
Zi Dian was also a top Void Cutter and might even take that final step and fully enter Star Ruler Realm at some point, so he was naturally sensitive to the world's oddities.
"Indeed." Wu Gui nodded. "It’s very difficult for normal Void Cutters to open a spatial rift here. Even for me, I'm afraid that my coordinates will be slightly off if I try to open a passage here."
While discussing this, two turned to Gu Nan in unison, as if eager to hear his opinion.
With his knowledge of the World of Gods, he should know the most about this subject.
However, Gu Nan didn’t have any intention of answering. From the time Zi Dian brought up space, his thoughts were already carried away on a tangent as he compared the two worlds.
Originally, Gu Nan had always looked for similarities between the Myriad Heavens Universe and the game world, and he did indeed find many similarities, such as the power system, as well as Star Rulers and gods.
But when he actually came to the World of Gods, which was extremely similar to the game world, he realized that the two plane clusters also had a large number of differences.
The most typical difference was in the world view.
Like Zi Dian said, the space in the World of Gods was very stable, and the “Legend Rank” here, which was equivalent to Void Cutter Realm, had almost no ability to tear open space, not unless they had some special laws.
Even most of the gods here frequently experienced a large deviation in their landing point when using spatial teleportation. To put it bluntly, the space was too stable, so it wasn’t easy to manipulate.
Because of this, no one here could just casually enter someone else's Divine Kingdom, which was very different from the situation in the Myriad Heavens Universe.
Moreover, the two sides even had entirely different world systems.
The Myriad Heavens Universe was completely composed of the astral worlds of various Star Rulers, and the remaining ownerless territories were simply planes that hadn’t been occupied by Star Rulers yet.
But the World of Gods was different. Here, the places with the highest concentration of powerhouses were the eleven main planes, and all the Diving Kingdoms, including those belonging to the greater gods, were only subsidiary planes that orbited the main planes.
The Undead Kingdom where Gu Nan’s group was currently at was one of the main planes that had already been abandoned. It was filled with a large number of undead, and gods no longer came here to recruit followers.
"Gu Nan?" Wu Gui's slightly surprised voice snapped Gu Nan out of his contemplation. "You seem quite absentminded."
Gu Nan came back to his senses and nodded. "I just remembered some things. You guys can wait for news here; I still have some things to do. We’ll enter the Scared Catacombs together after I return."
"Okay," Wu Gui agreed directly and didn’t even ask Gu Nan if he needed any help. After all, he wasn’t the type of person who’d hold back out of politeness if he did need help.
Gu Nan's figure soon disappeared, leaving only Zi Dian and Wu Gui. The former looked at Gu Nan's disappearing figure and remarked, "I really didn't expect for him to have already grown to this point in just a few short years."
"It might not necessarily be growth," Wu Gui replied expressionlessly. She had already concluded that Gu Nan was the reincarnation of a god from the World of Gods.
She believed he was just like her—who possessed all of her past life’s memories and part of her past life’s power—and experienced no bottlenecks when breaking through realms, so advancing was naturally as easy as breathing.
Zi Dian rubbed the scabbard in his hand and smiled. "Maybe we can investigate his origins here in the World of Gods… Even if we don’t become his enemies in the future, it never hurts to know more about him."
……
Of course Gu Nan didn’t know those two had already assumed that he was the reincarnation of a god and even wanted to investigate his origins in the World of Gods.
But he wouldn’t care even if he did know. An Evil God’s power was simply untraceable. It was a power exclusive to players, so much so that many native gods didn’t even know about Evil Gods.
Of course he didn’t suddenly leave on a whim. He really did have something to do.
Gu Nan never forgot his two goals for coming to the World of Gods. Firstly, to hunt down suitable gods to earn Evil Value for himself, and secondly, to find a suitable innately-gifted race to serve as his apostles.
There were actually many suitable gods to hunt, but with Gu Nan's current strength, gods worth 2,500 Evil Value weren’t very easy to kill, at least not with 100% certainty.
That was why he voluntarily brought Wu Gui along after hearing what she needed.
Gu Nan's target this time was inside the Sacred Catacombs of the Undead, so he wasn’t in a hurry to kill the target.
On one hand, he first had to subdue a race to be ready to attack at all times. On the other hand, he also needed certain special items to awaken the god slumbering in the Sacred Catacombs.
With Gu Nan's knowledge of the Undead Kingdom, it was naturally more convenient to resolve these two things together, so he quickly selected a destination:
The other major city of the Undead Kingdom, and also the central city belonging to the vampire clan—the Capital of Blood.

Changing major gods to greater gods

chapters.title: Chapter 350: Vampire Maiden
chapters.content:
Back in Skeleton City, Lu Xinhuan was already swamped with work. She had her hands full handling some matters here and also taking care of the little baggage she brought out of the house.
"Big Sis Lu, when are we going to the Capital of Blood?!" Zhong Die was like a real butterfly
[1]
, jumping up and down inside the room and fluttering all around Lu Xinhuan.
Lu Xinhuan rubbed her forehead helplessly. "The Ceremony of Blood will not start for another fifteen days. It’s useless even if you go there now…"
"I don't care, I don't care! I want to see the vampire big sisters!" Zhong Die made a face like she had nothing left to live for. "This stupid Skeleton City just has skeletons everywhere. I’m bored to death!"
To be fair, as a gathering place for skeleton-type undead, Skeleton City had everything from skeleton soldiers to bone dragons, so there actually were interesting things here.
But Zhong Die came all the way from the Myriad Heavens Universe just to see the vampires described in novels, so how could she be happy about wasting time to look at skeletons?
The little Zhong Die was quite young, but she wasn’t too weak and had steadily stepped into Prodigious Realm. However, she was still addicted to romance novels and was especially passionate about the subject of vampires.
But to sneak into the World of Gods just because of her love of vampire-themed novels—now that was a little insane.
What puzzled Lu Xinhuan even more was that Zhong Die’s inscrutable father, Zhong Qinghe, actually agreed to the plan without another word and even personally formulated a route to smuggle his daughter into the World of Gods.
‘This is probably just how Star Rulers are…’ Lu Xinhuan could only attribute the cause to this.
But Zhong Qinghe's attitude was also the reason Lu Xinhuan dared to bring Zhong Die here, or else how could she have the guts to abduct a Star Ruler’s daughter?
"Let's do this then: I'll have Du Ke take you to the Capital of Blood for a stroll first. But you must listen to him, do you understand?" Lu Xinhuan stared at Zhong Die seriously.
"I’ll definitely be good!" The little girl looked like she was cheering excitedly.
……
Gu Nan was already walking in the streets of the Capital of Blood, the vampire clan’s central city. It was a rare prosperous location within the Undead Kingdom.
No matter how gorgeous Skeleton City was, there was always a lifeless atmosphere about it, but the Capital of Blood was different.
Here, vampire girls in skimpy outfits, human girls kept in captivity by vampires, and necromancers wrapped in black robes could be seen everywhere.
Of course the Undead Kingdom didn’t only contain the undead. This place was called an abandoned main plane only because it was barren and desolate in terms of faith, but it wasn’t actually abandoned.
And the Capital of Blood was the gathering place of this plane’s living beings. Even among the necromancers, who universally had eccentric characters, not everyone was willing to deal with corpses all day.
In contrast, of course the necromancers would much rather prefer the powerful and beautiful vampires as servants!
Gu Nan also thought so.
If he was looking for servants anyhow, vampires were undoubtedly the better choice. Being easy on the eyes was one aspect. On the other hand, their characteristics of high agility and high attack were also more suited for raiding Crescent Moon World’s dungeon.
At the same time, vampires also possessed fairly good self-regeneration. Besides their lackluster defense and the fear of light, they were basically a weakened version of the Evil God physique.
There was only one vampire clan in the Capital of Blood. They had the surname "Raymond," which wasn’t quite the same as the legends from Gu Nan's previous life.
But backstories were never of interest to Gu Nan. He still remembered how to trigger the mission to subdue vampires—that was enough.
A few moments later, Gu Nan had changed his attire and was wandering the streets of the Capital of Blood once again.
He was dressed in a long silver-gray trench coat, riding a dark-red nightmare beast whose four hooves were aflame. He looked like an unruly wastrel.
"Mister Knight, want to buy flowers?" A timid voice rang in Gu Nan's ears. It was a girl in a short skirt with light makeup on her face.
Her hands were completely empty, not at all like a girl selling flowers, but she looked at Gu Nan expectantly.
In the Capital of Blood, buying and selling flowers didn’t refer to real flowers, but to the blood of virgins.
"What flowers are there?" Gu Nan asked calmly on the surface while thinking, ‘It’s here!’
The Capital of Blood had strict laws that prohibited vampires from sucking the blood of strangers at will, but there were always vampires who came out to find stimulation.
Gu Nan’s current attire resembled a down-and-out vampire who had a little money and couldn’t afford high-quality blood slaves, so he could only come here to sate his cravings.
The young girl’s eyes lit up when she heard Gu Nan's answer. "Copper flowers, beast flowers, whispering flowers—I have them all!"
These were code words among the people and referred to humans, therianthropes, and half-elves, respectively.
"Is there a deathly crimson safflower?" Gu Nan's cold voice rang out, causing the young girl to freeze slightly.
Deathly crimson safflower was a species of flower unique to the Undead Kingdom, and in this city, it specifically referred to vampire maidens.
Vampires were able to suck the blood of other vampires, but doing so wouldn’t give their bodies the necessary nutrients, so this was done purely for the pleasure of sucking blood.
To put it simply, the usual blood-sucking was like eating—it satisfied a physiological need for the vampires—while sucking blood from other vampires was like taking drugs. It could bring extra pleasure, but it was also a taboo.
The flower girl looked at Gu Nan with a strange gaze. No matter how one looked at it, a small-time “dealer” like her didn’t seem like she could possibly have high grade goods like deathly crimson safflowers, so why would the other party ask this?
But the greed inside her heart didn’t allow her to ponder this any longer—because coincidentally enough, she really did have a "deathly crimson safflower" in her hand.
……
Gu Nan sat alone in a dimly lit room. A somewhat messy bed was in front of him.
Knock, knock, knock.
The knocks on the door were neither too light nor too heavy, revealing the person's good upbringing, but the last two knocks seemed a bit rushed, revealing the apprehension in her heart.
"Come in."
Accompanied by Gu Nan's voice, a young girl in a long black dress walked in. Her white undergarments could still be seen under the gauze dress.
"My Lord." The maiden in a black dress saluted respectfully, trying to look less nervous. "You can call me—"
"Shana, that's your name, isn't it?" Gu Nan showed a faint smile and said softly.
"Who… Who are you?!" Shana only felt a chill in her heart as her original nervousness exploded out all at once; even her voice trembled slightly.
‘He actually knows my identity… Don’t tell me my family found out about what I’m doing and sent him to punish me?’
"No need to be nervous. As you can see, I am a prophet." Gu Nan said with a smile, "You seem to be very short on money, which is why you snuck out with hopes of raising money by selling your blood to other vampires?"
Shana's gaze took on some coldness, as well as some wariness, as she whispered, "Yes."
The prophet class indeed existed in this world, but Shana was completely unable to trust the other party.
"Someone killed your parents, and you want to take revenge?"
"You want to become the world's greatest vampire and rule the Capital of Blood?"
"You—"
"That's enough!" Shana interrupted icily, "I don't know where you learned about my identity and past, but don't even think about using these to tease me!"
Gu Nan showed a noncommittal expression, but the faint smile on his face remained unchanged. "Your older brother will soon make his move against you. I’ll find you again before the Ceremony of Blood starts."
Shana, however, just gave him a fierce glare, then got up and practically ran out of the room.
Gu Nan also walked out afterwards. The "flower" girl was guarding the door—she couldn’t afford to be careless with such an expensive deal involving a deathly crimson safflower.
"So fast?" She looked at Gu Nan suspiciously. The latter didn’t seem to have any blood on the corners of his lips. "Pay up now that you're done. Don't renege now!"
After saying this, the figures of several men walked out from behind her, each with a scimitar at his waist. They were actually the Drow Swordfighters well-known in the underworld.
In this kind of narrow terrain, Drow Swordfighters could bring out 200% of their combat power.
"Okay." Gu Nan nodded with a light smile.
The next instant, several shadows swooped out of the ground and instantly submerged these people along with the flower-selling girl.
"Killing the shopkeeper is a good habit," Gu Nan muttered words only he could understand while walking outside.

[1]
Zhong Die’s first name (Die) means butterfly
