When had Qu Hongye ever seen a visitor like Gu Nan before? It just so happened that she herself had a fearless personality, so she immediately turned her head away. "Want me to lead the way? Then beg me!"
Crack!
The girl delinquent immediately felt a sharp pain from her leg as a numbing crack traveled over. Gu Nan had stomped down on her leg, breaking the bone.
"Where is Xue Ren?" Gu Nan didn’t even bother adding any inflection to his voice.
"Y-y-y-you! If you’re so incredible, then kill— ah no, wrong line. W-w-w-wait!" Qu Hongye was in so much pain that she even started stammering, but she changed her tune quite fast.
So Gu Nan slowly withdrew the shadows that had already reached out. If Qu Hongye refused, he certainly didn’t mind refining her into a shadow servant first and then slowly asking questions.
But since she was willing to lead the way, Gu Nan could save energy and skip this step.
Of course players preferred the simplest, most efficient method. If they could be idle during something, then even one extra click of the mouse was considered a waste of energy.
"Lead the way."
Qu Hongye struggled to stand up, not even having the time to care about her broken leg. She revealed a strange smile and giggled. "Then follow me!"
While saying this, she flicked her hand and sent a message through the rune in her hand.
……
Outside the Sword Sect’s mountain gates, a young man and woman dressed in Daoist robes were surveying the scene from above.
"Junior Martial Sister Qu is in the Wutong District. She should’ve already arrived by now if she was bringing someone over. Why isn't she here yet?" The man sounded a little anxious.
"Why are you in such a hurry?" His female companion grumbled, "Junior Martial Sister said that person can catch her wave sword barehanded, so he’s likely to be a Star Ruler powerhouse. That’s why we need to retreat quickly when they arrive."
The man revealed a bitter smile. "The only reason we’re still here is because I can’t restrain the sword beast any longer… I would’ve asked Master for help if I’d known this earlier."
The woman was almost driven mad by him. She poked his head angrily. "Think with your head! If you asked Master, would Master let us both out? Would he be willing to avenge Junior Sister Qu?"
"Hey! Don't push me…" The man lost his balance from her jab. His movements suddenly became flustered, and the hand seal he was maintaining also dissipated.
His heart froze slightly as he subconsciously glanced behind him, only to see a giant ape as tall as ten people rushing forward with a great roar.
"It's over…"

chapters.title: Chapter 370: Strongest Swordsman Of The Myriad Heavens
chapters.content:
Star Rulers were completely independent existences. Outside of the Thirteen Heavens, it was almost impossible to see a certain Star Ruler living in someone else’s astral world as a subordinate.
In other words, even in a large plane like Extreme Sword Heaven, the only Star Ruler who truly belonged here was Xue Ren.
The other Star Rulers here were at most visiting or living in seclusion, or perhaps even seeking revenge, but they had absolutely no affiliation with Extreme Sword Heaven.
Only at the level of the Thirteen Heavens, where the Star Ruler merged with the great Dao and their astral world experienced a fundamental breakthrough, would a Star Ruler have a basis for recruiting other Star Rulers.
Because of this, there was a group of Star Rulers below the Thirteen Heavens who used all kinds of methods in their attempts to create Star Ruler Realm fighting strength.
Extreme Sword Heaven was a very typical example.
Xue Ren's own cultivation was more like conducting research, so he came across some peculiar methods that could be used to create soldiers during his research.
After all,science and technology are a primary productive force
[1]
, and the production of a fighting force was also considered production.
Gao Xiaowen's face was ashen as he stared at the “fighting force” rapidly flying away in front of him, his heart frozen in fear.
It was already a heavy crime to secretly take a sword beast outside the sect. It would be fine if he could resolve it perfectly, but he’d be implicated if the problem escalated.
And now, he actually lost control of a Star Ruler Realm sword beast… Gao Xiaowen didn’t know how he’d explain this to the sect. He might even be expelled for this.
Wang Qiu, his companion, also froze when she saw the roaring giant ape disappear into the distance. When she recalled the terrible consequences of an out-of-control sword beast, she couldn’t even speak for a while.
"W-What do we do…?" Wang Qiu's voice trembled.
"Hurry! We must go back and find Master!"
……
Gu Nan held Qu Hongye by the neck with one hand and slowly walked through a dense forest.
Ever since they approached the Sword Sect's mountain gate, Gu Nan never allowed Qu Hongye to leave his grasp.
The "physics sword Dao" was a field he’d never seen before. Who knew what kinds of strange abilities they had?
If Qu Hongye successfully wormed into a spatial passage just because he was careless, it’d be hard to find her again.
Laws could be cut off and abilities could be restricted, but the Evil God physique was unstoppable.
Gu Nan believed that as long as he was willing, not even Xue Ren himself would be able to stop Gu Nan from snapping Qu Hongye's neck.
"Hey! Can’t you put me down?" But Qu Hongye didn't have the same considerations as Gu Nan. She was currently asking in annoyance.
"Why?"
"I can walk by myself!" She said as she stomped her one good leg.
Gu Nan cast her a glance and unhurriedly placed her on the ground, then slammed his foot down on her good leg.
Crack!
The sound of bones breaking came again. Qu Hongye immediately cried out in pain. "What are you doing?!"
Gu Nan coldly swept her a glance. "Can you still walk now?"
"I-I… No." Qu Hongye wanted to draw her sword and cut this fellow, but the harsh reality made her give in.
"Just you wait…" Qu Hongye glared viciously at Gu Nan while wondering, ‘Why aren’t my senior brothers and sisters here yet?’
At that moment, an enormous roar traveled over from their front. A giant ape was giving a long roar while looking up at the sky, wreaking havoc on everything around it.
Qu Hongye's face paled. Of course she knew that a sword beast would never make such a move under normal circumstances.
This was clearly a sword beast they lost control of!
"A Tier 5 divine servant? Not bad," Gu Nan, however, just glanced in that direction and commented offhandedly.
Divine servants were a type of existence with the Divine Kingdom distinct from apostles and the populace, and generally, their responsibility was to conquer foreign planes.
To use the concept of base building games as an analogy, the Divine Kingdom’s populace were the normal residents, the apostles were the various types of heroes, and the divine servants were the soldiers.
Different types of heroes specialized in different fields, but different levels and types of soldiers all played the same role—to fight wars.
Divine servants were generally artificial creations, and most of them weren’t even living beings. They belonged to a relatively rare category of existences.
This was the first time Gu Nan had seen a divine servant since he transmigrated here.
"Get out of the way! Quick, get out of the way!"
A white-bearded old Daoist was chasing the giant ape. When he saw Gu Nan and Qu Hongye, he immediately shielded them protectively behind him.
"H-Hurry up and let go of me!" Gu Nan was still carrying Qu Hongye by the neck, but she couldn't help shouting right now.
Qu Hongye knew exactly how terrifying the sword ape's power was.
This was originally the product of her Martial Uncle’s experiments on making beasts take the path of traditional sword cultivators. Reality proved that beasts could also cultivate swordsmanship, and apes were the best among them.
The power of this sword ape was already enough to fight against a newly-advanced Star Ruler!
But what made her helpless was that Gu Nan didn’t move at all and just watched as the ape rushed forward, chopping its palm down.
This chop was as fast as lightning. It actually used its palm as a sword without scattering any sword intent contained within the strike at all. This chop alone was enough to prove the giant ape's extraordinary sword Dao attainment.
One had to wonder what the cultivators who wholeheartedly dedicated themselves to swordsmanship would feel if they saw this scene—man was inferior to ape.
Gu Nan just stood in front of the giant ape and raised his left hand.
He steadily caught the giant ape's palm, yet his hand didn’t even shake from the impact. On the contrary, the gales generated by the collision almost blew Qu Hongye away.
The giant ape's palm was the size of Gu Nan's entire body, but Gu Nan casually grabbed it with his hand. The small and large figures faced each other just like this, looking very bizarre.
The other people in the forest also fell silent. The giant ape, however, gave another roar as it tried to use all its power to break free.
The hand Gu Nan used to grab it didn’t budge. Only then did he violently fling it to one side. The giant ape was actually swung around like a ball, smashing into the ground.
With a loud rumble, the giant ape’s head hit the ground, and it let out a wail of pain.
The sword ape’s true power was entirely in its swordsmanship, but its actual body wasn’t very strong, so Gu Nan’s frightening strength caused it to lose consciousness.
"This… Don’t tell me it died from that throw?" Gao Xiaowen stared at the motionless sword ape on the ground and couldn’t help asking.
"How can it die so easily from just a throw? This is a sword beast!" Wang Qiu denied vehemently, but she didn’t sound very confident.
"It’s not dead, but it's almost there." Their master, the old white-bearded Daoist, sighed. "You guys drag the sword beast back first."
"No need, leave it to me," a gentle voice rang in everyone’s ears. Only then did they realize that an additional figure had already appeared beside them at some point.
It was a young man dressed in light green Daoist robes. As soon as the old Daoist saw him, he immediately bowed and greeted, "Sect Master, Senior Martial Brother."
"Martial Uncle! Martial Uncle, save me!" Qu Hongye, who was beside Gu Nan, even shouted hurriedly.
The person who just arrived was clearly the target Gu Nan wanted to meet, the strongest Sword Saint of the Myriad Heavens—Xue Ren, the Star Ruler of Extreme Sword Heaven.
Gu Nan raised such a ruckus here. If Xue Ren still couldn't sense that, then he wouldn’t be called a Star Ruler.
Xue Ren greeted the old Daoist, then took another step to arrive in front of Gu Nan and Qu Hongye, smiling gently. "Your Excellency Gu Nan, I've wanted to meet you for a long time."
As he said this, he also patted Qu Hongye's head gently, signaling for her to keep quiet for now.
"What did you want to meet me for?" Gu Nan asked the follow-up question.
"To test my sword." Xue Ren's voice was still as warm as jade, but there was a touch of fervor on his face. "I heard that your physical body is invincible. If you can block this strike of mine, I can grant a request of yours."
Swordsmen were usually martial arts fanatics, and Xue Ren was no exception.
But Xue Ren was a very special swordsman—he paid special attention to etiquette, or rather, going through the proper procedures first. Surprisingly, he didn’t have any intention of making a move before he received Gu Nan’s reply.
It was the first time Gu Nan had seen such a polite person, so he nodded. "Alright."
While saying that, he raised Qu Hongye in front of him like a shield, squarely blocking him from Xue Ren.
T/N:
[1]
“Science and technology are a primary productive force”
- Famous quote from Deng Xiaoping

chapters.title: Chapter 371: Xue Ren’s Request
chapters.content:
Everyone in the forest fell silent once again.
Qu Hongye was raised in front of Gu Nan like a shield and could feel the faint murderous aura coming from behind her. She could only stare at Xue Ren tearfully, not daring to make the slightest move.
The old Daoist and his two disciples stared at Gu Nan speechlessly. They’d already realized that the one before them was most likely a Star Ruler powerhouse.
But it was the first time they’d seen such a shameless Star Ruler.
Xue Ren was also dumbfounded. He laughed involuntarily, and the sword Qi that coalesced in front of him slowly dissipated.
……
A few minutes later, Gu Nan and Xue Ren sat across from each other.
Their meeting place was very special. It was a three-story pavilion built entirely from bamboo. The pavilion had a unique style, with a thin layer of woven mats on the floor. It was somewhat reminiscent of the Japanese style Gu Nan remembered.
Xue Ren even assumed a seiza posture, and Qu Hongye, who was waiting upon them from the side, also did the same.
"Where did you guys learn this?" Gu Nan looked at the two curiously. He didn’t seem to recall hearing about any Japanese swordsmanship schools in the Myriad Heavens Universe.
"You mean this?" Xue Ren gestured to their surroundings. "It was left behind by my Master. It’s a swordsman friend’s residence. His swordsmanship is very interesting."
Gu Nan nodded and didn't ask further questions, instead explaining the purpose of his visit.
"You want to bring 200 people into the Myriad Heavens?" Xue Ren rubbed his chin thoughtfully. "Lingyang told me you just came back from that side, but if you want to bring so many people over, smuggling them all isn’t very feasible. The Thirteen Heavens aren’t blind."
Xue Ren was one of the upper echelons of the Heaven-God Alliance. Both his personal strength and seniority were sufficient to qualify for this position.
So after Gu Nan joined the Heaven-God Alliance, Daoist Lingyang quickly informed this side of the news, and Xue Ren naturally knew about it.
Although the Thirteen Heavens couldn’t boast of having absolute control over the Myriad Heavens Universe, their control was by no means weak. They could turn a blind eye to human smuggling in relatively small numbers, but that was all.
"What about splitting it into smaller groups?" Gu Nan could easily think of this problem.
"That’s also a little difficult." Xue Ren explained with a smile, "Many of those engaged in human smuggling are actually people from the Thirteen Heavens. If you frequently send small groups over, then you’ll be discovered sooner or later."
Gu Nan couldn't help frowning slightly. He didn't expect for the Thirteen Heavens to actually have control over both the legal and illegal channels. Sure enough, forces at that level really wouldn’t leave many loopholes.
Seeing his expression, Xue Ren suggested, "But you just want to bring people over to this side. In fact, that’s easier than smuggling people out… Have you considered going through the official channels?"
"You mean, bring them to this side through the Thirteen Heavens?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow. He was used to acting alone, so this actually never occurred to him.
"That's right." Xue Ren replied with a smile, "If you don't mind the Thirteen Heavens knowing about the people you’re bringing in, I can do this favor for you."
There were naturally many advantages to bringing the vampires over through the Thirteen Heavens’ official channels. For one, there was no need to hide anything, and it was also stable and efficient.
The downside was that the people brought in would need to go through a background check. Their identities, origins, and whereabouts would all be recorded by the Thirteen Heavens.
Gu Nan thought about it and decided on this approach. After all, Shana's group of vampires didn’t really have anything to hide. Moreover, after they entered the Myriad Heavens and went inside his Divine Kingdom, the Thirteen Heavens would lose sight of them all the same.
"Okay," so Gu Nan agreed with a nod.
"Then it's a deal." Xue Ren didn’t act like a Star Ruler with a high status at all. He was as easy-going as normal people. "In exchange, I hope you can also help me with a small favor."
Gu Nan was all too familiar with the model of completing a mission to earn rewards, so he naturally had no objections.
"Want a fight?"
"No." Xue Ren smiled as he patted Qu Hongye's head. Under the latter's resentful gaze, he leisurely said, "Help me look after a child."
……
Although Qu Hongye was Xue Ren's Martial Niece, her master passed away when she was young, so she was actually brought up by Xue Ren from childhood. Thus, it wasn’t such a stretch to say that they had a master-disciple or even father-daughter relationship.
More importantly, Xue Ren only had a few disciples in total, and among them, Qu Hongye was the one who showed the most promise of inheriting his mantle.
With that, it was easy to imagine Qu Hongye’s status inside the Sword Sect.
But that same Qu Hongye was currently walking behind Gu Nan with a wary gaze, sizing him up.
The condition in exchange for Xue Ren’s help was for Gu Nan to help look after a child for a period of time, and this child was precisely Qu Hongye.
The period was around three to six months, and Gu Nan only needed to hand back an alive Qu Hongye upon Xue Ren’s return.
A few injuries were really nothing for a cultivator at this level—just like Qu Hongye's broken legs, which were treated in no time.
"Why does Xue Ren want me to look after you? Will someone come to kill you?" Gu Nan turned his head and asked Qu Hongye.
In his opinion, this was nothing more than a protection mission, and predicting possible crises was naturally what the player needed to do.
Gu Nan didn't mind staying in Extreme Sword Heaven for a while. In any case, after moving the vampire clan into his Divine Kingdom, he still needed to wait for a while for enough points to be accumulated.
Even if he planned to launch a Divine Kingdom War, the points that needed to be invested in the early stages were quite sizable.
It wasn’t like he wouldn’t be able to visit his Divine Kingdom at all while staying at Extreme Sword Heaven to babysit a child, so it wouldn’t affect his plans there.
Qu Hongye glanced at Gu Nan and said with some embarrassment, "I’m not very dangerous, but I’m prone to attracting dangers…"
……
Void Grotto Heaven.
Void Grotto Heaven was one of the Thirteen Heavens. Not only was it powerful, but it was also one of the first astral worlds to enter this level. Among the astral worlds, it was a veritable veteran Heaven Level plane.
In ancient times, Void Grotto Heaven was once known as the Daoist Sect, and the current Daoist Lingyang's Clear Profundity Realm was actually one of the branches of the ancient Daoist Sect.
Void Grotto Heaven was also passed down from each sect master through many generations, but surprisingly, every single generation’s ruler was an extraordinary pedant who successfully stepped into Unified Dao Realm. Thus, Void Grotto Heaven never once fell out of the ranks of the Thirteen Heavens.
Of course, perhaps it wasn’t even called the Thirteen Heavens back then.
Void Grotto Heaven’s current Star Ruler was a woman, which was quite rare. She was known in the mortal world as Nun Yu Lian, because her real name was Yu Lian.
At this time, Yu Lian was sitting across from Xue Ren, making small talk.
"Then I'll leave this matter to you." Xue Ren smiled lightly and took a sip of the clear tea. The Daoist Sect’s unique tea had an indescribable fragrance lingering about.
Yu Lian had an average appearance. She was neither beautiful nor ugly, yet her features were extremely symmetrical and orderly, giving people a comfortable impression.
"A small matter," was her response to Xue Ren's request.
It was just a matter of receiving a group of people into the Myriad Heavens—it was indeed a small matter. As long as the other party was willing to accept the background check, there was actually no price that the Thirteen Heavens needed to pay in return.
Some space-time crystals weren’t much of a big deal at all for the Thirteen Heavens, which controlled the resources of the entire Myriad Heavens Universe.
"The one who wants to bring people over is Gu Nan, right? Is this person worth going to all this trouble to win him over?" Yu Lian naturally knew who Xue Ren was doing a favor for.
"He’s a very interesting person." Xue Ren smiled, his gaze suddenly becoming somewhat meaningful. "He should be related to that side."

chapters.title: Chapter 372: Divinity
chapters.content:
Of course Yu Lian knew what Xue Ren meant by “that side,” so she frowned slightly.
"It’s true that I’ve never seen someone with those kinds of powers before… but it’s even less similar to that side." Yu Lian thought about it, then shook her head.
As one of the Star Rulers of the Thirteen Heavens, Yu Lian was certainly no stranger to the gods. She’d even personally fought that side’s greater gods before.
If the power system of the Myriad Heavens could barely be considered diverse, then the power system of the World of Gods could only be described as having only a single path.
Putting aside the differences in the gods’ divine authorities, it could be said that all gods followed the same path—that is, using the power of faith as a basis to control their powers through their Godheads.
Yu Lian didn’t really believe that Gu Nan was related to that side, but she didn’t entirely disbelieve it either—after all, this came from Xue Ren.
Leaving aside the fact that Xue Ren was also one of the top Star Rulers in the world who was just one step away from joining the Thirteen Heavens and may take that step at any time, just based on the personal friendship between the two, it was enough for Yu Lian to pay attention to Gu Nan.
"If there’s an opportunity, we can pull him to our side," she said.
"I will wait and see." Xue Ren was still smiling. Then he changed the subject, "The child Lu Wen found will go to the Void Ruins in the near future. You don’t need to make any preparations? I have to leave for a while, so I might not be able to help you."
"I didn’t need your help to begin with," Yu Lian replied decisively, her gaze turning a little cold. "Lu Wen is overstepping his bounds."
……
The Thirteen Heavens worked a little faster than Gu Nan thought. Less than two days later, there were already people there to extradite the vampires.
Shana and the others naturally didn’t care about the background check, and as for Zhong Die, whose identity was a bit problematic… She was originally from the Myriad Heavens Universe and wasn’t affected by the dimensional walls at all, so she didn’t need any background check in the first place.
Gu Nan sent the vampires inside his Divine Kingdom and assigned them a separate territory to develop. He had Shana lead two Legend Rank vampires and start raiding the Crescent Moon World dungeon.
However, Gu Nan decisively tossed Zhong Die into White Bones Realm, not giving her any chance to enter his Divine Kingdom.
After all, she was Zhong Qinghe's daughter. Who knew if Zhong Qinghe left any tracking spells on her? Letting her enter his Divine Kingdom was too risky.
If she wanted to enter the Divine Kingdom, then she at least had to wait until Gu Nan felt his Divine Kingdom was powerful enough, or until after he killed Zhong Qinghe.
The Raymond clan, which lived in the Undead Kingdom for years, wasn’t quite accustomed to the environment within Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom, but they were still quite satisfied.
There weren’t too many powerful forces here, and most of the resources were in an undeveloped state, which was very suitable for their survival.
Besides the somewhat different culture and social customs, as well as the fact that Legend Rank experts would occasionally be pulled away to do hard labor, there was really nothing else to be dissatisfied about.
After settling the vampires inside the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan supervised the progress of the Crescent Moon World dungeon raid while his main body stayed in Extreme Sword Heaven.
He soon understood what Qu Hongye meant by "attracting danger.”
"Senior Gu Nan, someone is knocking on our doors again because of Junior Sister Qu…" Gao Xiaowen ran to Gu Nan's side and reported with a troubled expression.
In just half a month's time, this was already the fourth time he ran over to ask for help. If possible, Gao Xiaowen definitely didn’t want to do this.
He was well aware of how horrifying the one before him was—or rather, how brutal he was.
Qu Hongye really was a trouble magnet. Her default expression was always mocking. She could always pull aggro no matter where she went. Every few days, people would knock on their door demanding an explanation or apology.
"Oh, you can’t blow them off this time?" Gu Nan asked unhurriedly while leisurely sunbathing, an open book covering his face.
The last three times he was approached, Gu Nan didn’t even have any intention of showing himself or resolving the problem and simply let the Sword Sect deal with them.
It was nothing more than apologizing when an apology was warranted or paying for damages—it wasn’t the first time the Sword Sect had cleaned up Qu Hongye’s mess.
"Yes, Junior Sister Qu killed someone this time…" Gao Xiaowen answered helplessly, "and it was the wife of a Star Ruler. That Star Ruler is now looking for Junior Sister Qu."
The Star Ruler in question came from a small plane. Even his astral world was established only recently, so he wasn’t very strong. But at the very least, he was still a Star Ruler, so Extreme Sword Heaven couldn’t be unreasonable.
The bigger the plane, the more it valued its face. Large planes couldn’t just openly bully others.
"Senior, it would be better to place Junior Sister Qu in confinement." Gao Xiaowen couldn't help suggesting, "If you don't manage her, then she's just too much of a troublemaker… The several Seniors who looked after Junior Sister Qu previously all ended up doing the same thing."
This clearly wasn’t the first time Qu Hongye had been left with someone else. Whenever Xue Ren went out to attend to a matter, he needed someone to babysit Qu Hongye.
But Gu Nan revealed an interested smile. "Let's go take a look."
……
Gao Xiaowen quickly led Gu Nan to the main hall, where Qu Hongye, several senior members of the Sword Sect, and a burly man with a scruffy beard were all gathered.
"This is Lord Qiao Deyu," Gao Xiaowen pointed to the large man and introduced him to Gu Nan.
Qiao Deyu sized Gu Nan up with cold eyes, uninterested in greeting him. His expression remained icy from beginning to end—he came here to demand __, not to make friends.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan, you’re just in time. Help us persuade Mr. Qiao together," nearby, an old man in Daoist robes said with a bitter smile. He was none other than Gao Xiaowen's master, an elderly Daoist named Zhang Hui.
Beside him was a female Daoist who was also a cultivator from the same generation as him. She was called Wu Yun and was also one of Qu Hongye's Martial Aunts.
Wu Yun was currently busy wiping Qu Hongye's ass for her. Plus, she also didn’t recognize Gu Nan, so she naturally didn’t have time to pay any attention to him.
But no matter how she persuaded and how much she promised to compensate, Qiao Deyu always had a frosty expression and said coldly, "I don't need any compensation, nor is it possible for you guys to compensate for my wife's life."
As he said that, he turned to look at Qu Hongye. "I just want to ask one thing—my wife had no enmity against your Extreme Sword Heaven, so why did you kill her?"
Everyone turned their heads to Qu Hongye, who just shrugged with a Hmph. "Her chest was bigger than mine. I hate big-chested women the most, so I killed her~"
Everyone was stunned by that answer. Qiao Deyu's eyes turned bloodshot, and the laws around him surged crazily, all directed at Qu Hongye.
"You’re courting death!"
The next second, a hand waved in front of Qu Hongye, instantly extinguishing all attacking laws—Gu Nan had appeared in front of Qu Hongye.
At the very least, Qiao Deyu was still a Star Ruler with an astral world, so he shouldn't have been this weak, but the one who actually came to Extreme Sword Heaven was just a clone.
Qiao Deyu wasn’t stupid. If he still came with his true body despite knowing full well that Extreme Sword Heaven was powerful and that they’d just become enemies, then he was simply looking for death.
Looking at Gu Nan's expressionless face, Qiao Deyu was so furious that he laughed. "Good! Very good! What a tyrannical and lawless Extreme Sword Heaven!"
After throwing down these words, he disappeared in a cloud of blue smoke.
Qiao Deyu’s disappearance left Gao Xiaowen and the others with faces full of worry. It was clearly impossible for the other party to give up on his revenge, which meant that Junior Sister Qu would have to face the threat of a Star Ruler whenever she went out in the future.
"You’re quite good." Gu Nan, however, smiled and patted Qu Hongye's head. This action was identical to Xue Ren's. "Xue Ren said you have the most hope of advancing to Star Ruler Realm. Indeed, that’s true."
"Ah? Why do you say so…?" Next to them, Gao Xiaowen was dumbfounded. He couldn’t understand why the Junior Sister Qu who made trouble for no reason would actually show the most promise of advancing to Star Ruler Realm.
In a certain sense, this was already considered complete disregard for human life.
Gu Nan looked at Qu Hongye with a light smile, as if looking at a highly promising beginner teammate in his past life’s game.
Qu Hongye wasn’t actually stupid, and it was impossible for that to be the first time Qiao Deyu asked her why she killed his wife. Her words were spoken deliberately for Gu Nan to hear.
As for her goal… She probably wanted to find some trouble for Gu Nan?
In any case, she could casually kill innocent people for her own goal—this was one of the marks of a Star Ruler.
In the World of Gods, this was called "divinity
[1]
."
"A clear-cut goal and sound logic, very good." Gu Nan said to Qu Hongye with a smile, "But you’ll have to clean up the mess you made."
Qu Hongye panicked slightly and subconsciously asked, "How to clean it up?"
"Wipe out that Qiao Deyu's astral world."
T/N:
[1]
Divinity:
Has more to do with personality here than actually being divine

chapters.title: Chapter 373: Vision For A Player Army
chapters.content:
Gu Nan admired Qu Hongye greatly. This kind of admiration was similar to finding a card with low stats but very special attributes while playing a card game.
If you happened to have a powerful card in your hand that could work with it, then even better.
Gu Nan saw a little of Zhong Die's shadow in Qu Hongye—no, she actually surpassed Zhong Die in terms of her compatibility as a player.
Zhong Die was just an experimental candidate for Gu Nan, who gave her the vampire quest line only because she was suited for becoming a vampire.
Gu Nan didn't even do the preliminary work to make sure Zhong Die would be under his complete control.
But armed with experience from Zhong Die's matter, Gu Nan already had other ideas—he wanted to make use of all player quest lines in the World of Gods to create a "player" army for himself!
Inside the Divine Kingdom, the populace could be born naturally and divine servants could be produced, but only apostles had to be recruited from outside.
Divine servants may have power exceeding Tier 5, but their intelligence would never reach that level, let alone their laws.
Only the apostles, who possessed complete intelligence from the start, could learn and evolve by themselves and could also be strengthened by the Apostle Hall.
So who better to fill the role of apostles than players?
‘If I can really control a player army, then Kingdom Wars would be too easy.’ Gu Nan sat in the room and watched Qu Hongye write furiously, while thoughts ran through his head.
Kingdom Wars was the players’ abbreviation for Divine Kingdom Wars, and it was also the main gameplay for players advancing from the First Round to the Second Round.
The earlier construction and management of the Divine Kingdom were essentially all to pave the way for the Divine Kingdom Wars.
And Qu Hongye was currently doing the same thing.
"I finished writing out the plan." With an impatient look on her face, Qu Hongye handed over a thin piece of paper with a few lines written sporadically on it.
These lines could roughly be summed up in one sentence: “Everyone follow me and charge.”
"Are you planning to take this to Gale World?" Gu Nan placed the paper down on the table and looked at Qu Hongye.
Gale World was Qiao Deyu's astral world. It was originally a naturally developing plane that Qiao Deyu just took control of for less than a few decades, so it was considered a newborn astral world.
"Is there a problem?" Qu Hongye asked with a glare.
Gu Nan shook his head. Gale World was only just starting out and had only one or two Void Cutters protecting it, so of course handling it through brute force wasn’t a problem.
But the purpose behind having Qu Hongye write out a plan wasn’t really for her to create a plan—rather, he wanted to analyze her attributes and personality.
As far as players were concerned, any NPC could be won over or subdued.
Since Gu Nan was considering having Qu Hongye join his "player army," of course he had to assess her ability stats in various aspects. It would be convenient if he directly accepted her as an apostle, since he’d be able to see her stats in the Apostle Hall.
But out of the same concern as Zhong Die, Gu Nan wouldn’t allow her to enter his Divine Kingdom for the time being.
Gu Nan even started considering whether he should set up another organization outside the Divine Kingdom to specifically place these people in if there were too many talents from large planes.
Anyhow, these "heroes" mostly needed to command the troops when invading foreign planes, so whether they were ever allowed inside his Divine Kingdom or not made no difference.
"Then I'm off!" Qu Hongye saw Gu Nan’s lack of response and said in an uncertain tone.
She was restless by nature and had always been interested in exciting things like this. It was impossible for her to get such an opportunity when Xue Ren was around.
Gu Nan waved his hand in dismissal. He wanted to see what Qu Hongye would be able to accomplish with this much freedom of command.
Her personality was very suited for joining the "player army," but unlike the experimental Zhong Die, if she was too weak, she would be abandoned by Gu Nan all the same.
In fact, after Qu Hongye’s example, Gu Nan's thinking had already broadened—if it was hard to meet such people, then he could simply raise them himself.
‘Let's try it first. There's nothing else to do here anyways.’ Gu Nan looked at Qu Hongye's disappearing figure and thought casually.
……
While Qu Hongye was gathering troops to level Gale World, new developments occurred inside Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom.
The changes came from two places. One was that Red Tail, who stayed in White Bones Realm to manage White Mist, finally advanced to Void Cutter Realm after a few times in the Apostle Hall and years of accumulation.
Don't be fooled by how Gu Nan killed Star Rulers so casually. Nevertheless, the degree of difficulty in breaking through to the next realm remained unchanged.
The Myriad Heavens Universe wasn’t a place where people could level up just by taking pills or elixirs. Even if someone advanced to a high realm, chances of that person’s family doing the same were very slim.
The second development was that the progress of Shana and the other vampires’ raid on Crescent Moon World went faster than Gu Nan expected.
In the boss battle, they were already able to cut off all of the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s escape routes before their party could suffer any casualties.
After limiting the Silver-Robed Ancestor’s ability to escape, the rest was nothing more than a slow grind. As long as the three mission experts were familiar with the boss’s fighting style, killing him was not a problem.
In the end, the Silver-Robed Ancestor inherited only part of Gu Nan's power, as well as his keen combat instincts.
But in reality, Gu Nan's most powerful weapon was his familiarity with the various kinds of powers, as well as the targeted tactics derived from them.
The Silver-Robed Ancestor didn’t have these memories, so sooner or later he would be killed.
In any case, Gu Nan still paid close attention to this. He even organized three additional Legend Rank vampires and had them start farming Crescent Moon World in two shifts based on the experience of Shana's party.
As long as Crescent Moon World was farmed continuously, Gu Nan would experience a large leap in the speed at which points accumulated. The initial capital needed to launch a Divine Kingdom War depended on this.
On this day, Gu Nan was still in Extreme Sword Heaven, but his gaze was focused on the rather distant other side of the Myriad Heavens, which was where Gale World was.
Qu Hongye's attack against Gale World had already begun.
Although the plane invasion she organized was, in Gu Nan's opinion, highly unskilled, extremely inefficient, and utterly lacking any sense of beauty, in the end, it was still an invasion.
Countless cultivators from Extreme Sword Heaven poured into Gale World, led by a few Void Cutter experts. They hunted down the experts native to Gale World with all their might.
Gu Nan, who was watching from the sidelines, couldn’t help secretly nodding in approval.
Although Qu Hongye's strategic arrangements were crude, Extreme Sword Heaven’s cultivators were all quite good. They carried out the blockade and slaughter very smoothly… Mm, it was obvious from a glance that this wasn’t their first time doing something like this.
On the other hand, it also fully illustrated just how weak Gale World’s foundation was.
The Void Cutter cultivators who came along didn’t even have to step in at all. This invasion didn’t meet any decent resistance.
Simply put, the civilization of Gale World was still stuck in the feudal era where most people were farmers. Qiao Deyu didn't have time to advance this world’s civilization before the invasion happened.
Let alone facing cultivators of a higher realm, the natives of Gale World even lost against enemies of the same level.
Finally, the two Void Cutters of Gale World tried to make a move and were easily killed by Qu Hongye herself. Shortly after, the entire Gale World was razed to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Alteration In The Void Ruins
chapters.content:
Gale World fell faster and more smoothly than imagined.
Gu Nan never even got a chance to attack. Instead, he found another difference between the Myriad Heavens Universe and the World of Gods while observing from the sidelines.
There was no doubt that this wasn’t the first time cultivators from Extreme Sword Heaven had invaded another plane, so Gu Nan was able to learn valuable information from their overall invasion strategy.
In this regard, the Myriad Heavens Universe was quite different from the World of Gods.
People from the Myriad Heavens Universe were all about "targeting the leader." They headed straight for the target plane’s powerful cultivators in order to destroy the enemy’s forces as quickly as possible.
But it was different in the World of Gods. There, the highest-priority targets were apostles, followed by the fanatics.
The reason behind this difference lies in a single word—faith.
The source of power that gods obtained through their Divine Kingdom was the faith of their Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants, while Star Rulers were more like Gu Nan—they just needed the inhabitants’ power.
So he was bound to make strategic adjustments to any future Divine Kingdom Wars to target this point.
After all, the ultimate goal of a Divine Kingdom War was still to kill the enemy Star Ruler or god. Attacking their plane was just a way to weaken their power.
Observing this battle allowed Gu Nan to figure out the differences between the two sides’ Divine Kingdom Wars, so he was still quite satisfied.
The only unsatisfying thing was that from beginning to end, Qiao Deyu never appeared.
While they didn’t experience any surprises during the entire invasion, Qiao Deyu's failure to show himself could be considered the biggest surprise.
"He actually didn't come out. What should we do now?" Qu Hongye returned to Gu Nan, looking as if she’d just gone out for a stroll.
The entire invasion didn’t even last one week. It was indeed no different from going on vacation.
Gu Nan was silent for a while, then asked Gao Xiaowen beside him, "Did you find Qiao Deyu's whereabouts yet?"
"Not yet. Our people are stepping up their investigations…" Gao Xiaowen wiped the cold sweat on his forehead and quickly reported.
The fact that Qiao Deyu never showed himself really was strange. After all, no matter how one looked at this, he had no reason to hide.
The destruction of his astral world would greatly weaken his power, returning him to the level of a normal Star Ruler overnight.
But if Qiao Deyu didn’t show himself because he was biding his time for a sneak attack, Qu Hongye even ended up using herself as bait and still failed to lure him out.
If there was still a slim chance that Qiao Deyu could take advantage of the chaos to kill Qu Hongye right now, then his chances would drop to zero after Xue Ren returned.
So what exactly was Qiao Deyu planning?
"Found him." Zhang Hui, the old Daoist, walked in from the door and said to the group, "Someone found Qiao Deyu’s traces in the Void Ruins."
"So he was in the Void Ruins!" Gao Xiaowen exclaimed in sudden realization, "No wonder he didn't come back even when his astral world was destroyed—it was simply impossible for him to leave!”
There were many strange places in the Myriad Heavens Universe. Some were formed naturally, while others were special zones created by ancient cataclysms.
The Void Ruins belonged to the latter category. It was the ruins of the ancient Void Grotto Heaven.
Void Grotto Heaven was one of the Thirteen Heavens, and it was also a rather legendary plane.
Void Grotto Heaven had an extremely long history, having already been one of the largest planes in the Myriad Heavens since ancient times. Furthermore, it always remained within the ranks of the Thirteen Heavens and never fell out of that level.
But it wasn’t all smooth-sailing. Void Grotto Heaven also experienced several major cataclysms.
During one of those cataclysms, a piece of the astral world even broke off and landed outside Void Grotto Heaven, forming today’s Void Ruins.
Many people knew the location of the Void Ruins, but it was so mysterious and treacherous that even people from Void Grotto Heaven didn’t dare to casually enter and explore.
Nobody expected Qiao Deyu to actually appear in the Void Ruins.
"He went in of his own accord?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows. To think that Qiao Deyu would still be in the mood to go treasure hunting after starting a blood feud. This really was odd.
"No," Zhang Hui, however, said, "we couldn’t find any trace of him at the entrance to the Void Ruins, so he was most likely pulled directly inside."
While speaking, Zhang Hui also explained the special characteristics of the Void Ruins.
The Void Ruins was a very special place. The law of space inside was different from the outside, forming a unique set of laws.
Legend has it that the Void Ruins was a place where one can never leave after entering, but this wasn’t entirely accurate.
The Void Ruins wouldn’t stop anyone from entering or leaving. If someone wanted to, they could even take a stroll inside twice every day and still be on time for dinner after returning home.
But the peculiarity of the Void Ruins was that many things inside would leave a mark on the cultivator, and these marks would be triggered randomly. Once the mark was triggered, the cultivator would immediately be sent back inside the Void Ruins.
But this time, it wouldn’t be so easy for the cultivator to leave. They must first deal with the event that triggered the mark, or else they would remain trapped inside forever.
Not even a Star Ruler like Qiao Deyu was immune to the laws that teleported people back inside. This was indeed frightening.
"How interesting." Gu Nan couldn't help revealing a slight smile after learning about this set of laws.
However, his eyes continued to read the rest of the document and unexpectedly found a familiar name in the information—Lou Wanying, the youth that Lu Wen was painstakingly raising.
The person who triggered the mark and pulled Qiao Deyu back inside the Void Ruins was none other than Lou Wanying.
Gu Nan's eyes narrowed slightly. To say that this was a coincidence—he didn’t really believe that.
But if it wasn’t a coincidence… Then who had the ability to set it all up? Qu Hongye’s level wasn’t high enough where she’d be able to know the situation in the Void Ruins, so Xue Ren was probably the only one who could have her “accidentally” find Qiao Deyu.
Gu Nan also recalled Xue Ren’s extremely normal smile when “entrusting” Qu Hongye to him, and then… he set the documents aside.
"Since Qiao Deyu is in the Void Ruins, let's wait for him to return," Gu Nan said casually, his gaze falling to the distant sky. "It shouldn’t take long."
……
As expected, not long after the destruction of Gale World, all the major newspapers suddenly published a piece that triggered a lively discussion throughout the entire Myriad Heavens Universe.
A huge alteration occurred in the Void Ruins—the emergence of the ancient Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance had already led to the deaths of six Star Rulers. And now, the ancient Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance fell into the hands of a person named Lou Wanying.
"Lou Wanying! It's him again!" Countless similar exclamations resounded throughout the Myriad Heavens.
Counting the previous Time Arena, Lou Wanying's name entered the eyes of all major powers for the second time.
But while the rest of the world was lamenting this turn of events, Lou Wanying himself was accompanying his two companions in Extreme Sword Heaven, making their way towards the Sword Sect’s mountain gate.
Lou Wanying was a little different from when Gu Nan last saw him. The old him still looked a little young and inexperienced, but now he seemed mature and calm. He wore a light green Daoist robe and possessed an extraordinary bearing.
His two companions also weren’t ordinary. One of them had a pair of wings on his back and two strange horns on his head. He looked wild and headstrong.
The other was a plain-clothed young girl with a longsword strapped to her back. She was holding a corpse in her hand—it was none other than Qiao Deyu.
"Who are you?" The disciple guarding the Sword Sect’s mountain gate asked in a heavy voice—no matter how he looked at it, these three didn’t seem like guests.
The young girl looked cold and detached as she gently placed Qiao Deyu's corpse on the ground and unsheathed the longsword from her back. "Senior Qiao died for me, so I will shoulder his grudge."
As soon as her words fell, a cut instantly appeared on the guard disciple’s neck, and his body collapsed to the ground.
The young lady stepped forth and walked towards the mountaintop step by step. Lou Wanying glanced at the dead disciple. His expression looked a bit uncomfortable, but he could only sigh helplessly in the end.
The wild man with two wings on his back, however, shouted to the crowd that had gathered, "Listen up, you people!"
"Our Boss Yin Qing is destined to become the strongest swordsman in the Myriad Heavens!"

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Making A Move
chapters.content:
Although Xue Ren had yet to return, someone who wanted to surpass him and become the strongest swordsman in the Myriad Heavens had already arrived.
However, even though many people set this as their lifelong goal, not many actually had the ability to achieve it.
Qu Hongye, Gao Xiaowen, and Zhang Hui were sitting high on the mountain peak with ugly expressions as they watched Yin Qing walk up, step by step and strike by strike. Sword in hand, she approached the summit just like that.
Yin Qing was the most traditional kind of swordsman. Every move and every style contained strong martial arts vibes. She was no different from the mortal world’s martial artists.
Due to Xue Ren’s unique sword path, the Sword Sect he controlled naturally also had a biased opinion of swordsmanship.
For example, Qu Hongye, his heir, had never been a fan of traditional swordsmanship, and a look of disapproval had already formed on her face.
"Stop!" Zhang Hui halted Qu Hongye, who wanted to go down the mountain. "What are you doing?"
Qu Hongye turned around and replied matter-of-factly, "To teach her a good lesson!"
Zhang Hui pulled her behind him and instructed Gao Xiaowen, "Go find another sword ape."
Gao Xiaowen hurriedly nodded and swiftly ran down. Since the Sword Sect had the ability to cultivate sword apes, of course they didn’t only raise one. Plus, now that Zhang Hui was present, there was no need to worry about losing control of the sword ape.
On the other hand, Qu Hongye could only bristle resentfully. Zhang Hui was also her Martial Uncle, so she had no way to disobey the other party's wishes.
As for Gu Nan, he was treated more like Qu Hongye's babysitter. It wasn’t like Xue Ren entrusted the entire Sword Sect to him. Yin Qing's current actions were tantamount to provoking the whole Sword Sect.
Judging by strength alone, Yin Qing was also considered a top-tier Void Cutter, so Zhang Hui directly dispatched a Star Ruler level sword ape without another word.
Sword apes didn’t have any laws, nor were they a higher-level lifeform, but their power was genuinely at Star Ruler Realm.
Even though a sword ape might be completely trounced when fighting a normal Star Ruler, it would still be enough to deal with a Void Cutter cultivator.
However, contrary to Zhang Hui’s expectations, the sword ape lost, and it was even lost very thoroughly, without any suspense at all. This wasn’t because the young lady could challenge opponents at a higher realm than her, but because… she was a Star Ruler!
This Star Ruler level sword ape was simply no different from the earlier Sword Sect disciples and was cleanly decapitated with a single swing of her sword.
"Tsk tsk, as expected of Boss.” The winged man, who was following her alongside Lou Wanying, couldn’t help chuckling as he watched the scene. "I'm afraid neither of us would’ve been able to defeat this big ape."
Lou Wanying nodded wordlessly. Unlike normal Star Rulers, the sword ape's power was almost completely exposed, so the two of them could easily discern how strong it was.
Because of this, Lou Wanying acknowledged that it would be quite a troublesome opponent for him without resorting to some of his trump cards.
On the mountaintop, Zhang Hui and the others’ expressions didn’t look very good. Qu Hongye flattened her mouth and no longer brought up the topic of "teaching her a lesson.”
She was very confident in her own swordsmanship, but not enough to ignore the gap between a Void Cutter and a Star Ruler.
Star Ruler meant one’s laws were complete and self-contained enough to create its own world, and until she could do the same, she lacked the power to challenge the other party for the time being.
Unfortunately, it just so happened that this step was the hardest to achieve in Xue Ren's swordsmanship—taking this step meant the establishment of an entirely new worldview. This wasn’t an easy feat even for Qu Hongye, who was raised with such ideas from the start.
"I'll do it," Gu Nan's voice rang in everyone’s ears.
Zhang Hui's expression changed slightly, but he ultimately shook his head firmly. "There’s no need to trouble sir yet. We must win back the Sword Sect's face by ourselves."
Xue Ren managed Extreme Sword Heaven for tens of thousands of years. He naturally had more than a couple of trump cards in his lair.
Otherwise, any random Star Ruler would be able to bully his astral world whenever he was gone, which would bring chaos to Extreme Sword Heaven.
Zhang Hui's gaze was fixed on Yin Qing below. The latter was already halfway up the mountain. ‘As long as she takes another step forward…’
Gu Nan, however, smiled. "I'm afraid it's too late."
Right as his words fell, Zhang Hui and the others' expressions changed simultaneously, because an indistinct sword intent had already reached them.
Yin Qing remained in the same spot and didn’t actually take that fatal step forward, yet her sword intent had already reached her enemy.
"Qu Hongye." Her will was composed entirely of sword intent, yet it clearly conveyed this message, as if there really was a person standing in front of them.
Qu Hongye's face paled slightly. The education she received never included sword intent, much less actually conveying a will through something like sword intent.
However, Gu Nan stepped forward at this time and appeared in front of Qu Hongye, blocking the attack and instantly severing all the sword intent.
The sword intent that seemed incomparably metaphysical to others was as clear as a beacon to Gu Nan's eyes.
However, he was secretly shaking his head at this time. Qu Hongye's performance wasn’t satisfactory enough for him.
Xue Ren used the method of cultivating scientists to train his heir, resulting in Qu Hongye's ability still having flaws. Perhaps time could be used to make up for it, but Gu Nan didn’t have that time.
In contrast, Gu Nan much preferred to use probability to select his apostles—if he raised a hundred people, then at least one person among them would stand out.
If a hundred wasn’t enough, then a thousand or even ten thousand. Human life was the most worthless thing in this world.
After making up his mind, Gu Nan no longer cared about Qu Hongye so much anymore. His gaze shifted down the mountain, turning somewhat cold and ruthless.
He didn’t want to waste any more time here.
Lou Wanying and the winged man—Yan Yang—also reached Yin Qing's side by this point. The latter warned coldly, "Do not take another step forward."
Before Lou Wanying could respond, Yan Yang had already stepped back with a swish. His movement was so exaggerated that it gave people a theatrical feeling.
"Hmph! I already knew that this Sword Sect isn’t a good place! To think there was actually a trap, how despicable and shameless!" Yan Yang muttered quickly under his breath. The speed of his words made Lou Wanying feel that it was perhaps even faster than his sword speed.
Yin Qing, however, wasn’t in the mood for jokes and told them in a heavy voice, "It's very dangerous. You two go back."
Only when she said these words did Lou Wanying and Yan Yang truly feel stunned. Even with Yan Yang’s personality, he was still surprised to hear this from the mouth of his Boss.
The next moment, Yin Qing brazenly drew her sword. The surging sword intent almost seemed to sever the sky and cut down the sun, moon, and stars.
But what descended from the sky was simply a fist.
The collision was entirely silent. Lou Wanying and his friend only felt their hearts sink, as if a heavy weight was pressing down on them, leaving them unable to breathe.
Yet the sword containing Yin Qing's full power also impaled that fist, traveling through the wrist, bones, and all the way to the shoulder before it tore out of the opponent’s body.
But even so, a small portion of the fist’s terrifying strength remained.
Yin Qing's sword-wielding right hand instantly burst apart, and blood spurted wildly from her mouth. Gu Nan's figure was standing there quietly in front of her.
His right hand had a longsword stuck in it, which looked a bit comical, but no one could laugh right now.
Because Gu Nan was currently casually raising his left hand, pulling the longsword out, and then casually tossing it onto the ground.
Immediately after that, the injury on his right hand started to heal.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Protection Of Nine Stars
chapters.content:
Yin Qing's swordsmanship was very strong.
This kind of powerhouse who focused on one path had a system that was inherently more logically consistent than other Star Rulers.
So Yin Qing was still considered a powerful figure even among Star Rulers, unless she happened to run into a Star Ruler with an astral world.
But it was extremely unfortunate that Gu Nan’s abilities completely countered any powers that relied on sword intent or will.
As long as the attack couldn’t destroy his Evil God physique, Gu Nan was equivalent to an immortal existence. Moreover, he also didn’t fear consecutive hits, because no one could catch up to him.
"Gu Nan!" Lou Wanying naturally recognized the other party in one glance, and the flames of rage in his eyes almost spewed out.
He and Gu Nan had crossed paths many times before.
He still considered the other party a teammate back when they went to Nirvana Heaven together, and later, he even wanted to invite Gu Nan along when heading to the Time Arena.
Despite being rejected at that time, the relationship between the two didn’t deteriorate—that is, until Gu Nan struck and killed Luo Ze, then beat up Lou Wanying to within an inch of his life and stole the sand of time.
Gu Nan had already become a bandit in the current Lou Wanying’s eyes—an enemy he held an extremely deep grudge against.
And in Gu Nan's words, his favorability with the other party had already fallen into the negatives.
Lou Wanying didn’t expect to see Gu Nan again in Extreme Sword Heaven’s Sword Sect. Even worse, he didn't expect that not even Yin Qing could stop the other party!
"Boss!" Yan Yang's expression changed wildly as he ran forward to help Yin Qing up and shot Gu Nan a vicious glare.
While Yan Yang did have a nasty personality, his many years of friendship with Yin Qing wasn’t fake.
Lou Wanying even shouted, "Gu Nan, whatever attacks you have, just direct them all at me. Those two have nothing to do with this matter!"
After Lou Wanying finished, he rushed forward without hesitation and pulled out a small box from his clothes and threw it out. A layer of fine powder started to drift in the air.
"You guys get out of here!" Lou Wanying told the two behind him.
Yan Yang didn’t have time to think. He opened a space passage with a wave of his hand and helped Yin Qing inside.
"You will all die." Gu Nan, however, only had a cold smile on his face as he stepped into that powder with one step. His figure was actually completely unhindered.
Yin Qing was only injured and had yet to lose consciousness, so she immediately stopped in her tracks when she saw this, planning to turn back and aid Lou Wanying.
But Yan Yang hastily dragged her back while urging, "Boss, what are you doing? That Lou Wanying kid is blessed with great luck. Normal people can’t hurt him."
It wasn’t like they’ve only known Lou Wanying for a day. They knew a long time ago that he enjoyed profound luck and fortune. Who knows which powerful figure was secretly backing Lou Wanying? So he wouldn’t be killed that easily.
Of course, Lou Wanying himself didn’t know this. He was currently watching Gu Nan’s punch fall down with a bitter smile on his face.
‘Brother Yan, Big Sis Yin, it seems that your little brother will be the first to leave this world…’ Lou Wanying thought helplessly in his heart.
However, right at that time, a white light suddenly flashed on his chest. Nine bright dots floated up out of thin air, forming a strange array.
……
Lu Wen sat in a chair above the endless sky, while a woman in Daoist robes stood in front of him.
She was none other than Yu Lian, the Star Ruler of Void Grotto Heaven. However, the two were currently inside Lu Wen’s Clockwork Heaven.
"Your people took my sect’s inheritance. Lu Wen, you went too far!"
Yu Lian glared at Lu Man coldly. Her words weren’t polite at all. In terms of seniority, she was much older than Lu Wen, and she was also quite strong, so there was naturally no need for her to be polite.
Lu Wen, however, just replied with a smile, "Lou Wanying is just a friend of mine. How is he one of my people?"
Of course Yu Lian wouldn’t bother to argue over sophistry with him here and sneered, "Good. I hope you can still say that when I kill him."
When it came to Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance, even someone with Yu Lian’s status no longer had the leisure to worry about losing face from bullying those weaker than her.
In fact, when one reached the level of the Thirteen Heavens, it was more about whether they themselves felt something was worth doing rather than what onlookers would think.
They could simply kill anyone who objected.
But Lu Wen’s expression remained unchanged as he shook his head slightly. "I’m afraid normal people won’t be able to harm him… And Xue Ren also has a matter to attend to recently, doesn’t he?"
Xue Ren and Yu Lian’s relationship wasn’t really a secret. But since Lu Wen brought Xue Ren up at this juncture, it was clear that Lu Wen was the one who created the trouble that Xue Ren had to deal with.
Yu Lian remained silent for a while when a smile suddenly appeared on her formerly blank face.
"Xue Ren has been called the Sword Saint for so many years. I’m afraid you all forgot that he was known for his infallible schemes when he was young."
After saying that, Yu Lian's figure vanished from Clockwork Heaven, returning to the spot within Void Grotto Heaven where she and Xue Ren conversed earlier.
Of course Xue Ren was no longer here, but the note he left behind was still there.
[Capture Lou Wanying when nine stars appear to obtain the inheritance]
"Regarding this matter, please ask Junior Martial Brother Xu to make a trip," Yu Lian's voice echoed within Void Grotto Heaven.
"Yes."
……
In Extreme Sword Heaven, the nine bright dots in front of Lou Wanying glowed brightly and actually formed a strange array, shielding him from Gu Nan.
And as the array took shape, the true appearances of these nine bright dots were also revealed.
They were nine people, all with different appearances. Children and adults, men and women, young and old—all of them could be found here. The common feature was that they were all Star Rulers.
Nine veritable Star Rulers!
Among these nine figures, Gu Nan saw the recently-deceased Qiao Deyu and also Rendering Mountain Venerable, the Star Ruler of Mountain River World.
Although he didn’t recognize the others, from this alone, it wasn’t difficult to conclude that these nine people all crossed paths with Lou Wanying at some point.
The nine spirits all had blank expressions as they entered a formation of five in front and four at the back, protecting Lou Wanying from harm.
Yan Yang couldn’t help exclaiming from the back, "Amazing! So the ‘Protection of Nine Stars’ that old man mentioned actually refers to nine genuine Star Rulers!"
After witnessing this, Yan Yang was longer in a hurry to escape with Yin Qing. Sure enough, Lou Wanying didn’t let him down and summoned nine Star Rulers at once. Was there any place he couldn’t visit now that he had this power?
What he didn't notice was that a man in black Daoist robes was already standing in the shadows, gazing coldly at Lou Wanying.
As long as Lou Wanying took a step back and left the protective formation’s range, he would be captured in one fell swoop.
Among the nine stars, the leader was none other than Rendering Mountain Venerable, a Star Ruler whose peak power once approached that of a Realm Level plane.
In his spirit state, he no longer recognized Gu Nan, but he still possessed Rendering Mountain Venerable’s strength and personality.
"Protection of Nine Stars!" Rendering Mountain Venerable shouted coldly as he smashed his fists down on Gu Nan, carrying the terrifying power of entire mountains behind them.
The remaining eight Star Rulers also didn’t remain idle. Almost simultaneously, they also attacked with their signature moves.
Gu Nan's eyes were indifferent as he watched Rendering Mountain Venerable’s fists fall with unparalleled momentum and suddenly raised his foot, kicking his opponent squarely in the abdomen.
Back then, a Tier 4 saint clone paired with Tier 6 laws was enough to shut Rendering Mountain Venerable down.
But now Gu Nan’s true body was here, and the power of the Evil God physique was even stronger than laws. How could Rendering Mountain Venerable resist?
The enemy who seemed to have the momentum of a crushing mountain mere seconds ago flew backwards at an even faster speed in the blink of an eye.
On the other side, Gu Nan’s figure flickered a little as he vanished. When he next appeared, he’d already bypassed the remaining eight Star Rulers and pounced on Lou Wanying.
Lou Wanying hurriedly retreated in shock. Thus, the figure of the black-robed Daoist also emerged behind him and caught him with one hand.
A cold laugh rang from his mouth. "You sure have a lot of guts to steal my Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance… Why don’t you come with this Daoist for a trip?"
He knocked Lou Wanying unconscious with his palm, then smiled at the Gu Nan who was rushing over. "Many thanks for your help today, Daoist Friend. Void Grotto Heaven will prepare a generous reward in the future… Bastard!"
The black-robed Daoist's words turned sharply, but Gu Nan didn’t even spare him a glance as he threw a punch at Lou Wanying’s head. The latter’s head instantly burst open. The bloody mist splashed the black-robed Daoist square in the face.

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Protect Gu Nan
chapters.content:
"The kid that Lu Wen is raising is dead."
"Lou Wanying?"
"Yeah."
This was the first thing Xue Ren heard when he returned to Void Grotto Heaven. This Sword Saint whom Yu Lian described as having "infallible schemes" missed the mark this time.
It happened inside his Extreme Sword Heaven, so it took Xue Ren very little time to learn what had transpired there.
"Gu Nan? How interesting." Xue Ren couldn’t help chuckling involuntarily after he understood the full picture. "Lu Wen really suffered a big loss this time."
He originally thought that by letting Gu Nan force out Lou Wanying’s trump card, Yu Lian's subordinate would then be able to take advantage of the opportunity to capture Lou Wanying and acquire the ancient Void Grotto Heaven's inheritance.
Of course it was impossible for Yu Lian to personally make a move. People at their level were too powerful—every move they made was sure to be sensed by powerhouses of the same level.
As soon as Yu Lian tried to attack, Lu Wen would most certainly stop her immediately, and vice versa. It wasn’t easy to say what the outcome would be, but once matters escalated to that point, a lot more people and forces would be drawn into the conflict.
However, now that Lou Wanying died at Gu Nan’s hands, the inheritance Yu Lian wanted also disappeared, but she wasn’t too concerned about that.
It wasn’t like there was only one inheritance inside the Void Ruins. Besides, wasn’t Void Grotto Heaven still one of the Thirteen Heavens, even after all these years? Their ancient predecessors’ inheritance might not necessarily be strong.
The crucial point was that it must not fall into an outsider’s hands. This was a matter of face, as well as maintaining the secrecy of her sect’s core techniques.
More importantly, as Xue Ren said, Lu Wen really lost a lot from Lou Wanying’s death!
"Lu Wen prepared a lot of things for that kid over the years." A rare smile appeared on Yu Lian’s usually indifferent face. "There’s only a one-third chance—how is he so sure that Lou Wanying is that person's son?"
Someone on Yu Lian’s level naturally understood why Lu Wen took such pains to raise Lou Wanying while never personally coming into contact with Lou Wanying at the same time.
It was precisely because of this that Lou Wanying actually died for real this time. Lu Wen wasn’t a god capable of casually resurrecting a person he’d never met before.
"She was still alive back when Lu Wen ascended to the ranks of the Thirteen Heavens. It’s not impossible for him to know some inside information." Xue Ren said, "Besides, the other two possible candidates are a little too unreliable."
Yu Lian didn’t care too much about it. Anyhow, even if that person really did revive and return from the River of Time, then she’d only be marginally stronger than Yu Lian. This wasn’t enough reason for Yu Lian to fear the other party.
No one at the level of the Thirteen Heavens would actually die that easily. Even for powerhouses like them, killing an enemy at their level would still be exceptionally difficult.
"Pay attention to that Gu Nan and protect him." Yu Lian then said to Xue Ren, "Don’t let anyone kill him. I will keep an eye on Lu Wen."
Lu Wen suddenly made a move on the Void Ruins and plotted to steal the ancient Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance—this was simply slapping the entire Void Grotto Heaven in the face.
Now that his plan was ruined by Gu Nan, of course Yu Lian was happy to protect Gu Nan to disgust Lu Wen from time to time.
"Okay." Xue Ren nodded. His gaze flickered slightly in thought.
……
Lu Wen sat alone in a place atop Clockwork Heaven. Neither joy nor anger could be seen from his face.
But the mere fact that he was "alone" was enough to indicate there was a problem—even when conversing with Yu Lian, a huge dragon was still perched on his shoulder, but now Long Ling'er was sitting obediently below him.
"Is the problem very serious?" Long Ling'er looked at Lu Wen's expression, then glanced at Duan Wenqi beside her, and couldn't help asking.
Duan Wenqi was one of the representatives of Astral Gate, a powerful Star Ruler, and also Lu Wen’s close friend.
As a matter of fact, he was the one who handled a lot of the matters involving Lou Wanying, so he was the first to sense that something had happened to Lou Wanying.
Then he immediately rushed over.
"It’s very serious." Duan Wenqi revealed a bitter smile and told Long Ling'er, "It's not as simple as a problem anymore. It's now a calamity."
Problems could be solved, but calamities couldn’t—they could only be endured.
Duan Wenqi knew just how much preparation Lu Wen had made for Lou Wanying and over how many years his plans spanned.
Only then was he able to hide this from others in the Thirteen Heavens and bring Lou Wanying under his control, and only when he was close to success right now did he finally allow everything to come out into the light.
But all of this was ruined because of one Gu Nan!
Lou Wanying was dead. Even if they resurrected him, because they never came into contact with his true spirit, it was impossible for the revived Lou Wanying to be the same as the original.
When that woman returned, would she still recognize the resurrected Lou Wanying as her son?
Thinking of this, Duan Wenqi couldn't help remarking, "Gu Nan killed her son. When she returns, not even Yu Lian will be able to protect him."
But his voice only echoed in the hall. Lu Wen didn’t respond, while Long Ling'er stared at them curiously.
Their conversation was incomprehensible to Long Ling'er. Perhaps she had enough information to understand, but she never bothered to spare the effort to analyze it.
Duan Wenqi mistook Lu Wen’s silence as being unable to hold back the anger in his heart, so Duan Wenqi stood up and said, "Since we can’t find Gu Nan, we can start with his people in White Bones Realm first!"
Only then did Lu Wen's gaze gradually regain focus. He replied slowly, "No need."
Duan Wenqi was also relieved to see him finally willing to speak. However, he still felt bad for his old friend, and his tone was tinged with some indignation, "Don’t tell me we’ll just allow Gu Nan to go on like this?"
"Of course… not." There was a strange glint in Lu Wen’s eyes, "Not only can we not harm Gu Nan right now, but we must also protect him carefully. We absolutely mustn’t let him die.”
"And why is that?" Now Duan Wenqi was truly shocked.
"Since he killed Lou Wanying, he now inherited this karma." Lu Wen explained unhurriedly, "When she returns, perhaps this Gu Nan might have a better effect on her than Lou Wanying."
……
Setting aside the two Thirteen Heavens level Unified Dao Realm Star Rulers who both decided to protect Gu Nan, the culprit himself immediately slipped back inside his Divine Kingdom as soon as he killed Lou Wanying.
True, he didn’t have to put the Thirteen Heavens in his eyes—in any case, as long as he didn’t cause a commotion, no one would know which plane he was in.
But if he still courted death by remaining in the same place after killing someone, then that would be just dumb.
As for Qu Hongye, Gu Nan already added her to the list of abandoned candidates after he determined that she had insufficient potential.
Unlike experimental test subjects like Zhong Die, the members of a real player army had to be strictly selected, and even their origins had to be screened.
Because it would naturally be the most convenient for members of the player army to become Gu Nan’s apostles. Be it the Time Arena or the Apostle Hall, both could significantly strengthen their powers.
After settling the matter in Extreme Sword Heaven, Gu Nan heard some good news not long after he returned to the Divine Kingdom.
The two groups of vampires raiding Crescent Moon World both cleared the Crescent Moon World dungeon on the same day, which meant Gu Nan finally had a second stable source of points!

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Transmigration
chapters.content:
The points earned from Crescent Moon World would be much higher than from Splendid World.
This was something Gu Nan had long anticipated. After all, Crescent Moon World was a Tier 4 dungeon, and the difficulty was also much higher than Splendid World, almost reaching the limit of difficulty levels for Tier 4 dungeons.
But Gu Nan was still surprised when the results were presented in front of him.
The profit from clearing Crescent Moon World once was ten times higher than Splendid World!
Now that the Divine Kingdom had already reached Tier 6 and the Evil God Temple had reached Level 1, if he wanted to advance, then six Level 1 structures were needed, as well as one miracle structure.
Getting six Level 1 structures was relatively simple. The previously constructed Level 0 structures could all be upgraded to Level 1 by spending 20,000 points.
But a miracle structure was slightly more troublesome. Launching a Divine Kingdom War was inevitable.
It took several months for Gu Nan to construct six Level 0 structures earlier, but now, he could upgrade one structure to Level 1 almost every three days.
Even if he had to build a completely new Level 1 structure, it would take at most five days.
Only this order of magnitude of points was enough to sustain the expenses of a Divine Kingdom War.
The second dungeon was enough to bring the logistics up to par, which made Gu Nan relatively cheerful. In the game, a large number of people sometimes couldn't afford to launch a war, even after building almost ten dungeons.
So the wealthy Classmate Gu Nan waved his hand and sent all six meritorious vampires into the Time Arena, spending a large amount of points on them to help them improve their strength considerably.
But neither did Gu Nan forget the Tier 3 mission experts clearing Splendid World because of this.
After all, the vast majority of dungeons didn’t test one’s strength. Crescent Moon World was just a special case.
If there were new high-difficulty dungeons in the future, they might still be needed to clear those.
After dealing with his subordinates, Gu Nan's gaze soon fell on the "Divine Servant Institute" structure. The Divine Servant Institute was the core of the Divine Kingdom Wars, because divine servants were the soldiers.
To fight a proper Divine Kingdom War, selecting the right types of soldiers and the precise ratio of soldier types was sometimes more important than the tactics on the battlefield.
Theoretically, as long as the quantity and quality of soldiers were up to par, even a pig could win a war.
Gu Nan sat in the middle of the Divine Kingdom. The ones who should be farming dungeons were farming, while the ones who should be managing the Divine Kingdom were busy managing it. Only Gu Nan rifled through documents for several days in a row.
The information was sent over by Red Tail from White Bones Realm. They all pertained to some small planes.
But even if they were small planes, these planes all shared one common feature—they were controlled by Star Rulers!
An astral world with an owner was completely different from an ownerless plane.
With an ownerless plane, no matter how much you messed it up, nobody would come after you. After all, the world’s will was just a will.
And a will couldn’t interfere with reality. This was the socialist materialistic view.
But an astral world with an owner was different—if you caused even a small commotion, the Star Ruler would probably find you directly.
For Star Rulers of small planes, the death of every single one of their inhabitants or cultivators may directly affect their power.
Killing their people was equivalent to weakening their power. It was no different from killing their father.
But it was extremely unfortunate that the target of the Divine Kingdom War could only be a Star Ruler’s astral world.
After all, the ultimate goal of the war was to slay a god. If the plane didn’t even have a god in the first place, then what would be the point of a war?
Even in the Myriad Heavens Universe, it was still the same.
Gu Nan was now looking for the right plane to be his next target.
As long as he could successfully destroy the target plane and kill the reigning Star Ruler, he would be able to earn a large quantity of points and Evil Value from the Divine Servant Institute.
This was the role of the Divine Servant Institute, the core structure of the Divine Kingdom War gameplay.
But Gu Nan had yet to decide on exactly what type of divine servants to train. It depended on the target plane; he would try to pick soldier types that held an advantage against the plane’s inhabitants.
Gu Nan still didn’t find a perfect target even after a few days, only a few he could try.
"In the end, this is too rushed." Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head a little.
Normally, there were very few players who could fight a war so quickly. Many would only have the chance to launch their first war upon reaching Tier 8.
The reason was simple: while there was certainly a difference in the types of soldiers divine servants could be, their absolute strength was limited by the structure’s level.
At most, Gu Nan could only build a Level 1 "Barracks" right now, so the soldiers produced by it naturally weren’t too strong.
Fortunately, after taking control of the Raymond clan, he had quite a few Tier 4 subordinates. Otherwise, it would be even harder to fight a Divine Kingdom War—after all, this was an event he couldn’t directly intervene in.
The gameplay for a Divine Kingdom War was to conquer other planes through the Divine Servant Institute. The player could only join the fight when it was "king against king" time, or else the earnings would be greatly reduced.
Since they couldn’t find a suitable plane to attack, Gu Nan could only tell Red Tail to continue narrowing down possible planes, while he himself began to prepare the player army plan.
The core of the player army vision was to create a group of people with great potential and under Gu Nan's control, preferably with a player's mentality.
The last point was harder to accomplish, but it was also fine to just have the first two.
It was just like how normal forces picked good seedlings. Gu Nan quickly communicated the requirements to his many apostles, asking them to collect suitable candidates.
What Gu Nan didn't expect was for Yan Xiaoxiao to be the first one to speak up.
"There’s a very good seedling in the Divine Kingdom. He’s from the Western Continent," Yan Xiaoxiao recommended calmly.
Because of Gu Nan's influence, they were now getting used to the term "Divine Kingdom."
Gu Nan showed some interest and asked, "How good?"
"He’s the champion of the latest Continental Martial Arts Tournament and is 29 years old."
"A late bloomer, huh?" Gu Nan commented with a raised eyebrow.
