In the Immortal Demon World that became Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom, the power system wasn’t very high, so those who reached the peak of their power here were often younger.
Gu Nan recalled that in the previous several Continental Martial Arts Tournaments, let alone the champion, the top three were rarely over 25 years of age.
Yan Xiaoxiao, however, seemed to have great confidence in this person. She revealed a small smile and replied, "Teacher, you’ll definitely be satisfied after you see him."
……
This world had never lacked talents, even more so when the population had swelled to the point where "world" was used as a unit of measurement.
Liang Ruxin stood in front of the doors to the Evil God Temple. His middle-aged face contained some surprise, but for the most part, he was calm.
He had good reason to be calm. In his under thirty years of life, he’d already experienced several ups and downs. Now that he’d won the Continental Martial Arts Tournament again, he could say that his life was complete.
If there was still one thing he wanted to know, then it would probably be…
Before Liang Ruxin had time to think more, he suddenly felt his vision go dark as his consciousness was instantly extracted. By the time he woke up again, it was inside a very different world.
"Teacher?" Yan Xiaoxiao stood beside Gu Nan, staring at the scene in shock. She personally witnessed Gu Nan send Liang Ruxin directly to another plane without even meeting him first.
"To see a person's true nature, nothing is better than a completely unfamiliar environment." Gu Nan turned his head and smiled lightly. "By the way, start looking for someone to write some novels and spread them among the Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants."
"What kind of novels?"
"Transmigration novels."

chapters.title: Chapter 379: Prelude To The Divine Kingdom War
chapters.content:
The fundamental goal behind having people spread transmigration novels inside the Divine Kingdom was to disseminate the concept of "transmigration.”
In the current Divine Kingdom, the antagonism between the Eastern and Western Continents had been completely established. The arrangement Gu Nan conceived back then was carried out by Yan Xiaoxiao and the others without fail.
From the time the inhabitants were born—before they could even read and write—the concept of "Martial Arts Tournaments" was constantly instilled in them.
Victory in a Martial Arts Tournament was both an individual and collective honor bestowed by society. In the Divine Kingdom, everyone’s goal was to win, win, and win again.
If one was strong enough and defeated enough opponents, they could gain social status, cultivation resources, and the power to control others.
Anything else was merely a derivative of those three things.
People who grew up in this kind of society hardly had time to ponder the meaning of their lives and the identity of the mastermind behind all this.
Many people believed the legend that a god was using this method to select the strongest person in the world.
As for why such an Eastern society had the concept of a “god,” one would have to ask Lan Si.
Loyalty to Gu Nan would be guaranteed for talents cultivated in this environment. At least to a large extent, they had no room to refuse.
Which was why Gu Nan dared to use the "transmigration" method to test Liang Ruxin’s "quality." In fact, this kind of method might even work better.
Of course, in order to ensure that all future candidates immediately understand what to do in this kind of situation, it was essential to spread the concept of “transmigration.”
The plane Gu Nan picked for Liang Ruxin wasn’t just randomly selected. Rather, it was one of several alternative target planes for the first war.
……
Jin Lin World.
Liang Ruxin stared blankly at the scene before him. He was in the middle of a mountainous forest. Birds chirped overhead, and human figures could even be seen up ahead.
But he could confirm that he most certainly wasn’t in his original world anymore. The reason was simple—the Divine Kingdom didn’t have three suns.
Harsh sunlight shone down from the three suns in the sky, making Liang Ruxin feel like he couldn’t open his eyes for a while.
That was when a cold female voice rang in his ears.
[Ultimate Mission: Become the king of this state within one year
Mission Reward: Unknown
Mission Failure Penalty: Death]
……
After giving Liang Ruxin an "ultimate mission," Gu Nan calmly continued his work.
Gu Nan wasn’t a real system, nor did he have time to observe Liang Ruxin's every move, so he only gave Liang Ruxin an ultimate mission and then watched it gradually take effect.
Jin Lin World was an even smaller plane than the Divine Kingdom, so time flowed faster over there. A year over there might only be two or three months in the Divine Kingdom.
Speaking of which, as the Evil God Temple leveled up, Yan Xiaoxiao and Lan Si informed Gu Nan several times that the flow of time inside the Divine Kingdom showed signs of slowing down.
If the time flow ratio with the main world was 10:1 at first, then it was probably 9:1 now or even 8:1.
This wasn’t a bad thing. Perhaps once Gu Nan advanced to Tier 8 or Tier 9, the Divine Kingdom would ascend to the ranks of a Realm Level plane and could also be transformed into a main world.
At that time, the Divine Kingdom’s coordinates would naturally be exposed. It was impossible to hide Realm Level planes from everyone's eyes. Of course, at the same time, his Divine Kingdom would also enjoy all the conveniences of being a main world.
The most typical advantage was naturally the possibility of initiating reincarnation directly from inside the Divine Kingdom, so there would be no need for the White Mist branch in White Bones Realm to exist.
"There’s still a long way to go with the Divine Kingdom’s construction!" Gu Nan took in the entire Divine Kingdom’s situation with a glance and lamented.
This was, after all, the core gameplay for players who finished the First Round. It was also the most time-consuming stage for players, so of course the process couldn’t be simple.
Launching an outward invasion was inevitable, or else let alone points and Evil Value—he might not even have enough materials needed for construction.
The materials needed for certain Level 1 structures weren’t just limited to basic resources.
In order to find a suitable plane to invade, Liang Ruxin wasn’t the only “transmigrator” Gu Nan appointed.
In fact, Gu Nan first selected nearly ten planes, then sent out the candidates Yan Xiaoxiao and the others selected to scout these planes.
Of course Gu Nan didn’t have time to keep an eye on them all the time, but as the big boss, he had no problem telling his subordinates to handle it.
So he made use of the White Mist members in White Bones Realm once again, who became stalkers one after another, regularly reporting on these people’s situations.
There was no other way to deal with this.
All the planes Gu Nan selected had Star Rulers watching over them. Whether Gu Nan went in person or sent a Void Cutter, the local Star Ruler would immediately sense them.
Don't be fooled by how casually Gu Nan could kill normal Star Rulers—Star Rulers with and without an astral world were on two completely different levels, especially if fighting on that person’s home turf.
Many considered Star Rulers without an astral world to simply be powerful Void Cutters, and there really was nothing wrong with that statement.
But having an astral world meant they could easily mobilize the whole astral world’s power, and with an almost endless source of power, their explosive power would increase dramatically.
For example, if Gu Nan had forbidden Qu Hongye from taking people from Extreme Sword Heaven with her, overwhelming and slaughtering the native cultivators of Gale World, then Qiao Deyu would’ve been very powerful.
Even if Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was stronger than Qiao Deyu’s and he could receive a higher power boost, that only applied to a fair battle between the two; the battle absolutely couldn't take place in Gale World.
Just like how the former Zuo Zuo, who was at the peak of Tier 10 back then, ran to Star Realm to deal with a half-dead Red—the level gap between them was close to 2.5 tiers, yet he only managed to suppress her and couldn’t actually kill her.
Star Rulers received too much of a power boost in their own astral worlds, so much so that any battles between gods must first go through a Divine Kingdom War first. It was impossible for a direct fight before then.
Otherwise, things would get pretty troublesome once the enemy hid inside their own astral world.
Of course, it wasn’t like Star Rulers could mobilize the power of their astral worlds whenever they wanted. Every use was an enormous loss for the astral world. Unless it was a matter of life and death, nobody was willing to use such power casually.
Due to this series of reasons, Gu Nan couldn’t directly deal with the astral world’s Star Ruler and could only slowly chip away at them through weaker methods first.
Divine Kingdom Wars had never been about a group of soldiers shouting battle cries as they rushed into battle.
Preliminary investigation, soldier type selection, undercover infiltration, provoking civil unrest, and even internal and external cooperation were all a matter of course.
From the instant Gu Nan decided to fight, the war had already begun.
But just as Gu Nan sent a bunch of people out and waited for news, Red Tail sent him a message first.
"Xue Ren wants to see me?" After Gu Nan received this message, he considered for a moment but didn’t refuse.
He had to hide from the "furious" Lu Wen for a while, so of course his true body couldn’t show up, but it wasn’t a problem to use a clone to meet up.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: The Reason The Heaven-God Alliance Exists
chapters.content:
Extreme Sword Heaven.
Xue Ren was still the same Xue Ren, and Qu Hongye was still the same Qu Hongye, but Gu Nan had changed bodies.
Now he was dressed in a silver robe, having arrived using the saint clone.
"Quite an interesting clone." Xue Ren couldn’t help chuckling when he glanced at Gu Nan's saint clone. With his insight, it wasn’t hard to discern some of the saint clone’s origins.
"Someone said you came from that side. Looks like it's true." Xue Ren, who was familiar with the World of Gods, was able to glean even more information from the saint clone.
Since Qu Hongye wasn’t here right now, this was the first time the two discussed matters related to the Heaven-God Alliance.
Gu Nan raised an eyebrow and asked, "Did Wu Gui tell you that?"
Xue Ren, however, shook his head. "I am acquainted with the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara, but we don’t know each other well.”
With the other party's status, he was unlikely to lie about such things. Thus, another person’s name popped up in Gu Nan's mind. "Then it's Zi Dian?"
Sure enough, Xue Ren revealed a small smile. "More accurately, it was his mother, Zi Yi, who relayed this to me. That I was able to become a cultivator back then was also thanks to Senior Zi Yi."
Gu Nan frowned slightly, although his brain was already trying to sort out the relationship between all these Star Rulers… Forget it, the relationship was too complicated; he was too lazy to think.
But figuring out the approximate timeline was still pretty easy.
On Zuo Zuo's side, he was contemporaries with Zi Yi and Red. Xue Ren, on the other hand, was in almost the same generation as the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara, which meant they were both a bit younger than Zi Yi and the others.
As for how many generations of a gap existed between the two groups or how many tens of thousands of years the gap was, those were of no concern to Gu Nan.
"What did you want to see me for?" Gu Nan asked, changing the subject. He wasn’t interested in elaborating on his own origins.
Let them guess. No one would guess it anyway.
Xue Ren's expression turned serious. "Since you’ve joined the Heaven-God Alliance, I must tell you the reason this organization was established."
Gu Nan also became slightly serious as well. Matters concerning the Heaven-God Alliance had always been of great interest to him.
"Simply put, the Heaven-God Alliance has only one goal, and that is to reach Unified Dao Realm." Xue Ren explained calmly, "To use the term over there, it’s to ascend to a greater god."
Without waiting for Gu Nan to respond, Xue Ren added, "You should know that there are many paths in the world that lead straight to the great Dao, but only one person can take each path."
Gu Nan nodded. Of course he knew that. The vast majority of conflicts between the greater gods stemmed from this.
Because of this, the Beast God was even replaced multiple times.
There was no other way. Compared to other gods who could still become a greater god by taking a detour, there was only one path for every generation’s Beast God who wanted to reach the top, which was to kill their predecessor.
The problem of overlapping fundamental laws wasn’t so easily resolved by something as simple as just a slight deviation.
For example, if the God of Wind wanted to advance, but if there was already a God of Air among the greater gods, then it was bound to be extremely hard for the former to ascend.
"Among the Thirteen Heavens, there is one called Weapon Martial Heaven." Xue Ren's voice became somewhat heavy, "Weapon Martial Heaven’s Zou Jiming controls all the weapons and martial arts in this world."
"All martial arts cultivators and weapon cultivators are subject to his influence when they attempt to break through to Unified Dao Realm, including me."
Gu Nan instantly understood what he meant and blurted out, "So you want to run to the World of Gods to enter Unified Dao Realm?"
"That's right." Xue Ren grinned. "The God of War on that side isn’t in the same power system as us at all. At the very least, his influence would be far less than Zou Jiming."
Gu Nan laughed involuntarily. It had to be said that none of these famous Star Rulers were fools.
The two sides’ respective differences and advantages had long been thoroughly analyzed by them, and they even thought of using such loopholes to strengthen themselves.
"So you’re going to break through now?" Gu Nan asked in amusement.
With Gu Nan, something as momentous as becoming a greater god sounded as simple as eating a casual meal.
But Xue Ren didn’t care. He just replied, "I'm not that fast… But it’s true that someone is going to ascend, and you might even know this person."
"Who?"
"Rolensia."
……
Frontline plane, Heavenly Province World.
It wasn’t the first time Gu Nan visited Heavenly Province World, so he was slightly familiar with it.
However, he didn’t visit in his original body this time, but in an extremely well-hidden clone.
The saint clone was fully wrapped in a black robe, while a familiar silver mask covered his face. If he didn’t attack, almost no one would recognize Gu Nan.
Gu Nan made this trip over to meet Rolensia.
The God of Luxuriant Blossoms Rolensia, a powerful Tier 10 god on the same level as Xue Ren, was unexpectedly preparing to ascend. This was very much out of Gu Nan's expectations.
Because Rolensia advancing to a greater god had never happened even once in his years of gaming history.
In other words, what caused Rolensia to make this choice was entirely due to the existence of the Myriad Heavens Universe.
It would be extremely difficult for her to advance in the World of Gods because among the twelve greater gods, there was one called the Goddess of Nature.
The Goddess of Nature controlled all natural living beings and was also known as the "God of Flowers and Leaves" in ancient times, which was in direct conflict with Rolensia's divine authority.
Although it wasn’t so bad as to completely block Rolensia’s path to advancement, it still made it much more difficult.
In contrast, coming to the Myriad Heavens Universe to advance was a good choice.
But with Rolensia's power and status, it wasn’t an easy task to quietly enter the Myriad Heavens Universe.
As long as she made any abnormal movement, the greater gods would immediately become aware of it. And once she entered the Myriad Heavens Universe, she would also be noticed by the Thirteen Heavens.
Who knows if someone in the Thirteen Heavens would leak this information to the greater gods?
This was a matter of course. If Rolensia broke through to Unified Dao Realm inside the Myriad Heavens Universe, then wasn’t that the same as stealing a limited spot from this side?
This matter could be said to be detrimental to the collective interests of the Myriad Heavens Universe, so only people who belonged to the same Heaven-God Alliance would be willing to help her.
Heavenly Province World was a highly modernized technology plane. Gu Nan was now sitting in a delicately furnished cafe. The drink in front of him was steaming hot but hadn’t been touched.
Combined with his all-black robe, he really looked out of place.
But Gu Nan just sat there calmly until a man in a black suit hurriedly walked in and saw Gu Nan at a glance.
It couldn’t be helped; Gu Nan’s getup really was a bit flashy.
The corners of the man’s mouth twitched slightly as he reluctantly walked up to Gu Nan and whispered, "Mr. Gu?"
"Mm." Gu Nan nodded, spoke a string of numbers, and gently scratched out a seal with his hand.
The man breathed a sigh of relief and also nodded slightly. This was the secret code the two sides agreed upon. The numbers and seal both had to match before he could hand over the item to the other party.
What Gu Nan received was a small box wrapped up in black cloth.
He stared down at it. It was hard to imagine that a powerful Tier 10 god was hidden inside this box, even if it was just a part of her.
"Where are the other two?" Gu Nan's gaze shifted slightly and landed on the man's face.
"With my companion. She'll be over soon… Damn it!" Halfway through the man's sentence, he suddenly paused, because voices were coming in continuously from his wireless headset.
A short while later, he looked at Gu Nan again and said, "I'm very sorry. There's a little situation on my companion's side, please—"
"It was robbed? Does someone know what you’re transporting?"
"No, no." The man hastily waved his hand. "It should be a habitual bandit. Sometimes they don't even need to know what the cargo is. As long as it's something important, they can always sell it for a good price after snatching it."
Gu Nan's eyes narrowed as he said in a cold voice, "That makes sense… Take me there."
The man immediately revealed a troubled look and stood up. "Sir, the members and routes are our company’s internal secrets."
Gu Nan looked up indifferently. That gaze was as if he was staring at a dead person.
A few moments later, Gu Nan walked out of the cafe, a shadowy figure leading the way in front of him, while the cafe was already dead silent. No sounds of life could be heard anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 381: Box
chapters.content:
Scenes of the bustling city kept passing by Gu Nan on the noisy street. Still hidden within a strange black robe, he walked quickly through the crowd.
Neither did Gu Nan intentionally look for trouble—the shadow servant had turned into a lump of shadows, quietly sticking to the ground, unbeknownst to anyone.
As for Gu Nan himself, his dress was a bit eccentric, but a frontline plane like Heavenly Province World saw its fair share of people who dressed oddly or even looked strange.
Gu Nan followed the shadow servant through the streets and alleys and soon came to an isolated corner, but just as he turned into it, a shout came from behind him.
"Halt!"
Gu Nan turned his head and saw two police officers patrolling in plain clothes walking towards him with dark expressions. One of them had a hand on his waist, while the other was holding a cell phone, quickly talking into it.
Heavenly Province World was a very interesting place. Although its technology was advanced, it was metaphysical technology, which was a little different from pure scientific technology.
For example, the pistol that the policeman was about to pull out didn’t operate on the principle of gunpowder, but a high energy explosive bullet instead.
And the other person’s cell phone was even more different—in fact, this was the first time Gu Nan saw something like a cell phone outside of Star Realm.
It wasn’t that people didn’t like to use convenient things like cell phones. Rather, most of the planes in the Myriad Heavens Universe weren’t planets.
These planes’ structures all operated on the flat earth principle, so there were no satellites or base stations. Where would a cell phone get its signal?
Even the cell phones in Heavenly Province World didn’t necessarily use the principle of electromagnetic waves, but something more metaphysical.
Gu Nan's gaze swept over the two police officers… Technology wasn’t the only interesting thing in Heavenly Province World. Even the people here were interesting.
The two policemen in plain clothes were real plainclothes policemen. They wore identical uniforms with the word "plainclothes" written on them.
"Put your hands up." The plainclothes officer who had his hands at his waist said in a low voice, "We mean no harm, we just need to check your identity. Please cooperate with us, sir."
The next second, Gu Nan cooperated by throwing a punch, and two headless corpses slowly fell down.
"Very shoddy phones." Gu Nan picked up the phone from the corpse and glanced at it, then casually tossed it aside.
This thing wasn’t so much a cell phone as a walkie-talkie in the nature of a local area network. It was far less convenient than the instantaneous telepathic messages high-ranking cultivators could send.
After casually dealing with his two tails, Gu Nan looked up again. The shadow servant had stopped outside this courtyard wall, motionless.
So Gu Nan walked up, smashing through the wall without hesitation—although it wasn’t all that troublesome to take two extra steps to walk through the door, why would players take the door when they could demolish the wall instead?
The huge commotion Gu Nan made immediately startled the people inside.
A woman was hanging upside-down from a tree in the courtyard. She was covered with blood, and her entire body was tortured beyond recognition.
Her right hand was severed from the joints, and the flesh of her arm was also scraped away, leaving only ghastly white bones; her face was covered with knife cuts, and even half of her scalp had been torn off.
Several men were drinking wine in front of her, looking lively. Just as Gu Nan crashed in, one of them was still bellowing, "Where's the item?!"
"Where's the item?" Gu Nan's question was almost exactly the same as the man's, except his tone was a bit more bland.
No matter how one looked at it, the black-robed Gu Nan didn’t look like he was one to be messed with. The four men sitting together exchanged a glance, then simultaneously scattered and fled.
They’d long developed a tacit understanding—they had a tacit understanding when it came to killing the enemy, and even more so when it came to running for their lives.
But this was completely meaningless in front of Gu Nan. Four shadows simultaneously emerged behind them, grabbing them and throwing them into the endless shadows.
Gu Nan could deal with four measly Tier 3 opponents at will.
He leisurely walked up to one of the shadows, and on the ground beside it was an exquisite box.
Gu Nan didn’t actually need to ask. The purpose of his inquiry was simply to confirm whether the item was in the four’s possession—if not, then surely they wouldn’t have fled so decisively.
However, just as Gu Nan was about to pick up the box, a blinding figure suddenly flashed across his eyes and snatched the box away.
"Hm?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows slightly and turned. He saw a young girl wearing light yellow casual clothes standing to the side. She waved the box in her hand at him.
This young girl looked at most 15 or 16 years old. She definitely fit the description of youthful and beautiful and even had a playful look on her face.
Even more surprising, her cultivation was already at the peak of Void Cutter Realm—the genuine peak; her laws were already close to complete, and she was only a step away from Star Ruler Realm.
But her strength had nothing to do with Gu Nan. He only knew that the woman in front of him stole his item.
So this young girl who gained a reputation for her speed watched as Gu Nan's figure flickered and instantly appeared in front of her. His left hand went to grab the box in her hand, while his right hand swung a fist down towards her abdomen.
The young lady in yellow had a stunned look on her face, but her reaction was also extremely fast, and her body responded simultaneously.
Her waist twisted strangely, and her whole body seemed to twist into a curve, forcibly dodging Gu Nan's punch, but she lost the box in her hand.
Gu Nan casually snatched the box away and also stared at her with some surprise.
At his level, people who could match him in close combat could be counted on one hand, even if they could only withstand one of his punches without dying.
After speed reached the extreme, any moves or techniques all seemed very meaningless.
But to put it bluntly, the only reason this girl could dodge his punch was because he was using a clone, so his cultivation was the same as the other party’s. If his main body came, then he most likely wouldn’t even need to use the Evil God physique.
"What's wrong with you? I’m also a member of the organization. How can you make a move without even asking a single question?" The young girl was still in shock, and seeing Gu Nan snatch the box back, she immediately exclaimed angrily.
"The organization even recruits Void Cutters?" Gu Nan indifferently swept her a glance and replied disdainfully. With his current realm, of course he could tell whether the other party was the true body or a clone.
And as a joint organization of Star Rulers and gods, it was only logical that there would be no members below Tier 5 in the Heaven-God Alliance.
"I… I am a reserve member!" The young girl glared back, then glanced at Gu Nan again. "Aren't you the same? You also received news that some goods were lost and rushed here to help, right?"
The young lady in yellow certainly couldn't tell Gu Nan’s identity as a clone and immediately made up an origin for him in her head.
Of course Gu Nan wouldn’t be so bored as to explain things to her. He walked straight to the woman who was hanging upside-down and asked, "Where’s the other box?"
This woman was at Prodigious Realm, so she didn’t die that easily, but the words that came out of her mouth made Gu Nan and the girl frown.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Lost
chapters.content:
"All I got was a box,” the almost-dead woman uttered these words with considerable difficulty.
“We’re the client." The young woman in yellow was a little anxious and even thought the other party didn’t believe their identities, so she added, "My name is Yu Shuyun. I— Are you crazy?!"
Classmate Yu Shuyun didn’t get to finish introducing herself when a shadow impaled the woman through the chest and dragged her corpse into the ground.
Gu Nan didn’t even spare Yu Shuyun a glance and quickly summoned a new shadow servant, asking it the same question.
But the answer left him very dissatisfied. This woman really only received one box.
“What… What in the world is going on here…?” Yu Shuyun roughly figured out what Gu Nan was doing, but she was equally unable to understand the result.
The gods on that side should’ve sent people to deliver the items to the gap between the two worlds, and their side then arranged for people from this company to take over.
Throughout the entire process, neither the gods nor the Star Rulers, as well as their subordinates, had too much direct contact to prevent the big shots above from noticing anything.
After all, their current operation would lead to an outcome that 25 powerful figures across the two sides didn’t want to see.
But now they lost a few boxes, so where did things go wrong?
"Hey, where are you going?" Yu Shuyun's brain was a muddle, but she quickly asked when she saw Gu Nan turn to leave.
"The rendezvous."
……
In a remote alley in Heavenly Province World, a skinny teenager was curled into a ball, hugging his knees while tears streamed down his face uncontrollably.
He was covered in filth and footprints. He’d just been bullied by some "old friends,” but his tears weren’t because of this.
A big yellow dog was lying at his side, but now it was already dying.
“Oh Da Huang, Da Huang! I never thought I would live longer than you,” the teen murmured as he stretched out a hand and petted the big yellow dog’s head.
The big yellow dog whimpered but could only make a weak sound, then used its remaining strength to push the object between the two.
Clearly laid out there was a small box of exquisite workmanship.
"You mean, this is for me?" The teenager spoke in a slight daze.
Although it looked quite expensive, he actually didn't like this box very much, but after all, this was something Da Huang used his life to get.
Since this was Da Huang’s will, it should be inherited properly. So the teen nodded his head forcefully. "I understand."
He stretched out a hand and opened the box without much effort, but there was nothing inside after removing the packaging.
“It’s actually empty…” The youth was a little disappointed. In that case, its only remaining value was the box itself.
However, just then, an inexplicable power burrowed into the teen's body, and a voice rang out in his head.
"What's your name?"
"Huh?! Me? My name is Dong Xun…”
……
"They lost them during the entry into Heavenly Province World."
A group of solemn-looking people stood around a pile of small boxes in a small hut, and the one who spoke was an old Daoist.
Gu Nan and Yu Shuyun were among them, while the one who spoke was Daoist Lingyang.
Of course, Daoist Lingyang's face was also masked. Gu Nan wouldn’t have recognized him if he didn’t meet Daoist Lingyang before.
The current group was none other than members of the Heaven-God Alliance. They were responsible for retrieving Rolensia’s scattered divine body and finding a way to reassemble her.
Everyone present wore masks, and all the official members came using clones. This was to prevent everyone from being taken out all at once in case there were traitors.
Now that box after box was retrieved, they discovered the problem—some boxes were missing, namely three.
"What kind of lousy security company is this? We must wipe them all out once this matter is over!" A burly man next to Daoist Lingyang exclaimed angrily.
After he said that, a silver-haired woman next to him laughed. ”We never intended to let them live in the first place."
"Now is not the time to argue about this." Daoist Lingyang said in a heavy voice, "Let's split up and look for them. If someone opens the box, the aura will be obvious."
Be it her Tier 10 power or her distinctive godly aura, both were a beacon to this crowd.
"We don't have much time,” another person said. This person was similar to Gu Nan, wrapped in black robes. Not even their gender could be seen.
Judging from the voice alone, this should be a woman.
Daoist Lingyang nodded. “That’s right. We have to leave in two days regardless of whether we can find all the boxes or not."
"What if we can't find all of them?" Someone asked from the back.
Daoist Lingyang was silent for a moment. “Losing a wisp of soul wouldn’t affect much."
……
After receiving Daoist Lingyang's instructions, members of the Heaven-God Alliance collectively went out to search for the three boxes whose whereabouts were unknown.
Since one of the boxes was lost in their area, Gu Nan and Yu Shuyun naturally followed this clue and started searching.
"Hey, wait,” Yu Shuyun shouted from behind Gu Nan, "I have a friend… Just wait up!"
From what Yu Shuyun could see, Gu Nan had no intention of waiting at all and quickly walked forward, ignoring her words as if he heard nothing.
Yu Shuyun stomped her foot in anger. She was a pampered genius who came from a large plane and was also quite young, so her personality was certainly not that calm.
"Shuyun, what's wrong?" A voice asked from beside her. A teenager had reached her side.
This teenager could be described as having red lips and white teeth, and with a flowing white coat. He looked like a fluttering beautiful boy.
“Ah Bu, you came just in time!" Yu Shuyun had always been energetic and pointed to Gu Nan. “Let's hurry. That guy is almost gone!"
The teenager followed Yu Shuyun's finger and could only see a blurred back.
"Didn't you tell him to wait?" The teenager asked in surprise.
"I shouted! He ignored me…”
"What an impolite fellow,” the teenager muttered as he took a step out, his figure appearing in front of Gu Nan.
Someone who could do such a thing without fanfare in this crowded street either had incredible speed or the ability to manipulate space.
Gu Nan raised his head. This was the second time he ran into someone who controlled space. The first time was the Dragon of Space.
But the other party’s identity didn't affect his attitude.
"Something the matter?"
The teen frowned slightly. The other party's attitude displeased him, but his fine upbringing made sure none of that displeasure showed on his face. “This humble one is Qi Bu, from Academic Heaven."
After saying this, he stood straight and waited for the other party to introduce himself, after which both sides would salute—according to the education he received, it had always been like this.
However, the Gu Nan in front of him didn't even spare him a glance and walked straight past, even leaving a puzzled sentence, “This kind of organization still has dumbasses who give away their real names?”

chapters.title: Chapter 383: Fan Hua And Dong Xun
chapters.content:
Gu Nan stared at Qi Bu the same way one would look at a fool.
A special organization like the Heaven-God Alliance practically made enemies of the greater god-level existences in both the Myriad Heavens Universe and the World of Gods. Did hiding one’s identity require any thought?
Gu Nan didn’t feel much when Yu Shuyun introduced herself because he didn’t even recognize a mere Tier 4 as a member of the Heaven-God Alliance.
But the Qi Bu before him was different. With Gu Nan's insight, he could naturally see that Qi Bu was a Star Ruler.
An inexperienced Star Ruler who just advanced not long ago and didn’t have time to acquire his own astral world—perhaps he hadn’t even entered the Inner World yet.
Of course, even the most inexperienced Star Ruler was still a Star Ruler, so in Gu Nan's eyes, he was qualified to be an official member of the Heaven-God Alliance.
But to Qi Bu, this sounded like an insult.
In all honesty, Yu Shuyun forcibly dragged him into the Heaven-God Alliance decades ago, when he hadn't even advanced to Star Ruler Realm yet.
But Qi Bu had never cared much about this organization, while Yu Shuyun was habitually ignorant, so to this day, both of them still didn't even know the organization’s name.
For Yu Shuyun, joining a secret organization was more about experiencing a sense of excitement from the clandestine operations.
The two glared angrily at Gu Nan, while Gu Nan completely ignored them. His figure vanished without a trace in the blink of an eye.
"Truly… such poor upbringing!" The young Qi Bu watched Gu Nan disappear but was at a loss for words. Finally, he could only leave such a sentence.
He came from Academic Heaven’s Confucian Academy, so he paid particular attention to etiquette with regards to his speech, actions, and bearing. Usually, he never even swore.
Academic Heaven was also one of the Thirteen Heavens, and it was probably the most famous of the Thirteen Heavens and the most well-known plane in the world.
The reason for this was that, as the name implied, this plane contained the greatest number of academies, which were the most sought-after places of learning for students all over the Myriad Heavens Universe.
Because of this, Academic Heaven had the highest number of Star Rulers stationed in the plane—some were outstanding students like Qi Bu, but many more were teachers.
Yu Shuyun also came from Academic Heaven, but she was clearly not from the Confucian Academy.
“Ah Bu, we must find him and teach him an unforgettable lesson!" Yu Shuyun chimed in from the side, waving her little fist hard.
Didn’t she drag Qi Bu along precisely to teach that self-important guy a lesson?
Yu Shuyun, who hadn't suffered a loss at the hands of someone on her same level ever since she graduated from the academy, was always thinking about winning back some face for herself.
……
Dong Xun panted heavily. His face was splattered with blood, but the warmth that surged through his body felt unusually pleasant.
"I still want… more… power." He ruthlessly plunged the dagger into the chest of a young man on the ground.
The youth on the ground didn’t even twitch. Only a small amount of blood was still gushing out, because he was already dead.
There were nearly ten corpses scattered throughout the alleyway. It was the same group of youths who often bullied Dong Xun, but now they could never do that again.
Dong Xun stabbed the corpse hard a few more times, then stood up with a big pant and a deranged smile on his face.
“What… What are you doing?" A slightly panicked voice came from behind him.
Dong Xun swiveled back and saw an impeccably-dressed man in a suit who happened to pass by and was currently scrambling backwards in horror.
He was just a normal office worker who never even practiced martial arts before and had never seen such a bloody scene in his life.
Yet Dong Xun, who just turned fourteen, curled his lips into a strange smile as his body lunged forward like a leopard.
In fact, he wasn’t very fast at all, and his already-frail body was weary and exhausted, but this was enough to take care of a normal person.
The dagger stabbed straight into the man's abdomen, but Dong Xun had no intention of stopping at all. His right hand spasmed wildly, the dagger flying in and out, and blood gushed out continuously.
The man struggled with all his power, but Dong Xun’s arms caught him with a vice-like grip. He couldn’t break free at all.
The next moment, the dagger slashed across the man's carotid artery. Dong Xun, who wasn’t very skilled at this, used more force than necessary, so more blood sprayed out.
Dong Xun didn’t have the slightest intention of avoiding it. Instead, he moved his face closer and let the blood pour down from his head and cover his entire body with a look of pure bliss on his face.
In just two days, he’d already turned from an ignorant teenager into a psychopathic serial killer.
This couldn’t be helped. He was destined to take such a path the moment he accepted Rolensia’s power.
Perhaps the title of the God of Luxuriant Blossoms sounds very beautiful, but don’t forget that Rolensia is a god belonging to the Dark Faction—she was that from the moment she became a god.
Although luxuriant blossoms were a type of flower, in Rolensia’s hometown, luxuriant blossoms were a strange flower that fed on animals.
Once a luxuriant blossom was “full," it would spray out the excess blood it ingested to form an extremely beautiful blood flower. This was the origin of the name “luxuriant blossom.”
Therefore, luxuriant blossoms could also be referred to as blood flowers.
"You're progressing quickly,” a cold voice similar to Rolensia’s echoed in Dong Xun's head.
Dong Xun slowly opened his eyes, his exhaustion greatly alleviated. He grinned. "If I can obtain power, I… do not fear anything."
Of course he wouldn’t know that just as he was enjoying the fountain of blood, a figure was standing in the shadows, calmly watching all of this.
“He actually fused with a wisp of Rolensia’s soul? Or rather, it’s more accurate to say that this wisp of soul underwent a mutation… How interesting."
……
"It's extremely difficult to find the three lost boxes. Heavenly Province World is very chaotic to begin with, and we don't even know what's in those boxes,” Qi Bu couldn’t help complaining under his breath as he walked down the street with Yu Shuyun.
Classmate Qi Bu had always been a very earnest person. Since they were looking for the lost objects, he was even trying to find all three by himself.
‘It’s the very act of accomplishing what ordinary people cannot that fully demonstrates the excellence of my Academic Heaven’s pupils!’
But it was extremely unfortunate that they were completely stuck at the first step.
Where exactly did the box get lost? Don't know. In whose hands was the box lost? Don't know. What was in the box and what impact would it have if it was stolen? Don’t know either.
‘How can I start looking without any information? Ahh!’
The originally ambitious Qi Bu was at a standstill, completely clueless. On the contrary, Yu Shuyun wasn’t anxious at all, still cheerfully dragging Qi Bu around on a lazy stroll.
According to her: "Maybe the clue will appear on its own?"
"How can a coincidence like that exist!”
It hadn’t even been that long since Qi Bu's retort when the roadside news broadcast mentioned a wanted notice—it was about a vicious, psychopathic serial killer.
"You saw that news just now, right? Hey, the killer first appeared only two days ago!"
Qi Bi nodded slowly and said seriously, "I take back what I just said."
T/N:
Fan Hua = Luxuriant Blossoms

chapters.title: Chapter 384: Deep And Righteous Friendship
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was still following Dong Xun, observing his every move, but his thoughts were elsewhere.
Certain thoughts did occur to him when faced with a pile of fragments of Rolensia’s divine body, such as whether to steal all the boxes, reassemble Rolensia himself, and eat her for exp.
But such a thought only lingered for an instant before it was directly kicked out of his mind.
The reason was very simple—Rolensia’s level was too high; she’d give him indigestion.
Gu Nan gradually had to start considering a problem as his Evil Value and level increased, which was concealing his identity as an Evil God.
In the game, the player’s identity would be exposed as soon as they completed the Second Round. There was absolutely no possibility of hiding it further.
Even before the Second Round, at Tier 9 or Tier 10, there was still a chance of being discovered if the player ran into some of the more powerful greater gods.
After players looked into this, they realized that the decisive factor in determining when the player’s identity would be exposed was none other than Evil Value.
The higher the Evil Value, the more likely it was for the player’s identity as an Evil God to be exposed.
So even though Gu Nan could already travel to the World of Gods and knew the weaknesses of a large number of gods, he still had no intention of going on a killing spree.
In his previous life's game, this was originally designed to prevent players from ignoring the gameplay altogether and directly farming levels on a large scale.
If players slaughtered too many gods, yet the construction of their Divine Kingdom had yet to keep up, they wouldn’t have enough points to upgrade the Evil God Temple, which meant they wouldn’t be able to level up… Then their only option would be to wait for the gods to discover their identity, leading to game over.
So although it wasn’t much of a problem that Gu Nan killed some small Tier 7 or 8 gods, his identity would likely be exposed once he swallowed a Tier 10 god, so the losses outweighed the benefits.
On the other hand, Gu Nan was also eager to see what kind of scene would play out in the World of Gods if Rolensia succeeded in breaking through Unified Dao Realm in the Myriad Heavens Universe and then returned to that side?
The emergence of a new greater god would probably instantly upset the balance of power between the two godly factions, perhaps even setting off a war between the gods.
If a war really broke out among the gods, then Gu Nan would be all too happy. He’d be able to fish in troubled waters, greatly improving the efficiency of Divine Kingdom Wars.
But this was his earlier plan. After seeing the fragment of Rolensia’s soul on Dong Xun suspected of having awakened self-awareness, Gu Nan's thoughts changed.
If Rolensia really ascended to a greater god, then this sliver of soul in front of him would hold an unimaginable value.
"Let's take him away first, then slowly confirm the split soul’s situation… Hm? There are two children here, perfect for being scapegoats."
……
“This murder method again,” Qi Bu muttered in disgust as he looked at the corpses and blood strewn all over the ground.
This was already the third time they stumbled upon such a scene in their pursuit of the fugitive.
It wasn’t like the two had never seen corpses before, but this kind of grisly scene would always make people uncomfortable.
But Yu Shuyun's footsteps paused, as if she was listening intently to something.
"What's wrong?" Qi Bu turned his head in confusion.
"The organization just sent out a message." Yu Shuyun replied quickly, "Two boxes have already been found, and they suspect that the third box is in the hands of the fugitive who mysteriously appeared."
“They already found two?" Qi Bu huffed, "In that case, we also need to speed up our investigation!"
Classmate Qi Bu, a model student from Academic Heaven, immediately felt his heart light up with fighting spirit.
Just then, an abnormal energy fluctuation came from up ahead. Qi Bu, whose ability could manipulate space, blurted out, "Someone is opening a spatial passage!"
The two didn't waste time on further words and swiftly rushed forth, but by the time they arrived, a comatose Dong Xun was slowly being placed inside the spatial passage.
Although Void Cutters had the ability to tear through space, there was a certain degree of difficulty involved if they wanted to take others with them.
This difficulty lay in the fact that the spatial passage wasn’t stable enough, so the transport speed was slow. This delay allowed Qi Bu and his companion to sigh in relief.
They made it in time!
As long as they dealt with the person maintaining the spatial passage… Qi Bu's eyes suddenly glared as he stared ahead.
"It's you!" Qi Bu couldn’t help shouting furiously, "You traitor!"
A familiar black-robed figure was in front of him; his features were hidden under a silver mask.
Even if he didn't know much about this mysterious organization, Qi Bu knew that now was the time for everyone to unite and find the missing boxes, yet this fellow wanted to send the box away!
Yu Shuyun also stared at this scene with a bewildered expression. She still had a hard time accepting this.
But Gu Nan shattered her fantasy the next second. His figure moved, and his fist was already in front of the two.
“Watch out!" Qi Bu pushed Yu Shuyun away as a spatial ripple surfaced in front of him.
These ripples shifted and rotated horizontally in space, eventually forming seven large characters— “Righteous Qi exists in Heaven and Earth!”
The moment the seven large characters appeared, it was as if there was some kind of will attached to them, and an aura of righteousness emerged out of thin air.
Although Qi Bu already advanced to Star Ruler Realm, he didn’t underestimate his opponent at all, having clearly attacked with his full power.
The power of space was the ability he was naturally born with, while Confucianism was the essence of what he learned in his life. Only when he perfectly combined the two did he enter Star Ruler Realm in one fell swoop!
Qi Bu formed his right index and middle fingers into a pen and quickly traced over the seven characters before pushing them forward.
Although he wouldn’t underestimate his opponent, he also wouldn’t underestimate himself either…
Crack.
With a light sound, Qi Bu’s careful arrangement was instantly blown to pieces by Gu Nan's fist.
"Too weak." Gu Nan couldn’t help shaking his head. However, this was within his expectations.
This punch contained his full strength and was different from the casual attack Yu Shuyun dodged earlier. The strength behind the punch had reached an astonishing level.
Even if Qi Bu was a Star Ruler and Gu Nan was just a clone, the result of a direct clash was never in question—though they were Star Rulers who both used the law of space, Qi Bu was much weaker than the Dragon of Space.
To deal with the Evil God physique, one must either have overwhelming strength or some other strange methods.
Gu Nan rushed forward directly. Qi Bu’s expression shifted slightly, but his hands didn’t tremble in the slightest as they wrote out one character after another, blasting them on Gu Nan's body.
The instant these characters appeared, they hit Gu Nan's body directly, giving him no chance to react.
This was what made Qi Bu so terrifying as a spatial ability user.
But to his surprise, Gu Nan had no intention of dodging, simply letting the characters hit him.
The next moment, Gu Nan had already reached Qi Bu and swung a fist down, aiming for none other than the top of Qi Bu's head.
With Gu Nan's terrifying speed, even Qi Bu himself was unable to react, so who could save him? Actually, there really was someone like that on the scene.
Yu Shuyun's law was precisely related to speed. In this lightning-fast split second, she ran out without hesitation and blocked the attack for Qi Bu.
"No!" Qi Bu reacted this time and watched as the punch fell. A roar filled with grief and rage tore out of his mouth.
He never hated his own incompetence so much. If he could, he would definitely choose to die in Yu Shuyun’s place!
Bam!
Gu Nan's fist tore through Yu Shuyun's chest, then blasted Qi Bu's head to pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 385: Aftermath
chapters.content:
After impaling the two like a skewer, Gu Nan didn’t spare them another glance and casually flung Yu Shuyun aside, instead focusing on sending Dong Xun away.
He had to send Dong Xun to a small, obscure plane and was a little rushed for time. Qi Bu's attack had already attracted the attention of the powerful figures in Heavenly Province World, including Daoist Lingyang and the others.
So Gu Nan must send Dong Xun away as soon as possible, or else he would face more and more setbacks.
A few moments later, when Daoist Lingyang and the other members of the Heaven-God Alliance rushed to the scene, Gu Nan's figure was long gone, leaving only a headless corpse, as well as Yu Shuyun, who had a bloody hole in her chest.
"This one is one of our people,” a member of the Heaven-God Alliance said heavily after lowering his head to examine Yu Shuyun, whose eyes were blood-red in anger.
"A reserve member?" Daoist Lingyang glanced down slightly. Yu Shuyun didn’t hide her face, but he had no memory of this person.
"Yeah."
Daoist Lingyang was silent for a while. Finally, he shook his head. "Someone snatched the box—let’s forget about it. Recall everyone."
……
Academic Heaven, inside a strangely-shaped tower, an old man opened his eyes and sighed slightly.
"Mingxuan."
The old man called out to the door, and immediately a youth walked in and bowed. "Master."
“Make a trip to Heavenly Province World and bring your Junior Sister back." Some helplessness appeared on the old man's face, as if this wasn’t the first time he’d ordered such a thing.
Sure enough, Chu Mingxuan looked unhappy and complained under his breath, "Has Junior Sister caused trouble again? Like I said, that kid Qi Bu may seem fastidious, but he’s incompetent and completely unreliable.”
The old man gave another light sigh and gently waved his hand, causing some lines to suddenly appear on the canvas in front of him.
The lines tangled and curled, forming a rough human shape, and then colors began to appear on it. A short while later, an exact copy of Yu Shuyun was sketched out.
But what made Chu Mingxuan's jaw drop was that his familiar junior sister was staring wide-eyed, with a grisly hole in her chest. Her entire expression was lifeless.
"Who did this?!" Chu Mingxuan only felt a wave of white-hot anger rush straight to his head and blurted out words that promised violence.
Their youngest martial sister was their master’s favorite and was also treasured by himself and several other senior brothers. Usually, they couldn’t even say anything harsh to her. Yet someone actually hurt her this much?
The old man said with a heavy face, “We can look for the murderer later. Go bring her back first. If it takes too long, even if I’m preserving her true spirit right now, I still may not be able to save her."
"Yes!" Chu Mingxuan said solemnly, and his figure quickly disappeared.
……
Three days later, the saint clone reentered White Bones Realm, while Gu Nan's original body remained inside his Divine Kingdom.
He didn’t intervene again in Rolensia’s matter after that. In fact, Star Rulers like him and Xue Ren, who were under too much attention from the Thirteen Heavens, were long since unsuited to being involved in such secret matters.
Especially Xue Ren—as soon as he made a move, all the powerhouses in the Thirteen Heavens would immediately know. None of his moves would be a secret.
On the contrary, Daoist Lingyang’s identity hadn’t been exposed yet and was more suited to taking charge of this kind of matter.
In all likelihood, the reason Xue Ren deliberately had Gu Nan join this event was to force him to throw in his lot with the Heaven-God Alliance.
Having participated in “smuggling" Rolensia meant he stood on the opposite side of the Thirteen Heavens, and it would be impossible to defect back to that side again.
After all, given the nature of the Heaven-God Alliance, the group had to be extremely cautious about the addition of any new members. Gu Nan wasn’t stuck on this step when he joined because of his clear origins, but it was also impossible for the organization to immediately give him access to their core members and matters.
Only a powerful Star Ruler like Xue Ren, who didn’t fear having his identity exposed, could make contact with Gu Nan.
“Rolensia's advancement can't be done overnight. There’s no telling how long it’ll take,” Gu Nan withdrew his gaze from a certain small plane and muttered to himself.
Of course he was staring at Rolensia’s location. This powerful god who was ruthless to the point of slicing herself into pieces had now reassembled her divine body and was currently trying to make contact with her own Divine Kingdom from within the Myriad Heavens Universe.
Speaking of which, in all his years of gaming history, Gu Nan had never really seen a god ascend to a greater god by themselves.
There were quest chains that allowed gods to level up into greater gods, but they all required the player's help, and none of the gods in the several quest chains were Rolensia.
Rolensia’s advancement to a greater god was entirely up to her now, and Gu Nan also didn’t have time to stare at that plane all day.
In the next few days, he was finally about to take a step towards Tier 7 and wage a Divine Kingdom War.
……
"My Lord, preparations in Jin Lin World are finished. Liang Ruxin launched an armed rebellion and overthrew the state of Zhao’s royal family in one fell swoop. He ascended the throne as emperor two days ago local time,” inside the Divine Kingdom, a white-haired young man with an enchanting face reported respectfully as he stood before Gu Nan.
This man was named Bai Xi and came from White Bones Realm. He first joined the White Mist organization based in White Bones Realm and was later recommended over by Red Tail due to his outstanding performance, ultimately becoming one of Gu Nan’s apostles.
It was worth mentioning that due to the Time Arena’s powerful effect, White Mist’s strength swelled even further after Red Tail's advancement to Void Cutter Realm.
More and more strong experts joined White Mist, and a portion of them entered the ranks of Gu Nan’s apostles.
Since then, the replenishment of apostles entered a virtuous cycle, and Gu Nan's Apostle Hall already had over two dozen names recorded in it.
And the special characteristic of apostles meant Gu Nan didn’t have to worry about their loyalty.
As long as someone had second thoughts, the Apostle Hall would give a clear notification, and their loyalty stat would immediately drop dramatically, so Gu Nan had plenty of time to kill traitors.
"Good." Gu Nan sat high on the throne in the Evil God Temple and said calmly, "Notify Shana: have the vampires get ready and raise their spirits for battle.”
"On Jin Lin World’s side, have Liang Ruxin send troops to attack the state of Qi. Doesn’t matter if he can win or not—just keep fighting till the last troop standing, no matter what.”
Bai Xi bowed in response, but Gu Nan spoke once again, "Notify all the apostles that the invasion of Jin Lin World will take place in half a month. All apostles at or above Void Cutter Realm must participate."
……
Bai Xi had just left the Evil God Temple, keeping Gu Nan's several orders in mind, when he saw Lan Si quickly walking over.
"Lord Lan Si." Bai Xi hurriedly saluted. He was a very careful person. Lan Si was far above him in terms of both strength and status, so Bai Xi naturally didn’t dare to be rude.
Lan Si nodded as a greeting to Bai Xi.
Ever since that year, Lan Si’s character became increasingly taciturn, somewhat approaching Gu Nan’s mannerisms. This was actually a form of imitation. People always subconsciously imitate those they idolize.
Bai Xi also didn’t mind, since he knew Lan Si had always been like this, and just added, "My Lord ordered an invasion of Jin Lin World in half a month. Everyone at or above Void Cutter Realm must participate."
"Got it,” Lan Si replied casually, but her feet were already walking forward again.
But as she stepped into the Evil God Temple, she saw a new structure forming. It was different from anything she’d seen before and was clearly a huge black portal.

chapters.title: Chapter 386: Grand Army
chapters.content:
Gu Nan ultimately decided to target Jin Lin World.
It wasn’t only because Liang Ruxin completed his mission splendidly, but also because the situation in Jin Lin World was a war between four states, and the power system was more suited to their troops.
Lan Si stared at the black portal that just appeared and couldn't help wondering, "This is…?”
"Dark Warrior Portal. It produces Dark Warriors.” Gu Nan explained from the side, uncaring as to whether Lan Si could understand or not, "The current production capacity is around a thousand a week, enough to fight a small war."
Dark Warrior Portal, this was one of the upgraded structures of the Divine Servant Institute.
The Divine Servant Institute was the most basic barracks structure, which could produce divine servants, a basic type of soldier. But the simple divine servants were basically no different from the “peasants" in typical strategy games, so Gu Nan didn’t even bother making any.
In contrast, the type of troops produced became a bit interesting once the Divine Servant Institute was upgraded to a Level 1 Dark Warrior Portal.
Dark Warriors was one of the frequently selected soldier types in the early stage and were half-living, half-dead darkness attribute creatures. They were relatively hard to kill and also had high resistance against a large portion of laws.
Moreover, Dark Warriors were good at assaulting fortified positions, and their overall stats were more comprehensive. They were already a very good choice when there were only enough points to build one type of barracks.
Finally, the Dark Warrior’s special ability was also very suited for early-stage wars.
The Dark Warrior's ability was "Death Sacrifice”—that is, after killing the opponent, they can harvest a certain amount of dark energy to strengthen themselves. They belonged to the category of troops that grew stronger the more battles they fought.
As Gu Nan kept investing more points, one Dark Warrior after another walked out of the portal.
They were all clad in black armor, holding a broadsword in their hands. Their faces were obscured by their helmets, revealing only a pair of cold, emotionless eyes.
“Their power is somewhere between Innate and Prodigious Realm.” Lan Si couldn’t help frowning after she found a random Dark Warrior and briefly tested its power.
However, Gu Nan replied, “It’s enough. Once these 2,000 Dark Warriors die till roughly 500 remain, the survivors will all be able to reach Tier 3. How many people would it take to crush everyone in an insignificant small plane?”
……
Jin Lin World.
Liang Ruxin sat high on the throne, looking down at the group of ministers slowly retreating, and actually felt as if everything happened a lifetime ago.
In a short half year or so, he’d managed to ascend from a penniless stranger to this exalted throne, where one word of his could decide the fates of tens of thousands of people.
Although there were still three other existences like him in this world, Liang Ruxin had complete confidence in his ability to sweep away all three of those states.
After being in this world for so long, he’d long since grown used to his new identity.
But Liang Ruxin never imagined he’d still have the chance to meet people from his previous life.
"Your Majesty, this is absolutely not a good time to send troops to attack Qi!" A middle-aged man dressed as a strategist hurriedly walked up to Liang Ruxin and earnestly advised.
Not only did the middle-aged strategist say this, he also took out a piece of paper, on which he clearly wrote ten disadvantages of sending out an army at this time.
He was about to give Liang Ruxin an analysis one by one when he saw Liang Ruxin say expressionlessly, "Tian Yuan has disturbed the troop’s morale. Capture him."
Immediately, people rushed up and took the strategist named Tian Yuan away, throwing him into prison.
Liang Ruxin had risen to power through a bloody coup d’etat, so he had extremely high control over his subordinates, which was why he dared to do such a thing.
But Liang Ruxin couldn't help sighing after Tian Yuan was taken away. In fact, with his knowledge and experience, how could he not know that attacking Qi now would be completely detrimental?
But Liang Ruxin had no way to resist, not only because the voice in his head gave a new order, but also because of the person from his previous life that he’d just met.
"Send troops to attack Qi—this is your mission,” the words spoken by that bewitching white-haired man were still fresh in his ears.
Liang Ruxin accepted the mission very decisively, not simply because the voice in his head also had the exact same order, but also because he was completely powerless to fight back against the stranger.
With his martial arts cultivation, he was only one step short of that legendary realm capable of shattering space, yet there was still someone who could toy with him like he was in the palm of the mysterious stranger’s hand. One could well imagine just how high the other party’s cultivation was.
More importantly, Liang Ruxin clearly sensed that this wasn’t the other party’s true body at all and was merely a wisp of his soul, weakened to the point where his realm was similar to Liang Ruxin’s when they fought.
Thus, the newborn state of Zhao, under Liang Ruxin’s “tyrannical order,” commanded an army of 200,000 troops north to attack Qi, shocking the entire world.
Even more shocking was that in just half a month, Liang Ruxin personally joined this war, and the fighting became so fierce and desperate to the point where they were practically using human lives to fill an entire city just to capture it.
With the way he was fighting, people were afraid that the Zhao army would only manage to capture ten borderline cities at most before they exhausted all their troops.
Of course, Qi also suffered from such a mad strategy. Countless cultivators and soldiers died on the battlefield, and both sides were said to be greatly diminished.
Rumors had it that the king of Qi had already lost his temper several times in the imperial court, cursing Liang Ruxin as a lunatic.
Until one day, two men who called themselves "angels" came to the imperial court of Qi and ordered the king of Qi to stop the war immediately.
As one of the most powerful people in the world, the king of Qi wasn’t ignorant of the existence of angels, but he was concerned about another matter.
"What about Liang Ruxin?" The king of Qi asked with a livid expression.
"Naturally, someone will inform him." The angel remained expressionless from beginning to end.
The king of Qi, however, wasn’t placated by this half-hearted response and said furiously, "He sent troops to attack Qi, causing us to lose so many generals for nothing. Should we just let it go?!"
The man looked at him coldly but didn’t say anything, only revealing an icy smile.
……
Liang Ruxin’s military tent also welcomed two “angels," but it was a man and a woman this time—a slightly different configuration.
"Who are you?"
"You don't need to know who we are. You just need to obey orders." The man had a mocking smile on his face.
"Order the immediate withdrawal of your troops and fetter yourself. My Lord wants to see you,” the woman instructed. Her expression was like ice, and her tone contained even more high-and-mighty indifference.
Liang Ruxin wasn’t a stranger to this tone. The man from his previous life who visited him earlier also spoke this way.
So Liang Ruxin gently clenched his fists. No one liked to be treated like this, but he was extremely aware that he had no room to resist.
As if seeing through his emotions, the man said again, “Hurry up. If not for the fact that you actually have some talent and the Lord wants to train you, we wouldn’t be merely taking you away."
Liang Ruxin relaxed and asked in a low voice, "May I ask, who exactly is the Lord you’re talking about?"
The man and woman glanced at each other, finding it hard to suppress the laughter on their faces. It was as if they just saw an ant ask a question with utter seriousness, which was always a comical sight.
However, what the two didn’t expect was for a voice to echo softly, answering the question for them.
“Jin Lin World, Star Ruler Jin Lin?"
In Liang Ruxin's line of sight, a golden-haired, blue-eyed, blood-red figure appeared in front of them. All she did was pass by the two angels, yet her crimson nail, which was as long as a finger, had already sliced off their heads.
And immediately after that, Liang Ruxin saw a scene that he would never forget in his life.
As far as the eye could see, warriors in pitch-black armor were descending from the sky in an orderly formation, walking down from the sky step by step.

chapters.title: Chapter 387: Jin Lin
chapters.content:
The army of Dark Warriors descended to Jin Lin World, taking advantage of the golden opportunity presented by Liang Ruxin attacking Qi with his entire kingdom’s troops, giving the divine servants the best chance to grow by killing enemies.
The invading force descended upon the frontlines of the battlefield between the two armies. The two thousand Dark Warriors headed straight for the Qi army from the moment they descended.
Of course, neither did the Dark Warriors avoid any Zhao troops who just happened to be in the way, killing them almost in passing—in any case, killing any soldier here would increase their strength.
"Are you guys planning to kill everyone here?" Liang Ruxin asked as he helplessly watched his subordinates being slaughtered, barely keeping his expression calm.
Shana flung her blonde hair and gave a charming smile. "If by 'here' you mean this Divine Kingdom, then…… yes."
……
In Jin Lin World, despite the chaotic situation of four states vying for supremacy, the people of the four kingdoms had all heard of a legend.
It was said that at the center of the continent existed a sacred mountain where immortals lived, and if one could be accepted as an immortal’s disciple, they would have the chance to also gain immortality in the future.
Some people questioned the authenticity of the immortals, but even more people believed it without a doubt, because the monarchs of the four states would also periodically send people to the sacred mountain to make offerings to the immortals.
For an intruder like Gu Nan, the sacred mountain represented something all too obvious—it must be the residence of the Star Ruler, Jin Lin.
The name Jin Lin World came from the fact that six hundred years ago, Jin Lin took control of this world and named his astral world after himself.
Actually, many Star Rulers did this, and in fact, this practice was more conducive to establishing a branding effect that would better attract Void Cutters from other planes to work under them.
The "profession" of Star Rulers was indeed somewhat similar to that of the lord of a territory. Not only did they need to develop their own “territory," but they also had to find ways to recruit outside talents.
In reality, Void Cutters were the most important talents working under most Star Rulers.
It was to the extent where even the strength of an astral world was measured—to a large extent—by the number of Void Cutters stationed in it.
For example, Qiao Deyu’s Gale World was only a recently-established astral world, so only one to two Void Cutters who were already his friends pledged their loyalty to him.
Even if other Void Cutters went there, they still wouldn’t use Gale World as their main base.
In contrast, Jin Lin World was a little better. The Star Ruler, Jin Lin, had already managed this world for hundreds of years. Not only did he recruit Void Cutter subordinates from outside, even some of the astral world’s more powerful inhabitants broke through to Void Cutter Realm.
For example, Jin Lin sent four Void Cutters in one fell swoop to halt the war between Zhao and Qi, which wasn’t an insignificant portion of the fighting force for small astral worlds.
But the result clearly wasn’t good at all.
Jin Lin stood in the hall with a livid expression, glaring at the white-robed figure standing calmly before him, his gaze cold enough to freeze someone.
"Gu Nan?" Jin Lin wasn’t an isolationist and was well aware of what transpired in the Myriad Heavens Universe recently, so he recognized Gu Nan's face at a glance.
“There’s no enmity between us, so why are you attacking my Jin Lin World?" Jin Lin asked in a heavy voice as he fixed his stare on Gu Nan's face.
Gu Nan also had no intention of hiding his identity. He simply looked at this Star Ruler with a wordless smile, yet his attack didn’t slow down at all.
A lightning-fast fist arrived directly in front of Jin Lin, almost making space itself cave in.
Normally, if Jin Lin had encountered this punch, he might really have fallen victim to this sneak attack and been heavily injured, but he was currently inside his own astral world.
The instant Gu Nan swung his fist, Jin Lin had already seen through the attack’s trajectory, and a golden wall appeared out of thin air in front of him.
Gu Nan's fist smashed into the wall, causing a terrifying crash. Outsiders even thought that a landslide had occurred on the sacred mountain.
The two in the hall stood across from each other. Gu Nan pulled back his hand and shook it slightly, revealing an odd smile. “Being buffed by an astral world really is an advantage."
With the characteristics of Gu Nan's Evil God physique, winning against even a Tier 7 Star Ruler outside might not be out of the question.
But in Jin Lin’s own astral world, Gu Nan had no chance of winning against a Tier 6 Star Ruler like Jin Lin. At best, all he could do was maintain the current status quo.
Jin Lin sneered as the golden light in front of him turned into several sharp arrows that flew straight at Gu Nan.
His law was the law of gold. When entering Star Ruler Realm, he added supplementary laws such as “sharpness” and “piercing,” perfecting impalement attacks.
Therefore, Jin Lin's laws could be described with four words—able to pierce anything.
And with the support of his astral world, Jin Lin's power was strengthened by another level. Golden arrows holding unstoppable power pierced straight into Gu Nan’s chest.
And then… There was no “and then,” because Gu Nan stood before Jin Lin like nothing had happened.
“You…” Jin Lin watched as Gu Nan patted his chest, the bloody holes disappearing at a speed visible to the naked eye as if they never even existed in the first place.
While “able to pierce anything” was certainly very powerful, it first had to break through the opponent’s defense.
Jin Lin's expression changed slightly as he received more and more warnings from his astral world. Not only were his inhabitants slaughtered by a mysterious army, but even his sacred mountain was being invaded by a group of Void Cutters.
He couldn't afford to be locked in battle with Gu Nan any longer and wanted to leave immediately, his figure flickering, but Gu Nan's fist descended right at this moment.
The buff the astral world provided for the Star Ruler was mainly reflected in laws, boosting the Star Ruler’s law straight up by one to two tiers, but there was little buff for the Star Ruler themselves.
Players had a unique advantage in this regard, because the existence of the Evil God physique allowed them to directly destroy the enemy's physical body.
It was easy to fight laws with laws, but to fight a physical body with nothing but laws, one must first go through the “solidification" step, so the attack power was instantly reduced.
With no other alternative, Jin Lin was forced to stop his attempts to create a spatial passage and prioritize the organization of defensive measures to block Gu Nan's attacks.
But Gu Nan's attacks were continuous and never seemed to let up, forcing Jin Lin to repeatedly take a defensive stance, unable to free himself to do anything else.
At this moment, Jin Lin finally understood Gu Nan's purpose—he never had any intention of defeating Jin Lin; Gu Nan just wanted to stall him.
His opponent had more powerful subordinates, so as long as Jin Lin was tied up fighting Gu Nan, the other party would be free to slaughter everyone in Jin Lin World, no matter the cost.
And as the powerful cultivators in Jin Lin World continued dying off while some Void Cutters even fled without a fight, the power his astral world provided to Jin Lin would weaken even further.
This would continue until a certain critical point when Gu Nan's power would be enough to suppress him.
Jin Lin realized all this, but he couldn’t do anything in the face of Gu Nan's combination punches.
Despite having a lifespan of nearly ten thousand years, this was the first time Jin Lin ever faced an invasion of his astral world ever since he took control of Jin Lin World, so he was completely inexperienced in this area.
Even more unfortunate was the fact that the first opponent he faced under such circumstances had to be a terrifying existence like Gu Nan.

chapters.title: Chapter 388: Farm It Again
chapters.content:
On Jin Lin World’s sacred mountain.
After Gu Nan trapped Jin Lin himself deep in the sacred mountain, the invaders cut through this world like a hot knife through butter.
The group invading the sacred mountain was led by Lan Si, but the main force was still the vampires of the Raymond clan. After all, vampires were too good at bullying the weak and cowering from the strong.
They were easily overwhelmed across the board when facing an opponent with stronger overall specs; but when facing an opponent weaker than them, the vampires could bring out 120% of their strength.
"Who are you people?!"
“To trespass upon the sacred mountain, you all… Ah!"
Clouds of bloody mist exploded all over the enemy’s body, and they slowly collapsed to the ground. Lan Si had a cold look on her face as she casually said, "If you want to blame something, blame the fact that you chose to follow the wrong person."
As the vampires surged into the mountain, blood instantly flowed like rivers. One after another, the experts and their families here were killed without mercy, no matter whether they begged for mercy or resisted.
In fact, in Gu Nan's order, besides not needing to pursue the Void Cutters who fled of their own accord, everyone else had to be killed to the last person.
Bai Xi was also on the sacred mountain’s battlefield, but he didn't quite understand this order.
He came from a large family in White Bones Realm and used to be a genuine heaven-defying genius. However, Bai Xi lacked the arrogance of a typical young master; instead, he was curious about the outside world.
While curious, Bai Xi was also very aware of his own position and never stepped out of bounds, so he was able to become Gu Nan's apostle.
But Bai Xi's obedience and acknowledgement of Gu Nan didn’t mean that he didn’t have his own ideas and thoughts. In fact, in Bai Xi's perception, all leaders preferred subordinates with creative opinions.
So with little hesitation, Bai Xi expressed his opinion to Lan Si, "Lord Lan Si, isn't it a little unwise for us to slaughter every human here?"
“Why is it unwise?" Lan Si turned her head and looked at him in confusion.
Bai Xi took a deep breath and explained, "If we continue killing like this, I'm afraid that all His Excellency will get in the end will just be an empty shell."
Of course only an empty shell would be left after everyone was killed. Bai Xi knew that there would be invasions among Star Rulers, but no Star Ruler would do what Gu Nan did.
The gains weren’t worth the losses!
The goal behind invading other astral worlds should be to kill the enemy Star Ruler and incorporate that astral world into their own territory, so why would anyone want to slaughter all the inhabitants?
But Lan Si shook her head. "That's what My Lord ordered."
Bai Xi said without backing down, "If there’s a mistake in His Excellency's orders, we should at least raise it, or else who will advise His Excellency if anything was overlooked?"
Hearing Bai Xi's words, Lan Si glanced deep into the sacred mountain and replied, "I'm afraid it's too late to say that now."
……
Comrade Bai Xi, who wanted to advise Gu Nan if anything was overlooked, was undoubtedly a good comrade, only it never would’ve occurred to him that Gu Nan gave Shana's side an even more ruthless order.
The Dark Warrior army swept across the battlefield, sweeping away armies, cities, countrysides… In short, anything that could be leveled was leveled without any semblance of reason.
Not only did they kill the cultivators, but they even killed the civilians in passing. No matter how small a mosquito was, it was still meat.
This was actually because Gu Nan’s goal for launching this Divine Kingdom War differed from that of normal Star Rulers and gods.
Star Rulers mainly wanted new territory because their astral worlds could be expanded by absorbing conquered planes. Gods, on the other hand, wanted faith. Their Divine Kingdoms could be continuously expanded by recruiting new believers.
Players like Gu Nan were different from both.
The player's goal was Evil Value and points, and the way to obtain both was actually based on how many enemies the player’s divine servants killed.
Any lifeform that could provide power to the enemy Star Ruler was the divine servants’ enemy.
This strange level-up path was unique to players. That was why players launched frenzied invasions one after another in the mid- to late-stages of the game, biting any Divine Kingdom they caught.
Divine servants earned points through war. Although not much Evil Value could be earned this way, players would also be able to earn a lot of Evil Value if they ultimately managed to kill the god ruling the Divine Kingdom.
Liang Ruxin silently followed Shana, his expression turning colder and more detached.
Anyone who kept sending loyal soldiers right into the path of the Dark Warrior army while seeing the shocked eyes of his former subordinates would become this way.
"Well done." Shana revealed a charming smile and told Liang Ruixin appreciatively, "With your ability, I believe you will soon be rewarded by My Lord."
