"And then continue being an undercover agent?" Liang Ruxin asked, but his tone didn’t have any inflection, making it impossible to discern happiness or anger from it.
Shana, however, simply replied, "As long as you can advance to Legend Rank, that job will naturally be done by someone else."
Liang Ruxin didn’t respond. His gaze was on the army of Dark Warriors. He murmured, “Any army that doesn’t fear death, grows stronger with every battle, and possesses unlimited stamina… For such a perfect army, your command is too crude."
Dark Warriors were half-undead divine servants that possessed many of the advantages unique to the undead, which simplified a war that originally should’ve been quite complicated.
"Then you can be the commander." With an indifferent expression, Shana handed command directly over to Liang Ruixin.
Liang Ruxin stared at her in surprise. "You're not afraid that I'll take advantage of this opportunity to seize power?"
Shana responded with a vampire noble’s most standard smile, "When you reach my realm, you’ll understand that this doesn't matter at all. Besides… it won't be long before we retreat."
……
Deep inside the sacred mountain, Jin Lin’s expression was already ugly. Countless golden arrows shot in all directions, while the walls around him were becoming weaker and weaker.
For Star Rulers of the Myriad Heavens Universe, the degree to which their astral worlds boosted their powers mainly depended on the number of high-level cultivators inside their astral world, so Jin Lin's power quickly weakened as the sacred mountain was slaughtered clean.
But Gu Nan's condition wasn’t very good either. His body could already be described as being riddled with a thousand holes, and even his head had been hit by several arrows.
On one hand, he had to endure unavoidable attacks, while on the other hand, he also had to think of ways to stall Jin Lin. Gu Nan wasn’t invincible after all, so this was the most he could manage.
If too much of the enemy Star Ruler’s laws accumulated in his body, it would be enough to interfere with the Evil God physique’s self-healing ability.
It was precisely because he sensed this that Jin Lin abandoned defense in favor of offense in an attempt to kill Gu Nan before the power from his astral world disappeared.
‘The losses to my astral world are already inevitable, but as long as I kill the other party, I can take over Gu Nan's forces!' Jin Lin's mind was very clear. He found a way to stop the losses or even make a bloody profit in the process.
With Jin Lin's judgment of the situation, if the two of them fought with their lives on the line, both had a 50-50% chance of winning.
But he didn’t expect Gu Nan to suddenly stop at a certain moment, his figure already standing outside the hall and muttering to himself, "These guys are really slow…”
As if realizing something, Jin Lin swiftly chased him outside, but Gu Nan had already disappeared without a trace.
Jin Lin couldn’t possibly match Gu Nan in terms of speed, even if his astral world wasn’t destroyed.
More importantly, by the time Jin Lin was free to observe what was happening outside the sacred mountain, he discovered that those damned invaders had long since vanished.
"Gu Nan!" Jin Lin roared frantically in place.
……
Inside his Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan was sitting leisurely in the Evil God Temple, recuperating.
Shana had already brought back the army of Dark Warriors and reported, "My Lord, the Divine Kingdom War has already ended. Shall I arrange for them to continue heading to Crescent Moon World?"
"What's the hurry?” Gu Nan, however, waved his hand and pointed to Jin Lin World in the distance. “Jin Lin himself isn’t even dead yet. We’ll head over and farm it again after a while.”

chapters.title: Chapter 389: Repercussions
chapters.content:
A resourceful player will always pursue the playstyle that maximizes profit—unless he thinks there’s a risk associated with this playstyle.
Unlike all the Star Rulers who invaded other astral worlds, Gu Nan's aim was never to fight over territory, but to kill enough of that world’s inhabitants in order to cut off the supply of power to the enemy Star Ruler.
From this perspective, the Myriad Heavens Universe was more convenient than the World of Gods.
Because in the Myriad Heavens Universe, the Star Rulers' source of power was primarily high-level cultivators and secondarily civilians, not believers.
Although it was harder to kill powerful cultivators, as long as Gu Nan could provide a large and powerful enough army, it was definitely easier to simply kill people rather than killing believers.
After all, powerful cultivators were instantly recognizable, while believers were not. Besides the few particularly fanatical ones, the only choice was to wipe out all inhabitants to prevent a particularly big fish from slipping through the net.
It wasn’t like the Myriad Heavens Universe at all, where cultivator targets were obvious enough that they couldn’t run away in time. As for civilians, the invading army killed as many as they were able to, but it wasn’t a big deal if they couldn’t kill all civilians. Anyways, they wouldn’t lose much.
This was precisely why Gu Nan wouldn’t kill the target plane in a single blow. He much rather preferred "sustainable development,” farming it over and over.
Perhaps one day, a Star Ruler like Jin Lin would be driven mad by him and simply abandon this plane, searching for a new astral world in a fit of rage. Then Gu Nan would have to give up along with him.
Gu Nan sat in the Divine Kingdom. Almost half a month had passed since his first Divine Kingdom War.
His injuries from the battle with Jin Lin had already healed—when not in combat, the Evil God physique’s healing factor was on another level.
Gu Nan obtained substantial gains from this Divine Kingdom War.
Originally, Gu Nan already squandered all his points to create 2,000 Dark Warriors, but now that number directly swelled to nearly 50,000 points.
Merely one Divine Kingdom War that was slightly rushed for time and executed by relatively inexperienced apostles brought in this amount of revenue. War really was something that could return a huge profit with only a small investment.
There was also the fact that Gu Nan couldn't stall Jin Lin for too long, and there were also no Tier 4 divine servants among the invading troops.
The absence of Tier 4 divine servants meant it was almost impossible for the army to kill Tier 4 opponents—enemies killed by apostles didn’t give any points.
His Evil Value, on the other hand, probably grew by about 200, a somewhat pitifully small number compared to Gu Nan's current level.
This was also by intentional design. It wasn’t like no one in the game had ever tried the same tactic as Gu Nan—leaving the enemy Star Ruler alive—with the intention of repeatedly farming points.
But for one thing, immigrating to a new astral world to escape the invasion was far less troublesome than cultivating new believers from scratch in the same world. For another, it was the above reason—how could players get Evil Value if they didn’t kill gods?
This was unlike the current Gu Nan, whose sources of Evil Value and points were separated, which gave him the incentive to farm Jin Lin World repeatedly.
Although the gains were substantial, the losses suffered by the Dark Warrior army were also considerable. Though being unfearing of death was a good quality in battle, one would start hating this quality once they started counting the casualties suffered by the troops.
Of the 2,000 Dark Warriors, after a slaughter that lasted less than a few hours, there were now less than 300 left. The casualty ratio reached an alarming point.
The level of the Dark Warriors wasn’t high in the first place, so casualties could easily occur even when facing low-level soldiers from Jin Lin World.
However, divine servants were creatures created from laws and could be mass-produced as long as points were invested, so Gu Nan didn't care how many died.
It was fine as long as his Tier 4 subordinates didn’t die—they were still needed to keep an eye on the hostile Void Cutters, since Gu Nan currently lacked a stable source of Tier 4 troops.
Gu Nan, who got 50,000 points, put 30,000 of them into the Divine Kingdom’s structures without another word.
This time, he still chose the Divine Servant Institute, as well as the other divine servant structure created after the upgrade, called the "Ghoul Camp.”
The second type of soldier Gu Nan planned to select was none other than Ghouls.
If Dark Warriors were still half-human and half-undead, retaining part of the characteristics of flesh and blood creatures, then Ghouls were pure undead creatures.
In the early stages of the Divine Kingdom’s development, undead soldiers were indeed the most suitable starting troops.
The reason was simple—the vast majority of troops that could “grow their numbers with each war” and perhaps even grow stronger with every battle belonged to the undead category.
The well-known necromancers all became famous because they built up huge undead empires with their own power.
Dark Warriors had the “Death Sacrifice" ability, able to strengthen themselves by killing enemies, while Ghouls had the “Corpse Eater” ability that allowed them to regenerate and even level up by devouring corpses.
Of the two, one killed enemies and one ate up their corpses. The latter could help kill more enemies after eating corpses and might even grow powerful enough to take over the battle, so they were the perfect match.
But Ghouls were on the weaker side when first starting out, which was why Gu Nan didn't choose them immediately.
As for the remaining 20,000 points, Gu Nan put them into the production of Dark Warriors and Ghouls with a 3:1 ratio.
Although he said he planned to farm Jin Lin World a second time, Gu Nan still had a group of Legend Rank vampires farm the Crescent Moon dungeon to earn points for him.
This wasn’t because Gu Nan intended to renege on his promise. Rather, it was because Comrade Jin Lin's “capital construction" was too ineffective.
Time in a small plane flowed even faster than inside the Divine Kingdom, but Jin Lin World already had almost half a year to recuperate, yet the states of Qi and Zhao still looked the same. They didn’t appear rebuilt at all.
In other words, if Gu Nan wanted to return and slaughter all the powerful cultivators in the armies again, he could only set his sights on the two other states.
But it wasn’t wartime, so those armies were scattered all over the continent, drastically reducing the efficiency of just one massacre.
At the end of the day, Jin Lin World was still Jin Lin's territory, and Gu Nan couldn’t stall the other party indefinitely.
Now that he thought about it, the fact that Zuo Zuo was able to suppress Red inside her own astral world for so many years was quite a terrifying feat. If not for Ying Ge’s existence creating a weak point in his mind and forcing him to choose self-destruction, the result might still be uncertain.
After all, Zuo Zuo was a powerful Tier 10 Star Ruler, second only to the Thirteen Heavens. He wouldn’t be killed so easily.
But in reality, this wasn’t much of a setback. If Gu Nan could send one Liang Ruxin to incite a war between two states, he could naturally also send a second Liang Ruxin.
It would only take a little time.
But while Gu Nan was busy farming his points, conversations in the Myriad Heavens Universe exploded again because of his actions.
In fact, in the Myriad Heavens Universe, Star Ruler Realm battles were still relatively rare.
Although there were quite a few Star Rulers and astral worlds in the Myriad Heavens Universe, Star Rulers usually fought each other in the Inner World, so fights that happened in the real world were particularly conspicuous.
Even though Jin Lin World was only a small plane, it still had a certain degree of popularity as an astral world controlled by a Star Ruler.
People noticed as soon as the war broke out, and after inquiring about the identity of the invading Star Ruler, that information attracted even more people’s attention.
Gu Nan! It was actually Gu Nan!
Gu Nan, suspected of having already advanced to Star Ruler Realm and perhaps even having his own astral world! The same Gu Nan who killed Lou Wanying and likely stole the ancient Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance!

chapters.title: Chapter 390: Karma
chapters.content:
Gu Nan wasn’t an unfamiliar name to those in the Myriad Heavens Universe.
For people below Star Ruler Realm, there were actually two levels that they were most concerned about.
One was the Thirteen Heavens kind of existence. They were the real big shots, the actual rulers of the Myriad Heavens. Their every word and action was eye-catching.
The other was the top-level Void Cutters, as well as recently-advanced Star Rulers.
Void Cutters were the pinnacle of mortals. They belonged to the "present management" category of existences and also received attention, such as the previous Gu Nan.
When Gu Nan first rose to fame in the Myriad Heavens, it was still as a Void Cutter.
It was only his participation in Nirvana Heaven's invasion of Star Realm that brought him to people’s attention.
But later, as Gu Nan did more and more things, more and more people knew about him. Someone in a similar boat was Lou Wanying.
Under Lu Wen’s manipulation, Lou Wanying had done a lot of earth-shattering things.
The matter with the Time Arena was considered Lu Wen's personal endorsement of Lou Wanying, and the fight over the ancient Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance even alarmed people at the level of the Thirteen Heavens.
In this way, Lou Wanying's reputation may actually be above Gu Nan’s.
But this didn’t matter much, because the moment Lou Wanying died at Gu Nan's hands, all the attention given to the two of them was now focused on Gu Nan alone!
Under certain people’s deliberate manipulation, people very logically deduced a piece of information.
Lou Wanying acquired the ancient Void Grotto Heaven's inheritance, while Gu Nan killed him, so who currently had the inheritance? Of course it was Gu Nan!
With the exception of Void Grotto Heaven, who knew that it was very difficult to steal the inheritance from Lou Wanying, other people wouldn’t really know or care as much.
Even if Gu Nan had a one percent chance of getting this inheritance, it was still a tempting enough reason to go after him.
"Gu Nan invaded Jin Lin World. So it’s true that he already has an astral world?"
"But the invasion wasn’t really successful? He wasn’t able to seize the land, and his losses aren’t necessarily smaller than Jin Lin World.”
"Who knows! All I care now is where in the world Gu Nan's astral world is…”
Where was Gu Nan’s astral world? This was a question many people were curious about. Because finding his astral world was the same as finding Gu Nan himself, which meant also finding the inheritance.
Usually, it wasn’t hard to locate the whereabouts of a Star Ruler’s astral world.
For example, with Jin Lin World, Jin Lin was all too eager to announce that there was a small astral world here, trying to increase the plane’s popularity.
But on the other hand, if the Star Ruler himself wasn’t willing to reveal it and didn’t use the power of his astral world in front of others, then it was very difficult to discover the whereabouts of someone’s astral world.
Even if a person went to that astral world by accident, they still wouldn’t know who it belonged to!
Amidst this popular craze where everyone was searching for Gu Nan, someone came knocking on his door.
Of course, it wasn’t as exaggerated as finding his Divine Kingdom. Instead, she found Gu Nan’s clone in White Bones Realm.
The saint clone sat in a quiet room, studying Long Ling'er with a somewhat thoughtful gaze.
Gu Nan truly didn’t expect for the first person to approach him at this juncture to be from Lu Wen’s side.
"Lu Wen’s looking for me?" Gu Nan didn't bother with pleasantries and asked bluntly.
Long Ling'er was clearly also satisfied with this type of exchange and nodded. ”He told me to tell you that since you killed Lou Wanying, you will also inherit his karma."
"And?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow.
“Nothing else." Long Ling'er, however, shook her head, then excused herself and left as quickly as she came.
This actually puzzled Gu Nan a little. She came all the way here just to say this?
This wasn’t the first time Gu Nan had heard the concept of “karma."
As early as his time in Star Realm, a large portion of reincarnators believed that reincarnation was an act that affected karma.
But as his level rose, Gu Nan was more inclined to believe it was nonsense.
But the karma that Long Ling'er had paid a special visit to warn him about didn’t seem that simple, no matter how he looked at it.
However, Gu Nan soon realized how this karma manifested.
"My Lord, someone came to our door again. It doesn’t seem like we can make them leave very easily this time,” in White Bones Realm, Red Tail hurriedly came to report to Gu Nan again.
"Which side are they from again?" Gu Nan asked after some thought.
"It's Daoist Sect Realm this time."
Gu Nan knew what the other party was here for as soon as he heard the name.
Daoist Sect Realm wasn’t among the Heaven Level planes, but it wasn't far from it. It was only slightly weaker than top-tier Realm Level planes like White Bones Realm.
Even more importantly, Daoist Sect Realm and Void Grotto Heaven originated from the same source.
Back when Void Grotto Heaven was undergoing a cataclysmic change, it was because of a fight between two martial brothers. In the end, the senior brother succeeded in ascending and took charge of Void Grotto Heaven.
The defeated junior brother left in disgrace and established his own astral world outside, under the name of Daoist Sect.
In this way, the Star Ruler of Daoist Sect Realm, Daoist Monarch Wu Tian, was actually Yu Lian’s martial uncle.
So when people from Daoist Sect Realm came knocking on Gu Nan’s door, their goal was naturally the ancient Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance. After all, to them, this inheritance was no different from their own inheritance, and it might even be more complete than their current inheritance.
“Should we let them in?" Red Tail asked when she saw Gu Nan’s look of understanding.
"No need." Gu Nan, however, had absolutely no intention of going out to meet anyone and casually told her, "Just relay my message to them."
"What message?”
"Inheritance, don’t have, fuck off."
……
A few minutes later, Red Tail stood outside White Mist’s branch office in White Bones Realm, entertaining the two emissaries from Daoist Sect Realm.
She had a somewhat helpless smile on her face and a young girl sitting beside her—the only daughter of Daoist White Bones, Bai Qiaozhen.
With Daoist White Bones’ personality, Bai Qiaozhen was the de facto manager of White Bones Realm.
Red Tail was naturally the one who called Bai Qiaozhen over. She didn’t dare to actually convey Gu Nan’s message word for word. And since Gu Nan made it clear that he wouldn’t be accepting meetings with anyone, she could only rely on Bai Qiaozhen to send off the uninvited guests.
Fortunately, after the events surrounding White Bones Realm being besieged by seven planes, Daoist White Bones, a Star Ruler true to himself, had always been very kind to Gu Nan and had taken much care of White Mist.
“Honored guests, My Lord is indeed not here right now." Red Tail made a troubled face and suggested, "How about this, I will immediately inform the two of you as soon as he returns?"
The two men from Daoist Sect Realm were both dressed as Daoists. The older one called himself Wen Congdao, and the other was a young man called Guan Feng.
Wen Congdao always had a cold expression from beginning to end. On the other hand, the younger Guan Feng revealed a kind smile. “Why must Daoist Friend Red Tail say such things? Everyone knows that Lord Gu Nan lives here permanently."
Red Tail, now also a Void Cutter, had more courage in her heart and immediately changed her expression. “May I ask where you heard that? My Lord's whereabouts are not something we can inquire about excessively."
Having met two refusals in a row, Guan Feng's expression gradually turned cold.
At the side, Wen Congdao suddenly spoke up, "This matter is easy to resolve. Since Daoist Friend is sure that the person we’re looking for isn’t there, why don't you let us go inside and search?"
Red Tail immediately replied with a sneer, "Are you two joking?"
If even the organization's headquarters could be casually searched by outsiders, then there would be no need for White Mist to exist.
Wen Congdao's eyes narrowed slightly, and a dangerous glint shone in them, while Guan Feng glanced at Bai Qiaozhen next to him and spoke first, "In that case, this humble Daoist and Martial Uncle will take their leave."
After saying that, Guan Feng actually stood up, and Wen Congdao followed suit.
Seeing their figures fading away, Bai Qiaozhen couldn't help sighing, “From what I’ve seen, you guys will have to prepare in advance."

chapters.title: Chapter 391: Siege
chapters.content:
Be it Red Tail or White Mist, of course it was necessary for both to prepare in advance. Daoist Sect Realm wasn’t a weak force and was on the same level as Star Realm in its earlier years. It belonged to the second echelon of Realm Level planes.
Based on Gu Nan’s level system, Daoist Monarch Wu Tian was probably around Tier 8. The current Gu Nan naturally wasn’t capable of defeating him, but running away wasn’t a problem.
In other words, Gu Nan wasn’t afraid of Daoist Sect Realm.
This was perfectly reflected in his following attitude.
“No need to care about their identities." Gu Nan's saint clone was just sitting deep in White Mist’s headquarters. “As long as Wu Tian himself doesn’t come, treat any other uninvited guests the same way."
No matter how powerful Daoist Sect Realm was, it was merely a Realm Level plane that couldn’t possibly have Star Ruler subordinates, so Wu Tian's underlings were at most Void Cutters.
And if Void Cutters came over to attack White Mist… White Mist might even be able to take care of all attackers itself without needing Gu Nan’s help.
Gu Nan spent so much effort raising forces with the Time Arena and recruiting people from Crescent Moon World and the World of Gods precisely because he wanted capable subordinates.
Tier 4 was the highest level for mortals. It was impossible for divine servants to reach this level anytime soon, so he could only rely on apostles.
Today's White Mist included a Void Cutter Realm Red Tail, three Legend Rank vampires stationed here, Crescent Moon World's Transcendent Realm martial artists, as well as locally recruited experts from White Bones Realm…
To put it bluntly, if not for the deterrent called Daoist Monarch Wu Tian standing behind Daoist Sect Realm, Red Tail could’ve captured Wen Congdao and his companion on the spot.
So Red Tail largely agreed with Gu Nan’s attitude, but she asked, "What if Wu Tian actually decides to come in person?"
Gu Nan thought about it and answered quite earnestly, "Then I'll take a stroll around Daoist Sect Realm."
……
Although Gu Nan all but ignored Lou Wanying's karma, other people didn't have the same thoughts.
After Bai Qiaozhen left White Mist, she informed Daoist White Bones of the current situation. The latter's comment on this was simply a single sentence: “Help Gu Nan with whatever he wants.”
Daoist White Bones had never been a ruler who shied away from troublesome matters. A mere Daoist Sect Realm wasn’t enough to make him change his mind.
On the other side, there was another person paying attention to Gu Nan.
Zi Luo Heaven.
Duan Wenqi was quite an interesting person. He was a relatively strong Star Ruler and also one of the leaders of Astral Gate.
Very few people knew that Duan Wenqi was actually one of Astral Gate’s founders, and the earliest Astral Gate was established in Zi Luo Heaven.
As the founders from back then either died or entered Star Ruler Realm, the only one still willing to invest a lot of energy in Astral Gate was Duan Wenqi alone.
In a sense, the current Astral Gate was about to become Duan Wenqi's sole possession. If he wanted, it was possible to take over the entire organization with just a little preparation.
Duan Wenqi was now sitting inside Astral Gate, and the documents placed in front of him were all regarding Gu Nan.
From the time he killed Lou Wanying, to his brief appearance in Jin Lin World, to the visit from people of Daoist Sect Realm heading to White Bones Realm—all the information was laid out in full in front of Duan Wenqi.
“Really, what youthful vigor!" Duan Wenqi certainly saw White Mist’s response and couldn't help revealing a smile.
In his opinion, since people were already coveting the inheritance in Gu Nan’s hands, he should find a way to resolve it.
The best method was naturally to prove that Gu Nan had nothing worth coveting—that is, to prove he didn’t have the inheritance, but this was very hard, and there was always bound to be people who didn’t believe him.
The next best method was to shift the target, such as handing over the inheritance or seeking a powerful figure’s protection. As long as someone else was standing in front of Gu Nan, at least he wouldn’t have to face these pressures himself.
But Gu Nan's current solution was undoubtedly the worst kind—he was simply opposing everyone head-on!
"Daoist Sect Realm is merely the tip of the iceberg. So many more people are also interested in the inheritance. How long can you hold out?" A cold smile flashed across Duan Wenqi's eyes.
Daoist Sect Realm actively sought out Gu Nan with the intention of asking for the inheritance because of their claim over it, but they didn't expect to be barred from meeting Gu Nan. The other forces, on the other hand, wouldn’t actively expose themselves like this.
In fact, Duan Wenqi had no reason to pay so much attention to Gu Nan; there was no direct conflict between the two.
It's just that the previous several confrontations made Duan Wenqi naturally resent Gu Nan, and if he could see Gu Nan suffer, he would be happy to do so.
"How about adding some more fuel to the fire…”
……
On the third day since the two emissaries from Daoist Sect Realm left White Mist, a suicide team shouting the slogan “ancient inheritance" broke inside White Mist.
Of course, this team, which didn’t even have a single Void Cutter, was taken down in a flash, but the implication was significant.
It meant that the first shot in the fight over ancient Void Grotto Heaven's inheritance had been fired.
Early the next morning, Wen Congdao and Guan Feng stood in front of White Mist’s gates once again.
"This time, I think Daoist Friend Red Tail will make a wise decision." Guan Feng still had a kind smile on his face, only it looked more mocking.
It was only a few days, but it was already enough for them to gather the information they wanted.
It wasn’t just one or two forces eyeing the inheritance. The number of spies currently lurking outside White Mist might even surpass the actual members White Mist had.
With so many astral worlds and Star Rulers watching, not even their Daoist Sect Realm dared to oppose everyone here head-on, so what power did a mere White Mist have to resist to the end?
Even if Gu Nan ascended to Star Ruler Realm and controlled an astral world, his astral world was still far from becoming a Realm Level plane, let alone the fact that there were even a few Realm Level astral worlds currently watching him.
"If she isn’t sensible, then someone will teach her to be sensible,” Wen Congdao said with an icy expression.
This martial uncle and nephew pair carried out the carrot-and-stick act well. They’d been working together quite well all year long.
But contrary to their expectations, the person who walked out of White Mist this time wasn’t Red Tail, but a silver-robed man with a calm face.
The two couldn’t help exchanging a smile after recognizing the other party’s face—in the end, the other side decided to compromise.
It wasn’t easy to meet a Star Ruler’s true body. The fact that Gu Nan was willing to meet them through a clone was enough to satisfy their mission. In any case, even if they wanted to make a deal over the inheritance, that wasn’t a job for two lowly Void Cutters.
The smile on Guan Feng's face thickened. "Lord Gu Nan, I’ve been looking forward to meeting you for a long time. This humble Daoist and Martial Uncle—“
"Want the inheritance?" Gu Nan, however, interrupted him bluntly.
Such directness stunned Guan Feng slightly, but he then came back to his senses and smiled. "Exactly."
Gu Nan nodded and shouted behind the two again, "Anyone else who’s here for the inheritance, come out. Don't blame me for not warning you. Those who don’t show themselves now will never have another chance to get the inheritance."
As Gu Nan's words fell, dozens of figures instantly appeared behind Guan Feng and Wen Congdao, each of them at Void Cutter Realm.
Naturally, only Void Cutters could ensure any urgent messages were sent back immediately.
Wen Congdao still said stiffly, "Hand over the inheritance, and we can try to satisfy your conditions."
His words also represented the attitude of the entire crowd. After all, the one before them was just a clone, so they weren’t afraid of sudden attacks from Gu Nan. Moreover, this crowd included dozens of astral worlds…
Before he could finish such thoughts, the crowd felt the sky suddenly darken as a giant hand made of shadows descended from above.

chapters.title: Chapter 392: Star Rulers Arrive
chapters.content:
Gu Nan's true body was standing in the sky above White Bones Realm, and Tier 6 laws gushed out generously, enlarging the giant hand of shadows.
The terrifying and wildly expanding shadow fell like a titanic mountain, stunning dozens of Void Cutters from various forces in this instant.
Even the most radical strategist wouldn’t have guessed Gu Nan's move—he truly planned to make enemies of dozens of astral worlds simultaneously and was actually attacking with his main body!
‘This, this, this… Isn't this the strong bullying the weak?!’
The ones bearing the brunt of the attack were Wen Congdao and Guan Feng. Their “oh crap” feeling was far heavier than the people next to them.
But faced with the crisis that suddenly struck, no one had time to complain about Gu Nan’s lack of manners. Without another thought, the cold-faced Wen Congdao took out an item and threw it on Guan Feng.
"Go!"
A flash of green light suddenly exploded out, instantly blowing Guan Feng away, but it allowed him to escape being locked onto by the laws powering the giant shadow hand, while Wen Congdao himself remained trapped in place.
After all, these laws were Tier 6, and the natural suppression from the higher level alone was enough to make it difficult for this group of Void Cutters to withstand.
"Martial Uncle!" A scream of sorrow tore out of Guan Feng's mouth, but there was nothing he could do except watch as the shadow hand fell and his martial uncle was engulfed.
It wasn’t just Wen Congdao; of the dozens of Void Cutters who showed up in response to Gu Nan’s shout, less than five ultimately escaped the fate of death.
Gu Nan’s palm strike directly slaughtered dozens of Void Cutters!
Even during wars between planes, no one had ever heard of so many Void Cutters dying at the same time.
After all, Void Cutters weren’t fools and wouldn’t voluntarily gather together in a dangerous situation and send themselves right to their deaths.
Except for this time…
"Gu Nan! Although you can kill all of us here today, the Daoist Monarch absolutely won’t spare you!"
Guan Feng's eyes were bloodshot, having lost all of his usual refinement and elegance. Instead, his face was filled with a hideous, sinister expression.
He thought Gu Nan must’ve gone crazy, or else why would anyone make enemies of dozens of astral worlds simultaneously?
These were major astral worlds with considerable reputation!
The few other Void Cutter survivors were also cursing Gu Nan out, but even more were turning around and fleeing.
Gu Nan going crazy was his own business. However, they couldn’t afford to endanger their own lives just for a psycho.
Only Guan Feng felt it hard to suppress the grief and rage in his heart after seeing his martial uncle die right in front of his eyes, and then…
Boom!
Another giant shadow hand fell, and Guan Feng looked like he was also about to be crushed into powder.
His poor martial uncle sacrificed his life to give Guan Feng a chance to live, but now his sacrifice seemed in vain.
“You dare?!” An explosive shout came from the sky just then, and a figure dressed in golden Daoist robes instantly appeared above Guan Feng.
He created a seal with a wave of his hand and flung it out, which collided directly with the giant shadow hand as both attacks simultaneously dissipated.
Having just escaped from death, Guan Feng couldn’t help gazing at that Daoist gratefully. "Daoist Monarch…”
"I know." Daoist Monarch Wu Tian nodded with a cold face. "Your martial uncle will not die in vain."
As soon as Wu Tian appeared, another figure also appeared on the scene. This person wore a crown made of bones and had a sickly pale face, his expression grave. He was none other than Daoist White Bones.
Since two outside Star Rulers personally descended to White Bones Realm, Daoist White Bones had to appear no matter what.
Wu Tian looked at him coldly. "White Bones, this matter is our personal feud. Mind your own business."
“I can’t mind matters happening right inside my White Bones Realm?" Daoist White Bones questioned back without any hint of politeness.
These two were both addressed as monarchs and had stubborn personalities. At this time, neither gave in.
By this stage, the surrounding Void Cutters had either died or fled, so there were no longer many people at the scene.
But too many people had died under Gu Nan's palm, so much so that countless Star Rulers cast their gazes towards this place.
A dangerous glint flashed through Wu Tian's eyes. He didn't want to make an enemy of Daoist White Bones for no reason, but he couldn’t afford to lose face when so many forces were watching.
Next to him, Guan Feng understood this and immediately spoke up, "We have no intention of making an enemy of Your Lordship, but Gu Nan slaughtered my pitiful master uncle for no reason, along with dozens of fellow Daoists. We must seek justice for them!"
"That's right,” a gloomy, sorrowful voice added as another person walked over from the horizon. He was a man in gray.
"It's the Star Ruler of No-Other Realm,” Guan Feng's eyes lit up as he blurted out.
"Killing people whenever you want—do you believe we’re all easy to bully?"
“There were rumors earlier about him being the reincarnation of a Heavenly Demon. Looking at it now, they might not be rumors after all.”
“Good timing, then we’ll exterminate evil and uphold justice today.”
As the conversation picked up, more and more Star Rulers descended to White Bones Realm, their target all being Gu Nan.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, watched all this indifferently from beginning to end, his expression never changing. He didn't care how many people were hostile to him; on the contrary, he was even afraid that there wouldn't be enough people hostile to him.
When it comes to resolving karma, Duan Wenqi understood, but Gu Nan also understood. It’s just that he preferred to use his own methods to deal with it.
In just a few short moments, nearly twenty Star Rulers had shown up. Daoist White Bones still faced them with a cold expression. After all, this was his astral world. He had nothing to worry about, even if more enemies came.
Among the group of Star Rulers, one person walked out of the crowd and said to Gu Nan, "Gu Nan, do you dare to change locations to have a fair fight with me?"
The person who stepped forward carried a long blade on his back. He was a burly man with a firm expression.
"Blade King World’s Wang He,” Red Tail whispered to Gu Nan’s clone down below. ”Wang He and Jin Lin are close friends."
Gu Nan wasn’t surprised. Jin Lin was a veteran Star Ruler of many years, so he naturally had his own network. It’s just that Gu Nan’s earlier war happened too fast and caught them off guard.
But Gu Nan had zero intention of answering Wang He. With a flicker, his figure had already vanished.
The next second, he reappeared directly in front of Wang He.
This was the first time Gu Nan attacked under the gazes of countless forces. Just his terrifying speed alone already scared the crowd.
Wang He was also startled, but he quickly calmed down. He knew a little about Gu Nan. This understanding mainly came from Jin Lin.
From Jin Lin’s description, Gu Nan was just a despicable villain who used a special ability to forcibly hold him up for a few moments and wasn't actually that strong.
Wang He drew his long blade, the action seemingly slow but extremely fast in reality. The power from Blade King World was already working to strengthen him.
Even if he wasn’t in his astral world and received less power, Wang He still had enough confidence he could beat Gu Nan.
Because through Jin Lin, he knew one of Gu Nan's greatest weaknesses—he didn’t have an astral world strengthening him!
So Wang He already started swinging his long blade before Gu Nan's fist hit while simultaneously calling his opponent's bluff, "Gu Nan, your astral world has yet to form. How can you block this slash of mine?!"
His words immediately caused a renewed commotion among the crowd of Star Rulers. The fact that Gu Nan actually hadn’t reached that step yet gave them even more confidence.
Only Gu Nan himself wasn’t moved in the slightest; his punch fell as usual.
Let alone power from an astral world, he didn’t even use any laws, relying on the power of his physical body.
But in precisely such an exchange, the long blade cut into Gu Nan’s body without any hindrance, while Gu Nan’s fist also hit Wang He in the chest.
The next moment, Wang He's chest cavity cracked open like plastic, inch by inch. He revealed an incredulous look.
Gu Nan, however, acted like nothing had happened as he pulled the long blade out of his chest, then swept his gaze across the crowd behind him, revealing a cold smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 393: Don’t Recognize Anyone
chapters.content:
The open space outside White Mist was instantly plunged into an inexplicable silence.
Gu Nan's attitude was so fierce that the group of Star Rulers were all flabbergasted—there was no enmity between them!
In fact, even if they surrounded Gu Nan like this, their ultimate goal was only to force him to hand over Void Grotto Heaven’s inheritance. Not many actually wanted to kill Gu Nan.
Because they knew it wasn’t a simple matter to kill a Star Ruler who might have an astral world—at the very least, they first had to know where his astral world was.
At the Star Ruler level, very few people acted impulsively. The vast majority of them only acted to further their own interests, making the most beneficial choice for themselves.
Because of this, they didn’t understand Gu Nan's actions.
How can someone just start a fight to the death without even saying a word?
‘We didn’t go through all this trouble to climb to Star Ruler Realm, trampling tens of thousands of mortals under our feet, just to engage in fights to the death! There are so many resources; won’t it be great if everyone can develop peacefully?'
The Star Rulers were puzzled. Classmate Wang He, who received a punch from Gu Nan, was even more puzzled.
Not only did he not understand Gu Nan's attitude, but he also didn’t understand why this punch contained such frightening strength and why the other party seemed unharmed by his blade.
Now Wang He knew that his good friend Jin Lin was absolutely bullshitting him— ‘What do you mean, average strength? A single punch from Gu Nan almost smashed me apart!’
If not for his own astral world’s protection, he really would’ve died under this punch.
With no time for further thoughts, Wang He’s figure directly exploded into a cloud of blade energy, instantly breaking away from Gu Nan's attack and fleeing to the rear in panic.
Then, without waiting for anyone to greet him, he actually opened a portal and darted inside.
“He actually ran back to his own astral world. How cowardly!” Some Star Rulers couldn't help mocking, though their voices sounded a little uncertain.
To be fair, if one were to be targeted by a psycho like Gu Nan, they were afraid they would also have to hide away for a while… ‘Yup, this is a strategic retreat.’
On the other hand, Gu Nan's gaze had already fallen on them.
Gu Nan didn’t choose to attack the frontmost Daoist Monarch Wu Tian because Wu Tian's strength was around Tier 8. He wasn’t someone Gu Nan could kill just because he wanted to.
The targets he chose were a few people standing at the back of the group.
Star Rulers were all smart people and had very accurate judgment of the situation. Of course they didn’t mind showing up when they believed Gu Nan couldn’t escape from the disaster and there seemed to be hope of getting the inheritance.
But even so, it was impossible for some weaker Star Rulers to be at the front of the group, such as…
"Little Sumeru World’s Qin Anqi!"
"Cai Xi!"
"Underworld Star Sovereign!"
Gu Nan listed off one name after another as he swept his gaze across the rear of the group. They were none other than the Star Rulers he was targeting.
Among those Star Rulers, there were newly-advanced ones who just came into possession of astral worlds, as well as normal ones who’d yet to control an astral world and only acted under their real names or Daoist titles.
On the ground, Red Tail stood behind the saint clone and carefully reported these Star Rulers’ origins to him—as White Mist gained more power and influence, Red Tail's insight was naturally far superior to her previous self.
The three Star Rulers whose names were called felt their scalps go numb, especially as they watched Gu Nan's figure approach them at an unimaginable speed.
Without even thinking, two of the three quickly fled. Only the middle-aged man nicknamed “Underworld Star Sovereign" stayed behind.
Even Qin Anqi, who had an astral world, ran away, but this Underworld Star Sovereign dared to stay behind—he really was bold.
"Everyone, please help me—”
Bang!
Before the Underworld Star Sovereign finished speaking, he saw Gu Nan's figure blink away, flat-out ignoring the many laws locking him into place and directly appearing behind his enemy.
The punch that immediately followed directly blasted the Underworld Star Sovereign’s head to pieces.
A supreme Star Ruler who surpassed the mortal world died at this point.
Even until his death, the Underworld Star Sovereign had a look of disbelief in his eyes, because Gu Nan's fighting style was completely beyond their understanding.
There had never been a Star Ruler who relied purely on their physical body to fight!
Fights between Star Rulers were already purely in the realm of laws. Even for people like Xue Ren and Wang He, who used swords or blades, they were still merely using their weapons to control laws.
Moreover, because their laws were related to weapons—eventually condensing laws into weapons—the power was far greater than ordinary weapons.
As for the legendary body refining cultivators, that was also achieved by strengthening oneself with the power of laws, and then manifesting superb strength.
Either way, as long as one faced laws on a higher level, they were bound to be suppressed—only Gu Nan remained unaffected.
Because the source of his power really was just his physical body.
“You’ve got guts." A nasty grin appeared on Gu Nan's face as he swung another fist down, shattering the Underworld Star Sovereign’s corpse.
The next moment, a large seal suddenly appeared above Gu Nan's head, smashing down on him out of thin air. The words "Daoist Sect" were clearly engraved on the seal.
Daoist Sect Realm’s Daoist Monarch Wu Tian finally made a move.
Star Rulers weren’t fools who’d stand around waiting to be killed. And it was impossible for them to notify Gu Nan before they made a move.
Wu Tian was certainly not the only person who struck at this most opportune moment. Among the remaining Star Rulers, at least half of them also made their move simultaneously, while the other half still had a wait-and-see mentality.
Various laws emerged, both openly and in the dark. Some were blatantly obvious, while others were insidious and vicious. The number of attacks was almost dazzling.
Daoist Monarch Wu Tian fixed his gaze on Gu Nan, but he was very certain of the outcome. ‘No matter how strong your resistance to laws is, it’s impossible to escape unscathed when surrounded by so many laws.’
But a cold smile emerged on Gu Nan’s face. His figure flickered again and instantly turned into pure shadows.
Surrounded on all sides, it was true that it was impossible for Gu Nan to break through with his Evil God physique, but he still had the law of shadows. Just how good was the law of shadows at running away? One could tell just by looking at Sylvia.
The Sylvia in the World of Gods was also only Tier 6, yet the reason she could survive through several godly world wars wasn’t only because she had an overprotective older brother.
After all, when the two major godly factions went to war, her identity was no longer a form of protection. Instead, she became an attractive target for enemy gods.
If she hadn't run into Gu Nan—someone who also controlled shadows—back then, it would’ve been almost impossible for anyone to catch Sylvia.
Countless laws fell, and the shadows that Gu Nan turned into were wantonly torn apart, as if they were cut apart by a large net, turning into pieces of fragmented shadows.
But the next second, these broken pieces instantly reorganized themselves to form a new Gu Nan.
“Next," Gu Nan's cold voice rang out, causing the hearts of the Star Rulers present to chill in unison. Countless protective measures instantly sprung up in front of them.
Gu Nan's gaze was fixed on one person in the group, and his figure rushed over in a flash.
"Wait! You don't even know me. Why would you single me out?!” That Star Ruler retreated at the fastest speed in his life as he shouted.
“It’s not like I know anyone else either,” Gu Nan, who was already too lazy to listen to Red Tail's introductions, retorted coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 394: World-Renowned With One Battle
chapters.content:
Duan Wenqi and Lu Wen sat across from each other in Zi Luo Heaven, watching the events unfolding in White Bones Realm.
There was nothing strange about this. Around 80% of the powerful figures in the Myriad Heavens were probably all watching White Bones Realm right now.
“Don’t tell me he’ll really be able to find a solution just by killing like this?!" Duan Wenqi exclaimed incredulously.
Lu Wen just chuckled without responding.
Long Ling'er still maintained her giant dragon form and stood on Lu Wen's shoulder. Her neck was slightly lowered, and there was some grievance on her face—this room wasn’t high enough.
Duan Wenqi wasn’t in the mood to pay attention to Long Ling'er's emotions. He slapped the table and continued, “Not even dozens of Star Rulers can suppress this Gu Nan. Looks like there's no need for us to protect him."
“Really now, you still can't let go of that anger in your heart." Lu Wen couldn't help laughing as he pointed at Duan Wenqi.
Of course Duan Wenqi couldn't let it go. He didn’t have a superior-subordinate relationship with Lu Wen, and he’d always thought of them as equals in his heart. Because of this, he was extraordinarily angry with Gu Nan.
Because he also put a lot of effort in this entire matter.
If he was simply helping Lu Wen, then while it was unfortunate, there was also no need to dwell on bygone matters for so long.
After a pause, Lu Wen continued, "Gu Nan's trump cards have already been exposed—the law of shadows and an extremely strong physique. Such a combination is indeed very difficult to handle."
The extreme escape ability granted by the law of shadows coupled with the pure use of physical force against the enemy allowed Gu Nan to challenge opponents of a higher level.
Of course Duan Wenqi also understood this, so he also sighed in relief at this time. “To force out his trump cards—this trip wasn't a waste after all."
……
In White Bones Realm, after yet another Star Ruler was targeted by Gu Nan, and after Gu Nan rushed into the crowd in the blink of an eye, the Star Rulers scattered in all directions instead.
Now everyone knew that they couldn’t threaten Gu Nan by joining forces, and Gu Nan had the ability to pick off the weaker members of their group.
Instead of staying in the same place and risking friendly fire, they might as well disperse in advance and leave enough room for those capable of dealing with Gu Nan.
Gu Nan merely had strange abilities, but he wasn’t invincible. The Star Rulers present all saw through this.
Wu Tian was the first to strike. In a single step, he arrived right in front of Gu Nan, blocking his path—since space wasn’t currently sealed by countless laws, the space-shrinking technique could naturally also be used.
But Gu Nan didn’t even spare him a glance. His body suddenly disappeared, having turned into shadows again.
When he reappeared, he was already behind the target Star Ruler, stabbing a shadow dagger straight into the enemy’s heart.
This Star Ruler was an average-looking young man. He was caught off guard and could only barely respond.
This youth wasn’t a martial artist to begin with and only used Tier 5 defensive laws, so how could he be Gu Nan’s match?
Even if Gu Nan didn’t use the Evil God physique’s full strength in this attack, the Tier 6 shadow dagger was still enough to deal with him.
The dagger pierced through the youth's defensive laws like thin paper, then sank into his abdomen.
Behind them, Daoist Monarch Wu Tian’s face turned bright red, enraged at Gu Nan's reckless abandon and also at his own two failed attack attempts.
But the law of shadows really was too slippery, making him both hard to catch and hard to hit. Plus, it was also extremely lethal in Gu Nan's hands, giving people incomparable headaches.
Seeing Gu Nan injure yet another Star Ruler, Wu Tian's thoughts churned rapidly, his gaze finally falling to the White Mist building below them.
His eyes immediately lit up, as if he’d caught Gu Nan's weakness, and he shouted, "Gu Nan, if you don’t surrender right now, this one will start sacrificing your people!"
As soon as he said this, there was indeed a pause in Gu Nan’s movements, and then he slowly turned his head.
Only the look on Gu Nan's face wasn’t the annoyance of being caught in a painful situation as he expected, but a sneer of disdain.
Gu Nan suddenly announced to his surroundings, “Everyone, come find me in Daoist Sect Realm if you want the inheritance."
After saying that, Gu Nan ignored the Star Rulers around him, opening a portal and stepping inside.
There was no need to even think. Everyone knew which plane was at the other end of this passage.
Daoist Monarch Wu Tian couldn’t hide the stupefied look on his face, but he didn’t have time to think further and hurriedly followed Gu Nan back to his own astral world.
……
"He ran to Daoist Sect Realm."
In Void Grotto Heaven, Xue Ren said as he gently wiped a longsword placed flat in front of him.
Yu Lian stood next to him with some curiosity on her face. “At his current realm, he actually dares to fight Wu Tian inside Daoist Sect Realm?"
Since they shared the same roots, Yu Lian understood her martial uncle’s cultivation realm better than most and knew that Wu Tian’s strength was absolutely genuine.
From leaving Void Grotto Heaven after his advancement to Star Ruler and ascending his own astral world to a Realm Level plane, there had been absolutely no luck involved in any of that.
"How can that be?" Xue Ren, however, laughed involuntarily. “In my view, Gu Nan is doing this precisely because he
doesn’t
want to fight Wu Tian."
……
In Daoist Sect Realm, Daoist Monarch Wu Tian stood above the void, overlooking the expanses of ruins below, his face so dark it could be mistaken for a storm cloud.
In just a few short moments, his Daoist Sect Realm was already wrecked by Gu Nan, and three important strongholds in a row were destroyed by two shadow swords.
Yet Wu Tian, as this world’s Star Ruler, couldn’t even catch the other party’s shadow!
The Star Rulers staying in their own astral worlds were also watching this scene and chatting from the sidelines.
“It’s Wu Tian’s loss this time."
"This Gu Nan is too slippery. The law of shadows is secretive and unpredictable. We simply can’t catch him."
"Actually, the most important thing is that we can't find Gu Nan's astral world, right?"
This sentence immediately silenced all the Star Rulers.
At this point, no one had any doubt that Gu Nan was a Star Ruler who already possessed an astral world. But the fact that no one could find his astral world’s location was the most awkward factor.
Not being able to find his astral world meant that he could act with impunity, and he also just happened to have the ability to act with impunity!
He ran to Daoist Sect Realm to wreak havoc, yet Wu Tian couldn’t even catch him—this was his greatest ability.
The group of spectators put themselves in Wu Tian's shoes and asked themselves if they could do anything against such a Gu Nan?
The answer made everyone fall silent.
"Gu Nan!" Daoist Monarch Wu Tian couldn’t help speaking up after yet another failed chase, biting Gu Nan’s dust once again.
Although he couldn't see Gu Nan's figure, he knew the other party could hear him.
Wu Tian could only take a deep breath. "Daoist Friend Gu, this humble Daoist was possessed by greed and attempted to take your inheritance. When this matter is over, this humble Daoist will make amends to you, how about it?"
No one expected for Wu Tian, the Daoist Monarch who valued face the most, to admit defeat so readily.
"Okay."
After a long time, Gu Nan's voice came directly from the horizon, but his figure couldn’t be seen.
Daoist Monarch Wu Tian, who received Gu Nan's reply, finally let out a sigh of relief tinged with helplessness.
In the Myriad Heavens, countless people also sighed at the same time.
Everyone knew that as long as they couldn’t find the coordinates of Gu Nan's astral world, there would be one more demon king in this world.
And on the next day, countless powerhouses’ remarks on this matter gradually spread.
“Except for Heaven Level planes, there’s nowhere he can't go." This was Weapon Martial Heaven’s Star Ruler.
“Even more of a troublemaker than Lou Wanying.” This was Lu Wen.
"Whoever ends up finding his astral world, remember to let me know first." This was Void Grotto Heaven’s Yu Lian.
……
Countless discussions and rumors rose in all directions until deep in Zi Luo Heaven, an old man who’d been slumbering for eons suddenly spoke.
"Haha, world-renowned with one battle."
The Myriad Heavens Universe’s evaluation of Gu Nan was thus determined.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: Zi Luo’s Past
chapters.content:
Zi Luo Heaven, the first Heaven Level plane Gu Nan came into contact with, was actually a very special existence.
As the largest neutral trading plane in the Myriad Heavens, Zi Luo Heaven was filled with the shadows of all major organizations, many of which had set up their headquarters here or were even created here.
Everyone was used to Zi Luo Heaven’s current appearance, but few people ever wondered who the Star Ruler of Zi Luo Heaven really was.
It was only after Gu Nan made such a big commotion this time and the old man slumbering in Zi Luo Heaven suddenly woke up and spoke that comment that many people realized there was such an existence.
"Zi Luo Elder? To think that even he returned." Duan Wenqi was also from that era, so of course he heard rumors of this person.
But those were merely rumors, because by the time he and Lu Wen became cultivators, Zi Luo Elder had long since fallen into a deep slumber.
In a rare occurrence, no smile could be seen on Lu Wen's face this time. Instead, it was full of seriousness. "Zi Luo Elder… He lived in an era much earlier than even Dream Immortal, yet he awakened at this juncture. It can't possibly be a coincidence."
Duan Wenqi couldn’t be more familiar with the name Dream Immortal. This woman, who was older than both he and Lu Wen by a little over half a generation, was none other than Lou Wanying's mother. She was a powerhouse who once buried herself.
Duan Wenqi was silent for a moment before saying, "Zi Luo Elder’s cultivation realm fell a hundred thousand years ago, and now even his astral world has become public domain, so what can he use to recover his strength?"
“Perhaps the reason he awakened now is also the same reason he might be able to recover his strength in the future,” Lu Wen answered lightly.
Duan Wenqi couldn’t help but freeze upon hearing those words as a figure immediately sprang into his mind.
By now, he no longer dared to underestimate Gu Nan at all—Wu Tian was stronger than himself, and the fact that Wu Tian couldn't do anything to Gu Nan meant that he would end up the same way.
To think that a weakling Star Ruler who just acquired his own astral world could actually wreak havoc in Realm Level planes at will. This surpassed Duan Wenqi's expectations.
……
Like Lu Wen, many others also pondered the reason behind Zi Luo Elder’s awakening, because the first words he spoke after his slumber were way too targeted.
Thus, Gu Nan's reputation, almost like an inflated balloon, flew to every corner of the Myriad Heavens.
He’d gone from a junior with a rising reputation to a big shot with an infamous reputation that no organization dared to underestimate.
This was, after all, a vicious character who could force the Star Ruler of a Realm Level plane to bow his head in apology, all while Gu Nan never once showed his face.
On the other hand, it was also because Gu Nan's name was tied to this legendary figure, Zi Luo Elder.
Almost overnight, this old man who’d been forgotten by the times was once again remembered by all the forces. They remembered his former glory, but they also remembered his fall.
Zi Luo Heaven was one of the most ancient astral worlds. In the earliest days, there were only four planes on the level of the current Thirteen Heavens, and Zi Luo Heaven was one of them.
Furthermore, Zi Luo Elder was widely known by his title, "peach and plum all over the world,” which referred to how his students and direct disciples were everywhere in the Myriad Heavens.
Even the law with which he achieved Unified Dao was related to this point. But this also laid the groundwork for his fall.
Zi Luo Elder’s law was related to “teaching," so he became an obstacle for Song Fei, the ruler of Academic Heaven, when he gradually drew closer to Unified Dao Realm.
Although the two’s laws didn’t completely overlap, as long as Zi Luo Elder existed, Song Fei’s chances of breaking through to Unified Dao were pitifully small. No matter how much self-confidence Song Fei possessed, he still refused to take any risks with his own foundation.
So it wasn’t a surprise that Song Fei eventually teamed up with Jiu Po Heaven, which was already at Unified Dao Realm, to set a trap for Zi Luo Elder, making his cultivation realm fall.
Next, before anyone else had time to react, Song Fei entered Unified Dao in one fell swoop. No matter how dissatisfied Zi Luo Elder’s disciples and grand-disciples were, there was nothing much they could do.
This was a very dishonorable tactic, but then again, honor wasn’t ever a consideration when someone’s path to the great Dao was blocked.
"Nonsense, utter nonsense! Grandpa Song is such a kindhearted person. How could he ever do such a thing?!" Inside Academic Heaven, Yu Shuyun had bandages wrapped around her chest, but her face was filled with anger.
Yu Shuyun, who should’ve died in Heavenly Mansion World after being impaled through the chest by Gu Nan’s fist, was saved by her senior brother.
"Of course Grandpa Song couldn't have done that. It’s just baseless slander by some villains.” Chu Mingxuan walked into the room with disdain on his face. “Nevermind that, though. The most important thing right now is to recuperate. Don't pay attention to outside matters."
Yu Shuyun was still a bit indignant, but she sat down peacefully under her senior brother’s persuasion.
Song Fei stepped into Unified Dao Realm too early, so not many people remembered what happened almost 100,000 years ago.
Moreover, after Song Fei's ascension to the ranks of the Thirteen Heavens, plenty of people were willing to help whitewash him. Plus, he himself wasn’t really a wicked or evil person, so the secrets from back then were covered up. At least, not many people in Academic Heaven knew the truth.
From the bottom of her heart, Yu Shuyun didn’t believe in this kind of nonsense. Instead, it was very easy for her to cast those thoughts aside.
When she sat down again, Chu Mingxuan continued, “We may have found the person who hurt you earlier."
"Who is it?!" Yu Shuyun immediately stood up again, grimacing in pain when she instantly aggravated the injury on her chest.
Chu Mingxuan helplessly pushed her back down and took out a scroll and handed it to her. On it was a painting of Gu Nan's saint clone from the battle in White Bones Realm.
Yu Shuyun had seen Gu Nan fight, and his abilities were quite recognizable. Plus, with Gu Nan’s current reputation, it really wasn't hard to recognize him.
"That's right! That's him… Wait a minute, he's that Gu Nan?" Yu Shuyun also paid attention to this recent battle and instantly recognized the background in the scroll.
Chu Mingxuan nodded with a dark expression. ”Yes."
His mood was somewhat heavy. If the person who injured his junior sister was Gu Nan, then it wouldn’t be that simple for himself and the others to take revenge.
‘Even if Master makes a move, there’s still no guarantee… No, Master likely won’t be able to kill him either.’
Even Daoist Monarch Wu Tian could only watch Gu Nan come and go in his own astral world. As long as Gu Nan himself didn’t court death by running into certain large astral worlds, then who could capture him?
But Yu Shuyun didn’t care about all that. She immediately grabbed Chu Mingxuan's sleeve. "Senior Brother, you have to avenge me! He killed Ah Bu and almost killed me!"
As she said this, Yu Shuyun's eyes almost spewed flames.
But Chu Mingxuan was slightly taken aback, then his eyes lit up. “That’s right! Qi Bu also died at Gu Nan’s hands! Let’s tell the Graceful Academy about this matter and have them go after Gu Nan!"
The Graceful Academy was also the Confucian Academy where Qi Bu studied. Yu Shuyun stared blankly, then asked, "Will they… actually help?”
"Of course!" Chu Mingxuan’s face was full of confidence. "Do you know what those foolish bookworms value the most?"
“…Loyalty and righteousness?”
"Wrong, it's face!"

chapters.title: Chapter 396: Two Years, Tier 7
chapters.content:
Gu Nan disappeared from everyone’s sight after killing off a bunch of Star Rulers; no one knew where he went.
It wasn’t like nobody knew—at least one person, insignificant to the point where no one knew about him, accidentally learned of Gu Nan's whereabouts.
"Ah Hua, where do you think we are?" Dong Xun hid in the underbrush, allowing the rain to freely drip down his head.
"My name is Fan Hua—”
“Then you’re Ah Hua,” Dong Xun licked his lips and casually interrupted, but his gaze was fixed in front of him.
Two people were cautiously walking over from that direction. They kept glancing around, as if they were looking for something.
However, Dong Xun's concealment was so good that not even the slightest sound of breathing could be heard. There was no way to detect him at all.
The instant the two walked past Dong Xun, Dong Xun suddenly lunged, plunging his knife directly into the neck of the person in front.
At the same time, he leaned his head forward, opening his mouth and biting the other person’s carotid artery. Hot blood immediately gushed out.
In just a few seconds, Dong Xun turned himself into a bloody person, while two more corpses appeared in front of him.
"Ah Hua, where do you think we are?" The exact same question came out of Dong Xun's mouth.
“You lunatic, I told you this is not my world, I… Eh?”
The voice ringing in Dong Xun's head came to a screeching halt at a certain instant, dead silent as a figure landed in front of him.
“Self-taught genius?” Gu Nan looked around and couldn't help revealing an astonished smile.
Dong Xun was still smiling idiotically, like a fool people casually bullied, but the knife in his hand wasn’t slow at all as he stabbed Gu Nan in the waist.
The knife released a crisp crack the second it hit Gu Nan's waist and instantly broke in half. The broken knife flew out a long way, stressing just how strong Dong Xun's strength was.
Dong Xun's simpleminded smile started to look slightly puzzled. He held up the broken knife for quite a while, seemingly unable to figure out why Gu Nan was perfectly fine.
Gu Nan chuckled as he looked at Dong Xun. "Want to kill people?"
Dong Xun just looked up in confusion.
"Want to see blood?"
"Yes!" Suddenly Dong Xun even started drooling, but his response was incomparably clear.
Gu Nan glanced at him with slightly deeper meaning. This Dong Xun was originally just a normal teenager who’d become somewhat neurotic after being infected by Rolensia’s split soul.
Moreover, he was similar to Zhong Die, both having a strange obsession with blood.
The difference was that Zhong Die was obsessed with drinking blood, while Dong Xun simply wanted to see the image of blood spraying out.
The two corpses that fell at his feet were still spraying out blood continuously, but Dong Xun didn’t do anything to them after killing them.
‘The early stage of Rolensia’s law really is bizarre.’ Such an opinion emerged in Gu Nan’s mind.
What Dong Xun was doing now was retracing Rolensia’s path—if he could survive, that is.
Gu Nan formed a jet black dagger in his hand and handed it to Dong Xun.
Dong Xun subconsciously reached for it, but the dagger gently floated up and instantly plunged into his heart.
This sudden development didn’t change Dong Xun’s expression, as if he could no longer feel pain.
But after the jet black dagger sank into Dong Xun’s body, the wound on his chest actually healed up as if nothing had happened.
“I have high hopes for you." Gu Nan smiled at him.
Dong Xun smiled back, still looking simpleminded and foolish. Only those who knew the human heart best could see the brutality deep in his bones.
“Go. Your journey starts here."
……
Time passed by one day at a time, and the rumors that were so rampant in the Myriad Heavens were slowly forgotten or replaced by new topics.
In the blink of an eye, another two years passed, and Gu Nan launched several successive invasions against other small planes, brazenly waging Divine Kingdom Wars.
According to the compiled statistics, Gu Nan already "visited" over ten small astral worlds during this time. Among them, Jin Lin World was the worst off, having already suffered four devastating blows.
Compared to the hundreds of years it took the astral world to develop, being bullied four times over a span of two years was definitely a tragic number.
And the reason there was no fifth time wasn’t because Gu Nan was merciful. Rather, Classmate Jin Lin finally couldn’t stand such torture anymore and resolutely abandoned his astral world.
Perhaps for him, being a rogue Star Ruler again was still better than being raised like a pig and harvested at Gu Nan’s leisure.
Gu Nan also ignored him. He couldn’t gain anything from killing Star Rulers, so it was better to just develop his own Divine Kingdom properly.
Plus, after two years, Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom construction also reached another stage.
Divine Kingdom Wars and the Crescent Moon World dungeon gave Gu Nan too many profits.
After two years of accumulation, the outside of the Evil God Temple was now accompanied by nearly ten structures of various colors.
All of them were Divine Servant Institutes.
Divine Servant Institutes were the Divine Kingdom’s barracks. The diversity of troop types was the guarantee of victory in Divine Kingdom Wars. There was no way to cut down on such expenditures.
Not only did Gu Nan build a large number of Divine Servant Institutes, but he also constructed important structures that had to be skipped back when there was no money.
On this day, under the watchful eyes of an increasing number of apostles in the Divine Kingdom, the Evil God Temple violently expanded outwards as a strange aura emerged from the depths of the souls of everyone present.
Apostles like Lan Si and Shana, who already reached Tier 4, only felt that something was weighing down on their hearts, giving them a heavy feeling.
“Tier 7." Gu Nan sat atop the throne inside the Evil God Temple and slowly opened his eyes, but there was a deathly stillness in his gaze.
It was as if he was an aloof and distant god, gazing down indifferently at everything on earth.
After two years of accumulation, Gu Nan finally took that crucial step to advance to Tier 7.
In reality, he reached the required thresholds in terms of Evil Value, points, and structures a long time ago, but he’d been holding back on leveling up until now.
This was naturally because it was much easier for outsiders to discover the locations of powerful astral worlds, such as a Tier 7 Divine Kingdom.
The Star Rulers Gu Nan humiliated two years ago never gave up their search for Gu Nan’s astral world, not even for a moment.
If they couldn’t find any clues on it, they could still use the dumb method of manually searching every single plane. The probability of being found increased exponentially every time the Divine Kingdom leveled up.
Gu Nan's mind had always been very clear. He knew that the reason he was world-renowned absolutely wasn’t because he was strong, but because he was good at running away.
When he could no longer run away, he either had to endure the losses or have enough strength to deter enemies.
And now, Gu Nan believed that he’d accumulated enough strength.
“My Lord, congratulations on leaving isolated cultivation after a successful breakthrough. Your miraculous skill is unrivaled, and Your Lordship will soon unify the entire Jianghu!”
A voice sounded beside Gu Nan, who turned his head in surprise and saw Shana standing there.
"Where did you learn all this?"
Perhaps because Gu Nan's reaction didn’t look very satisfied, Shana couldn’t help feeling a little flustered.
“A-A small plane…”
Gu Nan laughed in spite of himself and shook his head. There were many such martial arts style planes in the Myriad Heavens, so he didn’t give it much thought.
"It's Nine Swords World, our newly-selected target plane,” Yan Xiaoxiao appeared by Shana's side and explained with a light smile.
Immediately after, she continued, "Teacher, after your isolated cultivation this time… I’m afraid the location of the Divine Kingdom can no longer be hidden?"
"Mm, but there’s no longer any need to hide." Gu Nan smiled as he checked the panel on his Evil God Temple, where a value was reaching a new high.
Divine Power: 1,050

chapters.title: Chapter 397: Real And Fake Unified Dao Ascensions
chapters.content:
Divine power was the single most important value in the Divine Kingdom gameplay, there was no “one of.”
In the end, the Evil God game wasn’t a base-building game. Although it offered an incredible number of playstyles, the official recommendation was always to strengthen oneself.
So even though the core of the First Round was the Divine Kingdom, the goal of the Divine Kingdom gameplay remained unchanged. It was still to enhance the player's own strength.
Just as all Star Rulers and gods could receive buffs from their own planes, players could do something similar.
And divine power was the numerical standard to measure the effect of the buff.
Gu Nan also had divine power when he first acquired the Divine Kingdom, but it was only in the single digits at that time, while it finally reached one thousand today.
Divine power was a very special value. It wasn’t like points, which could be spent and earned again, nor was it like Evil Value, which never went down.
In fact, divine power was more like the MP bar in players’ understanding. It was consumed during usage, but it would refill naturally over time.
What determined the upper limit of divine power was the Divine Kingdom’s level, as well as the total strength of the Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants.
On the other hand, what determined the speed of divine power usage and recovery was how efficiently Gu Nan could siphon power from the Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants—Gu Nan had done as much as humanly possible on this point.
His Divine Kingdom was the former Immortal Demon World that Zuo Zuo left behind. This particular plane could collect half of the inhabitants’ souls and directly extract their power.
This characteristic was a little too unreasonable… Well, this was also the reason Gu Nan went to all the trouble to take Immortal Demon World for himself back then.
“With around 1,000 divine power, I can suppress Tier 8 enemies outside. If it’s inside the Divine Kingdom… then I can even fight Tier 10 enemies."
After advancing to Tier 7, Gu Nan's judgment of his own strength immediately went up a level.
With the Evil God physique, he could already fight Tier 8 laws head-on, except neither would be able to overpower the other. And with the addition of divine power, it was enough to completely suppress Tier 8 opponents.
If it was inside his own Divine Kingdom, then as long as they weren’t greater god-level existences, Gu Nan welcomed all enemies.
If inside their own astral worlds, it wasn’t uncommon for Tier 7 or 8 Star Rulers to fight Tier 10 enemies on equal ground. Gu Nan wasn’t the only example.
Red was one such example—her own strength barely reached Tier 8, yet a powerful Tier 10 Star Ruler like Zuo Zuo could only manage to suppress her inside her own astral world, unable to kill her.
Another example was the earlier Daoist Monarch Wu Tian, who was a veritable Tier 8 Star Ruler. In the words of the Myriad Heavens, Wu Tian was an experienced powerhouse with the power of a Realm Level plane behind him.
Someone like Wu Tian could completely fight on equal ground with Tier 10 enemies inside his astral world without being at the slightest disadvantage.
Only a freak like Gu Nan could force Daoist Monarch Wu Tian to bow his head in his own astral world, Daoist Sect Realm.
This was because Gu Nan was all too familiar with the buffs astral worlds provided. From the player's point of view, this buff only increased the strength of one’s laws and wasn’t a comprehensive buff.
In other words, when the enemy didn’t engage in fighting your laws with their laws and was hellbent on escaping, an impossible-to-catch enemy might still be impossible to catch.
As the Evil God Temple upgraded to Level 2 and as Gu Nan himself advanced Tier 7, the Divine Kingdom’s essence also received a corresponding upgrade.
Gu Nan knew it was only a matter of time before the Divine Kingdom’s coordinates were exposed. After all, it was impossible for no one to notice a major Tier 7 astral world.
Since this was the case, it was better to make good use of this opportunity… ‘Classmate Rolensia, this is as much as I can help you!’
……
The Tier 10 god Rolensia mysteriously disappeared for two years—this matter already attracted fairly large-scale attention in the World of Gods.
Although it wasn’t unusual for a god of Rolensia’s level to not appear for several years or even decades, the fact that her followers and apostles couldn’t contact her either absolutely wasn’t normal.
But at this time, no one had realized yet what exactly Rolensia planned to do. Even the Goddess of Nature, who blocked Rolensia’s path, had yet to realize Rolensia’s plan.
On the contrary, in the Myriad Heavens Universe, far away from the World of Gods, the Thirteen Heavens big shots had already sensed something.
As Unified Dao powerhouses, they themselves had a certain degree of connection with the laws of heaven and earth, so naturally they could sense when someone was about to merge with a great Dao.
Thus, similar statements continued to ring out in all parts of the Myriad Heavens.
"Someone is about to enter Unified Dao Realm."
"Someone is about to enter Unified Dao Realm,” Yu Lian also said the same thing to Xue Ren and added one more sentence, "Tell me the truth, do you have anything to do with this?”
"How can I have anything to do with it?" Xue Ren denied righteously. "It's not like I'm the one ascending to Unified Dao, and besides, I'm just your average, run-of-the-mill Star Ruler… Okay, fine, I arranged this."
Xue Ren faltered halfway through his lie as Yu Lian’s glare intensified and finally admitted with a face full of helplessness.
In fact, the two had been good friends for tens of thousands of years. No matter how good Xue Ren’s acting was, it was still hard to hide from the Star Ruler of Void Grotto Heaven, so it was better to simply admit it.
Yu Lian made a look of surprise and exclaimed with a little exaggeration, “Look at you! You can even casually arrange the creation of a Unified Dao powerhouse now?"
Xue Ren spread his hands, indicating that he had nothing to say about it.
"So, what did you come here for?" Yu Lian didn't expect to get any straight answers from him. Instead, she asked about Xue Ren's reason for visiting.
"I may or may not create some ruckus in the near future. When that happens, you’ll have to cover for me,” Xue Ren answered seriously.
“You want to help that Unified Dao powerhouse by directing people’s attention elsewhere?" Yu Lian saw through Xue Ren's goal at a glance and thought for a moment. "What do you need me to do?"
"Just act mysterious when the time comes." Xue Ren revealed a bright smile.
……
The Myriad Heavens Universe was very lively these days.
The excitement from Gu Nan's sudden appearance and Zi Luo Elder’s awakening two years ago hadn’t even died down completely when news that someone wanted to ascend to Unified Dao Realm caught everyone off guard.
This was Unified Dao Realm! The supreme existences of the Myriad Heavens Universe!
For a while, everyone tried to guess this person’s identity.
Some guessed it was Xue Ren, who was the "closest to the Thirteen Heavens.” They claimed he’d been sharpening his sword for a thousand years and was finally about to take that step.
Other people guessed that it was the Zi Luo Elder, who’d awakened from a deep slumber and, once recovered, was about to point his sword at the Thirteen Heavens again.
Others guessed that it was Red Candle Heaven’s Green Lantern Fairy, Wang Li of Severing Dao Heaven, the Cult Master of the Holy Luo Cult from Three Corpses Heaven… These were all powerful Tier 10 Star Rulers. No matter who among them ended up being the first to take that step into the ranks of the Thirteen Heavens, no one would be surprised.
However, just when people in the Myriad Heavens were discussing spiritedly, news suddenly came out from Extreme Sword Heaven.
The Sword Sect’s Sect Master, Xue Ren, sent invitations to several fellow Daoists, inviting them to visit Extreme Sword Heaven to test their swords… Among those invited were top-tier Star Rulers like the Holy Luo Cult’s Cult Master and the Green Lantern Fairy.
“To merge with the great Dao, to test my sword against the world!”
Although Xue Ren had no intention of revealing his cultivation realm, the meaning behind Xue Ren sending such a heroic invitation at such a juncture couldn’t be more obvious.

chapters.title: Chapter 398: Count Him Unlucky
chapters.content:
News that Xue Ren of Extreme Sword Heaven invited fellow Daoists to sharpen his sword spread throughout the entire Myriad Heavens almost overnight.
