As long as there were Void Cutters who could see outside events, it was inevitable for everyone to hear the news. The birth of a new Unified Dao powerhouse would be a major event that would shake the Myriad Heavens.
But after the initial surprise, people felt that this was to be expected.
Xue Ren had been called the "closest to the Thirteen Heavens" for many years. This in itself was enough to show that his realm was only one step away from that level.
There was nothing strange about him finally taking this step. It was only a matter of time.
Of course, since Xue Ren hadn’t yet admitted it himself, there was still another possibility.
Xue Ren set the date of the spar for half a month later, but only two days had passed before rumors spread that the Star Ruler of Weapon Martial Heaven, one of the Thirteen Heavens, had gone to Void Grotto Heaven’s Yu Lian to verify the truthfulness of the rumors.
Many people knew about the relationship between Xue Ren and Yu Lian of Void Grotto Heaven, so Yu Lian was naturally the most obvious choice to inquire about Xue Ren’s situation.
However, Yu Lian’s attitude was interesting—she didn't say anything, let alone give any indication of her position, and simply said three words.
"Wait and see."
……
Within Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom, the intense preparations for soldier production had reached the most critical stage.
After the Evil God Temple was upgraded to Level 2, Gu Nan was able to level up structures to Level 2. With the Divine Servant Institute, it could be leveled up twice, with more powerful soldier types.
For example, the earlier Dark Warriors and Ghouls could be upgraded into Dark Knights and Patchwork Monsters respectively, more than doubling their original strength.
Gu Nan had been preparing for Tier 7’s advancement for two years and had long accumulated a large number of points. If he didn't sense that time was running out, he would’ve waited even longer.
Of course, it would still take some time to upgrade structures, manufacture soldiers, and convert these points into real combat power.
"My Lord, news spread like crazy in the Myriad Heavens. Lord Xue Ren of Extreme Sword Heaven will soon ascend to Unified Dao Realm, so he’s sending out invitations far and wide to test his sword…”
On a rare occasion, Red Tail wasn’t in White Bones Realm, but came to Gu Nan's side and personally reported the news.
She knew Gu Nan had some connection to Xue Ren and knew that this matter was so important that she had to come and speak to Gu Nan in person.
What she didn't expect was that, in response to what she saw as an earth-shattering event, Gu Nan merely revealed an odd smile. "Xue Ren? He’s thinking of the same thing I am.”
Red Tail didn’t understand Gu Nan's meaning and could only ask, "Then should we…?”
"Did Xue Ren invite me?" Gu Nan asked after some thought.
"Yes, Elder Zhang Hui of the Sword Sect personally delivered the invitation." Red Tail hastily nodded; this was also one of the reasons she reported to Gu Nan in person.
"Accept the invitation and have him bring a message back—I’ll be there, and also have Xue Ren help me invite another person."
"Who?"
“Rending Mountain Venerable of Mountain River World."
……
Mountain River World.
Mountain River World was only a small plane that couldn’t even compare to those Realm Level astral worlds, much less… White Bones Realm.
That’s right. As a Star Ruler who once fought with Daoist White Bones for the opportunity to ascend his astral world to a Realm Level plane, Rending Mountain Venerable had always compared himself against White Bones Realm.
Even if times were different now and White Bones Realm was already a top-tier Realm Level plane while his Mountain River World didn’t advance but actually grew weaker, unable to even compare to its former glory.
But in Rending Mountain Venerable’s heart, he never conceded defeat and was always thinking of turning the tide.
Unfortunately, others didn’t see it that way. As the status of Daoist White Bones rose higher and higher, more Star Rulers were naturally willing to befriend him.
But on Rending Mountain Venerable’s side, almost everyone who approached him were just bootlickers hoping to win some favors with flattery.
There wasn’t much Rending Mountain Venerable could do about this besides sulk and curse at these people a few times in passing.
Until this day, he received an invitation from Extreme Sword Heaven and finally felt vindicated.
‘The Sword Sect’s Sect Master Xue Ren of Extreme Sword Heaven sent me an invitation to observe the ceremony!’
Although the invitation clearly wrote the phrase “sword watching," Rending Mountain Venerable didn’t feel insulted in the slightest—in any case, even if Daoist White Bones received an invitation, it would still say “sword watching” at most.
"As expected of a big shot about to enter Unified Dao, he has good taste!" Rending Mountain Venerable exclaimed to the people around him with a laugh.
There were many bootlickers around Rending Mountain Venerable, but there were still people with discerning eyes among the Void Cutter subordinates.
"My Lord, that one from Extreme Sword Heaven has… no dealings with you. How come he suddenly thought of sending Your Lordship an invitation?" A middle-aged man dressed as a Confucian scholar next to him asked.
In fact, what the middle-aged Confucian scholar actually wanted to say was: “Just how high is Xue Ren’s status? Why would he ever notice a small fry like you?”
But Rending Mountain Venerable didn’t seem to understand what he was implying and replied with a smile, "Xue Ren must be very confident of taking that step, so he invited a large number of unrelated people to observe the ceremony. This is a show of extravagance!”
When he said the word “show," Rending Mountain Venerable practically had
this is what a manly man is like
written on his face.
The middle-aged Confucian scholar thought about it for a long time but still felt that something was wrong. However, he couldn’t find the problem.
‘Could it be that Xue Ren wants Mountain River World? But why would a powerhouse like Xue Ren be interested in a tiny Mountain River World…?’
……
Half a month passed in a flash. The time of Xue Ren's sword testing ceremony had arrived, and many Star Rulers gathered in Extreme Sword Heaven.
"Senior Gu Nan, please come with me,” Gao Xiaowen said respectfully as he walked into Gu Nan’s room.
With Gu Nan's current reputation, it was quite appropriate for Gao Xiaowen to call him “Senior.”
But this was a little early. Gu Nan couldn’t help but wonder, "The sword testing ceremony hasn’t started yet, right? Does Xue Ren want to trade a couple blows with me first?"
Gao Xiaowen was shocked by Gu Nan's mysterious confidence, then managed to squeeze a smile onto his face. "Senior must be joking… Martial Uncle asked you to come over to discuss something."
Gu Nan nodded, then said to the Lan Si who came with him, "Inform Shana that she can make a move on that side."
Lan Si responded and left, but Gao Xiaowen looked confused. "What do you mean?"
Gu Nan flashed him a friendly smile. "I haven’t slaughtered someone’s entire family in a long time."
……
To host the sword testing ceremony, the Sword Sect purposely built a sword testing platform just for this event. Right now, the surrounding area was already filled with people, with countless Star Rulers among the spectators.
At the back of the sword testing platform, Gu Nan was meeting Xue Ren and the friend he brought along.
It was an old man with white hair and a wrinkled face, as if he could collapse at any moment.
"This is a venerable senior." Xue Ren introduced him to Gu Nan, "We usually call him Zi Luo Elder."
Gu Nan raised an eyebrow as his gaze instantly landed on this old man. He’d also heard of Zi Luo Elder’s story.
An amiable smile emerged on Zi Luo Elder’s face as he waved his hand. “This old man just came for a sip of hot tea. You guys discuss your matters."
Xue Ren also didn’t care and nodded with a smile. He said to Gu Nan, "Originally, I just wanted to invite you to come for a stroll and help me put up a front when the time comes."
“But now it looks like you also have guests to entertain?"
“Mine’s an enemy."
"Then you hold grudges for quite long." Xue Ren couldn't help laughing in spite of himself. He knew about Gu Nan's conflict with Rending Mountain Venerable, but that was just a trivial matter. He didn't expect Gu Nan to still remember it now.
Gu Nan thought for a moment and replied, "I have to find someone to kill. There's no other suitable candidate, so count him unlucky."

chapters.title: Chapter 399: Confusing Battle
chapters.content:
Rending Mountain Venerable’s conflict with Gu Nan wasn’t quite an eye-catching matter.
Xue Ren even felt that the only reason he even paid attention to it was because of Lou Wanying, otherwise a busy person like him wouldn’t have time to try and keep track of these trivial matters.
Rending Mountain Venerable was Lou Wanying's friend, despite the difference in age. After the Time Arena incident, he nursed a grudge on Lou Wanying’s behalf against Gu Nan.
Later, when Daoist White Bones was rumored to be heavily injured in the fight over Nirvana Heaven’s “inheritance” and White Bones Realm was attacked by seven planes, Rending Mountain Venerable was one of the invaders.
Originally, the seven attackers had agreed to advance and retreat together, but when Rending Mountain Venerable discovered that Gu Nan was also in White Bones Realm, he wanted to take a detour to deal with Gu Nan, then turn back to fight Daoist White Bones.
"What happened after that?" Zi Luo Elder revealed an interested expression, the smile on his face unspeakably amiable.
Gu Nan had already left by this time; he only came over to meet Xue Ren. Or rather, Xue Ren invited him over solely to introduce him to this old man.
Seeing the old man’s interest, Xue Ren continued, "Gu Nan only left a Void Cutter clone in White Bones Realm. With this clone, he transmitted a portion of his true body’s laws over and stopped Rending Mountain Venerable in his tracks."
Speaking of this, Xue Ren couldn’t help adding, "Now that I think about it, he might already possess an astral world as early as then.”
“He walked too fast." Zi Luo Elder sighed with emotion, his gaze also seeming to contain some laughter.
Gu Nan certainly walked fast; he was practically progressing at a speed hundreds or thousands of times faster than others. The speed of his growth was enough to make anyone's jaw drop.
“Is he someone’s reincarnation?" Zi Luo Elder lowered his head slightly, but his mind wasn’t slow in the slightest, hitting the crux of the matter at once.
“We’re also looking for his past life’s identity.” Xue Ren was silent for a moment, then added, "He joined the organization from that side, so we suspect… He is the reincarnation of someone from that side."
Some astonishment finally appeared on Zi Luo Elder’s face. "A god from that side reincarnated into the Myriad Heavens? How interesting… Could any of the gods in our organization glean information about his origins?"
Xue Ren, however, could only shake his head. "No. Of the gods who wield divine authority over shadows, we only know a single Sylvia and have never heard of anyone else like that."
That meant Gu Nan probably even changed his original law… Then how could they even start looking for his origins?
"Then forget it." The smile reappeared on Zi Luo Elder’s face. “Let Gu Nan cause chaos as he pleases. There must not be any mistakes with Rolensia’s matter."
……
Under the sword testing platform, the Star Rulers had already settled down one by one, waiting for those powerful figures to show up.
The large and small Star Rulers Xue Ren invited over this time added up to hundreds of people, especially those at Realm Level or above, who were all sent invitations.
In the face of an invitation from a powerhouse who might soon enter Unified Dao Realm, these Star Rulers certainly didn’t have their usual reserved, aloof air.
As long as they weren’t occupied by a pressing matter and truly couldn’t get away, almost everyone who received an invitation personally rushed to Extreme Sword Heaven to observe the ceremony.
Xue Ren also didn’t make the crowd wait for too long. His figure appeared on the sword testing platform as he cupped his hands at the spectators. “This humble one recently received an unexpected enlightenment and wishes to verify it with everyone… Brother Wang?"
As his words fell, a man also appeared at the same time. From his appearance, he seemed to be in his thirties. There wasn’t much of an expression on his face, and he held a long blade in his right hand.
Severing Dao Heaven’s Wang Li, an unparalleled powerhouse who became a powerful Star Ruler through the blade Dao. If not for that one in Weapon Martial Heaven who also used a blade, he would rightfully be the number one blademaster in the Myriad Heavens.
“Come," Wang Li merely said one word after he appeared, but his voice instantly spread throughout the entire sword testing platform and below.
The Star Rulers below the platform immediately fell silent, because everyone seemed to see a clear, cold blade energy gently arc around them.
Wang Li clearly only spoke one word, but it put a terrifying pressure on the Star Rulers.
Unlike Xue Ren, Wang Li was the most traditional kind of blademaster. His martial path was the blade of the heart, true to the saying the “blade goes wherever the heart goes.” His blade intent was strong enough to sever mountains and rivers.
"Okay." Xue Ren also smiled; the longsword in his hand had already thrust out.
No one imagined that these two would attack so decisively. It was simply too inconsistent with their statuses.
Xue Ren’s sword style was the very same Wave Sword that he became famous for. But the Wave Sword used by Xue Ren was too different from Qu Hongye's.
A sword thrust out. Xue Ren's entire body seemed to merge with the sword, then scattered into a huge sword cloud.
Every position was Xue Ren inside this sword cloud, yet Xue Ren didn’t exist in any position. The location of his sword couldn’t be predicted.
Wang Li's expression remained unchanged. He gently raised his long blade and actually stabbed it out like a longsword, with the tip of the blade randomly pointing at a certain point in the sword cloud.
In this instant, something in space seemed to be torn apart. The sword cloud collapsed at a speed visible to the naked eye, and for a while, it seemed like a black hole appeared on the sword testing platform.
But the next moment, endless sword light cut through the horizon. The light was actually faster than the speed at which space collapsed, allowing it to drill out of the black hole.
Wang Li brazenly slashed out with his blade at this instant. The blade’s afterimage, which was originally floating, seemed to have swelled up at once, as if flooding the whole world.
The peerless, tyrannical long blade fell, yet the sword light didn’t flicker or dodge, simply allowing the slash to land. Indeed, the long blade couldn’t block the sword light. The latter hit Wang Li unhindered.
"Sword light is also light… You let me win." Xue Ren reappeared, smiling at Wang Li.
From his words, it seemed that the two actually decided victory and defeat in this moment.
Wang Li thought for a moment with a wooden expression and said, "Very strong, but still not enough."
"That's why I need you guys to help,” Xue Ren understood his meaning and casually responded.
Wang Li nodded, more or less agreeing with him. Below the sword testing platform, the voices of discussion rang out again—it couldn’t be helped since many people didn’t actually understand the exchange between these two.
True, the two had high cultivation realms, but wasn’t this a little too outrageous?
Many famous Star Rulers were swearing in their hearts. ‘I don’t even understand what these two just did, so how the hell can I explain it to my disciples and descendants?’
‘Star Rulers who use swords or blades really are annoying!’
Outside of Extreme Sword Heaven, some of the big names in the Thirteen Heavens were also watching this spar.
After all, once Xue Ren broke through, he would be on the same level of existence as them, so it was reasonable to give Xue Ren the necessary attention.
Within Void Grotto Heaven, Yu Lian had a new guest. This person was dressed in a gorgeous long gown, with a short blade hanging from his waist. Its sheath was full of gems, crystals, and other decorations.
From the looks of it, this youth with a short blade appeared very much like a nouveau riche, no different from the hedonistic young masters of the secular world.
But only those who knew his identity would know just how terrifying this youth was.
He was none other than one of the Thirteen Heavens—Zou Jiming, the Star Ruler of Weapon Martial Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: Monk Nuxin
chapters.content:
Zou Jiming was a very hated Star Ruler, especially since he was one of the Thirteen Heavens, which attracted even more hate.
Firstly, this was because Zou Jiming acted without scruples, and secondly, it was because his law blocked the paths of too many people.
Zou Jiming started his cultivation journey as a blademaster and walked to Star Ruler Realm step by step, yet he tried and failed to break through to Unified Dao Realm three times in a row, nearly injuring his foundation, and became the laughingstock back then.
Attempting to ascend to Unified Dao Realm was a very enviable matter, but if he kept failing, then he just became someone who overestimated his own capabilities.
In the face of such ridicule, Zou Jiming pondered the painful experience over a thousand years of secluded cultivation and finally realized that his own law didn’t match his acknowledged path.
His Dao wasn’t simply a blade; rather, it should be any weapon.
His blade, too, wasn’t just a blade, but it could also be a sword, a spear, or any other type of weapon imaginable.
Thus, this genius blademaster who became famous at a young age resolutely chose to destroy his own foundation. Then he spent ten times as much time as he previously did to re-walk his entire path, once again reaching the edge of Unified Dao Realm and finally succeeding in claiming his great Dao in one fell swoop.
From a heaven-defying genius to a powerhouse who matured extremely slowly, Zou Jiming forcibly walked a path other people couldn’t even finish in their entire lives
twice
, finally creating the legend known as Weapon Martial Heaven.
Of course, although his journey was legendary, like a huge, immovable mountain, Zou Jiming’s ascension to Unified Dao practically blocked the paths of all swordsmen, blademasters, and martial arts cultivators, sharply increasing their difficulty in entering Unified Dao Realm.
This was also the biggest reason Zou Jiming attracted so much hate.
The day Xue Ren held the sword testing ceremony, Zou Jiming came to Void Grotto Heaven.
“He’s not ready to enter Unified Dao yet. What exactly are you guys planning?" Zou Jiming stood in front of Yu Lian and asked rather rudely.
While others might not be able to tell whether Xue Ren was about to advance to Unified Dao, it was something that couldn’t be concealed from the eyes of the Thirteen Heavens once Xue Ran revealed his powers.
Yu Lian didn’t actually know what Xue Ren was planning either, but she plastered a faint smile on her face. "You'll know after watching."
Zou Jiming still wanted to say something, but then paused violently, his gaze landing on a certain small astral world in the Myriad Heavens with a slight frown. "Merely to help him? You guys are causing an excessively big fuss over a minor issue."
While continuing to maintain a profound, mysterious smile on her face, Yu Lian secretly but hurriedly focused her attention on that location and discovered an astonishing scene.
In an unfamiliar plane, countless grotesquely-shaped monsters were pouring out and forming an army, descending in batches to another astral world through a space passage created from some sort of strange power.
……
Under the sword testing platform, Rending Mountain Venerable was staring up at the platform blankly, wondering what just happened in Xue Ren and Wang Li’s fight.
Unlike certain Star Rulers around him who also didn’t understand yet still pretended they understood, Rending Mountain Venerable had always been very honest. He turned his head and asked a person beside him, "Daoist Friend…”
"Shhh!" The person next to him hurriedly shushed him and immediately closed his eyes in contemplation, as if he received astonishing enlightenment from the previous exchange.
No matter how straightforward Rending Mountain Venerable was, he still couldn’t help casting this person a look of contempt. He was about to say something else when someone patted his shoulder.
He subconsciously turned his head and saw a familiar figure.
"Gu Nan?!" Rending Mountain Venerable recognized the person in front of him and spoke angrily, “You actually dare to appear in front of me? Last time, there was that scum Daoist White Bones to protect you, but let’s see where you can run to this time!"
Rending Mountain Venerable was a Star Ruler who never knew fear. He wasn’t even afraid of Daoist White Bones, so of course he didn’t fear Gu Nan.
However, this was still Xue Ren’s sword testing ceremony, so he didn’t brazenly make a move. In the end, he still had some scruples.
But Gu Nan didn’t have such scruples. He laughed in spite of himself and threw a kick at Rending Mountain Venerable.
Rending Mountain Venerable reacted very quickly and threw out a Mountain River Seal, as if a big mountain was pressing down on Gu Nan, but the result was completely unexpected.
This enormous mountain that fell from the sky couldn’t even block Gu Nan's kick and was smashed to pieces.
"Impossible!" Rending Mountain Venerable blurted out, his mind so shocked that he didn’t even think about dodging.
The last time he saw Gu Nan, the other party could only rely on some laws to barely stall him, but now Gu Nan could actually smash the Mountain River Seal with just his physical body alone?
What he didn’t know was that now that Gu Nan advanced to Tier 7, he might even be able to fight Daoist White Bones to a tie, so how could a tiny Star Ruler like Rending Mountain Venerable resist?
But while Rending Mountain Venerable was frozen in shock, someone next to him couldn’t bear to watch anymore.
“Amitabha. Today is the day Benefactor Xue attains Unified Dao. How can you be allowed to be this unbridled?" A large monk with a wide body next to him said, chanting the Buddha’s name.
Although this monk said “Amitabha," his entire expression was fierce-looking, not containing an ounce of the Buddha's compassion.
His hand closed around something, holding up a monk’s staff in front of Rending Mountain Venerable and blocking Gu Nan’s kick.
Fortunately, this was just a casual kick cushioned by the earlier Mountain River Seal, or else this monk might not be able to block it.
"Gu Nan, you little thief, don't think that you can act wantonly just because you can force Daoist Monarch Wu Tian to lower his head." The great monk blocked with his staff and couldn’t help sneering, “Can’t you see what kind of place this is and how many Star Rulers are present!?”
Gu Nan didn’t rush to attack and only asked, "Which astral world are you from?"
The monk figured that Xue Ran would never let Gu Nan go for making trouble right beneath the sword testing platform, so he wasn’t scared at all and proudly answered, “This one controls Furious Buddha World. If you have the ability, then come find trouble for me!"
Gu Nan was now famous. The clamor on this side immediately attracted the attention of the surrounding Star Rulers.
"It's Gu Nan again."
"He likes to send people to some small astral worlds to wreak havoc. Who knows what his goal is?”
"What goal can he possibly have? He’s just letting the power get to his head and running amok… I’m afraid he’ll be attacked by an entire crowd the day his astral world’s location is exposed.”
"Haha, I can’t wait to see that day."
This great monk’s Buddhist name was Nuxin, a name he gave himself. He was a self-made genius. Hearing the surrounding discussion, Monk Nuxin’s face became even more smug.
Although he looked simpleminded, in fact, his thoughts were very cunning. Other people were extremely afraid of Gu Nan, fearing his retaliation if they provoked him, but Monk Nuxin wasn’t afraid.
He could see things very clearly. His own astral world was just starting out, so even if Gu Nan wreaked some havoc inside, he still wouldn’t incur much damage.
On the contrary, he could take advantage of Gu Nan's current fame to make a big deal out of the matter, raising his own reputation and making it easier for him to recruit Void Cutter subordinates.
In the end, the overall strength of the astral world still depended on the number of Void Cutters inside.
Monk Nuxin managed to stop the joy from showing on his face with great difficulty, not the slightest bit afraid. Anyhow, this was Extreme Sword Heaven. As a guest invited by Xue Ren, the host couldn’t simply stand by and do nothing as Gu Nan killed him.
"Give me some face. If you guys have a conflict, resolve it outside.” True to his expectations, Xue Ren also noticed the situation here and immediately came over.
Monk Nuxin was confident his plan had gone off without a hitch and immediately bid goodbye to Xue Ren, preparing to return to his own astral world.
As long as he was in his own astral world, Monk Nuxin wasn’t afraid of the other party. And Gu Nan’s type of destruction that switched locations after merely firing one shot was just adding to his own reputation.
"No problem." Yet Gu Nan just nodded at Xue Ren, then grabbed Monk Nuxin’s shoulder with one hand. "Come, let's sit down for a chat."
Then Gu Nan turned his head to Rending Mountain Venerable again. "You’ll have to thank him."
Rending Mountain Venerable didn’t understand. "Why?"
“His whole family died in place of yours."

chapters.title: Chapter 401: Leave None Alive
chapters.content:
The Divine Kingdom Wars waged by Gu Nan had always been led by Shana and Lan Si.
Shana led members of the Raymond clan, while Lan Si led some of the Void Cutters in White Mist, as well as other Void Cutter Realm apostles.
It was the same this time, with the slight difference that Shana was accompanied by a small annoyance.
"Lady, aren't we going to Mountain River World? Why are we changing places again!?" Zhong Die followed Shana and exclaimed with a puff of anger.
Little Zhong Die possessed the origin blood and walked the player route. After two years of work, she’d already advanced to Tier 4.
She finally managed to leave secluded cultivation after much difficulty and was simply itching to test her newfound strength, but they had just arrived at Mountain River World when Shana informed them that they had to change the battlefield at the last minute.
"Target: Wrathful Buddha World. Depart.”
"This is My Lord’s order." Shana finally turned to Zhong Die after she finished instructing the apostles and subordinates. "His exact words were— ‘You have to learn to switch lanes.’"
……
Under the sword testing platform.
As one of the current focuses of the Myriad Heavens, Gu Nan's every move was watched. The conversation between him, Rending Mountain Venerable, and Monk Nuxin immediately spread through their surroundings.
No one capable of entering Star Ruler Realm was a fool. When Monk Nuxin was stopped by Gu Nan, he immediately realized the other party’s intentions.
With a slight change in his expression, he hurriedly sensed the situation in his own astral world, but the scene he saw nearly made him faint.
Wave after wave of troops were pouring into his Wrathful Buddha World, all coming from a strange astral world.
These troops were all bizarrely shaped, from heavily armored human legions to tentacled monsters with a single eye, floating in the air.
If Gu Nan knew what Monk Nuxin was thinking, he would’ve very kindly informed him— “That’s called an Evil Eye.”
Level 2 soldier type Evil Eye. Specializes primarily in long-range attacks, but neither would they suffer any penalties for engaging in close combat. Their attacks come with a large number of curse debuffs, so they were one of the most annoying troop types.
But Monk Nuxin wasn’t in the mood to slowly understand these things. Rage and anxiety practically surged through his heart, and he wanted to return to his astral world immediately.
While he did want to use Gu Nan as a stepping stone to fame, he actually wanted to force the other party to engage in guerrilla warfare against him as a way to show off his strength… not like this!
If he could only watch as Gu Nan destroyed his astral world without being able to do anything to stop it, then he’d no longer become famous—he’d become a laughingstock instead.
"Let go of me!" Monk Nuxin bellowed as his whole body glowed with a golden Buddhist light, just like a real wrathful Buddha.
If not for the fact that the monk was bald, Gu Nan even suspected that he’d become a Super Saiyan if he just put some blond hair on his head.
But this was completely meaningless to Gu Nan, whose hand was already pressing down on Monk Nuxin’s bald head. The far more sublime power of shadows poured out, completely suppressing all of the Buddhist glow in the blink of an eye.
Monk Nuxin stared at this blankly, as if he could scarcely believe that Gu Nan, who’d always fought using his physical body alone, actually had such high attainment in law manipulation as well.
“His astral world isn’t far from reaching Realm Level." Xue Ren cast one more glance at Gu Nan and recalled Zi Luo Elder’s “too fast” remark, agreeing with it even more.
In what might as well be the blink of an eye, he watched Gu Nan go from a normal Star Ruler and walk to the point where he could already touch the edge of Realm Level.
The smile on Gu Nan's face remained unchanged. He was already Tier 7, so of course it wasn’t a problem to suppress Monk Nuxin, who was at most Tier 6.
The effect of suppression from a higher level was very obvious when using laws to counter the enemy’s laws, which was also why Gu Nan generally only used his physical body against higher-leveled enemies previously.
After Monk Nuxin was caught by Gu Nan, the group of spectating Star Rulers naturally paid attention to his astral world. Moreover, a major movement like the invasion of a plane couldn’t be hidden from them.
Extreme Sword Heaven was one of the main worlds, while Wrathful Buddha World was just a small astral world, so time flowed much faster in that small world than here.
So by the time the Star Rulers started paying attention to that side, Wrathful Buddha World had already become a wreck, and there were troops from Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom everywhere.
"This is…”
"It's Gu Nan's astral world!"
"He actually dared to reveal his astral world. He’s got guts."
"Daoist Monarch Wu Tian can finally breathe a sigh of relief."
Unlike Monk Nuxin, the spectating Star Rulers didn’t care just how much damage had been done to Wrathful Buddha World. They were more concerned about the place these troops came from.
This time, the number of divine servants Gu Nan deployed far exceeded those small-scale wars in the past two years.
So the army couldn’t simply descend all at once. Troops were still falling in a steady stream, so it was easy to discover their source—the Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, countless people silently memorized the coordinates to Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom.
One should know that just yesterday, merely the words "Gu Nan's astral world" would’ve been information worth a thousand pounds of gold. Many great Star Rulers would be willing to pay for it.
But now, this information was openly revealed.
Daoist Monarch Wu Tian was one of the few Star Rulers who didn’t attend the sword testing ceremony in Extreme Sword Heaven, but he was still paying attention to any news from that side.
Originally, he was absentmindedly paying attention, but he didn't expect to accidentally learn the location of Gu Nan's astral world, which almost made him jump for joy.
"Good! Gu Nan, you rascal, let’s see if you still dare to come to Daoist Sect Realm to wreak havoc in the future!" Daoist Monarch Wu Tian clapped fiercely.
If Gu Nan still dared to go to other people’s homes and engage in guerrilla warfare even after his own astral world’s location was exposed, then others could do the same to him and wreak havoc inside his Divine Kingdom.
More importantly, Gu Nan offended too many people. In all likelihood, he wouldn’t even need to go looking for anyone's trouble, and someone would soon come to his door to find trouble.
From the moment Gu Nan's astral world was exposed, various thoughts raced through all the Star Rulers’ heads as they thoroughly analyzed the implications of this matter.
‘I’m afraid it’ll be eventful in the Myriad Heavens from now on…’ Too many people simultaneously shared the same thought.
While everyone else was pondering what kind of changes the exposure of Gu Nan’s astral world would cause, only Monk Nuxin wanted to cry but had no tears.
He didn’t care where Gu Nan’s astral world was, nor did he have the ability to go there and cause trouble. All he knew was that his own astral world’s inhabitants were wantonly slaughtered in the blink of an eye!
Temple after temple collapsed, statues of Buddhas were smashed one by one, and countless monks in Wrathful Buddha World died at the hands of the divine servants.
The Dark Knights’ iron hooves of oppression left the land barren, the Patchwork Monsters nibbled clean all living beings in sight, the Evil Eyes’ Curse Ray cursed all enemies, while the Heavy Artillery Unit could take down a city with three volleys of gunfire…
These divine servants carried out the order of “leave none alive” to the letter, not even leaving a dog alive for Monk Nuxin. They passed through the land like locusts, leaving no breathing beings in their wake.
Thousands of years of painstaking work ruined in a few moments!
Now Monk Nuxin really did have a “furious heart
[1]
.” The rage in his heart couldn’t even be described with words. He began to crazily mobilize the power of his astral world to strengthen himself without regard to anything else.
‘Even if I have to use up all my power, I must still snatch the slightest chance of survival from this powerful enemy’s hands!’
‘As long as I can return to my astral world, everything will—’
Bam!
Gu Nan's fist smashed into his stomach, and the astral world’s power that Monk Nuxin just mobilized was shattered in the blink of an eye.
T/N:
[1] Furious Heart
= Nuxin

chapters.title: Chapter 402: Fang Chaoyun
chapters.content:
Gu Nan just stood in Extreme Sword Heaven, watching indifferently as Wrathful Buddha World was slaughtered into oblivion.
A perfectly fine small astral world was instantly reduced to nothing because of Gu Nan's single order, and everything had to start from scratch again.
Monk Nuxin’s eyes were practically bleeding as he glared coldly at Gu Nan. The destruction of his astral world was already irreversible; right now, he only wanted to drag Gu Nan down with him.
If he could watch Gu Nan die, then even if he couldn't make up for his loss, he could at least feel vindicated.
"Gu Nan, if you have the guts, then kill me!” Monk Nuxin shouted without cowering at all as he raised his head and put on a calm facade of having accepted death.
"Your perverse way of doing things has already made you enemies all over the world. Sooner or later, you’ll meet a tragic end!"
Monk Nuxin wasn’t actually a simple-minded fellow like Rending Mountain Venerable. He knew that he had nothing left, so he could only stand firmly on the opposite side as Gu Nan.
‘The enemy of my enemy is my friend, and Gu Nan has so many powerful enemies. As long as even a single person can help me a little, then this much loss is nothing!’
It had to be said that Monk Nuxin’s scheme was very shrewd. Just as his words fell, a new voice responded to him, "That is reasonable."
As the three words fell unhurriedly, another inexplicable will enveloped everyone present. Not even the Star Rulers could escape it.
A new feeling emerged in all of their hearts—they suddenly somewhat agreed with Monk Nuxin’s words, as if something the mysterious voice deemed "reasonable" truly was reasonable.
Some Star Rulers with fast reactions immediately realized what had happened, because Wang Li had already demonstrated this kind of thing moments ago.
"Another great Star Ruler on the edge of Unified Dao?"
Xue Ren frowned slightly while a woman in green appeared next to him. She was none other than Red Candle Heaven’s Green Lantern Fairy and stared at the horizon with a very unfriendly gaze.
"It's that old fart from the Graceful Academy," Green Lantern Fairy’s voice came out, immediately informing the surrounding area of the visitor’s identity.
Elder Fang—Fang Chaoyun of Graceful Heaven was also the head of the Graceful Academy situated inside Academic Heaven.
Fang Chaoyun was slightly weaker than Xue Ren and the others, but he wasn’t much weaker than most Star Rulers at that level. Moreover, because he was affiliated with Academic Heaven, he actually wielded more power and influence than his peers.
Gu Nan also raised his head. Based on his calculation, the visitor’s level was probably around Tier 10, having just reached the criterion for Tier 10.
Academic Heaven actually had powerful Tier 10 Star Rulers. As expected of one of the major astral worlds that ranked among the very front even within the Thirteen Heavens.
After saying the three words, however, Fang Chaoyun didn’t immediately appear. Instead, he continued, "My disciple Qi Bu died at the hands of Mr. Gu Nan. I am here to seek justice for him. Mr. Xue, please understand."
Fang Chaoyun was the most "reasonable" Star Ruler among the Myriad Heavens. Even the act of seeking revenge followed a prescribed pattern to the letter.
It was normal for such a teacher to produce a student like Qi Bu.
Xue Ren's eyes narrowed slightly, but he was slow to respond, nor did he have any intention of letting Fang Chaoyun into Extreme Sword Heaven. Instead, he glanced at Gu Nan first.
If Gu Nan didn’t want to meet Fang Chaoyun, then Xue Ren would immediately block Fang Chaoyun outside of his astral world.
With Xue Ren's position, he didn't have to fear Fang Chaoyun at all if he was determined to protect Gu Nan—except that way, Gu Nan’s astral world might not be able to survive.
"Graceful Heaven?" Gu Nan revealed a cold smile, but his reaction was beyond everyone's expectations.
His figure flickered, casually throwing Monk Nuxin aside and directly stepping into a portal. The Star Rulers with fast reactions hurriedly checked and realized that he actually… went straight to Graceful Heaven!
"I’m afraid he’s gone… crazy, hasn’t he?"
"He really did go crazy!"
"Running to Graceful Heaven to make trouble? Elder Fang can kill him with a slap of his hand!"
Even Xue Ren was taken aback, then shook his head with a chuckle. Gu Nan, this fellow, indeed defied expectations. His actions were completely outside of common sense.
Next to him, the Green Lantern Fairy's eyes lit up. She and Fang Chaoyun were feuding. If not for her apprehension about Song Fei, the one backing Fang Chaoyun, she probably would’ve gone to Graceful Heaven every day to make trouble.
Setting aside the crowd’s reactions for now, Gu Nan entered Graceful Heaven with one step and was greeted with a huge statue.
This was his first time in Graceful Heaven, and he also hadn’t conducted any investigations in advance, but one thing was very clear—the centermost part of the astral world was often the most important place in terms of status!
At the center of Graceful Heaven stood a giant statue of an elderly man in a long gown. He held a scroll of classic books in his hand, looking scholarly and righteous.
Without any thought, Gu Nan stood directly in midair and swung a fist at the old man’s head.
"How dare you!" A few roars came from below. A few Void Cutters in this academy had discovered Gu Nan's action.
But how could they stop it in time? They could only watch as Gu Nan's fist fell and the statue flickered with white light, as if a protective barrier had been triggered.
Unfortunately, this kind of mortal means was utterly useless against Gu Nan.
The barrier instantly shattered with a loud boom, and half of the statue’s head was smashed to pieces by Gu Nan.
But after doing this, Gu Nan turned around and ran without saying a word, returning directly to his Divine Kingdom.
Such a large commotion immediately caused countless scholars to run out and then look up in astonishment.
"An-Ancestor's statue…"
"Ancestor was smashed! No wait, Ancestor’s statue was smashed!"
Inside Extreme Sword Heaven, even more Star Rulers felt their jaws drop. Smashing a statue was nothing impressive and didn’t really say anything about one’s ability, but the problem was… this was Fang Chaoyun's statue!
‘I’m afraid they’ll be mortal enemies now…’
And it was even in a situation where Fang Chaoyun had spoken first, and during a time when Xue Ren sent invitations to the vast majority of Star Rulers, so the entire Myriad Heavens was paying attention to Gu Nan. Elder Fang lost face directly in front of every corner of the Myriad Heavens.
But how would Gu Nan deal with the repercussions? The rage of a top Star Ruler wasn’t so easy to withstand.
Sure enough, almost as soon as Gu Nan fled, an old man with a livid expression suddenly appeared next to the statue.
His figure and appearance were no different from the statue, only scaled down. He was none other than Fang Chaoyun himself.
"Gu Nan, you little thief!" Even with Elder Fang's self-restraint, he still couldn’t help swearing angrily, then ran directly into Gu Nan's astral world.
The reason he showed up in Extreme Sword Heaven was because the location of Gu Nan's astral world was exposed, and he was determined to seek justice for his disciple since Gu Nan could no longer move his astral world.
He never thought the other party would be so unbridled!
Within the Divine Kingdom, Fang Chaoyun's figure appeared over the Evil God Temple and announced with a dark expression, "Gu Nan, you killed my disciple first and destroyed…"
However, before he could finish, Gu Nan's figure suddenly emerged and threw a fist at him.
His response once again surprised the Star Rulers—faced with a powerhouse like Fang Chaoyun, Gu Nan still dared to make the first move.
Even if he was strengthened by his astral world, it hadn't even reached the level of a Realm Level plane yet. How could he dare to fight Fang Chaoyun?
Even Fang Chaoyun himself was amused. He didn’t retreat an inch and wrote out the character for "suppress" with a wave of his hand, which fell towards Gu Nan.
He wanted to use this one character to directly suppress Gu Nan inside his own astral world.
The instant the punch was about to hit the “suppress” character, the sky went dark.
Strengthened by the astral world’s power, shadows filled the sky and covered the sun.

chapters.title: Chapter 403: First Clash With The Thirteen Heavens
chapters.content:
The sky went dark.
The moment the endless shadows emerged, all the Star Rulers who had their eyes on Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom felt as if the sky instantly darkened, turning from day to night.
Fang Chaoyun looked up. This kind of abnormal phenomenon capable of altering heaven and earth instantly raised his vigilance to the highest point.
In fact, he didn’t need to be on the alert. The shadows flowing crazily through Gu Nan's fist made the power of this punch very clear.
The "suppress" character finally collided with Gu Nan's punch. The technique used by Fang Chaoyun, a Tier 10 Star Ruler, unexpectedly failed to suppress Gu Nan. On the contrary, the shadows grew stronger.
Gu Nan's punch didn’t directly shatter the character, but the shadows on his fist seeped through, almost dyeing the "suppress" character black.
Sylvia once said that Gu Nan's shadows were very different from her own. The shadows from her knowledge were quiet and secretive, while Gu Nan’s shadows had a bit more tyranny and madness bordering the edge of secretiveness.
A law’s aura was influenced by the cultivator himself. Fang Chaoyun's characters were righteous and upright, but when it met Gu Nan's unreasonable shadows, there was the feeling of a scholar meeting a soldier.
Fang Chaoyun's gaze turned slightly grave as he stopped looking down on his opponent, waving his hand to write out another character.
This was clearly the character for "kill"!
Confucians respect heaven and earth, keep their distance from ghosts and gods, and walk the great Dao of humanity, so the Confucian “kill” represents the great momentum of the human world!
This character was created with Fang Chaoyun's full strength. Wherever the character went, it was as if a god had arrived. Gales swirled continuously, and the world changed color. But Gu Nan still responded with a punch.
Only this punch consumed even more shadows.
Fist and character collided again, and the “kill” character was also quickly dyed by shadows, turning pitch-black. The character for "kill," which carried the great force of heaven and earth, finally made Gu Nan suffer some injuries.
A faint crack appeared on his neck and rapidly expanded. Gu Nan looked like he was made of ceramic as his body began to shatter.
But Gu Nan seemed entirely unaware of it and followed up with another punch without a second thought, this time aimed at Fang Chaoyun himself.
Fang Chaoyun couldn’t keep the look of disdain from his face.
‘He’s actually able to fight with me by relying on the power boost from his astral world; this is indeed a very astonishing thing. But if he believes that it’s possible to defeat me just because of this, then that’s a complete joke.’
‘Although I used my full strength in that character just now, I can write hundreds of characters at full strength without any effort, but how long can he last?’
‘It’s clear that his astral world is just starting out. How much of his astral world’s power can he afford to lose?’
After all, he was a powerful Star Ruler who lived for tens of thousands of years. Fang Chaoyun had experienced countless battles in his life, so his judgment of the situation couldn’t be clearer.
However, he failed to notice that his two contaminated characters were still floating in midair, even now. They merely became transparent and indistinguishable, but they never disappeared.
Not only did they not disappear, these two characters even formed an inexplicable connection with the shadows in the sky. It's just that the momentum behind Gu Nan's punches was so strong that he didn't notice the anomaly.
Fang Chaoyun was very patient. Since he decided to wear the enemy down in a battle of attrition, he even switched his focus from offense to defense.
For every punch Gu Nan threw, he leisurely wrote a character to deal with it, and every character was different.
If not for the fact that Gu Nan was still able to use his astral world’s power to give him slight pressure, this Elder Fang could’ve written an entire poetry essay.
Throughout the whole fight, it seemed like Gu Nan was fighting with all his might with every punch, while Fang Chaoyun was firmly holding the upper hand while looking like he was simply going for a stroll.
This was also in line with people's understanding of the two sides. That Gu Nan used offense in place of defense to last for this long under Fang Chaoyun's attacks was already quite good.
Only existences at Xue Ren’s level or even higher could see the dark cloud over the two’s heads darkening even further.
Thus, a soft sigh rang out from the depths of Academic Heaven, reaching every corner of the Myriad Heavens.
Fang Chaoyun clearly also heard this soft sigh, so he looked up suddenly, only to realize that the dark cloud above his head was clearly giving him an intense sense of foreboding.
‘To think I actually failed to sense such a threat hanging right above my head and had to be reminded by my teacher all the way back in Academic Heaven?’
Fang Chaoyun suddenly felt chills on his back. He finally realized that Gu Nan was gradually increasing the power of his attacks, so much so that he was forced to constantly devote more energy to the battle in order to maintain his upper hand.
It was precisely because of this that he didn’t even notice the great danger approaching him.
Fang Chaoyun's reaction couldn’t be described as slow. He understood Gu Nan’s entire plan in the blink of an eye, but unfortunately, Gu Nan, the one who set it all up, was inevitably faster than him.
As early as when the sigh rang out, he’d already brought all his movements to an abrupt stop, and the shadow in the sky suddenly fell down.
At the same time, the characters previously written by Fang Chaoyun lit up one after another, except they were all pitch-black and gave off a sinister aura.
Fang Chaoyun was instantly surrounded by hundreds of black characters; all his laws were sealed by the shadows, and the cloud of shadows fell down on his head.
Elder Fang could only face this inescapable blow head-on.
Both of his eyes glowed red, and he finally couldn’t resist using his astral world’s power to write a huge "seal" character with his raised hand.
The character for "seal" rose to the top of the sky, seemingly pushing the cloud of shadows away, but Gu Nan revealed a sneer.
He waved his hand, and the cloud of shadows suddenly broke apart on its own. Like all-pervading shadows, they passed through the “seal” character’s surroundings, chinks, and gaps, blasting Fang Chaoyun.
Secretive and ever-changing—this was one of the most important qualities of shadows.
It took a while for the shadow bombardment to come to an end, and the black characters suspended in midair dimmed one by one.
Fang Chaoyun’s hair was disheveled, and a cloud of crimson mist was in front of his chest. Clearly, he couldn’t hold back a mouthful of blood.
However, Gu Nan actually wasn’t in a hurry to attack anymore. Even with an astral world’s backing, killing a Tier 10 Star Ruler in one fell swoop simply wasn’t realistic.
Especially since the shadow cloud wasn’t able to accumulate to its limit yet before someone interrupted the attack, while Gu Nan himself also didn’t have much energy left—of the 1,050 divine power, he had only a little over 300 left.
But likewise, Fang Chaoyun's injuries would probably also require a few hundred years of recuperation to fully recover.
Such a battle was enough for Gu Nan to make a name for himself, so that everyone who wanted to come to his Divine Kingdom to cause trouble would think twice after seeing the consequences.
A green light lit up from the depths of the void and slowly shone onto Fang Chaoyun's body as a figure appeared beside him.
The visitor had the appearance of a young man, only his expression seemed particularly gentle, with less of the sharpness characteristic of youths.
"Teacher." Fang Chaoyun, who was quite heavily injured, struggled to get up after seeing the visitor and bowed respectfully.
The young man accepted his bow in its entirety before holding Fang Chaoyun and gently sweeping his student behind himself. He then looked towards Gu Nan. "Little Friend has injured my disciple. Care to give me an explanation?"
Academic Heaven’s Song Fei, the most overprotective person in the Myriad Heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 404: Don’t Be A Wimp
chapters.content:
The 13 powerhouses of the Thirteen Heavens were known and praised for many qualities, but the most famous characteristic of Academic Heaven’s Song Fei had always been his overprotective nature.
Song Fei had a gentle demeanor, spoke politely, and often gave people the refreshing feeling of a spring breeze. He almost perfectly fit the standard scholar template, except… he loved to stand up for his disciples a little too much.
He was already famous for this back when he wasn’t even a Unified Dao bigshot yet, and he caused a lot of trouble for himself because of this.
But Song Fei still continued acting the same way even after ascending to Unified Dao, frequently bullying those weaker than him without any regard to his status.
In Song Fei’s words, "You can curse me; I will not lower myself to your level. But if my disciple has been wronged, then I will seek justice without any regard to face."
Red Candle Heaven’s Green Lantern Fairy had a deep grudge against Fang Chaoyun.
But she never targeted Fang Chaoyun and merely watched him walk all the way to this point because of Song Fei’s existence.
Gu Nan also didn’t expect Song Fei to actually help his Tier 10 disciple, even with his status. This was already akin to throwing his face on the ground and stomping on it a few times.
But in the face of a shameless Thirteen Heavens level figure, did Gu Nan have any way to resist?
Of course he did.
Gu Nan smiled. "I’ve no explanation to give. But whatever losses I suffer today, your disciples might just suffer the exact same losses two days later."
After a pause, he narrowed his eyes and added, "If worst comes to worst, I’ll just abandon my astral world and start all over again. It hasn’t even been 50 years since I walked from an ordinary person all the way here. What’s there to fear?”
Song Fei was still smiling gently. "That means there’s someone who will stand up for you? Let me guess, is it Yu Lian, or is it that meddlesome old man?"
Song Fei’s voice didn’t sound unnatural at all when mentioning that old man, as if he wasn’t the one who screwed Zi Luo Elder over back then.
Gu Nan’s expression remained unchanged and had no intention of replying, merely revealing an odd smile.
From Xue Ren sending invitations far and wide to Gu Nan trying to find ways to stall for time, it was now almost time.
Song Fei was a very intelligent person. Just from Gu Nan’s attitude alone, he immediately associated Gu Nan’s plans with the matter of someone ascending to Unified Dao soon.
But with the way Xue Ren fought earlier, he didn’t look like someone who was about to enter Unified Dao.
Song Fei’s thoughts resembled the myriad curves of the Yellow River, housing a thousand schemes in his mind. He smiled at this time and said, "Ultimately, Xue Ren has yet to take that final step. If matters turn sour, it’s not impossible for this one to destroy his path to the great Dao."
"Amazing." Gu Nan gave him a sincere thumbs up. To decide to ruin a powerful Tier 10 Star Ruler’s path with a mere sentence; this was indeed very awe-inspiring.
It's just that there was something mocking about how that word sounded when coming from Gu Nan’s mouth.
Since he failed to sound out any useful information from Gu Nan, Song Fei’s interest also faded slightly. With his status, there really was no need to speak so much with a child like Gu Nan.
However, at this time, a mysterious aura rose out of thin air, bringing the entire Myriad Heavens to a boil.
Song Fei's expression turned a little grave, and, no longer caring about Gu Nan's matter, his gaze seemed capable of piercing through planes, landing directly on a certain small plane.
Xue Ren, on the other hand, remained under the sword testing platform, his gaze likewise looking towards that small plane as the corners of his mouth curled into a smile. "Don't let me down…"
Beside him, the Green Lantern Fairy, Wang Li, and the others were all astonished.
Because this was clearly a sign that someone was about to enter Unified Dao, but Xue Ren was still standing right in front of them…
‘Then who’s the one breaking through to Unified Dao? And what does Xue Ren hope to accomplish by making such a scene?’
There was no need for them to ponder this further, because the aura that practically triggered a change in the laws of heaven and earth was becoming more and more intense.
By this time, anyone could discover the source of the aura.
"What is that place?"
"I don't recognize it. It seems to be a small plane."
"That plane doesn’t even have a Star Ruler. Not even that, it hasn’t even been discovered before… How can such a small plane possibly produce a Unified Dao powerhouse?”
The Star Rulers were bewildered, unable to understand what they were seeing. After all, it was a matter of course for Star Rulers to break through to Unified Dao Realm from inside their own astral worlds. Why would anyone run to an obscure plane?
"It's too late." In Void Grotto Heaven, Yu Lian was naturally also paying attention to that plane. At this time, she gave a light sigh.
"Blood and flowers." Zou Jiming frowned slightly, but he was able to determine the meaning contained in this aura and judge this Unified Dao cultivator’s law inclination.
But a judgment was just a judgment. This result puzzled him greatly. Because in his impression, there had never been a major Star Ruler who used those laws.
‘This person can’t have appeared out of thin air, right?’
Under countless gazes, a red light suddenly emerged from that small plane and shot straight to the sky.
The red pillar broke through the clouds, and lotuses emerged on the horizon, as if countless rituals and music were being played, and the whole plane was filled with a festive mood.
This was the phenomenon that accompanied a cultivator’s successful ascension to Unified Dao, carrying the congratulations of heaven and earth—like Yu Lian said, they were too late to stop it.
But ever since the red pillar appeared, the special power that surrounded it—which had a strong sense of worship and sublimity—was finally recognized at a glance.
"The power of faith?" Song Fei's expression finally darkened completely, and there were no longer any hints of a smile in his gaze when he looked at Gu Nan.
Fang Chaoyun likewise knew what this meant and immediately pointed angrily at Gu Nan. "You guys actually invited foreign gods into our world and blocked the paths of Myriad Heaven’s cultivators from attaining the great Dao, you traitors!”
Wordlessly, Song Fei waved his hand and threw out a green light that headed straight for Gu Nan.
Faced with an attack from one of the Thirteen Heavens, by all rights, Gu Nan should be entirely powerless to resist.
And he very straightforwardly didn’t resist—judging which situations could be fought and which couldn’t was the player’s job.
However, at the same time Song Fei made his move, the red pillar of light that broke through the clouds in that small plane seemed to have grown eyes, falling straight into Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom.
The red light collided with the green light and dissipated simultaneously. After the red light flickered slightly, Rolensia's figure appeared in front of Gu Nan.
The current Rolensia’s appearance had undergone a great change. She wore a red mantle outside. The mantle was painted with strange patterns, and even her hair turned entirely crimson.
Gu Nan was familiar with this appearance, because in the player's extremely rare quest lines where Rolensia advanced to a greater god, she donned exactly this outfit.
There was no mistake. After over two years of seclusion, Rolensia finally took that most crucial step in the Myriad Heavens.
Now, instead of being called the God of Luxuriant Blossoms, it would be more accurate to call Rolensia the Ruler of Luxuriant Blossoms.
After Rolensia blocked Song Fei's blow, she first nodded at Gu Nan and said, "Many thanks."
Then she turned to Song Fei and Fang Chaoyun. "My name is Rolensia."
Song Fei nodded a little but didn’t speak. If this Unified Dao expert from the World of Gods was very determined to protect Gu Nan, then there was no need to fall out with her.
Or rather, her foundation was in the World of Gods, so there was no such thing as mutual restraint. Here in the Myriad heavens, she could act without the slightest scruple.
Rolensia was the first ever greater god who could enter the Myriad Heavens.
Although Song Fei was shrewd, his disciple, Mr. Fang Chaoyun, was not the same.
This old gentleman had been upright all his life. Not even living for tens of thousands of years managed to change his nature, so he immediately spoke righteously.
"Nonhuman races will not have humanity’s best interests at heart!" Fang Chaoyun bowed to Song Fei. "Teacher, that such barbaric foreigners entered our Myriad Heavens must mean they harbor wicked ulterior motives. Why not gather all the seniors—"
Before he could finish, a red light lit up on his body.
Song Fei's gaze turned slightly cold, but it was too late to stop it, so he casually pointed a finger, and a green light directly pierced Gu Nan's heart.
The two Unified Dao figures struck, and Gu Nan and Fang Chaoyun were hit almost simultaneously.
Gu Nan's heart shattered, while Fang Chaoyun's veins also burst. These injuries weren’t fatal for them, but they definitely weren’t light either.
Song Fei supported his own disciple's body with a light smile on his face, but he had no intention of backing down.
"Your Excellency Rolensia, both sides will only suffer more losses if we continue like this. Why don't we each take a step back?"
"Don't bother." Before Rolensia could respond, Gu Nan had already patted his chest, as if the gaping hole in his chest didn’t exist, and replied with a calm expression, "Let’s continue. Whoever gives in is a wimp."

chapters.title: Chapter 405: Reactions From All Sides
chapters.content:
At this critical time, Gu Nan’s thug-like declaration made it a little hard for Song Fei to stop halfway.
Although Gu Nan and Fang Chaoyun were both injured, in terms of vitality, Fang Chaoyun couldn’t catch up to Gu Nan even on horseback, not to mention that he also sustained considerable injuries when fighting Gu Nan earlier.
Nevertheless, Song Fei was Song Fei. How could a figure on this level be shaken by mere words?
After he finished speaking, he flat-out ignored Gu Nan and Rolensia’s reactions. Instead, both he and Fang Chaoyun disappeared in a swirl with a wave of his hand.
"In that case, the juniors' grudges should be resolved by themselves. Little Friend Gu Nan, you should be prepared."
In the end, Song Fei was a powerhouse who’d been in Unified Dao Realm for 100,000 years. If he wanted to leave, it was impossible for the newly-ascended Rolensia to stop him.
He left very decisively after seeing that nothing more could be done. Efficient, succinct, and uncaring of face—as expected of one of the Thirteen Heavens, Academic Heaven’s Song Fei.
But in any case, the fact that Rolensia stepped into the realm of a greater god meant Gu Nan and the others’ plan was a great success.
When Rolensia saw Song Fei leave, she turned to Gu Nan. "I won't remain on this side for too long. See you in Extreme Sword Heaven in three days."
After saying this, Rolensia also didn’t dally and quickly disappeared from Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom. Gu Nan, on the other hand, rubbed his chin and pondered.
If his guess was correct, then he would finally be able to meet the core members of the Heaven-God Alliance in Extreme Sword Heaven three days later.
As the two Unified Dao experts retreated, this grand drama full of twists and turns finally came to an end.
Outside, countless Star Rulers who were watching Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom, waiting to see the outcome of this once-in-a-century battle, felt their eyes almost pop out of their sockets.
The battle between Gu Nan and Fang Chaoyun ultimately led to a stand-off between two Unified Dao bigshots. This was a scene that hadn’t occurred in the Myriad Heavens for a thousand years.
Even more people were already considering Rolensia’s identity, as well as the ramifications.
For Star Rulers and even the more knowledgeable Void Cutters, the World of Gods wasn’t much of a secret, and many people had heard of Rolensia's name.
Rolensia’s act of running to the Myriad Heavens to enter Unified Dao was akin to occupying a limited spot that originally belonged to the Myriad Heavens.
In Fang Chaoyun’s words, Gu Nan and the others undoubtedly invited the wolf right into their house, damaging the interests of the entire Myriad Heavens. They were no different from traitors.
Both Gu Nan, who used the exposure of his astral world as a pretense to attract attention, and Xue Ren, who sent out invitations far and wide for a fake Unified Dao ascension ceremony in order to take the attention off of Rolensia, deserved the label of "traitor."
So the next day, the topic of "traitor" spread throughout the Myriad Heavens, and the front page of all the major newspapers covered the short fight between the foreign greater god and Academic Heaven’s Song Fei.
Gu Nan and Fang Chaoyun, the two who served as the fuse for all this, were naturally also reported in detail.
This wasn’t really surprising. In fact, even without the appearance of Unified Dao figures, the level of Gu Nan and Fang Chaoyun’s battle was also worth the attention of the entire Myriad Heavens.
After all, powerful Tier 10 Star Rulers couldn’t be seen at will.
……
Void Grotto Heaven.
"It’s all thanks to your family’s Xue Ren and that little fellow named Gu Nan this time. Truly, well done!" Zou Jiming saw Song Fei being forced back and laughed so hard that tears almost came out of his eyes.
Song Fei's reputation among the Thirteen Heavens showed a very obvious polarization.
Several Unified Dao existences, led by Jiu Po Heaven, had an extremely close relationship with Song Fei, while several others, including Zou Jiming, particularly detested him.
No matter what, it was a fact that he screwed over Zi Luo Elder back in the day; it was impossible for mere rumors to erase this truth from the memories of the Thirteen Heavens.
Yu Lian rolled her eyes in exasperation. "What do you mean by my family’s Xue Ren? I’m seriously going to kick you out."
Zou Jiming hurriedly made a pleading face and showed an apologetic smile. He was also in an extremely good mood, or else he wouldn’t have behaved like this in front of Yu Lian, whom he didn’t really have a close relationship with.
As the Star Ruler of Weapon Martial Heaven, Zou Jiming was probably the person who most wanted to see Rolensia enter Unified Dao.
The reason was very simple—if Rolensia can run to the Myriad Heavens to ascend to Unified Dao, then Xue Ren can also go to the World of Gods to do the same!
With Xue Ren’s title as the strongest swordsman in the Myriad Heavens, even if Zou Jiming was a Unified Dao powerhouse, he still felt some pressure. With Song Fei's precedent right in front of him, who the hell knows if Xue Ren would also go to such extremes in the future?
Without the pressure of Xue Ren chasing after him, Zou Jiming felt his entire body relax.
And his statement about this matter being all thanks to Xue Ren and Gu Nan was also quite an accurate judgment.
Without the two of them attracting everyone’s attention, Rolensia's law fluctuations would inevitably be seen through by other Unified Dao existences the instant she entered that realm.
What was the most likely ending for a Unified Dao cultivator who was a complete stranger to everyone? Of course she would be attacked from all sides.
If they could combine their efforts to prevent an unfamiliar face from reaching Unified Dao, then no one in the Thirteen Heavens wanted to become the Fourteen Heavens.
After all, Rolensia didn’t have any protection from her own Divine Kingdom when she ascended to Unified Dao on this side. She was completely exposed to outside attacks, which was also the biggest drawback of “breaking through in a different world.”
It was precisely because Gu Nan and Xue Ren understood this point in advance that they could each use different methods to attract as much attention as possible and cover for Rolensia.
Due to these two’s excellent performances, even the Thirteen Heavens were temporarily fooled. Until Rolensia succeeded in entering Unified Dao, they were still paying attention to Gu Nan’s side.
This was also why Rolensia thanked Gu Nan.
……
In Clockwork Heaven, Duan Wenqi ran to Lu Wen's side with great enthusiasm, carrying a stack of newspapers.
"Gu Nan and Xue Ren are now completely infamous. I'm afraid they’ll never be able to wash away the word ‘traitor’ from their reputations," Duan Wenqi remarked with a laugh. His mood had not been this good for a long time.
Lu Wen took the newspaper without comment and casually skimmed it.
As Duan Wenqi said, the majority of newspapers leaned towards accusing Gu Nan and Xue Ren of "defecting to the enemy’s side" and harming the interests of the entire Myriad Heavens.
Even some of their past deeds were unearthed, making them appear almost wicked beyond redemption.
After all, it was impossible for anyone to have a pristine record free of blemishes.
Nonetheless, Xue Ren was still a figure on the verge of reaching Unified Dao, so the major newspapers more or less still had some scruples about criticizing him. Thus, more firepower was concentrated on Gu Nan’s head. It was no wonder that Duan Wenqi looked so happy.
However, Lu Wen just shook his head with a light smile after he finished reading. "Why would Star Rulers like you and I ever care about outsiders' opinions of us?"
"In that earlier battle, Gu Nan has already proved that he doesn’t even fear someone at Fang Chaoyun’s level if inside his own astral world. In such a situation, just how many would dare to uphold justice on behalf of heaven?"
"What’s the use of verbal criticisms when no one dares to actually attack Gu Nan?"
Lu Wen's words poured a bucket of cold water on Duan Wenqi's head. In fact, this should also have occurred to Duan Wenqi, given his knowledge. It’s just that he was too happy earlier, so he didn’t think of it.
Now that Lu Wen pointed out the flaw in his logic, Duan Wenqi's expression turned ugly.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: Heaven-God Alliance Core Members
chapters.content:
"Gu Nan… His astral world isn’t even at Realm Level yet, but he can already fight Fang Chaoyun. If we wait until he grows further…"
Duan Wenqi's expression didn’t look very good as he shook his head. "I'm afraid he’ll have already stepped into Unified Dao before the Dream Immortal returns.”
The Dream Immortal's return from the River of Time was already set in stone. Although Duan Wenqi's prediction sounded a bit exaggerated, considering Gu Nan's terrifying advancement speed, it was actually quite hard to say.
But the always calm Lu Wen revealed a wry smile at this time. "It's a little too late to say this now…"
"Why is it late?" A sinister expression flashed across Duan Wenqi's face. "As long as you’re willing to make a move, you can kill Gu Nan effortlessly, and it might even be possible to kill Xue Ren."
Existences on the level of the Thirteen Heavens were never for show. As long as they felt the need, they would definitely take action personally, just like the unreasonably overprotective Song Fei.
If Lu Wen launched a sneak attack without regard to his face, he’d have very high chances of killing Xue Ren, let alone Gu Nan.
"Say I kill them—then what?" Lu Wen asked rhetorically, "Song Fei could’ve killed Gu Nan that day, so why didn't he?"
Duan Wenqi stared blankly, and only then did he spit out a name with a bitter look on his face, "Rolensia…"
That’s right, the deterrent was none other than Rolensia. As long as Rolensia didn’t return to the World of Gods, Gu Nan would be a cup of poisonous wine—pleasant to drink, yet there was also a price for drinking it.
Rolensia's Divine Kingdom wasn’t on this side. In the worst case scenario, she could simply slaughter every inhabitant in one of the Thirteen Heavens and then leisurely run away. Who could stop her?
It was way too difficult to actually kill a Unified Dao powerhouse. The death of every Unified Dao existence was always after thousands of years of schemes before finally succeeding in one fell swoop.
"But she has to go back sooner or later." A trace of coldness flashed through Duan Wenqi's eyes. "When she returns to that side, let's see who can still protect them."
……
Extreme Sword Heaven.
When Gu Nan stepped onto this land again, a strange feeling suddenly arose for an instant, as if he was being watched.
He knew this definitely wasn’t a hallucination, and people really were watching him.
When inside his own Divine Kingdom, not even Unified Dao cultivators could always keep an eye on him, but once he left the Divine Kingdom, his whereabouts could no longer be hidden from the bigshots.
Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head with a small chuckle. He didn't expect to enjoy Xue Ren's treatment so early.
But such a feeling lasted only for an instant, because Xue Ren immediately used the power of his astral world to place Gu Nan under his protection and hide him from the gazes of the outside world.
In the next second, Gu Nan entered Sword Sect in a single step, and his figure appeared at the top of Sword Sect's mountain, where Xue Ren and Rolensia were both already waiting.
In addition to them, Gu Nan also saw several acquaintances.
Daoist Lingyang was undoubtedly present, and the one sitting on the main seat was an unexpected person—Zi Luo Elder.
"Little Friend Gu Nan, we meet again." Zi Luo Elder was still smiling, as if he was merely an amiable old man next door.
But Gu Nan knew that if his suspicions were correct, then this old man might actually be the founder of the Heaven-God Alliance and one of the first members.
Furthermore, if there was a position like the "President of the Heaven-God Alliance," then it would almost certainly belong to Zi Luo Elder.
The whole matter became clearer in Gu Nan's mind.
Zi Luo Elder probably already awakened many years ago; it’s just that he never revealed himself to the public until now. It wasn’t until Rolensia was about to ascend that he truly walked into the limelight.
Perhaps without Gu Nan and Xue Ren, the one covering for Rolensia would be Zi Luo Elder himself.
Gu Nan greeted everyone individually and waited quietly under Xue Ren's guidance for the rest of the members to arrive.
A few more Star Rulers arrived soon after.
Gu Nan recognized these people’s identities. All of them were prestigious, powerful Star Rulers. Before today, Gu Nan never knew that they were also members of the Heaven-God Alliance.
The list he saw from Sylvia back then clearly only included some peripheral members, while the ones sitting here were the core members.
Gu Nan secretly counted. Excluding Rolensia, there were only eight Star Rulers in total here.
In other words, there were only eight core members of the Heaven-God Alliance from the Myriad Heavens’ side.
"Since everyone has arrived, let's get started," after everyone had arrived, Xue Ren opened his mouth.
He looked around, and his gaze finally landed on Rolensia. "Recently, two major events happened in the organization. I'm sure everyone is aware of them. One is Rolensia’s successful ascension to Unified Dao, and the other is—"
"The other is that we finally have a new core member after 6,000 years?" A woman beside Gu Nan finished for Xue Ren while covering her mouth with a smile.
This woman was dressed in a luxurious lavender robe, appearing somewhat like a mature woman. Her every move carried a different kind of charm.
This was Immortal Empress Taisheng, the Star Ruler of Imperial Glory Heaven. Imperial Glory Heaven was an astral world with a classic kingdom of immortals governance system, where each generation’s Star Ruler would be decided by whoever inherited the throne. The competition among the royal heirs was even more intense than in Clear Profundity Realm.
Immortal Empress Taisheng looked at Gu Nan with a small smile. Naturally, everyone present knew what the latter had done the other day.
"That's right." Xue Ren coughed slightly. "Gu Nan helped considerably in Rolensia’s advancement and even made an enemy of Song Fei over this. I trust that no one has any objections with promoting him to core member, right?”
The group of Star Rulers waved their hands and looked at Gu Nan with a little more kindness in their gazes.
Gu Nan nodded slightly. He knew all too well that having a major contribution was a must if he wanted to be truly accepted by the Heaven-God Alliance, while offending Song Fei an even better show of his loyalty.
If Zi Luo Elder was the founder of the Heaven-God Alliance, then the meaning of this organization's existence was also obvious.
They were trying to build a super organization that spanned two worlds, cultivating Unified Dao experts who belonged to the organization!
Unified Dao figures’ relationships were linked in countless ways, but multiple Unified Dao powerhouses who belonged to the same organization was something that had never been done before.
Sure enough, after Xue Ren finished speaking, Zi Luo Elder got up and announced, "Rolensia is going to return to that side eventually. This old man invited all of you here today because he wants to tell you something."
He looked around the circle. "After today, the Heaven-God Alliance will be exposed to the eyes of Unified Dao cultivators. If any of you feel like the Thirteen Heavens suspect your identity, then you might as well come along with us to the World of Gods for a while."
Once Rolensia left, the Thirteen Heavens would no longer have any scruples, and it would be very easy to deal with the rest of these people here.
Zi Luo Elder’s words made the crowd settle down at once.
They gradually sobered up from the excitement of Rolensia's ascension. The situation right now was definitely not considered a perfect conclusion, but rather a crisis.
But for everyone to abandon their astral worlds and run to the World of Gods by themselves…
The Thirteen Heavens might not lower themselves to the level of finding trouble for these people’s astral worlds, but there were plenty of people willing to throw stones when someone’s down.
The crowd fell into contemplation. Xue Ren was the first to take a stand, announcing with a light smile, "I'm definitely going to leave and lie low for a while."
"Ditto," this was Gu Nan.
Although they couldn't understand his words, his meaning was clear. Daoist Lingyang followed, "I'm involved in too many matters, so I won't stay here and take risks."
The remaining few people were still hesitating, but Zi Luo Elder spoke up at that moment, "You all can still think about it for a while. But before we leave, this old man has to collect a little interest for a certain event."

chapters.title: Chapter 407: Zi Luo’s Might
chapters.content:
Extreme Sword Heaven, Sword Sect’s gates.
The core members of the Heaven-God Alliance had already dispersed, each leaving more cautiously than the previous one.
Ultimately, the only ones who decided to follow Zi Luo Elder and Rolensia to the World of Gods were Gu Nan, Xue Ren, and Daoist Lingyang.
The remaining four were either still hesitating or had made up their minds to remain in the Myriad Heavens Universe. At the very least, they couldn’t leave so decisively.
Over the years, the four of them rarely participated in the affairs of the Heaven-God Alliance, so there was a low chance of their identities getting exposed. Hence, they believed they could try their luck by staying behind.
After all, not leaving meant merely the possibility of exposing their identities, while leaving would 100% expose their identities.
"They’ve all lived for tens of thousands of years. How come they’re still so blind?" Daoist Lingyang chuckled slightly and shook his head. "As long as you’re alive, no one can take away your astral world.”
At this time, he was sitting with Xue Ren and Gu Nan on the top of Sword Mountain. They were enjoying the mountain breeze and drinking mountain wine made from the Sword Sect's clear spring.
"The destruction of one’s astral world is akin to having ten thousand years of hard work go up in flames. How many people can be clearheaded in such a situation?" Xue Ren replied with a smile, then glanced at Gu Nan. "You really don't want a cup?"
While saying that, he even shook his wine glass at Gu Nan.
