The name “mountain wine” was coined by Xue Ren himself, and it already became one of Sword Sect’s specialties.
The clear spring on Sword Mountain naturally contained an overwhelming sword intent. When drinking wine made with this water, one can feel a strong rush even before it hits their throat.
Daoist Lingyang and Xue Ren were longtime friends who liked to come here to drink a bottle of mountain wine in their free time. This time, they also brought Gu Nan along.
Unfortunately, Gu Nan just waved his hand. In fact, he hadn’t drunk alcohol for many years. After all, when players were playing a game, food and drink were merely there to satisfy one’s appetite and nothing more.
Xue Ren didn’t press when he saw Gu Nan’s disinterest and laughed. "Gu Nan, it turns out you’re the most carefree one. The construction of your astral world only took a few decades, so it wouldn’t be a pity to lose it."
"That’s true in theory." Gu Nan thought about it and said, "But if there’s a chance it can be protected, then that would naturally be best."
For these Star Rulers, decades passed in the blink of an eye, but Gu Nan's entire gaming journey may not even add up to decades.
Speaking of ways to protect one’s astral world from greater gods, Gu Nan actually did know feasible methods. There were items in this world capable of sealing an astral world, only those items were in the World of Gods.
In the end, Gu Nan was still most familiar with the World of Gods, but he didn’t know if that item would still be effective in the Myriad Heavens Universe.
Daoist Lingyang nodded. "It will naturally be best if our astral worlds can remain undamaged. Zi Luo Elder’s trip this time is precisely to protect our astral worlds."
"Oh?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrow. He seemed to understand something and laughed. "Then I look forward to seeing it."
……
Although Gu Nan said he looked forward to seeing it, he couldn't actually see it—because what transpired afterwards happened inside one of the Thirteen Heavens. Besides the parties involved, no one else witnessed it.
Song Fei was injured.
This news shocked the entire Myriad Heavens as soon as it came out.
Although many inferred from Rolensia’s earlier ascension that a battle between Unified Dao existences was inevitable, it came way too quickly, and it was actually Song Fei who suffered injuries.
This was Song Fei! Even among the Thirteen Heavens, Academic Heaven was still one of the top ranked ones.
After confirming that the news came from the Thirteen Heavens and was most likely not fabricated, people's attention immediately shifted from Song Fei to another question.
Who injured Song Fei?
No news came out the day it happened, but by the next day, the entire matter’s cause became clear to everyone, while they learned another piece of news.
The organization hidden behind both the Myriad Heavens Universe and the World of Gods—the Heaven-God Alliance—finally stepped into the limelight for the first time.
Song Fei was in Graceful Heaven, healing his disciple Fang Chaoyun, when he was injured by two people who suddenly descended from the sky.
One of them was none other than the recently-ascended Unified Dao figure, the Ruler of Luxuriant Blossoms Rolensia, while the other attacker’s identity once again made countless people drop their glasses.
The one who struck was actually Zi Luo Elder!
This old man who slumbered for nearly 100,000 years actually participated in a fight between Unified Dao powerhouses as a mere Star Ruler!
And as the news continued to ferment, details of that battle were gradually revealed. Slowly, people discovered that Zi Luo Elder seemed to have played a rather significant role in the fight.
Admittedly, Song Fei did temporarily leave himself in a state of emptiness in order to help his disciple heal.
However, it was Zi Luo Elder who found the opportunity to take advantage of Song Fei’s empty state, grasping Song Fei’s weak spot every step of the way. Rolensia, on the other hand, only provided the power for the last blow.
In other words, Rolensia could be replaced with any other random Unified Dao cultivator, but Zi Luo Elder was irreplaceable in this sneak attack.
After this old man wounded Song Fei, he also left this sentence:
"I taught you everything you know. If you want to take revenge, bring Jiu Po and come find me."
……
"So it turns out Song Fei was also Zi Luo Elder’s disciple. This is truly unexpected," Duan Wenqi sighed with emotion, a thoughtful look on his face.
He and Lu Wen never witnessed Zi Luo Heaven’s original fall, but since they were still rather close in eras, they still knew something about the enmity between Zi Luo and Song Fei.
Everyone thought there wasn’t much of a connection between Song Fei and Zi Luo Elder, and that it was purely because the latter got in Song Fei's path that he was schemed.
But as soon as this sentence came out, the label of “killing one’s teacher” slammed onto Song Fei’s head!
"It’s a little strange." Lu Wen patted the Long Ling'er on his shoulder, instructing her to fly around on her own. "Zi Luo Elder doesn’t seem like the type of person to say such things."
"You feel like he’s being a little too arrogant?" But Duan Wenqi just laughed. "He clearly wants to protect the astral worlds of Xue Ren, Gu Nan, and the others, and have those words serve as a deterrent against anyone who might have ideas… I’m afraid these people will go far away very soon.”
Lu Wen’s eyes lit up and he suddenly said, "So that's how it is… People have referred to me as one of the Thirteen Heavens for so long that I even developed tunnel vision."
Those personally involved in the situation might not see as clearly as an outsider. Earlier, it was Lu Wen who helped Duan Wenqi see the big picture, but now that the matter involved Unified Dao cultivators and Lu Wen himself was included in the situation, Duan Wenqi was actually able to see more clearly.
"Right now, the known members of the Heaven-God Alliance are Zi Luo, Rolensia, Xue Ren, and Gu Nan. One Unified Dao powerhouse, two top-tier major Star Rulers, and a little monster who was able to injure Fang Chaoyun in his own astral world."
Duan Wenqi continued, "Now that Zi Luo put on such a show, even if Rolensia leaves, the Heaven-God Alliance will still have a fearsome reputation to act as deterrent."
Lu Wen nodded lightly, his fingers tapping continuously on the desk.
"If they really leave, then it’ll be our chance." A smile appeared on Lu Wen’s face, and he gently placed down a chess piece on top of another piece.
The lower chess piece instantly shattered, and its position was replaced by the one in his hand.
"Lou Wanying may be dead, but others are still alive. And there are people… who don’t fear the Heaven-God Alliance."
"They’re going to look for Gu Nan’s trouble?" Duan Wenqi's eyes lit up and he asked at once.
"No." When Lu Wen withdrew his hand, that piece suddenly had an extra strand of sword intent on it. "It's Xue Ren."

chapters.title: Chapter 408: Zhong Qinghe
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan’s group of three saw Zi Luo Elder and Rolensia again, they were already in a frontline plane.
It was a great coincidence that their destination was, once again, Heavenly Province World—of course, it might not actually be a coincidence, and Daoist Lingyang expressed his responsibility for this coincidence.
After they greeted each other, Zi Luo Elder suddenly raised his head.
"Mad Fist is here, it seems that this old man’s earlier show wasn’t in vain." The old man had a smile on his face, seemingly happy with the latest arrival.
Mad Fist referred to the Star Ruler of Martial Sect Realm.
Martial Sect Realm was an old, well-known astral world, and its Star Ruler was named "Mad Fist." It was said that this was his nickname in his early years. After he became a Star Ruler, he simply abandoned his real name and used Mad Fist as his name.
Martial Sect Realm was a very special astral world. Although it was only a Realm Level plane, its Star Ruler Mad Fist's combat power even surpassed that of many Star Rulers of Heaven Level planes.
Unfortunately, Mad Fist was too inattentive to the construction of his astral world, so that his astral world itself was dragging him down.
At the same time, Mad Fist was also one of the core members of the Heaven-God Alliance. He didn’t follow them over earlier, but now he most likely changed his mind.
"What did you say, old man? Didn't we agree to gather at this time? What, did you guys do something again?" After Mad Fist heard Zi Luo Elder's words, he actually looked surprised.
Gu Nan and Rolensia, who were meeting Mad Fist for the first time, couldn’t help being slightly taken aback at his appearance.
Could this person be a true martial arts fanatic, so much so that he didn’t even pay attention to the major events that transpired over the past two days?
"Alright, you can stop pretending." Xue Ren, who was familiar with him, came up and told Gu Nan and Rolensia, "This guy likes to pretend to be a martial arts fanatic, but his head is stuffed to the brim with schemes."
Mad Fist showed a coy smile. "Only those who wholeheartedly want to win are called martial arts fanatics. For the sake of victory, what's wrong with pretending to be a martial arts fanatic?"
"Makes sense." Gu Nan nodded at him.
"Right? Right?" Mad Fist seemed happy that someone else agreed with his view.
Rolensia remained silent, while Zi Luo Elder added, "Let's set off. Let’s leave early and return early."
He looked at Gu Nan and the other two. "After this old man's earlier strike, not many people will dare to openly attack your astral worlds now, but there will still be some small movement."
Now that the Heaven-God Alliance walked into the limelight and even injured Song Fei, they immediately scared the Star Rulers who wanted to beat a drowning dog into setting aside their petty schemes for now.
No one knew whether the Heaven-God Alliance might make a comeback after some time.
If there really was such a day, then today's pleasure may well become tomorrow's bane.
However, as Zi Luo Elder said, although fewer people dared to openly jump out, there would still be people making small moves in secret.
……
Qinghe Realm.
As the largest trade-oriented astral world in the Myriad Heavens, Qinghe Realm, under the leadership of its ruler Zhong Qinghe, had always developed faster than astral worlds of the same level.
After all, if done properly, the potential of commerce was far greater than that of agricultural civilizations, and trade was the best and only way to circulate resources.
On this day, Zhong Qinghe was finishing up one of the Commerce Association’s internal meetings when he was called by a vice president.
"My Lord, I made an appointment with your secretary last week. There are some matters I want to discuss with you,” the vice president said respectfully.
"Old Zhou, why are you still being so polite with me? Take a seat." Zhong Qinghe casually greeted the other party and sat down, acting like they were very close.
Old Zhou showed a grateful look. "Lord, do you still remember that Lu Xinhuan took the Eldest Miss to the World of Gods, and the two of them ended up disappearing together?"
Zhong Qinghe nodded. "Xinhuan has most likely been killed already, what a pity… Little Die’s life soul is still there, indicating that her life is safe, but her whereabouts are unknown."
"We found Eldest Miss," Old Zhou said at once.
Zhong Qinghe raised his head, the gaze he leveled at Old Zhou finally showing some surprise.
Old Zhou cleared his throat and reported, "Our forces in the Capital of Blood have been uprooted. But some of the traces left behind point to… Gu Nan."
"Gu Nan? Now that his astral world has been revealed to the world, you found Little Die inside?" Zhong Qinghe's expression remained unchanged.
"Your Excellency is wise," Old Zhou flattered Zhong Qinghe.
Zhong Qinghe had a calm smile on his face and said as if casually, "Then you guys can go bring her back."
Old Zhou stared blankly, then hurriedly said yes and left, but he failed to notice the strange smile on Zhong Qinghe’s face as he left.
……
Gu Nan and the others passed through the dimensional wall and entered the World of Gods very smoothly. They barely ran into any obstacles.
In reality, no one would try to stop them. Wasn’t it a little too stupid to try stopping a Unified Dao bigshot from returning to the World of Gods?
On the contrary, the moment Rolensia returned to the World of Gods, the original twelve greater gods sensed something at the same time, and a black-haired young girl in a long dress descended in front of them.
"Welcome back, Rolensia." The black-haired maiden seemed to want to give Rolensia a hug, only to be decisively ignored by the latter.
Xue Ren glanced at her and came over to Gu Nan's side. "Who is this one?"
"The incarnation of night, the Goddess of Darkness, Daisy," Gu Nan acted as the commentator and answered with little hesitation.
He knew many people suspected that he was from the World of Gods, and he had no intention of hiding this.
Let them guess. No one will guess the truth anyway.
The Goddess of Darkness Daisy, a top-tier god who ranked towards the front even among the twelve greater gods, personally came to welcome Rolensia’s return today.
In fact, Rolensia’s ascension was definitely a pleasant surprise for the Dark Faction.
Originally, seven of the twelve greater gods already belonged to their faction, and the Light Faction relied entirely on the might of the Ruler of Light and Justice to not fall into a disadvantage in wars.
Now that the Dark Faction had one more person, the situation in the World of Gods was about to change again.
Daisy and Rolensia’s conversation didn’t last long. Certain deeper-level matters wouldn’t be exchanged during an occasion like this.
After separating from Daisy, Rolensia brought Gu Nan and the others back to her Divine Kingdom.
Compared to the Myriad Heavens Universe, where danger lurked everywhere, staying inside an allied greater god’s Divine Kingdom was undoubtedly safe beyond measure.
"You're leaving?" Rolensia looked at Gu Nan with slight surprise. "Your Thirteen Heavens are able to influence some people on this side. It's dangerous for you to head out now."
Gu Nan, however, just revealed a small smile. "I know, but I really do have some matters to attend to."
Faced with Gu Nan's insistence, Rolensia finally nodded. "Sylvia said she wants to visit you sometime."
"I'll be back soon." Gu Nan thought for a moment and added, "As for Sylvia, you can tell her to wait for me in the Dragon Realm."
"Okay."
……
At the same time that his true body arrived in the World of Gods, Gu Nan's saint clone, who was hiding in a small plane, slowly opened his eyes.
"It’s time to start the plan for the player army."
"But before that," Gu Nan's gaze fell back to his own astral world, "there are still some small bugs to deal with."
There, Zhong Die was staring at the two men in black that appeared before her with a bewildered expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 409: Dragon Realm
chapters.content:
"Eldest Miss, please come with us," two men in black stood in front of Zhong Die, their voices respectful but resolute.
"Who are you guys?" Zhong Die tilted her head, her expression innocent.
The two looked at each other, and the one on the left stepped forward. "Shadow guards 356 and 357 under the Commerce Association greet the Eldest Miss."
Zhong Die blinked as it suddenly dawned on her. "So Daddy sent you guys… Can you tell him I don't want to go back yet?"
The man who opened his mouth shook his head. "You must at least go back and meet His Lordship."
"Then I won't be able to come out again." Zhong Die pressed her lips into a thin line, her expression full of regret. The next second, a red light flashed in front of her, and her right hand had already extended out at some point.
The red light came so quickly that the man in front of Zhong Die couldn’t react at all, while Zhong Die's right hand had already plunged into his heart.
……
"Useless! They’re all useless!"
Old Zhou's real name was Zhou Shi. His identity was similar to Lu Xinhuan's, and he was also one of the vice presidents of Qinghe Realm’s Commerce Association. But at this moment, Old Zhou possessed none of the cool and reserved air of a vice president and was full of rage and frustration.
"You know full well that there’s a group of vampires around the Eldest Miss, yet you guys still sent two trash over. Tell me, are you trash or not!"
Crash!
A porcelain cup was viciously smashed into the ground, signaling how Old Zhou's anger had reached the point of complete eruption.
His subordinates stood before him, their backs ramrod straight. Their heads were lowered, and they didn’t dare say a word.
Old Zhou cursed that the two who took action were trash, and the people here who handled matters were also trash, yet none of them dare to refute him. To put it bluntly, he wasn’t wrong.
Qinghe Realm’s distinguished Commerce Association handled the entire mission, yet they actually allowed a spoiled young lady like Zhong Die to escape from their hands?
If this happened in the past, back when the Commerce Association had just expanded and was at its most militarized, they would’ve had to take responsibility for this failure by committing suicide.
What's more, it wouldn’t be easy to find Zhong Die again now that they let her get away. She wasn’t stupid. How could she still show herself when she knew people wanted to capture her?
It was only when Old Zhou grew tired from cursing that one person carefully spoke up, "Actually, we already used quite a few methods to lure away all the vampires around Eldest Miss… The two shadow guards were killed by Eldest Miss herself."
"Eldest Miss killed them herself?" That finally stunned Old Zhou slightly, and he frowned.
He also just received the news and didn’t have time to learn the details yet. Only when he heard his subordinate’s words did he get a shock.
Old Zhou had watched Zhong Die grow up. He knew better than anyone else just what kind of cultivation and what kind of personality she had.
Yet she was now capable of killing two Void Cutters after going to Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom?
Even if these two only just entered Void Cutter Realm, anyone capable of killing them would undoubtedly also have to be a Void Cutter…
That subordinate snuck a glance at Old Zhou's expression and continued, "Eldest Miss has already advanced to Void Cutter Realm, and she… seems to have already turned into a vampire."
Crash!
Old Zhou shattered the other cup on his desk. He was about to break into a cursing fit again when his mind felt a little dazed.
The next instant, a silver-robed figure appeared in front of him, while the corpses of his subordinates slowly crumpled to the ground at the same time.
When he looked closely, all of their heads had already been cleanly separated from their bodies.
"You…" Old Zhou got up abruptly. By the time he recognized the newcomer’s identity, cold sweat dripped down from his forehead.
‘Now that news has spread throughout the Myriad Heavens, the other party should’ve already gone to the World of Gods, so how can he appear here? No wait, this seems to be a clone…’
At the very least, Old Zhou was someone who often met various Star Rulers, so he quickly recognized the other party as a clone.
But what made him feel helpless was that even Gu Nan’s clone could still kill Old Zhou easily.
"There’s something I want you to do," Gu Nan's voice didn’t contain any emotion and seemed incomparably natural, as if he was instructing his own subordinate.
Old Zhou hurriedly forced a smile onto his face. "Please command me. As long as this humble servant can do it…”
"I want a batch of space-time crystals. I'll give you three days to transport them to this plane." Gu Nan said indifferently, "Don’t play tricks. Within three steps of me, not even Zhong Qinghe can protect you."
Old Zhou's heart was full of bitterness, truly hating the fact that he wasn’t inside Qinghe Realm right now and just had to do his business in this small plane instead.
However, a vice president like him wouldn’t be in headquarters most of the time, so there was nothing that could be done about it.
……
That Zhong Die could kill two Void Cutters by herself not only shocked Old Zhou, but even Gu Nan was a little surprised.
The player route was indeed powerful. Zhong Die, who possessed the origin blood, leveled up at a speed not much slower than normal players. At most, she just lacked direction.
But this also reinforced his idea of building a player army. He told Old Zhou to look for space-time crystals precisely to transport a group of potential seedlings to the World of Gods.
If he could have a player army in hand, he wouldn’t be at a disadvantage in the next Divine Kingdom War with regards to Tier 4 forces.
No organization could resist the onslaught of a group of Tier 4 troops taking the player route.
Gu Nan originally intended to set this plan in motion and even had most of the seedlings ready but didn’t have time to collect the space-time crystals yet.
Many people knew about Gu Nan’s clone, and inside the Divine Kingdom, Red Tail, Lan Si, and even Yan Xiaoxiao were most likely being watched.
As soon as the saint clone revealed itself, it would be immediately captured.
While the clone was keeping an eye on Old Zhou in the small plane, Gu Nan's main body arrived at Dragon Realm in the World of Gods, where Sylvia was indeed already waiting for him.
"How did you know I’d be at this entrance?" Sylvia asked with slight curiosity when she saw Gu Nan arrive.
The World of Gods was different from the Myriad Heavens. Other than the several main planes, normal planes like Dragon Realm couldn’t be entered or exited at will.
The space here was much denser, so there was no such thing as teleporting here at will, which was why normal planes all had fixed entrances.
However, Dragon Realm was also a well-known large plane and had once almost become one of the main planes back when the ancient Dragon God was still alive, so there were definitely many entrances.
"You only know this entrance, right?" Gu Nan didn't even turn his head back, slowly stepping inside Dragon Realm. "I heard Dvalin taught you a lesson before?"
Dvalin was the leader of the metal dragon clan, a dragon of considerable age.
When Sylvia was young, she once had a conflict with Dvalin. At that time, the old Dragon God was still alive, so the result was that they both had to smooth things over and make peace, which didn’t end well for either of them.
The Dragon God later died, but Sylvia wasn’t someone who held long grudges, so she hadn’t thought of revenge for many years.
That is, until Gu Nan brought up this matter. She glanced at him in astonishment. "You even know about this matter?"
This was tens of thousands of years ago, and it was an infinitesimally small matter. Without personally experiencing that era, it was almost impossible for someone to know about it.
The look she cast at Gu Nan was colored with suspicion, and it seemed she could now narrow down her speculation about the other party's identity to a very small range.

chapters.title: Chapter 410: Metallic Silver Island
chapters.content:
Gu Nan didn’t know what she was thinking, nor was he interested in knowing.
Moreover, he wasn’t about to tell Sylvia that not only did he know her past with Dvalin, every single player who has ever done the "dragonkin" system mission knew about it.
Dragonkin was one of the special races that players could reincarnate into, and this race was so much better than vampires.
In the end, vampires were only a half-undead clan belonging to the Dark Faction. It was already considered very impressive for a clan to have ten Legend Rank members.
But the dragon clan?
As long as they grew normally, any pure-blooded dragonkin would naturally reach Legend Rank upon entering adulthood. Even mix-blooded dragonkin were still much stronger than vampires.
Not only did the dragonkin retain the dragon race’s superb heritage, but they also possessed the human race’s short growth cycle, as well as the potential for unlimited evolution.
The moment he decided to build a player army, dragonkin was already a must-have route in Gu Nan's plans.
But he didn’t come here solely for the dragonkin this time. Dragon Realm also housed an item that could temporarily seal a Divine Kingdom, which could perhaps be used to preserve his own Divine Kingdom.
"Then let's find trouble for Dvalin?" Sylvia sounded a little eager.
Even though she was a god with a somewhat poor memory, when Dvalin’s name reappeared in her mind, she couldn't help but recall her past feud.
In fact, in the original game, the player needs to complete another mission before this where they’d meet Sylvia and have her recall these memories.
However, Gu Nan didn’t have to go through such a troublesome process this time; he could simply tell her directly.
He needed Dvalin’s blood plus the heads of twenty metal dragons to open the Dragon Tomb.
While it was possible to handle this matter without Sylvia, it’d be better to have the latter as a scapegoat so that Gu Nan himself wouldn’t attract too many people’s attention.
"No, we need to get something first."
……
Dragon Realm was a very large plane, where countless islands floated overseas, surrounding a vast continent in the center.
Similar to the setting in many fantasy novels, this continent was known as the Dragon God Continent, and legends often began here.
Of course the Dragon God Continent didn’t only have dragons. Like all planes, the race with the largest population here was also the human race, which had astonishing reproductive abilities.
In the northwestern part of the continent, the Flame Dragon Empire, which was blessed by the Red Dragon, ruled over thousands of subjects there.
Within the Flame Dragon Empire, there was a distinguished Prince Charlie, whose fame was comparable to that of his legendary father.
"I'm looking for Charlie." Gu Nan took Sylvia with him and descended directly into the Flame Dragon Empire’s imperial palace.
The servant who was grabbed by Gu Nan couldn't help but sound a little strained when he felt the tremendous pressure coming from the two strangers, "Un-Understood. I will inform him right away—"
"You just need to tell me where he is."
A few minutes later, Gu Nan was already standing in front of Charlie's door.
Sylvia pursed her lips. "If you want to find someone, as long as we disclose our identities, they’ll naturally come to us of their own accord."
With Sylvia's status, she naturally didn’t care for such a sneaky way of doing things.
But neither did Gu Nan enjoy pretending to be a pig in order to eat a tiger. It’s just that it wasn’t convenient for him to reveal his identity here.
Otherwise, it would seem too deliberate when he later went to Dvalin’s territory again using Sylvia's name.
When Sylvia saw his lack of a response, she asked a different question, "What do you want with this mortal?"
"To have him pull out a sword for me."
"Oh! These greedy mortals will definitely take advantage of the opportunity to demand a high reward!" Sylvia looked like she’d been deeply hurt by this in the past.
Gu Nan just looked at her like she was an idiot.
After pushing open the door and entering, the two soon saw Prince Charlie. He was teaching a young girl to read.
"The sword in the stone has appeared in the westernmost land," Gu Nan didn’t bother conversing with the two and simply said these words like an incantation.
As soon as his voice fell, his and Sylvia's figures had already disappeared.
All the way until they left, Prince Charlie and his little sister, Alice, were still in a dumbfounded state.
It was little Alice who came back to her senses first and said excitedly, "Brother! Did you hear that? There’s a sword in the stone in the west! Two apostles even came in person to pass on the message!"
In the World of Gods, the legend of the sword in the stone has always been linked to a change in throneship, a symbol of the gods' chosen emperor.
And apostles coming to the door to convey the will of the gods was something that would only happen in fictional stories. They never thought such a scene would really appear in front of them.
Other princes might experience a wave of fear in this situation, but Prince Charlie was different.
The reason why Prince Charlie was famous was because of his majestic talent and military excellence. His taking over the throne was practically a given.
On the contrary, the emergence of the sword in the stone and the apostles visiting him were pleasant surprises.
……
"What is the westernmost land?" Sylvia asked curiously as she walked side by side with Gu Nan.
"The world is round. There’s no such thing as the westernmost land." Gu Nan looked at her like she was a mediocre student. "West of the Flame Dragon Empire is Metallic Silver Island. Don’t tell me you don’t even know that?”
Sylvia froze. As previously stated, her knowledge of Dragon Realm definitely wasn’t deep, and her geography was a mess.
But she at least knew that Metallic Silver Island was the lair of the metal dragons and Dvalin’s residence.
……
A week later, Prince Charlie led his adventurer squad through many hardships, finally arriving at the outskirts of Metallic Silver Island…
And then they were stopped by a dragon.
"Leave immediately! Lowly humans, Metallic Silver Island is not a place you should’ve come to—"
Boom!
A lightning bolt fell from the sky and struck the metal dragon on the head; its huge dragon body fell heavily to the ground.
Charlie and others glanced at each other, but now that the gatekeeper fell so inexplicably, they didn’t dare delay and hurried towards the center of Metallic Silver Island.
"Hey! A dragon struck unconscious by lightning—isn’t this a little too comical?" Sylvia slowly walked out from the shadows, seemingly dissatisfied with Gu Nan's clumsy tactics.
Although manipulating adventurers for their own use was a tactic gods often used, they never made things this ridiculous.
"Metal tends to attract lightning. This is common sense," Gu Nan shrugged, talking about irrelevant theories while his feet already started walking inside.
But he suddenly stopped after only a few steps and stared ahead with slight surprise. "We’re not very lucky; we ran into some trouble."
Dvalin was a troublemaker who caused countless problems. Thus, no matter what time, it wouldn’t be strange to see people looking for his trouble.
But to run into the most troublesome person as soon as they arrived. One could only say that Gu Nan’s luck was too good… Or rather, Sylvia’s luck wasn’t good.
By now, the Goddess of Shadows had also discovered who exactly was on Metallic Silver Island. Her expression changed slightly and she hurriedly said, "Something came up, so I’ll take my lea—"
"Too late."
Sylvia was slightly stunned, then immediately heard an angry roar coming from the front:
"Sylvia! You ran out to seduce men again!"

chapters.title: Chapter 411: Wrestling Goddess Karina
chapters.content:
An angry female voice traveled over from Metallic Silver Island, her voice practically spreading through the entire island, especially the word "seduce."
Classmate Sylvia's face turned beet red at a speed visible to the naked eye, and since she was also afraid of arguing with that person and making herself an even bigger laughingstock, she turned around and tried to leave.
But as soon as she turned around, a wild figure appeared in front of her.
The newcomer was a girl with a ponytail wearing a leopard pattern skirt and holding a golden spear, with hard facial features that added a bit to her “tough guy” appearance.
Wrestling Goddess Karina, the Tier 8 god that players jokingly called the Amazon Valkyrie, with combat power that far exceeded that of her divine power. She was a famous violent woman.
But while violent, Karina also possessed incomprehensible tenderness.
She was the number one fangirl of the Ruler of Light and Justice, Austin, and since the Second Great War among the gods, she madly pursued that God of Light, even though Austin was not yet a greater god at that time.
"Sylvia, as Austin's little sister, how can you hang out with a man?" Karina glared at the Goddess of Shadows.
Sylvia couldn't help rolling her eyes as she twisted her head back. "Who I hang out with is none of your business."
Karina sighed, as if she was a helpless mother watching her naughty daughter. "You are, of course, free to like whomever. But before your older brother and I get married, you should live an honest, moral life."
Feeling like she was about to rip her hair out, the Shadow Goddess pointed at Karina indignantly and said, "My brother will marry you? You horny sow, stop dreaming!"
Gu Nan, who had never seen Sylvia like this before, couldn't help but look at the two in amazement.
Karina, this Valkyrie who was a little slow-witted, was also famous in the game, but what happened after she met Sylvia was a scene that even Gu Nan had never seen before.
In reality, in the game world, there weren’t many missions about Sylvia to begin with. More often than not, the Goddess of Shadows was invisible to players.
As if a little ashamed of her cursing, Sylvia glanced at Gu Nan quickly, then hurriedly glared at Karina furiously.
But Karina didn’t seem angry at all even when cursed at. Instead, she turned a little bashful. "Excessive enthusiasm is indeed one of my shortcomings. I would also like to overcome this, but every time I see Austin… Oh!"
Miss Valkyrie, who was deep in her fantasies, suddenly blushed and even forgot to finish her sentence.
But Gu Nan suddenly raised his head at this time, pointing behind Karina and shouting, "Austin!"
"Where?!" Karina turned back in bewilderment, then felt a pain in the back of her head where Gu Nan's fist just punched her.
Karina stumbled forward from the punch. Immediately afterwards, she lunged at Gu Nan with a strange scream.
Gu Nan fought her without hesitation. After the two of them exchanged several blows, Karina seemed entirely unaffected and laughed, "This man can fight quite well. Sylvia has a good eye this time."
"You shut up!" Sylvia had every reason to be angry. She was just interacting with some male gods normally, yet every time Karina bumped into her, she was labeled as "seducing" them.
"Austin!" Gu Nan pointed behind her again.
"Where?"
So Karina received another punch to the back of her head.
"Austin!"
"Austin!"
"Austin!"
"Do you think I'm stupid?" After receiving two punches to the back of her head, Karina, whose head was starting to spin, finally shouted angrily at Gu Nan.
"Austin!" Gu Nan shouted once again.
Thus, Karina turned her head again skeptically.
Wham!
Another heavy fist smashed down, finally punching the Valkyrie unconscious.
Gu Nan shook his right hand, which was a bit sore, and greeted Sylvia, "Let's go. Let's deal with Dvalin first. It won't take long for her to wake up."
Sylvia followed Gu Nan in a daze, as if she couldn't believe that Karina, the fellow who gave countless gods headaches, had been dealt with by Gu Nan just like that.
Of course Gu Nan wouldn’t tell her that Karina has also caused countless players headaches, and finally, players came up with this method of temporarily knocking her out.
But that was all. It was practically impossible to kill this thick-skinned woman.
Karina wasn’t an ordinary god; she had a big secret hiding on her.
One of the game’s main quest lines was to help Karina ascend to a greater god. If the player wanted to help the Light Faction win the Fourth Great War among the gods, then this was one of the very few routes that could make it possible.
Once Karina, this cockroach who couldn’t be killed, became a greater god, her strength would catch up with Austin, surpassing even Lady Daisy.
Let alone that Gu Nan was currently only Tier 7 and had a slightly lower level than Karina, even if he was already Tier 10, killing the other party would still be all but impossible.
Only when the player completed the Second Round would it be easier to go back and kill Karina.
But by that stage, the drops from the Valkyrie wouldn’t be of much use to players anymore. At most, it would just satisfy some players' collecting hobby.
Gu Nan didn’t care about the unconscious Karina on the ground. To him, Karina’s appearance merely added a restriction to his current operation—to take care of the metal dragon clan before the Valkyrie woke up.
‘I’ll have to speed things up. It’s just that it won’t be easy to pin everything on Sylvia if I do that…’ Gu Nan silently calculated in his heart.
"Which Excellency is descending on Metallic Silver Island?" An old voice slowly asked from the depths of Metallic Silver Island.
Gu Nan and Sylvia knew this voice all too well. This was none other than the old dragon Dvalin.
He originally thought that Karina’s appearance would definitely make the two trespassers leave, but he didn’t expect…
Gu Nan reached the very center of Metallic Silver Island in the blink of an eye. A silver dragon was flying around in the air. When he saw Gu Nan appear, he was first taken aback, then quickly swung his tail at the trespasser.
"Little Evan, stop!" Dvalin also didn’t expect Gu Nan to move so fast. By the time he called out the warning, it was already too late.
Without even raising his head, Gu Nan casually grabbed the silver metal dragon by the tail and gave a light shake, instantly transmitting over a huge force.
The metal dragon Evan seemed to freeze. His enormous body stalled in midair. As Gu Nan swung his right hand down, the dragon also crashed to the ground with extreme force.
Smoke and dust filled the air. Gu Nan just standing in midair, still holding the tail in his hand, gazing indifferently at the figure before him.
It was a robed old man. Wrinkles practically covered his face, visible in his old age.
After all, dragons weren’t natural-born gods. Even a long lifespan had a limit. Dvalin lived for tens of thousands of years and had now entered old age.
Evan, on the other hand, was one of his most promising clan members, as well as his direct descendant. Now, he was lying helplessly on the ground, his tail still held by the man in front of him like a mark of shame.

chapters.title: Chapter 412: Selling Out A Teammate
chapters.content:
Dvalin knew the person in front of him came together with Sylvia, so this visitor probably bore ill will.
But the old dragon had offended too many people in his lifetime, so he had ample experience dealing with people who came to his home to seek vengeance.
He spoke with a solemn face, "Your Excellency, this is Dragon Realm, and my metal dragon clan is under the protection of—"
"Joshua, I know," Gu Nan revealed a cold smile as he finished Dvalin’s sentence.
Joshua, the God of the White Crow, was the god protecting the metal dragon clan. No normal god would be able to bring a dragon tribe under his command, and in fact, Joshua was a powerful Tier 9 god.
But Gu Nan wasn’t too concerned because Joshua was a particularly lazy god.
He was powerful, treated his subordinates well, and also held grudges; he was a god you didn’t want as an enemy. But the problem with the God of the White Crow was that he wasn’t very interested in anything and was the type to drag out one day’s work into three days.
If Dvalin sent a distress signal right now, Joshua probably wouldn’t even look at it—nothing was allowed to disturb his naptime.
Dvalin instantly felt a little helpless at bumping into someone who wasn’t afraid of Joshua. He could only reluctantly say, "Your Excellency…"
Gu Nan casually grabbed little Evan's tail and threw Evan directly in front of Dvalin, casually cutting in, "I just came to Metallic Silver Island to find something. I’ll leave as soon as I find it.”
"If you cooperate, everything will be fine. If you don’t cooperate, your whole family will die, understand?" Gu Nan pointed at Dvalin and said.
As the head of the metal dragon clan for tens of thousands of years, when had Dvalin ever encountered such a straightforward threat before?
His old face darkened.
He wanted to attack but didn’t dare; this was a vicious person who even put Karina down. He wanted to give in, but he’d lose a lot of face; such a large commotion had long alerted the other clansmen on Metallic Silver Island.
But Gu Nan didn’t bother looking at him again. Dvalin’s final decision didn’t matter—in fact, there were only two paths he could take.
Cooperate to live, or cooperate by dying.
Prince Charlie's squad was getting deeper and deeper, and the great commotion in the center of Metallic Silver Island astonished them while simultaneously giving them a sense of anticipation.
"Brother, the sword in the stone must be just ahead. Let's speed up!" Little Alice also secretly followed the group, and at this time shouted from next to Charlie.
Alice's forehead was covered with sweat, and her long golden hair was almost plastered to her head, but her expression was still exuberant.
"There's no harm in being careful," Prince Charlie hurriedly pulled her back and exhorted.
"I know that… Hey, is that the sword in the stone?" Alice's pleasantly surprised voice exclaimed.
Charlie also hurriedly looked up to see a broken sword stuck in the ground in front of him.
"We found it this easily?" Charlie seemed a little incredulous, feeling that his own adventure this time shouldn't be so simple.
But the sword in the stone was right in front of him, and he had no reason to hesitate, rushing forward as soon as possible and pulling the broken sword out.
And then… nothing happened. The broken sword was still a broken sword.
The next moment, Charlie felt two shadows emerge from the ground, gripping him and pulling him forward.
Not long after, a huge body appeared in front of him, while the broken sword plunged into it.
"This is… dragon?!" After calming down, Charlie realized that the broken sword had stabbed a huge silver dragon covered with metal scales.
But these scales of incredible hardness appeared to be paper in front of the broken sword.
"What is that human holding in his hand? Dvalin shouted madly, because he sensed the special aura coming from the broken sword.
The broken sword was nothing special when it was first pulled out, but the moment it entered Evan's body, the resentful spirits of countless dragons seemed to surge out at the same time.
Such weapons had a special name in the World of Gods.
"Dragon Slayer." Sylvia frowned slightly. She didn’t expect Gu Nan to be looking for this.
"Dragon’s Bane,” Gu Nan uttered the players' loving name for the sword.
Prince Charlie pulled out the broken sword in a daze but discovered that it was no longer appropriate to call it a "broken sword."
After absorbing a dragon’s blood, the rust had faded away completely, revealing its original appearance.
It was a dagger that glowed golden all over!
"As expected of the sword in the stone…" Prince Charlie murmured.
But immediately afterwards, he felt a flash of shadows in front of him, and the dagger in his hand was snatched away.
Prince Charlie instantly looked up angrily, only to see the "apostle" he saw the other day holding the dagger and examining it carefully.
Each "Dragon Slayer" had a hidden "Dragon Grudge" attribute, which had a strong taunting effect on the dragon race.
Now that this dagger appeared on Metallic Silver Island, it would lure countless furious dragons over in the blink of an eye, and this was exactly Gu Nan's goal.
He needed the heads of twenty metal dragons, but dragons were all cowards who valued their lives, and they also ran away fast. Rather than spending the effort to chase the dragons down one by one, it was better to find someone to pull out this dagger.
Now that Gu Nan got the sword, Classmate Charlie wasn’t so happy anymore.
But not only did this charismatic prince not have any intention of sternly criticizing Gu Nan, he actually revealed a respectful expression.
"This humble one would like to offer the divine sword in respect to your god. May I know the name of that one…"
He figured that the two before him must be the apostles of a certain god, just slightly greedier than average. After all, not all apostles were good people.
But as long as he knew the identity of that god, he could always get back what he lost in today’s encounter. Perhaps the god might even give more compensation.
Gods always needed mortals to complete certain tasks for them, so a good reputation was quite important.
However, Gu Nan just cast him a glance, then took the golden dagger and plunged it into his stomach.
"Don't think too much." He patted Prince Charlie's shoulder.
"Brother!"
"Your Highness Charlie!"
Cries of alarm came from behind. A golden light flashed across the scene, and corpses littered the ground.
"This dagger is the real thing." Gu Nan shook off the blood on the dagger and nodded.
"Why?" Sylvia had come up behind him.
"It's sharp when cutting dragons, not when cutting humans."
The corner of Sylvia's mouth twitched slightly. She gave Gu Nan a meaningful look. "If you do this, I'm afraid your reputation here will be all ruined, and no one will dare to work for you in the future."
To think that a god would slaughter the adventurers working for him. Once this matter spreads…
"It’s all right." Gu Nan smiled at her.
Sylvia, however, was serious, "Karina already knows you were here. Don't think that no one will know if you simply kill everyone!”
Gu Nan glanced at her, then raised the dagger in his hand high above his head and stared at the metal dragons on the horizon that had gradually gathered, lured here by Dragon Slayer.
"In the name of Her Highness Sylvia, die, Dvalin the blasphemer!"
A sudden shout echoed throughout Metallic Silver Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 413: Zhong Qinghe
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan’s group of three saw Zi Luo Elder and Rolensia again, they were already in a frontline plane.
It was a great coincidence that their destination was, once again, Heavenly Province World—of course, it might not actually be a coincidence, and Daoist Lingyang expressed his responsibility for this coincidence.
After they greeted each other, Zi Luo Elder suddenly raised his head.
"Mad Fist is here, it seems that this old man’s earlier show wasn’t in vain." The old man had a smile on his face, seemingly happy with the latest arrival.
Mad Fist referred to the Star Ruler of Martial Sect Realm.
Martial Sect Realm was an old, well-known astral world, and its Star Ruler was named "Mad Fist." It was said that this was his nickname in his early years. After he became a Star Ruler, he simply abandoned his real name and used Mad Fist as his name.
Martial Sect Realm was a very special astral world. Although it was only a Realm Level plane, its Star Ruler Mad Fist's combat power even surpassed that of many Star Rulers of Heaven Level planes.
Unfortunately, Mad Fist was too inattentive to the construction of his astral world, so that his astral world itself was dragging him down.
At the same time, Mad Fist was also one of the core members of the Heaven-God Alliance. He didn’t follow them over earlier, but now he most likely changed his mind.
"What did you say, old man? Didn't we agree to gather at this time? What, did you guys do something again?" After Mad Fist heard Zi Luo Elder's words, he actually looked surprised.
Gu Nan and Rolensia, who were meeting Mad Fist for the first time, couldn’t help being slightly taken aback at his appearance.
Could this person be a true martial arts fanatic, so much so that he didn’t even pay attention to the major events that transpired over the past two days?
"Alright, you can stop pretending." Xue Ren, who was familiar with him, came up and told Gu Nan and Rolensia, "This guy likes to pretend to be a martial arts fanatic, but his head is stuffed to the brim with schemes."
Mad Fist showed a coy smile. "Only those who wholeheartedly want to win are called martial arts fanatics. For the sake of victory, what's wrong with pretending to be a martial arts fanatic?"
"Makes sense." Gu Nan nodded at him.
"Right? Right?" Mad Fist seemed happy that someone else agreed with his view.
Rolensia remained silent, while Zi Luo Elder added, "Let's set off. Let’s leave early and return early."
He looked at Gu Nan and the other two. "After this old man's earlier strike, not many people will dare to openly attack your astral worlds now, but there will still be some small movement."
Now that the Heaven-God Alliance walked into the limelight and even injured Song Fei, they immediately scared the Star Rulers who wanted to beat a drowning dog into setting aside their petty schemes for now.
No one knew whether the Heaven-God Alliance might make a comeback after some time.
If there really was such a day, then today's pleasure may well become tomorrow's bane.
However, as Zi Luo Elder said, although fewer people dared to openly jump out, there would still be people making small moves in secret.
……
Qinghe Realm.
As the largest trade-oriented astral world in the Myriad Heavens, Qinghe Realm, under the leadership of its ruler Zhong Qinghe, had always developed faster than astral worlds of the same level.
After all, if done properly, the potential of commerce was far greater than that of agricultural civilizations, and trade was the best and only way to circulate resources.
On this day, Zhong Qinghe was finishing up one of the Commerce Association’s internal meetings when he was called by a vice president.
"My Lord, I made an appointment with your secretary last week. There are some matters I want to discuss with you,” the vice president said respectfully.
"Old Zhou, why are you still being so polite with me? Take a seat." Zhong Qinghe casually greeted the other party and sat down, acting like they were very close.
Old Zhou showed a grateful look. "Lord, do you still remember that Lu Xinhuan took the Eldest Miss to the World of Gods, and the two of them ended up disappearing together?"
Zhong Qinghe nodded. "Xinhuan has most likely been killed already, what a pity… Little Die’s life soul is still there, indicating that her life is safe, but her whereabouts are unknown."
"We found Eldest Miss," Old Zhou said at once.
Zhong Qinghe raised his head, the gaze he leveled at Old Zhou finally showing some surprise.
Old Zhou cleared his throat and reported, "Our forces in the Capital of Blood have been uprooted. But some of the traces left behind point to… Gu Nan."
"Gu Nan? Now that his astral world has been revealed to the world, you found Little Die inside?" Zhong Qinghe's expression remained unchanged.
"Your Excellency is wise," Old Zhou flattered Zhong Qinghe.
Zhong Qinghe had a calm smile on his face and said as if casually, "Then you guys can go bring her back."
Old Zhou stared blankly, then hurriedly said yes and left, but he failed to notice the strange smile on Zhong Qinghe’s face as he left.
……
Gu Nan and the others passed through the dimensional wall and entered the World of Gods very smoothly. They barely ran into any obstacles.
In reality, no one would try to stop them. Wasn’t it a little too stupid to try stopping a Unified Dao bigshot from returning to the World of Gods?
On the contrary, the moment Rolensia returned to the World of Gods, the original twelve greater gods sensed something at the same time, and a black-haired young girl in a long dress descended in front of them.
"Welcome back, Rolensia." The black-haired maiden seemed to want to give Rolensia a hug, only to be decisively ignored by the latter.
Xue Ren glanced at her and came over to Gu Nan's side. "Who is this one?"
"The incarnation of night, the Goddess of Darkness, Daisy," Gu Nan acted as the commentator and answered with little hesitation.
He knew many people suspected that he was from the World of Gods, and he had no intention of hiding this.
Let them guess. No one will guess the truth anyway.
The Goddess of Darkness Daisy, a top-tier god who ranked towards the front even among the twelve greater gods, personally came to welcome Rolensia’s return today.
In fact, Rolensia’s ascension was definitely a pleasant surprise for the Dark Faction.
Originally, seven of the twelve greater gods already belonged to their faction, and the Light Faction relied entirely on the might of the Ruler of Light and Justice to not fall into a disadvantage in wars.
Now that the Dark Faction had one more person, the situation in the World of Gods was about to change again.
Daisy and Rolensia’s conversation didn’t last long. Certain deeper-level matters wouldn’t be exchanged during an occasion like this.
After separating from Daisy, Rolensia brought Gu Nan and the others back to her Divine Kingdom.
Compared to the Myriad Heavens Universe, where danger lurked everywhere, staying inside an allied greater god’s Divine Kingdom was undoubtedly safe beyond measure.
"You're leaving?" Rolensia looked at Gu Nan with slight surprise. "Your Thirteen Heavens are able to influence some people on this side. It's dangerous for you to head out now."
Gu Nan, however, just revealed a small smile. "I know, but I really do have some matters to attend to."
Faced with Gu Nan's insistence, Rolensia finally nodded. "Sylvia said she wants to visit you sometime."
"I'll be back soon." Gu Nan thought for a moment and added, "As for Sylvia, you can tell her to wait for me in the Dragon Realm."
"Okay."
……
At the same time that his true body arrived in the World of Gods, Gu Nan's saint clone, who was hiding in a small plane, slowly opened his eyes.
"It’s time to start the plan for the player army."
"But before that," Gu Nan's gaze fell back to his own astral world, "there are still some small bugs to deal with."
There, Zhong Die was staring at the two men in black that appeared before her with a bewildered expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: Reward
chapters.content:
It was one of Gu Nan's habits to casually make stuff up. In fact, all experienced players had this habit.
Because there were so many hidden settings and Easter eggs in the game that the developers refused to reveal them all, players could only explore and discover them little by little.
And telling NPCs something beyond their understanding could very well trigger a special mechanism, leading to unexpected gains.
Of course, this was merely an offhanded attempt to discover some prize, so it didn’t matter if nothing ultimately came of it.
Gu Nan ignored the pensive Sylvia and stepped into the unsealed world.
In reality, the world below the valley of Metallic Silver Island didn’t have much going on, and it was even pitifully small for a world, only as big as a room.
Under normal circumstances, it was impossible for such a small world to exist. Not even pocket dimensions were this small.
But the truth was already in front of them—a clear crystal orb was before Gu Nan, shimmering with light.
If it wasn’t floating in the air, it wouldn’t appear to be anything special at all, but Sylvia realized the cause behind this strange phenomenon at a glance after she came down.
"The world… is in there?" She pointed at the orb incredulously, where an entire world could be seen inside.
"That's right. This is the crystallization of a Divine Kingdom’s consciousness." Gu Nan nodded earnestly, then… reached out and grabbed the orb, causing the light from the ground to dim instantly.
"Are you crazy?!" Sylvia was about to freak out. Gu Nan actually snatched such a precious item away, just like that? Anyone would have to carefully study it first, right?!
Gu Nan ignored her after taking the orb and began to reach out to his Divine Kingdom, trying to stuff it inside.
He didn't know what this orb was, but he knew exactly what it did.
In the game, the scientific name of this item was "Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb," which could be used to swallow and store a Divine Kingdom.
The biggest role of the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb was actually for players to capture, cultivate, and slaughter hostile Divine Kingdoms indefinitely. Gu Nan’s current plan to store his own Divine Kingdom in it wasn’t a very conventional usage of this item.
Normally, nobody would possibly want to do this, because after the Divine Kingdom was placed into the orb, it would no longer provide the owner with any astral world buffs, which was equivalent to breaking both the player’s arms.
What's more, Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was located in the Myriad Heavens Universe. Barely managing to communicate with it wasn’t a problem, but whether it could be placed in the orb was an entirely different matter.
Under Sylvia's watchful eye, fine beads of sweat gradually coated Gu Nan's forehead, but he finally sighed helplessly.
He managed to establish a connection with his Divine Kingdom several times after great difficulty, but the connection was instantly severed whenever he tried to stuff the Divine Kingdom into the orb.
‘Looks like it won't work. I can only try again after I return to the Myriad Heavens.’ Gu Nan shook his head. In the end, he could only put the orb away.
Fortunately, this was within his expectations, so he wasn’t very disappointed. Anyhow, he only came here to try it out. His operation in the World of Gods had to wait until the “player army” seedlings were sent over first.
……
The Myriad Heavens Universe.
"My Lord, the space-time crystals are ready," Old Zhou drove everyone out, then spoke to the air with trepidation.
In front of him was a large box of space-time crystals. Qinghe Realm really did handle matters efficiently.
"Not bad." The saint clone emerged and nodded in satisfaction.
Old Zhou saw Gu Nan put away the space-time crystals one by one and tried to muster up the courage to say, "Your Excellency, Miss Zhong Die is after all the daughter of my realm’s ruler. If you are interested in accepting her as a subordinate, why don't you—"
"I’ll find you again the next time I need you." Gu Nan finished counting the crystals—enough to satisfy his request—and patted Old Zhou's shoulder.
After saying this, the saint clone disappeared instantly. As for Zhong Die's matter, that wasn’t on his mind at all.
Whether Zhong Qinghe wanted to leave her alone or find someone to take her away, Gu Nan didn't really care.
The true player army was bound to consist of apostles under his absolute control, and Zhong Die wasn’t yet qualified to enter those ranks—if not for the fact that he was no longer hiding his Divine Kingdom, she wouldn’t even be qualified to enter his Divine Kingdom.
……
Within the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes, a hint of satisfaction flashing through his eyes.
The space-time crystals were ready. Now he just had to wait for that batch of seedlings to be shipped over so that he could set those people on player routes, one after another.
Sylvia was currently sitting across from Gu Nan, fixing him with a furious glare.
"Where is that orb?" Sylvia asked, glaring at Gu Nan.
"Something the matter?" Gu Nan raised a brow.
Sylvia said hatefully, "I asked my brother. It's impossible for a Divine Kingdom to produce a consciousness, and it's even more impossible for greater gods than normal gods!"
At a greater god’s level, there was actually the intention of breaking away from their Divine Kingdom and consolidating their power in themselves.
In the words of the Myriad Heavens, the cultivator merges with a great Dao, and from then on, they themself will be the incarnation of that law, so their astral world will not be as important as before.
So Gu Nan’s previous set of statements was also bullying Sylvia for her lack of understanding of greater gods, while it was impossible for her older brother Austin to be fooled by such lies.
"Oh. Anything else the matter?" Although Gu Nan’s lie was exposed to his face, he didn’t have much of a response.
So the scene descended into silence. Sylvia didn’t speak, and Gu Nan also didn’t continue the conversation.
"In fact, Sylvia came over this time to request your help on a matter," a voice eventually rang out from beside the two as Daoist Lingyang’s figure slowly appeared.
This Daoist was all smiles and looked very good-natured.
Daoist Lingyang was considered half a resident of the World of Gods and was quite familiar with the situation over here. He happened to be on this side when Gu Nan joined the Heaven-God Alliance earlier.
His words weren’t out of Gu Nan's expectations. While Sylvia was certainly a relatively idle god, it wasn’t like she didn't have anything to do.
Of course she didn’t visit Gu Nan just to follow him around Dragon Realm for a stroll. She must have some other intention as well.
It's just that there were so many unexpected events along the way that she didn't even have time to speak up.
"It's a duel regarding laws," after Daoist Lingyang laid the foundation, Sylvia finally felt it less awkward to speak up.
"I will represent ‘Shadow’ in the battle, but… my opponent might be very strong, so I would like you to take my place."
A trace of realization flashed through Gu Nan's eyes, and he seemed to understand what Sylvia was about to be involved in. That event was also a famous event in the game.
"Since we’re all part of the same organization, helping out is certainly no problem," Gu Nan agreed readily. "As for the reward…"
He turned to Daoist Lingyang. "I have a batch of people I want to transport to this side. Can your people help out?"
Daoist Lingyang accepted with a smile, "Of course, that’s a trivial matter."
"Hey! You still want another reward?" Sylvia, who had been screwed over several times already by Gu Nan, was immediately dissatisfied. "I've already taken the blame for you."
Gu Nan glanced at her, then thought about it and replied, "That blame is something I pinned on your head, so it doesn’t count as you helping me."

chapters.title: Chapter 415: Shadow Cult Event
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Shadow Cult Event
It really wasn't too much of a hassle for Daoist Lingyang's Clear Profundity Realm to send a group of people to the World of Gods, especially if Gu Nan already prepared the space-time crystals in advance.
But when players complete missions, they always try to take as much advantage as possible without any regard to losing face.
Sylvia left unhappily, and after Daoist Lingyang asked about the people Gu Nan wanted to send and agreed on a meeting place, his figure also quickly disappeared.
Gu Nan looked at his departing back and pondered.
The purpose behind the existence of an organization like the Heaven-God Alliance, which straddled two worlds, was multifaceted by its very nature.
For people like Xue Ren and Rolensia, what they wanted was an unhindered path to Unified Dao in the other world, but for those like Daoist Lingyang and Sylvia, it was still a little too early to consider that.
The world was full of Star Rulers and gods who indulged in carnal pleasures—if not, how could there be so many illegitimate children of gods?
Daoist Lingyang didn't look like someone addicted to pleasure, but he frequently visited the World of Gods, as if he was managing something on this side.
Then Gu Nan shook his head again. Daoist Lingyang's plans were none of his business.
The more important matter right now was still the event that Sylvia came to him about.
The events in the Evil God game were set up in a very interesting way, and the vast majority of them had rogue-like characteristics. Every new cycle in the game, the same events would happen at slightly different times, and even the details would be a little different.
Only the main content of the event would be the same, which made events more unpredictable and gave the players more entertainment—of course, now Gu Nan would prefer not to have such entertainment.
Gu Nan knew what Sylvia needed his help with even before she explained.
The Shadow Cult.
In the World of Gods, there was a cult that existed throughout many planes and even had believers in all the main planes. This was the Shadow Cult.
The Shadow Cult was a relatively special cult because it didn't belong to a particular god, but was a sect formed by an alliance of three gods.
The Goddess of Shadows Sylvia, the God of Thieves Sirius, and the Sage of Deadwood Aiden—these three were the founders of Shadow Cult, which was mainly made up of their followers.
The three joined forces to protect this sect and also obtained faith from the sect, which was one of the better methods for weak gods to harvest faith.
After all, it was unlikely that any single one of the three would be able to develop the cult to this extent on their own.
But at some point in time, Shadow Cult will face the attack of another sect, or rather, face the challenge of a powerful god.
...
When Sylvia dropped by Gu Nan's residence once again, she also brought information on a certain god.
"Shadow Sword Saint Chamberlain, he's our opponent this time," Sylvia pointed to the information on the paper and said with a slightly grave expression.
Gu Nan wasn't surprised. No matter how Shadow Cult's crisis changed, the final boss was always the same Chamberlain.
The conflict between the two sides was also very simple: it was a fight over faith.
The "Shadow" in Shadow Cult was the common point of the three gods' laws, but unfortunately, the origin law of the Shadow Sword Saint was also "Shadow."
In such a situation, a portion of Chamberlain's followers was naturally divided up by Shadow Cult, so of course the Sword Saint was unwilling.
This wasn't because Sylvia and her two allies wanted to take advantage of him. Rather, Chamberlain didn't even exist back when they founded Shadow Cult.
The Shadow Sword Saint was a god who rose abruptly only in the last 10,000 years, and in just a short few thousand years, his strength had already progressed to Tier 8. He could be described as a natural-born genius.
It was only after he gained a grasp of his own power that he began to take on Shadow Cult, bullying this joint sect of one Tier 6 and two Tier 7 gods.
Of course, he didn't want to completely break up Shadow Cult.
This was an alliance of three old, well-known gods. Although none of them were too strong, they had many friends, so they didn't fear a full-scale war against anyone.
Chamberlain's goal this time was merely to force Shadow Cult to change its name, so that it wouldn't take away the believers who should've gone to him.
He proposed a fair fight between himself and the three gods behind Shadow Cult, and the winner would win the right to use "Shadow" in their name.
"Chamberlain, huh… He knows which lines shouldn't be crossed," Gu Nan commented. If Mr. Sword Saint dared to brute force this matter, then there were plenty of people willing to stand up for Sylvia to suck up to the Greater God of Light.
On the contrary, if he kept the situation purely to a dispute of faith, then Sylvia and co's friends wouldn't have a good reason to intervene.
Of course they could find outside help if it concerned their sect's continued existence, but if they needed external help even for something like a fight over faith, then the loss of believers would be very serious.
"But if the sect were to change its name, the loss of faith would be just as serious," Sylvia sounded a bit distressed. This was their current predicament.
Of course changing the name of a sect that had been operating for tens of thousands of years would cause a loss of believers, and getting help from an outsider would actually result in a similar outcome.
"Then how can I help you?" Gu Nan thought for a moment and asked.
"Fight in my place. Anyhow, we both use the law of shadows, and Chamberlain has never seen me before, so there's no reason he'd recognize me."
"I may not fight with just shadows. What if he recognizes that?"
"Then I'll tell him you're a new member of Shadow Cult!" Sylvia had obviously thought of a way out long ago, "Even if you genuinely want to join, I'm sure the other two won't refuse."
Gu Nan couldn't help smiling. Who said Sylvia was simpleminded? She wasn't slow at all when it involved her own benefits.
To join Shadow Cult, either in name or in substance—this was also the solution in the game.
As long as the player's law was related to shadows and the player was sufficiently acquainted with one of the three founding gods, it was possible to trigger the "Shadow Cult" event.
The player can intervene by temporarily joining Shadow Cult as a god, and it's up to the player to choose whether to stay or quit after the event ends.
"I got it." Gu Nan nodded. "When and where is the sword fight?"
The phrase "sword fight" made the corner of Sylvia's mouth twitch slightly, but she eventually told Gu Nan the information, then quickly excused herself and went back to communicate with the other two gods.
After, adding a new god to the sect wasn't a trivial matter.
Of course, Gu Nan wouldn't be very interested in faith. The reason he wanted to participate in this matter was actually because of Chamberlain himself.
This just happened to match what Gu Nan planned to do next. If he wanted to create a player army, then cracking down on Chamberlain was inevitable.
Because only when the player participates in the Shadow Cult Event and successfully defeats Chamberlain will the Shadow Sword Saint learn from this painful experience and honor his promise to give up the name "Shadow," changing his name to "Phantom Sword Saint."
And only then will the hidden class "Phantom Sword Saint" unlock for players.
So Gu Nan paused for a moment and said, "I'll go with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 416: Another Shadow User
chapters.content:
The Phantom Sword Saint was a very powerful class, but it was also a very hard class to acquire.
First of all, this was a class that players could change to even after completing the First Round—the game’s equivalent of gods, who were at least Tier 6—so it was undoubtedly a powerful class.
In other words, this class had a very high upper limit and could be used until the Second Round, after which the player would have to return to the Evil God route.
The second reason was because the player participated in the Shadow Cult Event, which was the same as directly dropping Chamberlain’s favorability into the negatives, so one could only imagine the difficulty of trying to learn from him again after that.
And because Chamberlain was the founder of this route, killing him wouldn’t give the player any sort of inheritance.
There were some crazy completionist players who, in order to experience the power of the "Phantom Sword Saint" route, even used self-destructive methods.
After they defeated Chamberlain, they decisively chose to destroy their own Evil God physique, then respawned in the Evil God Temple, eventually changing their entire appearance to obtain the Phantom Sword Saint class.
Gu Nan himself also experienced this event, but he wasn’t deranged to the point of destroying his own avatar. After several failed attempts to change his class to Phantom Sword Saint, he decisively gave up.
However, it was much easier now. He just needed to pull in some people from the Myriad Heavens and have them select that class.
But what Gu Nan didn't expect was for certain actions of his to cause the event to somewhat exceed his expectations.
……
Two figures slowly appeared in Sylvia's Shadows Divine Kingdom.
One was a very thin and somewhat hunchbacked old man. This was Aiden, the Sage of Deadwood.
Legend has it that Aiden was originally from the Shepherd Tree clan and was the only god among the Shepherd Tree people, only he became a god because he awakened to extremely special laws after being abandoned by his clan.
The other newcomer was tall and handsome. His every move seemed gentle and polite, like a model gentleman.
It was very hard to imagine that this would be the legendary God of Thieves, the complete opposite of the "shifty-eyed thief" image that people often thought of.
"The one that seems the most unlikely to commit crimes is often the real criminal." Gu Nan knew this very well, because the three great gods of crime all had the same image discrepancy.
After the two arrived, they didn’t rush to greet Sylvia, instead studying Gu Nan first.
"Welcome, my friends." Sylvia led the two into the castle and took the lead in introducing Gu Nan beside her, "This is Mr. Gu Nan, from the… Myriad Heavens Universe."
"So that’s it." A smile of understanding appeared on the Deadwood Sage’s withered face. "It is a bit strange that nobody has ever heard of another wielder of shadows."
When Sylvia asked the two to come, she naturally told them the reason for the meeting.
Aiden was explaining the two’s earlier actions, and Gu Nan nodded slightly without saying anything else.
The God of Thieves Sirius said, "Your Excellency Gu Nan, will you replace Sylvia in the battle? Since Your Excellency doesn't mind joining Shadow Cult, why don't you participate in this matter as yourself?"
Chamberlain's reputation was so great that both Aiden and Sirius were actually somewhat uncertain about their chances of victory.
After all, none of the three had laws suited for direct combat, while their opponent was the exact opposite—the epithet of Sword Saint was originally earned by piling up mountains of corpses and seas of blood.
If Gu Nan participated using his own identity, it would be the same as having four people simultaneously fight their opponent, so the chances of winning would be a bit greater that way.
"Actually… it won’t make much of a difference," Gu Nan considered for a moment and replied.
Sylvia's face instantly darkened again. After Gu Nan noticed this, he turned his head again and very seriously explained, "Don’t misunderstand—I wasn’t targeting you specifically."
"......"
"Ahem." The Deadwood Sage coughed lightly to ease the awkwardness a little. "Mr. Gu Nan is very confident, so… will you let us see for ourselves?"
Be it substituting for Sylvia or simply joining Shadow Cult, testing Gu Nan's strength was inevitable. This was the main purpose behind the two’s visit.
If Gu Nan were to join Shadow Cult, his strength would determine the internal distribution of benefits.
"Sure thing." Gu Nan smiled, the shadows under his feet already starting to converge. "Which one of you will go first?"
The God of Thieves and the Deadwood Sage exchanged a glance. Since it was just a test, it was actually enough for one person to go, so who went first was completely irrelevant.
Thus, the Deadwood Sage gently waved his hand, and among the crevices of Sylvia's castle, withered branches gradually sprang up and swiftly crawled towards Gu Nan.
These withered branches were scorched black, as if they had been burned by fire, yet they exuded ample vitality, looking incomparably eerie.
In the blink of an eye, the withered branches had curled and twisted themselves into a huge deadwood giant, which swung a fist down at Gu Nan.
Normally, Gu Nan would simply let the giant smash into him without even blinking, but this time, he used the power of shadows.
The shadows beneath Gu Nan's feet suddenly rose, turning into countless tentacles that rushed towards the deadwood giant. They drilled into the giant's body, weaving between gaps in the withered wood.
The next moment, the entire deadwood giant was instantly dismantled, a shadow attached to each withered branch.
The smile on Aiden’s face stiffened. He continuously activated his divine power but couldn’t influence the withered branches in the slightest. He knew what this meant.
Utter defeat.
……
Chamberlain was a very cautious person.
Despite having extreme confidence in his ability to suppress his opponents, even in a one-on-three fight, he didn’t stop collecting information about the three enemies for even a second.
There was a lot of news about the God of Thieves and the Sage of Deadwood, but contrary to expectations, there was very little news about Sylvia. This mysterious goddess’s trail was rarely discovered by people.
But this time, news about Sylvia spread everywhere.
Many people already identified Sylvia as the perpetrator of the tragedy on Dragon Realm’s Metallic Silver Island. After all, she did appear there once.
But Chamberlain didn’t believe that—because he was also a well-traveled person and had many friends, the majority of whom were battle maniacs like himself, such as Karina.
"You’re saying there’s an unfamiliar god by Sylvia’s side?" Chamberlain asked contemplatively as he stroked the stubble beard on his chin.
"It's an unfamiliar god with a very hard fist!" Karina emphasized this while rubbing the back of her head, which was still a little sore. "And I can tell that his fundamental law is shadows."
That was what perplexed the two of them the most—that there was another god whose law was shadows whom they’ve never even heard of.
"Sylvia appeared together with a strange god at a time like this. It looks like there will be more twists and turns if I want to claim the name of ‘Shadow’." Chamberlain couldn't help but sigh.
"You mean that person will help during the fight?" Karina revealed a look of surprise. "Great!"

chapters.title: Chapter 417: Homecoming And Black Cards
chapters.content:
The Myriad Heavens Universe.
Inside a frontline plane, several youths were slowly walking onto a starship in a neat formation, and standing in front of them was none other than Lan Si.
"Lord Lan Si, all arrangements have been finished on that side. A guide will take you to Lord Gu Nan as soon as you reach the World of Gods," a Daoist informed Lan Si with a smile from next to her.
"Which plane is he in?" Lan Si nodded.
"The Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom."
……
On the starship, Lan Si gazed at the scenery slowly sailing by on both sides, lost in thought for a while.
Gu Nan planned to transport a group of seedlings to the World of Gods, and as one of the Divine Kingdom’s administrators, Lan Si was bound to be the one leading that group.
Because these seedlings either grew up in the Divine Kingdom or were gathered from outside, Lan Si and Yan Xiaoxiao initially managed them.
So only the two of them had enough prestige among these people to lead them.
There were a total of nine seedlings heading to the World of Gods this time. Every single one was the elite of the elite, and every single one walked to their positions by stepping over piles of corpses and bones. How could ordinary people control them?
And Yan Xiaoxiao was connected to the Divine Kingdom’s origin. As she continued her cultivation all these years… In Lan Si’s words, Yan Xiaoxiao seemed more and more inhuman.
In short, the only one who could run out to lead the team was her. But initially, Lan Si didn’t know that she was actually heading to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom.
That… was her hometown, the place where she grew up.
Many years had passed, and she’d long since stopped being the ignorant young girl from back then. She was afraid the number of people who died at her hands even exceeded the number of people she’d seen in the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom.
"Lord Lan Si." Liang Ruxin appeared beside Lan Si. When he saw her slightly melancholy profile, he thought his eyes were playing tricks on him.
Lan Si turned back, all traces of emotion vanishing from her face. She just said calmly, "Of the nine of you, you have the greatest potential, and your origins are also clear. When you reach His Lordship’s side, you must perform well."
After saying this, she gave Liang Ruxin another meaningful look. "I believe you are a smart person."
"Of course." Liang Ruxin revealed a faint smile. "These days, the sentence I hear the most from people around me is that that one's existence is supreme and cannot be opposed."
Lan Si nodded and was about to respond when Liang Ruxin continued, "But I feel that there will always be existences as supreme as that one in this world.”
As he said this, Liang Ruxin watched Lan Si’s expression closely. This might be his only chance to learn more about that one before meeting him.
To Liang Ruxin's surprise, Lan Si didn’t show any anger or annoyance from the offense. She only had a mocking smile.
