"If you are an ambitious person, then following that Lord is the best choice for you."
……
When Lan Si led her group to meet Gu Nan, he was sitting with one leg crossed over the other, with no image to speak of whatsoever. In his hands were cards full of decorative patterns.
And sitting across from him was Sylvia. At this time, she seemed to be scratching her cheeks out of frustration. She also held some patterned cards in her hands, but they were few in number.
What they played was called Black Cards, a card game that was quite popular within the World of Gods. It was used to simulate Divine Kingdom Wars.
This card game was also quite popular among players and later even had a dedicated game server just for that, independent from the Evil God game.
Not many gods liked to play cards, but Sylvia, a god with a lot of free time, just happened to be one of them and just happened to run into a bored Gu Nan, so they started a card fight on the spot. In any case, there was still a lot of time until the duel.
The result, of course, was that the Shadow Goddess lost ten out of ten rounds and didn’t even manage to force out any of Gu Nan's trump cards.
Knowing that she was about to lose this round as well, Sylvia jumped at the chance to leave after seeing Lan Si bring people over. Regardless of whether she recognized them or not, she flung her cards away and got up. "You have guests, so I'll leave now!"
After saying this, her figure disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye. Not even Gu Nan could catch her this time—after all, she was still the Goddess of Shadows, so she was quite skilled at running away.
Gu Nan’s gaze revealed a trace of mockery. He picked up the cards she dropped and placed them outside the field, then restored the field she just messed up to its original state… so that she can get ready for her eleventh consecutive loss on her next visit.
Then Gu Nan thought about it and took a passing glance at Sylvia’s cards.
Liang Ruixin trailed behind Lan Si, his eyes lowered.
He never judged people by their appearances and had also seen many ambitious and formidable characters who acted unrestrained, so he certainly wouldn’t underestimate the one in front of him just because of some trifling matters.
"My Lord, it’s these nine," Lan Si said meticulously, as if she didn’t see anything just now.
"Good." Gu Nan also put the cards down and nodded. "It's not easy to come back here. Have you seen Rolensia yet?"
Lan Si was slightly taken aback. She thought Gu Nan would skirt around this topic, but who would’ve thought…
But then she shook her head with a bit of helplessness in her eyes. "That one… probably doesn't remember me anymore, or rather, she probably never even knew me."
Rolensia was already a powerful Tier 10 god when Lan Si first left, and how many apostles were there in her Divine Kingdom?
Not to mention the fact that Lan Si and her sibling weren’t even considered apostles back then. At most, they could only be considered Rolensia’s fanatics, so of course the god wouldn’t remember them by name.
They originally ran to the Myriad Heavens for the sake of the most basic water attribute Godhead. It may have seemed very powerful at that time, but in reality, in Rolensia’s eyes, it wasn’t something worth her time at all.
If she really wanted a Godhead, she could simply kill an enemy god.
So back then, the one who assigned this mission to Lan Si and her brother was Rolensia’s apostle, who might even be weaker than the current Lan Si.
"Still, you should go back for a stroll. Maybe you can trigger some event… Mm, maybe you can meet some acquaintances." Gu Nan beamed at her.
Lan Si’s heart shook slightly, but she still nodded. "Yes."
Only after Lan Si left did Gu Nan look at the nine people who she brought over. "You’ve all been sent on missions to smaller planes before, right? What I need you to do in the future is the same thing."
After a pause, Gu Nan added, "Work for me and complete the missions I give you, and as reward, you will receive… power."
After a moment of silence from the nine, one of them finally spoke up. He looked like a young teen. "Do we have the right to refuse?"
"Of course," Gu Nan answered graciously. "But that would upset me, and when I'm upset, I will kill the person who upset me."
The teenager fell silent, and a young girl next to him couldn't help sneering, "Isn’t that the same as not having the right to refuse?"
"Not at all." Gu Nan corrected earnestly, "You have the right to refuse, and I also have the power to kill you. I respect your right, and you also have to respect my power. That's always the truth of this world."

chapters.title: Chapter 418: Weakness
chapters.content:
Of the nine people who were brought over, this pair of teen girl and boy were the youngest and also the most talented.
Young people, after all, had the characteristics of youths. They weren’t calm and calculating like the others, who never even spoke up.
To reward their courage, Gu Nan was willing to teach them some life lessons.
The teenager thought for a long time and finally looked at Gu Nan. "If I can beat you one day, will you let me go?"
"If you can beat me, then it's not whether I let you go or not, but the other way around."
The youth nodded thoughtfully, then flung his sleeves fiercely without any of the earlier inexperienced air and declared like a bandit, "I, your father, will do this thing!"
"What's your name and what did you do originally?" Gu Nan looked at him.
"An Tiansheng, bandit."
……
An Tiansheng the bandit was fourteen years old, a fact that Gu Nan just learned.
But he didn’t mind using child labor. As long as they could finish the tasks he assigned, he even dared to use four year olds.
At this time, the nine people were no longer in front of Gu Nan. Rather, they all remained inside a room, swiftly browsing through a pile of documents.
These were documents Gu Nan recently sorted out and contained information on player routes.
Routes were very important things. Instead of having Gu Nan get to know them one by one, it would be better to let them make their own choices first.
For the sake of secrecy, from the time they entered the room, they weren’t allowed to leave until they selected the route they wanted to take.
And after choosing a route, they had to explain their own specialties, as well as the reasons for picking this route. After Gu Nan looked over their choice, only then would he direct them on the path to acquiring that class.
To Gu Nan's slight surprise, the first person to come out was not An Tiansheng, but the young girl.
"I'm Xie Yun, sir," perhaps Gu Nan's earlier words had an effect, because the young Xie Yun had a significantly better attitude, and her voice sounded crisp.
"Your chosen route is?"
"Firearms Specialist."
Gu Nan couldn’t help smiling as he accepted the documents from Xie Yun. "This is not a class a normal person would choose."
Firearms Specialist was a very interesting class that could project firearms using energy. It was purely suppression through modern weaponry.
However, this also meant that this route didn’t have a very high upper limit. It was useful only from around Tier 3 to Tier 6.
It could barely work in Tier 7, but any higher, and the abilities from a Firearms Specialist would be essentially useless, and the player would only be able to use their Evil God physique and their original laws in fights.
And since the people Gu Nan chose didn’t have the Evil God Temple, that meant the Firearms Specialist route Xie Yun chose would at most have a combat power of low Tier 7.
Unless she changed her class later on and started all over again.
Of course, this was already a completely acceptable outcome for Xie Yun if her combat power could reach Tier 7. Not everyone wanted to head straight for Unified Dao.
"Have you ever seen a gun?" Gu Nan thought about it and asked.
"Of course." Xie Yun nodded. "I once went to a technological plane with very advanced weapon development!"
Xie Yun's eyes lit up as she talked. Gu Nan could already imagine what it was like for a young girl who grew up in a metaphysical plane to witness modern weapons for the first time in her life.
For lower level fights, modern weapons were indeed practical and cool, but they wouldn’t work in slightly higher levels.
For example, with the strength of Gu Nan's current body, he could tank a nuclear explosion without any problem. Be it the heat, shockwave, or radiation, it was impossible to hurt him.
"Then let's try it," Gu Nan said as such, writing down some information and handing it to Xie Yun.
……
When the day of Shadow Cult's duel with Chamberlain arrived, all nine people that Lan Si brought over had been dispatched.
They went to their respective destinations to attempt the class change quests and acquire the class they wanted.
No one picked the Phantom Sword Saint route so far, but Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry. It would be pretty good if half of the nine successfully completed the class change.
Player routes weren’t that easy to walk. Even normal players had a small chance of failing, let alone these NPCs with no game experience and average strength.
"Hey, it's time to go!" Sylvia had already gotten familiar with Gu Nan, so she didn’t look polite at all. "I hope you’re not defeated by a single strike from Chamberlain."
"My strength is as reliable as my card skills." Gu Nan said with a smirk, "If it goes well, you will welcome your 50th consecutive defeat this afternoon."
"You have no chivalry whatsoever! You’ll never be favored by a lady,” Sylvia bristled and grumbled.
The gods' dueling locations were also very special. To not affect mortals—mainly to preserve their reputations—they usually picked deserted planes to fight in.
This time was no different. Sirius and Aiden were already waiting when Gu Nan arrived.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan, I received a message just now." The extraordinarily handsome God of Thieves said, "Chamberlain might have a helper as well."
Sylvia frowned. "Is the helper he found qualified to intervene in this battle of ours?"
If any random person could intervene, then Sylvia would have way too many people to choose from and wouldn’t have to rely on the annoying Gu Nan.
"Sylvia!" A slightly gruff female voice came from the horizon, immediately making Sylvia go pale.
The Valkyrie holding a golden spear instantly descended, and the spear came straight at Gu Nan.
Gu Nan didn't even raise his head and casually blocked with his hand. The golden spear struck his palm but didn't even leave a mark.
"Karina, this is a fight between our Shadow Cult and Chamberlain. Are you sure you want to interfere?" Sylvia's voice was slightly cold. If Karina intervened in this matter, then they would truly become enemies.
"I'm just here for this guy!" Karina wasn’t stupid either. She pointed her spear at Gu Nan. "He beat me up once. Am I not allowed to take revenge?"
Sylvia couldn't help feeling enraged. "What's the difference between picking now of all times to seek revenge and helping Chamberlain?!"
Next to them, Aiden and Sirius had wry smiles.
They weren’t like Sylvia, who had a powerful older brother. Based on their past experience with Karina, this one wouldn’t listen to any attempt to reason.
Sure enough, Karina’s next words were, "I don't care!"
As soon as those words fell, she didn’t give Sylvia the opportunity to respond before thrusting her spear towards Gu Nan.
The golden spear shone with an astonishing radiance. Clearly, Karina already strengthened it with her own laws, quite unlike the casual jab just now.
Everyone's gazes landed on Gu Nan, wanting to see how he would respond. However… Gu Nan did not respond.
The spear pierced Gu Nan's chest unhindered, punching through his back and leaving a gruesome bloody hole.
Sylvia's eyes widened, and even Karina herself didn’t expect for the opponent who once knocked her out to be so weak.
But she realized something was wrong the next second.
Gu Nan, whose chest was clearly impaled, gave a strange smile, while she was actually unable to pull her spear out. It seemed to be stuck inside her opponent.
After the spear entered the enemy’s body, her laws were briefly suppressed, while Gu Nan raised one hand and grabbed the spear's shaft.
"Let me teach you all a lesson today." Gu Nan's voice remained calm as usual, making Sylvia feel slightly more at ease. "The Wrestling Goddess also has a weakness."
"What weakness!?" Karina asked before anyone else. She felt that she had already achieved the limit for her level. Her divine body was close to perfect, so it would be hard to improve on it anymore.
Her divine body was indeed perfect. Even Gu Nan had a hard time finding a way to kill her, but it was only a perfect divine body.
"Your attack is too low!" Gu Nan said rudely, "If not, why would you need to find the God of Blacksmiths just to forge this divine spear?"
As Gu Nan said this, he pointed at the golden spear that pierced his body and was currently gripped in one hand.
While Karina was still staring blankly, Gu Nan had already raised his other hand and slammed it down on the spear shaft with great force.
The divine spear, which accompanied Karina for tens of thousands of years, responded by breaking in half.

chapters.title: Chapter 419: Shadow Sword Saint
chapters.content:
This was the scene Chamberlain saw when he arrived.
Karina was staring blankly at the broken spear in her hand while Gu Nan casually pulled out the other half of the divine spear from his chest and threw it to the ground.
"Chamberlain is here, so let's get started." Gu Nan looked like he didn't put Karina in his eyes at all.
Karina punched him in annoyance, but Gu Nan didn't even bother dodging, letting her hit his shoulder, and then… and then nothing.
Players can always find the weakness of any NPC, even if it's Karina, the hidden protagonist of the next godly world war.
After all, even the players' Evil God physiques were bound to have development directions depending on the skills players chose before their First Round.
For example, Gu Nan’s focus was on speed and regeneration, so his attack and defense were just average among players.
And Karina was known as the Wrestling Goddess, but in fact, her laws should be related to defense, providing her with amazing resistance against all sorts of laws. Even Gu Nan found it hard to wound her, let alone kill her.
But on the flip side, she was nowhere near Gu Nan's level in either speed or attack power.
With the divine spear that provided most of her attack power damaged, she lost her best means of fighting the enemy.
"Karina, you should not interfere in this matter anymore," Chamberlain obviously also saw this and said with a serious expression.
After all, Karina only had an excuse to attack Gu Nan, but Gu Nan could ignore her attacks.
Of course, she could still hold him back slightly if she kept on pestering him, but then the scene would be too ugly, as if this Valkyrie was just throwing a tantrum.
Perhaps the goddess herself wouldn’t care about her image, but Chamberlain didn’t intend to do that.
He wasn’t a sinister villain and originally only wanted to fight for the name of "Shadow" that should belong to him. He didn’t want to start a blood feud with the three gods.
So Karina resentfully stepped aside, while Gu Nan and the two other gods stepped up on Shadow Cult’s side—because Chamberlain abided by the rules, they decided to not attack him with four people.
"After this battle, there will only be one party using the name of 'Shadow' in this world." Chamberlain slowly unsheathed his longsword from his waist. "If this humble one loses, I will change my name to 'Phantom’."
The Shadow Sword Saint was indeed an open and honest person. He didn’t use his superior strength to repeatedly challenge Shadow Cult over and over again.
He still behaved honorably, even if Sylvia had found Gu Nan—an outside helper—for this duel.
So this time, Sylvia became a little embarrassed and took the initiative to speak, "Actually—"
"You shut up." Gu Nan quickly interrupted, "The Light Faction really is indecisive. If we’re gonna fight, then let’s fight now."
Chamberlain and Sylvia both belonged to the Light Faction, and only they would engage in this kind of humble back-and-forth on a major matter like a fight over faith.
Just look at the Dark Faction’s Sirius and Aiden—one was one of the three great gods of crime and the other was a fallen Shepherd Tree clan member. Did they have an ounce of humility right now?
Both had extremely wicked grins.
Sylvia had a lot to say but was blocked by Gu Nan’s "Shut up," so she could only shoot him a vicious glare.
Chamberlain wasn’t affected at all. The longsword in his hand was already heading straight for the God of Thieves.
The Shadow Sword Saint's tactical intent was very clear. He wanted to first destroy the weakest link called Sirius, then free up his hands to deal with the remaining two.
Fights where the opponents outnumbered you more or less always had two strategies—either destroy the weakest first or the strongest first.
Gu Nan proved that he wasn’t a very easy target to exterminate, so Sirius became the best target.
Sirius and Aiden both reacted extremely fast. In fact, the two of them had a good relationship, having fought together many times before.
Without another word, the tall and handsome God of Thieves suddenly disappeared from the air, while the countless withered branches from the Sage of Deadwood slammed into Chamberlain's sword.
Swordsmanship in the World of Gods was very different from the sword Dao over in the Myriad Heavens.
There was no such thing as sword intent or sword heart here; there was only the ultimate speed!
Chamberlain's longsword was as fast as lightning, leaving streaks of afterimages in the air. As soon as the Deadwood Sage struck, six figures appeared around Aiden.
He created a diversion to strike his true target!
The aged Aiden glared, trying to mobilize the withered branches again, but it was too late. Thus, his entire body quickly swelled up, his skin blackening inch by inch, quickly transforming into deadwood.
This Tier 7 god already brought out his true form in just one exchange. One could see just how much pressure the Shadow Sword Saint gave him.
The six shadowy afterimages that surrounded him were none other than Chamberlain's famous sword art. All six shadows were real, and each one could inflict astonishing damage.
However, just as the six shadows swung their swords, a fist came down from the sky and hit one of them.
The six shadows froze simultaneously, then changed their sword paths in unison and came straight at the Gu Nan who just appeared.
Gu Nan didn’t even look at them, allowing the six swords to pierce his body, while his fist hit the enemy as usual.
Thus, the other five shadows disappeared at the same time, leaving only the one in front of Gu Nan. It was none other than Chamberlain himself, who had blood dripping out of the corner of his mouth.
Not even a Tier 8 god could shrug off a direct hit from Gu Nan’s fist. After all, not everyone was as abnormal as Karina.
"You seem to know me well?" Chamberlain didn’t seem to care about his own injuries, instead staring at Gu Nan strangely.
His Transforming Shadow Sword Technique had been famous for many years, but those who truly knew its essence could be counted on one hand. As far as he knew, Gu Nan was obviously not included in that group.
"Every one of them is real, but there’s always one that’s more real, right?" Gu Nan revealed an odd smile, then exposed the secret behind this sword technique in one sentence.
These were Chamberlain’s exact words, but only after he became the Phantom Sword Saint, so Gu Nan was borrowing them in advance.
On the other hand, the fact that he was able to find Chamberlain’s true body actually had very little to do with his ability to see through reality or illusions—he simply took a chance and bet on luck. In any case, at least one of the six was real, but he didn’t expect to hit the jackpot on the first try.
If the first one wasn’t right, then he would decisively attack the next shadow. As for Aiden's life or death, that was none of his concern.
But Chamberlain didn’t know this. His gaze turned slightly grave. In his eyes, Gu Nan became even more mysterious.
He didn’t want to take another punch, so he decisively gave up the Transforming Shadow Sword Technique, and his body began to change into a shadow, swimming through the cracks in space.
The next instant, the tip of his sword emerged abruptly and directly pierced the heart of Aiden's tree.
The Deadwood Sage had no time to react before he was impaled by the sword, but a ruthless look appeared in his eyes, and his hands violently grabbed the longsword, refusing to let go.
The longsword instantly jerked away, slicing off both of Aiden's hands, but a muffled grunt came from the space next to Aiden as the figures of Sirius and Chamberlain appeared at the same time.
In the tall Sirius’s hands, he was playing with a dagger.

chapters.title: Chapter 420: Bandit An Tiansheng
chapters.content:
This was the strategy Aiden and Sirius came up with.
If Gu Nan didn’t exist, then they would be fighting with the Deadwood Sage as the main tank, the God of Thieves as the damage dealer waiting for an opportunity to strike, and the Goddess of Shadows holding back the enemy from the side.
But it must be said that this plan was very inefficient.
With the meager damage from Sirius’s dagger, stabbing Chamberlain to death would be a very lengthy process, and it was hard to say how long the Deadwood Sage could last.
But Chamberlain's misfortune lies in the fact that Gu Nan was also here.
The instant Chamberlain appeared, Gu Nan had already attacked at full power. The sword of shadows fell on him dead-on, forcing Chamberlain to raise his sword to block the attack.
Both were people who excelled in speed, exchanging hundreds of blows in an instant. Every strike from Gu Nan only advanced forward, leaving no room for retreat. They targeted the opponent’s vitals, but Chamberlain blocked them all.
His reputation as a Sword Saint was well-deserved.
Gu Nan shrugged somewhat helplessly. In the mid- to late-stages of the game, all players will face this situation where NPCs’ skills were also quite strong, not losing out at all to PVPs.
But this didn’t really matter.
Just when Chamberlain thought he had a moment to catch his breath, Gu Nan rushed up fiercely, directly tanking the opponent's longsword with his stomach before leisurely thrusting his sword out.
A sword stuck on Gu Nan was not as easy to retrieve as when it was stuck on Aiden.
The corner of Chamberlain's mouth twitched slightly, and he was forced to leap, trying to dodge Gu Nan's attack in midair.
But after he dodged Gu Nan's shadow sword, he also no longer had space to move around, so Gu Nan slammed his head into Chamberlain’s forehead without a second thought as a horrifying crack sounded…
A few seconds later, Classmate Shadow Sword Saint held his sword with one hand while his other hand covered his forehead, which was bleeding profusely.
Chamberlain was completely human. Even after becoming a god, his blood was still bright red, but now it looked a little miserable.
The grand Sword Saint was actually defeated with this kind of street thug fighting style.
Chamberlain ended up in a disadvantage in both exchanges. It wasn’t that he was much weaker than Gu Nan, but that he had picked a riskier tactic in order to ultimately win, only to be completely countered by Gu Nan.
The wounded Chamberlain was still fighting hard. People who could make it this far did not lack perseverance and persistence.
In terms of willpower, Gu Nan was probably no match for his opponent, but the problem was… he didn’t have to undergo any tests of willpower.
Any injury Gu Nan suffered would heal very quickly, and he didn’t need to bother thinking about how to fight.
All Gu Nan needed to do was simply to stab his sword into Chamberlain’s body, no matter the price.
A few moments later, Gu Nan was still standing there as good as new while Chamberlain’s entire body was already covered in wounds.
After once again blocking an attack by the God of Thieves that came out of the void, Chamberlain let out a small sigh.
"It’s my loss." He slowly sheathed his longsword and took the initiative to say, "From today onwards, the name of ‘Shadow’ belongs to your sect."
Sirius and Aiden exchanged a glance and finally sighed in relief. Sylvia still wanted to say something, but Chamberlain's figure had already disappeared.
Although the Sword Saint who lost the name of Shadow left, Karina still didn’t leave. Instead, she walked up to Gu Nan.
"I will bring enough divine spears next time and find you again!" The Valkyrie clearly couldn’t accept losing to Gu Nan like this.
"I’m just afraid you won’t dare come," Gu Nan responded with a chuckle.
"Where do you live?"
"The Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, the one that just ascended to a greater god."
"......"
……
Gu Nan caused quite a stir after he came to the World of Gods, but this couldn't compare to what Rolensia stirred up.
A newly ascended greater god!
The birth of every greater god was an earth-shattering event, enough to directly change the situation in the World of Gods.
During this time, Rolensia was practically always busy. She had too many matters to handle and also too many people she needed to meet.
In particular, she didn’t ascend through the normal method, instead taking this final step in the Myriad Heavens Universe, which attracted even more curiosity.
And so, the existence of the Heaven-God Alliance became equally well known in the World of Gods, and more and more gods tried to join.
"So, when can we head back?" Gu Nan asked as such within the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom.
In front of him were Xue Ren, Daoist Lingyang, and Mad Fist, the very same people who came from the Myriad Heavens.
The only one whose traces couldn’t be seen since arriving here was Zi Luo Elder.
"Soon." Xue Ren answered with a smile, "In around a year at most, we will be able to return to the Myriad Heavens in style."
Mad Fist cut in from the side, "What's the point of going back? There are plenty of people to fight with here."
Unlike Gu Nan, who had to return to farm points, Mad Fist lived a comfortable life recently.
Not many people in the World of Gods knew his reputation, allowing him to easily find people to challenge. Oftentimes, his opponents still didn’t know who he was even after the fight.
Of the people who came over from the Myriad Heavens Universe, if the rowdiest one was Gu Nan, then Mad Fist would undoubtedly be the second rowdiest person.
Gu Nan shrugged and expressed indifference to this.
Because of the lack of points, it wasn’t convenient for him to accumulate too much Evil Value for the time being, but that wasn’t a big problem.
Before stepping into Tier 9, time was still on his side, so there was no need for him to be in too much of a hurry.
And Xue Ren's response undoubtedly hinted at something; that outcome was not hard to guess.
Gu Nan's life turned peaceful again. His usual activities were just having tea with Xue Ren and Daoist Lingyang or playing two rounds of black cards with Sylvia.
Although Sylvia never won, nor did she ever come close to winning.
As the days slowly passed, the nine people who were sent out earlier returned one after another.
The result was a little worse than Gu Nan expected. Eight of the nine returned already, but only three completed a class change, even if all of them had the full walkthrough Gu Nan provided.
He was already prepared for this, so Gu Nan wasn’t that disappointed. He simply told them to try again or switch to a different route.
Of course, before that, it was inevitable to recommend some people to pursue the "Phantom Sword Saint" route.
This kind of route that required a prerequisite mission to unlock usually had more powerful attributes and faster growth than normal routes.
"Who is still missing?" Gu Nan asked Lan Si, who had already returned.
"An Tiansheng. He picked the Bandit route."
Gu Nan remembered the teen who called himself a "bandit" and couldn't help revealing a trace of a smile. "The Bandit route does suit him well, but it's not easy to get that class.”
"Since he’s still not back yet, he most likely ran into trouble. Find out where he is," Gu Nan instructed as such, but he wasn’t actually too concerned.
He left marks on all nine people. If there was a threat to their lives, he would be the first to know.
What he didn't expect was that just one day later, Lan Si came back and reported, "My Lord, I'm afraid An Tiansheng is in trouble… He stole something he shouldn't have stolen when selecting the Bandit route."

chapters.title: Chapter 421: Daughter Of God
chapters.content:
The "routes" that players could select in the game were a very interesting feature.
Theoretically, a player could choose multiple routes, and rather than a class change, it was more like "learning from a master," and the skills learned were of course the player’s to keep.
Each route had its own upper and lower limits, as well as stat and level requirements, but none of them would affect the player's own power.
These routes could also help one level up in a variety of ways, with "Bandit" being one of the more interesting ones.
The Bandit route can be acquired by stealing someone else’s most precious treasure and obtaining power in exchange, and the quests and skills at the time of the class change will also be related to it.
Based on Gu Nan’s experience, the target one needs to steal from during the class change quest always has either considerable strength or background and was never a fellow who could be easily messed with—don't ask why Gu Nan has experience with this.
Similarly, An Tiansheng stole from a dangerous fellow this time when trying to complete the class change.
"Daughter of God, Macefield. She’s a daughter of god in the truest sense—both her parents are gods," Lan Si saw that Gu Nan wasn’t concerned in the slightest and hurriedly reported gravely.
"Oh, Macefield, I know." But Gu Nan knew even more than Lan Si. "Daughter of the God of Iron and the Goddess of Sunlight. She likes to roast people into jerky at the drop of a hat."
Daughter of God Macefield was also a well-known NPC in the game.
Because not only did she live in a main plane, her strength was also Legend Rank, and her identity was also very special, so there were countless missions about her.
Neither of her parents were considered high ranking gods, but Macefield was their only daughter, so one could only imagine how spoiled she was.
The Goddess of Sunlight was a veteran Tier 7 god who’d remained at this level for a long time, so her network and forces were all extraordinary.
On the other hand, the God of Iron only just recently advanced to Tier 7, but there was strong momentum behind his growth, and it wasn’t impossible for him to ascend to Tier 8 or even Tier 9 in the future.
It was precisely because of his potential that these two gods were able to get together.
Speaking of which, Gu Nan even had an indirect connection with the God of Iron before.
Back when Gu Nan went to the Undead Kingdom, he brought the Raymond clan to the Myriad Heavens as a reserve force for his Divine Kingdom. And before Gu Nan, the Raymond clan was precisely under the protection of the God of Iron.
"Macefield should’ve already been Legend Rank a long time ago, right? Looks like that child succeeded in his class change," Gu Nan said with a smile.
An Tiansheng was originally only Tier 3 and couldn’t even be considered the peak of Tier 3. If he wanted to rob from the Tier 4 Macefield, he must’ve successfully acquired the Bandit class already.
"Yes." Lan Si nodded and continued, "And the item he stole—"
"What? He stole her panties?" Gu Nan immediately finished for her. He really had seen that kind of mission before.
The corners of Lan Si's mouth twitched slightly. "How can that be possible… He stole a crystal ball. It’s said that Macefield issued a high reward to find An Tiansheng’s whereabouts."
"Macefield’s crystal ball, that’s a good item!" Gu Nan couldn't help sighing with emotion.
The Bandit route was very special. It required players to steal the target’s most treasured possession, but their most treasured possession may not necessarily be a good item.
So a situation like Macefield, where the value of the stolen item was extremely high, was especially precious.
"What is that?" Even Gu Nan thought it was something good, which made Lan Si inevitably grow a little curious.
"It's no longer of much use to me, but it’s a good item for you guys." Gu Nan elaborated, "That crystal ball can store a person’s soul. If you guys die outside, you can use this to resurrect."
Macefield's crystal ball, a necessary item for the Lich route, was the perfect phylactery to store a lich’s soul.
Even those who weren’t liches could also use this crystal ball to resurrect; they just needed someone else’s help for that. It was considered one of the very best items before the First Round.
And the difficulty of obtaining this item wasn’t high. Macefield was a sloppy young lady, so it was all too easy to con her into giving away this crystal ball.
Lan Si’s eyes lit up. "Then we… will keep the crystal ball?"
"Of course!" Gu Nan looked at her strangely. "Someone actually wants to take back something that already fell into my hands?”
……
An Tiansheng was running swiftly through the jungle, carrying a wild wolf in his hand.
Don’t be mistaken—he wasn't running for his life. Rather, he was busy rushing back to make a fire and cook dinner—today's dinner was roasted wolf meat.
An Tiansheng, who grew up in a bandit den, was no stranger to wilderness survival at all. The pursuers from Macefield were like a joke.
An Tiansheng only had to change places every two days and was even in the mood to improve his diet during this time.
Just as An Tiansheng was sitting on the barren ground, unhurriedly roasting wolf meat, a voice rang out.
"Looks like you're having a comfortable time," Lan Si had appeared beside him at some point and spoke in a clear, cold tone.
An Tiansheng, however, didn’t look surprised in the slightest, as if he expected Lan Si’s appearance long ago. He just took a big bite of the wolf meat and said, "When are you guys planning to takeLaozi
[1]
back?"
Instead of answering his words, Lan Si's gaze turned colder. "Do you think you can beat me now?"
"That's right!" An Tiansheng fiercely tossed aside his wolf leg and swung his fist at Lan Si.
Then… he flew back at an even faster speed.
After all, Lan Si was someone who possessed a Godhead. After so many years of cultivation and accumulation, her power had long been pushed to the peak of Tier 4. She was only waiting to have an epiphany one day and take that final step to ignite the divine fire.
Even if he acquired the Bandit class, it was still completely impossible for An Tiansheng to surpass Lan Si, at least for the time being.
A few seconds later, An Tiansheng was standing beside Lan Si with a fawning expression. "Lord Lan Si, I was wrong!"
Lan Si glanced at him icily. "Come with me."
……
Within the Sunlight Divine Kingdom, a young blonde girl was tugging on the arm of a noblewoman and saying with a bitter expression, "Lord Mother, someone snatched my crystal ball… I swear I wasn’t the one who caused trouble this time!"
These two were naturally Miss Macefield, as well as her mother, the Goddess of Sunlight Sandra.
The Goddess of Sunlight clearly didn't quite believe her daughter's words. She put down the brush in her hand, her gaze still resting on the canvas in front of her. "You really didn’t provoke the other party first?”
"Absolutely not!" Macefield raised her finger and vowed, "Uncle Adam can testify for me. That person was clearly the one who came to steal my stuff for no reason!”
Sandra frowned slightly. Judging from her daughter’s certain expression, she didn’t seem to be lying… ‘Then is there really a mortal who dares to bully my daughter?’
Thinking of this, Sandra no longer asked her daughter further questions and instead ordered the guards outside, "Tell Adam to come see me."
"Yes, Your Highness," the guards answered from outside the hall, followed by a flash of sunlight flying into the mortal realm.
T/N:
[1] Laozi
:
Addressing oneself as “your father” or a much senior role. Extremely rude

chapters.title: Chapter 422: Very Expensive
chapters.content:
"Did a thief really steal her crystal ball?" Sandra asked somewhat incredulously.
Her daughter's crystal ball was a good item—this Sandra knew for a long time. It was a gift her husband brought back from the Undead Kingdom for their daughter.
“But someone dared to rob my daughter… Could it be that the other party doesn’t know who he’s stealing from?”
"We thought the same thing until yesterday," Adam stood in front of the Goddess of Sunlight, but his tone was a bit grave, "but today we received news that someone took that bandit away… to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom."
"Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom?" Sandra’s expression suddenly froze, and the brush in her hand also stopped moving.
That was the Divine Kingdom of the newly-ascended greater god Rolensia. Even if her foundation couldn’t compare to more established greater gods, she still wasn’t someone a mere Tier 7 god like Sandra could offend.
The Goddess of Sunlight was silent for a while before finally ordering, "First, investigate that bandit’s origins."
……
"Bring out the crystal ball," Gu Nan said to An Tiansheng, who was standing in front of him.
"I stole this with my own ability. Why should I give it to you?" An Tiansheng, who had been obedient up until that point, immediately changed color when he heard that he had to hand over his spoils of war.
"You robbed someone else, and I can also rob you. Will you hand it over yourself, or will you have me rob it?" Gu Nan asked with a smile that didn’t reach his eyes.
An Tiansheng's gaze darted around, and he ultimately took out the crystal ball while saying, "Boss, I have no problem giving you the goods, but you can't take it all, right?"
"When we used to share the spoils, the boss took the biggest share, but the brothers also had their share! Otherwise, who would be willing to work so hard to rob things?"
An Tiansheng painstakingly exhorted Gu Nan to not keep everything for himself and even brought up his time as a bandit as an example.
"You also have a point." Gu Nan revealed a contemplative look. "Then as payment, you can receive a chance to be resurrected."
"Resurrection?" An Tiansheng showed a puzzled look, not quite understanding.
"That's right. If you’re killed outside, I can resurrect you as long as you leave a wisp of your soul with me."
An Tiansheng was instantly ecstatic. "Is there no price?"
Gu Nan laughed involuntarily. "Of course there is. The resurrection won’t restore your power, so you’ll have to start cultivating from scratch again."
"Still, that’s quite good…" An Tiansheng mulled it over in his head, and it didn't take long for him to decide. "Deal!"
"Then, leave your soul in this." Gu Nan handed the crystal ball back to An Tiansheng.
……
Realizing that he seemed to have been tricked, Classmate An Tiansheng left with an indignant expression. After he left, Liang Ruixin soon appeared.
Liang Ruxin belonged to the portion of the nine who failed. He suffered a crushing defeat in the route challenge and didn’t even get past the first level.
Gu Nan had long foreseen this, because the route Liang Ruxin chose really was bad… he chose the Scholar.
The majority of the Scholar's test wasn’t related to strength. Rather, it tested the challenger’s knowledge. In this aspect, how could Liang Ruxin compare to the players, who all had Baidu?
So when the first question appeared, asking him to observe the convergence of a limit, Liang Ruixin decisively chose to give up.
"How does it feel to challenge a completely unknown field?" Gu Nan asked with a smile as he comfortably sipped a kind of light green fruit juice.
Liang Ruxin revealed a bitter smile. "I am willing to follow the route you recommend, My Lord."
"Smart man." Gu Nan patted his shoulder. "Go try the Phantom Sword Saint first. With your foundation, there’s hope for success."
"Yes."
The Phantom Sword Saint was a powerful route that could be used all the way to Tier 10, and the entry threshold was almost nonexistent, so it was a very high-quality route.
A true Phantom Sword Saint class could only be acquired when one was close to Tier 5, but anyone with outstanding qualifications could study under Chamberlain and simply take their time cultivating.
After giving Liang Ruxin a once-over of the main points of an apprenticeship under Chamberlain, Gu Nan then sent him back to prepare, while a new figure slowly appeared at that moment.
"Good afternoon, Your Excellency Gu Nan. This humble servant is McKenzie." It was a tall man wearing a black suit, but at this moment, he was bowing slightly with a respectful expression.
"Rolensia’s subordinate?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrow. Rolensia had been so busy lately that he didn't expect her to have the time to send someone over to him.
"Master has already left for the Red River Divine Kingdom." As if he could see what Gu Nan was thinking, McKenzie explained with a light smile, "This humble servant is here for the matter regarding the Goddess of Sunlight and the Daughter of God."
……
In another location within the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, several men and women in neatly uniformed robes were discussing something.
"I heard that Miss Macefield’s crystal ball was stolen, so Her Highness the Goddess of Sunlight sent someone over to negotiate."
"Who stole it?"
"One of the guests Her Majesty brought over from the Myriad Heavens Universe."
"The Myriad Heavens Universe? As expected, they’re as barbaric as the people of the North!"
The Myriad Heavens regarded the gods on this side as barbarians; the reverse was true for this side.
These people were all Rolensia’s apostles, and they were apostles responsible for managing the Divine Kingdom, so they possessed considerable authority.
"In my view, Her Majesty has already become a supreme existence, so why does she need to bother with Sandra?" The blue-haired woman among them said as such. Clearly, she wasn’t a fan of the Goddess of Sunlight.
As an apostle, she wasn’t supposed to call the gods by their names.
"Mind your tongue!" The youth beside her frowned at once. "Dira, remember our identities… McKenzie went to talk with that guest. Let's wait and see how he responds."
"You expect barbarians like them to hand over something they stole?" The previous blue-haired woman named Dira bristled again.
She wasn’t biased—she despised both sides equally.
A person next to her interjected, "Her Majesty has just ascended, so we must be fair in our dealings and not leave a bad reputation."
"Exactly."
They were still talking when McKenzie finally walked in slowly, worry evident on his face.
"Well? Did that guest have a bad attitude?" The youth from earlier couldn’t help asking after seeing McKenzie's expression.
"As a matter of fact, he didn’t. That Lord Gu Nan is very polite." McKenzie revealed a troubled smile. Indeed, he didn’t receive any negative response from Gu Nan.
"That's good then. That one doesn't seem like an unreasonable person," another apostle piped up.
This person had contact with Gu Nan and the others before and also witnessed Gu Nan and Sylvia playing cards together.
"Then you’re wrong about that." McKenzie revealed a helpless look. "Do you guys still remember how two goddesses fought in Dragon Realm not long ago and destroyed Metallic Silver Island?”
"Of course. I heard that Her Highness Karina was injured, and even her weapon was broken… Rumor has it that Her Highness Sylvia must have gotten help from someone."
McKenzie nodded wordlessly, then took out two broken halves of a spear from behind him. "That one told me to give this to the Goddess of Sunlight, and he also said…"
The group of apostles immediately gathered around him and grabbed the spear shafts from McKenzie's hands.
"Could this be…?"
"Judging from the material and rank, it does look like it…"
"Don't gossip just yet—what else did that one say?"
McKenzie took a deep breath and imitated Gu Nan's tone, "Don’t forget to return it after showing it to Sandra. This is very expensive."

chapters.title: Chapter 423: Weakness
chapters.content:
Of the nine people who were brought over, this pair of teen girl and boy were the youngest and also the most talented.
Young people, after all, had the characteristics of youths. They weren’t calm and calculating like the others, who never even spoke up.
To reward their courage, Gu Nan was willing to teach them some life lessons.
The teenager thought for a long time and finally looked at Gu Nan. "If I can beat you one day, will you let me go?"
"If you can beat me, then it's not whether I let you go or not, but the other way around."
The youth nodded thoughtfully, then flung his sleeves fiercely without any of the earlier inexperienced air and declared like a bandit, "I, your father, will do this thing!"
"What's your name and what did you do originally?" Gu Nan looked at him.
"An Tiansheng, bandit."
……
An Tiansheng the bandit was fourteen years old, a fact that Gu Nan just learned.
But he didn’t mind using child labor. As long as they could finish the tasks he assigned, he even dared to use four year olds.
At this time, the nine people were no longer in front of Gu Nan. Rather, they all remained inside a room, swiftly browsing through a pile of documents.
These were documents Gu Nan recently sorted out and contained information on player routes.
Routes were very important things. Instead of having Gu Nan get to know them one by one, it would be better to let them make their own choices first.
For the sake of secrecy, from the time they entered the room, they weren’t allowed to leave until they selected the route they wanted to take.
And after choosing a route, they had to explain their own specialties, as well as the reasons for picking this route. After Gu Nan looked over their choice, only then would he direct them on the path to acquiring that class.
To Gu Nan's slight surprise, the first person to come out was not An Tiansheng, but the young girl.
"I'm Xie Yun, sir," perhaps Gu Nan's earlier words had an effect, because the young Xie Yun had a significantly better attitude, and her voice sounded crisp.
"Your chosen route is?"
"Firearms Specialist."
Gu Nan couldn’t help smiling as he accepted the documents from Xie Yun. "This is not a class a normal person would choose."
Firearms Specialist was a very interesting class that could project firearms using energy. It was purely suppression through modern weaponry.
However, this also meant that this route didn’t have a very high upper limit. It was useful only from around Tier 3 to Tier 6.
It could barely work in Tier 7, but any higher, and the abilities from a Firearms Specialist would be essentially useless, and the player would only be able to use their Evil God physique and their original laws in fights.
And since the people Gu Nan chose didn’t have the Evil God Temple, that meant the Firearms Specialist route Xie Yun chose would at most have a combat power of low Tier 7.
Unless she changed her class later on and started all over again.
Of course, this was already a completely acceptable outcome for Xie Yun if her combat power could reach Tier 7. Not everyone wanted to head straight for Unified Dao.
"Have you ever seen a gun?" Gu Nan thought about it and asked.
"Of course." Xie Yun nodded. "I once went to a technological plane with very advanced weapon development!"
Xie Yun's eyes lit up as she talked. Gu Nan could already imagine what it was like for a young girl who grew up in a metaphysical plane to witness modern weapons for the first time in her life.
For lower level fights, modern weapons were indeed practical and cool, but they wouldn’t work in slightly higher levels.
For example, with the strength of Gu Nan's current body, he could tank a nuclear explosion without any problem. Be it the heat, shockwave, or radiation, it was impossible to hurt him.
"Then let's try it," Gu Nan said as such, writing down some information and handing it to Xie Yun.
……
When the day of Shadow Cult's duel with Chamberlain arrived, all nine people that Lan Si brought over had been dispatched.
They went to their respective destinations to attempt the class change quests and acquire the class they wanted.
No one picked the Phantom Sword Saint route so far, but Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry. It would be pretty good if half of the nine successfully completed the class change.
Player routes weren’t that easy to walk. Even normal players had a small chance of failing, let alone these NPCs with no game experience and average strength.
"Hey, it's time to go!" Sylvia had already gotten familiar with Gu Nan, so she didn’t look polite at all. "I hope you’re not defeated by a single strike from Chamberlain."
"My strength is as reliable as my card skills." Gu Nan said with a smirk, "If it goes well, you will welcome your 50th consecutive defeat this afternoon."
"You have no chivalry whatsoever! You’ll never be favored by a lady,” Sylvia bristled and grumbled.
The gods' dueling locations were also very special. To not affect mortals—mainly to preserve their reputations—they usually picked deserted planes to fight in.
This time was no different. Sirius and Aiden were already waiting when Gu Nan arrived.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan, I received a message just now." The extraordinarily handsome God of Thieves said, "Chamberlain might have a helper as well."
Sylvia frowned. "Is the helper he found qualified to intervene in this battle of ours?"
If any random person could intervene, then Sylvia would have way too many people to choose from and wouldn’t have to rely on the annoying Gu Nan.
"Sylvia!" A slightly gruff female voice came from the horizon, immediately making Sylvia go pale.
The Valkyrie holding a golden spear instantly descended, and the spear came straight at Gu Nan.
Gu Nan didn't even raise his head and casually blocked with his hand. The golden spear struck his palm but didn't even leave a mark.
"Karina, this is a fight between our Shadow Cult and Chamberlain. Are you sure you want to interfere?" Sylvia's voice was slightly cold. If Karina intervened in this matter, then they would truly become enemies.
"I'm just here for this guy!" Karina wasn’t stupid either. She pointed her spear at Gu Nan. "He beat me up once. Am I not allowed to take revenge?"
Sylvia couldn't help feeling enraged. "What's the difference between picking now of all times to seek revenge and helping Chamberlain?!"
Next to them, Aiden and Sirius had wry smiles.
They weren’t like Sylvia, who had a powerful older brother. Based on their past experience with Karina, this one wouldn’t listen to any attempt to reason.
Sure enough, Karina’s next words were, "I don't care!"
As soon as those words fell, she didn’t give Sylvia the opportunity to respond before thrusting her spear towards Gu Nan.
The golden spear shone with an astonishing radiance. Clearly, Karina already strengthened it with her own laws, quite unlike the casual jab just now.
Everyone's gazes landed on Gu Nan, wanting to see how he would respond. However… Gu Nan did not respond.
The spear pierced Gu Nan's chest unhindered, punching through his back and leaving a gruesome bloody hole.
Sylvia's eyes widened, and even Karina herself didn’t expect for the opponent who once knocked her out to be so weak.
But she realized something was wrong the next second.
Gu Nan, whose chest was clearly impaled, gave a strange smile, while she was actually unable to pull her spear out. It seemed to be stuck inside her opponent.
After the spear entered the enemy’s body, her laws were briefly suppressed, while Gu Nan raised one hand and grabbed the spear's shaft.
"Let me teach you all a lesson today." Gu Nan's voice remained calm as usual, making Sylvia feel slightly more at ease. "The Wrestling Goddess also has a weakness."
"What weakness!?" Karina asked before anyone else. She felt that she had already achieved the limit for her level. Her divine body was close to perfect, so it would be hard to improve on it anymore.
Her divine body was indeed perfect. Even Gu Nan had a hard time finding a way to kill her, but it was only a perfect divine body.
"Your attack is too low!" Gu Nan said rudely, "If not, why would you need to find the God of Blacksmiths just to forge this divine spear?"
As Gu Nan said this, he pointed at the golden spear that pierced his body and was currently gripped in one hand.
While Karina was still staring blankly, Gu Nan had already raised his other hand and slammed it down on the spear shaft with great force.
The divine spear, which accompanied Karina for tens of thousands of years, responded by breaking in half.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: Chance
chapters.content:
It would be bizarre if there were no factions within an organization.
Internal conflicts exist within any group—this Gu Nan was well aware of, but it was really the first time he'd seen someone like Daoist Lingyang, who talked about factions so openly.
However, the old Daoist quickly gave his explanation.
One should know that all members of the Heaven-God Alliance were existences at the level of Star Rulers or gods, so they didn’t have a high demand for resources. Thus, it could be said that there were rarely any direct conflicts of interest.
In this case, instead of devolving into a chaotic mess, it would actually be better to divide the organization into clear factions, which would be more convenient for management and collaboration.
After all, factions didn't necessarily have to be in conflict with each other; they could also have a cooperative relationship.
In Daoist Lingyang's vision, the future Heaven-God Alliance would exist in the form of an alliance of several major factions. This idea was also accepted by Xue Ren and Zi Luo Elder.
"That doesn't sound too bad." Gu Nan was no stranger to this kind of organization. In fact, a certain well-known assassin organization also used a similar organizational framework.
Since Gu Nan had no objections, Daoist Lingyang handed him a list of gods who had applied to join the Heaven-God Alliance.
"We need to assess the strength and goals of the applicants, mainly the latter," Daoist Lingyang explained.
The strength of various gods wasn’t much of a secret. On the other hand, their motives for joining the Heaven-God Alliance warranted an investigation.
"Assess them in what way?" Gu Nan asked while looking at the names on the list.
"There are no restrictions. You can choose any method." Daoist Lingyang gave Gu Nan complete authority over the process. "It’s fine even if you forgo an assessment altogether and just recruit people directly.”
"But if something goes wrong, I, the faction leader, will need to be responsible?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow.
"That's right. But ‘faction leader’ doesn’t sound very impressive, so I’ll have to think up a more imposing title in the future," Daoist Lingyang replied with a smile.
After knowing him for a while, one would realize that this old Daoist was actually quite a humorous person and wasn’t as old-fashioned as he looked.
Allowing core members to become leaders of their respective factions and developing new members by developing their factions wasn’t an inefficient choice.
And to ensure that no one would add people indiscriminately, there was also a reasonable accountability system holding the core members responsible for their factions.
It was no wonder that the other core members were so slow with their assessments. Perhaps they never had any intention of adding too many people in the first place.
As gods from this side, they already had their own network, so they could just directly choose people from there.
"Is Sylvia a core member?" The first thing Gu Nan thought of was naturally his card buddy.
"She has a lot of seniority, but she hasn't been very involved in the organization's affairs, so she's not considered core."
Daoist Lingyang paused a little, then added, "The older batch of members must also belong to a major faction. You can take Sylvia under your wing as long as she’s willing."
Gu Nan nodded noncommittally, then circled two names on the list.
"I’ll go with them. I think I have some idea of what these two are here for."
……
"You're actually going to accept Karina into the organization… I, I don't agree!"
In Gu Nan's room, card buddy Sylvia had just agreed to join Gu Nan's faction and was immediately shocked by the bombshell that followed.
That’s right—one of the two names Gu Nan circled was none other than the Wrestling Goddess Karina.
"Oh." Gu Nan nodded at Sylvia's protest. "It's your turn to play a card."
"All you care about is playing cards!" The Goddess of Shadows angrily threw aside her cards. "Do you know why Karina wants to join the organization?"
"If it’s not because of you, then it’s because of me…" Gu Nan answered without the slightest care. "By the way, Karina's card skills aren’t bad. Do you two want to try a round sometime?"
Sylvia left furiously, probably going off somewhere to find someone to complain to, while Gu Nan didn't care at all.
It was a waste to not use Karina, a combat power he can get for free. Besides, the one he was really interested in this time was the other god he chose.
David, the God of Labyrinths. His divine power was very special in nature and could create labyrinths impossible to escape from, as well as track something back to its origin.
His second ability was exactly what Gu Nan needed right now.
Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was in the Myriad Heavens, so he wasn’t able to farm too many points on this side, but there were still plenty of good items worth acquiring in this territory he was familiar with.
For example, after getting Karina's broken spear, one can use it to unlock a treasure that contains an item that can help the Divine Kingdom immensely.
However, Gu Nan hadn't done this mission before and was still considering how to find the treasure’s location when David delivered himself to his door just in time.
……
In the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, Xue Ren and Daoist Lingyang were sitting across from each other.
"Gu Nan went to assess the newcomers, and Mad Fist ran off to challenge some gods. Are you still going to stop me?" Daoist Lingyang asked calmly as he stared at Xue Ren.
"Looks like you have already prepared everything." Xue Ren nodded, then sighed softly. "Still can't let go after all these years?"
Daoist Lingyang chuckled. "This is the only reason I joined the Heaven-God Alliance and have been planning for so many years—all for today."
"You won’t wait until the old man finishes his breakthrough? All of us can help you then." This was one of the rare times where no smile could be seen on Xue Ren's face, only seriousness.
"Senior Zi Luo has already saved my life, and all of you from the Heaven-God Alliance have nothing to do with this matter, so why drag you guys into this mess?" Daoist Lingyang’s expression was still full of calmness.
"You don’t believe you have any chance of success." Xue Ren stared into his old friend's eyes.
……
When Gu Nan met this God of Labyrinths, his downtrodden appearance almost startled Gu Nan.
Speaking of which, Gu Nan had also met the God of Labyrinths when he was playing the game, and David certainly did not look this miserable back then.
The God of Labyrinths was dressed in tattered clothes, and his face was covered in dirt and grime, as if he was a beggar who had wandered for a long time.
"You
are
David, right? Your appearance…"
"Your Excellency Gu Nan." David revealed a bitter smile. "I'm afraid I can only appear like this for the near future… I accidentally offended that one from Mist Town."
Gu Nan instantly understood when he heard that and laughed. "You offended Diana? Your courage is commendable."
God of Poverty Diana, one of the Three Sisters of Misery. Offending her was equal to being cursed by the God of Poverty, the God of Decline, and the God of Misfortune at the same time.
David, the God of Labyrinths, was famous for his ability to attract aggro. He could always offend people no matter where he went. So as soon as Gu Nan saw his name, he knew that this one must have come to take refuge.
"You want to join the Heaven-God Alliance?" Gu Nan asked bluntly without beating around the bush.
"Yes, Your Excellency." David straightened his clothes, making himself look barely presentable.
"This humble one has long heard of your noble organization's impressive reputation, and—"
"Alright, drop the flattery," Gu Nan interrupted. He didn't believe that this fellow, who was always terribly busy all year round, would know much about the Heaven-God Alliance.
While speaking, he brought out Karina's divine spear again.
"These two spear shafts are stained with the blood of the first Blacksmith God. Help me find the source of the blood, and the Heaven-God Alliance will be able to protect you."
David's face stiffened. "The first generation Blacksmith God—that was during the First Great War. It would take an unimaginable amount of divine power to find him…"
Gu Nan tapped his arm with a broken spear. "You'll lose all your divine power if you can't find him."

chapters.title: Chapter 425: Entrusting
chapters.content:
A residence was arranged for David.
Since he already came to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan wasn't afraid he would escape. And even if they eventually had to set off to trace the blood back to its origin, there was no rush at the moment. At least, Gu Nan didn't want to travel with a beggar.
The Three Sisters of Misery were famous and also quite strong, but at the same time, they knew that their abilities were detested, so they didn’t casually get into conflicts with people.
Even for someone like David, who habitually courted death, they would at most punish him slightly—he wouldn’t be cursed for too long.
Gu Nan was in no hurry at the moment. When Rolensia first ascended, it took her two years just to prepare. Even if Zi Luo Elder's foundation was better, it would still take him a while.
For their level, it was perfectly normal for “soon” to mean a year.
"Gu Nan!" Karina went to Gu Nan. Clearly, she had already found out Gu Nan's identity.
The fact that Rolensia returned from the Myriad Heavens Universe and brought along a few guests from the Myriad Heavens was no secret among the gods.
"Let’s fight!" Karina said as she held up a brand new golden spear and pointed it at Gu Nan from afar.
The spear looked no different from her original one, but both Gu Nan and Karina herself knew the difference.
If nothing else, the divine spear that had accompanied Karina for tens of thousands of years had absorbed the blood of hundreds of gods. This was rare for divine weapons.
"Why do you want to fight me?" Gu Nan asked this instead of attacking.
If it was someone else, Karina would’ve thrust her spear out without another word. But Gu Nan was, after all, someone who defeated her once, which earned him the right to have a conversation.
Karina tilted her head in thought. She didn't seem to have much of a grudge against this person. He was standing next to Sylvia when they first met…
"You attacked me!" Karina's simple brain circuits finally remembered that Gu Nan hadn’t hesitated to punch her when the two first met.
Gu Nan nodded but didn't apologize at all. "I can help you get Austin."
Karina’s spear, which was already close to stabbing Gu Nan, stopped instantly just then, and she quickly hid it behind her back.
"Th-that… Your Excellency Gu Nan…" Karina suddenly looked like a shy, polite girl, which wasn’t convincing at all when combined with her appearance.
"If you act like this every time you see Austin, then it makes sense that he never fell for you." Gu Nan pursed his lips with a shake of his head.
Karina’s bashful expression immediately vanished, and she glared fiercely at Gu Nan. If the latter couldn't give her an explanation, then the next strike from her divine spear would be an all-out attack.
"Theoretically, Austin will never see you that way in his life. At least, I haven't seen such an outcome yet." Gu Nan recalled the main storylines in his head and said seriously, "But there is one route where you guys end up together."
"What do I have to do?!" Karina blurted out, glossing over the parts she couldn't understand. Anyhow, many people said things that she didn’t understand.
"Become a greater god before the next Great War." Gu Nan stared into her eyes. "Help the Light Faction achieve total victory and ascend to the pinnacle of all gods… By that time, you’ll be able to marry whoever you want."
Karina's expression turned a little blank. True, she was a little of a nutjob, but she wasn’t so nutty that she believed she could casually ascend to greater god.
The World of Gods only had twelve greater gods right now, and counting the just-ascended Rolensia and those who had fallen in earlier years, the total was less than twenty.
Of the billions of living beings in countless planes, fewer than twenty were able to take that final step. One could imagine the difficulty involved.
"What if I… can't do it?" Karina murmured.
"If you can't do it, then just wait till the next war." Gu Nan said matter-of-factly, "Austin doesn't have much room for improvement anymore, so you'll be able to catch up with him sooner or later as long as you work hard. Good luck, youngster. Power up with the power of love—you can do it."
……
Karina was indeed the paragon of powering up through love. The official explanation for her ability to start from Tier 8 and work her way up to the position of the leader of the Light Faction was "because of love."
Although this Wrestling Goddess did have some background, breaking through so many tiers so fiercely was beyond the scope of a golden finger’s abilities.
Gu Nan didn’t lie to Karina. In the game's many endings, this was the only way for her to get together with Austin.
Only when she advances to a greater god and personally participates in the next Great War—which would cause great chaos between the two major godly factions… only then would the Ruler of Light and Justice be knocked all the way down to mortality.
"But as long as she’s with Austin, it doesn't matter if he’s just a mortal, right?" Gu Nan couldn't help revealing a light smile as he thought of that ending.
It was also in Gu Nan's interest to encourage the next Great War.
The fact that his Divine Kingdom was located in the Myriad Heavens meant he couldn’t think of ways to invade other gods’ Divine Kingdoms and eliminate those few important gods while he was in the First Round.
This would leave him with a bit too many enemies to face after the Second Round. Only by triggering a Great War would he be able to reduce the pressure in the future.
A few days later, when the God of Labyrinths was finally freed from his curse and returned to dressing as a noble young lord, Karina approached Gu Nan once again.
"Why did you come here again?" Gu Nan was planning to take David with him and set off in search of the divine spear’s origin.
After a few days of searching, David had basically determined their destination, which was inside the main plane that the Dark Faction had just acquired, the Atalante main plane.
"To fight!" Karina pointed her spear at Gu Nan again. "If I want to advance, I need to find someone to fight with!"
Gu Nan was taken aback for a while before finally nodding. "Come with me. I’ll take you to a fight."
……
"Atalante, I'm back."
A somewhat indifferent voice calmly rang out. Xue Ren and Daoist Lingyang had just arrived, and Daoist Lingyang spoke just now.
The two were standing in a field of grass. Up ahead was a cemetery. People came and went, most of them holding a bouquet of chrysanthemums.
The atmosphere was slightly melancholy, yet the heavens didn’t cooperate with some light sprinkles of rain. Instead, it was a bright, clear sky.
Daoist Lingyang slowly entered the cemetery, walking up to a tombstone with the skill of someone who’d done it countless times. Written on the tombstone was one Lady Margaret.
Judging from the date, it had been thousands of years since her death.
It was also a very rare thing for a tombstone to be preserved for thousands of years. Not only did it show that the tombstone was made of amazing materials, it also showed that the place had been cleaned from time to time.
"Apologies for the disturbance." A man who looked middle-aged came up to the two and looked at Daoist Lingyang in surprise. "Are you two gentlemen here for Lady Margaret?"
Daoist Lingyang frowned slightly. "And you are?"
"I am Hughton, Hughton Cable," Hughton made a point of emphasizing his last name. "Our family has been entrusted with guarding this lady's tombstone for a thousand years."
"Yes." Daoist Lingyang nodded. "I entrusted your family with that."

chapters.title: Chapter 426: Shifting The Blame
chapters.content:
After visiting Margaret's grave, Daoist Lingyang threw himself into intense preparations.
The chaos of war had just ended on the ancient continent of Atalante, with the Church of Light being completely destroyed and the Dark Empire ruling the continent.
From then on, this place fell under the Dark Faction’s control.
This was the general trend of the World of Gods. Seven of the twelve greater gods were from the Dark Faction, and their strength was enough to crush the Light Faction.
If Austin hadn't saved the day by desperately supporting the Light Faction with his own strength, perhaps the World of Gods would have already lost sight of any light.
However, what Daoist Lingyang was doing at this very moment was to subvert the Dark Empire’s rule—to be more accurate, he was trying to subvert the rule of its imperial family.
Order after order was issued, team after team was dispatched, and a plan countless years in the making was now revealing the tip of its iceberg now that Atalante was finally unified.
"Gu Nan and Karina have come to Atalante," Xue Ren suddenly spoke up while Daoist Lingyang was writing furiously.
Xue Ren was responsible for receiving information from the Heaven-God Alliance, so he was the first to know.
There was a slight lurch to Daoist Lingyang’s movements, but then he said, "Gu Nan has taken in the God of Labyrinths. He’s most likely looking for some kind of ancient relic. It has nothing to do with us."
Atalante was very large. Gu Nan going on a treasure hunt didn't conflict with his own plans.
"You really won’t consider having the two of them do you a favor?" Xue Ren asked with a small smile.
This time, Daoist Lingyang’s movements didn’t pause as he casually replied, "I don't screw over my allies."
"So, I'm not one of your allies?" Xue Ren pretended to be angry, glaring at him.
"You jumped into this mess yourself."
……
Atalante was indeed huge. There weren't many main planes in the entire World of Gods to begin with, and this was one of them.
It was even rarer to find a main plane under the complete control of the Dark Faction. It meant this place could be managed and developed in a unified manner, with the power of faith being harvested with the highest efficiency.
Gu Nan brought Karina and David to a strange place.
This place originally seemed to be a small mountain range, but it was shrouded by a marvelous power, forming a garden.
"The first-generation Blacksmith God created the divine spear right here, and he used his own blood to water this divine weapon. His blood evaporated into mist and affected the surrounding laws," David's hollow pupils slowly returned to normal while he spoke.
"There are several Legend Rank humans occupying this place." Karina raised her head to glance ahead. The layer of mist outside the garden seemed completely useless against her.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, was no stranger to this place. "This is the Garden of Spirits… I didn't realize the divine spear was forged here."
Atalante produced countless missions because of its constant war, so Gu Nan was quite familiar with this continent.
Gu Nan took out the two broken spear halves, and sure enough, he saw a shimmering light emanating from them. This was the result of the item the Blacksmith God left behind back then resonating with the divine spear.
"Is this my spear?" Karina stuck her head over.
"It's mine now," Gu Nan emphasized.
Karina couldn't help rolling her eyes and raised the new divine spear in her hand. "It's merely a masterpiece of the first Blacksmith God."
True. If it hadn’t been bathed in the blood of countless gods, just in terms of the forging technique and materials, the first Blacksmith God was definitely no match for the current one.
Time passed, and gods also advanced. The belief that gods who existed in ancient times were more powerful than the current gods had always been nonsense.
But what Gu Nan cared about wasn't the weapon itself, but what it represented.
The first Blacksmith God was the Blacksmith God who had been in office the longest. In other words, he also amassed wealth unimaginable to ordinary gods.
After all, it cost money to seek him out to forge a divine weapon.
And according to the background in the game, all of his truly amazing goodies were left behind in the place where he forged this divine spear.
"Why did the first Blacksmith God do this?" Karina couldn't help wondering after hearing Gu Nan's narration.
She was born much later than the first Blacksmith God and wasn't the first owner of the divine spear, so she didn’t know much about it.
"This divine spear, which he called Muse, was the highest achievement of his life, although it doesn't seem like much nowadays," Gu Nan explained flatly.
This was the power of technological innovation, and even more so, the power of knowledge.
At least, the first Blacksmith God did not understand materials science, and his proudest divine spear was hard enough but weak in shear resistance, so it was easily smashed by Gu Nan.
"Go in," Gu Nan said without further elaboration.
The Garden of Spirits was nothing more than the stronghold of a few Legend Rank mortals, so the three gods weren't concerned about them in the slightest. They didn't even have any intention of hiding their tracks as they directly stepped inside.
A shadow instantly floated up to them the second the three stepped inside, lowering its gaze respectfully but uttering words that weren’t necessarily respectful.
"Your Highnesses, the Garden of Spirits is under the protection of Archmage Claude, and we are believers of the Tenebrosity Divine Kingdom."
The Tenebrosity Divine Kingdom was the Divine Kingdom of the God of Tenebrosity Lewis, and Archmage Claude was Lewis's spokesperson on this continent.
The laws of the God of Tenebrosity and the Goddess of Darkness were extremely similar. While this certainly caused Lewis to practically lose all hope of stepping into the greater god realm, it also gave him strength far beyond his peers.
With origin laws like light and darkness, as long as the person who obtained it wasn’t too stupid, they would always end up pretty well off.
"So this is Lord Lewis's territory." David nodded. His face didn’t betray anything, but he was already planning to retreat.
Main planes were very special existences where powerhouses at the greater god level couldn’t personally descend. At best, they could only launch a long-distance attack from another plane, so powerful gods like Lewis were the main force in raiding main planes.
In fact, on the continent of Atalante, the Dark Empire’s imperial family was none other than Lewis’s bloodline descendants.
So it wasn't at all unusual for Gu Nan and the others to run into Lewis's forces, as his faction was the most powerful people on this continent to begin with.
David only came here to look for treasure under Gu Nan's "coercion." He absolutely didn’t want to offend Lewis because of this.
Of course, this was also because the person in front of him was respectful enough. Otherwise, the dignity of a god was not something a mere Legend Rank could offend.
David was ready to retreat. Even if it was Lewis's territory, it was still fine for the three of them to sneak in.
However, he never could’ve imagined that Gu Nan wouldn’t even say a word before half of a divine spear was already embedded into the person before them.
Gu Nan was using Karina’s broken spear, which directly shattered the newly solidified shadow, and even the entire Garden of Spirits began to shake.
"It's going to collapse." Gu Nan raised his head nonchalantly, knowing that the one he just killed was most likely the garden’s manager.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan…" David’s mouth turned a little dry. "If you just kill him so directly, won’t it…?"
"It's fine. It'll be a while before news reaches Lewis," Gu Nan said while raising the broken spear in his hand. "And didn't I find a scapegoat already?"
Shifting the blame 2.0.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: Archmage Claude
chapters.content:
Atalante was a pretty lively main plane, as it was the main quest map for players when they first entered the game a few decades ago.
From this, Gu Nan could also infer that the timeline of the World of Gods was likely the same as in the game.
The day he transmigrated into the Myriad Heavens, the World of Gods was also at the same point in time when the player first entered the game.
But Gu Nan spent several decades in the Myriad Heavens, resulting in the main storyline of Atalante having ended by the time he came over here.
Just like the outcome if the player did nothing but watch the entire time, the Dark Faction achieved total victory.
The absolute protagonist of the storyline, "Dark Warrior" Goro, rose abruptly, and at less than fifty years old, he had gone from an ordinary person to a god, successfully igniting his divine fire.
And as the god who led the charge in this continental war, it was only logical for Lewis to get the largest gains since he achieved full results.
Lewis, who was already a Tier 10 god, saw his status within the Dark Faction rise once again.
The position of strongest under the greater gods was originally occupied by Rolensia, but now that she successfully ascended, Lewis was favored to take over this position.
But it was precisely against a Lewis with this kind of status that Gu Nan had no intention of giving face at all.
He stabbed the guardian of the Garden of Spirits to death, causing the protective laws of this grotto heaven to instantly collapse and revealing the garden’s true appearance.
After losing the laws disguising it, the Garden of Spirits soon lost that mysterious and enigmatic aura, reverting back into an ordinary garden.
More and more people began to flee in all directions. When faced with an enemy they couldn't possibly defeat, most people didn’t have the courage to fight back.
Gu Nan walked ahead of the others, mercilessly trampling the precious plants in the Garden of Spirits underfoot.
It wasn't as if no one tried to fight back at all. After the garden manager’s instant death, Gu Nan could sense the two other Legend Ranks having a disagreement of opinion.
One of them fled quickly, presumably to report back to the empire, while the other activated the defensive magic formation within the garden in an attempt to stall for a bit of time.
The result was certainly nothing to write home about. With such a low level, it was impossible for those laws to trap even David—the other party clearly didn't realize the level of the opponents he was facing.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan…" David followed Gu Nan, his face somewhat troubled. "Since you have the divine spear in hand, finding the Blacksmith God's treasure shouldn’t be too difficult, so why don't I take my lea—"
"This is part of your assessment, Mr. David," Gu Nan revealed a strange smile as he replied unhurriedly.
