David stiffened, only then remembering that although his trip was an exam in name, his mind had already tacitly acknowledged it as a deal.
Since Gu Nan didn't want to let him go, he had no choice but to continue to follow along.
After all, he was also someone who had been hunted down for so many years. The God of Labyrinths gritted his teeth and finally adjusted his mindset, not uttering another word.
Even if he had never offended someone on the level of Lewis, the God of Tenebrosity, before.
"Hey, didn't you say you brought me here to fight?" Karina was even less afraid of Lewis and asked bluntly.
This Wrestling Goddess claimed she didn’t fear anyone who wasn’t a greater god, and it wasn't as if she hadn’t fought Tier 10 gods before. The outcomes were all the same—no one could beat her super-durable divine body.
Although the law of wrestling was called "wrestling," among players, it was called the law of "taking a beating" or the law of "iron skin."
Because it wasn’t just Karina. Players who picked a defensive build could also choose the law of wrestling and ultimately arrive at a similar route.
Superb defense combined with the Evil God phyqisue’s own superb recovery, but lacking in damage output.
"You’ll get to fight someone soon." Gu Nan said flatly, "The first Blacksmith God wasn’t just good at hammering iron; he was also good at hammering people."
……
Busy figures could be seen everywhere in the Dark Empire’s imperial palace, many of them government personnel dealing with official matters within the various palaces.
At the time when they just unified the continent, there were many matters to be dealt with and missions to be dispatched, and unexpected situations were occurring all over the place.
However, the number of unexpected situations that popped up today seemed especially high.
"Lord Claude, a mutiny broke out in the borderlands…"
"Lord Claude, a letter from Archduke Vanstorf…"
"Lord Claude…"
"......"
Archmage Claude was the figure that held the position of Chancellor within the Dark Empire. Almost all internal affairs had to be handled by him, and at the same time, he was also the Dark Emperor’s strategist.
However, this wise counselor was a bit frazzled today. He felt that situations everywhere seemed to have all erupted on the same day, and there were so many matters to deal with all of a sudden that even he found it hard to accept.
For a moment, Claude even suspected that someone was constructing a large-scale conspiracy whose first phase was bogging down the entire internal affairs department of the empire with a large number of burdensome political affairs.
But he quickly ruled out this idea. After all, the geographical area where things had gone awry was too large and the types of situations were too complex, it really didn't seem man-made.
If it was truly man-made, then just how much time and energy had the other party spent to set up such a plot?
As the strategist of the Dark Empire that had just unified the world, Claude couldn't think of any force that could have done this.
"Lord Claude, there’s a situation in the Garden of Spirits," another official hurriedly came in and walked to the Archmage's table, quickly reporting.
He didn't even have time to hand over the report and directly reported it himself, obviously feeling that this piece of news was too urgent and had to "jump the queue."
Claude, who was originally scribbling rapidly on documents, looked up when he heard these words, and his eyes were fixed on the messenger who just entered.
"Who did this?" The Archmage stopped the pen in his hand, a deep indifference in his voice.
This world was ultimately a world that belonged to the top powerhouses, and an army of mortals actually didn't have much power to oppose a Legend Rank expert.
The fact that the Garden of Spirits was easily breached despite having the protection of three Legend Ranks—and even the news had to be passed on by officials—meant the enemy's power was beyond imagination.
‘Does a certain side’s remaining forces still have top-notch combat power left?’
Claude furrowed his brows. This situation could be much more troublesome than those small matters from earlier.
"It's not forces from the continent." The official seemed to know what Claude was thinking and took the initiative to say, "It's gods… The last message we received from that side is that the invader is Her Highness Karina, the Wrestling Goddess."
The official's face was pained as he said this, but he also looked a little relaxed—after all, bigshots on that level were way above what he was expected to handle.
However, there was nothing relaxing about this for Claude, who was already neck-deep in governmental matters. For a famously powerful goddess to suddenly appear on top of that was the last straw.
"Go inform His Majesty of this. I will personally head to the Garden of Spirits," the Archmage pondered for a moment before quickly making a decision.

chapters.title: Chapter 428: Powerful Undead
chapters.content:
The Garden of Spirits covered a large area.
From Gu Nan's understanding, this seemed to be an official place set up by the Dark Empire dedicated to growing rare plants, but the government didn’t admit this.
There were even missions in the game digging into this matter, but it no longer held much appeal to Gu Nan at this point in time.
Gu Nan wasn't too familiar with the interior of the garden, but there was really no chance of getting lost with the divine spear guiding them, and they headed straight for their goal.
"Is this the treasure?" As Gu Nan finally stopped at a place, Karina couldn't help looking around suspiciously.
Because there was nothing around them; their surroundings were completely empty.
There didn't seem to be anything strange underneath the ground either. It was a breeze for gods like them to determine whether the ground was hollow or solid.
"It’s indeed here," David confirmed instead. Although this God of Labyrinths was a little cowardly and a little too good at attracting aggro, he still had an extremely strong control over his divine authority.
However, he was similarly puzzled as to where exactly the first Blacksmith God had hidden the so-called treasure.
While the God of Labyrinths was responsible for leading the way, he wasn’t responsible for digging up the treasure.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, was very familiar with the process. Although he hadn't personally dug up this "treasure" in the game, there were bound to be players who did.
A large advantage players held was their ability to communicate with each other, and Gu Nan had also seen the process on forums and guides.
He took out the two broken spears, then ruthlessly plunged them into the ground.
The reason the word “ruthless” was used was because Gu Nan's movements and demeanor were indeed vicious, as if he was stabbing into an enemy's body.
And to the surprise of the two beside him, right after Gu Nan finished, the ground cracked in a very strange way.
It didn’t look like the cracks that naturally formed on the ground. Instead, it felt a bit like a needle piercing into skin, and even after the spear entered the ground, some black, sticky fluid started oozing out of the ground.
"This is…" David stared at the ground in shock. He felt an extremely familiar energy from the black fluid.
This familiarity didn’t come from having seen it in the distant past, but rather… he’d seen it just seconds ago.
"The ground of the Garden of Spirits is particularly hard and also particularly fertile, so it's very suitable for plant growth." Gu Nan explained with a faint smile, "Few people know… that this is because this is not the ground at all, but the skin of a god."
As Gu Nan's words slowly fell, the three of them felt the ground shake, as if something under the ground had awakened.
No, it wasn’t quite right to call it under the ground. It was more accurate to say the ground itself was awakening.
"The first-generation Blacksmith God died at the hands of the second-generation God of Death, and he wasn't even a greater god at that time." Gu Nan's voice continued, "The very same God of Death who’s the ancestor of all necromancers."
……
In the eastern part of the Atalante continent, Daoist Lingyang slowly walked into a dilapidated church, which was covered in dust and seemed to have been untouched for a long time.
However, Daoist Lingyang was completely unconcerned, as if speaking to the empty church, "Lady Maria, please show yourself."
No one responded.
Daoist Lingyang gently drew a Daoist symbol with his finger and imprinted it on top of the church. A green light fell, and everything inside the church was revealed before his eyes.
Many officers and soldiers were lying strewn about in a corner of the church. Some of them were no longer breathing, but more were still letting out moans of pain.
After this scene was exposed, one of the head nuns finally got up helplessly and walked over to Daoist Lingyang.
"Your Excellency, I greet you with the highest respect." Sister Maria said with a lowered gaze, "We would love to serve you, but…"
"I don't need anything from you." Daoist Lingyang interrupted her, "I just need you guys to come forward."
……
Of course the Dark Empire had teleportation spells, so Claude could rush to the Garden of Spirits immediately.
However, when he actually arrived, he realized that things were not at all what he expected.
"What is… this?!"
In front of Claude was a dark-skinned giant hundreds of meters tall, holding an enormous hammer. He couldn’t sense any signs of life from it.
As one of the highest echelons of the Dark Empire, Claude was all too familiar with this kind of aura.
This was an undead creature!
But… How could there be such a powerful undead creature?
Every swing of the black giant's hammer caused Claude's heart to palpitate. This Archmage, who was called a "demigod" by the world, felt that just one swing of the hammer was enough to shatter all the bones in his body.
Of course, this feeling wasn’t an illusion, because he could clearly see who was fighting the black giant on the other side.
That athletic figure holding a golden spear was none other than the Wrestling Goddess!
‘An undead creature that can fight on equal ground with the Wrestling Goddess… How great would it be if we can control this undead?’
Claude couldn't help harboring such thoughts. Not even the Dark Emperor could possibly be a match for an existence of this level.
If handled properly, this would become the Dark Empire's incredible trump card, laying the foundation of the empire's rule for thousands of years.
However, right at this moment, a figure appeared behind Claude.
"Archmage Claude?"
Claude suddenly turned his head, only to find a white-robed youth looking at him with a smile. He couldn’t discern the other party's power level at all, but someone capable of silently appearing behind him couldn't be weak by any stretch of the imagination.
"Your Excellency is…"
Gu Nan chuckled. "Don't look at something you shouldn't see."
As soon as Gu Nan's voice fell, Claude felt his vision go dark, his head instantly blasted apart as a sliver of his soul awakened in another location.
This location was extremely hidden. It was neither the Dark Empire's palace nor Claude's own magic tower, but a place that seemed completely unrelated to him.
"What a close call…" Claude's consciousness, which woke up inside a body he prepared long in advance, still felt lingering fear.
He recalled the white-robed youth but couldn't figure out who it was at all. Was there such an existence among the gods who was also an acquaintance of the Wrestling Goddess?
Claude had no clue. But no matter what, with at least two gods descending on Atalante and that powerful undead creature, he had to send a message back as soon as possible.
However, a familiar voice rang in his ears just as he tried to get up.
"Lich?"
Claude's entire body jumped up. His face looked like he’d just seen a ghost, because this voice was exactly the same as the one from earlier.
Claude's mind raced as he said quickly, "Your Excellency, you cannot kill me! If I die, that one one will—"
The next second, he felt a sharp pain coming from the depths of his soul as his soul was instantly ripped to shreds.
Back at the Garden of Spirits, Karina was still fighting to her heart’s content, while David shot Gu Nan a suspicious look.
"Where did you go just now?"
Gu Nan stared at the black giant in front of him and said quietly, "The situation is a little different from what I expected… Time to call Lewis over for a stroll."

chapters.title: Chapter 429: Crusaders
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Crusaders
The first-generation Blacksmith God undead in Gu Nan's impression wasn't this strong.
Although he hadn't personally done this mission before, it was impossible for him to make a mistake in judging the minimum player level required for this quest—this was the basic ability of a top player.
At least in the walkthroughs he saw in his past life, he'd never heard of this mission requiring a player's battle strength to reach Tier 9 or even higher.
That's right. This dark giant's combat power was already close to Tier 9.
The first Blacksmith God wasn't just a great blacksmith; he also possessed power that matched his level and was a veritable Tier 10 god.
After his death at the hands of the second-generation God of Death, he was successfully turned into an undead creature by this first-ever necromancer, and his strength also declined compared to when he was alive.
After all, it was impossible for the undead to possess any laws, so the undead was relying solely on the physical body left behind by the Blacksmith God to fight.
Fortunately, it was the corpse of the Blacksmith God. If it was any other god, their undead version would most likely be even weaker.
But on the flip side, even if it was the first Blacksmith God, this undead giant was still too overpowered—to be able to fight on even ground with Karina meant it would be very difficult for almost any player to kill him.
"You… You lured Lewis over as well?" David stared at Gu Nan with wide eyes, completely flummoxed by Gu Nan's actions.
'Even if this person doesn't fear powerful gods, there's still no need to voluntarily provoke them, right? What good would this do him?'
Gu Nan remained silent, or perhaps he couldn't be bothered to explain to David—after all, the latter no longer had any use. Instead, his gaze landed on the dark giant.
What was the benefit of luring Lewis over? Of course there were benefits, the biggest one being accumulating enough damage output.
The skin of the Blacksmith God undead was even tougher than expected. Gu Nan even tried a few attacks himself, but neither his fists nor the sword of shadows inflicted deep damage on the dark giant.
He briefly estimated that it would take him at least half a day to kill this powerful undead—the damage from Karina was basically negligible.
But if he caused such a big commotion in Atalante, he was afraid he would attract the attention of everyone in the World of Gods. By that time, everyone will know that there is a peculiar existence called Gu Nan.
He had no intention of exposing himself on such a large scale before he advanced to Tier 9 or even Tier 10.
"Let's go." So Gu Nan stood up and repelled the pouncing giant with a single punch before grabbing Karina's shoulder.
Karina still couldn't get enough of the fight; it had been a long time since she stumbled upon an opponent she could fight to her heart's content.
The two of them had met their match—neither could kill the other.
"You can leave if you want!" Karina refused rudely. She wasn't Gu Nan's subordinate. She didn't even fear Lewis, so she certainly didn't take orders from Gu Nan.
Gu Nan also didn't bring up Austin to pressure her. The fact that this Wrestling Goddess wanted to stay behind and fight wouldn't hinder his plans.
So with a shrug, Gu Nan's figure quickly disappeared.
...
In the east.
Daoist Lingyang was sitting calmly in his tent, issuing orders as the general. He was actually mobilizing soldiers and horses to quickly set out, attacking cities at an astonishing speed and quickly seizing the Dark Empire's territory.
And the banner they fought under was none other than the Church of Light, as well as gods of the Light Faction.
The Church of Light's banner was still very useful. The Dark Empire only recently unified the continent, and to say it had gained more popularity in territories that originally belonged to the Church of Light was obviously impossible.
As a matter of fact, a few decades ago, the Church of Light was far stronger than the Dark Empire on the continent of Atalante.
To a large extent, the reason the empire ultimately emerged victorious was thanks to the Dark Warrior Goro. This newly-ascended god's rise to power was basically the Dark Empire's path to victory.
So when Daoist Lingyang's people captured those territories, they won the support of the local populace almost effortlessly, amassing even more power.
This army that started in the east had gathered an enormous force in a very short time, snowballing like a prairie fire.
At least within the Eastern realm, they already had the ability to threaten the empire's rule.
Of course, as more and more former soldiers of the Church of Light joined, it wasn't without some problems.
For example, at this very moment, Maria was surrounded by several blond-haired, blue-eyed former Crusader commanders in white armor.
"Lady Maria, how can the Holy Church's army be commanded by an outsider?" One of them protested righteously. The armor on his body was the most worn out. Clearly, he didn't have an easy time in the post Holy War era.
This man's name was Ramiro. He was originally the commander of the Third Crusader Regiment and one of the top ten bigshots in the Church of Light. He hurriedly rushed over as soon as he received news of the Church of Light's resurgence.
But Ramiro didn't see a single Crusader when he arrived, and he himself was quickly placed under house arrest, his treatment completely lacking the expected courtesy and military authority he deserved.
"Lord Ramiro, I can understand your feelings." Maria showed a helpless look as she tried to placate the people around her, "But all the troops here are that… Daoist priest's people. There's nothing we can do about that."
"Daoist priest" was a bit of a mouthful for these natives, but Daoist Lingyang insisted that he be addressed as such.
"Perhaps that was true at first." A proud look appeared on Ramiro's face. "But it's different now. Many of My Lord's followers have rejoined us, so how can the army still be under that person's control?"
"That's right. He wants to use the Holy Church's name to recruit people easily, yet he doesn't want us to intervene in military matters. How can there be such a good thing?" Another commander beside him also chimed in supportively.
Lady Maria's eyebrows were knitted together. To be honest, she also wanted to revive the Holy Church's glory and didn't want to be taken advantage of by someone who was clearly just using their flag.
However, the forces resisting the Dark Empire had just picked up a bit of steam right now, so she really didn't want any internal conflicts to occur.
After thinking for a long time, Maria sighed softly and relented, "Tell you what, I'll take you guys to meet the Daoist priest."
When they met Daoist Lingyang, the latter was reading a document, his expression one of deep thought. Nobody knew what he was pondering.
Maria explained her group's intention, and to her surprise, Daoist Lingyang didn't show any dissatisfaction. Instead, he laughed and said, "No problem. This humble Daoist just happens to be up to my ears in work and needs some help."
He spread out a map in front of the crowd and pointed to one spot. "I just received word that a very powerful undead creature has appeared here, so why don't a few of the commanders lead the army to exterminate it?"
Maria wasn't familiar with military affairs and could only look back at Ramiro.
Ramiro and his several companions glanced at each other and instantly spoke, "With honor. What is the exact location we are going to?"
"The Garden of Spirits."

chapters.title: Chapter 430: Darkness and Opportunity
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Darkness and Opportunity
Ramiro quickly left with a few companions after confirming the location.
Regarding the powerful undead Daoist Lingyang mentioned, they didn't give it a second thought. In the many years they led the Holy Church, they'd killed countless undead and were more than familiar with this.
'Just how powerful can an undead possibly be?'
With several Crusader commanders joining forces, they could even take on a half-god lich.
After the Church of Light's former troops left, Xue Ren's figure slowly appeared next to Daoist Lingyang. ''Sending them to their deaths? You really are two-faced."
Daoist Lingyang smiled coyly. "There are still quite many people in the Church of Light, and it would be too ugly to kill them directly… Sending them to their deaths is a small matter. The undead that can fight Karina to a standstill, on the other hand, is a much bigger matter."
Towards the end, his expression subconsciously turned serious.
The intelligence report Daoist Lingyang was reading when Maria entered with her group just now was precisely news about the emergence of a powerful undead fighting the Wrestling Goddess Karina in the Garden of Spirits.
"This was Gu Nan's doing, wasn't it? He really stirs up trouble wherever he goes." Xue Ren revealed an amused expression as he shook his head.
He knew who Karina came along with, so it certainly wasn't difficult to deduce Gu Nan's involvement.
"If Gu Nan was the one who lured out that undead, then that's a good thing." Daoist Lingyang also smiled.
To him, it was a good thing as long as the situation wasn't created by the Dark Empire itself and was instead an unexpected crisis the empire had to deal with. This was because his ultimate goal had always been to create a crisis the empire couldn't handle.
"I'm just afraid the commotion will be too big and will inadvertently alert the enemy, making him more cautious," Xue Ren, however, poured cold water on their conversation as he handed over another piece of information.
Daoist Lingyang frowned as he took it. The information contained within the intelligence report caused his pupils to shrink slightly.
Clearly written on it was the sentence: "Archmage Claude is dead, and the Dark Emperor is personally heading to the Garden of Spirits."
Knowing that god-level existences were fighting and facing an existence that easily killed Claude, if one still believed the Dark Emperor would head there alone, then one would be looking down on this emperor's intelligence too much.
Daoist Lingyang took a deep breath.
He knew that his target was about to appear as well.
...
After realizing the Blacksmith God undead was stronger than he imagined and could not be killed quickly, Gu Nan was actually in no hurry to make his move.
In any case, the item he wanted would appear as soon as the Blacksmith God undead died, and he didn't care who killed the undead. More importantly, that item was probably not something other people had much use for, and it was highly unlikely that they would even fight over it.
The Blacksmith God undead would drop a blueprint used specifically for constructing a structure inside the Divine Kingdom.
That structure was something Gu Nan had a use for, but neither Karina nor Lewis—who had already reached Tier 10 and whose Divine Kingdom was close to being perfected—needed it much.
That was why Gu Nan killed Claude, hoping to use his death to draw the Dark Empire's attention.
As long as Lewis's attention was drawn this way and he noticed the existence of the Blacksmith God undead, there was a high likelihood of Lewis showing up in person. At the very least, Lewis would consider subduing this undead and putting it under his control.
However, Gu Nan didn't expect for the first to arrive to not be the Dark Empire's army, but the Crusaders.
...
"Too undisciplined. They have no sense of honor as a Crusader at all!" A Crusader commander couldn't help complaining during the march.
"They should be honored to fight for the Holy Light. They'll understand sooner or later," Ramiro, on the other hand, wasn't too anxious and said to the companions around him.
Although Daoist Lingyang didn't form the Crusaders, when Ramiro and the other commanders stepped forward, an army called the "Crusaders" was quickly formed.
Of course, the result of forcibly bringing a new army to battle was that the troops were extremely undisciplined, which was unacceptable to the several commanders.
"We're almost there. Everyone, be on your guard!" Ramiro suddenly glanced at the ground, as if sensing something, and shouted loudly.
The remaining few commanders also straightened up. As veterans in fighting the undead, they all knew exactly what Ramiro sensed.
Where powerful undead creatures exist, the death aura from their bodies tend to spread naturally, affecting the surrounding space and land.
Land eroded by death aura was especially prone to producing new undead, so every powerful undead creature often represented an undead army.
As expected, they didn't travel for too long before the Crusaders ran into a large number of weak undead, but they were easily cleared away.
"Didn't they say that the undead was just born? How come there are so many undead soldiers?" Ramiro furrowed his brows as he ordered the troops to march with more caution.
In any case, the caliber of the several commanders leading the troops was still very high, and as the Crusaders slowly advanced, more and more undead died at their hands while their casualties were quite limited.
However, the unease in Ramiro's heart grew heavier, because not only was the number of undead far beyond imagination, the size of this dead land also seemed a bit too large.
'Exactly how powerful is this so-called powerful undead?'
Ramiro soon saw him. The Crusaders didn't have to march much further before the dark giant's enormous figure appeared in everyone's sight.
A golden light was also moving rapidly near the black giant. Every time the golden light collided with the giant, it would generate unimaginably powerful aftershocks.
"What… What kind of undead is this?!" Ramiro stared at this scene with his jaw dropped. This dark giant had already surpassed his understanding of undead creatures.
"It's an undead god…"
A soft sigh rang out beside him. Ramiro turned his head suddenly, only to see a youth with gentle features dressed in a dark purple robe just standing there.
Ramiro didn't recognize the youth, but he recognized the person standing next to the youth—that middle-aged man in black standing behind the youth was someone whose appearance Ramiro would never forget in his life.
The Dark Emperor!
The founder of the Dark Empire, the man who single-handedly led countless troops and destroyed the thousand-year foundation of the Church of Light!
"Glory to the Holy Light!" Ramiro let out a roar, drew the longsword at his waist, and quickly rushed at the Dark Emperor.
As long as he could kill this man, Ramiro would gladly give his own life in exchange!
However, he was only greeted with an indifferent look from the Dark Emperor. This emperor didn't even deign to move, as he knew very well that it was impossible for the other party to come closer.
The commander began to charge, and the Crusaders naturally followed suit, but they quickly realized something was wrong.
The path in front of them darkened, and the sky above their heads and the ground under their feet also darkened further. Their charge seemed to have fallen into boundless darkness.
The purple-robed youth was just standing in place, but it was as if there was endless darkness behind him.
"Sleep for all eternity inside the darkness," the youth's soft sigh rang out, and the entire Crusader army was instantly buried in darkness.
The Dark Emperor didn't even spare them a glance. He just stared at the dark giant and asked in confusion, "Ancestor, who is this?"
"The first God of Blacksmiths," the youth in purple answered softly, a strange light flickering in his eyes. "This is an opportunity."

chapters.title: Chapter 431: Helper
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Helper
"This is an opportunity," Daoist Lingyang murmured as he stood in the sky, his gaze landing on the Dark Emperor below.
Of course Daoist Lingyang recognized the two figures below. The Dark Emperor, as well as his ancestor—the God of Tenebrosity Lewis.
Daoist Lingyang struggled to keep his gaze from landing on Lewis.
Tier 10 powerhouses were very sensitive to their surroundings and could even sense any gaze directed at them.
Especially such a… malicious gaze like Daoist Lingyang's.
"Him showing up in a main plane is indeed your best chance." Xue Ren similarly didn't look at Lewis. In fact, he didn't look at any of them because this didn't concern him.
After saying that, he added with some amusement, "You've been plotting for today for a thousand years, but your plan hasn't even unfolded yet when your target was already lured out by Gu Nan… How do you feel about that?"
Xue Ren nearly laughed out loud towards the end, only refraining to save his old friend some face.
The old Daoist's story was actually not complicated at all. As a good friend, Xue Ren was quite familiar with it.
Before he even became a Star Ruler, Daoist Lingyang had come to the World of Gods to explore, and it was precisely this experience that helped him stand out from his competition for Clear Profundity Sect's Sect Master position later on, ultimately allowing him to take control of Clear Profundity Realm.
It was also during his journey in the World of Gods that he befriended a goddess who helped him greatly.
Later on, he still hadn't forgotten that goddess even after he became the Star Ruler of Clear Profundity Realm. Unfortunately, by the time he freed up some time to visit the World of Gods again, she had already fallen, dying at the hands of none other than Lewis.
Azure Water Goddess Margaret.
After a thousand years, not even her descendants could remember that their ancestor had once been a god, but Daoist Lingyang still remembered.
Even if there were only a few simple encounters between them and they were far from lovers, and even if not even Daoist Lingyang himself was sure whether Margaret would still remember him.
But none of that mattered. She was dead and he wanted revenge—it was as simple as that. This old Daoist was precisely such a stubborn person.
But killing Lewis was absolutely not a simple matter.
Setting aside the fact that the God of Tenebrosity was a Tier 10 god, there was still a very basic issue in his way—Daoist Lingyang was unable to mobilize the power of his astral world in the World of Gods.
The dimensional walls had a great impact. Except for people like Gu Nan who fought with their physical bodies, normal Star Rulers couldn't even utilize 80% of their power.
Fortunately, there were still places like main planes here.
Main planes were very special existences in the World of Gods. The spatial laws of the World of Gods were very stable, and among them, the ones in main planes were especially stable.
Existences stabilized at the level of a greater god were completely unable to enter main planes using their true bodies. Even normal gods could barely use the power of their Divine Kingdoms in main planes.
Here, Lewis's combat power wasn't much stronger than Daoist Lingyang, which was why Xue Ren said this was his best chance.
What was rather awkward, however, was that this opportunity wasn't of his own making—rather, Gu Nan had created it for him.
"Laugh if you want." Daoist Lingyang also didn't expect for this undead to be such a strong temptation for Lewis, but all in all, this wasn't a bad thing.
As long as his purpose was achieved, what did it matter even if his thousand years of scheming was mostly discarded?
Xue Ren coughed dryly, sort of easing the embarrassment. ''Let's not talk about that. Now that Lewis has come out, just how much certainty do you have? Do you need my help?"
In Xue Ren's opinion, they only had one shot at this. Once they startled Lewis and alerted him to their intent, it would be very hard to kill a Tier 10 god.
Daoist Lingyang's gaze was still directed at the ground below. "Wait just a little longer…"
...
Lewis was studying the dark giant.
He felt some vague unease in his heart, but this didn't make him vigilant. If he didn't feel threatened at all even when facing the undead made from the first Blacksmith God, then that would be a sign that something was wrong with his intuition.
The God of Tenebrosity was also a god who lived for countless years, so he was familiar with the first Blacksmith God's death. He just didn't know that the Blacksmith God had died in Atalante.
"Karina," he directly showed up and spoke without any intention of hiding himself.
The ruckus created by the Wrestling Goddess was too great. It wouldn't be long before countless gods noticed this scene, and by then, there would be a whole lot more contenders if they wanted to capture this undead.
Karina and the dark giant had already fought for a while, and the first three minutes of excitement was more or less over by now, so she turned her head back when she heard the shout.
"Oh, it's you. Something the matter?" Karina's hand movements did not stop, and she casually replied as she viciously stabbed her spear into the dark giant's palm once again.
This Wrestling Goddess seemed completely unaware that two of her teammates had already escaped.
Lewis didn't actually want to provoke this crazy woman, so he first asked, "Is the Blacksmith God undead your target? I want a living undead. We can cooperate if our goals don't conflict."
Karina's eyes lit up at once. "Can you capture him so I can fight him from time to time?"
She was a little tired now, but it was a bit of a shame to let this opponent go. It would be great if someone could keep it under control for her to fight whenever she had time.
"Sure." Lewis flashed a smile. He wasn't surprised in the slightest by Karina's answer. Every single senior god knew what kind of person the Wrestling Goddess was.
"Deal!" Karina agreed without hesitation.
She wasn't afraid of Lewis reneging or backstabbing her—in any case, if there was no undead, then she would simply find Lewis for a fight.
"Cooperation? Count me in as well," another voice interjected. The voice sounded dry and gloomy, as if iron sheets were being scraped together, making people's hairs stand on end.
Another person appeared out of thin air beside the two. It was a bone-thin old man with a wrinkled face.
Skeletal Sage Stevenson, another bigshot within the Dark Faction and one of the rare undead creatures to ascend to godhood.
Legend has it that Stevenson was initially just an ordinary skeleton soldier born in the Undead Kingdom but ultimately reached his current level. He was definitely not to be underestimated.
"Stevenson." Lewis's gaze lingered on him for a moment, and he said in a low voice, "I want the undead himself, and Karina wants to fight him. What do you want?"
A cold smile tugged at the Skeletal Sage's old face. "I need him for some research. It won't affect his vitality."
The Skeletal Sage ultimately chose the path of a Skeleton Mage, which was actually very similar to a human Necromancer, so he had no reason to let the masterpiece of the second-generation Death God slip through his fingers.
Lewis contemplated for a moment and eventually nodded in agreement.
Only Xue Ren, who was in the sky above them, leveled a meaningful gaze at Daoist Lingyang. "So you still had a helper."

chapters.title: Chapter 432: Goro
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Goro
Once the three gods reached a consensus, dealing with the undead became a breeze.
After all, there was the Skeletal Sage, an expert in undead creatures, and their aim was not to kill the undead but to find a way to control or even subdue him.
After an extraordinarily long time, the Blacksmith God undead had completely lost its self-awareness, acting entirely on instinct.
"Time has worn away the Blacksmith God's consciousness. Now he only has his undead instincts left, so it's not hard to control him." Stevenson said, "But I'm rather curious: how did he awaken?"
An undead that had been slumbering for tens of thousands of years wouldn't have woken up on its own—so the Skeletal Sage looked at Karina.
If the two of them knew that someone deliberately released this undead, they would probably be more vigilant.
But Karina didn't care about that. She just urged them to capture the other party as soon as possible.
Stevenson shook his head. "I'll set up a magic circle. You guys keep him inside the circle and weaken his soul fire as much as possible. Everything will be settled once the magic circle is completed."
Weakening the soul fire of an undead actually just meant injuring him as much as possible.
Karina shrugged, indicating that she couldn't do anything about that, so Lewis said, "Leave that to me."
Even though the law of tenebrosity didn't specialize in offense or defense, he was after all a Tier 10 god, and the level suppression helped him deal enough damage.
Many people felt that Karina's attack power was very weak, but they actually ignored her true level.
With her Tier 8 power, this was naturally the result when going up against a Tier 9 or 10 enemy. But once she advances to Tier 10, she would truly become invincible besides attacks from greater gods.
The Skeletal Sage busied himself with setting up the magic circle while the other two began to attack the undead. Karina was in charge of holding it back while Lewis was in charge of dealing damage.
Compared to the Wrestling Goddess, Lewis actually knew more about how to kill undead creatures, or rather, he had more methods for dealing with them.
The sharp blade of tenebrosity fell and directly sliced through a small part of the dark giant's head, revealing the soul fire burning within.
The dark giant, on the other hand, didn't feel anything until the darkness landed on that flame, causing him to let out an astonishing roar.
"A very tough soul." Lewis couldn't help sighing with emotion, actually looking more pleased than troubled.
Even though such a soul was causing him trouble right now, the undead would be able to remain for a long time once he subdued it.
It was as if Lewis could already see himself easily occupying a main plane for ten thousand years and accumulating a huge amount of faith.
One blade of darkness after another hit the soul fire continuously, causing the dark giant to constantly roar in pain, but it was powerless to resist the two's siege.
Karina could easily block all of his attacks, and the God of Tenebrosity was even less likely to be affected by them.
Finally, as the aura of the Blacksmith God undead gradually weakened, Stevenson finished his spell.
The deathly aura that rose up to the sky satisfied Lewis. The Skeletal Sage had also put his heart into it, otherwise it would be hard to set up a grand magic circle of this level in a short time—
unless he already prepared this in advance.
Lewis felt a violent jolt in his heart when he had this thought, as if he realized something, but his realization had come too late.
A staff made of bones pointed at his back, and the characteristic gloomy voice from the Skeletal Sage rang out.
"Now then, fall into the trap, Lord Lewis."
A ball of white flames erupted from the tip of the bony staff, instantly engulfing Lewis's entire being.
Such an attack couldn't truly hurt Lewis, but it could make him fall into the magic circle that had just been laid out.
Lewis wasn't wrong—the Skeletal Sage had indeed prepared in advance, and it was a trap prepared just for him.
The instant Lewis fell, a Daoist talisman seemed to fall from the sky and instantly land on top of Lewis' head.
A dazzling green light radiated from the Daoist talisman and began to crazily drill into Lewis's body. But trapped inside the skeletal magic circle, Lewis was unable to free his hands to block it and could only watch the green light entering his body.
Daoist Lingyang slowly stepped out. He was finally able to recklessly cast his gaze upon the purple-robed youth in front of him.
Seemingly sensing the new arrival's malice, Lewis also finally figured out the mastermind behind this trap.
He didn't recognize the other party, but that was normal. Lewis had killed too many people in his life. How could he remember every single enemy?
But he never expected for the other party to get the help of the Skeletal Sage.
"Stevenson, this won't do you any good." After the unavoidable green light entered his body, Lewis simply chose not to resist and instead looked at the Skeletal Sage.
"You can't give me what I want. But this… Mm, His Excellency Daoist priest, can." Stevenson obviously didn't know much about the Myriad Heavens, and the way he addressed Daoist Lingyang was a bit ridiculous.
Lewis's gaze turned slightly cold. He began trying to mobilize the law of tenebrosity, but to no avail. Instead, it made the green light enter even faster.
The man with the strange attire was obviously using his full power to control the green light in order to finish in the shortest possible time.
Lewis didn't know what this green light was, but it wasn't anything good.
His gaze moved to Karina. The Wrestling Goddess wasn't trapped inside the magic circle. In other words, she still had strength to spare if she stepped in to help.
However, without waiting for him to open his mouth, Stevenson already said, "Lord Karina, I will give you a complete and controllable Blacksmith God undead once we finish off Lewis."
And so Karina stopped moving as well, revealing a disinterested expression. Anyhow, she wasn't afraid of people reneging.
Another option was snuffed out, but the expression on Lewis's face didn't change much. Instead, he became silent.
As for the Blacksmith God undead beside Lewis, his soul fire was already close to sputtering out and was being continuously exhausted inside the skeletal magic circle.
If Daoist Lingyang's movements were any slower, perhaps even before Lewis fell, the Blacksmith God undead would be the first to perish.
Right at this moment, the Dark Emperor standing below them suddenly sighed and said to one of the people in the group behind him, "Goro, it's up to you now."
A man holding a black greatsword, his body hidden in pitch-black armor, slowly stepped out as he smiled lightly. "It seems that Lord Lewis's caution was correct."
"I didn't expect for me, his trump card," the armored warrior Goro couldn't avoid it.
A sword cloud fell from the sky, precisely blocking the way to lifted his greatsword slightly, "to actually come in handy."
In the next second, the pitch-black silhouette instantly appeared in midair. Now on the same level as the many gods, his sword chopped down.
At the same time, Lewis, who'd remained silent until now, suddenly raised his head, and two purple rays of light shot out from his eyes, heading straight for Daoist Lingyang.
The last of the power of tenebrosity broke out of the magic circle, and since Daoist Lingyang had to control the talisman, he naturally couldn't avoid it.
A sword cloud fell from the sky, precisely blocking the way to Daoist Lingyang, before revealing Xue Ren's figure.
However, there wasn't much triumph on his face, because after saving his old friend, he could no longer stop that pitch-black warrior in time.
Lewis finally revealed a cold smile and shouted, "You can't deal with them. Break this magic circle for me and release the Blacksmith God undead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 433: Dividing the Spoils
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Dividing the Spoils
In every sense, Lewis made the right call.
By ambushing someone who'd been entirely unaware until then, Daoist Lingyang had already taken this trap to the extreme, utilizing every condition that could be utilized.
With the Skeletal Sage's magic circle to trap him, Daoist Lingyang's Daoist talisman as a killing move, and Xue Ren as a trump card to prevent Lewis from making any last-ditch moves—this was a very strict plan.
In other words, Lewis only needed to cut off one link in the entire plan to escape.
The only difficulty was that Lewis had almost no cards left in his hand.
After failing to persuade Stevenson, and with Karina's disinterest in intervening and his own counterattack being blocked, the only card left in his hand was the Dark Warrior "Goro."
Goro was truly a very promising young man, and to Lewis, he was even a direct descendant.
Because Goro was the son-in-law of the current Dark Emperor. As early as when Goro first started showing potential, the Dark Emperor keenly discovered his potential and decided to marry his favorite daughter to him.
But even Goro, who rose as abruptly as the rising sun, still lacked time. The current him was only a Tier 6 god who had just ignited his divine fire.
Perhaps using some of his trump cards, he had the ability to threaten even Tier 7 gods, but to say that he could oppose the likes of the Skeletal Sage was still too much.
However, it was enough to have him interfere with Stevenson's grand spell.
As long as even the slightest flaw appeared in the magic circle, the Blacksmith God undead, who was no longer being held back by Karina, would immediately expand the flaw indefinitely, and the entire grand spell would be broken without Lewis having to attack.
Hearing Lewis's reminder, Goro's greatsword changed direction and pointed decisively at the magic circle under his feet.
The tangle of relationships here was quite complicated, but it was as clear as day in the eyes of the several parties involved.
But Stevenson couldn't free himself while operating the magic circle, Daoist Lingyang also couldn't free himself, and in order to block Lewis's attack, Xue Ren could no longer stop this in time…
Many times, the fight between two sides was like playing cards. Whoever has more cards and whoever hides their cards better will be the final victor.
Daoist Lingyang felt that he had forced out all of his opponent's trump cards, but he never imagined that Lewis still had a mere Tier 6 card, which at this point was more than enough to determine victory or defeat.
Of course, Lewis similarly couldn't have imagined that he wouldn't actually be able to play this card.
Just when the jet black sword was about to break through the magic circle, a hand appeared out of thin air and held the sword's blade, trapping it in place.
Goro was slightly stunned, and in an instant, his sword changed direction as black flames quickly flared up on his black armor, and he swung the sword with all his might at the newcomer.
Although he only experienced a few decades of life, Goro's combat experience was already incomparably rich.
He concluded that as long as he forced his opponent back a step, the aftershock from this blow would be enough to interfere with the grand spell… 'And even a Tier 7 god has to avoid a strike at my full power, so there's no reason I'll fail.'
Gu Nan's figure slowly stepped out from the void, and after blocking the greatsword with one hand, he didn't even raise his head in the face of a renewed attack from the same sword.
He allowed the sword to hit his arm, then nonchalantly dusted off the place that just got hit—the sword didn't even leave a mark; all Gu Nan dusted off was some dust.
The next second, Gu Nan casually raised his foot and threw a kick. The terrifyingly monstrous force instantly extinguished all the black flames, and even the sound of armor breaking could be heard.
Goro was like a meteor that cut through the sky, then slammed heavily into the ground, smashing a deep hole in the ground.
Daoist Lingyang and Xue Ren exchanged a glance, relief clear in each other's eyes.
Of course they knew Gu Nan was nearby, but they weren't sure at all if Gu Nan would step in to help, or even which side he would help if he did.
Mad Fist was crazy, and Karina was also crazy, but there was a method to their madness.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, was even crazier, and his madness was something that others couldn't understand. Or rather, neither Xue Ren nor Daoist Lingyang had found what Gu Nan actually wanted yet.
"And who are you…?" Lewis asked, fixing Gu Nan with a deathly glare. His voice was a little hoarse, because he knew he was most likely going to die this time.
"You don't recognize me?" Some surprise seemed to surface on Gu Nan's face.
Lewis shook his head very honestly.
"That's great," Gu Nan said with satisfaction.
...
Lewis died.
For a god of this level, even the description of "falling" couldn't do justice to his power, but he died so easily.
As he neared his death, this God of Tenebrosity thought of every possible method to survive.
He tried to persuade every god present, even Daoist Lingyang, all to find even the slightest chance of survival, but unfortunately, only Karina chatted with him for a few moments.
He tried to use his own power to break out of the situation, but unfortunately, both Stevenson and Daoist Lingyang were all too familiar with his methods, and there was absolutely no chance of success.
"Since you dared to enter a main plane, you're already prepared to fall, right?" Karina was a little puzzled that the God of Tenebrosity protection of their Divine Kingdom, it was tantamount to giving up their greatest advantage.
tried so many tactics. The phrase "pleading for one's life" never even existed in her dictionary.
When a god's true body entered a main plane and lost the protection of their Divine Kingdom, it was tantamount to giving up their greatest advantage.
That was why main planes were the most common place of death for powerful gods who'd fallen throughout the ages. This was true even for the several Great Wars.
Since they took this step for the sake of benefits, they shouldn't expect to come back unharmed every time.
The fall of the God of Tenebrosity was too fast, and Daoist Lingyang was also way too prepared, not giving anyone the slightest time to react.
By the time all the gods in the World of Gods came back to their senses, all traces of gods had long since vanished from Atalante, and even Lewis's corpse had been taken away by the Skeletal Sage.
"No matter what, I still have to thank you this time," Daoist Lingyang stood in front of Gu Nan and said with the most official Daoist bow.
Gu Nan looked at the old Daoist and thought for a long time. "You don't seem to have anything you can thank me with, so let's talk about it later."
Daoist Lingyang was probably shocked by Gu Nan's bluntness and didn't say anything for a while, but Karina spoke up, disgruntled, "You killed that undead, so will you fight with me in the future?"
The Blacksmith God undead was naturally also dead, and the remains it left behind were held in Gu Nan's hand, which was an odd-looking finger bone.
"Didn't someone guarantee you a completely intact undead?" Gu Nan pointed his head towards Stevenson and said quite rudely, "Go find him!"
The Skeletal Sage almost choked to death; this was the first time he experienced Gu Nan's shamelessness, and for a moment, he didn't know what to say.
Based on his previous agreement with Daoist Lingyang, this Blacksmith God undead that unexpectedly appeared should've been his as well.
It was only because of Gu Nan's critical intervention and his long acquaintance with Daoist Lingyang that Stevenson allowed the spoils from the Blacksmith God undead to go to Gu Nan, yet now he actually had the face to say such a thing?
Then he saw Karina walk up to him.
"He has a point," Karina said seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 434: Blacksmith Temple
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Blacksmith Temple
The scene at the division of spoils suddenly turned a bit awkward.
The Skeletal Sage glanced at Daoist Lingyang but realized the latter didn't have any reaction—their cooperation was limited to Lewis, and there was no personal friendship between them.
Thus, a cold smile appeared on Stevenson's old face. In his opinion, the other side was clearly trying to backstab their former ally once they saw that he was alone.
However, he was a little surprised Karina would also cooperate with them on this.
"He's the one who killed the Blacksmith God undead, so why are you coming to me instead of looking for his trouble?" The Skeletal Sage tried to persuade her and even provoked her with amusement, "What, is he a better fighter than you?"
"He… more or less can fight as well as me!" Karina paused for a moment, then said decisively, "If you won't compensate me with an opponent, then fight me yourself!"
As soon as her words fell, she thrust her divine spear forward without giving Stevenson the chance to respond.
Stevenson was a bit stunned. He finally understood this Wrestling Goddess's intention—she was simply bullying the weak while fearing the strong!
Karina's statement that Gu Nan "more or less can fight as well as her" was basically no different from admitting he was a better fighter than her.
The Skeletal Sage didn't know whether to laugh or cry. At the very least, he was still a pillar of the Dark Faction and was only slightly weaker than Lewis, yet someone was actually picking on him because he was the "weakest."
Daoist Lingyang very unrighteously ignored him. This old Daoist was carrying a bag in his hand containing Lewis's head.
The old Daoist decided to follow the custom of his hometown and bring the head of Margaret's enemy to her grave.
Gu Nan had even less to say. He decisively turned and walked away. He already got the item he wanted, so there was nothing more he cared about here.
Be it Karina or the Dark Warrior who disappeared a while ago, neither was of any concern to Gu Nan.
...
Gu Nan sat in his room inside the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, playing with the crystalline finger bone in his hand.
This finger bone was Gu Nan's spoils of war and the target item he had gone to great lengths to obtain.
The finger bone from the first-generation Blacksmith God was actually a blueprint that could be used to construct a miracle structure called the Blacksmith Temple.
Miracle structures constructed with blueprints couldn't be upgraded and didn't count as a structure required for the Divine Kingdom's advancement, so there was basically no extra benefit.
In exchange, the structure itself had a powerful function.
The role of the Blacksmith Temple was to create equipment that could provide apostles with the weapons or armor most suited for them, and it was fully automatic.
The Blacksmith Temple would have one free crafting slot every month, and one could also use it by paying points, but it wasn't cheap.
The Blacksmith Temple was a highly popular structure among players because it produced equipment with very good effects that didn't even lose out to the Evil God Temple.
In other words, once the Blacksmith Temple was in place, the combat abilities of apostles would be greatly enhanced, and it wouldn't be impossible for them to challenge higher level enemies.
As a veteran player, Gu Nan was well aware that the entire First Round Divine Kingdom playstyle was not too difficult in and of itself.
Regardless of the player's speed of development, it was always possible to trounce the gods without feeling any pressure.
However, it was clearly not in the game officials' best interest to merely make the game a grind without any difficulty whatsoever, so there was bound to be an actual crisis that could lead to a total game over.
After the player advances to Tier 9 or even Tier 10, the possibility of the Evil God's identity being exposed increases greatly, especially in the eyes of greater gods.
Often, 90% of newbies died because they were too arrogant during the First Round, drawing too much attention, and were then caught and exterminated as soon as they reached Tier 10.
Seasoned veterans, on the other hand, would make preparations in the early stages to ensure the success rate of Divine Kingdom Wars.
They would wait until their Evil Value reached a critical point, then rapidly accumulate points in an attempt to step into the Second "You lost again!" Sylvia's voice rang in Gu Nan's ears, and what entered his sight immediately afterward was none other than the Round in one fell swoop.
"You lost again!" Sylvia's voice rang in Gu Nan's ears, and what entered his sight immediately afterward was none other than the Shadow Goddess's smug smile.
The one she just defeated was naturally not Gu Nan, but rather Lan Si, who was currently filled with chagrin.
After officially losing 50 consecutive matches, Sylvia finally abandoned her "dignity" and turned to challenge the people around Gu Nan.
Every member of the player army who came back to "report on their route" would be asked to play black cards with her, and when even they started avoiding her, she could only try for Lan Si.
Gu Nan ignored this boring goddess; he was busy with his player army.
With attempt after attempt, the player army was gradually on the verge of taking shape.
Seven out of the nine had already gotten their classes and were constantly improving themselves based on the plan Gu Nan drew up.
They were already some of the best among Tier 3 experts, and after changing to player classes, they quickly entered Tier 4.
The gap between Tiers 3 and 4, which was like an insurmountable chasm for mortals, was particularly powerless in front of player routes.
Among them, the one who advanced the fastest was An Tiansheng.
This little fellow was indeed a natural-born bandit. He was way too suitable for the "Bandit" route.
After he realized that robbing others could improve his cultivation, he spiraled out of control.
Not only did he successfully complete the missions Gu Nan gave him, but he also robbed a bunch of gods' children, apostles, Legend Ranks, and even ancient beasts along the way.
He was now running to another main plane, living a life of incomparable fulfillment since gods rarely entered main planes.
As for the two who had yet to complete their class change, one was Liang Ruxin, who hadn't been heard from again ever since he started studying under the Phantom Sword Saint, and the other was Xie Yun.
The Phantom Sword Saint was by no means an easy route to acquire, so it was only natural that there was no news from Liang Ruxin for the time being.
Gu Nan wasn't afraid that someone would dare to betray him; there were simply too many methods of controlling people in the World of Gods.
He originally wanted to go and find a random item himself, but An Tiansheng just happened to deliver the crystal ball from the Daughter of God right to his door. Since it could resurrect apostles, it naturally also had the ability to control their life and death.
This was all possible because Gu Nan's power far exceeded theirs. Only with absolute power can one easily accomplish many things. The World of Gods has always operated under that rule.
And just as Gu Nan was traveling east and west, plundering the resources he wanted to his heart's content, the opportunity for them to return to the Myriad Heavens finally arrived.
On this day, everyone in the World of Gods simultaneously felt a palpitating sensation without warning.
Immediately following that was the simultaneous awakening of the twelve greater gods, who all cast their gazes at the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, Rolensia's location.
Rolensia was silent. She merely sealed up her Divine Kingdom completely, blocking all outside gazes.
Under these circumstances, if anyone still dared to spy on her, it would be the same as making a complete enemy of Rolensia.
Thus, at this moment, the true high-level figures of both worlds realized that another greater god level figure was about to be born.
Perhaps it couldn't be called a birth, but rather a return.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: Pay to Win Expert
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Pay to Win Expert
Myriad Heavens Universe.
Two figures were wandering around the vicinity of Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom, exploring the surrounding space and seemingly searching for… a suitable ambush location.
"Zi Luo Elder will return sooner or later, and so will Gu Nan. Our best chance to strike will be when he's just returned to the Myriad Heavens and hasn't had time to take control of anything yet."
These two were clearly a monk and a Daoist priest, and it was the Daoist who spoke just now.
However, they were a bit odd. The monk had short hair and even carried a longsword on his back, resembling a sword cultivator more than a monk.
The Daoist, on the other hand, was holding a hossu and had a Daoist hat on his head, but he wore a neat Buddhist robe. The gold and red colors reflected each other, looking very eye-catching.
The monk didn't resemble a monk, and the Daoist didn't resemble a Daoist. This monk-Daoist pair was quite famous in the Myriad Heavens—the Sword Arhat and the Buddhist Daoist.
The Sword Arhat also agreed with the Buddhist Daoist's words, but he still felt a bit stifled. "That person surnamed Duan is the one who has a grudge against Gu Nan, but he's using us as pawns."
"It can't be helped." The Buddhist Daoist sighed. "Who let the Cult Master be about to return, yet we even got the wrong Saint and allowed the real Saint to die at Gu Nan's hands?"
The Sword Arhat sneered, "Isn't that all thanks to Lu Wen? If it wasn't for him swapping the two back then…"
"Forget it," the Buddhist Daoist interrupted with a flick of his hossu. "Only by killing Gu Nan will we have a chance to remedy the situation. Make preparations; we must not allow him to return to his astral world."
The Sword Arhat nodded silently.
Before Rolensia ascended to Unified Dao, Gu Nan was already able to stand up to Graceful Heaven's Fang Chaoyun with his own strength while inside his astral world.
Since then, no one under the Thirteen Heavens dared to claim they had a solid chance of defeating Gu Nan, because no one could do anything about him as long as he hid inside his astral world.
...
Xie Yun had failed once again.
As one of the nine people who came to this side from the Myriad Heavens, Xie Yun's qualifications could be said to be one of the best; An Tiansheng was probably the only one who could compare to her.
Liang Ruxin had the most seniority amongst the nine and was also the most composed, but in terms of qualifications, he still couldn't compare to these two children.
But even so, the 16-year-old Xie Yun was destined to be the last of the nine to acquire a class—it was even possible that she wouldn't be able to obtain a class, because Gu Nan was returning to the Myriad Heavens soon.
"Firearms Expert doesn't suit you," Gu Nan stated indifferently as he placed a data sheet in front of the young girl.
After several failed attempts, Gu Nan had long since realized the problem, but he never spoke to Xie Yun about it until she personally came to ask for advice.
"Why?" Xie Yun asked stubbornly as she glanced down, then was blinded by the paper full of information she couldn't understand.
"Your knowledge of firearms is severely lacking, whether it's their manufacture or assembly and application, not to mention making modifications that best suit you."
Gu Nan paused for a moment and pointed at the paper. "This has the names of every single firearm you've ever used. How can you play as a gunner when you don't even know what they're called or what properties they have?"
"I love firearms!" Xie Yun said loudly, "And aren't guns more powerful the more expensive they are?"
Gu Nan shook his head. Her playing with guns this way was undoubtedly a very embarrassing thing… Hm, that said, there really was a route that suited her.
This slight pause made him remember a very special route.
There were so many routes players could choose in the game that not even Gu Nan could remember them all. The list he wrote down and gave to the nine earlier just had some of the routes that he remembered as being more cost-effective and easier to acquire.
"If you simply like playing with guns, you can try this route." Gu Nan quickly lowered his head and wrote down something before handing it over to Xie Yun.
Xie Yun looked down in confusion, only to see the words "Pay to Win Expert" written at the top of the paper.
The official name for the Pay to Win Expert should be "Gold-Devouring Expert." This route was very peculiar. The player could select a natal weapon, then enhance it by means of "gold."
The natal weapon can be whatever the player wants it to be, but it can't be changed after the route is chosen, only evolved. Improvement of the weapon also improves the player's own strength.
To put it simply, it was paying money to become stronger.
"Strengthening yourself by devouring gold?" Xie Yun did understand this time, because the upgrade logic of a Pay to Win Expert was indeed very simple—just pay gold.
Moreover, the "gold" it referred to really was just the metal itself; any other form of currency or valuables was ineffective.
Xie Yun's eyes lit up when she read the natal weapon's introduction. "Can I choose a gun?"
"Of course."
"Then I choose this route!"
...
Xie Yun came and went in a hurry, but her visit didn't affect much.
Gu Nan was sitting inside the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, about to personally witness the second Unified Dao ascension.
Almost two days had passed since the abnormal phenomenon started inside the Divine Kingdom, and now the signs in the World of Gods were so intense that even Tier 4 mortals could feel them.
Zi Luo Elder was making a breakthrough, while everyone outside was silently waiting for that tipping point to arrive.
Breaking through was a slow and lengthy process, and it wasn't as if one could immediately break through by shouting, "Break through for me!"
It was like adding one straw after another to a camel's back. While it seemed like the final straw caused the qualitative change, in reality, it was no different from the previous straws.
"It's coming," Xue Ren's voice rang in Gu Nan's ears. The world's number one swordsman, who had already reached Gu Nan's side at some point, wore a relieved smile on his face.
"You seem very nervous?" Gu Nan, however, could see the worry in the depths of his eyes.
"Of course." Xue Ren smiled freely. "If the old man's breakthrough fails, then I'm afraid we'll have to rebuild our astral worlds on this side… The matter of ascending to Unified Dao has never been a surefire success."
No one dared to claim they would definitely succeed in breaking through to Unified Dao.
With Xue Ren and Gu Nan's situation where they blatantly offended the Thirteen Heavens, once news of Zi Luo Elder's failed ascension reached the Myriad Heavens, the two of them would probably be the first to have their astral worlds destroyed.
Even if Song Fei himself didn't do anything and didn't issue such an order, there was absolutely no need for him to personally give the word.
Almost at the same time that Xue Ren opened his mouth, Gu Nan saw a purple pillar of light shoot up into the sky, as if something had awakened in the depths of the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom and was heading straight for the sky.
However, at this very moment, a ray of light came from the far east, falling straight towards that purple pillar.
The light from the east seemed to pierce through space itself, having already struck the purple pillar as soon as it lit up. Only then did people have a chance to see what the light was.
It was clearly a ruler, as simple and outdated as those used in private schools in the countryside.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: Ten Years Time Limit
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Ten Years Time Limit
This ruler naturally wasn't a normal ruler. It was Academic Heaven Song Fei's famed weapon: Measuring… It wasn't actually called the Measuring Heaven Ruler; its name was just Ruler.
Song Fei started cultivating in a private school in a small plane, and the ruler he used back then was none other than this one, so this ruler didn't really have a name.
Later on, a disciple asked Song Fei for the name of this ruler—his most famous weapon—and Song Fei said exactly these four words: "Its name is Ruler."
At the most critical moment when Zi Luo Elder was about to break through to Unified Dao, Song Fei finally struck brazenly, using his own weapon to attack from a distance and forcibly piercing the dimensional wall.
"Song Fei…" Xue Ren looked in that direction with a somewhat cold and dark gaze.
He wasn't surprised that Song Fei would make a move; it was obvious. On the contrary, if the other party did nothing, Xue Ren would instead have to wonder if there was some kind of conspiracy behind it.
What really made Xue Ren's heart sink was the fact that Rolensia didn't try to stop it.
This was her Divine Kingdom. It was impossible that she didn't sense Ruler's arrival. Of course, it was also unlikely that she had betrayed the organization.
If she truly betrayed the organization, she could simply kill everyone here; there was no need to go to all this trouble.
So there was only one possibility.
...
"Daphne." Rolensia glared coldly at the graceful noblewoman in front of her, having fallen into a field of verdant green.
Even though this was her Divine Kingdom and she could break through her opponent's restriction in an instant, she already missed the most crucial moment.
The other party appeared at the exact instant the ruler appeared.
Goddess of Nature, Daphne.
There ought to be no communication between the highest levels of the Myriad Heavens and the World of Gods.
That was why Rolensia had completely failed to anticipate that someone would collude with the Myriad Heavens and join forces to prevent Zi Luo Elder's ascension to Unified Dao.
"Why?" Rolensia asked coldly.
A sea of blood immediately destroyed the emerald green barrier, but it was meaningless. The ruler had long since disappeared without a trace, while the influence it left behind festered.
"It's quite simple," Daphne, a mature woman with a dignified aura, answered softly.
"No one wants to see you all rise peacefully and form a behemoth that not even greater gods can restrain."
The existence of the Heaven-God Alliance was something that had It had jumped from a small, obscure organization to a super organization with a greater god at its helm, and now a second never existed before, or at least, it was the first time something like this entered the sights of the greater gods.
It had jumped from a small, obscure organization to a super organization with a greater god at its helm, and now a second Unified Dao member would appear.
As long as the greater gods weren't blind, they wouldn't just sit back and watch the Heaven-God Alliance grow stronger.
Of course, there were also interests entangled between the greater gods, and wanting them to join forces was likewise a joke. At best, they'd just agree on having someone make a move.
And now, Daphne made that move. The reason she was the one making that move was also simple—she wasn't afraid of offending Rolensia at all.
Back when Rolensia was still the God of Luxuriant Blossoms, this Goddess of Nature was an obstacle blocking her path.
Conversely, Daphne also regarded the former as a strong pursuer and made frequent attempts to suppress her both openly and secretly, so the relationship between the two had never been good.
Since there was never any friendship, there was no fear of offending the other party.
"Your power is very interesting." The Goddess of Nature waved with a smile before her figure slowly disappeared.
...
"Song Fei is still the same Song Fei." Lu Wen gently took a sip of the clear wine as a trace of realization appeared on his face.
Lu Wen's generation was relatively new, so he never witnessed the conflict between Song Fei and Zi Luo Elder back then, but he had seen Song Fei's decisive style.
This sage-level figure, who was known as the "Teacher of All Worlds," struck like a genius swordsman, breaking through all illusions and hitting the opponent's vital point with a single blow.
"Whether it's the Heaven-God Alliance or that greater god they have, they're ultimately just external strength." Duan Wenqi also sighed softly. "As long as Zi Luo Elder doesn't enter Unified Dao, Song Fei's position will be as stable as Mt. Tai."
His earlier silence was all for today's fatal strike—this was Song Fei.
"Others only saw the strength of the Heaven-God Alliance, but he saw its fragility." Lu Wen shook his head with a smile. "But then, won't your arrangements have been in vain?"
Duan Wenqi shrugged. "That's even better."
...
Of course, while the Myriad Heavens marveled at Song Fei's acumen, the atmosphere inside the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom was incomparably heavier.
Daoist Lingyang had long since reunited with the crowd, but even Mad Fist no longer had a casual look on his face, his expression grim.
When he first followed Zi Luo Elder to this side, it was to avoid the slim chance of unexpected events happening, but he hadn't expected for an even slimmer possibility to occur.
Gu Nan was likewise present, although he was a bit more composed than the others.
Or perhaps he had already been through countless battles and was experienced as hell. It wasn't like he hadn't encountered situations in the game where his Divine Kingdom was destroyed—it was just a matter of starting from scratch again.
There were even players who felt underprepared and believed their identities would be easily exposed after reaching Tier 10, so they actually destroyed their own Divine Kingdoms to start over.
"We still have a chance," Zi Luo Elder's voice finally rang out and gave the crowd hope as it did so.
This old man slowly walked out from the void, his appearance not much different from earlier, except that there was a bit more flamboyance in his demeanor.
"Elder, you succeeded?" Daoist Lingyang couldn't help blurting out.
Rolensia also appeared, but she didn't say much, only frowning slightly as she looked at Zi Luo Elder.
"I succeeded, and also failed." Zi Luo Elder greeted the crowd and sat down before answering, "Ten years."
He looked at Xue Ren. "I only have ten years. In these ten years, I can protect you from Song Fei and Zou Jiming. You must ascend to Unified Dao within ten years."
"Ten years?" Xue Ren's gaze flickered slightly as he repeated Zi Luo Elder's words in a low voice.
Adding a time limit to the words "Unified Dao" was a matter of immense pressure for anyone, even Xue Ren, who was known to be the closest to Unified Dao Realm.
Zi Luo Elder nodded gently. "I will place the headquarters of the Heaven-God Alliance in Zi Luo Heaven. If you can successfully ascend to Unified Dao, I will also obtain a chance of survival, otherwise, everything will be over."
Xue Ren lowered his head wordlessly at those words, and Zi Luo Elder looked at Gu Nan and the other three again.
"At that time, if things don't go as planned, I'm afraid it'll be difficult for you all to leave the Myriad Heavens again. If you are unwilling to take this risk, you can simply stay on this side."
If they stayed in the World of Gods, at least they already had Rolensia as a powerful backer. The natural organizational relationship between the two sides gave them a basis for an alliance.
Without much hesitation, Mad Fist directly said, "I've fought everywhere on this side. It's time to go back and see my old friends."
He came over at first because he didn't want to take any chances, and as a result, he was faced with an even more difficult choice, so this time, he didn't want to be cautious.
Instead, Daoist Lingyang was silent for a moment before saying, "I'll stay."
Xue Ren looked up in surprise, seemingly not understanding why his old friend would make that decision.
Daoist Lingyang explained with a laugh, "I fear death."
Xue Ren could only shake his head slightly in response, clearly not believing him.
"What about you?" Zi Luo Elder finally turned his gaze towards Gu Nan.
"Can we set off now?" Gu Nan asked. "Ten years—that's cutting it a little close."

chapters.title: Chapter 437: Ambush and  Reorganization
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Ambush and Reorganization
To the true higher-ups of the Myriad Heavens, the ruler that inexplicably appeared in the World of Gods was no secret.
So just when everyone believed that old man would never appear in the Myriad Heavens again…
He came back. Bringing along all the Star Rulers who left with him in the first place, he returned to Zi Luo Heaven bombastically, establishing the headquarters of the now well-known Heaven-God Alliance in Zi Luo Heaven.
Zi Luo Heaven had been an ownerless plane for tens of thousands of years, but the moment Zi Luo Elder returned, it now had a master.
Also from this moment onwards, the term "Thirteen Heavens" officially became a thing of the past. Now, they should be called the Fourteen Heavens.
But what really baffled people was that Academic Heaven's Song Fei didn't express any opinion—let alone make any move—regarding Zi Luo Elder's return.
Similarly, that old man also didn't express any dissatisfaction with the ruler that appeared that day. Both parties acted as if nothing had happened.
This bizarre attitude couldn't help but cause the onlookers to fall silent as well.
If not for the fact that Zi Luo Elder's power couldn't be faked, unintentionally revealed something in a conversation, that the time limit of "ten years" was gradually spread around the world.
people would've thought this was actually a dream.
It wasn't until one day, when one of Song Fei's disciples seemingly unintentionally revealed something in a conversation, that the time limit of "ten years" was gradually spread around the world.
Subsequently, because of the tacit confirmation from the rest of the Unified Dao powerhouses, the news increased in authenticity.
However, these were all later events focused on Zi Luo Elder and had little to do with Gu Nan.
What was truly related to Gu Nan was another matter.
As soon as he re-entered the Myriad Heavens, he returned to his Divine Kingdom, yet the moment he was about to descend, a sword and a hossu hit him simultaneously.
The ambushers, who'd been lying in wait for a long time, hit Gu Nan head-on without any warning—of course, he also had no intention of dodging it.
The longsword instantly pierced Gu Nan's neck, while the hossu struck him hard on his forehead, the strong impact causing space to shatter… Only Gu Nan remained unmoved.
The scene seemed to freeze all of a sudden, and Gu Nan's unresponsive appearance caused the hearts of the two ambushers to turn slightly cold.
"Go!" The Sword Arhat quickly pulled back his sword as he swiftly retreated, already realizing that the ambush was a failure, but he saw his companion lag behind.
The Buddhist Daoist was merely one step slower, yet it was already too late for him, all because the hossu in his hand was already grasped by Gu Nan.
The Buddhist Daoist, a Star Ruler who already possessed Tier 7 strength despite his astral world not reaching Realm Level yet, was powerless before Gu Nan.
All of his laws, attainment, and astral world's power became a joke when he delivered himself to Gu Nan in close combat.
The Sword Arhat was already regretting their decision. They thought only Gu Nan's astral world was special and that the person himself wasn't too strong since he'd only just taken control of an astral world.
However, they didn't realize that merely in terms of personal strength, the other party was also far beyond the two's imagination.
In order to ambush the opponent, they purposely chose to fight in close combat, delivering themselves right to Gu Nan's door.
Gu Nan grabbed the hossu with one hand, a cold smile already on his face as he swung a fist straight at the Buddhist Daoist's head. At the same time, he aimed a kick at the enemy's stomach while his other leg bent, his knee heading towards the Sword Arhat.
