This set of movements was done in a natural, flowing manner, causing Gu Nan's entire body to twist into an odd posture, yet it was full of mechanical beauty.
Gu Nan was at least a virtual reality wrestling master, so his understanding of small-scale fighting really wasn't inferior to these Star Rulers who fought with laws for years on end.
After his initial shock, the Buddhist Daoist didn't hesitate any longer and directly let go of the hossu in his hand, his figure retreating explosively.
However, he clearly couldn't beat Gu Nan in terms of speed, so the Buddhist Daoist could only barely incline his head to avoid Gu Nan's fatal punch, although his stomach was inevitably subjected to that kick.
The Buddhist Daoist felt like his stomach had been hit by a star. He'd never experienced such a hard hit ever since he entered Star Ruler Realm, so this kind of pain was especially unfamiliar to him.
Gu Nan, however, gained momentum and avoided the Sword Arhat by virtue of an earlier knee strike, immediately chasing after the Buddhist Daoist and raining down two more punches.
"Wait!" Seeing that he was unable to stop the other party, the Sword Arhat instantly shouted, "Don't you want to know who sent us here? Someone is secretly scheming you—"
Wham!
Gu Nan's fist struck the head of the Buddhist Daoist, instantly blasting the latter's head to pieces and destroying his soul.
"Not really," Gu Nan shook off the blood on his hand and turned to reply.
...
The ambush near his Divine Kingdom wasn't taken seriously by Gu Nan.
As players leveled up and attracted more and more enemies, this sort of thing had long since become commonplace.
The two's ambush ended with the instantaneous fall of the Buddhist Daoist and the escape of the Sword Arhat; the two didn't die together.
True, the Evil God physique was powerful, but not to the point of omnipotence. Simply put, the goal Gu Nan pursued was invincibility within five meters, and anything outside that range was none of his business.
If the Star Rulers kept enough of a distance from him, it would be very hard for Gu Nan to pursue and kill them. After all, all of these people had many methods of preserving their lives.
Instead, the apostles who were about to welcome Gu Nan's return collectively entered a state of explosive productivity after this incident.
In the days of Gu Nan's absence, both the group of veteran apostles led by Red Tail, who had always been loyal to Gu Nan, and the group of new apostles led by Bai Xi, who had returned from White Bones Realm, all realized Gu Nan's importance.
Normally, it seemed as if the Divine Kingdom could function as usual without Gu Nan, and his absence wouldn't have much of an impact, but the actual situation wasn't so simple.
Without Gu Nan, the Divine Kingdom had no goal. With no one to launch Divine Kingdom Wars and no one to spend the points that piled up, the Divine Kingdom's development was far slower than it had been before.
And when the development of the Divine Kingdom came to a standstill, the apostles naturally couldn't enjoy the benefits of development, be it the pursuit of power or authority.
Thus, with everyone competing to perform their best, a mere two quite obvious among the Star Rulers of the Myriad Heavens. They also made no attempt to hide themselves," Red Tail quickly hours later, information about the monk-Daoist pair was placed in front of Gu Nan's table.
"Pretty fast," Gu Nan couldn't help commenting as he glanced at it.
"The Sword Arhat and the Buddhist Daoist's characteristics are quite obvious among the Star Rulers of the Myriad Heavens. They also made no attempt to hide themselves," Red Tail quickly explained.
Gu Nan nodded and started reading the information. He was actually quite unsuited for the role of a leader or even a manager—
after all, he was just a gamer.
He only knew how to play games and, in passing, learned how to kill people in the game—that was all.
Thankfully, as long as he had enough power, Gu Nan didn't need to fear anyone's betrayal, and there would even be a group of people who would spontaneously gather around him.
All the abilities in this world were important, and among them, the ability to control people's life and death was the most important of them all.

chapters.title: Chapter 438: A New Target
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: A New Target
There was nothing unexpected about the monk-Daoist duo's information.
Two Star Rulers whose strength had already reached Tier 7, but who'd been slow to raise their astral worlds to Realm Level planes.
As for why they ambushed him, Red Tail and the others weren't able to dig too deeply yet and only knew it was related to Duan Wenqi of Astral Gate.
"I'll have to have a chat with this Old Duan sometime," Gu Nan tossed the information aside and said casually.
Gu Nan's mindset in playing games had always been optimal, never letting NPCs' provocations affect his development plan.
After all, if players were led by the nose by NPCs, wouldn't they fall into the game designer's trap?
Gu Nan, who held such a view long ago, could naturally ignore ambushes of this caliber.
In contrast, his long absence from the Divine Kingdom had resulted in a whole pile of matters waiting for Gu Nan to deal with.
The first was that no Divine Kingdom Wars had been launched, but the two dungeons were still being farmed nonstop, and a whole bunch of points had accumulated, so the raw materials for the next war were already prepared.
As long as a suitable invasion target was identified, the points could immediately be invested into troop production, launching an all-out strike with the most suitable troop types.
Another matter was that he already brought back seven members of the player army, and the next step would be their debut in the Myriad Heavens. It was time to verify the might of the player army.
Xie Yun and Liang Ruxin remained in the World of Gods while Lan Si also stayed over there to wait for them. In any case, Gu Nan wasn't worried about any accidents since Rolensia and Daoist Lingyang were looking after them.
It was already afternoon by the time Gu Nan finished dealing with matters inside the Divine Kingdom, and Red Tail handed over a new report just in time.
It pertained to the selection of the next invasion target for their Divine Kingdom, and the top target made Gu Nan pause slightly.
Star Realm.
Noticing Gu Nan's expression, Red Tail, who was also born in Star Realm, revealed a light smile as she explained, "This is a suggestion from the Cabinet, and most of its members have no connection to Star Realm."
Gu Nan knew Red Tail was worried that he would think she was taking advantage of the opportunity to avenge a personal grudge. After all, there was still an unsettled score between her and her fellow tribemates back in Star Realm.
But this wasn't what Gu Nan cared about. Instead, he asked with interest, "The Cabinet has already been built?"
"Yes, about three years after you left… Well, three years inside the Divine Kingdom."
The Divine Kingdom couldn't be left unmanaged for too long, nor could it be left entirely in the hands of a single person, and that was the reason for the Cabinet's existence.
In fact, the intention to establish a Cabinet had already appeared before Gu Nan left, and even the name was given by Gu Nan, with its main duty being managing the Divine Kingdom's internal affairs.
The Cabinet was headed by Yan Xiaoxiao and Red Tail, with a large number of political talents as well as think tanks to assist in the construction of the Divine Kingdom.
Of course, a significant portion of the military generals under Red Tail's command also held positions in the Cabinet.
After all, Divine Kingdom Wars were the main source of revenue for the Divine Kingdom.
"The Cabinet brainstormed over a dozen planes worth attacking and gave evaluations in aspects such as profit, difficulty, casualty expectations, etc. for each target… Star Realm's overall score far exceeds that of the other astral worlds."
Red Tail also read the report and eventually sent it on to Gu Nan, evidently agreeing with the Cabinet's suggestion.
Gu Nan nodded wordlessly as he continued reading the report from the Cabinet.
Just as Red Tail said, the report analyzed the specific situation of several planes in detail and made a judgment on them.
Among them, Star Realm's situation was indeed very much in line with Gu Nan's impression.
According to the report, Star Realm's Star Ruler had been injured ever since ten thousand years ago and was in a state of slumber for a very long time, resulting in extreme chaos inside the plane where multiple parties tried to set up independent regimes.
Compared to White Bones Realm, Clear Profundity Realm, and other iron-clad astral worlds, the difficulty of attacking Star Realm was simply at the level of a newbie village.
And a little over a decade ago, Zuo Zuo's invasion of Star Realm made matters worse, exacerbating Red's injuries.
With its Star Ruler badly injured and the astral world weakened, Gu Nan could hardly find any drawbacks to attacking Star Realm, except for the somewhat troublesome issue of communication inside the plane's starry sea.
"Then let's attack Star Realm," Gu Nan readily accepted the sound advice and agreed without any semblance of pressure.
"Yes," Red Tail immediately answered.
The Cabinet also attached required troop types at the bottom, which Gu Nan had no comments on. The Divine Kingdom already possessed virtually all of the common troop types, and there were basically no mistakes in the Cabinet's choices.
"Before we leave, pick three apostles from the group who will set out on the expedition who pass the test in terms of strength and loyalty," Gu Nan suddenly added.
Red Tail nodded in response, then inquired, "Do you need them to do anything?"
"No." Gu Nan waved his hand. "It's to equip you guys with some equipment."
...
The day after Gu Nan's return, a brand new structure was erected inside the Divine Kingdom.
It looked extraordinarily majestic and spectacular compared to the other structures, both in terms of appearance and size.
It was a palace that, when fully completed, was almost as large as half of the Evil God Temple; after all, it was a miracle structure that couldn't be built without an external blueprint.
On the first day of the Blacksmith Temple's completion, Shana, currently the number one general under Gu Nan's command, received her first weapon from it.
Shana's talent was truly unrivaled, and her strength progressed extremely quickly, leaving the other vampires in the dust in just a few years.
As for Lan Si, the possessor of a Godhead, she was far away in the World of Gods at this time, so this vampire got the first weapon.
After investing a considerable amount of points, what Shana got from it was a dagger.
"Komofil Dagger." Gu Nan instantly recognized the dagger's origin after just a glance. "High damage and high agility, and the self-inflicted damage buff trait goes well with the vampire race."
When one activates this dagger's unique skill, it can spontaneously inflict damage on the user in exchange for an extremely high increase in attack in the next strike.
Shana played with the dagger in her hand for a while, feeling the abundant power contained within. For a moment, she actually loved it too much to let go.
The quality of the equipment produced by the Blacksmith Temple was very high. It wasn't any inferior to players' equipment, and almost all of them were famous divine weapons in the game.
The first batch of divine weapons only went to a select few. Apart from a few apostles such as Shana, only a few people with outstanding military service received them.
And combined with the news that Red Tail was going to pick three apostles next, it would undoubtedly mobilize the apostles in the best way possible.
Gu Nan could ignore this in the past, but now he was in a hurry.
The Divine Kingdom War was the most time-consuming gameplay, and in order to accumulate enough points within ten years, he had to do everything he could to increase his efficiency.
"Then let's set off. Target: Star Realm."
A mere three days later, Gu Nan stood in front of a group of apostles and divine servants in formation and calmly uttered these words.
After many years, Gu Nan finally stepped onto Star Realm's land once again, returning to this large astral world that he first transmigrated to.
It's just that this time, his arrival was full of malice.

chapters.title: Chapter 439: Red
chapters.content:
Star Realm.
Red stayed in her palace as usual, gazing sedately at the boundless starry sky.
Compared to back when Gu Nan was still in Star Realm, Red looked much more haggard. Clearly, the battle with Zuo Zuo back then affected her more than expected.
On this day, a figure slowly appeared in the silent and deserted Sky Palace.
Several shadows simultaneously showed themselves as soon as this figure emerged, blocking the newcomer’s way. They were none other than the guards of Sky Palace.
However, the guards quickly retreated again after they saw the figure’s face, evidently already quite familiar with the newcomer.
"Someone has come again?" Red was still sitting on her throne, calmly looking ahead, as Wu Gui slowly walked over.
Ever since that battle back then, these two had become good allies.
The weak Star Realm actually attracted many covetous invaders before, and Red's power couldn't withstand too much depletion, so it was only with Wu Gui’s assistance that she was able to repel the incoming enemies every time.
Wu Gui didn't answer her directly, instead remarking, "Your guards are getting much better at hiding themselves."
Wu Gui didn’t notice these guards revealing themselves even when she just descended. Red had clearly invested a lot of energy in this area.
Red smiled. "Only after spending many years in silence did I realize that I like this kind of environment."
In the past, Red's palace was very lively. But after Zuo Zuo descended and Qian Han’s betrayal turned all of her guards against her, only then did the term silence come into being.
Wu Gui, however, didn’t smile as she said with a dark expression, "Whether or not you’ve recovered from your past battles, we are in trouble this time."
The expression on Red's face didn't change much, appearing indifferent. "Who's coming?"
"Gu Nan," Wu Gui spat out these two words with force, her expression a little strange.
Red fell into a very long silence, and only after a long time did she slowly open her mouth, "So it's him…"
When Red heard this name, what came to mind first was still Gu Nan’s fleeing figure as he panickedly escaped after blocking a long-distance blow from her many years back. He was barely considered a Star Ruler back then.
But in a little over a decade—the length of a mere nap for Star Rulers—this person had already slaughtered his way back here, with a very different status this time.
Red didn't ask Wu Gui where she heard the news from, because if it was really Gu Nan, the entire Myriad Heavens would know about it as soon as he made a move.
What was Gu Nan's current status?
A powerful core member of the Heaven-God Alliance, the youngest Star Ruler in history, someone who could fight Graceful Heaven’s Fang Chaoyun to a standstill…
In a sense, the pressure Gu Nan brought to the two was even greater than the former Zuo Zuo.
At least Zuo Zuo had obvious weaknesses, and Red had prepared a trap to deal with him long in advance, but what weakness did Gu Nan have?
Those who read his background would discover that ever since Gu Nan's debut, he hadn’t really suffered any genuine defeats—to still manage to retreat even when facing an opponent whose strength far surpassed his own was undoubtedly a glorious victory.
And due to the existence of the Heaven-God Alliance, even more people would praise Gu Nan if not for the “ten years time limit.”
"Have his people already arrived?" Red's gaze swept across the starry sky, and all she saw was divine servants descending from the sky onto every single region.
"It's the same as the rumors said." Wu Gui sighed. "They fear neither injury nor death, and most of them aren’t human."
"Where in the world did he find these fellows…? Forget it, I still have to try."
……
Gu Nan stood in the space above the Central Region, accompanied by none other than Red Tail.
"Aren't you going to meet your fellow clansmen?" Gu Nan looked at Red Tail, who was commanding the divine servants to land and start their slaughter. "Guan Hongchen has gone to pick up her family?"
"Yes." Red Tail nodded. "It's not just her… The apostles from Star Realm are all planning to bring some of their friends and family back to the Divine Kingdom."
Gu Nan didn't have much of an opinion on that. He wasn’t that short on points, and having the apostles bring back their relatives would obviously be a better way to motivate them.
Only after she finished issuing orders to all the divine servants did Red Tail let out a deep breath. "I… don't know what to say if I see my tribe again."
She certainly did have a few close friends in the tribe, but in theory, these people were all targets to be slaughtered.
"You’re the victor now, so say whatever you want." Gu Nan patted her shoulder. "Go on, remember to leave a group of children alive."
Red Tail was stunned, as if she couldn't believe these words were coming from Gu Nan's mouth—when had this one ever shown consideration for others? And he even specifically asked her to spare the children?
"Your Indigo Mound tribe reproduces at a pretty good rate, so we can come back in a few years," Gu Nan added matter-of-factly.
……
Red Tail ended up going to Indigo Mountain, although Gu Nan didn't really care whether she’d heed his words or not.
The claim of leaving children alive was just something he said offhandedly. Who knew what would happen in a few years' time? Besides, whether or not Star Realm would still exist after today depends on Red's attitude.
Just as Gu Nan was thinking, Red's figure unsurprisingly appeared.
"You two actually became a team?" Gu Nan glanced at Wu Gui, who appeared alongside Red, with some surprise.
The current Wu Gui's strength had improved quite a bit from back then. At the very least, she already acquired her own astral world and was Tier 6 at the lowest.
Of course, it was more likely that her astral world always existed, only she finally succeeded in remodeling it, turning it into a Demonic Buddha Kingdom that belonged solely to her.
Even as the reincarnation of a great power, Wu Gui's advancement speed was still ridiculously fast.
It was only when compared to Gu Nan, an even more outrageous fellow, that she was left far in the dust.
Faced with Gu Nan's surprise, Red didn’t respond immediately.
Instead, Wu Gui asked, "What do you want? We can give it to you. Must you attack Star Realm?"
"I want human lives." Gu Nan shrugged indifferently. "If you’re willing to provide them, I will gladly accept such cooperation."
Red finally revealed a sneer. "Meaning I work hard to raise cultivators and then give them to you to slaughter?"
"No." Gu Nan waved his hand and earnestly corrected her, "It's that you can raise cultivators all you want, and my people can kill them all they want. I don't mind if they resist."
Red's gaze gradually turned icy as it landed on Gu Nan. "Then try it."
Even if she was already heavily injured and had yet to recover; even if Star Realm was merely inherited; even if she hadn’t actually managed this plane in a long time… This was ultimately her astral world.
Not just anyone could come and wreak havoc!
Answering the remaining dignity of a Realm Level Star Ruler, an endless red began to descend, enveloping Gu Nan’s entire being, as if his world had turned completely red.
"Try it," two calm words traveled out from the red barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: Indigo Mound Tribe’S Crisis
chapters.content:
Red wasn’t the type of Star Ruler that specialized in offense.
Her abilities were related to blood and the color red, which were more suited for large-scale battles, and if she was commanding a legion, she would be able to have an unimaginable impact.
It was a pity that she was forced to fight against an individual, and Gu Nan happened to be an expert in this area.
The red color was getting thicker and thicker, almost wrapping Gu Nan in a cocoon, and it was already completely impossible to see his figure anymore.
The next second, a loud sound traveled out from within the crimson cocoon, as if something had smashed against the outer shell, and even space shook with a burst of tremors.
Wu Gui actually felt some relief when she saw Gu Nan getting trapped so easily, but at that moment, she glanced at Red in shock.
"Go help," Red spoke laboriously as beads of sweat started to fall from her forehead.
"Help whom?" Wu Gui asked quickly. She believed that with this scene at hand, Red wasn’t trying to ask her to help fight against Gu Nan.
Bang! Bang! Bang…
The loud bangs from inside the cocoon grew louder, and the two could already imagine the scene of Gu Nan's fists smashing heavily against the walls.
"Ying Ge," Red seemed to have used up all her strength to utter those two words.
……
Bang!
Accompanied by some kind of sound similar to glass breaking, the crimson cocoon finally shattered, and an unharmed Gu Nan slowly stepped out from it.
"Your power declined way too much." Gu Nan calmly looked at Red.
He wasn't injured, just stained with some red color. This meant Red's control over her power was no longer able to achieve even the most basic materialization of her laws into physical form.
In a little over a decade, Gu Nan had broken through two consecutive levels and his power had skyrocketed, whereas Red had regressed instead of advancing and couldn’t even compare to her former self from ten years ago.
More importantly, since Star Realm was an outer space-type plane with great distance between planets, the Star Ruler’s control was far weaker than that of an ordinary astral world.
The power that Red could borrow from Star Realm was even weaker than that of some Tier 6 Star Rulers, and she was fighting more with her own strength.
"You told Wu Gui to save Ying Ge?" Gu Nan revealed a smile. "Looks like your relationship isn't that simple."
To think that Ying Ge and Zi Dian were still staying in Star Realm. Moreover, with their levels, they couldn’t pose a threat to Gu Nan at all.
……
Indigo Mountain.
Groups of Dark Knights descended from the sky and started charging while in midair, aiming straight for the peak of Indigo Mountain.
The skeletal warhorses the knights rode galloped wantonly in the air while making loud rumbles that shook the ground.
The leader of the Dark Knights was also a knight, except he was covered in crimson armor, making him particularly conspicuous in the crowd.
Ren Dongzhan, one of the nine members of the player army. The route he chose was the Blood Knight Commander.
The Blood Knight Commander was a so-so route that didn't have many amazing powers, but every ability was very practical.
First, it had the abilities shared by all Knight Commander classes that augmented the user’s commands and strengthened the cavalry, and then it also had the special laws related to blood.
Blood Resurrection, Blood Strengthening, Blood Tracking, and so on—it was quite like a combination of vampires and undead.
This time, he led the Dark Knight Cavalry, and his target was none other than the gathering place of special cultivators, such as Indigo Mountain.
"Who goes there?!"
As the first Dark Knight landed, a clear and delicate voice rang out. There were already quite a few fox ladies standing below.
All the apostles descended as soon as the invasion started, so these natives obviously didn't realize what was happening.
Ren Dongzhan coldly surveyed the fox ladies below. The delicate faces of the Indigo Mound Tribe didn’t move his expression at all under his helmet.
And without any new commands from him, the Dark Knights naturally only carried out their original order.
Charge! Continue charging!
The skeletal warhorses galloped on the void, and each step caused the knights' speed to increase, their charge to pick up momentum, and the converging laws to solidify even further.
That’s right. These Dark Knights, who generally only had Tier 3 strength, were already able to materialize laws because of their characteristics as divine servants.
"Stop now! To dare trespass into my Indigo Mountain, you—"
Before a fox lady could finish her shout, the lance from Ren Dongzhan had already arrived, instantly impaling her skull.
Following closely behind him were the Dark Knights in an extremely fast charge. They had no intention of slowing down at all, stabbing the enemies in front of them before stepping over their corpses.
The knights directly landed on the peak of Indigo Mountain, then headed towards the middle of the mountain, where the fox clan lived.
The six Indigo Mound elders had already shown themselves. All of them were astonished at these enemies that appeared out of nowhere.
However, right at this moment, a layer of mist began to gradually emerge, blocking the path of the Dark Knights' advance.
As soon as the knights entered the mist, their charge slowed down at a speed visible to the naked eye.
No, it wasn't that their charge was slowed down, but rather, it was as if an extremely long distance had been added between them and Indigo Mountain.
"Our utmost gratitude to you, Lord Di Wen. We’d be in trouble this time if you weren’t here," an Indigo Mound elder gave a full bow, expressing her gratitude towards a youth beside her.
"It's a trivial matter." Di Wen waved his hand and laughed. "With me and Xian'er’s relationship, how can I sit back and watch the Indigo Mound tribe suffer?"
By his side stood a beautiful-looking young girl, and a blush surfaced on her face when she heard this.
"I don’t know where these vicious invaders came from… But since they dared to act so unbridled in the Central Region, Starry Ocean Pavilion will teach them a lesson," another Indigo Mound elder also spoke confidently.
The words “Starry Ocean Pavilion” still held a lot of weight in Star Realm, calming the hearts of the crowd.
Di Wen even laughed. "Although these fellows look powerful, they're only at Prodigious Realm. I'm afraid it won't take more than a few minutes for them to run out of strength."
A few minutes passed.
Ren Dongzhan was still leading the charge at the forefront of the cavalry instead of relying on his own strength to move forward quickly, while Di Wen's expression turned a little stiff.
A few more minutes passed. The army had already charged through over half of the mist, yet the cavalry didn't have the slightest intention of slowing down. Di Wen began to exert his full strength.
The mist space was once again stretched, but the cavalry accelerated even faster!
"They're coming!" Di Wen couldn’t manage to stall them any longer and could only reluctantly shout, signaling for the people around him to take shelter.
But what he didn't expect was that the instant his voice fell, a blood-red figure had already taken the lead and arrived in front of him in the blink of an eye!
Blood Knight Commander, Ren Dongzhan!
The blood-red lance in Ren Dongzhan's hand gently reached forward, but it was like a violent ram from some ferocious beast, and Di Wen, who had been hit in the chest, instantly exploded into a cloud of bloody mist.
Immediately following Ren Dongzhan and charging out of the mist was one black hurricane after another. Di Wen's mist was like a perfect acceleration belt, accelerating the Dark Knights’ speed to the extreme.
The Indigo Mound elders who showed up didn’t even have time to grunt in pain before all of them perished in the blink of an eye.
Ren Dongzhan glanced down at the corpses on the ground and led along his warhorse. "Continue charging. By His Excellency’s order, leave none alive."
On this day, blood flowed like rivers on Indigo Mountain, while similar scenes played out all over Star Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 441: Charge!
chapters.content:
Crash!
After another crisp fracturing sound, a layer of red shattered in front of Gu Nan, revealing Red's pale face behind it.
Just as Gu Nan initially guessed, Red's peak power was probably around Tier 8 and had declined after being injured in her early years, falling between Tiers 7 and 8.
But after finally recovering a little through many years of recuperation, she had to fight off Zuo Zuo’s invasion, which was like a leaky house suffering a night of nonstop rain.
And now, her realm was similar to Gu Nan's, although her power was far from enough to compete with the Evil God physique.
Star Realm’s current weak state prevented Red from borrowing too much power to kill Gu Nan in one go, which meant she could only be worn down by him bit by bit.
Gu Nan stepped out fiercely, landing a punch on Red's left shoulder. The latter reacted extremely quickly, and a flash of red covered her shoulder, somewhat blocking the punch.
However, the terrifying force was still transmitted over, causing Red's body to tremble slightly as the bones in her shoulder fractured and broke.
In the next second, her figure instantly disappeared, leaving only a red shadow in its place.
"Can you escape?" Gu Nan laughed silently and soon vanished right after her.
……
On Indigo Mountain, the Dark Knight Cavalry under the leadership of Ren Dongzhan charged again and again, and the entire scene was filled with only the sounds of hoofbeats, screams, and cursing, but not a single sound could be heard from these knights.
They were like a group of ghosts whose sole reason for existence was to kill.
"What in the world are these things?" Ying Ge looked down with a heavy frown from the top of Indigo Mountain. The existence of the Dark Knights struck her as strange.
"They seem to be some sort of ghost or undead, like the thousand-year zombies that awaken in mass graves," Zi Dian held the hilt of his sword with one hand and answered in an uncertain tone.
The two of them only came to Indigo Mountain because of a coincidence, not realizing that they had stumbled right into the middle of the Dark Knight Cavalry’s invasion.
"Let me try." Ying Ge drew a blood-red scimitar from her waist.
Ultimately, these two were not as shameless as Gu Nan and couldn’t bring themselves to abandon a mountain full of Indigo Mound clansmen.
Despite the earlier gruesome deaths of the Indigo Mound elders, the two were not deterred. They could be considered highly skilled, and instead of feeling intimidated, they analyzed the enemy's weaknesses from that encounter.
"That idiot Di Wen, he actually used a spatial distancing technique on ghosts, allowing them to accelerate to their limits," Ying Ge sneered.
Zi Dian also nodded. "Those black-armored knights are only at Prodigious Realm. Let's cut in from their flank."
"Okay."
The instant she responded, the two figures disappeared simultaneously. Years of cooperation had given them a tacit understanding, and they appeared beside the Dark Knight Cavalry’s left flank at the same time, each selecting a knight as their target.
Ying Ge’s scimitar and Zi Dian’s longsword hit their targets simultaneously, and one of the two knights had half of his body sliced off, while the other was impaled through the throat.
"They’re indeed only at Prodigious Realm…" A trace of astonishment surfaced on Ying Ge’s face. She still felt that these monsters weren't that simple.
"Watch out!"
Ying Ge shifted her body to the side without hesitation as soon as she heard Zi Dian’s warning. Only then did she see the blood-red knight in the lead stabbing her original position with a spear.
‘This is a Void Cutter…’
Before Ying Ge finished such a thought, she suddenly felt something clamp around her from behind, as if she was being tightly bound by steel, while Ren Dongzhan's lance aimed straight for her face.
She couldn't help turning around in surprise and saw that the Dark Knight whose body she cut in half was actually using his only remaining arm to hug her in a deadly embrace!
Clang!
Ren Dongzhan's lance was precisely deflected by Zi Dian before it could even hit Ying Ge. Zi Dian then chopped off the Dark Knight's arm with his sword and grabbed Ying Ge’s arm as they flew back, retreating sharply.
Ren Dongzhan glanced at the two coldly but didn’t order the knights to give chase. Having the Dark Knight Cavalry chase after two Tier 4 powerhouses was fine in terms of speed, but they were bound to change directions repeatedly, making it extremely difficult to catch up.
He was a well-known battlefield general before he became Gu Nan’s apostle, so of course he wouldn't make such a mistake.
As for the two who escaped, it wasn’t until they retreated all the way back to the top of the mountain before Ying Ge spoke with lingering fear, "Not even a General Rank zombie can move freely after its head is gone…"
"I'm afraid that those aren't living beings at all." Zi Dian's expression was slightly dark. He also didn't expect Ying Ge to be almost injured as soon as they exchanged blows.
He thought for a moment and said, "Let's go back to meet… that one first and see what exactly happened?"
With these two’s low levels, major events in the Myriad Heavens were a little too far removed from them, so they normally didn't pay much attention to the news. Naturally, they didn’t know what just happened this time.
Ying Ge gritted her teeth, thought carefully for a while, and ultimately said in a low voice, "Let’s try one more time."
……
"Ren Dongzhan."
A voice came from the back, causing the Blood Knight Commander to frown slightly and turn around.
Red Tail slowly walked over, holding the hand of a little girl from the Indigo Mound tribe. This little girl had messy hair and a dirty face. She hastily shrunk back as soon as she saw the Dark Knight Cavalry.
Red Tail gently patted her head, signaling that she didn't need to be afraid, before leisurely opening her mouth.
"My Lord ordered us to leave the young children of the Indigo Mound tribe alive."
Ren Dongzhan's gaze turned a little serious, and he said in a deep voice, "The order I received was… slaughter everything."
While speaking, he also glanced down slightly at the little girl, his icy gaze causing the latter's body to tremble slightly, almost crying out.
"The order has changed!" Red Tail suddenly raised her voice. She was the chief commander of this operation; even Ren Dongzhan's team was dispatched under her orders.
However, Ren Dongzhan only revealed a cold smile, not even sparing Red Tail another glance as he leapt onto his horse.
"Charge!"
As his command fell, the Dark Knight Cavalry once again charged upwards. They had already slaughtered their way through the entire Indigo Mountain and were now about to return to the mountaintop.
Even until the Dark Knights’ figures disappeared, Ren Dongzhan didn’t even look back for a second.
Red Tail crushed a talisman with a dark expression as she issued an order to a few other apostles, who were none other than the subordinates she originally recruited from White Mist.
"Immediately bring people over to Indigo Mountain!"
Just as Red Tail issued her order, a red light suddenly lit up at the top of Indigo Mountain. Ying Ge’s scimitar had reappeared, this time pointing straight at Ren Dongzhan.
Ying Ge and Zi Dian had realized that gradually wearing down the enemy troops wasn’t very realistic, so it was better to capture the leader first!
The same time the scimitar appeared, a purple sword energy also surrounded Ren Dongzhan's body, actually separating him from the surrounding Dark Knights.
The two of them had a clear division of labor, and they were also certain that Ren Dongzhan's strength was inferior to Ying Ge’s, so even a single exchange would be enough to seriously injure him!
What they didn't expect, however, was this Blood Knight Commander's response.
"Charge! Charge!"
A sharp command rang out in the military formation, and the entire Dark Knight Cavalry once again picked up speed—Ren Dongzhan actually had no intention of retreating at all and instead chose to continue charging!

chapters.title: Chapter 442: The Role Of Divine Servants
chapters.content:
The military formation crashed into Ying Ge and Zi Dian with unparalleled might.
The crimson scimitar and the longsword named "Purple Lightning" easily struck Ren Dongzhan, but the latter's face was as hard as iron, and his expression didn’t even change.
Strengthened by the Blood Knight Commander, the charging Dark Knights displayed an unimaginably powerful force of impact.
Over a dozen consecutive collisions knocked Zi Dian back to the point of coughing up blood, and he could only hurriedly disengage from the battle formation and look down with shock.
One should know that his sword energy wasn’t just a normal sword technique. Rather, it contained a powerful law that belonged exclusively to Void Cutters, yet it was actually shattered by the charge of a group of Prodigious Realm soldiers.
On the other side, as Ying Ge pulled her scimitar out of Ren Dongzhan, the charging battle formation also reached her.
In the end, she was still a top-notch Void Cutter, and at this most critical juncture, her body actually loosened up as her entire body turned into blood, scattering onto the ground.
This was her very final life-saving trump card. She would be able to revive herself as long as even a drop of blood remained.
But it was rather unfortunate that the enemy Ying Ge ran into this time held the class of Blood Knight Commander.
As soon as he saw his opponent turn into blood, Ren Dongzhan gave a sharp tug on his horse’s reins, whereupon the Dark Knights behind him stopped on the spot without taking a half step more.
The image looked incomparably bizarre, with all the knights stopping in an instant, as if inertia didn’t exist at all.
Ren Dongzhan planted his lance on the ground, and a bright light emitted from the crimson armor in front of his chest, to the extent that the strange patterns painted on it gradually lit up.
Attracted by the crimson light from the armor, all the blood in the surroundings began to spontaneously rise up and head in Ren Dongzhan's direction.
Even Red Tail, who was in the back, felt a suction force, as if all the blood in her body was about to be pulled out, let alone Ying Ge, who bore the brunt of the attack.
"No!" Zi Dian seemed to realize something and screamed furiously, his entire body rushing towards Ren Dongzhan like he’d gone mad.
Ren Dongzhan's face was expressionless, yet he seemed to suddenly sense something and glanced up at the sky in confusion.
All the way at the end of the horizon, a palm print laced with gold and purple seemed to be descending.
……
Deep in the starry sky in Red’s palace, one guard after another appeared from the void, fiercely stabbing at Gu Nan, only to disappear an instant later.
"Quite the interesting guards, but they can only delay your defeat." One of these unpredictable attacks stabbed Gu Nan in the stomach, but his expression didn’t even change.
Red's true power lay in the fact that she could buff her subordinates—that was the greatest use of her astral world’s power.
That was why she had a thousand guards in her palace back then, only to be betrayed by Qian Han and her guards slaughtered thanks to his schemes.
Now, however, she changed her mindset and made all the guards hidden servants. Under the red curtain's enhancement, their offensive and defensive abilities increased dramatically, becoming the most terrifying assassins.
It had to be said that even against Zuo Zuo, her current method was far more effective than her former method, but it was a pity that she was now dealing with Gu Nan.
Thud!
Another knife stabbed into the right side of Gu Nan's stomach, and this time, Gu Nan finally grabbed the opportunity and suddenly stretched out his right hand and punched the space directly in front of him.
A cloud of bloody mist exploded violently in front of him as half of a corpse fell out of the void; it was the guard who had most of his body blasted apart.
At the same time, the wound on Gu Nan’s body healed rapidly, completely recovering in the blink of an eye.
Normal Star Ruler invasions prioritized finishing the battle in the shortest time possible, as they couldn’t possibly fight a war of attrition on the enemy’s own turf, which was equivalent to courting death.
But Gu Nan was only using his physical body to fight, which allowed him to choose the strategy to stall the opponent while his divine servants went on the offensive and invaded territories—which was his goal to begin with.
But this time, Red was very calm. "I prepared three thousand guards for you, so you can take your time playing with them… I hope those subordinates of yours can survive against Wu Gui."
What Gu Nan didn’t expect was for Red's intentions to be the same as his. As long as Gu Nan, the strongest combatant, was stalled, Wu Gui could completely wipe out his underlings.
Gu Nan's movements suddenly stopped for a second, which caused him to be stabbed two more times, but he didn't care.
"Thanks for the reminder." He nodded at the deepest part of the palace, then tanked the assassination attempts of countless guards as he forcibly opened a spatial passage and slowly walked in.
……
Wu Gui’s palm strike landed on Indigo Mountain, instantly slapping Ren Dongzhang into the ground and interrupting the blood extraction.
The droplets of blood belonging to Ying Ge took advantage of that opportunity to escape and manifested her form next to Wu Gui, gasping for air with an expression full of fright.
She never imagined that the other party would be so decisive. If she was given a chance to do it over again, she would never choose to attack Ren Dongzhan again.
"Are you alright?" Wu Gui's gaze lingered on Ying Ge for a moment and asked blandly.
Ying Ge shook her head slightly as she sheathed her scimitar. "I’m fine… Hmm? He's still alive."
Ren Dongzhan was still crushed flat on the ground, but a few drops of blood were converging towards the center.
The next moment, the blood swelled up violently, transforming into a new Ren Dongzhan who swiftly mounted his horse.
"Wait!" A voice interjected. Red Tail had rushed over.
She cast Ren Dongzhan a glance, signaling for him to back off for the time being. Red Tail was a person who came from Star Realm and was fully aware of what kind of identity the one before her held. Wu Gui was by no means someone the Dark Knight Cavalry could oppose.
"Buddhist Ancestor Wu Gui." She then looked at Wu Gui and said, "This time, His Excellency is pouring all his efforts into attacking Star Realm. The destruction of this realm is imminent, so why must you involve yourself in this mess?"
But what kind of personality did Wu Gui have? When had she ever cared about a mere mortal’s words? She immediately sneered, "It's not your place to lecture me."
Red Tail gritted her teeth and was about to say something else, but a loud sound came from behind her.
"Charge!"
"Have you gone mad?!" Red Tail couldn't help turning around and cursing, but what entered her sight was the image of the Dark Knight Cavalry without a single person retreating.
She turned back again and saw Ren Dongzhan’s figure charging forward without hesitation even though he couldn’t withstand even a single blow from Wu Gui.
The sneer on Wu Gui's face became more pronounced, and she casually sent out a palm strike. The Buddhist and demonic intent intertwined, all of a sudden swelling up into a huge handprint that destroyed most of the Dark Knights.
But even so, Ren Dongzhan still revived again and led the remaining Dark Knights, charging at Wu Gui and picking up speed.
But anyone could tell that Ren Dongzhan's power had started to wane; it was clear that his resurrection wasn’t without cost.
"Why…?" Red Tail was speechless for a while, completely unable to understand this senseless act of throwing his life away.
"Good job."
Just then, however, she heard an appreciative voice near her ears. She hurriedly turned to see Gu Nan already standing beside her.
"Learn from him." Gu Nan pointed at Ren Dongzhan in front of her and said to Red Tail, "Divine servants are meant to be sacrificed. Sooner or later, you'll have to kill a Star Ruler by throwing waves of expendable troops at them. You’re too softhearted."

chapters.title: Chapter 443: Unexpected Variable
chapters.content:
The current Gu Nan could shrug off the points needed to create the Dark Knights.
Divine Kingdom Wars were a type of large-investment, large-gain playstyle, and the most difficult part was undoubtedly the initial accumulation of points.
By the time a player successfully formed an army and managed to conquer a plane, the points earned would often be more than what they invested.
The hardest part of the First Round wasn’t players not knowing how to make money; rather, it was players not knowing how to spend money. Newbies tended to make the mistake of conserving their points, which actually lowered their efficiency.
That was why Gu Nan was quite appreciative of Ren Dongzhan's approach.
Even if he was just throwing his life away, it could nevertheless serve as an example to others—anyhow, resurrecting mortals was no longer a difficult task after obtaining Macefield's crystal ball.
As subordinates, they need only carry out orders meticulously. Weighing the gains and losses wasn't something they should do, especially when Gu Nan himself didn't care about the losses.
Regardless of Gu Nan's war policy, his arrival was a turning point for the battlefield.
Wu Gui was the first to sense that something was wrong, and she didn't have any intention of fighting Gu Nan. She casually slapped Ren Dongzhan down, while her other hand had already swept Ying Ge and Zi Dian into her kasaya with a light wave.
However, she felt a blur in front of her eyes just as she was about to retreat; Gu Nan was already standing in front of her at some point.
Wu Gui launched a palm strike without hesitation, and boundless Buddhist chants instantly enveloped their surroundings, making Gu Nan feel as if he was in the Kingdom of Three Thousand Buddhas.
It was the same Buddhist kingdom as the one she created in the past, but Wu Gui had to make sufficient preparations to call it out back then, while she could casually create it now, so she clearly made tremendous progress.
Unfortunately, Gu Nan's changes were even greater, and with his current realm, he was able to tank Wu Gui’s attack without any pressure.
Gu Nan’s fist smashed into Wu Gui’s palm, whereupon all the Buddhist chants disappeared in this instant and all the Buddhas crumbled and disintegrated, while Wu Gui’s entire body flew backwards.
"Mm, you guys continue." Gu Nan glanced down at them. Then his figure instantly disappeared, actually returning to the depths of the starry sea.
……
In the blink of an eye, Gu Nan had traveled back and forth between the Sky Palace and Indigo Mountain, and after severely injuring Wu Gui, he once again stood in front of Red.
Based on his estimate, after Wu Gui received a direct punch from himself, even if she didn't die on the spot, she wouldn't have much fighting power left.
Even if she could still attack, he could simply give her a second punch.
Red's face, however, was pale. Her ghostly guards continued to gather one after another, surrounding Gu Nan on all sides. Having already learned her lesson, she didn't want to make the mistake a second time.
Red’s initial plan was to lure Gu Nan here and utilize her home-field advantage and her own power to the extreme as a means of stalling her opponent.
Apart from that, her other words and actions were nothing more than psychological warfare.
It’s just that she hadn't expected Gu Nan to be so tough to the point that he could withstand all the attacks from the Crimson Guards and still leave her palace.
But in Gu Nan's view, there was nothing remarkable about it. It was nothing more than a tactical contest between the two sides.
Red wanted to utilize her own advantages by using an army to slow him down, so of course he could do the reverse, utilizing the army’s shortcomings of being too bulky and far less agile than himself to counterattack.
At this point in time, Red no longer had many trump cards left.
She wasn’t a Star Ruler who had a wide network of friends to begin with. She couldn't even manage her own astral world all these years because all her time was spent trying to recuperate from her injuries.
If the script went on like this, Red would have to helplessly watch her astral world be invaded and completely destroyed by Gu Nan's army of divine servants.
And the divine servants did indeed do so. Under the leadership of their respective apostles, they simultaneously launched attacks on all nine major regions, and the flames of war instantly engulfed Star Realm.
Gu Nan could also use this to gain a large amount of points. Based on earlier estimates, he would likely be able to save enough points to advance to Tier 8 this time.
After all, although Star Realm was internally weak, largely due to the characteristic of an outer space-type astral world making it impossible to centralize high-end power, the total value of points wasn’t low.
But reality was never as rosy as the script.
Just as Gu Nan was leisurely dealing with the Crimson Guards’ attacks in the Sky Palace, he and Red’s expressions changed simultaneously.
"So there were more helpers?" Gu Nan glanced at Red with a smile that didn’t reach his eyes.
In his senses, a Star Ruler was descending from the Myriad Heavens, going directly to a region in Star Realm and sniping Gu Nan's army of divine servants.
However, this Star Ruler wasn’t very strong and appeared to have barely reached Tier 6. He most likely hadn’t even chosen an astral world yet.
But instead of a look of understanding, Red’s expression seemed equally puzzled. However, such an emotion only flickered for a second before disappearing. She was fully aware that the most important thing right now was to prevent Gu Nan from seeing through her bluff.
Gu Nan didn't think much of it as his figure vanished once again. This time, the Crimson Guards couldn't even delay his departure at all; it was clear that he’d already familiarized himself with their attack patterns.
Gu Nan's figure instantly appeared in front of that Star Ruler and swung a punch down without another word. The terrifying force behind that punch caused the Star Ruler to instantly change color.
But at that instant, an inexplicable sense of danger rose up in Gu Nan's heart, as if there was a thorn in his back, causing him to subconsciously pull back his punch.
The warning from the Evil God physique was indeed accurate. At the same time Gu Nan withdrew, a solemn and rigid "kill" character appeared out of thin air in his original position.
An old man with white hair and beard slowly appeared. There was no expression on his face, but his gaze was firmly fixed on Gu Nan.
"Fang Chaoyun?" Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow when he saw the new arrival.
This person was none other than Graceful Heaven’s Fang Chaoyun, who'd previously been injured at Gu Nan's hands. He was Song Fei's disciple as well as a powerful Tier 10 Star Ruler, and was considered a bigshot even in the Myriad Heavens.
Gu Nan laughed involuntarily, not expecting someone with this person’s status to actually pay a special visit just to look for his trouble.
But Fang Chaoyun's next words made Gu Nan realize that the other party not only came to find trouble for Gu Nan, but that he intended to keep finding trouble for him.
"Gu Nan." Fang Chaoyun slowly stepped forward and said in a low voice, "Star Realm’s Star Ruler has no grudges against you, so why are you invading this plane?"
"None of your business," Gu Nan shot back rudely.
Fang Chaoyun, however, sneered. "If the chaos of war rages on endlessly, then it will devastate all living beings. This humble one lives life holding the Confucian teachings in the highest regard and accepts the responsibility of protecting the safety and security of all common people, so how can I sit back and watch you run amok?"
This erudite speech gave Gu Nan a slight headache, but he got the meaning.
To put it simply, it was just one sentence: “If you, Gu Nan, want to invade other astral worlds in the future, you’ll have to ask me, Old Fang, first.”
After all, Old Fang was a Tier 10 Star Ruler. The only reason he suffered injuries at Gu Nan’s hands previously was because he courted death by running inside Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom. But if they fought outside, he really didn’t fear Gu Nan.

chapters.title: Chapter 444: Mastermind
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was also facing a dilemma.
Sooner or later, invasions of other planes would give rise to a collective resistance towards the end; this was inevitable. It was impossible for the Star Rulers to not understand the principle of “if the rabbit dies, the fox will also grieve,” as any of them could become the target of the next invasion.
But someone like Fang Chaoyun, who made it clear that he wanted to oppose Gu Nan under the excuse of righteousness, was still a bit troublesome.
This old man had strength, connections, and a strong backing, so he really was pretty much invulnerable. It was almost impossible to find any weaknesses of his.
However, it wasn’t just once or twice that Gu Nan encountered high-difficulty missions, so of course he wouldn’t just give up like this. He already swung a fist at Fang Chaoyun without another word.
A familiar "suppress" character appeared, easily blocking Gu Nan.
"Weaker than last time, but not much weaker…" Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry to follow up with another attack after his first blow was ineffective, instead analyzing the enemy's situation.
Normally, it would take Fang Chaoyun at least a hundred years to recover from the injuries he sustained last time, but now it looked like even though he was still injured, it was no longer as serious.
This was undoubtedly Song Fei’s doing.
Even more unexpectedly, nearly ten Star Rulers appeared simultaneously in the blink of an eye, entering Star Realm from various places and targeting the divine servants who were in the midst of slaughter.
Gu Nan frowned slightly, giving up the plan of killing the enemies by sacrificing a large number of divine servants, and decisively sent an order to his Divine Kingdom.
"Full retreat. Save as many divine servants as possible."
His voice rang out simultaneously in the hearts of all apostles, so the army of divine servants that entered Star Realm instantly changed formation, fleeing inside Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom in unison.
Of course, losses were inevitable with the intervention of Star Rulers. A Star Ruler was still too powerful for most of the divine servants under Tier 4.
Divine servants obeyed orders unconditionally, and there was no such thing as distance when traveling through the void, so the retreat was extremely fast.
Fang Chaoyun's senses were similarly scanning the whole Star Realm. He made no move to stop Gu Nan's troops from withdrawing en masse, instead making a lot of posturing before speaking.
"It's not too late to recognize your mistakes and reform yourself." Fang Chaoyun stroked his beard and laughed. "I hope that you’ll be able to restrain yourself after this, or else I don't mind taking further disciplinary action."
After announcing that, he actually turned and returned to his own astral world without waiting for Gu Nan’s response.
This was probably the cultured person’s version of a threat. And at the same time Fang Chaoyun disappeared, those individual Star Rulers also cleanly vanished in the blink of an eye, as if afraid Gu Nan would catch them.
"How interesting." Gu Nan revealed an odd smile.
……
"That wasn’t a wise decision," Lu Wen said bluntly while sitting across from Duan Wenqi inside Clockwork Heaven.
But Duan Wenqi wasn't angry. He knew that he often couldn’t see things as clearly as his old friend did, so he didn't mind listening to Lu Wen’s opinion.
Lu Wen didn't even give Duan Wenqi a chance to open his mouth and continued straightforwardly, "It's fine to incite those two idiots to find trouble for Gu Nan—that’s just a trivial matter. But cooperating with Fang Chaoyun…"
Towards the end, Lu Wen couldn't help letting out a deep sigh. "Everyone else is trying to avoid getting dragged into the fight between Zi Luo and Song Fei at all costs, so why did you voluntarily stick your nose into that mess?"
That’s right. The fact that Fang Chaoyun would personally oppose Gu Nan and even enlist the help of over ten Star Rulers was largely due to Duan Wenqi.
He was the first to bring up Gu Nan's wanton behavior and gain Fang Chaoyun's approval, and he was also the one who personally went out and contacted the Star Rulers connected to Academic Heaven to join forces against Gu Nan in Fang Chaoyun's name.
It could be said that after this incident, Duan Wenqi had completely taken Song Fei's side.
Duan Wenqi's status and strength weren’t low, so the fact that he was in such a hurry to pick a side was what Lu Wen found incomprehensible.
Faced with Lu Wen’s question, Duan Wenqi just smiled. "As long as you choose the right side, you can gain more benefits than if you don't help either side, isn't that right?"
Lu Wen frowned slightly, but in the end, he didn't try to persuade him any further and could only let out a helpless sigh.
……
Inside the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan was already sitting in the Evil God Temple, waiting for the results of this tally.
"How are the losses?"
"We lost over 80% of divine servants, and 10 apostles died in battle, all of whom ended up dying at the hands of Star Rulers." Red Tail's expression was grave, even a little gloomy.
She couldn't see the existence of points, but she was well aware of how much time Gu Nan had spent preparing for the sake of this batch of divine servants, and she hadn't expected to lose over half of them in the blink of an eye.
Simultaneous attacks from over ten Star Rulers was a little too strong. Every single one of them seemed to be here to kill and maim the army. They struck mercilessly without any regard to protecting Star Realm.
The apostle side was still alright. Although the losses weren't small either, at least no important figures were killed in action.
And after this setback, Red Tail, who originally planned to teach Ren Dongzhan a lesson, was no longer in the mood.
Gu Nan merely nodded lightly, not as worried as Red Tail. The first batch of divine servants took a long time to manufacture largely due to having to construct and upgrade structures. It didn't actually take many points to manufacture divine servants.
On the other hand, although this invasion wasn’t perfect, the harvest was still good.
They only conquered roughly 70% of Star Realm, but the points gained were quite substantial. It wasn't far from reaching the point requirement for Tier 8, and it was entirely possible to make up the remaining points by farming dungeons. At most, it would take a few months in real time.
But on the flip side, if he could take down Star Realm in one fell swoop, Gu Nan's points could completely explode in an instant, so Fang Chaoyun and his group still caused significant losses.
"Teacher, a secret message from the Heaven-God Alliance." At this moment, Yan Xiaoxiao's figure appeared.
Gu Nan accepted the secret message with a nod, unsurprised. Fang Chaoyun was targeting him, and if one was to claim that Song Fei and Zi Luo Elder’s feud didn’t play a role in this, not even Gu Nan himself would believe that.
Of course the Heaven-God Alliance would respond in this situation.
Unsurprisingly, the secret message explained the cause of this matter in detail, naturally focusing on the person who convinced over ten Star Rulers to strike at the same time.
The letter didn’t contain any suggestions on how to respond to this matter, but instead, it invited him to visit Clear Profundity Realm to catch up.
The inscription was the new ruler of Clear Profundity Realm, Daoist Zhuangxuan.
"Duan Wenqi," Gu Nan softly recited the name.
From his memory, the conflict between him and this Astral Gate elder wasn't really that big. He didn’t expect for this side quest that he hadn't freed up time to resolve to lead to a much larger side quest.
In any case, the Tier 10 Fang Chaoyun was not someone he could deal with for the time being. Gu Nan's plan had changed to waiting for enough points to accumulate, traveling to the World of Gods to harvest Evil Value, and advancing to Tier 8 before doing anything about this.
He had to lay low when it was necessary to lay low. Brainless brute force was not wise. At least he would no longer fear Fang Chaoyun in direct combat after reaching Tier 8, so it wasn't as if he didn't have a way to deal with this group of people by then.
He also needed to make a trip to Clear Profundity Realm to see the Heaven-God Alliance’s internal stance on this matter, since its essence was still a fight between Zi Luo Elder and Song Fei.
But before that…
"Duan Wenqi," Gu Nan repeated the name once more, a cold smile on his face as a transparent crystal orb appeared in his hand, "you think Lu Wen can protect you?"
Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb.

chapters.title: Chapter 445: Cause
chapters.content:
Duan Wenqi left Clockwork Heaven and subconsciously headed towards Zi Luo Heaven, but he immediately stopped in his tracks.
Only after letting out a small sigh did he turn around and head to another astral world, which was his own—Savage Beasts World.
Speaking of which, Duan Wenqi hadn't been here for a long time. This was truly an inconceivable thing for a Star Ruler.
The astral world was a Star Ruler’s foundation and the cornerstone of their power. Even if one felt that their astral world was terrible in every aspect, they could simply switch to a different astral world. There really was no need to make life difficult for themselves.
Back when Gu Nan first met him, he sensed that Duan Wenqi’s power was almost on par with Red’s.
In terms of just his own cultivation, Duan Wenqi wasn’t any weaker than Red, but his astral world was still a World Level plane. No matter how weak Star Realm was, it was a genuine Realm Level plane, so the two weren’t on the same level at all.
Savage Beasts World’s slow development also had a lot to do with the fact that Duan Wenqi invested much of his time into Astral Gate.
Savage Beasts World was a typical uncivilized plane where civilization stopped at a very backward level, similar to the ancient eras in many planes’ legends.
And the origin of the name Savage Beasts World was precisely due to the fact that this place was filled with a large number of beast races.
Great beasts of all shapes and sizes wantonly roamed this vast wilderness, engaging in the most primitive forms of predation and survival.
Only when he returned to his own astral world did Duan Wenqi truly lower his guard, slapping a palm down as if he was venting and slicing off half of a mountain in front of him. The irritation in his heart was evident.
"That damned Zi Luo…"
Duan Wenqi's eyes were bloodshot, veins bulged out on his forehead, and he was breathing heavily, unable to calm down for a long time.
Star Rulers rarely lost their tempers to this extent.
Lu Wen had trouble understanding Duan Wenqi’s deliberate targeting of Gu Nan—this was natural, because Duan Wenqi wasn't trying to target Gu Nan at all; he was trying to target Zi Luo Elder.
From the very beginning, Duan Wenqi had to be on Song Fei's side, so did he still need a reason to target Gu Nan?
He, Duan Wenqi, had toiled away for tens of thousands of years to manage Astral Gate, so much so that he didn’t even have time to manage his own astral world. Now that Astral Gate became a dowry for someone else overnight, how could he not be annoyed?
The first thing Zi Luo Elder did after returning to the Myriad Heavens was to station the Heaven-God Alliance in Zi Luo Heaven, while the second was to incorporate all pre-existing organizations inside Zi Luo Heaven into his own forces.
Regardless of their size, all of these organizations must come under the banner of the Heaven-God Alliance and become subsidiary organizations of the Heaven-God Alliance, or else they would be expelled from Zi Luo Heaven.
This move was incomparably tyrannical, but the major organizations had no choice but to accept it.
For one thing, the other party was a Unified Dao powerhouse and the rightful owner of Zi Luo Heaven, so they were simply powerless to resist. Additionally, after so many years of operation, everyone's roots were already firmly planted in Zi Luo Heaven, making it impossible for them to move to another location.
Many people didn't understand Zi Luo Elder’s motives behind this, but only Duan Wenqi knew—it was because Zi Luo Heaven’s origin law was none other than the law of organizations.
Every Star Ruler had their own law, and the existence of such laws would inevitably affect their astral world.
It was just like how it was easier to cultivate swordsmanship in Extreme Sword Heaven and how opening a school in Academic Heaven would benefit both teachers and students alike. The core law of an astral world genuinely influenced that world.
The core law of Zi Luo Heaven was organizations, so when Zi Luo Elder disappeared, this place became the perfect place for all major organizations to develop.
It was precisely because it was a special law like "organizations" that it overlapped with Song Fei's law of “education.”
Both of them needed to mentor later generations in order to advance their own cultivation, which was why Zi Luo Elder blocked Song Fei's path back then.
That was exactly why Zi Luo Elder went to all the trouble to manage the Heaven-God Alliance and spared no effort to help Rolensia, Xue Ren, and the others reach Unified Dao.
To him, helping others was helping himself.
However, this kind of move was extraordinarily unacceptable to Duan Wenqi… because his law was also organizations!
He’d managed Astral Gate for so many years, even secretly taking over some small external organizations, so his power in Zi Luo Heaven had swelled to a rather terrifying degree.
If he was given another few thousand years, perhaps he really would be able to take the entire Zi Luo Heaven into his own hands through the means of peaceful developments.
"Representative," a voice rang out beside Duan Wenqi. The newcomer was a young man in blue.
This person's name was Fang Tun, Duan Wenqi's trusted aid from the former Astral Gate.
Under Duan Wenqi's orders, Astral Gate was one of the few organizations that flat-out refused to be incorporated and decisively moved into Savage Beasts World—it was also fortunate that Astral Gate's main business was reincarnation, or else the losses would’ve been too great to accept.
Hearing this familiar title, Duan Wenqi slowly gathered his emotions and nodded. "How is the transfer of members going?"
Fang Tun reported with a bitter smile, "There’s not much of a problem in other areas, it's just that the reincarnation work has all but stopped… This isn't a Realm Level plane yet."
If it wasn’t a Heaven or Realm Level plane, it was naturally impossible to reincarnate into other planes.
Duan Wenqi was taken aback. Living in Zi Luo Heaven all these years nearly made him forget this rule. If everything had gone smoothly, he wouldn't even have to consider this problem in the first place, but…
His hatred towards Zi Luo Elder increased a little more. Duan Wenqi could only say, "Arrange for them to reincarnate from inside Clockwork Heaven for the time being. I'll think of a solution for this side."
Fortunately, Le Wen was his close friend, so he didn't have to worry too much.
Only, Duan Wenqi never could’ve imagined that the greatest calamity of his life since he became a Star Ruler was about to arrive.
……
"Who are you?"
Inside the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan looked at the tall, thin Daoist standing in front of him and asked suspiciously.
"This humble Daoist is Zhuangxuan. I'd like to trouble you to accompany this humble Daoist to Clear Profundity Realm," the Daoist bowed his head and answered in a voice devoid of emotion.
Gu Nan finally remembered him. This was the one who wrote the secret letter on behalf of the Heaven-God Alliance. Daoist Lingyang had stayed behind in the World of Gods, so it was only natural for someone to inherit Clear Profundity Realm.
It’s just that this succession was so swift that the successor even inherited Daoist Lingyang’s responsibilities inside the Heaven-God Alliance, which was a bit too decisive. This hinted at only one possibility—Daoist Lingyang intended to step down a long time ago.
That old Daoist’s face emerged in Gu Nan's mind. He had indeed arranged everything in advance.
"Daoist Lingyang is…"
"My revered master."
Although Daoist Lingyang appeared quite normal, Gu Nan didn’t expect him to raise such an old-fashioned disciple.
Shrugging this off, Gu Nan nodded and put away the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb in his hand as he casually said, "I'm dropping by somewhere else first. I'll visit Clear Profundity Realm after I'm done."
After saying this, he was about to turn and leave, but Zhuangxuan frowned slightly and blocked his way. "Please wait, esteemed one. You may not have understood what has happened… This time, not only your affairs were targeted. Senior Xue and Senior Mad Fist also received simultaneous attacks."
Gu Nan was slightly taken aback. He truly didn’t expect for the enemy’s plan to be so grand as to affect all three core members of the Heaven-God Alliance whose identities were already exposed.

chapters.title: Chapter 446: Zhuangxuan
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan arrived at Clear Profundity Realm, a few core members of the Heaven-God Alliance were also there, namely Xue Ren, Mad Fist, and Imperial Glory Heaven's Immortal Empress Taisheng.
The Immortal Empress ultimately decided against leaving the Myriad Heavens back when Zi Luo Elder planned to bring a group to the World of Gods, but now she was present here.
This time, she wasn't afraid of being exposed anymore. The reason was simple—her left hand was wrapped in white bandages.
"Looks like quite a few people were attacked." Gu Nan scanned the circle. Xue Ren and Mad Fist’s expressions didn't look very good, so it was clear that this was a meeting for people who were attacked. Evidently, the situation was a bit serious.
Xue Ren only had ten years to reach Unified Dao, yet even he took time away from cultivating to run here. It was clear that this problem had reached the most critical stage.
"The old man was also attacked," Xue Ren announced in a low voice upon seeing Gu Nan arrive, then pointed upwards.
This finally surprised Gu Nan. He didn’t expect for Zi Luo Elder’s return to the Myriad Heavens to be more powerless than expected.
"Song Fei?"
"It would still be alright if it was him… It was Jiu Po," Xue Ren's voice sounded heavy. Compared to Academic Heaven's Song Fei, who always stood in the center of the stage, Star Ruler Jiu Po was a much tougher nut to crack.
This Star Ruler was likewise one of the oldest Unified Dao cultivators, and he was precisely the one who helped Song Fei back then, knocking Zi Luo Elder into the ground.
Moreover, although Song Fei's actions weren't considered upright, at least they were laid out in the open, whereas Jiu Po was different.
Even the fact that he had secretly attacked Zi Luo Elder was only known by the two parties involved. The rest of the Myriad Heavens never heard anything about it at all.
In a sense, this was the poisonous snake that lurked in the shadows, biting its enemy’s weakest spot as soon as it opened its mouth.
Immediately following that reveal was the exchange of information among the members present.
Gu Nan’s invasion of other astral worlds was hindered, Mad Fist had been ambushed while challenging others, and internal instability appeared in Xue Ren’s Extreme Sword Heaven as the conflict between traditional swordsmanship and Xue Ren’s new swordsmanship resurfaced.
The most bizarre situation of all was Immortal Empress Taisheng. A bunch of dragon Qi suddenly appeared inside her Imperial Glory Heaven, and it was completely out of her control.
For an astral world like Imperial Glory Heaven, this phenomenon signified the rise of a new immortal empire, and Immortal Empress Taisheng, who also used dragon Qi as her foundation, was practically helpless to stop it.
The four of them simultaneously encountered problems tailored to their situations, and Zi Luo Elder was even ambushed by Jiu Po Heaven’s ruler himself, so it was clear that the enemy didn’t have good intentions.
At this time, Daoist Zhuangxuan suddenly coughed lightly and spoke up, "Everyone, the situation may be more complicated than you think."
"Oh?" Immortal Empress Taisheng raised an eyebrow. Even though she only spat out a single word, one could still hear some dissatisfaction in her tone.
She was dissatisfied with Daoist Zhuangxuan's unauthorized interjection, which stemmed from the fact that she didn’t have a very good impression of this junior to begin with.
Originally, Daoist Lingyang played the role of the head manager in the Heaven-God Alliance and had always been the one who handled the day-to-day affairs.
With Daoist Lingyang staying behind in the World of Gods, it was only natural for someone to take over the vacant position on this side.
Xue Ren was busy preparing for his ascension to Unified Dao, so according to seniority, Immortal Empress Taisheng was undoubtedly the most qualified after him. Unfortunately, before she could take her rightful position, this disciple of Daoist Lingyang popped up out of nowhere.
Unaffected by her attitude, Zhuangxuan explained, "The attacks on the four seniors and Zi Luo Elder all appear to have been planned by the same person, but among them, senior Xue Ren's situation is slightly different."
He paused for a second, then continued without giving Immortal Empress Taisheng any chance to respond, "I’ve looked at everyone’s crises. It might’ve been possible that other matters were planned at the last minute, but not the swordsmanship dispute."
Xue Ren was slightly taken aback, then nodded. "That's right. The ones who stepped forward this time are my two senior brothers, both of whom have laid low for thousands of years and are very well prepared this time."
The struggle over the dominant swordsmanship ideology could only be done by those inside Extreme Sword Heaven, and a plan requiring such intense preparation would’ve been very troublesome for an outsider to set up, so it was impossible to resolve it quickly.
Immortal Empress Taisheng frowned at Zhuangxuan. "What exactly are you trying to say?"
"I'm saying that there might be two groups of people secretly making moves," Zhuangxuan's young face remained stoic and expressionless, but his words were enough to surprise the crowd.
Xue Ren narrowed his eyes slightly. "One group is indeed acting on a last-minute decision, striking at us through various methods, while the other group has been plotting for a long time, specifically targeting me?"
"That’s right." Zhuangxuan finally nodded. "That's why I think that our immediate strategy should be to pull back our battle lines across the board in order to not give the first group any chance."
No one present was a fool. After Zhuangxuan pointed out the main point, the strategy he subsequently proposed seemed logical.
Impulsively-planned attacks could be dealt with by avoiding battle. Instead, Xue Ren was currently the Heaven-God Alliance’s top priority, so it was only right to focus resources on helping him solve his problem first.
Crazy Fist immediately stated, "Got it, I'll stay in my astral world for a while… But don’t blame me if I beat up the enemies who come knocking on my door!"
Zhuangxuan replied, "If an enemy comes to your door, I would also like to request that Senior Mad Fist doesn’t hold back."
Immortal Empress Taisheng’s expression was a bit strange. She was also able to see the big picture clearly now. It’s just that having to rely on a junior’s help to realize this really made her feel odd.
When it comes to oneself, even Lu Wen inevitably had times when he failed to see the big picture, let alone them.
However, she also knew that this was by no means the time to let emotions sway her actions, Plus, the advice given by Zhuangxuan did have merit.
"I will handle those dragon Qi in my astral world myself." Immortal Empress Taisheng looked towards Xue Ren and said, "Just speak up if you need my help."
This Immortal Empress was able to seize the throne and win against all other princes and princesses. Her personality was even bolder than a man's.
Zhuangxuan, however, replied, "Dragon Qi cleansing is not a difficult task, but I also ask that Senior Taisheng focus on treating the symptoms and refrain from tracing the problem to its roots for the time being."
Simply put, it was to maintain the status quo.
After Immortal Empress Taisheng nodded in acquiescence, Zhuangxuan then looked at Gu Nan. "Senior Gu Nan's matter is the easiest to resolve. As long as you suspend invasions of other astral worlds for the time being and tightly guard the entrance to your own astral world, you won’t have anything to fear from Fang Chaoyun’s group."
Zhuangxuan kept talking nonstop, listing out all of the enemy's possible moves as well as what his side should do in response.
This young man appeared somewhat dull, but only at this moment did his eyes radiate a strange luster, as if he was born to do this.
After he finished speaking, the scene turned silent—everything that needed to be said had already been said by Zhuangxuan.
Xue Ren subtly scanned the circle, taking in everyone’s reactions.
Daoist Lingyang had naturally asked Xue Ren to take care of his heir beforehand, and today was also the stage Xue Ren had designed for Zhuangxuan.
As long as he won the approval of everyone present, coupled with Xue Ren’s own support, Zhuangxuan would be considered to have gained a complete foothold in his new position.
‘From their reactions, the effect is still quite… Wait a minute.’
Xue Ren’s gaze landed on Gu Nan, whose expression seemed to be a little different from what he imagined.
"Done?" Gu Nan’s expression looked like he’d skipped the entire story dialogue. "Then I should go and talk to Duan Wenqi now."
"Senior Gu Nan." Zhuangxuan frowned slightly and stood up. "You don't have any justification…"
"I don't need a justification," Gu Nan interrupted him. "All I know is, fight back if you don’t like it."

chapters.title: Chapter 447: Savage Beasts World
chapters.content:
From the start, Gu Nan never paid much attention to Zhuangxuan’s explanation.
After all, in addition to his initial analysis, he also brought up a cumbersome list of subsequent causes, and players just happened to have very little patience.
Being able to understand the NPC’s general attitude was good enough for players; the rest of the story dialogue was skippable.
Gu Nan didn't have any objection to Zhuangxuan’s suggestion to suspend Divine Kingdom Wars. In any case, he was unlikely to accomplish anything when Fang Chaoyun was so set on thwarting him, and it would be a waste of divine servants for nothing.
To resume Divine Kingdom Wars again, he’d at least have to wait until he advanced to Tier 8 and beat up Fang Chaoyun and the others.
But before that, Duan Wenqi was also someone who had to be dealt with. If he wasn't taught a lesson, wouldn't any random person dare to scheme Gu Nan from behind the scenes in the future?
"Senior Gu Nan." At some point, Zhuangxuan had walked up to Gu Nan, blocking his path and meeting his gaze without flinching.
Even if Gu Nan had a vicious reputation outside, it didn’t seem to be enough to make Zhuangxuan fearful.
This young man actually acted with great delicacy.
