Earlier, when he wanted to persuade Gu Nan to visit Clear Profundity Realm, he didn’t use the more respectful address of "Senior", as he wouldn't have been able to get Gu Nan to take him seriously if he had taken too low a stance.
However, at this meeting, he placed himself in a lower status as a junior, not wanting to make Gu Nan feel like he was isolating him.
Zhuangxuan's dull demeanor didn’t make him look like a crafty person by any stretch of the imagination. However, his actions seemed to have a very clear goal, which was doing as much as possible to unite as many forces as possible.
In terms of being the Heaven-God Alliance’s head manager, Zhuangxuan had almost done as much as humanly possible. There was nothing to nitpick about.
"Gu Nan." Xue Ren paused briefly before speaking as well, "The big picture is more important."
However, even faced with these two’s dissuasion, Gu Nan continued forward without looking back, walking straight past Zhuangxuan and casually waving a hand behind him.
Only when Gu Nan's figure had completely disappeared did Immortal Empress Taisheng helplessly shake her head. "His entire journey has been too smooth-sailing. He hardly suffered any setbacks, so it's inevitable that he's like this."
"Lu Wen is standing behind Duan Wenqi. This is not a good target to use to regain his confidence." Xue Ren similarly shook his head.
Gu Nan's miraculous feats had obvious problems in the eyes of many. Advancing too fast inevitably led to an unstable foundation, and this world had never been one where whoever went the fastest would go the furthest.
In particular, it was all too common for geniuses who had a smooth life up until then to fall flat on their faces because of a single setback.
Ever since Gu Nan's debut, he had been the one gaining things from almost every battle—even when he faced Song Fei, Gu Nan had similarly achieved his goal.
But such a person practically suffered total defeat this time, losing the vast majority of his army in one fell swoop, so it was only natural for his mentality to become unstable.
From the perspective of Immortal Empress Taisheng and Xue Ren, they could actually understand Gu Nan's feelings.
Similarly, Zhuangxuan could also understand those feelings, but that didn’t prevent him from making the best choice.
"Since Senior Gu Nan is adamant about this, let him do what he wants. Everyone else can just act according to the plan… The other party only made one move so far, so we cannot fall into disarray on our own."
After saying this, he made the most official salute and turned to leave. The mobilization of the Heaven-God Alliance’s resources was not something that could be clarified in one or two sentences, and it still required Zhuangxuan to plan the specifics.
"This brat is a little interesting." After Zhuangxuan left, the first person to make a comment was actually Mad Fist, who was standing at the side.
Immortal Empress Taisheng also remarked, "He and Lingyang are the same type of people… although they don't look like it."
Daoist Lingyang had a gentle personality, treated people with humility and courtesy, and had keen insight regarding worldly affairs, making him an excellent candidate to manage the Heaven-God Alliance.
But this disciple he taught probably only had half of Lingyang’s courtesy and character.
However, no matter how it looked on the outside, at least there wasn't much of a problem in terms of ability. Even Immortal Empress Taisheng was satisfied with him and temporarily dismissed her thoughts of competing for that position.
For someone of her status, while fighting for some authority was certainly useful, it wasn't to the point where that position was an absolute necessity.
Xue Ren revealed a faint smile. Even though Gu Nan's reaction was a bit unexpected, Zhuangxuan was still able to establish his position, so this trip wasn’t in vain.
……
Savage Beasts World.
The transfer of the Astral Gate members went quite smoothly. They were sent to Clockwork Heaven without many issues, which allowed Duan Wenqi to finally feel slightly consoled.
Before Savage Beasts World ascends to a Realm Level plane, these personnel can only stay in Clockwork Heaven for the time being.
With years of experience in managing Astral Gate, Duan Wenqi's ability in actually running a plane was no inferior to some top-tier Star Rulers.
If he hadn't tried to reach the heavens in one fell swoop with Astral Gate and Zi Luo Heaven, perhaps Savage Beasts World would’ve advanced to Realm Level a long time ago or even qualified to break through to a Heaven Level plane.
Now, with Duan Wenqi's center of focus shifting back, Savage Beasts World instantly entered a phase of rapid development.
By relying on a time flow far faster than that of the outside world, Savage Beasts World underwent rapid changes day by day, and in a very short time, it went from savage wilderness to a semi-technological era.
During this, of course the influx of a large number of Astral Gate members was also indispensable. After all, Astral Gate was a top-tier organization in the Myriad Heavens, so its technology was equally top notch.
Inside the current Savage Beasts World, structures inscribed with strange runes could already be seen, sitting on top of a foundation surrounded by the same runes.
Duan Wenqi calmly presided over all of this, and the blue-clothed youth Fang Tun was standing in front of him, reporting on the mission progress one by one, just as he had done in Astral Gate.
"Continue to support the human race and teach them the method to capture and rear the beast races." Duan Wenqi said as such, "The human race's civilization potential isn’t something that beasts can compare to."
"Yes," Fang Tun respectfully answered and was about to continue his report when he saw Duan Wenqi's expression change.
"My Lord?"
Duan Wenqi frowned slightly, as if he was trying to sense something with his eyes closed, but in the end, he shook his head. "It's nothing, continue."
And so Fang Tun resumed his report. Actually, what Duan Wenqi sensed just now was a vague feeling that someone had entered Savage Beasts World, but then the feeling disappeared without a trace.
His first thought was that Gu Nan had come, but then he dismissed the thought.
This was because, by definition, other Star Rulers were unable to hide their presence inside someone else's astral world.
It had nothing to do with the strength or characteristic of the foreign Star Ruler’s power. As long as the enemy Star Ruler was inside this environment and still interacted with the outside world, they would inevitably expose themselves.
Perhaps they might be able to hide themselves from other people, but they definitely couldn’t conceal themselves from the owner of the world itself, who was one with their astral world.
Duan Wenqi knew this very well, so he ultimately chose to trust himself and his senses.
However, there was one situation that was an exception—that was when the one who entered the astral world wasn't a Star Ruler.
On the other side of Savage Beasts World, a silver-robed figure slowly manifested, wrapped in a layer of shadow that concealed all of his energy signature.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: Expert At Courting Death
chapters.content:
Duan Wenqi never could’ve imagined that Gu Nan would choose to throw a Tier 4 clone into his astral world.
This saint clone, which Gu Nan rarely had a use for ever since he reached Tier 7, was once again put to good use.
Tier 4 mortals were able to hide themselves better than Star Rulers, but this wasn’t to say that Tier 4 cultivators were hard to detect because they didn’t interact with their environment at all.
Rather, it was because there were many Tier 4 existences in the astral world. Star Rulers were also human beings, and their senses were also based on their own judgment; they weren’t radar.
An extra drop of ink on a piece of white paper could naturally be detected at first glance, but it would be much more difficult to detect if that ink drop was painted over with white paint—even if the other party's eyesight was as high as 20/20.
Gu Nan's saint clone descended onto Savage Beasts World, still holding the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb in his hand, and walked unhurriedly on the land.
Duan Wenqi's transformation of Savage Beasts World was quick, but it wasn't considered thorough. While the central region where Gu Nan’s clone landed already displayed some signs of metaphysical technology, the remote areas were still undeveloped wilderness.
For example, in Gu Nan’s current area, rampaging beasts and giant birds could be seen everywhere. Nine suns hung in the sky overhead, and the earth seemed to also be evaporating from the heat.
"What a nice place," Gu Nan, however, said with a smile.
This was indeed a good place to place the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb.
The function of the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb was to stow away a plane. Although it sounded very powerful in theory, there were still some troublesome conditions in practice.
For example, the player must enter the target plane and give the orb a certain amount of time to function before the plane could truly be swallowed up.
After all, the initial purpose of this item was for players to capture and farm Divine Kingdoms, not as a weapon to fight enemies.
Gu Nan buried the orb in a random place deep in the savage wilderness and then had the saint clone sit nearby.
Almost as soon as the orb entered the ground, an inexplicable suction force appeared, as if there was a black hole buried in the ground, and its range was rapidly expanding.
Even the saint clone could feel the obvious force. Based on this speed, it would be able to swallow up the entire Savage Beasts World in an hour at most.
But such a large commotion would never be able to escape Duan Wenqi’s eyes, and in fact, he should be able to sense something by the time half an hour passed.
In order to stop Duan Wenqi from interfering, Gu Nan didn't choose to put up any protective measures, but instead planned to use another matter to attract the other party's attention.
……
In the center of Savage Beasts World, Duan Wenqi was still diligently directing his subordinates to do their work, even assigning Fang Tun on a task.
As long as he could ascend Savage Beasts World to a Realm Level plane in the shortest time possible, all his early investments would be worth it.
However, right at this heated moment, a giant palm suddenly fell from the sky, completely destroying a building’s foundation that had just been built.
"Who is it?!" Duan Wenqi was furious and fiercely rushed over.
Duan Wenqi had chosen rune technology for his astral world, and the construction of foundations was more difficult and valuable than the actual building itself.
This time, the location of the intruder was clearly visible in Duan Wenqi's senses, and the enemy didn't feel weak.
But Duan Wenqi wasn’t afraid at all. With his experience and strength, there was nothing that could make him retreat without a fight—not to mention, this was Savage Beasts World!
Strengthened by the power of his astral world, Duan Wenqi instantly locked onto the enemy's position, and the longsword in his hand pointed straight at the other party.
But only when he got closer did he realize the enemy's true identity—it was Gu Nan!
"So it's you!" When Duan Wenqi saw Gu Nan, old and new grudges surged up in his heart, and he immediately gritted his teeth.
However, his thoughts were incomparably clear. The other party was someone who could force Daoist Sect Realm to bow their heads. Even though he could defeat the other party, he couldn’t stop Gu Nan from entering or leaving the astral world.
The thought of this caused Duan Wenqi to calm down instantly. It was pointless to blindly chase after Gu Nan; instead, it was more important to figure out the other party's intentions.
However, Gu Nan didn’t intend to give him this opportunity, having already swung his fist out without another word.
"How foolish." Duan Wenqi snorted disdainfully, his hand casually blocking Gu Nan's attack.
He wasn’t weak to begin with, and inside his own astral world, he was on par with a Tier 9 existence, so he didn’t fear a direct confrontation with Gu Nan at all.
And Gu Nan's decision to give up his own speed advantage and run here to fight Duan Wenqi was undoubtedly courting death.
Duan Wenqi no longer had any intention of holding back, and a large beast’s shadow began to emerge behind him. It was a half-fish, half-bird beast.
The great beast’s shadow spread its wings slightly, and a terrifying might immediately landed on Gu Nan's head. Wielding thousands of beast clans’ powers, this was Duan Wenqi’s fearsome strength.
However, Gu Nan laughed heartily and actually… ran away without looking back.
Duan Wenqi was slightly taken aback, then immediately heard the sound of explosions coming from the distance again, which was obviously Gu Nan’s handiwork.
The other party was so fast that not even the great beast’s shadow could catch up… Duan Wenqi gritted his teeth and quickly caught up to Gu Nan, but his enemy changed places again.
"Gu Nan, what exactly are you trying to do?" In the end, Duan Wenqi simply didn't bother chasing after him anymore, stopping in place to ask.
If the other party wanted to rely on wanton destruction of his astral world to force his hand, that would be too naive.
The construction work of Savage Beasts World had only just begun, so Duan Wenqi wouldn’t lose much even if things were destroyed.
It seemed that his words had an effect, as the other party actually turned back to attack him again, and this time, Gu Nan adopted the tactic of exchanging injury for injury, not caring about himself at all.
Duan Wenqi was more than happy to oblige. The terrifying power he gained from his astral world was still able to inflict damage on Gu Nan, who was unable to recover quickly.
‘At this pace, I only need half a day at most to…’
‘Wait a minute!’
Duan Wenqi still had ample experience, so he immediately realized— ‘Could the other party’s intention be to stall for time?’
Duan Wenqi instantly noticed the abnormality within his astral world as soon as such a thought occurred to him. Somewhere at the edge of his astral world, a powerful suction force was wantonly sucking in everything around it.
"Damn it!" Duan Wenqi longer had time to worry about the Gu Nan in front of him. WIth a single thought, he opened up a portal and landed on the edge of Savage Beasts World.
If not for Gu Nan's interference, he would’ve discovered this location’s abnormality long ago. Clearly, this was Gu Nan's true purpose.
"What the hell is this?" Duan Wenqi stood near the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb. Although the strong suction force continuously tried to pull him in, it wasn't enough to affect a Star Ruler like him.
On the contrary, the wondrous sight in front of him attracted his attention, and he gradually realized that the item before him was most likely an extremely precious treasure.
A treasure capable of sucking up worlds was completely unheard of!
Duan Wenqi didn't hesitate any longer and headed directly towards the center of the suction force—he didn't choose to destroy it to stop the vortex. Instead, he wanted to directly snatch the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb!
"How greedy." Gu Nan stood high in the sky, a cold smile on his face.
Of course Duan Wenqi didn’t forget about Gu Nan's existence. He dared to act in such a manner only because he was completely certain that he could defeat Gu Nan inside his own astral world.
After all, the suction force had already grown to a terrifying level at Duan Wenqi’s current location.
Aside from Duan Wenqi, who was able to stand his ground by relying on the power of his astral world, not even Gu Nan could get close—not unless he was willing to die together with Duan Wenqi.
Gu Nan shook his head lightly and turned to leave Savage Beasts World.
And down below, near the orb, a ray of silver light cut through space and slammed into Duan Wenqi with great force.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: Yan Xiaoxiao's Choice
chapters.content:
By the time Lu Wen received the news, the entire Savage Beasts World had already vanished.
Disappearing along with it was Duan Wenqi himself, as well as some of his Astral Gate members—they all vanished without a trace.
"What the hell happened?" Lu Wen's face was horribly gloomy, and half-kneeling in front of him was a group of people from various organizations.
However, they all had one thing in common—they were the last ones to have contact with Duan Wenqi before his disappearance.
Fang Tun was one of them. This blue-clothed kid was very lucky that he had to leave Savage Beasts World for his last mission right before Gu Nan showed up, so he happened to avoid a disaster.
If he was still in Savage Beasts World, he would’ve disappeared along with it.
"His Lordship, he… he seems to have discovered something." Fang Tun carefully recalled the scene, even mimicking Duan Wenqi's expression at the time.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t provide much information at all, as he didn't even know whether what Duan Wenqi had discovered was a person or a thing.
Lu Wen’s expression was still dark. He had already gathered everyone who last had contact with Duan Wenqi and interrogated them, but he still couldn't get any useful information.
What exactly happened in Savage Beasts World?
After hearing news of Duan Wenqi's accident, Lu Wen’s first reaction was that someone was seeking revenge, and it was even likely that Gu Nan, who had just been attacked, was the one behind this.
However, he also couldn’t be sure. After all, Duan Wenqi was a well-known Star Ruler, and Astral Gate had also made quite a few enemies over the years.
Now that Astral Gate had been driven out of Zi Luo Heaven, it would make perfect sense for an old enemy to take advantage of the situation to take revenge on Duan Wenqi and frame Gu Nan and the others as scapegoats.
Lu Wen waved his hand to dismiss the crowd, while he himself sat back in his seat with a frown.
The silver dragon on his shoulder soared up and circled around in midair before slowly transforming into her human form.
As she gradually gained experience, Long Ling'er seemed to have grown more accustomed to her human form as well and would often maintain that form and imitate other people’s behaviors when discussing matters with Lu Wen.
"It’s not possible to look back in time?" Long Ling'er asked. She heard the entire message and naturally understood what had happened.
Lu Wen shook his head and replied, "Even time has been swallowed up. A piece of the River of Time disappeared and was quickly patched up… but the section that went missing is gone forever."
As one who controls time, there were actually very few things in this world that Lu Wen didn't know. He could see practically everything he wanted to see by tracing along the River of Time.
But this time, even the law of time had disappeared, so there was nothing Lu Wen could do about it.
Long Ling'er was flabbergasted, then pondered seriously, ''Could it be a plane collapse? I took a look at the situation in Savage Beasts World, and there is indeed a collapse point present."
The spatial collapse point was so obvious that it was impossible for Lu Wen to not have considered it, only he quickly ruled out the possibility.
"A natural spatial collapse would last for a very long time. Old Duan would never sit back and watch his own astral world suffer," Lu Wen patiently explained to Long Ling'er.
Lu Wen thought much further than Long Ling'er.
Spatial collapse was indeed the most likely scenario. If someone artificially triggered the collapse and found a person to stall Duan Wenqi, wouldn't it be possible to bring about this situation?
But while inside Savage Beasts World, just how many people were capable of stalling Duan Wenqi?
Lu Wen knew his old friend's ability very well. Gu Nan couldn’t do such a thing. He was afraid that it would take someone on Fang Chaoyun's level to achieve this.
And even if such a person did make a move, how would they drag Duan Wenqi into the spatial collapse?
Lu Wen knew Duan Wenqi's character all too well. Although the latter was sometimes very irritable, he was also an extremely calm person who would never let emotions affect his decisions.
Once he realized that the situation couldn’t be salvaged, he would definitely flee at the first opportunity. There was no reason for Duan Wenqi to die alongside Savage Beasts World.
‘It’s just a small astral world. With my old friend’s ability and my help, how hard would it be to find another one?’
All sorts of questions surfaced in Lu Wen's mind. No matter how much he thought about it, there would always be something that couldn't be explained, causing Lu Wen to feel an incomparable headache for a while.
It was Long Ling'er who, after a long period of silence, suddenly opened her mouth, "Is he really dead though?"
Lu Wen stared blankly, then stood up with a start.
……
Duan Wenqi actually wasn’t dead yet.
This Star Ruler who’d been consumed by greed was now trapped inside the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb along with the entire Savage Beasts World… and also trapped in Gu Nan's hands.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan tossed the orb in his hand up and down, a light smile on his face.
"Ah, Old Duan! In order to seal you away, I paid the price of a saint clone."
Gu Nan's original intention was simply to seal away Savage Beasts World and take advantage of Duan Wenqi's loss of astral world power to ruthlessly teach him a lesson. After all, with Lu Wen around, it wouldn't be easy to truly kill Duan Wenqi.
Unexpectedly, Duan Wenqi was calmer than he thought and discovered the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb in advance.
As a result, before Gu Nan could even activate his backup plan, Duan Wenqi tried to take control of the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb out of greed.
Gu Nan then used the saint clone to knock Duan Wenqi into the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb.
However, with Gu Nan's current points, a mere saint clone wasn’t actually a big deal anymore. Instead, trapping Duan Wenqi in the orb gave him some new ideas.
At the very least, Duan Wenqi was a Tier 7 Star Ruler. If used well, the Round Two phase would be much safer.
"Teacher, everything is ready," Yan Xiaoxiao's voice came from the side, reminding Gu Nan that it was time to head to the World of Gods once again.
This time, he was heading over to slaughter some gods to accumulate Evil Value while also bringing Lan Si, Xie Yun, and Liang Ruxin back in passing—but only if the latter two had already successfully changed classes.
Gu Nan nodded and got up. His gaze landed on Yan Xiaoxiao again, and he couldn't help sighing slightly. ''You still decided to take this path? By the time I return, you'll never be able to go back."
Yan Xiaoxiao's face, as in years past, flashed a light smile. "I was destined to take this step from the moment I was born."
Perhaps in the eyes of others, Yan Xiaoxiao was no different from her former self, but Gu Nan, the owner of the Divine Kingdom, was perfectly aware.
In a sense, the current Yan Xiaoxiao could no longer be considered human.
While her former companions broke through one by one, she had always remained at the peak of Tier 3. It wasn't that she was unable to take that step, but that she was unwilling.
She had taken a different path—she gradually fused herself with the Divine Kingdom, allowing herself to become part of its origin.
Because from the very beginning, Yan Xiaoxiao was a part of the origin of "Immortal Demon World"—the predecessor to the Divine Kingdom—and was forcibly pulled out by Zuo Zuo.
All she was doing now was reversing the process.
By the time Gu Nan advances to Tier 8 and the Divine Kingdom fully ascends to a Realm Level plane, the human part of Yan Xiaoxiao would completely disappear, and she would become the manifestation of the Divine Kingdom’s will.
If the Divine Kingdom was compared to an enormous artifact, then Yan Xiaoxiao would become the artifact's spirit.
At that time, Gu Nan's control over the Divine Kingdom would also rise to an indescribable level.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: Misplaced Mission
chapters.content:
After coming here a few times, Gu Nan was already familiar with the process.
However, this time was a bit different from the past, as Gu Nan finally entered the World of Gods through official channels instead of smuggling himself in.
After Zi Luo Elder’s ascension, although no one called him the “Fourteenth Heaven” for the time being due to the ten years time limit, at least the members of the Heaven-God Alliance no longer had to hide themselves.
As long as it wasn’t confirmed that Zi Luo Elder’s realm had fallen, the Heaven-God Alliance would still be a tremendously popular organization in the Myriad Heavens, at least for the time being, and Gu Nan and the others were able to travel unhindered.
"Lord Gu Nan, please wait here. We will arrive at the World of Gods tomorrow evening," an attendant stood respectfully in front of Gu Nan and said.
Gu Nan, who had gone through the official channels, was currently inside a giant cruise ship.
The cruise ship wasn’t sailing in water, but traveling directly through the void between the two worlds.
It had to be said that this kind of giant cruise ship, which transported thousands of people at once, was indeed much more efficient than smuggling.
But that wasn’t necessarily the case when it came down to the individuals themselves. At least Gu Nan wouldn’t need to go through layers of vetting and gatekeeping if he entered through more illegal channels.
And since they had to transport thousands of people at a time, the speed of the cruise ship naturally had to slow down, which was the main cause of the delay.
The attendant bowed and left, so Gu Nan took a stroll alone on the top floor of the cruise ship, pondering which god he should hunt this time.
Now that he’d already leveled up to Tier 7, there were more targets to choose from. It wasn't like when he was at Tier 6 earlier, where he had to specifically look for the Mirror God’s trouble.
Theoretically, he would have to kill a Tier 9 god to accumulate enough Evil Value, but killing a Tier 9 god right now might cause a bit too much commotion.
If possible, Gu Nan didn’t mind killing a few more Tier 8 gods, or even Tier 7 and Tier 6 ones.
If bosses didn't drop equipment but only experience, then farming normal monsters was undoubtedly more efficient.
Gu Nan's mind went through suitable candidates, each with a corresponding event to trigger in order to get these gods to appear alone.
Just as Gu Nan was leaning on the railing with one hand, deep in thought, footsteps sounded by his ears.
"Save me! My Lord, please save me!"
Along with the sound of footsteps was a woman’s cry for help.
Gu Nan turned to look, and what entered his sight was a young blonde girl. She was wearing a conspicuous pink dress that looked a little wrinkled, and it seemed like she hadn't changed it in quite a while.
Gu Nan, however, was slightly taken aback when he saw her and subconsciously blurted out, "Elise?"
The blonde girl froze as well, as if she didn’t expect to run into someone who recognized her in a place like this.
From the expression on the young girl's face, Gu Nan could tell that the other party was indeed the Elise he remembered.
It’s just that she was supposed to be from the World of Gods, so how could she appear in such a place? Gu Nan felt that many things seemed to be disturbed again.
The sound of footsteps behind Elise became more and more urgent, and she no longer had the luxury to ask more questions, so she hurriedly hid behind Gu Nan.
Several uniformed men quickly arrived, their eyes landing on the Elise behind Gu Nan.
One of the younger ones glared and reached out to grab Elise but was pulled back by the older one next to him.
This was the top floor of the cruise ship. All the people living here were true powerhouses, none of whom they could afford to casually offend.
However, he also had no intention of backing down, believing that with his master's identity, the other party would be willing to give them face.
"This woman is the favorite concubine of Daoist Heir Qin Ning. Please hand her over, and Void Grotto Heaven will definitely reward Your Excellency generously," after stopping the young man, the elder said to Gu Nan in manner neither servile nor overbearing.
Gu Nan's reputation at this point was considered to be sky-high, but not many people actually recognized his face. After all, he’d only ever been in contact with bigshots.
Gu Nan didn’t take the other party seriously at all.
The so-called Daoist Heir was nothing more than the next-generation successor that Void Grotto Heaven was looking for. In case Yu Lian met with a calamity, Void Grotto Heaven wouldn't have a break in leadership or inheritance.
However, there were at least dozens of such Daoist Heirs, and in Gu Nan's eyes, they were completely insignificant.
Gu Nan flat-out ignored the person in front of him and turned to look at Elise. "Why are you here?"
"I… came to the Myriad Heavens with my Lord Father," Elise didn't dare to hide anything when she saw Gu Nan's serious expression.
"Later, Lord Father wanted to marry me off to Mr. Qin Ning…”
"I see." Gu Nan nodded and asked, "Where’s your father?"
Elise shook her head. "I snuck out alone."
The conversation between the two ended here. Gu Nan had nothing more to ask for the time being, only a strange feeling in his heart.
Elise had a linked quest on her, and the trigger mechanism was her father wanting to marry her off. But in the original game, she definitely wasn’t supposed to be married to some Daoist Heir.
In other words, the storyline was misplaced.
Instead, Elise came to the Myriad Heavens, and the target of the mission had also changed to someone from the Myriad Heavens.
This change intrigued Gu Nan, and he wanted to know what had prompted it all. But before that, he had to deal with these fellows in front of him.
"Your Excellency, you also heard her." The man from earlier spoke again, "This is a family matter between this girl and my family’s Daoist Heir. You—"
"Go back and tell her old man that if he wants his daughter back, he’ll have to come find me in the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom." Gu Nan patted Elise's shoulder, signaling for her to follow him.
"Stop!" The young man who looked hot-tempered finally couldn't stand this blatant disregard any longer.
He drew a long blade from his waist and glared ahead with a deep, cold gaze… The next instant, he was immediately swatted aside by a shadow, and his figure crashed through the skylight and fell into the endless void.
Countless void substances harmful to ordinary people quickly poured in, and the location of the skylight was already covered with a layer of black fog. The older man from earlier couldn’t help feeling his heart skip a beat.
‘This matter just got very out of hand…’
Alarms immediately began ringing inside the cruise ship, and several cruise ship guards swiftly arrived, already skillfully starting to patch up the broken skylight. Evidently, this wasn’t the first time they had done this kind of thing.
But Lu Tao, one of the vice captains who arrived immediately afterward, was still very annoyed. He couldn't believe that someone was already causing violent incidents when the cruise ship had just departed—and even stirring up such a big commotion to boot!
Wasn’t this showing complete disregard for the owner of the cruise ship—Weapon Martial Heaven’s Lord Zou Jiming?
Lu Tao looked at the older man with a dark expression. ''Which family are you from? Personal fights are strictly forbidden on the cruise ship. Weren't you warned before boarding the ship?"
One of the older man’s companions had just died, yet here he was still being pelted with beratings, so his expression didn’t look good either.
But he also knew that the other party's status far outranked his own, so he forced down his anger and responded, "I am the Sixth Guardian under Daoist Heir Qin Ning. Just now, it was that person who attacked first. My Lord, I beg of you to investigate this matter."
"Who attacked?" Lu Tao asked darkly.
The Sixth Guardian quickly pointed to the side, to the very room that Gu Nan had brought Elise into.
At the same time, he felt a little smug: ‘Even for a noble guest living on the top floor, offending two of the Thirteen Heavens at the same time is still…’
"Are you guys looking for death?!" Unexpectedly, Lu Tao blurted that out as soon as he saw which room it was.
Immediately afterward, he waved his hand with a wretched expression. "Tell your Daoist Heir or whatever to hurry up and get off the ship lest he dies without even knowing how he got killed!"

chapters.title: Chapter 451: Bad Luck Charm
chapters.content:
Elise was also a pretty interesting mission character.
In the game, she was famous throughout the World of Gods for being a bad luck charm.
Her father married her off thrice—once to a Legend Rank expert, once to the son of a god, and once to a genuine god.
But none of these three could last until the day of their marriage. From the time they became engaged to Elise, they were destined to die a violent death.
This phenomenon attracted many people’s attention, and some thought that it was because she possessed something related to "misfortune”, but the Three Misery Sisters denied it.
Many people didn’t believe that at first, but when Elise's third fiancé—that is, the god—also died inexplicably, no one suspected the Three Misery Sisters anymore.
To be able to directly curse a god to death—even if the Goddess of Misfortune herself acted, it would still be impossible to do so without leaving a trace.
So in a sense, Gu Nan actually saved that Daoist Heir Qin Ning’s life, although the latter might not appreciate it.
"How many fiancés have you had?" Gu Nan asked this first after bringing Elise to a place without other people.
The storyline on Elise was likewise not fixed in time, and how far her storyline had progressed determined how much was still left for Gu Nan to take advantage of.
"T-three," Elise answered with some stuttering.
When she heard Gu Nan ask this, she also knew that this person was aware of her reputation, and she immediately felt a sense of shame at having her history revealed.
Gu Nan nodded with slight disappointment. Elise had already cursed that god to death, which meant that she didn’t have much value left… Oh, there was still one last point left.
The content about her life was something that could lure out a Tier 8 god, which was better than nothing.
But the fact that Elise appeared in this place still made him a little curious. "Your father… I recall he’s called Donald, right? Why did he go to the Myriad Heavens?"
"My father is Fox, Alexander Fox…" Elise gave an angry huff as she glared at Gu Nan, then deflated. "He thinks that no one on that side is willing to marry me anymore and wants me to try this side."
Elise’s father, Don…. no, Fox, the old man whose name Gu Nan couldn’t even remember, was also a pitiful fellow.
His wife died at an early age, so he doted on his daughter immensely, wholeheartedly trying to find her a good husband. But as a result, he raised the number one bad luck charm in the World of Gods.
With this kind of embarrassing situation, her father probably wouldn't feel too good either.
"So, do you need my help?" Gu Nan looked at the young girl with a faint smile. "If nothing goes wrong, it won't be long before you can marry normally."
"Really?!" Elise looked at Gu Nan in surprise. With her not-so-rich worldly experience, she had yet to learn to be skeptical of strangers.
Gu Nan nodded with a smile. True, he wasn’t lying. It’s just that by that time, she herself might not be so willing to marry anymore.
……
"Daoist Heir." The Sixth Guardian stood stiffly in front of Qin Ning, the expression on his face still a little ugly. "Old Nine, he—"
"I know about this matter." Qin Ning waved his hand to interrupt the Sixth Guardian's words and sighed.
Daoist Heir Qin Ning appeared to be a teenager with fair skin and a youthful appearance, only with a touch of indifference in his demeanor, making it impossible for anyone to believe that he was just a teenager.
The Old Nine the Sixth Guardian mentioned was precisely the youth who previously died at Gu Nan’s hands. They, the Nine Guardians, hadn't been bullied like this since they started working under Daoist Heir Qin Ning!
It’s just that from Qin Ning's attitude, he clearly didn’t intend to pursue this matter any further.
The Sixth Guardian felt a slight chill in his heart but didn’t dare say anything else. Instead, one of the people next to them asked, "Daoist Heir, should we notify the Sect Leader?"
This person was also one of the Nine Guardians. Although Old Nine was hot-tempered, he was well-liked in general, and now that he had been killed for no reason like this, of course his companions would be filled with righteous indignation.
Daoist Heir Qin Ning, however, glanced at the man coldly. "What? You want to ask the Sect Leader to avenge Old Nine?"
The Daoist Heir’s attitude caused the man who opened his mouth to pause slightly, but he still managed to force himself to say, "That person looked down on our Void Grotto Heaven so much—"
"Do you know who that is?" Daoist Heir Qin Ning’s words caused the people around him to quiet down at the same time. Vice Captain Lu Tao had only exchanged words with Qin Ning after he came here.
Daoist Heir Qin Ning scanned the circle. When he saw everyone’s faces say
Just say the name. We’re not scared no matter who it is
, he couldn't help but secretly shake his head.
These people had been following him for so long that they even forgot to exercise the most basic caution. They really thought they’d be able to run amok in the Myriad Heavens just because they were from one of the Thirteen Heavens.
Qin Ning pointed at the Sixth Guardian and asked, "What is the purpose of my trip to the World of Gods this time? Old Six, do you remember?"
The Sixth Guardian instantly answered, "To visit Star Ruler Lingyang and join the Heaven-God Alliance."
"That's right." Qin Ning said, "The Sect Leader forbid us from meddling in matters related to the Heaven-God Alliance, but there are nearly a hundred Daoist Heirs in this world, so how was I able to stand out? It's all because I dared to gamble."
After saying that, Qin Ning gave the Sixth Guardian another cold look. "If all goes well, that person might be one of my examiners. Do you understand?"
……
The little episode on the cruise ship didn’t cause Gu Nan any trouble, and no one dared to question him.
The captain even personally ran up to Gu Nan afterward, apologizing for allowing such scoundrels to come to the top floor and disturb the honored guest.
Gu Nan had little interest in this kind of shallow statement and waved his hand in dismissal.
With Gu Nan's current status and strength, no one would doubt his ultimate accomplishment. Other than people whose levels were too far apart, how could anyone else be unenlightened enough to court death by offending him?
After all, even if Zi Luo Elder fell and Gu Nan ran to join another one of the Thirteen Heavens, the latter would definitely accept him with joy—even Song Fei was the same.
The next night, the cruise ship arrived at the World of Gods.
Gu Nan naturally took Elise to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, first checking on the progress of the two remaining player army members and triggering Elise’s quest in passing.
Gu Nan already had a rough idea of which gods he wanted to hunt, but no matter who he was going to kill, the one that was delivered straight to his door should always be dealt with first.
"Mr. Gu Nan, will my father come here as well?"
"Of course. I've already sent someone to notify him," Gu Nan casually answered Elise, and as his feet stepped inside the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, he saw a familiar figure.
Daoist Lingyang—actually, he probably couldn’t be called a Daoist now. He had changed into clothes native to the World of Gods and had the appearance of a countryside nouveau riche.
Not only was he dressed up, but even his appearance looked much younger than before. He seemed like a regular person in his early thirties at best, and by virtue of his temperament, his class was forcibly pulled up.
"What do you think of this appearance of mine?" This outsider from the Myriad Heavens even earnestly asked Gu Nan for advice.
"Pretty good." Gu Nan nodded seriously. "It only lags behind mainstream fashion by 300 years at most."

chapters.title: Chapter 452: Legend Of The Red Embroidered Ball
chapters.content:
Although Daoist Lingyang frequently visited the World of Gods and even spent a long time here in his early years, culture wasn’t something that could be accepted so easily.
It was the same as a foreigner in imperial China—no matter how many years he spent there, people would still recognize him as a foreigner as soon as he opened his mouth. That was culture.
The World of Gods also had its own unique culture, which came from wars among the gods in ancient times and developed step by step until now.
For instance…
"Will playing this really help me integrate here?" Daoist Lingyang held some black cards. After several rounds of crushing defeat at Gu Nan’s hands, he finally asked with a face full of confusion.
"Of course," Gu Nan replied without hesitation. "At least you can use this to communicate with Sylvia more often. Culture can be learned through communication."
Daoist Lingyang thought about it for a moment before finally nodding. "You have a point."
……
Xie Yun was able to acquire the Pay to Win Expert route, while Liang Ruxin also seemed to reach the end of his quest and was about to undergo his final exam.
The two’s progress wasn’t out of Gu Nan's expectations, but Xie Yun's compatibility with Pay to Win Expert surprised Gu Nan a bit.
According to Lan Si, Xie Yun barely encountered any troubles before she successfully changed her class.
Moreover, Xie Yun seemed to have an innate talent for exchanging everything she could think of into gold and investing it all into her class.
"She ran off to Atalante, where the ore deposits are richer," Lan Si said with a helpless look.
There were a large number of gold mines within Atalante, and it was clear that Xie Yun was no longer satisfied with ordinary trade and was determined to directly plunder the gold mines.
Gu Nan nodded in understanding. Pay to Win Experts tended to experience skyrocketing power shortly after they acquired that class, but they would soon fall into a bottleneck as well.
This was because this route requires a terrifying amount of gold upon reaching the mid- to late-stages. Not even emptying all the gold in a few main planes would be enough.
But then again… This route seemed well-suited for the Myriad Heavens.
Unlike the artificially-created Divine Kingdoms here, the planes in the Myriad Heavens all occurred naturally, many of which contained gold mines ripe for plunder.
"Just bring her along when we leave. Leave her to her own devices for now."
After Gu Nan made up his mind, he stopped paying attention to Xie Yun's situation and focused on preparing Elise’s matter.
In theory, Elise had already lost much of her value after her reputation as the “three-time fiancé killer” spread.
Because by this point, most of the missions related to her were already completed, and there were only a few minor subplots left that didn’t give good rewards.
But players were players precisely because they could turn the impossible into possible.
"Lan Si." Gu Nan called his apostle to his side, "Spread the news."
……
By the time old Fox arrived, news of Elise finding a husband through "ball tossing" had already spread throughout the entire World of Gods.
If it was the original Fox, he probably wouldn't have understood what an "embroidered ball" was. But after traveling to the Myriad Heavens, this was not the first time he had seen this custom.
‘Sure enough, a powerful figure from the Myriad Heavens snatched Elise away!’
Old Fox couldn't help clenching his fists, his eyes full of indignation— ‘That damned fellow even wants to tarnish Elise's reputation!’
As someone who personally married his daughter off three times, old Fox knew all too well how his daughter's reputation was nowadays.
If not for the fact that Elise’s godly fiancé didn’t believe in bad luck, there would actually be no one willing to marry his daughter for the third time.
But now that person actually wants Elise to publicly solicit marriage. This… this was simply rubbing salt in the wound!
"Where is that damned fellow? I want to see him!"
"That one invited you to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom to see him…"
"What a joke! How am I supposed to go to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom?!"
……
For mortals, the main plane they lived in was their entire world, and the greater gods’ Divine Kingdoms were existences they could never hope to set foot upon.
Unless one was guided by a god’s apostle, there was no way to enter the Divine Kingdom.
Regardless of Gu Nan’s intentions, news that Elise planned to "toss the ball" had already spread.
People didn't know there was a mastermind behind Elise and only believed this "bad luck charm" had gotten so desperate that she came up with such a stupid move.
Did she really think that people would be willing to come to her door if she openly looked for a partner?
Many people treated this as watching a show, and the reality was also similar to their expectations.
The place where Elise threw the ball was also in Atalante, a new continent that was still in turmoil, so even fewer people showed up.
It’s just that amidst the jokes about it, a new piece of news came out.
Even though Elise didn’t manage to find a husband, her embroidered ball was still thrown out, and it had strayed to who knows where.
It was said to have been unintentionally picked up by a man who was already engaged, whereupon this gentleman, who didn't even know Elise, similarly died a violent death.
When this rumor began to circulate, the World of Gods finally boiled over—this was practically a divine weapon that could kill people tracelessly!
And the men who were already engaged but hadn't gotten around to consummating their marriages yet felt a sense of crisis.
Who didn't have a few enemies? No one wanted to wake up with a big red embroidered ball in their house and live in fear of a violent death.
A wave of marriages and withdrawals spread among the young men of Atalante.
Whether they got married or withdrew their engagement, the purpose was the same: to free themselves from the status of being a "fiancé".
And due to factors like cumbersome procedures and the required approval of the bride’s side, marriage was naturally far more troublesome than withdrawing an engagement, so countless scenes of "don’t look down on me just because I’m a poor girl" repeated across the entire continent.
Even more terrifying was that in a few days' time, a big red embroidered ball really did appear in some young men's homes.
Just like that, the horrifying legend about the "red embroidered ball" spread among mortals.
"Why on earth are you doing this?” Daoist Lingyang, who was dressed as a nouveau riche, looked at Gu Nan curiously.
The two of them were sitting comfortably in a remote manor in Atalante. On this rare occasion, Gu Nan had also changed his clothes, putting on a flashy outfit that made him look like a wealthy young master.
It had to be said that Gu Nan's taste was still a bit better than Daoist Lingyang's.
Daoist Lingyang was extremely curious about Gu Nan's actions, especially after seeing him organize a husband-recruiting ceremony for Elise where a grand total of zero candidates showed up, then creating the embroidered ball himself.
That’s right—the vast majority of the embroidered balls that were secretly circulating on the continent today came from Gu Nan's hands, and every single one of them sold for a high price.
Sometimes he even specifically arranged for people to kill the youths who received the embroidered balls in order to corroborate the curse’s authenticity.
It could be said that a large part of the reason why Atalante was in a state of panic nowadays was due to Gu Nan.
"I need to kill some gods." Gu Nan had no intention of hiding it, and it wasn’t like he could hide it from Daoist Lingyang anyway.
"Revenge?" This was Daoist Lingyang’s first thought, as he had done the same himself.
"No, no." Gu Nan, however, waved his hand. "I just want to slaughter gods, doesn’t matter which ones."
Daoist Lingyang was slightly taken aback, then asked, "So, you can lure over a god by doing this?"
He had personally proven just how difficult it was to lure a god down to the main plane.
Of course, he seemed to have also forgotten that the last time Gu Nan had done something similar, it was likewise a very easy process for Gu Nan.
"It’s here," Gu Nan didn’t answer him, but merely smiled and said.
Outside the manor, a woman in a light red cloak was slowly walking up to the entrance.
"In the name of My Lord, Her Majesty Emma." The woman's pretty face was filled with frost. "Stop these foolish acts immediately, vile merchants!"

chapters.title: Chapter 453: God Of Love
chapters.content:
"Which god is Emma?" Daoist Lingyang asked with slight surprise.
He’d also traveled through almost half of the World of Gods, but he had never heard of the name Emma before.
There were only a few hundred gods in the entire World of Gods, so for Daoist Lingyang, who was also at this level, there shouldn't be any that he didn't recognize.
However, Gu Nan knew Emma was an exception. As a matter of fact, let alone Daoist Lingyang, very few gods native to the World of Gods knew of Emma's existence.
To be more accurate, ever since the first Great War of the gods, she had vanished without a trace, and very few people had contact with her after that.
What was even more interesting was that Emma didn’t intentionally hide herself. She simply detached herself from both the Light and Dark Factions after that year, announcing that she wouldn't get involved in future godly wars.
But she wasn’t adverse to showing herself if it was necessarily for fulfilling her divine duties. It’s just that for tens of thousands of years, there were very few situations that required her to step in.
She was Emma, God of Love Emma.
"God of Love?" Daoist Lingyang carefully searched his memory and confirmed that this was the first time he heard this name.
"Emma's divine authority is love." Gu Nan explained succinctly, "But since there is no God of Marriage, the marriage part is also in her hands."
This was why an apostle of the God of Love appeared outside the manor.
Gu Nan's series of actions had severely disrupted the normal matrimonial cycle of Atalante and harmed Emma's operations, which was why she sent an apostle to stop them.
Of course, under Gu Nan's deliberate arrangement, this God of Love who was already somewhat muddle-headed to begin with didn’t realize that this was all a conspiracy.
In the news she received, it was just a rich mortal merchant who had the sudden urge to sell embroidered balls to make money after hearing about Elise's story.
Even though it wasn't the other party's intention to make Atalante’s people tremble in fear and cause the marriage rate to plummet, it was still necessary to send an apostle to punish the other party and make them stop this.
After roughly understanding the entire process, Daoist Lingyang couldn't help revealing an odd expression.
"How did you know that this would lure out Emma?" Gu Nan's actions were too purposeful. Daoist Lingyang didn’t get the feeling that he was trying things out at all; rather, he felt that Gu Nan was already sure of the outcome in advance.
Gu Nan shrugged without replying.
It wasn’t like he could say this was a storyline that a certain bored player accidentally triggered in his past life while tormenting the mission called Elise.
Gu Nan also didn't meet that God of Love's apostle, or else it would be easy for Emma to notice something was off.
Following his plan, he already prepared a Legend Rank expert in advance to step in and kick that apostle out in an extremely rude manner.
Even when the other party identified herself as an apostle, the Legend Rank powerhouse still used vulgar words to swear at her and make her leave.
"My Lord, what you commanded has been done…" Legend Rank powerhouse Jotun said with a rather nervous expression as he stood in front of Gu Nan.
Not only was he scared of Gu Nan, he was even more terrified of retaliation from the gods—after all, his earlier behavior had truly angered a god.
Gu Nan was leisurely playing black cards with Daoist Lingyang and crushing him without much effort. He casually replied, "You're afraid? No need to be nervous. Emma is an extremely hot-tempered god, so she'll come over very soon."
Jotun was on the verge of tears. Who reassured people like this?
Daoist Lingyang, however, understood what Gu Nan meant—since she would arrive very soon, she would naturally also die very soon.
……
Old Fox was currently in Atalante.
Days of rushing around had left him with a weathered look on his face. As a mortal, he didn't have the ability to travel through planes, but luckily, the cruise ship from the Myriad Heavens happened to place him in Atalante.
"Mr. Fox, I must warn you… that what you are doing right now is very dangerous," a man stood by old Fox's side and cautiously reminded for the twentieth time.
This man was a subordinate of Daoist Heir Qin Ning and was none other than the Second Guardian, who had been specifically sent to Fox's side by Qin Ning.
Fortunately, the Second Guardian was here, or else old Fox would’ve been killed a long time ago due to Elise’s current infamy.
Now the two of them were on their way to the place where Elise "tossed the ball".
If the Second Guardian’s guess wasn’t wrong, then that powerful figure would most likely be paying close attention to that place or might even be there in person. It was truly a perilous place where it would be difficult to survive.
"My daughter is there." Old Fox gazed firmly ahead. At this time, they were almost at their destination.
Due to his orders, the Second Guardian couldn’t stop Fox from acting and could only dissuade Fox, which filled him with helplessness.
However, he didn't want to follow Fox and throw his life away as well, so he could only try his best to dissuade him, "That one obviously has plans. You might as well wait until this matter is over…"
"Who knows what he'll do to my daughter!" Old Fox displayed the characteristic stubbornness of the Atalante people and glared at the Second Guardian.
The Second Guardian couldn't help but bristle. He was very tempted to say that with that one’s status, if he really wanted to do something to your daughter, no one would be able to stop him at all.
While the two were talking, a sudden throbbing came from the front, as if a heavy force was pressing down on their hearts.
Old Fox stared blankly ahead, not understanding what was happening, but the Second Guardian was familiar with this as panic entered his expression.
"A god…"
……
The God of Love had arrived.
As previously stated, this god with a very artful divine authority actually had a personality that was not at all low-key and could even be said to blow up at the slightest grievance.
It’s just that she had very few friends, and after the first Great War, even fewer people recognized her. Combined with the fact that gods who overlapped with Emma's divine authority were extremely rare, she became an invisible person among the gods.
But today, the invisible person was aggroed out by Gu Nan.
Emma was a blue-haired girl who wore a light red robe. She stepped out of the void and announced, "Mortal, you will be punished for your foolishness, shallowness, and—"
Shadows emerged from behind Emma, bringing the God of Love’s words to an abrupt halt as the sense of danger that penetrated her bones caused her entire being to involuntarily tremble.
It had been way too long since she experienced something like this.
Ever since the Great War tens of thousands of years ago, she rarely had the chance to fight anyone, and normally, no one was willing to mess with a Tier 8 god either.
But at this moment, her opponent was completely oblivious to all of this and went for a fatal blow as soon as he appeared!
Gu Nan's fist smashed down from behind Emma's head, while his power of shadows wrapped around the both of them, isolating the aura of gods fighting.
In the eyes of outsiders, they could probably only see a ball of shadows.
Daoist Lingyang stood in the manor, calmly gazing at the scene taking place in the sky above.
He was perfectly aware that not even Gu Nan could maintain this level of shadow concealment for long—in other words, Gu Nan was certain that he could resolve the fight in a very short time.
A puzzled expression appeared in Daoist Lingyang's eyes: ‘The other party is a Tier 8 god. What will you do?’

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Elise's Origins
chapters.content:
Although ripping apart a Tier 8 god with one’s bare hands seemed a bit absurd in Daoist Lingyang’s eyes, Gu Nan had done it many times before.
Azure blood splashed out from the back of Emma's neck. Thanks to Gu Nan's monstrous strength, cracks began to appear all over Emma's divine body.
"Who… are you?" Emma couldn't catch her opponent's figure at all and only felt pain coming from her entire body, which was enduring a frenzy of blows.
Of course her question went unanswered.
Emma tried to escape, attempting to get away from Gu Nan's crazed attacks, but she, who had never been good at combat, simply couldn’t do it.
However, no matter how slow-witted she was, at this time, she also realized that this incident was never a simple matter of a merchant’s underhanded profit-making scheme, but rather… an outright conspiracy!
A conspiracy completely aimed at her in an attempt to kill her in a main plane!
Emma hadn't been in such a sorry state ever since the first Great War.
Her laws were easily shattered by her opponent, and her supreme divine power was completely useless, like a pebble sinking into the sea when she hit her opponent with it, unable to elicit even the tiniest reaction.
"Who in the world is this person?" Although she was in such a desperate situation, Emma was still in the mood to ponder this question.
Of course it wasn’t because this Love God didn’t fear death, but because she didn't believe she was going to die here, even if her enemy was exceedingly powerful.
"You cannot kill me, Your Excellency." Emotion gradually faded from Emma's voice, "I think we should put aside our prejudice and talk."
Even faced with an assassin who launched a sneak attack, the god was still able to make rational judgments. The Love God was just hot-tempered, not a nutjob like Karina.
However, Gu Nan didn’t react to her gesture of kindness at all and even intensified his attacks.
The scars on Emma's divine body were increasing, and blue blood flowed all over her body, resembling a porcelain filled with blue pigment.
"It's useless." Emma finally gave up resisting altogether and let her divine body be destroyed. "Why do you want to kill me? Why don’t we sit down and talk? I can help you."
She looked like a knowing older sister at this point. "For love? Your lover left you? Or fell in love with someone else?"
"As long as no other gods are involved, I can make any young girl fall in love with you unconditionally."
Wham!
Gu Nan's fist finally struck Emma's head, smashing her skull apart. He seemed to have completely ignored her earlier words.
"I told you, it's useless," Emma's voice remained calm, even if it was beginning to distort due to the damage to her vocal cords.
She seemed to have faced such a scene many times before, so she was able to appear unperturbed.
The next second, a pink mist rose up and began to envelop Emma's entire body, gradually restoring her body to its original state.
The process wasn't fast and was nowhere near as quick as some actual resurrection abilities. It could even be forcibly interrupted.
Gu Nan, however, knew how frightening this ability was. It could only be interrupted, but would never lose effectiveness.
In other words, the God of Love was immortal. It was because of this ability that she was able to survive the Great War, which had the heaviest death toll.
Love was immortal, and as long as love still existed in the world, the God of Love would not perish.
"Love exists forever in the world." Emma's head had fully regenerated. "Please stop your meaningless attacks, Your Excellency."
The God of Love could not be destroyed, even by a super powerful greater god like the Ruler of Light and Justice or by a player who finished Round Two.
Gu Nan didn't know what the significance of this setting was, or perhaps it was just bad taste on the part of the game designers, but he knew how to crack it.
To be precise, it wasn't by cracking the "love is eternal" point, but bypassing this point to kill the God of Love.
Elise appeared in Gu Nan's hands, or rather, in front of Emma.
Emma stared blankly, not understanding what this meant. "Your Excellency…"
"Go on, take back your birthright." Gu Nan, however, simply gave Elise a gentle push, and the little girl suddenly rushed towards the Love God with a face full of bewilderment.
Emma, who was in the middle of recovering, was powerless to resist and could only watch as the little girl crashed into her.
"I don't know if love is eternal, but you certainly aren't."
A shadow longsword coalesced in Gu Nan's hand, which he stabbed into the center of Emma’s forehead without hesitation, and a flash of golden light began to flicker.
That was where the Godhead was located.
Normally, the Godhead would only be exposed when a god died and could not be attacked at any other time.
Not even Emma herself knew why her Godhead would appear at this time.
"It’s because of love." Gu Nan pointed at Elise, who was being pulled forth by the light emanating from the Godhead and slowly walking forward.
Her body gradually overlapped with Emma's. Only then did Emma realize that the young girl was extremely similar to her in height, silhouette, and physique.
"There has only ever been one generation of the God of Love, and that was the case since you first emerged, but that is not the complete truth," Gu Nan continued to speak, his words piercing straight through Emma's heart like the sharpest blade.
As if Emma had realized something, a low scream of terror came out of her mouth, "No…"
Elise gradually merged with the golden light, and a strange radiance began to emerge on her face. Gu Nan was very familiar with this—it was divinity.
For mortals, becoming a god was a very difficult thing. But for some people, they only needed to take one step to become a god.
Love might be eternal, but when the God of Love’s divine authority was stripped away, Emma would no longer be eternal.
Bang!
Gu Nan landed another punch, and this time, Emma's head exploded like a watermelon, disappearing completely from the world.
In the air, the golden glow from Elise's body grew brighter and brighter.
On the ground, old Fox finally arrived, and he shouted into the air like a madman, "Elise! Elise!"
Elise slowly opened her eyes and looked at the familiar yet unfamiliar figure below, pausing for a while before she vacantly responded, "Father."
Old Fox sighed heavily in relief. No matter what happened, it was fine as long as Elise was fine.
But Elise wasn't really fine. She was no longer the mortal maiden of the past; she was now the new God of Love.
There weren't many instances of a mortal ascending to godhood in one fell swoop, and Elise happened to be one of them. The reason for that was due to her mother.
Even old Fox himself didn't know that the girl he met by chance in his early years was actually the incarnation of another God of Love.
She died at Emma’s hands in the first Great War, and from then on, the divine authority of the God of Love was held solely by Emma.
But again, due to the characteristics of the God of Love's eternal existence, that fallen goddess’s divine power did not die out, but remained in the main planes and was even absorbed by some mortal women to create incarnations.
"Elise, are you alright?!" The old man pulled his daughter in front of him and carefully examined her to make sure she wasn't hurt.
"She's never been better." Gu Nan's voice came from the side while looking at Elise, "You can marry now, but I must warn you."
"The person who becomes the husband of the God of Love may run into some strange events, so you’ll have to help him."
Having a romantic relationship with the God of Love was actually equivalent to interfering with her divine duties, so the violator would be admonished and punished by the laws of the world, unless the God of Love herself was willing to influence the world in turn.
"Plus… no one dares to marry me anymore, right?" Elise asked calmly.
After Gu Nan's publicity stunt, her infamous reputation had become even more entrenched in people’s hearts.
"Theoretically, that’s true." Gu Nan nodded and looked at Daoist Lingyang again. "Oh right, didn’t you say yesterday that some Daoist Heir or whatever wants to join the Heaven-God Alliance?"
"Daoist Heir Qin Ning."
"He's not married yet, is he?"

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Qin Ning's Scheme
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was no longer interested in knowing what kind of story would happen when Daoist Heir Qin Ning met Daoist Lingyang and what this Daoist Heir would do in response.
For him, successfully hunting the God of Love and harvesting nearly three 3,000 Evil Value was the most important thing.
The God of Love was worth more than the Mirror God. Even though she looked a bit weaker and was actually also a bit weaker, how much Evil Value a god was worth wasn’t entirely determined by strength.
Just as monsters didn’t necessarily give more EXP the harder they were to fight, there were always other factors involved.
The first thing that determined a god’s value was, of course, their level. Gu Nan needed to collect another 10,000 Evil Value to advance to Tier 8, and killing one Tier 9 god was perfectly sufficient.
However, if it was Tier 8 gods, it could be anywhere from three to four. This range was due to the different Evil Values each god was worth.
The god’s level determined the order of magnitude, while the amount of faith the god amassed within their Divine Kingdom determined the specific gain from slaughtering that god.
A god like the Mirror God who’d been slumbering for countless years and even needed to rebuild his Divine Kingdom was naturally unlikely to be worth too much Evil Value.
Likewise, the God of Love rarely appeared in public, so the amount of faith she could gain was by no means high, and it wasn't even close to the average level of a Tier 8 god.
‘Not bad. At this rate, we'll reach the requirement after two more kills.’ Gu Nan roughly estimated in his mind the average level of a god in this period.
There was actually quite a big difference between killing three gods and killing four.
The most convenient place to hunt gods was naturally main planes. If he had to run to a god’s Divine Kingdom to kill them, neither the difficulty level nor the success rate would look too favorable.
However, gods weren’t fools, and if there were consecutive incidents of gods dying in main planes, no one would casually descend here anymore.
This was also why Gu Nan enveloped the entire battlefield in the power of shadows, doing his best to conceal the battle.
"Qin Ning has agreed," on this day, Daoist Lingyang came to Gu Nan's residence, and this was the first thing he said.
"Oh, that's nice." Gu Nan casually replied, "Did you tell him the consequences?"
"Of course… Did you think everyone is like you and likes to screw over their own people?" Daoist Lingyang cast him a disdainful glance. "He's going back to the Myriad Heavens soon, so the impact won’t be as great."
Gu Nan nodded. It was true that Qin Ning wouldn’t be too afraid of backlash from the laws of the world if he returned to the Myriad Heavens, since there was no God of Love over there.
However, Elise would be busy taking charge of the previous Love God’s inheritance, so she probably wouldn’t be able to go with him. The young couple was destined to be separated.
"By the way, Qin Ning would like to pay you a visit," Daoist Lingyang added.
……
This was Gu Nan's first meeting with Qin Ning, although Gu Nan’s name wasn’t unfamiliar to the latter. After all, Gu Nan was too famous right now.
Daoist Heir Qin Ning had a very good excuse for the visit. Naturally, it was to apologize to Gu Nan for the earlier offense of his underling Guardians.
Speaking of which, the whole matter was quite ironic.
Originally, Elise ran away by herself because she didn’t want to marry Daoist Heir Qin Ning and ended up meeting Gu Nan, yet she still ended up going down this path.
However, she was unwilling to marry back then because she didn’t want to harm Qin Ning, but that might not necessarily be the case anymore. Just from outward appearance alone, this Daoist Heir Qin Ning was still quite good, and his speech and demeanor were flawless.
More importantly, he wasn't a Void Cutter, but a Star Ruler.
Of course Void Grotto Heaven, one of the Thirteen Heavens, would never cultivate dozens of Void Cutter Realm successors—even if Yu Lian was willing to step down, what qualifications would they have to ascend to the heavens in one fell swoop?
Therefore, although there were nearly a hundred Daoist Heirs in Void Grotto Heaven, there were currently less than ten Daoist Heirs who had already broken through to Star Ruler Realm and were therefore qualified to compete for the inheritance.
Qin Ning was one of them. He was already ahead of many others, but he wasn't satisfied; he wanted to be ahead of everyone.
Having a god as his wife would make certain matters much easier. As long as he could withstand the consequences, this deal was worth it.
"Lord Gu Nan." Daoist Heir Qin Ning respectfully sat in front of Gu Nan, humbling his demeanor as much as possible. "In addition to apologizing, this subordinate actually came here for another matter."
Gu Nan knew that this was the other party's true intention, so he said flatly, "Speak."
Qin Ning straightened his expression and said solemnly, "Recently, some in Void Grotto Heaven have voiced concerns… about His Excellency Xue Ren."
The relationship between Void Grotto Heaven and Extreme Sword Heaven had always been very good thanks to the excellent personal relationship between the two planes’ Star Rulers.
But now that Xue Ren had become a high-ranking member of the Heaven-God Alliance, would the relationship between him and Zi Luo Elder be even closer than that of Void Grotto Heaven?
If Xue Ren ascended to Unified Dao one day and Void Grotto Heaven became enemies with the Heaven-God Alliance, which side would he favor?
As long as this kind of suspicion exists, it would inevitably affect Void Grotto Heaven’s attitude—unless Xue Ren made a public statement.
After all, Void Grotto Heaven was not completely Yu Lian’s, as she had gotten it by inheritance, not by her own power.
Gu Nan understood the root cause of all this, but he wasn't very interested in it and just smiled. "You should talk to Lingyang or Xue Ren himself about something like this. There's no use telling me."
"No, My Lord." Qin Ning, however, said firmly, "You are the only one left who can help His Excellency Xue Ren right now."
Without waiting for Gu Nan to respond, he continued, "As long as you’re willing to stand up and declare His Excellency Xue Ren’s position on his behalf, the Sect Leader will be able to easily suppress the voices of dissent. This is also the best opportunity for the Heaven-God Alliance and Void Grotto Heaven to make direct contact!"
Daoist Heir Qin Ning’s face was filled with excitement when he said this.
In a sense, this was the real reason why Daoist Heir Qin Ning traveled all the way to the World of Gods and now requested a meeting with Gu Nan.
If he didn’t want to directly connect Void Grotto Heaven with the Heaven-God Alliance, he could’ve simply found a way to join the Heaven-God Alliance in the Myriad Heavens. Why would he need to run all the way here?
In the end, he needed someone with great weight inside the Heaven-God Alliance and who also had a close relationship with Xue Ren to come forward and make a stand for Xue Ren.
This way, not only could the suspicions between the two sides be resolved, but with the Heaven-God Alliance and Void Grotto Heaven being in direct contact, the contact points on both sides would undoubtedly gain great benefits.
These two contact points were naturally Gu Nan and Qin Ning himself.
Qin Ning didn’t explicitly spell this out, but he believed that Gu Nan could understand and that it was a win-win situation the latter had absolutely no reason to refuse.
Even if Xue Ren really wanted to alienate himself from Void Grotto Heaven, that still wouldn't prevent Gu Nan from taking action.
The calculations and speculations about the human heart involved were extraordinarily delicate and tedious, and Qin Ning had also spent a long time planning this before finally standing in front of Gu Nan.
That was why he was confident in himself.
"Why?" Gu Nan asked with a puzzled expression.
Qin Ning's heart full of schemes froze on his face, and he could only force himself to say, "My Lord, if this matter comes to fruition, it will be good for all parties. Whether it's the Heaven-God Alliance or Void Grotto Heaven, or you yourself…"
"Oh, you can talk to Zhuangxuan about these kinds of matters." Gu Nan waved his hand dismissively and added, "The disciple of that old man outside, you can find him in Clear Profundity Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Yin Yang Swords
chapters.content:
Daoist Heir Qin Ning left reluctantly, his heart full of bewilderment.
Even until he left, he still believed that Gu Nan had some deeper meaning for doing this and even sought out Daoist Lingyang to test the waters.
However, Daoist Lingyang just laughed involuntarily after hearing this. "Even if you want to give a gift, you still need to know what the person actually wants, right?"
A few moments later, Daoist Lingyang came back to Gu Nan's side and said with a smile, "This little fellow was originally supposed to talk to me."
Of course it was impossible for Daoist Heir Qin Ning to predict that Gu Nan would come to the World of Gods right now. His initial target was definitely Daoist Lingyang.
After all, even if the latter wasn’t in the Myriad Heavens, his status within the Heaven-God Alliance still wouldn’t drop too much. He would still be one of the elders, just responsible for different matters.
Gu Nan shook his head. He was completely uninterested in Qin Ning's so-called benefits. Status inside the Heaven-God Alliance? The opportunity to directly interact with Void Grotto Heaven? None of it was worth mentioning in Gu Nan's eyes.
Most of the interactions between players and NPCs were limited to the "mission-reward" pattern. Besides a few with special hobbies, no one would bother to have deeper interactions with NPCs.
As for seeking status within an NPC organization, that was even more laughable.
Players only knew to beat up disobedient NPCs until they obeyed and beat up those who still refused to obey until they died.
"So, do you have a grudge against any other gods?" Gu Nan turned to look at Daoist Lingyang again. He still hadn't forgotten that last time, Daoist Lingyang’s schemes to kill Lewis were still quite remarkable.
Daoist Lingyang replied a little curtly, "No!"
……
After Daoist Lingyang left as well, Gu Nan finally started to focus on considering which god he would be better off going after.
If a player had developed normally, they wouldn’t actually have these kinds of worries at all. This was because if one took the normal route to becoming a god, they would inevitably make some enemies and friends, so it was much more convenient to lay out a plan around them than going after someone out of thin air.
Just like how he used Elise to lure out the God of Love, there were quite many lures similar to Elise. It’s just that trying to find such lures wasn’t an easy task.
Of course it wasn’t like there weren’t any upsides to Gu Nan’s current situation. At least he was like an invisible person in the World of Gods, ensuring that as long as he didn't do anything too eye-catching, very few people would pay attention to him.
A few moments later, Lan Si was called before Gu Nan.
Lan Si’s life was very peaceful lately. As long as she kept an eye on both Xie Yun and Liang Ruxin, she only needed to focus on her own cultivation, which was much easier than in the Myriad Heavens.
However, she knew her peaceful days were finally coming to an end when Gu Nan placed a document in front of her.
"Here's a list." Gu Nan pointed to the list and said, "Find out what these people are up to and if they've encountered anything strange recently."
Lan Si skimmed through the names on the list and realized they were basically all mortals—it was rare to see even Legend Rank experts on that list—and all of them lived in the main planes.
"Understood," Lan Si didn't ask further questions and immediately agreed. "But we're understaffed here, time-wise…"
Actually, it wasn't just a lack of manpower. Gu Nan simply had no manpower to speak of in the World of Gods.
"Ask… Lingyang for help. Atalante is already mostly his anyway. Since he’s going to rebuild his astral world, there's no way he doesn't have forces in the other main planes."
Gu Nan thought about it and ultimately decided not to seek Rolensia’s help.
Now that she was already a greater god, openly seeking her assistance to kill other gods might cause her to see some clues and discover his identity as an Evil God.
As for Daoist Lingyang, it seemed that he made up his mind to establish his astral world in the World of Gods. Nobody knew what exactly he was thinking.
Lan Si took the list drawn up by Gu Nan and started investigating the situation of all the baits listed on there, but only two days later, Gu Nan received a different piece of news first.
Liang Ruxin had returned.
"My Lord." Liang Ruxin, who was carrying two swords on his back, met Gu Nan with a very different appearance. If it wasn’t for some similarities in his facial structure, Gu Nan wouldn't have been able to recognize him.
The former Liang Ruxin had gone through the vicissitudes of life, so his face appeared older, resembling a middle-aged uncle with a face full of scruff.
But now his skin was as white as a woman’s, with no calluses visible on the palms of his hands. His long hair fell down to his shoulders, and his entire person exuded a decadent and demonic aura.
"Are you sure the class you changed to is Phantom Sword Saint and notSunflower Successor
[1]
?" Gu Nan asked while rubbing his chin. Even Chamberlain himself didn’t have this appearance after creating this class.
Liang Ruxin, however, revealed a troubled smile. "Master's sword art is too profound for this humble one to comprehend directly, so I had to divide it into two and cultivate them one after the other."
"How did you divide it?"
"I divided the sword art into Yin and Yang." Liang Ruxin instantly straightened up when he started discussing swordsmanship. "I first obtained the Yin Sword. I will learn the Yang Sword after that, entering major attainment only after I master both parts."
Gu Nan's expression couldn't help turning a little strange. Although he himself had never gone the Phantom Sword Saint route, he knew that there was absolutely no such thing as Yin and Yang in this route.
In fact, this was entirely Liang Ruxin's own understanding, a theory of swordsmanship from the Myriad Heavens.
