This was also an issue Gu Nan had overlooked. In the end, people of the Myriad Heavens weren’t players. They had their own set of worldviews, as well as their own understanding of power systems.
Young people like An Tiansheng and Xie Yun were still fine, but Liang Ruxin's three views had already been formed, and his talent and understanding were equally high, so it was too much to ask him to honestly follow the unfamiliar new route to the letter.
However, being able to have his own understanding might not necessarily be a bad thing, and he might achieve more in the future.
Gu Nan was more interested in the so-called "Yin Yang Swords" and casually said, "Try attacking with it."
Liang Ruxin nodded and pulled out a sword directly from behind him. He knew that the gap between himself and the one before him was so great that it was impossible to injure the other party, so he had nothing to worry about.
Moreover, now that he’d broken through to Void Cutter Realm, he was eager to test his newfound strength.
The longsword Liang Ruxin held was a strange sword that glowed faintly, but for some inexplicable reason, the light seemed to capture people's hearts and minds.
There was nothing strange about the sword itself. Rather, it became like this only after Liang Ruxin infused it with his power.
In the next moment, the Yin Sword instantly cut through space and arrived straight in front of Gu Nan—to be in front of Gu Nan and still be able to easily tear through space was something that even many gods couldn’t do!
Gu Nan's gaze turned slightly serious. Already, this was not an ability that belonged to the Phantom Sword Saint class, but rather created through Liang Ruxin's own understanding of the route.
Just as the Yin Sword was about to land on Gu Nan, Liang Ruxin moved his body again, actually splitting into six images of himself who all simultaneously attacked from six different directions. This was the Phantom Sword Saint’s signature ability.
"How interesting." Gu Nan grabbed one of the longswords with one hand but allowed the others to stab his body, a small smile appearing on his face.
The illusory swords instantly disappeared, while only a few white spots were left on Gu Nan's body. Liang Ruxin was slightly taken aback, but he came back to his senses and hastily sheathed his sword. "I’ve offended you."
Gu Nan waved his hand with a smile. "Do you know what role your current abilities are best suited for?"
"What?"
"Assassin."
T/N:
[1] Sunflower Successor
- Reference to the Sunflower Manual from the Wuxia novel
The Smiling, Proud Wanderer
where anyone who cultivates it must first castrate themselves

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Opportunity
chapters.content:
For Gu Nan, the benefits of Liang Ruxin's peculiar interpretation of his route still outweigh the losses.
Phantom Sword Saint was a melee class that specialized in direct combat, and the class change wouldn't affect Liang Ruxin's role as a close-range fighter, but it was different now thanks to his new ability—assassin-type characters could sometimes play unimaginably critical roles.
Because both the Myriad Heavens and the World of Gods were ultimately worlds where organizations were held up by a few powerful people, the destruction of high-end combatants often meant the collapse of the group.
More importantly, Gu Nan didn’t have a shortage of melee fighters under his command. Instead, he was very short on such specialized talents.
Early the next morning, Gu Nan called Xie Yun over as well, asking her to try her hand against Liang Ruxin.
The outcome was unsurprising. Xie Yun, who’d been searching for gold mines all over the world just now, completely underestimated Liang Ruxin, who had just broken through to Void Cutter Realm, and she lost five out of five battles.
Towards the end, even Xie Yun herself felt a little dizzy and made several low-level mistakes in a row, leading to an almost overwhelming defeat in the last fight.
After the two left, Gu Nan looked at Lan Si. "What do you think of the two of them?"
Lan Si answered without much hesitation, "Xie Yun is stronger in terms of pure strength, but Liang Ruxin has more tricks up his sleeve and more experience."
Gu Nan nodded slightly. With Lan Si’s current insight, her evaluation of the two was basically spot on.
Using the game’s terms, Xie Yun was like a normal player with all purple rarity equipment. She was only able to play the game and was far from highly skilled in terms of technical skills.
Liang Ruxin, on the other hand, was like a professional player with all white rarity equipment. Although his stats weren’t as good, he had far more skills than his opponents, and his experience was also more sophisticated.
However, the issue of experience varied from person to person. What Gu Nan wanted to tell Lan Si was actually the difference in routes.
"You shouldn't think that Liang Ruxin is more valuable than Xie Yun just because of this," Gu Nan said as such. "No matter how fast Liang Ruxin can comprehend his sword art, he still has to rely on himself to reach enlightenment."
Lan Si seemed to understand something and asked somewhat incredulously, "Don’t tell me that Xie Yun can break through to Tier 5 as long as she has enough gold?"
In fact, even she herself was still stuck at the threshold of Tier 5. This was, after all, the difference between a god and a human.
It’s just that Lan Si possessed a Godhead, so it was far easier for her to reach that threshold than others, and even if she was stuck at the threshold, she was still able to wield power stronger than others her level.
But Xie Yun… didn't even have a threshold.
"That’s right." Gu Nan smiled. "As long as you pay money, you can become stronger—this is the only conscience greedy game developers have."
In terms of overall strength, the Pay to Win Expert could only be considered an average route. After all, players just needed Evil Value and points to level up, so it wasn't really that difficult.
Moreover, this route hardly provided any combat-oriented skills, and all its class-specific skills just made it easier to get gold.
But for NPCs who had to cultivate on their own, the advantages of a Pay to Win Expert were immense. No bottlenecks, no need for enlightenment, leveling up by paying money—this was the dream of countless NPCs.
"I'll take her back to the Myriad Heavens as soon as possible." Lan Si had already realized Xie Yun's enormous potential, especially when paired with the near-infinite resources of the Myriad Heavens.
Gu Nan nodded and instructed, "Take Liang Ruxin with you as well. Have them familiarize themselves with their abilities as soon as possible. I will most likely launch a new Divine Kingdom War soon after I return."
Lan Si nodded and left, getting to work on Gu Nan's list.
This was the only mission left for her on this side. As long as she delivered the information to Gu Nan, she could return to the Myriad Heavens as soon as possible.
……
However, Gu Nan didn’t expect a perfect opportunity to deliver itself right to his door before he even heard news about that list.
"There's a little bit of trouble, I might need help from you guys," Sylvia said calmly while holding a cup of green tea.
This cup of clear tea naturally came from the Daoist Lingyang next to her. The World of Gods didn't have a drink like green tea.
"Oh?" Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow, a little curious. In his impression, Sylvia had never been a god with a lot of missions on her. Instead, she could be considered the type that really didn’t make many enemies.
However, it was true that Sylvia rarely showed up recently and seemed to have something on her mind.
Daoist Lingyang looked like he already knew what was going on and chuckled from the sidelines. "Speaking of which, this actually has something to do with this old Daoist."
Sylvia glared at him in annoyance before slowly explaining what happened.
This matter was indeed related to Daoist Lingyang. Earlier, he schemed to kill Lewis. Though the process was a bit different from what he expected, the result was still quite satisfactory.
Lewis was most certainly dead after that battle, and the Dark Empire on Atalante began to fall apart, but one person survived.
Dark Warrior Goro, this genius character who had risen like a comet from mortal beginnings to godhood step by step, was still active in the main planes.
Back then, not even Daoist Lingyang attacked him. Not only were there numerous secrets on this person, but he was also rumored to have a connection to a certain bigshot in the Dark Faction and was by no means someone who was easy to deal with.
Of course, no one could compare to Sylvia when it came to having a backer, but it wasn't her personal matter this time.
Diana, Goddess of the Night and the Moon and one of Sylvia's few close friends, was now practically archenemies with Goro.
"After Lewis died, Goro left his faction and went solo." Daoist Lingyang helped explain, "There was a treasure that was originally offered to Diana by an apostle in a main plane, but Goro stole it."
Gu Nan frowned in thought for a while but failed to recall any entanglements these two had.
If memory served him, then Goro and Diana shouldn't have crossed paths, even if their laws were indeed quite similar.
Or rather, putting aside the part of Diana's divine authority related to the moon, it was even reasonable to say that those two had the exact same divine authority.
Gu Nan, who was familiar with the game’s backstory, knew that Goro's law was precisely the law of night, and there was even a plotline that helped Goro become the greater god ruling over night.
"It's something from that side," Daoist Lingyang added, naturally referring to the Myriad Heavens. "It was originally supposed to be gifted to Lewis."
When Daoist Lingyang said this, Gu Nan understood.
The present was originally supposed to be given to Lewis, but Lewis had already died at Daoist Lingyang’s hands by the time it was delivered. However, how could a treasure capable of tempting even Lewis truly be gifted without wanting anything in exchange?
Since it was no longer possible for Lewis to return this favor, the item was naturally gifted to someone else who needed it.
Gu Nan figured this out and asked, "Is it a treasure related to the law of night?"
"Yes." Daoist Lingyang nodded. "The Night King's blade from 7,000 years ago. Who would have imagined that it would become an item no one wanted, so it could only be sent here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 458: Goro’S Whereabouts
chapters.content:
The Night King was quite a famous Star Ruler in the Myriad Heavens, having made a legendary reputation for himself 7,000 years ago, only to fall quickly afterwards.
He didn't die at the hands of his enemies but lost to the Great Dao—back then, the Tier 10 Night King failed in the final step of breaking through to Unified Dao.
After the Night King, no other famous cultivators using the law of “night” appeared in the Myriad Heavens, so the person who obtained the Blade of Night had no choice but to sell it to this side.
Perhaps some weaker Star Rulers who just entered that realm might have the right law, but they couldn't afford the exorbitant price.
"Perhaps this blade was also the reason Goro fell out with Lewis's former subordinates," Gu Nan said with a smile, already imagining the big drama that happened.
Lewis was already a Tier 10 god himself, so he had very little need for the Blade of Night. There was an 80% chance that he bought this blade for Goro as a way of roping him into his faction.
"Exactly." Daoist Lingyang also added, "That's why Goro openly set out to steal it. In any case, Diana hasn't paid for it yet."
"But Diana doesn't want to give up that blade," Sylvia said stiffly from the sidelines.
Of course she was siding with her friend. From Diana’s point of view, she didn’t care about all these reasons—all she knew was that someone had stolen her stuff.
Unlike Sylvia, Diana was definitely a god with a very good social network.
She belonged to the Light Faction, but because of the nature of her own laws, she also had friendships with many Dark Faction gods. Goro stealing her item was akin to stirring up a hornet's nest.
Sylvia wanted to help, but Goro's strength grew too fast and was probably almost at Tier 7 by now. She wasn't sure she could handle Goro, so she wanted to invite Gu Nan and Daoist Lingyang to join her.
"If you guys have locked onto Goro's location and need anything from this old Daoist, just say the word," Daoist Lingyang was a good person, so he naturally wouldn’t refuse such an easy request.
Rather, it was Gu Nan's reaction that was somewhat out of their expectations.
"How can you guys leave me out?" Gu Nan’s expression seemed to indicate he was honor-bound to do this. "As long as there are any traces of Goro, please be sure to notify me. I will help confirm Goro’s whereabouts."
Daoist Lingyang stared at Gu Nan strangely. In his impression, Gu Nan didn't seem like someone with an overwhelming sense of justice at all.
Sylvia, on the other hand, was happy. She was too lazy to think about Gu Nan’s actual motives; she was just satisfied with his statement.
"Excellent! Diana is trying to organize gods who are willing to contribute. Do you want to come along?"
Gu Nan nodded vigorously. "Naturally."
……
Daoist Lingyang sent Lan Si and her group away. Along with Xie Yun and Liang Ruxin, they returned to the Myriad Heavens.
Gazing at their departing figures, the now younger-looking Daoist Lingyang revealed a thoughtful expression.
Gu Nan never actually had any intention of hiding his actions from Daoist Lingyang and even asked for Daoist Lingyang’s help when tasking Lan Si with finding that list of mortals.
Especially after learning that Gu Nan's goal was to hunt gods, Daoist Lingyang felt more and more puzzled.
He couldn't figure out how Gu Nan's actions would help him accomplish his goal, not to mention the fact that he actually showed such keen interest after hearing about the Blade of Night.
The fact that Gu Nan then asked him to send Lan Si and the others away undoubtedly meant he saw no need for Lan Si to stay here any longer.
"Could it be that he wants to kill Goro?" Daoist Lingyang thought about it and eventually came up with this conclusion.
Gu Nan's origins had always been mysterious. Perhaps others were afraid of Goro's possible backer, while Gu Nan had no such scruples at all and wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to strike.
Of course, what he didn’t know was that Gu Nan still needed to kill at least two Tier 8 gods. His appetite simply couldn’t be sated with a mere Goro.
……
The Divine Kingdom of Night and Moon.
"I'm very grateful to everyone for coming. The night sides with justice, and the night will remember your help," Diana smiled gently as she thanked the arriving helpers.
This time, ten gods had converged here, and that was just the vanguard responsible for locking onto Goro’s location. Clearly, Diana was very popular.
However, since Diana herself was only a Tier 8 god, there were no characters beyond that level among the people who came to help this time.
Including Gu Nan and Sylvia, there were a total of ten helpers here, and the strongest among them were the three Tier 8 gods.
God of Paper Marshall, God of Recovery Luke, and Sky God Cliff, who had met Gu Nan once before and was also a member of the Heaven-God Alliance.
These three were all gods from the Light Faction. While it showed that Diana was well-liked, it also showed that a divide still existed between gods of different factions.
Cliff was slightly taken aback when he saw Gu Nan and Sylvia, then took the lead in nodding at them in greeting.
"We're all here to hunt down Goro, so let's not be too polite," Paper God Marshall was the first to speak. "Goro undoubtedly stole the Blade of Night for his own enlightenment, leaving us with little time."
With the Blade of Night in Goro's hands, every additional day that passed increased the likelihood of him completely comprehending the law contained in the weapon, and by that time, the weapon will lose some effectiveness even if they manage to recapture it.
It was practically common knowledge that Marshall was a devoted suitor of the Goddess of Night and Moon, so it was easy for him to say the things that were inconvenient for Diana to say.
"That's right, we need to find Goro as soon as possible," Luke, who was on the sidelines, nodded as well.
Luke looked like an uncle with messy hair; the word unkempt was practically made for him.
However, he himself didn't think so and had always regarded his grooming as trendy, believing that he could win some goddesses’ favor with it, and he was likewise Diana's suitor.
If Marshall was a true fan of Diana's, then Luke was purely wooing her to prove his own charms.
The two always liked to follow Diana everywhere, and this time was no exception.
Gu Nan's gaze swept over the two and continued the conversation, "Goro is likely hiding in Atalante."
"How so?" Seeing that a third person had finally spoken up, Marshall didn't want to go toe-to-toe with his old rival at a time like this, so he hurriedly asked while looking at Gu Nan.
Luke also rubbed his disheveled hair and stared at Gu Nan. "Goro is definitely hiding in a main plane—this we all know, but what makes you say he's in Atalante?"
Only the spatial limitations of main planes would make it hard for the gods to quickly find Goro, and they were also the most suitable hiding places. This point needed no further explanation.
But there were so many main planes, and how to determine which one Goro was hiding in became the most important thing.
"Because I saw him there recently," Gu Nan, who’d been staying inside the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom all this time, said shamelessly.
"Really?" Diana was instantly pleasantly surprised. It was the best of luck to have a god who had once stumbled upon Goro by chance.
"Of course." Gu Nan smiled inscrutably. "Do I have any reason to lie to you guys?"

chapters.title: Chapter 459: Blade Of Night
chapters.content:
Diana and the others had reason to believe Gu Nan because like he said, why would he deceive them?
Sylvia's introduction of him was very clear—as a person from a foreign land who held no grudges against anyone here, Gu Nan had come to help solely because of Sylvia.
Therefore, after Gu Nan's "testimony", the focus of the search would undoubtedly shift to Atalante.
Of course, that wasn't to say they wouldn’t search the other main planes. After all, Goro was still alive, so it was entirely possible that he was in Atalante a while ago and then ran off to somewhere else.
Gu Nan only encountered him by chance earlier; it wasn't as if he predicted what would happen in advance and then kept an eye on Goro all the way.
However, it wasn't like no one suspected him.
"Hey, did you really see Goro?" Sylvia asked, looking at Gu Nan with a face full of disbelief.
At this time, everyone else had already left after being assigned search areas, so Sylvia finally had a chance to voice her unspoken doubts from earlier.
"Of course," Gu Nan replied firmly, not ashamed at all at telling a lie, "I previously investigated some mortals, and the focus was on Atalante. Lingyang can testify to that."
Sylvia naturally didn’t have the time to find Daoist Lingyang to corroborate those claims and was forced to leave skeptically.
There were a lot of main planes, and every main plane needed a god to search it, so even if Atalante was the focus of the search, only four gods were on this plane.
Gu Nan himself didn't need to be mentioned, and with Diana going to a nearby plane, among the three remaining gods in Atalante, only one was Tier 8—Luke, the God of Recovery.
As for the last two, Sylvia was not one of them. Diana herself assigned the gods to various search areas, distributing the power as evenly as possible without any time to take into account their respective relationships.
"Only one Tier 8—it's just right." Only when Sylvia left did Gu Nan reveal a smile.
For gods, crossing between planes wasn't a difficult task, but going from one main plane to another always took some time.
There was only one Luke in Atalante, which was undoubtedly Gu Nan's favorite situation.
Goro was at most Tier 7 right now, perhaps still Tier 6 even, and this bit of meat on a mosquito's leg certainly couldn’t satisfy Gu Nan. From the very beginning, his target was the group of gods that came to search for Goro.
Among these gods, no one could’ve imagined that Gu Nan was actually targeting them, because they couldn't find a motive.
What kind of case was the most difficult to solve? Of course it was the kind where no real motive for the crime could be found.
However, Gu Nan still needed to make some preparations before he could actually do anything—the current him didn’t plan to completely expose his identity.
……
Atalante, Ian City.
Ian was the capital of the Dark Empire, and with the Dark Empire's unification of the continent, this place had rightfully become the political center of the entire continent.
Gu Nan calmly strolled through the streets, his eyes skimming over the familiar streetscape.
Of course he was familiar with this place. As the continent with the most substantial plotline in the game, Atalante was the main plane that 70% of players first came into contact with, while 100% of the players had done missions in this plane.
Gu Nan had also started from the Dark Empire map on more than one occasion, so not only was he familiar with Ian City, he was also very familiar with Goro.
This predetermined protagonist of the game's storyline had been screwed over by players countless times, and some players even took pleasure in bullying Goro.
Gu Nan wasn't so bored as to bully Goro for fun, but he definitely knew Goro’s weaknesses better than that group of high and mighty gods.
Just like this, Gu Nan walked through the streets step by step until he slowly entered the palace, but none of the guards or passersby around him noticed his presence, as if he didn't exist at all.
Only when he walked up to a woman did everyone suddenly come back to their senses, feeling as if a silhouette had flashed through their minds, but for the life of them, they couldn’t remember what this person looked like.
"Your Excellency… who are you?" Natasha did her best to keep herself calm and asked in a low voice.
Even though she wielded great authority for a long time and the entire empire had been under her control ever since her father left, authority and power in the mortal world was ultimately a mere illusion.
Natasha, who was a Legend Rank powerhouse herself, was perfectly aware of this.
Therefore, she also knew that the person before her was absolutely not someone she could oppose. Resistance was futile. All she could do was to figure out the other party's goal as soon as possible.
"No need to be nervous, I'm not looking for you," Gu Nan replied with a smile.
Before Natasha could return to her senses, a small pitch-black dagger emerged out of thin air and shot straight at Natasha's forehead.
Natasha was completely unable to guard against this dagger. She only felt a flash in front of her eyes as the tip of the dagger shot over, and then a curtain of night jumped out in front of her, barely blocking the dagger.
It wasn’t accurate to say it blocked it, because the curtain of night only blocked the dagger for a split second before it shattered.
But thanks to this delay, Natasha had time to leap to the side in a hurry, glancing over in fright.
"Your Excellency, who are you?"
It was the same question, but this time, it didn’t come from Natasha's mouth, but from a male voice from the depths of the room—it was Goro's voice.
Of course Gu Nan couldn't possibly know where Goro was, and he didn't have the time to search all over Atalante, but he knew how to find Goro.
The reasoning was also simple: as a key figure in the rise of the Dark Empire, Goro was none other than the husband of Imperial Princess Natasha. This sentimental and righteous Dark Warrior could never sit back and watch his wife die.
By relying on the locator spell he placed on Natasha in advance, Goro rushed to the palace as soon as possible and stared at Gu Nan with a dark expression.
He was indeed in Atalante, but he was hiding in an obscure corner. A cunning rabbit had three burrows; searching for him was most certainly not an easy task.
Now that Gu Nan forced him to show himself, the risk of his exposure was much greater.
"Give me the Blade of Night," Gu Nan said calmly.
Without any half-hearted hesitation at all, Goro drew the long blade from his waist and threw it in front of Gu Nan before saying, "Can I take her away now?"
"I'm afraid not yet." Gu Nan took the Blade of Night and sensed the law of night inside, then smiled.
"In the end, you still affected the law of night inside it. I’ll have to wait for Diana to see it herself. She can decide what to do with you." Gu Nan had an
It’s not up to me; I was just entrusted with this
look.
Goro didn't really suspect him. Of course his punishment had to be decided by Diana, the victim herself—this was a matter of course.
He just felt that he was too unlucky. There was actually such a shameless person among these high and mighty gods who knew so much about him and knew to threaten him with Natasha.
Gu Nan waved his hand and summoned a shadow to trap Natasha in place, ensuring that no one could break through and take her away, before he leisurely disappeared with the Blade of Night.
The next second, he appeared at the other end of Atalante, in Luke’s search area.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: Prey
chapters.content:
Gu Nan arrived so quickly that even Luke was a little surprised.
"You found Goro's trail?" Luke asked Gu Nan as he tilted his head of messy hair.
"Yup, I was lucky." Gu Nan nodded and took out a long blade from behind him. "Do you recognize this?"
At the very least, Luke was still a Tier 8 god, and although his law wasn’t very strong in terms of both grade and combat power, he could still recognize the law aura on the Blade of Night at first glance.
"This is… the Blade of Night?" He found it a little hard to believe. He and the others hadn't even done anything yet, but someone already obtained the item that Diana needed just like this.
"How can it be that simple?" Gu Nan revealed a helpless look and said, "There are still some problems with this Blade of Night."
Only then did Luke nod in understanding. Goro had always been known among the gods for his cunning and resourcefulness, so he didn’t really believe Gu Nan was able to get his hands on the Blade of Night that easily.
On the contrary, it was more plausible that Gu Nan suddenly discovered Goro’s whereabouts, so he had to leave the Blade of Night behind in a hurry, but also left them some trouble inside the weapon.
Luke’s imaginative brain filled in all the details for him while Gu Nan held up the Blade of Night in front of Luke.
"What's wrong with the blade?"
"See the edge?" Gu Nan pointed at the blade of the Blade of Night, which was radiating a rich darkness.
Luke stared at the blade with unblinking eyes, as if he wanted to find some clues from it.
However, in the next instant, the Blade of Night suddenly shot up and viciously slashed at his neck!
Golden divine blood spurted out violently as a large portion of Luke’s neck was severed. Only then did he look at Gu Nan in disbelief.
With his divine body critically damaged in an instant, it was already too late for him to mobilize his own laws.
"Why…?"
Gu Nan had no intention of giving Luke a chance to recover at all, much less answering his question, and slashed down several more times.
The Blade of Night, a weapon that once belonged to a Tier 10 powerhouse, was utilized to astonishing effect in Gu Nan's hands.
The curtain of night easily tore through Luke's defenses and chopped his body into several pieces.
This God of Recovery, who was supposed to be the hardest to kill, was put down without any resistance by Gu Nan's shameful sneak attack.
The law he was so proud of didn't come in handy at all, as Gu Nan's burst damage was too high and didn't give him a chance to heal his HP at all.
"Next…"
Gu Nan's gaze flickered as his mind recalled the geographic distribution of the remaining Tier 8 gods.
The main plane closest to Atalante had a Tier 8 god, and that was the Sky God Cliff.
Although the cautious Cliff would be harder to deal with compared to Marshall, there was no other choice at the moment.
After all, if he deliberately made a detour, his plan to frame Goro wouldn’t hold up under scrutiny, and Gu Nan's special trip to get the Blade of Night would become meaningless.
Gu Nan organized Luke's corpse and put it in a pile to the side, then quickly left Atalante.
He was on a very tight schedule. After all, Luke wasn't an invisible person like the Love God. His death would soon be discovered, so the next kill had to be done as soon as possible.
The Evil Value contributed by Luke—which was a bit higher than the God of Love—had already reached 3,500, and it would be enough to just kill one more Tier 8 god.
……
The main plane Cliff was in charge of searching belonged to the Light Faction and had an interesting name: it was called Sanctuary Continent.
Sanctuary Continent was the main plane that produced the greatest number of light attribute creatures, including all types of angels, light elementals, holy unicorns, and so on.
However, Sanctuary Continent wasn’t a unified continent. Rather, it was divided into three empires on the outer edge, with a large number of small- and mid-sized kingdoms in the center.
The main fighting forces of the various kingdoms were the elite knight orders that shared a common faith and even had similar doctrines.
Unlike Luke, who was hiding in Atalante, Cliff was openly staying in one of his temples, as he was one of the gods worshiped in Sanctuary Continent to begin with.
But that didn't mean Cliff wasn't being cautious—in fact, he was far more careful than Luke. It was absolutely necessary for gods to remain vigilant at all times whenever they were in a main plane.
The existence of his temple also ensured that no one could sneak in at will; this was a god’s home turf.
However, Gu Nan knew Cliff's personality equally well and naturally found a solution.
Cliff sat in silence inside the temple with his eyes closed, waiting for information from the search parties, but his eyes suddenly flew open.
In his senses, a distinct aura emerged outside the temple—it was precisely the law of night!
However, Cliff, who was cautious by nature, didn’t act rashly. Instead, a trace of mockery appeared in his eyes.
"Such an obvious diversion. Are you trying to trick me into calling the others over?"
The law of night appeared too close to him, which made him suspicious instead, so he decided to wait and see.
That aura hovered outside the temple for a while and, seemingly slightly anxious at Cliff’s lack of response, actually rushed towards the temple.
The sneer in Cliff's heart intensified, and while ordering his apostles to surround the intruder, he himself also rushed that way.
Since Goro dared to intrude into his sacred temple, would Cliff still actively avoid him? To put it bluntly, Goro was just a talented junior.
However, Cliff abruptly came back to his senses when the two started to make contact.
The one standing in front of him was not Goro!
The intruder was too fast and had too clear of a target, arriving in front of Cliff almost in the blink of an eye. It was none other than Gu Nan, who was holding the Blade of Night.
The current Gu Nan had wrapped his entire body pitch-black shadows, looking like a demonic creature.
Alarm bells started ringing in Cliff's head, but at the same time, the identity of the visitor made him suspicious.
The power of the Blade of Night had been brought out to the extreme, and the overly dense law of night masked Gu Nan's own power of shadows.
Moreover, the law of night and the law of shadows bore a certain resemblance to begin with, making it all the more impossible for Cliff to judge. But he knew at least one thing: this person was not Goro.
Gu Nan's cold gaze landed on Cliff, and without even saying anything, his hand rose up and was already swinging the blade at Cliff's body.
However, Cliff was prepared, and the Blade of Night didn’t cut into his divine body but was instead firmly blocked.
A light blue luster emerged in front of Cliff, as if he had set up the entire sky in front of him.
The Sky God was known as the god with the strongest defense; very few laws could break through his defense.
However, Gu Nan only smiled coldly without saying anything as his left hand threw another punch without hesitation. Could a strong defense be stronger than Karina?
The Blade of Night couldn’t bring out Gu Nan's full power at all because he was afraid it would break within a few strikes if he swung it with all his might.
The punch containing monstrous strength blasted apart the space in front of Cliff, directly shattering the sky in front of him.
The next instant, the Blade of Night stabbed into his body without any resistance.
Accompanied by the natural eruption of the law of night, another Tier 8 god died easily at Gu Nan's hands.
Reality proved that once an Evil God got close to them, gods weren’t actually much harder to kill than mortals.
And only now did the other gods searching for Goro finally arrive, beginning to gather on Sanctuary Continent—they were attracted by the erupting law of night.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: Confounding Mystery
chapters.content:
While Gu Nan was killing Cliff, he intentionally emitted the Blade of Night’s aura.
On one hand, it was to hide himself and prevent his identity from being seen through by Cliff at a glance, and on the other hand, it was a deliberate ploy to alert Diana and the others to the commotion here.
Gu Nan glanced at Cliff's corpse at his feet, a faint smile appearing on his face. Unlike Luke, Cliff's corpse hadn't been destroyed by him and only had a bloody gash in his chest.
The blame was ready, now he just had to pin it on Goro’s head.
Gu Nan's figure quickly disappeared before the other gods arrived, rushing back to Atalante.
……
This was the scene that greeted Diana and her group of gods by the time they arrived—Cliff's corpse was lying quietly inside the Sky Temple, with the law of night still lingering all over his body.
"Was it Goro?" Marshall gazed at the ground incredulously. Cliff's corpse made him feel a stab of pain.
Cliff was very strong, so much so that even Marshall believed Cliff to be the strongest god in this group. If even Cliff could be killed, then wasn't everyone else—including himself—also in danger?
Diana's expression was also extremely ugly. In any case, Cliff had been killed while helping her, and it made her feel very bad inside.
"It's possible that it's Goro… but how the hell did he do it?"
"Even Cliff died at his hands. As expected of a fellow who grew stronger alongside his main plane…"
“…Wait!" Sylvia snapped back from the shock of Cliff's death. "Why hasn't Gu Nan come over yet? Luke hasn't either!"
Accompanied by this cry of shock from Sylvia, the gods who arrived from all directions realized that there were two members missing among them.
As if she understood something, Diana blurted out, "Quick! Let's head to Atalante!"
……
Atalante.
Gu Nan returned to the palace inside Ian City, where Natasha was still being held captive by him; Goro didn’t even have the time to hide himself yet.
In fact, Gu Nan's round trip didn't take much time. His god-slaying journey moved very quickly. Goro had just finished placating his wife when Gu Nan returned.
Of course, it wasn't as if Goro hadn't tried to break Gu Nan's restraints on Natasha during this period, but with his mere Tier 6 power, he couldn't do such a thing yet.
As soon as he realized Gu Nan had shown up, Goro quickly stood up and glanced at him warily.
Gu Nan, however, merely smiled, casually tossing aside the Blade of Night before lifting the restraints on Natasha.
"What do you want? Are you letting us go?" The vigilance on Goro's face didn't diminish. He didn't even bother to pick up Blade of Night, shielding Natasha protectively behind him in the process.
"That's right." Gu Nan said calmly, "I'll add on a piece of advice as well: take this blade with you and get out of here as soon as possible."
Gu Nan's figure instantly vanished after saying that, as if he’d never been there in the first place.
The palace turned quiet again. Goro slowly walked forward and picked up the Blade of Night. The law of night within it was still strong and didn’t seem to have suffered any damage to the weapon itself.
"He must’ve done something evil with this blade and pinned it on your head," Natasha couldn't help speaking up as she watched Goro's movements.
She grew up in the palace and assisted her father the emperor with political affairs when she was young, so she was all too familiar with such tactics.
It was also because Gu Nan made it very obvious, not bothering to hide it from the two at all.
Goro took a deep breath and put the Blade of Night back in its sheath. "Even if I know that’s the case… I still have to accept this blade."
Natasha was stunned. "Is it really that valuable?"
She wasn't a god, so of course she couldn't tell the Blade of Night's exact value at a glance. She just felt that since Gu Nan had gone to such lengths to make Goro the scapegoat, the blame he was pinning on Goro would definitely be heavy.
"The fact that this is a valuable weapon is one factor…" Goro said helplessly, "More importantly, this blade is something I stole from someone. Would anyone believe me if I went out now and told them someone else stole it from me?"
……
Diana also didn’t believe it. Nobody who could become a god was stupid… Well, except for Karina.
After searching Atalante thoroughly, there was still no sign of Gu Nan and Luke, which was enough for the crowd to understand what had happened.
Goro suddenly gained a great deal of strength or temporarily gained some other kind of leverage and killed two of Atalante's searchers—this leverage, of course, was most likely the Blade of Night.
Then he ran to Sanctuary Continent and killed Cliff inside the Sky Temple, but because the latter was already prepared, Goro had to bring out all the power hidden inside the Blade of Night, alerting the other gods in the vicinity and causing him to flee in a hurry.
The most typical evidence was, of course, that Cliff's corpse hadn't been disposed of in time and was left behind as evidence.
Granted, although gods didn’t trust people easily, this was already the most likely scenario based on the evidence they found so far.
In order to disprove this claim or argue for other possibilities, the first step was to find Goro—so the question arose again: Who still dared to stay in the main plane after all this?
One Tier 8 god had already fallen and two other gods were missing, so who dared to claim that they were infallible?
Even Diana herself was too embarrassed to open her mouth and ask the crowd to venture forward to search for Goro.
"I’ve troubled everyone this time." With a helpless smile, Diana urged everyone to leave, as long as they could occasionally keep an eye out for Goro.
Of course, if they could find Gu Nan or Luke, she also requested the gods to help ask those two what happened to them.
One by one, the gods left helplessly, except for Sylvia, who left deep in thought—she didn't have much evidence, but intuition didn't need evidence.
……
"What? You're saying Gu Nan hasn't returned?" Sylvia looked at Daoist Lingyang in surprise, as if the answer was quite unexpected.
She, who originally thought that Gu Nan would return secretly, couldn’t help feeling a little more worried. "Could it be that… Gu Nan really met with an accident?"
Sylvia wasn't actually very concerned about Gu Nan. Rather, since she was the one who asked the other party for help, she more or less shared some responsibility if Gu Nan died at Goro’s hands.
"What happened?" Daoist Lingyang couldn't help asking.
Sylvia didn't hide anything and recounted what happened after they started searching for Goro.
After understanding the entire matter, Daoist Lingyang revealed a strange smile and said, "So that’s it… You don't have to worry about him. Gu Nan has great fortune, so he’ll be fine."
"Do you know something?" Sylvia sized up the other party with a skeptical gaze and asked suspiciously.
Daoist Lingyang, however, just shook his head in silence. After a long time, he replied, "If you want to confirm Gu Nan's status, wouldn't it be better to take a look yourself?"
"Take a look how?"
"His astral world is still in the Myriad Heavens…" Daoist Lingyang said matter-of-factly.
Sylvia’s eyes instantly lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Tier 8
chapters.content:
When Gu Nan finally reappeared, he was already inside his own Divine Kingdom back in the Myriad Heavens.
He was considered someone from the Myriad Heavens in this life, so he needed a space-time crystal to enter the World of Gods but naturally didn't need one to go back.
When Gu Nan returned, not much time actually passed since Lan Si and her group came back. However, because of the time flow difference unique to the Myriad Heavens, quite a bit of time went by in the Divine Kingdom.
At least, Xie Yun had already reached Tier 5 by now!
The special law of time in the Myriad Heavens made it so that the smaller the plane, the easier and more efficient it was to develop.
This was especially true for people like Xie Yun, who needed special resources—regardless of whether it was a large or small plane, gold was always the same.
"Her breakthrough was too fast. Will it leave any problems?" More than one person expressed concern about this, but Gu Nan himself was the only one who had no such worries.
Player routes were originally prepared to serve the players, and the benefits they brought were completely free of side effects. This was what made the player army so powerful.
Utilizing resources meant for players to create NPCs that were beyond imagination.
Of course, it wasn’t like a Pay to Win Expert was invincible. After all, this class could only make the player themselves stronger, but the astral world still had to be developed entirely by the player.
In other words, perhaps in the near future, Gu Nan would have a group of oddball underlings who already reached Tier 6 or 7 themselves but didn't even possess an astral world yet.
It was naturally inconceivable for anyone else, but player routes could indeed bring about this kind of advancement that went beyond common sense.
Instead, it was Lan Si who looked a little depressed. She was originally the strongest apostle under Gu Nan, but she didn't expect to be surpassed by a little girl like Xie Yun in the blink of an eye.
She even somewhat regretted not taking the opportunity to join the player army as well back in the World of Gods—at that time, she felt that since she had a Godhead, other paths couldn’t even compare to her rate of progress.
This was the limitation in an NPC’s viewpoint. They could never understand the power of players.
Fortunately, Pay to Win Expert only gave Xie Yun a high cultivation realm; her combat skills and experience still had major flaws.
As a result, she couldn’t beat Lan Si—who’d been making steady progress in contrast—for the time being, and she would even lose two to three out of ten rounds to Liang Ruxin.
But again, this was much stronger compared to before.
……
Gu Nan sat alone on the throne in the Evil God Temple, calmly operating the panel as he upgraded structure after structure, with Tier 8 already close at hand.
After killing Cliff, Gu Nan's Evil Value exceeded 16,000, satisfying the requirement for Tier 8.
As a well-known Tier 8 God, Cliff gave a lot of Evil Value and was practically the peak of all Tier 8 gods.
After he upgraded all the basic structures and even a few Divine Servant Institutes to meet the minimum requirements, all the conditions for Gu Nan's advancement were in place.
Without much hesitation, he directly chose to upgrade the Evil God Temple.
Similar to earlier advancements, the Evil God Temple inside the Divine Kingdom swelled violently in size, expanding to the point where it was as big as a small city.
Boundless power of shadows poured into Gu Nan's body, while he had long since grown accustomed to this.
Instead, the strange phenomena happening outside the Divine Kingdom caused a stir.
……
As a famous person in the Myriad Heavens, Gu Nan and his Divine Kingdom were also watched by countless forces.
Therefore, many people noticed as soon as changes started occurring to the Divine Kingdom and immediately reported the situation to their superiors.
In the Myriad Heavens, Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom began to leap towards the center at a rapid pace. The power of the law of time gradually weakened, and space itself was further strengthened instead.
Time and space were originally two sides of the same coin, and now that one was strengthening and the other weakening, many people realized what was happening.
"This means… it’s about to ascend to a Realm Level plane?!"
Once the astral world leapt to the center of the Myriad Heavens, the flow of time would no longer be any different from the main world. Space became extremely stable, and living beings could now reincarnate from the astral world to other worlds, while the reverse became impossible.
From all angles, it wasn’t an exaggeration to say that this was as monumental a step as acarp leaping over the Dragon Gate
[1]
!
Countless intelligence officers caught wind of this astonishing news and reported it to their superiors at the first opportunity.
……
"It’s ascending to a Realm Level plane so quickly?" Xue Ren was staying in his own astral world at the moment and couldn’t help his slight surprise at hearing the news.
It had taken him quite a bit of effort to suppress the internal strife within Extreme Sword Heaven and once again devote himself fully to his own cultivation.
However, Xue Ren wasn't completely oblivious to external events, so of course a major commotion like Gu Nan's ascension immediately reached his ears.
Gao Xiaowen was the one who passed on the news, and he was also referred by Xue Ren into the Heaven-God Alliance.
"Martial Uncle, should we invite Lord Gu Nan over…"
"No need." Xue Ren waved his hand. "Just go and congratulate him on my behalf. He will naturally speak up if he really wants to get involved with matters here."
"Yes."
……
Not only did Xue Ren get the news, all major forces received first-hand information at practically the same time!
The ascension of a new Realm Level plane was considered a big deal no matter what when.
In Clockwork Heaven, Lu Wen tapped his fingers on the desk, his gaze slightly cold.
In Void Grotto Heaven, standing in front of Yu Lian was none other than Daoist Heir Qin Ning, recounting his encounter with Gu Nan in the World of Gods.
In Zi Luo Heaven, the old man who no longer made frequent appearances in public showed a rare hint of a smile and even ordered someone to send a congratulatory gift to Gu Nan.
The biggest reaction was naturally still inside Academic Heaven.
Fang Chaoyun personally rushed to Academic Heaven to meet his teacher as soon as he received the news.
"Teacher, Gu Nan’s astral world ascended to a Realm Level plane," Fang Chaoyun was still a powerful Tier 10 Star Ruler, so he didn't lose his cool and just spoke of the matter like a routine report.
Song Fei, on the other hand, still had that calm demeanor, as if nothing in the world could move him.
It’s just that he knew very well that the fact his own disciple paid a special visit to Academic Heaven was in itself proof of the importance he attached to this event.
So Song Fei let out a small sigh and responded, "Since that's the case, let's stop the operation targeting him."
Fang Chaoyun didn't answer for a long time before finally replying somewhat unwillingly, "He’s just at Realm Level. In a fair fight, your disciple has nothing to fear."
He was one of the strongest people under Unified Dao Realm, so he naturally didn't feel like a mere Realm Level Star Ruler was much of a threat.
Song Fei, however, only chuckled slightly. "Gu Nan is nothing to worry about. But we are about to focus on dealing with Zi Luo and Xue Ren right now. By getting entangled with Gu Nan’s matter, you will have fallen into their trap."
Fang Chaoyun was slightly stunned. "Gu Nan is those two’s pawn?"
"It matters not whether he is or isn’t." Song Fei said noncommittally, "Ten years from now, as long as Xue Ren doesn't enter Unified Dao, Zi Luo will naturally die, and it won't be too late to circle back and deal with Gu Nan at that time."
Only after Fang Chaoyun heard this did he slowly nod. "A gentleman can wait ten years to take revenge. In that case, I will follow Teacher's wishes."
Song Fei once again revealed a smile. "There just happens to be something I want you to do right now."
"What is it?"
"Join the Heaven-God Alliance."

Chinese mythology where a carp swimming upstream and leaping over the Dragon Gate at the top of a legendary waterfall would be able to become a dragon

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Naming The Astral World
chapters.content:
The ascension of Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom to Realm Level was naturally the most important event in the Myriad Heavens right now, but the person who started all this uproar was currently staring at Yan Xiaoxiao, whose appearance had changed.
Strictly speaking, it wasn't a change in appearance but rather a younger-looking Yan Xiaoxiao, only she was a little too young.
Gu Nan looked at this little girl in a light blue dress—who looked at most thirteen or fourteen years old—and almost couldn’t recognize her as Yan Xiaoxiao.
"Is this what you used to look like?" Gu Nan's memory was quite good, vaguely recalling that Yan Xiaoxiao looked somewhat similar to the person before him when he first met her.
"Yup." Yan Xiaoxiao smiled lightly and even twirled in passing.
The sunlight shone on her body, but it just passed straight through, leaving no trace of a shadow on the ground—the current Yan Xiaoxiao no longer had a tangible form.
From the moment Gu Nan advanced to Tier 8 and his Divine Kingdom jumped to a Realm Level plane, the world’s origin was strengthened again, and Yan Xiaoxiao could no longer escape her destiny.
She was originally created when Zuo Zuo extracted a portion of Immortal Demon World's origin, and only after reincarnating over and over again did she end up in her current state.
Now that Gu Nan planned to ascend his Divine Kingdom to Realm Level, unless Yan Xiaoxiao was willing to go far away, this day would come sooner or later.
The current Yan Xiaoxiao had completely fused with the Divine Kingdom, and it could be said that she was the embodiment of the world's will and also possessed the highest authority to manage the Divine Kingdom.
In the words of the Myriad Heavens, Yan Xiaoxiao had become the embodiment of the Heavenly Dao of this world.
Gu Nan glanced at her again and said, "You will forever exist alongside the Divine Kingdom in this world, and in the future, perhaps you’ll even become the embodiment of the will of the entire Myriad Heavens, but… you will never be able to exist in real life either."
The current Yan Xiaoxiao was the world itself, and the world was her. The person in front of Gu Nan was nothing more than a projection.
Unless the Divine Kingdom was destroyed, she would never die.
Yan Xiaoxiao, however, just nodded with a smile. "Eternal life doesn’t feel bad either. Then, Teacher, please don't let me disappear… Oh right, there's one more thing."
Yan Xiaoxiao sent Red Tail to Gu Nan after she said this.
"Is there a problem with the Divine Kingdom War’s target plane?" Gu Nan looked at her with puzzlement. At the moment, Red Tail was responsible for matters related to the Divine Kingdom War.
"That’s not it…" Red Tail shook her head with an awkward smile. "My Lord, you seem to keep forgetting one thing—this Divine Kingdom still doesn't have a name yet."
Red Tail's words caused Gu Nan to stare blankly, and then he remembered that this really was the case.
The various astral worlds of the Myriad Heavens, from the largest astral worlds at the level of the Thirteen Heavens to the smallest planes that had yet to be controlled by anyone, definitely had names—as long as they were discovered.
Some astral worlds were named after the plane’s special characteristics, some had names that came from the personal preferences of their Star Rulers, and others were simply named after the Star Rulers themselves.
For example, if Gu Nan put off naming his Divine Kingdom any longer, people would have to call it "Gu Nan Realm"—the first Realm Level plane ever to be named so casually.
Normally, when a plane was first discovered, there was no need to rush to name it.
This was because nobody knew exactly what special characteristics it had and how its future Star Ruler would go about naming it. It would probably take tens or hundreds of years before a recognized name would emerge for this astral world.
However, Gu Nan had developed a little too fast, raising his astral world to a “Realm” Level plane in almost the blink of an eye.
It wouldn't make sense for an astral world at this level to still be unnamed.
"Do you guys have any suggestions?" Gu Nan thought for a moment and looked at Red Tail and Yan Xiaoxiao.
He really didn't have any ideas himself, and it wasn’t like the Divine Kingdom had many special features to speak of. To put it bluntly, its only special characteristic was having an Evil God Temple—but including Evil God in the name would be a bit too stupid.
Wasn’t that blatantly announcing his identity to the gods next door?
"How about calling it the Hundred Wars Realm?" Red Tail didn't try to be polite with Gu Nan and suggested directly, "We rose up by waging one war after another, which precisely fits the description of ‘elite troops forged through a hundred wars’."
"I'm just sending you guys to slaughter other planes, what's so warlike about that?" Gu Nan vetoed the suggestion without thinking.
Yan Xiaoxiao also piped up, "If there aren’t any good suggestions, why don't we just use the previous 'Immortal Demon'? In any case, it's just a name."
Before Gu Nan could respond, Lan Si had also walked in at some point and interjected, "I think it's better to call it the ‘One God Realm', as Your Excellency can be considered the only god here."
Along with the first three, the number of people who subsequently entered the Evil God Temple increased, and after hearing about the important matter of naming this world, the suggestions also multiplied.
However, none of these names could satisfy Gu Nan, and in the end, it was he himself who made the final decision.
"Just call it ‘No Name Change til Unified Dao’ Realm."
……
The ascension of Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom to Realm Level caused a sensational impact in the Myriad Heavens, so much so that even the latest news from inside the Divine Kingdom quickly spread throughout the major planes.
"That name really is like him." Xue Ren didn’t know whether to laugh or cry as he sat across from Zhuangxuan.
Xue Ren was running out of time, so he couldn’t even spare time to personally visit Gu Nan and congratulate him on his astral world’s ascension. This time, it was still Zhuangxuan who specially rushed over to bring him the latest news.
Only Gu Nan would treat a matter as serious as the name of one’s astral world so flippantly.
On the contrary, Zhuangxuan wasn’t surprised by this, or even if he was, his face still wouldn’t show anything.
"The name will not affect Senior Gu Nan's power." Zhuangxuan said calmly, "As long as the organization can survive this ten-year calamity, he will undoubtedly be the next target we will focus all our resources on raising."
The Heaven-God Alliance had developed in secret for many years, and it also saw explosive growth just recently, so it had considerable resources under its control.
Pouring out the entire organization's strength to help a certain Star Ruler might not be of much help in terms of ascending to Unified Dao, but it had an all-encompassing effect in other areas.
Zhuangxuan was like the calmest of managers, always making choices in the organization’s best interest.
Xue Ren agreed with him, so he calmly waited for Zhuangxuan to continue—a mere controversial name was not worth Zhuangxuan's trip here.
Without disappointing Xue Ren, Zhuangxuan indeed added, "I came over this time because I received Fang Chaoyun's membership application."
"Who?" Xue Ren raised his eyebrows slightly and almost thought he had heard wrong.
"Fang Chaoyun," Zhuangxuan's voice was still calm, but it also seemed to contain a trace of helplessness.
Xue Ren froze for a long time, then slowly came back to his senses as he realized the malicious intent behind this application. After a long time, he couldn’t help sighing softly. "Sure enough, this is Song Fei’s handiwork…"
Upright and frank Song Fei. When it came to Academic Heaven's Unified Dao powerhouse, every single move was laid out in the open for all to see, and now it was the Heaven-God Alliance’s turn to make a choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 464: Seeking Revenge
chapters.content:
News that Fang Chaoyun wanted to join the Heaven-God Alliance undoubtedly stunned many people as soon as it came out.
Fang Chaoyun was a top-tier Star Ruler and was even a disciple of Academic Heaven’s Song Fei, so how could he join Zi Luo Elder’s Heaven-God Alliance? Weren't the two sides irreconcilable enemies?
So lots of people initially scoffed at this. Coupled with the fact that the Heaven-God Alliance didn’t give any comment about it, people thought it was fake news.
However, Fang Chaoyun himself soon stepped forward and spoke out, proving that he truly did submit an application to join the Heaven-God Alliance, and that he did indeed want to join the Heaven-God Alliance.
"The Heaven-God Alliance is an organization that belongs to the gods and Star Rulers. It's not one person’s sole possession, so why can't I join?"
Elder Fang's powerful question was like a sharp spear that tore through the layer of protective excuses in front of the Heaven-God Alliance.
The Heaven-God Alliance was founded entirely by Zi Luo Elder, and he also wielded the most authority inside the organization, but that didn't mean he could openly proclaim that the Heaven-God Alliance was his sole possession.
The current Heaven-God Alliance was flourishing mainly due to the fact that some Star Rulers wanted to cling onto a powerful organization. They would be able to tap into the strength of a group, which was why they wanted to join an organization that seemed incomparably powerful.
After all, an organization with a Unified Dao powerhouse sitting at its helm had never appeared in the entire Myriad Heavens before.
Previously, Zhuangxuan and the others had always been promoting the organization as being open to everyone, so people didn’t realize something was wrong. Only Song Fei saw the weakness hidden in the deepest part of the organization.
The organization may be open to everyone, but Unified Dao cultivators had their own stances.
If Fang Chaoyun's membership application was rejected, then all those who had a grudge against Zi Luo Elder’s people would have to reconsider their own stances.
In other words, from the moment Fang Chaoyun acknowledged his own application, the attitude of the Heaven-God Alliance became less important.
Even if onlookers could still apply enthusiastically, the Heaven-God Alliance wouldn't dare to accept people as recklessly as before, because Fang Chaoyun's move was likewise a warning to the Heaven-God Alliance.
It didn't matter if his own application was accepted or not, but who knows if there were spies from Academic Heaven among the subsequent applicants?
Song Fei's move pretty much brought everything that was originally buried deep in people's hearts to the surface.
"I've already rejected Fang Chaoyun's application without giving a reason," Zhuangxuan said as such.
Xue Ren nodded slightly. At times like this, rather than finding some specious excuses, it was better to not give an explanation. In any case, everyone already knew why.
However, Zhuangxuan then continued, "Of the people who joined the Alliance in the past two days, two have already withdrawn, and a few now need to be re-examined. There’s even an old member who was found to have originated from Academic Heaven."
Xue Ren fell silent for a moment. "Many of the older members didn't know about the old man's existence when they joined the Alliance…"
"But no one can guarantee that they won't be incited into betraying us in the future." Zhuangxuan was still filled with indifference, completely unconcerned that everyone he was talking about was his senior. "We can't take any chances right now."
Xue Ren could only sigh again.
He knew Zhuangxuan was right. Although Song Fei could make his moves with ease, they couldn’t afford to take any risks, especially at this juncture.
The ten-year time limit was close at hand, and the entire Heaven-God Alliance could be destroyed if they slipped up right now.
However, Gao Xiaowen suddenly knocked on the door urgently and walked in, bringing a slightly frightening piece of information.
"Martial Uncle, Senior Gu Nan, he… went to seek revenge against Fang Chaoyun!"
……
It was true that Gu Nan had gone to seek revenge.
Although Fang Chaoyun intended to let Gu Nan go for the time being, Gu Nan had no intention of letting the other party go.
Without beating Fang Chaoyun into submission—beating him to the point where other people wouldn’t even dare to think about hindering Gu Nan—how could he continue his Divine Kingdom Wars?
And what Gu Nan did was also very simple, hardly much different from earlier.
He ran to Graceful Heaven and wreaked havoc before leisurely taking his leave, leaving behind an enraged Fang Chaoyun.
However, what was different from back then was that this time, Gu Nan did not return to his Divine Kingdom but stayed in the vicinity of Graceful Heaven instead.
"How dare you, impudent whelp!" Fang Chaoyun was the first to discover Gu Nan's whereabouts and struck without any hesitation.
Song Fei had told him not to provoke Gu Nan for the time being, but he hadn't forbidden him from fighting back.
A huge word "kill" character emerged from the void and quickly fell towards Gu Nan, which showed the murderous intent in Fang Chaoyun's heart.
However, Gu Nan just chuckled and casually threw a punch at the character. The giant character shattered while Gu Nan was sent flying, his right hand already a bloodied mess.
Gu Nan, who already advanced to Tier 8, finally had the ability to fight Fang Chaoyun head-on.
Although he still couldn’t really fight back, as long as he survived the encounter, Gu Nan had already achieved his goal.
Gu Nan revealed a trace of mockery as his figure instantly plunged into a spatial rift, having already gone to another plane.
His movements appeared hasty, and before he could close the spatial passage, Fang Chaoyun rushed over in the spur of the moment.
He could tell that the destination wasn’t Gu Nan's bizarre astral world, so he had nothing to fear.
However, Fang Chaoyun had just arrived when he heard cries for help.
"Elder Fang, please help! This thieving Gu Nan is here for my Origin Martial Realm!"
The one who opened his mouth was Origin Martial Realm’s Star Ruler Cao Yu, who was struggling to hold on under Gu Nan's frenzied attacks. When he saw Fang Chaoyun's arrival, it was as if he’d seen his savior.
Origin Martial Realm's Cao Yu, one of the Star Rulers who previously obstructed Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom War, was Gu Nan’s target this time.
Fang Chaoyun realized what Gu Nan was trying to do: he was clearly using this to warn all the Star Rulers who opposed him!
Cao Yu was considered the weakest of the Realm Level Star Rulers—not much better than Red—but he was still a Realm Level Star Ruler nevertheless.
If even he suffered heavy losses under Gu Nan's rampage, who else would dare to participate in the war against Gu Nan?
All these thoughts instantly flashed through Fang Chaoyun's mind, and without any further hesitation, he wrote out nine consecutive large characters.
However, Gu Nan just laughed, tossing Cao Yu aside and running away without another word, heading for Cao Yu’s lair below.
The nine large characters naturally followed him and were forcibly smashed apart by Gu Nan one by one, erupting with terrifying aftershocks that destroyed almost all of Cao Yu's lair.
Cao Yu looked like he wanted to cry but had no tears. "Elder Fang, this…"
Fang Chaoyun's expression was similarly ugly. Not long ago, he was able to easily defeat the other party and force Gu Nan to flee into his own astral world, but now he could no longer do anything to Gu Nan.
In the end, the Dao of literature that he specialized in was not the Dao of slaughter, so it was very difficult to kill Gu Nan.
But that didn’t mean Fang Chaoyun was out of options.
"No need to be anxious," he said in a low voice.
Fang Chaoyun began to write out characters quickly, and one "suppress" character after another appeared under his brush.
"As long as this person is suppressed, I’m confident I can…"
"Next, Black Dragon World." After Gu Nan destroyed Cao Yu's lair, he nonchalantly waved at them. "Old Cao, I'll come back again after I finish teaching everyone the first round of their lessons!"

chapters.title: Chapter 465: Post-War Impact
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was always true to his word.
Because of Fang Chaoyun's interference, it was too late to cause more damage to Cao Yu's Origin Martial Realm, but Gu Nan could always find the next "victim".
In Black Dragon World, the Star Ruler’s true form was a large black dragon, but normally he preferred to take on human form, and he especially liked to wear a black dragon robe.
When Gu Nan arrived, this black dragon emperor was sitting majestically on his throne, looking down on the humans and dragons under his command.
A white-haired old man standing below bowed. "Your Majesty, this year…"
The sky suddenly lit up with a black light, and a terrifying pressure descended from the sky, directly smashing onto the entire palace.
The old man in front of the black dragon—along with all the officials below him—were all completely annihilated by this strike, and the palace toppled over.
"Who?!"
The black dragon instantly transformed back to his original form, his angry roar reaching the horizon and almost piercing through the clouds.
However, a fist came from the void and mercilessly smashed into his head. This black dragon, who’d always been known for his strong physique, felt his skin split open as his flesh was torn apart.
The black dragon whose head was smashed open immediately released a series of miserable roars before he realized who the visitor was.
"Your Excellency Gu Nan… please stop!" The black dragon shouted loudly, his figure rapidly shrinking to reduce the surface area where he could be hit.
Of course Gu Nan ignored him. Even in his own astral world, this kind of Star Ruler who merely had a World Level plane couldn’t possibly be Gu Nan's match.
After a few more consecutive punches landed, the black dragon’s human form was already frantically coughing up blood. If it wasn't for his strong physique as one of the dragon race, he probably would’ve perished under these punches.
Fang Chaoyun finally arrived belatedly, but Gu Nan had no plans of engaging him and ran away again without another word, not even sparing a second glance at the already dying black dragon.
Cao Yu also sneakily followed over. He was an old friend of the black dragon, so he hurriedly ran up to his injured friend.
Gu Nan couldn’t help feeling amused when he saw Cao Yu show up. ''You still have the leisure to worry about others? Looks like I haven’t wrecked Origin Martial Realm enough."
After saying that, he suddenly changed direction and instantly returned to Origin Martial Realm.
"No… Don’t!" Classmate Cao Yu's face almost turned green. He really wanted to give himself a hard slap right now— ‘Why did you have to stick your nose in something that wasn’t your business?’
But Gu Nan had always been true to his word, and even if Fang Chaoyun followed him back, he still tanked Fang Chaoyun's attacks and forcibly smashed Origin Martial Realm to pieces before leaving leisurely.
Thus, in just a few short hours, Gu Nan had visited all of the ten or so Star Rulers who blocked his invasion of Star Realm and killed a large number of his divine servants.
Among them, more troublesome enemies like Origin Martial Realm's Cao Yu even had the pleasure of enjoying repeat visits, causing corpses to be strewn everywhere and rivers of blood to flow in his astral world.
And through all this, Fang Chaoyun, who was a Tier 10 Star Ruler, could only chase after Gu Nan’s dust, unable to pose any threat to him at all.
Having already broken through to Tier 8, Gu Nan’s speed reached an unrivaled level, and the power of laws was completely unable to restrict him.
It wasn't as if Fang Chaoyun hadn't thought of an ambush. He calculated Gu Nan's route several times and set up the suppressing formation in advance, waiting for Gu Nan to come right to his door.
However, his ambush couldn’t confine Gu Nan at all. The 99 "suppress" characters that Mr. Fang wrote down with all his heart and soul only stopped Gu Nan for an instant before he easily broke through with his Evil God physique.
Later, Fang Chaoyun attempted to pursue Gu Nan relentlessly, not giving him a chance to catch his breath at all. He was trying to launch a barrage of attacks without giving Gu Nan time to recover.
Unfortunately, just as he was about to succeed, Gu Nan turned around and returned to his Divine Kingdom, then ran back with great vigor an hour later.
As for Mr. Fang, he could only glare from outside the Divine Kingdom with bloodshot eyes—he had already suffered a loss in Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom once. He didn't dare enter again.
All in all, the ruckus Gu Nan personally caused was an eye-opener for the entire Myriad Heavens, which normally wasn’t able to see so many Star Rulers fighting at once.
But what even more people saw was the terrifying destructive power of Gu Nan, this Demon King.
Over ten astral worlds had been vandalized and looted, and some of the Star Rulers themselves were even missing—not daring to remain in their astral worlds waiting for death—while Gu Nan himself was completely uninjured.
The Tier 10 Star Ruler Fang Chaoyun, on the other hand, had become a complete backdrop, and his frantic pursuit only contributed to Gu Nan's great fame—even such a powerful Star Ruler couldn’t do anything about Gu Nan.
Zi Luo Elder’s presence deterred Song Fei from making the first move in this ten-year timeframe. Thus, no one under Unified Dao Realm could stop Gu Nan anymore.
Interestingly enough, the ruckus Gu Nan created counteracted some of the effects of Fang Chaoyun's membership application.
While everyone now understood the Heaven-God Alliance’s stance thanks to Song Fei, it still managed to attract a group of Star Rulers because of Gu Nan's undefeated reputation.
These people might not necessarily be as loyal to the Heaven-God Alliance, but as long as the Heaven-God Alliance didn’t show any signs of decline, they were happy to become cornerstones of the organization.
Illusory prosperity was still prosperity, and as long as the core wasn’t damaged, even illusions could be turned into truth.
……
The battle against ten Star Rulers caused Gu Nan's reputation to resound throughout the Myriad Heavens once again, and some even began to claim he was the strongest person under Unified Dao Realm.
Gu Nan was only a Realm Level Star Ruler at this time, but he was able to directly fight with such a powerful Star Ruler like Fang Chaoyun, and he even dared to run into Graceful Heaven to cause trouble, while Fang Chaoyun, on the other hand, didn't even dare step foot into Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom.
Comparing the two, wasn't it enough to show who was stronger? With such a comparison, more and more people began to participate in the discussion of Gu Nan's strength.
In today's Myriad Heavens, there were only a few people at the same level as Fang Chaoyun and Xue Ren.
There was no need to discuss Red Candle Heaven’s Green Lantern Fairy, the most recent junior to ascend her astral world to Heaven Level. Her strength was recognized as the weakest and couldn’t even compare to Fang Chaoyun.
Xue Ren himself certainly wouldn’t become Gu Nan’s enemy, and because of the characteristics of his own laws, the Cult Master of Three Corpses Heaven’s Holy Luo Cult was naturally at a disadvantage against a cultivator with a strong physical body like Gu Nan, so he was also considered slightly weaker than Gu Nan.
The only other person who might be a match for Gu Nan was Severing Dao Heaven’s Wang Li, who briefly sparred with Xue Ren back when Xue Ren was holding a fake Unified Dao ceremony.
The two had exchanged sword and blade in that battle, fighting a battle onlookers couldn't even understand, so much so that they couldn’t even estimate those two’s realms, so people could only evaluate Wang Li as "profound and unfathomable".
But precisely because of this, regarding the question of whether Wang Li or Gu Nan was stronger… More accurately, regarding whether Gu Nan could escape from Wang Li’s hands, this question set off countless disputes.
Gu Nan was entirely noncommittal on this. Furthermore, he didn’t even allow any Star Ruler to step foot into his "No Name Change til Unified Dao" Realm, slaughtering any who dared to enter.
In the end, only a personal statement from Wang Li himself managed to put an end to the fervent public debate.
"I can't capture him in a head-on fight."
When this comment appeared, the claim that Gu Nan was invincible against everyone under Unified Dao finally became widespread.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: Found Out
chapters.content:
Regardless of what the onlookers were saying, Gu Nan himself wasn’t interested in it, as he was busy organizing a new round of Divine Kingdom Wars.
After leveling up to Tier 8, many brand-new structure choices started appearing, and he had to select some more useful ones, organizing their functions and expenditures for the Cabinet to analyze.
At the same time, the Cabinet also needed to analyze the average strength of the major astral worlds, the invasion difficulty, the expected earnings, and so on.
Only by combining information from all aspects could Gu Nan choose the most suitable astral world to attack.
Of course, considering that there were fewer and fewer targets to choose from nowadays, by removing some of the obviously unsuitable ones, one might even be able to make a blind guess as to which one was the most suitable.
In the end, the only name left in the report handed over by the Cabinet was Daoist Sect Realm.
Daoist Monarch Wu Tian's Daoist Sect Realm had once been at odds with Gu Nan, and he was also the target of Gu Nan's earliest demonstrations of his appalling power.
Later on, Daoist Monarch Wu Tian realized that there was nothing he could do to Gu Nan, and he was forced to concede and apologize in order to avoid further losses.
However, the grudge between the two sides wasn’t actually resolved, and Wu Tian's apology was more like hanging up a non-aggression waiver, so if there was a good opportunity to strike, neither side would let it go.
And the time was now ripe.
After the Divine Kingdom ascended to Realm Level, Gu Nan's own power was enough to counteract Wu Tian's home turf advantage in Daoist Sect Realm, so the conditions for invading Daoist Sect Realm were already in place.
More importantly, Daoist Sect Realm had a grudge against Gu Nan, which was the core reason the Cabinet made such a decision.
Of course it wasn't as simple as just venting some anger; the fact that the two sides already had a grudge meant there was a justifiable cause.
The previous skirmishes were still fine, but attacking a Realm Level plane with or without a justifiable cause were completely different matters.
If Gu Nan’s wanton invasion was only targeted at astral worlds he already had a feud against, then at worst, he would have a reputation of being a vindictive person, which was no big deal.
However, if he attacked other astral worlds for no reason, it would easily cause everyone in the Myriad Heavens to feel a sense of danger, ultimately triggering a collective resistance against Gu Nan.
If everyone was worried about being attacked by Gu Nan, it wouldn't make much sense to threaten people with damage to their astral worlds.
Gu Nan might not care much about this sort of thing, but the Cabinet definitely had to do its best.
"Daoist Sect Realm? Let's go with that then." Gu Nan didn't have much of an opinion on this and quickly adopted the Cabinet's proposal before beginning to set up the divine servant army.
On the other hand, he himself visited Daoist Sect Realm a few times over the next few days and started to wreak havoc in advance, causing Daoist Monarch Wu Tian to be buried in work.
He even consumed most of Daoist Monarch Wu Tian's astral world power in a very short time. This Daoist Monarch would probably be dirt poor by the time the war officially started.
However, what Gu Nan didn’t expect was that just when the Divine Kingdom War was in the tense preparation stage, an "uninvited guest" suddenly came to his door.
……
"So you really
are
alive!" Sylvia glared at Gu Nan in annoyance and questioned sternly, "Since you're fine, why don't you come out and explain everything!"
"Explain what?" Gu Nan didn't feel ashamed at all and smiled instead. "Isn't it already very clear who killed them? What else do you need me to prove?"
Sylvia clenched her hands into fists and pursed her lips.
She followed Daoist Lingyang’s advice and rushed over here from the World of Gods just to see how Gu Nan was doing. Unexpectedly, she immediately heard news about Gu Nan as soon as she arrived.
With Gu Nan’s current fame, she didn’t even need to inquire—the news came to her on its own.
"You… killed both Luke and Cliff, didn’t you?" The Goddess of Shadows forced out this sentence through gritted teeth.
Gu Nan sat on the throne high above, calmly looking down at Sylvia without replying.
An eerie silence fell over the Evil God Temple, and Sylvia suddenly felt a slight chill on her back, while Gu Nan abruptly stood up at that moment.
"If you knew that, why did you dare to come here?" Gu Nan's voice was very tranquil, but it seemed to carry a trace of regret.
The next second, shadow tentacles drilled out from the ceiling of the Evil God Temple, instantly binding Sylvia's limbs and rapidly dragging her upwards.
Sylvia was caught off guard, and her entire body was quickly dragged up. A look of panic crossed her face as she tried to turn into a shadow to escape, but she discovered that all her laws were suppressed.
Their laws originated from the same source in the first place, and since Gu Nan was also inside his Divine Kingdom, Sylvia was certainly powerless to resist.
She thought that as long as she remained vigilant, the shadows would be able to help her escape, but she hadn't counted on Gu Nan reaching Tier 8.
If this was before his advancement, Gu Nan really wouldn't have been able to capture her, not unless they fought in close quarters.
"Let go of me—" Sylvia's voice ended abruptly, because the shadows had already gagged her.
This Goddess of Shadows was thus firmly affixed to the ceiling, her body covered in pitch-black shadows. Not a single trace of her could be seen from the outside.
Gu Nan shook his head with a wry smile. Of course it was impossible to kill Sylvia. If he did that, her brother Austin would definitely be the first to notice.
