Shi Yeyan couldn’t help falling silent for a long time before he answered, "Youngest Martial Brother has already been murdered. Master and I came here precisely to seek justice for him."
Sophia's face paled further, as if a condemned prisoner had finally been notified that she was going to the execution ground.
Seeing this, Shi Yeyan could only let out a secret sigh, then asked, "I heard Youngest Martial Brother still has a child here. Where is he?"
"Little Jialiang is in the 391st Nightmare Land. I was afraid that someone would harm him, so I didn’t dare take him with me…" Sophia responded.
With her experience and ability, this wasn’t a wrong decision. Nightmare Land was at least an official organization with a certain level of protection afforded to its students.
However, Shi Yeyan knew better. This was no small matter. An insignificant mortal organization on Nightmare Continent wouldn’t be taken seriously by the culprits at all.
"Please take me there immediately."
Sophia looked more and more alarmed. "Could it be… that someone might harm Jialiang?"
"We can’t rule out such a possibility," Shi Yeyan was as blunt as ever.
……
"What? You're saying Jialiang was taken away?" Sophia stood in the Nightmare Land’s hall, feeling a wave of dizziness as grief and indignation washed over her. "How could you guys do this?!"
The only reason she left her son here was because she believed in Nightmare Land, thinking that since they were subordinates of the great Ruler of Nightmares, they certainly wouldn't be swayed by the powerful, but who knew…
How could she have known that the relationship between Nightmare Land and its greater god namesake was so far removed that they were nothing more than subordinates in name only?
The person in charge of Nightmare Land had long since lost interest in humoring her. Instead, he secretly sized up Shi Yeyan several times, considering whether or not this person was some kind of bigshot.
However, he answered quite fast as he assumed an innocent expression. "Lu Jialiang killed Brook, and we couldn't stop Lord Andy from taking him away as a murder suspect!"
The two understood what happened after the head of Nightmare Land finished speaking. Sophia became even more anxious and hurriedly asked Shi Yeyan for help.
From what she knew about her son, killing Brook in a fit of rage really was possible!
"Where was he taken?" Shi Yeyan asked coldly.
"Lord Andy is His Majesty Freidman's attendant…" The head of Nightmare Land didn't dare hide it and immediately revealed Andy's background, which wasn't much of a secret in the first place.
God of Gluttony Freidman, a Tier 9 god of the Dark Faction and one of the gods who existed since ancient times.
Shi Yeyan nodded and calmly thanked him, then left with Sophia.
"Where are we going?" Sophia was uncertain.
"To find Freid—"
Shi Yeyan was halfway through his sentence when he suddenly stopped, staring at the silver light illuminating the sky.
The terrifying sword energy that descended from the sky caused Shi Yeyan to react instantly and launch a palm strike at the sky.
Next to him, Sophia and the head of Nightmare Land—who weren’t able to react at all—only felt a strong gale sweep past their faces, and then nothing happened.
Shi Yeyan withdrew his palm and looked at the sky consideringly. “It doesn’t contain any sword intent and is driven by pure strength… It should be a native powerhouse. Definitely a god. Who could it be?"
Many gods in the World of Gods used swords, and since the other party only made a cursory strike and retreated after a single blow, Shi Yeyan couldn’t guess the attacker’s identity for the moment.
"S-Senior Martial Brother Shi, what's wrong?" Sophia had a hard time pronouncing the tongue-twisting title.
"Nothing." Shi Yeyan shook his head. "It's probably someone who noticed me and launched an attack to test me."
Sophia nodded blankly, but the head of Nightmare Land beside them secretly sighed in relief. Since the fellow who came out to test him seemed very weak, the person standing in front of him probably shouldn’t be too strong either, right?
Shi Yeyan quickly left with Sophia, and as the head of Nightmare Land ordered his subordinates to return, he turned around to see a scene that stunned him.
Behind him, the 391st Nightmare Land had been cut in half, and what split them up was a sword gash several meters deep.
……
Above the distant horizon, Gu Nan's figure slowly emerged while muttering under his breath, "A giant palm driven by laws? I’ll name it Vigorous Vajra Palm for now."
He glanced at the direction the two disappeared in again. "Quite fast, but… to find Freidman, you guys first have to know the way!"

chapters.title: Chapter 477: Overt Schemes, Hidden Schemes
chapters.content:
One aspect of the World of Gods differed significantly from the Myriad Heavens, and that was how the gods’ Divine Kingdoms were not naturally-existing planes. Many of them were built from scratch.
Some of these gods placed great importance on concealing their own Divine Kingdoms. Even though their locations could be determined through spatial coordinates, it was difficult to find them directly because of the extreme complexity of their Divine Kingdoms' positions in the void.
Freidman, the God of Gluttony, was one such existence.
He built his Divine Kingdom in the depths of the void, and even entering or leaving it required several spatial jumps.
Legend had it that this god didn't value faith all that much. Instead, his favorite hobby was to hide in his Divine Kingdom every day and find a bunch of gourmet food to gorge on.
Therefore, it would take Shi Yeyan considerable effort to find the location of the Gluttony Divine Kingdom.
……
"It's already been three jumps. We’ll be able to arrive at the Divine Kingdom after two more spatial jumps," Andy calmly announced as he looked at his group, who were all busy throwing up on the ground.
"Lord Andy, how come we still need to do this two more times… Urgh…" One of the youths said bitterly, "Doesn't it normally only take four jumps?"
The spatial laws of the World of Gods were quite stable, so spatial jumping was a very unpleasant experience for the weak.
Andy calmly explained, "We still have to bring him back for judgment; we can't just let him die, so we took some long detours to weaken the impact of the spatial shocks."
Andy was naturally referring to Lu Jialiang. The teen was currently lying on the ground with a pale face, having already collapsed from vomiting too much. He no longer had the strength to budge even a little.
Lu Jialiang was the weakest and was therefore affected the most.
"My Lord, why don’t we… find a place to rest first?" The one who spoke earlier suggested with a troubled expression, "I think he's really going to die during transport if we keep going like this."
He patted Lu Jialiang's shoulder. The latter’s breathing had already become shallow and weak.
Andy was silent for a moment before he finally nodded. "Might as well."
Although they were in a hurry to bring back the apostle’s murderer, it was fine to rest a little as well—not even they themselves ever experienced five spatial jumps in a row when returning to the Divine Kingdom.
When the person beside him saw Andy agree, he broke into a smile and got up to kick Lu Jialiang. "Get up, you murderer!"
Lu Jialiang rolled over from the kick, having no strength left in his body, but when he heard the other person's words, he still used all his power to roar, "I'm not…"
The man laughed nastily and was about to give this youth a little lesson, but then he suddenly realized that something was wrong.
Lu Jialiang fell sideways on the ground, but the shadow under him was expanding little by little, growing to the width of several people in the blink of an eye, as if it was a hideous giant maw.
"What is this…"
Before Andy and his party could react, Lu Jialiang's entire body fell into the shadow, as if falling into a bottomless abyss. His miserable shrieks seemed to echo endlessly in the crowd’s ears.
This scene made everyone’s blood run cold. The group felt like their hairs were standing on end. Only the Legend Rank Andy was able to maintain his composure slightly.
"Which Excellency is here?" He pushed down the fear in his heart and shouted at his surroundings.
After all, he and the others were apostles of a Tier 9 god. Even if the other party might be a great existence, they still wouldn’t attack unprovoked…
Bang!
A huge palm suddenly fell from the air, crushing the entire group.
……
After dealing with Andy's group using the attack Shi Yeyan subconsciously displayed, Gu Nan turned and left this small plane, heading for Freidman’s Divine Kingdom.
It’s just that not even he expected to run into someone the very moment he stepped out of this plane.
"Counting that time with Goro, you've already used the blame-shifting trick three times." Daoist Lingyang looked at Gu Nan helplessly with that middle-aged uncle's face.
Gu Nan’s cold gaze landed on him as he shrugged. "You even know about that?"
"It’s not that clever a trick." Daoist Lingyang shook his head.
If Diana and her group of gods were still fooled the first time Gu Nan used this trick, then Daoist Lingyang, who was already aware of this, wasn't so easy to fool.
After observing Gu Nan's every move this time around, he naturally realized what Gu Nan was trying to do.
"Scheming doesn’t suit you. It's not your style." Daoist Lingyang returned the gaze with the same indifference. "The God Hunting Manual is a good move… I also didn't expect that you’d actually want to start a war between the two sides."
Gu Nan's style had always been straightforward, and the God Hunting Manual was even more of an overt scheme. Compared to that, Daoist Lingyang didn't think much of this subsequent trick to shift the blame onto someone else.
"This plan has too many holes." Daoist Lingyang shook his head slightly. "Even if an apostle died, it still wouldn't be enough to make both sides lose their cool. Instead, you'd only expose yourself."
Gu Nan was in no hurry at this moment. He crossed his arms and asked, "What exactly are you trying to say?"
Daoist Lingyang stared into his eyes and replied, "The fact it’s riddled with holes means that Zhuangxuan and Xue Ren aren’t involved. This is your own operation?"
"So what if it is?"
"Stop now." Daoist Lingyang sighed. "Return to the Heaven-God Alliance with me; I'll find a way to deal with the aftermath on this side… Countless living beings will suffer if the two sides go to war. Why do so?"
Gu Nan almost laughed. "How come I didn't know you were so compassionate? Forget it, I can’t chat with you anymore. The person I'm waiting for is here."
Daoist Lingyang froze, then saw Shi Yeyan's figure appear in a small plane nearby.
Of course Gu Nan didn’t waste so much time chatting with Daoist Lingyang because he had nothing else to do. Rather, he’d long since anticipated that his target would come here, so he was just waiting at the destination.
Gu Nan was far more familiar with the path leading to the Gluttony Divine Kingdom than these visitors from the Myriad Heavens. As long as Shi Yeyan intended to travel there, he would definitely have to pass through this region.
Daoist Lingyang's expression changed slightly as he hurriedly looked up, while Gu Nan's figure instantly vanished, leaving behind only a trace of imperceptible laws.
Daoist Lingyang, who knew him well, was slightly stunned and exclaimed incredulously, "Realm Level?!"
……
Above the endless void of the World of Gods, Song Fei and Zou Jiming stood side by side, and standing in front of them was the Ruler of War Eugene and the Ruler of Nightmares.
Two came from the Myriad Heavens, so this side naturally also sent two greater gods to receive them. The number worked out perfectly, with each godly faction sending one person.
Eugene had volunteered, while the Ruler of Nightmares was here because Song Fei's youngest apprentice, Lu Yang, had died precisely on his territory, so he couldn't shirk his responsibilities even if he wanted.
"Your Excellency Song Fei." The Ruler of Nightmares said with little emotion, "I apologize regarding that Star Ruler’s death, but it was indeed an accident."

chapters.title: Chapter 478: Motive Uncovered
chapters.content:
"Accident?" Song Fei raised a brow and looked at Kenneth, the Ruler of Nightmares, with a cold smile.
Kenneth appeared as a somewhat thin old man with slightly gray skin and a few wrinkles on his face. He didn’t seem very energetic.
"That's right." Kenneth said slowly, "The god who dealt with him only found out after the fact that he’d settled here as early as six hundred years ago. The reason he was immediately disposed of was due to suspicion that he was involved in a God Hunt."
Song Fei's brows furrowed slightly. Only after Kenneth explained further did he realize what happened.
It wasn't really that complicated. While the gods were hunting down a God Hunter, they found out that he had contact with Lu Yang and suspected him of being involved in this matter as well.
In reality, that God Hunter was indeed a close friend of Lu Yang’s, and he came to the World of Gods on the pretext of visiting Lu Yang while secretly participating in the God Hunt.
There was indeed no lack of cool-headed people amongst the Star Rulers, and such a cover was definitely much smarter than what people like Mai Cheng did.
By the time the gods came to his door to investigate, Lu Yang, despite not being all that strong and not having even chosen his own astral world yet, had an unyielding temper.
At the very least, he was the direct disciple of a Unified Dao powerhouse. How could he endure having his house searched and inspected? Conflict erupted between the two sides, and Lu Yang was killed on the spot.
Perhaps not even Lu Yang himself expected the situation this time to be so serious, but there was no room for regret.
Song Fei listened to the other party with a dark expression and was about to speak, but then his expression changed violently.
……
By the time Daoist Lingyang hurriedly arrived near the Gluttony Divine Kingdom, Shi Yeyan had already been completely dismembered by Gu Nan.
The head of Song Fei's favored disciple was tossed aside lonesomely, a look of disbelief frozen on his face.
Let alone him, even Daoist Lingyang never imagined that such a Star Ruler on par with a Tier 9 god couldn’t even last a single exchange at Gu Nan's hands.
Didn’t he just advance to Realm Level?
If he was already this strong now, then wouldn’t he be able to easily kill anyone under Unified Dao once he reached Heaven Level?
But Gu Nan wasn’t surprised in the slightest. Indeed, Shi Yeyan wasn’t even able to put up any resistance to his sneak attack and had his heart directly blasted apart.
After all, the current Gu Nan could already fight Tier 10 enemies head on, and he also used a sneak attack this time, so a Star Ruler was no different from a mortal in his hands.
Reality wasn’t a novel. The stronger person wasn’t determined by simply displaying the greatest combat power.
The characteristics of one’s abilities, the fighters’ conditions, who attacked first, etc., will all affect the final outcome.
Gu Nan ignored Daoist Lingyang's arrival. He was using a longsword to cut up Shi Yeyan's corpse, slicing him into neat pieces.
After the corpse was completely cut up, he burned it with fire.
Daoist Lingyang watched all this in silence. Being somewhat familiar with the God of Gluttony, he knew exactly what Gu Nan was doing.
Cutting up the victim’s soul along with their corpse was exactly what Freidman always did before eating his "food".
He was still playing the same trick of pinning the blame on someone else!
But this time, Daoist Lingyang no longer felt that such a tactic was clumsy. The reason was simple: Shi Yeyan was the one who died.
The death of a few apostles was an insignificant matter that wouldn't cloud either side’s judgment, but what if the one who died was Shi Yeyan?
Two of Song Fei’s disciples died in the World of Gods. One of them even followed him over and was killed right under his nose… If he could still concede in this situation, then he might as well wait for the total collapse of Academic Heaven once he returns.
This was also an overt scheme…
Daoist Lingyang looked at Gu Nan in silence, only now fully understanding the goal behind all his actions.
His plan was crude because he simply didn't care. When Shi Yeyan died, all the holes in the plan would no longer be holes.
"What would you gain from inciting a war between the two sides?" Daoist Lingyang slowly collected his thoughts and asked with a serious gaze.
Gu Nan, who was disposing of Shi Yeyan's corpse at this moment, shook his head with a smile. "Didn't I already tell you?"
Gu Nan's words stunned Daoist Lingyang slightly, and before he could even think about what exactly he’d been told already, Gu Nan had already swung a fist at his head.
A punch to the head without any mercy!
Since he’d seen through Gu Nan’s secret, it was only natural that he be silenced. Gu Nan was never the type to have misgivings because of past friendship.
However, the expected scene of a head exploding didn’t happen. Blue light emerged in front of Daoist Lingyang. A Daoist talisman appeared between the two, emitting a faint light.
Gu Nan recognized this talisman. It was the very same talisman Daoist Lingyang used to restrain Lewis and eventually kill the other party.
"A Tier 11 item?" Only when he was personally confronted with this talisman did Gu Nan truly realize how powerful it was.
Daoist Lingyang seemed to expect the attack and calmly spoke without any surprise on his face, "That's right. This is a treasure a senior left behind, which I obtained by chance when I was young."
Daoist Lingyang himself was probably between Tier 8 and Tier 9, and it was with this talisman that he was able to kill the Tier 10 God of Tenebrosity in the first place.
Now, he was also relying on this talisman to block Gu Nan's attack. If he didn't have this trump card, who was he to dare come and persuade Gu Nan to turn back?
"Too bad you’re too late." Gu Nan shook his head. "I can't kill you, but I can keep an eye on you."
As he spoke, he leisurely waved his hand, and pitch-black shadows wrapped around the blue curtain of light, sending Daoist Lingyang directly out of this plane.
……
Above the endless void, Song Fei's sudden dark expression turned the atmosphere a little tense.
It was Zou Jiming’s first time seeing Song Fei so emotional, so he couldn't help wondering, "What happened?"
"Something happened to Yeyan as well," Song Fei cast a cold glance at the two greater gods and answered without hiding anything.
He retained a fragment of Shi Yeyan's soul, so he was able to sense the latter's state.
However, the soul fragment suddenly shattered just now, and the last message that was transmitted over was Shi Yeyan's soul being cut into countless pieces, with no possibility of resurrection.
The two greater gods also heard Song Fei, and the Ruler of Nightmares immediately turned to look at Eugene, the God of War beside him.
"Why are you looking at me? I didn't do it!" Eugene instantly roared.
Indeed, two people popped into Kenneth’s head as soon as he heard the news—one was the Beast God from his faction, and the other was Eugene.
Both of them were warlike beings who wished the world was in chaos!
"Your Excellency Song Fei, we will give you an explanation for this matter," Kenneth hurriedly said, but secretly, he wasn’t so sure.
Even he couldn't be sure that this wasn't done by one of his own people.
Or rather, he could basically confirm that one of his people had killed Shi Yeyan—it wasn’t like Song Fei’s disciple ran to the World of Gods just to commit suicide. The only difference was whether or not there was still a way to reconcile the situation.
Song Fei remained silent for a while and finally replied coldly, "Fine. I'll wait for this explanation."
After saying that, he stormed off, no longer planning to stay here.

chapters.title: Chapter 479: Song Fei's Decisiveness
chapters.content:
After Song Fei stormed off, the two greater gods from the World of Gods quickly entered a state of "self-investigation" and invited Song Fei to supervise and check their progress to show they weren’t hiding anything.
But what surprised them was that Song Fei declined such an invitation and instead asked Zou Jiming to come out and supervise.
"Perhaps he’s too sad to face reality?" Zou Jiming found an excuse so bad that it couldn't possibly be any worse, glossing everything over with the other party.
He was all too eager to lead the negotiations—anyhow, the blame was already pinned on Song Fei, so no matter what was promised down the line, when the time came, he would just shrug it all off as promises Song Fei made.
It wasn't that hard to find out the cause of Shi Yeyan's death.
After all, all of his tracks after arriving at the World of Gods were clearly visible, and the greater gods didn't have to make much effort to trace the clues all the way to the end.
Finding Sophia, learning Lu Jialiang was taken away for killing Brook, and disappearing in the process of chasing Andy and his group.
And the location where Shi Yeyan died was also found. It was in the depths of the void, where the Gluttony Divine Kingdom was located…
"Did Freidman do it?" Eugene asked in a heavy voice as his gaze landed on the depths of the void. Even though it was a question, there was a bit of certainty in his tone.
After all, Shi Yeyan’s soul was chopped up—this trait was just too obvious.
Furthermore, Shi Yeyan himself was equivalent to a Tier 9 god, so besides Freidman—whose Divine Kingdom was nearby—who else would be able to kill him?
"It's possible." The Ruler of Nightmares didn't hide anything in Zou Jiming's presence and nodded. "But if it's not Freidman, then… this matter will be much more complicated."
All the parties involved were already dead. There simply wasn't enough information to determine whether the truth was as it appeared, or whether there was another mastermind behind the scenes.
Speaking of a mastermind… there was indeed such a possibility. After all, the whole matter looked way too coincidental, but there was also no evidence to prove this.
Without any evidence, could they really just give a mere conjecture as their "explanation" to Song Fei?
The existing evidence all pointed to Freidman, but in the end, that wasn’t conclusive evidence either, so capturing one of their own Tier 9 gods based on this was also not justifiable.
Both Eugene and Kenneth felt this was a thorny problem.
"Let's find Freidman first and see what he has to say for himself." Kenneth rubbed his temples, nursing a headache, while Eugene also expressed agreement.
Instead, it was Zou Jiming who waited confidently with crossed arms for the two greater gods to state their position. Even though his ultimate stance was also to not go to war, basic negotiation skills were still required.
But none of the three expected for someone to have already made the choice for them.
Just as the three stepped into the Gluttony Divine Kingdom, this plane suddenly started to collapse without warning. The originally azure sky was quickly dyed red, the stars began to fall, and the earth cracked.
"Could this be…?" Zou Jiming's knowledge of Divine Kingdoms wasn't exactly deep, but such extremely obvious signs still allowed him to understand something.
"Freidman is dead!" The Ruler of Nightmares said heavily, taking a step into the deepest part of the Gluttony Divine Kingdom, and sure enough, he saw Freidman’s corpse silently laying there.
The next second, his expression suddenly changed, and he abruptly turned to look at Zou Jiming.
Zou Jiming was a step behind him. He still didn’t understand what happened yet—not until he saw a ruler embedded in the heart of the corpse on the ground.
That was Song Fei's ruler.
The corners of Zou Jiming's mouth twitched slightly while he immediately tried to retreat, but his will fell into a trance for a split second, and the power of the dream realm had already descended upon him.
Before he was swept inside the dream realm, Zou Jiming's last thought was:
‘Song Fei screwed me over!’
……
Three days later, news spread throughout the two worlds.
Song Fei, who had gone to the World of Gods to negotiate, found his favored disciple Shi Yeyan killed by the God of Gluttony, and in a fit of rage, he personally took action and killed Freidman to vent his anger and purposely left behind his own ruler as proof of his identity.
This was also in line with Song Fei's style. He’d always acted openly and never covered anything up. If he was the murderer, he would never deny it.
But from that day onwards, negotiations between the two sides officially broke down, and war between the two worlds was imminent.
"Song Fei got to vent, but Zou Jiming probably got screwed over miserably," Daoist Lingyang couldn’t help laughing involuntarily after hearing this and said to Gu Nan.
Daoist Lingyang was in charge of Clear Profundity Realm for many years and had been the Heaven-God Alliance’s head manager for so long, so he naturally knew the Thirteen Heavens quite well.
Song Fei clearly wanted Zou Jiming to distract the greater gods while he himself decisively chose to go to war, which was tantamount to selling Zou Jiming out.
Facing the greater gods who were all hostile to him… Weapon Martial Heaven’s Star Ruler might not necessarily die, but the severity of injuries he’d suffer would depend on how many greater gods appeared to fight him.
"If war breaks out, Zou Jiming will be dissatisfied no matter what, so it's better to have him nurse his injuries for a few thousand years instead." Daoist Lingyang seemed to have a unique understanding of the relationships among the Thirteen Heavens.
Gu Nan was standing next to him, staring at him with a faint smile. "Why don’t you stop talking about the Thirteen Heavens and talk about how much longer you can last?"
The two of them were now in an obscure small plane. It was deserted and had no native civilizations, it was a completely remote and desolate area.
The blue light that surrounded Daoist Lingyang's body was already far dimmer than it had been initially and even wavered slightly.
Ever since Gu Nan took him away from the depths of the void, Daoist Lingyang hadn’t been given the slightest opportunity to escape, always being watched by Gu Nan until the talisman’s power was about to run out.
If Daoist Lingyang was given enough time to prepare, he could even kill a Tier 10 powerhouse with this talisman, but unfortunately, Gu Nan didn’t give him any time, and he had to use all of the talisman’s power for defense.
"What would you gain from killing me?" Daoist Lingyang stared at Gu Nan calmly, as if the conversation wasn’t about killing him.
Gu Nan didn’t answer but just looked at the talisman in his hand.
Daoist Lingyang seemed to understand something and shook his head with a faint smile before violently slapping his palm on his forehead.
With this strike, the blue light suddenly disappeared, while Daoist Lingyang's body simultaneously froze, then turned into fine powder and scattered with a gust of wind.
Gu Nan frowned slightly and slowly stepped forward, only to find that all of Daoist Lingyang's clothing and belongings—along with the talisman—had all disappeared without a trace. They seemed to have similarly dissipated, scattering into dust.
"Golden cicada shedding its shell to escape?" Gu Nan revealed a thoughtful expression. Daoist Lingyang wasn’t a simple person—this was something he’d always known. He just didn’t expect this person to have so many trump cards.
However, he also wasn’t worried.
He wanted to kill Daoist Lingyang only because he wanted to take a look at that talisman. Now that war between the two sides was inevitable, whether Daoist Lingyang escaped or not had long become irrelevant.
He also didn't think Daoist Lingyang would try to expose him. To put it bluntly, there was no evidence for this, and it was also too late to talk about this now.
"Gotta hurry back," Gu Nan muttered.
Once the war started, it wouldn't be so easy for him to travel through the dimensional barrier again. After all, the ideal situation was naturally taking advantage of the war to harvest a wave of gods before turning his blade on friendly forces.

chapters.title: Chapter 480: Joining The War
chapters.content:
Myriad Heavens.
Gu Nan heard some breaking news when he returned to this side.
"Academic Heaven raised the banner of war against the World of Gods, which gained popular support from a group of weak Star Lords, while Weapon Martial Heaven unilaterally withdrew from this war and is more popular among Star Rulers above Realm Level."
Red Tail truthfully reported this side’s situation to Gu Nan. It wasn’t really a secret; it was the biggest discussion topic in the Myriad Heavens these days.
Academic Heaven declared that the World of Gods harbored ambitious designs and had wanted war for a long time, so they must deliver a frontal assault. Weapon Martial Heaven, on the other hand, accused Academic Heaven of going to war over a personal vendetta, sweeping innocent people into their feud.
There was even news that Lord Zou Jiming, one of the Thirteen Heavens, personally went to Academic Heaven to argue with Song Fei as soon as he returned, and the two ended up parting on bad terms.
"If they weren’t in Academic Heaven, I'm afraid a big fight would’ve broken out." Gu Nan shook his head, laughing in spite of himself.
Song Fei screwed over Zou Jiming, causing him to fall into an ambush by the greater gods. These two now had a serious grudge against each other. Unless there was a situation where their interests were highly aligned next time, there was no possibility of joining forces again.
Song Fei himself probably also knew this, so he decisively hid inside his own astral world as soon as he came back.
Even though the astral world’s influence on Star Rulers was no longer as great after reaching Unified Dao, they would still be strengthened slightly when inside their own astral world.
On the contrary, Zou Jiming's injuries in the World of Gods were certainly not shallow, and it was still a toss-up as to what the outcome of a real fight would be.
Of course, the Star Rulers below them would never learn the truth about what actually happened in the World of Gods.
Red Tail also didn't intend to ask further questions and directly said, "Then My Lord, we…"
"Of course we're on Academic Heaven’s side," Gu Nan answered without hesitation. "We may have a grudge between us, but in front of the greater good concerning the survival of the Myriad Heavens, personal grudges can be put aside!"
These words were spoken so righteously that the corners of Red Tail's mouth twitched a couple of times before she nodded. "Understood, I'll go make arrangements…"
……
With the great war on the horizon, the entire Myriad Heavens entered a state of war preparation, of which the most active group was naturally forces allied with Academic Heaven.
Academic Heaven also had every reason to be furious. After all, two of Song Fei's disciples died at the hands of despicable gods, so they had to return the favor—a tooth for a tooth.
Moreover, after Shi Yeyan's death, even the ones unwilling to go to war didn’t have a reason to blame Song Fei anymore.
Academic Heaven decisively became the vanguard of the attack on the World of Gods, not only sending out a large number of powerful cultivators to lead the way, but also sending out a call to the entire Myriad Heavens.
They hoped to consolidate the powerful and unify their dispatch in order to utilize the maximum power of the entire Myriad Heavens.
Lu Wen had actually done something similar back when he fought the God of Time, Valen.
Back then, Lu Wen motivated people with benefits, and now Song Fei was doing the same.
For some of the weaker Star Rulers who wanted to obtain Godheads but were struggling to make it on their own due to lack of connections, this was the perfect opportunity!
With Academic Heaven as a guarantor, the possibility of infighting was avoided to the greatest possible extent, and there was even less need to worry about the distribution of loot.
A large number of Star Rulers began to converge on Academic Heaven, and some people even referred to the order issued by Academic Heaven as the "God Hunt Order", implying that these people were all here for the God Hunt.
Of course, Academic Heaven wouldn’t officially acknowledge this, but the name "God Hunt Order" still became widespread.
"What did you say? Gu Nan also accepted the God Hunt Order?" Fang Chaoyun was dealing with the matters at hand when he heard a disciple's hurried report and immediately looked up.
Upon hearing the grievous news that his own Second Martial Brother had also perished, the evil-hating Mr. Fang voluntarily ran to Academic Heaven to assist his master with affairs.
Currently, he was responsible for none other than vetting and assigning outside Star Rulers.
Most of the outside Star Rulers actually didn't need to be vetted, since there was no reason to stop those willing to contribute to the Myriad Heavens. What was more important was assigning and registering them to prevent them from betraying their own people.
"Yes." That disciple was Fang Chaoyun's direct disciple, equivalent to Song Fei's grand-disciple. He was currently wiping the cold sweat from his face. "Our subordinates received his information and didn't dare neglect this, so they sent it directly to me."
Fang Chaoyun silently nodded. After thinking about it, he said, "Gu Nan has a grudge against me and is himself a member of the Heaven-God Alliance…"
"Then should we reject his request?" That disciple hastily interjected. He couldn't wait to draw a clear line with a scourge like Gu Nan.
However, Fang Chaoyun glared at him. "On what grounds? Personal grudges can't jeopardize the greater good. Since Gu Nan is willing to contribute to the Myriad Heavens, how can we refuse?"
That disciple nodded resentfully while thinking, ‘Master, isn’t it because you get angry every time he’s mentioned?’
Fang Chaoyun added, "There’s no need for special treatment. Just treat him as a normal Realm Level Star Ruler… How many Star Rulers at Realm Level or above are willing to participate in the war right now?"
Academic Heaven had no shortage of weak Star Rulers, so their most important task was to rope in those Realm Level and Heaven Level bigshots to join the war.
The disciple answered without any hesitation, "Excluding Gu Nan, there are now six Realm Level Star Rulers and two Heaven Level ones."
This figure only included people who weren’t part of Academic Heaven’s forces in the first place. They were originally neutral and were roped into the war by Academic Heaven.
However, Fang Chaoyun still frowned heavily. "That’s far from enough… The other side is gathering the power of their entire world. We have too few people in comparison!"
His disciple didn't dare respond and could only remain silent.
A few moments later, Fang Chaoyun spoke again on his own, "Now that the gods have already assembled at the frontlines, we are at a numerical disadvantage. That's why it’s even more important for us to strike first!"
……
Gu Nan calmly sat in the lobby without a hint of awkwardness, waiting for the earlier disciple to return.
On the contrary, the few disciples of Academic Heaven keeping him company were very much on pins and needles.
Fortunately, the disciple who’d gone to report to their superiors soon returned and came before Gu Nan, respectfully saying, "Lord Gu Nan, Master has approved your request to join the combat squad. Please follow me to register."
Gu Nan didn’t mind and followed the young disciple to register his name before another person showed up.
This was none other than the direct disciple from Graceful Heaven named Lin Huan who had reported directly to Fang Chaoyun earlier.
Lin Huan guided Gu Nan to a seat, then smiled again. "Your Excellency Gu Nan's willingness to come to Academic Heaven is indeed out of Master’s expectations. However, Master has said that personal grudges must not jeopardize the greater good—"
"What do you want me to do?" Gu Nan interrupted bluntly, having no intention of wasting words on him.
The corners of Lin Huan's lips twitched slightly. After considering that the other party was a powerhouse who could fight against his master, he forced himself to suppress his ire again.
"For Star Rulers willing to participate in the war, we will always provide two options." Lin Huan explained, "Participate in a frontal battle and accept our dispatch, or form your own squad, directly invading the World of Gods and hunting down targets in fixed locations."
"I'll choose the second one," Gu Nan decided without much hesitation.
Lin Huan slowly nodded. This wasn’t out of his expectations. On the contrary, if Gu Nan was actually willing to accept Academic Heaven’s dispatch orders, then he would have to go back and ask his master how to respond.
However, he then got up again. "That is certainly not a problem, but we still have a presumptuous request…"
"What?" Gu Nan gave him a puzzled look.
"Please make sure you hide your identity."

chapters.title: Chapter 481: Teammates
chapters.content:
Academic Heaven’s request that he hide his identity was something Gu Nan initially didn’t understand the significance of but then realized with some amusement.
To put it bluntly, this was a case of not intending to refuse his participation in the war but also not wanting his participation to be publicized and cause further controversy at this juncture.
Gu Nan didn't intend to argue over such trivial matters and quickly agreed. He wasn’t a contrarian and didn't like to be confrontational on every matter.
And in fact, Gu Nan did need to join Academic Heaven's camp in order to disguise his goal of hunting gods.
After all, with Gu Nan's current fame, his every move would receive a great deal of attention, and it would be easy for people to connect the dots if he suddenly ran to the frontlines to hunt gods.
On the contrary, if he joined Academic Heaven's camp first, he would have a justifiable excuse for hunting gods.
Even if others were still suspicious of him, they would first suspect whether he had designs on Academic Heaven or Fang Chaoyun—his enemy—and wouldn’t directly think of the God Hunt aspect.
After all, recruiting Void Cutters was no longer a difficult task for a Realm Level Star Ruler like him, so it would look really suspicious if he went to all this effort just for some Godheads.
……
"Your Excellency Gu Nan, you have accepted a hunting mission."
A crisp female voice rang out in front of Gu Nan as a bunch of mission information was revealed, including the target, the best hunting spot, the danger and difficulty, and so on.
This was a temporary law construct created by Academic Heaven specifically for this war’s strategic coordination.
For a major event such as the great war between the two worlds, it was only natural for Academic Heaven to step in and produce a comprehensive mission assignment system.
Gu Nan's mission target this time was merely a Tier 7 god.
His inputted personal information was calculated based on a normal Realm Level Star Ruler’s stats, so the target assigned to him would naturally be one level lower. Otherwise, the hunters might become the hunted.
However, a mere Tier 7 was clearly unable to satisfy Gu Nan's appetite. Hadn't he gone through so much trouble for the sole purpose of being able to openly slaughter gods?
"Raise the target level."
After inputting the command, the blue light in front of Gu Nan flickered slightly for a moment before mission details were outputted again, this time to a Tier 8 god.
"Raise the target level," Gu Nan didn't even look at the results before commanding again.
The blue light flickered even more, only this time it didn't make Gu Nan wait too long, directly giving out a bunch of information.
Gu Nan glanced down and finally revealed a satisfied smile.
Tier 9 god, Snow God Claudia.
……
A man and a woman were sitting silently in a small hall near the place where Gu Nan accepted his mission. They were the two external Heaven Level Star Rulers that Academic Heaven was able to rope into the war.
The man was leisurely sipping a cup of tea, while the woman's expression was clearly one of irritation and extreme impatience.
The woman’s behavior was quite rare for powerhouses on their level.
Of the two, one was Yang Yan of Northern Underworld Heaven, and the other was Yu Yeifei of Hundred Specters Heaven. Both were genuine Heaven Level Star Rulers, so by all accounts, they should’ve been able to control their emotions long ago.
However, Yu Yeifei was a special case because she was originally a Void Cutter who inherited Hundred Specters Heaven from its previous Star Ruler.
Such an experience could definitely be called "ascending to heaven in one fell swoop", but no matter how amazingly talented Yu Yeifei was, jumping from Tier 4 to right underneath Unified Dao was still a bit too big of a leap.
Just stabilizing her cultivation base and settling the revolts in the astral world had taken her thousands of years. Even now, she still hadn't fully digested her predecessor's legacy.
Hundred Specters Heaven was originally a great plane approaching Tier 10, but now it could only be considered Tier 9, so the damage was quite substantial.
However, this was also normal for astral worlds that were inherited. At least it didn’t directly fall out of the ranks of Heaven Level planes, so Yu Yeifei was already considered a good successor.
"Didn't they say they found a third person? Could that Fang geezer be brushing us off?" Seeing Yang Yan's tranquil demeanor, Yu Yeifei could only forcefully suppress the annoyance in her heart and ask in a low voice.
In the information Academic Heaven gathered, Snow God Claudia was the most suitable Tier 9 target for the God Hunt. But she was nevertheless Tier 9, so it was impossible to just send a single Star Ruler of the same rank to hunt her.
To ensure safety, it had to be at least a three-on-one fight, so it wasn't until Academic Heaven found a third person that the two were summoned here.
"Perhaps some matter delayed them." Yang Yan had a calm and unperturbed look on his face and laughed lightly. "Yu, you really need to change this temper of yours, or else you’ll suffer a loss sooner or later because of this."
Yu Yeifei's irritable nature was also well-known in the Star Ruler circles.
As for Yang Yan, despite his young appearance, his actual age was already several times older than Yu Yeifei’s, so no one could say anything about lecturing her like this.
Yu Yeifei took a deep breath and tried to calm herself down.
She also knew about the flaws in her character. She actually wasn’t like this when she was young; it was entirely due to the fact that she was in a hurry to catch up with the explosive growth in her cultivation after ascending to heaven in one fell swoop that she suffered Qi deviation.
Perhaps only when she reaches Tier 10 would this influence be completely removed. But just as Yu Yeifei wanted to speak again, a figure appeared behind the two.
"I’m the third person, let's go," a calm voice came from behind them, causing the two to turn their heads at the first opportunity.
The newcomer was wrapped entirely in black robes, not revealing any aura, so there was no way to determine the stranger’s identity.
But the fact that the other party was able to silently appear beside the two without being detected until he spoke up was a testament in itself.
Yang Yan and Yu Yefei glanced at each other, somewhat puzzled by the other party's move to hide his identity.
Characters at their level were already pitifully scarce in number—there were only so many, so hiding one’s identity was simply pointless.
As soon as he attacked, all his earlier hiding would be for nothing.
Yang Yan didn't mind it and nodded in response, but Yu Yeifei couldn't help spitting out a sentence because she was already in a foul mood, "Just tell us who you are. What's the point of hiding yourself?"
If not for the fact that Academic Heaven played a big role in helping her inherit Hundred Specters Heaven back then, she wouldn't have bothered to get involved in this war.
"None of your business."
A flat reply came, causing Yu Yeifei's eyelids to twitch slightly. She couldn't help sneering, "Fine. If you won't say it, I'll find out myself!"
As soon as her words fell, her right hand had already struck out, flashing with a tranquil, ghostly blue light, which seemed to all be contained inside her right palm, swiftly landing on the opponent’s body.
As long as the other party blocked it, it wouldn’t be hard to see what laws he wielded, which would allow her to narrow down the suspects of his identity to the single digits.
However, what she didn't expect was that the stranger not only didn't dodge, but he didn’t even try to block, simply allowing her palm to hit his body.
In Yu Yeifei's senses, it was as if this palm had struck a wall, a pebble sinking into the sea with no ripples.
Instead, she suddenly felt a coldness on her face as a gaze so icy it felt real struck her face.
"Then why don’t you try?"

chapters.title: Chapter 482: Starting The Hunt
chapters.content:
Before Yu Yefei could register these words, she felt a sharp pain in her stomach as all her protective laws were instantly blasted through, and her body was struck without hindrance.
Her entire body flew backwards. Yang Yan frowned slightly, already appearing behind Yu Yefei in a flash as he caught her.
Yu Yefei was too close to see what happened, but he saw everything.
That person took Yu Yefei's palm strike head-on before instantly throwing a kick that broke through all of Yu Yefei’s defensive laws and hit her body.
"Pure strength? Who could this be?" Yang Yan put Yu Yefei down, his mind already going through a list of possible identities.
In his impression, there didn’t seem to be any body tempering cultivators at their level, or rather, even those experts would have recognizable characteristics when attacking, unlike this person…
"Could he be a god?"
Because of the recent war between the two worlds, this was the first thought that popped into Yang Yan's mind. He once again glanced at Yu Yefei, who seemed to have similar thoughts.
Though Yu Yefei was sent flying by the black-robed person’s kick, she wasn’t injured since it wasn't a strike at full power.
The two of them went through the entire list of possible identities for the stranger, but they never found a match.
Gu Nan’s figure might have appeared in their minds for a second, but he was ruled out in the blink of an eye.
This wasn’t their fault. After all, the outside world’s impression of Gu Nan was still that of a junior with somewhat mysterious abilities who just ascended to Realm Level.
He caused too much commotion with his advancement to Realm Level, and although he then fought Fang Chaoyun, he was just on the defensive and didn’t display many abilities, so there was no way for onlookers to judge his strength.
Speaking of special methods to temporarily fight against Tier 10 powerhouses, these two could also do the same; they’d just need some time to prepare.
Even Fang Chaoyun himself only viewed Gu Nan as a normal Realm Level Star Ruler.
In most people's minds, the rank of one’s astral world was the best measure of comprehensive strength, and if someone was strong in a certain aspect, then they were bound to be deficient in another aspect.
"Any other questions?" The black-robed man's calm and indifferent voice rang out.
Yu Yefei's gaze was slightly cold, and she was about to speak again when Yang Yan stopped her.
"Let’s depart," Northern Underworld Heaven’s Star Ruler said with a sunny smile.
……
Their current target was Snow God Claudia, an old god in the truest sense of the word. She was even older than many greater gods.
That was why there was no such thing as generations of Snow Gods; she was the only one since ancient times.
"An old fart of a god," Yang Yan gave quite a rude evaluation. "These types of existences usually fear death more. To think she’s actually part of the vanguard this time."
Yu Yefei had obviously done her homework, "Her daughter and son-in-law—both gods—all died at the hands of God Hunters."
"So she’s seeking revenge? We can use this in our plan," Yang Yan said with a nod.
Once they knew the target's goal, they could undoubtedly create a targeted ambush, getting the greatest gain at the smallest cost.
At the very least, the other party was a Tier 9 god. Older didn’t mean weaker, so they must not underestimate her.
Yang Yan and Yu Yefei discussed countermeasures and tactics for the actual ambush. Only the black-robed stranger never said a word.
The three had already reached the edge of the Myriad Heavens and were now in the frontlines. Yang Yan glanced at the stranger and asked, "Does Your Excellency have any advice?"
He originally thought this person would either give an opinion or continue to remain silent and pretend to be mysterious, but he didn't expect the other party to open his mouth…
"No."
The corners of Yang Yan’s lips twitched slightly, finally understanding Yu Yefei’s feelings. This kind of tone really was asking for a beating…
"Then how are you planning to deal with the Snow God?" Yu Yefei couldn't help sneering.
The black-robed man paused slightly and turned his head to look at Yu Yefei. "Find her, then kill her."
……
Finding the Snow God wasn’t too hard. Academic Heaven’s people had never let Claudia out of their sight ever since they discovered her trail.
Or rather, there weren’t many places to hide in the first place when it came to the frontlines where the two worlds met.
The Snow God was precisely one of the few high-ranking gods who traveled to the frontlines at this stage of the war. She was responsible for the preparations taking place in several frontline planes.
At the same time, she was also responsible for guarding the frontlines to prevent a surprise attack. And if she herself was the one to be ambushed, one can well imagine that the nearby gods would also step in.
"Claudia is down there." Yang Yan stood above the void and gazed at a small plane below them. "According to the information given by Academic Heaven, she’s not hiding herself and usually… Hey!"
Before Yang Yan could finish, he saw the black-robed figure next to him leap out, with absolutely no intention of discussing anything.
"Damn it!"
Yang Yan subconsciously made to follow him. If this fellow startled their target and she escaped, it would be much harder for them to succeed in their God Hunt the next time.
However, now it was Yu Yefei’s turn to pull him back. This young Star Ruler said with a serious face, "Let him test the waters first… It won’t be too late for us to attack after we confirm there’s no danger."
Yang Yan immediately understood. The war between the two worlds had too wide a reach. The enemy greater gods could strike at any time, so it would be better to let the black-robed man be the vanguard.
They weren't subordinates of Academic Heaven, so failing a hunt was no big deal. At worst, they would simply change a target next time, so there was no need to take risks.
Yang Yan stopped in his tracks, but then he felt a bit puzzled. "But that guy doesn’t seem to care about this at all. Could he be from Academic Heaven’s direct branch?"
"Like hell a direct branch would be sent out to die!" Yu Yefei refuted with a cold smile.
Ever since taking charge of Hundred Specters Heaven, her relationship with Academic Heaven had progressively deteriorated, which was inevitable.
As they watched, the black-robed stranger fell directly into the plane from the sky, and a pitch-black giant sword suddenly coalesced in his hand, chopping downwards with great force.
"He’s not a pure body tempering cultivator!" Yu Yefei was a little startled. She didn’t expect that although the other party’s physical body was so powerful already, his laws weren’t actually related to physical strength.
Yang Yan's thoughts churned, and his range of speculations regarding the stranger’s identity suddenly expanded a bit more.
Regardless of the two’s guesses, the black-robed figure on the ground didn’t hesitate in the slightest, chopping straight into the crowd.
This strike alone cost the World of Gods at least ten Legend Ranks and even injured some gods.
But after this strike, the black-robed man simply turned and left without saying a word, as if he only came to unleash this one attack.
Just as he turned to leave, a chill instantly descended on the small plane, and snowflakes began to drift in the sky.
Claudia finally made her move in an attempt to stop the enemy from fleeing, but something unexpected happened.
That black-robed person actually turned around in an instant and headed straight for the center of the snowstorm!
His entire body disappeared into the shadows, which hid all traces of his aura, as he arrived in front of Claudia in the blink of an eye.
A fist swung down, and Claudia instantly transformed into a sky full of snowflakes, escaping without a word as well.
"Can you really escape?" The black-robed figure let out a cold laugh, and he shouted at the two people outside the plane again.
"Are you two here to watch a play?!"
Yang Yan and Yu Yefei looked at each other in dismay and really did feel like they were watching a play… After seeing the black-robed stranger’s full power, they’d be blind if they still couldn't recognize him.
‘It was actually him! He’s already able to fight a Tier 9 god… How can this not be a play?’

chapters.title: Chapter 483: Snow God
chapters.content:
The black-robed person was Gu Nan.
After seeing the giant sword of shadows, discerning their black-robed teammate’s laws was no longer difficult. The characteristics of a Star Ruler who possessed both the law of shadows and a powerful physical body were just too distinctive!
"To think it’s actually him… I can’t believe he’s helping Academic Heaven…" Yu Yefei muttered to herself incredulously.
Her mind instantly filled in a bunch of drama, such as Gu Nan actually being Academic Heaven's pawn or Academic Heaven originally sending someone else as their third teammate, only for Gu Nan to intercept and kill that person…
Yang Yan’s eyes flickered, clearly also quite unsettled after recognizing Gu Nan.
Regardless of what Yu Yefei and Yang Yan were speculating, they didn’t forget the purpose of their trip and descended to the small plane at the first opportunity, completely surrounding the sky full of snow.
The fact that Gu Nan’s attack didn’t attract a greater god’s descent meant their enemies weren’t paying attention to this place, at least for the time being.
They had to finish this as quickly as possible. Plus, their mission would be complete after killing Claudia!
Unlike Gu Nan, who was genuinely interested in hunting gods, these two were invited by Academic Heaven solely because of their past relations and might not have been willing to get involved in this matter otherwise.
Who knows when the enemy greater gods would descend and whether Song Fei would be able to save them?
It wouldn’t be strange at all for something to go wrong during battles of that level.
As soon as the two landed in the small plane, they unleashed their own laws at full power, and purple and cyan light radiated from their bodies respectively, quickly destroying all the snowflakes in their surroundings.
Transforming into snowflakes was one of the Snow God's abilities. As long as a single snowflake could escape, she would revive herself.
Snowflakes were much harder to deal with than blood or energy. The essence of snow was water, and even if heat made it melt, it would at worst turn into water vapor and float into the air.
Water molecules were extremely stable structures, so one could well imagine the difficulty of destroying all the water in a certain area.
That's why it required three powerhouses of the same level to ensure Claudia wouldn’t escape.
Gu Nan stabbed his shadow longsword into the ground, and the shadows rapidly expanded like a black hole, sucking in anything they engulfed and completely pulverizing the land without leaving an inch of grass behind.
The sky was completely swallowed up by Yang Yan's law domain, and cyan-colored lightning wantonly swept through it, even churning up space itself.
Yu Yefei landed on the ground and pressed one hand to the land. The power from the abyss began to wreak havoc and churn underground.
Under the three’s joint efforts, a perfectly fine plane became riddled with holes. Since even the plane itself couldn’t be spared, Claudia was naturally affected as well.
At the other end of the small plane, the Snow God’s human form materialized as she quickly opened a crack in space with lingering fear, trying to hide in one of the other planes. She didn’t even dare spare any time to sneak a quick glance behind her.
However, Gu Nan's party was already prepared for this, so how could they let her escape?
The ground under Claudia's feet suddenly cracked, as if a terrifying force from the nine abyss had struck, instantly swallowing up her entire being.
A loud cry cut through the cyan sky, and a monster that resembled both a roc and a fish descended from above. The monster’s tremendous weight bore down on Claudia, as if trying to crush her completely.
Yang Yan and Yu Yefei's seamless cooperation instantly sealed off all of Claudia's escape routes, cornering her in the truest sense of the word.
And just as this Snow God was doing her best to escape from the two’s overlapping attacks, a shadow appeared behind her.
Claudia never imagined that an enemy would actually dare sneak up on her amidst bombardment from two sides… Even if the other party managed to hit her, wouldn’t he still have to worry about escaping unscathed himself?
Reality wasn’t a game; there was no such thing as immunity to friendly fire. The onslaught from the sky and the ground was something that everyone had to endure.
So only when a shadow sword suddenly stabbed Claudia in the back and shot out of her chest did the Snow God turn her head in surprise.
"You—"
But Gu Nan's fist had already landed before Claudia could utter a single word, blasting her entire head apart.
Gold blood splashed out in all directions but was instantly vaporized again by the raging powers between heaven and earth.
After losing the support of her own laws, even Claudia's corpse was completely engulfed in the blink of an eye, leaving no trace behind.
On the contrary, the two outside—Yang Yan and Yu Yefei—were slightly stunned upon seeing this and hastily stopped their bombardment.
Even they never expected Gu Nan to be this resolute, determined to kill Claudia on the spot even if it meant tanking both of their attacks.
A moment later, they saw Gu Nan's figure slowly emerge from the ruins of a wrecked plane, calmly walking up to them.
The simultaneous attacks of two Tier 9 cultivators—especially imbued with laws charged up in advance—caused Gu Nan considerable damage.
His body was enveloped by the power of the nine abyss, and his entire body looked as if it had been scrubbed with sandpaper. Not a single piece of skin on his body remained intact.
His head was suppressed by the crushing weight of the Kunpeng[1] Dharma. The massive force created by the law snapped his neck completely, twisting it over 360 degrees and causing him to look at the two from a tilted angle.
"Let’s go," Gu Nan didn’t care about such a small injury and casually called out to the two.
There was no doubt that Claudia was dead, as Gu Nan's Evil Value had already arrived.
This ancient Tier 9 god provided Gu Nan with nearly 10,000 Evil Value, allowing his current Evil Value to exceed 25,000, which wasn’t far from the Tier 9 threshold.
However, Gu Nan's goal this time wasn’t to reach Tier 9, but to farm enough Evil Value to directly reach Tier 10, which was still a bit far away.
In terms of enemies, he would need the Evil Value from killing three Tier 10 gods to reach the Tier 10 requirement. Translated to Tier 9 gods, he would probably need to kill nine to ten of them.
Gu Nan's tone was calm, but it gave Yang Yan and Yu Yefei a very strange feeling. They knew better than anyone else what kind of injuries Gu Nan had suffered, which was why they felt even more horrified.
Even after receiving injuries like these, he could still act as if nothing had happened?
They even noticed that the parts of Gu Nan's body scraped raw by the power of the nine abyss were recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye, with brand-new flesh and skin rapidly regenerating, as if he’d never been injured in the first place.
Even his head, which was twisted at a strange angle, was wrenched right back by Gu Nan's hands as he spoke.
However, the broken vertebrae had obviously yet to regrow, so his head could only hang limply from his neck, unnaturally crooked.
It was Yang Yan who finally replied with a light cough, "Since we've already killed the target, let's leave quickly before any greater gods target us."
Yu Yefei also nodded. Such a large commotion would undoubtedly attract attention soon.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, waved his hand dismissively. "Claudia’s death doesn’t really matter. No greater god will come over… But it's true that we should leave soon."
He still wanted to rush back to find another target to hunt.
T/N:
[1] Kunpeng: An enormous mythological beast that can transform into both a roc (Peng) and a fish (Kun)

chapters.title: Chapter 484: Preparations For The Final Divine Kingdom War
chapters.content:
After saying that, Gu Nan left first without further explanation.
Yang Yan and Yu Yefei exchanged a glance, knowing that Gu Nan was bound to have some inside information. However, they wouldn't ask if he was unwilling to divulge it, and they also didn't have the obligation to share information in the first place.
Moreover, the two tacitly agreed to keep silent about Gu Nan's involvement in this and even made up their minds to pretend they didn't know about it once they returned.
Gu Nan had hidden his identity to come and help Academic Heaven, and regardless of the actual reason, it was obvious that he didn’t want outsiders to know.
If they leaked this, they would undoubtedly bring Gu Nan or even Academic Heaven’s retaliation down on their heads, so it was better to not do anything at all and keep it to themselves.
Gu Nan also ignored these two teammates of his. He knew that after this battle, the two would most likely not be participating in the war anymore.
There weren't many high-ranking powerhouses willing to join the war to begin with, or else Academic Heaven wouldn't have chosen this kind of hunting operation.
……
In Academic Heaven, news of Claudia's death quickly reached Fang Chaoyun's ears by way of Lin Huan’s report.
"The two seniors, Yang Yan and Yu Yefei, have each returned to their astral worlds." Lin Huan reported as such, "On the contrary, Gu Nan is inquiring if there are any new targets."
"Two shortsighted people!" Fang Chaoyun scoffed disdainfully, then added, "The motive behind Gu Nan’s actions is hard to fathom… But if he wants to help us kill gods, we don't have to stop him. Just give him a target."
Lin Huan, however, said with an awkward smile, "Master, the problem is that we currently don't have any targets for him to hunt."
"How?" Fang Chaoyun’s eyebrows shot up. "We have the whereabouts of at least 200 gods. Don’t tell me not a single one is a suitable target?"
Lin Huan stammered, "Gu Nan, he… he plans to hunt Tier 9 gods alone."
……
When Gu Nan returned to the Myriad Heavens, he received a message from Academic Heaven saying there was no suitable target for the time being and asking him to wait patiently.
Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head slightly, but he knew this was the norm.
High-ranked gods weren't fools. How could they run to the frontlines with a target on their backs before the war officially started? Even for the Myriad Heavens, most of the people currently assembled on the frontlines were normal armies.
Claudia was just a special case. The information Academic Heaven dug up on her daughter and son-in-law was actually nothing more than a front.
Gu Nan knew exactly why the Snow God had gone to the frontlines—she and Rolensia were mortal enemies, the kind with a rather deep grudge.
Claudia had been hiding her tracks ever since Rolensia ascended to a greater god, fearing that the Ruler of Luxuriant Blossoms would try to settle the score once the time was right.
And while Rolensia might not have been able to free up time to deal with Claudia initially, she clearly wouldn't let go of the opportunity this time. Claudia was almost certainly forced out here by Rolensia.
If Gu Nan wants to hunt another high-ranking god, he would probably have to wait until the war officially starts and look for an opportunity amidst the chaos.
The Evil Value each god gave was related to their level first and foremost, with a roughly 1:3 ratio difference between each level. But the lower the level, the more this ratio would increase.
Once the chaotic war truly started, Gu Nan planned to prioritize hunting the lower-ranked gods to push his Evil Value to a higher level before attacking and killing the higher-ranked gods to reach the threshold in one fell swoop.
This was mainly due to the fact that he would attract the greater gods’ attention if he went on a hunting spree to kill high-ranked gods as soon as the war started.
If the greater gods noticed him right from the start, then Gu Nan's identity might be seen through as his Evil Value accumulated.
After all, the distinct characteristics of an Evil God would begin to appear once his Evil Value reaches Tier 9 or Tier 10.
"My Lord, the new target has been selected," Red Tail walked inside the Evil God Temple and reported to Gu Nan. By new target, she naturally meant an astral world.
Evil Value had to be earned from hunts, but points couldn’t just be ignored either. Both had to be farmed, and both had to be planned for.
Even though the actual start of the Divine Kingdom War would be after Gu Nan finished collecting enough Evil Value at the earliest, preparations for the war had to begin now to ensure it could be waged at any time.
Using Daoist Sect Realm as a unit of measurement, only 1.5 Daoist Sect Realms were needed for Gu Nan to advance to Tier 10, but the so-called "1.5" was actually a bit awkward.
Daoist Sect Realm was already considered one of the more powerful astral worlds among the Realm Level planes.
Even other first-tier Realm Level planes like White Bones Realm could hardly reach the level of 1.5 Daoist Sect Realms.
But things would spiral out of control if he organized two Divine Kingdom Wars. After all, the big picture now was the Great War between the two worlds. Academic Heaven would not sit back and allow any infighting in the Myriad Heavens.
At that time, let alone Fang Chaoyun, it was even possible for Song Fei to personally take action.
So the best method was to simply find a Heaven Level plane from the start—the Divine Kingdom War playstyle was nearing its end, and as long as he could farm enough points, it didn't matter if he lost all the divine servants or even apostles.
When such a tactical intent was set forth, the Cabinet quickly selected a target.
"Imperial Glory Heaven?" Gu Nan raised his brow slightly, a little surprised.
The Star Ruler of Imperial Glory Heaven was Immortal Empress Taisheng. It was one of the more bottom-of-the-barrel planes among the Heaven Level astral worlds, with the Star Ruler position similarly coming from inheritance. Perhaps Immortal Empress Taisheng’s strength couldn’t even compare to Yu Yefei’s.
No matter how many competitors she defeated and how shrewd and calculating this woman was, power could never be gained out of thin air.
What surprised Gu Nan slightly was the fact that Imperial Glory Heaven was the target… Immortal Empress Taisheng was a member of the Heaven-God Alliance, and a core member at that.
Invading Imperial Glory Heaven was tantamount to falling out with the Heaven-God Alliance.
"That’s right." Red Tail nodded. "The reasoning given by the Cabinet is that Imperial Glory Heaven experienced a dragon Qi leakage not long ago that led to various independent regimes seceding from imperial rule."
"Immortal Empress Taisheng spent considerable effort to quell the strife within her astral world. Now, the concentration of dragon Qi inside Imperial Glory Heaven has dropped greatly, so it's a good opportunity to invade."
Gu Nan continued looking through the dossier and realized that Imperial Glory Heaven was indeed a special astral world.
The unique existence known as dragon Qi was exclusive to Imperial Glory Heaven, and how much power the Star Ruler could get from her astral world also depended on the amount of dragon Qi her dynasty possessed, which made it slightly different from other astral worlds.
What's more, the Star Ruler herself couldn't attack internal rebels, and the plundering of dragon Qi must follow the rule of "kings can’t fight other kings", so the tactic of taking out the rebel leaders couldn’t be used.
"A good place indeed." Gu Nan couldn’t help smiling when he finished reading the dossier.
Imperial Glory Heaven was indeed a suitable target. With such a suitable target in front of him, Gu Nan no longer cared about falling out with the Heaven-God Alliance.
To be precise, he didn’t fear falling out with anyone.
In addition, the Cabinet also provided a reason that might not necessarily get used but wasn’t without merit: attacking Imperial Glory Heaven could be disguised as the Heaven-God Alliance’s internal conflict, lowering the probability of Song Fei interfering.

chapters.title: Chapter 485: Ghost Of The Battlefield
chapters.content:
The Great War started.
Once both sides deemed their preparations to be sufficient, war inevitably broke out regardless of anyone's will.
Both sides’ objective was also very clear—not for territory or resources, but solely to kill the enemy.
The Star Rulers went to war for the Godheads inside gods’ bodies, while the gods also went to war for the Godheads, only they wanted to protect them. Only by giving those Star Rulers a painful beating could the God Hunt be curbed.
Of course, mortal armies were also essential. Be it gods or Star Rulers, both were elusive existences who would never obediently wait for death by staying in one location.
Only by using mortal armies to invade the corresponding planes was it possible to truly determine these people’s locations.
That was why the mortals already started fighting in this war a while ago. For example, information on the various gods that Academic Heaven previously gave Gu Nan was obtained through the sacrifice of countless mortal lives.
When the Star Rulers and gods started participating in the war on a large scale, the military campaign’s rhythm began to shift as well.
The mortal armies on both sides no longer patrolled and restrained each other, instead continuously invading target planes to wantonly wreak havoc and plunder, forcing out the other side's powerful figures.
After all, wars at this level were already vastly different from mortal wars.
It was impossible for mortals to pose a threat to Star Rulers, so they could only assist from the sidelines, aiming to weaken the enemy plane.
Therefore, the war eventually developed into a situation where hundreds of Star Rulers either acted alone or in groups to launch surprise attacks. Though their ambushes seemed uncoordinated, like scattered sand, Academic Heaven was commanding all dispatches from the center based on a larger strategy.
Those in the World of Gods also had something similar, but overall, they were on the defensive.
The reason was simple: the main force for the Myriad Heavens was the low-ranked Star Rulers, as well as the forces under their command—the very group of people who had the greatest demand for Godheads.
As long as they obtained a single Godhead, they could turn around and mass-produce over a dozen Void Cutters who were then capable of swiftly joining the war.
In contrast, the World of Gods had no time flow difference to speak of, so the efficiency of cultivating Legend Ranks was so low that they had to rely entirely on the gods' own apostles to defend.
……
Frontlines, Fairhaven.
Fairhaven was one of the largest planes belonging to the World of Gods at the junction of the two worlds, with a large number of gods and mortal armies assembled there.
In a sense, Fairhaven was the frontline command center for the World of Gods. It coordinated most of the frontline battles and personnel dispatchment.
However, the gods meeting in Fairhaven all looked gloomy today.
"Four more gods fell yesterday, which means our enemies have at least forty more Legend Ranks." A middle-aged man with blond hair pounded the tabletop with great force. "Everyone, things can't go on like this!"
This was God of Knights Wayne, a recently-ascended Tier 8 god, yet he was already one of the higher-ranked people in the frontline command center.
"What else can we do? Let’s ask for help from above. The enemies’ personnel can be constantly replenished, but we’ll only lose more people as we fight…" A young man beside him complained with a grimace.
"If we keep fighting like this, it’ll be too late once all our apostles die, weakening our own powers."
"That’s right. We should’ve requested their assistance a long time ago…"
The gods in attendance discussed amongst themselves, but the consensus was basically the same—to invite high-ranking gods to help out by ambushing enemy Star Rulers.
After all, if they used their apostles to fight enemy Void Cutters, they might be able to handle it for a short while, but losing too many apostles would inevitably weaken their own powers.
Apostles themselves were the most devout believers and would receive a small portion of the god's divine power, so every apostle’s death was a major loss.
Wayne listened to the crowd's arguments in silence, at a loss on what to say for a while.
Even the people here had lost their confidence and were only thinking of asking the high-ranking gods to intervene, so one could see just how bad the situation had gotten.
But Wayne knew perfectly well what caused this. There were two reasons—one was Claudia’s death not long ago, making the higher-level gods fearful of stepping foot onto the frontlines.
The other reason was even simpler. Wayne glanced down at the intelligence report on the table. Of the four gods that fell yesterday, three had once again died at the hands of "Ghost".
"That damned ‘Ghost’…"
……
In the gap between the two worlds, the sixteenth spatial jump point.
A tidal wave of armies from the Myriad Heavens continuously surged in, attempting to capture this place in one fell swoop.
Spatial jump points were the best places to enter larger worlds. Crossing the dimensional barrier from here can minimize risk of injuries, so it was a location the two sides would inevitably fight over.
After all, there wasn’t much need to worry about spatial jump points when only a few people were sneaking through, but they couldn't just pick a random location when trying to move a large army.
The strengths of individual members of the mortal army were insufficient, so if they didn't go through the jump point, the casualties incurred during the trip alone would be astronomical.
"Shameless invaders! In the name of His Majesty Tarak, I will drive out all evil!"
A blond girl in full armor floated in the air. The towering shield in her hands glowed with golden light, shielding the gods’ side from hundreds of enemy troops at once while attacks from her forces were able to travel through the golden light freely, inflicting a large number of kills.
Julie was an apostle of Shield God Tarak and had been dispatched to the sixteenth spatial jump point to defend against the evil invaders’ attacks.
As a genius who managed to step into the threshold of Legend Rank at the young age of nineteen, Julie had every right to be proud of herself, and she was confident that any evil would be destroyed under the holy light.
However, only after she came to the frontlines did Julie realize that the world was a harsh place.
The enemy was not only evil and cunning, but also far more powerful than she imagined! One by one, powerful Legend Rank enemies as strong as herself—or even stronger—rushed at her, as if they didn’t care about their lives at all.
How could she know that these "mass-produced" Void Cutters were originally a part of the Star Rulers’ direct branch to begin with, so they naturally didn’t care about their lives?
Or perhaps they already entered an agreement to risk their lives fighting for the Star Ruler with all their might for a certain length of time in exchange for the opportunity to become a Void Cutter. Otherwise, why would they be chosen to become Void Cutters?
Outside the golden shield, she saw the mortals being swiftly killed off one by one while the Legend Rank opponents temporarily dodged their attacks. In the end, they didn’t manage to injure a single Legend Rank enemy.
Julie couldn't help hating herself for not learning divine arts that dealt wide-area damage so that she could exterminate these despicable invaders in one fell swoop.
When the divine power that Julie invoked was exhausted, the radiance from her shield gradually dimmed, as if endless enemies were once again surrounding her.
Julie gazed ahead in slight despair. The empty feeling from her depleted power caused her to stagger a little.
"My Lord… is this the end?"
With the last of her strength, the young girl silently mouthed the name of her god while slowly closing her eyes, waiting for death to arrive.
A faint sigh seemed to travel over from beyond the horizon, followed by endless golden light falling down, blocking and even annihilating all the invaders from the Myriad Heavens.
This time, not even the Legend Rank enemies escaped.

chapters.title: Chapter 486: Another Ghost
chapters.content:
"It's a god!"
"Run!"
"Our mission is complete, everyone… Ah!"
The Void Cutters from the Myriad Heavens tried to flee at practically the same time the golden light appeared, each person running faster than the next.
They knew all too well that their strategic intent was simply to force out the enemy gods, who would naturally be dealt with by Star Rulers, so what happened afterwards was no longer part of their mission.
It was also due to this kind of thinking that the number of Void Cutters who actually died from this attack wasn’t as high as one would have imagined.
In fact, the powerful Legend Rank enemies who appeared to be numerous in Julie's eyes actually strictly adhered to the principle of "no more than 10 gathered at once" to ensure the God Hunt returned a "profit".
So in reality, only two Void Cutters were killed instantly by Shield God Tarak, while the rest had already fled.
The blond girl opened her eyes in shock and realized she was surrounded by boundless golden light, and the enemies around her had long since dissipated without a trace…
"Miracle! This is the miracle that father and the others talked about!"
Julie burst into tears. She couldn't help kneeling down on one knee and paying her respect with the most perfect salute.
However, at this very moment, the golden light filling the whole sky seemed to be stopped by something, instantly freezing and then quickly vanishing as if it had never appeared in the first place.
"This is…" Julie looked up incredulously, only to see all the golden light collapsing towards a single point.
The golden light seemed to have been devoured entirely in the blink of an eye, and that one black spot also disappeared right as the golden light dissipated.
Julie’s heart suddenly felt empty, as if something had disappeared, almost as if her faith suddenly had no place to go…
