This young believer hadn't experienced a collapse of faith yet, or else she would’ve immediately realized that she could no longer mobilize her divine power.
Only after this did a few figures quickly arrive, two men and one woman.
"Seriously, what awful luck! Someone stole our target again! Who the hell is this rude? I only managed to lure this god out after losing a Void Cutter!" An old man with a gloomy aura wrapped entirely in a black robe cursed.
According to the unspoken rules in the Myriad Heavens, the Godhead naturally belonged to the person whose subordinates lured out that god.
No matter the circumstances, "kill stealing" was always despised.
"Old Yin, stop complaining." The woman next to him also said angrily, "I also lost a Void Cutter, and three more got injured. Who can I ask to compensate me for this loss?"
The other man beside them didn't lose any Void Cutters, so his mood was slightly better in comparison, and he couldn't help chuckling. "You two… In the past, the loss of a Void Cutter would’ve been enough to make you heartbroken for twenty years, right?"
The other two glared at him, though neither ultimately responded.
Because the man wasn’t wrong. In the past, if weak Star Rulers like them who just entered this realm could recruit even a single Void Cutter, they would be raising the Void Cutter like a precious treasure. How would they dare send Void Cutters to the battlefield?
It was only after they got the Godhead Cultivation Method that they dared to be so extravagant.
"Forget it!" The ghostly old man waved his hand. "Let's hurry up and withdraw, lest we lure the high-ranked gods over."
The other two naturally had no objections, but it was the woman who spoke again after some thought, "Wait, check if the Godhead is still there. I heard from a friend that a ‘Ghost' has been frequenting the battlefield recently and only hunts gods without taking their Godheads…"
Old Yin couldn't help snorting disdainfully. "Such a person actually exists? To just hunt gods without taking their Godheads—is this Ghost some sort of altruist?"
But he didn’t move at all, clearly utterly unconvinced. The man next to him didn't really believe it either, but since his companion had spoken, it didn’t hurt to take a look.
He cut open Tarak's corpse with a wave of his hand, then revealed an incredulous expression.
"The Godhead really exists!"
Old Yin turned his head violently, his eyes almost popping out of their sockets as he stared blankly at the Godhead that shimmered with golden light on the Shield God's corpse.
The woman on the side was equally incredulous, muttering under her breath, "Ghost really exists…"
……
Gu Nan’s figure reformed near the vicinity of the sixteenth spatial jump point, a slightly unfathomable smile on his face.
Shield God Tarak was only a Tier 7 god and was taken by surprise, so of course Tarak died on contact with Gu Nan, unable to resist in any way.
"That’s the third one today. Time to call it a day," Gu Nan looked at his Evil Value and leisurely said to himself.
After days of nonstop hunting, his Evil Value already reached 39,000. The results were even more lucrative than hunting a Tier 9 god.
And the number of gods who died at his hands during this period already exceeded ten, all of whom were low-ranked gods.
In order to ensure he didn't draw attention to himself, Gu Nan set a rule for himself—he would not strike more than three times a day. As long as his kills weren’t too frequent, they wouldn’t be noticed for the time being.
As for leaving behind the Godhead, that was also a deliberate decision on Gu Nan's part.
Compared to a “kill steal", it was always easier for a "pleasant surprise" to remain hidden and not spread too quickly.
Star Rulers weren’t stupid. Who knows whether “Ghost” will still strike again once everyone knows about him? Even if they bet on that luck, they still wouldn’t wantonly publicize the existence of “Ghost”.
……
After killing the Shield God, Gu Nan returned to Heavenly Province World.
If Fairhaven was the frontline command center for the World of Gods, then Heavenly Province World would undoubtedly hold a similar position for the Myriad Heavens.
Although Heavenly Province World wasn't too large, a considerable number of powerful people were already gathered here from the start, and its location was also quite crucial, so this plane was undoubtedly favored by Star Rulers.
So much so that Star Rulers had created places of mutual information and item exchange in Heavenly Province World.
Gu Nan's figure slowly appeared, walking into a dimly lit underground bar. He didn’t show his face and was wrapped in a pitch-black cloak, making his identity impossible to discern.
A bartender came forward and was about to greet Gu Nan and ask for an order, but after seeing this attire, his expression suddenly changed, and he respectfully said, "Lord Black Robe, are you going 'downstairs' this time as well?"
"Yeah, open the door," Gu Nan nodded and replied indifferently.
The bartender turned around in response and led Gu Nan to a wall. He reached out and gave it a gentle push, and the wall actually flipped over violently along with the ground, sending him and Gu Nan to the other side.
On this side, there happened to be a woman already in front of them. When she saw the visitor behind her, she couldn't help greeting with a smile, "Black Robe? It's been a long time since you've been here."
Gu Nan glanced at her. This person was a weak Star Ruler he met previously, so he smiled and replied, "Just taking a look."
There were several similar Star Ruler gathering places in this plane, and Gu Nan was rotating through them.
Gu Nan's attitude was very cold, but the woman didn't mind and continued, "Someone's auctioning off a Tier 7 Godhead today, are you interested?"
"Selling even a Tier 7 Godhead? They must be very rich already!" Gu Nan didn't answer her directly and casually remarked.
"Eh, he just picked it up. It’s not like he can use it anytime soon." The woman shrugged. "What a lucky fellow! The legend of the Ghost of the battlefield is actually true… Even the God of Giantwood lost his life at Ghost’s hands."
Gu Nan's footsteps stilled, his gaze turning serious.
He didn’t kill the God of Giantwood.

chapters.title: Chapter 487: Investigation
chapters.content:
The female Star Ruler in front of Gu Nan was Hua Zhenxiu, a person who entered this realm some time ago but never found a suitable astral world yet.
Such Star Rulers weren’t uncommon at all—or rather, people at Hua Zhenxiu's stage made up the largest portion of Star Rulers.
Finding an astral world required luck. Even if they had enough resources and power, finding a suitable astral world still wasn’t a simple matter.
The lucky bastard from Hua Zhenxiu’s story who picked up a Tier 7 Godhead on the battlefield from Ghost was another Star Ruler called Ren Fu.
Ren Fu and Hua Zhenxiu were of the same generation. The two did have contact before, but they didn’t have friendly relations and even had a slight rivalry.
However, Ren Fu later found a suitable astral world for himself before she did and named it "Grand Mission World", a reference to the phrase "a grand mission will descend upon the skilled", and now he was already the ruler of a plane.
"Ren Fu?" Gu Nan stroked his chin and nodded to indicate that he knew.
Hua Zhenxiu smiled in satisfaction and said, "Then I'll go in first."
Frankly, this woman deliberately mentioned Ren Fu to Gu Nan as both a probe to sound out more information and a casual move to see if she could find some trouble for Ren Fu.
If something later happened to Ren Fu, then she would get to vent some anger while also learning more about the mysterious Black Robe, so it wasn't a loss by any stretch of the imagination.
When Hua Zhenxiu's figure disappeared, Gu Nan followed suit and walked into the room behind the bar.
This place could definitely be called a pocket dimension. Even if Heavenly Province World was a plane with advanced technology, it was still hard to imagine someone being able to create such a vast area in a chamber hidden underground.
In fact, this wasn’t a product of technology and was a pocket dimension a Star Ruler constructed with their own laws. In essence, this space didn’t belong to Heavenly Province World.
Such a pocket dimension could only exist temporarily, and if the need arose, any random Star Ruler could destroy it without being trapped here.
This safety guarantee was also the reason Star Rulers were willing to gather here.
This one gathering spot was called Dark Pavilion by Star Rulers. The origin of the name was simple—the bar outside was called the Dark Night Bar, that’s all.
Just as Hua Zhenxiu said, Dark Pavilion was currently holding a small auction.
This kind of auction didn’t have a host to speak of. Any Star Ruler who had a nice item they wanted to sell would walk onto the stage and wait for bids from the crowd below.
Of course, this was also because the value of the auction items weren’t at the point of making people go crazy. Otherwise, the Star Rulers here wouldn’t mind rising up as a group to attack the seller.
As for the case with the Godhead Ren Fu planned to sell, that was because several Tier 7 gods had already fallen in the past few days, or else he wouldn't have dared to put it up for auction.
Gu Nan watched this auction with a dispassionate gaze. For one thing, he wasn't interested in what these Star Rulers were auctioning off, and for another, he also didn't have any money.
Even if something really did catch his interest, he could just memorize the buyer’s identity and snatch it later. There was no need to attract other people's attention here.
Ren Fu looked like a young man, but his calm and steady demeanor made people feel that he was very reliable. At this time, he was putting the God of Giantwood's Godhead on the stage to start the auction.
Quite a few people already knew about the fact that he’d picked up a Tier 7 Godhead, and it was Ren Fu himself who had spread that. This was one of the main reasons so many Star Rulers gathered at the Dark Pavilion today.
"Gentlemen, the Tier 7 God of Giantwood’s Godhead." Ren Fu placed the Godhead on the stage and said to the audience with a faint smile, "Everyone, please bid first. The buyer can come up and inspect the goods. We'll trade here; this transaction is only valid on this stage."
Which meant he would no longer acknowledge the trade after leaving the stage.
There were bound to be people who doubted the authenticity of the Godhead. Rather than arguing, it was better to make things clear— “I, Ren Fu, have nothing to prove. It’s up to you guys to believe me or not. Just don’t buy it if you don’t believe me.”
However, though he refused to argue with people, the Star Rulers below still had their own verification methods.
"Dare I ask Daoist Friend Ren where he picked up this Godhead?" A Star Ruler dressed as an old man opened his mouth to inquire about its origin.
The fall of a Tier 7 god couldn’t possibly be a silent affair. There would always be someone who knew about it.
Ren Fu didn't hide anything and reported the name of a frontline plane. It was a small plane that belonged to the World of Gods, but it was obvious that not many people present knew about it. After all, it was just a relatively obscure plane.
Some people began to secretly contact their subordinates to urgently check the situation in this plane to see if any gods had fallen today.
There were also people who started bidding without another word. Perhaps they happened to be in that plane today, so they no longer had any doubts about Ren Fu's words.
But even so, the others didn't dare make a bid—who knew if the people who already started bidding were in cahoots with Ren Fu?
There was only one person who reacted in a way that surprised those who noticed him.
After Gu Nan heard the Godhead’s origin, he actually turned to leave without any intention of bidding. Many Star Rulers wondered if this person had visited that plane today and knew that Ren Fu was lying.
The ones who cooperated by bidding might be in cahoots, but the one who turned and left wouldn't be an act, right?
……
In a small frontline plane in the World of Gods, Gu Nan's figure slowly appeared in a certain corner.
"Ren Fu is telling the truth." Gu Nan sensed the aura around him and quickly determined that this was indeed the place where the God of Giantwood had fallen.
The energy given off by a god’s death wouldn’t dissipate so easily. Though Star Rulers might not be able to utilize this, it was a beacon in Gu Nan's eyes.
It was already nighttime, yet battles were still raging in this plane. Evidently, that Great Wars didn't have any ceasefires to speak of.
"Who could it be?" Gu Nan walked through the flames of war without the slightest hint of being affected and soon arrived in a forest.
This was the place with the densest Giantwood divine power. The god had clearly fallen here. His laws—which hadn’t completely dissipated even after his death—caused a forest of giant trees to grow.
Gu Nan walked through the forest of giant trees, carefully scrutinizing each and every trace of laws, trying to find a wisp of law that didn’t belong to the God of Giantwood.
‘Killing a god without anyone’s notice means it was basically an instant kill. Not taking away the Godhead after killing him means the killer’s aim isn’t to cultivate Void Cutters…’
Gu Nan pondered as he walked.
It had to be said that this person's imitation of "Ghost" was very accurate, successfully imitating every distinct feature without revealing any of their own.
What was even stranger was that no trace of the killer’s law was exposed—even that aspect was exactly the same as Gu Nan.
‘Either the killer is also like me and killed the god directly with pure strength, or… it's a law that acts directly on the gods themselves!’ Gu Nan didn’t ponder for too long and directly concluded.
When comparing the two possibilities, it was clear that the latter was more likely.
"Is it a law that acts upon the psyche?" Gu Nan's gaze fell in the distance, where he saw a figure slowly approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Another Test
chapters.content:
"Black Robe?" The other party quickly revealed a look of shock when she saw Gu Nan, then exclaimed with an odd expression.
Due to his frequent trips to the major Star Ruler gathering places in Heavenly Province World, Gu Nan's identity as "Black Robe" was quite well known nowadays.
Long Jiayu, a Star Ruler who was quite famous in the weaker Star Rulers’ circles, had gotten her fame from her special law, the law of true knowledge.
At its essence, the law of true knowledge was a branch of knowledge, and when it came to Long Jiayu, it could be described by another phrase: “There is always only one truth!”
To put it simply, Long Jiayu was a detective Star Ruler, and her daily activities consisted of exploring and researching certain special events to find the truth behind them.
"Are you also here to search for the Ghost of the battlefield?" Long Jiayu asked with a very friendly smile, looking at Gu Nan.
This Star Ruler was a harmless-looking young girl with short coffee-colored hair and a casual outfit, but a Star Ruler's actual age and true nature could never be discerned from their appearance.
"Mm." Gu Nan nodded. He was already here, so there was no point hiding it.
"I received a message from a friend and ran here to take a look." Long Jiayu continued, "From the looks of it, the God of Giantwood really did die here."
"It could also be Ren Fu’s act." Gu Nan spoke casually, "If he was working with the God of Giantwood, they might be able to create this scene."
Long Jiayu froze for a moment before nodding. "You have a point…"
She didn't have Gu Nan's ability to tell if the God of Giantwood was dead from the aura here alone. Only looking at this forest of giant trees, it might have been the result of the god's death, but it was also true that it could’ve been created by the god himself.
After leading the young detective into blind guesses with a casual remark, Gu Nan didn't remain and quickly disappeared.
After he left, Long Jiayu stared at the forest of giant trees, then turned her head to glance at the spot where Gu Nan just disappeared, her lips curling into a faint smile.
……
After confirming that the God of Giantwood was dead and that it was a mystery person’s handiwork, Gu Nan stopped his investigation and continued his hunt.
Of course, it could also be said that because there were too few clues, Gu Nan hadn't found a direction to investigate and could only wait for the other party to make a mistake and reveal more information.
As long as the other party planned to continue killing gods, their information would be exposed sooner or later.
If possible, Gu Nan didn’t mind killing this competitor of his. After all, the other killer’s existence had already seriously damaged the "hunting ecology" and would attract more attention to Ghost.
The Godhead in Ren Fu's hands was eventually bought by another Star Ruler at an enormous price. The buyer then disappeared without a trace, clearly rushing to raise as many Void Cutters as possible.
Because of Ren Fu's previous publicity, the number of people who knew about Ghost gradually increased.
Possibly due to this, Gu Nan wasn’t able to find traces of the other Ghost’s appearance in the following days.
He himself simply sped up his pace, slightly increasing the number of gods he harvested each day.
A little over half a month later, Gu Nan's Evil Value was approaching the 60,000 mark, and the large number of gods and Star Rulers killed left both sides a little overwhelmed. The war was beginning to enter the next stage.
The next stage naturally involved battles between higher-ranked powerhouses, and usually the winners and losers of the previous stage determined which side was on the offensive.
In terms of overall numbers, with the faster time flow and the large number of small planes, the Myriad Heavens undoubtedly had a great advantage.
However, after entering the next stage, the Myriad Heavens’ high-level Star Rulers had no motivation to help in the war, so their side started to pale in comparison.
Often, a Realm Level Star Ruler finally managed to find an opening after much difficulty, only to realize there were several gods of the same level waiting on the opposite side, and in the end, they could only turn and flee.
On the contrary, Gu Nan increasingly felt like a fish back in water. No matter what level the godly ambushers were at, as long as they were taken by surprise, very few of them could dodge this bullet.
It’s just that the other Ghost showed up less and less during this period, not giving Gu Nan any opportunity to catch the other party.
All the way until the war escalated to Realm Level, that other Ghost rarely showed up again and soon vanished completely.
Gu Nan didn't really care. As long as no one was "stealing business" from him, he didn't really care who was impersonating him, and it was none of his business anyway.
However, there was one thing that even Gu Nan didn’t expect—the other Ghost wasn't a single person, but a group.
……
In one of the small frontline planes in the Myriad Heavens, several black-clothed people were talking.
"Those gods are also getting smarter. They're becoming harder to deal with. We almost failed this time," one of them grumbled. His face was a bit pale, evidently still injured.
Another voice picked up, "The gods showing up now are at least Tier 7. They’re indeed not easy to deal with… We were only able to smoothly kill the God of Giantwood last time because it just so happened that we could counter his powers."
The injured man in black couldn't help saying, "Really makes you wonder who that real Ghost is… I heard he’s still hunting gods?"
"Yes." Their leader nodded slightly. No emotion could be seen on his face.
"Tsk tsk, he’s probably some bigshot. He should at least be a Heaven Level existence."
The several black-robed figures couldn't help speculating about the true identity of "Ghost", but in the end, it was their leader who interrupted them.
"Let’s drop this." He gave a light cough. "The war between the two worlds is our chance. Collect as much power of faith as possible from that side so that our Cult Master can return as soon as possible!"
"We understand!" The crowd of black-robed figures responded in unison.
……
The Great War had been unfolding for nearly two and a half months. The levels of the participating gods were getting higher and higher, but the pace of the war was gradually slowing down.
Often, there would be as long as half a month of peace and quiet, then suddenly a major battle would occur, with even high-level gods and Star Rulers showing up.
Such a situation gave Gu Nan a bit of a headache, as it was less convenient for him to fish in troubled waters.
Just two days ago, he witnessed the fall of a Tier 7 god, yet even until the very end, he never made a move.
There was no other reason—it was because there were too many Star Rulers around, and it wasn't quite worth it for a mere Tier 7 god.
Well, if it had been a Tier 8 god, perhaps Gu Nan would’ve stolen that kill.
However, such an experience also made Gu Nan realize that the good old days of taking advantage of the chaos to wantonly harvest Evil Value was almost at an end.
Next, he had to gradually increase the level of his target, and instead of "killing many low-level gods for a small amount of experience", he had to start preparing for the "kill a target with enough experience to last him three years" path.
But at this very moment, a message from the Divine Kingdom appeared in front of Gu Nan.
Academic Heaven, which had been silent for a long time, finally couldn't help contacting Gu Nan once the war gradually escalated into a high-level exchange.
"It came at just the right time." Gu Nan’s lips curled into a faint smile as he read the details of the target given in the message.
This target was both a stranger and an acquaintance.
Demon Lord Alfred, the flame archmage from Hell. They never met each other before, yet both had heard of each other.
Alfred was likewise one of the key members of the Heaven-God Alliance. He joined the Alliance very early on, so his name had naturally been reported to Gu Nan long ago.
The fact that Academic Heaven made him the target was undoubtedly a further test for Gu Nan.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: Each With Their Own Schemes
chapters.content:
If Demon Lord Alfred was a god, his equivalent rank would probably be somewhere between Tiers 9 and 10, and he was also an existence that similarly possessed a Godhead.
In fact, Demon Lords had an inherent advantage over normal gods. They naturally owned large territories in Hell, and all the demons inside could be developed into their followers.
Compared to ordinary gods who had to work hard to find believers after lighting their divine fire, Demon Lords simply had it easy.
Of course, these types of Demon Lords were also Gu Nan's hunting targets. However, he would not target Demon Lords under normal circumstances.
The reason for this was simple: most Demon Lords were the type with a lot of enemies, so the locations of their hiding places were very closely guarded secrets, making it hard for even Gu Nan to easily find them.
However, he didn't mind accepting this time, as the most difficult part of the process had already been done by Academic Heaven on his behalf.
……
Inside Academic Heaven, Fang Chaoyun and his eldest disciple—Lin Huan—were also discussing Gu Nan's current mission.
"Master, do you think Gu Nan will accept this mission?" Lin Huan asked without much confidence.
This time, it was precisely after he happened to learn of Alfred's identity as a member of the Heaven-God Alliance that he purposely found this Demon Lord’s hiding place and then sent the mission to Gu Nan.
Of course, this was only because Alfred really was participating in the war. Otherwise, if they did something like this, their intentions would seem too blatant and wouldn’t be in line with Academic Heaven’s open and straightforward style.
But if someone questioned them about this, they could just shrug it off by saying they didn't know Alfred’s identity.
Fang Chaoyun put down the brush in his hand and answered after some thought, "It's hard to say. I actually hope he’ll refuse."
"Alfred is an important member of the Heaven-God Alliance. If Gu Nan really goes after him, the conflict between the two sides will escalate," Lin Huan said excitedly.
Fang Chaoyun stayed silent, so Lin Huan continued, "Even if Gu Nan acts secretly and hides this matter, we’ll still have a secret we can threaten him with!"
"Enough!" Fang Chaoyun rebuked with a heavy voice, "These tactics are already close to despicable. I’ll let it go this time, but you must not use them again in the future!"
Lin Huan was frightened and quickly bowed to admit his mistake. Fortunately, Fang Chaoyun didn’t intend to investigate further and quickly dismissed this disciple of his.
Only after leaving Fang Chaoyun's study did Lin Huan let out a sigh of relief, but he actually became more determined.
His master was a righteous man, which was why that villain Gu Nan could scheme him repeatedly. However, Lin Huan’s background wasn’t purely in Confucianism, so he didn’t have so many scruples!
Lin Huan's thoughts were very clear. He knew that Academic Heaven’s greatest enemy was the Heaven-God Alliance, especially Zi Luo Elder.
Gu Nan and the Heaven-God Alliance might not necessarily be united, so it may not be impossible to find a way to divide and conquer… It would be a delight to watch two dogs bite each other to death!
With such a thought, even Lin Huan’s footsteps seemed lighter, feeling some joy from being able to plan victory from a thousand miles away.
……
Gu Nan had already returned to his Divine Kingdom by now.
His two identities of "Ghost" and "Black Robe" mainly frequented the frontlines of the war between the two worlds, so it wasn't hard for him to return to the Myriad Heavens.
The mission to hunt Demon Lord Alfred had been handed to him, but it was impossible to communicate all the details in that message, so it was necessary for Gu Nan to return to the Divine Kingdom.
Besides, Gu Nan hadn't said that he would accept this mission…
"Tell Fang Chaoyun I'll consider this matter," Gu Nan expressionlessly said to the emissary from Academic Heaven.
When he entered the Evil God Temple, Red Tail was the first to come up to Gu Nan. "My Lord, will you accept the Demon Lord mission?"
Although it was a question, there wasn't much surprise in her tone, as if she was already certain of his answer.
After all, she had long known that Gu Nan intended to invade Imperial Glory Heaven, so it didn't matter if he fell out with the Heaven-God Alliance.
"Of course I’m going to accept." Gu Nan said with a smile, "But if the order of events is different, it’ll be a completely different matter…"
Red Tail stared blankly, not understanding what he meant.
"Prepare to start the Divine Kingdom War," Gu Nan calmly ordered, having no intention of elaborating further.
So Red Tail didn't ask anything else and left with a nod. The greatest strength of this old subordinate of Gu Nan’s is that she knows what to ask and what not to ask.
Gu Nan glanced at his panel. After two and a half months of frenzied hunting, his Evil Value was already close to 80,000, which was getting closer and closer to the Tier 10 requirement.
One of the more interesting features in the game was that the Evil Value requirement during the Second Round wasn’t a fixed value but was instead related to the player's earlier gaming history.
In other words, if a player wanted to advance to Tier 10, the system would sum up all their previous experiences, ultimately giving a specific Evil Value requirement.
Due to his constant pursuit of maximum efficiency, Gu Nan’s Evil Value requirement for Tier 10 this time was around 130,000, so he roughly still needed… one and a half Tier 10 gods.
"Since Hell comes with a large swath of faith, the Evil Value from Demon Lords like Alfred should be about the same as a Tier 10 god." It wasn't like Gu Nan had never killed a Demon Lord before, so he had some experience with this.
If their locations were known, Demon Lords were indeed easy targets; the difficulty was much lower than directly looking for Tier 10 kills.
Assuming that one Alfred would give 30,000 Evil Value at most, there was still a gap of about 20,000 that needed to be filled by two Tier 9 gods…
"Two Tier 9 gods, might as well get them in one fell swoop this time!"
……
Lin Huan finally received Gu Nan's reply, and the latter's answer was undoubtedly affirmative.
"Good, good." Lin Huan couldn't help secretly sneering. He had already set the stage. As long as Gu Nan participated in Alfred’s ambush, it would be hard for him to disassociate himself from this matter any longer.
And with such a weakness in hand, this information could always be used against Gu Nan. Perhaps in the future, at a critical time, this would be an extremely important chess piece!
Lin Huan didn't delay, immediately writing something down and sending it to the frontline command center.
This was an order to command four high-ranking Star Rulers to join forces to ambush a Demon Lord. Despite his own lack of strength, being able to command high-ranked Star Rulers like this gave Lin Huan the illusion of having power.
……
Zhang Xuyan of Lyrical Heaven, Ye Xing of Literature Heaven, and an old acquaintance of Gu Nan's, White Bones Realm's Daoist White Bones—these three were Gu Nan's teammates this time.
The first two were both from Academic Heaven, martial brothers in the truest sense of the word, while Daoist White Bones was a powerful Star Ruler invited by Academic Heaven at great cost to help deal with high-ranked gods.
Of course, now that the Great War between the two sides had developed to this extent, there was no longer anyone who could truly stay out of it. After all, they also had family and friends who were affected, and Daoist White Bones was no exception.
It could be said that Academic Heaven had used most of its trump cards this time in order to deal with the Demon Lord.
Putting aside these two Heaven Level Star Rulers, the next time Academic Heaven's powerhouses struck, it would probably be Fang Chaoyun himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: Traitor
chapters.content:
"Daoist Friend Gu Nan has arrived," Zhang Xuyan said with a faint smile when he saw Gu Nan's arrival.
Zhang Xuyan was a middle-aged man with a refined air, and even though his astral world was called "Lyrical", he called Gu Nan "Daoist Friend", which was a bit strange.
His junior martial brother, Ye Xing, had an aloof and detached demeanor. Let alone Gu Nan, he didn't even glance at Daoist White Bones and had been resting with his eyes closed.
When Daoist White Bones heard this, he glanced at Gu Nan with slight astonishment, obviously not expecting him to be able to participate in a hunt of this level.
Seeing that Zhang Xuyan had called out his identity, Gu Nan simply stopped hiding it and directly showed his true appearance.
However, he was already grumbling in his heart, ‘Academic Heaven's people really are troublesome. I wouldn’t have hidden my identity if you’d just told me earlier. Was there any need to specifically have Zhang Xuyan do this?’
After everyone greeted each other, Daoist White Bones spoke first, "The Demon Lord may change position at any time. Let's hurry up."
The remaining three naturally had no objections and immediately rushed towards the World of Gods.
It had to be said that in order to not give Gu Nan any chance to back out, Lin Huan had also put in substantial capital this time, mobilizing all the power in his hands.
The two Academic Heaven brothers were both Tier 9 Heaven Level Star Rulers, while the combat power of Daoist White Bones far exceeded Realm Level, and he certainly didn’t fear fighting Heaven Level opponents. With the addition of Gu Nan, this lineup was indeed more than enough for one Demon Lord.
……
The frontlines were still filled with nonstop battles, only it seemed more desperate and miserable compared to two months ago.
Nowadays, with the gods intervening less and less, all too many pious believers shed their last drop of blood as they died on the battlefield, unable to receive even a tiny blessing from the gods.
This was because even their gods might lose their lives as soon as they showed themselves.
Of course, this had nothing to do with Gu Nan and the others, who swept past at top speed, heading directly for the interior of the World of Gods.
Demon Lord Alfred was a powerful figure who never personally stepped onto the battlefield yet held an astonishing influence over the war.
The Myriad Heavens replenished Void Cutters by hunting gods to obtain a constant stream of combat power. This tactic of gaining more resources through war made the gods miserable.
But it wasn't like there weren't capable people among the gods. Alfred had come up with an idea to utilize the undead resurrection technique unique to the World of Gods to transform enemies on the battlefield into undead.
To do this, a huge number of necromancers was needed, and it was obviously too late to cultivate them among humans, so demons—who were naturally born with the darkness attribute—became the best substitute.
Allowing demons to master simple necromancy spells and then running to the battlefield to become undead conversion machines—this method was extremely efficient and had already been put into use.
"Almost half of the demon necromancers on the battlefield right now came directly from Alfred's territory, and most of the others were also recommended by him," Zhang Xuyan told the three people beside him.
"Now that the technique of undead conversion has matured, killing him won't help…" Zhang Xuyan sighed again. "But at least we can vent a little!"
Only Star Rulers fully committed to the war like him knew just how much trouble the undead conversion secret technique had caused them.
This amiable-looking middle-aged Confucian scholar seemed to be far from calm inside.
Gu Nan wasn't interested in the frontal battlefield, and his gaze fell on a place behind the group. "That's Fairhaven over there, right? Is it still the frontline command center?"
Zhang Xuyan nodded. "Right now as well."
Fairhaven was still the biggest frontline plane, and it was also the largest gathering place for the highest-ranked gods nowadays.
Gu Nan suggested with a smile that didn’t reach his eyes, "Do you guys want to stop there for a stroll once we kill Alfred?"
The three present were all high-ranking Star Rulers and immediately understood what he meant. All of them stared at Gu Nan like they’d seen a ghost.
Only after a long time did Zhang Xuyan force a smile onto his face. "Daoist Friend Gu must be joking. There are at least three Tier 9 and one Tier 10 god in Fairhaven… After we complete our mission, it's better to retreat as soon as possible."
Now that the war was escalating, Fairhaven was naturally heavily guarded as well, truly becoming the gates of hell.
Gu Nan, however, only nodded slightly without saying anything else, so the group didn’t know what exactly he was thinking.
……
On the 89th Floor of Hell, Alfred shook hands amicably with the Demon Lord of this floor as they signed a demon supply treaty.
Nowadays, he had become the spokesperson of the entire Hell, recommending demons from Hell to the frontlines and exchanging them for other resources from the gods.
For the Demon Lords, sending away some arrogant, disobedient demons in exchange for precious resources to develop their territories was definitely a great bargain that would normally be unimaginable.
In any case, those fellows would be executed if they weren’t sent away, and now that they were given to the gods, how they were managed was none of these Demon Lords' business anymore.
"300 kilograms of Parasitic Inferno Stones, it's a deal!" The Demon Lord of the 89th Floor, a strange-looking female demon, said to Alfred with a dainty smile.
Alfred replied with a light smile, "As long as the demons under your command reach the intended location, the resources won't be a problem. Ma’am, this is the gods’ trustworthy guarantee, not mine."
The female demon nodded in satisfaction and sent Alfred away. She knew the other party was bound to take a cut in this, but someone had to be the middleman, right?
Alfred was equally satisfied. With his silver tongue, he managed to keep the price very low this time, which meant…
Before his elation could truly end, a flash of warning violently appeared in his heart.
A high-ranked god’s ability to sense danger caused Alfred to instantly activate his laws, attempting to pull himself into the void to avoid any incoming attacks.
But what he didn’t anticipate was that what came immediately after was not an attack, but a method to isolate him from the world.
Two large characters—"suppress" and "seal"—appeared out of thin air, dragging Alfred into a strange space where several figures were already waiting for him.
"We must kill him quickly. Our isolation barrier won't last long in Hell," Zhang Xuyan wasn’t worried about being overheard by the enemy and spoke bluntly.
But there was no need for his reminder. The group had already made their move at the first opportunity.
Ye Xing raised the brush in his hand, but he didn’t bother to write anything. Instead, he directly used the brush like a sword and thrust forward.
Daoist White Bones’ law enveloped the Demon Lord, as if he was instantly surrounded by boundless white bones. Countless bone spikes stabbed him from all directions.
But Alfred wasn’t incompetent. He was incomparably decisive in this life-and-death crisis, actually allowing the white bones to freely stab his body while his raging demonic flames single-mindedly surged towards Ye Xing's pen.
He wanted to force open a path to survival at the cost of some injuries!
However, just as the demonic flames swept in, a shadow inexplicably appeared behind the Demon Lord, causing his entire being to fall into an icy abyss.
‘How can anyone completely hide their presence in a place like this?’
‘This is the power of shadows, could it be Sylvia… No! It's Gu Nan!’
The sword of shadows ran through Alfred's chest, and this Demon Lord turned around with a fierce expression, glaring coldly at Gu Nan.
"You… traitor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 491: Message
chapters.content:
The three of them joining forces to trap Alfred while Gu Nan dealt the fatal blow was a tactic that had been agreed upon in advance.
Knowing how Snow God Claudia died and Gu Nan's terrifying assassination ability, it wasn't surprising that Academic Heaven would formulate such a tactic.
Or rather, it was precisely because of Gu Nan's presence that they dared to send four powerful individuals deep into enemy territory in the World of Gods to hunt down this Demon Lord.
As long as they could quickly kill Alfred, then it wouldn't be hard for them to escape unscathed, unless a greater god stepped in.
Under Gu Nan's sword, all of the Demon Lord's laws rapidly melted away like snow in spring, and his life force weakened in the blink of an eye, with most of his vitality severed.
This grand Tier 9 or even higher powerhouse had difficulty withstanding even a single blow from Gu Nan even though the latter was only Tier 8 at the moment.
The Evil God physique itself was stronger than those at the same level, and it was an ability where all the skill points were put into "close combat".
Therefore, once Gu Nan got close to him, let alone Tier 9, even a genuine Tier 10 powerhouse would be seriously wounded by that strike.
"Don't give him a chance to escape!" Although Daoist White Bones was surprised, he was also a powerful figure who slaughtered his way out of a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood, allowing him to react extremely quickly and shout.
The white bones filling up the sky lit up violently, and white flames began to soar above the bone spikes, heading towards Alfred.
Zhang Xuyan and Ye Xing also both struck, knowing that they must not give their opponent a chance to catch his breath.
However, they underestimated the weight of the word "traitor". This Demon Lord didn't even run. His fist, burning with demonic flames, punched Gu Nan directly in the chest with great force.
‘Just how much do you hate me?’ Gu Nan, who’d always been the more reckless one in fights, saw someone who didn’t fear death for the first time in his life. For a split second, he couldn't dodge in time.
The demonic flames from Hell attacked his body, the high temperature searing both his body and mind, yet Gu Nan didn't even bat an eye.
He mercilessly returned the favor with a punch!
Alfred's entire face instantly caved in, as if a deep pit had been dug on his face, while the attacks from the other three finally arrived.
Daoist White Bones’ bone fire reached his body, instantly igniting the Demon Lord's soul, and the latter immediately released a mournful scream.
As for Zhang Xuyan and Ye Xing, the pair of martial brothers, they gave Alfred a fatal blow. A character and a brush utterly extinguished the Demon Lord’s life force.
Of course, the instant before Alfred's death, Gu Nan rushed in with a punch without hesitation—in the end, players had the most experience stealing kills.
"Let’s leave! The high-ranked gods can arrive at any moment!" Zhang Xuyan didn’t care about who landed the final blow and immediately shouted upon seeing the Demon Lord die.
Daoist White Bones, on the other hand, glanced at Gu Nan next to him, who was still burning with a blazing demonic flame that had no sign of going out.
He was likewise not slow, having already started flying outside the plane, only he also asked Gu Nan in passing, "Are you okay?"
"I'm fine." Gu Nan laughed, not caring at all that he was about to become a Super Saiyan. "But you all… might not get to leave so easily."
Daoist White Bones was slightly taken aback for a second, then immediately looked back. Sure enough, he saw a divine light already flickering from Fairhaven’s direction.
Zhang Xuyan couldn't help gritting his teeth. He didn't expect the gods to react so quickly, as if they were expecting this, so he had no choice but to shout, "Let’s split up!"
Everyone was a high-ranking Star Ruler. They might still have a chance to escape if they split up, but if they gathered together, they were bound to be taken out all at once.
Ye Xing still didn't say a word, but he clearly heeded his senior martial brother’s instructions and wordlessly fled in a different direction.
But no one expected Gu Nan to suddenly turn around and charge at Fairhaven with a righteous declaration at this very moment.
"You guys go!" Gu Nan shouted at the three of them, "I’ve been burned with demonic flames and don't have much hope of escape, so let me block the pursuers!"
He had already rushed towards Fairhaven as soon as his words fell, having no intention of discussing this with his three teammates at all.
This made even Zhang Xuyan and Ye Xing pause. ‘This is Gu Nan? The same Gu Nan Senior Martial Brother Fang described as despicable and unscrupulous?’
They put themselves in his shoes. Their chances of survival were only slightly lower right now; it wasn’t like this was certain death. If they were in Gu Nan’s shoes, they certainly wouldn’t have made such a choice.
‘Hey! The situation hasn't reached that point yet, right?’
‘Why do this?’
However, no matter the three’s thoughts, it was already too late to stop Gu Nan, so they could only try their best to escape and not waste the opportunity Gu Nan had worked so hard to create.
Four beams of light left in four different directions. Thus, Gu Nan was the only one who came to Fairhaven to face a group of high-ranked gods alone.
There was an error in Zhang Xuyan's intelligence. In addition to a Tier 10 god here, there were not three Tier 9 gods, but… four.
Speaking of which, Gu Nan actually met this Tier 10 powerhouse before; the two could be said to be acquainted.
This powerful figure from the Dark Faction, Skeletal Sage Stevenson, had once assisted Daoist Lingyang in killing the God of Tenebrosity Lewis, and it was precisely during that encounter that he and Gu Nan met.
"It's you?" Stevenson saw Gu Nan's face, then saw the burning demonic flames on his body and understood what happened here.
"It's me," Gu Nan let the demonic flames on him burn freely and responded with a faint smile. He didn't mind chatting a little so that his three teammates could fuck off farther.
Behind the Skeletal Sage were four other Tier 9 gods, all gazing at Gu Nan with indifference, as if they were looking at a corpse.
The laws naturally resisting the demonic flames already exposed Gu Nan's true rank—no matter how one looked at it, it was impossible for a mere Tier 8 who was surrounded by such a powerful lineup to escape.
Stevenson sighed softly. "We’re also considered acquaintances… You really killed Alfred?"
Few people knew that because of his acquaintance with Daoist Lingyang, the Skeletal Sage knew some inside information on the Heaven-God Alliance, so he was naturally aware of Gu Nan's relationship with Demon Lord Alfred.
That was why it was even harder for him to comprehend why Gu Nan would kill Alfred.
"It's me," Gu Nan nodded and repeated those two words once again before grinning. "Not only was it me who killed him, but I was also the one who sent you guys the message."
These words caused the gods to be taken aback.
The reason they were able to discover the anomaly so quickly and realize Alfred was being attacked was precisely because someone secretly sent them a message informing them of the Demon Lord’s assassination.
It’s just that the informant seemed to have deliberately delayed the message. By the time they verified the message content, the Demon Lord had already fallen, and they only arrived in time to pursue his murderers.
This matter should only be known to a few higher-ups like them, but the other party was able to hit the nail on the head… Was he really the one who sent that message?
"Did they coerce you into this?" The Skeletal Sage frowned. After thinking about it, he could only come up with this reason.
However, Gu Nan merely shook his head, and in the next instant, his figure suddenly disappeared, reappearing behind a Tier 9 god.

chapters.title: Chapter 492: What Does He Want?
chapters.content:
Gu Nan actually dared to attack first!
Facing one Tier 10 and four Tier 9 enemies, Gu Nan struck without the slightest hesitation, and with an absolutely fatal blow as soon as he attacked.
Since his advancement to Tier 8, this was probably the first time Gu Nan had gone all out.
Even back when he killed Shi Yeyan, it was still a sneak attack from the shadows, which allowed him to kill the Tier 9 Star Ruler with ease.
But it was different this time. Even while facing an unimaginably powerful enemy, he planned to forcefully kill at least two Tier 9 gods!
That was why Gu Nan struck with a lightning-fast blow, the law of shadows erupting in full force to envelop one of his enemies, followed by a barrage of furious close-quarters blows.
When had that god ever seen such a battle before? They tried to counter Gu Nan's punches and kicks with their own laws but never expected those laws to be smashed apart without a hint of delay.
Even Fang Chaoyun's characters could be blasted to pieces by Gu Nan; it really wasn't that hard to shatter laws with his physical body.
After that god took two punches, cracks instantly appeared in his divine body. By the time the god made to turn around and put some distance between them, the law of shadows surrounding the god finally had an effect.
Purely in terms of laws, it was unrealistic—even for Gu Nan—to resist Tier 9 laws with his Tier 8 laws, especially since he was still under attack from outside.
That was why his shadows shattered almost instantly, but Gu Nan's goal had been achieved.
He used laws to stall his opponent for an instant, and that instant was enough for him to deal a fatal blow!
A heavy punch slammed into the enemy's heart, shattering the heart inside his divine body. And at the same time, attacks from the rest of the enemies landed on Gu Nan.
A bone spear coalesced in front of the Skeletal Sage and pierced Gu Nan's abdomen, leaving a huge bleeding wound on him.
However, Gu Nan ignored these attacks, not even paying attention to the injuries on his body, and simply continued hunting down the person in front of him.
One punch, then another!
Gu Nan's fists rained down, throwing dozens of punches in the blink of an eye and actually beating a Tier 9 god to death.
His body, however, was run through by a bone spear and hit by the remaining three’s attacks, so it was already riddled with holes.
The demonic flames were still burning, even spontaneously drilling into Gu Nan's body through the open wounds and setting his internal organs aflame as well.
Gu Nan had managed to kill a Tier 9 god at the cost of being heavily injured and dying himself. If he were a normal person, he wouldn’t even have the strength to move at this moment.
However, Gu Nan's eyes remained cold as he slowly turned back to look at the still-surviving Skeletal Sage and the other Tier 9 gods, his gaze stony.
For some reason, even though they clearly had the advantage, the several gods still felt like they were targeted by a hunter.
Stevenson said in a heavy voice, "Everyone, scatter. Don't give him the chance to get close… All of his strength is focused on close-quarters combat."
Having personally seen Gu Nan strike, the Skeletal Sage finally understood their enemy’s characteristics.
The gods reacted extremely quickly. Some directly disappeared into a pocket dimension while others added a layer of protective laws to ensure their own safety.
Only Stevenson himself remained in front of Gu Nan—as a Tier 10 god, this wasn’t enough to intimidate him.
Another bone spear shot out, and this time Gu Nan didn't remain in place. His body instantly transformed into shadows that split into three, simultaneously heading towards the three gods.
The three Tier 9 gods learned their lesson this time, relying on their spatial barriers to disappear again without waiting for Gu Nan to get close. Instead, Gu Nan was hit by two more bone spears as he entered and exited space.
Gu Nan only smiled coldly at this, and without sparing these people another glance, he lunged towards Fairhaven.
This was the frontline command center for the World of Gods!
"No good!" One of the Tier 9 gods couldn't help showing himself to stop Gu Nan. In all likelihood, someone important had been left behind in Fairhaven, so the gods couldn’t just sit back and watch Gu Nan run amok there.
Reality proved that only the winner in a head-on battle could have the final say.
The instant that person appeared, Gu Nan suddenly switched his target, once again displaying his outrageous speed.
And so a scene not dissimilar to the previous one reappeared—Gu Nan caught a god and hammered him with attacks while allowing the remaining enemies’ strikes to freely hit him.
He looked like he should have died a long time ago, but he was still able to make frenzied attacks, perfectly aware of the key to group fights—it doesn’t matter how many enemies there are; just grab someone and beat that person to death.
But that god was also prepared, mobilizing the full power of his law in an attempt to force Gu Nan away while he himself traveled to Fairhaven.
But Gu Nan intended to tank even the Skeletal Sage's attacks, so why would he care about attacks from a Tier 9 god?
A few short minutes later, another god had died at Gu Nan’s hands at the cost of having most of his body destroyed. Of his four limbs, only one arm could still move.
Stevenson's expression was frigid, but his heart was already speechless.
He had never seen an opponent fight like this before. Gu Nan was practically using his own life to kill enemies… Why would he go this far?
And after Gu Nan almost lost his life to kill two Tier 9 gods, he finally revealed a satisfied smile as his tattered body crashed down towards Fairhaven.
The three people led by the Skeletal Sage, however, only ever dared to strike across several layers of space, not daring to get close enough to capture him at all.
It was only until Gu Nan completely fell that Stevenson ordered darkly, "All gods, withdraw from Fairhaven and conduct a full search for Gu Nan's whereabouts… I want to see his corpse!"
……
In the current Myriad Heavens, the war between the two worlds was undoubtedly the most important matter, but any news related to it would become a hot topic.
And just when the war was burning up, an earth-shattering piece of information spread throughout the entire Myriad Heavens in the blink of an eye.
Academic Heaven had sent out a team consisting of four high-ranked Star Rulers—an elite assassination squad in the truest sense—to successfully kill Demon Lord Alfred!
And who was this Demon Lord?
Thanks to Academic Heaven’s propaganda, bringing demon necromancers onto the battlefield became Alfred's foremost feat, and killing him undoubtedly boosted the morale of the Myriad Heavens!
As the details of the entire assassination operation were revealed to the world bit by bit, the existence of a single person instantly attracted all the attention.
Gu Nan? Why did Gu Nan appear here?
To think he would actually participate in this Great War, even decisively staying behind to give everyone else a chance to escape…
This didn’t make sense!
Not only did this not match people's usual impression of Gu Nan, it was even more inconsistent with Gu Nan's own position.
How could he—a core member of the Heaven-God Alliance and a fellow who’d always been selfish and unscrupulous—do such a thing?
Academic Heaven did not offer any explanation for this, so a plausible-sounding rumor began to make a clamor.
Academic Heaven must have something they were using against Gu Nan—perhaps even pertaining to his very life—which forced Gu Nan to secretly change sides.
Gu Nan's eventual decision to stay behind to help his teammates escape could also be explained by this.
Almost everyone believed this explanation. The only thing still up for debate was what exactly Academic Heaven was holding over Gu Nan’s head, as well as whether or not he was already dead.
Even Fang Chaoyun half-believed the rumors and called Lin Huan in front of him.
"Are you threatening Gu Nan with some kind of secret?"
Lin Huan couldn't help smiling bitterly. "How could your disciple have this ability…? If anything, it’s that he secretly helped us, but there was still no need for him to personally stay behind!"
Fang Chaoyun knocked on the table suspiciously. "Then what exactly is he trying to do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 493: Speculations
chapters.content:
What exactly was Gu Nan trying to do? It was unclear even to the top echelons of Academic Heaven—who actually knew the inside story—let alone the outside world.
To the outside world, it was clearly more interesting to speculate on how Academic Heaven had managed to coerce Gu Nan, making him end up in such a wretched situation.
That’s right. The final outcome of this fiasco was Gu Nan fighting to the death to stall the higher-ranked gods, killing two Tier 9 gods by himself and subsequently suffering heavy injuries of his own. No one knew whether he was alive or dead.
Although Gu Nan's astral world remained unchanged, the gods' search in Fairhaven continued, proving that Gu Nan hadn’t been found yet.
Some believed Gu Nan was already dead and that his astral world was only maintaining the status quo for the time being.
They believed that Gu Nan, an exceptional genius who’d risen to Realm Level in less than a hundred years, was doomed to repeat the fate of many geniuses in history, who would quickly fall after a short-lived glory.
There were also those who believed that Gu Nan wasn’t truly dead. Rather, he would be freed from Academic Heaven’s control after this incident.
At the same time, he would take advantage of the situation to withdraw from this Great War and also withdraw from the conflict between the Heaven-God Alliance and Academic Heaven, going into seclusion to single-mindedly focus on his cultivation.
Perhaps it would take hundreds or even thousands of years, but in any case, the next time Gu Nan reappeared in public, his cultivation would have reached a completely new height.
There were all kinds of contradicting speculations about Gu Nan, and no consensus could be reached.
The Heaven-God Alliance was equally puzzled, and both the core and normal members wanted to know what had happened to Gu Nan that forced him to attack Alfred.
Zhuangxuan immediately traveled to Extreme Sword Heaven.
As much as he didn't want to disturb Xue Ren during secluded cultivation, the matter this time was already too big for him to resolve alone, so he had to ask Xue Ren for help.
However, Zhuangxuan met someone unexpected when he reached Extreme Sword Heaven.
"You've come." The white-haired old man with a face full of wrinkles was sitting on the old-fashioned chair, staring at Zhuangxuan with a smile.
Only one person could both foresee Zhuangxuan’s arrival and enter and leave Extreme Sword Heaven at will—Zi Luo Elder, the fourteenth Unified Dao cultivator of the Myriad Heavens.
Zhuangxuan froze, then hurriedly saluted. "Sir."
"Xue Ren has reached a critical stage; it’s inconvenient for him to come out for the time being," Zi Luo Elder explained softly, then grew serious. "I already know about Gu Nan's matter."
Zhuangxuan added, "After the incident, I used all types of methods to investigate, but I didn't find any contact between Gu Nan and Academic Heaven before the Great War."
"You won’t find anything." Zi Luo Elder shook his head a little. "If they really are using a weakness of Gu Nan’s to coerce him, then you definitely won’t be able to find the person who went out to meet him."
Realization flashed through Zhuangxuan's eyes. "Are you saying… that one paid him a visit?"
Right now, the Heaven-God Alliance’s forces were spread across the whole Myriad Heavens. If someone from Academic Heaven visited Gu Nan without a trace, it could only have been done by Song Fei himself.
Zi Luo Elder nodded. "And it must have been before the war. Once the Great War starts, it's unlikely that Song Fei will have the energy to focus on this anymore."
Don’t be fooled into thinking that the current Great War consisted entirely of battles among mortals that had nothing to do with the Unified Dao figures.
In reality, existences at this level on both sides were bound to be confronting each other in a corner somewhere. No matter which side revealed a weakness first, these Unified Dao powerhouses definitely didn't mind striking.
As long as they were given the slightest bit of time to spare, it would be a calamity for the Star Rulers and gods below them.
Zhuangxuan frowned in contemplation, gradually straightening out the entire sequence of events. "That is to say, Song Fei discovered a certain secret of Senior Gu Nan’s before the war started and coerced him into aiding Academic Heaven during the war."
"It's just that previously, Senior Gu Nan always hid his identity, all the way until Academic Heaven thought his value had been exhausted, so they used him one last time by ordering him to kill Alfred."
A piece of information suddenly flashed through Zhuangxuan's mind as realization dawned on him, "No wonder we received news from the frontlines earlier that a ‘Ghost' specializing in hunting gods without taking their Godheads had appeared. In all likelihood, Senior Gu Nan must be Ghost."
This series of analyses was consistent with each other, and with all the information known at present, this was indeed the closest answer to the truth.
Some regret surfaced on Zi Luo Elder's face as he said, "Gu Nan, what a pity. If there’s any secret Academic Heaven can use against Gu Nan… His origin has always been a mystery, so it’s most likely related to that."
Many people knew Gu Nan was incomparably familiar with the World of Gods and was most likely the reincarnation of a certain powerhouse from that side, but his exact identity had always remained a mystery.
Song Fei personally traveled to the World of Gods just recently, so it was indeed very likely that he discovered a secret relating to Gu Nan's origins in the process.
Zhuangxuan nodded with a heavy expression. "I will investigate in this direction."
……
Zi Luo Elder and Zhuangxuan's speculations were off the mark, while other people’s conjectures were even more off the mark.
Lu Wen, for one, knew very little about Gu Nan’s matter, and since he wasn't one of the parties involved, he didn't even want to investigate it; his attention was focused on another matter.
On his desk, report after report clearly showed that there was a group of people donning the guise of "Ghost", looking to kill gods who were by themselves on the battlefield.
Unlike Gu Nan, who only killed gods but didn't take their Godheads, not only did they do the same thing, but they also sent a team to the targeted god's Divine Kingdom to collect faith.
Yes, the reason this group hunted gods was to collect the power of faith in the gods’ Divine Kingdoms.
Once a god died, the faith of the believers inside the Divine Kingdom would undoubtedly collapse instantly, so the power of faith drifting aimlessly became this group’s best prey.
While others might not know what this group of people were doing, Lu Wen knew very well.
"The power of faith and the power of dreams are both branches of mental power and are two sides of the same coin from the beginning…" Lu Wen put the dossier down and said softly, "Dream Immortal, you really fooled everyone."
……
Just when the entire Myriad Heavens was discussing Gu Nan, the fellow rumored to be dead was leisurely hiding in a small plane, basking in the rare sunlight here.
Gu Nan also didn't know what world this was, only that there were six hours of sunlight in a day here.
Of course, that wasn’t the important part. The important part was that he’d come here to heal.
After tanking sustained attacks from a Tier 10 god plus multiple Tier 9 gods, even Gu Nan's Evil God physique was overtaxed and needed constant rest and recuperation.
Only now, over half a month later, did he fully recover.
It was fortunate that the special characteristic of the law of shadows allowed him to escape from Fairhaven without truly being trapped to death in the World of Gods.
And by taking advantage of this large amount of Evil Value credited to him, Gu Nan's Evil Value finally exceeded 130,000, reaching the standard for Tier 10!
The current Gu Nan would never dare show himself in front of greater gods, or else his identity as an Evil God would be seen through instantly. The most important thing he needed to do right now was naturally to reach Tier 10 as soon as possible.
And all Gu Nan was currently missing for Tier 10 was just 1.5 times the points given by Daoist Sect Realm.
"Those people should have had plenty of time to speculate… So then, attack," a small smile appeared as he transmitted a message to his Divine Kingdom.
The last Divine Kingdom War had finally broken out.
Target: Imperial Glory Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: Entering Tier 9 First
chapters.content:
No one expected that after merely half a month of hiding, "hot topic” Gu Nan would reappear with another big move.
He was attacking Imperial Glory Heaven!
As if they were prepared long in advance, the army descended upon Imperial Glory Heaven in an incomparably coordinated manner and immediately started the massacre.
However, people didn’t immediately notice this invasion, as Gu Nan's army didn’t descend openly, but rather infiltrated in secret.
It turned out that the recent instability inside Imperial Glory Heaven where numerous outstanding heroes rose up simultaneously was all backed by Gu Nan's forces. His army had long since infiltrated the ranks of Imperial Glory Heaven.
Only when the Divine Kingdom War broke out did Gu Nan’s army sneak in under the guise of helping the various forces.
By the time Immortal Empress Taisheng discovered all this, the massacre was already mostly complete, and the entire Imperial Glory Heaven was inundated with the misery of living beings, with nine out of ten houses empty.
"Why?" In her palace, Immortal Empress Taisheng glared coldly at Gu Nan, who was standing calmly.
Ever since she realized something was amiss, Gu Nan had already shown himself, obviously prepared for it.
Gu Nan gave a small sigh with a shake of his head. "I was forced."
……
Gu Nan's attack on Imperial Glory Heaven was already a major event that the Myriad Heavens paid great attention to, so this revelation immediately set off waves in the Myriad Heavens.
"Academic Heaven really has extraordinary methods. First, they used Gu Nan as cannon fodder and sent him to his death, and then, when he didn’t die from that, they forced him to attack Imperial Glory Heaven instead. They’re practically forcing him to fall out with the Heaven-God Alliance!"
"That old man Fang Chaoyun said he wanted to join the Heaven-God Alliance earlier, yet he then turned around and used such underhanded tactics. He really is… Tsk tsk!"
"Old Fang really is petty. To think his personal grudge with Gu Nan caused such a ruckus."
“……”
Discussions arose in all directions. While debating exactly what Academic Heaven had over Gu Nan, people also included their disdain for Fang Chaoyun this time.
Of course, Academic Heaven immediately received news of this as well.
"He was forced! Ha, yeah right!" Fang Chaoyun almost snapped his brush in half, the rage in his heart unable to be quelled.
How could he not know Gu Nan's goal by now? This was clearly an attempt to use Academic Heaven as a scapegoat!
If the many previous events didn’t occur, no one would try to decipher Gu Nan's words in depth. Worse, they might even suspect Gu Nan’s own intentions.
However, in the context of the Demon Lord incident and the many speculations that took place afterwards, Gu Nan then threw out such a sentence…
Even without naming anyone, the spearhead was undoubtedly pointing directly at Academic Heaven, especially Fang Chaoyun!
With the earlier preconceived impression still fresh in their minds, no one doubted the truth of Gu Nan's words anymore, because Gu Nan's attitude matched their speculations perfectly.
"Master, this must be the Heaven-God Alliance’s scheme!" Lin Huan anxiously rushed into Fang Chaoyun's study. "The most urgent matter is to stop Gu Nan from continuing his actions and to show our attitude!"
Lin Huan felt like he finally understood everything now. This was all a play performed by the Heaven-God Alliance and Gu Nan as a counterattack to his master’s earlier membership application.
In this play, Gu Nan was merely a pawn acting out a scripted role. The mastermind behind the Heaven-God Alliance controlling everything was the truly terrifying person!
"Why should we stop him?" Fang Chaoyun snorted coldly. "The innocent party has no guilty conscience! We haven't done anything like this. When your Grand Master returns, the truth will naturally come out."
Lin Huan froze, not expecting this old man to be stubborn at a time like this. "Master…”
"You need not say anything else." Fang Chaoyun waved his hand. "Besides, do you think our clarification will make any difference? Our current plan is to keep calm and maintain our rationality."
……
Academic Heaven adopted the strategy of "keeping calm", giving no response to the entire "Gu Nan" incident, resolutely maintaining a cold and detached approach.
This near-acquiescent attitude made the ridicule from all sides even louder, but that was all.
After all, they couldn't actually do anything against Academic Heaven. Instead, the Great War still continued in an orderly fashion.
The great war on Gu Nan's side was also underway.
The divine servant army split into multiple units and entered Imperial Glory Heaven in advance in order to immediately inflict a large number of casualties, earning points for Gu Nan while simultaneously weakening Immortal Empress Taisheng’s power.
The laws of Imperial Glory Heaven were special, and the strengthening its Star Ruler could receive was mainly manifested in the form of dragon Qi.
Therefore, when the Immortal Empire continuously lost ground under the divine servant army’s attack, Immortal Empress Taisheng’s power also weakened.
Originally, with her level, she should’ve been able to easily suppress Gu Nan in her own astral world, but now her continuously weakening power was actually allowing Gu Nan to stabilize the situation for the time being.
"You won't be able to stall for long!" Immortal Empress Taisheng coldly glared at Gu Nan and said darkly.
She didn't care what reasons Gu Nan had. From the moment the latter invaded Imperial Glory Heaven, they became mortal enemies.
Every move of hers contained a terrifying pressure. The mighty forces of heaven and earth all bore down on Gu Nan, as if he was fighting the entire world.
In the end, Immortal Empress Taisheng was still an experienced powerhouse. Though she was weaker than Fang Chaoyun, it wasn’t by far.
She even ignored the enemy armies inside her astral world, aiming to crush Gu Nan in one fell swoop!
Even if her dragon Qi was dwindling, she was still confident she could crush Gu Nan quickly.
She was right. If there were no other variables, Gu Nan definitely wouldn't be able to hold on for long.
However, Gu Nan was still struggling to endure because the situation at this moment was already much better than he predicted.
Thanks to Academic Heaven’s "valuable assistance", at least the Heaven-God Alliance was still hesitating and hadn't collectively made a move to help Imperial Glory Heaven.
Thus, Gu Nan waited.
He already had enough Evil Value to advance to Tier 10, but he was still short on points, so he might be able to meet the standard after slaughtering most of Imperial Glory Heaven’s inhabitants.
But that didn't mean he had to hold out until then.
He could absolutely collect a wave of points and return to his Divine Kingdom to level up to Tier 9 first!
Imperial Empress Taisheng's suppression continued, but due to Gu Nan's prior arrangements, the invasion was far more efficient than expected.
While Gu Nan was enduring the spiritual pressure of heaven and earth, he was still keeping an eye on the number of points shown on the panel.
‘Still short 50,000… 30,000… 10,000… The last 5,000!’
‘Success!’
As soon as his points reached the Tier 9 mark, Gu Nan’s figure shrank as his entire body transformed into shadows that quickly disappeared without a trace.
"Ran away? How sharp!" Immortal Empress Taisheng sneered, but she didn't suspect much.
She originally thought Gu Nan had some special trump card that gave him the courage to invade, but now, it seemed like he merely took advantage of her astral world’s internal unrest.
Given the power difference between the two sides, if Gu Nan still didn’t leave, it wouldn't be long before he died under the omnipresent pressure.
Of course Immortal Empress Taisheng was aware of Gu Nan's terrifying recovery power, but any ability in this world could be countered, and Gu Nan was naturally no exception.
She aimed to crush him with the weight of heaven and earth, and when the pressure reached a certain critical point, Gu Nan's body would instantly collapse, which was undoubtedly a counter to his regeneration.
She didn't waste much time and immediately went down to the mortal world, personally cleaning up Gu Nan's army.
What puzzled her was that these armies didn't seem to have any intention of retreating. Instead, all of Gu Nan’s troops tried to slaughter everything in their way with no regard for their own lives, only seeking to inflict more kills.
But in a place she couldn’t see, Gu Nan had long since returned to his Divine Kingdom, opening the interface at the fastest speed in his life. He quickly selected one structure after another and built them outside the Evil God Temple.
"Hurry! Hurry! Hurry!" Gu Nan's mind operated quickly, refusing to waste a single second.
One should know that the Divine Kingdom War was still going on right now and that countless divine servants were dying at Immortal Empress Taisheng’s hands every second. Right now, every second was precious!
Under Gu Nan's frantic operations, all the structures were constructed at the fastest speed possible, and he then clicked on the advancement button without hesitation.
Tier 9!

chapters.title: Chapter 495: Imperial Glory Heaven Falls
chapters.content:
How powerful would a Tier 9 Gu Nan be?
To existences like gods or Star Rulers used to the original power system, Gu Nan was like an extra realm that popped out of nowhere.
There was originally an insurmountable chasm between those at Unified Dao and below, but Gu Nan was slowly closing that gap.
Immortal Empress Taisheng, who originally thought that Gu Nan had already withdrawn, felt an inexplicable sense of danger in her heart as she began to clean up the divine servant army and pacify the civil unrest in Imperial Glory Heaven.
Immortal Empress Taisheng was also someone who’d experienced layers of intrigue and power struggles to finally get to her current position, so she never lost her vigilance and immediately reacted.
Immortal Empress Taisheng abruptly dodged to the side, and the terrifying power that crushed heaven and earth reappeared. Only then did a shadow slowly appear in her original place.
"Gu Nan?" Immortal Empress Taisheng glanced over in surprise, shocked at Gu Nan's return and even more shocked at the power he just displayed. "You—"
Bang!
Gu Nan threw a fist, his speed reaching an unbelievable level. The punch headed straight for Immortal Empress Taisheng but hit the barrier in front of her with a muffled sound.
Fear lingered in Immortal Empress Taisheng’s heart, while cold sweat had already broken out on her forehead. She thanked the fact that they were in Imperial Glory Heaven and that she could solidify the power of heaven and earth with a single thought.
In terms of the influence of laws on the world, Immortal Empress Taisheng’s technique to solidify heaven and earth was definitely one of the best.
But Gu Nan just revealed a cold smile and wordlessly swung another punch.
Bang!
The terrifying force shook Immortal Empress Taisheng’s heart as the law barrier created from the solidified power of heaven and earth was struck. She could even feel faint tremors, as if the world itself was trembling from the punch.
"How can…"
Another punch landed, and Immortal Empress Taisheng felt her entire body shaking along with the world. This empress might not have experienced earthquakes before, but now she did.
But she had no time to think about that. She only wanted to know how Gu Nan's power suddenly grew so much.
A secret technique? A special magic treasure? A gift from a Unified Dao bigshot?
Countless possibilities instantly flashed through Immortal Empress Taisheng’s head, but none of them could explain the situation in front of her. It wasn’t until she tried to get away, her figure dodging upwards, that she realized.
Gu Nan staggered his steps, his entire body instantly transforming into shadows. He emerged above his opponent in the blink of an eye and smashed a vicious punch down on Immortal Empress Taisheng.
This action allowed Immortal Empress Taisheng to finally see Gu Nan's law.
"Heaven Level!" The empress blurted out, her face filled with horror.
‘A Star Ruler who just advanced to Realm Level not long ago is now advancing again a few short years later, stepping into Heaven Level in one fell swoop… Is such a thing even possible?’
This completely defied common sense!
Immortal Empress Taisheng stared at Gu Nan like he was a monster. This was no longer a matter of genius or talent—such a thing was simply impossible!
When did he have time to accumulate the resources needed for his astral world, and how did he recruit enough experts for his astral world? The comprehension of laws might be dependent on one’s talent, but how could all these things be achieved overnight?
The advancement of one’s astral world had to be done one step at a time; there was no such thing as ascending to heaven in one fell swoop.
But Gu Nan did it, which Immortal Empress Taisheng found utterly incomprehensible.
With her thoughts distracted for a split second, her control over the laws of heaven and earth seemed to slip slightly. The perceptive Gu Nan instantly grasped this moment of weakness and thrust out the sword of shadows.
Thunk!
The longsword pierced Immortal Empress Taisheng’s chest, and pain that she hadn't experienced in a long time made her come back to her senses.
After all, she was a figure who distinguished herself from hundreds of successors and ultimately took over a major astral world. Immortal Empress Taisheng’s immediate reaction was so decisive that even Gu Nan admired it.
Without any hesitation, she stood up as the laws of heaven and earth suddenly exploded. She actually detonated the power of her astral world.
The terrifying explosion directly sent Gu Nan flying. He immediately lost control over Immortal Empress Taisheng, which gave the latter the chance to escape.
After realizing defeat was imminent, Immortal Empress Taisheng even abandoned her own astral world, risking everything to create an escape route.
This kind of decisiveness and courage was rare even among men.
"Quite decisive."
Seeing that it would be hard to find further traces of Immortal Empress Taisheng, Gu Nan simply stopped pursuing her. The most urgent matter was harvesting points.
In this Divine Kingdom War, Gu Nan had given the order to "kill with all your power regardless of casualties", so even though the harvesting was extremely efficient, the losses were also quite heavy.
Under such orders, it was needless to say that the divine servants—which were created entirely by points—and even the apostles were constantly dying.
Over half of Gu Nan's player army had already died. If not for the fact that these people could be resurrected, Gu Nan's earlier move would’ve been tantamount to squandering money in vain.
Of course, Gu Nan wouldn’t bat an eye even if he did lose the entire player army.
After harvesting this wave of points, Gu Nan's goals had all been accomplished. He only needed to return to the Divine Kingdom to advance to Tier 10, and then he could start preparing for the Second Round.
At that time, he would undoubtedly be able to fly as high as the sky would allow, completely disregarding the Divine Kingdom—anyhow, everything needed to wait until after the Second Round.
Pre- and post-Second Round were two completely different worlds.
The entire First Round was centered around the Divine Kingdom gameplay, but once the Second Round was completed, players would go back to the gameplay that revolved around themselves.
Of course, there were also people who remained addicted to the Divine Kingdom playstyle for their entire lives and were unable to extricate themselves from their obsessive management, but Gu Nan was clearly not this kind of person.
Gu Nan simply stayed inside Imperial Glory Heaven, watching the divine servant army slaughter all inhabitants, then issued an order.
……
"Lord Shana, we really must thank you guys this time," inside the Imperial City, a handsome-looking youth sincerely thanked Shana.
This time, an alliance of eighteen vassal states joined hands for a crusade against the muddleheaded royal family in order to purge corruption. They agreed that whoever broke into the Imperial City first would gain the merit of protecting the country and take over the continent.
"General Zhang is too polite." Shana seemed like a native of the Myriad Heavens; outsiders couldn’t tell that she had grown up in the World of Gods at all.
