"Like hell their origins are unknown." Lin Ling sneered. "This is clearly Gu Nan's ploy. In terms of inter-plane warfare, ten of him will still be no match for your master. Of course he has to play these trivial tricks.”
He paused for a moment, then continued, "Senior Martial Brother is right to not be fooled. If he comes back at this time, then he’ll have fallen for the opponent's scheme!"
Only then did the scholars come to a sudden realization. Most of them didn’t understand military strategy, or else they wouldn’t have stayed in their hometown and would have gone to the battlefield long ago.
Lin Ling understood military strategy very well, but he had no in-depth understanding of both sides of the war and could only judge matters using conventional thinking.
……
Early the next morning, Lin Ling, escorted by a group of succubi, led a grandiose procession out of the gates of Graceful Academy.
In addition to the ten succubi he took as concubines, there were several more succubi this time. They were obviously the harem reserves.
"Lin Ling left." Zhuangxuan stood at the corner of the street, calmly watching Lin Ling's procession leave, and whispered, "Next, we can set up part of the formation directly inside the academy."
As long as Fang Chaoyun didn’t return, a situation where “the darkest place is directly under the lamp” would exist; it wouldn’t occur to anyone that there would be a problem in the academy.
Zhuangxuan slowly withdrew his gaze with a slight shake of his head. "It's a pity that the level of the succubi is too low. If they could actually influence Lin Ling, then we would have a greater chance of success."

chapters.title: Chapter 506: Discovered
chapters.content:
"It's not that simple." Gu Nan couldn't help laughing. "It’s precisely because their levels are too low that Lin Ling can rest assured when taking concubines, or else he would’ve interrogated them long ago."
Succubi were one of the most common demon races in the abyss. Common often meant average. Their individual strength was indeed weak. Not many could even reach Tier 3.
But succubi had quite the outstanding talent when it came to lovemaking.
Their physical recovery ability was superb, allowing them to have super long-lasting "combat power", and at the same time, their passionate nature made them the ideal lovers.
It was such a unique existence that plunged Graceful City into chaos.
Some men randomly picked up a succubus and took her home. After getting a taste, they insisted on taking the succubus as concubine without regard to opposition, resulting in family discord and chaos.
Some people took the opportunity to capture succubi on a large scale, leaving a few for themselves and selling the rest at high prices to others, making a fortune without any cost.
There were even people who—after getting tired of playing with their succubi—exchanged them with others or sold them directly…
Throughout all this, the succubi themselves never once resisted. Even if she was sold by her master for money, she could still quickly cater to a new master and was definitely the most qualified personal maid.
In fact, this was the norm in the abyss; the succubi had long gotten used to it.
But when this trend spread quickly, Graceful City—and even the entire astral world—was greatly affected.
Owning a succubus slave became a status symbol. If they didn't have one, they would find a way to disguise a human as one.
Some people even made a special trip to the frontlines to purchase succubi. It can only be said that as long as there’s a profit, there will always be someone doing that business.
However, these matters had nothing to do with Gu Nan and his group.
Gu Nan originally just wanted to use the succubus army to disrupt Graceful Academy, but it was surprisingly effective. Even Lin Ling was forced to leave, so they could set up the formation with less worry.
Gu Nan stayed in Graceful City for the next three days, entering Graceful Academy every night and personally setting up the formation.
After the first sub-formation was finished, Gu Nan would bring out the skull exuding strong bloodthirst from the Evil God Temple’s second floor and place it on the eye of the formation.
Thus, a mysterious connection began to appear between the sub-formation and the skull. Even if the skull was removed from the formation eye, this connection still wouldn’t be broken.
"Let's go, still 998 left," Gu Nan muttered with a helpless shrug.
999 sub-formations might sound very impressive on paper, but they were extremely cumbersome in practice.
Fortunately, while the first sub-formation was being laid out, preliminary work had already begun on the other sub-formations.
This allowed Gu Nan to just travel all over the plane to activate them instead of waiting for three days every time he reached a new spot.
And with Gu Nan and Zhuangxuan's realms, distance was completely negligible. They could arrive immediately by breaking through space.
But they also knew all too well that the next step was a battle against time.
It was impossible to set up thousands of formations without leaving any trace.
Once people inside Graceful Heaven noticed, the grand formation must be completed as soon as possible.
……
"Senior Martial Brother Hou! Another academy sent a report about seeing suspicious activities near their academy!" A disciple notified Hou Songshan.
"This is the sixth time in two days." Hou Songshan frowned heavily, almost squeezing together the wrinkles on his aged face. "Has that academy found any information on the other party?"
The disciple shook his head. "They haven't found anything yet… but Northwind Academy followed the traces and found an underground formation."
Northwind Academy wasn’t far from Graceful City. It was a veritable military science academy. Most of the disciples who left the academy went to the battlefield.
Therefore, the management of Northwind Academy was extremely strict, and it was least affected by the succubus crisis. At the same time, it was also the most vigilant.
Hou Songshan asked in surprise, "What formation?"
"They’ve yet to ascertain its effect." The disciple answered with a shake of his head. "But according to the explanation from there, the formation should’ve been installed not long ago. It wasn’t left behind from ancient times."
Hou Songshan didn’t know why, but he suddenly felt uneasy. He decisively ordered, "Ask Northwind to send me a formation diagram immediately!"
……
Long-distance communication naturally wasn’t hard for a large plane like Graceful Heaven. Hai Tong, the dean of Northwind Academy, quickly received the news.
"Formation diagram?" Hai Tong looked at the request with a little surprise. He felt that Elder Hou was making a fuss over nothing.
Someone had set up a grand formation under the academy—although this sounded scary, Hai Tong also had confidence in his own academy.
"Forget it, since Elder Hou requested it, just draw a formation diagram and pass it on," Hai Tong didn't think much of it and ordered.
"Yes, Dean."
Creating a formation diagram would take some time. Hai Tong also didn’t slack off during this time and started studying this grand formation.
This should be a kind of formation passed down from ancient times and improved upon by modern cultivators. The other party seemed to have intentionally hidden the function of the formation. Many of the changes were focused on concealing the formation’s effect.
Hai Tong was also someone with vast knowledge. He discovered something when he calmed down and slowly studied the formation diagram.
"This formation… seems to be both a core formation and a part of a larger formation?"
Hai Tong didn't dare neglect this matter. If his guess was correct, then the ones who set up this formation definitely weren’t some petty thieves. They probably had grand designs.
"Immediately ask someone from the main academy to come over. Additionally, inform Elder Hou that this… Where is everyone?! Where have they gone?!"
Hai Tong issued a series of orders but received no response. After a while, he couldn't help glancing behind him in annoyance, but what entered his sight was an unexpected person.
"Your insight isn’t bad." Gu Nan's faint laughter echoed underground.
The next moment, the head of the dean of Northwind Academy flew up and landed to the side.
After the grand formation was discovered, people from the Heaven-God Alliance were naturally monitoring this side. Seeing that Hai Tong was about to discover the final secret, they had no choice but to ask him to shut up forever.
Zhuangxuan's figure slowly walked out from the shadow behind Gu Nan and said heavily, "The formation is only about one-third complete. It really is impossible to completely hide all traces."
Gu Nan didn’t feel much and casually said, "Since it’s already been discovered, tell everyone to speed up at all costs. There’s no need to worry about hiding themselves."
Zhuangxuan couldn't help but frown upon hearing this. "It's not like we don't have other options…"
"There’s not enough time," Gu Nan cut in.
Zhuangxuan glanced at him in confusion. "Is it Senior’s astral world?"
There was no doubt about Fang Chaoyun's ability, but it was still a little too fast for him to have already captured Gu Nan's astral world.
There was also the secret help from Zhong Qinghe—the armaments alone were enough to delay Fang Chaoyun for a long time.
Gu Nan shook his head. "The last person I wanted to discover me has finally discovered me."
At the edge of the Myriad Heavens, a ray of holy light descended from a distant place.

chapters.title: Chapter 507: Holy Light
chapters.content:
"Austin?" Song Fei's voice traveled over from the void as his figure slowly emerged.
The holy light stopped, revealing Austin's figure. This Ruler of Light and Justice had a lanky figure and was nearly two meters tall. He wore a light gold robe made of holy light, while his appearance was typical of Westerners.
During the Great War, Song Fei left everything to Fang Chaoyun and sat quietly in the void precisely to monitor the movements of the thirteen greater gods on the opposing side.
But he had to focus all his energy here in order to do this, making it difficult to pay attention to what’s happening with the Great War.
"I didn't expect you to be the first to come." Song Fei looked a little curious.
Of course Song Fei knew this person, the one known as the only Tier 15 greater god in the world and the God of Light whose might suppressed the entire World of Gods.
Although he was curious as to why the other party was the first to show up, he wasn’t really afraid.
For top-level existences like them, level only meant a quantitative difference, but what determined victory or defeat was often a qualitative difference.
Austin's ability to prop up the Light Faction all by himself wasn’t reliant on his level, but on his simultaneous rule over the two apex laws of light and justice.
"I'm not here for the war." Austin shook his head. "Your side’s people captured my sister Sylvia."
Song Fei was stunned and subconsciously asked, "Who did this?"
"I don't know yet." Austin's eyes were slightly cold. "After entering the Myriad Heavens, I can find her within three days at most."
Song Fei fell silent. Letting Austin enter the Myriad Heavens at this time was risky. If he hit Academic Heaven with an attack in passing, there would be no need to continue this war.
But now that Austin came up with this reason, he obviously wouldn’t take no for an answer.
A ruler slowly appeared in front of Song Fei; he no longer planned to settle this with words.
But he didn’t expect Austin to react even faster. Just as the ruler emerged, holy light suddenly shot out and hit Song Fei's ruler.
Light! Endless light!
Real light was far from the world’s impression of it—only having a sacred and gentle side. Rather, it was also the most tyrannical existence in the world.
Overwhelm everything and assimilate everything. There was nothing within the holy light’s reach that could not be purified. This was the essence of the holy light.
Song Fei fought Austin for the first time, but in just one exchange, he saw the most powerful god’s domineering power. The holy light seemed to be everywhere, knocking him down and squeezing out a passage past him.
However, just when the holy light was about to slip past, a blue radiance began to flash above, and a horsetail whisk brushed out from the void, directly beating the holy light down.
"The Myriad Heavens isn’t a place you can break into at will." Yu Lian watched coldly as Austin appeared. With a flick of her right hand, the whisk floated back to rest on her left elbow.
"What an annoying light," a voice rang out behind Austin. The River Styx seemed to flow in reverse, and powers from the underworld poured down from the sky.
A young man in a black Daoist robe curled his lips slightly, having already appeared above Austin at some point.
He was one of the Thirteen Heavens, Qin Guanruo of Underworld Heaven.
As a god, Austin wanted to force his way into the Myriad Heavens. This was a major taboo. Generally, the Unified Dao existences of the Thirteen Heavens rarely showed themselves, yet two more arrived in the blink of an eye.
Qin Guanruo seemed like a specter that fell from the sky, but before he could fully materialize, a gleam of light suddenly lit up.
It seemed as if the boundless holy light spread out—like the earth holding up the sky—pushing back the underworld. Two completely different laws constantly collided and destroyed each other, creating shock waves capable of obliterating everything.
But everyone present was a Unified Dao Realm powerhouse, so they naturally weren’t affected by this aftershock.
However, the collision of two powers drowned out all the energy signatures in their vicinity. None of the three Unified Dao cultivators noticed that a ray of holy light stealthily separated from the rest and quickly shot into the Myriad Heavens.
By the time they noticed it, it was already too late to stop it.
Even Austin had no intention of confronting three Unified Dao powers head-on, but he achieved his goal.
"He sent a clone. This was his purpose from the beginning." Yu Lian's eyes narrowed slightly. She realized what Austin was doing as soon as she glanced at that ray of light.
Void Grotto Heaven had always regarded itself as the most authentic Daoist sect and was the leader of all sects in the Myriad Heavens, so it was necessary to step up at this time.
"Looks like he’s telling the truth," Qin Guanruo remarked from the side.
If it was just a clone, he wouldn’t be able to cause much damage. They could easily subdue him as soon as he showed himself, so there was nothing to worry about.
Austin definitely didn’t run over just to greet them and throw a clone into the Myriad Heavens. In all likelihood, his sister really was missing.
Yu Lian said, "Since he didn't come here for the war, let’s just let him go. But Song Fei, your disciple doesn't even care about the Great War now?"
Song Fei frowned and quickly glanced towards his own astral world. Sure enough, Fang Chaoyun was nowhere to be seen. A quick search revealed that… Comrade Fang was staying at Gu Nan's place.
"How irresponsible!" The corners of Song Fei’s lips twitched slightly, and he couldn't help cursing.
……
Moments later, Fang Chaoyun hurried to Academic Heaven and saw Song Fei standing there with a dark expression while Tang Jie—his junior martial brother—stood behind Song Fei, flashing him a helpless expression.
"M-Master…" Fang Chaoyun carefully walked up to Song Fei, like an elementary school student who had done something wrong.
"You still remembered to come back? Why don’t you wait until the Great War is over to return?" Song Fei didn't give Fang Chaoyun a chance to speak and scolded him on the spot.
In fact, Song Fei focused all his attention on keeping an eye on the thirteen greater gods, not daring to be distracted for a second for fear that a greater god would secretly attack the weaker cultivators below him.
Yet Comrade Fang squandered the precious time he worked so hard to buy to deal with Gu Nan instead. How could Song Fei not be furious?
Fang Chaoyun didn't dare argue and could only bow his head silently. Just when he wanted to explain the situation, his expression suddenly changed.
"Master, something terrible is happening!"
……
Sylvia didn't know how long she’d been imprisoned. All she could touch was darkness.
All actions were impossible and all laws were restricted. She could only try to use her divine body to collide against her prison to eliminate the law of shadows that bound her.
She didn't know how long it would take to escape with this method, but it was the only thing she could do.
Whenever Sylvia had to stop and rest after over-exhausting her divine body, she couldn’t help wondering: ‘Will Brother realize I’m missing? If he does, will he be able to find me?’
If given another chance, she would definitely visit the Holy Light Divine Kingdom every day to ensure that Austin would discover her disappearance as soon as she went missing.
‘Too bad… Huh?’
Sylvia suddenly sensed that something was emitting a faint light in front of her chest. It was a pendant, like a ray of holy light shining in the boundless darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 508: Blood Sacrifice
chapters.content:
A catastrophe had befallen Graceful Heaven.
Almost all its academies were attacked. Powerful enemies appeared out of nowhere and instantly captured all the major academies while even more powerful people descended from all sides, quickly invading Graceful Heaven and spreading out to set up large formations in various places.
The moment an enemy entered Graceful Academy, Lin Ling, who was invited by Fang Chaoyun to guard his astral world, rushed to the scene immediately.
He sent a horizontal slash with his sword, and the terrifying sword energy blocked all the enemies outside the academy. However, he had no intention of continuing and just stared at the sky gravely.
"Martial Uncle Lin, many villains have entered. Please take action!"
"Martial Uncle, if you need any help from us, please feel free to ask!"
"Martial Uncle Lin, they must be people sent by Gu Nan—"
"Everyone shut up!" Lin Ling looked irritated and berated all the scholars, causing them to fall silent, "He didn't just send people; he came in person."
……
As its Star Ruler, Fang Chaoyun was naturally the first to know about Graceful Heaven’s situation, and Song Fei could also see the situation at a glance. He couldn't help frowning. "Go back first and deal with the matter before coming back."
Fang Chaoyun didn't have time to say anything else and left immediately, rushing to his astral world as soon as possible.
He also never expected Gu Nan to be so bold as to dare to attack Graceful Heaven directly.
He was already one of the most powerful existences under Unified Dao. Even people like Xue Ren had to avoid fighting Fang Chaoyun inside his own astral world, so what gave Gu Nan the guts to do this?
Fang Chaoyun's rage surged, and he quickly threw himself into the spatial passage without too much thought.
……
Space travel also took time. Before Fang Chaoyun could arrive, the situation in Graceful Heaven took a turn for the worse.
Lin Ling knew Gu Nan's impressive, vicious reputation and didn’t dare to be careless. He just used his sword energy to protect the academy and didn’t consider going out at all.
However, to his surprise, Gu Nan had no intention of hiding himself. He showed up just like that and leisurely walked up to the academy.
"We barely managed to set up the various sub-formations, but they’re still incomplete. Senior will need to stay inside the main formation and link up the sub-formations scattered throughout this world," Zhuangxuan said from beside Gu Nan.
Gu Nan just nodded wordlessly. He took a step forward and was already inside Graceful Academy by the time his foot hit the ground.
"Gu Nan!" Lin Ling couldn't help shouting when she saw his figure, “You dare to act unbridled in Graceful Heaven? Senior Martial Brother Fang will return soon, and then—"
Lin Ling’s voice abruptly cut off before he could finish. That was because Gu Nan's figure had landed in front of him and casually twisted his head off.
With Gu Nan's current Tier 10 Evil God physique, the strength and speed of his physical body alone had already reached incredible levels.
He simply moved, yet to others, he appeared to be teleporting. Moreover, his strength could easily destroy Star Rulers, making it impossible for them to resist.
Hou Songshan stood next to Lin Ling, watching Gu Nan appear inexplicably while the martial uncle holding a sword next to him slowly fell down, unable to say a word.
The next moment, Gu Nan's figure suddenly disappeared again, heading underground to control the core formation. As for the Confucian scholars who came with Hou Songshan, they were naturally dealt with by Zhuangxuan's people.
The grand formation underneath Graceful Academy was the core formation controlling all the sub-formations and the location where power extracted from the blood sacrifice would gather.
Gu Nan placed the crimson skull down, and a faint red light appeared from both ends, then quickly flew into the skull.
All living creatures in Graceful City clearly felt a mysterious power descend, as if something was surging inside their bodies and trying to break out.
At the same time, the threads of life they couldn’t see were being continuously pulled out and gathered underground.
Some creatures with short lifespans already showed signs of rapid aging and reached the end of their lifespans in the blink of an eye.
This strange phenomenon quickly caused panic. Those who had the ability to leave Graceful Heaven already fled as if they were taking refuge; the remaining inhabitants were normal people with insufficient strength.
At this moment, Fang Chaoyun finally arrived.
He took in Graceful Heaven’s entire situation in a glance and almost fainted, his vision going dark.
‘What a bully!’
This Gu Nan didn't come here just to stir up trouble; he actually wanted to blood sacrifice the entire Graceful Heaven!
Fang Chaoyun was filled with remorse and shame. If he hadn't been so blinded by hatred and gone to the frontlines himself, he would never have given Gu Nan such a chance!
"Die!"
Along with a loud shout, a huge "die" character appeared out of thin air and landed in the sky above Graceful Academy.
Deep underground, Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes, glanced at the grand formation on the ground that had turned blood-red, and finally smiled.
"Song Fei and Austin are both here. Thank goodness I prepared in advance."
He stepped out of the formation, grabbed an orb out of thin air, and pressed it directly into the ground.
"Consider yourself lucky. Make room for Old Fang."
As Gu Nan finished speaking, the world originally sealed inside the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb quickly dissipated and returned to its original place, while a new vortex started forming around the orb.
The next second, Gu Nan's figure suddenly disappeared and reappeared in midair, facing the word "die" falling directly on his head.
Less than two years later, Gu Nan once again stood before Fang Chaoyun, yet the current him was incomparably stronger than before.
Fang Chaoyun held nothing back this time, imbuing a huge amount of his astral world’s power into one character. Even a Tier 10 powerhouse would need to avoid that attack.
It could be said that very few people could confront the current Fang Chaoyun head-on, but Gu Nan just happened to be one of them.
Without any unnecessary movement, Gu Nan raised his fist and punched up, hitting the "die" character square in the center.
A head-on confrontation!
Gu Nan's choice was unexpected, and the result was equally unexpected.
The punch collided with the character, and the terrifying impact almost blew the entire Graceful Academy away while Gu Nan's figure seemed to be unaffected and jumped outside the shockwave’’s range at extremely high speed.
In the end, Fang Chaoyun was someone who lived for tens of thousands of years. Even when he was extremely furious, he didn’t lose his basic vigilance.
He’d already realized something was wrong the instant Gu Nan suddenly appeared. He wrote six characters for "resist" in quick succession, which floated around him in an attempt to resist possible attacks.
Unfortunately, the one he had to face was a Tier 10 Gu Nan, a monstrous existence Yan Xiaoxiao described as unprecedented.
Another punch landed, and Fang Chaoyun felt as if a whole world was bearing down on him. The six "resist" characters couldn't even block for an instant and were destroyed as soon as they made contact!
Fang Chaoyun strengthened his defense with his astral world’s power, but it was completely destroyed. ‘Could it be that… a Unified Dao existence is secretly helping him?’
With his thoughts distracted for a split second, it was no longer possible for him to turn the tables on Gu Nan.
Gu Nan's movements flowed naturally. While breaking through Fang Chaoyun’s defense with one punch, another punch was already headed for the enemy’s abdomen.
Just as this lightning-fast punch was about to land, an aura suddenly rose in the air, and a ruler finally fell from the void, targeting Gu Nan's heart.
Gu Nan, however, didn’t retreat but instead advanced, increasing his speed even further. He was actually planning to tank an attack from a Unified Dao powerhouse!

chapters.title: Chapter 509: Public Enemy Of The Gods
chapters.content:
Unified Dao and below Unified Dao were two completely different realms.
In a sense, reaching Star Ruler Realm was taking a qualitative leap to become a higher lifeform, and Unified Dao was another one, with the magnitude of this leap being even greater.
There had never been a precedent for a normal Star Ruler challenging a Unified Dao cultivator. Even the most amazingly talented Star Rulers in history only managed to escape from a Unified Dao existence at most.
The last person to achieve such a feat was Li Ci, the ruler of one of the Thirteen Heavens, Myriad Laws Heaven.
Li Ci was famous for his "myriad laws", which referred to how he escaped from the hands of a Unified Dao powerhouse by virtue of his myriad cunning and frequently-changing laws back when he was still a normal Star Ruler.
But Gu Nan intended to do something even more terrifying right now—he wanted to tank an attack from a Unified Dao figure.
The ruler landed without any hindrance and hit Gu Nan square in the chest. The blow was like the collision of heaven and earth, its power having completely surpassed Gu Nan’s current level. Not even the Evil God physique could resist.
Gu Nan's chest instantly cracked open, as if a cannonball hit his chest and blasted a gaping hole in his body.
But not even such an injury could stop Gu Nan from landing his punch.
Fang Chaoyun must die!
In Fang Chaoyun's pupils, Gu Nan's figure grew bigger at an incredible speed, and then his fist landed.
Indescribable power surged forth, and Fang Chaoyun felt something inside his body explode as his consciousness immediately dissipated.
Gu Nan's fist was also like a cannonball, and it was a cannonball filled with ample gunpowder. With one punch, Fang Chaoyun's whole body exploded, and blood and flesh started to rain down from the air.
"The power of the astral world can only strengthen one’s laws. It’s still too weak." Gu Nan retracted his fist and shook his head slightly. The injury on his chest was recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if the ruler had never landed.
The next instant, Song Fei's figure appeared in front of him, staring at Gu Nan with an unprecedented grave expression.
"I should have killed you back then," he spoke his mind without hiding anything.
However, Song Fei didn’t take action again. He knew that since the previous blow didn’t kill Gu Nan, it was even more impossible now.
Setting aside the fact that Gu Nan would be able to escape, this scene just now was enough for Zi Luo Elder to protect Gu Nan. After this, Zi Luo Elder couldn’t possibly allow Song Fei to kill him.
A Star Ruler capable of withstanding a blow from a Unified Dao cultivator would almost certainly ascend to Unified Dao; the only question was how long it would take.
Gu Nan shrugged wordlessly. Song Fei appearing so early was indeed unexpected, but in his original plan, it would be impossible to hide Fang Chaoyun’s death from Song Fei anyways.
The blood sacrifice operation had entered the final stage, and Gu Nan already made plans to deal with this.
Song Fei stared at Gu Nan for a while, then suddenly asked, "Austin is here for you?"
"Hey now, don't pin all the blame on me," Gu Nan countered with a dissatisfied expression. He didn’t look like he was lying at all.
Song Fei nodded, then raised his ruler again, pointing it directly at Gu Nan.
Just because he wouldn't take action for now didn't mean he would simply let Gu Nan go. Even if he really couldn't kill the other party, what must be done still had to be done!
Gu Nan didn’t try to tank it this time and instantly disappeared, wandering through the boundary between shadow and reality.
But such a lowly application of laws was completely worthless in the eyes of a Unified Dao power. Song Fei turned his ruler and struck a spot in the void, directly exposing Gu Nan’s location.
The strike hit Gu Nan's neck this time, blasting apart almost half of his head, but this was still not a fatal injury.
The next second, boundless purple intent descended from the sky, dyeing the entire sky purple and crushing directly down on Song Fei.
Song Fei shook his head with a faint sigh, knowing there would be no opportunity to attack Gu Nan again. His figure disappeared without a trace before the purple color landed. Immediately after, Zi Luo Elder’s figure appeared next to Gu Nan.
"Austin said that you’re called an Evil God on that side?" Zi Luo Elder looked at Gu Nan with a smile.
Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow. "He already visited you?"
Zi Luo Elder nodded lightly. "He brought Sylvia along and met all the Unified Dao cultivators here. However, Song Fei didn't have time to meet him yet because of Fang Chaoyun's matter."
After a pause, the old man continued with a chuckle, "Song Fei most likely asked that question because someone else notified him just now."
Gu Nan nodded silently. When he looked back at his own Divine Kingdom, he saw that Sylvia was gone. After all, Austin was Austin. Let alone three days, it didn’t even take him three hours to find his target.
And quietly rescuing Sylvia without giving the Evil God Temple a blow in passing was likely because he didn't want to inadvertently alert Gu Nan. ‘He wants to join forces with the Unified Dao powers on this side to capture me?’
As if he knew what Gu Nan was thinking, Zi Luo Elder twirled his beard and added, "He asked for our cooperation to kill you on the grounds that you are a public enemy of the gods. Naturally, we… rejected him."
Gu Nan finally raised his head in confusion. He, who was accustomed to being hunted by the entire world as soon as his identity was exposed, had yet to process this turn of events.
This time, Zi Luo Elder didn’t say anything. Instead, another voice spoke up from behind them.
"What does the public enemy of the gods have to do with us? You are the public enemy of the gods—this just means that you are the most solid supporter of the Myriad Heavens." Yu Lian, the leader of all Daoist sects, slowly walked out and looked at Gu Nan. "I very much look forward to your ascension to Unified Dao.”
……
"Brother, Gu Nan is an Evil God, the same kind of Evil God who will definitely destroy the whole world. Why don't those fools understand?!"
Sylvia couldn’t help complaining while following Austin back to the World of Gods.
After Austin rescued her, he kept her with him, even taking her along to meet all the other Unified Dao cultivators. Thus, Sylvia also witnessed the Thirteen Heavens’ "I refuse" attitude.
They didn't believe Austin at all. None of the Thirteen Heavens were willing to help.
She clearly knew how dangerous Gu Nan was, yet she was unable to kill him when he was still weak, all thanks to these pig teammates. This made Sylvia furious, especially since she had been trapped for so long…
Austin came here using just a clone, so his real power was barely enough to be considered a Star Ruler. However, he could still control the law of light, which allowed him to rescue Sylvia.
If his main body had come here, he would’ve killed Gu Nan with a slap a long time ago, and there would’ve been no need to ask anyone for help.
"The Myriad Heavens doesn’t have any legends about Evil Gods," Austin indifferently gave the "standard answer", then shook his head. "If I’d known he was an Evil God earlier, then even if I had to force my way in, I would definitely take the opportunity to come over."
He recently realized that Sylvia was missing and just wanted to send a clone over to find his sister. Who knew that things would be so complicated?
"Then what should we do now?" Sylvia asked anxiously.
"Go back," The Ruler of Light and Justice spat out those words. "Then… slaughter our way over and kill him."

chapters.title: Chapter 510: Realm For One
chapters.content:
After Song Fei left, no one else interfered with Gu Nan's blood sacrifice.
However, just to guard against the unexpected, the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb that he placed in advance still worked, and the entire Graceful Heaven was sealed inside it. The majority of the blood sacrifice was completed inside the orb.
On the other hand, Duan Wenqi, who was originally imprisoned in the orb, was finally freed. Gu Nan let him out to make room for Graceful Heaven.
Together with his Savage Beasts World, they both returned to their original positions.
After Fang Chaoyun died and Gu Nan took away Graceful Heaven, he could finally wait for the blood sacrifice to finish and then take out the crimson skull.
In other words, Gu Nan just needed to stay at home and wait for the Second Round to finish now.
……
While Gu Nan was waiting for the Second Round, the Thirteen Heavens convened again. Zi Luo Elder was still not present, but the attitude of the thirteen bigshots was different from before.
The last Unified Dao meeting was to deal with the potential Great War between the two worlds, while this time, it was to prepare for the possible arrival of a new member.
That's right: Zi Luo Elder, who could only exist for ten years, wasn’t yet acknowledged by these people, but Gu Nan, who’d displayed astonishing power, was viewed as someone who would almost certainly ascend to Unified Dao.
"So you met him?" Zou Jiming was still the first to speak, staring at the Yu Lian who just appeared.
Regarding Gu Nan's rapid growth, Yu Lian, who’d personally met him, undoubtedly had the most say.
As for Song Fei… because he was screwed over before, Zou Jiming just wanted to completely ignore this person now.
Yu Lian didn't mind and nodded. "The ascension aura on his body is already very obvious, and the current him also possesses some characteristics of Unified Dao Realm."
The monstrous, distorted aura Gu Nan gave off couldn’t be hidden and was naturally noticed by Yu Lian.
Perhaps the gods could only see the monstrous aspect, but the Unified Dao existences from the Myriad Heavens had other opinions.
They held no prejudice against Evil Gods and only regarded them as a special path. There were countless Great Daos, all of which could reach Unified Dao Realm.
After Yu Lian finished speaking, the remaining twelve Unified Dao figures all had different expressions. Qin Guanruo walked up to Song Fei and shook his head.
He had a good personal relationship with Song Fei, but now he came to persuade Song Fei to stop. If his disciples died, he could still train more. But if he obstinately opposed Gu Nan to the end, both sides would suffer losses.
Song Fei waved his hand to indicate that he was fine, apparently able to accept this outcome.
The ascension of practically every Unified Dao cultivator was not smooth-sailing, and there would almost always be conflicts with other forces to some extent.
Back when Song Fei broke through, he stepped over Zi Luo Elder to ascend to his current position. Now, that karma was simply coming back to bite him.
"As for power." Yu Lian paused, then said, "In ancient times, our Daoist sect referred to Unified Dao cultivators as ‘Saints’. I think it’s time to use the current Gu Nan as a benchmark to establish a Half-Saint Realm."
"In that case, we’ll ignore Austin’s demand?" Milky Way Heaven’s Si Yun spoke up. He was one of the Unified Dao powers more hostile to gods.
His Milky Way Heaven’s cultivation path placed equal emphasis on metaphysics and technology and attached great importance to exploring the wisdom of mortals, so he scorned the gods’ use of faith.
"He called Gu Nan the public enemy of the gods. If we don't give Gu Nan to them, I'm afraid a real Great War will be inevitable," Song Fei interjected. He’d already heard Austin’s words by now.
Lu Wen said with a sneer, "If they want a fight, we’re happy to oblige. If we just give them whomever they want, then will we even have any face left?"
Regardless of whether they had a personal vendetta against Gu Nan, directly lowering their heads and surrendering Gu Nan to the gods would make the entire Myriad Heavens lose face.
Immediately afterwards, several more people spoke their opinions, which were all similar to Lu Wen’s. Regardless of whether Gu Nan could ascend or not, it was impossible for them to allow the gods to take him away just like that.
Finally, Yu Lian looked around. "Then it’s decided."
……
While the Unified Dao powerhouses were discussing Gu Nan, all the major forces in the Myriad Heavens were equally astonished by his impressive feat this time.
There has never been a normal Star Ruler capable of completely blasting apart an opponent like Fang Chaoyun—who even had the blessing of his astral world—with one punch.
Likewise, there has never been a normal Star Ruler who could tank two attacks from a Unified Dao powerhouse and still act like nothing happened afterwards.
The specific content of the Thirteen Heavens’ meeting naturally wasn’t announced to the public, but Yu Lian's evaluation of Gu Nan's strength somehow circulated.
Thus, the idea of adding a "Half-Saint" realm between the peak of Star Ruler Realm and Unified Dao Realm began to spread among the Myriad Heavens.
"With just one person’s power, he created an entirely new cultivation realm. This fellow really is impressive."
In Extreme Sword Heaven, Xue Ren commented with a faint smile as he sipped a cup of tea.
Although his words sounded envious, there was no emotion in his voice, only tranquility.
Immortal Empress Taisheng was still with him. Seeing Xue Ren’s reaction, she couldn't help asking, "You don't seem surprised?"
"Of course I'm not surprised." Xue Ren smiled, pointing to the wound on his chest. "After all, I was the first witness of this Half-Saint Realm."
Immortal Empress Taisheng remained silent for a long time. She seemed to feel that Xue Ren's words undermined himself a bit too much, so she couldn't help saying, "If he doesn’t successfully enter Unified Dao, being a Half-Saint is just a joke."
She looked up at Xue Ren again. "This injury will allow you to recuperate quietly and properly focus on breaking through. You should go into isolated cultivation as soon as possible. Don't waste time."
However, Xue Ren shook his head with a smile. "I’m already in isolated cultivation."
……
In Star Realm, the maiden Wu Gui rushed to Red and advised her to leave her astral world and hide herself for the time being.
In Void Grotto Heaven, the first thing Yu Lian did when she returned to her astral world was to send someone to warn Daoist Monarch Wu Tian to drop all thoughts of becoming Gu Nan’s enemy again.
Lu Wen, Duan Wenqi, the Heaven-God Alliance… Be they Gu Nan’s former enemies or friends, all of them completely changed their attitudes towards him after this incident.
Not even Unified Dao powerhouses could kill him. This meant that as long as Gu Nan didn't court death, even if he had to wait thousands or tens of thousands of years, he would still advance to Unified Dao sooner or later.
……
Austin immediately informed all the greater gods of the Evil God’s existence as soon as he returned to the World of Gods.
Unlike the Unified Dao cultivators next door, the greater gods attached the utmost importance to the existence of Evil Gods, almost to the point of affecting their survival as a species.
Because in the ancient legends of the World of Gods, the first greater god in the ancient era was the God of Creation. He created the world, but he also created Evil Gods.
And Evil Gods exist precisely to destroy the world. Even the God of Creation ultimately chose to sacrifice himself in order to seal the extremely powerful Evil God.
"The Evil God from ancient times actually reincarnated into the Myriad Heavens?" Eugene, the Ruler of War, asked with a frown.
While he was very bellicose, that didn’t mean he didn’t understand how much trouble the separation of the two worlds would cause for them.
"But the Evil God must die," Goddess of Darkness Daisy said decisively.
"Of course, but…" the Ruler of Nightmares chuckled. "Before that, I want to share some new discoveries with you. Perhaps we can use this to our advantage."
As the Ruler of Nightmares finished, a scene slowly appeared in front of everyone. It was the scene of a group of people sneaking into a certain Divine Kingdom to seize the power of faith.
"What do these people from the Myriad Heavens need the power of faith for?" Goddess of Nature Daphne frowned and asked.
"Divine power isn’t the only thing faith can transform into." The Ruler of Nightmares’ smile grew more and more mysterious. "It’s a power of the psyche first and foremost, so it can also become… the power of the dream realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 511: Dream Realm
chapters.content:
What was Gu Nan—the person once again at the center of the storm—doing right now?
He was leisurely sitting in his Divine Kingdom and observing the Graceful Heaven trapped inside the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb. It was continuously blood sacrificed into wisps of blood Qi that then flew into the crimson skull.
Gu Nan originally thought the blood sacrifice could be completed quickly, but it turned out that the hurriedly-completed Blood Sacrifice Formation was flawed after all.
Even though Fang Chaoyun was already dead, Graceful Heaven’s residents didn’t bow their heads and wait for death. Instead, they upheld the Confucian spirit of "unrelenting self-improvement" and devised all kinds of ways to survive the blood sacrifice.
When the sky cracked and the earth broke apart, they moved to a more stable area; when ferocious beasts ran rampant, they found ways to hunt the beasts and leave a safe area where normal people could live.
These lucky people who survived the blood sacrifice—or rather, it wasn’t their turn to be sacrificed yet—displayed amazing vitality.
Such scenes were very reminiscent of the human race in ancient times overcoming obstacles and seeking a path to survival among all the other races.
However… their efforts were futile.
It was impossible for Graceful Heaven, which was trapped inside the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb, to escape the fate of being completely blood sacrificed—because no one could save them.
And the string in Gu Nan's heart that was always drawn tight ever since he came to this world could finally relax a little.
As long as he completed the Second Round, there would be very few people in this world who could truly threaten his life.
Even if he was facing a powerhouse like Austin, Gu Nan was quite sure he could still escape with his life, and he might not even suffer too many injuries.
In fact, his current survival situation was much better than in the game.
A large number of players in the game chose to build their Divine Kingdoms in secret or even deep in the void because they didn’t want to be noticed by the greater gods.
This was because it was extremely difficult for players to hide their identity after the Second Round; being discovered was almost inevitable.
And once they became the gods’ public enemy, the player must face a situation where they would be hunted down by all gods. They would become street rats who had to hide themselves at all times.
It could be said that starting from the Second Round, the difficulty of the game would really start to show, suddenly becoming a stealth survival game.
Players must hide their whereabouts while hunting powerful gods and continuously spreading evil to finally break out of the predicament.
But the current Gu Nan was different. The existence of the Myriad Heavens gave him the perfect safe haven for survival. It would not be easy for the gods to come over and hunt him down.
‘It's time to consider matters after the Second Round.’ The blood sacrifice would take about half a month to complete, so Gu Nan's thoughts turned elsewhere.
Although the Myriad Heavens allowed him to develop more steadily, it also affected his advancement post-Second Round. There were both advantages and disadvantages to this.
After the player's Second Round, points gradually left the self-advancement system and could only be used for Divine Kingdom construction while Evil Value became the main basis for leveling up.
The core principle behind earning Evil Value hadn’t changed, but the methods became more diverse.
But no matter what, it would still be related to the gods, so being in the Myriad Heavens would always be a little inconvenient…
While Gu Nan was thinking, Yan Xiaoxiao's voice came from the side, interrupting his thoughts.
"Teacher, a Unified Dao cultivator has come to the Divine Kingdom... No, not a Unified Dao cultivator, but power belonging to Unified Dao Realm," Yan Xiaoxiao's voice was very urgent, and the situation really did warrant such urgency.
Gu Nan suddenly opened his eyes. His figure disappeared from the Evil God Temple and appeared on the border of the Divine Kingdom.
"The power of faith? No, the power of the dream realm." Gu Nan frowned slightly, having already determined the source of this power in the blink of an eye.
He noticed that power was converging here for an attack and also discovered the other party’s origin, but he had no way to stop its descent, because this attack was purely composed of laws.
After all, Gu Nan was still Tier 10 and hadn’t actually finished the Second Round yet, so there was a qualitative difference in the power of his laws.
He was only able to fight Unified Dao figures thanks to his extremely powerful physical body, but he had no advantage in terms of laws. It was just like how Song Fei was still able to pull him out with a ruler when Gu Nan tried to hide in the shadows.
Now that this Unified Dao-level dream realm descended, its target being his entire Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan could only watch.
Fortunately, he only needed to wait for the Second Round to finish now, so the Divine Kingdom was no longer his focus, and… this power didn’t seem to be here to kill, instead having a different aim.
Dream-like power descended from the sky, causing most of the creatures in the whole Divine Kingdom to fall into a deep slumber at the same time, and the entire Divine Kingdom turned silent.
However, no one died from this, but all of them were fast asleep.
Laws at Unified Dao Realm could easily affect a large plane. They were capable of terrifying effects like these.
Of course Gu Nan didn’t fall asleep from this, but he was inevitably affected by the power of the dream realm. His thoughts began to dull, and his body gradually became uncontrollable.
If someone wanted to ambush him, this was undoubtedly the best time.
Fortunately, the Evil God physique was powerful. Almost all the debuffs affecting Gu Nan's physical body were assimilated and eliminated by the Evil God physique.
Because the power of the dream realm directly affected one’s psyche, this process was delayed, but it still had an effect.
By the time Gu Nan came back to his senses, the dream realm’s power had completely enveloped his Divine Kingdom. All creatures in the Divine Kingdom were trapped in the dream realm, and wisps of psychic power were constantly being drawn out.
This scene was somewhat similar to Gu Nan's blood sacrifice of Graceful Heaven, except Gu Nan took away life force while the dream realm only collected mental power.
The process of gathering psychic power was slow and long-lasting. As the mental power gradually gathered, Gu Nan began to notice something unusual.
Laws continued to emerge, a will started to descend, and a brand new lifeform seemed to be born from it.
……
Just as the power of the dream realm descended upon Gu Nan’s Divine Kingdom, the Great War between the two worlds suddenly intensified.
This was caused by a sudden escalation from the World of Gods. A large number of high-level gods attacked, catching the Myriad Heavens by surprise.
Even the greater gods began to wantonly intervene. The greater gods who were originally rarely seen could be seen on the frontlines almost every other day.
Even if they were the first to attack every time and thus couldn’t gain the upper hand over the Unified Dao cultivators on this side, they were still happy.
This offensive continued for over ten days. It seemed that the gods really were making good on Austin’s threat.
The Unified Dao figures had already expected this, but they didn't expect the gods to take action so quickly.
After the initial disarray, the Unified Dao cultivators quickly dealt with the situation calmly, feeling quite relaxed.
After all, they always had the upper hand. If the World of Gods continued like this, it would only exhaust the greater gods’ condition.
In just ten days, two greater gods had been injured, one of them even suffering heavy injuries. It was precisely the overly enthusiastic Ruler of War, Eugene.

chapters.title: Chapter 512: Second Round
chapters.content:
Just when the Unified Dao figures thought the gods had gone crazy trying to kill Gu Nan at all cost, the lifeform inside the dream realm finally woke up completely.
A faint sigh that seemed to emanate from ancient times rang out in the dreams of everyone in the Divine Kingdom.
Almost at the same time, Gu Nan also opened his eyes. Graceful Heaven’s blood sacrifice finished just now.
Due to Fang Chaoyun's death, most of the plane collapsed, and all the living beings had their vitality completely drained by Gu Nan. It could be said that Graceful Heaven had ceased to exist.
And when all the life force was absorbed by the crimson skull, the skull started emitting a strange brilliance, even dyeing the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb scarlet.
After all, the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb was just an item and had its own usage limitations; the crimson skull clearly almost exceeded its usage range.
Gu Nan removed the skull from the orb without hesitation, then made for the Evil God Temple, heading up to the second floor.
As long as he placed the crimson skull back in its original spot, the Second Round would be complete!
……
Outside the Divine Kingdom, as that woman sighed, the Great War happening on the frontlines slowed down.
"Dream Immortal returned so soon?" Yu Lian raised a brow slightly and asked with some surprise.
The timing of Dream Immortal’s return was uncertain, but the general consensus was that it would be at least a hundred years later… What allowed her to return early?
Yu Lian looked at Lu Wen. The two happened to be on the same battlefield at this time, and the fact that Lu Wen had already intervened in Dream Immortal’s return a long time ago was no secret.
Lu Wen smiled and had no intention of hiding anything anymore. He told Yu Lian everything about Dream Immortal’s former followers, who went to the World of Gods to collect the power of faith to help her recover in advance.
"Speaking of which, it’s all thanks to the recent war." Lu Wen added, "If so many gods hadn't died, they wouldn't have been able to collect faith so easily."
"So then, they might also be the ones who instigated the Great War between the two worlds?" Yu Lian raised an eyebrow.
"It's hard to say." Of course Lu Wen also suspected them before, but he still had some doubts. "This time Dream Immortal’s return… Wait! This is not Dream Immortal’s power!"
Lu Wen was startled. Glancing back at the Myriad Heavens, he saw that the place Dream Immortal revived from looked a little familiar.
Dream Immortal just happened to revive inside Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom, but the power she ultimately used was not her own. Could this even be a coincidence?
As if to confirm Lu Wen's suspicions, a dark purple beam slipped out of the dream realm and quickly shot towards the Evil God Temple.
After the purple beam passed, a girl with a graceful figure slowly emerged, frowning at that ray of purple light.
"You’re scheming me? I don’t care who you are—"
"Dream Immortal," another voice interrupted from behind her. It was a square-faced man wearing full golden armor.
Alkaid Heaven’s Huo Kui, the only one of the Thirteen Heavens who started out as a mortal general and ultimately reached this position. He was also Dream Immortal’s most important ally in the past.
In the battle where Dream Immortal almost died, Huo Kui was the only one who stood by her side. He also sustained heavy injuries because of that, or else Lu Wen wouldn’t have gotten the opportunity to swap Dream Immortal’s son.
Dream Immortal nodded slightly at him. "I haven't seen you for tens of thousands of years. I don't seem to recognize these Myriad Heavens anymore."
"A lot of things happened." Huo Kui sighed. "Not counting you, one more new Unified Dao cultivator might emerge soon… It could also be two."
Dream Immortal was slightly taken aback. She knew perfectly well what the birth of a new Unified Dao existence meant, and she also knew just how difficult it was to take this step.
Don’t be fooled by how there were over ten such existences in each of the two worlds. In fact, this number was accumulated over endless years.
Before Dream Immortal could ask anything else, her former followers arrived.
"We welcome the Cult Master’s return!"
Star Rulers and Void Cutters with various appearances—dressed in black cult uniforms—all looked at Dream Immortal with tears of excitement.
They were diehard cultists of the Cloud Dream Cult in the past. After ten thousand years of perseverance, they finally witnessed their Cult Master’s return.
Dream Immortal still attached great importance to her old subordinates, and almost everyone wanted to have a few words alone.
But then the leader felt ashamed. "Your subordinate is incompetent. The Young Master…"
"I already know about this." Dream Immortal interrupted, "I personally swapped three babies back then in order to fool everyone. I didn't expect Lu Wen to know about it."
Dream Immortal was slumbering in the long River of Time and was unaware of events in the outside world. Only things related to Lou Wanying could be known through the connection of fate.
"The person who killed him has been implicated by my mark. I can feel that he is here." Dream Immortal's expression gradually darkened. "Since you dared to kill my son, you will naturally have to pay…"
She was only halfway through when her attention was drawn to movement in the distance, causing her to stop talking.
She saw the purple light in the distance landing on top of the Evil God Temple. Immediately after, the light erupted, turning into a figure with a sublime aura.
"Dream manifestation? Someone else ascended to Unified Dao using the Great Dao of dreams?" Dream Immortal suddenly turned around and asked Huo Kui.
Huo Kui slowly shook his head. "No. It's the Ruler of Nightmares from the World of Gods. As for why he can project his power here… He probably borrowed the power of your resurrection."
While the two were talking, the figure made of holy light that manifested through projection was already holding a longsword of holy light and slashing down directly at the Evil God Temple!
Everything that happened before was just a diversion, distracting all the Unified Dao powers and preventing them from immediately discovering Dream Immortal’s return.
And when the power of the dreams completely materialized, Kenneth took advantage of it to transfer Austin's power over—this was the gods’ ultimate goal!
"Austin…" Dream Immortal frowned tightly. She didn't completely understand this God of Light’s actions.
‘The person he wants to deal with is the same fellow who killed my son? Judging from the astral world, he should merely be a normal top-tier Star Ruler. Why would Austin need to personally take action?’
Dream Immortal's gaze paused for a moment and then stopped looking. She borrowed the mental power of this world’s inhabitants to revive, so she knew this Star Ruler’s level very well.
However, a surprising twist happened when the sword of holy light fell.
That temple seemed to have predicted the holy sword in advance and voluntarily split into two, revealing a human figure in the middle.
"Austin, Kenneth." A calm voice came from that person’s mouth, seemingly with a smile, "I’ll pay you guys a visit when I have time. As for this time… I accept your partial Godheads."
In order to ensure nothing could go wrong, the two greater gods simultaneously sent out clones, and they were clones that truly possessed portions of their own powers. After all, these clones were created using a fragment of their Godheads!
Austin didn’t seem to hear the other party’s words, and the holy sword accelerated slightly, as if he wanted to slice apart the opponent's body along with his astral world.
Dream Immortal glanced at Huo Kui in confusion and asked, "Who is this person? A Star Ruler who just advanced in the last ten thousand years?"
Huo Kui answered gravely, "Ten thousand years…? No, he’s a Unified Dao power who just ascended within a hundred years."
As Huo Kui finished speaking, Gu Nan instantly took action. Boundless shadows seemed to be surging behind him, swallowing up the holy sword and the power of nightmares.
This was genuine Unified Dao Realm power!

chapters.title: Chapter 513: Agreement Among Unified Dao Powers
chapters.content:
After Gu Nan placed the crimson skull on the second floor of the Evil God Temple, the Second Round was completed.
There were no abnormal phenomena around the world, no signs of someone ascending to Unified Dao. As a matter of fact, no one even noticed. But Gu Nan had already stepped into Unified Dao Realm.
Based on classifications from the World of Gods and the game, the current Gu Nan was already at Tier 11.
There were existences on the same level as him, such as the two top powers reigning over the law of time on both sides, Clockwork Heaven’s Lu Wen and God of Time Valen.
These two were both juniors in the Unified Dao hierarchy and ascended most recently. Of course, Rolensia was also among those ranks now.
But after reaching this stage, how early or late someone entered this realm and their level could no longer be used to judge the person’s strength.
For example, even if Lu Wen was only at Tier 11, he still didn’t fear the Tier 12 Song Fei at all. This confidence stemmed from the special nature of his laws and also from the two Great Daos he comprehended when he ascended to Unified Dao.
The same went for Gu Nan. Even if he just reached Tier 11, he still had the confidence to kill the clones of two veteran greater gods!
The holy sword struck Gu Nan's head with great force as terrifying holy flames poured out, spreading all over Gu Nan's body in the blink of an eye. But Gu Nan continued charging forward without slowing down at all.
The holy sword could not damage his body, and the holy flames could not effectively burn him. On the other hand, Gu Nan was getting closer and closer to the holy light clone and purple mist.
One must know that the power of the dream realm appeared in the sky above the Evil God Temple, almost at the edge of the astral world, and Austin even sealed off space—disabling all teleportation—in order to leave an escape route for himself.
But now, Gu Nan relied solely on his own speed to shorten the distance enough for a counterattack!
Austin's clone made three consecutive slashes, each slash imbued with blazing holy flames. Even laws were burned and distorted by the holy flames, then assimilated into boundless light.
Even with just a clone, the characteristics of the law of light have not changed.
Gu Nan's own law of shadows was quickly assimilated, but he held the advantage of being here in person, so he could use far more laws than his opponent's two clones.
Shadows quickly enveloped the clones of Austin and Kenneth. Even if the shadows were assimilated in the blink of an eye, it was still enough to delay them for a little while.
And all Gu Nan needed was just this little while.
One punch!
Gu Nan landed a heavy punch, directly punching through the holy light making up Austin's clone. Sparkling, translucent dots of light scattered throughout their surroundings and were instantly swallowed up by the shadows.
But Austin didn't hesitate in the slightest. He swung the sword down again, hitting Gu Nan square on the shoulder.
But it was still… useless!
The clone’s absolute power was insufficient, and the sublime characteristics of the law of light alone was not enough to harm the post-Second Round Evil God physique.
On the contrary, Gu Nan's fists didn’t pause at all. Each punch pierced straight through Austin’s body and destroyed the laws attached to the clone, consuming Austin's power to the maximum extent.
Apart from saint clones, which walked among mortals, gods’ clones were essentially a fusion of portions of their Godhead and laws.
The separated Godhead fragment acted as a core, directing the laws to attack enemies. So while the quality of the clone’s laws weren’t inferior to their original body, the total amount was far inferior, and they also weren’t protected by a god’s divine body.
Gu Nan was all too familiar with the gods' methods and made the most correct decision every step of the way. Facing him, the two greater gods’ clones couldn’t actually do much in response.
Just like this, Gu Nan flat-out tanked the holy sword’s attacks and threw hundreds of punches in just half an instant, turning the clone of holy light into a sieve riddled with holes.
The holy light collapsed instantly and was swallowed up by the all-consuming shadows. Without its driving force, the holy flames also stopped burning and quickly sank into the shadows.
Gu Nan reached out and grabbed a crystal object from inside the collapsing holy light. It was the remaining fragment of Austin's Godhead.
He put the Godhead away and moved his gaze to the purple mist on the sidelines.
Ruler of Nightmares, Kenneth. This greater god who discovered the actions of Cloud Dream Cult’s cultists and personally planned the illegal crossing this time didn’t even intend to say anything as the purple mist quickly tried to escape into the void.
However, he too had no room to escape as the shadows swept over him. The power of the dream realm could not affect Gu Nan, so he could only watch as his own laws were exhausted.
In just a few short minutes, Gu Nan already had fragments of two greater gods’ Godheads in his hands. The whole process flowed very naturally, as if he’d done this kind of thing countless times before.
On the side, Dream Immortal and Huo Kui exchanged confused glances.
Even if they were only two clones, they were still greater god-level clones. How come they looked just like normal gods at Gu Nan's hands?
After Gu Nan took the two Godheads, he had no intention of returning to the Divine Kingdom, instead appearing before Dream Immortal and Huo Kui.
Huo Kui had already removed his full body golden armor at this time, actually possessing a graceful appearance. He was originally a scholar and took the name "Kui
[1]
" for himself. He didn’t expect to eventually embark on the path of military enlistment by pure chance.Seeing Gu Nan's arrival, he took the initiative to say, "Since you already entered Unified Dao, head to Void Grotto Heaven whenever you have time. Yu Lian will arrange for us all to meet."
Huo Kui was the first to speak, having already acknowledged Gu Nan's status as an existence in the same realm as himself.
Gu Nan nodded. At his current level, he could already see these Unified Dao cultivators’ relative power levels. Huo Kui and Dream Immortal were both relatively powerful ones among the Unified Dao group.
In terms of levels, they were probably around Tier 13.
Of course, the same sentence still applied—when it came to Unified Dao Realm, one’s level was often just a reference. Even Song Fei, whose laws weren’t very special, possessed the possibility of defeating them, although that possibility was at most 20% to 30%.
Gu Nan then looked at Dream Immortal. "Are you Lou Wanying's mother?"
The corner of Dream Immortal's mouth twitched slightly, not knowing how to respond for a while. She could only answer in a low voice, "That’s right."
Without another word, Gu Nan swung a punch straight at Dream Immortal’s face.
Dream Immortal's entire body instantly turned illusory, causing Gu Nan's punch to miss, but it still caused damage to her laws.
"How impudent!" A cold snort came from the void, and the frightening power of the dream realm swelled up again, directly covering Gu Nan’s entire Divine Kingdom.
This time, Dream Immortal personally took action. Once she finished her attack, it would probably be a real killing move, enough to erase the consciousness of all living beings inside the Divine Kingdom.
But a golden brilliance slowly emerged, blocking the space between the two. Huo Kui said helplessly, "Gu Nan, please wait a minute… Dream Immortal will not seek revenge on you."
Only then did Gu Nan stop his movements and looked at Huo Kui doubtfully. After confirming the relationship between Dream Immortal and Lou Wanying, of course he had to strike first.
But Huo Kui explained, "We, the Unified Dao cultivators, have had an agreement since long ago. Unified Dao means transcending worldliness and detaching oneself, so all the previous grudges are wiped clean. This is why Song Fei will not pursue the matter of Graceful Heaven… Well, unless they’re mortal enemies."
To think there was such an agreement between Unified Dao powers. Gu Nan had never heard anyone mention it, but he still subconsciously asked, "What’s considered a mortal enemy?"
Huo Kui glanced at him. "Like Zi Luo."
T/N:
[1]
Kui
= Sunflower

chapters.title: Chapter 514: Name Change
chapters.content:
There was indeed such an agreement among Unified Dao powers.
It could be said that it was impossible for any Star Ruler to avoid conflicts with others while advancing.
For the Star Rulers qualified to ascend to Unified Dao, offending a certain Unified Dao existence in the process was a very likely event.
For example, Xue Ren had a certain conflict of laws with Zou Jiming, so their relationship had never been very harmonious.
He did have a very good relationship with Yu Lian, which was also a tradition left from the past. Otherwise, if he just offended everyone without making allies, he might be ambushed when breaking through to Unified Dao.
It was also to protect those who entered this realm later that such an agreement was made between the Unified Dao cultivators. Once a newcomer ascended to this realm, all previous grievances and grudges other Unified Dao powers had against them would be erased, and they would start with a clean slate from now on.
Of course, Song Fei's situation—where he directly caused Zi Luo Elder’s cultivation realm to fall, unable to recover for tens of thousands of years—was another matter entirely.
"That's indeed true," Yu Lian sat across from Gu Nan and confirmed Huo Kui's statement.
This wasn’t Void Grotto Heaven. Rather, Yu Lian personally came over to meet Gu Nan. The implication behind her words was that she wanted to pull Gu Nan into her faction.
While it was true that the Unified Dao powers in the Myriad Heavens didn’t have clear-cut factions like the two major godly factions next door, they were still more or less divided into unofficial factions.
For example, Jiu Po and Song Fei were relatively close, and Song Fei had a good relationship with Qin Guanruo, so they could be said to be one faction.
Gu Nan had always been closer to Yu Lian due to his relationship with the Heaven-God Alliance and Xue Ren, so it was normal for Yu Lian to try to win him over immediately.
"In other words, neither Song Fei nor Dream Immortal will trouble me because of old grudges?"
"Yes and no." Yu Lian explained with a half-smile, "The agreement is just an agreement. If one day you no longer have Unified Dao Realm power, they most likely won’t let you go."
Gu Nan finally nodded. To put it bluntly, this so-called agreement simply gave everyone an excuse to de-escalate the situation so that it wouldn’t have to develop into a life-and-death struggle.
It was quite hard for a Unified Dao cultivator to kill an opponent on the same level. But how can they give an account to their subordinates in situations where their disciples and children died at other people’s hands?
Since it was hard to give an account, just create an agreement like this. As for when they need to take action… They don’t have to abide by the agreement at all.
"Dream Immortal has just returned and still needs to deal with her former organization’s affairs. And after you ascended, Zi Luo was able to stabilize his injuries." Yu Lian continued, "I will call a meeting with everyone after those two handle their respective affairs. The date will be one month later."
"Okay." Gu Nan had no objections and nodded.
Yu Lian cast Gu Nan another meaningful glance. "We suddenly gained three more Unified Dao members this time, but both of the other two are old members. You’re the only newcomer. There are some matters I will tell you when the time comes.”
Gu Nan glanced at her. There was obviously something hidden in her words, but since Yu Lian didn't want to explain it now, it would be better to wait a month.
Anyhow, it was unlikely to be as bad as "the world is about to be destroyed, so the Unified Dao powers need to take turns defending it" or "there’s an invasion of foreign enemies, and the Unified Dao cultivators need to take turns guarding the border" or something like that.
Seeing as how Song Fei still had time to start a war against the World of Gods, Gu Nan knew those situations wouldn’t be the case here.
After the two agreed, Yu Lian had no intention of staying any longer and quickly disappeared.
It was already two days after Gu Nan’s advancement. Everything had settled down. The gods all retreated, and the overall war entered a sluggish state.
The Myriad Heavens wouldn’t know what the gods were thinking, and they also had no time to care, because they were all busy welcoming the arrival of a new Unified Dao powerhouse.
Prior to this, although Gu Nan's reputation was well-known, it had always been a mix of praise and criticism, but now it became one-sided praise.
No one dared to make comments such as "unstable foundation", "narrow-minded and made too many enemies", or "vicious and unscrupulous actions" any longer.
Even the classic battles since Gu Nan's debut were made into case studies for all of the Myriad Heavens to analyze, and then people discovered… there was nothing to analyze at all.
How can a fellow who debuted less than a century ago and shot to the level of Unified Dao like a rocket be analyzed?
Favored by luck? Nope. Monstrous genius? Ridiculously monstrous. Unswerving determination? Can’t really tell. The Heavenly Dao rewards diligence? Nonexistent. A late bloomer… Late, your foot!
Analysts from all major forces began to burst into tears. If they could still use "his breakthroughs were too hasty, so his foundation is unstable" as an excuse in the past, now they really didn’t know what to say.
That was, until news spread from somewhere that Gu Nan was actually not a mortal, but the reincarnation of an ancient Evil God from the World of Gods. It was precisely because of this that the greater gods were so determined to kill him.
This news won the immediate approval of the majority of analysts as soon as it came out.
Reincarnation of a powerhouse!
They finally found a reason for his absurd growth rate. They really did go to great lengths to make the story sound reasonable.
And as the "Evil God theory" spread far and wide—gaining more people’s acknowledgement—and more information about Gu Nan's history was uncovered, a new problem emerged.
How did a great power from the World of Gods reincarnate into the Myriad Heavens?
Due to the existence of the dimensional wall between the two worlds, it could be said that there was no way to cross except for space-time crystals, and reincarnation was even more out of the question.
This triggered a wave of research on "cross-border reincarnation". Many people wanted to sneak into the World of Gods this way, but that's another story.
Gu Nan himself didn't pay attention to the turbulent discussions outside. He never cared for other people's opinions.
Gu Nan was sitting in his Divine Kingdom and watching Red Tail bring in batches of lists, all of which were cultivators who applied to join the Divine Kingdom.
Because Gu Nan prohibited outsiders from entering his astral world, after several waves of killings, no one dared to trespass anymore and obediently submitted applications instead.
Those who could be selected by Red Tail were absolutely not bottom-of-the-barrel, and many of them were even Star Rulers.
Joining a Unified Dao power’s astral world was definitely not a bad thing for Star Rulers. If others found out about it, they wouldn’t feel embarrassed but would feel honored instead.
As a matter of fact, the vast majority of weak Star Rulers lived in the astral worlds of Unified Dao existences and used it as their regular residence.
There was slight worry on Red Tail’s face. "My Lord, if we don't let these people in, I'm afraid…"
"There's nothing to worry about. Tell them all to fuck off. I don't need outsiders in my astral world," Gu Nan waved his hand and said rudely.
After the Second Round, the law buff that the Divine Kingdom could provide was far less powerful than in the First Round.
And the subsequent arrangements that Gu Nan would make for his Divine Kingdom—more accurately, the purge that would be carried out in it—required full control over the Divine Kingdom. There was no room for these outsiders.
Rather than kicking them out when the time came, it would be better to not let them in at all.
"Oh right." Gu Nan added, "Since I’ve already reached Unified Dao, let's change the Divine Kingdom’s name. This time, it’ll be called 'This World is Full Do Not Join' Heaven."

chapters.title: Chapter 515: Path Post-Second Round
chapters.content:
When news came out that Gu Nan had once again changed his astral world’s name, his acquaintances didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
"He doesn’t want anyone to interfere with his astral world that badly?" Xue Ren sat calmly across from Zi Luo Elder, chuckling over Gu Nan’s matter.
He was once known as "the one closest to Unified Dao", but now… Well, he still was the one closest to Unified Dao; someone merely shot past him.
However, Xue Ren didn’t seem to mind such an embarrassing situation at all. At least, nothing could be seen from his face.
Zi Luo Elder was still smiling, but his complexion looked much better than before.
His law was very special and was related to "organizations", so his self-advancement path was to develop organizations. It could be said that the Heaven-God Alliance was his main foundation.
If Xue Ren, a pillar of the Heaven-God Alliance, broke through to Unified Dao, it would be enough to fully recover all of Zi Luo Elder’s injuries, and he would even get to advance further than he ever had.
After all, Gu Nan wasn’t a diehard loyalist of the Heaven-God Alliance, and his ascension did not help Zi Luo Elder as much as he had imagined.
"Gu Nan always has his own goals behind everything he does, but they are unfathomable to others." Zi Luo Elder chuckled.
Xue Ren nodded. "Everyone has their own path."
Zi Luo Elder stared at Xue Ren with a deep gaze. "After taking this path, you will not be able to turn back. Now that my injury has stabilized, you no longer have to hurry."
Even if he wasn’t a diehard Heaven-God Alliance loyalist, Gu Nan's advancement still greatly extended Zi Luo Elder’s lifespan. The ten-year time limit no longer existed; he could afford to wait now.
Everyone could see that Xue Ren would definitely break through within a hundred years, and Zi Luo Elder would also officially return by then, so the Unified Dao figures already regarded Zi Luo Elder as a member of the "Unified Dao Club".
Xue Ren said expressionlessly, "We can't wait any longer. I have a hunch that what Austin said… may not be impossible."
"You mean, Gu Nan will cause the world to collapse?" Zi Luo Elder shook his head. "Even if you have a premonition, you still cannot win other people's trust with just a hunch."
The Star Rulers here were not gods. The Unified Dao powerhouses all reached this point by relying on their own cultivation, step-by-step, and not the faith of all living beings.
So they didn’t believe in any legends at all; they only believed in themselves. They had absolute confidence in themselves. Even existences at the same level as them would find it hard to destroy them, let alone completely destroy everyone.
Of course Xue Ren knew this, but that didn’t mean he would give up. "That's precisely why I have to hurry."
Zi Luo Elder stared at him for a long time, then finally gave a soft sigh. "Alright. I have a unique secret technique that no one else in the world knows, which can help you hide until the critical moment."
"Many thanks."
……
Gu Nan didn't care what other people were doing. He was busy tinkering with new things in his own Divine Kingdom.
Two crystal-clear Godheads floated in front of him, and Gu Nan was using his own law of shadows to erase the divine imprints in them bit by bit.
These two Godheads were naturally Austin and Kenneth’s Godhead fragments that Gu Nan captured from their clones.
If Godheads on this level could have their ownership imprints purged, they would undoubtedly become extremely precious items.
More importantly, being able to control two greater god-level Godheads—even mere fragments—would be of great help to Gu Nan's next operation.
After the player's Second Round, the only key to self-improvement was Evil Value while points became supplementary.
In fact, this had always been the case, but in the Divine Kingdom phase, points were necessary to upgrade the Evil God Temple’s level, which was why they became particularly important.
Earning Evil Value by killing gods was still a viable option, but the problem with this was… there weren’t enough gods to kill.
The total number of gods in the entire World of Gods probably didn’t exceed a thousand. Among them were a large number of low-level gods with very few followers, and the proportion of high-level gods was very small.
Previously, just to advance to Tier 10, many high-level gods had been killed, and the remaining gods were definitely not enough for Gu Nan to reach Tier 15.
For example, just to advance to Tier 12, he would need to have an Evil Value of 200,000, which was a full 70,000 difference from his current Evil Value.
Therefore, if he wanted to continue earning Evil Value, he must find a sustainable, long-term method, and the method given in the game was very simple: to cultivate blasphemers.
What was a blasphemer?
To put it simply, they were former believers who fell and abandoned their faith.
