Blasphemy is sin, and blasphemy by a blasphemer’s hands is undoubtedly an even greater sin. Therefore, the ultimate goal of cultivating a blasphemer is for them to personally kill the god they originally worshiped.
It was precisely because of the existence of this final goal that players were only able to use this method to earn Evil Value after completing the Second Round.
After all, having the blasphemer kill the god themself meant the blasphemer needed to be trained into a new god, which could only be done after the Second Round.
It was just like how Gu Nan obtained a water-type Godhead in his early years and gave it to Lan Si, but the current Lan Si could no longer be regarded as a true god.
Strictly speaking, Lan Si was also a blasphemer, but if he expected her to kill Rolensia, Gu Nan might as well just complete the mission himself.
Although Gu Nan could use his own power to accelerate the blasphemer’s growth, he wouldn’t be able to hide the Evil God’s aura on the blasphemer. They would be easily discovered, so it was a waste of money.
The best method was to provide the blasphemers with a high-level Godhead so that they can grow quickly and reach the point where they can kill gods.
The power of shadows was still surging, constantly purging the divinity imprints from the two Godhead fragments in the air, one white and one purple.
The white fragment from Austin remained motionless, as if it was completely unaffected by the power of shadows, but the Nightmare Godhead was already swaying.
From purely a laws perspective, Gu Nan was only at Tier 11, so it would be a bit more difficult to rewrite Austin's godhead.
On the other hand, Ruler of Nightmares Kenneth was merely at Tier 13, and because he only played a supporting role in this battle, he used a very small fragment of his Godhead this time. The internal laws were almost completely cleansed.
"I’ll finish Kenneth’s first and keep the Tier 15 Godhead for later." Gu Nan originally had the attitude of giving it a try. Seeing this situation, he immediately made a decision.
As long as he had a greater god's Godhead in hand, he would have a way to cultivate the first blasphemer. As for later… he could simply retrieve the Godhead after the blasphemy was completed.
"Call Red Tail over," Gu Nan's voice traveled out from the Evil God Temple and was quickly conveyed to Red Tail through Yan Xiaoxiao.
"My Lord." Red Tail quickly walked in. She didn't need to prepare for any wars recently, so she also had a little free time and looked a bit stout.
"You’ll be busy again in the future." Gu Nan patted her on the shoulder. "White Mist is going to build a new branch."
"What branch?"
"World of Gods branch."

chapters.title: Chapter 516: Greater God Dimension
chapters.content:
"The World of Gods?" Red Tail suddenly felt dizzy. She couldn't imagine why the one before her would want to establish a branch there when the war was still at a stalemate.
Gu Nan nodded. "Don't worry, the war is coming to an end. I’ll write another manual in two days to create a complete ceasefire between the two sides."
Red Tail couldn't help asking curiously, "W-What manual?"
"Gods’ Hunting Protection Manual."
As the author of the Weak Gods Hunting Manual, Gu Nan certainly knew what key points were worth paying attention to and what loopholes could be exploited by the gods in advance.
As long as the difficulty of the God Hunt increased—causing the costs and benefits to return to a normal ratio—the wave of God Hunts would no longer be as frenzied and would inevitably turn into a small-scale activity.
The corner of Red Tail's mouth twitched slightly. She hesitantly ventured, "But… if My Lord wants to instigate another war in the future…"
"Won’t I just have to write a Hunting Manual 2.0?" Gu Nan answered with a shrug and glanced at Red Tail. "You’re very talkative today. Don’t want to go to the World of Gods?"
"It’s not that…" Red Tail replied speechlessly. She’d been bored sick these days and longed for something to do, but running to the World of Gods was indeed a bit sudden.
However, as Gu Nan's most useful subordinate, Red Tail quickly adjusted her mentality and said with a serious expression, "I understand. May I inquire about the main goal behind establishing a branch office this time?"
"To collect intelligence, especially information from the main planes." Gu Nan thought for a while and added, "I need you to help me find some good seedlings. They must be people who originally believed in gods but later experienced a collapse in faith."
"What if the other party’s faith has always been firm?"
"Then find a way to make them fall," Gu Nan answered without even looking up. "Lan Si will go with you; she’ll be a good guide. Bring Xie Yun and the others with you as well; they can be used as hired thugs."
The so-called "Xie Yun and the others" referred to Xie Yun, An Tiansheng, and Liang Ruxin.
Although Gu Nan's player army didn’t have many members, practically all of them were elites, especially Xie Yun, An Tiansheng, and Liang Ruxin, who had all advanced to Tier 5 by now.
For mortals, Tier 5 was equivalent to a Star Ruler or god.
Among them, Xie Yun and An Tiansheng relied on the special characteristics of their routes to a certain extent, while Liang Ruxin relied entirely on his own talent and enlightenment to reach this point after having a clear-cut direction to go in.
Under Gu Nan's arrangement, almost all the major high-end forces in the Divine Kingdom were mobilized.
Red Tail knew this meant that the focus of Gu Nan's subsequent plans would be in the World of Gods, so she quickly responded, "Yes, I will set off today."
……
The plans in the World of Gods were already underway, but establishing an intelligence organization from scratch would not happen overnight.
Fortunately, with the support of an experienced administrator like Red Tail and a group of powerful subordinates, the progress was quite fast.
Gu Nan had already completed the Second Round. It could be said that he truly had the ability to defend himself now. He no longer had to urgently level up like before and could stop and enjoy life occasionally.
For example… playing a few rounds of black cards.
"This game is very simple," Yu Lian said, having managed to defeat Gu Nan for the first time on the third day of their card battles.
Gu Nan didn’t mind and said with a smile, "Try to beat me three times in a row?"
After all, black cards was a card game with limited rules. For veritable top-tier powerhouses, their win rates were all basically about 50%. What really determined the outcome was luck.
However, compared to the former Sylvia, Yu Lian, who looked like a Daoist nun, was already extremely talented, and her progress was astonishingly fast.
After leaving the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan ran to Void Grotto Heaven to play cards with Yu Lian.
Anyhow, he had nothing to do recently. He could only wait for the Unified Dao meeting in Void Grotto Heaven to be held, so he might as well come early and wait.
He already finished making arrangements in his Divine Kingdom, and once Red Tail gathered enough people on that side, he could automatically start a screening mechanism to select candidates who were qualified to inherit the Godhead fragments.
After losing two consecutive rounds, Yu Lian calmly pushed away the cards and pretended to get to business, "Zou Jiming said he wants to talk to you. Why don't you go meet him?"
……
Atalante.
In this war-torn continent, a large number of civilians were displaced, and a large number of believers were unable to receive protection during the war. Eventually, they lost their faith and became unbelievers.
Vivian was one such girl.
She worshiped the Goddess of Radiance ever since she was a child. Even though her god had little divine power, Vivian had always firmly believed that gods couldn’t be ranked purely by the strength of their divine powers.
Righteousness triumphed in the world; power was not the absolute truth.
Until one day… When war came, Vivian finally learned the harsh reality.
That day, the girl's town suffered a sudden attack. The evil invaders destroyed her home and massacred her relatives.
Originally, the young girl thought she was going to die too. Fortunately, a god with medium divine power performed a miracle, but he was unable to protect everyone and could only selectively protect a group of people.
Therefore, this god’s believers naturally became the first batch of protection targets, and Vivian was lucky enough to be selected as the second batch, but her older brother was not so lucky.
After watching her brother die tragically under the enemy's slaughter, the pious girl finally understood the truth of life.
There must be power first, then righteousness.
Now, after two months of hellish war, Vivian had grown from a young girl into a mature female mercenary.
Her fair skin turned dark, and she frequented the tavern. She burned the priest's robe that she had yearned to wear when she was young and put on a tight long coat. Her hands were already stained with blood.
She’d even completely forgotten all the divine arts. Now, she only knew how to kill people with a machete.
She became strong, brave, and even heartless, like a rose covered with thorns. Only in the dead of night would she recall the helplessness of her loved ones as they died, and she would crave power even more.
Until one day, a mysterious voice rang in her ears.
"Do you want power?"
"Do you want to protect your everything?"
"Do you… want eternal life?"
This voice seemed to be torturing Vivian's soul, and she could not go against her heart. ‘Of course I want it! Power! Give me more power!’
When such thoughts fell, Vivian felt her vision go dark, and her consciousness seemed to fall into a drowsy state.
When she woke up next, the girl carefully opened her eyes, only to find that she was in a jungle, with some people nearby and a small sign not far away.
It’s just that the style of the houses here was very strange. It seemed to be different from any kind of civilization she knew. Even the text on the nearby sign was made of unfamiliar square-shaped characters.
"What… does this say?" Vivian stared at the sign curiously.
"Are you new? There are common language interpretations next to it," a voice sounded near Vivian as a tall woman slowly walked over.
Vivian quickly turned her head to look, and sure enough, she saw familiar words that clearly read:
[Welcome to the Greater God Dimension]

chapters.title: Chapter 517: Subject No. 29
chapters.content:
[Mission Location: Ghost Sea World]
[Mission Goal: Assist the Heavenly City Floating Island forces in defeating the invaders]
[Mission Difficulty: Three Stars]
The tall blonde, Nancy, couldn't help frowning when the mission details were revealed. "It's a three-star mission. Vivian, don't come with us this time."
A three-star mission normally required three or more Tier 3 members for a greater chance of success.
Nancy's team did have three Tier 3 members, but if they took Vivian with them, they might not be able to protect her.
"Big Sis Nancy, I can do it!" Vivian insisted, "I’m already a Tier 2 mercenary. If Adam doesn't use his laws, he sometimes even loses to me!"
The blue-haired young man on the side denied resentfully, "I was just careless that time! And I only… I only lost to you once…"
Before Adam could finish, Vivian glared right back at him, and his voice trailed off.
It had been nearly a month since Vivian came to this mysterious place. She basically figured out the rules here and also experienced a rapid growth in strength.
In one short month, she grew from a normal mercenary who only knew some fighting skills to a Tier 2 expert.
While it was true that much of this was thanks to the support provided by the Greater God Dimension, these results were also inseparable from Vivian's own efforts and talent.
Nancy stared at her for a while, then finally nodded. "Alright, if you insist. But you have to promise to follow my commands at all times."
"I will!" Vivian said excitedly.
……
Ghost Sea World.
Nancy took Vivian, Adam, and another Tier 3 teammate—a little boy named Jonathan who was adept at using bows. The four of them swiftly moved through the terrain.
"The mission requires us to assist the Heavenly City Floating Island in battle, but we must first understand the situation and figure out who our enemies and allies are," Nancy said calmly, looking like a dignified female boss.
"In the past, some teams were treated as spies by friendly forces due to their rash actions and executed." Nancy was afraid that some team members might get careless, so she added, "Dying in the Greater God Dimension means dying for real…"
"Boss, we get it. You’ve said this almost twenty times." Adam patted the greatsword on his waist and adjusted his posture into a more comfortable one as they moved forward. "And none of the people who died in the Greater God Dimension came back. Who knows whether they died or returned…"
In everyone’s eyes, the so-called "returned" naturally meant returning to the World of Gods, which was what they considered the main plane.
"Then you can try it," Nancy interrupted angrily, glaring at Adam.
Vivian stood to the side and exchanged a glance with Jonathan, the archer. She couldn’t help covering her mouth to hide her chuckle. The first time she saw Sister Nancy arguing with Adam, she thought they were going to quarrel.
Later, it was Jonathan who told her that those two actually came from the same continent and entered the Greater God Dimension at almost the same time. They had supported each other until now, and their relationship was so good that they could sleep together.
When the two finished bickering, Vivian interjected curiously, "Do you think the Greater God Dimension was really built by a greater god?"
This was the boring part of the journey, so the three of them didn't mind chatting with Vivian for a while.
Adam was the first to respond, "Probably. No matter which god established this, normal gods would never dare name this place the ‘Greater God Dimension’."
Adam showed no respect at all when discussing the gods and even had a bit of ridicule in his voice.
If this was her past self, Vivian would probably be very dissatisfied with his attitude, but now, not only did she not mind this, she even felt faint elation.
The god she once devoutly believed in did not protect her in the face of death, so what was the meaning of her piety?
On the contrary, Adam's words now gave Vivian a strange pleasure, as if entering a forbidden realm and tasting forbidden fruit.
……
"Subject No. 29 is currently performing well."
Inside White Mist, a man wearing white work clothes looked away from No. 29’s records and wrote down his own evaluation.
"No. 29, is that the girl named Vivian?" The man heard a voice behind him and quickly turned around, only to see Red Tail already standing there.
"Yes." The man said respectfully, "My Lord, you personally brought her back."
Red Tail nodded. When she was in the World of Gods, she set out to establish the White Mist branch and also selected talents from all the major planes, especially those who’d already lost their faith.
As for the seedlings who still worshiped their gods, White Mist had to make arrangements on that side to destroy their faiths one by one.
On the other hand, people like Vivian—who already lost their faiths—were very suitable for in-depth cultivation, so they were taken directly back to the Myriad Heavens, entering the "Greater God Dimension" established by Gu Nan himself.
As for why it was necessary to build a Greater God Dimension… Even the name was chosen by Gu Nan himself, so Red Tail certainly couldn’t object.
Red Tail nodded, and after carefully checking Vivian's records, she ordered, "Have Adam die in this mission. He can talk to Vivian a little before he dies."
The man in work clothes quickly agreed, but then pointed out, "It's just… the blasphemy evaluation of Subject No. 29 is only average. We need Adam's existence to cultivate the subject’s quality in this field."
But Red Tail insisted, "Just arrange for a new person to join the team. Your original training method is too slow. Vivian's potential is greater than you think."
……
Red Tail was naturally responsible for cultivating blasphemers in the Greater God Dimension. Gu Nan never paid attention to matters there ever since he finished setting up the Greater God Dimension.
He stayed in Void Grotto Heaven and met the Unified Dao cultivators, who visited one after another.
Even Song Fei was no exception. The top powerhouse in charge of Academic Heaven gave Gu Nan a kind smile for the first time and specifically told him not to take past matters to heart.
Now that Gu Nan ascended to Unified Dao, based on the agreement, all previous grudges would be wiped clean—even though Song Fei was the one who tried his best to kill Gu Nan before he actually entered Unified Dao.
Of course Gu Nan didn't take such words to heart. Anyhow, if they wanted to fall out, these Unified Dao figures could fall out at any time. The agreement was just hot air.
Except for Zi Luo Elder and Dream Immortal, Gu Nan saw all of the Myriad Heavens’ original Thirteen Heavens one by one this time, and the first person he met was Zou Jiming.
This somewhat talkative Star Ruler of Weapon Martial Heaven didn't provide much help to Gu Nan; he just came to chat.
In fact, most of these meetings were idle chatter. After all, they didn’t really have many dealings with Gu Nan. The only Unified Dao cultivators Gu Nan truly interacted with were Song Fei, Lu Wen, Zi Luo Elder, etc.
It wasn't until one person’s appearance that Gu Nan gained some new insights.

chapters.title: Chapter 518: Origin Of The Ancient Three Realms
chapters.content:
There was one person among the Thirteen Heavens whom Gu Nan had heard of a long time ago but never personally met.
This person was the Star Ruler of Jiu Po Heaven, Jiu Po.
Jiu Po was one of the oldest Unified Dao cultivators in the Myriad Heavens, almost being in the same generation as Zi Luo Elder. And ever since he entered Unified Dao, he’d always been the most mysterious existence among them.
Just how mysterious?
It could be said that no more than thirty people in the entire Myriad Heavens knew what Jiu Po looked like, and this number even included all the Unified Dao figures.
Today, Gu Nan became another person who saw Jiu Po's true appearance.
However, upon actually meeting Jiu Po, one would feel that there was nothing exceptional about this person. Seeing him was the same as not seeing him. His face was completely average and looked like a middle-aged uncle. He smiled all day long, utterly lacking the vibes of a mysterious final boss.
Based on the exhaustibility of human appearances, there might be hundreds of guys who resembled him in all the major planes.
"Gu Nan, I've wanted to get to know you for a long time," Jiu Po greeted Gu Nan with a smile on his face.
Gu Nan glanced at him. "I heard you’re on Song Fei’s side?"
Song Fei was only able to ascend to Unified Dao due to Jiu Po's assistance. If it weren't for his help, Song Fei alone would never have been able to bring about Zi Luo Elder’s fall.
But Jiu Po shook his head. "It’s more accurate to say that I invested in him."
"Isn't that the same?" Gu Nan shrugged. "If Song Fei dies, then you won't be able to get a return on your investment, so won’t you still be forced to help him?"
Jiu Po smiled in response to such a view. "There are exceptions. For example, if I invest in a new target, and the return on this new target is higher."
Gu Nan finally nodded in understanding. "So you want to invest in me? What kind of capital can you invest?"
"I can help you kill gods." Jiu Po said without changing his expression, "Greater gods."
……
The newest Unified Dao meeting finally began, with a total of sixteen people present this time.
They were made of the original Thirteen Heavens headed by Yu Lian, plus Gu Nan, Zi Luo Elder, and Dream Immortal. The return of two old comrades and the ascension of a newcomer turned the Thirteen Heavens directly into the "Sixteen Heavens."
If nothing else happened, from this day forward, the name "Sixteen Heavens" would be known to the world and would be used to describe the most powerful group of people in the Myriad Heavens.
These Sixteen Heavens were: Void Grotto Heaven, God Emperor Heaven, Jiu Po Heaven… as well as This World is Full Do Not Join Heaven.
Sixteen Unified Dao cultivators gathered in Void Grotto Heaven. This was the first time Gu Nan saw so many Unified Dao existences appearing in one place at the same time, even though he had already met all of them individually just recently.
Yu Lian sat in the main seat, and to either side of her were Jiu Po and a solemn-looking young man, who was the Star Ruler of God Emperor Heaven, Human King Zhao.
In the history of the Myriad Heavens, the ancient era did not have myriad planes like now. Instead, it was divided into only three realms: Heaven, Earth, and Human.
The three realms were not isolated from each other, and the ancient cultivators were able to travel freely among them.
That was, until a great cataclysm shook the world. The three realms crumbled, splitting into countless large and small planes.
However, the most essential parts of each of the three realms were preserved and managed by the three Saints of that time. These three places were passed down from generation to generation to this day and were still within the ranks of Unified Dao.
The Heaven Realm was governed by the authentic direct branch of Daoism, which became today's Void Grotto Heaven. The Earth Realm, which had lost the power of underworld reincarnation, became a normal plane and was today's Jiu Po Heaven. On the other hand, the Human Realm developed and evolved over tens of thousands of generations, producing many great powers belonging to the human race. Thus, it became God Emperor Heaven.
This was the origin of the three oldest astral worlds—Void Grotto Heaven, God Emperor Heaven, and Jiu Po Heaven.
Of course, the current masters of these three astral worlds were no longer the original three Saints. Even Jiu Po, the oldest among them, was not the first ruler of Jiu Po Heaven.
However, unlike the other two realms—which were passed down through inheritance—Jiu Po stole the Earth Realm’s core from the Saint’s successor after the Saint’s death, then changed its name to Jiu Po Heaven.
Nowadays, whenever people talk about Jiu Po Heaven, the core of their discussion is still on its origins, which shows how mighty this past feat was.
Gu Nan shifted his gaze away from Jiu Po and looked at Yu Lian and Human King Zhao. Both of these people inherited their astral worlds from their predecessors after it was passed down for many generations.
As the origin of Daoism, Void Grotto Heaven had always been said to be the leader of all planes. Therefore, whenever a new Unified Dao cultivator appeared, Void Grotto Heaven would always preside over the meeting.
God Emperor Heaven, however, was more interesting. Every Star Ruler of this astral world would change their names to Human King. The only difference was their surnames.
Compared with Void Grotto Heaven's attitude of intervening in everything, God Emperor Heaven was more like a self-contained astral world.
It wasn’t completely closed to the outside world like Gu Nan’s, but those who wanted to join God Emperor Heaven needed to undergo a strict review process. The majority of this astral world’s population growth was through internal reproduction.
To put it simply, the primary mission of each generation of Human Kings was to protect their own astral world so that the flames of the human race could burn forever in God Emperor Heaven.
As for the happenings outside, that had nothing to do with them.
"I’ve convened this meeting because new Unified Dao cultivators have emerged. Zi Luo and Dream Immortal are old friends, and I imagine everyone has already met Gu Nan," Yu Lian didn't put on any airs, starting off very directly.
She was also aware that Void Grotto Heaven’s title as the so-called leader of the Myriad Heavens was just in name. If any conflicts of interest popped up, no one would care about that at all.
Only when something troublesome like this needed to be hosted would everyone remember that such a title even existed.
"Based on customs." Yu Lian stood up and said to Gu Nan, "Gu Nan, you need to offer incense to the seniors, and the seniors… Forget it, you probably don’t want to do it either. Let's just get down to business."
Halfway through Yu Lian's sentence, she thought about it and decided not to ask, simply moving on to the next step.
When talking about business, Yu Lian's expression turned serious, staring at Gu Nan. "Though we Unified Dao cultivators have great freedom in the world, we also have to bear the heavy responsibility of the world."
"What do you mean? Don’t tell me we really need to save the world?" Gu Nan couldn't help asking, remembering some of his earlier jokes.
"Not like that…" Yu Lian replied somewhat speechlessly. "It’s our responsibility to maintain the normal operation of the Myriad Heavens and cultivate more powerful Star Rulers."
Gu Nan flat-out ignored the matter of cultivating Star Rulers. However, Yu Lian’s earlier sentence made him frown slightly. "The operation of the Myriad Heavens is maintained by Unified Dao powers?"
"Strictly speaking, yes." Yu Lian nodded. "When you first became a Star Ruler and started looking for your own astral world, you should have been to a place called the Inner World."
After a pause, she continued, "In a sense, the Inner World does not exist. It is an artificial control center we created by gathering everyone’s power."
Gu Nan suddenly had a flash of understanding. All the questions he had about entering and leaving the Inner World back then were explained at this moment.
No wonder the existence of the Inner World was so strange, as if it was provided solely to facilitate the Star Rulers’ search for an astral world.
No wonder he’d never heard of an equivalent place in the World of Gods, which was similar in nature to the Myriad Heavens.
And no wonder the laws inside the Inner World seemed mechanical and lifeless. It turned out that they were artificially created…
"What exactly do we need to do?" Gu Nan couldn't help feeling curious.
Yu Lian didn’t answer directly but pointed to the side. "Ask Li Ci to take you to the Inner World. You’ll understand as soon as you see it again. It’s his turn to be on duty this time."

chapters.title: Chapter 519: Essence Of The World
chapters.content:
"Daoist Friend Gu Nan, please come with me," Li Ci smiled plainly and said to Gu Nan.
The two of them had arrived in the Inner World at this time, with Li Ci walking in front and guiding Gu Nan in a certain direction.
Li Ci was a handsome young man with sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, but his actual age was much older than Lu Wen. He could be regarded as a powerhouse from the mid-antiquity era.
One of the most famous feats about Li Ci was naturally how he used his endless combination of techniques to escape from another Unified Dao existence before he even entered Unified Dao.
From that day on, no one dared to provoke Li Ci casually. He was practically treated as a future Unified Dao cultivator.
Li Ci also did not disappoint the world. Over a thousand years later, he successfully broke through to Unified Dao and became a powerhouse.
The current Li Ci was considered a Tier 13 cultivator, surpassing even Song Fei, who ascended earlier than him. It was only a matter of time before he surpassed others.
Of course, the primary issue he faced right now was not being caught up too quickly by Gu Nan.
Gu Nan followed Li Ci and slowly stepped through the Inner World’s gates, then saw the familiar and unfamiliar Inner World.
This wasn’t his first time coming to the Inner World. Back when he was only at Tier 3, he accidentally entered this place because of the personal dungeon.
It was during that experience that he met Zuo Zuo and the others, which led to the series of subsequent events.
Later, in order to earn Evil Value and points, Gu Nan also used the Inner World as a dungeon center and came here to find new dungeons.
After formally finishing the First Round and entering the Divine Kingdom phase, the Inner World that briefly appeared in Gu Nan's vision finally completely withdrew from the stage of history.
But now that Gu Nan returned, his perception of the Inner World was completely different from before.
There were still countless bright dots floating around balls of light. They were the Star Rulers constantly searching for suitable astral worlds.
The existence of such a strange scene was something that had never happened in the game in Gu Nan’s past life. Even this world’s World of Gods did not have it; only the Myriad Heavens had this.
When Gu Nan saw the Inner World in the past, everything merely felt strange, but now that he knew it was an artificial creation, it looked more simple and crude.
It's as if it had been forcibly pieced together, existing solely for functionality without any adornments.
"Do you think it's too simple?" Li Ci seemed to understand what Gu Nan was thinking and said with a smile, "I felt the same way when I first came here."
Li Ci also had the experience of "coming here for the first time", which meant he wasn’t one of the Inner World’s creators. This place should have been created by Unified Dao figures from earlier years.
Before Gu Nan could speak again, Li Ci continued, "After the collapse of the ancient three realms, the Saints discovered that the fragments of those realms were constantly drifting outward, getting further and further away from the center of the Myriad Heavens."
"As these fragments drifted to the edge of the Myriad Heavens, some started to crumble on their own while others vanished completely without a trace. No one could find them anymore."
"If this continues, then sooner or later, all the fragments will disappear completely, and there will only be a few large astral worlds left in the Myriad Heavens, and the name of ‘Myriad Heavens' will no longer be accurate…"
Through Li Ci’s explanation, Gu Nan gradually gained a new understanding of the Myriad Heavens’ history and worldview.
In reality, he already knew most of these things long ago but never connected the dots to look at them from a much higher perspective.
To describe it with a simple metaphor, the entire Myriad Heavens was like a sphere that was constantly rotating, and the planes—or astral worlds—were the particles making up the sphere.
Heaven Level planes were at the very center of the sphere, accounting for a huge proportion of its volume and had completely fixed coordinates.
Realm Level planes accounted for a slightly smaller proportion and were on the outer edges of the central area, but they also had their own stable coordinates and wouldn’t be thrown out of the center.
But the World Level planes below them didn’t receive such good treatment. Almost all of them were outside the central area. They were affected by the sphere’s rotation and were constantly being thrown out to the edge.
It was precisely because of this that time in Heaven and Realm Level planes was completely unified, while other planes always had their own time flow differences.
Using Gu Nan's limited knowledge of physics to speculate, it was roughly because the planes in different orbits had extremely different relative speeds, which led to the difference in time flow.
"In ancient times, there was no such thing as a Star Ruler." Li Ci explained, "In order to prevent the fragments of planes from getting away, the Saints called on the cultivators to leave the main planes and continue to expand outwards. They also passed down the cultivation method of linking a cultivator to a specific plane.”
Hearing this, Gu Nan couldn't help laughing. "So that's how Star Rulers and astral worlds came about."
Although they were similarly linking a plane to themselves, the gods next door actually built their Divine Kingdoms from scratch, which was completely different from the Myriad Heavens. Although the two reached the same goal from different paths, they were drastically different during the Divine Kingdom phase.
"The Star Rulers control their astral worlds. As they continuously strengthen themselves, their astral worlds will also continue to grow. When they ascend to Realm Level, this plane fragment will be completely saved."
Li Ci went on, "However, there are too many world fragments. It would be too inefficient if we relied on the Star Rulers to find them all. Therefore, the second generation Unified Dao cultivators decided to summarize all the fragments first, and this summary mechanism is the Inner World.”
After saying this, Li Ci led Gu Nan forward. They had already entered the core of the Inner World, the control center in the truest sense.
Then he took back his laws, which were controlling the command center, and motioned for Gu Nan to take over the position while saying with a smile, "I don't need to explain what happens next. Someone else will tell you."
Gu Nan looked at him strangely. When he injected his laws into the control center, he suddenly felt an inexplicable throbbing, as if something was beating inside the center.
"It’s alive?" Gu Nan looked at Li Ci, who just nodded slightly, indicating that he should wait a moment.
Sure enough, just a minute later, Gu Nan heard a soft female voice echoing in his ears, "It’s nice to meet you, new King."
A woman’s projection slowly appeared in front of Gu Nan. This woman had a slender figure, but her body was made entirely of blue light beams, and her face had no appearance.
"We usually call her 'Zero'." Li Ci finally spoke again, "She is the origin of the Inner World and the living creature that coexists with it."
"So she’s the housekeeper, right?" Gu Nan wasn’t affected by Li Ci at all, immediately seeing through Zero's true nature.
To put it bluntly, these Unified Dao figures were all quite busy themselves and had no time to deal with world fragments all the time, so they found a full-time housekeeper to do the job.
"You’re correct, King." Zero's voice sounded again, "I was first created as a manager."
Gu Nan looked at Li Ci. "What does ‘King’ mean?"
Li Ci chuckled. "Here, you can control the entire world and manipulate anything you want. In a sense, you are the King of the World."
Author's Note:
(The end… Just kidding)

chapters.title: Chapter 520: King Of The World
chapters.content:
"Yes, King." Zero's voice echoed in agreement, "You can do anything you wish, as long as the other party is still inside the world."
"King of the World?" Gu Nan thought for a moment, then pointed at Li Ci. "Zero, help me kick this annoying fellow out first."
Zero suddenly fell silent, as if she had never received such an order before.
Li Ci experienced Gu Nan's trolling tendencies for the first time and couldn't help laughing in spite of himself. "You needn’t bother; I was just about to leave. Daoist Friend Gu, let’s meet again if fate allows."
After saying this, Li Ci had no intention of dallying and quickly disappeared.
It wasn't until he disappeared that Zero's voice sounded weakly, "King, his power cannot be controlled by the world…"
"I know." Gu Nan waved his hand. If this bullshit King of the World really could control Unified Dao powers, then that would truly be absurd.
In reality, let alone Unified Dao, the Inner World would have very weak control over any astral worlds ruled by even normal Star Rulers.
The Inner World reflects all the planes that exist in reality. Including the current Sixteen Heavens, no plane could escape, including Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom.
But this didn’t mean the Inner World had any control over these astral worlds.
As long as it was an astral world already under a Star Ruler’s rule, the world itself would be controlled by that Star Ruler first and foremost and indirectly affected by the Inner World second.
Of course, except for bored people like Gu Nan, no Unified Dao powerhouse would try to influence other planes through the Inner World.
If they truly wanted to affect something, they could simply issue an order.
The Inner World must be overseen by a Unified Dao existence because it needed the support of Unified Dao Realm laws to maintain its normal operations.
For the Unified Dao figures, this was a completely useless existence, with almost no meaning to its existence besides giving some pleasure over "controlling the world".
Based on the agreement among Unified Dao cultivators, every person's shift was one thousand years, so any pleasure would be eventually worn down… No wonder Li Ci fled like he was running away and didn’t want to stay any longer.
"Is there anything else you need me to do?" Gu Nan studied the Inner World and asked again.
"Nothing else… If something unexpected happens, I will contact you as soon as possible," Zero's voice sounded a little weak, as if she was afraid that Gu Nan would give some strange orders again.
Normally, Gu Nan will return home after his curiosity gradually fades, and then it will be hundreds of years before an unexpected situation occurs.
The so-called unexpected situations were mostly just a sudden collapse of a certain plane, affecting nearby planes, or a certain plane suddenly experiencing a leap and requiring Gu Nan to provide power to help stabilize it…
All these trivial, boring tasks were the daily life of the so-called King of the World.
However, Gu Nan didn’t leave quickly, because he realized that being the King of the World was quite interesting.
"King of the World or whatever, it suits me quite well!" Gu Nan nodded and turned his attention to a certain plane—Ghost Sea World.
……
Ghost Sea World.
Vivian carried Adam, who was covered in blood, on her back and hurriedly ran through the dense forest. At the same time, she had to avoid the arrows shot from behind, which was extremely difficult.
After a while, the pursuers were still closing in on them. Vivian knew it was impossible for her to escape, so she simply let Adam down from her back.
"Adam, leave quickly! I'll stop them!" Vivian gritted her teeth and said with extreme regret.
If she hadn't stubbornly insisted on coming along, everyone else wouldn't have bungled the mission to this extent just to protect her.
Now, the whereabouts of Sister Nancy and Jonathan were unknown, and Adam was poisoned by the enemy while helping her escape… ‘It's time for me to stand up!’
However, the next second, she was sent flying by a strong force that flung her away from behind.
Adam had managed to stand up at some point and said with a grin, "Even if I’m crippled, I still won’t need a little girl like you to protect me! Leave now and tell Nancy…"
Vivian's whole body spun in midair until she crashed into the ground. She could no longer catch what Adam wanted to tell Nancy at the end, but tears kept flowing down her face.
She hated her lack of power so much, just like she had when she watched her brother die.
She thought everything was getting back on track, and she told herself that what transpired back then would never happen again, but she didn't expect to experience it again just a few months later.
But Vivian was very strong. Even if her body felt like it was falling apart, she still forced herself to stand up, wiping the tears from her face and quickly moving forward.
The mission must be completed. If it couldn’t be completed, there was only death. This was the rule of the Greater God Dimension… She must find Sister Nancy and Jonathan. She didn’t want to die, let alone let Adam’s death be in vain!
……
But just as Vivian was bravely moving forward, Red Tail was flying into a terrible rage in White Mist.
"What in the world is going on? Why is this kind of mission evaluated as three stars?" Red Tail slammed down a stack of mission reports and asked with an annoyed expression.
According to their plan, Vivian's mission should be successfully completed after a battle of wits and courage.
Only at the last minute would White Mist arrange for the group to be split into two. Vivian's mistake would cause Adam's death, and he would tell Vivian his story before dying.
It would certainly be a story regarding gods, betrayal, and falling.
"My Lord, it was our mistake this time…" The young man in white work clothes was constantly wiping cold sweat from his face. He didn't expect to encounter such a serious problem on the rare occasion Red Tail actually visited in person.
This completely disrupted the training plan of Subject No. 29.
Red Tail’s anger still didn’t dissipate, and she asked, "Where is Adam?"
Just as she finished, a blue-haired young man hurried in from outside with an angry look on his face. "What the hell were you guys doing? This mission is definitely not three stars. It’s at least… Ah, Lord Red Tail!”
Adam was complaining about the intelligence officer’s mistakes when he accidentally saw Red Tail’s figure and quickly saluted.
Red Tail waved her hand and asked directly, "You’ve fought against the hostile forces. What’s your impression?"
"The information on the hostile floating island is correct, but it’s a confrontation mission this time!" Adam said without hesitation, "What the hell was the reincarnation department doing? How could they mix a confrontation mission into the Blasphemer Project?!"
As soon as he said this, everyone suddenly realized.
If it was a confrontation mission, the opponents would be genuine reincarnators from the Myriad Heavens, and the mission difficulty would suddenly increase by more than half a star. No wonder Adam’s team had no way to fight back.
After all, the people in the team had to play the role of residents from the World of Gods and could only use abilities obtained from the Greater God Dimension. How could they compare to the enemy reincarnators?
Red Tail didn't have time to investigate what led to the mistake. She said coldly, "How do you plan to resolve this matter?"
Adam exchanged a glance with the young man in work clothes, and the latter responded, "In my opinion, we can only use outside help right now… such as arranging for Nancy to suddenly break through?"
"You might as well hope that meteorites will fall from the sky and kill all the enemies." Adam curled his lips.
Vivian was not a fool. How could she be unable to tell whether Nancy had actually broken through or not?
However, a person next to them suddenly shouted, "Everyone… Everyone, look!"
This person pointed to the screen on the side, which was exactly where the two floating islands were fighting. Meteorites were constantly falling from the sky, and bizarrely enough, they all smashed into the enemy side.
In less than a minute, Heavenly City Floating Island had achieved an overwhelming victory, and Vivian and her team’s mission was declared complete.
Everyone in White Mist was stunned, all staring at Adam with strange expressions. Even Adam himself was flabbergasted, wondering if he had any strange ability to turn speech into reality.
"Don't look at me like this. Actually, I… Hey, these meteorites seem to be writing out some words?" Adam seemed to have suddenly discovered something and said quickly.
Everyone turned and saw that the meteorites had indeed smashed out four giant words: King of the World.

chapters.title: Chapter 521: Blasphemer Project
chapters.content:
Even now, Vivian was still unable to accept the fact that the mission was suddenly declared complete, and she and her other two team members were sent directly back to the Greater God Dimension.
"It's a hidden time-limited mission," Nancy said with a sullen expression, placing her greatsword on the ground, her back looking a little powerless.
"What’s that?" Jonathan's expression looked equally ugly. They already learned from Vivian what happened after the four of them separated.
Since Adam was not summoned back by the Greater God Dimension, that meant he would never return.
Nancy glanced at him and explained, "The mission difficulty is higher than normal, and it’s extremely hard to complete the mission directly. However, there’s actually a time limit. As long as you can survive until the end of the time limit, the mission will be automatically completed."
Jonathan stared blankly for a long time before he said angrily, "The Greater God Dimension is too much! Since it’s a time-limited mission, why not tell us in advance?"
"If we knew the existence of the time limit in advance, we wouldn't try our best to complete the mission." Nancy sighed. "If we were allowed to simply stall for time, I’m afraid the mission difficulty would be on a whole other level."
Jonathan opened his mouth and closed it several times, but in the end, he could only sigh helplessly. "Sure enough, the Greater God Dimension really doesn’t give you any chance to take advantage of loopholes."
"It's all my fault, it's all my fault…" Vivian half-squatted on the ground, holding her head in her hands, and said in an extremely weak voice, "If I’d just persevered a little longer and didn’t give up so quickly, Adam wouldn't have died!"
Meteorites fell from the sky—Vivian naturally also saw this scene, so she knew that the mission was completed merely a few minutes after Adam’s death.
If she could’ve held on for a little longer, even staying behind to fight alongside Adam, the two of them would have a good chance of surviving.
Although Nancy also looked depressed, she still walked up to Vivian and patted her shoulder. "This is not your fault. Even I didn't expect this to be a time-limited mission…"
Vivian raised her head, a vacant look in her eyes, as if the conviction in her heart had collapsed once again.
The scene fell silent for a while, and Nancy didn't speak further. Adam's death had already made her haggard.
It wasn't until a long time later that Jonathan's voice slowly rang out, "If you don't want what happened today to repeat itself, then reach Tier 3 as soon as possible and enter the Greater God Plaza."
The Greater God Plaza was a place only Tier 3 reincarnators could enter. It was where all the reincarnators could exchange materials and information.
Nancy and the others were able to communicate with other reincarnators precisely because of the existence of the Greater God Plaza.
"Tier 3?" Vivian stared at Jonathan for a while, then nodded heavily.
……
In the exclusive small village provided for Nancy's team to rest, Jonathan and Nancy were talking alone after avoiding Vivian.
"We finally managed to smooth things over." Jonathan shook his head helplessly. "The people in the reincarnation department really are unreliable. They even assigned us a confrontation mission.”
Nancy couldn't help curling her lips. "It's a good thing they were able to come up with the idea of a time-limited mission… But say, why did so many meteorites fall that day?"
"Some bigshot probably intervened," Jonathan answered without raising his head. "It’s said that the backer behind our organization is the one who just ascended. Who knows what powers those bigshots have."
Nancy's knowledge was obviously superior to Jonathan’s, and she slowly shook her head. "Ghost Sea World is a plane-type astral world. Meteorites don’t even exist in that world… Someone who can do such a thing is definitely not your average Star Ruler."
Hearing this, Jonathan couldn't help feeling slightly startled, then replied, "Whatever! It’ll be clear once we complete the Vivian mission and return to the organization. Speaking of which, I really envy Adam, that fellow…"
Based on the normal script, Adam had to act as Vivian's spiritual mentor, so he actually got to “get off work” early this time.
Nancy also smiled but said nothing.
The current Nancy didn't look as cold as usual. She looked just like a normal person. If Vivian saw this scene, she would probably suspect that the Nancy she knew was fake.
In fact, that was exactly right. The person she knew was a fake Nancy, and even the name Nancy was fake. Everyone she saw in the Greater God Dimension were "actors" from White Mist.
Even the journey Vivian would experience next had been planned.
Which missions she’ll clear, which missions she’ll fail, and which missions will have her meeting key figures…
"After this mission is over, I won’t accept these kinds of missions again." Nancy said, "She’s such a good girl. If one day she finds out that everyone is lying to her, then…"
"Don't get soft-hearted and tell her the truth!" Jonathan's voice suddenly became louder, with a serious look on his face. "This will only kill everyone, do you understand?"
White Mist was not a benevolent organization. Jonathan knew this very well.
"I know," Nancy nodded and said expressionlessly.
……
"My Lord." Soon after Red Tail walked out of the observation room, she saw Gu Nan.
What descended was not Gu Nan's main body, but a clone. With Gu Nan's current realm, it wasn’t hard to create thousands of clones. Shadows already possessed this attribute in the first place.
"See those meteorites?" Gu Nan said with a light smile, "If you need this kind of assistance when you train blasphemers in the future, you can give me a list."
Red Tail was a little shocked and quickly nodded in agreement.
Even Nancy knew how difficult it was to create a meteorite shower in Ghost Sea World, so how could Red Tail not understand?
Not to mention, using meteorites to write out actual words. This meant Gu Nan could completely control the laws of heaven and earth according to his own wishes.
Even if the Star Ruler of that world wanted to do this kind of thing, it would still take a long time to prepare, let alone an outsider doing it.
This kind of power would definitely be a heaven-defying cheat if it was used to help a reincarnation organization. However, Red Tail didn't dare make Gu Nan work for her. She only dared to request such assistance from Gu Nan with matters involving the Blasphemer Project.
Red Tail knew very well that the Blasphemer Project would be Gu Nan's next focus, and even White Mist and the entire Divine Kingdom would do everything in their power to serve this purpose.
"Also," Gu Nan said again, "there are too few blasphemers right now. A few dozen people are not enough. With so many main planes in the World of Gods, how can there be a lack of candidates?"
Red Tail hurriedly nodded, but then responded, "The main problem is that we have to design mission plans for each blasphemer and also to free up manpower to play their teammates. It takes up too much manpower… If White Mist continues to recruit people, the organizational structure will become too bloated.”
Regarding this situation, Gu Nan thought for a while and said, "List out the groups in the Greater God Dimension project and hand them over to the Cabinet. White Mist will only be responsible for finding seedlings from now on."

chapters.title: Chapter 522: I Don't Cultivate
chapters.content:
Management was a science.
As a shut-in who only knew how to play games, Gu Nan didn’t actually know much about management. All he knew was to leave the professional matters to professionals.
If a professional refuses to do it, then find a way to get him to do it. If that still doesn't work, threaten him with a knife.
Therefore, when something like the Blasphemer Project—which had the highest priority and took precedence over everything else by Gu Nan’s orders—suddenly entered White Mist’s daily workload, all kinds of problems were bound to arise.
But discovering the problems right now wasn’t too late, and Gu Nan's countermeasures were effective.
Since the Greater God Dimension’s planning and preparation required too much manpower and affected White Mist’s normal operation, this part of the work could simply be handed over to another organization.
Even if they couldn’t do this work, they still knew how to push it onto someone else, right?
Shifting management of the Greater God Dimension to the Cabinet was also a more beneficial approach for the Divine Kingdom.
Because Gu Nan implemented the policy of "complete isolation", it was crucial for the Divine Kingdom itself to still maintain external exchanges, and the Greater God Dimension was a very good entry point.
……
Half a month later.
Gu Nanan was sitting in the Divine Kingdom while Yan Xiaoxiao was reporting on the progress of the Greater God Dimension and Blasphemer Project during this period.
"The Blasphemer Project is progressing quite smoothly. Currently, the number of candidates has exceeded one hundred, and nearly twenty of them have been evaluated as S-Ranked and have relatively high potential to inherit the Godheads."
"As for the Greater God Dimension, the Cabinet has now established the Greater God Department, which is responsible for handling these matters."
"Currently, we have prepared over fifty ownerless planes. All missions that the blasphemers will carry out will be formulated and screened by the Cabinet to avoid errors in mission difficulty evaluation ratings."
The Cabinet was indeed much more well-developed than an organization like White Mist in terms of execution of affairs.
At least for the missions issued by the Greater God Dimension, White Mist could only rely on reincarnation missions, but the Cabinet could prepare people to design missions from scratch. The gap in resources here was extremely huge.
After all, the Cabinet was the essence of the entire Divine Kingdom, and almost all its think tanks were included in it.
"Well done," Gu Nan praised with a nod. "The Cabinet needs a prime minister. Have you considered taking up this position?"
Of course his words were directed at Yan Xiaoxiao.
After becoming the spirit of the Divine Kingdom, Yan Xiaoxiao would never tire and could always maintain endless energy. She didn’t need to eat or sleep and could easily understand what was happening in every corner of the Divine Kingdom…
Such an existence was simply the perfect candidate for the administrator role.
"I would be happy to accept." Yan Xiaoxiao said with a chuckle, "If Teacher doesn’t mind that the Divine Kingdom will never have a second prime minister, that is."
Gu Nan shrugged, indicating that he didn't mind. Even the current Cabinet was only able to achieve such high efficiency largely thanks to Yan Xiaoxiao.
Moreover, after Yan Xiaoxiao became the spirit of the Divine Kingdom, it was almost impossible for her to betray Gu Nan because she herself coexisted with the Divine Kingdom.
……
"How does it feel to be the King of the World?" In Void Grotto Heaven, Yu Lian asked Gu Nan with a slight smile on her face.
"Not bad," Gu Nan replied casually. "But that Zero… Why does her accent sound like someone from the World of Gods?"
Although she spoke the language of the Myriad Heavens, Zero's words gave Gu Nan a familiar feeling, just like the way system NPCs spoke in his past life’s game.
Yu Lian cast him a meaningful glance. "You’re right. Zero's original body did come from the World of Gods. A long time ago, My Martial Ancestor and the other two Saints once visited the World of Gods and even participated in the First Divine War.”
"The First Divine War?" Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow.
The First Divine War happened before the current generation’s most active group of greater gods truly grew up, and it belonged entirely to the era of the older generation of gods.
If the two sides had contact or even dealings since a long time ago, then the backstory of the World of Gods here may be somewhat different from Gu Nan's memories.
Yu Lian just nodded slightly, waiting for Gu Nan to ask questions. Of course she didn't bring up this matter unintentionally. Rather, she was deliberately testing Gu Nan's origins.
The Myriad Heavens’ Unified Dao cultivators now had no doubts about Gu Nan's identity. After all, Austin personally verified Gu Nan’s identity as an Evil God.
But what deeds this Evil God accomplished in his past life and who he had contact with were still mysteries shrouded in fog.
Of course Yu Lian and the others tried every means to investigate, but they found nothing.
The ancient World of Gods was in the same era as the ancient Myriad Heavens. That was before the collapse of the three realms. There were almost no historical records handed down from that time, and future generations did not know what happened back then.
Gu Nan thought for a while. "Does Void Grotto Heaven have any records in this regard?"
Now that the Second Round was completed, Gu Nan had ways to escape from even Austin himself.
The Blasphemer Project was already in progress, so Gu Nan had enough time to do some things that interested him, such as exploring the mysteries of the World of Gods.
Zero's existence felt vaguely familiar, but he couldn't pinpoint where he’d seen her before. Perhaps he would only remember if he found her true body.
"Yes." Yu Lian's smile grew a little wider, as if she was waiting for Gu Nan to ask. "But in exchange for reading that information, I hope you can help with a matter."
Because they couldn’t threaten each other’s lives, Unified Dao powers often engaged in such transactions. Yu Lian was already extremely familiar with this.
Gu Nan also didn't mind paying some remuneration to obtain information in a time-saving and effort-saving way, so he nodded immediately. "What the matter?"
"I have a disciple who wants to study under you for a while," Yu Lian said, staring into Gu Nan's eyes.
Gu Nan couldn't help laughing in spite of himself. "Since you know I’m an Evil God, you should understand that there are some things that cannot be learned by studying."
"Of course." Yu Lian said, "She will learn by merely shadowing you, so you don't need to teach her anything. We at Void Grotto Heaven like to collect all kinds of cultivation routes."
"Ye Wu."
While she was talking, a young girl walked out from behind her with small, quick steps. She hurriedly stopped before Gu Nan and bowed. "Lord Gu Nan, my name is Ye Wu. You can call me Little Wu… Please take care of me!"
Gu Nan glanced at her and said noncommittally, "How long will she study for? I may have to go to the World of Gods soon."
"One… year." Yu Lian glanced at Gu Nan's expression. She originally wanted to say a hundred years, but considering Gu Nan's growth speed, she straight-out compressed that by a hundred times.
"No matter where you go, just take her with you. When the one-year agreement expires, Void Grotto Heaven’s records will be open to you."
"Alright." Gu Nan didn't have any objections. With his current abundance of time, he could still afford to wait a year. It was just a matter of heading to the World of Gods to investigate first.
Ye Wu seemed to be very excited when she heard Gu Nan agree. Her little face flushed bright red. "Then I’ll have to trouble you, Lord Gu Nan! Please don't pay attention to my existence. Be it cultivation or enlightenment, please go about it the same as usual."
"Same as usual?" Gu Nan glanced at her. "I usually don't cultivate; I just play."

chapters.title: Chapter 523: Old Hank
chapters.content:
The Blasphemer Project was a relatively time-consuming process.
In fact, after players successfully finished the Second Round, the main focus of game design changed from attracting new players to retaining existing players.
The developers hoped to get as many players addicted to the game as possible, so they provided more ways to kill time, such as allowing players to continuously train NPCs and have them hunt gods.
Because the Evil Value blasphemers could harvest from hunting gods was far greater than the amount earned from players killing gods themselves.
Of course, even in this case, players often still ran into the problem of not having enough gods to kill, so their Evil Value was never enough. In the end, they had no choice but to set their sights on the greater gods.
But how could greater gods be so easy to kill?
After the Second Round, even if the player wanted to kill opponents of the same level, it was far from the same as before.
After all, the greater gods themselves were a part of the very laws they ruled over. Just destroying the greater gods’ divine bodies could not completely kill them. Killing a greater god was a very time-consuming and labor-intensive task.
But right now, Gu Nan's advantage over the actual game was that he had a lot of time.
After all, the game was played by players, and a player’s time was not infinite. On the contrary, now… Well, in a sense, the current Gu Nan had infinite time.
So Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry at all. The Blasphemer Project was slowly advancing, and the corresponding Greater God Dimension required a lot of manpower and material resources to build.
Ideally, the fully-complete Greater God Dimension should be a self-sufficient system that controlled the overall situation of multiple ownerless planes and could throw blasphemers into them at any time. At the same time, it would also be able to obtain resources from each plane.
The present Greater God Dimension was still completely dependent on supply from the Divine Kingdom. At best, it could only be regarded as… the preliminary stage of socialism.
So Gu Nan's current plan was to wait for new developments in the Blasphemer Project and to go to the World of Gods to learn more about its history.
According to Yu Lian, as early as the First Divine War, the Saints from the Myriad Heavens had already started intervening in the World of Gods.
So what was the difference between the history there and Gu Nan's memories? This was worth investigating.
……
"It's your turn."
On the starship heading to the World of Gods, Gu Nan leisurely spoke to Ye Wu while holding a few cards in his hand.
Ye Wu was frowning heavily, wracking her brains. She wasn’t a genius like Yu Lian, who could master everything in seconds. Facing a very strategic game like black cards, she was tortured into misery for a while.
However, the somewhat dull Classmate Ye Wu was still studying meticulously, following Gu Nan's instructions and carefully learning how to… play cards.
Ye Wu, who was often assigned by Yu Lian to study under various bigshots, had actually seen much of the world.
She’d met all kinds of strange teachers. Let alone those who taught by playing cards, there were also those who taught through painting, farming, and even visiting brothels.
Therefore, Ye Wu studied very hard, even trying to understand the rules of black cards bit by bit and wondering whether there was any deeper meaning behind it.
‘Maybe there is a truth hidden in the law of playing cards?’
Gu Nan didn't take Ye Wu's thoughts to heart at all. He just found someone to play cards with because he had nothing to do…
During this trip to the World of Gods, Gu Nan truly changed his appearance. Not only did he change his attire, but even his height and appearance were also modified, all except his personality.
This couldn’t be helped. He was too famous now, and because he just advanced to Unified Dao, too many people in the current generation recognized his appearance.
As long as Gu Nan didn't want to hide his tracks everywhere he went, then it was necessary to change his face.
On the other hand, with Gu Nan's current status, he wasn’t suited for entering the World of Gods alone. That would be putting too big a target on himself. The thirteen greater gods were not fools.
Instead, no one would notice him if he blended in with the crowd.
After they finished two more rounds, Classmate Ye Wu suffered crushing defeat, as expected. If this was strip poker, she might even have to peel off her skin.
"I lost again. I’m so stupid!" Ye Wu wailed with distress, seemingly extremely dissatisfied with her own performance.
However, Ye Wu had always been persistent, and she did not lose heart. While thinking about the rules of the card game, she asked, "Gu… My Lord, where are we going this time?"
"Saint-Groux Continent," Gu Nan seemed to be in a good mood and offhandedly replied, "Regarding the history of gods, the Scholar Temple is probably the place with the most complete information."
Saint-Groux Continent was controlled by the Light Faction and managed by Jones, the God of Knowledge.
In the World of Gods, the most knowledgeable group was mages, while the most knowledgeable individual was definitely the God of Knowledge.
The God of Knowledge, also called the God of Scholars, possessed one of the oldest divine authorities. But as for the godhood itself… that had already changed hands several times over the generations.
However, the God of Knowledge was also one of the very rare cases where the god’s strength would grow with each successive generation’s God of Knowledge.
In the early days of the World of Gods, the God of Knowledge was just a weak god with an obscure divine authority and weak divinity, only having a few believers.
But as history developed, be it gods or mortals, knowledge was constantly accumulating, which invisibly strengthened the God of Knowledge.
Therefore, the current generation’s God of Knowledge had power at least on par with a Tier 9 god. If things continued like this, this god would become a greater god sooner or later.
"Are you two also heading to the Saint-Groux Continent?" A curious voice came from the side, speaking to Gu Nan and Ye Wu.
The two weren’t sitting in their own rooms and playing cards. Instead, they stayed in the lobby of the starship, and their conversations were naturally overheard by people around them.
Because this starship was very small and took a shortcut, it only took less than a few hours to reach the World of Gods, so there were no separate rooms for each passenger.
Gu Nan looked up. The person who spoke was an old man, but his appearance had obvious Caucasian features, and the style of his clothes was also from the World of Gods.
"That's right. You are?" Gu Nan's voice was very calm and his tone was indifferent, not very friendly.
The old man didn't mind and answered with a smile, "You can call me Old Hank. I'm from the Saint-Groux Continent, but I often go to the Myriad Heavens. I usually spend more time there."
Since there were Star Rulers like Daoist Lingyang, who lived in the World of Gods for a long time, in turn, there were naturally also gods who went to the Myriad Heavens.
But this Old Hank was not a god, just a normal Legend Rank expert.
Facing Old Hank's self-introduction, Gu Nan just nodded slightly and showed no intention of responding. Ye Wu quickly introduced herself but only referred to Gu Nan as her teacher.
"So you’re Void Grotto Heaven’s elite disciple!" Old Hank said quickly after hearing Ye Wu's introduction. He was indeed familiar with the Myriad Heavens and even knew to use the phrase "elite disciple".

chapters.title: Chapter 524: An Extra God
chapters.content:
Perhaps Ye Wu's origin made Old Hank misunderstand Gu Nan's identity, believing that Gu Nan also came from Void Grotto Heaven, and even the address he used was a bit weird.
"This… Daoist Priest." Old Hank smiled with some respect. The pronunciation of the word "Daoist Priest" was not very standard. "May I inquire about the purpose of your trip to Saint-Groux Continent? Perhaps I can help."
Gu Nan originally wanted to ignore him, but since this old man volunteered, he didn't mind using Old Hank to disguise his identity.
"We just want to go to the Scholar Temple and check some information."
There was nothing suspicious about this answer. At least six out of ten foreigners heading to Saint-Groux Continent were going to the Scholar Temple.
Old Hank was not surprised by this, evidently having expected it. "It just so happens that I, Old Hank, know a few priests from the Scholar Temple. Daoist Priest, why don’t I lead the way for you?"
Gu Nan agreed with a faint smile.
……
Just when Gu Nan was heading to the World of Gods again, the Heaven-God Alliance was facing a dilemma.
Xue Ren’s whereabouts were unknown and Immortal Empress Taisheng was busy repairing her destroyed astral world, so Zhuangxuan was the only person remaining by Zi Luo Elder’s side.
However, usually Zhuangxuan's ability was more than enough to handle the various matters by himself, but he really couldn't handle the problem this time.
Rolensia sent a message hoping that the Heaven-God Alliance would expel Gu Nan, or else she would voluntarily withdraw from the Heaven-God Alliance.
To put it simply, it was just three words— “Me or him!”
The message was very long, but it merely emphasized the dangers of the Evil God and the fact that Gu Nan would inevitably bring the world to ruin in the future. Even if the Heaven-God Alliance didn’t try to hunt him down, it could at least still kick this person out.
"What exactly is an Evil God?" Zhuangxuan frowned. "I’ve checked a lot of records, but such an existence has never been mentioned. However, many of the living gods say they’ve heard of related legends before."
Zi Luo Elder didn't find it strange and replied calmly, "Information on Evil Gods isn’t written down; it’s only passed down orally. This is a rule that only existed in ancient times. They believe that writing about Evil Gods will lead to the advent of evil."
Hearing this, Zhuangxuan could only shake his head wordlessly.
If there was any major difference between Star Rulers and gods, it was that the element of mysticism was more important in the gods’ world, to the point where even the greater gods would be affected.
Gods believed in fate, believed in ancient legends, and even believed that the more ancient the existence, the more powerful they were… To the Myriad Heavens, this sounded like utter nonsense.
For example, the first and second generation Saints in ancient times would definitely be no match for modern Unified Dao cultivators in a real fight. This was the result of overwhelming superiority in terms of knowledge, techniques, and laws.
As the discussion on Evil Gods failed to produce any results, Zhuangxuan began to seriously consider the situation and suggested, "The core of the Heaven-God Alliance is still you, Esteemed Elder. I think it’s best not to respond to this matter."
"What if Rolensia insists on withdrawing from the Heaven-God Alliance?" Zi Luo Elder asked with a smile.
"Then let her quit." Zhuangxuan said without hesitation, "Even if we force her to stay, it will still be impossible for her to ever cooperate with Senior Gu Nan in the future. But after this incident, we do have to find opportunities to make Senior Gu Nan also withdraw from the organization.”
Zhuangxuan knew very well that Rolensia was definitely not an exception. In fact, she was just a representative of the godly members.
As long as Gu Nan was in the Heaven-God Alliance, it was impossible for the gods to feel a sense of belonging to the organization. And without the support of the gods, the Heaven-God Alliance would no longer be worthy of having “God” in its name.
Zi Luo Elder sighed softly. "What we want is a complete organization, not a single individual… I'll leave this matter to you."
"Yes."
……
The Scholar Temple was actually very easy to find.
Or rather, on the Saint-Groux Continent, one could see Scholar Temples everywhere. It wasn’t just a single building, but the knowledge inside was all the same.
In more modern terms, it was a huge database with countless terminals spread across the continent, and any one of them could be accessed.
"Daoist Priest, Miss Ye, this is the Scholar Temple I'm talking about." Old Hank led Gu Nan and Ye Wu along and found a Scholar Temple in the corner of a rural town.
This temple really was dilapidated. Two of the pillars in front of the door were even broken. It was more accurate to say that one shouldn’t expect a temple in a place like this to be luxurious.
Ye Wu cast Old Hank an odd look, which made the latter look slightly embarrassed as he quickly explained.
"I’ve been staying in the Myriad Heavens for the past two years. In the past… In the past, this place used to be quite popular. However, the records in the Scholar Temples are all connected, and the information can be accessed from any branch."
"No matter." Gu Nan waved his hand. Of course he knew the database in the Scholar Temples was connected, and he much rather preferred an obscure location like this in the first place.
Old Hank really did know the priest of this temple, and the priest here seemed to be very friendly, quickly letting Gu Nan and Ye Wu inside.
This was also related to the God of Knowledge. Every single generation’s God of Knowledge had opened their temples to the outside world, and anyone could come to consult any records.
Gu Nan didn’t choose to slaughter his way inside this time. On one hand, he had more time now and didn’t need to pursue extreme efficiency. On the other hand, he did not want to expose his identity prematurely.
If he killed people inside the temple, even if Jones couldn’t trace his whereabouts, he would immediately realize that Gu Nan had come to the World of Gods.
"Daoist Priest, what information are you looking for?"
"Ancient myths and epics," Gu Nan casually answered. The ancient era of the World of Gods had no such thing as historical records; only myths and epics remained.
"Oh, okay." Old Hank nodded repeatedly, then began to think hard. "Regarding ancient mythology, that should be in…"
"Legends Section 19, this way." Gu Nan knew the ropes and led the way.
Ye Wu naturally followed quickly, while Old Hank looked surprised. "Daoist Priest, have you been to a Scholar Temple before?"
Gu Nan just nodded without responding. Much of what players knew about the game world came from the Scholar Temple. This was similarly true for Gu Nan, who often came here to investigate information.
After all, the game background had way too much content and was too complex. It was impossible for even top players to stuff all that information into their heads. They were just good at finding the information they needed most.
Gu Nan barely paused as he flipped through several files in quick succession, but the results were no different from what he remembered.
Old Hank couldn't help taking a sneak peek and found that the information Gu Nan was looking at was all related to the First Divine War, and he suddenly felt confident.
‘This Daoist Priest is probably interested in the history of the World of Gods, so…’
"Who is this God of Twilight?" Gu Nan suddenly stopped and pointed at a name in the file.
He was certain that there was absolutely no God of Twilight in his memories.
"It should be some ancient god…" Old Hank said unknowingly. He was just a mortal and did not have a deep understanding of gods.
However, at this moment, a voice came from next to the group. "Young man, why do you want to know about the God of Twilight?"

chapters.title: Chapter 525: Crescent City
chapters.content:
An old man in a priest's robe appeared in front of Gu Nan and the others. Strangely enough, his appearance was exactly the same as that of Old Hank.
But though they were both old men, Old Hank looked like a merchant who’d been exposed to wind and rain and was often on the road, but this person had a completely different air and looked full of energy.
Even though they had the same appearance, anyone who saw the two would definitely not mistake them for each other.
"A-Are you twins?" Ye Wu stared at the two curiously, glancing at Old Hank and then at the old priest.
Old Hank looked helpless. "Yes, this is my older brother. You can call him Hank."
"You’re both called Hank?" Ye Wu obviously didn't know much about the culture of the World of Gods, so she didn't understand why there would be two Hanks in one family.
"I'm Old Hank," Old Hank emphasized.
Priest Hank wasn’t affected by the chat between the two and kept his eyes on Gu Nan. "Young man, you haven't answered my question yet."
But Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry to answer. He just looked at the priest. "Are you Jones’s apostle?"
Jones was this generation’s God of Knowledge. Anyone who could wear priest attire in the Scholar Temple was probably his apostle.
"You…" Anger flashed across the old priest’s face when he saw the other party directly calling his god’s name, but then he seemed to have realized something and asked in a heavy voice, "Who is Your Excellency?"
Gu Nan withdrew his gaze and continued to browse through the files. He wasn’t interested in chatting with a mere apostle.
A God of Twilight appeared out of thin air in the epic, and even an apostle paid special attention to this god. This meant that Jones had long known something was off.
But was the God of Twilight the only extra god here?
Gu Nan looked through the ancient records one by one. Not only the First Divine War, but the entire history of the World of Gods was within the scope of his research.
However, he found no other differences as obvious as the God of Twilight.
After all, Gu Nan was just a gamer in his past life and didn't do systematic research, so it was impossible to memorize the entire history of the World of Gods.
For example, did four or five gods die in a certain battle in the Second Divine War—who the hell could remember this? By the time players first entered the game, the Fourth Divine War had already ended.
‘I’ll have to start with this God of Twilight.’ Gu Nan immediately decided when he couldn't find any other clues.
Since such a god appeared out of thin air, he would always be able to find some clues by following this god’s journey and tracing the descendants he left behind.
Gu Nan began to carefully search for specific information about the God of Twilight. The amount of information he needed to find this time was greater, but he was more efficient now.
Because he discovered that this God of Twilight had a historical biography.
After entering the modern era, the World of Gods also had history books and the like. In particular, the rise of mage organizations among the mortals contributed significantly to this development, as mages held great interest in researching the stories of gods.
Most mages were unbelievers, and some of the especially zealous mages would even shout slogans such as "Gods are just more powerful mages".
Among them, theological scholars would research the entire history of both well-known and obscure gods and compile their life stories into biographies for future generations to analyze.
However, while Gu Nan was busy investigating the God of Twilight, Priest Hank’s situation turned a little awkward, because he was completely ignored by Gu Nan.
"Your Excellency…" Priest Hank suppressed his anger and looked directly at Gu Nan.
However, before he could speak further, a shadow hand stretched out from behind the temple and directly dragged the priest into the shadows.
In order to prevent Jones from noticing, Gu Nan didn’t kill the other party directly this time, but instead… dragged him into the shadows first, then killed him.
In this way, in the God of Knowledge’s senses, this apostle just disappeared mysteriously. Who knows when they might get around to investigating this?
"Daoist Priest!" Old Hank suddenly gave a furious roar, his eyes widening. No matter what, Priest Hank was still his big brother...
"Oh, there's one more." Gu Nan looked up from the files at Old Hank, and then the shadow hand reappeared.
After Old Hank was also dragged into the shadows, the Scholar Temple’s library became quiet, with only Ye Wu following Gu Nan with a pale face.
Even though she’d heard of Lord Gu Nan's cruel and ruthless reputation before leaving, she didn’t think that—given his current realm—he would still attack these ordinary people.
‘It’s truly unimaginable… Is this also what Master wants me to learn?’
Ye Wu, who was wholeheartedly devoted to learning, thought as such.
After all, these days, Ye Wu finally realized that Gu Nan wasn’t joking back then. He really did play every day and never cultivated.
This was truly inconceivable. Even Unified Dao bigshots like Yu Lian and Song Fei needed to constantly review and consolidate their own foundations, or else they might fall behind.
