Daoist Yellow Springs said he saw Jiu Po, but Gu Nan knew all too well that the other party’s avatar—the God of Twilight—never appeared in the game. Instead, the NPC related to Zero appeared as normal.
In other words, Gu Nan first noticed the other party precisely because the actual history here did not match the one from his memories.
If people who came from the Gap World could all see a part of history, then how could these discrepancies be explained?
After having the two sides’ information for comparison, Gu Nan's work proceeded smoothly. It was only by observing the entire history of the World of Gods that Gu Nan made new discoveries.
There were actually quite a few extra gods like the God of Twilight, but most of them didn’t have clear titles unique to gods, and even their appearances in the World of Gods were short-lived.
This group mainly appeared during the Third Divine War and remained so until now. They were clearly Star Rulers from the Myriad Heavens.
However, like the former God of Twilight, due to their low levels, their influence on the general trend of history was insignificant, and the changes to history were merely limited to the local regions.
Especially after the Fourth Divine War, the entire World of Gods was reshuffled, and Star Rulers withdrew en-masse, making the current World of Gods similar to the one from Gu Nan’s memories.
"Not a single person from the Myriad Heavens appeared in the game…" After Gu Nan came to this conclusion, he couldn't help slowly standing up.
This conspicuous regularity that completely separated and isolated the two worlds from each other couldn’t possibly be mere coincidence.
‘The Gap World probably holds other secrets. It's impossible for Daoist Yellow Springs to stay in the gap between two worlds for thousands of years just for some tranquility.’ Gu Nan had a suspicion in his mind.
Gu Nan had contact with Jiu Po and knew that back when Daoist Yellow Springs left, he claimed to be looking for his "hometown".
But no matter what, ultimately, Gu Nan still needed to increase his strength.
If Gu Nan was already at Tier 15 right now or even post-Third Round, then he could simply take over the two major worlds, gathering both worlds’ power to investigate the gap between the worlds and explore the secrets inside.
Just when Gu Nan was thinking about his next steps, Yan Xiaoxiao suddenly projected a human form and came up to him.
"Teacher, something happened." Yan Xiaoxiao's face was unusually grave. "An Tiansheng died, and Lan Si and Xie Yun were also heavily injured."
Gu Nan slowly turned his head, his face expressionless. "Who did it?"
"Cloud Dream Heaven… But the root of this matter still lies in the incident with Imperial Glory Heaven," Yan Xiaoxiao explained as concisely as possible.
The matter wasn’t complicated.
Although Gu Nan cut his Divine Kingdom off from the outside world, people inside the Divine Kingdom would still go out to carry out trade and daily tasks.
And some people from the player army, like An Tiansheng and Xie Yun, also spent most of their time outside the Divine Kingdom.
This incident involved a relatively important trade where a batch of top-tier resources needed to be transported, so Red Tail invited Lan Si, An Tiansheng, and Xie Yun to jointly keep watch.
But even with such a lineup, they still received a powerful blow. The attacker was none other than Cloud Dream Heaven.
"Cloud Dream Heaven is connected to Imperial Glory Heaven?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow.
"The previous Star Ruler of Imperial Glory Heaven used to be good friends with Dream Immortal. It was also during the battle that caused Dream Immortal to fall into a deep slumber that he suffered irreparable injuries."
Yan Xiaoxiao had obviously investigated thoroughly and sorted out the whole incident.
Finally, she added, "In addition, we found out that the Heaven-God Alliance might have been involved behind the scenes here as well…"
But Gu Nan stood up and interrupted her, "That’s no longer important."
……
Cloud Dream Heaven.
Standing in front of Dream Immortal was Huo Kui. After hearing about the conflict between the two sides, he rushed to Cloud Dream Heaven as soon as possible.
"This matter is not simple." Huo Kui said, "Taisheng is not someone who likes to rely on others. She didn't ask you for help before, so why would she suddenly do it now?"
Dream Immortal smiled faintly. "I know. But I watched Taisheng grow up. Now that things have come to this, I have no reason to stay out of it."
Huo Kui was still trying to dissuade her, "Gu Nan’s massacre of Imperial Glory Heaven happened before he ascended to Unified Dao. Now…"
"No one said this is revenge." Dream Immortal sneered, "It's just a normal conflict. If Gu Nan is dissatisfied, then he can talk to me."
Huo Kui couldn't help giving a deep sigh. He knew his old friend was determined to oppose Gu Nan.
But she had clearly witnessed Gu Nan's power. Back then, she didn’t even take revenge for her son’s death, yet she was now taking action just for an outsider?
Huo Kui glanced at Dream Immortal's calm face again, then finally nodded slightly.
Seeing that he finally understood her intentions, Dream Immortal couldn't help smiling. But just when she was about to speak, her expression suddenly changed.
"Gu Nan went to Imperial Glory Heaven!" A cold glint flashed through Dream Immortal's eyes. "Is he planning to attack Taisheng, just like this?"
It would be too shameless for a mighty Unified Dao bigshot to attack directly without any evidence.
"You'd better head to Imperial Glory Heaven immediately." Huo Kui, who had witnessed Gu Nan's rise and knew his style, couldn't help saying, "He’s indeed capable of such a thing."
On the other side, in the Imperial Glory Heaven that was just rebuilt not long ago.
An enormous shadow greatsword tens of thousands of meters long fell like a meteorite and smashed into Immortal Empress Taisheng’s just-rebuilt palace.
"Gu Nan!"

chapters.title: Chapter 537: Three Buddha And Evil Demon
chapters.content:
"Gu Nan!"
Following Immortal Empress Taisheng's enraged roar, all the power in Imperial Glory Heaven surged, converging upon a single point as it headed for Gu Nan.
Although the rebuilt Imperial Glory Heaven wasn’t as powerful as before, Immortal Empress Taisheng could now exercise 100% control over the astral world.
In such circumstances, Immortal Empress Taisheng’s burst damage was even more powerful than before.
Unfortunately, the current Gu Nan was vastly different from earlier. He didn’t even need to use the Evil God physique. Just the law of shadows alone was enough to wreck the enemy!
Gu Nan casually pointed to the ground, and the shadow sword thousands of meters long was instantly ignited, engulfing the entire palace in flames formed from shadows.
The astral world power Immortal Empress Taisheng just drew out couldn’t withstand the shadow flames at all, being burned to nothing in the blink of an eye and even turning into the shadows’ nourishment.
This was an attack he learned from Austin.
Light and shadow were indeed connected. Although the holy light was extremely tyrannical, shadows could also display similar properties, and its assimilation ability was even stronger than that of the holy light.
So under the furious glare of Immortal Empress Taisheng, who was about to cough up blood, most of the Imperial Glory Heaven she’d worked so hard to rebuild was destroyed by a fire.
This couldn’t be helped. During the initial stages of empire-type astral worlds’ construction, the top priority was naturally concentrating resources to build the political and economic center, so Gu Nan was able to cleanly burn the most important location to the ground.
"Gu Nan, what grudge do you have against me? To destroy my astral world twice…"
"Dream Immortal touched my people, so you’ll have to repay this debt," Gu Nan casually answered without any change in expression while standing in the air, coldly gazing down.
Immortal Empress Taisheng really wanted to cough up blood this time.
Immortal Empress Taisheng had also heard about the fact that a Star Ruler in Cloud Dream Heaven attacked several of Gu Nan's subordinates due to the earlier matter concerning herself, but she didn’t take it seriously.
Because she had a clear conscience—this matter had nothing to do with her at all, so how could anyone pin the blame on her head?
Besides, Gu Nan was already a grand Unified Dao bigshot. Even if he was dissatisfied with this matter, he should still retaliate against Cloud Dream Heaven. What reason would he have to come here?
Even Song Fei, who was famous for his overprotectiveness, had never done such an unreasonable thing before!
But Gu Nan proved through his actions that sorry, the strong really can do whatever they want.
Gu Nan just stood in the raging sea of flames, waiting for Dream Immortal’s arrival. He never thought about negotiations or the like. He only knew to force the enemy out, then beat them into submission.
But to his surprise, the first visitor was not Dream Immortal, but Zi Luo Elder.
After Zi Luo Elder appeared, he first extinguished the shadow flames that Gu Nan casually released, then blocked Immortal Empress Taisheng proactively behind him. He sighed. "Gu Nan, you both ultimately belong to the Heaven-God Alliance, so why don't you stop here this time?"
As his words fell, Immortal Empress Taisheng couldn't help casting him a surprised glance. Everyone knew Gu Nan would never just stop halfway. ‘So Zi Luo Elder’s goal… Is he trying to force Gu Nan to withdraw from the Heaven-God Alliance?’
Immortal Empress Taisheng was also someone who dealt with schemes for many years. She immediately understood Zi Luo Elder’s true intention and was even able to connect more dots…
But no matter what, Gu Nan's withdrawal from the Heaven-God Alliance was something she was happy to see. At least from now on, the Heaven-God Alliance would be able to support her if Gu Nan ever dared to attack her astral world again.
But neither of them anticipated Gu Nan's reaction.
"Sure, the matter this time will no longer concern her." Gu Nan nodded. In any case, everything that should be burned had already been burned, so of course this matter no longer concerned Immortal Empress Taisheng.
Zi Luo Elder also heard his unspoken implication and said with a slightly dark expression, "There can’t be a next time either… If you attack your colleagues in the organization without any reason again, I can only ask you to leave the Heaven-God Alliance."
This old man had also realized that he must not beat around the bush in front of Gu Nan, or else he’d be led into a ditch.
"Alright." Sure enough, Gu Nan was quite straightforward this time. The Heaven-God Alliance no longer held any value to him, so of course he didn’t care about leaving.
Zi Luo Elder fell silent, seemingly considering the matter. He did not give an immediate response.
At this moment, Dream Immortal's figure suddenly descended. With pink lotus flowers under her feet, she walked from the horizon step by step, covering the entire distance in just a short instant.
A long lotus path appeared in the sky, making people feel like they were inside a dream.
"Gu Nan." Dream Immortal's gaze landed on Gu Nan, and her voice seemed to travel from the distant horizon like an illusory dream, "I advise you not to act rashly. Take a closer look at who came this time."
Her steps paused slightly, making way for several figures behind her.
Academic Heaven’s Song Fei, Three Buddha Heaven’s Fa Kong, and Alkaid Heaven’s Huo Kui.
Huo Kui was Dream Immortal's close friend. After he realized this was an ambush against Gu Nan, he did not refuse her invitation and participated.
Nothing more needed to be said about Song Fei; he was already Gu Nan's old "friend". However, he’d already given up on revenge, yet he still showed up here. It was apparent that he had another goal.
So the cause fell onto the last person.
Three Buddha Heaven’s Fa Kong.
Three Buddha Heaven was the only plane among the original Thirteen Heavens with a basis in Buddhism. In a sense, Three Buddha Heaven was also the true holy land of Buddhism, the place that all Buddhist disciples most yearned to enter.
In terms of history and origin, Three Buddha Heaven was actually very ancient. However, this astral world also experienced several ups and downs. The current Three Buddha Heaven was very different from the past.
The astral world was named "Three Buddha", which meant there were three Buddhist ancestors in the astral world when it was established. After changing owners several times, the current Star Ruler was the great monk before Gu Nan.
Monk Fa Kong.
"Amitabha." Monk Fa Kong smiled, as if he was practicing Zen Buddhism, even though beneath his feet were living beings who had just suffered a calamity. "Benefactor Gu has committed too many murders, so it is better to put down the butcher’s knife and live in the Buddha's Pure Land with this humble monk to attain peace."
Although these words were convoluted, the meaning was very clear—he wanted to gather everyone's strength to capture Gu Nan and seal him inside Three Buddha Heaven!
Three Buddha Heaven was precisely such a strange astral world. Its strength was affected by the intensity of the believers’ faith, as well as the evil demons sealed in it.
The more evil demons that were sealed in Three Buddha Heaven and the more powerful they were, the stronger Three Buddha Heaven’s Buddhist power would grow.
And this time, Monk Fa Kong was obviously eyeing the "evil demon" called Gu Nan.
Logically speaking, a guy like Gu Nan who killed so wantonly should have been targeted by Three Buddha Heaven a long time ago. But he was still weak in his early years, so much so that the mighty Three Buddha Heaven felt such a weakling was beneath their notice.
And once Gu Nan truly became famous, his strength shot up too quickly. Before Three Buddha Heaven could react, he was already a Unified Dao powerhouse.
But this only made Fa Kong more interested in him—a Unified Dao "evil demon" had never appeared before!

chapters.title: Chapter 538: Four Enemies
chapters.content:
What satisfied Monk Fa Kong even more was that Gu Nan's past decisiveness when killing already earned him countless enemies, and even among the Unified Dao existences, many were willing to attack him.
After all these motives and conditions matured, today’s situation became possible.
Fa Kong, Song Fei, Dream Immortal, and Huo Kui ambushing and killing Gu Nan… Saying killing was a bit too much; they did not expect to actually kill Gu Nan.
As long as they cooperated with Monk Fa Kong's unique technique and sealed Gu Nan inside Three Buddha Heaven, this world would undoubtedly be a much more peaceful place.
As for Zi Luo Elder, he just happened to be in the right place at the right time. Although he’d long wanted to force Gu Nan out of the Heaven-God Alliance and also took the opportunity to secretly push events to this point, he had no intention of completely falling out with Gu Nan.
Including Gu Nan, six Unified Dao bigshots had gathered in the small Imperial Glory Heaven. This was an extremely rare scene.
Gu Nan's gaze swept across the four’s faces, finally landing on Song Fei.
The next instant, his figure suddenly disappeared as a punch headed for Song Fei's face. Only then did Gu Nan’s voice come belatedly, "First one."
At Gu Nan's level, reaction and speed no longer mattered. The pure strength and speed of the Evil God physique almost formed laws such as "sure hit" and "breaking through anything". In the end, it still came down to a contest of laws.
It's just that the laws represented by the Evil God physique far exceeded the precedence of normal laws, so a huge black hole immediately broke out at Song Fei’s location.
Gu Nan’s single punch instantly pierced through space itself.
Song Fei almost coughed blood onto Gu Nan's face. On the surface, it was Dream Immortal who started this conflict, and behind the scenes, it was Monk Fa Kong who planned this ambush. He, Song Fei, was just here to help out, so why was he the “first one”?
However, he had no time to question anything right now. He quickly waved his ruler and escaped from the black hole Gu Nan punched out.
Song Fei's laws weren’t really special, but they were vigorous and tenacious. They couldn’t be completely destroyed very easily and could always find room to turn the tables.
But Gu Nan put tremendous pressure on Song Fei as soon as he struck—this was a monster whose physical body became so powerful that every move was enough to form laws!
Gu Nan was unyielding after he gained the upper hand. He stepped forward and reappeared behind Song Fei, throwing another punch at his head.
"Amitabha!"
Naturally, the three around him couldn't just sit back and watch Song Fei get beaten up. Monk Fa Kong chanted the Buddha’s name and attacked first.
Gu Nan had seen Buddhist experts before. Back when he advanced to Tier 4, the maiden Wu Gui was the reincarnation of the Buddha of Ten Thousand Samsara.
Her Palm-Sized Buddha Kingdom once left an impression on Gu Nan.
But compared to Monk Fa Kong, the difference was as great as heaven and earth. As the only Unified Dao Buddhist cultivator in the world, Monk Fa Kong had the power to suppress all evil demons.
Golden light filled the sky, almost dyeing most of Imperial Glory Heaven gold.
Dream Immortal and Huo Kui struck simultaneously, and the power of the dream realm suddenly converged, directly affecting Gu Nan himself.
Huo Kui, on the other hand, donned his full-body golden armor, holding a spear in his hand and thrusting it at Gu Nan.
At Huo Kui's realm, his spear was composed entirely of laws. It was capable of ignoring all physical defenses and directly attacking Gu Nan's mind.
Gu Nan aimed a punch at Song Fei's head as he faced attacks from three Unified Dao cultivators, but he didn't care.
Tank them!
Gu Nan had never changed his fighting style ever since his debut. This was true even after entering Unified Dao.
The exceedingly tyrannical punch landed, its power comparable to the law of destruction. The punch instantly destroyed Song Fei's body while Gu Nan himself also took the attacks from everyone else.
The power of dreams fully manifested, causing his body to begin to twist and deform, like a monster in a dream.
Under the light of the Buddha, Gu Nan's body as a "monster" quickly started to melt and disintegrate.
And the golden spear from Huo Kui was destroying Gu Nan's will, slowing his movements.
Song Fei reassembled his body to the side, his face slightly pale. It could be said that Gu Nan's punch destroyed part of his laws and caused some damage to him, but it was not fatal.
Correspondingly, Gu Nan himself definitely had graver injuries.
But he never expected Gu Nan to completely ignore his own sorry state, instead doggedly chasing Song Fei with another punch!
"Are you crazy?!" Song Fei no longer had the energy to care about his manners and roared as he swung down the ruler without hesitation at Gu Nan.
Both sides would suffer grievously if Gu Nan fought to the death like this… And if he fought like this, even Unified Dao existences would really die!
The ruler utterly failed to block Gu Nan's movements. He didn't care about his injuries at all; he just wanted to take Song Fei's head.
Blasted apart with one punch!
When his body was destroyed for the second time, Song Fei lost all interest in ambushing Gu Nan. He directly took back all his laws and fled to his own astral world.
Gu Nan's two punches caused too much damage to him. He was just here to help out, so how could he be willing to risk his life?
Once Gu Nan saw Song Fei leave, he stood still and twisted his neck.
Due to the dream realm’s ability to distort objects, Gu Nan almost twisted his head off.
But his recovery ability was so powerful that even such injuries could be healed in the blink of an eye.
There were only three enemies left before him. Gu Nan glanced around again, his gaze finally stopping on Huo Kui. "Second one."
Huo Kui felt as if he was being watched by a poisonous snake, and his heart suddenly skipped a beat.
The next second, he experienced Song Fei's fate. He felt a pain in the back of his head as his golden armor shattered at a speed visible to the naked eye, and even his own body began to fall apart.
Nevertheless, Huo Kui started out as a martial artist and was also stronger than Song Fei. He reacted viciously and managed to impale Gu Nan’s forehead with his spear.
Gu Nan didn't even try to dodge, letting the golden spear pierce his head, and then blasted apart his opponent with a punch.
"Third one." In the boundless bloody mist, Gu Nan pulled the golden spear out of his head and tossed it aside, then looked at Dream Immortal.
The corners of Dream Immortal's lips twitched slightly. Huo Kui also did not reappear after his physical body was destroyed. This was tantamount to persuading her to give up.
Although Gu Nan was extremely formidable in battle, at least he couldn't chase them to the ends of the world.
What Dream Immortal truly couldn't accept was how anyone could still forcibly kill others while tanking attacks from three Unified Dao powerhouses.
Fa Kong's Buddhist light suppressed all evil demons. Under normal circumstances, their opponent should have been sealed long ago.
"Amitabha!" Monk Fa Kong chanted and stood in front of Dream Immortal, blocking her from Gu Nan’s sight. He also knew that at this point, he had to take the lead.
This monk, who was always smiling, stared at Gu Nan with a soft sigh. "Benefactor, you risked your life to injure two comrades, but you’ve likely also suffered heavy injuries. Why head for a dead end?"
"It would be better to go with this humble monk to the Buddha's realm and cleanse the murderous intent in your heart."
"Three Buddha Heaven? I will pay it a visit eventually." Gu Nan said with a vicious smile, "I just want to kill you monks, or… Mm, there’s no ‘or’."

chapters.title: Chapter 539: Seal
chapters.content:
Gu Nan was indeed heavily injured.
The strength of his physical body far surpassed those of the same level and was so powerful that he could forcibly destroy Unified Dao bigshots with just his physical body.
But even such a Gu Nan was not an invincible being who could never be hurt. Directly tanking three Unified Dao experts’ attacks still caused great damage to his body.
Huo Kui's final spear attack right before his body crumpled was especially brutal, directly destroying most of Gu Nan's soul. If Gu Nan was a traditional Unified Dao cultivator, he wouldn’t even be able to use any power of laws after this.
But unfortunately, Gu Nan dared to fight like this precisely because of his incredible regeneration ability and the confidence that he could fight or escape whenever he wanted.
"Third one," Gu Nan's cold gaze fell on Dream Immortal's face as he repeated this sentence.
Dream Immortal's heart tensed up slightly. The lessons learned from Song Fei and Huo Kui were right before her eyes. Even if Monk Fa Kong was standing protectively in front of her, she still couldn't afford to be careless.
The power of dreams turned slightly sluggish as she withdrew some from Gu Nan and enveloped herself protectively.
Dream Immortal's figure started to turn illusory, placing herself between dreams and reality to ensure that even if Gu Nan attacked instantly, he wouldn’t be able to immediately destroy her.
Sure enough, Gu Nan's figure instantly disappeared at this moment.
Dream Immortal's body suddenly became completely illusory. Even if this state consumed a lot of power, it was still better than being destroyed by Gu Nan.
Monk Fa Kong also raised his hand abruptly, and the prayer beads from his wrist scattered in all directions, falling all around Dream Immortal.
He actually used a protective magic treasure directly on Dream Immortal, completely disregarding himself despite the risk that Gu Nan might also switch targets and attack him.
However… Gu Nan had vanished.
Dream Immortal’s act of placing herself in the dream realm despite the enormous power consumption and the prayer bead magic treasure Monk Faking immediately activated… were all in vain.
"He ran away?" Dream Immortal waited for a long time to confirm that Gu Nan’s aura was completely gone and couldn't help blurting out.
She originally thought Gu Nan was lurking nearby, but she finally realized what happened after the power of dreams and the Buddhist light simultaneously covered their surroundings and still couldn’t detect any trace of Gu Nan.
However, Monk Fa Kong's expression changed slightly. "Not good!"
……
Gu Nan had always been capable of doing something as shameless as bullying juniors weaker than him, even when he was already a mighty Unified Dao powerhouse.
He could even casually slaughter Imperial Glory Heaven, so why would Three Buddha Heaven be an exception?
Monk Fa Kong realized this possibility and rushed back to his astral world as soon as possible. However, to his surprise, Gu Nan was not here.
Three Buddha Heaven was very peaceful, without any sign of foreign invasion.
Just as Monk Fa Kong returned, another scream came from Imperial Glory Heaven. Dream Immortal’s waiting paid off as Gu Nan's attack finally arrived, but she would definitely not like this kind of attack.
In just a short while, Gu Nan had recovered over half of his injuries due to avoiding all attacks in that period.
Gu Nan, who was freed from the dream realm’s influence, immediately appeared behind Dream Immortal and tore apart the power of dreams protecting her.
However, the dream realm’s protection was still effective. Dream Immortal was not destroyed instantly like Song Fei and Huo Kui. Instead, she used the dream realm to counterattack, engulfing Gu Nan's body in an instant.
After close contact with the power of dreams, the law clung to Gu Nan's body like a nightmare. Every move he made would cause his body to be torn apart and suffer horrific wounds.
At the same time, the Evil God physique was rapidly regenerating and recovering, allowing Gu Nan to remain in a state where he was about to die but not completely dead or destroyed yet.
Dream Immortal was also a great power who experienced major battles and was the same type of person as Huo Kui at heart.
Faced with such a desperate situation, the thought of fleeing never even occurred to her. She hardened her resolve, and all the laws of the dream realm suddenly surged towards Gu Nan.
Dream Immortal knew all too well that Gu Nan's strength lay in his explosive power and unparalleled speed. If they want to catch him, they must wait for an opportunity to be created when Gu Nan makes the first attack.
Now was the best opportunity!
"Do it!" Following Dream Immortal's shout, Gu Nan only felt his consciousness sway slightly while he himself had completely fallen into a dream.
Endless Buddhist light engulfed Gu Nan again. Amplified by the power of dreams, its intensity was several times Monk Fa Kong’s own power.
The radiance shone on Gu Nan, causing his body to rapidly melt. But his punch had already landed on Dream Immortal before his body could melt completely.
This Unified Dao bigshot who just returned from a long slumber was instantly blown apart by this punch. And because she overexerted herself to attack just now, the damage she suffered was even greater than that of Song Fei and Huo Kui.
People who were ruthless towards others were oftentimes even more ruthless towards themselves, and Dream Immortal was undoubtedly this kind of person.
Fa Kong appeared, continuously drawing out the power of his astral world without a care for the consequences. All the power in Three Buddha Heaven was mobilized, crushing down like a huge weight.
Although Gu Nan's body melted, everyone knew he wasn’t truly dead. A Unified Dao existence couldn’t be killed so easily.
A ball of shadows emitting black light was completely surrounded by a golden radiance. This was Gu Nan’s law of shadows.
Shadows were everywhere and ever-present. Normally, they couldn’t be trapped at all.
Only a true Buddhist powerhouse like Monk Fa Kong could create a domain with endless Buddhist light and extract all the laws in its range.
This was his method of suppressing evil demons, and he wanted to use this to seal Gu Nan away.
At this time, Song Fei and Huo Kui also appeared simultaneously. A ruler and a golden spear descended together, knocking that ball of shadows down again.
Although Gu Nan beat them till they didn’t dare show their faces anymore, as soon as Gu Nan fell into a disadvantage, these two wouldn’t mind coming out again to beat him while he was down.
It had to be said that no one who could reach Unified Dao lacked combat experience.
Gu Nan’s greatest strength was his unparalleled physical body, but it also meant that Gu Nan would fall into an extremely weak state as long as this strength was neutralized.
At the cost of immense damage to herself, Dream Immortal resolutely teamed up with Fa Kong to temporarily destroy the Evil God physique, finally giving the four Unified Dao ambushers an opportunity.
Right now, Gu Nan's physical body hadn’t recovered yet and he could only use laws, so he was no match against the combined efforts of the four Unified Dao powerhouses.
As long as they could seize this opportunity to seal him, they could achieve great success!
Of course Monk Fa Kong knew this, so he had no intention of being stingy at all. The prayer beads appeared in his hand again, but this time, he destroyed all the beads with a slight shock!
The beads crumbled into clumps of powder and trapped the shadows below, causing the entire Imperial Glory Heaven to glow with a golden brilliance.
……
"It’ll be very hard for Gu Nan to weather this tribulation." In a corner of Imperial Glory Heaven, Zi Luo Elder sighed as he shook his head slightly.
Immortal Empress Taisheng was also by his side.
Although she really wanted to see Gu Nan suffer misfortune, the fact that a newly-ascended Unified Dao cultivator was ambushed and might even be in danger of being sealed still made her sympathize with the distress of a like-minded person.

chapters.title: Chapter 540: Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
For any Star Ruler with ambitions of reaching Unified Dao, that realm was their ultimate goal.
And ultimate goal meant that once they reached this goal, they could at least have some breathing room. Gu Nan’s experience at this time undoubtedly gave Immortal Empress Taisheng a considerable shock.
She was considered a junior in front of these Unified Dao existences, and it was the first time she saw a Unified Dao level life-and-death battle, so she couldn’t help feeling some sorrow.
"Will Gu Nan die?" she couldn't help asking.
"No. A Unified Dao cultivator is not so easy to kill." Zi Luo Elder shook his head and explained, "But he committed too many murders, so he won’t be able to avoid being sealed by Fa Kong."
Immortal Empress Taisheng was silent. The word "seal" didn’t specify the length of time—he may be sealed for a while, or he may be sealed for tens of thousands of years.
When he saw Monk Fa Kong resolutely destroying his prayer beads, Zi Luo Elder understood that Gu Nan might not be able to avoid this tribulation.
That treasure was one of the trump cards accumulated by Three Buddha Heaven over tens of thousands of years. It was a divine weapon refined from the sarira left behind by six top-tier Buddhist Star Rulers after their deaths.
Fa Kong invested so many priceless resources, all to seal Gu Nan in the shortest possible time. This showed just how much pressure the latter put on him.
"To be able to oppose four Unified Dao enemies as soon as he ascended to Unified Dao, Gu Nan can stand proud," Zi Luo Elder remarked with some regret. "Perhaps not even these four expected to pay such a high price to seal him."
The golden glow in Imperial Glory Heaven gradually withdrew into itself, continuously converging towards the center. The ball of shadows had reached the point where it was unable to move, having been completely sealed by the prayer beads’ fragments.
Like Zi Luo Elder said, neither Dream Immortal nor Song Fei, nor even the organizer—Monk Fa Kong—predicted that this battle would be so wretched.
The person who suffered the smallest loss in this battle was Huo Kui, who was just here as an extra. His physical body was only destroyed once, but at least he managed to deal some damage before he "died", so it wasn’t much of a loss.
Song Fei was completely treated as a moving target and ended up taking two punches from Gu Nan, and all he had for show was merely stalling for some time. Not only did he suffer huge losses, but he also lost a lot of face.
Once the outcome of this battle became public, Song Fei would undoubtedly be regarded as the weakest among the five who participated in the Unified Dao battle.
Dream Immortal and Monk Fa Kong were the two who suffered the greatest losses. One was critically injured and over-exhausted her powers. Nobody knows how many years it would take her to recover. The other lost a supreme treasure he always carried with him, directly damaging his astral world’s foundation.
Monk Fa Kong still had a compassionate expression, but whether his heart was actually bleeding from the loss, only he himself would know.
When the golden light converged and completely sealed the shadows, Monk Fa Kong chanted the Buddha’s name, "Amitabha. The evil demon has been sealed. This humble monk expresses his gratitude to the three righteous Benefactors on behalf of all living beings in the Myriad Heavens."
Dream Immortal naturally wasn’t interested in hearing such nonsense. She snorted coldly and turned around, returning to her astral world to recuperate in earnest.
Huo Kui had no friendship with Monk Fa Kong. He came purely to help Dream Immortal this time, so he naturally left after saying goodbye.
Song Fei, on the other hand, actually chatted with Monk Fa Kong for a little longer. In any case, after this battle, they could be regarded as comrades-in-arms. Sometimes, the friendship between Unified Dao cultivators was accumulated bit by bit, just like this.
……
News that six Unified Dao bigshots appeared in Imperial Glory Heaven and that Gu Nan was ambushed by four of them was like a depth charge that detonated in the Myriad Heavens immediately after the battle.
The Myriad Heavens had not seen a battle of this magnitude for many years, especially one with such a shocking outcome, ending with Gu Nan sealed and all four Unified Dao ambushers injured.
Some people firmly believe that a Unified Dao powerhouse would not die like this and that Gu Nan would definitely make a comeback, as evidenced by the fact that his astral world was still perfectly intact.
Others believed that although Gu Nan’s astral world was unharmed, he himself would inevitably be trapped in Three Buddha Heaven for tens of thousands of years and become the most high-level evil demon sealed in Three Buddha Heaven.
At the same time, various rumors were also circulating.
Various conspiracy theories such as "Gu Nan was too strong and was able to fight four Unified Dao experts on equal ground right after he ascended, which made them feel threatened and led to the ambush", "The original Thirteen Heavens have joined forces to suppress the newly-ascended Unified Dao cultivator”, etc., were simply unstoppable.
As for this battle, the current Sixteen Heavens all fell silent at the same time. Not a single one of them publicly expressed any opinions on it.
This strange silence further fueled speculation among people from all walks of life.
Clockwork Heaven.
"Gu Nan can't be dealt with so easily." Lu Wen seemed to have great confidence in Gu Nan. "If Fa Kong was smart, he’d hand Gu Nan over to the gods, or else he’ll regret it sooner or later."
"Even you think so? But if Fa Kong had such decisiveness in the first place, he wouldn’t have dared to attack Gu Nan," another person across from Lu Wen replied casually, calmly sipping tea.
This person was none other than Jiu Po, the one who previously invited Gu Nan to join forces.
Jiu Po was so mysterious that very few people even knew what he looked like, and even fewer people knew that he actually had contact with Lu Wen, and their relationship also seemed quite good.
"That's true." Lu Wen also chuckled.
Monk Fa Kong attacked Gu Nan because of his identity as a "Unified Dao level evil demon". But if he handed Gu Nan over to the gods, wouldn’t all his previous "investment" be in vain?
This was especially true now that Gu Nan was trapped. It was unlikely that a Unified Dao grand monk would have so little confidence in himself.
……
Amidst all the explosive news, while other astral worlds were just watching the excitement, the people in Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom were naturally suffering the most.
"Has His Lordship… truly been sealed?" An Tiansheng’s face was full of worry as he said through gritted teeth, "Damn it! If only we’d been more careful, we wouldn't have…"
He had already been resurrected by Gu Nan, but the ambush targeting his group was the trigger behind the whole incident.
Although An Tiansheng had a nasty personality, he also understood the principle of repaying kindness. It was entirely thanks to Gu Nan that he could be where he was today, so he blamed himself incessantly for this incident.
On the side, Red Tail interrupted with a wave of her hand, "The Divine Kingdom is unharmed, so His Lordship will naturally be alright. Let's wait for news from Xiaoxiao."
As the spirit of the Divine Kingdom, Yan Xiaoxiao naturally had the closest connection to Gu Nan. Right now, everyone was waiting for her to show up.
Red Tail was actually very nervous, but she knew that the more dire a situation, the less panic she could reveal. At least until enemies come knocking on their door, everything must remain as usual.
"Teacher is fine. He’ll return soon," Yan Xiaoxiao finally appeared inside the Evil God Temple and brought the news everyone was most looking forward to.
Red Tail and the others breathed a collective sigh of relief. Xie Yun couldn't help asking, "The outside is saying that most of His Lordship’s laws have been sealed. That’s not true, right?"
Unified Dao cultivators merge with laws, so they themselves represent a part of those laws. It could even be said that they were composed of laws. This was consistent with the greater gods taking the Godheads as their foundation.
To have most of his laws sealed would mean that most of Gu Nan's power was sealed.
"It's true," Yan Xiaoxiao answered without hiding it. Everyone couldn’t help quieting down as her words fell, not knowing what to say.
But she then added with a smile, "But they might have misunderstood something. Teacher’s strength has never been his laws."

chapters.title: Chapter 541: Hidden Ascender
chapters.content:
In the Evil God Temple, Gu Nan's reconstructed body slowly opened his eyes.
However, he could only open his eyes, because his body only consisted of a small part of his head. The rest of his body was still missing.
Like all Unified Dao existences, Gu Nan's body had merged with laws. Simply destroying his physical body was not enough to truly kill him.
However, his physical body was far stronger than that of normal Unified Dao cultivators, so the power required to rebuild it was far greater.
On the other hand, Monk Fa Kong's seal really did seal away most of Gu Nan's laws, limiting the maximum power he could mobilize to a very small level.
For Unified Dao figures, the strength of their own laws actually represented their maximum explosive power.
And the existence of astral worlds could replenish their laws at a high speed, removing the need to worry about running out of power and giving them almost inexhaustible power.
It was precisely due to this characteristic that the Star Ruler system replaced normal cultivators and became the most popular cultivation method.
Since most of Gu Nan's laws were sealed, the power he could currently use was only equivalent to that of a Tier 10 Star Ruler.
Using this kind of power ceiling to reconstruct Gu Nan’s ridiculously strong physical body would naturally take a long time.
Gu Nan checked his body and estimated that it would take at least five to ten years to fully recover, and that was taking into account the Evil God physique’s ability to automatically repair itself.
That might only be the blink of an eye for other Unified Dao powers, but this was the heaviest injury Gu Nan had suffered since his debut.
Dream Immortal and Fa Kong's final frenzied counterattack did bring very grave consequences, and these two’s ferocity exceeded many people's expectations.
If he hadn't already reached Unified Dao, just this battle alone would be enough to truly kill Gu Nan.
Of course, from another perspective, Gu Nan would never have fought like this if he wasn’t already aware of his own advantages. Perhaps he would’ve fled a long time ago.
"I’ll take this opportunity to accumulate Evil Value and advance to Tier 12 first." Gu Nan quickly made a decision.
The loss of laws did not affect the majority of Gu Nan's combat power, so he wasn’t in a hurry for the time being.
He wasn’t worried about anyone taking this opportunity to invade his Divine Kingdom at all. He was simply waiting for his physical body to fully recover so that his subsequent actions would have a higher chance of success.
"Teacher." Yan Xiaoxiao entered the Evil God Temple alone and saw Gu Nan, who had just reconstructed most of his head.
After Gu Nan's injury, Yan Xiaoxiao immediately sealed off the entire Evil God Temple, forbidding anyone from entering. At the same time, she also cut off all channels outsiders could use to learn about Gu Nan’s condition.
Although both she and Red Tail appeared to be full of confidence in front of their subordinates, they were actually still quite worried.
If an astral world lost its Star Ruler and also never cultivated a successor, what kind of fate would it face? Just look at the former Nirvana Heaven.
"I'm fine," Gu Nan's voice rang out directly from the temple. He didn't even have vocal cords anymore, so naturally he couldn't speak normally. "How is the Blasphemer Project?"
"Vivian failed." Yan Xiaoxiao reported calmly, "She was barely able to break through the structure of the Nightmare Godhead. Her fusion with the Godhead was very forced, so she did not obtain enough power from it."
There was only one fate awaiting a blasphemer who failed to kill their former god, and that was death at the hands of the true god.
Gu Nan also expected this. After all, this world didn’t have a true “Chosen One”. On one hand, Vivian being the first to successfully fuse with the Godhead was due to her own hard work, but at the same time, it was also the inevitable result of probability.
They prepared hundreds of subjects to throw at the Nightmare Godhead. Eventually, someone would break through the Godhead’s stable structure.
But as long as there was a first success, it would be much easier for future candidates to fuse with the Godhead’s power.
Sure enough, Yan Xiaoxiao then said, "The number of blasphemers who have successfully fused with the Godhead now exceeds ten, and one person even reached Tier 7."
The power of a greater god was much higher than that of ordinary gods. Even a Godhead fragment from them still held unimaginable power and could be of enormous help to mortals.
Of course, experts created with this method had no way to replenish their power. Once their power was exhausted, all that was left would be an understanding of laws.
To put it bluntly, they did not have Divine Kingdoms or astral worlds serving as their foundation, so naturally they couldn’t compare to normal experts.
"Good." Gu Nan's voice seemed calm, "Continue with the plan… Hmm?"
Gu Nan was halfway through his sentence when he suddenly stopped, his gaze slowly moving up. On top of the Evil God Temple, someone was slowly making their way over.
When not even Dream Immortal and Fa Kong thought about succeeding in one fell swoop and eradicating Gu Nan completely, an unexpected person came first.
"So you’ve already ascended." Gu Nan's gaze shifted slightly, but his tone remained calm, as if the old friend in front of him still was an old friend.
Xue Ren held a sword in one hand and stared at Gu Nan's reforming body—a little over half a head—with a smile on his lips.
"Not yet." Xue Ren shook his head slightly. "I’ve been waiting for this moment."
As his words fell, his figure started to blur, as if his entire person had become an illusion, but his aura was constantly surging, growing at an unimaginable speed.
The secret technique Zi Luo Elder gave him was not so much covering up Unified Dao Realm’s fluctuations as simply keeping him stuck at the threshold of Unified Dao, putting him in a state where he could break through at any time.
And now, Xue Ren felt like he could break through.
Yan Xiaoxiao's gaze shifted slightly. An inexplicable aura suddenly appeared in the Evil God Temple, about to rush towards Xue Ren, but Gu Nan shook his head to stop her.
"You want to kill me?" Though Gu Nan asked this, he didn't seem to have any doubts.
Xue Ren responded calmly, "That's right. None of them believe Austin’s warning, but I think he’s right. If I don't kill you, you will destroy the entire world sooner or later."
Gu Nan's advancement speed was utterly terrifying and could be called the fastest in the Myriad Heavens, but Gu Nan was also the reincarnation of a powerhouse, so this did not make the Unified Dao cultivators feel threatened.
In other words, those who could reach Unified Dao would not be frightened by something like this and lose all confidence in themselves.
Only Xue Ren wasn’t already in Unified Dao Realm back then. Instead, he watched Gu Nan walk to his current position step-by-step and was also familiar with Gu Nan’s actions in the World of Gods. He had a deep understanding of the phrase "public enemy of the gods".
So Gu Nan nodded, and—without any hesitation—his half-reconstructed head flew directly at Xue Ren!
Even having just half a head still didn’t undermine the strength of Gu Nan's physical body, because this was the head of the Evil God physique—even if he just head-slammed enemies, he could still kill most Unified Dao existences!
Xue Ren, who gave up his own path and came with the intention of saving the world, didn't even have time to react as Gu Nan’s half a head suddenly rammed into him.

chapters.title: Chapter 542: Advent of Holy Light
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Advent of Holy Light
Yu Lian was giving a lecture in Void Grotto Heaven today, surrounded by hundreds of Daoist Heirs.
A top-notch astral world like Void Grotto Heaven, which had gone through several cycles of prosperity and decline, naturally placed the utmost importance on the cultivation of successors.
Even though the current Yu Lian already had a very high status, she still gave frequent lectures in person, not only teaching the principles of cultivation, but also the practicalities of managing an astral world and how to coordinate the various departments.
For the leader of all Daoist sects to remain standing to this day, pragmatism was essential.
Today’s class was a debate on a topic of the students’ choosing. The Daoist Heirs would each state their views and then evaluate each other's opinions. And the most popular topic today was naturally the stunning fight between the five Unified Dao figures.
Most of Void Grotto Heaven’s Daoist Heirs were true heaven-sent geniuses. Not only would one of them succeed Void Grotto Heaven in the future, but even for the ones who lost the succession competition, many would still end up leaving and establishing their own astral worlds.
Therefore, these Daoist Heirs all had very high bars for topics that could catch their attention. They were full of vim and didn’t shy away from discussing Unified Dao battles at all, frequently debating about these bigshots.
"Ultimately, that one’s road has been too smooth-sailing until now. While single-handedly fighting four Unified Dao cultivators is an extraordinary feat, the losses also cannot be ignored. This humble one believes that it will be difficult to hear any news about that one again in the next thousand years."
"I disagree. It’s common for later generations to surpass older generations. Three Buddha Heaven may have sealed that one in the name of suppressing evil demons, but there will inevitably be another battle between them in a hundred years at most."
"Now that the matter has already reached this point, further discussion is useless. The events you two predicted will only happen in the future. But that one in Three Buddha Heaven has obtained the power of a Unified Dao level evil demon. How to deal with Three Buddha Heaven is our most pressing concern right now."
Void Grotto Heaven was the head of all Daoist sects, so of course it was at odds with Three Buddha Heaven. Most of the Daoist Heirs had ambitions of controlling the overall situation of the Myriad Heavens, so they wouldn’t forget about this conflict.
Only when the discussion came to a slight lull did Yu Lian finally conclude, "Gu Nan's setback is not necessarily a bad thing. Fa Kong doesn't understand the principle of eradicating evil at the roots, which will come back to haunt him in the future."
Everyone made noises of agreement, but at this moment, an indescribable aura suddenly surged between heaven and earth.
Very few people had felt this kind of aura before, but almost all cultivators had heard of it from ancient records.
This was a sign that someone was ascending to Unified Dao. In Void Grotto Heaven, it was called the "emergence of a new Saint amidst the celebrations of Heaven and Earth."
"A new Saint is about to emerge?"
"Who is it? I see sword energy in this Saint Omen. Could it be…?"
"It's Xue Ren." Yu Lian was quite certain, and the expression on her face turned gentler. She had a rather good personal relationship with Xue Ren, so she was naturally happy for him.
"Congratulations, Sect Master!"
"So it’s the one in Extreme Sword Heaven. His reputation as the best swordsman in the Myriad Heavens is probably about to become the truth."
"I think so too… Eh? Why has the Saint Omen disappeared?"
Just when Void Grotto Heaven was filled with joyful congratulations, the celebrations of Heaven and Earth abruptly disappeared, as if someone suddenly paused a cassette that had been playing.
……
Many people didn’t understand that having the power to destroy the world was not the same as actually wanting to destroy the world.
Of course, most people didn’t want someone else to have such power in the first place. From that perspective, both viewpoints would lead to the same response.
As was the case with Xue Ren. He came, he ascended, and then… he died.
Under Yan Xiaoxiao's dumbfounded gaze, Xue Ren's head exploded, and his corpse lay limply inside the Evil God Temple. The aura of Unified Dao ascension had not yet dissipated from his body.
Even a genuine Unified Dao existence might not fare much better if Gu Nan’s head smashed into them like this, let alone Xue Ren, who had yet to truly break through.
It could only be said that Xue Ren was too overconfident that Gu Nan had lost most of his strength. In order to prevent Gu Nan from escaping, Xue Ren’s action of showing up in advance sent him onto the path of no return.
Gu Nan's half-head fell back to its original position. There was nothing strange about his expression, but he was thinking some strange thoughts in his mind.
‘Shouldn’t killing a high-level monster with a special method give an achievement like "Headshot Monster" or something?’
……
The origin of the Saint Omen that was abruptly cut off midway through its appearance couldn’t be hidden from the world.
More and more people learned that Xue Ren had ascended, but he mysteriously died during his ascension.
Some people suspected that he was too eager to break through, which caused his own path to deviate, and that was why he suffered backlash from the Great Dao. But everyone fell silent when they found out the place where Xue Ren died.
Xue Ren died in Gu Nan's astral world.
Gu Nan, who just had most of his power sealed away, could actually cause Xue Ren to fall mid-ascension! Some of Gu Nan’s enemies who were beginning to stir because of the earlier Unified Dao battle immediately became well-behaved again.
On the contrary, Gu Nan's image in people's minds became even more eerie and unpredictable—not that it was much better before.
But amidst this strange atmosphere, Gu Nan entered a long incubation period. While repairing his body, he also waited for the Blasphemer Project to yield results.
With the release of the first batch of blasphemers, although he couldn’t harvest the fruits of labor from Vivian, subsequent subjects did not disappoint.
More and more Godhead fusion vessels succeeded in killing gods, constantly providing Gu Nan with Evil Value. When a blasphemer trained by Gu Nan killed a god, the efficiency of earning Evil Value was almost ten times what Gu Nan would get from killing that god himself.
The Greater God Dimension was still gradually developing. Moreover, with the increase in subjects and the gradual improvement of the Dimension’s rules, the "actors" were slowly exiting the stage.
Besides certain candidates that required close observation, actors were used less frequently.
After all, actors were just actors. On one hand, there were problems with their acting skills. On the other hand, following a script may not be the best development route for the subjects. It was better to let them grow freely.
Selecting one out of a hundred subjects—using this method of cultivating gu to find suitable subjects would not be a bad idea no matter how one looked at it.
While Gu Nan was waiting on that, he wasn’t just idling away either. He did not forget that there were still some experiments waiting for him to complete in the Gap World.
……
Gap World, Earth.
Fu Cheng received the complete information on 《Evil God》 from Professor Wang and understood Gu Nan's intention and requirements. Thus, she immediately began to reconstruct the game.
This woman, who built a gaming empire in just three years, really did possess amazing game development talent.
In just two months, she and her team fully analyzed Austin, compiled a comprehensive growth path, and made it into the game’s main plot.
Maintaining the role-playing style of the original work, the entire game was based on Austin's journey and growth while incorporating sandbox game characteristics—players could also do whatever they wanted in the World of Gods.
Of course, corresponding to 《Evil God》, what players needed to obtain for growth was not Evil Value, but Holy Light Value.
The leveling settings of the original work was basically copied exactly. Players needed to earn Holy Light Value and points during several phases, such as the First and Second Rounds, to raise their level.
"The details of the game are like this." Fu Cheng stood in front of a notebook and described the game they developed bit by bit, without missing any details.
This explanation took several hours. When even Fu Cheng's throat turned dry, a few words finally appeared in the notebook.
"Launch the game."

chapters.title: Chapter 543: 5 Years, Tier 12
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: 5 Years, Tier 12
Following Gu Nan's will, the reconstructed version of 《Evil God》 was branded as a new game called 《King of Gods: The Origin of Light》. After its official launch, it quickly set off a craze throughout the entire civilization on Earth.
On one hand, during the almost half a year from its initial development to official launch, Chengying Entertainment was fully invested in the game and deliberately concealed the game’s theme, which already whetted players’ appetite.
On the other hand, it was also because of the 《Evil God》game. Although it had been forgotten by today’s players, it still had quite a high historical status.
As the first ultra-realistic game, its name could still be seen in documentaries on the development history of various games.
Chengying Entertainment’s decision to suddenly launch a reconstructed version of 《Evil God》 this time triggered a wave of nostalgia. Many players even started playing that old game from hundreds of years ago.
And due to its excellent development and thorough early promotion, the new game 《Origin of Light》 quickly became very popular among players and truly opened up the market.
Chengying Entertainment once again led the gaming trend, though people seemed accustomed to that by now.
Fu Cheng's move to look back and reinvent an old game was interpreted by colleagues in the gaming industry as a new approach to "inject a breath of fresh air into today's highly homogenized gaming industry". No one thought there was any deeper meaning behind this.
Only Fu Cheng herself knew that this game was actually made under the instruction of another person… No, maybe not a person.
"What do you need me to do next?" Fu Cheng returned to her notebook and asked this question with a calm expression, but her heart wasn’t calm at all.
During these days, she never received more of that invigorating power that returned her to her youth, which caused her originally young face to show signs of aging.
Fu Cheng, who returned to being thirty years old, didn’t get sick even once in the past six months. She was in excellent health every day and didn't want to go back to her previous state.
"Monitor all players above the Second Round, especially those who can complete the Third Round." Such a sentence gradually appeared in the notebook.
This made Fu Cheng frown slightly. As a game developer, of course Chengying Entertainment could get player information from the server, but this kind of monitoring would be a long-term task.
"Based on our design… The players’ Second Round will probably happen two or three years later," Fu Cheng said after carefully considering her words.
《Origin of Light》was an ambitiously grand game, not the kind of product that could be cleared in a few afternoons. It had the potential to become a nostalgic memory for an entire generation.
What Fu Cheng actually meant was that she might not even be alive anymore by the time this matter came to fruition.
Before Fu Cheng could react, a black light suddenly fell down and cleansed her entire body.
This time, it didn’t just strengthen Fu Cheng's foundation. She could even feel a surge of strength coming from her body, and her clenched fists seemed to have a thousand catties of strength.
Having some knowledge about cultivators, she quickly judged from some details that she was now no weaker than some normal Force cultivators.
Even if only a small part of his laws were left, Gu Nan could still give an ordinary person like Fu Cheng some benefits.
Fu Cheng felt the surging power in her body and said gratefully, "I will definitely complete this task…"
"Notify me as soon as possible if you discover that a post-Second Round player has disappeared." The writing that appeared on the notebook again made Fu Cheng subconsciously stop talking.
"What does ‘disappeared’ mean?" Fu Cheng quickly asked. She didn't want something to go wrong just because she failed to understand what the other party meant.
"Disappeared means disappeared," the notebook answered as such.
……
In the Evil God Temple, Gu Nan withdrew his will from the Gap World. His gaze landed on the moonlit space outside the temple, but his thoughts were slowly churning.
Making a game based on Austin's journey was actually the result of Gu Nan's careful consideration.
Since Earth’s current civilization was hundreds of years after his own era, it was impossible to retain the player data from that time, so Gu Nan could only choose to reconstruct the game.
Re-launching the 《Evil God》 game with a new look might give him another “transmigrator” case to reference, but it was also a bit of a risky move.
If he truly created another "player", he might as well be playing with fire and burning himself.
So Gu Nan chose the route of the Ruler of Light. Even if there was another player, anyone walking on the holy light route was destined to keep a high profile the whole way, so it would be impossible to hide themself.
As long as he extinguished the fire in advance, it would naturally not be a threat.
……
Five years passed by in a flash.
Unexpectedly, players in 《Origin of Light》 advanced the plot slower than expected. Less than ten Second Round players appeared in five years, let alone any Third Round players.
Gu Nan had been monitoring this group of players through Fu Cheng, but currently, everything seemed to be normal with them.
On the other hand, after a full five years of accumulation, the reconstruction of Gu Nan's physical body finally made a breakthrough.
To put it bluntly, the so-called breakthrough just meant the Evil God physique’s recovery had reached a certain critical point, which finally triggered its super regeneration, causing it to recover completely in the blink of an eye.
"I seem stronger than before?" Gu Nan keenly noticed as he sensed the power inside his body. "Oh, turns out I’m already Tier 12."
During these five years, the Blasphemer Project also continued to progress. A large number of low-level gods were wiped out, causing Gu Nan's Evil Value to accumulate rapidly. Right now, it already exceeded the threshold of Tier 12.
After the Second Round, level was determined entirely by the amount of Evil Value, and players were no longer allowed to delay their advancements. Instead, they were forcibly leveled up as soon as they met the requirements.
Gu Nan’s earlier strategy of holding back his level-ups so that he could advance two levels at once was no longer applicable at this stage.
Gu Nan was not surprised by this. He was perfectly aware of the Blasphemer Project’s efficiency in harvesting Evil Value. It was still quite impressive when the player had just completed the Second Round.
But this plan’s efficiency would be greatly reduced as the number of low-ranked gods decreased. If he wanted to rely solely on this to advance to Tier 13, it would take at least ten times the time.
‘Sure enough, I need to find ways to kill greater gods.’ This thought popped up in Gu Nan's head. Even a mere Tier 11 greater god would still save him at least thirty years.
But greater gods were not so easy to kill. He couldn’t just run to their doors and kill them with one punch. They could create eight or ten clones in the blink of an eye for him to kill. Anyhow, the greater gods would be fine as long as they didn’t use the power of their Godheads to create those clones.
Greater gods were not stupid. They would go into hiding after their physical body was destroyed. Nobody would still run outside and obediently wait for death.
On the contrary, as soon as the player made a move, all the greater gods would notice, which would lead to the player getting besieged by a group of greater gods. This was the biggest dilemma for post-Second Round players.
It seemed extremely unrealistic to destroy a greater god’s Divine Kingdom at this stage, so players often turned to scheming behind the scenes, such as inciting another Divine War.
If not for Jiu Po's invitation, Gu Nan would probably also resume his "old trade" and embark on this path. But now, he could hear Jiu Po out first.

chapters.title: Chapter 544: Mistaken
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Mistaken
Jiu Po Heaven.
As one of the three most ancient planes in the Myriad Heavens that evolved from the essence of the original Earth Realm, Jiu Po Heaven had always been quite mysterious.
Each astral world and plane had its own spatial coordinates, but not many people knew the coordinates of Jiu Po Heaven. At least, not many people were qualified to enter it.
Under Jiu Po’s deliberate guidance, Jiu Po Heaven became a semi-public plane. Outsiders who wanted to enter must pass background checks on their origins and strength.
Of course, this was nothing surprising. Most astral worlds mandated background checks and tests for applicants, but Jiu Po Heaven’s requirements were particularly high.
Star Rulers who did not own an astral world were not allowed to enter at all.
This condition alone directly filtered down the qualified applicants to less than a thousand people.
But other than this one rule, Jiu Po Heaven’s other conditions seemed more lax, with no special rules or even any characteristics.
Void Grotto Heaven was the origin of Daoist sects, and God Emperor Heaven also had ancient relics relating to the human path. Only Jiu Po Heaven had completely washed away the traces of its past.
When Gu Nan stepped foot here, what he saw was an ordinary astral world, just like Jiu Po's average face.
"What a rare visitor." As soon as Gu Nan set foot in this world, Jiu Po's voice rang out beside him, "Hmm? You've actually broken through again?"
Gu Nan broke through yet another level only a few years after entering Unified Dao. This was indeed astonishing, especially since most of his laws had just been sealed.
But Jiu Po was also not an ordinary person. He too came from the Gap World and witnessed the collapse of the three realms in advance, ultimately reaching his current position.
"It seems that the history you’ve seen has not yet ended," Jiu Po remarked while giving Gu Nan a deep look.
He was one of the people who profited from knowing the future, so he was all too aware that these advantages would bring considerable benefits if used properly.
Gu Nan was noncommittal and just asked, "Last time, you offered to cooperate to kill greater gods. Do you have any certainty of success?"
"Yes." Jiu Po smiled. "But my only target is Valen. I won't consider others."
Ruler of Time, Valen!
Jiu Po's earlier invitation to Gu Nan to join forces to “invest in his potential” was more of an excuse. So when Gu Nan came to the door this time, he didn't hesitate anymore and revealed his goal.
Gu Nan didn't know how this Valen fellow offended Jiu Po to the point where he wanted to kill the other party.
But judging from the timeline, it was obviously not because of history—Valen debuted much later than Jiu Po, even later than Daoist Yellow Springs’ incarnation, the God of Twilight.
But in terms of personality alone, it wasn’t that surprising.
Valen's background and laws were similar to this side’s Lu Wen, but his personality was similar to Zou Jiming. In other words, he was the king of pulling aggro.
Even in the World of Gods, there were many gods who despised him.
Gu Nan thought for a moment and answered, "Alright. When will we attack?"
Valen was also a newly-ascended greater god. Besides his somewhat special laws, his actual power might not even compare to Rolensia, who ascended later than him.
"I will notify you when the time comes."
"Okay." Gu Nan nodded, then turned to leave.
Jiu Po glanced at his back. "Are you going to Three Buddha Heaven?"
Gu Nan grinned. "Gotta retrieve my power before the hunt."
……
World of Gods.
A ray of light fell from the sky and landed in an unknown Divine Kingdom.
Calling it unknown wasn’t quite right, because this Divine Kingdom belonged to a new high-level god, the God of Time.
This particular God of Time—who recently advanced to Tier 8—had just made his debut in the World of Gods and wasn’t very famous at all.
The law of time couldn’t be said to be a very rare law, and there were quite a few gods with similar laws, but very few were truly able to reach a high level.
On one hand, this law was extremely cryptic, and on the other hand, there was already a Ruler of Time standing high above them, causing the gods controlling time to lose the motivation to advance.
If it was just similar, overlapping laws, there would still be a chance of success, but the law of time was extremely exclusive. As long as Valen was still alive, it was practically impossible for another God of Time to ascend to a greater god.
If someone else wanted to become the new Greater God of Time, they basically had to wait for Valen to fall, or… make him fall.
This Tier 8 God of Time—an obscure god named Sven—revealed a smile after receiving a message from a foreign land.
……
After Gu Nan left Jiu Po Heaven, he didn’t even return to his own Divine Kingdom and directly descended onto Three Buddha Heaven instead.
Although the law of shadows could no longer raise Gu Nan's direct combat effectiveness relative to the Evil God physique, the characteristics of shadows were still quite useful.
When heading to the World of Gods, Gu Nan undoubtedly needed the power of shadows to hide himself and launch the fatal blow.
Three Buddha Heaven was a well-known Buddhist plane in the Myriad Heavens. It had never introduced too many technological advancements in order to maintain the purity of the common people's faith.
In a sense, Three Buddha Heaven was somewhat similar to the Divine Kingdoms in the World of Gods. The only difference was that its Star Ruler did not rely on faith to obtain power.
Inside Three Buddha Heaven, the Buddhist Sect was undoubtedly the most powerful sect in each region. Buddhist temples were also institutions with absolute authority over various regions. The government was only the executor of specific management measures.
In the center of Three Buddha Heaven, the holy land in the hearts of all Buddhist disciples, stood Three Buddha Temple.
The name “Three Buddha” also came from the three founding Buddhist ancestors who established this plane in ancient times. They were the founders of Three Buddha Heaven, as well as the creators of Three Buddha Temple.
However, there were currently some discordant voices in Three Buddha Temple.
"Five years have passed in the blink of an eye. Can anyone tell this humble monk why Gu Nan has not been suppressed yet?" Monk Fa Kong sat on a golden lotus, looking down at the Buddhist monks below.
Although he was the Star Ruler of Three Buddha Heaven, the work of suppressing evil demons could not be completed by him alone, so much so that his participation wasn’t even required.
Ever since they sealed most of Gu Nan's laws and brought it back to Three Buddha Heaven, the monks had never stopped the work of suppressing this evil demon.
Only by suppressing evil demons inside the astral world could the astral world truly benefit from it, but progress on this particular evil demon had always been very slow.
The outside world believed that Three Buddha Heaven could even seal a Unified Dao powerhouse; its prestige was truly enough to suppress the Myriad Heavens. However, they didn’t know that even now, Three Buddha Heaven had yet to benefit from it.
At first, everyone just thought that Unified Dao level evil demons were rare and would take more time, but up until now, the suppression work had made basically zero progress, which inevitably angered Fa Kong.
Hearing Fa Kong's question, a young monk below couldn't help standing up to speak.
"Martial Uncle, based on this young monk’s experience, as well as that of all my martial uncles and seniors, it seems that the laws left by Benefactor Gu Nan are not affected by the light of the World-Suppressing Buddha."
"What do you mean?" Fa Kong suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart.
"That is to say…" An awkward expression appeared on the young monk’s face. "It’s possible that Benefactor Gu Nan is not an evil demon."
Just as the young monk finished speaking, Three Buddha Temple suddenly caved in from the top, as if someone had smashed it with a heavy fist.

chapters.title: Chapter 545: Retrieval
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Retrieval
Although he called it a possibility, the young monk was almost certain that this was the truth.
Though they never sealed Unified Dao level evil demons before, they did seal demonic weapons of this level, so they weren’t completely inexperienced.
Even at that time, the sealed object still didn’t have absolutely no reaction at all to the Buddha’s aura… But the laws left by Gu Nan were not affected by the Buddha's light at all.
If this was truly the case, then Three Buddha Heaven may have suffered a huge loss this time.
But before the young monk could figure out how to provide evidence for this, the bad news had already descended from the sky.
The instant the ceiling of Three Buddha Temple collapsed, Monk Fa Kong had already stood up suddenly, chanting a Buddha's name. Golden light reappeared in the sky, pushing back the fallen roof.
Fa Kong recognized the intruder at a glance and immediately said, "Amitabha. Benefactor Gu Nan, this matter is actually a mis—"
Before he could finish saying "misunderstanding", Gu Nan’s fist hit Monk Fa Kong's head first.
After all, Monk Fa Kong had witnessed Gu Nan's fearsome strength and was also in Three Buddha Heaven at the moment. Since he knew he couldn't avoid Gu Nan's punch, he didn’t even try to dodge it.
His whole body shook, and a Buddhist halo slowly rose up behind him. He now had three heads and eight arms, and his whole body turned into gold, like a diamond-hard body.
Combining the power of Three Buddha Heaven into one body and hardening his body to resist Gu Nan's punch—Monk Fa Kong indeed accomplished that.
Although the punch created the sound of metals clashing, Fa Kong was not directly destroyed by this strike.
Instead, the splash damage from this terrifying punch caused a shockwave in the main hall of Three Buddha Temple. Most of the monks were directly sent flying, and many of them died.
Monk Fa Kong also saw this and revealed a compassionate expression. "Since Benefactor is not an evil demon, why bother with murder? If Benefactor is dissatisfied with this humble monk, why don’t this humble monk receive three of Benefactor’s punches—"
"Sure!" Gu Nan agreed straightforwardly and threw a punch at his head again.
The corners of Monk Fa Kong's lips twitched slightly. He wanted to say that those "three punches" were not without conditions, but it was a pity that Gu Nan never paid attention to his words from the start.
Regardless of whether there were conditions, what should be fought would still be fought.
The diamond-hard body reappeared, and this time, the sound of metals colliding was even louder, even to the point of being ear-piercing, forcibly distorting the surrounding laws. The monks were all running away with their ears covered, unable to withstand the power of a Unified Dao battle.
To be accurate, it couldn't be considered a battle. It was just Gu Nan's unilateral beating of Monk Fa Kong.
This time, Gu Nan no longer struck one punch at a time, instead attacking like a violent storm. His barrage of punches landed like bullets, beating Monk Fa Kong into a sieve.
No matter how powerful his hardened body was, it still couldn’t withstand such furious attacks. Monk Fa Kong couldn’t even utter a sound before he was smashed into countless pieces by Gu Nan.
Seeing that he wasn’t in a hurry to revive himself and throw his life away again, Gu Nan also stopped paying attention to him, his eyes falling on the young monk who spoke up before.
"Where are my laws?" Gu Nan asked as he patted the young monk on the shoulder.
"Amitabha." The young monk stood up. He was one of the few monks who was not affected by the shockwave. "Although Benefactor is not an evil demon, you are more murderous than a real demon. Forgive this monk for being unable to answer."
Gu Nan glanced at him. "You’re not afraid of death?"
The young monk showed a peaceful smile. "This monk is not."
"Then are you afraid that they will die?" Gu Nan pointed to a monk lying on the ground. Because he’d heard the sound produced by laws, he was currently bleeding from all seven orifices and lying on the ground, his vital signals growing weaker and weaker.
The next second, Gu Nan stamped down on the monk's head, causing his head to explode and splashing blood onto the young monk's face.
"You… You…" The little monk raised his head in shock and pointed at Gu Nan, speechless for a long time.
"Where are my laws?" Gu Nan asked again coldly.
The young monk gritted his teeth and said nothing. Unfortunately, after witnessing the deaths of several more monks, he could no longer hold his silence and personally took Gu Nan to the sealing location.
In fact, it wasn’t hard to find the place where Gu Nan's laws were sealed. After all, Three Buddha Temple was only so big; he could always find it if he just walked around a few more times. It's just that Gu Nan was too lazy to look for it by himself.
There were still monks standing guard in the temple. They were spared if they pretended not to see the two. But if anyone dared to come forward, they naturally wouldn’t be able to escape Gu Nan's vicious hands.
After a while, the law of shadows returned to him, and Gu Nan left Three Buddha Heaven, leaving only a field of wreckage of what used to be Three Buddha Temple.
And after this news spread, the people who’d been arguing about whether Gu Nan would silently withdraw from history might finally be able to stop.
Of course, not even the most optimistic people expected Gu Nan to return to Three Buddha Heaven in just five years and give the great monks a hard slap in the face.
……
The first organization to receive news that Gu Nan retrieved his laws was none other than the Heaven-God Alliance.
In Zi Luo Heaven, Zhuangxuan and Immortal Empress Taisheng stood behind Zi Luo Elder, listening to him recount the battle in Three Buddha Heaven.
As a Unified Dao cultivator, Zi Luo Elder paid careful attention and did not miss the beginning or end of the battle inside Three Buddha Heaven.
"Senior Gu Nan has an extraordinary background. It may not be a bad thing for the organization to draw a clear line with him," Zhuangxuan spoke up after a few minutes of silence.
His mind was clearer than anyone else and knew that people like Gu Nan couldn't be easily controlled. Rather than forcing him to stay in the organization, it was better for them to have nothing to do with each other.
Immortal Empress Taisheng responded with the same silence. She remembered the time when Gu Nan had not yet entered Unified Dao or even when he just stepped into that realm…That seemed like yesterday.
This world's common sense regarding cultivation had been broken by him time and time again, and this time was no exception.
Zi Luo Elder sighed softly. "Xue Ren couldn't see through this, so he died. Zhuangxuan, the organization is in your hands. I hope you will not learn from him in the future, but learn more from your master."
Daoist Lingyang inexplicably resigned from his position as the organization’s manager and even gave up his astral world, going to the World of Gods to develop from scratch again. This was indeed a bit strange.
Zhuangxuan slowly raised his head when his master was mentioned. "Is Master still a member of the organization?"
"Of course." Zi Luo Elder smiled. "Your master has always been in the organization."
……
After Gu Nan took back his laws, he quickly returned to his own Divine Kingdom without further delay.
During this period, he also stopped by the Gap World in passing to have another look. Fu Cheng did a good job monitoring the players.
Per Gu Nan's request, she monitored every player who advanced to the Second Round, first monitoring their vital signals, and then their living habits and other details.
However, as the monitoring work deepened, Gu Nan did not receive the results he wanted. Instead, he only managed to prove one thing—in the Earth ruled by the Federation a few hundred years after his time, public security really was quite good. None of the players met any accidents.
However, Gu Nan wasn’t too worried, because a Third Round or above player had yet to appear, so nothing could be proved yet.
All Gu Nan could do now was wait—wait for progress on the project in the Gap World and news from Jiu Po.

chapters.title: Chapter 546: Time and Time
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Time and Time
The World of Gods.
