Just when Gu Nan was wrecking Three Buddha Heaven and slaughtering all the monks, a small incident also occurred in the World of Gods.
It was indeed a very insignificant event. The mighty Ruler of Time, Valen, accidentally discovered an extraordinarily-talented young boy while strolling through the mortal world, so he brought him back to his Divine Kingdom.
Needless to say, the little boy became the new Saint in the main temple and received the greater god’s inheritance. Such things happened from time to time; there was nothing unusual about it.
But the truly extraordinary event happened later.
This little boy indeed displayed amazing talent. In particular, his sensitivity to the law of time far exceeded normal.
The apostle responsible for mentoring him was overjoyed. Not only did he try his best to teach the boy, but he also quickly reported the news to Valen.
However, just when everyone in the main temple was happy that the Divine Kingdom had a little genius, a piece of news caught the main temple off guard.
It turned out that this little boy was not a mortal, but the child a god left behind in the mortal world. His father was none other than Sven, the God of Time.
It was also not uncommon for children of gods to wander. Otherwise, the main planes would not have so many myths and legends. But once the child of one god became favored by another god, things became very awkward.
Especially since the boy had been brought back to the temple and already received a new inheritance. Should this person still be returned or not?
Logically speaking, this was another god’s son, so there was no reason not to return him. But the little boy had already accepted a greater god’s inheritance, so how could he be allowed to go back?
And it just so happened that this matter could not be blamed on the person involved—he was just a little boy who turned four years old not long ago, so how could he understand these matters?
Valen also had a headache after hearing about this, but he never had a personality that gave much consideration to others. After thinking about it, he decided, "Let the boy stay. If Sven wants him, he can come find me in person."
When Valen's words spread, some people felt that his action was shameless, but in the end, he was still a great existence, so no one dared to object.
That was, until this Classmate Sven very honestly knocked on Valen’s door, having gone to the Time Divine Kingdom in person to ask for his son back.
Others were afraid of offending Valen, but Sven was not. In any case, he also controlled the law of time. Unless Valen dies, he will never ascend to a greater god, and he will not pose a threat to others.
No one knew the specific negotiations between the two. They only knew that the two ultimately parted on bad terms, and in the end, Sven did not manage to bring his son back.
But after returning to his Divine Kingdom, Sven recklessly started amassing his believers and brazenly launched a war against the Time Divine Kingdom.
A Tier 8 god launching a war against a greater god might sound ridiculous, but those who knew the whole story could feel a sense of tragedy in it.
Perhaps out of guilt, the Time Divine Kingdom did not respond to this but only passively defended against the outside invasion.
Of course, this kind of invasion seemed entirely meaningless—because the foundation of a Tier 8 Divine Kingdom was far inferior to that of a greater god’s Divine Kingdom.
If not for the fact that his opponent was only passively defending, Sven's Divine Kingdom would’ve been razed to the ground in a matter of minutes.
But Sven seemed to have gone insane and still put his full power into it, and because of the matter with the godling, all his believers faced death with equanimity. None of them succumbed to the power of the Time Divine Kingdom.
Right at this moment, a message reached Gu Nan.
"The time has come."
……
"Didn't expect you to be part of this," Gu Nan commented as he looked at Jiu Po and Lu Wen in a frontline plane at the edge of the Myriad Heavens.
Lu Wen chuckled. "Or rather, this is actually my business. Jiu Po and Valen may have some disagreements, but not to this extent."
Gu Nan glanced at the two of them and nodded, not having any doubts about this.
When he first set foot onto the frontline planes, he had encountered a fight between Lu Wen and Valen. At that time, the two were fighting over the Time Arena.
The two of them ascended at similar times, and their laws were practically the same, but who could’ve expected that Lu Wen had already finished all preparations for a sneak attack?
"How are you guys going to get there?" Gu Nan then asked.
Gu Nan himself had the law of shadows and was quite familiar with the World of Gods, so it wasn’t hard for him to sneak over, but Jiu Po and Lu Wen were different.
It was quite difficult for existences at their level to travel between the two worlds without being discovered.
Back then, Austin and the Ruler of Nightmares had to rely on Dream Immortal’s resurrection to deliver the power of their laws here in order to kill Gu Nan, but still, they could only launch one attack.
Jiu Po answered, "I have my own method of getting there."
"And I'm already there." Lu Wen had an enigmatic smile on his face.
……
The Divine Kingdom War launched by the God of Time reached a truly intense stage. Even he himself joined the frontlines and went all out, quite intent on fighting to the death.
Even the gods watching from the sidelines didn't understand. It was just a mere godling. Was there a need to go this far?
But it was fine if they didn’t understand. After all, everything happens for a reason, so everyone could only watch and see how things would ultimately develop.
But this development completely exceeded everyone's expectations.
Valen was injured!
After his patience ran out from Sven's repeated harassment, the Ruler of Time finally couldn't help taking action himself to drive away this annoying fly. Thus, he was injured at the fly's hands.
A mere Tier 8 god that could barely be considered a high-level god actually injured a mighty greater god!
This kind of thing completely overturned common sense. The person involved, Sven, also became well-known in one battle and quickly became famous throughout the World of Gods.
All the forces were asking how Sven did such a thing, but the results were somewhat shocking.
It was said that because the two had the same laws, Valen originally wanted to rely on his own understanding of time to forcibly reverse Sven's laws and make him understand the gap between them.
However, it was precisely because of this move that he discovered the other party's understanding of time was actually higher than his own and had even reached the stage of merging time and space.
"Who the hell are you?" Valen coldly looked at Sven.
He was injured because of laws, but the injury was not serious. On the contrary, the other party’s dogged persistence made him realize that something was amiss.
This person was absolutely not a normal god, but the other party also truly possessed the law of time… ‘Could he be some fallen god who just resurrected?’
God of Time Sven had a faint smile on his face. He didn't look like someone who had his son taken from him at all.
"Instead of worrying about who I am, you should consider how you’re going to survive this disaster instead, Valen."
Valen couldn't help sneering. The opponent’s understanding of laws was indeed beyond his expectation, but to say it could threaten him would be an exaggeration.
The gap between greater gods and normal gods couldn’t be bridged by mere understanding of laws, or else wouldn’t all those reincarnations of powerhouses be invincible?
If not for his doubts about this person’s identity, Valen would have killed him a long time ago.
And now that things reached this stage, Valen did not hesitate anymore and did exactly that.
With a slight thought, the endless Rain of Time suddenly fell, targeting none other than Sven.
This was an attack that materialized the law of time. It was already a confrontation of hard power and could not be reversed by understanding alone.
However, Sven simply allowed the raindrops to hit his body, seemingly completely unaffected.
The strange aura on the other’s body that was only now exposed finally allowed Valen to recognize him.
"It's you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 547: Light and Justice
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Light and Justice
Of course Valen could recognize Lu Wen. It had only been a few decades since the two last fought, which was the blink of an eye for a greater god.
Valen finally realized this entire conflict was a trap aimed at him.
Tier 8 God of Time? That was just a clone of the person before him. But he didn't know how many years Lu Wen had been planning this, to actually leave such a flawless clone here. No one expected the truth to be like this.
"Lu Wen." But in the end, Valen was still a great god-level figure. He quickly calmed down after his initial shock.
He was inside his own Divine Kingdom. What was there to fear when facing an opponent of the same level?
Even if the unexpected attack earlier injured him slightly, he still didn't believe the other party could easily take him down. And as long as more time passed, other greater gods would definitely notice that something was wrong here.
Once that happened, Lu Wen would be besieged by thirteen greater gods, and it would be his turn to worry about escaping.
However, as soon as Valen's thoughts fell, he felt a chill on his back. A shadow had arrived behind him at some point, and the sword of shadows stabbed directly into his back.
The force of this strike was so great that even the shadow sword itself couldnt withstand it. The laws seemed to be on the verge of breaking down.
With Gu Nan's current realm, the Evil God physique almost had the tendency of crushing his own laws, reaching a completely new level.
For Gu Nan, the most significant benefit of leveling up was to strengthen his physical body, making it harder for others to withstand his attacks or destroy his body.
As for his actual laws, those became less relevant.
As expected, Valen was completely powerless against this punch, and his divine body instantly transformed into pure laws that scattered throughout his Divine Kingdom.
It was naturally impossible for him to escape with Lu Wen present; the Time Divine Kingdom had already been completely sealed off long ago.
It was a Divine Kingdom built by the law of time in the first place, so it was much easier for Lu Wen to take it over when Valen was preoccupied and had no time to manage it.
For a second, Gu Nan even felt like it would be much more convenient to bring a Unified Dao cultivator with the same law when killing greater gods in the future.
Of course, except for a special case like Valen, there would probably be no such opportunity in the future.
Gu Nan's aura appeared for only an instant, and after killing Valen once, he never appeared again so as not to attract the attention of other greater gods.
"Ignorant one!"
Valen's voice instantly resounded throughout the entire Divine Kingdom. As the Ruler of Time who was also in his own Divine Kingdom, not even destroying his physical body could possibly make him shrink back.
But neither was Valen a fool. He wasnt stupid enough to reconstruct his divine body again for Gu Nan to do another instant kill. He continued fighting by only manipulating his laws.
Of course, without his divine body acting as the core, his control over laws would also be weakened. If Gu Nan changed targets to destroy his Divine Kingdom right now, his tens of thousands of years of hard work would be destroyed in mere moments.
But Valen made such a decision precisely because hed already recognized Gu Nan the instant the latter struck.
He was gambling on the fact that the other party would not dare show up again. If it was just Lu Wen, Valen would be able to hold him back with his laws alone.
Valen was right, but he was also wrong. Although he correctly judged that Gu Nan wouldn't show up again, he made the mistake of assuming the other side only had two people.
An inexplicable quake reverberated from within the Time Divine Kingdom, and all living beings in the Divine Kingdom suddenly felt a slight tremor under their feet, which rapidly intensified in a short period of time.
"Earthquake! Earthquake!"
"Earth No! This is not an earthquake, this is"
This was indeed not a simple earthquake. Rather, the ley lines themselves had been upended by a power rising from the depths of the earth. On this inverted land, it didnt matter if one was god or mortalnone had the power to resist.
Some people tried to appease the earth with laws, but unfortunately, they did not know that this phenomenon was caused by a sublime law in the first place.
Jiu Po Heavens Star Ruler Jiu Po controlled the power of the nine depths, the ley lines and the earth. He had the ability to make the earth swallow the sky and destroy thousands of living beings with a wave of his hand.
By the time Valen realized this, it was already too late to stop it. And Jiu Pos true realm was also revealed with this blow.
Tier 15!
The oldest Star Ruler in the Myriad Heavens was already a supreme powerhouse on par with Austin, truly standing at the top of the world.
Under the crushing force of the Tier 15 lawsand with Lu Wen restraining him from the sideValen was unable to resist at all and could only watch the fall of his Divine Kingdom.
"All of you will die here!" Valen couldn't help reforming his body and glaring at Lu Wen furiously.
"You should worry about yourself first," a flat voice came from behind him. With Gu Nan's punch, the divine body that just formed was also smashed to pieces.
And after Gu Nan revealed himself this time, he no longer intended to go back into hiding. It was impossible for the other greater gods to not notice the huge ruckus Jiu Po just caused. What they needed to do now was to seize every second.
"Attack!" Of course Lu Wen also knew this and shouted, but his hand movements did not slow down as he purged everything in the Divine Kingdom as quickly as possible.
For gods, the Divine Kingdom was their foundation, but greater gods went one step furtherthe Divine Kingdom became their shield.
To kill the greater gods who were one with the laws themselves, one must first destroy their Divine Kingdom, and only then could they be stripped of their godhood.
A greater gods Divine Kingdom was naturally extremely prosperous, but under the joint efforts of three Unified Dao powers, it was also quite fragile.
Setting aside everything else, just the upending of the ley lines was enough to destroy the Divine Kingdom.
The Time Divine Kingdom had already been completely destroyed before the other greater gods could arrive, and Lu Wen breathed a small sigh of relief. The next step was to find Valens hiding spot and actually kill him.
But Jiu Po's expression changed slightly right at this moment. "Austin is here You guys find Valen."
His figure blurred as Jiu Po suddenly disappeared, and what descended in his place was endless holy light.
"Intruders." Austin's gaze landed on the two, and the holy light surrounding him flickered slightly. "Sheltering the Evil God is akin to courting death."
Jiu Po smiled. "Thats not for you to worry about."
As he finished speaking, a spectral light suddenly lit up from the ground and rushed straight at Austin.
The Ruler of Light and Justice didn't even spare it a glance. He just casually pointed down, and the holy light shot downwards instantly, attempting to engulf the attack.
The two rays of light collided, but they were evenly matched. It was because the twos laws were at the same level, and their ranks were also very close, so it was impossible to determine the winner this early.
Furthermore, Jiu Po's intention was merely to stall Austin and give Lu Wen and Gu Nan time to kill Valen before the other gods could arrive.
But it was a pity that Jiu Po had never truly fought against Austin. He overlooked one factor at this timethe other party did not only control holy light.
Austin frowned slightly, revealing his true form in a flash of holy light.
There were twelve pairs of pure white wings on his back, and his curly golden hair almost fell down to his waist. He held a holy sword in his left hand and gently lifted the scales of justice in his right hand.
At this time, the holy light shone brilliantly. Austin pulled back the holy sword slightly, instead raising the scales.

chapters.title: Chapter 548: Twin Dragons of Time and Space
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Twin Dragons of Time and Space
Austin was too powerful.
The reason he was known as the strongest greater god in history wasnt only because of his extremely terrifying holy light, but also because he controlled two greater gods laws by himself.
Light and justice were both supremely sublime laws.
At this time, Austin raised the scales of justice, and an illusion of the scales fell at the intersection of the holy light and nine depths, actually causing the powers on both sides to quickly dissipate.
In the end, Jiu Po was not fighting on his home turf and couldnt receive any support from his astral world. Purely in terms of the quantity of laws, how could he possibly be a match for Austin?
In just a few moments, a hole was torn in the light of the earth, and the holy light quickly poured in the direction Lu Wen and Gu Nan disappeared to.
However, at this second, a large black hole suddenly burst out from the top of the holy light, as if someone had smashed it open.
Jiu Po took advantage of this opportunity to quickly repair the sudden opening Austin created in his defenses, and only then could he glance over there.
Gu Nan's advancing figure gradually appeared in the dissipating holy light, his fist still out. His whole body was covered with burns courtesy of the holy light, but he was recovering quickly and even flashed a grin at Austin.
With Gu Nan's in-depth understanding of Austin, of course he wouldnt make Jiu Pos mistake.
"Evil God." Strong killing intent appeared in Austin's cold eyes, and he threw the holy sword without even thinking about it.
Gu Nan was also very decisive. Knowing that he was fixed in place by the holy light, he didnt even attempt to dodge and allowed the holy sword to pierce through his heart.
Then he patted the wound as if nothing was wrong and swiftly left, even stepping on Austin's holy sword in passing.
Valen couldn't run very far.
The Time Divine Kingdom was sealed by Lu Wen, and he himself was also wounded twice. Moreover, most of his Godhead was already destroyed, so how could he run very far?
Valen was a troublemaker by nature, and he had never suffered such a big loss ever since he became a greater god. At this time, he couldn't help deciding to risk it all with his life on the line.
Valen reappeared, mobilizing the remaining power in his Divine Kingdom to attack Lu Wen with all his strength before Gu Nan could return.
But Lu Wen just smiled without much concern. "I didnt even fear you when I was a mere clone, let alone now."
As his words fell, Valen felt the Rain of Time suddenly fall in reverse, and time and space became chaotic and disorderly, spiraling completely out of his control.
"Time and space..." A hint of enthrallment emerged in Valen's eyes. The realm of uniting time and space into one was exactly what he pursued, but to see his enemy display the realm he so desperately sought was truly.
What he didn't know was that Lu Wen had already attained the two Great Daos of time and space as early as when he ascended to Unified Dao.
Its just that Lu Wens Dao attainment was too shallow at that time, so he had to extract his understanding of the law of space to form another entity, which created the Dragon of Space that always stayed by his side.
The two of them belonged to two different worlds and attained the Great Dao of time in the same era, but there was a veritable gap in their realms.
Under the reversal of time and space, Valen's laws immediately encountered complete suppression. He could not even put up any effective resistance and could only watch his own Godhead being eaten away repeatedly by time itself.
After losing his Divine Kingdom, which served as his foundation, Valen was consuming the power of his own laws with every passing second and was about to truly die inside the Rain of Time.
But who could even save him right now?
Austin was held back by Jiu Po, and the other greater gods had yet to arrive. Moreover, even if they arrived, would they be able to break through the Rain of Time and reach him?
Just when Valen fell into despair, he sensed an aura appear beside him, seemingly completely unaffected by the Rain of Time.
There really is someone who can enter this place!
The next second, Valen's body shattered into pieces with a loud bang. Even his Godhead was completely shattered this time, leaving him no chance of survival.
The combined power of three Unified Dao existencescoupled with Lu Wen's countless years of schemingfinally led to the fall of a greater god.
Gu Nan's figure appeared next to Lu Wen, feeling no guilt whatsoever for stealing the kill. After all, Valen had to die at his hands in order to count as Evil Value.
But Lu Wen didn't care about this. He quickly collected the scattered Godhead fragments once Valen died, and the law of time belonging to Valen all fell into his hands.
"Let's go," Jiu Po's voice rang in their ears.
Since they achieved their goal, the three had no intention of staying here any longerif they stayed any longer, the greater gods might force them to stay forever as corpses.
From the time Gu Nan and his group entered the World of Gods and took action to when Valen truly died, the entire process did not exceed seven minutes.
The cooperation of three Unified Dao cultivators fully demonstrated the definition of efficiency.
The main reason a greater god fell so easily was because Lu Wen was well prepared, leaving Valen with nowhere to run and no time to prepare.
The second an utterly unguarded Valen allowed Lu Wen's clone to enter his Divine Kingdom and even reach his person, his fate was already sealed.
When Lu Wen reached the Myriad Heavens, he had no time to waste and immediately released the gathered laws.
He didn't intend to hide it from Jiu Po and Gu Nan, or maybe he didn't have time to worry about that, because Valens Godhead that Gu Nan shattered was already starting to dissipate.
The law of time was thrown out by Lu Wen, gradually emitting bursts of light and then transforming into an illusory dragon.
Lu Wen raised his hand again, and a shadow flew out of his sleeve. It was Gu Nan's old friend, the Dragon of Space named Long Ling'er.
Long Ling'er, whod always been resting on Lu Wen's shoulder before this, was hidden in his sleeve this time and did not appear until now.
After she soared into the sky, she quickly approached the illusory dragon, and that illusion also quickly took on a solid form at this time, becoming a new giant dragon.
"Twin Dragons of Time and Space." Jiu Po looked at the scene in the sky and couldn't help sighing lightly. "Its indeed him."
As Jiu Po's words fell, on the other side, Lu Wen slowly closed his eyes and began to float in the air, gradually merging with the Twin Dragons of Time and Space.
As the Dragon of Space, Long Ling'er was born from Lu Wen's understanding of the law of space in the first place, and the new Dragon of Time was also created by Lu Wen. They could be said to be the same existence, possessing the same origin.
Now, the three were gradually fusing together. Lu Wen was sitting cross-legged in midair, and the Twin Dragons of Time and Space were slowly merged into his body, eventually forming a strange pattern on his forehead.
It was a pattern formed by two giant dragons intertwining, one black and one white, like a slanted Yin Yang pattern, full of mystical Daoist attainment.
"So it's you." Yu Lian had arrived at some point, looking at Lu Wen with some inexplicable familiarity in her eyes.
"Who is he?" Gu Nan didn't recognize this appearance, so he asked Yu Lian "shamelessly".
"Based on seniority, I should call him Grand-Master Uncle." Yu Lian sighed. "He used to be my Void Grotto Heavens"
"Traitor," Lu Wen finished Yu Lian's sentence with a smile. He was wearing a black and white Daoist robe and a seven-star Daoist crown, and he bowed to Gu Nan.
"Is Daoist Friend Yellow Springs doing well?"

chapters.title: Chapter 549: I want to go home
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: I want to go home
Clockwork Heaven.
Gu Nan, Jiu Po, and Lu Wen were all sitting down. The first two looked as usual, but Lu Wen kept his earlier appearance.
Black and white Daoist robes, a seven-star Daoist crown, and the twin dragon Yin Yang diagram on his forehead made Lu Wen look extremely eye-catching. One could tell he was extraordinary at first glance.
"So, youre going to look this flashy from now on?" Gu Nan glanced at Lu Wen and asked.
Lu Wen had long grown accustomed to Gu Nan's style and smiled without any surprise. "This is actually my original appearance. As for what Yu Lian said thats simply what she believes to be true."
"Original appearance?" Gu Nan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"The appearance from my past life." Lu Wen showed an amused smile. "You know which past life Im referring to."
Of course Gu Nan knew.
The great-martial uncle Yu Lian mentioned was Daoist Yin Yang, a former traitor of Void Grotto Heaven and a disciple of the second-generation Saint. Based on Yu Lian's understanding, Lu Wen was undoubtedly Daoist Yin Yangs reincarnation.
But judging from Lu Wens answer just now, his current appearance was not that of Daoist Yin Yang, but from his real past lifethe Gap World.
There was no doubt that cultivators existed in the Gap World.
Even technological civilizations such as Earth could develop rudimentary cultivation systems like the Force on their own after hundreds of years of progress. It would be natural for actual cultivation civilizations to exist as well.
It was apparent that Gu Nan, Jiu Po, and Daoist Yellow Springs were all from technological civilizations. The latter two only knew some future events, so their advantage wasnt great at all.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, carried an Evil God Temple with him. Moreover, the ultra-realistic game allowed him to experience cultivation, which gave him a far greater advantage than the former two.
Now, a Lu Wen popped up amongst their ranks as well. Lu Wen actually seemed to be a genuine cultivator in his past life.
"In my previous life, I stood on the brink of Unified Dao. In the end, I died from the Heavenly Daos punishment because I futilely tried to merge with two Great Daos." Lu Wen shook his head slightly.
No wonder he could reach this point so easily and be so familiar with the laws of time and space This person actually was the reincarnation of a powerhouse.
A flicker of surprise appeared in Gu Nan's eyes. "Can that world reach this realm? Haven't you guys noticed the abnormality in that world?"
Let alone someone standing on the verge of Unified Dao, even an ordinary Star Ruler could travel through the entire Gap World. All one needed was enough time.
"We call it the Origin World." Lu Wen said, "As a galaxy-type plane, the Origin World itself is vast enough, as well as closed-off."
Lu Wen then looked at Gu Nan and Jiu Po. "In my past lifes civilization, Unified Dao cultivators did exist. They were also called Saints. But even those Saints have never seen the world outside of the Origin World.
Some confusion cleared up in Gu Nans eyes.
Based on this statement, the universe that housed his past lifes Earth was precisely the Origin World Lu Wen mentioned. Cultivation civilizations existed in the Origin World, and there were even Unified Dao experts there, but it was completely isolated from the outside world.
Gu Nan didn't doubt this, because hed witnessed the dimensional wall separating the Origin World from the outside. It was so powerful that even he couldn't break through it directly and could only descend via a strand of consciousness.
Using what little astronomical knowledge Gu Nan retained from his previous life, he could tell that the universe Earth was located in was indeed larger than most of the planes in the Myriad Heavens.
Even Star Realm and Milky Way Heaven, which were both galaxy-type planes, couldnt compare with the Origin World in terms of actual size.
"Then how did you get out?" Gu Nan asked Lu Wen. With Lu Wen's cultivation at that time, he shouldnt be completely unaware of the process by which he left the Origin World.
Lu Wen revealed a bitter smile. He turned to Jiu Po and motioned for him to answer this question.
Jiu Po didnt refuse, explaining with a sigh, "During that tribulation, someone rescued his soul when it was about to be destroyed. Ive always suspected that Yellow Springs did it, but he never admitted it."
Lu Wen also nodded. "Back then, I couldn't tell who saved me, but judging from the timeline, Daoist Friend Yellow Springs is indeed the most likely candidate."
Gu Nan started to frown. The information gathered from Jiu Po, Lu Wen, and Daoist Yellow Springs gave him a strange feeling, as if something was missing.
Jiu Po said Daoist Yellow Springs left to look for his hometown, disappearing without a trace. Jiu Po never saw him again.
Lu Wen called their hometown the Origin World, but he did not enter the Myriad Heavens and World of Gods naturally. Instead, he was rescued, and the time of his rescue coincided with Yellow Springss disappearance in the historical timeline.
Daoist Yellow Springs called the Origin World the Gap Worldbecause he had indeed found the Origin World, which was located in the gap between the two worlds.
Jiu Po was most likely telling the truth. If he knew where the Origin World was, there would be no need to waste any time chatting with Gu Nan; he would just go find Yellow Springs directly.
The only possibility was that he still didnt know where his hometown was. He merely deduced Gu Nan's origin, and from some of Gu Nans strange behaviors, he realized that Gu Nan may have met Daoist Yellow Springs at some point.
In fact, if not for the history of the World of Gods being inconsistent with the history in the game, Gu Nan would not be able to follow the clues and find Daoist Yellow Springs in the gap.
But what puzzled Gu Nan was that if Daoist Yellow Springs truly rescued Lu Wen, then why would he need to deny it? And how could he allow Lu Wen to fall into Jiu Po's hands?
But if that wasn't Yellow Springs's doing Then could there be another fellow transmigrator?
Several questions swirled through Gu Nan's head, keeping him quiet for a while as he fell into deep thought.
Lu Wen and Jiu Po didn't interrupt his thoughts. It wasn't until they saw that he had come to a decision that Lu Wen said, "The events that transpired in the Origin World are in the past. Gu Nan, if you see Daoist Yellow Springs, its enough to ask him to help this humble Daoist look after a few old friends."
"Okay." Gu Nan thought for a while and finally nodded.
If there was a chance, he really did want to go back to the Origin World and take another looknot just simple communication with Fu Cheng, but having his will actually descend.
"Then, the next matter is the most important matter," Jiu Po finally stood up and said with a smile.
"You mean what we just discussed isnt important?" Gu Nan asked with a shrug.
"The following is more important." Jiu Po said seriously, "With Valens death, another Great War is inevitable, and it will even affect Unified Dao cultivators. Gu Nan, if you intend to attack the greater gods, we can help."
Gu Nan raised his head and looked at Jiu Po, then Lu Wen. "What are your conditions?"
He didn't believe these two would be altruistic enough to help for nothing. Everyone had an ulterior motive behind their actions.
Jiu Po smiled. "Youll probably refuse even if we ask you to reveal Yellow Springss whereabouts, and we most likely wont fully trust your answer either So all we want is for you to stand on our side when the time comes."
Gu Nan heard the bone-deep bloodshed contained in those words and couldn't help smiling faintly. "You want to make an enemy out of the entire Myriad Heavens?"
"I want to go home." There was no expression at all on Jiu Po's face. "Ive already been a Unified Dao cultivator for tens of thousands of years. I am tired. I just want to see my hometown again."
"Since Yellow Springs refuses to come out to see me, I will turn the entire world upside down and dig up the ground to find his trail."

chapters.title: Chapter 550: First Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: First Kill
It was already three days after he left Clockwork Heaven when Gu Nan next appeared in his own Divine Kingdom.
He believed that Jiu Po was telling the truth.
If Daoist Yellow Springs didnt exist and there were no other transmigrators who came from the same place, maybe Jiu Po really would be at ease enough to remain in the Myriad Heavens as an ancient powerhouse.
Unfortunately, Daoist Yellow Springs left to find his hometown. Jiu Po didn't choose to go with him at that time, but then he discovered the appearances of Zero, Lu Wen, Gu Nan, and others.
"If we kill all the greater gods and Unified Dao cultivators of the two worlds and gather the two worlds power, perhaps well be able to break through the dimensional wall?" Gu Nan rubbed his chin in thought and began to agree with this plan.
A normal person's thought process would probably be uniting the existing Unified Dao existences to jointly search for and develop the Origin World.
But Jiu Po, who came up with this plan, was obviously not a normal person, and Gu Nan, who accepted this plan, was even further from the definition of normal.
Then lets give it a try.
"The next one is Rolensia." Gu Nan looked at a stack of documents on the table detailing the experiences of an insignificant character over the years. This person was called Dong Xun.
World of Gods.
The thirteen greater gods Oh, there were only twelve greater gods now. They gathered once again to discuss Valens death.
"We must not pretend like nothing has happened." Ruler of War Eugene slammed his hand on the table. "This time, it was Valen. Who will it be next time?"
"Then what do you suggest we do?" Goddess of Darkness Daisy asked with a smile.
"Slaughter our way over!" Eugene answered decisively.
Austin also spoke at this time, "The mastermind behind this matter is Lu Wen. Hes wanted to kill Valen for a long time now. God of Time Sven is none other than his clone."
Gu Nan and the others struck so swiftly that the other greater gods didn't even have time to rush to the scene, so they didn't understand the specifics.
Only after hearing Austin recount the situation did they realize that the other party actually had a clone lurking here and attacked Valen in such an unpredictable way.
"That Evil God was also involved?" Ruler of Nightmares Kenneth asked gravely.
Hed personally been to the Myriad Heavens and witnessed Gu Nan's unpredictable power firsthand. At this time, he couldn't help saying, "The Evil God is growing too fast. We don't have time to waste."
By itself, Valens death wouldnt be enough of a reason for the Dark Faction to take action, but no one could stay out of the matter when the Evil God was involved.
After a period of silence, Dark Lady Daisy finally said, "Then, let's start an all-out war.
Reality proved that no amount of provocation was more provocative than directly killing a greater god.
The all-out war meant both the Light and Dark Factions began to set aside all their differences while the greater gods acted as the vanguard to proactively launch a war against the Myriad Heavens.
Such a large-scale and high-level war had never broken out between the two worlds before ever since they first came into contact with each other back in the ancient times.
Because the two sides didnt actually have many conflicts of interest in the past, nor could they gain benefits from killing the other side, so there wasnt much incentive to go to war.
But things were different now. The gods were not fighting for benefits, but for their own survival.
If the Myriad Heavens Unified Dao cultivators were allowed to continue like this, the greater gods of the World of Gods would die off one by one sooner or later, eventually ushering in a full-scale invasion by the Myriad Heavens.
And once the greater gods took the lead, a large number of gods immediately decided to join the war with almost no hesitation.
The consequences of the earlier God Hunt hadnt passed yet Speaking of which, this was all Gu Nan's fault.
The World of Gods finally launched a full-scale war. Wave after wave of the gods armies continued to pour into the Myriad Heavens, targeting none other than the Star Rulers astral worlds.
When the gods made up their minds to launch a large-scale invasion, one of the Myriad Heavens weak points was finally exposed.
Unlike Divine Kingdomswhose locations were freely selected by the gods themselvesStar Rulers essentially chose naturally-formed planes to be their astral worlds.
Therefore, while Divine Kingdoms could be established in very remote locations, Star Rulers could only fine-tune their astral worlds coordinates at most, and traces of their locations could always be found.
In just three days since the start of the war, the Myriad Heavens was caught off guard and suffered a huge loss. A large number of astral worlds were breached by the gods, many Star Rulers lost their foundations, and thousands of years of hard work was ruined in an instant.
The last time the two worlds went to war, the battlefield was actually in the World of Gods. It was a war between the defending gods and the invaders. Thus, the Star Rulers had never experienced such devastating losses before.
It wasnt like no one secretly complained about Lu Wen and the others when they learned the inside story behind the all-out war. But after hearing that Gu Nan was also involved, not many people criticized them anymore.
"Your reputation among the Star Rulers below is much higher than that of us older folks."
Li Ci remarked to Gu Nan with a smile at the meeting of the Myriad Heavens Unified Dao powers.
Gu Nan replied with a shrug, "Youll also get a reputation if you slaughter a few more waves."
Li Ci didn't know how to respond to this kind of person who could kill any conversation, so he could only focus his attention on Monk Fa Kong on the other side.
Faced with the World of Gods invasion, it was natural for the Sixteen Heavens to gather together to discuss a feasible strategy.
This time, at Yu Lians invitation, the sixteen Unified Dao existences gathered at Void Grotto Heaven. No matter their relationships or conflicts, encounters were inevitable.
Naturally, the four who ambushed Gu Nan five years ago were also present.
Among them, Song Fei and Huo Kui suffered small losses, Dream Immortal received serious injuries, and Monk Fa Kong lost so much he could cry tears of blood.
Not only was the sealed law of shadows useless to him, but Gu Nan even slaughtered his way into Three Buddha Heaven. Most of the monks there died as collateral damage from the battle between two Unified Dao bigshots.
"Amitabha." However, Monk Fa Kong was a Unified Dao powerhouse, and his control over his emotions was not to be underestimated. "Benefactor Gu Nan, we meet again."
Gu Nan glanced at him. "Want me to stay at your house some more?"
"..."
The corners of Monk Fa Kong's mouth twitched slightly. No matter how well-mannered he was, he still didn't know how to respond to Gu Nan's direct face-slapping behavior.
In fact, it was quite common for Unified Dao cultivators to attack each other or even join forces with others in battles.
It was just like how Song Fei also screwed over Zou Jiming a while back and how Song Fei secretly attacked Zi Luo Elder when the latter was trying to re-ascend to Unified Dao.
As long as there was no absolute power gap between them, this kind of thing would only be limited to small conflicts. It was very rare for someone to be determined to kill the other party.
Because if the two sides insisted on starting a war, if nothing else, both of their astral worlds would definitely not survive, and it would only end in a lose-lose situation for both sides.
Monk Fa Kong screwed others over before and had also been screwed over by others, but he had never seen someone as keen on face-slapping as Gu Nan.
Fortunately, Li Ci came to his rescue, "Since everyone is here, let's talk business."
From the main seat, Yu Lian also said, "The Great War is coming, and no one can stay out of this matter. Right now, I hope everyone will put aside their prejudices to fight our common enemy as a united front."
Gu Nan was the first to agree, "No problem, I can kill a greater god first."
This kind of relaxed toneas if killing a greater god was as easy as killing a chickenmade everyone look at him.
"Are you certain of your success?" Yu Lian asked him, "Who are you going to kill?"
"Of course its" Gu Nan paused, then glanced around. "Ruler of War, Eugene."

chapters.title: Chapter 551: Mu Qishuang
chapters.content:
551 Chapter 551: Mu Qishuang
"You really want to kill Eugene first?"
"I lied."
"Then who's your true target?"
"None of your damn business."
The above conversation took place between Zou Jiming and Gu Nan after the Unified Dao meeting. Classmate Zou Jiming, who'd always been good at worming his way into being friends with people, seemed to have hit a wall with Gu Nan.
But Zou Jiming didn't seem to care. Maybe he'd long grown accustomed to these kinds of situations.
Unable to get any more information out of Gu Nan, he left with a smile, having no intention of pestering Gu Nan any further.
In fact, not many arguments or disputes happened during this meeting of the Sixteen Heavens. Even though the conflict was triggered by Lu Wen and Gu Nan, war was unavoidable—everyone knew that.
Right now, it was meaningless to argue about whose fault this was. This meeting was more about entering a firm and unanimous alliance against the external threat and formulating their next plans.
But any plan they could think of paled in comparison to Gu Nan's "I'll kill one first" remark.
Since Gu Nan had this confidence, the Unified Dao powers didn't mind supporting this plan of his.
In any case, Gu Nan would be the only person losing face if the operation ultimately failed, which would only cause his words to hold little weight in the future. On the other hand, they wouldn't suffer any real losses.
...
In Clockwork Heaven, when Gu Nan, Lu Wen, and Jiu Po sat together again, the topic of discussion was naturally what Gu Nan just said.
"Do you think some of us will secretly leak that information to the World of Gods?" Lu Wen asked.
Regarding Gu Nan's target of Eugene, he subconsciously felt that it was unlikely. In terms of both difficulty level and strength, Eugene was not the best choice at the moment.
In the Great War between the two worlds, Eugene was almost certainly the commander-in-chief of the war operation. There was no doubt about this.
To put it bluntly, as soon as the war started, he would basically never leave Austin's side for even half a second. Even if he joined the battlefield in person, his top priority would still be ensuring his own safety.
Killing Eugene would definitely deal a heavy blow to the World of Gods and bring the entire wartime command chain to a standstill, but it would undoubtedly be extremely difficult.
There were so many possible targets, so why would Gu Nan pick the hardest one?
"Even if no one leaks it, we still have to have someone to leak this matter." Gu Nan said, "So what if they know it might be a diversion? Would they dare leave Eugene unguarded after that?"
Gu Nan took a sip of tea. "Old Lu, you don't understand just what kind of existence Evil Gods are to these gods. They even believe I can destroy the world. What can't they believe?"
"You have a point…" Lu Wen gently twirled the short beard on his chin.
He also didn't quite understand the greater gods' thoughts. At least based on his interactions with Gu Nan, the other party was not someone with self-destructive tendencies. Rather, Gu Nan was excessively rational.
In Lu Wen's eyes, any decision Gu Nan made must certainly bring him the greatest benefit, and for this goal, he could ignore all morality and rules.
Sometimes onlookers might think his actions unwise or outrageous, but in the end, time would always prove that Gu Nan was right all along. It's just that outsiders couldn't see the whole picture at first.
Gu Nan then glanced at Jiu Po again. "You guys can arrange for someone to leak the information. I need to find a person in the Sixteen Heavens who has no connection to me on the surface to do something for me."
"Not a problem." Jiu Po immediately nodded. He'd been operating in the Myriad Heavens for tens of thousands of years, and the current Sixteen Heavens' Star Rulers were all basically his juniors.
There were quite many people he secretly invested in—like Song Fei—who had a good relationship with him. It's just that very few people knew about their relationship.
If Song Fei's attack on Zi Luo Elder hadn't had such a huge impact, he probably also wouldn't be remembered until now.
...
Inside the Divine Kingdom, Gu Nan was sitting comfortably in the Evil God Temple, waiting for the person arranged by Jiu Po to arrive.
After harvesting Valen's Evil Value, he already took a big step towards Tier 13. Of course, if he only relied on the Blasphemer Project, he'd still have to wait for a long time.
This waiting time would at least be ten to twenty years, and that was even taking into account the increased efficiency from further expansion of the Greater God Dimension.
But in reality, with the resumption of the Great War between the two worlds, it was a foregone conclusion that a large number of gods would fall, and the Blasphemer Project could only be said to be the meat on a mosquito's leg, better than nothing.
"In the end, I still have to hunt greater gods…" Gu Nan understood his situation very well.
Starting from now, every greater god was extremely precious and must not be allowed to die at anyone else's hands, or else he might end up having to raise greater gods himself.
For greater gods and Unified Dao cultivators, level was not too important. At most, it only affected the upper limit of their power output.
What truly determined one's combat effectiveness was more the nature of their laws and actual fighting style. There were all too many cases of tactics deciding victory or defeat in fights. Anyhow, with their astral worlds and Divine Kingdoms around, everyone's power was practically endless.
But Gu Nan was different. Level would actually affect the strength of his Evil God physique, which in turn determined how long he could last against the enemy. In contrast, the increase in attack power became less significant. In any case, everyone would die in one punch.
"Teacher, someone…" Yan Xiaoxiao's voice sounded a little urgent. It was obvious that the person did not enter through normal methods, having broken into the Evil God Temple directly.
"It's okay." Gu Nan waved his hand. This was the person recommended by Jiu Po.
In the Evil God Temple, a travel-worn figure appeared before Gu Nan. This was a graceful young girl in a light green dress. There was a strange pattern painted on her face, which made her appear somewhat bewitching.
This was the only other female Unified Dao existence in the Sixteen Heavens besides Yu Lian and Dream Immortal—Azure Sky Heaven's Mu Qishuang.
Gu Nan had met everyone in the Sixteen Heavens. He only had a superficial understanding of some, while others left a deeper impression. Mu Qishuang belonged to the latter category.
The reason she left a deep impression was because she was a Unified Dao cultivator with a very special law.
This kind of law was so special that not even Gu Nan had seen it before. Perhaps such a law never even appeared in the entire World of Gods. It was a law that belonged exclusively to the Myriad Heavens.
To "commune with Heaven"—this was the name of Mu Qishuang's law.
Mu Qishuang could communicate with the Heavenly Dao of any world. Her cultivation path was to continuously understand and communicate with all planes until she mastered every aspect of them.
However, the World of Gods did not have so many planes in the first place, and the artificially-built Divine Kingdoms couldn't be communicated with casually, so such a law naturally wouldn't exist there.
"Jiu Po said you need my help with something?" After a brief greeting, Mu Qishuang cut straight to the chase.
"That's right." Gu Nan nodded. "I need you to help me train a person and have him advance to Tier 5 as soon as possible. It would be best if he can join the Heaven-God Alliance and head to the World of Gods."
While saying this, Gu Nan also handed over all the information about Dong Xun to Mu Qishuang.
The pawn called Dong Xun must be handled by someone with no connection to Gu Nan, or else this bait might not be able to catch a big fish.

chapters.title: Chapter 552: Dong Xun and Qi Zhi
chapters.content:
The Heaven-God Alliance played a major role in helping Rolensia become a greater god, and even Gu Nan himself participated in the operation.
As the first greater god to break through in the Myriad Heavens, Rolensia's entire ascension process could be said to be "stumbling through the dark". Even the Heaven-God Alliance itself had zero prior experience.
Therefore, in order to ensure she wouldn’t be noticed by the Thirteen Heavens, Rolensia chose to shatter her soul and give it to members of the Heaven-God Alliance to "smuggle" in batches and transport to the Myriad Heavens.
But during this process, Gu Nan secretly hid a fragment and used it to cultivate a chess piece named Dong Xun.
The loss of only a very small portion of her soul actually had no impact on Rolensia herself, and she might not even be aware of it.
But it would become an uncontrollable weakness when someone with malicious intentions took advantage of this.
……
Azure Sky Heaven.
"Dong Xun? My Lord, this person is…?"
"You don't need to worry about who this is. Just do as it says."
"Yes, My Lord."
Mu Qishuang watched her subordinates leave, but her gaze also landed on the dossier on the table. She had read the information on Dong Xun no less than ten times, but she still couldn’t discover anything unusual.
Mu Qishuang was not a fool. On the surface, Gu Nan said he wanted to attack Eugene, but secretly, he found her—someone completely unrelated to him—through Jiu Po. His goal must not be simple.
But Dong Xun's experience seemed to be nothing special.
From an ordinary mortal in a small plane, he gradually grew through the occasional fortunate encounters. Now, he already had Void Cutter Realm cultivation.
Although his progress seemed a little fast, considering the existence of the reincarnation system, it was actually not uncommon at all.
Maybe the key was what he found through a fortunate encounter? But it wasn’t like she could cut Dong Xun open and take a look, so she could only wait for him to reveal some clues.
……
While Mu Qishuang was wondering about Dong Xun's origins, Dong Xun himself was standing in Zi Luo Heaven, staring curiously at everything around him.
A while had already passed since Dong Xun broke through to Void Cutter Realm, but he’d been staying in his original small plane until now, busy dealing with the karma left over from earlier years.
In some small planes, breaking through to Void Cutter Realm was described as ascending. Many people believed that it was impossible to come back after ascending to become an immortal, so they naturally had to deal with all the "karma" they left in the mortal world before that.
It wasn't until Dong Xun "ascended" to some large planes that he discovered that this was not the case at all.
He began to understand the nature of this world, the relationship between the major planes, and gradually understood the principle behind Void Cutter Realm.
But Dong Xun still couldn't find any clues about the origin of the voice in his head and the mysterious person he first met.
With Dong Xun's current ability, he wasn’t qualified to explore too much. All he could do at present was ensure his own survival.
As the most well-known neutral plane in the Myriad Heavens, Zi Luo Heaven was extremely famous to begin with. After Zi Luo Elder ascended to Unified Dao and forcibly absorbed all the organizations in Zi Luo Heaven, his reputation did not fall but actually rose.
Because although Zi Luo Elder was tyrannical, he wasn’t someone who wanted to oppress the major organizations. On the contrary, as long as they were willing to cooperate, they all received better benefits and treatment.
In any case, it was better to have a Unified Dao powerhouse as backing than to rely on one's own efforts.
To put it simply, Zi Luo Heaven had transformed from a loose organizational platform into a gigantic organization with a unified system and comprehensive organizational structure.
And the absolute core of this organization was undoubtedly the Heaven-God Alliance.
"This is the Heaven-God Alliance," a girl introduced to Dong Xun. "But it’ll be very hard for you to join the Heaven-God Alliance"
Dong Xun just replied with a smile, "I’ll do my best."
The girl shrugged and said noncommittally, "Then I'll wait for you outside…"
"You mean wait for my triumphant return." Dong Xun revealed a peaceful smile, as if he was a completely different person from his psychotic, stubborn past self.
Those who never saw the former Dong Xun probably wouldn’t be able to believe these two were the same person.
The two parted ways. Dong Xun walked towards the Heaven-God Alliance, while the girl turned around and walked back, where a man in blue was already waiting for her.
"I've done what you guys asked of me. Where’s the reward?" The girl asked, glaring at the man in blue.
The stranger casually took out a box and handed it to the girl. "Two Ghost Spirit Fruit seeds. Relax, our organization won’t rob you of such a small reward."
What the man said was very true. After all, he was the trusted aide of a Unified Dao existence, so he wouldn’t be so stingy as to renege on a Void Cutter’s resources.
Besides, if not for this girl named Qi Zhi, Dong Xun wouldn't have been referred to the Heaven-God Alliance so easily.
The mission handed down from above was so urgent that they didn’t even have time to formulate a proper plan, so they could only start with the people around Dong Xun.
Fortunately, they discovered someone like Qi Zhi among Dong Xun’s acquaintances. She had a great desire for cultivation resources and didn't mind doing small tasks for them.
"Let's chat a little." The man in blue smiled lightly. "What do you think of Dong Xun?"
"What’s there to think about?" Qi Zhi shrugged. "In terms of strength, he’s not bad. In terms of personality, he’s foolish and easy to trick—that’s all."
The man nodded. "There will be other opportunities like this in the future. Stay by Dong Xun’s side, do you understand?"
Qi Zhi no longer doubted the mystery organization’s financial resources, but her thoughts swirled, and she asked, "Just who is Dong Xun, to make you guys scheme him like this?"
"That isn’t something you should know." The man pushed the table and stood up. His figure quickly disappeared from Qi Zhi's sight.
Qi Zhi could only shrug and look away, waiting for Dong Xun to return.
She was already a Void Cutter back when she first met the not-yet Void Cutter Realm Dong Xun and even gave him a lot of help. This was how the two became acquainted.
At that time, it was just an offhand gesture on Qi Zhi’s part, but now, Dong Xun seemed to be a large treasure buried in the ground, just waiting for her to unearth.
‘Should I take this chance to seduce him?’ Such a thought occurred to Qi Zhi, but she then discarded it.
‘First, let’s figure out why this mysterious organization wants to lead Dong Xun to the Heaven-God Alliance. If they’re planning to set a trap for him, then won’t I also be implicated if we become a couple?’
Qi Zhi shook her head repeatedly.
……
Just as Dong Xun followed Azure Sky Heaven’s guidance and walked step by step towards the route Gu Nan designed for him, Gu Nan himself had arrived at the boundary between the two worlds.
The goal of his trip this time was still the World of Gods, but he met an unexpected person at the border.
"Are you making your move now?" Yu Lian seemed to have been waiting here for a long time. She stared at Gu Nan and asked, "Eugene is not your real target, right?"
Many people were able to guess that Gu Nan was lying, but there weren’t many like Yu Lian, who could predict the route Gu Nan would take and wait there to personally verify her conjecture.
"That's right." Gu Nan nodded without denying it. "But even if it's a lie, I still have to show these gods just why their legends say Evil Gods are capable of destroying the world."

chapters.title: Chapter 553: Restrain
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Restrain
This gods hatred for Evil Gods essentially stemmed from their fear.
They feared that the Evil Gods tremendous power and cunning, unpredictable methods would cause the entire world to perish.
The gods' belief in ancient legends and reverence for mysticism made them emphasize the terror and power of Evil Gods, even if they had to ignore their own experiences.
In other words, they would rather believe the legends than risk the destruction of the world.
This kind of thought process would cause Gu Nan a lot of trouble in a world where there were only gods, but in a place where two worlds coexisted, it turned out to be something he could take advantage of.
When Gu Nan announced his plans to attack a certain greater god, all the greater gods would inevitably take action in response; one dared to underestimate him.
Gu Nans announcement at the Unified Dao meeting actually reached all the greater gods ears already, but its authenticity had yet to be verified.
It wasnt like the Unified Dao cultivators could just run over and tell them the news was true, so it would still take some time to confirm, but protective measures for Eugene had already started in the meantime.
Eugene sat at the very back of the World of Gods and directly commanded all armies, so that the power of the gods could be twisted into a firm rope that could bring out 120% of its strength.
And Austin always left a clone by his side. If something happened, Austin could return at any time.
In fact, every single greater god was surrounded by the wills of the top greater gods to prevent them from being defeated one by one.
The Light Faction had Ruler of Light and Justice Austin and Ruler of Ashen Cyan Boswell, while the Dark Faction had Dark Lady Daisy and Death God Baal.
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan was the oldest greater god still alive today and could be called a living fossil among gods. On the other hand, the God of Death wasnt very old, but his laws were special, so he could be regarded as one of the strongest greater gods.
Austin was out at the moment, so Boswell was guarding Eugene.
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan was dressed in dark blue robes, holding a wooden staff that was taller than a person. He had a long beard and white hair, and even his eyebrows were white.
Eugene was still issuing orders and directing frontline operations, but today, he wasnt as efficient and often hesitated.
"Relax." Boswell tapped the staff in his hand and said to Eugene, "The Evil God must be destroyed, and he will certainly be destroyed."
Eugene let out a long breath. He did not deny that it was the Evil God's words that brought him pressure, but he knew that it was not fear, but caution.
If he forced himself to underestimate the other side because of the Evil Gods existence, only then would he truly be affected.
"Lord Boswell, is the Evil God truly so frightening?" Eugene couldn't help voicing the doubts in his heart when no one else was around.
With the Ruler of Ashen Cyans strength and experience, it wasnt unusual for Eugene to use honorifics with him.
It was impossible for the greater gods to hold no doubts about the legends of the Evil God.
As mentioned before, this was a mentality where they would rather believe the worst-case scenario than be caught off guard, which was why no one among the gods would publicly voice any doubts. Only in front of a knowledgeable person like the Ruler of Ashen Cyan would Eugene even ask such a question.
He originally thought Boswell would quote the classics and use various methods to demonstrate the Evil Gods power and cruelty, but the latter only said one sentence.
"Yes." Boswell merely nodded. "No matter the circumstances, never underestimate the power of the Evil God."
All the way towards the rear of the World of Gods, the ancient Boswell stood before Eugene. His extremely certain expression gave the latter an unspeakable shock.
"I understand." Eugene nodded heavily, having completely restrained his unruly nature right now as he responded with the utmost caution.
However, just when Eugene made up his mind, a foreign energy started to appear near the two.
"Hes here." The Ruler of Ashen Cyans voice suddenly paused. The staff in his hand was already pointing towards a certain corner, and a cyan beam of light directly hit Gu Nan, exposing his location.
As the oldest god in the world, the Ruler of Ashen Cyan's level was roughly between Tiers 14 and 15, but in an actual fight, not even Austin dared claim he could win for certain.
If Gu Nan was at Tier 15, he would have more confidence in his chances than Austin did, but unfortunately, he was still only at Tier 12 right now.
The level suppression caused his law of shadows to lose its exceptional concealment abilities, making it impossible for him to launch a preemptive sneak attack.
"Boswell?" Gu Nan's eyes landed on the Ruler of Ashen Cyan, and he couldn't help smiling. To think even you came out."
Ruler of Ashen Cyan and Demon King Stanleythese two old farts had always been the most mysterious among the greater gods, and they rarely appeared in public. Unexpectedly, even Boswell showed himself.
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan had no intention of speaking with Gu Nan. He waved his staff again, and the cyan light began to envelope the entire hall.
As soon as Gu Nan appeared, the power of holy light also descended simultaneously, the holy sword crashing down on Gu Nan's head again.
Austin had arrived!
It could be said that these greater gods did not give Gu Nan even the slightest opportunity. In just an instant, Austin arrived directly. It was impossible for Gu Nan to kill Eugene now.
But Gu Nans figure vanished instantly without the slightest hesitation. This time, even the Ruler of Ashen Cyan couldn't tell his location.
"He ran away. Hes also targeting someone else," Austin immediately said after scanning their surroundings with holy light and finding no trace of Gu Nan.
The greater gods were not fools. Gu Nan's sudden appearance and disappearance undoubtedly contained ulterior motives. The most likely reason was that he had another target.
At this moment, Austin's gaze suddenly shifted again, and his figure quickly vanished.
"Daphne."
Gu Nan suddenly showed up on the battlefields frontlines at precisely Daphnes location, which shocked the two currently fighting.
Daphne was one of the greater gods who came to the battlefield in person, and the one fighting her now was Underworld Heavens Qin Guanruo.
The two laws of life and death rapidly alternated and collided, dyeing the entire sky two different colors. This display continued until Gu Nans sudden appearance, shocking Daphne into quickly retreating.
This was not the first time that they encountered a "gank" during a proper fight.
After all, not all the greater gods and Unified Dao experts had shown themselves, and Gu Nan wasnt the only one to come up with the strategy of concentrating firepower to kill a single person.
Daphne retreated in time, but Gu Nan moved even faster. Almost as soon as he appeared, his fist landed on Daphne's head.
But this attack was different from the sneak attack on Valen. It could be said that Daphne had always maintained the utmost vigilance.
As soon as Gu Nan struck, she had already erected a law barrier. Although Gu Nan's fist instantly shattered it, the punch was delayed slightly, giving her the chance to retreat.
More importantly, with Daphne's split-second delay, the holy light found them again. After being played by Gu Nan several times, Austin seemed furious.
"All evil will eventually return to nothingness!"

chapters.title: Chapter 554: Awakening
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Awakening
The overwhelming holy light fell down instantly, shrouding the entire battlefield.
Qin Guanruo frowned slightly. Hed witnessed Austin's terrifying might before, and his own laws were vaguely suppressed by the holy light, so it was hard for him to stay here any longer.
Thus, Qin Guanruo did not choose to remain and also hid quickly, but he did not leave immediately, instead observing the situation from afar.
In any case, Gu Nan was still a member of the Myriad Heavens, and Qin Guanruo could not just sit back and watch him be killed.
However, to his surprise, Gu Nan seemed completely unaffected by the all-consuming holy light that was difficult to resist in Qin Guanruos eyes. He took a shower in the holy light, then leisurely turned and left.
"He ran away?" Daphne couldn't help asking in shock when Gu Nan's energy signature completely disappeared.
She clearly wasnt very familiar with the characteristics of Gu Nan's law of shadows. In fact, after reaching Tier 12, his law evolved to make it harder for Gu Nan to be found, which was why he dared to act like this.
"It's shadows," Austin answered in a heavy voice.
In the past, Gu Nan's level was too low, so his enemies tended to focus on his Evil God physique while overlooking the special nature of his law of shadows. Now, someone finally realized it.
Light and shadow were two sides of the same coin to begin with. Even his younger sister wielded the law of shadows, so Austin understood the special nature of shadows very well.
This was not a law that specialized in attack, but its concealment and stealth abilities were far superior to that of other laws.
Before Austin could say anything else, his figure disappeared againbecause Gu Nan had already gone ahead to his next target.
Eugene again!
In the rear, Eugene, who let out a small sigh of relief because Gu Nan had just been driven away, finally found himself faced with Gu Nan's full power.
This time, Gu Nan didn't greet Boswell, throwing a punch with all his strength as soon as he appeared!
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan reacted extremely quickly as his power instantly enveloped Eugene's body, trying to prevent Eugene from being killed in one punch, but the target of Gu Nan's attack suddenly shifted to himself midway through.
Boswell was thrown into the air. Fortunately, he wasnt completely without the protection of his laws, so he wasnt killed in one blow either.
Holy light burst forth again. Austin's expression was already a little frigid. He moved extremely fast this time, and the holy sword seemed to have grown eyes of its own, landing in advance at Gu Nans destination.
But Gu Nan made no attempt to dodge and allowed the sword to strike him. Most of his body was destroyed in an instant. Countless holy flames invaded his body and seemed to completely burn away his internal organs.
But Gu Nan just laughed and vanished again, using the law of shadows to its fullest.
The Evil God physique had recovered in the blink of an eye. Austin's gaze turned slightly icy, and he rushed to Daphne's side in advance without waiting for Gu Nan to move.
But this time, Gu Nan set his sight on someone elseRolensia!
Rolensia and Daphne could be regarded as the two weakest points among the current greater gods, so Gu Nan's choice didnt make Austin suspicious. However, his response was slightly slower this time.
Because he knew that others would help Rolensia this time.
A punch smashed down on Rolensias head, but at the same time, a scythe appeared, blocking the path of Gu Nan's punch and rendering it useless.
Ever since Gu Nan completed the Second Round, this was the first time someone successfully used the power of laws to forcibly block his fist.
"Evil God." A grayed-haired young man wearing a gray cloak slowly walked out from beside Rolensia and stared at Gu Nan with cold eyes.
Baal, the God of Death.
The God of Death was also a position that had gone through several successors. Like the God of Knowledge, almost every generation was stronger than the previous one.
Because the more lives that died in this world, the stronger the power of death would become. This was true from generation to generation.
Faced with the Death Gods sudden appearance, Gu Nan just curled his lips into a mocking smile. He also had no intention of staying for long and disappeared again under the fluctuation of the law of shadows.
No one could catch himholder of the law of shadowsand no one could instakill his Evil God physique, which meant Gu Nan could wander alone behind enemy lines without fear.
But while there are only four people in the Light Faction now, there are eight in the Dark Faction. Can you guys protect them all?
Gu Nan's figure blurred, lurking in the shadows once more. When he looked back at the frontline battlefield again, he felt like laughing.
He suddenly discovered that all the Dark Factions greater gods would always be in groups whenever they appeared on the battlefield, and there were only two groups max at a time.
It was evident that everyone in the Dark Faction had also witnessed his earlier back and forth with the Light Faction, which gave them time to prepare countermeasures.
Gathering into two groups did not mean the two Dark Faction leaders could each protect one grouprather, it made it easier for the Dark Lady and the God of Death to keep track of them so that they could rush to their side as soon as possible.
"How interesting." Gu Nan smiled, then returned to the Myriad Heavens.
By keeping them in check like this, not many from the World of Gods dared to show themselves, and at the same time, it disrupted the greater gods focus, so he pretty much achieved his goal.
Zi Luo Heaven.
"You succeeded? You actually succeeded?" Qi Zhi widened her eyes, pretending to be surprised as she stared at Dong Xun.
Dong Xun seemed to enjoy Qi Zhi's surprise. He, who had always been gentle, now looked immensely proud of himself.
Of course, in reality, Qi Zhi knew all too well that Dong Xun would definitely succeed. That mysterious organization put so much effort into guiding Dong Xun to join the Heaven-God Alliance, so how could they let him fail?
But Qi Zhi's face gave nothing away, and she continued to show a surprised expression, probing for the mysterious organizations next goal.
"Now that youve joined the Heaven-God Alliance, does the organization have any missions for you?" Qi Zhi asked.
"There is one." Dong Xun nodded and said with a slight frown, "It turns out that the Heaven-God Alliance is a joint alliance of the two worlds. The first mission wants me to head to the World of Gods."
"World of Gods?" Qi Zhi looked confused. She wasnt pretending this time; she really was confused.
The two worlds overall situation was actually quite vague for ordinary Void Cutters.
Even Dong Xun himself just learned so the world was actually like this after he joined the Heaven-God Alliance, and the first mission the organization assigned him was to head there to kill a target.
After listening to Dong Xun's explanation and learning what kind of existence the World of Gods was, Qi Zhi couldn't help offering, "That must be very far How about I go with you?"
"Really?!" Dong Xun suddenly looked pleasantly surprised. He really wanted Qi Zhi to go with him, but he didn't know how to bring it up.
"Really." Qi Zhi nodded vigorously without any hesitation. Because just now, a mysterious voice rang in her ears.
"If you go with him, you can get double your previous reward."
But what Qi Zhi didn't know was that at this time, a will was slowly awakening inside Dong Xun's mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 555: Legend of the Sixteen Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: Legend of the Sixteen Heavens
Ah Hua? Is that you, Ah Hua? Dong Xun called out to the consciousness in his head.
Don't call me Ah Hua" The newly awakened consciousness slowly spoke, but her voice sounded a little weak.
Pleasant surprise flashed across Dong Xun's features. He was currently staying in a hotel and had a rare moment of alone time, so he immediately called out to the existence in his mind.
The split soul that called herself "Luxuriant Blossoms" actually fell into a deep slumber when she was forced to overuse her power due to an accident during Dong Xuns journey.
It wasn't until Dong Xun broke through to Void Cutter Realm and had enough power to feed this soul fragment that the Luxuriant Blossoms soul remnant gradually awakened.
Dong Xun seemed very happy about "Ah Huas awakening. After communicating with the other party, he recounted all his experiences during this time to the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment.
"Heaven-God Alliance? World of Gods?" The Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment sounded slightly confused, "In my memory, that place seems to be related to my origins Maybe you can see my original body there."
"Your original body?" Dong Xun repeated with slight difficulty.
If this soul fragment that accompanied him through his journey ended up meeting her original body, then wouldnt she be reabsorbed by the original?
As if seeing through Dong Xun's thoughts, the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment reassured him with a smile, "I am me, and the original is the original. I no longer have any connection with my original body. If you can reach that point, perhaps we can even replace her."
After Rolensia deliberately shattered her own soul and successfully recombined it, this extra soul fragment had no connection to the original body anymore.
Even the memories she could get were pitiful, and her memory of the original body was still frozen at Tier 10.
If she knew that Rolensia had already ascended to a greater god, she would definitely not have such thoughts.
"What is your mission this time?" The Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment asked. After she gained a general understanding of the Heaven-God Alliances situation, she immediately became concerned about this issue.
Dong Xun answered without much hesitation, "They want me to kill a target. I wont know the specifics until I get there."
It was actually rare for the mission details to not be disclosed in advance. However, considering that Dong Xun had just joined the organization and they had never been in contact with an organization as powerful as the Heaven-God Alliance before, the two had no objections.
On the contrary, Dong Xun was quite eager to give it a try. He couldn't wait to complete the mission in order to receive the organizations rewards.
The mission rewards that an organization at the level of the Heaven-God Alliance gave its members made Dong Xun, a Void Cutter from a small plane, stare in stunned silence for a while.
And this was just his reward as an unofficial member. After all, all the official members of the Heaven-God Alliance were all gods and Star Rulers.
The Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment was quiet for a long time, as if considering Dong Xun's overall experience during her slumber, then asked, "Don't you think this entire process seems too smooth?"
These words startled Dong Xun slightly. As a matter of fact, he did feel that everything had gone very smoothly recently, but this was also the result of his hard work, so he didn't suspect much.
On the other hand, the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment was able to see things more clearly because she was an onlooker. As soon as she heard Dong Xun's recounting, she felt that something was off.
Dong Xun greatly valued the Luxuriant Blossom soul fragments opinion. After thinking about it carefully, he couldnt help saying, "Youre right. Before starting the mission, I need to consult Elder Tang first."
Early the next morning, Dong Xun temporarily set aside his thoughts about the mission and informed Qi Zhi that he planned to make a trip back to Black River World.
Dong Xun's hometown was Heavenly Province World, the famous frontline plane. But after obtaining the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment, he was sent to another small plane by Gu Nan, which was none other than Black River World.
"What are you going to Black River World for?" Qi Zhi asked in confusion, "The mission is about to start. Why don't you head to the World of Gods earlier to prepare?"
Dong Xun shook his head. "My recent experience seems to be a little too smooth-sailing. I plan to ask Elder Tang for advice."
These words startled Qi Zhi a little. After all, she was all too aware that Dong Xun's recent experience was indeed deliberately arranged by someone, and even she was involved in it.
"Who is Elder Tang?" Qi Zhi suppressed the emotions in her heart and changed the subject.
Shed known Dong Xun for a long time, but she didnt know much about Dong Xun's experiences before reaching Void Cutter Realm.
"A senior worthy of respect," Dong Xun answered seriously.
Black River World.
"What a rare visitor!" An elderly man in plain clothes exclaimed with a smile, looking at Dong Xun and Qi Zhi in front of him. "Dong Xun, why do you still have time to visit my place?"
"Elder Tang." Dong Xun bowed honestly and then introduced the two of them.
Qi Zhi just greeted him politely. She nodded slightly, then stood behind Dong Xun without saying anything else.
She had no friendship with this Elder Tang. He was nothing more than a Prodigious Realm mortal, so naturally, she didnt place much value on him. If it weren't for Dong Xun, she wouldn't even spare this old man a second glance.
As for respecting the elderly and cherishing the young, this simply didnt work among Void Cuttersthis Elder Tang might not even be as old as Qi Zhi herself.
Before Dong Xun broke through, he received a lot of help from Elder Tang and was able to establish his own forces in Black River World.
"Elder Tang, I came here because I was hoping to consult you on certain matters," Dong Xun started and briefly explained the problem.
After hearing the whole story, Elder Tang frowned slightly and asked Dong Xun for a few more details. After a moment of silence, he finally spoke.
"Judging from your experience alone, it does look like someone powerful has intervened." Elder Tang said in a low voice, "But"
"But what?" Qi Zhi asked. She was actually the one who cared the most about Elder Tangs answer.
Elder Tang's gaze only lingered on Qi Zhi for a moment. Then he shook his head and continued, "One of the Sixteen Heavens is behind the Heaven-God Alliance, so no one can control them."
"Sixteen Heavens?" Dong Xun repeated doubtfully. He did not have enough knowledge about the highest forces in the Myriad Heavens.
For example, he knew that Zi Luo Heaven was very powerful and the Heaven-God Alliance was also very powerful, but he didn't quite understand exactly how powerful they were.
"Sixteen Heavens?!" Unlike Dong Xun, although Qi Zhi also didn't know about the Heaven-God Alliances backer, she had at least heard of the Sixteen Heavens before.
Dong Xun was still confused, but Qi Zhi had already reacted and said repeatedly, "Since its someone from the Sixteen Heavens, theres no need to worry about someone manipulating the Heaven-God Alliance from behind the scenes. This is simply impossible."
