Elder Tang also agreed, "That's right. Dong Xun, at least you dont have to worry that someone is pulling the strings behind your act of joining the Heaven-God Alliance. On the contrary, if you really are targeted by a powerful figure, the Heaven-God Alliance can even become your backing."
With the affirmations from Elder Tang and Qi Zhi, Dong Xun felt much more at ease, and he also felt like hed been too paranoid.
He was just an ordinary person with a few fortunate encounters. Why would so many powerhouses pay attention to him?

chapters.title: Chapter 556: Player
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Player
"In that case, this humble one will take his leave first." Dong Xun received a satisfactory answer and seemed to be in a good mood, so he left immediately.
He was now anxious to return to Zi Luo Heaven to make preparations to head to the World of Gods and complete the mission assigned by the Heaven-God Alliance.
Dong Xun already made up his mind to gain considerable status within the Heaven-God Alliance so that he would have a backing if he ever encountered a powerhouse in the future.
But after hearing about the Sixteen Heavens, for some reason, he remembered the silver-robed masked figure he met back then.
He was originally from Heavenly Province World but was forcibly sent to Black River World. That silver-masked person even left a small black dagger in his body.
If theres a powerful person observing my movements, then hes probably involved I wonder how that person compares to the Sixteen Heavens? Dong Xun thought to himself.
It was a pity that he didn't know the mysterious figures appearance, or else it shouldn't be hard to trace his identity.
Only after Dong Xun and Qi Zhi left did Elder Tang gradually relax, and another person slowly emerged in front of him.
If Qi Zhi was here, she would definitely recognize himthis was the man in blue shed met before who gave her resources and missions.
"You did well." The newcomer nodded with a smile. Evidently, hed heard the entire conversation between Elder Tang and Dong Xun.
There wasnt much of an expression on Elder Tang's face. He just inquired with a smile, "I wonder which of the Sixteen Heavens does Your Excellency belong to?"
The newcomer paused slightly, then lifted his head to stare at Old Tang. "You even know about this? You dont seem like someone who came from a small plane."
There was no reason for people inside small planes to be so familiar with forces at the Unified Dao level.
Elder Tang shook his head slightly, as if to indicate this was nothing much. "Of course its impossible for normal people to control the one behind the Heaven-God Alliance, but if its someone whos also part of the Sixteen Heavens, having the Heaven-God Alliance do some small tasks for them wont be a problem."
The man in blue looked a little more grave and said darkly, "It would be best not to investigate matters you shouldn't know about."
"Of course." Elder Tang smiled. "I have no intention of going against a powerful figure. Dong Xun is just a child I met in my early years."
He distanced himself from Dong Xun, implying that he would not get involved if a bigshot was interested in Dong Xun.
The man gave him a meaningful glance, then quickly vanished, reappearing in front of several other people.
"Go investigate this person surnamed Tang." He said to several of his subordinates, "Especially what he did before coming to Black River World. Dont leave anything out!"
"Yes!" His underlings hurriedly left, but one person walked up from behind.
"This person might be a variable. Do you want to inform Her Excellency?"
"Forget it. There's no need to trouble My Lord over such a trivial matter." The man thought for a while and finally shook his head. He recalled Mu Qishuang's expression when she assigned this matter. It probably wasnt that important.
Just as Dong Xun joined the Heaven-God Alliance and was about to embark on a journey to the World of Gods, the war between the two worlds entered a slight lull and became less intense than at the start.
The greater gods attacked less frequently, but the gods below were still constantly invading the Myriad Heavens with the goal of destroying the Star Rulers astral worlds. They showed remarkable results.
This was because both sides were far more determined than before, and it was a battle at the greater god level from the beginning.
As a result, after a long period of fighting, both sides highest-level combatants were somewhat worn-out. Many bigshots even sustained injuries, so the frequency of their attacks naturally declined.
In fact, in terms of high-end combat power, the World of Gods should be inferior. After all, they only had twelve greater gods, while the Myriad Heavens had the "Sixteen Heavens".
But in comparison, the Unified Dao cultivators werent very united, and Yu Lian had nowhere near the prestige of Austin, Daisy, and the others. She could not directly order everyone to join the war.
For example, Emperor Zhao of God Emperor Heaven, Jiu Po, Si Yun, and others had not taken action so far, but in contrast, Lu Wen was quite active.
It couldnt be helped. As the culprit who killed Valen, he received special treatment from the gods, and some people even came to his Clockwork Heaven directly to cause trouble.
On the contrary, Gu Nan, the Evil God, had such a vicious reputation that ordinary gods were warned off by the greater gods. As a result, not many people dared to harass Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom.
However, the battles between greater gods and Unified Dao cultivators were gradually slowing down, which meant the two sides had now entered a war of attrition. Both sides were throwing away countless lives in hopes of the other side not being able to hold on any longer.
Of course, a large part of the credit for making the greater gods dare not show themselves actually went to Gu Nan. It could be said that the war entered the attrition stage in advance, which was precisely the result of Gu Nans deliberate manipulation.
"What are you planning?" In Azure Sky Heaven, Mu Qishuang looked at Gu Nan, who was sitting comfortably on a chair, and tilted her head.
During this period, Gu Nan had been staying in Azure Sky Heaven, personally controlling all the plans involving Dong Xun.
Mu Qishuang was just a cover to hide the truth from others. It was impossible for her to realize Gu Nan's intentions perfectly. This matter must be handled by him personally.
"Dong Xun will kill someone he shouldn't have killed." Gu Nan had nothing to hide and answered casually, "When Rolensia finds out, she will definitely send someone to capture Dong Xun and take him back to her Divine Kingdom."
As the executor of Gu Nan's plan, it was certainly impossible to hide Dong Xun's mission details from Mu Qishuang, so she was fully aware that Gu Nan's real target was Rolensia.
"So what?" Mu Qishuang thought about it carefully and didn't understand what the trap was. "And the target is just an insignificant figure. Rolensia could just have Dong Xun killed outside."
"No." Gu Nan said firmly, "Rolensia will definitely capture Dong Xun and kill him with her own hands, and when she does she will receive a surprise."
Mu Qishuang's eyes narrowed slightly. "Who is this person youre asking Dong Xun to kill?"
"Rolensia's former teacher."
The poisoned apple called Dong Xun was almost ripe. Now, Gu Nan was just waiting for Rolensia to discover it and eat it.
But at this moment, Gu Nan suddenly left Azure Sky Heaven. An unexpected situation just appeared, forcing him to rush to the Gap World.
Gu Nan originally wanted to explore this placewhich Lu Wen called the Origin Worldafter killing Rolensia, but he had to return early now.
The strand of consciousness he left here told him that there was news from Fu Cheng that the first Third Round player had appeared.
Gu Nan's will invaded the Gap World and immediately read all of this player's information, as well as his entire gaming history.
This was a shut-in named Li Han who was obsessed with various role-playing games.
After trying over a dozen different methods, he finally succeeded in raising his in-game avatar to the Third RoundTier 16becoming the true King of Gods, progressing far beyond that of other players.
Behind Li Han, the second fastest person had just reached Tier 13.

chapters.title: Chapter 557: Did Not Disappear
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Did Not Disappear
Under Fu Chengs leadership, the game Origin of Light became very successful.
In Earths Federation,Origin of Light was so popular that it already turned into a trend. Almost all RPG players would definitely buy one, and there were more and more high-level players.
It's just that the appearance of a Third Round player this early slightly exceeded Gu Nan's expectations.
Gu Nan projected his will on Earth again and found a random person to possess, arriving at Fu Cheng's house. Based on his earlier instructions, Fu Cheng had left all the data here.
Perhaps because Gu Nan usually only communicated with Fu Cheng via a notebook, the latter chose to print all the information out on paper and give it to Gu Nan that way.
In this era of advanced technology, it was actually quite rare to still use paper to record information.
Fortunately, Li Han didnt have much information to record. Even if all his information was printed out, it only amounted to a stack of files the width of a finger.
Fu Cheng's house was a double-storey villa. Gu Nan entered quietly, then skillfully swaggered into Fu Cheng's study. He sat down and slowly started reading Li Han's information.
After all, information obtained through the notebooks conversations were limited, so it was only at this time that Gu Nan was able to see the full picture on Li Han.
He seemed like an extremely ordinary shut-in gamerto be the first to reach the Third Round while throwing the second-ranked player behind him far in the dust, no one would believe it if he claimed he wasnt a serious shut-in.
Of course, just being a shut-in wasnt enough.
To achieve this kind of thing, in addition to investing an enormous amount of time, one also needed extremely high gaming talent.
It was just like how Gu Nan was a top player. This wasnt the cause, but the effect. It was because Gu Nan was a gaming genius himself and had also gone through a lot of training in order to get to where he was today.
The same went for Li Han.
In the profile photos, Li Han was a slightly handsome male who was twenty-six years old this year. He did not encounter any major events in his life.
He grew up in a normal middle-class family. They werent very wealthy, but they had enough money to not worry about food and clothing. He liked games ever since he was a child and became self-employed as an adult.
In this era, the term self-employed was no longer anything derogatory. Instead, it became synonymous with those with special skills. Many people envied how they didnt have to work 9 to 5 jobs. They could freely allocate their time and also received a considerable income.
Li Han made a living in the gaming industry. His daily income mainly consisted of game guides, copyright fees for game videos, and some consulting fees.
Gu Nan was actually quite familiar with this kind of lifestylebecause he was in a similar situation back then.
And Li Han's in-game journey wasnt much different from Gu Nans expectations. He basically followed the developers official path and reached the Third Round step by step.
Although he took advantage of some loopholes here and there, they were still within the scope of permissible gameplay. It was just like how Gu Nan himself also held off on leveling up at a certain point in order to simultaneously level up twice. These were all unique strategies in the game.
All in all, this was a very normal playerboth in real life and in the game. The only abnormal thing about him was that he did not disappear.
Thats right. After Li Han successfully completed the Third Round and theoretically cleared the entire Origin of Light game, he was still living normally on Earth.
Origin of Light was like a completely normalalbeit excellentgame to him. It was something he devoted five years of his youth to, but that was all.
Transmigration? Leaving the Gap World? Those were nonexistent for him.
What does this mean? Have all the conditions not been met yet, or has another Li Han already appeared outside? Gu Nan's imagination ran wild, speculating on the possibilities.
It was certainly reasonable to say that not all the conditions were exactly the same as Gu Nans. After all, this was just an imitation Gu Nan created. Neither the game itself nor the timeline could be said to have accounted for all unpredictable variables.
It's just that if it was the latter possibility, then it seemed a little laughable.
Gu Nan seemed to see another him on Earth hundreds of years ago. After completing the Third Round, that Gu Nan continued to live a mediocre life, then slowly walked towards death.
And now, just a few hundred years later, not even a trace of that person was left.
These thoughts only stayed in Gu Nan's mind for an instant and were immediately thrown out. No matter what the truth was, he was already a Tier 12 Unified Dao existence. No one in this world could easily erase his existence anymore.
Regardless of whether the Gap World throwing people outside was a natural phenomenon or if there really was a mastermind behind it, that did not stop Gu Nan from finding out the truth and then killing any threats to him.
Instead, Gu Nan became more determined. After returning, he would tell his subordinates to keep an eye out for someone named "Li Han" and any newcomers wielding the holy light attribute.
"Perhaps Jiu Po is right." Gu Nan rubbed his chin and muttered to himself, "Only by controlling both worlds can we most conveniently explore the secrets here."
On the other hand, since he was already in the Gap World again, why not take a look at Lu Wens hometown?
Gu Nan also held a certain interest in the cultivation civilization that existed in the Gap World. According to Lu Wen, there were Unified Dao cultivators here, and perhaps they held a different perception of this world.
Just as Gu Nan was considering this, footsteps sounded from outside, followed by the sound of a door opening.
"Mom! Wait Who are you?!" The startled girl stared at him. A girl with light gray hair pointed at Gu Nan and asked.
This was Fu Cheng's daughter, Chen Jingjing. Her last name was her fathers, and her hair color was the sameFu Cheng's ex-husband was one-quarter white.
Chen Jingjing had just gotten home and was looking around to see if Fu Cheng was at home. She didn't expect to run into a stranger here.
Five years had passed, and Chen Jingjing was now an eighteen-year-old girl. She did not lose her cool and did not scream.
She just stared at Gu Nan warily. No matter how she looked at it, the latter didn't look like her mother's friend, but more like a burglar.
"There are surveillance cameras everywhere near my house. No matter how you entered, you must have already been caught on camera." Chen Jingjing took a deep breath to prevent her voice from trembling.
"If you leave now, I can pretend I didn't see anything."
Gu Nan's indifferent gaze swept over her. He didnt respond to her and just slowly walked towards the window.
Under Chen Jingjing's stunned gaze, Gu Nan controlled the body he was possessing to open the window, then jumped out.
Boom!
A soft sound rang in Chen Jingjing's ears, and she quickly ran to the window, only to see that the stranger had landed steadily on the ground and was slowly walking away.
Chen Jingjing swallowed and looked down. Her house was a high-rise villa. Even if it only had two floors, it was still close to seven or eight meters high Is he a powerful Force cultivator?
Should I call the police? I should just wait until Mom comes back

chapters.title: Chapter 558: Discovered
chapters.content:
After Gu Nan left Fu Cheng's house, he casually found a river and jumped in before pulling his consciousness away from the body.
Even if there was a five-year gap between them, it might be easy for a sharp observer to connect the dots between two consecutive mysterious deaths of bodies that were perfectly fine before, especially since both were related to Fu Cheng.
For now, Gu Nan did not want Earth’s civilization to become aware of himself, let alone the existence of high-level cultivators.
After his consciousness left Earth, Gu Nan then tried to find Lu Wen's hometown, but the Origin World was indeed vast.
The nature of galaxy-type planes meant they were far larger than other major astral worlds. Even with Gu Nan's current realm, it was difficult to quickly scan the entire plane.
And it was impossible for Lu Wen to reveal the coordinates of his original civilization, so it would take some time to find it.freёwebnovel-com
Gu Nan simply left part of his will here to continue searching, and at the same time, he sent a clone to Azure Sky Heaven to keep an eye on Dong Xun's progress.
……
Dong Xun had already arrived at the World of Gods.
Accompanying him was naturally Classmate Qi Zhi, who treated him as a cash cow. However, the two’s journey really was full of danger; it wasn’t peaceful at all.
After all, the two worlds were still at war. Entering and leaving either one could be regarded as smuggling in the truest sense. They would not have a good ending if caught.
Only the Heaven-God Alliance, which had skilled personnel and a lot of courage—as well as the support of people inside the World of Gods—dared to engage in smuggling.
Of course, even in the Heaven-God Alliance, both sides were more focused on their own affairs right now. If Dong Xun hadn't received Azure Sky Heaven’s special care, it would have been impossible for him to be assigned such a mission.
"We’re finally here…" Qi Zhi complained as she let out a deep breath.
They had suffered a lot along the way. If not for the fact that she wanted to stay by Dong Xun’s side to see if there were any new “missions” she could accept, she certainly wouldn’t be willing to suffer like this.
Dong Xun comforted her a little, and Qi Zhi was also a Void Cutter who wouldn’t let emotions affect her actions, so the two quickly started the mission.
When they arrived at the World of Gods, the members of the Heaven-God Alliance here had already handed over the mission details to Dong Xun.
This time, he needed to kill an old man named Claude. The target was once a top-tier Legend Rank expert, but now that he was getting on in years, his strength had declined.
A seemingly normal old man somehow offended the Heaven-God Alliance, which insisted on sending a member to assassinate him.
But it wasn’t like Dong Xun had never joined a powerful organization before. He was fully aware of the unspoken rule in these organizations—that is, to just complete the mission and not ask about the reasons behind it.
……
Old Claude lived in the Atalante plane that Gu Nan was most familiar with.
This most important continent in the game was home to many important NPC characters and also housed major questlines. Claude was one of them.
The relationship between Claude and Rolensia was extremely complicated.
He was Rolensia’s teacher, and at the same time, he was also the object of Rolensia’s admiration and almost became this god's lover.
But in the end, after realizing her feelings, Claude resolutely left his favorite disciple and completely severed their relationship.
Because Claude knew all too well that the path Rolensia walked could not have love, or else she would inevitably die on the way to lighting her divine fire. After all, a mortal’s ascension to godhood had never been a simple undertaking.
When Rolensia finally became the God of Luxuriant Blossoms and came back to look for Claude, her teacher was already old.
Of course the lifespan of a mortal couldn’t compare to a god’s. Claude was able to live until now only with the help of Rolensia’s divine power.
She turned Claude into her own apostle, allowing the latter to live for eternity under the blessing of her divine power. The price was that Claude no longer had the possibility of ascension, and their paths would never cross again.
"Is the target an apostle?" Dong Xun read the mission dossier carefully, which mentioned Claude's identity. Of course, it did not include his past with Rolensia.
Even the name of Luxuriant Blossoms was deliberately hidden, so that Dong Xun did not notice anything unusual.
But the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment felt an inexplicably familiarity upon hearing Claude’s name. "I feel like I've seen him somewhere before…"
But unfortunately, she was just a fragment of Rolensia’s soul and inherited barely any memories. It was obvious that such a profound early memory like Claude would not be included in what little memories she had.
Qi Zhi piped up from the side, "The target's strength is about the same as us two, maybe a little weaker, and his daily schedule is very consistent. Looks like our main goal this time is to prevent the other party from escaping."
Claude lived in a remote town and was an old knight. No one knew how old he was and where he came from.
He repeated a similar life every day and did not practice martial arts. Most of his strength had already been lost.
With Dong Xun and Qi Zhi’s power, it wouldn’t be hard to defeat Claude. Instead, what they needed to consider was how to ensure the kill and how to escape the gods’ pursuit after the kill.
……
Claude was already very old.
His hair was gray, and he habitually brought a walking cane with him whenever he went out. Only his mind was still fine, and his eyes were bright.
The divine blessing made him immortal, but it did not give him the motivation to live. He could only repeat the same actions day after day, watching his friends and relatives grow old one by one.
Sometimes he also wondered, would it be better if he died right now?
But Claude knew this was impossible, because whenever he encountered fatal danger, the power from the God of Luxuriant Blossoms would protect him.
As an apostle under the protection of a greater god, he naturally received such preferential treatment.
Claude walked on the road as usual. He didn't like riding in a carriage, preferring to move forward with his own feet.
The next second, a dim light suddenly appeared in front of Claude as a sharp sword pierced his heart, trying to take away his life.
Dong Xun had been preparing this strike for a long time. With his current realm and years of life-and-death battle experience, Claude couldn’t possibly resist.
Old Claude watched helplessly as the tip of the sword pierced his heart, but there was no expression on his face.
Would he still be saved by divine power? Or would the injury be healed by divine power? Claude, who was used to this, was still waiting quietly.
However, to his surprise, the moment the divine power surged up, it instantly withdrew again after coming into contact with Dong Xun's laws.
Claude stared at this scene in shock. His heart was completely destroyed, and his corpse crashed to the ground.
"It’s that simple?" Dong Xun looked at the ground doubtfully, confirming that the target was indeed dead.
Qi Zhi also appeared next to him. She didn't take action right away because her job was to prevent Claude from escaping. She didn't expect to not be needed at all.
Dong Xun was a little confused. This mission went way too smoothly, and the target clearly had an extremely sublime aura, so why did it suddenly disappear again?
Dong Xun didn't realize something was wrong until a voice rang out in his head.
"We may be in big trouble." The Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment said with a trembling voice, "This old man is my original body’s apostle, and his divine power also disappeared because of me…"
"In other words, she has already discovered me."

chapters.title: Chapter 559: Poisoned Apple
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Poisoned Apple
"Weve been discovered!" Panic flashed through Dong Xun's heart, but he didn't just start cultivating, so he quickly calmed down.
"Will the main body reabsorb you directly? If theres still a chance, let's leave here immediately!"
Having been with the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment for many years, Dong Xun certainly knew that shed already developed self-awareness and was by no means as simple as a clone of her original body, so she definitely wouldnt want to meet her main body like this.
But now that things had developed to this extent, some matters were beyond their control.
"It's too late" The Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment spoke again, but this time, her voice didnt tremble. Instead, it only contained deep despair.
Dong Xun's heart froze. He subconsciously wanted to leave this place, but he clearly didn't know what a preferentially-treated apostle meant to a god.
In just the blink of an eye, two rays of divine light landed in front of them. Two tall and imposing apostles stared at Dong Xun with apathetic eyes.
"That's him." One of them seemed to confirm Dong Xun's identity, while the other nodded and reached out to grab Dong Xun without any hesitation.
Dong Xun had yet to put away the longsword in his hand, so he simply stabbed towards that person while rapidly retreating at the same time.
Unfortunately, his resistance was completely useless. The opponent sliced Dong Xuns sword in half with just a light wave of their hand. Instead, the apostle grabbed Dong Xuns shoulder with one hand, preventing him from moving.
Merely a casual grab made Dong Xun feel all the laws in his body being suppressed. He could not move an inch and could only watch his opponent helplessly.
It was the first time Dong Xun faced such an enemy, but he already realized what it meant.
"Star Ruler Realm!"
Greater gods apostles were formidable because they could even break through the limitations of Tier 4 when borrowing their greater god's divine power. Even the most ordinary Tier 5 powerhouse was not someone that a Legend Rank expert could oppose.
Dong Xun couldnt resist at all, and the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment in his mind immediately fell into a voluntary slumber, sinking herself into the depths of Dong Xun's consciousness in an attempt to escape Rolensia's search.
Even though she knew her chances of succeeding were impossibly slim, she couldnt think of any other solutions.
After the two apostles caught Dong Xun, they immediately took him away without even looking at Qi Zhi from beginning to end, as if the latter was just an insignificant character.
After Dong Xun was taken away, Qi Zhi looked around her but didn't see any Heaven-God Alliance members showing up. Finally, she began to connect some dots.
"Did you kill Claude?" Rolensia's calm and indifferent gaze landed on Dong Xun's face like moonlight, making him feel like he couldnt hide anything from her.
"Y-Yes" Dong Xun subconsciously answered, feeling as if his entire body was no longer under his control.
Rolensia sighed softly.
Over ten thousand years had passed, somewhat blurring her impression of Claude. Very little of their former friendship remained, or else the latter would not have been killed so easily.
As long as Rolensia was actually paying attention to him instead of simply using divine power to passively protect him, she could have saved Claude.
But now that things were like this, Rolensia didnt have many regrets. Perhaps ending Claudes immortal existence was a good thing for him.
"Why do you want to kill him?" Rolensia's voice was still calm, but the power that penetrated people's hearts had not weakened.
Dong Xun was just a Void Cutter and could not hide anything from a greater god. He answered honestly, "I am a member of the Heaven-God Alliance. This is the organization's mission"
"Heaven-God Alliance?" Rolensia raised a slight brow. She didn't expect this.
Because of Gu Nans matter back then, she no longer belonged to the Heaven-God Alliance. Her first impression was that Zi Luo Elder was taking revenge on her.
But she immediately dismissed this possibility. Firstly, there was no reason for Zi Luo Elder to know who Claude was, and secondly, it was pointless for him to use this kind of thing to retaliate against her.
Rolensia's gaze hit Dong Xun's face again, as if she wanted to pierce into the depths of his mind and cut open the deepest parts of his soul.
That Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragments stubborn resistance was obviously entirely useless. She had no room to hide in front of Rolensia.
"It's my soul" Rolensia recognized it as soon as she saw the soul fragment. "From back then"
She recalled how she sliced apart her soul and had it transported into the Myriad Heavens in order to ascend to a greater god back then. She didnt expect a soul fragment to still be floating around outside.
But now, this soul fragment appeared in such an unexpected way.
"Is it purely a coincidence, or did someone do it on purpose?" The greater gods subconscious caution made Rolensia wonder if this was part of some greater plot.
"Go investigate," Rolensia ordered her apostles.
"It's my turn now," Gu Nan's voice rang out as he slowly stood up from inside Azure Sky Heaven.
Mu Qishuang already knew his entire plan and that he wanted to kill Rolensia with it, but she wasnt very optimistic about Gu Nan's plan.
The reason was very simple. She didn't believe that with a greater gods caution, Rolensia would easily step into Gu Nan's trap.
Even if Gu Nan asked Azure Sky Heaven to come forward as a front so that Rolensia's in-depth investigation wouldnt be effective this whole matter still lacked a proper temptation.
To put it simply, Rolensia had no need for the soul fragment. She could absorb the soul fragment and step into the trap, but she could also choose to not absorb the soul fragment out of caution.
She just needed to keep the soul fragment in her hands and not let it be controlled by others.
"You're not familiar with Rolensia." But Gu Nan replied thus, "She will definitely not want something like this that was delivered right to her door. But sometimes, merely being cautious might not necessarily be enough to stop her from eating the poisoned apple."
Gu Nan glanced at Mu Qishuang. "If she finds out that I was the mastermind behind this matter, then she will send Dong Xun far away and find a place to completely destroy him."
"Then what if she finds out its me?" Mu Qishuang very cooperatively asked.
"She's going to want to see what exactly youre trying to do."
"Azure Sky Heaven?" Without much effort, Rolensia found the organization who manipulated Dong Xun's actions.
After so many years, the Heaven-God Alliance had become an organization with quite a complicated web of members. Mu Qishuang could manipulate Dong Xuns actions from within, and Rolensia could naturally also find traces of this.
As Gu Nan expected, after a moment of silence, she quickly had Dong Xun brought before her again.
Rolensia's finger gave a light tap, and Dong Xun felt a chill on his forehead, as if something was being pulled out. His heart sank to rock bottom, knowing that ultimately, he failed to save the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment.
Although Rolensia extracted the soul fragment, she had no intention of absorbing it. Instead, she completely wrapped it up with the power of laws, intending to destroy her own soul fragment.
"What in the world are you trying to do?" She murmured, planning to use the destruction of her soul fragment as a threat to force the mastermind behind the scenes to express their attitude.
If they didnt then she would merely lose a soul fragment that she had no intention of absorbing in the first place.
What Rolensia didn't expect was that after the soul fragment left Dong Xun's body, another power began to awaken inside his body.
Sorry, this was the real poisoned apple.

chapters.title: Chapter 560: Desperate Straits
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Desperate Straits
Rolensia was very cautious.
She knew just how many opportunities an unprotected stray soul fragment wandering outside could give to enemies in the dark. If used in a trap, a piece of ones soul would be far more damaging than hair or flesh.
Therefore, she had no intention of accepting the soul fragment delivered right to her door. Instead, she made up her mind to destroy it and learn about the masterminds goal in the process.
But in this instant, she suddenly sensed a mysterious power fluctuation.
Next to her, Dong Xun couldn't move at all, but he could feel the power raging in his body, followed by a sharp stab of pain in his heart. A small black dagger instantly shot out, piercing through his chest and aiming straight for Rolensia.
Evil God!
In this instant, Rolensia not only recognized the other partys identity, but she also understood the whole trap.
Using the soul fragment to distract her while the Evil God brought his hidden power inside her Divine Kingdomthat was the other partys true goal!
For Gu Nan, the hardest part to killing greater gods was actually how to get close to them and strike while they were defenseless.
Greater gods who were already vigilant and preparedlike Eugene, Daphne, and the others earlierwere actually not easy to kill at all.
With Gu Nan's current strength, even Austin would have a hard time if he was directly hit by the Evil God physique, but the only problem was that Gu Nan couldnt hit them.
Hed launched a sneak attack on Daphne earlier, but before he could truly strike, the highly-vigilant Goddess of Nature had already avoided it in advance, using her laws to delay Gu Nan's movements slightly and escape.
But not even greater gods could be on high alert all the time. The instant they relaxed was the perfect time for assassination.
This was true for the current Rolensia. Most of her thoughts were focused on the soul fragment, wanting to see what Mu Qishuang's intentions were after setting up such a scheme.
It wasnt that she hadnt checked Dong Xun before, but the Luxuriant Blossoms soul fragment at the forefront of Dong Xuns soul completely covered up Gu Nan's power, and it wasn't until this instant that the hidden fangs were bared.
The black dagger was as fast as lightning, arriving in front of Rolensia almost as soon as it appeared.
Before Rolensia could block the dagger's attack with laws, she realized that the dagger stopped on its own and then exploded.
The energy of shadows instantly filled the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, and a figure emerged from it, instantly punching down on Rolensias head.
The shadow dagger was not a fatal attack, but a springboard for Gu Nan's descent!
From the daggers appearance to Gu Nan's punch, the entire process was completed in one go without giving Rolensia any breathing room.
Rolensia's divine body was shattered without any suspense, and Gu Nan immediately started destroying the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom without hesitation.
During the earlier ambush on Valen, this work was completed by Jiu Po and Lu Wen, but in fact, Gu Nan was equally skilled at it.
He stabbed the shadow longsword into the ground with one hand, and endless shadows quickly spread outward, covering the entire Divine Kingdom in the blink of an eye.
Gu Nans law of shadows was already at Tier 12, so he was able to do this with ease.
The apostles were dragged directly into the shadows one after another or killed by the emerging shadowy figures. They had no room to resist at all.
In a short seven to eight minutes, the entire Divine Kingdom had been completely destroyed. Gu Nans efficiency was astonishingly high.
Rolensia never showed up again ever since her divine body was shattered by Gu Nan. But after realizing that it was useless to resist through laws, she finally created another body again.
"Evil God you are indeed the source of all evil!" Rolensia said in a heavy voice, but she began to radiate a crimson light.
Her Divine Kingdom was invaded and a large number of its inhabitants died, forcing her into desperate straits.
But in the end, Rolensia was a ruthless person who dared to slice up her own soul even before she became a greater god. At this time, she had no intention of just sitting back and waiting for death. Instead, she wanted to make a last ditch effort.
Inexhaustible crimson light burst out of the edge of her Divine Kingdom. On every continent in the World of Gods, people could see a streak of crimson light shooting into the air, drawing a scarlet rainbow in the sky.
And all the greater gods simultaneously responded, rushing to the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom.
During the Great War, everyone's attention was on the frontlines. They didn't expect someone to attack Rolensia, who was in the rear!
In the Luxuriant Blossoms Divine Kingdom, endless blood pierced Gu Nan's whole body, while Gu Nan's fist also blasted apart Rolensia's head.
Rolensia made the most decisive choice in this split second between life and deathshe would force Gu Nan to stay behind at the expense of her own life!
As Rolensia's flesh and blood flew everywhere, Gu Nan's Evil Value soared again, exceeding the threshold of Tier 13, but it was already too late to level up right now. The remaining eleven greater gods had already arrived.
Rolensia had already fallen, but the last trace of crimson light she left behind condensed the remaining power of her Divine Kingdom, trapping Gu Nan like a cage.
Although Gu Nan broke the cage with a single punch, this delayed him for a split second and prevented his immediate escape. Following that, holy light suddenly descended.
"As expected of Rolensia"
Austin was still the first to show up, and he slashed down with the holy sword without hesitation, sealing Gu Nan's escape path.
If Gu Nan wanted to forcibly retreat, he would inevitably He retreated!
Gu Nan tanked the holy swords damage and forcibly opened a spatial passage. This wasnt the first time Austin had seen such a scene.
But the situation was different this time. Austin's expression shifted slightly while his hands kept moving, as if he would let Gu Nan escape, just like this.
But at this moment, an all-consuming darkness fell onto Gu Nans head, covering his whole body.
Boundless and inescapable.
Goddess of Darkness Daisy!
The scythe surrounded by death energy and the sky-piercing cyan light struck at the same time, targeting Gu Nan's back.
Death God Baal and Ruler of Ashen Cyan Boswell!
Almost instantly, Gu Nan had to face the simultaneous attacks of the four strongest greater gods, and there were more gods arriving behind him.
Just moments earlier, he had put Rolensia in a desperate situation. Now, it was his turn.
"Come!"
Gu Nan's gaze was cold. He took the holy swords power with his back, then slammed a punch into the death scythe and cyan light, parrying them.
As the holy sword entered his body, terrifying holy flames instantly ignited Gu Nan's whole body, and the all-devouring darkness began to envelope his head, dropping Gu Nan's consciousness into total darkness and making him lose all sense of perception.
The Dark Lady was a top powerhouse who wasnt much weaker than Austin. In terms of the nature of her power, it was even harder for Gu Nan to deal with her.
But Gu Nan still didn't care. Even though he completely lost all his senses, he was still moving forward along a pre-established route.
The route he set was very special. It did not lead to either of the two worlds, but to the Gap World.
The World of Gods was the home base of the gods, and he would have to pass through the dimensional wall to return to the Myriad Heavens, which meant he would likely be stopped midway. Thus, the best destination was undoubtedly the Gap World.
Charge! Charge over!
In the boundless silence and darkness, Gu Nan still maintained his consciousness and clear mind.
At this instant, Gu Nan rushed through the spatial passage, and the combined power of the four greater gods also completely destroyed that space at the same time, leaving no trace behind.
Austin glared coldly at the spot Gu Nan disappeared from and ordered darkly, "Find him."

chapters.title: Chapter 561: Vast Civilization
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Vast Civilization
Gu Nan disappeared again.
He was like one of those famous assassins in history who made a big splash with one assassination and then vanished from everyones sight.
Of course, with his status as a grand Unified Dao powerhouse, being an assassin was a bit below his station.
But on the other hand, if the assassination target was a greater god, this seemed to have become a glorious achievement instead.
The death of a greater god had only ever happened in large-scale wars at the Unified Dao level before. At least three or four people of the same level must target the greater god to succeed, such as the earlier Divine Wars or the previous ambush by Lu Wen, Jiu Po, and Gu Nan.
Nobody had ever seen a greater god die at the hands of a single person.
However, Rolensia, the Ruler of Luxuriant Blossoms, died at Gu Nans hands, yet Gu Nan was the only one in that ambush, and he succeeded in a very short amount of time!
The result of this battle caused a simultaneous uproar in both worlds. After all, it was related to the fall of a greater god, so no one dared to take it lightly.
On the other hand, the Great War between the two worlds had just begun, but two greater gods had already been killed one after another. This was also a blow to the gods morale.
Everyone knew that the Great War was essentially a war between the greater gods and Unified Dao cultivators.
No matter how many normal gods and Star Rulers there were, they would not have any impact on the upper echelons battles. Its just that once a war breaks out, whoever strikes first will be at a disadvantage.
But even setting aside the situation in the frontlines, two greater gods in the rear had already died. What were they still fighting for?
The dark clouds of defeat started to gather over the World of Gods.
"You still havent found him yet?" Both Austin and Dark Lady Daisy had grave expressions when they metbecause even now, they had yet to find Gu Nan's whereabouts.
Daisy shook her head slightly. "Weve been looking for him ever since he disappeared that day. There has been no fluctuation in the dimensional wall, and he hasnt returned to the Myriad Heavens. If he is not hiding in the gap between the two worlds, then he must still be hiding in some corner of the World of Gods."
Although she talked about two possibilities, Daisy was obviously more inclined towards the latter.
After all, the gap between the two worlds was too small. It wasnt like they didnt search there, but naturally, they found nothing.
Here, it must be said that the Gap Worlds location was indeed very remote. If Gu Nan had not discovered Daoist Yellow Springs first back then, he might not have been able to find the Origin World even if he searched nonstop for a year or two.
It wasnt that no one had ever explored the gap between the two worlds, but from ancient times to the present, only Daoist Yellow Springs discovered the location of the Origin World. This could not be explained by luck.
Austin also agreed with Daisy's point of view. He had some experience with Gu Nan's stealth abilities.
He believed that Gu Nan must be hiding in some corner of the World of Gods, secretly licking his wounds and waiting for the moment his injuries completely recovered. Then, he would continue to hunt greater gods.
Austin felt that this day would not be far away.
But Austin was about to be disappointed, because when Gu Nan's consciousness awakened, he had already arrived in the Gap World, which Lu Wen referred to as the Origin World.
The first thing that caught Gu Nan's eyes was the boundless starry sky, which was somewhat similar to the Milky Way Galaxy in his memory.
Gu Nan didn't study astronomy in his past life, and he couldn't discern his location from the celestial bodies relative positions, but after his consciousness awakened, he successfully got in touch with his main body.
Just as he expected, even the Evil God physique was severely damaged by the combined attacks of four top-tier greater gods.
"Rolensia is still Rolensia." Gu Nan couldn't help secretly shaking his head. He also didn't expect Rolensia to be so decisive, determined to drag him into the water even if it meant giving up all chances of her own survival.
After all, a greater god-level God of Luxuriant Blossoms was also an extremely rare situation in the game.
And the "darkness" from the Dark Lady left countless debuffs on his body, significantly delaying the self-healing process.
Only after the power of these laws was expelled could his body return to normal, so Gu Nan wasnt in a hurry and simply waited patiently here.
Thus, he discovered a vast civilization in the distance not far from his will.
"Coincidence?" Gu Nan raised his eyebrows slightly but soon came to his senses.
His will had been floating in the sea of stars for an unknown amount of time. This kind of floating was not random. On the contrary, it would be attracted to locations where a large number of living beings gathered. In fact, he was the one who came to their door.
However, even if he could find civilizations by floating freely like this, if it wasnt due to luck, then it could only mean one thinghis consciousness had probably stayed in the Origin World for a long time.
"What a pity." Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head a little. If hed been slumbering for over a hundred years, perhaps the Great War outside would have already ended, and his arrangements on Earth had probably all gone to waste.
For those at Unified Dao Realm, time really was quite a useless concept. Their existence in the world was too monumental, and influencing laws with their mere will alone definitely wasnt an exaggeration.
But it was useless to have these thoughts now. After his consciousness awakened, it would only take a few months at most for his body to repair itself. Gu Nan began to turn his attention to the vast civilization below.
This civilization was indeed very powerful, developing to an extent that not even Gu Nan had ever seen before.
Using terms from his previous life, this civilization spanned at least three galaxies, had transformed and controlled over 60 administrative planets, and possessed a large number of uninhabitable resource planets, all of which were continuously delivering supplies to the civilization.
There was definitely no civilization of comparable size in the Myriad Heavens. There werent many galaxy-type planes to begin with, and it was even less likely that such an enormous one existed.
Even Milky Way Heaven only concentrated a large number of people in the center of the plane and had no more than twenty administrative planets.
More importantly, Gu Nan sensed a familiar energy inside the civilizationthis familiarity did not stem from acquaintances, but from cultivation realm.
There were people at the same Unified Dao Realm as him here.
Gu Nan descended without much hesitation. In any case, he was just a strand of will. At most, he could use some laws, and he was also not afraid of being attacked.
As soon as Gu Nan entered the civilizations territory, three wills immediately rose from the center of the territory and quickly headed towards this side.
Just a moment later, three figures appeared before Gu Nan.
These three were dressed somewhat similarly. They all wore Daoist robes. An old man in the middle was wearing a Daoist crown, with a strange dragon-fish pattern embroidered on his chest. His expression was peaceful.
On either side of him was a man and a woman respectively. The man had his hair loose and an apathetic look on his face, as if he had no interest in Gu Nan whatsoever.
The woman's robe was pristine. Her hair was tied neatly behind her head, and her eyes were sharp.
Three Unified Dao cultivators!
This old Daoist is Xian He. I greet Daoist Friend. The old man performed a strange courtesy and directly conveyed his will to Gu Nan without speaking at all.
They all sensed the Saint level aura and rushed here. But judging from the way the other party was waiting calmly, there shouldn't be any ill intentions.
My name is Gu Nan. Gu Nan also conveyed the message with his will, I am an interstellar wanderer.

chapters.title: Chapter 562: To Become a Saint is to Trap Oneself
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: To Become a Saint is to Trap Oneself
After a brief exchange, Gu Nan learned the identities of the three before him, and the three also confirmed that Gu Nan did not hold any malicious intentions.
The old Daoist priest, Xian He, was actually not a traditional Daoist. His real name really was Xian He.
On the other hand, the stern-looking woman to the side did come from a Daoist background and called herself Daoist Lan Yi. And that young man with a casual expression was named Xu Anting. He was a wandering cultivator unaffiliated with other sects.
In a quiet little courtyard in the capital planet.
"Myriad Stars Civilization?" Gu Nan mused as he stood by the window, gazing at the scenery outside.
This civilization, called "Myriad Stars" by the three Saints, had indeed developed to an unimaginable extent.
Myriad Stars was a cultivation civilization at its core, but once the civilization developed to a certain extent, part of the technology tree would naturally also be lit up. However, similar to the Myriad Heavens, most of it was metaphysical technology.
So what entered Gu Nan's eyes was the strange sight of a group of people wearing long Daoist robes and driving hovercars.
"Daoist Friend Gu Nan, have you been to our civilization before?" Daoist Xian He walked out from behind Gu Nan with a faint smile.
Naturally, the three didn't believe Gu Nans self-proclaimed identity as an interstellar wanderer. Given their realm, they could naturally tell Gu Nans current state.
This person was clearly just a strand of will, and even his body was a temporary construct, so he must have his own foundation someplace else.
But to think there was a second civilization in this universe with Saint Realm power. This was what Xian He and his group were interested in.
"This is my first time here," Gu Nan replied calmly. "Do Saints like you guys frequently leave your territory to explore outer space?"
It wasnt hard at all for Unified Dao great powers to directly project their wills outside, which wouldnt be affected by the harsh environment of outer space.
"Of course we do." Xian He nodded. "However, the universe is unimaginably vast; its too inefficient for us to search for extraterrestrial civilizations. Such things are usually completed by spaceship fleets."
Gu Nan came from outside their territory, so Xian He expected this question.
During the conversation with Xian He, Gu Nan slowly learned about the Myriad Stars Civilizations situation.
Since the Origin Worlds law of space was highly stable, even Unified Dao cultivators could only manage to teleport for short distances in here, let alone Void Cutters.
Any barrier was stronger on the inside than on the outside. Gu Nan could only squeeze in a wisp of will from the outside, but the people inside could only be trapped here.
Is the Origin World a cage? This thought flashed through Gu Nan's mind but quickly disappeared.
There had never been any cage that projected information from the outside world and continuously sent people who obtained that information outside.
After a brief exchange, Gu Nan then asked, "Do you guys know a person named Lu Wen? He should have been a Saint on the verge of ascending."
Xian He shook his head. "Ive watched this civilization grow to this point, but I have never heard of such a person."
Gu Nan thought for a while and added, "His name might be different. He is a person who controls the dual laws of time and space"
"Youve met my master?!" Before Xian He could say anything, Daoist Lan Yi suddenly exclaimed as she quickly appeared in front of Gu Nan.
Only then did Gu Nan study her attire carefully and realize that the Daoist robe she was wearing was indeed somewhat similar in style to Lu Wen's.
Even though it was Xian He who came forward to communicate with Gu Nan, Daoist Lan Yi and Xu Anting obviously did not relax their surveillance of him.
Gu Nan's gaze slowly landed on Daoist Lan Yi. He was not surprised at all.
No matter how one thought about it, there shouldnt be too many ultra-powerful civilizations with Unified Dao cultivators, and it was very possible that there was only one such civilization. Thus, there was a high possibility that this place was related to Lu Wen.
Lu Wen was a figure from the Myriad Stars Civilization around ten thousand years ago. His real name was no longer known, and only his Daoist name "Heavenly Springs" remained.
Lu Wen didn't have many friends in his previous life, and he didn't have any prominent teachers or inheritances. He was more like a wandering cultivator; he didn't even have many direct disciples.
Now, ten thousand years later, there was only one remaining disciple named Daoist Lan Yi.
"Have you really met my master?" Daoist fixed Gu Nan with a hard stare.
"We had a chance encounter." Gu Nan adopted an enigmatic expression. "You know how it is. You can always meet all kinds of people in the boundless universe."
Daoist Lan Yi replied with a grave expression, "But he is already dead. He died in the tribulation while trying to become a Saint."
"Maybe he survived by luck."
"Impossible! Then why didnt he come back to see us?!" Lan Dao's mood suddenly became agitated.
Gu Nan shook his head slightly and did not pursue this topic any further. He turned to Xian He. "Then, do you guys recognize someone named Daoist Yellow Springs? Lu Wen's survival may have something to do with him."
Daoist Lan Yi shook her head to express her ignorance, but Xian He revealed, "When Heavenly Springs was undergoing the tribulation back then, he said something strange."
"Oh? What did he say?"
To become a Saint is to trap oneself.
Myriad Heavens.
Gu Nans slumber was actually not as long as he imagined. It was only a few years in total.
During Gu Nans disappearance, the two worlds had already fought a true war. A large number of gods and Star Rulers died on the battlefield, and even one of the Unified Dao powers fell.
The casualty was Underworld Heavens Qin Guanruo.
This relatively young but overconfident Unified Dao cultivator was finally targeted by the greater gods because of his frequent attacks during the war.
In the end, Austin and Baal teamed up to first kill his main body on the battlefield, and then, with the help of the Ruler of Nightmares, they secretly crossed to the Myriad Heavens again and directly attacked Underworld Heaven.
Faced with an enemy attack right on their doorstep, the Myriad Heavens Unified Dao figures were actually even less experienced.
After all, at least the greater gods had a Divine War every ten thousand years or so, and it wasnt like greater gods hadnt died in those wars before, but what about the Myriad Heavens?
In the early years, there were wars that led to the deaths of Unified Dao level Star Rulers, and it was said that the descendants would inherit their astral worlds, but this had never happened again in the past ten thousand years, and even fights between Unified Dao bigshots were rare now.
Therefore, Qin Guanruo was caught completely off guard and was chased into Underworld Heaven by Austin and Baal. He died in the blink of an eye without even giving his colleagues time to come to the rescue.
Finally, a Unified Dao existence from the Myriad Heavens died. This greatly boosted the morale of those in the World of Gods, and the flames of war started burning again.
The Myriad Heavens, which wasnt all that united to begin with, began to retreat again and again under the gods attacks and soon entered a situation where they were each fighting on their own isolated battlefields.
During the Great War, Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was originally like the Pure Land. No matter what happened outside, no one dared to court death by going there.
However, as the flames of war spread inside the Myriad Heavens, very few people obeyed the greater gods warning, and gods continued to invade the Divine Kingdom.
Fortunately, Yan Xiaoxiao's current strength was enough to temporarily mobilize the power of the Divine Kingdom, preventing it from being destroyed.
Until one day, Gu Nan's figure suddenly appeared in the Evil God Temple, and a deep yet secretive power began to emerge from the entire Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes, and what he saw was his Divine Kingdom in chaos.
"Some bugs are here."

chapters.title: Chapter 563: Raising the Curtains
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Raising the Curtains
Patrice was a newly-ascended god whose divine authority was ice.
This was a very popular divine authority. There were at least ten elemental gods in the World of Gods, and there were also many Gods of Fire.
But because no greater god had ever appeared yet with a divine authority of any of the four basic elements, everyone had a chance.
Patrice was an ambitious god. He was very active in the Great War, but he carefully protected himself and survived to this day with only his Tier 6 strength.
The secret to his survival was to avoid fights against truly powerful enemies as much as possible, only concentrate on causing destruction, and never stay too long on the frontal battlefield.
After only a few rounds, he found that this strategy actually suited him quite well.
Ice was essentially a derivative of the divine authority of water. Patrice had the ability to hide himself in water, and which astral world didnt have water?
Water sources became the best hiding places for Patrice, and the astral worlds in the Myriad Heavens that werent built by the Star Rulers themselves had way too many flaws in the eyes of the gods.
Patrice spent almost no effort to assassinate the powerful figures in these astral worlds one by one, quickly weakening these Star Rulers powers so that they could be defeated one after another.
As his assassinations went smoother and smoother, Patrice's ambition also grew. He was already quite famous among the gods, but he was not satisfied with just this. He wanted to become the most eye-catching person in this Great War.
What better way to become famous than to invade the astral world of a Unified Dao bigshot?
Gu Nan's disappearance wasnt much of a secret. Most people tend to believe that he was trapped in the World of Gods to recuperate, so his astral world must be the emptiest.
But Patrice was now regretting his choice.
"What is this?" Patrice stared ahead with disbelief. In his sight, a cloud of black mist was quickly covering the entire astral world.
This vigilant god didnt hesitate at all and retreated from the astral world directly, gazing down with lingering fear.
Sure enough, any intruders in regions the shadows swept through were all dragged into the shadows and silenced.
What frightened Patrice even more was that the black mist swallowed its targets with extreme precision, not missing a single enemy or killing a single ally.
That meant the black mist's control over this astral world had reached an unimaginable level
The Evil God must have return No! Before Patrice could finish his thoughts, a shadow appeared from behind and swallowed him whole.
Gu Nan slowly opened his eyes inside the Evil God Temple. After cleaning up the bugs that entered his Divine Kingdom, his Evil Value increased slightly, indicating that there were a few gods among them.
Such absolute precision targeting was naturally not entirely due to Gu Nan's own ability. Rather, he borrowed Yan Xiaoxiao's control over the Divine Kingdom.
Only the spirit of the Divine Kingdom could be so familiar with every corner of the Divine Kingdom, as if it was her own body.
"Teacher, can you please give a heads up before you disappear next time?" Yan Xiaoxiao's helpless voice traveled over. It was evident that shed expended considerable effort to deal with the attacks that came during his absence.
But Gu Nan just smiled. "There wont be a next time."
Yan Xiaoxiao was slightly taken aback, but Gu Nan had no intention of elaborating. His gaze paused on the Divine Kingdom for a moment, then quickly withdrew.
Hed already returned to his peak condition, and the Evil Value from Valen and Rolensia even allowed him to step into Tier 13 in one fell swoop.
Now, even if he went back and faced another ambush from the four most powerful greater gods, Gu Nan was confident he could escape unscathed.
If it was one-on-one, even if he couldnt single-handedly suppress Austin, at least Gu Nan wouldn't have much to fear anymorebecause Austin alone couldnt kill Gu Nan at all.
From the Second Round to now, it took Gu Nan over ten years to finally be able to say he was somewhat "invincible". The next step was to kill everyone who should be killed.
As the Divine Kingdoms other half, Yan Xiaoxiao seemed to sense Gu Nans thoughts and whispered, "Teacher, are you going to go on a killing spree?"
"Pretty much." Gu Nan nodded. "Jiu Po was right about one thing. Only when you have the world in your hands will it be easier to investigate certain matters."
Gu Nan completely stabilized his Tier 13 realm, and his strength reached a whole new level. However, he did not rush to plunder Evil Value, instead visiting another place first.
Jiu Po Heaven.
"You mean, Lu Wen already knew that theres a world beyond the Origin World a long time ago?" Jiu Po looked thoughtful after hearing Gu Nan's explanation.
Gu Nan did not reveal where he got this information, nor would he reveal that he had been in and out of the Gap World. He only told the other party what Lu Wen said before his tribulation.
"I suspect that Yellow Springs told him." Gu Nan said calmly, "Yellow Springs may have discovered the Origin World a long time ago and mightve had contact with Lu Wens past life."
Jiu Po nodded with a dark expression.
He understood what Gu Nan meant. At present, there were only four transmigrators confirmed to be from the Origin World. If Lu Wen and Yellow Springs had started colluding a long time ago, then Jiu Po and Gu Nan would have to be careful.
"Well have to accelerate the plan." Jiu Po saw the situation clearly. Lu Wen already regained the power from his previous life, so they must act as soon as possible.
Right now, the only advantage he and Gu Nan held was that in terms of power alone, they were superior to the other two, so they must take advantage of this period to completely control the two worlds.
"We need them to start a full-scale war," Gu Nan stated calmly. Despite the commotion of the current Great War, the only greater god or Unified Dao cultivator who actually died in the war was Qin Guanruo.
Jiu Po's eyes turned to Gu Nan. "Not everyone is willing to go all-out in this war. How do you plan to get them to do that?"
Gu Nan replied with a smile, "If someone refuses to give his best, then Ill take the fight to his house."
"Thats quite a vicious plan youve got!" Jiu Po couldn't help feeling amused. "Whos your first target? Dream Immortal? Si Yun?"
Cloud Dream Heavens Dream Immortal and Milky Way Heavens Si Yun were both Unified Dao cultivators who didnt contribute much in the Great War, having only appeared once or twice so far.
But these two minor characters could no longer enter Gu Nans eyes anymore, and he answered directly, "Emperor Zhao."
World of Gods.
A Divine Kingdom stood high above the clouds, filled with holy light and a sacred aura, making it impossible for anyone to harbor any blasphemous thoughts.
This was the kingdom that belonged to the King of Gods, the Divine Kingdom of the Ruler of Light and Justice, and the last Pure Land in this world.
If one day, the world was overrun by evil, then this Divine Kingdom would most certainly fight that evil until the last living creature shed their last drop of blood. Its inhabitants swore to kill all evil, even at the cost of death.
Thus, evil arrived today.
Gu Nan's figure suddenly appeared in the Holy Light Divine Kingdom and struck Austins main temple with a greatsword.
A holy light barrier instantly appeared. Although it was unable to resist Gu Nan's monstrous strength, it purified all the shadows he used to condense the body of the sword, leaving not even a trace behind.
In Austin's home court, Gu Nans just-ascended Tier 13 laws really were nothing much.

chapters.title: Chapter 564: Bait
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Bait
"Youre quite bold," Austin's voice came from behind Gu Nan as his figure emerged, glaring at Gu Nan coldly.
With the exception of the few who surrendered, all enemies who dared to step inside his Divine Kingdom closed their eyes forever.
Gu Nan turned around and just shot him a grin. Two words were clearly written in his grinunbridled arrogance.
Austin could see that this Evil Gods realm had increased again, almost to the point of making even himself wary. Clearly, this was the basis for the opponent's arrogance.
But Did he think just this was enough?
A holy sword suddenly crashed down. In the Holy Light Divine Kingdom, the power of this strike reached a fearsome level.
Gu Nan, whod long been able to tank the holy sword outside this Divine Kingdom and had even advanced to Tier 13, was still directly incinerated by this attack, leaving only a mass of shadows under his feet that was barely moving.
Austin's movements didnt pause at all as holy flames instantly swept over the ground, searing away the shadows, but Gu Nan's energy still did not dissipate.
Loud laughter came from the air. Gu Nan's figure reappeared and then quickly disappeared. He finished escape preparations a long time ago; the earlier Gu Nan was just a clone.
"You can't escape," Austin's voice was still cold and flat, but with a hint of certainty.
He could easily leave a mark on anyone who dared to enter the Holy Light Divine Kingdom, and the holy light would guide him in their direction.
Tracking techniques had never been a rarity, especially for people at Austin's level.
Long before he showed himself, Austin had already left a mark on Gu Nan with the help of the ever-present holy light in his Divine Kingdom.
Even though it was rushed, this mark would stay on Gu Nan for at least a few days, enough for Austin to track him down.
Although he didn't know why Gu Nan appeared in the Holy Light Divine Kingdom, since the opportunity was already in front of him, Austin had no reason not to seize it.
With a flash, he reappeared on the Dark Factions side.
"I left a mark on the Evil God. You guys cover for me while I enter the Myriad Heavens," Austin said to Dark Lady Daisy.
Daisy looked slightly taken aback, as if she was surprised the Evil God appeared again, then nodded. "Okay."
After Austin and Daisy agreed on a plan, the four top greater gods appeared on the two worlds battlefield and simultaneously rushed towards the Myriad Heavens.
After hearing about the Evil Gods trail, Baal and Boswell immediately joined this operation without hesitation.
However, this scene shocked the Unified Dao cultivators.
The four strongest existences among the greater gods all appeared at once, which was tantamount to completely giving up their frontline defense Was it time for a decisive battle?
Yu Lian and Jiu Po appeared immediately, and Emperor Zhao also appeared with them.
The Star Rulers of the three original astral worlds represented the strongest combat power of the Myriad Heavens. Emperor Zhao rarely participated in this war, but he had no choice but to show up this time.
Soon, he was thankful he arrived in time, because Austinunder the cover of the other three greater godsheaded straight for God Emperor Heaven!
The three Unified Dao powers who were held up by Daisy and the others were all startled. Emperor Zhao immediately forgot about Baal, the opponent before him, and turned to rush back to God Emperor Heaven.
But no one accused him of being selfish right now. Star Rulers could exert at least 120% of their power inside their own astral worlds. On the contrary, Yu Lian and Jiu Po were even trying their best to hold off the other enemies for him.
Emperor Zhao moved very quickly and appeared in front of Austin in the blink of an eye. The ancient bronze sword emerged from the sky and crashed down on Austin's head.
The Emperor Sword, the human paths divine weapon passed down from ancient times, faced off against the holy sword from the King of Gods!
Under normal circumstances, Austin might still be willing to fight, but now that he was in a hurry to track down the Evil God, how could he be in the mood?
So Austin used his holy sword to block the Emperor Sword, then pushed with his left hand. The golden scales appeared again and landed directly on Emperor Zhaos head.
Austin, who held two top-tier divine authorities, usually rarely used his "justice", but it could often produce astonishing results at critical times.
Emperor Zhao had fought against Austin before and did not fear this Greater God of Light.
Although his own realm only corresponded to Tier 13, the Emperor's special laws allowed him to fight against Austin.
But hed never seen Austin attack with "justice". When the scale fell down, Emperor Zhao subconsciously slashed it with his sword.
But he soon discovered that the Emperor Sword was motionless, suppressed by the golden scale, with Austin's holy sword placed on the other side of the scale.
Austin temporarily trapped Emperor Zhaos sword at the cost of his own holy sword!
The next second, Gu Nan voluntarily appeared, punching Austin hard from behind.
Of course Gu Nan wouldnt foolishly wait for the other party to find him. Instead, he took the initiative and pretended he was here to help Emperor Zhao.
Austin knew the Evil God was here, so he was naturally prepared. A ball of holy flames erupted from his right hand, and the terrifying shockwave slammed into Gu Nan.
Austin was a greater god who rose abruptly amidst the Divine Wars. He had extremely high combat instincts and quickly found a way to deal with Gu Nan.
Pure laws would be blasted away directly by Gu Nans enormous strength. Instead, converting the laws into physical force first could at least have a stalling effect.
But Gu Nan's Evil God physique was strengthened yet again, and the power behind his punch reached an unbelievable level. The holy flames were instantly blasted apart, but Gu Nan himself was also blown away by the shockwave.
Austin stuck to him like a shadow, immediately taking back his holy sword and striking Gu Nan directly, while the golden scale also bore down on Gu Nan's head.
But Gu Nan didnt intend to stay any longer and relied on the Evil God physique to tank Austin's sword while taking that opportunity to break free of the golden scales suppression, his figure disappearing in an instant.
Gu Nan wasnt like those Unified Dao cultivators; he was all too aware of how powerful the golden scale was in Austin's hands, so he had to escape its influence.
Thanks to this delay, Yu Lian, Jiu Po, and the Myriad Heavens other Unified Dao powers also arrived one after another, turning the scene chaotic for a while.
Baal stood next to Dark Lady Daisy. He narrowed his eyes. "We will stay behind as support. That Evil God has been marked by Austin and cannot escape."
Daisy and the Ruler of Ashen Cyan both nodded. With their strength, they did not fear being besieged by Unified Dao figures. They could always get a chance to escape.
But none of the three expected for Austin to return just a moment later.
"He ran away, Austin used three words to succinctly explain the meaning behind his reappearance.
"Where did he go?" Boswell, the Ruler of Ashen Cyan, couldn't help asking. He knew it was impossible for Gu Nan to escape Austin's surveillance.
"The frontlines, Austin answered flatly.
The other three suddenly turned. Sure enough, they saw Gu Nan standing behind the Beast God on the frontlines, while the latter was hurriedly avoiding Gu Nans attacks.
At this moment, they suddenly understood Gu Nan's intention.
He used himself as bait to completely ignite the war at the greater god level and he succeeded.
A chaotic battle was coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 565: Chaotic Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Chaotic Battle
Gu Nan appeared on the frontlines, and his first target was Beast God Bridges. However, Austin and the others were still in the Myriad Heavens and couldnt arrive in time, so other gods would have to help Bridges.
A lavender mist enshrouded the surroundings; the River Styx slowly extended out from behind Gu Nan; a violent storm churned over Gu Nans head, thunder and lightning intertwining; and before him was the phantom of a ferocious demon
The instant Gu Nan appeared, the Beast God retreated violently while the four greater gods behind him took simultaneous action to stop Gu Nan's advance.
Ruler of Nightmares Kenneth, Ruler of Styx August, Ruler of Tyrannical Storms Leyman, and Demon King Stanley.
They were the remaining four greater gods of the Dark Faction. Faced with Gu Nans sudden arrival, these four greater gods actually launched simultaneous attacks. The Unified Dao cultivators of the Myriad Heavens were definitely not this united.
For example, Austin had been wreaking havoc in God Emperor Heaven for a while now, but the number of Unified Dao existences who showed up to helpnot counting Yu Lian and Jiu Powas only two to three.
But this wasnt importantbecause Gu Nan, who was already Tier 13, did not care about the number of enemies at all.
No matter how many laws they gathered, all of it would still be destroyed in one punch!
With a single punch, the storm was blown apart, the dream realm collapsed, the River Styx flowed in reverse, and the demon retreated Then, under the Beast Gods incredulous stare, his divine body was shattered to pieces.
The battlefield instantly fell silent, and Myriad Laws Heavens Li Ci, who was originally fighting the Beast God, gave Gu Nan a strange look.
One punch broke through the combined attacks of four greater gods, then directly destroyed the Beast Gods divine body Li Ci suddenly felt that maybe the gods earlier warnings had some truth after all.
This person's growth speed wasnt normal at all. If he was allowed to continue developing, no one might be able to restrain him anymore.
Death God Baal was the first to arrive. Hed always had a good personal relationship with the Beast God, so a cold glint flashed through his eyes.
The greater gods relied on their Godheads to gather their laws. Although they wouldnt die on the spot if their divine body was destroyed, they would still suffer heavier losses than their Unified Dao counterparts. It was impossible to pretend this offense never happened.
The death scythe suddenly slashed out, but Gu Nan just raised his head calmly.
His body still contained the aura of four different laws. He twisted his head somewhat unnaturally, then punched the ice-cold scythe.
The power behind an attack with Baals full strength should not be underestimated. The scythe cut through most of Gu Nan's shoulder, revealing the ghastly white bones inside, but the wound was healing at a terrifying speed.
Gu Nan shattered the scythe with one punch, then shook his right hand. The injury caused by the scythe had already recovered.
He flashed Baal a cold smile as he suddenly vanished, having already switched his target to this Death God.
Austin and the other two also arrived just then. If the Evil God wasnt in the Myriad Heavens, then they wouldnt be foolish enough to fight on someone else's home turf. That would be tantamount to seeking death.
Baal had already become Gu Nan's target, so the Star Rulers of the three original realms also picked their own opponents.
Emperor Zhao was slightly weaker and did not let anger overtake his reasoning at this time. He faced off against Boswell, while Jiu Po approached Austin to continue their unfinished battle from last time.
Jiu Po fought Austin briefly back when he was hunting Valen.
That time, he underestimated "justice" and almost allowed Austin to escape, but Gu Nan made up for that misstep. This time, Jiu Po obviously would not make such a mistake again.
Yu Lian faced Dark Lady Daisy. This was also the only battle between the old and new generations.
Daisy was actually much older than Austin. Shed even met Yu Lians teacher before, while Yu Lian only inherited Void Grotto Heaven during this generation.
Besides these three groups, all greater gods from the World of Gods had already joined the fray.
The Dark Factions four greater godswhod already attacked earlierappeared together. Goddess of Nature Daphne and Ruler of War Eugene also arrived. Even the Beast God, whose divine body was already destroyed once, walked onto the battlefield again with a dark expression.
At this stage, the Myriad Heavens Unified Dao bigshots naturally couldnt hide any longer. The war between the two worlds had already reached the most critical stage.
On the contrary, the war among those below them paused. Because everyone knew that the final outcome of the war would be determined by this decisive battle taking place in the gap between the two worlds.
Everyone had already found their opponent, but one person was not so well-behaved, and that was Gu Nan.
Gu Nan threw a punch at Baal. The latter was already prepared and entered a state between life and death, while Gu Nan's punch went right through him, dealing zero damage.
Baal reversed his grip on the scythe and slashed down. Thick death energy seemed to rise up from the realm of the dead, trying to drag Gu Nan away from the world of the living.
Gu Nan grinned, and his body instantly melted into the shadows. The scythe also missed. Neither side gained an advantage in this exchange.
But Baal wasnt in a rush. As long as Gu Nan appeared from the shadows, it would be impossible to escape his lock-on.
He knew Gu Nan's regeneration ability was extremely strong, but as the Death God, he had a law for thatas long as enough death energy accumulated in Gu Nan's body, the final detonation would definitely cause huge damage.
The next second, Gu Nan suddenly appeared on the other side of the battlefield and punched someone hard.
Beast God Bridges!
Bridges almost coughed up blood. Why is this psycho targeting me again?
But no one could help him stall Gu Nan this time. All the greater gods were preoccupied with their own opponents. Only Baal was free, but Gu Nan didn't even spare him a glance, even as Baals scythe cut into him multiple times.
The Beast Gods divine body exploded again, and this poor greater god was once again blasted to smithereens, but the price was that Gu Nan was slashed by the death scythe yet again.
Moreover, Baal reacted extremely quickly. The same time he swung the scythe, he also attacked Bridges' enemy.
The person facing the Beast God was Gu Nan's acquaintance, Azure Sky Heavens Mu Qishuang. Mu Qishuang wasnt weak, but her laws were a bad matchup for the Death God, so she could barely block the scythe.
Baal originally only wanted to lessen the losses; he did not expect to have some unexpected gains.
So he immediately forgot about Gu Nanwho was more slippery than a loachand focused on dealing with Mu Qishuang.
In Baals view, if he fought Mu Qishuang, this womans laws would quickly be scattered and destroyed, so Gu Nan would be forced to come back and help her.
His idea was basically correct, but Why would Gu Nan care whether Mu Qishuang lived or died?
Gu Nans figure blurred again, this time appearing right next to Daphne and Zou Jiming. Thus, Daphne, who had no one to help her, was also downed by Gu Nan in three punches.
The vigilant Daphne dodged two punches, but in the end, it was impossible to avoid every single punch, so she was also smashed to pieces by Gu Nan's punch.
"Damn it!" Baals eyes exuded endless killing intent, but his thoughts were extremely clear.
He knew it would be very hard to catch Gu Nan, who held dominion over shadows, but he didn't expect Gu Nan to completely disregard his comrades lives. In that case
