Baal forced Mu Qishuang away with one blow, then ignored all other Unified Dao cultivators and headed straight for the area the top three were in.
His target was Emperor Zhao!

chapters.title: Chapter 566: Death Energy
chapters.content:
Baal was very clearheaded. He knew that if he continued to chase Gu Nan, he would only be left in the dust. Ultimately, the whole battle would be brought down by Gu Nan’s tactics.
Although this tactic enraged him greatly, the battlefield was a matter of life and death. Who could afford to worry about morality here?
So Baal made the best decision given the circumstances.
Since Gu Nan liked to go after normal greater gods, Baal would force Emperor Zhao to retreat. If Boswell could be freed up, even if they competed with Gu Nan for speed of kills, his side would still have the absolute advantage.
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan immediately understood Baal’s intentions. He pointed his staff to the distance, and the cyan light filling the sky intensified. Even Emperor Zhao's human path emperor Qi was suppressed.
The death scythe struck from behind again, and the corners of Emperor Zhao’s mouth couldn’t help twitching slightly. But he also couldn’t throw away his pride to ask Gu Nan for help, so he could only hold on with all his strength.
But he was already the weakest among the top seven powerhouses, and now, he was even besieged by two of them. How long could he hold out?
With the tacit cooperation between the Ruler of Ashen Cyan and the God of Death, Emperor Zhao was hit by the death scythe four consecutive times, after which Baal directly detonated the death energy accumulated in Emperor Zhao’s body, causing the latter’s body to explode.
The damage caused by the Death God was far more serious than Gu Nan’s punches. The death energy directly attacked Emperor Zhao’s laws, damaging the opponent's foundation.
At least in the near future, it would be hard for Emperor Zhao to be in fighting condition again.
But while Baal and Boswell were dealing with Emperor Zhao, Gu Nan was constantly attacking other greater gods.
He was extremely fast, and without the support of the top greater gods, normal greater gods couldn’t withstand Gu Nan's attacks at all, undergoing a round of purging.
The remaining five greater gods from the Dark Faction all had their divine bodies destroyed at least once. The most unlucky person, the Beast God, even had his divine body destroyed for the third time, and Goddess of Nature Daphne also had her body destroyed twice.
Even though the simple act of destroying a god’s divine body was slightly less damaging than a direct attack on their laws, it still meant losing a portion of their Godhead, which could not be regarded as an insignificant loss.
Baal and the Ruler of Ashen Cyan exchanged glances. They both knew that with the characteristics of their own laws, it wouldn’t be easy to catch Gu Nan.
Since the other party wanted to trade a life for a life, they would oblige!
The two didn't need to communicate at all and pounced directly on a Unified Dao cultivator near them—it was none other than Song Fei, who seemed relatively weaker.
Song Fei's laws weren’t very useful in fights, and his own realm also wasn’t considered high. He was naturally one of the easiest targets among the Unified Dao figures.
But to be besieged just because of Gu Nan's decision was the most painful thing.
Since when did Gu Nan’s decisions hold so much weight?
Song Fei held on just barely and was killed by the two greater gods almost in the blink of an eye. His soul quickly fled to Academic Heaven; he didn’t even have time to take back his laws.
This wasn’t because Song Fei didn’t try his best. Rather, the power of two Tier 14 greater gods joining forces could not be underestimated.
Baal and Boswell’s team-up allowed them to defeat Unified Dao enemies with an efficiency that did not lose out to Gu Nan, and they even caused more damage.
The Beast God could reappear again and again, but Song Fei dared not show his face again, or else he might truly die.
Baal and Boswell then found Dream Immortal. She hadn’t recovered from the injuries Gu Nan gave her yet, making her an easy target. On the other side, Gu Nan also switched his focus to the Ruler of Nightmares who just returned.
Austin and Daisy were kept busy by Jiu Po and Yu Lian, so Gu Nan started a hunting competition with Baal and Boswell, which was the strategy that best suited Gu Nan.
It couldn’t be helped. After all, no one could catch Gu Nan. If they didn’t engage in a hunting competition against him, should they just watch as Gu Nan slaughtered greater gods?
On the other hand, Yu Lian was already feeling the pressure from her senior.
She didn’t even have a chance to throw out most of her Daoist techniques before they were directly swallowed by the boundless darkness.
If she hadn't relied on some of Void Grotto Heaven’s secret techniques, perhaps she would’ve already lost now, unable to fight back at all.
On the contrary, Jiu Po and Austin were evenly matched; neither could suppress the other anytime soon.
Jiu Po was already on guard against "justice" and wouldn’t allow Austin to succeed easily this time. With his power, stalling the battle for a while was no problem at all.
"Your people can't last for long. Why don't you retreat?" Jiu Po pointed with a smile.
In the direction he pointed at, Daphne was once again targeted by Gu Nan. Her strength began to weaken, and she was unable to resist at all. Her Godhead was soon shattered by Gu Nan.
If not for the war between the two worlds, she would’ve hidden herself in her Divine Kingdom long ago instead of coming back to seek death again and again.
Austin’s expression was indifferent. "Aren't you guys the same?"
"It's different." Jiu Po shook his head and said seriously, "Gu Nan can actually kill people."
……
The situation took a new turn. After Gu Nan killed Daphne yet again, he quickly left the battlefield, with no intention of showing up again.
Baal and the Ruler of Ashen Cyan looked at each other and immediately returned to the World of Gods without much thought. Sure enough, they found Gu Nan already inside the Nature Divine Kingdom.
"His divine body is powerful, but it also has its drawbacks." Baal said in a low voice, "As long as we completely destroy him, he will have no chance to intervene in this battle again."
A winner would almost certainly be decided in this battle. As long as they completely conquered the Myriad Heavens, they would have plenty of time to deal with Gu Nan.
Boswell said seriously, "I will protect Daphne. You can find an opportunity to strike."
The Death God nodded solemnly. If Gu Nan wanted to kill Daphne, he wouldn’t run away again. They all knew that this was their best opportunity.
However, Baal soon discovered that he did not need to deliberately look for opportunities—because Gu Nan had no intention of hiding his whereabouts.
He stood brazenly in the Nature Divine Kingdom, and the law of shadows quickly radiated outwards, engulfing all living creatures in the Divine Kingdom.
Boswell raised his staff again, covering the Nature Divine Kingdom with a cyan light that quickly protected some creatures and continuously resisted Gu Nan’s law of shadows.
In a battle of pure laws, Gu Nan was no stronger than the Ruler of Ashen Cyan.
Gu Nan was also fully aware of this, so in a flash, he appeared behind Boswell and slammed a punch down.
As if Baal had expected that, he appeared in front of Gu Nan in advance, blocking his way with the death scythe.
A scene similar to before happened. The scythe left deep gashes on Gu Nan's body, while Gu Nan's fist also smashed the scythe into pieces.
But with such a delay, the Ruler of Ashen Cyan could naturally retreat calmly. No one at the greater god level lacked fighting experience.
However, Gu Nan just smiled. His figure flew around quickly and threw punches from all directions, all targeting the Ruler of Ashen Cyan.
Baal was like the sharpest hunter. No matter which angle Gu Nan attacked from, he could still block with great accuracy.
‘One more blow…’ Baal estimated the strength of the opponent's divine body in his mind. As long as Gu Nan was cut by his scythe again, the explosion of death energy would be enough to completely destroy the opponent.
The shadows reemerged, and Baal did not hesitate to slash Gu Nan hard.
‘It’s enough!’ Baal perked up and immediately detonated the death energy inside Gu Nan's body, but Gu Nan's subsequent move startled him.
As if he already knew Baal’s plans, Gu Nan flew towards Boswell.
The terrifying law of death exploded out with the two of them at the center.

chapters.title: Chapter 567: Light and Darkness
chapters.content:
Boswell never dreamed that Gu Nan would choose "mutual destruction" this way.
The death energy was directly detonated inside Gu Nan's body. Although Gu Nan bore the brunt of the attack, once he was right next to the Ruler of Ashen Cyan, the latter naturally couldn’t escape either.
Almost as soon as the death energy exploded, Boswell felt a terrifying shockwave hit him, and the power of laws also burst out instantly.
With Baal’s abilities, this attack naturally dealt damage to the opponent’s laws. His original intention was to kill Gu Nan with this, or at least destroy his body and laws so that he could no longer participate in this battle.
However, now that Boswell also became an attack target, he was similarly unable to withstand this horrifying blow. The laws in his body collapsed almost instantaneously, and his divine body also crumbled.
It wasn't that the Ruler of Ashen Cyan was too fragile. Rather, Gu Nan’s body had simply accumulated too much death energy.
It could be said that ever since Baal became a greater god, no one had ever been able to withstand so many of his attacks and accumulate so much death energy in their body.
A normal person—even a greater god—would have been sliced to pieces long ago if they were hit by the death scythe so many times.
But it was precisely because the enemy was Gu Nan that Baal was able to accumulate such a frightening amount of death energy, making it all but impossible for even Boswell to defend against the subsequent explosion.
Baal realized that he’d been used by Gu Nan, but his combat instincts were also quite sharp. He quickly suppressed all his emotions and rushed towards the center of the death energy.
He didn't believe that Gu Nan would voluntarily commit suicide. He definitely had other motives for doing this.
However, Baal discovered that things were not that simple when he arrived at the explosion’s center.
Like Boswell, Gu Nan's whole body was blown to bits by the death energy, but scattered pieces of his flesh and blood were not completely corroded by the death energy and were quickly fusing together.
After reaching Tier 13, the power of the Evil God physique had exceeded an ordinary person’s understanding. Just a drop of blood was enough to bring Gu Nan back to life.
Baal narrowed his eyes slightly, quickly controlling the surrounding death energy and using all his power to corrode Gu Nan's flesh and blood.
Unfortunately, Gu Nan was far more tenacious than he imagined. The scattered bits of flesh and blood rapidly grew from all the tiny corners, not giving Baal time to attack.
This was unlike the two previous times where Gu Nan was besieged. Firstly, he was already at Tier 13 now, and secondly, there was no Daisy this time, which meant no top-tier law of darkness to suppress his regeneration.
In just a few seconds, Gu Nan's body continued to recover everywhere.
To his left, Baal saw a Gu Nan with half of his head formed, and to his right was an arm rapidly growing out. Every scattered body part was as strong as Gu Nan’s normal body, making Baal not know which part to kill first.
Just a moment later, a complete Gu Nan reappeared, and the law of shadows was gathered again.
Gu Nan even gave Baal a nod and flashed him a friendly smile. If not for Baal’s help, he wouldn't have been able to deal with the Ruler of Ashen Cyan so easily.
The next second, Gu Nan's figure vanished again. The law of shadows expanded outwards once more, and the entire Nature Divine Kingdom fell into Gu Nan's control.
Baal tried to resist the shadows with death energy, but what greeted him was Gu Nan's punch.
……
A moment later, when Boswell finally managed to reconstruct his divine body after much difficulty and dragged his battered laws to the Nature Divine Kingdom, all he could see was Baal standing there, his face ashen pale.
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan sighed in his heart, knowing that despite their best efforts, they ultimately failed to stop the Evil God.
"Daphne…"
"Dead,” Baal answered darkly. To watch helplessly as a greater god died right in front of his eyes—this was the first time Baal ever experienced such a powerless feeling where all his strength and laws were useless.
He’d never met an opponent like Gu Nan, who seemed extremely familiar with every single one of his moves and completely saw through all his tactics.
This was a very unbelievable thing. There were countless ways for greater gods to utilize their laws, many of which weren’t even clear to the greater gods themselves and were even improvised in the middle of the battle based on the situation.
But his opponent could predict even these methods in advance, which could no longer be explained by experience.
Baal even wondered whether this Evil God had the ability to see a few minutes into the future, to be able to accomplish such outrageous feats.
But regardless, Daphne still died at Gu Nan’s hands, and now, there were only three greater gods left in the Light Faction. Besides Austin and Boswell, there was only Ruler of War Eugene.
Gu Nan had already run far away. Three greater gods—Valen, Rolensia, and Daphne—already died at his hands, and his Evil Value shot up even further.
Originally, after he killed two Tier 11 greater gods, he actually had a surplus of Evil Value that slightly exceeded the requirement for Tier 13.
Now that a Tier 12 Daphne was added, the Evil Value she gave was slightly higher than that of Valen and Rolensia combined. However, there was still a long way to go until Tier 14.
"I still need a lot more…" Gu Nan looked at the increase in Evil Value and saw that the gap was still quite big.
More importantly, the Evil Value greater gods could provide was a number that fluctuates with level, and the fluctuations may be very large, making it hard to get an accurate estimate.
Even if he calculated based on the maximum possible Evil Value each greater god could provide, he would still have to eliminate at least all five of the Dark Faction’s remaining greater gods before he could have any hope of reaching Tier 14.
After coming to this conclusion, Gu Nan could only shake his head slightly and pick up the pace as he headed for the next Divine Kingdom.
That was the Divine Kingdom of the Beast God Bridges.
……
In the gap between the two worlds, Jiu Po couldn’t help chuckling when he saw Austin suddenly pause. "Looks like it has already begun."
Gu Nan had the ability to hunt greater gods alone, and he was extremely efficient, leaving almost no room for the target to escape. That was his greatest strength.
Moreover, his super regeneration and law of shadows made it exceedingly difficult for anyone to stop Gu Nan. When he wanted to attack someone weaker than him, nobody could protect the latter.
Of course Austin knew that Gu Nan had already killed Daphne and was heading to the Beast God’s Divine Kingdom, while Boswell had suffered heavy injuries because of Gu Nan's trap.
"Tell Boswell and Baal to come back," Austin told Daisy abruptly. While saying that, he suddenly raised the golden scales and sent it to another battlefield.
The golden scale’s target was Yu Lian, who was already struggling to fight the Dark Lady to begin with. Daisy's expression stiffened slightly, but her response wasn’t slow at all, and the all-consuming darkness instantly enveloped Yu Lian.
Austin's timing was very crafty. Yu Lian, who had to deal with Daisy's suppression, was already mentally and physically exhausted. Now, she was suddenly caught off guard.
The golden scales stopped right on top of Yu Lian’s head. This time, the scale was not used to limit Yu Lian’s power, Instead, it took a portion of the darkness.
At the other end of the scale, a ball of holy light was already flickering.
The joint attack of Austin and Daisy, the unity of light and darkness—this almost impossible and inconceivable combination was forcibly achieved by Austin’s "justice".
The scale fell down, and everything was wiped out.

chapters.title: Chapter 568: Twin Dragons
chapters.content:
Terrifying energy shockwaves erupted from the gap between the two worlds; even Jiu Po was affected by the collision of light and darkness. Yu Lian, who bore the brunt of the attack, was completely destroyed almost instantly.
If Baal was here, he would definitely feel like "I've seen this episode before"—because Boswell also suffered a similar fate just now.
Boswell lost a divine body when Gu Nan—along with the explosion of death energy—neared him, while nothing remained of Yu Lian’s body after the collision of light and darkness.
The collapse of a large amount of laws also gave Yu Lian heavy injuries. She wasn’t much better off than Boswell.
Jiu Po was also affected, and his figure instantly escaped into the void. By the time he returned, Austin and Daisy had already vanished.
Jiu Po frowned slightly and quickly scanned the surroundings with his soul, looking for traces of the two greater gods. He then discovered an astonishing fact.
Austin and Daisy actually brought Baal with them, and the three of them simultaneously rushed into Emperor Zhao’s God Emperor Heaven!
Did they abandon their nest?
Jiu Po stared blankly for a moment but quickly understood the enemy’s plan. They were in a race of speed against Gu Nan, exchanging the lives of greater gods for Unified Dao cultivators!
It seemed that those who could become top-tier greater gods wouldn’t lose to anyone in terms of how ruthless they could be to their own people.
……
God Emperor Heaven.
Emperor Zhao was perhaps the most frustrated person right now.
It was very normal to strategically sacrifice certain individuals for the sake of the big picture, but it was harder to accept when that sacrifice became himself.
What's more, he couldn't even actively choose; it was entirely his enemies who chose him.
Austin, Daisy, and Baal’s besiegement was hard for even Jiu Po to withstand, let alone Emperor Zhao, who’d just been injured.
In fact, if he wasn’t inside his own astral world right now, he might not be able to survive even one exchange and would’ve been utterly annihilated by now.
Jiu Po quickly returned to the Myriad Heavens and headed directly to God Emperor Heaven to help Emperor Zhao stabilize the situation. If all the inhabitants of God Emperor Heaven were killed by the three greater gods, not even Jiu Po would be able to save him.
However, it was still very difficult for Emperor Zhao to hold on. A large number of living beings in God Emperor Heaven died, and even Jiu Po could not completely save them. On the contrary, Austin and the other two were overwhelming and unstoppable.
"Where's Yu Lian?!" Emperor Zhao loudly questioned Jiu Po upon seeing the other party.
Jiu Po looked grave as he answered heavily, "Yu Lian was wounded by Austin and Daisy’s joint attack. I'm afraid her injuries are even heavier than yours right now."
Emperor Zhao opened his mouth a few times, but no words came out. He knew all too well that if even Yu Lian suffered such injuries, it would be hard for her to help him now.
After all, she didn’t have any home field advantage here. On the contrary, if she came to God Emperor Heaven to help, the three greater gods would probably immediately turn around and kill Yu Lian first.
It had to be said that Austin's choice was very smart.
The tactic he used seemed to be the same as Gu Nan's, but Gu Nan relied on the fact that he was hard to kill and even harder to catch to chip away at the greater gods bit by bit.
But with Austin and the other two joining forces, no one could compete with them in terms of absolute strength. In terms of destructive power, they were far stronger than Gu Nan.
And at such a critical juncture where both sides were racing against time, destructive power meant efficiency, and efficiency determined victory or defeat!
Furthermore, the overwhelming power of Austin’s group meant they could head directly to God Emperor Heaven, while it was impossible for Gu Nan to go to the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom.
If Gu Nan wanted to destroy the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom with his mere Tier 13 laws, Boswell wouldn’t even need to show himself. He could just passively resist Gu Nan with laws alone.
Even if the Ruler of Ashen Cyan was injured, it would still be enough to stall Gu Nan for a long time. After all, that was his home court.
The World of Gods seemed to be at a disadvantage at the start of the Great War because two of its greater gods were killed first, but their high-end combat power was stronger than the Myriad Heavens’.
Now that the time had come for each side to make sacrifices in pursuit of victory, this advantage could be used to the extreme. If the two sides exchanged the lives of its top combatants, the final winner would undoubtedly be the World of Gods.
Austin's gaze was ice-cold, and he controlled laws with the utmost precision. His whole person was like a war machine, purifying all the world’s evil.
Emperor Zhao could only grit his teeth. He knew that all other Unified Dao cultivators were currently preoccupied. Of the two who were qualified to intervene in this fight—Yu Lian and Gu Nan—one could no longer even protect herself, while the other didn’t care about him at all.
However, an unexpected savior appeared at this moment.
The sky above God Emperor Heaven was suddenly covered by two enormous shadows. If one looked carefully, they would be able to make out two giant dragons crisscrossing through the sky.
Austin frowned and raised his head, but he felt as if he was inside a strange space. His control over his divine authorities and laws had been weakened to an extreme degree.
In this space, distance was stretched, time was compressed, and everything became extremely slow.
Laws escaped the three greater gods’ control and were quickly eroded by Jiu Po’s power of the earth. God Emperor Heaven’s situation instantly stabilized.
"Lu Wen!" Emperor Zhao looked up in shock, only to see Lu Wen's figure standing calmly in the sky, still wearing his seven-star Daoist robe, overlooking the battlefield below.
……
World of Gods.
Gu Nan was indeed not as efficient as Austin’s group. At the same time, due to the strength of his own laws, he also could not head to the top-tier greater gods’ Divine Kingdom.
But he seemed extremely skilled at dealing with greater gods who were not top-tier. The Beast God’s Divine Kingdom was already in shambles, and Bridges was barely managing to hold on through gritted teeth.
The situation he faced was even sadder than that of Emperor Zhao—because no one could help him, and the pressure that the elusive and unstoppable Gu Nan brought him was no weaker than the pressure from Austin’s group of three strongest greater gods.
A moment later, the Beast God’s Divine Kingdom had been completely engulfed by shadows. All the creatures inside either fled or were killed by Gu Nan, leaving only Bridges as the lone commander.
Bridges glared at Gu Nan coldly. He resisted until the very last moment, and then… ran away.
That's right. He waited until his Divine Kingdom was completely destroyed by Gu Nan. After he stalled for enough time, he then turned and ran without another word.
As early as when Austin formulated the tactic to exchange lives in a war of attrition, he’d already issued an order to all greater gods. If the Evil God started targeting someone, they should stall for as long as possible, then run away.
A destroyed Divine Kingdom could be rebuilt. As long as the Beast God was alive and the gods won this battle, everything would have a chance to be repaired.
This was a battle where both worlds put everything on the line; no one could stay out of it.
Gu Nan stared at Bridges' disappearing figure and revealed an odd smile. It would be too naive to believe that he could escape like this.
Gu Nan disappeared from his spot, then quickly broke into the Holy Light Divine Kingdom and found a familiar god, appearing in front of her.
This person's name was Sylvia.

chapters.title: Chapter 569: Bloodline
chapters.content:
Under normal circumstances, Gu Nan had no interest in entering the Holy Light Divine Kingdom.
This was Austin's headquarters. Not only was it filled with the ultimate law of holy light, it was also easy to draw out Austin himself.
For example, Gu Nan entered the Holy Light Divine Kingdom last time precisely to attract Austin's attention and have him leave a mark on Gu Nan so that he could be led to God Emperor Heaven.
And this time, he also had a special purpose. This purpose was Sylvia.
Ever since the Great War between the two worlds broke out, Sylvia’s older brother had kept her inside his Divine Kingdom to prevent her from being kidnapped as a hostage.
After all, the Holy Light Divine Kingdom was the safest place compared to any other place.
It was a pity that at this most critical moment, even if Austin sensed the abnormalities inside his Divine Kingdom, it was already too late for him to come back and rescue Sylvia.
Setting aside the fact that Jiu Po and Emperor Zhao wouldn’t let him leave so easily, even if he could leave, all his previous efforts in the invasion of God Emperor Heaven would be in vain.
Thus, in the instant Austin hesitated, Sylvia was already kidnapped by Gu Nan.
……
Myriad Heavens.
Austin sensed what happened inside his Divine Kingdom, and his expression suddenly turned frigid. But he also knew that it was too late to return now.
As a result, his purification of God Emperor Heaven suddenly turned much more violent, confusing even Daisy and Baal.
‘Does Austin hold some sort of personal grudge against Emperor Zhao?’
On the other side, Sylvia was caught completely off-guard and taken away by Gu Nan. She was currently glaring at Gu Nan fiercely.
"Evil God, kill me!" Sylvia shouted, "Don't delude yourself into thinking I’ll tell you anything, let alone thinking that you can threaten my brother this way!"
Sylvia didn't even need to think about why Gu Nan kidnapped her. Of course it was to threaten her brother.
However, she guessed wrong. What Gu Nan wanted did not require her cooperation. All he needed was… her divine blood.
……
Sylvia's laws were completely sealed. She felt her vision blur slightly, having already been brought to a tattered Divine Kingdom by Gu Nan when her eyes cleared up.
If not for the fact that there were still some traces of the main temple left and that Sylvia had also been to the Beast God’s Divine Kingdom before, she wouldn't even believe this was once the Divine Kingdom of a greater god.
"Beast God…" Sylvia murmured.
The next second, she felt a stinging pain on her wrist. A shadow blade had already cut open a gash, allowing divine blood to freely flow out.
"You—" Sylvia had just opened her mouth when Gu Nan silenced her voice, preventing her from saying another word.
Gods’ divine bodies were closely related to their divine authorities, and the blood of gods was even more precious than the blood of dragons. One could even consider the blood of the gods to have strong properties of laws.
Sylvia's divine blood was absorbed by Gu Nan, quickly creating the ultimate shadows that started drawing out a strange line in the void, starting from the Beast God’s painting in the main temple.
Sylvia’s eyes couldn't help widening when she saw this line. After all, this was something that came from her body, and she could vaguely feel what the end of the line was pointing to.
That was the location of Bridges—Beast God Bridges.
‘Why does my blood… have such power?’ Sylvia felt very incredulous. Not only was she confused about the phenomenon itself, but she also didn’t know why Gu Nan would know something like this.
Of course she couldn’t voice her questions, but Gu Nan seemed to understand and explained with a faint smile, "Austin is already the embodiment of laws. You, who are connected to him by blood, naturally also possess this characteristic."
In the World of Gods’ world setting, bloodline was an extremely intimate connection.
When a god ascended to a new realm, all of that god’s relatives and children would also receive a certain strengthening. It wasn’t entirely a coincidence that the children of gods were often more talented than ordinary people.
However, this improvement was so subtle that in many cases, not even the relatives themselves could feel it. Of course Sylvia also knew this, but it was even more rare for a god to become more powerful because their blood relative ascended.
Because of Austin, Sylvia also possesses characteristics of laws. To a certain extent, her blood represents shadow itself.
And it was common sense that laws related to shadows had tracking abilities.
Gu Nan wasn’t at Tier 15 yet and his laws had yet to reach their peak, so he could only borrow Sylvia's power for the time being.
……
Bridges was currently hiding in a small plane, gnashing his teeth as he stared at his wrecked Divine Kingdom while trying his best to hide himself. He only hoped that once they won the Great War, they would be able to use their full power to encircle and annihilate this damned Evil God.
So when the strange black thread slowly stopped in front of him, Bridges hadn't even registered what was happening yet.
Then he felt a sudden pain in the back of his head. Gu Nan had already appeared by his side at some point and thrown a direct punch.
Bridges didn't even have time to react to this completely unexpected sneak attack. His divine body was instantly blasted apart, leaving not even a fragment behind.
The terrifying explosive power of the Evil God physique was brought out to its fullest in this sneak attack, felling a greater god in an instant.
Gu Nan harvested Evil Value again, then immediately headed to the next Divine Kingdom. This time, his target was Demon King Stanley.
……
"Bridges is dead," Austin spoke up again in an unusually subdued voice.
Although they already had countermeasures prepared, Gu Nan still managed to kill a greater god. This development already exceeded his expectations.
Though it was quite cost-effective to take the lives of Unified Dao enemies in exchange for greater gods’ Divine Kingdoms by taking advantage of the other side’s lack of unity, exchanging the lives of greater gods for the enemies’ lives was not quite worth it.
But now that things were already like this, retreat was no longer an option for Austin and his group. It was impossible to stop halfway now.
Dark Lady Daisy said with a dark expression, "We can only rely on them to stall for time while we speed up our progress."
Baal did not speak, but he proved his attitude with his actions. Death energy began to spread crazily in God Emperor Heaven as Baal completely ignored his own energy consumption.
Lu Wen was still standing in the air, using the laws of time and space to hold back the movements of Austin’s group.
But such a surprise attack could only work once in a fight at this level. After the first wave of time and space laws were destroyed, it would be difficult for him to set another trap like this.
The pressure on Jiu Po and Emperor Zhao intensified with every passing second. Even with Lu Wen's help, it only delayed the destruction of God Emperor Heaven.
It was already unexpected that someone could intervene in a fight at this level. It would be too unreasonable to expect Lu Wen to be able to turn the tides.
"Give up." Jiu Po sighed and tried to convince Emperor Zhao, "An astral world can still be rebuilt after it’s destroyed."
Austin could understand this, so Unified Dao powerhouses could naturally understand it as well.
Unfortunately, although the greater gods could make such a decision, Emperor Zhao could not. The reason was very simple. God Emperor Heaven had been passed down through inheritance for endless years before it was finally passed into his hands.
If it was destroyed by the greater gods like this, how would he be able to face his predecessors?

chapters.title: Chapter 570: Double Kill
chapters.content:
"You guys should leave." Emperor Zhao gritted his teeth and said, "Even if I die, I will die here."
Jiu Po sighed again and finally gave up on trying to dissuade him, simply shifting his focus to fighting the three greater gods until the last possible moment.
This wasn’t to say that Jiu Po was altruistic. In any case, he himself was not under any pressure. The longer he delayed the enemies in God Emperor Heaven, the safer he himself would be.
In terms of the big picture, the later the destruction of God Emperor Heaven, the better the situation would be for the Myriad Heavens.
It was still a race against time. Everything depended on whether Gu Nan could kill all the greater gods first or whether Austin’s group could deal with the Myriad Heavens’ main forces first.
……
Gu Nan had already arrived at Demon King Stanley's Divine Kingdom, which was a strange plane that the mortal world called the "Demon Realm".
That’s right. The World of Gods did have a Demon Realm. However, the Demon Realm was not a main plane, but the Divine Kingdom of successive Demon Kings.
When his Divine Kingdom was targeted by Gu Nan, Stanley immediately returned from the frontline battlefield.
But instead of passively defending like the Beast God, he took the rarely-seen decision of revealing himself in front of Gu Nan.
The Demon King was a Tier 13 greater god, and he was considered a senior among the greater gods. More importantly, he held great confidence in himself.
"Choosing me as your next target will be the worst choice you ever make." Stanley stood calmly in front of Gu Nan and said with a faint smile, "You will be this Great War’s sinner."
What greeted him in response was naturally Gu Nan's punch.
No one could tank Gu Nan's punch with their physical body. Naturally, Stanley couldn’t either. His body was instantly blasted apart by Gu Nan, but another Stanley appeared immediately afterwards.
The special characteristic of the Demon King was that as long as his power was not exhausted, he was a nearly immortal existence.
His divinity was different from that of normal greater gods and was scattered among the various demons inside his Divine Kingdom. It could be said that every demon was a source of his power.
"It's useless." Stanley adjusted his collar as he leveled a faint smile at Gu Nan. "Your strength is all in your physical body. What can you use to kill me?"
Gu Nan smashed apart Stanley's body with another punch, then took out a bead with a crimson glow.
This was the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb he used to trap Graceful Heaven in back when he just completed the Second Round.
Now that Graceful Heaven had completely disappeared, only traces of the blood sacrifice were still inside. The Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb was once again empty, so Gu Nan could use it to deal with Stanley now.
Gu Nan pressed the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb into the ground, then leisurely stood aside as he looked at Stanley, who reappeared just now.
This time, it was Stanley's turn to be anxious.
The Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb was just a normal item. Both the difficulty in obtaining it and its effects were basically at the level of the First Round. Under normal circumstances, it couldn’t be used against greater gods at all.
In other words, during the course of a normal playthrough, this item had never trapped a greater god's Divine Kingdom before.
This wasn’t a matter of the item hitting an upper limit. Rather, it was simply impossible to achieve.
Attempting such a thing would immediately attract the combined attacks of all greater gods, and the collection process would be forcibly terminated. No player could handle being besieged by all the greater gods at once.
However, with the existence of the Myriad Heavens and the Great War between the two sides, Gu Nan now had the opportunity to do whatever he wanted.
Using Gu Nan's current power to activate the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb after it had been placed into the ground, the Demon Realm was quickly sucked into the orb at a speed that was almost visible to the naked eye.
Stanley no longer had the energy to make mocking remarks and started to draw on his laws crazily. Shadowy demons lunged at the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb one after another, trying to prevent the Divine Kingdom from being swallowed up.
But in the end, a Demon King was a Demon King. While the scattered nature of his Godhead gave him never-ending power, it also dispersed his burst damage.
With Gu Nan in charge, no matter how many demonic shadows came, they were mere canon fodder.
To put it another way, while others had the option of abandoning their Divine Kingdoms and escaping alone, Stanley couldn’t leave even if he wanted to. Because once he lost his Divine Kingdom, he would lose over 90% of his power, and he might not even be considered a greater god anymore.
Just a minute later, as Stanley gave one final miserable roar, the entire Demon Realm was swallowed up by the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb.
Stanley originally had a chance to escape, but in the end, he did not choose to escape. Instead, he entered the orb alongside his own Divine Kingdom.
Although he would be sealed as well, it was better than losing most of his power. After all, there was still hope of breaking out of the seal.
However, what he didn't know was that Gu Nan's purpose was not simply to get him to leave the battlefield, but to actually kill them.
After trapping the Demon Realm, Gu Nan tossed the Divine Kingdom Treasure Orb up and down a few times in his hand, then gave it a sudden slap—the orb shattered into pieces without any suspense.
……
God Emperor Heaven.
The battle here was concluding. Most of the astral world had already been occupied by the three greater gods. Emperor Zhao could only hold on to the last bit of territory left.
It could be said that in this situation, it was meaningless to agonize over staying or escaping—because all living creatures in the astral world had already died. However, Emperor Zhao still had no intention of leaving.
This was the Emperor. In ancient times, the king of the human race fought his way through the barren mountains and untamed rivers, overcoming all obstacles to finally carve out a path to survival. Now, similarly, there was no path of retreat either.
"Let's go," Jiu Po said as he appeared at Lu Wen's side. God Emperor Heaven no longer had any value, and they must adjust their conditions as soon as possible to help the three greater gods’ next target.
Lu Wen nodded and withdrew from God Emperor Heaven without hesitation. It was time for him to consider his own safety.
Because looking at the opponents’ attitude, since he stood out to help this time, he might just be the next one to suffer. But this couldn’t be helped. If he didn’t help God Emperor Heaven, other astral worlds wouldn’t even last as long as this one.
But one advantage Lu Wen had over Emperor Zhao was that he was decisive enough to give up his own astral world.
If it came down to it, he was ready to abandon his astral world and run to the World of Gods to kill normal greater gods.
This stage’s victory was right in front of their eyes. Even Jiu Po and Lu Wen had withdrawn. Austin’s group could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
"Destroy God Emperor Heaven as soon as possible," Austin emphasized.
Daisy and Baal nodded at the same time, but at this moment, Baal suddenly froze, an incredulous expression on his face as he said, “The Demon Realm disappeared, and Stanley also died…"
Austin suddenly turned around to stare at Baal’s face.
If stalling for time was their method of dealing with Gu Nan, then Stanley's Demon Realm was a trap. As long as Gu Nan stepped into it, he would inevitably have to waste a lot of time there.
Given the complexity of the Demon Realm, even if Austin went there in person, he would definitely not be able to conquer it overnight.
But now… Just how did Gu Nan do it?
Daisy said heavily, "The Evil God is a creature from ancient times. He may know some secrets that not even we understand."
"You believe that?" Austin looked at Daisy flatly, a cold glint in his eyes. "You want to retreat?"
Daisy was silent for a while, then finally said through gritted teeth, "Retreat is no longer an option."

chapters.title: Chapter 571: Race Against Time
chapters.content:
Retreating did cross Daisy’s mind when she found out that Stanley died at Gu Nan’s hands.
In any case, their top-level combat power was stronger than that of the Myriad Heavens. Victory or defeat in battles at the greater god level could not be determined by the number of participants on each side alone. It wasn’t too late to retreat now and focus on defense.
More importantly, there weren’t many people left in the Dark Faction anymore.
Apart from herself and Baal, there were only five other greater gods in the Dark Faction.
Now that Beast God Bridges and Demon King Stanley both died at Gu Nan's hands, only the Ruler of Nightmares and two others were left in the Dark Faction.
But the Light Faction’s situation seemed even bleaker, yet Austin was still determined to continue, so she could only grit her teeth and follow. At such a time, the World of Gods must remain united.
"Are we heading to Clockwork Heaven next?" Baal asked from the side. He utterly loathed the guy who interfered with their plans just now.
But Austin said, "No, let's start elsewhere. Lu Wen's ability will only be more effective in Clockwork Heaven."
Even though he also wanted to tear Lu Wen into a million pieces, Austin was still clearheaded.
What they lacked most right now was time. They must kill as many Unified Dao opponents as possible in the shortest possible time.
The reason they attacked God Emperor Heaven was because Emperor Zhao was already heavily injured and wasn’t as strong as Yu Lian and Jiu Po in the first place, so he was considered the most cost-effective target.
More importantly, if they didn’t find a way to force Unified Dao cultivators to return to the Myriad Heavens, the greater gods on the frontlines wouldn’t be able to hold out for any longer.
Boswell had already returned to the battlefield, joining forces with Eugene and the three Dark Faction greater gods. Only then were they able to barely withstand the attacks of the Unified Dao enemies after Lu Wen returned to the frontlines.
And this was even after the Ruler of Ashen Cyan risked his life to force Myriad Laws Heaven’s Li Ci and Alkaid Heaven’s Huo Kui to flee.
Austin had a good grasp of the war’s overall situation and immediately led the two to the next target—Weapon Martial Heaven.
……
"Is it Zou Jiming's turn?" Of course Gu Nan noticed the situation in the Myriad Heavens and realized that Austin’s group had switched targets. He couldn't help laughing.
Zou Jiming, who was on the frontline battlefield, naturally rushed back to his own astral world as soon as possible.
In any case, the Myriad Heavens still held the advantage on the frontlines right now, so there was no pressure for the time being.
However, Gu Nan knew that as the number of people on both sides continued to dwindle, this advantage would become smaller and smaller. Because the fewer enemies he had to deal with, the more confident Boswell would become.
The gap in top-end combat power between the two sides was just now beginning to show.
Among the four top-tier gods, only one of them needed to be present on the frontlines to hold back the majority of the Unified Dao cultivators.
But currently standing before Gu Nan was another greater god. To be precise, it was just the projection of a greater god—not everyone was like Stanley, capable of making thousands of incarnations and daring to show himself before Gu Nan.
"Kenneth, long time no see!" Gu Nan's law of shadows continued to spread outwards, but he leisurely greeted Kenneth.
That's right. He was now standing in the Nightmare Divine Kingdom, and his next target was the Ruler of Nightmares, Kenneth.
No, it would be more correct to say Gu Nan's next three targets. After appearing in the Nightmare Divine Kingdom and greeting Kenneth, he went directly to the Tyrannical Storms Divine Kingdom.
The Greater God of Tyrannical Storms, Leyman, received a fright and quickly left the frontlines to return to his Divine Kingdom, but a small swath of his Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants had already been killed by the shadows.
Next was naturally the River Styx Divine Kingdom. August, the Ruler of Styx, seemed to understand Gu Nan's plan and resisted the urge to return, remaining on the frontlines for a while longer.
As a result, Gu Nan simply stayed in the Styx Divine Kingdom a little longer, and the law of shadows spread out at an extremely fast speed, killing Styx believers in droves.
Therefore, as a last resort, the Ruler of Styx had no choice but to abandon the frontlines and rush back to his own Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan's move directly forced the Dark Faction’s three greater gods to leave the frontlines, which greatly increased the pressure on the battlefield’s remaining greater gods. Boswell and Eugene, the only two left, struggled to hold on.
Austin and the others also noticed Gu Nan's actions, but there was nothing they could do—because only Gu Nan could do something like this.
Only someone like Gu Nan, who was incredibly familiar with the World of Gods, could freely travel between the three major Divine Kingdoms.
On the other hand, Austin’s group was completely blind in the Myriad Heavens. They had trouble finding even a single astral world, so how could they have the ability to come and go without leaving a trace?
Thanks to Jiu Po's presence, teleportation was sealed for the greater gods here, forcing them to waste even more time.
Therefore, while large forces had a large force’s advantages, guerilla warfare also had its own advantages. In terms of strategic choice, both sides were trying to maximize their own strengths.
Just like this, Gu Nan wandered between the three major Divine Kingdoms, giving none of them a chance to breathe. His progress wasn’t much slower than conquering the Divine Kingdoms one after another.
This was also an experience Gu Nan learned after dealing with the Beast God.
Gu Nan discovered that in fact, when killing a Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants using the law of shadows, a lot of time was not actually spent on killing, but on playing games with the enemy greater gods.
For example, he had to look for places not under the greater god’s protection to massacre and find cracks in the protected areas. But when Gu Nan started working on three Divine Kingdoms at once, this time was saved and used to kill believers inside another Divine Kingdom instead.
It was no wonder that Gu Nan didn’t think of this strategy at first. After all, he rarely encountered such a perfect farming opportunity in the game. At most, he only engaged in guerrilla warfare, during which saving time wasn’t even a concern.
Gu Nan, who was operating on three fronts, was making rapid progress, but Austin’s group also worked hard, and their progress was no slower than Gu Nan's.
In just a few short minutes—because Zou Jiming was weaker than Emperor Zhao to begin with—Weapon Martial Heaven was breached in the blink of an eye, and he himself had no choice but to abandon his astral world and flee.
Austin’s group had no intention of pursuing him because they’d already achieved their goal.
A Unified Dao cultivator who lost his astral world would never dare to show himself in this Great War anymore, which was tantamount to losing his combat effectiveness. Because as long as he dared to show up, he would definitely face the despairing situation of all the top-tier gods ganging up to kill him.
"Next one," Austin said coldly.
The Unified Dao cultivators were forced back from the frontlines one after another, then saw their astral worlds destroyed. The originally glorious Sixteen Heavens suddenly became barren places devoid of life.
Even in astral worlds that had yet to be attacked, a large number of residents with considerable strength already fled—because no one knew whether they would be the next to suffer.
On the contrary, Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom remained tranquil and peaceful. No one could enter, and Austin’s group also had no intention of attacking this place.
It was the same reason why they didn’t attack Void Grotto Heaven and Jiu Po Heaven. The Star Rulers of these three astral worlds were too strong. Once they gained a home field advantage, Austin’s group was likely to be stalled to death there.
At best, their enemies would just send a different person to attack the World of Gods; it would be utterly meaningless.
This was the problem caused by a lack of information. If they understood how Evil Gods worked, they would definitely not have such a stupid thought. But it was a pity that no one else in this world knew as much about Evil Gods.
Time passed by, and after the three greater gods worked hard and finally hit all the weaker astral worlds at least once, Gu Nan's progress also came to an end.

chapters.title: Chapter 572: Final Kill
chapters.content:
One Tier 15 and two Tier 14 greater gods joined forces. They were naturally faster than Gu Nan at eroding enemies’ laws.
If they didn’t try to conquer the obstacle named God Emperor Heaven, Austin’s group probably would’ve been much faster, not giving Gu Nan the time he needed at all.
In the current Sixteen Heavens, the only three intact astral worlds left were Jiu Po Heaven, Void Grotto Heaven, and Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom.
Even Lu Wen’s Clockwork Heaven was massacred by the greater gods at the very last moment, and Lu Wen himself was forced to hide in an obscure small plane.
"We’ll head back and drive away the Evil God first, then come back," Austin quickly decided. His expression no longer looked as grave as before, having returned to its original calmness.
Judging from the current situation, through sound strategic decisions, the World of Gods already gained the upper hand.
There was still one Eugene left among the normal greater gods, but all the normal Unified Dao cultivators of the Myriad Heavens had either been wiped out or were no longer a threat. As for the top-tier greater gods, the World of Gods had the advantage in this aspect from the beginning.
Although Boswell’s injuries continuously worsened as he tried to stall for time on the frontlines, he had yet to completely lose his combat power.
On the contrary, here in the Myriad Heavens, Austin's initial decision to take out God Emperor Heaven no matter the cost was proving to be the correct choice.
Without God Emperor Heaven’s Emperor Zhao, only Jiu Po, Gu Nan, and a half-crippled Yu Lian were left on the Myriad Heavens’ side. How could they fight the World of Gods with just these people?
The only thing the greater gods found hard to accept was probably the fact that a large number of greater gods died at Gu Nan’s hands.
……
"Austin can't save you guys." Gu Nan visited Kenneth again, a cold smile on his face.
He knew what was happening in the Myriad Heavens, but it was already too late for Austin’s group of three to return at this time.
The Tyrannical Storms Divine Kingdom and the Styx Divine Kingdom had completely fallen already, and those two greater gods both fled.
Now, only the Ruler of Nightmares’ Divine Kingdom was left. Because of its special nature, Gu Nan put it last.
But Kenneth just smiled calmly. He was one of the first greater gods to come into contact with Gu Nan, and he personally watched Gu Nan ascend to Unified Dao.
Kenneth had been prepared ever since the war started.
He was just trying to stall for as much time as possible while considering how to escape after his Divine Kingdom is destroyed.
The Beast God and Demon King’s deaths sounded an alarm for Kenneth, letting him know that not even abandoning his Divine Kingdom and fleeing would ensure his safety.
But in the end, he didn't know how Gu Nan found those two. The normal thought process was that Gu Nan intercepted them during their escape.
As for the possibility that Gu Nan could track greater gods, that idea was too ridiculous to consider.
The Nightmare Divine Kingdom eventually still collapsed, and Kenneth sighed softly. He no longer had time to wait for Austin’s group to return, so his figure instantly escaped into the Dream Realm.
For a greater god with a special divine authority like him, the Dream Realm was undoubtedly safer than anywhere else.
Gu Nan seemed to react as expected. Since he wasn’t able to confirm Kenneth’s whereabouts, he never showed up again.
However, just a moment later, the Ruler of Nightmares received two pieces of news one after another—the Ruler of Tyrannical Storms and the Ruler of Styx both died at Gu Nan’s hands just now.
As of now, including Valen and Rolensia, as many as six greater gods had died at Gu Nan’s hands.
It could be said that everyone lost something in this Great War; it was only a matter of who suffered fewer losses. Only Gu Nan profited a ton.
"You’re the last one left," Gu Nan murmured, having already pinpointed Kenneth’s location through Sylvia's blood.
The Evil Value’s progress rate was similar to his expectations. He needed to kill roughly five greater gods to go from Tier 13 to Tier 14.
And Ruler of Nightmares Kenneth was now the fifth greater god!
Leveling up to Tier 12 and Tier 13 did not help Gu Nan as much as he expected, because the improvement to laws was mainly in terms of accumulation.
But Tier 14 was different.
If Tier 15 was a greater god’s pinnacle and the incarnation of a law itself, then Tier 14 was taking the first step into that realm.
People like Dark Lady Daisy, Death God Baal, and the others were actually all Tier 14, and their every move could directly affect the laws themselves.
And once one reached Tier 15—Austin’s realm—they themselves would represent the law’s will.
"Evil… God… You won't succeed!" Sylvia glared at Gu Nan icily and struggled to say.
Perhaps because Gu Nan's back and forth trips to the three major Divine Kingdoms took too much of his focus, Sylvia actually got a chance to speak.
However, excessive blood loss turned Sylvia’s face pale. Gods who lost their divine blood were weakened much more than mortals losing their blood.
Gu Nan smiled at her as a shadow blade instantly slashed Sylvia's neck. The Shadow Goddess who’d survived for tens of thousands of years finally died at the hands of the shadows themselves.
Gu Nan already collected enough divine blood, so Sylvia had no more value to him.
Austin, who was rushing back to the World of Gods, suddenly stiffened. As if he sensed something, cold murderous intent filled his eyes.
"Who did he kill now?" Daisy couldn't help asking after seeing his expression.
"Sylvia," Austin said coldly.
……
Dream Realm.
As a plane derived from the real world, there were some special creatures here.
The Ruler of Nightmares descended here with a greater god’s power, so he could naturally control most dream creatures. This could practically be considered his home field.
Gu Nan knew this very well, so he left Kenneth for last to make sure nothing could go wrong.
A punch suddenly swung through the void, but unlike before, it was not an instant kill. Instead, it seemed to hit a nightmare and passed directly through Kenneth’s body.
Kenneth was prepared.
Everyone knew he would hide in the Dream Realm, and Gu Nan certainly also knew that, so he didn't dare lower his guard for even a second.
Gu Nan was not dispirited. He was also mentally prepared. The Ruler of Nightmares was one of the hardest greater gods to kill with physical force alone, even if his fists already possessed some characteristics of laws.
Laws had always been the best way to deal with the Dream Realm.
Infinite shadows began to spread out from under Gu Nan's feet, quickly trapping Kenneth.
Though the Dream Realm provided Kenneth with the convenience of a home court, it was also like a cage, depriving him of the opportunity to move around.
In all the greater gods’ impressions, Gu Nan was still merely that newly-ascended Evil God. His power lied in his outrageously strong physical body, while the law of shadows merely concealed his whereabouts.
Few people noticed that he was already Tier 13.
He was at the same level as Kenneth, but his laws were shadows, which shared the same origin as light. This in itself was an extremely formidable power.
So when Kenneth discovered the entire Dream Realm quickly being swallowed up by shadows, he realized that something was wrong.
The law of shadows should clearly have a secretive, arcane nature, but it was indescribably domineering in Gu Nan's hands. This wasn’t like shadows at all. Rather, it seemed to resemble Daisy's "all-consuming darkness".
At this moment, a ray of holy light instantly cut into the Dream Realm and landed in front of Kenneth, trying to block the encroaching shadows.
"Too late." Gu Nan revealed a slight smile, and the entire Dream Realm instantly collapsed.

chapters.title: Chapter 573: "Justice"
chapters.content:
By the time Austin reached the Dream Realm, this world had completely collapsed under Gu Nan's power.
With his current Tier 13 laws, it was way too easy to destroy a semi-plane. Although there was a Kenneth of the same level resisting him, destroying something was much easier than protecting it.
Having lost the Dream Realm’s protection, the Ruler of Nightmares became even weaker than other gods of the same level. In just the blink of an eye, he’d already died from Gu Nan's punches.
Up to this point, most of the World of God’s thirteen greater gods had died, and all of them died at Gu Nan’s hands.
Among the greater gods still alive today—besides the four top-tier greater gods from the two factions—the only lucky survivor was Eugene.
Austin's figure slowly appeared in front of Gu Nan, followed by Dark Lady Daisy and the God of Death. Their gazes were cold, but moreso, were filled with resolve.
The deaths of so many greater gods did not make them want to flee. On the contrary, it just made them more determined to kill this Evil God.
At this point, there was actually no need for the two sides to converse. The conflict had already reached a point where one side must die for the other to survive. Thus, words had completely lost their meaning here.
Austin was the first to strike, filled with regret for the loss of his sister, hatred for the Evil God, and mercy for this world.
As the incarnation of holy light, he had reason to eliminate all evil for this world.
The holy sword sliced through the void and arrived before Gu Nan in the blink of an eye. Austin wasn’t expecting to kill Gu Nan with one sword; he just wanted to stop Gu Nan from escaping.
Even Jiu Po had to remain on the defensive for a while when faced with the three gods’ combined might, so he couldn't think of any reason for Gu Nan to confront them head-on.
However, he was destined to be wrong this time, because Gu Nan had no intention of dodging and just stood still.
The holy sword seemed to fall slowly yet quickly, but before it could reach Gu Nan, it seemed to have entered a muddy sludge. Its speed suddenly slowed down until the attack completely disappeared.
This time, Gu Nan did not use the Evil God physique. He only used the power of laws to completely engulf the holy sword.
"Tier 14!" Daisy exclaimed with some incredulousness from behind Austin, having witnessed everything just now.
‘It’s only been around ten years since Gu Nan ascended to a greater god, yet he’s already on an equal footing with me in the blink of an eye?’
Baal found it even more unbelievable—because he had just fought against Gu Nan, and he was very sure that the opponent at that time was definitely not at this level!
Did he just advance?
Austin stared at Gu Nan silently, then slowly said after a moment, "We may have made a mistake. It seems Evil Gods grow by killing gods."
After hearing Austin's explanation, Daisy and Baal suddenly exchanged a glance and finally understood the secret behind all this. But what followed was the fear and killing intent one felt towards their natural enemy.
Gods and Evil Gods were indeed two utterly incompatible existences.
After Gu Nan killed the Ruler of Nightmares, his Evil Value reached Tier 14’s standard. His laws and physical body began to advance simultaneously, continuously moving towards Tier 14’s level.
But his breakthrough wasn’t instantaneous this time. Rather, it was a rapid and visible process.
Gu Nan could feel himself becoming stronger with each passing second. This feeling was enough to overwhelm an ordinary person, but Gu Nan could still remain clearminded.
"I said it before—you guys are already too late." Gu Nan cracked his neck, his bones creaking.
The next instant, before the three could react, Gu Nan appeared directly in front of Baal and threw a strong punch at his stomach.
Baal had been on the highest alert for a long time, and without any delay, endless death energy immediately surged forth, trying to block Gu Nan for an instant.
This decision was no different from that of Nature Goddess Daphne. As long as he could block Gu Nan for an instant, it would be enough to get Baal out of the danger zone.
More importantly, there were two companions beside him this time. The split-second that the death energy stopped Gu Nan was more than enough time for them to attack.
But Baal didn't expect for Gu Nan's fist to break through the death energy without any hindrance. He seemed as if completely unaffected and directly hit Baal with a punch.
No one could withstand a single punch from Gu Nan, and this iron law was also effective on the God of Death.
So Baal's divine body burst like a watermelon, and the law of death exploded instantly. The terrifying shockwave even threw both Austin and Daisy away.
After countless law fragments landed on the ground, only Gu Nan was still standing in his original position, while Baal had his divine body destroyed and lost part of his Godhead.
Even for a Tier 14 god like Baal, the loss of a divine body’s worth of Godhead was still enough to make his heart ache.
Austin didn't say a word, but the holy sword in his hand reappeared, slashing straight towards Gu Nan's back, while a golden scale appeared in midair and landed directly on Gu Nan's head.
He already regarded Gu Nan as a true adversary and used everything at his disposal to deal with Gu Nan. Even Jiu Po suffered losses from this move earlier.
Even if Jiu Po later learned about the existence of "justice", he still didn’t have an effective countermeasure for it and could only passively hold Austin back.
All the way until God Emperor Heaven fell, Jiu Po was actually the one being suppressed by Austin, and only after suppressing Jiu Po did the other party deal with Emperor Zhao.
However, the situation was different when it came to Gu Nan.
The moment the golden scale fell down, one end was already filled with dense holy light, and the other end began to crazily absorb Gu Nan's law of shadows.
This was one of the applications of "justice". Austin's own law of holy light was exchanged for an equivalent amount of the other party's laws, binding both to the scale and rendering them unusable.
He was the only Tier 15 greater god in the world, so by relying on his massive reserve of laws that surpassed everyone else, this move of Austin's was invincible.
Gu Nan raised his head. As soon as the golden scale started absorbing the shadows, his body suddenly swayed, and his whole body became part of the shadows.
For the Tier 14 Gu Nan, turning his own body into shadows was tantamount to becoming one with the law of shadows.
Austin immediately felt a huge obstacle to the scale’s absorption of shadows—because Gu Nan himself affected the will of shadows itself, making it possible for this law to resist "justice".
If it was any other greater god, Austin would definitely persist to the end and directly seal the opponent inside the golden scale.
But Gu Nan was different. His physical body was so powerful that not even Austin could afford to pay the equivalent power necessary to seal it. The reason justice was justice was because Austin himself must also abide by the rules.
Moreover, because Gu Nan was protected by "justice", no one could hurt him in this state, not unless they broke the golden scale first.
Thus, Austin had no choice but to withdraw "justice". At the very least, he would not use this method to deal with Gu Nan again.
But there was one question Austin couldn’t figure out—why was the other party so familiar with "justice"?

chapters.title: Chapter 574: Enemy
chapters.content:
Austin was known as the "Ruler of Light and Justice". The power he usually revealed to the outside world was holy light; he rarely used the power of "justice".
On one hand, there was no need to, and on the other hand, he was trying to hide “justice” as much as possible to prevent others from learning about his trump card.
Even if Gu Nan was the reincarnation of the Evil God from ancient times and knew some of the World of Gods’ secrets, how could he be so familiar with the law of "justice"?
Even in the vast history of the World of Gods, there had never been another "God of Justice". It could be said to be a law unique to Austin.
But now was not the time to think about this. The Evil God’s power already exceeded everyone's imaginations; the opponent must be eliminated in this battle.
The golden scale was temporarily withdrawn, replaced again by a holy sword. At the same time, Daisy also attacked.
Darkness and shadow intertwined as they mixed together in the void, becoming indistinguishable from each other. But the confrontation of laws was very distinct, creating a stark contrast.
The holy sword slashed down, directly cutting the two apart and accurately slicing through Gu Nan's shadows.
The law of shadows swayed slightly and spread out like ripples. Not only did it avoid the holy sword’s blow, it also separated itself from the darkness in passing.
Gu Nan's figure instantly appeared to the side soundlessly. The whole process gave no indication of his presence. His control over laws had reached an unbelievable level.
Daisy couldn't help exchanging glances with Austin. She was starting to believe the Evil God reincarnation theory more and more. Otherwise, she couldn't explain why the other party could manipulate laws so skillfully.
Gu Nan just smiled, having already begun retreating.
He’d already gotten what he wanted from this battle. The four remaining top-tier greater gods were not easy to kill, so it was better to head back and prepare first.
More importantly, Gu Nan, who was already Tier 14, possessed enough power to conquer the whole world and force everyone to act according to his will.
Now that the danger of dying had greatly lessened, what Gu Nan was most interested in was the mystery of the Origin World.
He really wanted to see if he could forcibly break through the dimensional wall between the Origin World and the outside world with his current strength.
However, just when Gu Nan tried to retreat, a death scythe suddenly slashed down on the back of his head, the violent death energy trying to knock him over.
"Courting death," Gu Nan sneered and turned around without hesitation, directly tanking the scythe with his face.
Baal had just reconstructed his body and arrived, but he didn't expect Gu Nan to respond like this. He had no time to change his attack.
Gu Nan allowed the scythe to hit the side of his face but suddenly stretched out his right hand and pressed it on Baal’s head, tearing off this Death God’s head.
It had been a long time since he last saw an enemy who ran here just to engage in close quarters combat with Gu Nan; Baal was the first one in a while.
His goal might have been to delay Gu Nan and use his own sacrifice to create opportunities for Austin and Daisy to strike.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t have imagined that these two would similarly have no opportunities in front of Gu Nan.
It was exceedingly difficult for opponents at the same level to find each other. Gu Nan was able to search for the greater gods earlier only because he destroyed their Divine Kingdoms and used this to trace their paths.
Gu Nan disposed of Baal with one slap and—without giving Austin and Daisy a chance to react—left the World of Gods in the blink of an eye.
With his current strength, no one could stop him from leaving. The reason he stayed until now was just to display his strength so that these greater gods wouldn’t run over and annoy him later.
……
Myriad Heavens.
Gu Nan had no intention of hiding his return this time, and almost all the Unified Dao cultivators received the news immediately.
The Unified Dao meeting started again.
Compared with the bleak atmosphere of the World of Gods, things were much better in the Myriad Heavens.
Except for Qin Guanruo, who was the first to die, and Emperor Zhao, who refused to retreat, the other Unified Dao powers at least managed to save their own lives and did not die at the greater gods’ hands.
However, the losses were still heavy. Only three of the grand Sixteen Heavens remained; the rest needed to be rebuilt.
"Both sides suffered this time." After everyone arrived, Yu Lian was the first to speak, "Judging from the current situation, we should focus on defense. Time is on our side."
It wasn’t hard to understand what she meant. After all, most of the Unified Dao cultivators were still alive. It was much easier to rebuild astral worlds than for new greater gods to ascend.
When the Unified Dao cultivators whose astral worlds were destroyed in this battle managed to recover even a small amount of their combat effectiveness, it would be enough for them to rejoin the war.
"I'm afraid the other side won't give us this chance," Dream Immortal said coldly from the side.
She was probably the one who suffered the most among the surviving Unified Dao members. She’d just been resurrected and first exhausted too much power to ambush Gu Nan, then was injured on the battlefield, and finally had her astral world destroyed.
But what Dream Immortal said was true. As long as Austin and the others weren’t stupid, they would never relax their offensive. After all, their side was still stronger on paper.
Zou Jiming said with a smile, "I heard that in the last battle, Gu Nan, you fought three greater gods alone and even injured Baal?"
All the Unified Dao cultivators saw the fight between Gu Nan and Austin’s group.
Yu Lian also added, "With Gu Nan here, we will have countermeasures if the greater gods come over."
Not counting Gu Nan, their high-end combat power was currently in a four versus two situation, and the Myriad Heavens side basically had no chance of winning.
But Gu Nan just glanced at Yu Lian. "I won’t be here for a while."
He came back just to consolidate his realm. Once his Tier 14 laws and body were completely stable, the Origin World would be his next goal.
The scene suddenly turned a little cold. Song Fei coughed lightly. "Gu Nan, you are also a member of the Myriad Heavens. Besides, the cause of this war was because you teamed up to kill Valen—"
"Are you going to look for the Origin World?" Lu Wen suddenly interrupted Song Fei as he looked at Gu Nan.
He had no intention of hiding it from those present and directly revealed the phrase "Origin World".
At this stage, Gu Nan didn't care if anyone knew where the Origin World was and nodded.
Lu Wen frowned slightly but said nothing, lowering his head in thought. Jiu Po just stood above and watched everything calmly.
The rest of the group don't know what the Origin World was, but now was not the time to worry about that.
"Amitabha." Monk Fa Kong clasped his hands together. "If the gods invade, all living beings in the Myriad Heavens will be devastated. Benefactor Gu Nan, please stay for a while."
Zi Luo Elder also tried to persuade him, "If it's not an emergency, it's better to wait until the war has truly settled down before leaving."
Dream Immortal even stepped in front of Gu Nan. "The greater gods’ invasion is partly because of you, right? If we are defeated, you will also not have a good ending!"
No one had ever forgotten Gu Nan's identity as the gods’ public enemy.
However, Gu Nan just glanced at the three who spoke, then walked out unhurriedly. His actions would never be affected by others’ wills.
Dream Immortal glared at his back with cold eyes. "Gu Nan, you are already an enemy of the greater gods. Do you want to become our enemy too?"
Gu Nan thought for a moment after hearing this, then turned around. Countless shadow tentacles suddenly stretched out and grabbed Dream Immortal, pulling her before him.
The suppression from the Tier 14 law of shadows made Dream Immortal, who lost her astral world, completely unable to resist.
Then he stretched out a hand, casually snapped Dream Immortal’s neck, and looked at the corpse on the ground strangely.
"A weakling like you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 575: Yellow Springs
chapters.content:
A Unified Dao cultivator who lost their astral world was essentially no different from the Saints of ancient times. In fact, they were even more fragile.
In ancient times, Saints often placed part of their souls in the void for their own safety. To kill them, one must first find their souls in the void.
This method was naturally far inferior to that of modern Star Rulers.
No matter how well someone hid in the void, they could always be found. On the contrary, as long as the astral world was there, it could be a good shield.
But without their astral world, these Unified Dao figures appeared very weak.
As the one ruling over dreams, Dream Immortal had an extremely deep understanding of the laws of the world, but once she lost Cloud Dream Heaven, she couldn’t even withstand Gu Nan's punch.
When her body's vitality was completely destroyed, the former Unified Dao cultivator called Dream Immortal immediately turned into a skeleton and was swallowed up by the law of shadows, leaving no trace behind.
The meeting was dead silent.
Gu Nan raised his head to look at Monk Fa Kong and Zi Luo Elder, the two who also spoke up just now. Zi Luo Elder just kept silent, while Fa Kong kept chanting the Buddha's name.
"Amitabha, I’ve offended…"
However, Gu Nan was too lazy to pay attention to them and turned around and headed towards the Origin World, quickly disappearing from everyone’s sight.
"I regret not listening to Xue Ren back then," It wasn't until Gu Nan disappeared that Zi Luo Elder said helplessly with a wry smile.
"Xue Ren?" Yu Lian frowned as she slowly walked down from the high platform and asked, "What did Xue Ren say? Does he know anything?"
Xue Ren died inexplicably on the verge of ascension, and he died in Gu Nan's territory, which aroused suspicion.
And Gu Nan's act of murder chilled everyone present. No one liked to coexist peacefully with a psychopath.
It could be said that if they could still go back to the old era where the Myriad Heavens were full of people after this war, then Gu Nan would definitely be the person isolated and attacked by the entire group.
So when Zi Luo Elder mentioned Xue Ren’s words, everyone's eyes focused on him.
Zi Luo Elder shook his head slightly. "It was just a feeling. He felt that the gods might have been right. Gu Nan, the Evil God, may very well destroy the entire world."
Regarding this point of view, Li Ci actually felt the same way, but he met Gu Nan too late and discovered it too late.
So he spoke up at this time, "He’s right. The Evil God is a creature that we cannot understand. Looking at it now, his power is already beyond imagination, and he must be destroyed."
The Unified Dao existences could tolerate a tyrannical, violent, and even unstable person, but they could not tolerate a person who was too strong.
Gu Nan's real threat to them was his excessive strength, not his personality.
"I agree," Jiu Po took a step forward and said with a strange smile.
……
"They won’t be able to kill Gu Nan," Lu Wen said with a frown.
At this time, the Unified Dao meeting had ended. Lu Wen and Jiu Po met alone in private, but they still talked about what happened at the meeting.
At the end of the meeting, almost all Unified Dao cultivators agreed to work together to kill Gu Nan, and some even proposed allying with the World of Gods and reconciling with the greater gods.
However, there was no unified conclusion yet on whether to join forces with the greater gods. Only the fact that Gu Nan must die had been unanimously recognized.
However, Lu Wen expressed different opinions on this later.
"I know." Jiu Po said calmly, "Austin, Daisy, and Baal together couldn’t even kill him, so what can Yu Lian and I do? In a battle at this level, having more people is not necessarily useful."
Lu Wen stared at Jiu Po quietly, waiting for his explanation.
Jiu Po raised his head. "Gu Nan is looking for the Origin World, and I also want to look for it. Perhaps we will learn more about it the next time he returns."
……
Gap World.
Gu Nan hadn’t seen Daoist Yellow Springs for a long time. When he came here in the past, he always found a random place to enter without meeting Daoist Yellow Springs at all.
But he also knew that the other party was actually always there. It was just a matter of whether he wanted to come out to meet Gu Nan or not.
This time, he did come out.
"You've grown stronger again," Daoist Yellow Springs looked at Gu Nan calmly and said in an inexplicable tone.
Since Gu Nan often came to the Gap World, it could be said that Daoist Yellow Springs was more familiar with his growth than anyone else.
Gu Nan smiled. "I want to try and see if I can break the dimensional wall here."
"You can give it a try." Daoist Yellow Springs agreed, "But before that… I have some new discoveries."
"Oh?" Gu Nan couldn't help raising a brow.
Daoist Yellow Springs' body slowly became solid. He glanced at Gu Nan and explained with a smile, "I have made many attempts to exchange materials between the two worlds. I firmly believe that if this kind of experiment can succeed, sooner or later, it will be possible to transport living beings."
"It's a pity that the previous experiments all failed." Daoist Yellow Springs shook his head, then looked at Gu Nan with a chuckle. "There has been some progress recently. This is the inspiration you gave me."
Of course Gu Nan’s trips to and from the Origin World were watched by Daoist Yellow Springs, and the method he used was to force a sliver of his ridiculously powerful soul into the Origin World.
The descent of only his will greatly hindered Gu Nan's actions, and even his strength was drastically weakened, but he still managed to get in.
"I extracted the soul of an ordinary person, wrapped it with soul power, then sent it into the Gap World… It was successful," Daoist Yellow Springs said.
Gu Nan raised his head to look at the other party and suddenly smiled. "You already knew this, didn’t you? Wasn't it you who brought Lu Wen out?"
Daoist Yellow Springs’ expression froze for a second before he laughed involuntarily. "Looks like you know more than I thought."
"I’ve been to the civilization that Lu Wen came from in his previous life." Gu Nan said casually, "You and Lu Wen have been talking to each other for a long time, haven’t you? He pretended to not know how he left the Gap World. You guys want to trick Jiu Po?"
Gu Nan actually had no clue as to Daoist Yellow Springs and Lu Wen’s goal, so he just made a casual guess. After all, with his current strength, any schemes and tricks no longer mattered.
