Even if he didn’t explore the Origin World’s secrets, he would still be an invincible powerhouse.
If not for the lack of progress with the《Origin of Light》game, he wouldn't even be interested in Daoist Yellow Springs.
On the contrary, it was precisely such an attitude that made Daoist Yellow Springs unsure of just how much Gu Nan knew. His expression turned a little solemn. "Jiu Po chose to retreat back then, so he is not qualified to participate in my plan."
"So then, what do you want to do?" Gu Nan smiled slightly at Daoist Yellow Springs.
"I’m monitoring the entire Gap World." Daoist Yellow Springs said seriously, "If someone else leaves the Gap World, I will definitely be able to discover something."

chapters.title: Chapter 576: The Soul That Disappeared
chapters.content:
Gu Nan stared at him for a long time and finally asked, "I left here only a few hundred years ago. Did you discover anything back then?"
"Not at all… That’s what I don’t understand." Daoist Yellow Springs showed a distressed look. "So I want to ask you to help conduct an experiment."
"You want me to send someone out?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow and asked.
"Yes!" Daoist Yellow Springs’ expression looked very sincere. Perhaps this was his intention from the very beginning, but he initially tried to trick Gu Nan into helping him and was unwilling to tell the truth.
This was very normal. After all, he’d devoted tens of thousands of years of effort to observing and studying the Gap World. How could he be willing to share his results with others so easily?
"I'll try," Gu Nan thought for a while and agreed.
……
Gu Nan's first experiment was to forcibly squeeze himself inside the Origin World using his Tier 14 body and laws.
But unfortunately, even if he already reached Tier 14, the Origin World’s dimensional wall was still as stable as a rock, remaining unaffected no matter how Gu Nan bombarded it.
The stability of this space was unbelievable, even to Gu Nan.
He’d already entered the Origin World before and knew that the law of space inside was indeed more stable than the outside world’s, but not to this extent.
A dimensional wall that even a Tier 14 powerhouse could not break… Was there some unknown secret behind this?
Gu Nan didn't ponder this too deeply and used his will to descend to the Origin World, returning to Earth again.
With the power of laws, Fu Cheng was still the same Fu Cheng. Even her appearance hadn’t changed much.
She even started learning how to apply makeup to age her appearance just to make herself look a little older so as not to be regarded as a monster.
And《Origin of Light》, a game that was once popular throughout the Federation, finally made a slow exit from the market after over ten years of ups and downs.
No game could stay popular forever. That was inevitable.
Under the influx of a steady stream of new games, the current 《Origin of Light》 was more like a nostalgic memory, living in the memories of the older generation of gamers.
Even Fu Cheng's Chengying Entertainment had long since ceased its focus on operating this game, but there was one thing Fu Cheng had always been doing secretly.
She collected and recorded information on every player who completed the Second Round or above. In particular, those who could complete the Third Round were all placed under fixed-interval surveillance.
Fu Cheng had been doing this for several years, even though the person who gave her the task had fallen completely silent for several years.
Because every time Fu Cheng looked in the mirror and saw that young face that was completely different from her own, she would recall that memory.
On this day, when Fu Cheng returned home, she found a stranger in tattered clothes sitting at her desk, leisurely flipping through some documents.
Fu Cheng knew those documents all too well. She started placing this information here a few years ago and had never changed its location.
"Have abnormal players still not appeared?" The stranger across from her calmly asked without even raising his head to look at Fu Cheng, as if this was the way it naturally should be.
"Yes," Fu Cheng answered subconsciously, without any reluctance, "we have recorded all high-level players, and most of them are living normal lives."
"There are also some people who no longer work in the gaming industry due to life changes, but no deceased persons have been found yet," Fu Cheng reported cautiously.
Gu Nan never revealed his purpose behind placing all these players under surveillance, but she seemed to be somewhat aware of it.
Gu Nan didn't care what Fu Cheng knew. After he got the information, he had no interest in this anymore.
Now, he only knew that his game experiment probably failed, and no similar second transmigrator appeared.
Or was there some other trigger?
Gu Nan raised his head to look at Fu Cheng. "Do you want to see the outside world?"
Fu Cheng was stunned and murmured, "The outside world…"
She knew that Gu Nan's origin was not simple. He probably came from a civilization other than Earth, and now, the other party even admitted it.
Of course, she didn't know that what Gu Nan meant was somewhere even further outside.
However, after thinking for a long time, Fu Cheng still shook her head. "Sorry, I still have my daughter and Chengying Entertainment. For the time being…"
Before she could finish, Gu Nan gently raised his hand and extracted her soul, quickly taking it outside the Origin World.
Gu Nan was just asking for the sake of asking. As for Fu Cheng's opinion itself, that had no impact.
……
A moment later, Gu Nan wrapped Fu Cheng's soul with the power of laws and started trying to break through the Origin World’s dimensional wall.
The dimensional walls of the two major worlds only isolated one direction. That was to say, they severely hindered outsiders but didn’t have strong effects on native inhabitants.
In contrast, the dimensional wall of the Origin World was almost like an iron wall for both outsiders and natives, making it difficult for those in the Origin World to leave.
Even Gu Nan couldn't bring Fu Cheng out completely, so he chose to take away Fu Cheng's soul, which didn't take much effort.
Daoist Yellow Springs could even take away Lu Wen's soul back then. Gu Nan’s current endeavor was naturally easier than that.
But the moment Gu Nan took Fu Cheng out of the Origin World, he suddenly discovered a strange phenomenon.
Fu Cheng disappeared.
Fu Cheng's disappearance was not sudden. It could even be said that Gu Nan watched Fu Cheng disappear, and the whole process appeared clearly in his eyes.
The instant he left the Origin World, Fu Cheng's soul seemed to be enveloped by some kind of power, gradually breaking free of Gu Nan's control.
It felt like the dimensional wall naturally extended out to cover Fu Cheng so that Gu Nan could not control her and could only watch as she was dragged further and further away until she disappeared completely.
But even so, Gu Nan had a hunch that Fu Cheng was still alive.
Gu Nan frowned slightly, and his consciousness returned to his body. He looked at Daoist Yellow Springs. "Did you see that soul just now?"
When Daoist Yellow Springs heard this, he couldn't help showing a grave expression. "I saw you bring a soul out, but by the time you left the Origin World, you were the only one left."
Gu Nan frowned in thought for a while, then returned to Earth as if he understood something.
This time, he randomly grabbed a soul on the streets and took it directly away from the Origin World. This time, the soul did not disappear.
After Gu Nan left, Daoist Yellow Springs immediately said, "I saw that… the soul is still in your hand?"
Gu Nan nodded, then shook his head. He looked at the passerby's soul wrapped in his own laws, only to see that the soul had already crumbled apart.
There was basically no difference between Gu Nan's treatment of the two souls, so the real difference was actually in the two souls themselves.
What was special about Fu Cheng, who disappeared?
Gu Nan could come up with the answer without much thought—as the creator of 《Origin of Light》, she was extremely familiar with the real background of the World of Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 577: Experiment
chapters.content:
With the exception of Lu Wen, a special case who was artifically brought out, everyone who left the Origin World gained some knowledge of the outside world’s history through various methods.
But this history was incomplete. For example, the history Gu Nan knew only concerned the World of Gods, not the Myriad Heavens, and there was no God of Twilight in the game since that figure came from the Myriad Heavens.
On the other hand, this history seemed capable of adjusting itself, because Daoist Yellow Springs saw a history that included Jiu Po instead of a history that developed normally without anomalies like transmigrators.
"Did something like this happen when Lu Wen came out?" Gu Nan thought for a long time and turned to Daoist Yellow Springs.
"No." Daoist Yellow Springs shook his head. "Lu Wen's soul has always been in my hands, and I later placed him in the Myriad Heavens… But then he began to break free from my control."
Having said that, he smiled self-mockingly. "He actually ascended to Unified Dao earlier than I did. If not for the fact that he still cannot find me, I'm afraid he would’ve paid me a visit to settle accounts a long time ago."
After learning that the Origin World was just a small world, Lu Wen resolutely chose to not become a Saint there. He destroyed his own body and was taken outside by Daoist Yellow Springs while pretending to die from a Dao tribulation.
Of course it was impossible for such a decisive and resolute person to always be under Daoist Yellow Springs’ thumb. As long as he found an opportunity, he would establish his own forces.
But Lu Wen’s personality was none of Gu Nan's business. He just wanted to verify some of his conjectures through more experiments.
So Gu Nan returned to Earth again; this time, he found a person named Li Han.
Li Han was the first player to advance to the Third Round ever since the《Origin of Light》was launched. This already happened several years ago.
So Li Han was already a somewhat rotund uncle when Gu Nan found him.
Li Han’s passion for games still hadn’t waned, but to him, 《Origin of Light》 was merely an excellent game that was popular for a while. Now, he rarely touched it.
Gu Nan found Li Han and directly extracted his soul from a distance without any intention of revealing himself.
Gu Nan similarly took this soul out of the Origin World, but Li Han's soul produced a different result.
Fu Cheng was pulled away by the dimensional wall and directly broke free from Gu Nan's control; random passersby were completely unaffected but disintegrated when they came into contact with the outside world.
Li Han's soul also broke free from Gu Nan's control, then shattered with a loud bang when it touched the dimensional wall.
The fate awaiting a shattered soul was naturally to completely dissipate in the void.
"Is there a difference in the soul’s strength?" Daoist Yellow Springs also noticed this third type of soul and immediately asked. If it wasn’t a difference in knowledge, then the most likely reason was that the soul itself was not strong enough.
But Gu Nan shook his head a little.
Although he made contact with Fu Cheng and used the power of laws to extend her life, it did not actually have much effect on her soul.
For the sake of caution, Gu Nan simply found another Third Round player and also used laws to extend that person’s life. The result proved that his conjecture wasn’t wrong.
Regardless of the soul’s strength, Fu Cheng's uniqueness had still yet to be uncovered.
However, the result of this Third Round player's soul experiment was the same as Li Han's.
So at least one thing was certain now—souls that possessed a good understanding of the outside world would indeed receive special treatment from the dimensional wall when leaving the Origin World.
Gu Nan couldn't help speculating—back when he left the Origin World, was it because his soul was taken away by the dimensional wall that he wandered for a few hundred more years?
"I need to find Fu Cheng," Gu Nan quickly decided when there was no further progress in the experiment.
He began a slow search around the Origin World. Although it was a rather large galaxy-type plane, with Gu Nan's current cultivation realm, it wouldn't take long to just scan the vicinity.
Gu Nan did not find Fu Cheng's soul but found some vague traces, which he determined were caused by the movement of her soul.
Fu Cheng's soul had indeed traveled through the dimensional wall, but now, he could no longer find its definite location.
Has it already broken free from the dimensional wall and gone to the two major worlds?
Gu Nan frowned slightly. The mechanism behind Fu Cheng's disappearance was somewhat beyond his expectations. If he’d known this was the case, he would have unified the two worlds first and explored the mystery of the Origin World afterwards.
What Fu Cheng received was the World of Gods’ history, so it was very likely that she went to the World of Gods. Without forces spanning the two worlds, it would be very difficult to find Fu Cheng in the major planes.
"But even if she’s going to rise, it’ll still take some time. I have to hurry." Gu Nan's gaze landed on the World of Gods. The remaining greater gods suddenly felt a chill for some inexplicable reason.
……
The World of Gods.
As the Unified Dao figures expected, the greater gods would never give up like this. Instead, they must seize this final opportunity to completely conquer the Myriad Heavens.
"We don't have much time." Dark Lady Daisy spoke up heavily, "It will be our turn to suffer once those Unified Dao cultivators are allowed to rebuild their Divine Kingdoms."
Baal said through gritted teeth, "The biggest problem now is the Evil God. If we can find a way to deal with him, we will still have the advantage."
Although part of Baal’s Godhead was destroyed by Gu Nan during the three-person ambush, that did not make him fear battle.
Gu Nan was able to hit him only because he tried to block Gu Nan's way. If he wholeheartedly wanted to escape, Gu Nan might not even be able to catch him.
Austin slowly said, "I’ve looked through all the documents, but there is no record of the Evil God, not even any relevant information."
"That’s normal." Daisy replied, "The rumors about the Evil God are all vague references that appeared in some prophecies. They’ve never been clearly recorded."
In the World of Gods’ legends, the Evil God was more like a symbolic existence representing the incarnation of evil and all the evil existences in the world.
Precisely because this kind of description was too abstract, before Gu Nan appeared, very few people took the existence of Evil Gods seriously.
But for the current greater gods, not being able to find information on Gu Nan meant they couldn’t find the opponent's weaknesses, let alone how to fight against him.
On the side, Boswell pondered for a long time, then finally ventured, "The Evil God may not necessarily have no weaknesses. As far as we know, he is just a normal greater god with an extremely powerful divine body."
The Ruler of Ashen Cyan’s words enlightened the others. Although this was an existence spoken of only in legends, it might be easier to find a countermeasure if they started from reality.
However, at this moment, an energy signature broke into the World of Gods without bothering to hide itself, causing the several greater gods’ expressions to change at once.
"How dare he come here alone!" Baal was the first to shout, having suffered two losses at Gu Nan’s hands.
But Austin frowned. "Be careful, this might be a trap."
Dark Lady Daisy looked at the unstable Baal and couldn't help speaking up from the side, "I'll go."

chapters.title: Chapter 578: Decisiveness
chapters.content:
The Dark Lady was a Tier 14 greater god.
In the World of Gods, Austin was the only Tier 15 powerhouse and an existence referred to as the "King of Gods", while Dark Lady Daisy was the only one with the power to oppose him.
The fearless embodiment of darkness.
Gu Nan stood at the border of the World of Gods and did not go any further—because the space before him was already filled with darkness.
Countless tendrils of darkness crawled towards him from all angles, as if trying to make Gu Nan fall into an eternal abyss.
That was the deepest black. Any matter or law that came into contact with the pitch-black darkness would be directly devoured, leaving no trace behind.
Gu Nan stood still as the shadows under his feet spread out, quickly mixing with the approaching darkness, twisting and intertwining indistinguishably.
But a more careful inspection would find that the two laws were actually devouring each other. On the surface, they were indistinguishable from each other, but on the inside, they were entirely distinct existences.
Both laws possessed the characteristic of “devouring”, but the power displayed by the law of darkness was purer than that of Gu Nan's law of shadows.
For laws at the greater god level, the law’s characteristic was often more important than its level.
Gu Nan and Daisy were now at the same level, and there wasn’t much difference in the level of their laws. Even their control over their laws was almost the same.
The outcome of their battle soon became apparent—it was a draw.
For people at their realm, an instant of contact was enough for them to judge the outcome.
Daisy was a little surprised by this result because it meant that purely in terms of mastery over one’s laws, Gu Nan might have already surpassed Yu Lian.
But she wasn’t worried. The current her was not fighting alone. Once she fell into a disadvantage, the other three would take action immediately.
Gu Nan used shadows to fight darkness, and after confirming his degree of control over his laws, he had no intention of wasting time with Daisy anymore.
He came here to completely steamroll the whole world with his own strength this time. What was steamrolling? No matter the opponent, he would crush all without fail. That was steamrolling.
Gu Nan took a step forward, and under the pressure of an incomprehensibly strong physical body, the darkness originally entangled with the shadows instantly shattered.
Just like this, Gu Nan walked out of the darkness step by step. Even the laws personally controlled by Daisy could not hinder him.
Gu Nan waved his hand to shatter the darkness, then slowly walked into a spatial passage. On the other side was a Divine Kingdom, which was Baal’s Kingdom of Death.
The God of Death’s Divine Kingdom was a very special place. The inhabitants here were not the undead, but the souls of living people who died.
In many of the main planes, people did not know about the Death God’s Divine Kingdom. Instead, they called it the "Soul Realm", which was somewhat similar to Demon King Stanley's Demon Realm.
And when Gu Nan set foot here, the law of shadows immediately expanded in all directions, instantly wiping out a large number of souls.
Death God Baal appeared immediately and glared at Gu Nan coldly. The Death God's scythe suddenly slashed down, but Gu Nan didn't even try to dodge.
Baal had fought against Gu Nan many times, and he was even familiar with Gu Nan's fighting methods now.
So at this time, he wasn’t surprised at all and continuously slashed Gu Nan with his scythe, quickly accumulating death energy in Gu Nan's body that he then detonated with a bang.
In the earlier fight between the two, Gu Nan had used the explosion of death energy to kill Boswell once while he himself ended up being perfectly intact.
So Baal was all too aware that at least that level of death energy was meaningless to Gu Nan.
But this time, the death energy that erupted was three times that of last time!
However, the three-times larger death energy explosion did not bring about the results Baal wanted—because Gu Nan's physical body was already far stronger than last time.
The explosion of death energy made a muffled sound and didn’t even manage to blow Gu Nan to pieces. It only made a hole in his stomach that healed up in the blink of an eye.
A cold smile appeared on Gu Nan's face. His laws were still raging, while he had already thrown a punch at Baal’s face.
But Baal was already on guard, and this was his home turf. Life and death were exchanged in an instant; what Gu Nan hit was merely a corpse.
Austin and Daisy soon arrived and took action without any hesitation. Austin attacked Gu Nan himself, while Daisy worked to stop the expansion of the law of shadows.
Gu Nan had no intention of running away and simply swung a punch at Austin, his laws not retreating in the slightest. He actually wanted to fight three top-tier greater gods at the same time!
……
The Myriad Heavens.
Gu Nan disappeared for a while and then reappeared, immediately attracting the attention of all Unified Dao figures. What attracted even more attention was his action.
"Is he crazy? Even if he wants to deal with the greater gods, it doesn’t mean he has to face them head-on, right?" Li Ci didn't understand Gu Nan's behavior.
"This isn’t like him… He must have another goal,” Azure Sky Heaven’s Mu Qishuang also added.
She witnessed Gu Nan’s entire scheme to kill Rolensia. In her eyes, Gu Nan was undoubtedly a person who was particularly good at scheming and plotting.
But Zi Luo Elder just said with a chuckle, "No matter what he’s thinking, killing the greater gods is the top priority right now."
"I'll go." Jiu Po stood up calmly. "Boswell didn't join the fight yet. Yu Lian, you stay behind to provide support."
Yu Lian, who was sitting in the head seat, nodded slightly. Her face was a little pale, and it was obvious that her earlier injuries were quite serious, even to the point of being difficult to conceal.
"I'll go too," Another person piped up he stood up. It was Lu Wen.
……
Inside the Death God’s Divine Kingdom, the fight between Gu Nan, Baal, and Austin had entered the climax.
One had to admit that the combined power of two of the most powerful greater gods was quite impressive. Even the Tier 14 Gu Nan could only get the upper hand and couldn’t kill them.
But that didn’t matter. The gods’ strength lies in their Divine Kingdom, but their weakness also lies in their Divine Kingdom. Gu Nan was perfectly aware of this.
Since the battle took place inside the Death God's Divine Kingdom, Austin couldn’t actually use all his strength. The method that injured Yu Lian before couldn’t possibly be used here.
But Gu Nan didn't have such scruples. He could repeatedly change the battlefield by switching locations inside the Divine Kingdom. The collateral damage from the battle alone would cause immense destruction to the Divine Kingdom.
To make matters worse, Jiu Po arrived.
This Star Ruler of Jiu Po Heaven was also an expert at looting houses and exterminating families. He didn't even glance at Gu Nan and directly started to slaughter souls inside the Death God’s Divine Kingdom using his laws.
The flow of the ley lines instantly reversed, and powers of the earth raged. Daisy could not handle Jiu Po and Gu Nan joining hands.
"Kill Jiu Po," Austin ordered immediately, realizing that the situation would only become more and more unfavorable if this continued.
They were unable to cause any effective damage to Gu Nan, so they could only try to critically injure Jiu Po first.
However, Baal shook his head. "Even without Jiu Po, we still have no way to deal with the Evil God… There is only one method now."
Austin turned around and saw the ruthlessness and decisiveness in Baal’s eyes. This God of Death had never lacked courage.
"Alright." Austin nodded, and a golden scale began to emerge in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 579: Stigma of Life and Death
chapters.content:
"Justice" was a very special law, so special that no one except Austin ever managed to master it.
Even when Gu Nan launched《Origin of Light》 on Earth, it actually only adopted the law of light and did not give players the "justice" part.
This law’s effect was too strange, and it could do many incredible things. If it was handed over to the players, the entire game’s balance would probably be broken.
Austin could control this kind of law because he understood the essence of the law of justice, but at the same time, he was also restricted by "justice" and wasn’t able to do many things. Players, on the other hand, would not have such restrictions if they were able to use the law of justice.
But since Austin paid such a huge price, the "justice" he mastered was naturally worth the cost.
He injured Yu Lian using an inconceivable method. And right now, he once again used "justice" in hopes of completely destroying Gu Nan.
The golden scale floated in midair. On one end was the pure, holy light shining brilliantly, and on the other end was the death scythe surrounded by death energy.
The two gods’ sudden pause startled everyone on the battlefield.
Daisy raised her head in astonishment and saw what the two were doing. Without even having to think, she fled the Divine Kingdom and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Jiu Po seemed to realize something and wanted to leave the Kingdom of Death as soon as possible but was hindered by the death energy and could not escape for a while.
After all, this was Baal’s home court. Once he completely ignored his own followers’ safety and concentrated on trapping his enemies here, he could still have some effect.
Baal was not only courageous, but also very greedy. Not only did he want to kill Gu Nan, he also wanted to get rid of Jiu Po once and for all.
Jiu Po had already witnessed the terrifying eruption of power from the intertwining of light and darkness once, and this time, it was another set of opposing laws.
Life and death.
Holy light could not only display the nature of "light", but also "life".
Austin and Baal both placed their weapons on either end of the scale as proof, but the actual price they paid was so huge that it was unimaginable.
Baal directly put his entire Divine Kingdom onto the scale and even took out most of his own Godhead. He could be said to be gambling with his life in this battle.
And what Austin gave was also not weak. He extracted all his laws pertaining to "life" and placed them inside this holy sword, just like what Lu Wen did to create Long Ling’er back then.
After this battle, no matter the outcome, Baal would lose his combat power for a long time, while Austin would lose all his understanding of the law of "life" and would need to start from scratch again.
The two of them paid quite a hefty price, but they naturally had considerable gains as well.
"We need to leave!" Jiu Po seemed to sense something. The power of the earth crazily slammed into the death energy, trying to smash open an exit, as he shouted at Gu Nan.
However, Gu Nan just stared at the intersection of life and death calmly.
When life and death simultaneously fell on either end of the scale, the holy sword and the death scythe slowly floated up and then slashed each other.
After the silent impact, an inexplicable shockwave erupted in the void, just like the Big Bang. All matter was thrown out wildly, and all laws could no longer exist.
Jiu Po didn't even have time to say anything before his figure was instantly annihilated.
Gu Nan didn't look any better either. His body was blown to pieces, and countless bits of flesh and blood were directly crushed by the shockwave while still in the air.
Austin had already withdrawn a long time ago. One of the parties involved in this collision of life and death was Baal’s entire Divine Kingdom, so it was impossible for the Divine Kingdom to remain intact after the explosion.
Jiu Po had completely disappeared without a trace. He was extremely unlucky. Though he was only here to help out, who would’ve known that he’d encounter Austin and Baal’s powerful combination attack and suffer a big loss?
Even if he didn’t die from this, his injuries would not be lighter than Yu Lian’s.
But be it Austin, Baal, or Daisy—who’d just arrived again—they only cared about Gu Nan.
"Is he dead?" Daisy glanced at the Divine Kingdom down below. There was no trace of life left. Instead, its state was alternating between life and death.
After the power of life and death erupted, the void where the Death God’s Divine Kingdom once stood was completely polluted. If any living being stepped foot here in the future, they would immediately be transformed into a half-living, half-dead creature.
Austin shook his head, then nodded. "We don't know yet. But even if he isn’t dead, a fatal flaw has still been created."
"He’s not dead." Baal licked his chapped lips and grinned. "The Stigma of Life and Death has already been planted. It’s up to you guys now."
As if to verify Baal’s words, the flesh and blood that had been evaporated gradually began to reunite in the void, re-forming Gu Nan's appearance.
While the greater gods still had a chance to completely kill him when Gu Nan was Tier 13, a Tier 14 Evil God could no longer be killed by normal means.
At least in the game, Gu Nan had never seen players being killed by NPC greater gods after reaching Tier 14. As long as they didn’t court death, they could usually clear the game.
It would be a very difficult task for even Gu Nan to scheme and kill an existence like an Evil God, let alone the greater gods, who were entirely unfamiliar with Evil Gods’ abilities.
"Stigma of Life and Death?" Gu Nan looked down and saw a strange mark on his abdomen.
He’d never seen such a thing before. It was almost impossible for Austin to join forces with Baal inside the game, so the Stigma of Life and Death naturally wouldn’t appear.
The last boss fight players normally had to face was when Austin directly joined forces with Daisy. Only with the abnormal development of the war between the two worlds would this bizarre current situation exist.
Baal disappeared in the blink of an eye after saying that, leaving only Austin and Daisy.
Gu Nan was not in a hurry to give chase. He still had some of Sylvia's blood anyway, so Baal couldn't escape. Instead, he was more curious about this stigma’s effect.
Austin quickly told him the answer using the holy sword in his hand.
The holy sword accurately stabbed the stigma on Gu Nan's abdomen, and the stigma was instantly activated. Gu Nan felt a strange force coming from his body, affecting his entire body from the inside out.
Even the Evil God physique couldn't stop this power, which quickly spread throughout Gu Nan's body, transforming it into a strange state.
That was the state of "death".
The effect of the Stigma of Life and Death was to activate when hit by a certain amount of power, directly changing the target’s state from life to death.
Gu Nan's body died instantly but recovered very quickly. It was clear that the stigma’s power could not be maintained for long.
But for Austin, just this instant was enough.
Just as Gu Nan regained his ability to move, the holy sword struck the stigma again, and Gu Nan was once again transformed into a "dead" state.
Of course, it was only a second later that he was "revived" again, but this time, his “death” state seemed to last longer.

chapters.title: Chapter 580: Changing Targets
chapters.content:
The Stigma of Life and Death completely immobilized Gu Nan. He could only watch himself being "killed" and revived over and over again.
But Gu Nan wasn’t worried. As the time in between revivals lengthened, it was impossible for Austin to make an accurate judgment every time. Sooner or later, he’ll make a mistake.
Even a slight opening in Austin’s timing would be enough for Gu Nan to escape.
Just as Gu Nan thought, this was also Austin’s first time dealing with the Stigma of Life and Death, so there was no way he could get the timing right every time. During the 26th revival, the holy sword thrust out a little earlier, which in turn triggered the stigma into switching Gu Nan back into a “living” state, allowing him to be revived early.
Gu Nan suddenly opened his eyes and swung a punch straight at Austin’s face, but Austin didn't even try to dodge, determined to stab the stigma once again even if he had to tank Gu Nan’s punch.
Gu Nan was once again turned into a dead person, but he actually had nothing to worry about. Even if he died, the Evil God physique was so strong that Austin still couldn’t deal much damage.
On the contrary, in order to land this strike, Austin received a punch in the face, and his divine body was already shattered. Although he quickly re-formed his body again, he lost part of his Godhead.
When Gu Nan—who died yet again—regained consciousness once more, he was still faced with Austin's holy sword, but there was now a Daisy behind him and a scale above his head.
The next time, the two laws of light and darkness began to intertwine in the balance, but it was different from the earlier move that injured Yu Lian.
Last time, they were in a race against time to prevent Yu Lian from escaping and could only go for maximum burst damage.
But it would be very difficult for an explosion to kill Gu Nan. Austin knew this all too well, so even if he lost some of his Godhead in the process, he still had to drag Gu Nan into a state alternating between life and death.
The purpose behind stalling for time was to complete the sealing.
That's right. The laws of light and darkness were rapidly intertwining in the golden scale. For the first time, the two strongest greater gods in the world set aside their prejudices and wholeheartedly cooperated in order to completely seal away the Evil God.
If not for the Stigma of Life and Death, they wouldn't have the chance to set up the seal so calmly. On the other hand, without the Greater Gods of Light and Darkness working together to create the seal, the stigma would be completely meaningless.
Just as Gu Nan opened his eyes again, the black and white radiance in the golden scale completely merged, forming a formation full of arcane patterns that pressed down on Gu Nan.
Gu Nan, who’d just been resurrected from death, was directly imprisoned by this sealing formation, which isolated him from the gods. Finally, Austin’s sword could no longer reach the Stigma of Life and Death.
It wasn't until they completed this step that Austin and Daisy let out a long sigh of relief.
Gu Nan was standing calmly in front of them. There was a strange, cage-like light around him, trapping him.
Without any hesitation, Austin waved his hand and sent the cage flying into the endless void.
If everything went well, perhaps a new myth would spread in the World of Gods a few thousand years later.
An Evil God from outside this world descended and fought an earth-shattering battle against the gods. Eight greater gods fell in this battle.
But ultimately, the Light and Dark Factions set aside their differences and finally worked together to seal the greatest evil demon…
But the problem was that things weren’t going so smoothly—the cage of light and darkness that sprang from the golden scale was not as strong as they imagined.
Gu Nan’s punch slammed onto the glowing cage, causing the entire cage to tremble uncontrollably, but at the same time, a powerful counter-shock hit Gu Nan.
"It's useless. Light and darkness are the basis of all laws in the world, and this cage can also reflect back all laws in the world."
Austin's figure slowly walked out of the void, his gaze landing on Gu Nan. Even though he said it was useless, he couldn't seem to relax at all.
In fact, if Daisy and the others could defeat the Myriad Heavens, he wouldn't mind staying in the void permanently to keep a constant eye on Gu Nan.
Boom!
Another punch smashed into the cage made of mysterious light. There was no medium for sound to circulate in the void, but the sound of impact seemed as though it was real.
This was a phenomenon that occurred when overly powerful laws collided against each other and began to distort reality itself, directly affecting the spiritual senses of living beings.
Austin stared at Gu Nan indifferently, his eyes capturing the information in front of him, all the way until Gu Nan landed his next punch.
This punch seemed particularly special. Veined lines drew strange patterns on his fist. The moment it hit the cage, these lines began to wrap around the light and darkness formation runes, reversing the seal’s energy flow.
This was Gu Nan’s law of shadows. Though it only slightly affected the fusion of light and darkness for an instant, Gu Nan’s punch found its mark and directly blasted away the cage of light and darkness.
"Your synergy is too poor." Gu Nan shook his head and commented, "If it were after the Fifth Divine War, your cooperation would be much more seamless."
Austin and Daisy didn't actually fight each other very often in the Fourth Divine War. The two existed more as a deterrent force and didn't understand each other’s powers well enough.
Austin stared at Gu Nan silently, not quite understanding what he meant—so far, there had only been four Divine Wars in the World of Gods.
But this didn’t stop Austin from attacking. The holy sword stabbed at the Stigma of Life and Death without hesitation, but unfortunately, it did not hit the mark this time.
Gu Nan's figure shattered into pieces like shadows, then reappeared behind Austin, already swinging down a punch.
Austin stabbed his sword behind him without even thinking about it. He didn't care about himself at all and just wanted to drive Gu Nan into a state of death.
A hint of darkness emerged in the void. It was Daisy, who was lurking in the depths of the void with an attack closely following Austin’s. Her target was also the Stigma of Life and Death on Gu Nan's body.
It could be said that the blow Baal bet his entire Divine Kingdom on finally created a flaw in Gu Nan's otherwise perfect power system, preventing him from acting wantonly.
But as if he anticipated the two’s moves, Gu Nan suddenly retracted his fist and turned into a shadow, vanishing from their sight.
"He’s trying to trick you into showing yourself." Austin immediately told Daisy, "Baal is in danger!"
They knew Gu Nan had a method to track down gods. Since he disappeared without a trace, the most likely possibility was that he changed targets.
The two instantly entered the void and rushed to the plane Baal was hiding in, but everything seemed calm. Gu Nan did not appear here.
On the contrary, Baal looked at the two of them strangely. "You guys dealt with him?"
"Not yet." Daisy shook her head and looked at Austin again. "Does he want to remove the stigma first?"
"Impossible." Baal responded decisively before Austin could speak, "The Stigma of Life and Death is rooted in the soul. Unless he can change his soul, it will definitely exist."
But before the three finished their conversation, their expressions changed simultaneously.
Because in their senses, tragic news came from another Divine Kingdom, evidently having been the victim of a sudden sneak attack by Gu Nan. Though Gu Nan did change targets, the target he was looking for was not Baal, but another greater god.
That was the Ruler of Ashen Cyan, Boswell.

chapters.title: Chapter 581: Deadlock
chapters.content:
Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom.
Gu Nan's descent was beyond everyone's expectations. Even Boswell himself was only paying attention to Baal. He didn’t expect for Gu Nan to visit his own Divine Kingdom.
This wasn’t an issue with the gods overlooking something. Rather, no normal person would choose to do this.
Not even the most powerful greater gods could deal with the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom in a short amount of time. Expanding the influence of invading laws took time, and slaughtering the Divine Kingdom’s inhabitants took even more time.
After the initial surprise, Boswell quickly calmed down and began to deal with Gu Nan's attack.
He himself didn’t show up at all and only used laws to resist Gu Nan's invasion. This Ruler of Ashen Cyan was clearly very experienced. Even with Gu Nan's proficiency, his progress wasn’t fast.
Austin and Daisy rushed here shortly after and quickly attacked Gu Nan. Their target was naturally the Stigma of Life and Death.
In essence, the body was affected by the soul, and the Stigma of Life and Death was left directly on Gu Nan's soul, which meant the mark would definitely appear as long as he created a physical body.
And in the Ruler of Ashen Cyan’s territory—with Austin and Daisy also present—it was impossible for Gu Nan to act only using laws, or else he would be completely suppressed.
He needed to materialize a physical form, but the Stigma of Life and Death was planted on his body. On the other hand, the attackable targets were either protected or difficult to take down quickly. This seemed like a hopeless situation.
But Gu Nan never felt that a hopeless situation existed.
The same time Austin and Daisy descended, Gu Nan’s figure blurred and appeared directly above Austin's head, raining a punch down without hesitation.
Austin's reaction was no different from before. He completely ignored defense and raised his sword to stab the Stigma of Life and Death.
But Gu Nan didn’t choose to dodge this time and punched Austin, just like this. The terrifying force from the Evil God physique instantly destroyed Austin's divine body.
But the moment the holy sword pierced Gu Nan’s divine body, most of his body suddenly turned into shadows, including his abdomen, where the Stigma of Life and Death was located.
The Stigma of Life and Death was a very incredible thing. It directly affected the soul, so it wouldn’t actually disappear even if his body turned into laws.
Even if his entire body transformed into shadows, the stigma would not budge at all; it would still be stabbed by the holy sword.
But Gu Nan handled it very strangely. He turned the body at and below the abdomen into shadows but kept his upper body intact. This caused his soul to naturally shrink and concentrate on his remaining upper body.
As the soul shrunk, the Stigma of Life and Death naturally moved with it, so the holy sword weirdly missed its mark.
After all, Gu Nan was a seasoned player who’d fought countless greater gods. Even though it was his first time encountering the Stigma of Life and Death, he immediately discovered its advantages and disadvantages.
The Stigma of Life and Death was undoubtedly very powerful. Although there was a time limit for the forced death feature, the fact that it could directly affect Gu Nan’s body was already terrifying enough.
But the disadvantage of this kind of stigma was that the strength required to trigger it was dependent on the target’s power. In other words, the stronger the target, the stronger the force required to trigger the stigma and injure the opponent's soul.
With Gu Nan's current realm, there were only a few people in the world who could trigger the Stigma of Life and Death on him; even if others hit the mark, it would have no effect.
Gu Nan could also use this characteristic against Austin.
Although Austin had enough power to trigger the mark, he also had to concentrate his power to reach that threshold, so large-scale attacks were out of the question, which gave Gu Nan a chance to dodge.
It was under this series of psychological games that Gu Nan successfully deceived Austin once. Not only did Austin miss the mark, but his divine body was also blasted apart in the process.
Although Austin was able to reconstruct his divine body very quickly, damage done to his Godhead was still damage.
Even Austin couldn’t reconstruct his divine body indefinitely. Once his Godhead took too much damage, even his realm might fall.
The three of them were once again at a standstill. Gu Nan's trick of moving the mark also deceived Daisy, causing her attack to fail as well.
The inhabitants of the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom were still being slaughtered rapidly by Gu Nan, but Gu Nan looked at Austin and Daisy—whose expressions were as dark as storm clouds—and suddenly smiled.
Then, under the two’s flabbergasted gazes, Gu Nan suddenly turned and ran away.
He did not leave the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom, but ran directly with his legs, reaching an incredible speed.
Austin's figure cut through the void, descending in front of Gu Nan with endless holy light, but before he could attack, Gu Nan had already made a sharp turn, and in the blink of an eye, not even his shadow could be seen anymore.
The second shortcoming of the Stigma of Life and Death: How can you hit the stigma when you can't even catch the enemy?
The Evil God physique represented a comprehensive strengthening of the body. There were too many tactics Gu Nan could employ, each of which was different from normal greater god battles, making it hard for Austin and the others to adapt.
"Let's guard the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom and have Boswell come," Austin stopped in his tracks and said to Daisy.
In fact, Daisy also knew what to do even without his instructions. They were all top-tier figures and could naturally make the best decisions.
While Gu Nan was running, the law of shadows constantly eroding the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom seemed to encounter a sudden resistance, and his progress abruptly slowed down.
Because the two laws of light and darkness had already intervened, greatly curbing the shadows' progress and allowing Boswell to free up his hands.
So while Gu Nan was running, a cyan light suddenly rose in front of him, aiming directly for the mark on his abdomen.
This strike was extremely accurate, as if it had predicted all of Gu Nan's movements. The moment the cyan light reached his body, Gu Nan forcibly twisted himself at an angle and faced the green light with his waist.
The cyan light instantly penetrated his waist. It was apparent that Boswell had charged up a large amount of laws in this blow. The force was definitely not low, and it was completely enough to trigger the mark.
Being inside his own Divine Kingdom, Boswell could easily judge Gu Nan's movements and accurately hit the Stigma of Life and Death with his attacks, making him the best choice to deal with Gu Nan.
Similarly, if Gu Nan dared to enter the Holy Light Divine Kingdom, then Austin would definitely be able to hit the stigma easily.
However, in order to do this, Boswell was forced to materialize his divine body. Only when powerful laws converged at a certain point was it possible to launch attacks strong enough to trigger the stigma.
But Gu Nan wasn’t afraid. He began to dodge left and right and even had time to interfere with Austin and Daisy to speed up the shadow erosion.
Towards the end, he even ran close to Boswell's materialized divine body, punching him from time to time and throwing the battlefield into disarray.
During this whole process, Boswell failed to hit Gu Nan’s mark even once.
Gu Nan could make his body smaller, bigger, pure laws, etc. and had plenty of ways to change the stigma’s position while the Ruler of Ashen Cyan only had one attack—the Ashen Cyan ray.
His realm wasn’t high enough and he was also wounded, so he could only rely on this method to condense a large quantity of laws.
As time passed, the number of inhabitants in the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom continuously dwindled, and the three greater gods began to feel worried.

chapters.title: Chapter 582: Treating the Symptom, Not the Cause
chapters.content:
For Divine Kingdom Wars below the greater god level, large-scale slaughter was mainly carried out by mortal troops, but things were different at the greater god level.
As far as the greater gods were concerned, they themselves were already powerful enough to spread their laws throughout most of the world, so they didn’t need the mortals’ help at all.
No matter how seamlessly the mortals could cooperate, how could they compare to the greater gods’ laws, which act according to the owner’s wishes?
Gu Nan was doing this right now.
He continuously eroded the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom with his laws. Even with Austin and Daisy joining forces on defense, the number of inhabitants was still decreasing. Some died at Gu Nan’s hands; some ran away because their faith wasn’t all that strong to begin with.
This phenomenon was very normal and had nothing to do with realm or strength. After all, there were too many places to protect; no one could create a perfect defense.
Moreover, the invasion of a Divine Kingdom was not a war. Lost land could still be reclaimed, but it was impossible to resurrect dead inhabitants.
As the Divine Kingdom’s residents died one after another, the power of the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom continuously weakened, also reducing Boswell’s own power.
Although he was still constantly condensing his laws and trying to hit Gu Nan's stigma, the frequent failed attempts bewildered Boswell slightly.
He began to understand why Baal resolutely bet his entire Divine Kingdom earlier just to create a flaw on Gu Nan.
Such an enemy was too hard to deal with!
Even if there was already a major weakness, the other party still used various methods to hide the weakness and relied on his own strengths to counter it.
It was hard to imagine just how despair-inducing a perfect Evil God must be.
As the oldest greater god in the world, the Ruler of Ashen Cyan unexpectedly became distracted for a split second, so at this instant, Gu Nan suddenly punched Boswell!
Boswell’s divine body exploded, and Austin couldn't help giving a small sigh from the side. He knew that it was no longer possible to save the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom.
Boswell decided to fully devote himself to research many years ago and hadn’t paid much attention to combat since.
Although he still had his combat instincts honed over the years, he couldn't keep up with the rhythm of such a high-intensity battle at all and was led on a wild goose chase by Gu Nan.
As Austin expected, losing his divine body yet again dealt heavy damage to Boswell, almost causing him to lose control of his Divine Kingdom. The Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom soon fell.
Once again, their attempt failed. No one imagined that Gu Nan could still forcibly eat away at the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom while being imprinted with the Stigma of Life and Death.
But that was also the end of it, because Gu Nan had no chance of destroying the remaining two Divine Kingdoms.
Be it Daisy or Austin, both wielded absolute authority over their Divine Kingdoms and could easily hit the Stigma of Life and Death.
Oh, that’s right, there was also a Ruler of War Eugene who still managed to keep an intact Divine Kingdom, but no one had time to care about him right now.
As for Boswell and Baal, they’d already gone to the Light and Darkness Divine Kingdoms respectively.
Now that the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom had already fallen, Austin and Daisy could also stay inside their respective Divine Kingdoms. With the owners there, there was no safer place than those two Divine Kingdoms.
On the other hand, Gu Nan had already withdrawn from the World of Gods after destroying the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom.
As an experienced player who finished the Third Round before, Gu Nan knew very well that the closer the god-slaying journey was to the end, the stronger the enemies’ defenses.
Of course, these difficulties were nothing for Tier 14 players. However, the Stigma of Life and Death caused some trouble for Gu Nan.
He wasn’t in a hurry to continue the invasion after forcibly erasing the Ashen Cyan Divine Kingdom, and finding Fu Cheng was also not a pressing concern.
What he currently needed was a surefire strategy to neutralize the flaw of the Stigma of Life and Death—if it couldn’t be completely removed, then even treating the symptom, not the cause, was fine.
And there just happened to be a temporary solution in the Myriad Heavens.
……
"I want Fa Kong's life," Gu Nan directly stated his goal without any hesitation.
There was no expression on Jiu Po's face. Although part of his laws were directly left behind in the World of Gods, he didn’t completely lose his combat effectiveness.
Lu Wen looked at Gu Nan in slight amusement. "Why?"
He also followed Jiu Po over earlier, but he ultimately didn't show himself. His absolute strength was insufficient, and his original intention was to lurk in the shadows for a chance to sneak attack the gods, but he didn't expect to never even get the chance to attack.
Gu Nan answered calmly, "I need an item that can reduce law attack damage. Fa Kong's śarīra should be able to do this."
A normal cultivator definitely would not use strange descriptions like "item" and "attack damage reduction", but neither of them found it strange when it came to Gu Nan.
Gu Nan wasn’t a very normal person to begin with.
"I thought it was because Fa Kong offended you back then, and you’re finally planning on taking revenge now." Lu Wen shook his head.
At first, Monk Fa Kong regarded Gu Nan as an evil demon, so he joined forces with Dream Immortal, Huo Kui, and Song Fei to gather the power of four Unified Dao figures to seal Gu Nan.
Ultimately, at the cost of substantial loss to Dream Immortal’s laws and the destruction of Monk Fa Kong's personal treasured weapon, most of Gu Nan's laws were finally sealed.
But the result was that a short five years later, Gu Nan took his fully-regenerated body to Three Buddha Heaven to retrieve his laws.
"Fa Kong's śarīra can indeed be used to make a defensive weapon." Jiu Po said, "But do you know how to refine weapons?"
"No," Gu Nan replied matter-of-factly. “You powerhouses have all lived for tens of thousands of years. There must be someone among your ranks who can refine weapons, right?"
Lu Wen laughed again and said, "There’s indeed a weapon refinement grandmaster among the Unified Dao cultivators, but he may not necessarily be willing to help you."
"Who?"
"Song Fei."
Gu Nan thought for a moment. "He’ll help me."
……
Three Buddha Heaven.
To be precise, it should be the ruins of Three Buddha Heaven, because it was already wrecked. After the war came to an end, only a few Buddhist disciples gathered here again.
Gu Nan returned from the World of Gods after single-handedly destroying a major Divine Kingdom; his achievements were once again spread throughout the Myriad Heavens.
People personally witnessed his rise from obscurity to fame, to attaining Unified Dao, and then to the top of the world.
With Gu Nan's current strength and status, he was an apex existence even among the Unified Dao bigshots. This could be seen from the fact that his astral world was still perfectly intact.
Monk Fa Kong had a deep understanding of this, so when Gu Nan appeared before him, he’d already given in and apologized without even waiting for Gu Nan to speak.
"Amitabha. What happened back then was due to this humble monk’s impulsiveness." Monk Fa Kong clasped his hands together. "Benefactor…"
"There's no need to apologize. I just came to get something from you today." Gu Nan's figure slowly stepped out of the void and stopped in front of Monk Fa Kong.
Monk Fa Kong started to have a bad feeling, but he still forcibly calmed himself. "Benefactor is now fighting powerful enemies for our Myriad Heavens. If you want to borrow some items from this humble monk, please feel free."
"I'm not borrowing it." Gu Nan emphasized, "I'm taking it. I won't give it back to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 583: A New Kindred Soul
chapters.content:
The current Monk Fa Kong didn’t even have the power to fight back against Gu Nan anymore.
Fa Kong could still block a few punches with his secret technique back when Gu Nan was Tier 12, but he couldn't block even a single punch now.
Even Austin would be killed instantly if a punch hit him, so how could Monk Fa Kong be an exception?
After losing their astral world, Unified Dao cultivators were once again separated from the laws they embodied and would no longer be directly protected by laws, forcing them to only exist in this world with their real bodies.
Once their real body was destroyed, the Unified Dao cultivator would be completely erased from this world.
Monk Fa Kong's head was instantly blown apart. Only then did Gu Nan leisurely walk up and take out a śarīra from the pool of blood.
As a Unified Dao Realm Buddhist monk, Monk Fa Kong's śarīra was very strange. It looked simple and old-fashioned, yet it was untainted by even a speck of dust.
It was clearly taken from a pool of blood, but it was not contaminated with any filth, as if nothing in the world could fall on it.
The same time Monk Fa Kong fell down, several figures quickly landed here, led by Yu Lian and Jiu Po.
When a Unified Dao fight occurred, even an instantaneous fluctuation was enough for all Unified Dao powers to notice. At a time when their paranoia was at its highest, any disturbance would attract attention.
Yu Lian stared at Gu Nan silently, not knowing what to say.
Another Unified Dao figure died at Gu Nan's hands. They could have become an important force against the World of Gods and was also the core of the Myriad Heavens.
But it was also impossible for Yu Lian to denounce Gu Nan.
Because the current Gu Nan was no longer an existence they could oppose. Just like when Jiu Po forcibly knocked down Zi Luo Elder’s cultivation realm, no one could criticize him either.
Gu Nan glanced at the new arrivals a few times and found that Song Fei was also among them, which saved Gu Nan the effort of looking for him.
"Old Song," Gu Nan shouted in that direction.
This strange address made Song Fei feel chills on his back. He didn't know what Gu Nan wanted, but then he saw the latter slowly making his way towards him.
Yu Lian quickly stood in front of Gu Nan. "It’s true that Song Fei has offended you before, but—"
"I’m planning to ask him for help, not beat him up," Gu Nan interrupted her. He tossed the śarīra into the air a few times. “Help me make a defensive item with this śarīra."
After saying that, Gu Nan began to describe the characteristics of the required item, including its size, defensive range, durability, overall strength, etc.
"Do you understand?" After Gu Nan stated his needs, he looked at Song Fei.
Only then did Song Fei confirm that Gu Nan didn’t intend to kill him. He felt a little relieved and said with a strange expression, "Weapon refinement is just a small matter. It’s just that this śarīra was taken from Daoist Friend Fa Kong. Isn’t it…"
"I’ll beat you to death if you don't agree." Gu Nan cracked his neck.
Song Fei swallowed all his words in an instant.
……
Of course Song Fei ultimately agreed to help refine the item. With his realm and ability, he was fully capable of fulfilling all of Gu Nan's requirements.
However, it wasn’t easy to refine a Unified Dao magic weapon, especially one that must withstand attacks from a powerhouse like Austin.
The timeline Song Fei gave was three months to half a year, and that was even after accounting for the fact that Fa Kong’s śarīra would be the main material, which would greatly simplify the refinement process.
If the material’s level wasn’t already so high that it didn’t even require much refining, the normal weapon refining duration for Unified Dao cultivators would be several hundred years or more.
To finish in three short months, it probably couldn’t even be called weapon refinement at all. It could only be regarded as polishing the material slightly to make a rough product.
It was like hitting an iron panel a few times with a hammer and then calling it plate armor.
After finishing these matters, Gu Nan headed to another place without delay.
He originally wanted to return to his Divine Kingdom, but an unexpected message from Daoist Yellow Springs forced him to change his destination and head to the Gap World first.
Daoist Yellow Springs rarely sent messages to the outside world. Firstly, he did not want to reveal his location. Secondly, he had no one to communicate with.
But this time, Daoist Yellow Springs made almost no effort to hide it and directly sent the message to Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom. He definitely wouldn’t have done such a thing if it wasn't an emergency,
Gu Nan quickly reached the Origin World. Sure enough, he saw Daoist Yellow Springs appear nearby with a somewhat serious and feverish expression.
"I found it," the first sentence that left Daoist Yellow Springs’ mouth surprised Gu Nan. "I found another person who left the Origin World!"
Jiu Po said he wanted to find a way home, but compared with Daoist Yellow Springs—who’d been guarding the Origin World for tens of thousands of years—his obsession clearly paled in comparison.
After tens of thousands of years of perseverance, Daoist Yellow Springs' persistence finally paid off.
After Jiu Po, Lu Wen, Daoist Yellow Springs himself, and Gu Nan, he found another kindred soul from the Origin World.
"Where?" Gu Nan raised his brow and immediately asked.
"The World of Gods."
After hearing these four words, Gu Nan finally understood why Daoist Yellow Springs was so anxious to reveal the news to him.
With the World of Gods’ current situation, the only person who could freely travel there was himself.
Gu Nan quickly obtained information about this kindred soul from Daoist Yellow Springs.
This fellow transmigrator naturally wasn’t Fu Cheng. Even if Fu Cheng didn’t remain in the dimensional wall for long and transmigrated immediately after leaving the Origin World, it would still be impossible for her to rise in such a short amount of time.
Daoist Yellow Springs had established his own forces in both worlds, controlling more than one organization that constantly collected all kinds of intelligence for him.
In many of these organizations, even the top management didn’t know who their leader was and why they established this organization.
However, for Daoist Yellow Springs to find the kindred soul among the massive population, this person’s power shouldn’t be too weak.
What he found was a god, a god who’d only ascended for a short time but had a very dazzling journey.
A mortal called Molag, who was born in a remote small plane, quickly grew into a true god who lit his divine flame in less than two years.
Every move he made was as if he was standing at the forefront of history, possessing the ability to predict the future. He destroyed opponents one by one extremely smoothly and finally ascended to godhood.
What allowed him to do this?
Gu Nan carefully looked through all the information, refusing to miss any detail. Although they were kindred souls, he knew that there were also differences among kindred souls.
Except for himself, everyone else only knew about history or the future direction of the world and had no other cheat abilities.
Gu Nan himself was precisely the opposite. He brought an Evil God Temple here, but instead of going to the world whose history he knew, he came to the completely unfamiliar Myriad Heavens.
It was hard to say which situation was better. One could only say that each had its own advantages and disadvantages, and it depended on how each transmigrator used these powers.

chapters.title: Chapter 584: Online Game《Myriad Gods》
chapters.content:
By relying on his understanding of history, Jiu Po stole a part of the Earth Realm in advance to create his astral world, practically stabilizing his position as the strongest person in the Myriad Heavens, a title he then held for tens of thousands of years.
This continued all the way until Gu Nan appeared. By relying on the powerful Evil God Temple, he’d caught up with Jiu Po in merely a hundred years.
If not for the Stigma of Life and Death, he would be able to completely conquer the two major worlds. No one would be able to stop him.
But in comparison, Gu Nan's rise was clearly filled with more danger.
Not having the ability to predict the future meant all the situations he encountered were unpredictable. It wasn’t like Gu Nan had never encountered a life-or-death crisis here, and this was even after he tried to avoid life-threatening dangers.
People with the ability to predict history wouldn’t experience this. As long as they didn’t court death like Zero and had a slightly more cautious personality, they wouldn’t encounter too big of a crisis and could simply avoid it in advance.
Gu Nan even suspected that there were actually other transmigrators similar to him, except most of them probably died while trying to grow stronger.
So right now, it was very important to confirm which category Molag fell under.
Gu Nan didn't act rashly. He didn't want to alert the other party for the time being. Instead, he read through Molag’s background bit by bit, including every step of his rise.
This process wasn’t complicated. After all, it had only been a little over two years since Molag's rise, and there were only a few major operations to pay attention to.
Judging from Molag's history, he should be a transmigrator with knowledge of the future similar to Jiu Po and Daoist Yellow Springs, but he didn’t seem to have much direct help from the Origin World.
The cause behind every step of Molag's improvement could be seen. Although his actions were highly goal-oriented, one would eventually realize that his goal was always resources that could enhance his power.
On the other hand, there was something about Molag that was incongruous with his environment.
He knew many abilities, moves, and techniques that were not from contemporary times, and he also spoke some words that others couldn’t understand.
Perhaps not even Molag himself was aware of this, but they were all faithfully recorded by the intelligence organization under Daoist Yellow Springs and reported to the two currently present.
"Indeed, it’s very possible that he’s a kindred soul." Gu Nan exhaled a long breath. If the other party wasn’t a regressor—which had never appeared before—then he must undoubtedly come from the Origin World.
"It's not a possibility; it's a certainty." Upon hearing this, Daoist Yellow Springs revealed a strange smile and pointed to the Origin World below. "I found the civilization he came from."
……
World of Gods.
Molag looked at the brand-new Divine Kingdom and couldn't help letting out a heavy sigh of relief, finally feeling a little more relaxed.
The aesthetics of these natives who lived just before the Cataclysm were so weird that if they were allowed to build structures freely, Molag would not be able to live in them at all.
It had been two years since he transmigrated to this world. He’d grown from a mortal to a god. This speed was already incredibly fast, but Molag still wasn’t satisfied.
If this was his previous life’s game, his progress would definitely be faster.
That's right. Molag came from the Origin World. He once played an online game called 《Myriad Gods》, and the backstory in the game was exactly the same as this world’s history.
The point in time when Molag transmigrated to this world was the same as when players first started the game.
The game’s background at this time was that the seemingly peaceful World of Gods was about to encounter the greatest Cataclysm in history. The terrifying Evil God descended and slaughtered all the greater gods.
Although the two Greater Gods of Light and Darkness finally sealed the Evil God at the cost of their own lives, the World of Gods was still greatly damaged, and everything was in ruins.
Though the most powerful enemy was temporarily sealed, the external enemies were still powerful. All the players needed to work hard to build a homeland that belonged to the gods.
This was the first main story arc for the game after players passed the tutorial period: “The Evil God Destroys the World”.
By the time Molag transmigrated here, the online game had already entered its seventh arc. It was none other than players forming their own guilds and preparing to counterattack foreign enemies.
Molag was the guild leader of the Sunrise Sunset Guild, one of the three largest player guilds. He’d conquered countless dungeons and gotten many world bosses’ first kill achievements. He had a very deep understanding of the game.
《Myriad Gods》 was a very interesting game.
Most of the game was set after the Cataclysm, leaving only a small amount of time for players to adapt before the Evil God annihilates the world.
During this period, only the top players were allowed to become gods, and they would undoubtedly become the backbone of the player army, leading the rest of the players forward.
It was precisely because of this setting that Molag—a professional player—had room to use his own abilities instead of seeing the pay to win players take everything.
However, after the Cataclysm, most players would gradually grow into gods, building their homes while engaging in battles with foreign enemies. This was also the origin of the name 《Myriad Gods》.
Of course, battles among players were also essential.
The natural division of the Light and Darkness Factions also divided players into two camps, and there had never been a lack of conflict between them.
‘But none of that exists anymore…’
Molag looked at the sky in the distance and sighed softly. Because he was the only player in this world, the important responsibility of saving the world could only be entrusted to him.
It was indeed a very joyous thing to not have to compete with thousands of players for resources, but it was also very difficult to defeat powerful foreign enemies by himself.
But now that it had already come to this, Molag could only do his best, and at the same time, unite all the forces that could be united.
"Then, Your Highness Karina." Molag looked at Karina in front of him with a faint smile on his face. "Are you interested in my proposal?"
Molag approached Karina on his own. It was absolutely necessary to win Karina over to his side. This War Goddess would be the main force opposing foreign invaders in the future.
In fact, the third arc for the game was called the “Rise of the God of War”.
Molag, who was familiar with history, knew that contact with Karina was one of the main storylines, and if he wanted to receive her help, he must always stay by her side.
There was a lucky person in his previous life who stayed with Karina when the Cataclysm came and successfully dissuaded her from directly facing the Evil God. Ultimately, that player managed to gain the unconditional trust and friendship of the War Goddess.
So in the third arc, this player almost became a true protagonist.
……
Just as Molag made contact with Karina, what he didn't know was that two figures were slowly descending onto the Origin World, in a civilization called "Tilvence".
"Molag mentioned the word Tilvence several times in conversations with his subordinates. Judging from the context, it should be a place name," Daoist Yellow Springs said with a smile.
"That’s why you found this place." Gu Nan studied the civilization before him. It had just started interstellar travel and was somewhat similar to the past Earth. Soon, a smile appeared on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 585: The Person Who Witnessed History
chapters.content:
The word “Tilvence” was a transliteration of the name this civilization called itself.
This pronunciation roughly translates to "Three Stars" in the civilization’s language. It was because the birthplace of the Tilvence civilization was three habitable planets in close proximity to each other.
Of course, even now, the vast majority of Tilvencenians still lived on these three planets, but as the Federation’s territory gradually expanded, the three planets lost the absolute status they held back in the day.
Now that Daoist Yellow Springs found Tilvence, it was inevitable that he would launch an investigation into Molag.
However, because the other party’s past life was unclear, not much progress had been made on this front. Thus, Daoist Yellow Springs revealed Molag’s existence to Gu Nan in order to use his power to start investigating Molag in the World of Gods.
Although Gu Nan was more interested in Tilvence’s local online game, 《Myriad Gods》.
However, these two goals did not conflict, because Gu Nan easily confirmed Molag’s identity in the process of investigating《Myriad Gods》.
Over two years ago, the guild master of the Sunrise Sunset Guild, one of the three largest guilds, suddenly disappeared, which caused an uproar in the gaming community.
It wasn't until someone found his real life identity that they discovered he’d died suddenly while playing the game.
The official explanation was that the player whose real name was Zhou Xuan suffered a sudden cardiac arrest due to the influence of intense brainwaves, which led to his death.
After finding information on this guild master, Gu Nan was able to confirm that Zhou Xuan and Molag were indeed the same person without even having to compare their experiences.
Because Zhou Xuan's in-game ID was none other than Molag.
"Gamer?" Daoist Yellow Springs couldn't help looking dumbfounded after Molag's identity was confirmed.
It wasn’t that he hadn’t searched Tilvence before, but his main focus was on literature, films, and television series. It never even occurred to him to search through games.
On one hand, it was because his understanding of people from the Origin World basically came from Jiu Po and himself. He only thought that they had observed history in some way, but never realized that they might also have personally participated in it.
On the other hand, the online game《Myriad Gods》was far from a popular game famous throughout the internet. At most, it only had a group of enthusiastic players, which was incomparable to the Evil God game in Gu Nan's previous life.
After Gu Nan and Daoist Yellow Springs verified Molag's identity, they could confirm many things.
First of all, Zhou Xuan's disappearance and Molag's appearance were basically synchronized in time. Here, Zhou Xuan's disappearance happened more than two years ago.
And then… after Zhou Xuan disappeared,《Myriad Gods》actually did not end its service and was still operating as usual. Right now, the eighth main chapter was almost finished.
"Which means, all of this is the future?" Daoist Yellow Springs slowly flipped through the game storyline from《Myriad Gods》and muttered incredulously.
The storyline of 《Myriad Gods》 begins when the World of Gods is invaded and the greater gods desperately join forces to resist the foreign Evil God. In the eyes of Daoist Yellow Springs, this was clearly the war between the two worlds that just occurred.
"It's possible." Gu Nan was also looking at this piece of "history", although it felt strange to call events that hadn’t happened yet “history”.
This history was quite accurate.
It claimed the Evil God came to destroy the world and possessed incredible power, which the greater gods could not oppose. In the end, the God of Death sacrificed himself and finally created an opening in the Evil God’s defense. This was also the Evil God’s only weakness.
Although there were many differences between this storyline and reality, the overall history was correct.
And this game’s backstory had already been announced six or seven years ago, back when it was first launched… In other words, the Origin World could indeed predict the future.
"How interesting," Gu Nan remarked with a smile.
There was nothing amazing about predicting the future. Rather than mysterious things like multiple timelines and parallel worlds, Gu Nan believed more in the theory of "Laplace’s demon".
If the Origin World could gather enough information on the two worlds, then it was entirely possible to predict the future through inferences.
And the future is never set in stone. Now that additional factors have appeared, the future will inevitably change. In other words, from the moment Gu Nan laid eyes on these documents, the future has already changed.
The subsequent future was also seen by Gu Nan.
When the Evil God descended again, Austin and Daisy finally succeeded in sealing him away at the cost of their lives. This process was not described in detail, and Gu Nan only had the information written here to go off of, which wasn’t enough for him to judge certain things.
On the other hand, another puzzling matter was that there were errors in the seventh and eighth main chapters.
If the first six main chapters had considerable basis in reality and could be said to be accurate predictions, then starting from the seventh chapter, the predictions were simply nonsense.
Residents of the Myriad Heavens were truly turned into a group of demons. They had oriental Eastern powers and humanoid forms, but they were not normal humans. This detracted too far from reality.
"We must find this game’s designer," Gu Nan said as he stood up.
Of course an online game had its operators and developers. The game background and main storyline undoubtedly came from the development team.
Daoist Yellow Springs naturally wasn’t opposed, and he was also very interested in the question of "how history was leaked".
……
In a business park, Huang Haoshan was chewing on a white steamed bun as he hurriedly walked through the company building’s doors.
He had been developing games for Weidong Entertainment for over ten years, having experienced all the ups and downs in the past decade. Now that he was over thirty, he’d long since lost his earlier hot-bloodedness.
The current Huang Haoshan just wanted to leech off of the online game《Myriad Gods》all the way to the end… Although he also knew this was quite unrealistic, he at least hoped that《Myriad Gods》could be popular for a few more years.
However, in the end, the lifespan of a game was limited. He already knew this when he started developing《Myriad Gods》.
On this day, Huang Haoshan came to work as usual, but he found two strangers waiting inside his office when he entered.
The two were dressed in neat suits, and they didn't look like conmen. Huang Haoshan asked hesitantly, "You guys are…?"
"Mr. Huang Haoshan?" One of them stood up and looked at him calmly.
For some reason, this person’s gaze made Huang Haoshan feel chills on his back. He subconsciously nodded. “I’m Huang Haoshan, yes. What can I do for you?”
"We are from the Sixth Special Operations Division of the Federation’s Bureau of Investigation." The man said seriously, "We are here today to ask you something."
After a pause, the man continued, "Are you the one in charge of developing the game 《Myriad Gods》?"
Next ChapterPrevious ChapterIndex13 views0 commentsPost not marked as liked

chapters.title: Chapter 586: Molag's Ambition
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Molag's Ambition
"That's right." Huang Haoshan nodded, watching the two somewhat warily.
He'd never heard of a Sixth Special Operations Division or whatever. Although it sounded very powerful, why would the Federation's Bureau of Investigation care about a game he developed?
The man in the suit exchanged a glance with the other person, then turned to him again. "Are you the sole original creator of the game's backstory and content?"
Huang Haoshan's heart skipped a beat. Could the two before him be here to investigate intellectual property infringement? Was there really something wrong with the game's storyline?
"Y-Yes…" Huang Haoshan wiped the cold sweat that was about to drip from his forehead and answered tensely.
The stranger saw his response and suddenly smiled. He placed a hand on Huang Haoshan's shoulder and asked, "Then, can you please tell me why—starting from the seventh main chapter—the content is completely different from earlier storylines?"
It was as if a bomb instantly exploded inside Huang Haoshan's head, and he was finally certain that the other party did not just randomly find him. Rather, they actually had evidence.
The stranger's cold expression made Huang Haoshan imagine people in police uniforms arresting him and taking him away.
"I confess, I confess…" Huang Haoshan immediately admitted without any hesitation.
Under the Federation's law, intentional and unintentional intellectual property infringement were crimes of completely different severities. The sooner he confessed, the more likely he was to receive leniency.
