"It might sound unbelievable, but…" Huang Haoshan looked at the two a little awkwardly and revealed, "information about this game just appeared in my head."
...
Huang Haoshan never doubted the two investigators' origins.
Perhaps they could lie about being from the Federation's Bureau of Investigation, but the other party knew about the differences between the seventh and eight main chapters and the rest of the earlier storyline—that could not be a lie.
The entire in-game background of"Myriad Gods"was written by Huang Haoshan himself. Naturally, he also wrote the last two chapters.
But very few people knew that the earlier storylines were copied directly from the information that appeared in his head, while the last two chapters were written by him based on previous information.
However, after so many years of game development, Huang Haoshan was confident that there were no problems with the last two chapters, and the connection with the previous ones was also seamless.
It had already been two years since the last two main chapters were released, and they still received glowing reviews from players. No one ever complained about a decline in quality, so what could be wrong with them?
But Huang Haoshan knew that someone really might be able to discover the problem, and that was the original author of the information that popped up in his head.
After Huang Haoshan confessed everything, Gu Nan and Daoist Yellow Springs stared at each other, feeling a little dismayed for a moment.
No one would have thought that this precious information about the future of the two outside worlds would just randomly appear in some normal person's head.
Gu Nan thought for a while and asked, "You mean, after the sixth main chapter, no new information appeared in your head?"
"Yes." Huang Haoshan nodded. "New information would automatically appear in my head every July, but I haven't seen anything in the past two years."
After saying this, Huang Haoshan anxiously said, "Gentlemen, I didn't mean to plagiarize. I thought these were…"
"It's fine." Gu Nan patted his shoulder with a smile. "Don't tell anyone about what happened today."
...
In a nearby teahouse, Gu Nan and Daoist Yellow Springs were sitting across from each other.
"Do you think this is manmade?" Daoist Yellow Springs thought for a long time and suddenly asked.
He never thought the truth would be so absurd. He subconsciously believed there was a mastermind behind it and tried to analyze the other party's goal.
Gu Nan, on the other hand, shook his head. "We can't be certain yet. And even if it was manmade, the mastermind actually has better methods to handle this."
Simply stuffing information into a random person's brain was too crude.
Besides, the idea of a mastermind pulling the strings was simply too ridiculous. Why would the mastermind take such a big detour when there were way more efficient methods?
Gu Nan was more inclined to believe that this was a yet-undiscovered natural phenomenon. It was similar to how Fu Cheng was taken away, which was clearly a spontaneous behavior of the dimensional wall.
"We've now confirmed how information about the future appears, but why is it Molag?" Gu Nan's thoughts quickly moved onto the next step.
Besides Lu Wen, who was brought out by Daoist Yellow Springs, why Gu Nan and the others were able to leave the Origin World was also a mystery in itself.
Daoist Yellow Springs came to his senses and stood up., "I'll stay here. We need more information to confirm Zhou Xuan's special nature."
...
The investigation into Zhou Xuan and Molag continued, but this matter was mainly left to Daoist Yellow Springs while Gu Nan came to the World of Gods alone.
He completely hid his whereabouts with shadows. Thanks to the Tier 14 law of shadows, not even the greater gods could easily detect him.
He stopped near Molag's Divine Kingdom and quietly watched the other party's movements. In passing, he saw Karina leave.
Gu Nan wasn't surprised that Molag wanted to become friends with Karina.
After all, Gu Nan already read the information from Tilvence and knew what Karina would accomplish in the future… Actually, he didn't even need to read that to know.
Karina's strength and special nature had already been revealed during Gu Nan's era.
But what truly piqued Gu Nan's interest was that since Molag transmigrated while playing a game, was it possible that he possessed a related golden finger?
Although he and Daoist Yellow Springs didn't find anything unusual when they investigated Molag's background before, it may be that the other party's abilities were more subtle.
After all, directly lighting one's divine fire in just two years was still a bit miraculous.
Anyhow, there are still three months until Song Fei finishes with weapon refining, so he can quietly observe Molag's actions in the meantime…
Of course, observation alone was not enough. Molag's current life was a little too comfortable, which could not force him to reveal his potential.
If hardships didn't exist, one could simply create hardships.
The opportunity quickly came.
...
On this day, Molag developed his Divine Kingdom as usual, recruiting believers from different planes while simultaneously conducting a treasure hunt.
For transmigrators familiar with history, building the Divine Kingdom step by step was simply a waste of their knowledge.
After Molag drew up plans for his Divine Kingdom, he quickly led his army out and arrived at Dylan, a dual elemental plane of fire and ice.
In the game, this place was a dungeon that could drop blueprints for dual-element Divine Servants, which would definitely be of great help to the Divine Kingdom Molag first established.
Before the army set off, Molag's deputy voiced some concerns, "My Lord, the Dylan plane is said to be protected by His Majesty Wolf. We…"
"No worries." Molag just waved his hand with a smile. "Wolf, the Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice, is most likely facing a crisis right now. This is a great opportunity for us to attack Dylan."
The deputy stared at Molag in confusion, wondering where his lord received that information.
However, he'd seen them win all too many battles thanks to such mysterious information, so this time, he decisively chose to believe it.
'His Lordship's intelligence organization really is mysterious…' The deputy thought to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 587: The Changed History
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: The Changed History
Wolf, the Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice, was one of the relatively rare non-human gods. He was from a beast tribe.
But don't underestimate this Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice just because he wasn't human.
There were eighty thousand to a hundred thousand people named Wolf inside the wolf race. But whenever this name was mentioned nowadays, most people would immediately think of this Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice. One could well imagine his status from this.
But Molag wasn't afraid at all—because he was perfectly aware that Wolf was encountering the biggest crisis of his life at this very moment and had no time to rush over to Dylan.
Although the Dylan plane was very important to Wolf, was anything more important than his own life?
Molag's army descended onto Dylan in the blink of an eye and quickly spread out under Molag's command, heading to various resource nodes to plunder resources.
Molag's main goal was that Divine Servant blueprint, but there were also other resources to plunder in Dylan.
Followers and resources were equally important for a newly-ascended god. As a player, Molag was clearly more comfortable with plundering resources than recruiting believers.
Everything proceeded smoothly. After Molag finished issuing orders, he paid no more attention to this operation.
He didn't take a mere Dylan seriously at all. After all, for him—who had become a greater god in his previous life and even led players to fight back against evil—this level of intensity was simply too trifling.
Molag was already planning what he would do with the new troop unit after he obtained the "Temple of Fire and Ice" structure this time.
...
As Molag expected, Wolf was currently facing a huge crisis. Although he received news of Dylan's attack, he couldn't spare the time to deal with it.
Wolf's crisis came from his own race. The wolf race, to be precise.
The wolf race had a very large population, and the Two-Headed Wolves of Fire and Ice was just one of the smaller tribes.
Wolf's legendary rise brought prosperity to his clan, the Two-Headed Wolves of Fire and Ice, but naturally, he would also face challenges from many other wolves.
The current situation was exactly like this. Wolf was facing a young challenger from the Steel Wolves clan.
This Steel Wolf named Werewolf had an extremely commonplace name similar to Wolf and also possessed strength comparable to Wolf's.
The difference was that Wolf specialized in wielding the laws of fire and ice, while Werewolf was a pure lover of violence; all his power came from his body.
There was actually nothing to describe about the battle between the two. It was nothing more than the word "wolf" filling the entire screen.
But the predicted future was that Wolf, the Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice, ultimately won, tearing his opponent into pieces after a two-month fierce battle.
But he also paid a huge price. His Godhead was almost shattered and his body was severely injured, only managing to recover after a long rest period.
Molag knew this, which was why he was so confident in attacking Dylan.
However, because Wolf did not ultimately die, every player in "Myriad Gods"who cleared this dungeon would encounter Wolf's revenge in the future.
At this point in time, Wolf had just encountered the challenger, and the battle between the two wolves was at its peak.
All of Wolf's attention was focused on the opponent before him. The dual laws of fire and ice collided in midair, trying to force the fast-moving enemy to reveal himself. Then, he saw an unbelievable scene.
Werewolf suddenly froze, not budging an inch even when the fire and ice elements slammed into him. He just stood eerily still in the air, as if his time had been stopped.
Wolf was startled by this scene. If he couldn't see his opponent's eyes widening, an expression of fear and disbelief frozen on his face, Wolf would have thought this was one of the enemy's tricks.
After a while, the Steel Wolf's body began to disintegrate. Pieces of skin peeled off, followed by flesh, tissue, and internal organs…
In just the blink of an eye, Werewolf had become a pile of body parts soaked in thick blood.
Even Wolf, who was a god, had never seen such an eerie death scene before. It reminded him of those undead gods who played with corpses.
Did the other party offend a powerhouse from the Dark Faction before challenging him?
Wolf didn't have time to ponder this for too long. Since his opponent was dead, he didn't dare to dally and quickly left the battlefield.
And after His Majesty—the Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice—returned, the first place he visited was naturally Dylan, a plane currently under enemy attack.
...
"Hurry up, you lazy idiots! Don't forget that we are at war!" The deputy whipped a soldier and yelled.
Because he was wearing thick armor, the soldier didn't feel any pain. Instead, he smiled playfully at his deputy and hurried forward again.
It wasn't that the soldier wasn't vigilant. It was because His Lordship's arrangements rendered Dylan's opposition powerless, which filled the soldiers with the misconception that "the other party is quite weak".
They almost always had more troops than the enemy in the smaller battlefields throughout Dylan, forming a perfect numerical advantage.
This was something Gu Nan was incapable of doing. He excelled at solo fights. But this was a piece of cake for Molag, who was a guild leader.
"Robert, don't be nervous." Molag walked up from behind and patted his deputy on the shoulder. "Wolf will not be able to even summon subordinates for at least two months."
But Deputy Robert still looked serious. "In any case, it won't be a bad thing to finish things quickly."
Molag shrugged indifferently, having no intention of persuading him further. The reason he chose Robert as his deputy was precisely because he valued Robert's earnest nature.
"In that case, you can just… Hm?"
Before Molag could finish, he suddenly looked up at the sky in surprise.
In Dylan's unclear sky, two clouds of mist suddenly began to condense. It was the dual attributes of fire and ice, which finally formed Wolf's figure.
The mere appearance of Wolf, who had two wolf heads and a human body, boosted the morale of Dylan's troops, and counterattacks immediately began on all the battlefronts.
"My Lord! Wolf has appeared! My Lord?!" Robert also saw this scene and said to Molag anxiously.
Molag was staring upward blankly, speechless for a moment. He couldn't figure out how Wolf could appear at this time and look completely uninjured.
His first reaction was that the future he knew was wrong, but his experience in the past two years told him that the future he knew couldn't possibly be wrong.
'Did one of my earlier actions affect the course of history, preventing the Steel Wolf from challenging Wolf?'
Molag's thoughts were a mess, but as a former guild leader, Molag quickly calmed down. At this time, it was no longer useful to dwell on the cause. The pressing concern was how to resolve this.

chapters.title: Chapter 588: Transmigrator Alliance
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: Transmigrator Alliance
In order to maximize resources, Molag adopted the most expansive strategy for troop deployment.
He utilized every force to the extreme to ensure the highest resource plundering efficiency.
This was originally a very clever tactic, but this tactic became fatal to Molag's army when Wolf returned to Dylan.
"The only solution now is to kill Wolf!" Molag glared at the sky with cold eyes.
Wolf seemed to sense his gaze and slowly looked down.
Wolf was a god with rich combat experience against other gods. He knew that his side was at an absolute advantage right now, so even if he found the enemy, he wasn't in a hurry to strike.
After all, what happened today was too eerie. The Steel Wolf's inexplicable death made him feel like a mastermind was behind all this, so he didn't want to rashly take action.
But no matter what Wolf thought, Molag no longer had another option. He must kill the Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice.
"My Lord, what do you want to do?" Robert looked at Molag with some despair. He couldn't think of anything this newly-ascended god could use to oppose Wolf.
His Majesty, the Two-Headed Wolf of Fire and Ice, was a powerhouse who could fight Tier 7 gods.
Molag said nothing. He knew Wolf was waiting for him to reveal an opening while making the first strike, but he had no other choice.
"In that case…" Molag became decisive. With a slight thought, a bright light flashed in his line of sight.
The next second, a series of data appeared on his retina. This was something only he could see. If there were others who played"Myriad Gods" here, they would be very familiar with this data.
In the game, it had a name players were familiar with—the skill tree.
That's right. Although he couldn't transmigrate with the entire game system, Molag brought a skill tree with him.
A single skill tree was naturally not as powerful as the Evil God Temple, but since Molag himself was familiar with the future, there were incomparably large advantages when the two were combined.
He could always make the right choice. At the same time, he could also deal extremely high burst damage.
On the other hand, since the skill tree didn't affect Molag's actual realm, this improvement was difficult to see from the outside, so very few people noticed something was off about him.
A skill tree would only truly affect his combat effectiveness.
A look of madness appeared on Molag's face. He poured all the skill exp gained so far from killing monsters into one skill.
That was his favorite sword art in his past life, and it was also a sword style that only those who reached the realm of gods were qualified to use. Its name was "Divine Punishment Swordsmanship".
Divine Punishment Swordsmanship wasn't powerful in the early stages, but there would be unexpected effects once the skill reached a higher level.
Level 1, Level 2, Level 3… With the continuous infusion of skill exp, Molag upgraded his Divine Punishment Swordsmanship to Level 10 in the blink of an eye.freeweɓnovēl.coɱ
Level 10 was already the limit for his current level. If he continued upgrading this skill, it would become a greater god level swordsmanship skill, something far beyond Molag's control.
But even so, the Level 10 swordsmanship was still far beyond Molag's current realm.
After Molag clicked on the skill, his body slowly floated up into the sky, staring directly at Wolf.
Aerial combat was actually disadvantageous for a melee swordsman like him. On the other hand, Wolf's laws of fire and ice were not affected.
But Molag couldn't afford to worry about such things. He knew that he only had one blow—his divine power could only support one attack!
After one strike, he would either win or die!
Before Wolf even had time to open his mouth, he saw the enemy before him suddenly draw his sword. A ray of golden light sliced apart the sky and instantly struck him.
This sword was as fast as lightning, and all of Wolf's laws were instantly severed. He stared blankly at the golden light rapidly approaching him, then lost consciousness.
To those watching down below, it seemed as if the golden light directly cleaved Wolf apart. A golden line appeared down his forehead, and then his body slowly toppled over, falling from the air.
But after Molag used this skill, his whole figure seemed to have been drained of strength, and he also fell from the air.
Deputy Robert quickly rushed forward to catch him. Fortunately, Molag only had a pale face and was still conscious. He had overly exhausted all of his divine power.
"Proceed as planned," Molag propped himself up with difficulty and instructed Robert.
The fact that he successfully killed Wolf in one blow made Molag sigh in relief. It was fortunate that he had the skill tree…
However, he then noticed Robert staring at something behind him with a frightened expression, as if he'd seen a ghost.
Molag turned around suddenly, only to see an unfamiliar figure standing behind him, studying him with interest.
"Who are you?" Molag asked subconsciously.
He quickly flipped through his memories, trying to find the character whose appearance matched this stranger's, but he never succeeded.
The visitor did not speak and shot him a grin, then gently waved his hand, completely erasing Molag's consciousness.
...
When he regained consciousness, Molag found himself in a secure room.
The room was completely isolated from the outside world, making it impossible for him to discern the time and location. Under the dim light, there was not a single figure nearby, nor any memorable objects.
His divine power was completely sealed by a special power. Molag frowned and stood up, carefully examining his surroundings.
Then he noticed a book with a blank cover on the table next to him. It had no title, but the contents shocked Molag.
His complete history was clearly written on it. His journey—from his inexplicable arrival into this world to his upward ascent, step by step—were all recorded here in full.
"Curious why we collected your information?" A teasing voice traveled over from in front of him.
Molag raised his head and saw a figure wrapped in black robes standing before him. The stranger's appearance was exactly that of the person he'd seen before.
"Who the hell are you guys?!" Molag snapped. He had a sinking feeling that he seemed to have been targeted by some sort of organization.
"Welcome to the Transmigrator Alliance." The man in black robes smiled. "You can call me 'Gù'. Oh, I mean 'Gǔ'."
Molag stared at the man in front of him who called himself "Gu". He was no longer in the mood to care about the stranger's name. All his attention was attracted by those two words.
Transmigrator Alliance!
"You mean…"
"That's right." Gu Nan explained with a nod, "There are many transmigrators like you and me. We gathered together to form this alliance and then recruited more transmigrators from all over the world."
For a while, Molag didn't know what to say.
Gu Nan continued, "Now then, let's head over to test your ability."
The first Gu (顾) is the same as his surname, and the second one (古) means ancient. Different characters and pronunciations

chapters.title: Chapter 589: The Secret Behind the Golden Finger
chapters.content:
Transmigrator Alliance—these two words were deeply imprinted in Molag's mind.
When Molag walked out of the secure room, what entered his sight was pure white. It seemed like a military base, full of staff hurrying along.
They all wore white lab coats, a style Molag had only seen in his previous life and was definitely not a product of the World of Gods.
‘Is it really the Transmigrator Alliance?’ Seeing such a scene, Molag couldn't help believing in "Gu"'s words a little more.
Ever since he transmigrated, nothing in the entire world exceeded his expectations. That was, until he met "Gu" and the Transmigrator Alliance he mentioned.
‘And just now, "Gu" said he’ll take me to test my abilities? Could this mean…?’
"Each transmigrator has their own unique ability," "Gu" smiled and explained, as if he could see what Molag was thinking.
This confirmed Molag’s suspicions. If so, then his ability should be the skill tree.
"We’ve read your information, but it was only when you killed Wolf that we were able to ascertain your identity as a transmigrator." "Gu" looked at Molag. "Your ability seems to allow you to master some unknown skills?"
Molag nodded. "Yes, this is the power from my previous life."
Although he gradually came to believe "Gu"’s words, Molag did not lose his basic vigilance and wasn’t foolish enough to reveal his true identity.
"Gu" didn't speak anymore. He just took Molag to a laboratory, then said, "Use your ability here. We will measure the basic strength and rank of your ability."
Molag looked at him skeptically. "Abilities can be ranked?"
"Of course." "Gu" laughed involuntarily. "We divide tansmigrators’ abilities into seven levels according to their strength and type. The highest is S Rank, the lowest is F Rank."
Molag's heart quickened slightly. He asked, "Then what do you think my ability’s rough rank is?"
He knew that since "Gu" brought him here, this person must already have some ideas about his ability. On the other hand, he also planned to use Gu’s judgment to decide how much of his ability to display.
He received an entire skill tree! If the so-called "ability" referred to ordinary abilities, how could they compare with his?
However, "Gu" just answered flatly, "The strength may reach B Rank, but the ability type is at most E Rank."
Molag’s eyes couldn’t help widening in shock, unable to imagine why his ability evaluation would be so low. Being able to kill Wolf in one strike proved it wasn’t weak, right?
Seeing his expression, "Gu" just smiled and explained, "Only abilities that allow one to kill enemies of a higher level can be categorized as A Rank or above. As for the ability type… Your ability doesn’t help your realm grow at all. This won’t get you far."
Molag couldn't help falling silent after hearing this.
He, who had the experience of his previous life, certainly knew the importance of realm.
Don’t be fooled by how he could kill Wolf by casually learning a skill. That was because the enemy's level was too low. If it was a Tier 10 opponent, he wouldn’t actually have much of an advantage in terms of skills.
From this perspective, it wasn’t wrong for "Gu" to rate his ability type as E Rank.
"Then let's get started," Molag said seriously after quashing the arrogance in his heart.
He walked into the lab and let the staff install some test equipment. Then he saw one of them nodding to him, indicating that he could start.
Molag took a deep breath and activated his ability based on their instructions. The skill tree in his mind began to appear, and skill data began to appear on his retina.
Outside the laboratory, Gu Nan stood in front of a computer, watching the changes on it.
The so-called Transmigrator Alliance was naturally a complete lie Gu Nan made up to fool him. In fact, Molag had been in a coma for over a month; Gu Nan didn't wake him up until the arrangements were completed.
This set of equipment came from Milky Way Heaven. Gu Nan personally asked Si Yun for it. It could clearly reflect chemical changes in the target's body and even display its real-time location.
When Molag activated his ability, the screen clearly showed that an unprecedented substance was being secreted rapidly in his brain.
The device itself quickly analyzed the mysterious substance’s characteristics and found the corresponding substance from the substance table.
"No. 059812—What substance is this?" Gu Nan asked while looking at the results.
Sweating profusely, a staff member stood up and rummaged through another table.
If it was a normal substance, the device itself would give the name. But now, it only had a number, indicating that this was a substance that hadn’t been completely verified yet.
"Substance code 059, this is…" The staff found the meaning of the first half of the number and couldn't help exclaiming, "A specific ratio for a world origin."
"A world origin?" Gu Nan was stunned. He didn’t expect for Molag's body to secrete such a thing.
Milky Way Heaven’s equipment adopted the substance naming convention common to the Myriad Heavens. The “059” half meant it was a world origin, and the “812” behind signified the specific ratio.
World origins weren’t all that rare. There were so many planes in the Myriad Heavens, and each one had its own world origin.
These origins had certain commonalities, but each had its own special properties. Therefore, fundamentally, each origin had its own specific ratio.
Of course, this subtle difference was meaningless for most people. No matter the allocation ratio, it wouldn’t affect the world origin’s usage.
However, Gu Nan suddenly thought of another possibility— ‘Could No. 059812 be the Origin World’s origin?’
‘Could it be that the world origin is the cause behind transmigrators leaving the Origin World?’
These thoughts flashed through Gu Nan's head, and he ordered calmly, "Have him activate his ability again and see if this phenomenon is consistent."
The staff member nodded in agreement.
After several rounds of testing, they finally verified the results.
As long as Molag activated his ability, a world origin would automatically be secreted in his brain, and it was always No. 059812. But the amount of world origin that appeared was determined by the intensity of Molag's ability usage.
Gu Nan stared at this result in thought, then asked, "Can we mix this origin by ourselves?"
"Of course, My Lord." The lab member on the seat smiled. "As long as we know the number, we can mix any type of world origin."
"Good." Gu Nan nodded. "Create this world origin. Have Molag stop his ability, then inject the origin into his head."
This sounded a bit scary, but the researchers who came from labs were long since accustomed to this.
In their eyes, Molag was just a test subject.
Molag, who was in the experimental chamber, was still faithfully cooperating with the experiment. That was, until a syringe descended from the ceiling.

chapters.title: Chapter 590: Origin No. 059812
chapters.content:
"What’s this for?" Molag raised his head in confusion and stared at the syringe hanging steadily above his head.
He believed that nothing they wanted to test would require a syringe. This was clearly trying to inject something into his body!
"Gu! What on earth are you guys doing?!" Molag started shouting at the research area outside, feeling a little panicked again.
However, the next second, he felt something tighten around his neck as a mechanical arm clamped down around his neck, silencing him.
Molag knew something was wrong and quickly stopped using his skill tree.
In his opinion, if the other party had any ulterior motives towards him, it was most likely due to his special ability. Only by hiding his secret would he have the right to negotiate.
However, while Molag was immobilized, the needle wantonly descended and directly pierced the back of his neck, accurately stabbing between two spinal columns.
Immediately afterwards, Molag felt a chill that quickly traveled up his spine and rushed into his head.
Something horrifying happened.
Molag felt as if his skill tree spiraled completely out of control. Countless rows of text flew across his eyes. His previously meager allocable skill exp shot up at a terrifying speed.One must know that even after more than two years of accumulation, his total skill exp never surpassed two hundred thousand, but in a mere instant, his skill exp had already exceeded one billion…
"Check what's written on his retina," Gu Nan's voice rang out calmly.
Thanks to the monitoring equipment, none of the changes in Molag's body went undetected.
Gu Nan and the others could clearly see that with the influx of a large amount of origin, some data was directly projected onto Molag's retina.
"Yes!" The researcher hurriedly responded and began to operate the instrument again.
Thus, under Molag's horrified gaze, a small scalpel descended and instantly stabbed into his forehead, accurately severing his pain nerves.
Molag felt his head go cold, and an indescribable fear began to emerge in his heart. He didn't know what exactly these people wanted to do.
But what came next was even scarier. The scalpel cut from the top of his skull to his brow bone.
A mechanical hand reached inside and pulled his skull outward, revealing the internal structure and Gu Nan’s target—Molag's left eyeball.
The other robotic hand slowly stretched out, carefully moved the optic nerve to one side, pulled Molag's left eyeball forward, and connected it to the detection device.
With Molag's intact right eye, he could even see that his left eye was still connected to his own nerves, with blood dripping from it, but he could no longer feel pain.
The scene outside the lab room was still peaceful. No one paid any attention to such a trifling operation.
For this experimental subject—a god—such a small injury was nothing at all.
After taking out the eyeball, through analysis of both the eyeball imaging and retina, what Molag’s left eye saw quickly appeared in front of Gu Nan.
"Skill tree?" Gu Nan couldn't help raising an eyebrow. He didn't expect this to be Molag’s cheat ability.
Gu Nan had also seen《Myriad Gods》before, so of course he recognized it.
"Adjust the rate of origin infusion and see what changes happen to his body while the skill tree is in use."
Skills couldn’t be obtained out of thin air; they must be given through Molag's body.
"Understood." The researcher nodded again, but then said, "But My Lord, this may take a while."
……
Under the strict monitoring of high-precision instruments, every change in Molag's body was observed and recorded.
In the pure white lab, there was only the sound of mechanical limbs moving and muscles being sliced, but Molag was still unable to move.
He could only watch as the scalpel descended again and again, continuously cutting open various parts of his body to expose the changes in his muscles and bones.
The testing process didn't last long. Or rather, it was just a skill tree, so there weren't many things to test.
After finding the world origin’s ratio, it was only a trivial matter for the researchers to adjust the changes in the skill tree by changing factors such as injection speed and proportion.
It took almost no effort for the researchers to completely master operation of the skill tree, but the world origin’s influence on Molag's body was a very strange process.
Thanks to the monitoring equipment, it was possible to observe the world origin transforming via a special method. On one hand, it improved some of Molag's physical capabilities, and on the other hand, it directly stimulated his brain.
This appeared to be how skill-related memories were injected into his brain.
About half an hour later, the researchers could now freely control Molag's skill leveling, so Gu Nan ordered, "Upgrade his Divine Punishment Swordsmanship to Level 15."
Among all of Molag's current skills, the Divine Punishment Swordsmanship he just used had the highest level. In the past, he did not have the luxury to put all his skill exp into one sword skill.
One must know that Molag's skill tree also included many support skills that made daily life easier, which could greatly speed up the construction of his Divine Kingdom.
"Yes, My Lord." The head researcher immediately followed his instructions.
World origin continuously poured in, and Molag saw the skill exp display on his skill tree shooting up again.
In fact, his skill exp was already overflowing; the amount he currently held was so high that not even the skill tree could display it all. However, it wasn’t easy to use all this exp on a skill.
Leveling skills was essentially a process of strengthening Molag's body and memory. The speed of strengthening was limited by Molag himself.
"My Lord, the target's physical body is not strong enough. At Level 11, the swordsmanship has already touched upon the Unified Dao Realm, so the upgrade speed is very slow," the researcher immediately reported to Gu Nan.
"How long will it take?" Gu Nan thought for a while and asked.
"It’ll take at least half a month to reach Level 11. The subsequent level-ups may be faster."
Going from the mortal level to the greater god level was the most complicated process, but subsequent advancements were less troublesome.
"Go on then," Gu Nan ordered. Under his control, Molag could not put up further resistance, and Gu Nan could also afford to wait half a month.
On the contrary, Molag's experience began to give him some ideas.
Since origin No. 059812 could increase skill exp, could it directly increase his Evil Value as well?
After leaving the lab where Molag was located, Gu Nan walked into another lab room. There was another set of the same equipment, just without Molag.
This was a place Gu Nan prepared for himself.
Gu Nan walked into the lab, and the needle was inserted into Gu Nan's body just like Molag. The same world origin began to enter his body.
With regards to his own body, Gu Nan didn't actually need the help of instruments to see the changes clearly.
But what he didn't expect was that when this specific ratio of world origin entered his body, the first thing to change was not himself, but the Evil God Temple far away in his Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 591: The True Transmigrator
chapters.content:
Gu Nan didn’t feel much different when world origin No. 059812 entered his body, and his Evil Value also didn't change at all.
But strangely enough, the Evil God Temple connected to Gu Nan's soul starting to shine brightly due to the injection of origin.
Inside his Divine Kingdom, the Evil God Temple had always sat quietly in the center, unaffected by anything.
However, on this day, everyone in the Divine Kingdom could see an astonishing brilliance suddenly explode from the Evil God Temple’s location, dyeing the Divine Kingdom’s sky a deep blue.
The people who were originally inside the Evil God Temple were directly thrown out by a mysterious force, while the Evil God Temple itself began to shrink rapidly.
In just a minute, the Evil God Temple shrank to a very small state, then left the Divine Kingdom directly and fled towards the void.
"This is…" Red Tail happened to be inside the Divine Kingdom and couldn't help feeling dumbfounded when she saw this.
"I already notified Teacher," Yan Xiaoxiao's voice popped up beside her as her figure also appeared.
Red Tail couldn’t help sighing in relief. She knew what kind of existence Yan Xiaoxiao was. Since she was fine, the Divine Kingdom itself shouldn’t be greatly affected.
"Has His Lordship responded?" Red Tail asked again.Yan Xiaoxiao wordlessly shook her head, but there was some inexplicable worry in her eyes. The disappearance of the Evil God Temple made her feel as if something had severed part of the connection between Gu Nan and the Divine Kingdom.
Although the connection between the two was still there, it was no longer as inseparable as before.
……
Gu Nan stood in the lab, staring at the scene before him with an odd expression.
With Gu Nan's power, of course there wouldn’t be a limit to the infusion speed, and he was even the one controlling the rate of injection; the equipment only provided him with the origin.
However, while he discovered that his brain was also stimulated when the origin entered his body, the Evil Value panel did not change. Instead, the Evil God Temple mysteriously left the Divine Kingdom and came to a stop in front of him.
At this time, the Evil God Temple appeared small and exquisite. Unlike the behemoth structure that covered thousands of miles in the Divine Kingdom, it was as small as a model and could be held with one hand.
But Gu Nan could see that it was still fully equipped with everything that should be found in the Evil God Temple.
This scene wasn’t actually unfamiliar to Gu Nan. He’d seen it while playing the game in his previous life.
Once the player reaches the Third Round, the Evil God Temple will leave the Divine Kingdom and come to the player’s side, then completely shatter and become the sacrifice for the player’s advancement to the Third Round.
That scene felt like an evil ritual and seemed to symbolize the player breaking away from the Evil God Temple to become a completely independent existence.
Many players who passed the Third Round regarded this scene as a design choice to sublimate the theme of the game, but now, Gu Nan certainly knew that there must be a special meaning behind it.
The current situation was even stranger because Gu Nan hadn’t actually reached Tier 15—the critical point before the Third Round—yet, but the Evil God Temple had already appeared in advance.
In addition, although the scene before him was similar to the Third Round, the difference was that all the stats in the Evil God Temple were shooting up crazily, and the Evil Value was also completely overflowing.
The specific world origin did have an effect on Gu Nan, but this effect did not occur on him, affecting the Evil God Temple instead.
This was also the first time that the Evil Value on Gu Nan's person was inconsistent with that shown in the Evil God Temple; there was a disconnect between the two.
"Why?" Doubts appeared in Gu Nan's heart, but he didn’t take any further action and just waited for the Evil God Temple’s reaction.
The next moment, just as Gu Nan expected, the Evil God Temple shattered and turned into fragments that melted into Gu Nan's body.
The game panel in Gu Nan's mind gradually cracked until it completely shattered, and the Evil Value number in the display also split in half.
Everything was the same as the game’s Third Round, but Gu Nan could feel that he had yet to truly reach the Third Round.
‘It's still a little short… Is it because I don’t have enough Evil Value?’
This current state gave Gu Nan the feeling of having some—but not all—of the characteristics of the Third Round, but the overall amount was still a little short.
But after reaching the Third Round in advance, Gu Nan no longer had Evil Value and even lost the Evil God Temple. Without the Evil God Temple, could slaughtering gods still give Evil Value?
Gu Nan didn’t conduct any experiments for the time being and continued injecting the world origin into his body, but it had zero effect.
‘What does this mean? Don’t tell me that the true transmigrator isn’t me, but the Evil God Temple?’
This laughable thought flashed through Gu Nan's mind. It was just a joke at first, but it refused to leave once it appeared.
Because judging from the current situation, this seemed to be the answer closest to the truth.
Molag transmigrated by himself because the skill tree was integrated with him. Or rather, it was an ability that belonged to him, and the skill tree was just a way of displaying it.
Changing the display wouldn’t affect anything. It could’ve been a status panel, a library in his head, or an ability that gave skill points—it didn’t matter.
But Gu Nan was slightly different. His power actually came from the Evil God Temple. What he did in the past was to first upgrade the Evil God Temple, and then the Evil God Temple would repay him.
Of course, since the Evil God Temple had no consciousness itself and was completely controlled by Gu Nan, he didn't feel that anything was off.
Until today, when the Evil God Temple shattered due to its own laws, Gu Nan finally understood the difference.
"The world origin is the embodiment of the world’s laws. As long as there is enough power of laws, it can create anything, which naturally includes the Evil God Temple."
With Gu Nan's current realm, he already had a very in-depth understanding of the world origin.
The so-called origin could be understood as the basic energy that made up all creation. As long as the outside world gave the blueprint for an object, it could then be created using origin.
Molag's skill tree was such a blueprint. So when he obtained the Origin World’s origin, this blueprint was immediately activated and went into effect.
But without the outside world’s support, the users would somehow have to produce the Origin World’s origin themselves. Fortunately, the blueprints themselves contained ways of generating origin.
The skill tree gained skill exp by killing monsters while the Evil God Temple gained Evil Value through various methods.
As for why these kinds of blueprints would appear… The reason was very simple. These blueprints originally came from inside the Origin World. Perhaps only with the appropriate blueprint would it still work in the outside world.
In this way, perhaps Jiu Po, Daoist Yellow Springs, and the others also had these blueprints, but they might not have been able to activate them?
"One more experiment still needs to be done." After this revelation, Gu Nan immediately thought that more experimental cases were needed.
It's just that it was already too late to look for Fu Cheng now, and it would be hard to get cooperation from Daoist Yellow Springs and Jiu Po. And Lu Wen, a guy who didn’t even transmigrate naturally, wouldn’t be able to produce the answer…
After eliminating many candidates on the list, Gu Nan suddenly recalled a suitable candidate.

chapters.title: Chapter 592: System?
chapters.content:
Gu Nan's research on the Origin World progressed by leaps and bounds ever since he captured Molag.
This was especially true compared to Daoist Yellow Springs—tens of thousands of years of research and observation might not even be as useful as Gu Nan's few hours of experiments.
Of course, this could only illustrate one truth: actual practice is the sole criterion for judging truth.
With such a half-baked idea, Gu Nan quickly descended to the core of the Myriad Heavens, the Inner World created by the second-generation Saint.
The Inner World was a very special existence. It was an artificial construct whose purpose was to serve the entire Myriad Heavens.
There was an even more special fellow in the Inner World. That was the woman who also came from the Origin World but had her consciousness erased, remaining here as a puppet.
"Welcome back, my King," Zero's voice was the same as before, as if it would not change in tens of thousands of years.
Gu Nan raised his head and wordlessly looked at the glowing blue figure. He just calmly walked up to her and slowly poured a bottle of liquid into Zero's body.
This was naturally the mixed Origin World’s origin.
As a world origin, the Origin World’s origin didn’t seem that much different from the outside world’s. Moreover, the only difference was the specific ratio; it was still within the substance area code for world origins.But after it was applied to a transmigrator like Zero, strange changes occurred.
Zero's originally blue body glowed with silver light, and it seemed that some kind of ability was acting beyond her control, producing unexpected effects.
"Absorbing energy… Absorbing energy… Charging complete. The system is activating," a voice rang out in Zero's head.
"Is this… a system?" Gu Nan couldn't help laughing as he watched the silver light finally dim. With Gu Nan's current realm, the system's voice naturally couldn’t be hidden from him.
But even though the system was activated, Zero still didn't regain her consciousness. She just looked at Gu Nan again. "I will follow your orders, King."
"Detecting that the host's consciousness has been damaged. Do you want to repair it?" The system's voice sounded again, but Zero seemed like she didn’t hear it.
"Answer yes," Gu Nan made the decision for Zero.
"Yes."
"Command confirmed. System is repairing the host’s consciousness… Insufficient energy, repair failed."
When Gu Nan heard this, he immediately poured two more test tubes in.
He had nothing to worry about. With his current strength, he didn’t fear anyone at all, and only he knew the ratio of the Origin World’s origin.
"System is repairing the host’s consciousness… System is repairing the host’s consciousness… Repair successful!" After a while, a different voice finally came.
Zero’s blue energy body suddenly turned solid, becoming a real human. Her dull eyes also turned quick-witted, regarding Gu Nan warily.
"Who are you? Where am I?"
Gu Nan smiled at her. "Do you still remember who you are?"
Zero opened her mouth as if to say something, but no words came out. Finally, she shook her head in distress.
The so-called system repair was more like formatting her entire person.
"Come with me." Gu Nan shook his head and swept Zero away without another word, taking her to the lab.
A moment later, Zero also suffered the same fate as Molag. Her body was completely immobilized and connected to a wide range of instruments. The changes in her body were faithfully displayed on the screen.
"It’s very similar to the first experimental subject, My Lord," the researcher said excitedly. He had never seen such a strange situation before.
Two completely different people, but with similar and powerful abilities.
Compared to Molag, Zero's abilities were undoubtedly more comprehensive and powerful. The system on her body could perform any operation on her body and even forcibly upgrade it.
From their observations, this ability undoubtedly belonged to Zero herself, and the system was more like a product of her own imagination. At the same time, it was also the format by which this ability displayed itself.
During the experiment, through the injection of origin No. 059812, Zero's own genes could even be changed, turning her from a human into a beast, and then back again.
Of course, she could also perfectly transform into someone else.
‘In a sense, all of these transmigrators are actually the same type of mental patient,’ Gu Nan concluded.
But he knew that he did not belong to this category—because the Evil God Temple really did exist. It even had the ability to create things out of thin air; the equipment he used in earlier years was not fake.
‘But I also came from the Origin World, so what's the difference between me and these transmigrators?’ Gu Nan frowned again in thought.
He did not doubt the origin of his soul. Not only because of his memory, but also because his body was affected by his soul, causing his current appearance to actually approach that of his previous life.
These details all proved that Gu Nan's soul really did come from Earth, but he did not have a transmigrator’s characteristics. To put it another way, the characteristics of a transmigrator that originally should have belonged to him instead appeared on the Evil God Temple.
"Continue supplying her with origin." Gu Nan had some conjectures, though they weren’t verified yet. "Adjust her body’s composition to laws."
"Yes!" the researcher responded vigorously. He knew what he was doing—he could very well be witnessing the first man-made Unified Dao cultivator!
……
"He took Zero away." Yu Lian's voice sounded a little heavy, "What exactly do you guys want to do?"
Sitting in front of her was Jiu Po, a figure who stood at the top of the Myriad Heavens for a long time. At this time, his face looked a little lonely.
"Previously, we wanted to find a place." Jiu Po smiled helplessly. "But now, not even I know what he wants."
Even though they watched Gu Nan grow into a behemoth at an incredible speed, no one thought he could surpass them, not even Jiu Po himself.
People would always make mistakes when they were also a piece on the board.
Unfortunately, they didn’t have much time to respond. In just the blink of an eye, Gu Nan was already invincible.
Yu Lian was quiet for a while. "It's not without reason that he wants Song Fei to make a defensive weapon."
They were all familiar with Gu Nan's style. If it wasn't out of necessity, Gu Nan wouldn't stop at all, let alone require any defensive magic weapon.
The fact that Gu Nan started thinking about defense meant he now had a fatal flaw.
Jiu Po glanced at her. "You want to strike first?"
"This is self-defense!" Yu Lian slammed her hand into the table. "He’s a lunatic! If we don't kill him, we’ll all die at his hands sooner or later!"
She regretted not believing the Evil God story when Austin came to her door back then.
Of course, it wasn’t that she didn’t believe in the Evil God's cruelty and bloodthirst. Rather, she didn’t believe in the Evil God's power. Anyone who could walk to Unified Dao would think the same.
But now that the facts were before her eyes, she couldn't help but believe it.
Jiu Po stood up and slowly left without expressing his attitude.
"If you lose, you’ll die. Have you made up your mind?" His voice reached Yu Lian's ears.
Yu Lian's gaze was calm. "At the very least, I need to try."

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Heart Protector
chapters.content:
Back then, Xue Ren was called "the person closest to Unified Dao". Some people even claimed he could enter Unified Dao whenever he wanted.
Although Xue Ren was already dead, he did confirm the second half of that claim. When he wanted to break through to Unified Dao, the obstacles that seemed exceedingly difficult to others couldn’t stump him at all.
But now, it seemed that even the former Xue Ren could not get the title of "closest to Unified Dao", because this title could only belong to Zero.
Zero was only one step away from Unified Dao Realm before the second-generation Saint sealed her. But now that Gu Nan reactivated her system, she didn’t encounter any setbacks in her breakthrough.
For Zero, as long as she had enough of the Origin World’s origin, she could easily advance.
Time passed one day at a time, and Gu Nan stood in the lab, watching Zero and Molag being continuously infused with origin and then strengthened.
However, this process wasn’t fast. Due to the two’s physical limitations, the infusion speed could not be increased.
This limitation was not dependent on their strength, but on the fact that their "blueprints" were not strong enough and were already operating at max capacity.
A message from Song Fei quickly came, notifying Gu Nan that the defensive magic weapon had been refined and asking him to go to Academic Heaven to pick it up.
So Gu Nan stood up and said to the researcher here, "Move the entire lab into the Divine Kingdom. Continue to inject origin. Notify me immediately if abnormalities occur."Everyone agreed in unison, and only then did Gu Nan leave the lab, glancing at Zero and Molag before departing.
If everyone who came from the Origin World had a unique "blueprint", then wouldn't the Origin World be worthy of the name "world of cheats"?
Gu Nan shook his head. More examples were needed to prove this.
……
Reconstruction of Academic Heaven also started not long ago, but its progress was clearly faster than Three Buddha Heaven.
Gu Nan stepped foot into Song Fei's residence, and all the barriers, formations, and alarms the latter recently set up again… were triggered.
For a while, the entire Academic Heaven was in disarray. Gu Nan's behavior—which completely lacked any of the dignity expected of a powerhouse—almost made Song Fei’s eyes pop out of his head.
Even for a normal Unified Dao cultivator, these things weren’t all that impressive and could easily be avoided.
But the next second, these alarms disappeared without a trace. It wasn’t that Song Fei voluntarily turned them off. Rather, they were directly stamped out by Gu Nan’s foot, leaving no trace behind.
Song Fei secretly rolled his eyes. This wasn’t the first time he witnessed Gu Nan's unpredictable behavior, so he just pretended nothing happened. Anyhow, it wasn't a big deal.
"Old Song, you sure are efficient!" Gu Nan calculated the time and found that it took exactly three months—no more and no less—which was the minimum time needed according to Song Fei.
Song Fei was already immune to this form of address. He shook his head and took out a small mirror, handing it to Gu Nan. "This is merely a half-finished product."
"Oh?" Gu Nan studied the round mirror. The bright mirror surface was as smooth as ice, but the frame was covered with mysterious formation runes, exuding a majestic, ancient aura.
This wasn’t surprising. Song Fei himself was someone who lived from ancient times to the present.
The mortal world’s so-called long-lost "ancient techniques" were actually quite commonplace for these Unified Dao existences; these techniques were not lost at all.
What Gu Nan wanted was a heart protector. Of course, a heart protector didn’t necessarily have to protect the heart. For example, Gu Nan originally wanted to use it to protect his abdomen and block attacks to the Stigma of Life and Death.
Although the current him already reached the Third Round, his Evil Value hadn’t reached that threshold yet. Not even Gu Nan had seen this kind of bizarre situation before.
So right now, he also didn't know whether the Stigma of Life and Death was still effective on him, but with Gu Nan's usual caution, there was nothing wrong with being prepared.
When Song Fei saw him playing with the round mirror and seemingly satisfied with it, he said with a sigh, "Fa Kong's śarīra is very powerful, but I can only channel a part of its power."
"If this weapon is to be completely refined… It may take over two hundred years." Song Fei looked at Gu Nan.
Gu Nan didn’t doubt that. Taking hundreds of years to refine a magic weapon was perfectly normal for Unified Dao cultivators. On the contrary, completing something in three months was unheard of.
"What are the flaws of this half-finished product?" He asked bluntly.
"The intensity of the attacks it can withstand is not as strong as the finished product. In addition, after withstanding three excessively powerful attacks, the mirror will become worn-out, and you will have to bring it back to me for repair," Song Fei explained while pointing at the mirror.
Gu Nan could make out three long formation lines on the frame at the position Song Fei pointed to, which were clearly connected to the inside of the round mirror.
"That's enough." Gu Nan nodded and casually placed the mirror on his abdomen. Being able to withstand three attacks was enough for him to do a lot of things.
As soon as the mirror was pressed against Gu Nan's body, the three lines began to emit a faint glow, but strangely, the three colors were different.
One black, one white, one green.
The next instant, Gu Nan suddenly raised his head and tore off the mirror that was close to his abdomen. For some reason, the suction force attached to the protective mirror was incredibly strong, even tearing off a section of his flesh along with it.
Although the wound swiftly recovered, Gu Nan had already realized what just happened.
"Yu Lian." Gu Nan raised his head to look at the green light in front of him.
In front of Gu Nan, Song Fei's figure had already disappeared without a trace. In any case, his astral world had just been rebuilt, so he wouldn’t feel bad even if it was destroyed again. Only the three different rays of light remained, landing on the ground and turning into three figures.
The green light was none other than Yu Lian herself, and the white and black rays of light were Austin and Daisy, who’d descended from the World of Gods.
In order to deal with Gu Nan, Yu Lian actually chose to join forces with the two greater gods. Consequently, even if they succeeded in killing Gu Nan now, the Myriad Heavens may still face tremendous pressure from the war.
But Yu Lian also knew that if Gu Nan didn’t die, then the pressure would not only come from the battlefield, but also from life and death.
In the past, Dream Immortal teamed up with three Unified Dao powers to similarly ambush Gu Nan. Yu Lian’s current formation wasn’t any weaker.
She not only found two top-tier greater gods, but also took advantage of the defensive magic weapon that Gu Nan wanted to plant a trap and made some changes to the magic weapon in advance.
This heart protector had no defensive function at all. As long as Gu Nan tried to activate it, the mirror would automatically stick to Gu Nan's body and start transmitting power over.
The power transmitted naturally came from Yu Lian and the greater gods.
It could be said that as long as Gu Nan reacted even a tiny bit slower just now, the combined power from the three’s attacks would hit the Stigma of Life and Death.
"What a pity," Yu Lian lamented coldly. Failing to hit the stigma during their sneak attack brought both sides back to the same starting line. Now, everything will still be decided by strength.
"The survival of the two worlds depends on today," Austin said heavily.
If Gu Nan couldn’t be killed today, that meant the three of them would most likely die here, and the world would fall into the hands of this Evil God from now on.

chapters.title: Chapter 594: Light and Shadow
chapters.content:
The safety of both worlds was at stake in this decisive battle!
The three had no intention of saying anything else and attacked Gu Nan simultaneously. The target they chose was very consistent. It was none other than Gu Nan's Stigma of Life and Death!
Having already communicated with Austin and Daisy, Yu Lian certainly also knew the stigma’s significance, and her attacks were even fiercer than those two’s.
If the two greater gods still had a slim chance of survival even if they lost here, then she would most certainly be doomed to death, possibly even dragging the entire Void Grotto Heaven down with her.
‘Void Grotto Heaven, which has been passed down for 100,000 years, must not be destroyed in my hands!’
There was a look of madness in Yu Lian's eyes, but her Daoist techniques remained steadfast without a hint of panic, ever-changing in its unpredictability. A Daoist talisman suddenly turned into a long blade and slashed at the Stigma of Life and Death.
This talisman looked familiar to Gu Nan. The talisman used by Daoist Lingyang in the past to kill the God of Tenebrosity was somewhat similar to this one.
‘Sure enough, the inheritance Daoist Lingyang received is related to Void Grotto Heaven.’
To think Gu Nan still had time to indulge in idle thoughts, even at such a critical time. It could only be said that for someone in his realm, the speed of their thoughts was incomprehensibly fast.
Yu Lian's blade was the first to land with inexplicable sharpness and domineering spirit, directly hitting Gu Nan's body.The Dao was the blade; the blade was the Dao.
Unfortunately, Gu Nan was too perceptive to the rhythm of battle. He simply turned slightly to the side, and the blade containing the Heavenly Dao missed the Stigma of Life and Death and only slashed his waist.
The Blade of Providence sliced off a piece of flesh from Gu Nan's waist, but he recovered instantly. Gu Nan could completely ignore attacks of this level.
But Yu Lian’s original intention was simply to force Gu Nan to dodge. Almost as soon as Gu Nan moved, Austin's holy sword headed directly for the stigma.
Though Daisy struck later, her attack arrived first. The law of darkness condensed in the void, and a strange black light appeared directly near the mark.
Unlike Austin and Yu Lian, Daisy's power was more secretive and unfathomable, and also purer.
Even Austin had to rely on the holy sword in order to gather enough power to trigger the stigma, but Daisy could do the same just by materializing laws out of thin air.
In a sense, she was more troublesome and more dangerous than Austin.
A dark vortex appeared, and Gu Nan reacted extremely swiftly. The left side of his body quickly turned into laws, and the position of the Stigma of Life and Death shifted so that the dark vortex only hit the law of shadows.
But after this exchange, Austin had already closed the distance to Gu Nan. The holy sword in his hand turned and thrust directly at the Stigma of Life and Death. Gu Nan finally had no way to dodge.
Be it Yu Lian or Daisy, everything they did was to pave the way for Austin's strike.
Their aim was to force Gu Nan into an unavoidable situation and have Austin deal the final blow!
Gu Nan suddenly froze his body, and his right hand—which hadn’t turned into laws—instantly curled into a fist and swung out, hitting Austin hard in the face.
Austin's whole body splintered into pieces, but the holy sword continued its swift trajectory forward, seemingly about to pierce the Stigma of Life and Death.
But right then, Gu Nan suddenly pressed down with one hand and grabbed the holy sword. Although holy flames immediately ignited his body and his palms even showed signs of being assimilated by the holy light, he ultimately managed to block the attack.
Daisy was slightly taken aback. Gu Nan's decisiveness was somewhat beyond her expectations, but her response definitely wasn’t slow either. The dark vortex reappeared instantly.
Yu Lian once again activated the Blade of Providence and shouted loudly, "Don't give him a chance to breathe—"
However, before she could finish, she saw Gu Nan's figure flicker, a fist blazing with holy flames suddenly heading for her.
Yu Lian was so startled that she could only raise the Blade of Providence to block. Unfortunately, even Austin couldn't take Gu Nan's punch head-on.
The Blade of Province was smashed to pieces in an instant. Not even the Heavenly Dao could stop Gu Nan. Instead, a golden scale slowly appeared above Yu Lian's head.
Nothing was placed on either end of the scale. Instead, when it appeared, Yu Lian herself was directly taken away and placed on one end of the scale.
The person standing before Gu Nan was suddenly replaced by Austin. It was an Austin who just reconstructed his divine body and appeared in front of Gu Nan.
Figures like Austin wouldn’t lose out to anyone else when it came to flexible usage of their powers.
Speaking of which, Gu Nan had already shattered his divine body no less than three or four times, but Austin still seemed completely unaffected and was still surging with power.
He truly earned the title of “King of Gods”.
Austin raised his holy sword and blocked Gu Nan for an instant. Then his figure suddenly drifted away, having no intention of engaging in a direct confrontation as he thrust his sword directly at the Stigma of Life and Death.
Austin's swordsmanship style was clearly from the World of Gods, which was mainly focusing on thrusts and stabs. It was as different as can be from the Myriad Heavens’ swordsmanship, but it was very effective.
Such a stab might not have been lethal enough in the past, but now, it was an excellent way to trigger the Stigma of Life and Death.
Gu Nan didn't want to verify whether his Third Round was the real thing, so much so that even now, he still hadn’t revealed his true power after reaching the Third Round. He was waiting for an opportunity.
An opportunity to decide the outcome of the battle in one fell swoop.
The opportunity Gu Nan was waiting for soon arrived. Daisy took advantage of Gu Nan's retreat to suddenly make the dark vortex surge with power—her true body finally revealed itself, personally controlling the vortex to raise its power to the max.
She also didn't care about herself, determined to not give Gu Nan a chance to breathe even if she had to lose a divine body in the process.
However, what she didn't expect was that the moment the two made contact, the shadows that seemed to be born from the abyss erupted forth.
Daisy, who’d always been the one devouring others with endless darkness, experienced the feeling of being devoured for the first time. The shadows practically enveloped her completely. The darkness could only peek out an inch from her body, and even then, it would still immediately be assimilated and devoured.
"This is…" She’d never seen a law with such a strange effect before, not even from Austin. This was a completely different level of power.
If the peak of the Second Round was becoming one with a law and becoming the incarnation of that law, then after the Third Round, Gu Nan himself was commanding the law.
He no longer took the place of the law’s will, but was instead ordering the law with his own will, able to change it however he wanted.
If Gu Nan was the one complying with the nature of shadows and constantly adjusting himself to adapt to shadows in the earlier realms, then now, he could manifest shadows in any way, shape, or form.
Daisy felt this clearly.
"This isn’t shadow! What kind of power is this?!" The Dark Lady roared loudly.
She’d never seen such domineering shadows before. This power of rapid assimilation was practically the same as… Austin's law of light!
It was similarly highly invasive and possessed the power to assimilate almost everything. However, Gu Nan's shadow was more active and powerful.
All this happened in an instant. Austin and Yu Lian didn't even have time to react. They only heard Daisy’s shout, after which the law of darkness was instantly annihilated.
Yu Lian stared at this scene blankly and murmured, "It's over…"
Austin's face, which was always as calm as water, had the same ugly expression.
Even if Daisy didn’t die from this blow, she would probably still lose most of her combat power.
But what was even more frightening was that no one was capable of opposing the Evil God anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 595: Destroying Dao
chapters.content:
The law of shadows started turning back into Gu Nan's body, which soon returned to its original shape and reappeared in front of Austin and Yu Lian.
He completely destroyed Daisy earlier, and even now, she still hadn’t managed to reassemble her divine body. It was apparent that the attack at the law level dealt severe damage to her.
The three’s previous strategy of not giving Gu Nan a chance to breathe was completely crushed.
Yu Lian was experiencing a major shock while Austin remained silent. The battle seemed to reach a stalemate.
Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry to attack. He was comparing the differences between his "pseudo-Third Round" and the real Third Round, in terms of both laws and the Evil God physique.
In his past life, Gu Nan transmigrated as soon as he reached the Third Round and never personally experienced how powerful the Third Round was. However, he wasn’t the first player to reach the Third Round. At any rate, he’d also seen other people's game videos.
In comparison, it was true that his current state could not be considered the true Third Round. At the very least, the strength of the Evil God physique was far from the Third Round’s level. However, his laws did reveal some indication of the Third Round’s power.
Now, Gu Nan's shadows could be controlled freely and could even exhibit the properties of other laws. He could change its characteristics with a single thought.
In terms of level, even though he hadn’t reached the true Third Round yet, he’d still surpassed Tier 15 slightly, which was enough to suppress Austin, Daisy, and Yu Lian.
The Evil God physique, on the other hand, wasn’t much different from its pre-Third Round state, which gave Gu Nan some vague conjectures.Perhaps at his current stage, the strength of the Evil God physique was no longer determined by level, but by Evil Value.
This phenomenon was inconsistent with his past situation. Perhaps it was because the Evil God Temple shattered?
Gu Nan also didn't know the answer. The current him had gradually embarked on an unprecedented path, so much so that no one in this world even knew what the path after Tier 15 looked like.
For now, Gu Nan would have to explore and develop that path by himself.
Gu Nan's thoughts gradually returned to the present, and his gaze landed on Austin and Yu Lian again.
The next second, shadows surpassing their understanding emerged and quickly eroded the space around the two. Be it holy light or Daoist techniques, they both quickly disintegrated when coming into contact with the shadows.
Under Gu Nan's control, the shadows gained the characteristics of both light and darkness. It could assimilate and devour at the same time, swiftly defeating the enemy while simultaneously strengthening itself. It could be described as "invincible".
But for Austin and Yu Lian, the situation took a turn for the worse.
Daisy was critically wounded by Gu Nan's sudden attack, which greatly reduced the threat they posed to Gu Nan. With merely Austin and Yu Lian working together, it would be almost impossible to hit the Stigma of Life and Death.
Faced with the shadows that were quickly surrounding him, Austin glanced at Yu Lian beside him. When he saw her only barely holding on, he couldn't help sighing in his mind.
Then he waved his holy sword, and an enormous amount of holy light gathered, cutting open a path through the shadows as he tried to return to the World of Gods.
Gu Nan just cast him a glance. Immediately afterwards, his figure flickered slightly and reappeared directly in front of Austin, blocking his way.
The law of shadows was akin to maggots gnawing at bone, wrapping around the holy sword and making it hard for Austin to even swing the sword.
The next instant, Gu Nan's punch reached Austin's chest. Ensnared in shadows, this Greater God of Light couldn’t even put up any effective resistance as his body was instantly blown apart.
The current Austin—who used to be the strongest in both worlds—was no longer a match for Gu Nan.
If not for wanting to deal with Austin in the shortest possible time, Gu Nan could even use laws to cause more damage to Austin.
And after Austin was beaten back, Yu Lian was the only one left before Gu Nan.
But once things reached this point, the leader of Void Grotto Heaven actually turned calm.
She simply gave up on resisting and allowed the shadows to capture her. "Gu Nan, I’m willing to hand over the position of Star Ruler of Void Grotto Heaven. You can—"
"Don’t need it." Gu Nan stepped forward and clamped a hand around her neck. Countless shadows poured in from her seven orifices, almost assimilating her whole body into shadows.
In a one-on-one fight, Yu Lian would undoubtedly be completely suppressed by Gu Nan.
Her law realm wasn’t as high as Gu Nan's to begin with, and none of her Daoist techniques had any effect on Gu Nan. In addition, she was still heavily injured, so it could be said that she had no chance of winning.
Once even Void Grotto Heaven failed to pique Gu Nan's interest, Yu Lian had lost all value.
Gu Nan was determined to kill her this time. He would first clear out all resistance in the Myriad Heavens, then deal with the remaining greater gods. Only then would he be able to conduct his own experiments in peace.
Gathering the power of both worlds to research the secrets of the Origin World—this was Gu Nan's goal.
Yu Lian bore the influx of the law of shadows, unable to use any of her laws. She realized that if things continued like this, even her own laws would probably be washed away.
Having no other alternative, she could only use her power to detonate this body, sending countless fragments of her power through the void in all directions.
Self-detonation was already a very helpless choice for a Unified Dao powerhouse.
Because the disorderly law explosion could only cause a shockwave. The power was far less than that of a normal attack, so it was an extremely inefficient method.
Gu Nan slowly walked out of the void. The shockwave and lingering power from Yu Lian's self-destruction naturally had no effect on him.
He didn't have any intention of delaying and arrived in Void Grotto Heaven in one step. The shadows behind him flared up again, quickly erasing everything in Void Grotto Heaven.
This astral world, which was the core of the Heaven Realm in ancient times and the origin of Daoism in the present, fared no better than a normal astral world in the face of Gu Nan's shadows.
Countless Daoist priests died, and some even died inexplicably while in closed-door cultivation. Even until their deaths, they didn’t know what just happened.
Perhaps they were all high and mighty enlightened Daoists once upon a time, but everyone was equal in the face of death.
"Master! Sect Master!" A disciple stumbled into the temple, only to see Yu Lian sitting on the praying mat, staring blankly at the sky.
"Master, the elders…"
"I know." Yu Lian sighed softly. "If it can help the Daoist Sect survive this calamity, anything is fine."
The disciple’s eyes couldn't help but redden slightly. "But…"
Of course he knew what the elders were going to do.
An external enemy was invading their astral world, but the Sect Master could only imprison herself here while the elders went forth to plead with the enemy in order to beg for the sect’s continued survival…
This was humiliating!
‘Is there nobody in this enormous Void Grotto Heaven who can take the lead?’
The Daoist disciple couldn't help but feel the blood all over his body boiling with anger. He wished he could immediately become a Star Ruler and rush out to destroy that powerful enemy.
However, the next second, boundless shadows instantly swept across the entire hall. This disciple couldn’t even say anything before his whole person turned into ashes.
But Yu Lian just watched all of this blankly, without any reaction at all, and even allowed the shadows to invade the Daoist temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 596: The Disgrace of All Transmigrators
chapters.content:
Gu Nan stood in the sky above Void Grotto Heaven, indifferently gazing at all the living beings below while the shadows continued their onslaught.
Fully destroying Void Grotto Heaven was a plan Gu Nan established long ago, so that decision wouldn’t be easily changed by external factors.
He’d always acted without any care for others, and after reaching his current realm, there were even fewer people who could influence him.
But just when Gu Nan was carrying out his plan, three figures slowly floated into the air. They were two men and one woman, all dressed as Daoist priests.
Of the two men, there was one old and one young. The young man had a fair appearance. His height only reached Gu Nan's waist, but the expression on his face was calm and collected, unlike that of a child.
The old man looked like he had one foot in the grave. His whole person looked haggard, as if he was about to die any second.
The woman was even weirder. She was clearly dressed as a simple Daoist nun, and her expression was also calm and solemn, but she had an inexplicable seductive charm. This didn't seem to be something she did intentionally. Rather, she seemed to naturally exude such an aura.
To be honest, it was really rare to see such a Daoist nun in the peaceful Void Grotto Heaven.
The leader of the three was the old man. He came up to Gu Nan and gave a deep bow. "This old Daoist, Shu Huan, greets Your Excellency. Please have mercy."
This was a rare occurrence where Gu Nan didn't directly punch the opponent to death—because the old Daoist priest was holding something in his hand.It was an open scroll with four names written on it: Jiu Po, Daoist Yellow Springs, Snow Mountain Ascetic, as well as… Gu Nan.
To know of Daoist Yellow Springs’ existence and to list him together with Jiu Po and Gu Nan, it was clear that Void Grotto Heaven—the leader of the Myriad Heavens—did indeed know something.
However, even though he didn’t attack them, the shadows were still rapidly invading all directions.
The woman couldn't help speaking up hastily, "Your Excellency, please stop. Our Void Grotto Heaven has countless scrolls recording ancient secrets and also has—"
Gu Nan interrupted coldly, "I have no interest in ancient times. What right do those old farts who died in the river of time have to make me waste time learning about them?"
Having a long history has never been a big deal. How powerful Void Grotto Heaven’s ancestors were was none of Gu Nan's business.
If not for the four names in Shu Huan's hands, he wouldn't even have given the three a chance to speak.
His eyes shifted to the old Daoist, Shu Huan, and asked in a low voice, "Who is the Snow Mountain Ascetic?"
It was merely a casual question; Gu Nan didn't really care whether the other party answered or not. Of course it would be best if they were willing to answer. But if they weren’t willing to answer, then he would simply look for the answer after slaughtering all of Void Grotto Heaven.
However, this Daoist Shu Huan looked very honest and quickly explained, "The Snow Mountain Ascetic died 23,000 years ago. Records of his life, experience, and history are all in Void Grotto Heaven. Your Excellency, please follow this old Daoist to have a look. "
The child-like Daoist priest also spoke at this time, but his voice sounded very aged, carrying the hoarseness of a middle-aged man.
"As long as Your Excellency can allow Void Grotto Heaven a sliver of survival, Yu Lian can be yours to deal with." While he said this, he even glanced at the woman next to him. "The same goes for her older sister, Yu Luo."
Only then did Gu Nan learn that this woman was actually Yu Lian's older sister. While he did hear people mention Yu Lian having a sister before, he'd never seen her.
When Yu Luo heard this, she couldn't help turning around in shock with a somewhat dazed stare filled with bewilderment. Clearly, this was not within the scope of their previous agreement.
Gu Nan's gaze paused on them for a while. The shadows’ invasion finally stopped, and all the shadows in the sky withdrew behind Gu Nan.
"Take me to the information on the Snow Mountain Ascetic," Gu Nan told Daoist Shu Huan.
Daoist Shu Huan bowed again, then turned and led Gu Nan away.
……
In the Daoist Sect’s grand temple, Gu Nan stood in front of a bookshelf dozens of stories high, flipping through a file in his hand.
This was originally the residence of Daoist Sect’s sect master, but now that Yu Lian already lost that position, this temple temporarily belonged to Gu Nan.
It wasn’t that he had any interest in the Daoist Sect. It’s just that all the information he wanted was here.
After he finished reading one file, Gu Nan casually put it aside. The file automatically floated to a certain location on the bookshelf, and another file appeared out of thin air in Gu Nan's hand.
All these documents were related to the Snow Mountain Ascetic.
The Snow Mountain Ascetic’s surname was Wang, but his real name had already been lost in time. The world only knew that he liked to call himself the Snow Mountain Ascetic. He even called his residence the Snow Mountain Residence and established a small sect called the Snow Mountain Sect.
But it was precisely such a person who had a special fondness for "Snow Mountain" who showed amazing foresight as soon as he appeared.
