Be it his judgment of situations or his understanding of various martial arts, they were both far superior to that of ordinary people. More importantly, he once made predictions about major events in the Myriad Heavens and even profited from them.
After this kind of behavior happened many times, Void Grotto Heaven began to take special note of him.
In Gu Nan's eyes, this person was clearly the same type of person as Molag. Their behavioral trajectories were too similar.
But the strange thing was that this Snow Mountain Ascetic did not survive. He didn’t even get to become a Star Ruler and actually died in a small world.
"He’s simply the disgrace of all transmigrators," Gu Nan couldn't help shaking his head and muttering to himself.
But once he read further, Gu Nan also realized that this was not entirely the Snow Mountain Ascetic’s fault. It’s just that this person was a little too unlucky.
He hadn’t even reached Void Cutter Realm yet when he died and wasn’t even qualified to leave that small world, but he unexpectedly ran into a fight between two foreign visitors.
The two Star Rulers fought inside that small plane. The battlefield was very close to Snow Mountain Sect, and the Snow Mountain Ascetic died because of this.
‘If he’s truly a transmigrator with knowledge of history, he should know that it’s absolutely impossible for him to oppose Star Rulers at that time.’
‘If that's the case, why did he insist on staying in the sect instead of temporarily retreating?’ Gu Nan had some doubts in his mind, but he then thought of a possibility.
Sure enough, Daoist Shu Huan piped up from the side, "Although the Snow Mountain Ascetic died in that battle, his Snow Mountain Sect survived and remains there to this day."
"Is there anything strange about it?" Gu Nan raised an eyebrow.
"Yes." Daoist Shu Huan nodded. "There is a building in the Snow Mountain Sect that has not decayed for over 20,000 years. If Snow Mountain Sect disciples enter it, they will get a special fortuitous encounter."
No matter what the so-called fortuitous encounter was, the mere fact of enduring for 20,000 years was enough to confirm Gu Nan’s suspicions.
This power must be from the Origin World’s origin!
Not even Jiu Po and Daoist Yellow Springs noticed such a weak Snow Mountain Ascetic, but Void Grotto Heaven did.
Moreover, Void Grotto Heaven didn't even know where Gu Nan and the others came from, let alone the existence of the Origin World. They simply noticed the strange circumstances surrounding these transmigrators and felt these people were connected in some way.
As the leader of the Myriad Heavens, Void Grotto Heaven had an astronomical amount of information. After rigorous analysis and comparison, it wasn’t difficult to come up with such a conclusion.
So Gu Nan patted Shu Huan on the shoulder and commented, "Big data sure is reliable."

chapters.title: Chapter 597: Snow Mountain Sect’s Fortuitous Encounter
chapters.content:
Void Grotto Heaven may not know what big data was, but this didn’t stop them from using it.
Their metaphysical technology had sufficient computing power and the means to collect information, so the analysis and organization of such information was a matter of course.
Jiu Po and Daoist Yellow Springs likely also understood this, but they knew the Origin World must be kept a secret, so they didn’t want to delegate this part of the work to others.
And it was inevitable for things to slip through the cracks if only one person was trying to analyze big data.
Gu Nan was still checking information on the Snow Mountain Ascetic. He’d always been very patient with people suspected of being transmigrators and refused to overlook any details.
Gu Nan seemed to be the only one left in the entire Daoist temple. It wasn't until he read all the information that he realized Yu Lian was standing in front of him.
At this time, Yu Lian was not wearing her usual Daoist robes. Instead, she had changed into normal clothes, but her eyes were as calm as ever.
Gu Nan stared at her somewhat curiously. It wasn’t that he didn't understand Void Grotto Heaven’s intentions. Be it a hostage or a trophy, handing over Yu Lian was an inevitable result.
What made Gu Nan curious was that Yu Lian's current aura was very weak. It was far from her normal Tier 14 realm, even having almost fallen below Unified Dao.
This was a very bizarre thing—because even if their astral world was destroyed, the Star Ruler’s own realm still wouldn’t be greatly affected. They would only lose the source of their power, making it harder to recover.At the same time, it was almost impossible for a Star Ruler who lost their astral world to advance any further—unless their astral world was rebuilt.
But Void Grotto Heaven was clearly still fine, and Yu Lian was only slightly injured. How could her realm have fallen so much?
As if she saw Gu Nan's question, Yu Lian’s lips curled into a faint smile. "My Void Grotto Heaven has been passed down for many generations, and the astral world has always been intact. Do you know where the past Star Rulers went?"
This was indeed quite strange. For a Unified Dao powerhouse, it was almost impossible for the astral world to remain intact while the Star Ruler fell.
Because to kill a Unified Dao cultivator, one must first erase that person’s astral world, just like how Austin and the others destroyed God Emperor Heaven before.
Gu Nan thought for a while and guessed, "Could it be that you guys always hand over your Star Ruler every time you can’t defeat someone?"
Yu Lian was slightly taken aback, then said speechlessly, "You’re the first person in ten thousand years to force the Daoist Sect to hand its sect master over."
As if to prevent Gu Nan from getting any more strange ideas, Yu Lian simply took the initiative to explain, "The Daoist Sect has its own unique inheritance. Since my ancestor, there has never been a Star Ruler who reigned for 100,000 years."
As she spoke, she placed one hand on the bookshelf next to her, and a scroll automatically appeared in her hand in accordance with her will.
Gu Nan took the scroll from Yu Lian and looked down at it. It was actually secured with a golden rope. In the past, this was the highest level of confidentiality, and only the sect master could view it.
Besides the sect master—who had a special method to open it—no one else could open this golden rope.
"Can you open it?" Gu Nan asked Yu Lian, shaking the scroll in his hand.
"I’m no longer the sect master." Yu Lian shook her head.
"Oh," Gu Nan responded, then gave it a casual tug, and the golden rope immediately broke.
Yu Lian was already used to these kinds of situations, but she couldn't help rolling her eyes while subconsciously moving away from Gu Nan.
She was no longer the Star Ruler of Void Grotto Heaven. Perhaps Gu Nan could make her body crumble if he just poked her.
Gu Nan quickly skimmed through the scroll. It was handwritten by one of the Daoist Sect's sect masters, and this sect master was none other than the founder of Void Grotto Heaven.
According to history, this sect master should be the one who took away the Heaven Realm’s core when the ancient Three Realms collapsed, which became today’s Void Grotto Heaven.
If Gu Nan remembered correctly, his Daoist name should be Miao Xu.
Daoist Miao Xu was a true genius. It only took him two or three hundred years to become a Saint. He also turned the tide of the Myriad Heavens when it was in a crisis and single-handedly created the overall structure of the Myriad Heavens.
From the fragmentation of the Three Realms to the Inner World, to the inheritance of Void Grotto Heaven, his shadow was present in all kinds of events.
But the content in this handwritten scroll was very strange.
He first described in great detail a method of inheritance that could pass on Unified Dao Realm enlightenment, but the price was that this kind of enlightenment would not last long.
It was precisely because of this that every generation of Void Grotto Heaven's sect master couldn’t keep that role for longer than a hundred thousand years, and most of them were forced to pass down their positions after ten thousand years.
This method seemed to have quite a few flaws, but considering the difficulty of ascending to Unified Dao, it was already quite good.
It could practically guarantee a Unified Dao cultivator protecting the astral world at all times, unlike some astral worlds that would directly fall out of the ranks of Unified Dao during the inheritance process.
And after such a lengthy explanation came the real content, which was that Daoist Miao Xu himself was going to die soon, and the person who injured him was someone Gu Nan was very familiar with.
It was Jiu Po.
"Jiu Po’s destiny is difficult to divine. His fate seems to have appeared out of thin air. He has no past and no future. Future generations must remain wary of him," these were Daoist Miao Xu’s exact words.
Gu Nan knew very well how Jiu Po came to be and gradually connected the dots in his head.
He originally thought it would end here, but he didn't expect to see Miao Xu leave such a sentence at the end after a series of emotional laments.
"The loss of the Earth Realm is indeed due to a variable outside of this world. I regret not listening to Junior Martial Brother's words!"
Gu Nan raised his head to look at Yu Lian. "Who’s the junior martial brother he’s talking about?"
"You know him too." It seemed as if a burden had been taken off of Yu Lian’s shoulders, and she fiddled with her hair with a relaxed expression. "Daoist Yin Yang, my great-martial uncle who left the Daoist Sect back then because of the Jiu Po incident. In other words, the current Lu Wen."
Something strange flashed through Gu Nan's eyes, as if he understood something, and he suddenly closed the scroll in his hand.
"Take me to see the small plane where the Snow Mountain Ascetic resided."
……
In a small plane, Gu Nan and Yu Lian walked side by side and stopped in front of a barren mountain.
This was the former stronghold of the Snow Mountain Sect. Of course, it was the same now as well, but there were only small fries left in the sect, which had experienced an extreme decline.
However, although the current Snow Mountain Sect only had a few disciples, there were many tourists. Even the sect's ability to survive for this long was largely thanks to… collecting admission fees.
The strange structure that was still perfectly intact after 20,000 years was very attractive to many cultivators, and some even joined the Snow Mountain Sect just for that fortuitous encounter.
"What kind of fortuitous encounter does that structure provide?" Gu Nan casually asked.
"It varies." Yu Lian clearly also knew a little about this. "Some people received pills, some received weapons or skill manuals, and one person even received a pet spirit beast."

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Last Resort
chapters.content:
The Snow Mountain Sect’s building was indeed a famous attraction far and wide, attracting many tourists.
However, for the sect that owned such a miraculous building to have neither developed into a major sect nor been coveted by other major sects for 20,000 years, the problems with this were also obvious.
To put it bluntly, most of the items provided by that building were of low quality, and very few even reached Prodigious Realm. Moreover, only three people could use the structure every day, so very few people were tempted.
On the other hand, the Snow Mountain Sect's territory was extremely remote, and there were no developable resources around it, so even the major sects had no interest in this place.
"Looks like this building can’t be moved," Gu Nan stood in front of the so-called "Fortuitous Encounters Hall" and said flatly.
Because the rumors about fortuitous encounters were so deeply rooted in the people’s hearts, the Snow Mountain Sect simply named this hall the "Fortuitous Encounters Hall".
"That's natural." Yu Lian said with a smile, "With the power level of this small world’s inhabitants, they can't even destroy it."
The two were chatting as if nobody else was around. A few tourists occasionally passed by, but they walked straight past Gu Nan and Yu Lian, as if they couldn't see these two at all.
Gu Nan slowly entered the Fortuitous Encounters Hall, only to see a huge statue of a Daoist Venerable in the center, with three praying mats underneath.
Two of them were already turned over, and a person was worshiping respectfully on the last one. After kneeling three times and kowtowing nine times, a skill manual was placed in front of him.The person ran out in joy and kept showing off to his martial brothers. Among the fortuitous encounters given by the structure, skill manuals were often the most valuable type.
Gu Nan saw this entire scene, then shook his head slightly and said to Yu Lian, "Let's go."
"You’re done looking at it?" This time, it was Yu Lian's turn to be curious. It was actually not her first time setting this, but she couldn't really see anything strange about this whole process.
In fact, this was merely the process of creating items using the laws of the world. Perhaps someone used a special method to pull a small part of the world origin here to randomly create these trivial items.
It might be a formation or some kind of treasure, but obviously, none of these could surprise the grand Star Ruler of Void Grotto Heaven.
Gu Nan just shook his head without replying. He knew far better than Yu Lian what this scene signified.
The world origin used to create these items was unfamiliar to Yu Lian, but Gu Nan was very familiar with it. This was none other than origin No. 059812, from the Origin World.
This Snow Mountain Ascetic also came from the Origin World, but the blueprint he gained from the Origin World was clearly that of a sect.
It was precisely because of this that when the two Star Rulers fought, he had to stay in the sect to defend it and unfortunately became collateral damage.
Perhaps it wasn’t that he didn’t want to run. Rather, if the sect couldn’t survive, then it was useless even if he could run away.
……
Gu Nan sat in front of a desk. On the desk was a piece of paper with a list of names written on it from top to bottom.
Jiu Po, Daoist Yin Yang, Zero, Daoist Yellow Springs, Snow Mountain Ascetic, Lu Wen, Gu Nan, Molag.
This was the list of everyone currently related to the Origin World, sorted by time. It could be said that the appearance of the Snow Mountain Ascetic and Daoist Yin Yang truly filled the gaps in time.
After doing this, Gu Nan drew a red line to connect the two names "Daoist Yin Yang" and "Lu Wen".
Looking at this timeline now, one would find a very interesting pattern—that is, the point in time each name first appeared was when the previous person was about to complete their final transformation.
Daoist Yin Yang appeared right before Jiu Po captured the Earth Realm, but there wasn’t much time left before this happened, so he had no time to stop it.
He even took a risk and sent a warning to his senior martial brother, but his senior martial brother, Daoist Miao Xu, did not believe him.
Zero's life was unknown, and Daoist Yellow Springs also appeared before Zero completely disappeared; the time when the Snow Mountain Ascetic appeared was right before Daoist Yellow Springs ascended to Unified Dao.
There was a slight break from this pattern when it came to Lu Wen, because the Snow Mountain Ascetic unfortunately died from unexpected circumstances before he could grow into a powerhouse, so that case could only be ignored.
But then this pattern appeared again. Within a mere hundred years after Gu Nan's appearance, Lu Wen completed his awakening and regained the dual laws of time and space.
And just when Gu Nan was about to "destroy the world as the Evil God", Molag appeared, carrying with him the subsequent “history”.
As the transmigrators were found one by one, the pattern of visitors from the Origin World seemed to gradually reveal itself before Gu Nan.
Of course, this wasn’t without its contradictions.
For example, according to the previously known information, Lu Wen should have been brought out by Daoist Yellow Springs, but in reality, he was actually within the "quota" from the Origin World.
Another example was that Daoist Yellow Springs claimed to have seen history related to “Jiu Po”, but according to the pattern, it was actually Daoist Yin Yang who witnessed this portion of history.
"Yellow Springs is lying," Gu Nan put the pen gently on the table and said to himself after a period of silence. "Lu Wen's past and present lives may have been connected with Yellow Springs long ago."
Gu Nan didn't think Yellow Springs hiding things from him was anything surprising.
For someone like him, who’d been in the gap between the two worlds for tens of thousands of years, it would be stupid if he told Gu Nan everything.
Gu Nan never believed in information easily obtained from other people's mouths. He only believed in the things he found little by little through investigation. If even these things were tampered with, then he could only blame himself for being dumb enough to be fooled.
Looking away from the table, the paper was instantly burned to ashes without leaving any trace, and Gu Nan's figure appeared at the edge of the Myriad Heavens and began to move towards the World of Gods.
He already had all the information he needed to know. Next, he just had to take care of the greater gods.
It just so happened that he also wanted to check if slaughtering gods would still give any Evil Value.
As for Void Grotto Heaven… One had to say that the Daoist Sect’s ability to stand for hundreds of thousands of years was not without reason. Its continued survival did not only rely on strength.
Thanks to the information they handed over and the effectiveness they displayed in investigating the Snow Mountain Ascetic, the Daoist Sect gave Gu Nan a reason to let them go.
With such a sect that monitored the world, he might be able to discover some things that he wouldn't otherwise notice.
Of course, if Gu Nan was asked to choose between wisdom or strength, his choice would definitely be the latter.
If he could kill an enemy in one punch, why would he need to use his brain?
……
The World of Gods.
The five remaining greater gods were gathered in the Holy Light Divine Kingdom. Even Daisy and Baal stepped into this Divine Kingdom that they would never have entered in the past.
It could only be said that faced with the threat of the Evil God, it was meaningless to continue the conflict between the two major factions.
"The Evil God is no longer something we can oppose." Austin sighed slightly. "His laws and power… We can't pose a threat to him at all."
"Is there no other way?" Daisy's face was still a little pale. The injuries Gu Nan gave her earlier were so severe that they almost damaged her foundation.
Austin was quiet for a long time. Finally, he turned his attention to the person next to him. "The last resort… You are our last hope."
The person he was staring at was none other than Ruler of War, Eugene.
This Ruler of War, who’d been an invisible existence in the war for a long time, suddenly felt like he just heard "the organization has already decided".

chapters.title: Chapter 599: Exile
chapters.content:
Eugene stood in the void. As he watched the Divine Kingdom falling apart before his eyes, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of reluctance.
This was his Divine Kingdom.
That's right, the War Divine Kingdom that Gu Nan didn’t have time to destroy before was actually personally destroyed by Eugene after disbanding all its personnel.
As the master of this Divine Kingdom, when Eugene decided to destroy his own Divine Kingdom, his efficiency was definitely higher than that of any outsider.
In just the blink of an eye, the War Divine Kingdom was completely destroyed in the void, and the entire plane collapsed.
Eugene also didn’t want to do this if he had the choice, but just as Austin said, this was their only chance. If they could kill the Evil God, any sacrifice was worth it.
……
Gu Nan quickly discovered the strange situation here when he arrived at the World of Gods.
He could be said to be very familiar with this world, so he immediately noticed something was wrong as soon as he arrived.
It seemed that a small part of the laws of the entire world was beginning to overlap. If one looked carefully, they would be able to tell the overlapping parts—it was light and darkness.Gu Nan's gaze landed on the void, where the Holy Light and Darkness Divine Kingdoms were slowly overlapping in a strange way.
A pale golden scale was suspended at the junction of the two major Divine Kingdoms, and Austin and Daisy stood at both ends, pulling the two Divine Kingdoms together.
A sense of danger suddenly emerged in Gu Nan's heart. With his current realm, he was extremely sensitive to potential dangers. It was obvious that these two’s current actions could pose a threat to him.
‘Run, or put a stop to it?’ The instant this thought popped up in Gu Nan's mind, his intuition immediately gave the answer.
‘It must be stopped!’
If he delayed any longer, Gu Nan would probably never have the chance to enter the World of Gods again. More importantly, with his current strength, was there any need for caution?
Gu Nan took a step forward, his figure instantly descending in front of Austin and Daisy as he wantonly swung his fist at the golden scale.
He just swung a simple punch like this without bothering to hide his trajectory or changing his attack path; his target was all but written on his face.
But neither Austin nor Daisy could do anything about this punch. Be it laws or their divine bodies, they had no way to block this punch.
No one could stop him, hence why he was invincible.
The punch smashed into the golden scale. This incarnation of the law of "justice" was not affected by the laws of inertia, physics, motion, etc. Though it was hit by such a punch, it still stood firmly in the void.
Gu Nan only felt as if he’d hit the void. Although it made contact, there was no reaction force, which seemed extremely bizarre.
But Gu Nan didn't seem discouraged at all. A sinister smile appeared on his face, and his fists rained down on the golden scale like a storm, each punch powerful enough to shatter the void.
In fact, under this onslaught, no laws could exist near the scale of "justice" anymore, leaving only "justice" struggling to hold on.
Cracks began appearing on the base of the scale, and golden liquid even flowed out from the cracked areas, as if the scale was a living being.
Austin watched all this indifferently, but the speed of fusion accelerated slightly.
While Gu Nan was punching, the law of shadows wasn’t idle either. Endless shadows squeezed directly between the two worlds, madly devouring the surrounding light and darkness.
With Gu Nan's current power, no matter holy light or darkness, they could only barely defend themselves in the face of shadows, unable to fight back at all.
But Austin and Daisy completely ignored these and only focused on uniting the two Divine Kingdoms.
After all, Gu Nan came here alone. Even if his strength was already pseudo-Third Round, it was still impossible for his shadows to contend with all the laws accumulated in the two Divine Kingdoms.
Therefore, the matter of trying to separate the two Divine Kingdoms with shadows was just an afterthought. His ultimate goal was to completely destroy the scales of justice in the shortest possible time.
Crack!
Another punch landed, and the golden balance’s left arm finally broke. Austin’s figure, which was originally just standing there, suddenly shrank and almost fell into the void.
So Austin gave a soft sigh. "In the end, we couldn’t finish completely… But it's enough."
Daisy's expression was grave, her face not changing at all. She just slowly raised one arm.
In her hand, the origin of her Divine Kingdom, which represented the ultimate law of darkness, quickly flew inside the Holy Light Divine Kingdom. And likewise, Austin did something similar.
In the past, it was absolutely unimaginable to hand one's origin into the hands of their mortal enemy, who wielded the polar opposite law.
But at this instant, with the help of the scale of justice, light and darkness completed a true exchange for the first time.
At the same time light and darkness mixed together, the golden scale exploded, and the figures of Austin and Daisy disappeared simultaneously, becoming a part of the two Divine Kingdoms.
Gu Nan looked up with a slight frown because he saw that these two major Divine Kingdoms were already riddled with holes, and it was these two who voluntarily destroyed them.
Once the extremely unstable Divine Kingdoms lost the two’s active restraint, countless laws would erupt directly in the void.
But such a disorganized explosion of laws obviously could not harm Gu Nan. Moreover, these laws weren’t actually lost, but were instead all absorbed into the center.
The golden scale exploded and formed a vortex, as if it wanted to draw all the power inside, while Gu Nan just stood to the side and watched indifferently.
He had a feeling that Austin's arrangements had already been fully completed. No matter where he went, this golden vortex would definitely find him.
In that case, it was better to see what exactly they were trying to do.
Endless light and darkness converged. The golden light in the void shone brightly, then suddenly dimmed, turning into a small scale that imprinted itself directly on Gu Nan's solar plexus.
Gu Nan looked down at it. This scale clearly penetrated his law of shadows, penetrated this body, and was directly imprinted on his soul.
And the technique that Austin and Daisy almost paid their lives to complete would obviously not be simple.
‘Speaking of which, seems like I was also sealed by those two at the cost of their lives in the history Molag knew. So… is this the seal?’
Gu Nan casually sliced off the flesh on his chest using a shadow blade, and the golden scale brand fell into his hand.
But he knew that this was merely superficial. The imprint hidden deep in his soul couldn’t possibly be removed so easily.
However, the mass of flesh and blood in Gu Nan's hand actually underwent a strange change at this time. It began to gradually fade away until it completely disappeared from Gu Nan's hand.
At the same time that the piece of flesh disappeared, Gu Nan felt that his existence also seemed to fade slightly.
It was an inexplicable feeling, as if he was a little further away from this world, and he began to understand what Austin and Daisy had done.
Incantation · Exile.

chapters.title: Chapter 600: Arrangements
chapters.content:
Incantation was a type of divine art. The more sublime a god’s laws and the more devout their believers, the more they liked to teach this kind of divine art to followers.
Austin's holy light devotees were very good at incantations, so Gu Nan had seen the power of incantations more than once in his past life’s game.
If one delved deeper into the principles behind it, incantation was actually a kind of karmic art.
When the user wants to accomplish a specific task, they would pay a price far higher than completing the actual task itself to the world, and then leave the process of completing this task to the world.
In this process, the surplus power paid was actually used for conversion—in essence, the caster was leaving a task they cannot accomplish to the omnipotent laws of the world to complete.
The "Exile" incantation was a very typical one. The caster spends an enormous amount of energy to directly exile a powerful enemy to a different space, making it impossible for the opponent to return.
"Exile" at the mortal level was nothing more than throwing people to other planes. Nobody weaker than gods could travel between planes In the World of Gods, so of course the enemy could no longer return.
At the god level, it also had the effect of spacial imprisonment. The incantation target would be restrained by this spell and must wait until the power their enemy paid becomes exhausted before they can leave.
As for the greater god level… To be precise, as for the Exile incantation activated by the two strongest Greater Gods of Light and Darkness at the cost of their lives, he was afraid no one in history had ever seen it before.
Gu Nan could clearly feel that this exile was a continuous process and that he was being pulled into an unknown territory.Once the "Exile" was complete, perhaps he would completely disappear from here and go to a place from which he could never return.
As for where he would end up, he was afraid that not even Austin himself knew. The characteristic of incantation was that it only focused on the result and left the process to the world itself.
"How interesting." Gu Nan felt his power constantly fading, but he wasn’t worried.
In the end, incantation wasn’t invincible. It required an unimaginably vast amount of power to trap Gu Nan.
And Gu Nan could always wait until the incantation was complete, then use his fists to forcibly smash the cage apart.
"Is this the so-called seal?" Gu Nan recalled himself in "history". The end result was still disappearance for both sealing and exile. They were indeed not that different.
But what Gu Nan could be sure of was that the Evil God in that history definitely did not reach the Third Round.
After all, Gu Nan was only able to reach the Third Round by finding the origin ratio from Molag. It was impossible for the person called Molag to exist in that original history.
It was very likely that the Origin World’s predictions about history were intermittent. New predictions would emerge every time the previous historical era was about to come to an end.
The two largest Divine Kingdoms collapsed. Austin and Daisy sacrificed themselves while Baal and Boswell were nowhere to be found. Even Eugene had vanished.
The Ruler of War destroyed his own Divine Kingdom and erased all traces of himself from the world, so that not even Gu Nan could find him.
But Gu Nan didn’t care about this. What he wanted was to control the two worlds; he didn’t care whether Eugene lived or died.
But another discovery worried Gu Nan a little.
After a simple test, Gu Nan found that it was impossible to gain Evil Value from killing gods now.
As Gu Nan initially expected, Evil Value was actually a product of the Evil God Temple. Originally, he controlled the Evil God Temple, so he could use Evil Value to strengthen himself.
But now that the Evil God Temple was gone, of course it was impossible to benefit from killing gods.
Although the current Gu Nan was practically invincible, he was, after all, someone who had seen the true Third Round before, so he still wanted to see if there was a way to get there.
"If I can't take that last step, then I’ll set it aside for the time being," Gu Nan quickly made a decision. "Exile will officially take effect in two months at most. I’ll take advantage of this time to complete all my arrangements."
……
The plan to conquer the World of Gods proceeded more smoothly than Gu Nan expected. Only the Exile incantation was a bit unexpected.
However, Austin truly had no other alternative than borrowing an incantation’s power to bypass Gu Nan's monstrous defense in order to banish the Evil God.
Now, there was no greater god protecting the World of Gods. Even the ones hiding in the dark dared not show themselves, so the Myriad Heavens could fully conquer the World of Gods.
After Gu Nan returned to the Myriad Heavens, he ordered the major Star Rulers to organize a large-scale invasion without hesitation, with the goal of completely bringing the World of Gods under his control.
Version 2.0 of the God Hunting Manual was also launched in passing, and it immediately became the gods’ nightmare. A large number of gods were brutally slaughtered.
Because of its role in cultivating Void Cutters, Godheads became a favorite among Star Rulers, especially the Godheads of high-level gods, who rarely died on the battlefield.
Under Gu Nan's orders, even Unified Dao cultivators started participating in the war.
Although most of the Unified Dao figures’ astral worlds hadn’t been rebuilt yet, their own strength alone was more than sufficient to deal with those who weren’t greater gods.
The gods were hunted down and massacred in droves, and their Godheads became the Star Rulers’ trophies. Some weak gods were even captured, becoming their enemies’ playthings.
All of the possible treatment received by the oppressed under a reign of violence, the World of Gods experienced without fail.
Gu Nan was indifferent to all this. All he wanted was to bring both worlds under his control.
……
In the lab, Gu Nan stared at Molag and Zero calmly.
The two were each placed in a culture tank. A specific ratio of world origin was used as the culture fluid, generously being replaced batch by batch.
This approach was actually quite extravagant. Back when Gu Nan was still Tier 4 or 5, he even had to run to Astral Gate to complete missions just for a small handful of world origin.
But now, just to increase these two’s absorption efficiency, the world origin was frequently replaced before they even had a chance to completely absorb the previous batch. Instead, the world origin was treated like a cheap culture fluid. It was simply extravagant to the extreme.
But Gu Nan didn't care much. There were so many planes in the Myriad Heavens, and all those origins were at his disposal. He only needed to transform them into the Origin World’s specific ratio.
"How’s the situation?" Gu Nan walked to the lab station and asked the researcher there.
The researcher hurriedly handed the observation report to Gu Nan while also reporting on the recent situation. But in fact, the progress here wasn’t fast, and it could even be said that there was no progress.
Molag was slightly better. With the continuous origin infusion, his skill level was nevertheless always improving, but Zero was different.
The bottleneck before Unified Dao was too important. Even her system was very inefficient in this regard. This was even the result after an endless supply of origin.
The similarity between the two was that both experiments were unlikely to be completed within two months, and Gu Nan would not be able to see the results before leaving.
"Then I’ll wait until I get back." Gu Nan shook his head slightly and disappeared from the lab.
He arrived near the Origin World in one step. His next target was Daoist Yellow Springs. While his power hadn’t completely dissipated yet, there were some matters he must confirm.

chapters.title: Chapter 601: Scheme
chapters.content:
Daoist Yellow Springs vanished.
Just like his sudden first appearance, this person inexplicably disappeared from the world, as if he’d never existed.
Of course he didn't accurately predict when Gu Nan would arrive. In all likelihood, he already left a long time ago and had no intention of meeting Gu Nan.
‘He doesn't know that Void Grotto Heaven has collected so much information. So then, why did he run away?’ Gu Nan frowned as he scanned the Origin World’s vicinity and confirmed there was no trace of Daoist Yellow Springs.
However, although he didn’t know why Daoist Yellow Springs ran away, the fact that the other party needed to avoid Gu Nan at least proved that he wasn’t confident in his own strength.
Daoist Yellow Springs knew he would probably die at Gu Nan’s hands the next time they met, which was why he escaped in advance.
But the timing of his escape was indeed clever. If a Unified Dao power was determined to hide himself, even Gu Nan would have a hard time finding him.
He wasn’t like the greater gods in the Great War. The destroyed Divine Kingdoms still had their owners’ lingering energy signatures, so Gu Nan could follow the traces to find the gods’ true bodies.
On the other hand, finding someone like Eugene—who destroyed his Divine Kingdom with his own hands without leaving any trace, then hid in a random small plane—would undoubtedly be as difficult as ascending the heavens.
Daoist Yellow Springs didn’t even have an astral world to begin with, so he would undoubtedly be even harder to find.Gu Nan couldn’t help frowning slightly once he confirmed that Daoist Yellow Springs was not nearby. He then returned to the Myriad Heavens and ordered a comprehensive search of all major worlds.
The target of the search was expanded from the original Fu Cheng to include Daoist Yellow Springs.
"Sure enough, Daoist Yellow Springs is still alive?" Yu Lian calmly sat beside Gu Nan and helped him pen the upcoming decree.
Although he essentially controlled the two worlds, Gu Nan had never liked to engage in superficial formalities, so Void Grotto Heaven became his spokesperson, and all orders were issued through the Daoist Sect.
As for his own Divine Kingdom, it was still developing steadily, unaffected by these external events.
And Yu Lian, the Daoist Sect’s former sect master, seemed to have become Gu Nan's dedicated secretary. Whenever Gu Nan had any request, she needed to use various administrative methods to complete it.
When it came to handling practical matters, not even a hundred Gu Nan’s could compare to a single Yu Lian. Not even the Cabinet in his Divine Kingdom could do better than her.
After all, Gu Nan's Divine Kingdom was only that big. Be it the matters that needed to be handled or the external enemies and friends that needed to be contacted, the scale was far from comparable to that of Void Grotto Heaven.
As the leader of the Myriad Heavens, Void Grotto Heaven could influence over 80% of the planes in the Myriad Heavens. This was already a terrifying number.
Now that he was short on time, of course Gu Nan would adopt the most efficient method.
"He’s alive." Gu Nan nodded without any intention of hiding it.
Not only did he want to announce the fact that Daoist Yellow Springs was still alive, he also wanted to gather all the information on the other party’s appearance, aura, habits, and other data to serve as the basis for the search carried out by the people below.
Some of this information came from Gu Nan himself, and some came from Void Grotto Heaven’s archives. This behemoth, which governed the Myriad Heavens for several eras, did have its own foundation.
Under Gu Nan's order, all major organizations were mobilized and devoted a large amount of manpower and resources to the search, but this action obviously could not produce results anytime soon.
Nobody knew whether Fu Cheng had come to the two worlds and where she would appear. It would probably be very difficult to find her quickly.
This was even more true for Daoist Yellow Springs. With his Unified Dao methods, this was destined to be a long-term search.
Of course, the only information Gu Nan withheld about Daoist Yellow Springs was that he’d already ascended to Unified Dao Realm.
If people knew he quietly ascended to Unified Dao already, there was no guarantee that people wouldn’t associate him with the gap outside the two worlds. Gu Nan didn't want the Origin World to be exposed just yet.
As the days passed, Gu Nan stayed in the Daoist Sect’s temple, occasionally looking through the scrolls on the bookshelf, but more often than not, he was doing experiments.
He was conducting a comprehensive test on his current condition, analyzing and recording everything from the nature and strength of his laws to the various powers of his body.
This naturally also included the Stigma of Life and Death.
Due to the caster’s death, the power of the stigma seemed to be gradually fading. Under the erosion of the Evil God physique itself, even the mark’s structure was starting to become unstable.
This stigma, which the gods once pinned high hopes on and even gambled away Baal’s entire Divine Kingdom to create, was thwarted thanks to Gu Nan's unexpected advancement to the Third Round.
Now, Austin and Daisy had no choice but to sacrifice their lives and pin their hopes on the Exile incantation.
It had to be said that Exile’s power was indeed continuously taking effect. After two months, Gu Nan's body had already faded to the point where he almost became an illusion instead of a real existence.
It could be said that Gu Nan's current strength was very weak. The punch he threw right now was far from being able to destroy laws, and it may be similar to his strength at Tier 2.
And even this meager amount of power was rapidly fading.
Of course, conversely, Gu Nan had never been as safe as he was right now. Although his influence on the outside world was weakened, the reverse was also true.
If the outside world wanted to influence him, it would also have to put in thousands of times more power than normal. And with Gu Nan's physical defense, it was almost impossible to hurt the current him.
Yu Lian witnessed the entire Exile process with her own eyes, and because Gu Nan was always leisurely conducting experiments, she was particularly sensitive to the weakening of Gu Nan's power.
She didn't have many questions. After all, she was someone who once stood at the very peak of the Myriad Heavens. Yu Lian had a clear understanding of such an obvious principle.
In Yu Lian's eyes, Gu Nan seemed to be constantly transporting his body to a specified place.
But why this process was so difficult was something Yu Lian couldn’t understand.
On this day, in a rare occurrence, Gu Nan did not do anything. He just sat quietly in the Daoist temple, waiting for Exile to finally complete its incantation.
He was already very, very far away from this world, so far away that even if his power wanted to descend here, it could only show a very weak partial effect.
However, at this moment, a message appeared on the table of the Daoist temple.
Yu Lian, who had always been standing behind Gu Nan, was slightly startled and quickly went forward to pick up the document and hand it to Gu Nan. In the last few days, Gu Nan had begun to have difficulty touching even physical objects.
If Gu Nan were to try picking it up himself, his hand might go right through the paper.
Of course, this also contained a bit of selfishness on Yu Lian’s part.
A piece of news suddenly came through at such a critical moment. Yu Lian would never believe it to be a coincidence, so she wanted to see what was written in it.
Thus, she saw the message on the paper. It was very brief and could even be summarized in one sentence:
“Daoist Yellow Springs appeared, displaying Unified Dao Realm power, and stole Zero from the lab.”

chapters.title: Chapter 602: Yellow Springs
chapters.content:
Yu Lian stared at this sentence blankly. Only after a while did she turn back to look at Gu Nan. She suddenly felt that even though she was once the master of Void Grotto Heaven, there were still many things in this world that she didn't understand.
Daoist Yellow Springs actually turned out to be a Unified Dao cultivator, and Gu Nan took Zero away to put her in a secret lab, but now, she was kidnapped by Daoist Yellow Springs.
‘What does he want Zero for? What secrets does Zero hold?’
‘What is the connection between Jiu Po, Yellow Springs, and Gu Nan?’
These thoughts flashed through her head for an instant, but then she shook her head, unable to help laughing. No matter what the answer was, it had nothing to do with her. She was just a prisoner now.
"I don't have much time." Gu Nan shifted his gaze away from the information to look at Yu Lian. "I’ll give Void Grotto Heaven back to you. Block Jiu Po and Lu Wen for me."
Yu Lian suddenly looked up and saw that Gu Nan had placed a Daoist crown in front of her.
It was absolutely impossible for Gu Nan to do such a thing with his current strength, which meant he was already prepared for this long ago and was expecting such a situation.
Yu Lian tore her gaze away with some difficulty, preventing herself from looking at the Daoist crown. "The sect master position is decided by the Daoist Sect."
"You know it too. The protection magic on this isn’t worth anything to me." Gu Nan curled his lips disdainfully. "Take it, and you will be the only Star Ruler of Void Grotto Heaven from now on."Yu Lian gritted her teeth. She knew Gu Nan was implying that since the inheritance had already been destroyed, even if she didn't take it, she would at most just be giving her position to someone else.
Yu Lian fell silent for a while. "Why me?"
"You’ve seen my power, so you won’t dare betray me." Gu Nan said with a smile, "I will be back."
……
When Gu Nan next opened his eyes, he was already in an unfamiliar region.
The power of Exile gradually pulled his body away from the main world. It wasn’t until this process was completely finished that he truly arrived at this new place.
But it couldn’t really be said to be new, because this was actually a place Gu Nan was very familiar with—the Origin World.
The power of "Exile" ultimately sent Gu Nan inside the Origin World. It wasn’t like Gu Nan hadn’t considered this possibility before, so he wasn’t too surprised at this time.
After all, if there was any place in the world capable of imprisoning Gu Nan, come to think of it, it could only be the Origin World.
Gu Nan's original idea was to see if he could enter the Origin World through this, then smash the Origin World’s dimensional wall from the inside.
But before Gu Nan could respond, he discovered that the dimensional wall was extending automatically, gradually covering his body.
This scene was just like when Fu Cheng was taken away, but this time, the dimensional wall wasn’t taking him away, but imprisoning him.
This was the aftermath of Exile trying to imprison Gu Nan as much as possible.
Gu Nan's eyes moved slightly, and the Third Round law of shadows gathered on his fist as he threw a hard punch at the dimensional wall twisting around him.
A silent impact shook the void. Facing Gu Nan's Third Round punch, the Origin World’s dimensional wall finally had a reaction.
The dimensional wall seemed to have been hit by a huge force, and the entire wall vibrated nonstop. The shock even spread outwards continuously.
"It’s effective!" Gu Nan perked up. After finally seeing an effect, he immediately threw out several more punches and continued to hit the same spot on the dimensional wall.
The dimensional wall knew how to extend by itself, so it clearly had an instinctive will, but it was still early to say that it had sentience, so it could only allow Gu Nan to rain down attacks.
As Gu Nan's onslaught continued, the vibrations on the dimensional wall continuously intensified, but it didn’t seem to show any signs of breaking yet.
But Gu Nan wasn’t in a hurry. He wasn’t short on time right now. It wasn’t a big deal even if he had to stay here for ten or twenty years.
However, Daoist Yellow Springs' puzzling behavior right before Gu Nan disappeared made him suspicious.
Perhaps this mysterious fellow’s understanding of the Origin World was not as simple as it seemed on the surface. In terms of acting skills, characters at this level wouldn’t lose to anyone.
……
Time slowly passed, and Gu Nan persisted in his task of destroying the dimensional wall, making slow but steady progress.
However, other events were taking place in the outside world.
The Myriad Heavens.
Daoist Yellow Springs stood before Jiu Po with a faint smile on his face, just like countless years ago. The two of them seemed to have returned to the day they first parted ways.
Jiu Po chose to stay behind in the Myriad Heavens, so he became the most powerful Star Ruler in the Myriad Heavens. Daoist Yellow Springs chose to search for the Origin World, and he did indeed find it.
Until this day, he finally returned because he was already confident he could face Jiu Po.
Jiu Po stood in his own astral world. The earthen veins’ power bore down on his opponent while Daoist Yellow Springs just stood in the air, accepting the leylines’ baptism.
Not even his Daoist robe was affected. No external power could reach him, much less hurt him.
"Is this the power of the Origin World?" No emotion could be seen from Jiu Po's face. He just stared at Daoist Yellow Springs.
"That's right. Speaking of which, I need to thank Gu Nan. He actually discovered the Origin World’s origin and even discovered Zero’s secret…" Daoist Yellow Springs couldn't help bursting into laughter after saying this.
"And now." His smile faded as he continued calmly, "All the fruits of his labor are mine."
"People who came from the Origin World all have some mysterious abilities. It’s just that we haven't been able to activate them?" Jiu Po looked at the laughing opponent and asked thoughtfully.
"Not me." Daoist Yellow Springs shook his head. "I am the first person to have an ability, but you guys just didn’t know about it."
There was a strange look in Jiu Po's eyes, but then he smiled again. "No one has noticed for so many years. You’ve really hidden it well."
Daoist Yellow Springs looked at Jiu Po with a sneer. "Want to know why? Because my ability… is devouring!"
……
Yu Lian wore a Daoist crown on her head and sat in Void Grotto Heaven’s temple with an indifferent expression. Below her were the higher ups of Daoist Sect.
"Daoist Yellow Springs appeared in Jiu Po Heaven. We suspect he fought Jiu Po. After that, their current whereabouts are unknown—"
"What I want is the outcome," Yu Lian interrupted her subordinate.
The person paused for a moment, then whispered, "The outcome… is still unknown."
Yu Lian fell silent, and the entire temple also fell silent. It wasn’t until a long time later that she asked, "What did you find in Gu Nan's lab?"
"They’re raising two people using world origin. We found the partial experiment records they left behind,” the man answered and handed over the records.
But his expression looked very strange.
Yu Lian soon knew why his expression looked odd, because what was written in the records was too shocking.
They didn't even bother to cover up such important information and just wrote it down for everyone to see?
"Origin World…" Yu Lian heard this term for the first time and stood up slowly after a moment.
"Sect Master."
"I’m heading out for a while."

chapters.title: Chapter 603: Lu Wen
chapters.content:
Daoist Yellow Springs leisurely stepped inside Jiu Po Heaven, but the Jiu Po facing him looked unusually pale.
"So you really didn’t awaken any abilities. Truly disappointing…" Daoist Yellow Springs shook his head regretfully as he looked down at Jiu Po.
He took the experiment data from Gu Nan's lab. While he was shocked at how the Origin World’s origin was being created, at the same time, he was excited.
Most of the transmigrators from the Origin World had special abilities—he knew this already. He even knew that these abilities were driven by some kind of energy.
It's just that before Gu Nan, Daoist Yellow Springs never knew that this driving force turned out to be the specific Origin World’s origin.
But Gu Nan guessed wrong about one thing. It wasn’t that Zero didn't know she had a system. In fact, she turned on the system when she first transmigrated here, but… Her system later ran out of power.
Every transmigrator brought a part of the origin with them when leaving the Origin World, which was the energy used to activate their golden fingers.
It's just that some people could be self-sufficient, such as Gu Nan and Molag, while others could only spend energy without being able to recharge it, such as Zero, as well as… Daoist Yellow Springs.
Back then, Zero relied on the system to rise, but similarly, her eventual fall was also from losing the system. Daoist Yellow Springs, on the other hand, was much more cautious than her.
"Devouring?" Jiu Po watched the powers of the earth being swallowed bit by bit by the opponent while Daoist Yellow Springs' aura gradually grew.Jiu Po was certain this power didn’t come from anything Daoist Yellow Springs learned, nor was it any power he was familiar with.
As he devoured a large quantity of laws, Daoist Yellow Springs' power rose steadily, approaching Tier 14 in the blink of an eye.
And since he was directly inside Jiu Po Heaven, Jiu Po couldn’t withdraw his power even if he wanted to. He could only watch his opponent’s power skyrocket.
"That's right." The soaring strength seemed to affect Daoist Yellow Springs' state of mind, making him less calm. "You guys really have to thank Gu Nan. If not for him, how could I devour so wantonly?"
He could sense the land’s power constantly being assimilated into himself, making him feel full of power. Daoist Yellow Springs turned more arrogant, and at the same time, it became harder to hide the smugness in his heart.
He did indeed have a right to be smug because he knew he was destined to be the final winner.
Gu Nan was sent to the Origin World, so everything he did benefitted Daoist Yellow Springs instead, including the secret of Origin World’s origin. No wonder Gu Nan grew so fast. It turned out that he had discovered this secret a long time ago.
‘If I also had enough origin, my growth rate absolutely won’t be much slower than his!’
Ever since Daoist Yellow Springs started cultivating, he’d only ever dared to use his ability cautiously. In the later stages, he didn’t even dare to devour suitable targets for fear that he would run out of energy if he encountered a better target in the future.
But even with such a difficult life, after he became a major Star Ruler, he still used up the world origin he brought along when he transmigrated.
So he resolutely gave up the path of cultivating an astral world and even parted ways with Jiu Po. He stayed in the Origin World for tens of thousands of years just to find a way to recharge his ability.
Daoist Yellow Springs immediately discovered Zero when she appeared but to his regret, Zero's origin was also limited.
More importantly, the Myriad Heavens just underwent a cataclysm back then, and the cultivators’ understanding of world origins was still very superficial. The same was true for Daoist Yellow Springs. He also didn't understand what world origin was back then.
Later, the Snow Mountain Ascetic died too early, and Gu Nan didn’t show any signs of knowing the future, so Daoist Yellow Springs missed both of them—until Molag appeared.
Perhaps because fate had been cruel to him for too long, after Gu Nan took Molag away, Daoist Yellow Springs' fortune finally turned around.
Not only did he benefit from the fruits of Gu Nan’s research, but he also found a way to recharge his ability. It also just so happened that Gu Nan was trapped in the Origin World again, giving him the chance to make a comeback.
"Once I devour Jiu Po and all the Unified Dao cultivators, let’s see who among us is stronger then…" There was a hint of darkness in his eyes.
He witnessed Gu Nan's fight with the greater gods, so he knew the Stigma of Life and Death, the Exile incantation, and more importantly, just how strong Gu Nan was.
But now that he had the ability to devour infinitely, he had enough confidence!
What's more, he also controlled Gu Nan's biggest weakness right now, a man-made weakness…
……
Origin World.
Gu Nan swung his fists tirelessly. Cracks had begun to appear on the dimensional wall, and the progress seemed to be faster than he thought.
If things proceeded smoothly, he would be able to smash a crack through the Origin World in two days at most.
However, a figure appeared in front of him at this moment. To be precise, it appeared in his soul’s senses. The two were clearly facing each other, but they couldn't see each other.
Because what separated them was the strongest thing in the world, the Origin World’s dimensional wall.
"Lu Wen?" Gu Nan's punches kept coming, but his will focused on that side.
The newcomer was Lu Wen.
If there was anyone else in the world besides Gu Nan and Daoist Yellow Springs who might know the Origin World’s location, it could only be Lu Wen. Even Daoist Yellow Springs didn't know the full details of this person who had entered and left the Origin World twice.
But Gu Nan knew that Lu Wen's previous life—Daoist Yin Yang—was a transmigrator who originally came from the Origin World. Later, he entered the Origin World again by reincarnating into the Myriad Stars Civilization and was eventually brought out by Daoist Yellow Springs.
It was precisely because of this that Lu Wen said, "To become a Saint is to trap oneself", but Daoist Yellow Springs knew nothing about this.
"Daoist Yellow Springs' ability is devouring." Lu Wen's voice slowly traveled over, thick with regret, "He devoured Zero’s system, and now he's looking for Jiu Po. Only you can stop him."
Although Gu Nan continued punching out, his expression was slightly taken aback. ‘So it turns out that Daoist Yellow Springs' ability is devouring…’
Gu Nan immediately understood the whole story when he heard that. No wonder the other party was willing to stay near the Origin World for so many years.
And no wonder Lu Wen came to find Gu Nan at this time.
The most frustrated person right now was probably Lu Wen. If Gu Nan, Daoist Yellow Springs, and Lu Wen were all on the same race track, then Lu Wen was undoubtedly already close to the finish line, but he still couldn’t catch up to the person in front, no matter what.
Cultivation was like a race. The first person to reach the finish line could win everything. He could even block the finish line from now on so that those who came after him would never have the chance to take this step.
Transmigrators such as Gu Nan and Daoist Yellow Springs had special powers from the Origin World. They could undoubtedly run faster than others and had a better chance of taking first place.
However, Jiu Po, who had the first-mover advantage, voluntarily withdrew, and Daoist Yellow Springs, Zero, and the others exhausted their origins, which finally led to this situation.
"His power is devouring. If he wins, none of you will survive, right?" Gu Nan smiled as he glanced at Lu Wen, even though he couldn't actually see the other person's face.
"That's right." Lu Wen exhaled heavily. "If not for this, he wouldn't have forced us all to your side."

chapters.title: Chapter 604: Time Stop
chapters.content:
Before Gu Nan left, he had a premonition that Jiu Po and Daoist Yellow Springs would join forces to attack his Divine Kingdom as soon as he disappeared. Unexpectedly, Daoist Yellow Springs became a loner thanks to his "devouring" ability.
Now that he thought about it, that was normal. Who would want to work with a guy who could devour them at any time to increase his strength? Unless they had no other choice, people would always take the alternative.
In contrast, although Gu Nan was brutal, he had no motive to kill wantonly, which was better than being devoured.
It's just that Lu Wen’s appearance here meant he’d completely withdrawn from the race.
If Jiu Po was unfortunate enough to be devoured by Daoist Yellow Springs, then only Gu Nan and Yellow Springs would have the right to decide the final winner.
"You’re the one who gave him the opportunity," Lu Wen said seriously. If Gu Nan hadn't discovered the world origin’s secret, Daoist Yellow Springs wouldn’t even have any opportunity in the first place.
Gu Nan laughed. "It doesn't matter. Speaking of which, what’s your ability?"
Lu Wen was silent for a while, then slowly answered, "Dual attributes. I came out of the Origin World twice. That was my ability both times."
Dual attributes was the reason Lu Wen could master the dual laws of time and space.
"Tell me about how you left."Lu Wen knew he had to gain Gu Nan's trust, so he didn’t hide anything and explained decisively, "In fact, we’ve already figured out the process for leaving the Origin World. But only now were we able to confirm what the Origin World did to us."
Lu Wen spoke slowly, and the information he revealed was somewhat beyond Gu Nan's expectations, but the gist was no different from his suspicions.
Transmigrators who left the Origin World often had special abilities, which was determined by the special characteristics of the Origin World’s dimensional wall.
"We believe that this is not actually a dimensional wall, but a Wall of Laws." Lu Wen said, "Those who pass through this wall will have certain aspects of their power strengthened by laws."
Having said that, he glanced at Gu Nan again and continued with a smile, "Of course, it’s also possible for the target to be an item instead of a person."
……
The Myriad Heavens.
Jiu Po was at a complete disadvantage. He couldn’t damage Daoist Yellow Springs and could only watch his own power get absorbed.
Daoist Yellow Springs’ own strength already reached Tier 14, and his devouring ability grew even stronger, actually starting to suppress Jiu Po Heaven.
"You… cannot escape," Daoist Yellow Springs’ voice was a little hoarse. The large influx of power gave him no time to digest it all, and it was gradually distorting his personality.
Jiu Po just stared at him calmly. Only after a while did he speak up, "It's almost done."
Daoist Yellow Springs was slightly startled. Jiu Po suddenly raised his hand, and an exquisite pocket watch appeared in his hand.
The clock hands jumped slightly, and time seemed to stand still at this instant. Even Daoist Yellow Springs’ devouring ability also froze.
"It’s all thanks to your origin,” Jiu Po's indifferent voice finally rang out, followed by a sudden palm strike forward, setting off a wave of earthen powers.
The pocket watch shattered under the crushing weight of those laws, and time returned to normal. But Daoist Yellow Springs was still unable to block the earth’s power, and he had no time to activate devouring, so he could only take the blow head-on!
It turned out that Jiu Po only allowed him to devour so much power in order to secretly steal away a wisp of world origin. It wasn’t that Jiu Po did not have a special ability, but that the special ability was an item.
The power of the earth almost smashed the entire void, and strange laws filled the space, completely submerging Daoist Yellow Springs.
However, after a moment, Jiu Po gave a deep sigh. "Is it… too late?"
"That’s right, it's too late." Daoist Yellow Springs slowly emerged from behind him. His figure had been corroded beyond recognition, but his aura was still stable, and he was even devouring a large portion of the surrounding laws.
As long as he didn’t die, he could quickly recover his power.
After swallowing Jiu Po’s power, Daoist Yellow Springs was recovering at an alarming speed, a sneer on his face.
If Jiu Po stole the origin just a little faster and if he didn’t start to weaken just now, Daoist Yellow Springs’ power would not have grown so strong, and Jiu Po may really have succeeded in killing the enemy with one blow.
After all, Daoist Yellow Springs did not have an astral world and would truly die if his body was destroyed.
"Time stop? To think you hid that from everyone." He glared at Jiu Po with cold eyes, but he was no longer in a hurry. What the other party brought from the Origin World was not an ability, but an item…
Jiu Po just shook his head a little. "Back then, I took a step back, so I deserve this ending. But although I lost, you may not necessarily win."
Jiu Po also knew just how strong the current Gu Nan was. Based on their conjectures about Gu Nan, his ability probably had something to do with his physical body.
Therefore, after obtaining the Origin World’s origin, Gu Nan's physical body became incredibly strong. Even if Daoist Yellow Springs had the devouring ability, he still wouldn’t be able to deal with such a Gu Nan.
Daoist Yellow Springs naturally understood what Jiu Po meant, but he wasn’t afraid. He just smiled. "That’s why I found you first… Only by devouring your power will I gain the right to face him."
Jiu Po's expression shifted slightly, but his figure suddenly disappeared. The next second, the devouring power actually tried to bite him on the head.
"He fled?" Daoist Yellow Springs’ eyes were cold, but he didn't pay much attention to the escape and continued to devour the power of Jiu Po Heaven.
Astral world cultivators actually concentrated most of their power in their astral worlds. Jiu Po himself escaping would only speed up Daoist Yellow Springs' progress.
……
"Jiu Po also lost." Lu Wen sighed softly. "His time stop was a little late."
Gu Nan already found out Jiu Po's ability from Lu Wen. He actually brought out a pocket watch from the Origin World capable of temporarily stopping time.
Daoist Yellow Springs didn't know about this. On the contrary, Lu Wen, whose previous incarnation was in the same generation as Jiu Po, had witnessed that power of his.
As Gu Nan expected, Lu Wen was the one who saw Jiu Po’s historical era. Daoist Yellow Springs only learned about it from Lu Wen because he’d been beside the Origin World for a long time.
After Daoist Yellow Springs learned of Gu Nan's formidable power, he deliberately muddied up this pattern in hopes of misleading Gu Nan.
Unfortunately, he did not expect Molag’s appearance to single-handedly change the overall situation.
Now, everyone was sprinting across the final stretch, all to decide the ultimate winner.
Gu Nan didn’t stop punching but asked curiously, "You guys studied it for so many years. Do you know why the Origin World sent people like us out?"
"Of course." Lu Wen nodded. "What you’re currently doing is something Yellow Springs and I both tried back then, and thanks to that, my soul was able to enter the Origin World."
"Back then, did you want to become the next transmigrator?"
"Yes, and I succeeded," there was a hint of pride in Lu Wen's voice, but then it faded.
"But so what? If not for Molag’s appearance, we probably wouldn't have known even now—it turns out that the Origin World’s origin is the driving force behind our powers… That’s all it was!"

chapters.title: Chapter 605: Advance and Retreat (END)
chapters.content:
Gu Nan couldn't help but fall silent.
Before the appearance of people with the ability to produce the Origin World’s origin like Molag and himself, they really could only stumble about in the dark; it was impossible to find the origin.
Unless they were willing to cut themselves open or find the next transmigrator in advance, before that person used up their origin.
"Did you also see the future history before you transmigrated?" Gu Nan thought for a while and asked again. This was the Origin World’s strongest power.
Lu Wen seemed determined to join Gu Nan's side and answered all his questions.
"That’s right. Actually, I don't need to elaborate on this. You’ll see it when you continue to destroy the Wall of Laws."
Gu Nan raised his head and looked at the shattered dimensional wall. Suddenly, he saw something astonishing inside.
They were fragments of the future, some about the Myriad Heavens and others about the World of Gods, but the two sides seemed separate.
These fragments contained all kinds of information, including powerful cultivators like themselves, as well as insignificant characters like peddlers and servants. Everything was included, no matter how powerful.
There were even some contradictory fragment pairs, but over time, one of the two would fade away.Gu Nan seemed to understand why the Origin World's predictions were extremely accurate and why they were only related to the future of a single world.
"The essence of the Wall of Laws is indeed a dimensional wall, and it’s connected to the dimensional walls of the two outside worlds." Lu Wen's voice continued, "But it has the power to predict the future and can deduce the future of the two worlds on its own. "
Once this kind of future was deduced, it would fall into the Origin World and be obtained by a few people in the form of memories. And some of these people then used it to produce films, television series, and literary works, which eventually spread to a wider audience.
"But this kind of prediction isn’t completely accurate. The power of foreknowledge will eventually lean to one side of the world, completely foretelling the future there, while the other side will disappear until the next reincarnation."
The next reincarnation is when the next transmigrator appears.
Gu Nan nodded slightly. He understood the essence behind these transmigrators’ appearances. In sum, it was caused by a special dimensional wall like the Wall of Laws.
Perhaps the Origin World was merely an ordinary plane a long time ago, but it was separated from the two worlds due to the influence of the Wall of Laws.
"The power of prediction…" Gu Nan's gaze landed on the gradually shattering dimensional wall, a faint smile on his face. "As long as it’s destroyed, there won’t be any more transmigrators in the future."
Lu Wen was stunned. But before he could speak, another voice called out, "No, it's mine."
Daoist Yellow Springs slowly materialized next to Lu Wen. At this time, only a thin layer of the Wall of Laws was left. Gu Nan could even make out blurry figures on the other side.
Lu Wen’s expression suddenly changed, and he immediately started to move away, but Daoist Yellow Springs didn’t even spare him a glance, instead staring at the Wall of Laws, transfixed.
He was the one who stayed by the Origin World the longest, as well as the one who understood the Wall of Laws best.
"It's mine!" Daoist Yellow Springs repeated. Though his face looked calm, his voice was very serious.
While saying this, he already activated his devouring power, targeting none other than the fragments of the Wall of Laws and quickly swallowing them inside his body.
Sensing the rapid origin consumption inside his body, Daoist Yellow Springs became more and more excited.
His devouring ability could swallow everything in the world. The only limitation was the lack of origin. Moreover, the more powerful the target, the higher the origin consumption.
Now, he finally had enough origin, and the origin consumed through devouring the Wall of Laws was far more than anything else he ever devoured!
Even when devouring Jiu Po’s extremely powerful earthen energy, the rate of origin consumption wasn’t even half as fast as right now.
After all, the Wall of Laws was the true source of the Origin World’s miracles, and it was also the reason why everyone present could stand here.
"Power… Now this is true power…" Daoist Yellow Springs' eyes flickered slightly, and the laws had begun to spread all over his body, continuing to extend outward.
His law was very special. It was the "solidification" law that made all things congeal.
Under the influence of the solidification law, not only did the void gradually stop flowing, but even the Wall of Laws was restricted, and the changes in the predictive fragments also slowed down.
Boom!
A muffled sound seemed to come from the void. Daoist Yellow Springs suddenly opened his eyes and saw Gu Nan smashing apart the Wall of Laws with a punch and slowly walking out of the Origin World.
At this moment, Gu Nan became the first person in history to leave the Origin World without being in soul form.
After cracks appeared on the Wall of Laws, it began to rapidly crumble and disintegrate and even caused a collapse phenomenon, dissolving swiftly like snowflakes.
"No… This is mine… Mine!" Daoist Yellow Springs glared furiously, veins popping up on his forehead as the law of solidification quickly surged towards Gu Nan.
Gu Nan threw a casual punch without even glancing in his direction. The almost-solid laws surrounding Daoist Yellow Springs' body fell apart instantly, and his whole body flew backwards like a cannonball.
Daoist Yellow Springs devoured most of Jiu Po's power, but even Jiu Po lacked the ability to face Gu Nan head-on, let alone him.
Gu Nan turned around and gripped the edges of the crack in the Wall of Laws with both hands. The law of shadow began to pour out abruptly, rapidly enlarging the crack until it covered twenty percent of the entire wall in the blink of an eye.
But his movements paused a little because he actually discovered a soul inside the Wall of Laws.
That was Fu Cheng's soul.
‘So she was fused into the Wall of Laws… Is it because she came out too early, and the previous transmigrator’s era hasn’t ended yet?’ With Gu Nan's current understanding of the Wall of Laws, he immediately deduced why Fu Cheng was here.
She was fused into the Wall of Laws. In a few hundred more years, she might even be the next Gu Nan. Unfortunately, she no longer had that chance.
As the Wall of Laws fractured, Fu Cheng's soul also dissipated entirely.
"Gu Nan!" Daoist Yellow Springs shouted again, having just run back from the void. His hair was disheveled, and he shot a cold glare at Gu Nan.
"Stop, or else you’ll definitely regret it," Daoist Yellow Springs yelled at Gu Nan, his power still devouring the Wall of Laws.
Gu Nan was never a person who could be swayed by words. He didn't even spare the opponent a glance and was still tearing apart the Origin World’s dimensional wall at an incredible speed.
One could well imagine the consequences. Once Gu Nan completely tore it apart, the Origin World would merge with the outside world, and there would be no such thing as transmigrators henceforth.
Daoist Yellow Springs' face darkened slightly, He suddenly turned around and shouted, "Eugene, how much longer are you planning to wait?!"
The void seemed to pause for a second, and then a golden light lit up from behind Gu Nan. It was Eugene, the Ruler of War who had been lurking for a long time.
Gu Nan’s form was originally perfect and had almost no weaknesses to speak of. Even the Exile incantation could only trap him temporarily.
But Austin and the greater gods created a weakness in him.
Gu Nan suddenly turned and punched out, directly piercing Eugene's heart. This Ruler of War didn't even have time to react.
However, he seemed to be expecting this; no surprise could be seen in his eyes. Instead, he grinned and sent the golden light in his hands straight to Gu Nan.
Four rays of light—each a different color—swam inside the golden cloud, consisting of mainly two parts, one black and one white, that exuded a mysterious aura.
"This is… the essence of the two major Divine Kingdoms?" Gu Nan raised his brow slightly and immediately understood what Austin had done.
No wonder the strength of the Exile incantation was weaker than Gu Nan imagined. It turned out that the two didn't use their full strength at all.
And inside the golden ball of light in Eugene's hand, the impressive auras of the four strongest greater gods were gathered together. The two largest Divine Kingdoms served as the bridge, truly integrating the four’s powers.
At this moment, the Stigma of Life and Death on Gu Nan's body—which was about to disappear—suddenly lit up again.
This was Austin's last resort, using the power of four greater gods to trigger the Stigma of Life and Death. The Exile incantation was just to mislead the opponent, so as to help them deal a fatal blow right now.
If Gu Nan still wasn’t dead after this blow, then the four greater gods who sacrificed themselves would have no chance of returning.
Daoist Yellow Springs gazed at this scene with cold eyes.
He’d been hiding near the Origin World and was aware of the major moves in both worlds. Naturally, Austin and the others’ plan couldn’t be hidden from him.
"Gu Nan, your power is still incomplete. You’ve yet to take that last step, have you?" Daoist Yellow Springs' voice slowly rang out, "If you hide in the Origin World and try to comprehend the Wall of Laws to take that step, you might still have a chance. But it’s a pity…"
As Daoist Yellow Springs' words slowly fell, the golden light in the void became more and more blinding, even to the point of scorching.
Immediately afterwards, the golden light quickly converged on the mark on Gu Nan's abdomen, severing all of Gu Nan's vitality.
"It's over…" Jiu Po's figure appeared next to Lu Wen, shaking his head slowly.
He originally thought no one could catch up to Gu Nan, who grew at a monstrous speed, but he didn't expect Yellow Springs and the greater gods to join forces to ultimately defeat this foe.
Eugene covered his chest with one hand. Gu Nan’s punch right before he died instantly dealt critical damage. He couldn’t even move right now.
But being able to kill the Evil God made everything worth it.
Daoist Yellow Springs continued to devour the Wall of Laws. No one could oppose him now. The only thing that made him a little dissatisfied was that a large part of the laws had already been destroyed by Gu Nan.
He only cast a glance at Gu Nan's completely lifeless body and stopped paying attention to it. No matter how valuable Gu Nan's corpse was, it wasn’t as important as his own strength.
However, at this second, Eugene's expression suddenly changed. His whole person seemed to be pierced from behind by a monstrous force, pulverizing his internal organs and tearing his body apart.
Pieces of Eugene's corpse instantly fell into the void. At the same time, Gu Nan walked out from behind him while cracking his neck, a sinister smile on his face.
"The stigma is alright, but the strength is a bit lacking." He touched the Stigma of Life and Death on his abdomen, whose power had almost completely faded.
Eugene gathered the power of four greater gods and finally triggered the stigma’s final blow. Although it was effective, it also completely exhausted the stigma’s power.
More importantly, the Stigma of Life and Death did not actually have the intended effect.
Daoist Yellow Springs stared at this blankly, as if he couldn't understand why Gu Nan, who was clearly dead, could still revive.
In his eyes, Gu Nan was undoubtedly completely dead just now. Even his soul was instantly destroyed; not even his astral world could save him.
Gu Nan slowly walked up Daoist Yellow Springs, then glanced at Eugene, who was torn to pieces, and couldn't help shaking his head.
"If Austin found out that you wasted the precious opportunity he used his life to create, maybe he’d be so furious that he’d come back to life again?" Gu Nan wondered with some amusement.
He finally understood Austin's plan. From the beginning, the Greater God of Light had bet that Gu Nan would clash with other powerhouses sooner or later.
He asked Eugene to take action at that critical second, hoping to activate Gu Nan's Stigma of Life and Death to completely destroy Gu Nan's body.
Normally, his prediction would be entirely correct. Daoist Yellow Springs would certainly make sure Gu Nan was truly dead, not giving him any opportunity to revive.
It's a pity that this wasn’t a normal situation. The Wall of Laws was right in front of him. How could Daoist Yellow Springs care about anything else?
And Austin also didn't expect that with Gu Nan's current power, even if he gathered the power of four greater gods, the forced state of death would only last for a short moment.
Only when Gu Nan came back to life did Daoist Yellow Springs stop his movements and retreat violently.
Gu Nan simply took one step forward, instantly stomping through the congealed space and appearing directly before him.
At this time, Daoist Yellow Springs' power-addled mind seemed to have recovered, and his face gradually calmed down.
"You… still need to take that final step, right? I have a way to help you,” Daoist Yellow Springs lowered his head and tried his best to keep his voice as calm as possible.
Gu Nan didn't say anything, and Daoist Yellow Springs continued talking to himself, "You may have transmigrated with an item like Jiu Po did, but it’s already destroyed now."
"So what if I did?"
"I can help you!" Daoist Yellow Springs' voice suddenly became louder, "I have the deepest understanding of the Origin World, and I know how to bring out the ability you want…"
"Don’t destroy the Wall of Laws, and you'll have a chance to take that last step. Just find someone who can bring out the same item you did. And you can always keep an eye on me, so you won’t have to worry about me being a threat!"
Daoist Yellow Springs became more and more fluent as he spoke. Towards the end, it seemed like he even convinced himself.
Having said this, he pointed at Lu Wen and Jiu Po over there. "They are the same! As long as you keep an eye on us and don't let us come into contact with the origin, you won’t need to take any risks!"
He stared into Gu Nan's eyes and said in a low voice, "Think about it, with your current realm, as long as you take one final step, you’ll be able to see this world’s apex, the pinnacle of truth and pow— Why?"
Towards the end of his speech, Daoist Yellow Springs finally realized that Gu Nan didn't seem to be listening. Before he could register what just happened, the law of shadows had already invaded the Wall of Laws and destroyed it completely.
"Well, how is it? Has your devouring ability disappeared?" Gu Nan turned around to look at him. Only when he saw Daoist Yellow Springs’ sudden change in expression did he reveal a satisfied smile.
The only reason he spared Daoist Yellow Springs was to verify this.
All the transmigrators’ special abilities came from the Wall of Laws, and this connection still existed even after they left the Origin World.
Only when Gu Nan fully destroyed the Wall of Laws were they completely freed from its control.
Even Gu Nan himself felt his body turn lighter, and the fragments of the Evil God Temple that had melted into his body seemed to disappear at this moment.
"Why?" Daoist Yellow Springs stared at him in disbelief. "You could have gone even further, so why…?"
"I've already won." Gu Nan patted him on the shoulder and said with a smile, "The winner has no need to gamble any further."
